sukhamāste praśāntātmā brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्वयि भारं समासज्य वेदाभ्यसनतत्परः ..
सुखमास्ते प्रशान्तात्मा ब्रह्मा शुभचतुर्मुखः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having placed the burden upon you, intent upon the practice of the Vedas, / the auspicious four-faced Brahmā sits at ease with tranquil mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi bhāraṃ samāsajya devadevo'pi śaṅkaraḥ ..
āste tapasyabhirataḥ kailāse parvatottame .. 13 ..
meaning:
त्वयि भारं समासज्य देवदेवोऽपि शङ्करः ..
आस्ते तपस्यभिरतः कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे .. 13 ..
text_mt: Having placed the burden upon you, even Śaṅkara, the god of gods, / sits devoted to asceticism on Kailāsa, the excellent mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi bhāraṃ samāsajya sukhaṃ svapiti keśavaḥ ..
kṣīrodaśayane nityaṃ śeṣaparyaṅkamā sthitaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
त्वयि भारं समासज्य सुखं स्वपिति केशवः ..
क्षीरोदशयने नित्यं शेषपर्यङ्कमा स्थितः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having placed the burden upon you, Keśava sleeps happily / in his bed in the Ocean of Milk, always resting on the couch of Śeṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahasya yattejaḥ keśavasya śivasya ca ..
sthitaṃ tatsakalaṃ tubhyaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvamayo'rihā .. 15 ..
meaning:
पितामहस्य यत्तेजः केशवस्य शिवस्य च ..
स्थितं तत्सकलं तुभ्यं त्वं हि सर्वमयोऽरिहा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Whatever majesty belongs to the Grandfather, to Keśava, and to Śiva, / all of that abides in you, for you consist of all, O slayer of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā vinihato vṛtro balaścāpi niṣūditaḥ ..
tvayā ca nāśitaḥ pākastvayā daityā niṣūditāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्वया विनिहतो वृत्रो बलश्चापि निषूदितः ..
त्वया च नाशितः पाकस्त्वया दैत्या निषूदिताः .. 16 ..
text_mt: By you Vṛtra was slain, and Bala was destroyed; / by you Pāka was ruined, and by you the Daityas were killed.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyastvaṃ śaraṇyastvaṃ praṇatārtivināśanaḥ ..
sahasranayanaḥ śrīmānvajrapāṇirjagatpriyaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्यस्त्वं शरण्यस्त्वं प्रणतार्तिविनाशनः ..
सहस्रनयनः श्रीमान्वज्रपाणिर्जगत्प्रियः .. 17 ..
text_mt: You are devoted to brahmins, you are a refuge, the destroyer of the distress of those who bow to you, / thousand-eyed, glorious, thunderbolt-in-hand, beloved of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā tapasā yajñaiḥ śrutena ca damena ca ..
tvatto viśiṣṭaṃ loke'sminna paśyāmi śacīpate .. 18 ..
meaning:
तेजसा तपसा यज्ञैः श्रुतेन च दमेन च ..
त्वत्तो विशिष्टं लोकेऽस्मिन्न पश्यामि शचीपते .. 18 ..
text_mt: In majesty, asceticism, sacrifices, sacred knowledge, and self-restraint, / I see no one superior to you in this world, O lord of Śacī.

sanskrit_iast:
vedeṣu sarahasyeṣu gīyase tvaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
vedāḥ pravṛttā yajñārthaṃ tadarthaṃ kratavastathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
वेदेषु सरहस्येषु गीयसे त्वं पुनःपुनः ..
वेदाः प्रवृत्ता यज्ञार्थं तदर्थं क्रतवस्तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: In the Vedas along with the secret teachings you are sung again and again; / the Vedas have arisen for the sake of sacrifice, and likewise sacrifices are for your sake.

sanskrit_iast:
ye hatā dānavā yuddhe tvayā śakra punaḥpunaḥ ..
ta ime nṛṣu sambhūtāḥ kārtavīryaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 1.26.20 ..
meaning:
ये हता दानवा युद्धे त्वया शक्र पुनःपुनः ..
त इमे नृषु सम्भूताः कार्तवीर्यं समाश्रिताः .. 1.26.20 ..
text_mt: Those Dānavas who were slain by you in battle, O Śakra, again and again, / have been born among men, resorting to Kārtavīrya.

sanskrit_iast:
te'dya jātā mama vibho pīḍayanti ca māṃ bhṛśam ..
sā'haṃ bhārasamākrāntā tvāmadya śaraṇaṃ gatā .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेऽद्य जाता मम विभो पीडयन्ति च मां भृशम् ..
साऽहं भारसमाक्रान्ता त्वामद्य शरणं गता .. 21 ..
text_mt: They are now born from me, O powerful one, and they afflict me exceedingly; / overwhelmed by their burden, I have come to you today for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śakra uvāca ..
jānāmi bhārakhinnāṃ tvāṃ daityebhyo varavarṇini ..
teṣāṃ gatvā vadhopāyamahaṃ praṣṭāsmi vedhasam .. 22 ..
meaning:
.. शक्र उवाच ..
जानामि भारखिन्नां त्वां दैत्येभ्यो वरवर्णिनि ..
तेषां गत्वा वधोपायमहं प्रष्टास्मि वेधसम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Śakra said: / I know that you are distressed by the burden from the Daityas, O fair-complexioned one; / going to the Creator, I shall ask the means for their slaying.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktvā tridaśapradhānaḥ pṛdhvīsameto guruṇā ca rājan ..
yayau sabhāṃ devavarasya tasya pitāmahasyāpratimasya vīraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा त्रिदशप्रधानः पृध्वीसमेतो गुरुणा च राजन् ..
ययौ सभां देववरस्य तस्य पितामहस्याप्रतिमस्य वीरः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, the hero, the foremost of the thirty [gods], along with the Earth and with his preceptor, O king, / went to the assembly of that peerless Grandfather, the excellent god.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
te sametāḥ samāsādya pitāmahasabhāṃ śubhām ..
padmāsanagataṃ tatra dadṛśuḥ padmasambhavam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
ते समेताः समासाद्य पितामहसभां शुभाम् ..
पद्मासनगतं तत्र ददृशुः पद्मसम्भवम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Together having reached the auspicious assembly of the Grandfather, / they saw there the lotus-born one seated upon a lotus seat,
title: Brahmalokagamanam

sanskrit_iast:
padmapatrasavarṇāṃgaṃ padmabodhasamaprabham ..
caturvaktraṃ caturvedaṃ caturāśramapūjitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पद्मपत्रसवर्णांगं पद्मबोधसमप्रभम् ..
चतुर्वक्त्रं चतुर्वेदं चतुराश्रमपूजितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: his limbs having the color of a lotus petal, his radiance equal to the blossoming of a lotus, / four-faced, possessing the four Vedas, worshipped by the four stages of life,

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvarṇyadharaṃ devaṃ cāturhotrapravartakam ..
kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāntaṃ prabhuṃ prabhavatāmapi .. 3 ..
meaning:
चातुर्वर्ण्यधरं देवं चातुर्होत्रप्रवर्तकम् ..
कृष्णाजिनधरं शान्तं प्रभुं प्रभवतामपि .. 3 ..
text_mt: the god who maintains the four castes, who sets in motion the duties of the four priests, / wearing a black antelope skin, peaceful, the sovereign even of those with sovereign power,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhuvamacintyaṃ ca sargasaṃhārakārakam ..
taṃ samāsādya jagatī śakraśca guruṇā saha .. 4 ..
meaning:
स्वयंभुवमचिन्त्यं च सर्गसंहारकारकम् ..
तं समासाद्य जगती शक्रश्च गुरुणा सह .. 4 ..
text_mt: self-born, inconceivable, the maker of creation and destruction. / Having approached him, the earth and Śakra, together with their preceptor,

sanskrit_iast:
vavanduste mahābhāgaṃ tuṣṭuvuśca jagatprabhum ..
śakrādaya ūcuḥ ..
namaste devadeveśa sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇa! ..
vedamūrte tadādhāra yajña yajñāṃga yajñapa .. 5 ..
meaning:
ववन्दुस्ते महाभागं तुष्टुवुश्च जगत्प्रभुम् ..
शक्रादय ऊचुः ..
नमस्ते देवदेवेश सृष्टिसंहारकारण! ..
वेदमूर्ते तदाधार यज्ञ यज्ञांग यज्ञप .. 5 ..
text_mt: bowed to that illustrious one and praised the sovereign of the world. / Śakra and the others said: / Praise to you, O god, lord of gods, the cause of creation and destruction! / O you whose form is the Veda, its foundation, O sacrifice, limb of sacrifice, protector of sacrifice!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñayone jagadyone sarvasattvābhayaprada ..
prajāpatipate deva jagadbīja namo'stu te .. 6 ..
meaning:
यज्ञयोने जगद्योने सर्वसत्त्वाभयप्रद ..
प्रजापतिपते देव जगद्बीज नमोऽस्तु ते .. 6 ..
text_mt: Source of sacrifice, source of the world, grantor of fearlessness to all beings, / lord of the lords of creatures, O god, seed of the world, praise be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
svayambhuve svayaṃ kartre sarvabhūtāntarātmane ..
sarvabhūtavareṇyāya sarvabhūteśvarāya ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्वयम्भुवे स्वयं कर्त्रे सर्वभूतान्तरात्मने ..
सर्वभूतवरेण्याय सर्वभूतेश्वराय च .. 7 ..
text_mt: [Praise] to the self-born, to the self-maker, to the inner self of all beings, / to the one chosen among all beings, and to the lord of all beings!

sanskrit_iast:
acintyāyā'prameyāya prakāśāya mahātmane ..
tvamasya jagato nāthastvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .. 8 ..
meaning:
अचिन्त्यायाऽप्रमेयाय प्रकाशाय महात्मने ..
त्वमस्य जगतो नाथस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: [Homage] to the unthinkable, the immeasurable, the light, the Great Self! / You are the lord of this universe; in you everything is established.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā vinā jagatyasminnānyatkiñcana vidyate ..
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca tebhyaḥ parataraśca yat .. 9 ..
meaning:
त्वया विना जगत्यस्मिन्नान्यत्किञ्चन विद्यते ..
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च तेभ्यः परतरश्च यत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Without you, nothing else exists in this universe: / the senses and the sense-objects, and that which is higher than them.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāvyakto jagannātha tvamevaikaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
tvaṃ tapāṃsi variṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi niyamāni ca .. 1.27.10 ..
meaning:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तो जगन्नाथ त्वमेवैकः प्रकीर्तितः ..
त्वं तपांसि वरिष्ठानि कृच्छ्राणि नियमानि च .. 1.27.10 ..
text_mt: Manifest and unmanifest, O lord of the universe, you alone are proclaimed [to be]. / You are the highest austerities, the arduous penances, and the observances.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca kālasyāvayavāśca ye ..
kālacakraṃ jagaccakraṃ tvamekaḥ puruṣottamaḥ... 11..
meaning:
कलाः काष्ठा मुहूर्ताश्च कालस्यावयवाश्च ये ..
कालचक्रं जगच्चक्रं त्वमेकः पुरुषोत्तमः... 11..
text_mt: The kalās, kāṣṭhās, and muhūrtas, and whatever are the divisions of time, / the wheel of time, the wheel of the universe: you alone are the Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva varado dātā devaḥ śubhacaturmukhaḥ ..
tvattaḥ prasūtau loke'smindharmarudrau jagatpate .. 12 ..
meaning:
त्वमेव वरदो दाता देवः शुभचतुर्मुखः ..
त्वत्तः प्रसूतौ लोकेऽस्मिन्धर्मरुद्रौ जगत्पते .. 12 ..
text_mt: You alone are the giver of boons, the bestower, the auspicious four-faced god. / From you, O lord of the universe, Dharma and Rudra were born in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvaṃgirā marīcistu pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ..
atriścaiva vaśiṣṭhaśca tvayā sṛṣṭā jagatpate .. 13 ..
meaning:
भृग्वंगिरा मरीचिस्तु पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ..
अत्रिश्चैव वशिष्ठश्च त्वया सृष्टा जगत्पते .. 13 ..
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Marīci, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Atri, and Vasiṣṭha were created by you, O lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavānsanakaśca sanandanaḥ ..
ākṛtiśca ruciḥ śraddhā tvayā deva vinirmitā .. 14 ..

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvātte vadanājjātamṛgvedamamṛtaprabham ..
dakṣiṇādvadanājjātaṃ yajurvedaṃ tathaiva ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
पूर्वात्ते वदनाज्जातमृग्वेदममृतप्रभम् ..
दक्षिणाद्वदनाज्जातं यजुर्वेदं तथैव च .. 15 ..
text_mt: From your eastern face was born the Ṛgveda, shining with nectar; / and from your southern face was born the Yajurveda in the same way;

sanskrit_iast:
paścimādvadanājjātaṃ sāmavedaṃ tathā tava ..
uttarādvadanājjātamatharvāgirasaṃ śubham .. 16 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमाद्वदनाज्जातं सामवेदं तथा तव ..
उत्तराद्वदनाज्जातमथर्वागिरसं शुभम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: and from your western face was born your Sāmaveda; / from your northern face was born the auspicious Atharvāngirasa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāste mukhājjātā bāhubhyāṃ kṣattriyāstathā ..
ūrudvayāttathā vaiśyāḥ padbhyāṃ śūdrāstathaiva ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणास्ते मुखाज्जाता बाहुभ्यां क्षत्त्रियास्तथा ..
ऊरुद्वयात्तथा वैश्याः पद्भ्यां शूद्रास्तथैव च .. 17 ..
text_mt: The brahmins were born from your mouth, and likewise the kṣatriyas from your two arms; / similarly, the vaiśyas from your two thighs, and the śūdras likewise from your feet.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyuto'śanimeghāśca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca ..
tvattaḥ prabho prasūtāni praviśanti tathā tvayi .. 18 ..
meaning:
विद्युतोऽशनिमेघाश्च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च ..
त्वत्तः प्रभो प्रसूतानि प्रविशन्ति तथा त्वयि .. 18 ..
text_mt: Lightnings, thunderbolts, clouds, red rainbows, and rainbows, / having been produced from you, O lord, enter likewise into you.

sanskrit_iast:
svayambhūrbhagavānviṣṇurdevadevaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
nāmamātravibhedena mohayasyakhilaṃ jagat .. 19 ..
meaning:
स्वयम्भूर्भगवान्विष्णुर्देवदेवः सनातनः ..
नाममात्रविभेदेन मोहयस्यखिलं जगत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: [As] the self-born, the lord, Viṣṇu, the god of gods, the eternal one, / by a mere distinction of names you delude the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattejasā mayā daityā ye yuddhe vinipātitāḥ ..
te kṣitau kṣattriyā jātāḥ pīḍayanti tathā kṣamām .. 1.27.20 ..
meaning:
त्वत्तेजसा मया दैत्या ये युद्धे विनिपातिताः ..
ते क्षितौ क्षत्त्रिया जाताः पीडयन्ति तथा क्षमाम् .. 1.27.20 ..
text_mt: The Daityas who were struck down by me in battle by your splendour / have been born on the earth as kṣatriyas, and thus oppress the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ bhāreṇa khinneyaṃ tvatsakāśamupāgatā ..
vasudhā vasudhāpāla tāṃ trāyasva namo'stu te .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेषां भारेण खिन्नेयं त्वत्सकाशमुपागता ..
वसुधा वसुधापाल तां त्रायस्व नमोऽस्तु ते .. 21 ..
text_mt: Exhausted by their burden, this earth has approached you. / O protector of the earth, protect her! Homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ pitāmaho devaḥ stutaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā ..
guruṇā ca sametena pūjayāmāsa tāvubhau .. 22 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवं पितामहो देवः स्तुतः शक्रेण धीमता ..
गुरुणा च समेतेन पूजयामास तावुभौ .. 22 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus praised by the wise Śakra, accompanied by [his] guru, / the god, the grandfather [of the worlds], honoured them both.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā ca vasudhāṃ śakraṃ vacanamabravīt ..
vrajadhvaṃ devadevasya śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा च वसुधां शक्रं वचनमब्रवीत् ..
व्रजध्वं देवदेवस्य शङ्करस्य महात्मनः .. 23 ..
text_mt: And having honoured the earth, he spoke these words to Śakra: / "Go to the god of gods, the great-souled Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaścikīrṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayata mā ciram ..
upāyaṃ kṣatriyavadhe yuṣmākaṃ kathayiṣyati .. 24 ..
meaning:
भुवश्चिकीर्षितं सर्वं निवेदयत मा चिरम् ..
उपायं क्षत्रियवधे युष्माकं कथयिष्यति .. 24 ..
text_mt: Without delay, report all that the earth desires to do. / He will tell you the means for the slaying of the kṣatriyas."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktāstu pitāmahena jagmustadā rudrasadaḥ pratītāḥ ..
śakro'tha devī ca vasundharā ca guruḥ surāṇāñca sa dharmaśīlaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तास्तु पितामहेन जग्मुस्तदा रुद्रसदः प्रतीताः ..
शक्रोऽथ देवी च वसुन्धरा च गुरुः सुराणाञ्च स धर्मशीलः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed by the grandfather, confident they then went to the abode of Rudra: / Śakra, the goddess Earth, and that guru of the gods, steadfast in dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
rudralokamathāsādya dadṛśustryambakaṃ tadā ..
vahnipuñjaprakāśena jaṭābhāreṇa rājitam .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
रुद्रलोकमथासाद्य ददृशुस्त्र्यम्बकं तदा ..
वह्निपुञ्जप्रकाशेन जटाभारेण राजितम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, having reached the world of Rudra, they saw Tryambaka, / resplendent with a mass of matted hair having the radiance of a blazing fire,
title: adhyāyaḥ 028

sanskrit_iast:
sūryabhāsā tṛtīyena nayanena ca śobhitam ..

सूर्यभासा तृतीयेन नयनेन च शोभितम् ..
भालचन्द्रेण शुभ्रेण जटामण्डलशोभिना ..2..
text_mt: adorned with a third eye having the brilliance of the sun, / [and] with the white crescent moon on his forehead, adorning the circle of his matted hair;

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
व्यालयज्ञोपवीतश्च नागेश्वरकृतांशुकम् ..
नीलकण्ठं विशालाक्षदन्तिचर्मोत्तरच्छदम्.. .. 3 ..
text_mt: having a serpent as his sacred thread, wearing a garment made of the lord of snakes, / blue-throated, wide-eyed, with an elephant-skin upper garment;

sanskrit_iast:
umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam ..
nandinānugataṃ vīraṃ pramathaiśca sahasraśaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
उमासहायं वरदं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम् ..
नन्दिनानुगतं वीरं प्रमथैश्च सहस्रशः .. 4 ..
text_mt: accompanied by Umā, the giver of boons, the source of the origin of all beings, / attended by Nandin and by thousands of Pramathas,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvaktraśirogrīvairnānāyudhavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇataḥ prāha śakrastu guruṇā saha .. 5 ..
meaning:
नानावक्त्रशिरोग्रीवैर्नानायुधविभूषणैः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतः प्राह शक्रस्तु गुरुणा सह .. 5 ..
text_mt: who had diverse faces, heads, and necks, and were adorned with diverse weapons. / Having seen him, Śakra bowed low along with [his] guru and spoke:

sanskrit_iast:

namo'stu devadeveśa praṇatārtivināśana ..
nīlakaṇṭha mahābhāga hyumābhūṣaṇatatpara .. 6 ..
meaning:
शक्र उवाच ..
नमोऽस्तु देवदेवेश प्रणतार्तिविनाशन ..
नीलकण्ठ महाभाग ह्युमाभूषणतत्पर .. 6 ..
text_mt: Śakra said: / "Homage be to the lord of the god of gods, destroyer of the afflictions of those who bow! / O Blue-throated one, O highly fortunate one, devoted to the adornment of Umā!

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātaraṅganirdhautajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍita! ..
śaśāṅkaśatasaṃkāśa sūryakoṭisamaprabha .. 7 ..

गङ्गातरङ्गनिर्धौतजटामण्डलमण्डित! ..
शशाङ्कशतसंकाश सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ .. 7 ..
text_mt: O you who are adorned with a circle of matted hair washed by the waves of the Gaṅgā! / O you who resemble a hundred moons, with splendour equal to ten million suns!

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanairjaṭilairmuṇḍaiḥ pramathairīḍyase sadā ..

वामनैर्जटिलैर्मुण्डैः प्रमथैरीड्यसे सदा ..
तैश्च सार्धं महादेव रमसेऽमितविक्रम .. 8 ..
text_mt: You are ever praised by the Pramathas—dwarfish, matted-haired, and shaven-headed; / and together with them you delight, O Mahādeva of boundless prowess!

sanskrit_iast:
ghoraṃ hi brahmacaryaṃ te yathā nānyasya kasyacit ..
tava liṅgārcanaratāḥ pūyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..9 ..
meaning:
घोरं हि ब्रह्मचर्यं ते यथा नान्यस्य कस्यचित् ..
तव लिङ्गार्चनरताः पूयन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..9 ..
text_mt: Dreadful indeed is your ascetic chastity, such as belongs to no one else. / Those devoted to the worship of your liṅga are cleansed of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
smaranti ye tvāṃ satataṃ te hi yānti parāṃ gatim ..

स्मरन्ति ये त्वां सततं ते हि यान्ति परां गतिम् ..
विष्णोरचिन्त्यभागोऽसि प्रजासंहरणे कृते .. 1.28.10 ..
text_mt: Those who constantly remember you certainly go to the supreme state. / You are the unthinkable portion of Viṣṇu when the destruction of creatures is performed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayo dhātā sarvadevamayo'pi ca ..

meaning:
सर्वदेवमयो धाता सर्वदेवमयोऽपि च ..
सर्वदेववरेण्यस्त्वं सर्वभूतविभावनः ..11..
text_mt: You are the creator consisting of all the gods, and you consist of all the gods. / You are the most excellent of all gods, the source of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāmaragururdevaḥ sarvabhūteśvareśvaraḥ ..
sarvadevo mahāyogī mahājayo mahābalaḥ .. 12..
meaning:
सर्वामरगुरुर्देवः सर्वभूतेश्वरेश्वरः ..
सर्वदेवो महायोगी महाजयो महाबलः .. 12..
text_mt: the guru of all immortals, the god, the lord of the lords of all beings, / the all-god, the great yogin, the greatly victorious, possessing great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahātejā mahāyaśāḥ..
catuṣpātsakalo dharmo vāhanaste mahāvṛṣaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो महातेजा महायशाः..
चतुष्पात्सकलो धर्मो वाहनस्ते महावृषः .. 13 ..
text_mt: possessing great intellect, possessing great valor, possessing great majesty, possessing great renown. / Your vehicle is the great bull, the complete four-footed dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśāne vasatirnityaṃ citādhūmasamākule ..
nṛtyadbhūtākule bhūmerbhūtiśvetānulepanaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
श्मशाने वसतिर्नित्यं चिताधूमसमाकुले ..
नृत्यद्भूताकुले भूमेर्भूतिश्वेतानुलेपनः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Your dwelling is ever in the cremation ground, crowded with the smoke of funeral pyres, / filled with dancing spirits; your white ointment is the ashes of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūkhārkavarcaḥsalilayajamānenduvāyavaḥ ..
mūrttayaste smṛtā deva yābhirvyāptamidaṃ jagat .. 15 ..
meaning:
भूखार्कवर्चःसलिलयजमानेन्दुवायवः ..
मूर्त्तयस्ते स्मृता देव याभिर्व्याप्तमिदं जगत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Earth, space, fire, brilliance, water, the sacrificer, the moon, and the wind: / these are known as your forms, O god, by which this universe is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā vinā jagatyasminnānyatkiñcana vidyate ..
daityabhārābhitaptāṅgāṃ pālayasva namo'stu te .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्वया विना जगत्यस्मिन्नान्यत्किञ्चन विद्यते ..
दैत्यभाराभितप्ताङ्गां पालयस्व नमोऽस्तु ते .. 16 ..
text_mt: Without you, nothing else exists in this universe. / Protect her whose body is tormented by the burden of the Daityas! Homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktastu śakreṇa devaḥ śakramabhāṣata ..
kārtavīryamahaṃ tvājau kartā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm .. 17 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्तस्तु शक्रेण देवः शक्रमभाषत ..
कार्तवीर्यमहं त्वाजौ कर्ता निःक्षत्रियां महीम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus addressed by Śakra, the god spoke to Śakra: / "I will make the earth bereft of kṣatriyas in battle, but as for Kārtavīrya,

sanskrit_iast:
na śaktastridaśaśreṣṭha yataḥ smartāsmi tadvadham ..
viṣṇudattavaro rājā so'vadhyo mama vāsava .. 18 ..
meaning:
न शक्तस्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठ यतः स्मर्तास्मि तद्वधम् ..
विष्णुदत्तवरो राजा सोऽवध्यो मम वासव .. 18 ..
text_mt: I am not able, O best of the thirty [gods], to contemplate his slaying, / for, having received a boon from Viṣṇu, that king is invulnerable to me, O Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
tameva prārthayiṣyāmi vadhaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ ..
sarve yāta svakaṃ sthānaṃ tvahamapyamareśvaram .. 19 ..
meaning:
तमेव प्रार्थयिष्यामि वधं तस्य महात्मनः ..
सर्वे यात स्वकं स्थानं त्वहमप्यमरेश्वरम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: I shall pray to him alone for the slaying of that great-souled one. / Go all of you to your own place; I too [shall go] to the lord of the immortals,

sanskrit_iast:
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ yāsye varadamīśvaram ..
viṣṇuścārdhena bhāgena dattātreyo'bhavatkṣitau .. 1.28.20 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं यास्ये वरदमीश्वरम् ..
विष्णुश्चार्धेन भागेन दत्तात्रेयोऽभवत्क्षितौ .. 1.28.20 ..
text_mt: to the boon-granting Lord who stands within the orb of the moon. / For Viṣṇu, by a half portion, became Dattātreya on earth;

sanskrit_iast: tena dattavaro rājā pālayatyakhilāṃ mahīm .. 21 ..
meaning: तेन दत्तवरो राजा पालयत्यखिलां महीम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: granted a boon by him, the king protects the entire earth."

meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्रिदशेश्वरस्तु देवेन साक्षात्त्रिपुरान्तकेन ..

text_mt: Thus addressed by the god who was none other than the Destroyer of Tripura, / the lord of the thirty [gods], taking the Earth and [his] guru, O king, quickly went and entered his own city.

meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
गते सुरेश्वरे देवे शक्रे च सपुरोहिते ..
जगत्याञ्च प्रयातायां देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When Śakra, the god who is lord of the gods, had gone with his priest, / and the Earth had departed, the god of gods, Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhamātrako bhūtvā gaṅgātoye nyamajjata ..
so'vagāhya svalokasthāṃ gaṅgāṃ sarvagatāṃ nadīm .. 2 ..
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रको भूत्वा गङ्गातोये न्यमज्जत ..
सोऽवगाह्य स्वलोकस्थां गङ्गां सर्वगतां नदीम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: having become the size of a thumb, submerged himself in the water of the Gaṅgā. / Having plunged into the all-pervading river Gaṅgā situated in his own world,

tayohyamānaḥ prayayau vistīrṇaṃ candramaṇḍalam ..
navayojanasāhasro viṣkambho yasya kīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तयोह्यमानः प्रययौ विस्तीर्णं चन्द्रमण्डलम् ..
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कम्भो यस्य कीर्तितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Carried along by it, he reached the vast orb of the moon, / whose diameter is said to be nine thousand yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
vistārāddviguṇaścaiva pariṇāhaḥ samantataḥ ..
toyasāramayaṃ piṇḍa pitṝṇāṃ dhāmamadhyagam .. 4 ..
meaning:
विस्ताराद्द्विगुणश्चैव परिणाहः समन्ततः ..
तोयसारमयं पिण्ड पितॄणां धाममध्यगम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: and its circumference all around is twice its width. / Consisting of the essence of water, an orb situated in the midst of the realm of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ bhāvanaṃ sarvaṃ cādhāraṃ jagatāmapi ..
śarīriṇāṃ śaroreṣu rasaṃ pañcātmakaṃ smṛtam .. 5 ..
meaning:
प्रजानां भावनं सर्वं चाधारं जगतामपि ..
शरीरिणां शरोरेषु रसं पञ्चात्मकं स्मृतम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: the sustainer of all creatures and the support of the worlds, / it is known as the fivefold bodily fluid in the bodies of embodied beings:

sanskrit_iast:
ālambakaṃ kledakaṃ ca tathā caivāvabodhakam ..
saṃghātakaṃ tarpakañca dehināṃ dehagocaram .. 6 ..
meaning:
आलम्बकं क्लेदकं च तथा चैवावबोधकम् ..
संघातकं तर्पकञ्च देहिनां देहगोचरम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: supporting, moistening, stimulating perception, / solidifying, and nourishing, operating in the bodies of embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥsarvendriyāṇāñca sarveṣāṃ nāthakaṃ tathā ..
oṣadhīśaṃ jagadyonimamṛtādhāramavyayam .. 7 ..
meaning:
मनःसर्वेन्द्रियाणाञ्च सर्वेषां नाथकं तथा ..
ओषधीशं जगद्योनिममृताधारमव्ययम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Likewise it is the mind and the master of all sense organs, / the lord of plants, the source of the world, the imperishable vessel of nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ pibanti sadā devāḥ pitaraścāmṛtārthinaḥ ..
yaścakṣurdevadevasya viṣṇorvā sa prakīrtitaḥ ..8..
meaning:
यं पिबन्ति सदा देवाः पितरश्चामृतार्थिनः ..
यश्चक्षुर्देवदेवस्य विष्णोर्वा स प्रकीर्तितः ..8..
text_mt: which the gods and the ancestors, longing for nectar, constantly drink, / and which is proclaimed to be the eye of the god of gods, Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
havyakavyāśano devo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ..
praviśya maṇḍalaṃ tasya devadevo maheśvaraḥ .....
tasya yadvyāpakaṃ tejaḥ sūkṣmamannarasaṃ hi tam ..
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ yaṃ budhāḥ ke śivaṃ viduḥ .. 1.29.10 ..
meaning:
हव्यकव्याशनो देवो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः ..
प्रविश्य मण्डलं तस्य देवदेवो महेश्वरः .....
तस्य यद्व्यापकं तेजः सूक्ष्ममन्नरसं हि तम् ..
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं यं बुधाः के शिवं विदुः .. 1.29.10 ..
text_mt: The god who partakes of offerings to gods and ancestors, the self of beings, the source of beings, / having entered its orb, the god of gods, the great lord, / [perceived] that pervasive, subtle brilliance of his, which is indeed the essence of food, / that person the size of a thumb, whom some wise men know as Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣurgolakamadhyasthā dṛkśaktiriva yaḥ sthitaḥ ..
candragolakamadhyasthaḥ puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
चक्षुर्गोलकमध्यस्था दृक्शक्तिरिव यः स्थितः ..
चन्द्रगोलकमध्यस्थः पुरुषः स परः स्मृतः .. 11 ..
text_mt: who abides like the faculty of sight stationed in the middle of the eyeball; / stationed in the middle of the orb of the moon, that person is remembered as the Supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
karmasākṣī sa lokānāṃ sa cādhāraḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
ādityaraśmayaścaṃdre tamaḥsaṃmūrcchitaṃ kṣitau .. 12 ..
meaning:
कर्मसाक्षी स लोकानां स चाधारः परः स्मृतः ..
आदित्यरश्मयश्चंद्रे तमःसंमूर्च्छितं क्षितौ .. 12 ..
text_mt: He is the witness of the deeds of the worlds, and he is remembered as the supreme support. / The rays of the sun in the moon, [and those] fainting away into darkness upon the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣapayiṣyaṃti yannaiśaṃ śītāṃśustasya tejasī ..
yasya rūpamanirdeśyaṃ yasya tejaḥ suduḥsaham .. 13 ..
meaning:
क्षपयिष्यंति यन्नैशं शीतांशुस्तस्य तेजसी ..
यस्य रूपमनिर्देश्यं यस्य तेजः सुदुःसहम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: which will destroy the darkness of night—the cold-rayed [moon] abides in his fiery energy. / He whose form is indescribable, whose fiery energy is exceedingly difficult to endure—

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tu devavaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva tripurāntakaḥ ..
īśvara uvāca ..
agnīṣomamayaṃ caitajjagadetatprakīrtitam ..
agnīṣomau jagannāthau devadevo janārdanaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
तं तु देववरं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टाव त्रिपुरान्तकः ..
ईश्वर उवाच ..
अग्नीषोममयं चैतज्जगदेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..
अग्नीषोमौ जगन्नाथौ देवदेवो जनार्दनः .. 14 ..
text_mt: beholding that best of gods, the destroyer of Tripura praised him. / The Lord said: / 'This world is proclaimed to be composed of Agni and Soma. / Agni and Soma are the lords of the world, the god of gods, Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāgneyī tanuryā ca so'haṃ sa ca divākaraḥ ..
saumyā tu yā tanustasya sa bhavān sa pitāmahaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
तस्याग्नेयी तनुर्या च सोऽहं स च दिवाकरः ..
सौम्या तु या तनुस्तस्य स भवान् स पितामहः .. 15 ..
text_mt: His fiery body is both I and that maker of the day, / while his gentle body is you and the grandfather [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
tvayedaṃ dhāryate sarvaṃ nānyatpaśyāmi kāraṇam ..
tvadbimbe nirmale pṛthvī saśailavanakānanā 1...
meaning:
त्वयेदं धार्यते सर्वं नान्यत्पश्यामि कारणम् ..
त्वद्बिम्बे निर्मले पृथ्वी सशैलवनकानना 1...
text_mt: All this is upheld by you; I see no other cause. / In your spotless orb, the earth together with its mountains and forests

sanskrit_iast:
śaśākṛtiḥ sadā dṛśyā śaśalakṣmā'si cānagha ..
tenaiva kāraṇena tvamucyase mṛgalāñchanaḥ .. 17..
meaning:
शशाकृतिः सदा दृश्या शशलक्ष्माऽसि चानघ ..
तेनैव कारणेन त्वमुच्यसे मृगलाञ्छनः .. 17..
text_mt: is always seen in the form of a hare, and you are marked with a hare, O sinless one! / For that very reason you are called the deer-marked one.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśī śaśatvasaṃbandhātsaumyatvātsoma ucyate ..
śītāṃśutvācca śītāṃśuḥ niśeśe tvadvirājanāt .. 18 ..
meaning:
शशी शशत्वसंबन्धात्सौम्यत्वात्सोम उच्यते ..
शीतांशुत्वाच्च शीतांशुः निशेशे त्वद्विराजनात् .. 18 ..
text_mt: You are called Śaśin from your connection with having a hare; you are called Soma from your gentle nature; / you are Śītāṃśu because your rays are cool; and the lord of the night because you shine in it.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatranāthastatsvāmyādrājatvāttvaṃ dvijeśvaraḥ ..
vasanti te pitṛgaṇāḥ pitṛnāthastato bhavān .. 19 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रनाथस्तत्स्वाम्याद्राजत्वात्त्वं द्विजेश्वरः ..
वसन्ति ते पितृगणाः पितृनाथस्ततो भवान् .. 19 ..
text_mt: You are the lord of asterisms because of your mastery over them; being a king, you are the lord of the twice-born. / The hosts of your ancestors dwell [in you]; therefore you are the lord of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
bahvarthaścandra ityeṣa dhāturukto manīṣibhiḥ ..
śuklatve hyamṛtatve ca śītatve hrādane'pi ca ..1.29.20..
meaning:
बह्वर्थश्चन्द्र इत्येष धातुरुक्तो मनीषिभिः ..
शुक्लत्वे ह्यमृतत्वे च शीतत्वे ह्रादनेऽपि च ..1.29.20..
text_mt: The verbal root candr- has been declared by the wise to have many meanings: / in the sense of whiteness, immortality, coolness, and also gladdening.

sanskrit_iast:
tena te candratākhyātā satataṃ dharmavatsala! ..
sarve cāhlādamāyanti dṛṣṭe tvayi mahādyute .. 21 ..
meaning:
तेन ते चन्द्रताख्याता सततं धर्मवत्सल! ..
सर्वे चाह्लादमायन्ति दृष्टे त्वयि महाद्युते .. 21 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O lover of dharma, your nature as the moon is constantly proclaimed; / and everyone attains delight when you are seen, O you of great splendour!

sanskrit_iast:
prajākāryaṃ tvadāyattaṃ tatkuruṣva jagatprabho ..
dattātreyatvamāsādya tvayā dattavaro nṛpaḥ ..22..
meaning:
प्रजाकार्यं त्वदायत्तं तत्कुरुष्व जगत्प्रभो ..
दत्तात्रेयत्वमासाद्य त्वया दत्तवरो नृपः ..22..
text_mt: The business of creatures depends on you; therefore accomplish it, O lord of the world! / Having assumed the state of Dattātreya, a boon was granted by you to the king

sanskrit_iast:
kārtavīryārjuno nāma dānavāstamupāśritāḥ ..
sarve kṣattriyatāṃ prāpya tadvadhe yatnavān bhava ..23..
meaning:
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम दानवास्तमुपाश्रिताः ..
सर्वे क्षत्त्रियतां प्राप्य तद्वधे यत्नवान् भव ..23..
text_mt: named Kārtavīryārjuna; the Dānavas have taken refuge in him, / all having attained the status of kṣatriyas; exert yourself for his destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā dattavaraṃ hantuṃ nānyaḥ śaknoti kaścana..
avaśyaṃ ca tvayā kāryaṃ devakāryaṃ sadā vibho .. 24 ..
meaning:
त्वया दत्तवरं हन्तुं नान्यः शक्नोति कश्चन..
अवश्यं च त्वया कार्यं देवकार्यं सदा विभो .. 24 ..
text_mt: No one else is able to slay one who has been granted a boon by you; / and you must certainly accomplish the task of the gods always, O pervasive one!'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śaṃkareṇaivamuktastu pratipūjya ca śaṃkaram ..
uvāca devadeveśaṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ haram .. 25 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
शंकरेणैवमुक्तस्तु प्रतिपूज्य च शंकरम् ..
उवाच देवदेवेशं प्रणतार्तिहरं हरम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'Addressed thus by Śaṃkara, he worshipped Śaṃkara in return, / and spoke to the lord of the god of gods, Hara, who removes the distress of the bowed:'

sanskrit_iast:
candra uvāca ..
iyaṃ śaṅkara saumyā me tanuḥ suvihitā tava ..
tasmādarkasthitāṃ gaccha sā te kāmaṃ kariṣyati .. 26 ..
meaning:
चन्द्र उवाच ..
इयं शङ्कर सौम्या मे तनुः सुविहिता तव ..
तस्मादर्कस्थितां गच्छ सा ते कामं करिष्यति .. 26 ..
text_mt: The Moon said: / 'O Śaṅkara, this gentle body of mine has been well arranged for you. / Therefore, go to that [body of mine] abiding in the sun; it will accomplish your desire.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktastripurāntakārī somena rājñā parameśvareṇa ..
saṃpūjya devaṃ prayayau sa śīghraṃ tejomayaṃ maṃḍalamāśu rājan .. 27 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी सोमेन राज्ञा परमेश्वरेण ..
संपूज्य देवं प्रययौ स शीघ्रं तेजोमयं मंडलमाशु राजन् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'Addressed in this manner by Soma, the king, the supreme lord, the enemy who destroyed Tripura, / having worshipped the god, quickly went, O king, to that orb full of fiery energy.'

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
sa dadarśa tato gatvā vipulaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ..
candramaṇḍalamānena mānaṃ yasya ca saṃskṛtam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
स ददर्श ततो गत्वा विपुलं सूर्यमण्डलम् ..
चन्द्रमण्डलमानेन मानं यस्य च संस्कृतम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'Having gone there, he then saw the vast orb of the sun, / whose measure is perfected according to the measure of the orb of the moon,
title: Ādityadarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
yattatprajvalitaṃ piṇḍaṃ piṇḍitasya vibhāvasoḥ ..
devadevasya yaddhāma vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
यत्तत्प्रज्वलितं पिण्डं पिण्डितस्य विभावसोः ..
देवदेवस्य यद्धाम वासुदेवस्य धीमतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: which is that blazing mass of concentrated fire, / which is the realm of the god of gods, wise Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dharmaḥ paraṃ piṇḍaṃ brahmāṇḍāntaradīpanam ..
āgāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jaṭharasthaṃ hutāśanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
तस्य धर्मः परं पिण्डं ब्रह्माण्डान्तरदीपनम् ..
आगारं सर्वभूतानां जठरस्थं हुताशनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: His supreme mass is dharma, illuminating the interior of the cosmic egg, / the abode of all beings, the fire situated in the belly,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhā'vasthitaṃ dehe sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ smṛtaḥ ..
ālocakaḥ pācakaśca rocako gañjakastathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
पञ्चधाऽवस्थितं देहे सर्वेषां प्राणिनां स्मृतः ..
आलोचकः पाचकश्च रोचको गञ्जकस्तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: which is remembered as situated fivefold in the body of all living beings: / as the perceiver, the digester, the relisher, the extractor,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrājakaśca tathā devaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ..
yanmayaṃ dehināṃ cakṣuryaścakṣurdakṣiṇastathā .. 5 ..
meaning:
भ्राजकश्च तथा देवः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां तथा ..
यन्मयं देहिनां चक्षुर्यश्चक्षुर्दक्षिणस्तथा .. 5 ..
text_mt: and the illuminator—the divine [fire] of all living beings; / of whose nature is the eye of embodied beings, and who is the right eye [of the world].

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai devātidevasya vāsudevasya kīrtitaḥ ..
agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyaṅnityaṃ yatropatiṣṭhate .. 6 ..
meaning:
स वै देवातिदेवस्य वासुदेवस्य कीर्तितः ..
अग्नौ प्रास्ताहुतिः सम्यङ्नित्यं यत्रोपतिष्ठते .. 6 ..
text_mt: He is indeed proclaimed to be [the eye] of Vāsudeva, the god above gods, / where the oblation properly cast into the fire constantly attends.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya dattaṃ sadā tejaḥ sarveṣāmeva tejasā ..
yasmādambudharotpattiryasmādvarṣaṇasambhavaḥ ..7 ..
meaning:
यस्य दत्तं सदा तेजः सर्वेषामेव तेजसा ..
यस्मादम्बुधरोत्पत्तिर्यस्माद्वर्षणसम्भवः ..7 ..
text_mt: From his fiery energy the fiery energy of all things is always given; / from him is the origin of clouds, and from him arises rain;

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātpravartate sarvaṃ kālacakraṃ tathaiva ca ..
auṣadhīnāṃ paraḥ pākaḥ paraṃ yasmānna vidyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्प्रवर्तते सर्वं कालचक्रं तथैव च ..
औषधीनां परः पाकः परं यस्मान्न विद्यते .. 8 ..
text_mt: from him proceeds the whole wheel of time as well; / he is the supreme ripening of plants, beyond which nothing exists.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmaṇḍalamathāsādya kṛtvā rūpaṃ tu taijasam ..
viveśa maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā tanmadhyaṃ śaṅkarastadā .. 9..
meaning:
तन्मण्डलमथासाद्य कृत्वा रूपं तु तैजसम् ..
विवेश मण्डलं भित्त्वा तन्मध्यं शङ्करस्तदा .. 9..
text_mt: Then, having reached that orb and assumed a fiery form, / Śaṅkara pierced the orb and entered its centre.

sanskrit_iast:
so'ṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ dṛkśaktimiva veṣṭitam ..
taijasaṃ dṛṣṭavān rudraḥ tuṣṭāva ca mahādyutiḥ .. 1.30.10 ..
meaning:
सोऽङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं दृक्शक्तिमिव वेष्टितम् ..
तैजसं दृष्टवान् रुद्रः तुष्टाव च महाद्युतिः .. 1.30.10 ..
text_mt: Rudra, of great splendour, saw that fiery person the size of a thumb, / as if enveloped in the faculty of sight, and praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
rudra uvāca ..
tvāṃ namasyāmi deveśa tejasāṃ tu paraṃ nidhim ..
ārādhyastvaṃ vareṇyastvaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
रुद्र उवाच ..
त्वां नमस्यामि देवेश तेजसां तु परं निधिम् ..
आराध्यस्त्वं वरेण्यस्त्वं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Rudra said: / 'I bow to you, O lord of gods, the supreme repository of fiery energies! / You are worthy of worship, you are most excellent, the source of the existence of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ tathā bhavān..
anantaścāprameyastvaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarastathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गद्वारं प्रजाद्वारं मोक्षद्वारं तथा भवान्..
अनन्तश्चाप्रमेयस्त्वं सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरस्तथा .. 12 ..
text_mt: You are the door to heaven, the door to progeny, and likewise the door to liberation; / you are infinite, immeasurable, and subtler than the subtle.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā samarpitaṃ tejaḥ sakalaṃ tvayi bhāskara ..
mattastvaṃ na hi bhinno'si na ca devājjanārdanāt ..13..
meaning:
मया समर्पितं तेजः सकलं त्वयि भास्कर ..
मत्तस्त्वं न हि भिन्नोऽसि न च देवाज्जनार्दनात् ..13..
text_mt: All fiery energy has been deposited in you by me, O Bhāskara! / You are indeed not different from me, nor from the god Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ viṣṇurbhavān viṣṇurbrahmā viṣṇuḥ prabhākara ..
asmākaṃ sakalaṃ dhāma tvayi tiṣṭhati bhāskara .. 14 ..
meaning:
अहं विष्णुर्भवान् विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा विष्णुः प्रभाकर ..
अस्माकं सकलं धाम त्वयि तिष्ठति भास्कर .. 14 ..
text_mt: I am Viṣṇu, you are Viṣṇu, Brahmā is Viṣṇu, O light-maker! / All our light resides in you, O Bhāskara,

sanskrit_iast:
dhāmakāryaṃ hi kriyate yenāsya jagataḥ sadā ..
prajānāṃ tu prasavanātsaviteti nigadyase .. 15 ..
meaning:
धामकार्यं हि क्रियते येनास्य जगतः सदा ..
प्रजानां तु प्रसवनात्सवितेति निगद्यसे .. 15 ..
text_mt: by which the work of light is constantly performed for this world. / Because you bring forth creatures, you are called Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
rasānāñca tathā dānādravirityabhidhīyase ..
ādityastvaṃ tathā dānānmitrastvaṃ maitrabhāvataḥ ..16 ..
meaning:
रसानाञ्च तथा दानाद्रविरित्यभिधीयसे ..
आदित्यस्त्वं तथा दानान्मित्रस्त्वं मैत्रभावतः ..16 ..
text_mt: Because you bestow fluids, you are named Ravi; / you are Āditya from giving, and Mitra from your friendly disposition.'

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṇāsi sakalām̐llokāṃstena pūṣā nigadyase ..
dhāraṇācca tathā dhātā yamanādaryamā tathā .. 17 ..
meaning:
पुष्णासि सकलाम्̐ल्लोकांस्तेन पूषा निगद्यसे ..
धारणाच्च तथा धाता यमनादर्यमा तथा .. 17 ..
text_mt: You nourish all worlds, therefore you are called Pūṣan; / and from upholding [them] you are Dhātṛ, and Aryaman because of restraining.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśustvamaṃśudhāritvādvisargādvaruṇastathā ..
bhavaḥ saubhāgyavācyatvāttvaṣṭā sarvakriyākṛteḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
अंशुस्त्वमंशुधारित्वाद्विसर्गाद्वरुणस्तथा ..
भवः सौभाग्यवाच्यत्वात्त्वष्टा सर्वक्रियाकृतेः .. 18 ..
text_mt: You are Aṃśu from possessing rays, and Varuṇa from shedding [light]; / Bhava from being designated auspicious fortune, and Tvaṣṭṛ as the maker of every action.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajantusamatvācca vivasvānabhidhīyate ..
kramaṇācca tathā viṣṇurīśatvādindra ucyate .. 19 ..
meaning:
सर्वजन्तुसमत्वाच्च विवस्वानभिधीयते ..
क्रमणाच्च तथा विष्णुरीशत्वादिन्द्र उच्यते .. 19 ..
text_mt: And because of impartiality to all creatures, he is named Vivasvat; / and from striding, [he is] Viṣṇu, and from lordliness, Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvayā prajākāryaṃ kartavyamavicāritam ..
sthāvarairjaṃgamasthairvā bhūmirbhārābhipīḍitā .. 1.30.20 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वया प्रजाकार्यं कर्तव्यमविचारितम् ..
स्थावरैर्जंगमस्थैर्वा भूमिर्भाराभिपीडिता .. 1.30.20 ..
text_mt: Therefore, the work of the creatures must be done by you without hesitation. / The earth is oppressed by the burden of immovable or moving [beings].

sanskrit_iast:
kadācijaṅgamairbhūmiḥ sūryabhāreṇapīḍitā ..
kadācitsthāvarairadya bhāradvitayapīḍitā .. 21 ..
meaning:
कदाचिजङ्गमैर्भूमिः सूर्यभारेणपीडिता ..
कदाचित्स्थावरैरद्य भारद्वितयपीडिता .. 21 ..
text_mt: Sometimes the earth is burdened by moving beings, O Sun; / sometimes by immovable ones; today she is burdened by both weights.

sanskrit_iast:
arjune nṛpatau vṛddhiḥ parā bhāskara śākhinām ..
daityāḥ kṣattriyatāṃ prāpya pīḍayanti ca medinīm .. 22 ..
meaning:
अर्जुने नृपतौ वृद्धिः परा भास्कर शाखिनाम् ..
दैत्याः क्षत्त्रियतां प्राप्य पीडयन्ति च मेदिनीम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Under king Arjuna, O Sun, the increase of trees is supreme; / and daityas, having attained the rank of kṣatriyas, oppress the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya uvāca ..
tava darśanakāmena prāgeva na kṛtā mayā ..
sthāvarairjaṅgamaiḥ sarvāṃ prakṛtisthāṃ vasundharām .. 23 ..
meaning:
सूर्य उवाच ..
तव दर्शनकामेन प्रागेव न कृता मया ..
स्थावरैर्जङ्गमैः सर्वां प्रकृतिस्थां वसुन्धराम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: The Sun said: / Desiring the sight of you, I did not previously make / the whole earth restored to its natural state from the immovable and moving [beings].

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pūrvaṃ tathā'dyāhaṃ kariṣyāmi maheśvara ..
sāmprataṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā cārjuneneva pādapān ..24..
meaning:
यथा पूर्वं तथाऽद्याहं करिष्यामि महेश्वर ..
साम्प्रतं ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा चार्जुनेनेव पादपान् ..24..
text_mt: As before, so today I will act, O Maheśvara. / Becoming a brahmin right now, by means of Arjuna himself I will destroy

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānvināśayiṣyāmi śāsanena tathārjunam ..
vasiṣṭhādyojayiṣyāmi tatoṃśena vasundharām..25..
meaning:
सर्वान्विनाशयिष्यामि शासनेन तथार्जुनम् ..
वसिष्ठाद्योजयिष्यामि ततोंशेन वसुन्धराम्..25..
text_mt: all the trees, and Arjuna too by an order. / By means of Vasiṣṭha, I will then unite the earth with [my] portion;

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguvaṃśe kariṣyāmi tato niḥkṣattriyāṃ prajām ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktastripurāntakārī sūryeṇa sadraśmivirājitena ..
jagāma dhāma svamasau bibheti yatsarvalokāñjagatāṃ pradhānaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
भृगुवंशे करिष्यामि ततो निःक्षत्त्रियां प्रजाम् ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी सूर्येण सद्रश्मिविराजितेन ..
जगाम धाम स्वमसौ बिभेति यत्सर्वलोकाञ्जगतां प्रधानः .. 26 ..
text_mt: in the lineage of Bhṛgu, I will then make the creatures devoid of kṣatriyas. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having been thus addressed by the Sun radiant with splendid rays, / that destroyer of Tripura, the foremost of the worlds of beings whom everyone reveres, went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dvijarūpamathāsthāya devadevo'pi bhāskaraḥ ..
māhiṣmatīṃ yayau śīghraṃ nagarīṃ ratnamālinīm...
sa tatra dadṛkṣe vīraṃ kārtavīryārjunaṃ nṛpam ..
yajamānaṃ sudordaṇḍaṃ kalpavṛkṣamivāparam ..2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
द्विजरूपमथास्थाय देवदेवोऽपि भास्करः ..
माहिष्मतीं ययौ शीघ्रं नगरीं रत्नमालिनीम्...
स तत्र ददृक्षे वीरं कार्तवीर्यार्जुनं नृपम् ..
यजमानं सुदोर्दण्डं कल्पवृक्षमिवापरम् ..2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, having assumed the form of a twice-born, the Sun, the god of gods, / went swiftly to the city of Māhiṣmatī, garlanded with jewels. / There he saw the heroic king Kārtavīryārjuna / performing sacrifices, with mighty arms, like a second wishing tree.
title: Vanadāhaḥ

sanskrit_iast: pūjitaḥ kṛtavīryeṇa brāhmaṇo nṛpamabravīt .. 3 ..
meaning: पूजितः कृतवीर्येण ब्राह्मणो नृपमब्रवीत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Honored by the son of Kṛtavīrya, the brahmin spoke to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca ..
mahāśanaṃ māṃ jānīhi brāhmaṇaṃ kṣudhayārditam ..
prayaccha tasya me tṛptiṃ tvameko haihayottama .. 4 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच ..
महाशनं मां जानीहि ब्राह्मणं क्षुधयार्दितम् ..
प्रयच्छ तस्य मे तृप्तिं त्वमेको हैहयोत्तम .. 4 ..
text_mt: The brahmin said: / Know me to be a great eater, a brahmin afflicted with hunger. / You alone, O best of the Haihayas, grant me satisfaction!

sanskrit_iast:
arjuna uvāca ..
kenā'nnena bhavattṛptiḥ kimannaṃ vidadhāmi ta ..
tanmamā''cakṣva bhagavan succhaṃdenaiva mā ciram .. 5 ..
meaning:
अर्जुन उवाच ..
केनाऽन्नेन भवत्तृप्तिः किमन्नं विदधामि त ..
तन्ममा'ऽचक्ष्व भगवन् सुच्छंदेनैव मा चिरम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Arjuna said: / By what food comes your satisfaction? What food may I prepare for you? / Tell me that, O venerable one, according to your pleasure, without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca ..
ādityaṃ māṃ vijānīhi sthāvarānbhoktumudyatam ..
prayaccha tāni sarvāṇi mama pārthivapuṃgava .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच ..
आदित्यं मां विजानीहि स्थावरान्भोक्तुमुद्यतम् ..
प्रयच्छ तानि सर्वाणि मम पार्थिवपुंगव .. 6 ..
text_mt: The brahmin said: / Know me to be Āditya, ready to consume immovable things. / Grant all of them to me, O bull among kings!

sanskrit_iast:
arjuna uvāca ..
sthāvaraṃ bhūgataṃ dātuṃ śaktirnā'sti mamā'nagha ..
kathaṃ hi sthāvarā dagdhuṃ śakyā mānuṣyatejasā .. 7 ..
meaning:
अर्जुन उवाच ..
स्थावरं भूगतं दातुं शक्तिर्नाऽस्ति ममाऽनघ ..
कथं हि स्थावरा दग्धुं शक्या मानुष्यतेजसा .. 7 ..
text_mt: Arjuna said: / I do not have the power to give the immovable things on the earth, O sinless one. / How indeed can immovable things be burned by human power?

sanskrit_iast:
āditya uvāca ..
rathasthaḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha śarānmuṃca yadṛcchayā ..
teṣvahaṃ prajvalanrājanbhakṣayiṣyāmi pādapān .. 8 ..
meaning:
आदित्य उवाच ..
रथस्थः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ शरान्मुंच यदृच्छया ..
तेष्वहं प्रज्वलन्राजन्भक्षयिष्यामि पादपान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Āditya said: / Standing on a chariot, O best of kings, release arrows at will. / Blazing forth in them, O king, I will devour the trees.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadeva tvayā kāryaṃ nṛpate śaramokṣaṇam ..
yāvanna prajvaliṣyāmi mukteṣvapi śareṣvaham .. 9 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā gate sūrye kalpayitvā rathottamam ..
cikṣepa sa śarānrājā yatra tatra drumotkaram ..1.31.1 0..
te kṣiptā haihayeśena śātakauṃbhojjvalāḥ śarāḥ ..
jajvalannṛpaśārdūla jvalayaṃto vane drumān ..1 1..
meaning:
तावदेव त्वया कार्यं नृपते शरमोक्षणम् ..
यावन्न प्रज्वलिष्यामि मुक्तेष्वपि शरेष्वहम् .. 9 ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा गते सूर्ये कल्पयित्वा रथोत्तमम् ..
चिक्षेप स शरान्राजा यत्र तत्र द्रुमोत्करम् ..1.31.1 0..
ते क्षिप्ता हैहयेशेन शातकौंभोज्ज्वलाः शराः ..
जज्वलन्नृपशार्दूल ज्वलयंतो वने द्रुमान् ..1 1..
text_mt:
You must continue the releasing of arrows, O king, only so long / until I no longer blaze, even when arrows are released.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, when the Sun had gone, the king, having prepared an excellent chariot, / shot arrows here and there at the grove of trees.
Those arrows shot by the lord of the Haihayas, gleaming like gold, / blazed, O tiger among kings, setting fire to the trees in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
duṃdubhisvananirghoṣo visphuliṃgagaṇākulaḥ ..
ālolārcirmahāvegaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ..12..
meaning:
दुंदुभिस्वननिर्घोषो विस्फुलिंगगणाकुलः ..
आलोलार्चिर्महावेगः सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरः ..12..
text_mt: With the roar of a kettle drum's sound, filled with swarms of sparks, / with surging flames and great swiftness, inspiring terror in all creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdahanvṛkṣapuṃjāni taptakāṃcanasuprabhaḥ ..
jvālāmālī tadā bhāti sarvataḥ pāvakaḥ kṣitau..13..
meaning:
निर्दहन्वृक्षपुंजानि तप्तकांचनसुप्रभः ..
ज्वालामाली तदा भाति सर्वतः पावकः क्षितौ..13..
text_mt: burning massed trees, with the fine lustre of molten gold, / garlanded with flames, the fire then shone everywhere on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vaneṣu dahyamāneṣu tāpatṛṣṇārditā mṛgāḥ ..
jalāśayeṣu citreṣu gatacchāyāgnikeṣu ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
वनेषु दह्यमानेषु तापतृष्णार्दिता मृगाः ..
जलाशयेषु चित्रेषु गतच्छायाग्निकेषु च .. 14 ..
text_mt: As the forests burned, deer, afflicted with heat and thirst, [sought] / the diverse bodies of water and places where shade and fire were absent.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāhāgnistadā vṛkṣānyāvadicchā jagatpateḥ ..
babhūvā'tha praśāṃtārciḥ kṛtvā laghvīṃ vasuṃdharām.. 15..
meaning:
ददाहाग्निस्तदा वृक्षान्यावदिच्छा जगत्पतेः ..
बभूवाऽथ प्रशांतार्चिः कृत्वा लघ्वीं वसुंधराम्.. 15..
text_mt: The fire then burned the trees as long as the lord of the world desired; / then, having made the earth light, its flames were extinguished.

sanskrit_iast:
na jajvāla tathā vahniḥ kārtavīryaśareṣvapi ..
kṛtakāryaṃ tadā gatvā kārtavīryo divākaram .. 16 ..
meaning:
न जज्वाल तथा वह्निः कार्तवीर्यशरेष्वपि ..
कृतकार्यं तदा गत्वा कार्तवीर्यो दिवाकरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: The fire no longer blazed even in Kārtavīrya's arrows. / Having accomplished his task then, Kārtavīrya, having gone to the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
vinivṛtya rathaṃ paścādyāvanmāhiṣmatīṃ purīm ..
sa gacchanneva dadṛśe vasiṣṭhaṃ sarvatejasam .. 17..
meaning:
विनिवृत्य रथं पश्चाद्यावन्माहिष्मतीं पुरीम् ..
स गच्छन्नेव ददृशे वसिष्ठं सर्वतेजसम् .. 17..
text_mt: and then turned his chariot around towards the city of Māhiṣmatī, / saw while still going Vasiṣṭha, who possessed all splendours.

sanskrit_iast:
tena śapto vane dagdhe svakīye nṛpapuṅgavaḥ ..
yasmāttvayā vanaṃ dagdhaṃ mama pārthivaśāsana! .. 18 ..
meaning:
तेन शप्तो वने दग्धे स्वकीये नृपपुङ्गवः ..
यस्मात्त्वया वनं दग्धं मम पार्थिवशासन! .. 18 ..
text_mt: When his own forest was burned, the bull among kings was cursed by him: / 'Because a forest belonging to me was burned by you, O king's ruler,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācecchidyate bāhūn brāhmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ ..
tena śāpena viprasya rāmaḥ kṣatriyanandanaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
तस्माचेच्छिद्यते बाहून् ब्राह्मणः शंसितव्रतः ..
तेन शापेन विप्रस्य रामः क्षत्रियनन्दनः .. 19 ..
text_mt: therefore your arms will be cut off by a brahmin of praised vows!' / By that curse of the sage, Rāma, delight of the kṣatriyas,

sanskrit_iast: tasya bāhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ ciccheda bhṛgunandanaḥ .. 1.31.20 ..
meaning: तस्य बाहुवनं सर्वं चिच्छेद भृगुनन्दनः .. 1.31.20 ..
text_mt: the descendant of Bhṛgu, cut down all the forest of his arms.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
rāmastu kasminsa babhūva vaṃśe kathañca rājñastu mahābalasya ..
ciccheda dordaṇḍavanaṃ nṛvīraḥ sarvaṃ mamā''cakṣva bhṛgupradhāna .. 21 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
रामस्तु कस्मिन्स बभूव वंशे कथञ्च राज्ञस्तु महाबलस्य ..
चिच्छेद दोर्दण्डवनं नृवीरः सर्वं ममा'ऽचक्ष्व भृगुप्रधान .. 21 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / In which lineage was that Rāma born, and how did the heroic warrior / cut down the forest of arm-stems belonging to that mighty king? Tell me everything, O foremost of the Bhṛgus!

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
sarvadevātidevasya brahmaṇastanayo bhṛguḥ ..
paulomyāṃ janayāmāsa cyavanaṃ bhagavānbhṛguḥ ..1..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
सर्वदेवातिदेवस्य ब्रह्मणस्तनयो भृगुः ..
पौलोम्यां जनयामास च्यवनं भगवान्भृगुः ..1..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Bhṛgu was the son of Brahmā, the god beyond all gods; / the venerable Bhṛgu begot Cyavana on Paulomī.
title: adhyāyaḥ 032

sanskrit_iast:
yayātijā sukanyāpi cyavanādbhṛgunandanāt ..
ātmavānaṃ dadhīcañca janayāmāsa dhārmikau ..2 ..
meaning:
ययातिजा सुकन्यापि च्यवनाद्भृगुनन्दनात् ..
आत्मवानं दधीचञ्च जनयामास धार्मिकौ ..2 ..
text_mt: Sukanyā too, daughter of Yayāti, bore from Cyavana, son of Bhṛgu, / the two righteous sons Ātmavāna and Dadhīca.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣipatnī mahābhāgā cā''tmavānasya nāhuṣī ..
aurvaṃ saṃjanayāmāsa ṛcīkāparasaṃjñitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
ऋषिपत्नी महाभागा चा'ऽत्मवानस्य नाहुषी ..
और्वं संजनयामास ऋचीकापरसंज्ञितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: And the illustrious wife of that sage, the daughter of Nahuṣa, / bore to Ātmavāna Aurva, also known as Ṛcīka.

sanskrit_iast:
yena krodhābhibhūtena dṛṣṭo'gnirvaḍavāmukhaḥ ..
tasya satyavatī bhāryā kauśikī gādhijā śubhā .. 4 ..
meaning:
येन क्रोधाभिभूतेन दृष्टोऽग्निर्वडवामुखः ..
तस्य सत्यवती भार्या कौशिकी गाधिजा शुभा .. 4 ..
text_mt: By him, overcome with anger, the submarine fire of the mare's mouth was seen. / His wife was the auspicious Satyavatī, a Kauśikī, daughter of Gādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ sañjanayāmāsa putrāṇāṃ śatamūrjitam ..
jamadagniśca vatsaśca teṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamāvubhau .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्यां सञ्जनयामास पुत्राणां शतमूर्जितम् ..
जमदग्निश्च वत्सश्च तेषां श्रेष्ठतमावुभौ .. 5 ..
text_mt: Upon her he begot a hundred vigorous sons; / Jamadagni and Vatsa were the two foremost of them.

sanskrit_iast: strīṇāṃ caruviparyāsājjamadagnirajāyata .. 6 ..
meaning: स्त्रीणां चरुविपर्यासाज्जमदग्निरजायत .. 6 ..
text_mt: Through the exchange of sacrificial offerings by the women, Jamadagni was born.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
kathyatāmme yato brahmanvāḍavasya ca saṃbhavaḥ ..
saṃbhavaṃ jamadagneśca śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
कथ्यताम्मे यतो ब्रह्मन्वाडवस्य च संभवः ..
संभवं जमदग्नेश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Tell me, O brahmin, whence the origin of that submarine fire was; / and I wish to hear truly the origin of Jamadagni.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhṛgūṇāṃ haihayānāñca vairamāsītsudāruṇam ..
dhanahetostadā pāpairhaihayairbhṛgavo hatāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
भृगूणां हैहयानाञ्च वैरमासीत्सुदारुणम् ..
धनहेतोस्तदा पापैर्हैहयैर्भृगवो हताः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / There was a very terrible enmity between the Bhṛgus and the Haihayas. / For the sake of wealth, the Bhṛgus were then slain by the sinful Haihayas.

sanskrit_iast:
ye'pi garbhagatā bālāste'pi taiviniṣūditāḥ ..
garbheṣu hanyamāneṣu ṛṣiḥ paramaduḥkhitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
येऽपि गर्भगता बालास्तेऽपि तैविनिषूदिताः ..
गर्भेषु हन्यमानेषु ऋषिः परमदुःखितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Even the children in the womb were slaughtered by them. / As the embryos were being slain, the sage, deeply grieved,

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇaṃ dhārayāmāsa garbheṣṭaṃ dīptatejasam ..
pūrṇe kāle tadā bāla ūruṃ bhittvā vyajāyata .. 1.32.10 ..
meaning:
अरुणं धारयामास गर्भेष्टं दीप्ततेजसम् ..
पूर्णे काले तदा बाल ऊरुं भित्त्वा व्यजायत .. 1.32.10 ..
text_mt: held in his thigh the desired embryo, blazing with splendour. / When the full time arrived, the boy was born, having torn open the thigh.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātrastu cukrodha devatānāṃ mahātapā ..
haihayairhanyamānānāṃ bandhūnāṃ sumahātmanām .. 11 ..
meaning:
जातमात्रस्तु चुक्रोध देवतानां महातपा ..
हैहयैर्हन्यमानानां बन्धूनां सुमहात्मनाम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: As soon as he was born, the great ascetic was enraged at the gods: / 'When your kinsmen of exalted soul were being slain by the Haihayas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhirna kṛtaṃ trāṇaṃ tasmātsarvāñśapāmyaham ..
taṃ kruddhaṃ pitaro hantuṃ vārayāmāsurojasā ..12..
meaning:
भवद्भिर्न कृतं त्राणं तस्मात्सर्वाञ्शपाम्यहम् ..
तं क्रुद्धं पितरो हन्तुं वारयामासुरोजसा ..12..
text_mt: no protection was given by you; therefore I curse you all!' / As he was enraged to destroy them, the ancestors restrained him by their power:

sanskrit_iast:
krodhaḥ putra na kartavyaḥ sa hi śatrurnṛṇāṃ sadā ..
vayaṃ sarve jitakrodhāḥ kṣatriyairvinipātitāḥ ..13..
meaning:
क्रोधः पुत्र न कर्तव्यः स हि शत्रुर्नृणां सदा ..
वयं सर्वे जितक्रोधाः क्षत्रियैर्विनिपातिताः ..13..
text_mt: 'Anger must not be indulged, son; it is ever the enemy of men. / We, having all conquered anger, were struck down by the kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ na vadhe śaktāḥ kṣatriyā haihayādhipāḥ ..
evamuktaḥ pitṛgaṇairṛcīkastānathā'bravīt .. 14 ..
meaning:
अस्माकं न वधे शक्ताः क्षत्रिया हैहयाधिपाः ..
एवमुक्तः पितृगणैरृचीकस्तानथाऽब्रवीत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The kṣatriyas, the lords of the Haihayas, were not capable of slaying us.' / Addressed thus by the company of ancestors, Ṛcīka then said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
na hi me śāmyati krodho yuṣmannidhanakāritaḥ ..
tasmāddevagaṇānsarvānnihaniṣyāmi tejasā ..15..
meaning:
न हि मे शाम्यति क्रोधो युष्मन्निधनकारितः ..
तस्माद्देवगणान्सर्वान्निहनिष्यामि तेजसा ..15..
text_mt: 'My anger, caused by your slaughter, does not subside; / therefore I will destroy all the hosts of gods with my fiery energy!'

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu mahītoyasamākulā ..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam .. .. 16 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु महीतोयसमाकुला ..
जगाम शरणं विष्णुं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम् .. .. 16 ..
text_mt: At that very time, the earth, overwhelmed with waters, / went for refuge to Viṣṇu, the source of the birth and existence of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
devānprati samutpannaṃ krodhamaurvasya yacchubham ..
taṃ praviśya grasiṣyāmi toyaṃ sarvaṃ vasundhare..17..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
देवान्प्रति समुत्पन्नं क्रोधमौर्वस्य यच्छुभम् ..
तं प्रविश्य ग्रसिष्यामि तोयं सर्वं वसुन्धरे..17..
text_mt: The Holy One said: / 'The anger born of Aurva against the gods, which is auspicious— / entering that, I shall swallow all the water, O Earth!'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
ityevamuktvā vasudhāmaurvaṃ krodhaṃ samāviśat ..
bhūtvā ca vaḍavāvaktrastaccharīrādvinissṛtaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वसुधामौर्वं क्रोधं समाविशत् ..
भूत्वा च वडवावक्त्रस्तच्छरीराद्विनिस्सृतः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus to the earth, he entered Aurva's anger, / and having become mare-faced, he emerged from that body.

sanskrit_iast:
na trātāro bhaviṣyanti putra sarve divaukasaḥ ..
krodhaścā'yaṃ tava vṛthā na bhaviṣyati putraka .. 19 ..
meaning:
न त्रातारो भविष्यन्ति पुत्र सर्वे दिवौकसः ..
क्रोधश्चाऽयं तव वृथा न भविष्यति पुत्रक .. 19 ..
text_mt: 'All the celestials will not be protectors, son, / nor will this anger of yours be in vain, dear child.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu bhṛguṇā ṛcīkā'gnimabhāṣata ..
pūrvottare samāsādya samudre vasa putraka .. 1.32.20 ...
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु भृगुणा ऋचीकाऽग्निमभाषत ..
पूर्वोत्तरे समासाद्य समुद्रे वस पुत्रक .. 1.32.20 ...
text_mt: Addressed thus by Bhṛgu, Ṛcīka spoke to the fire: / 'Having reached the ocean in the northeast, dwell there, dear child,

sanskrit_iast:
pibam̐statra sadā vegamambhasāṃ sumahādyute ..
asmākaṃ tu kule bhāvī kṣatradharmā dvijottamaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
पिबम्̐स्तत्र सदा वेगमम्भसां सुमहाद्युते ..
अस्माकं तु कुले भावी क्षत्रधर्मा द्विजोत्तमः .. 21 ..
text_mt: ever drinking the force of the waters there, O one of immense radiance! / In our family, moreover, there will be a foremost twice-born of kṣatriya duty,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ samucchedaṃ yaḥ kariṣyatyanekaśaḥ ...
evamuktastu pitrā vai pibanmāsāṣṭakaṃ jalam .. 22 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियाणां समुच्छेदं यः करिष्यत्यनेकशः ...
एवमुक्तस्तु पित्रा वै पिबन्मासाष्टकं जलम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: who will bring about the destruction of the kṣatriyas many times.' / Addressed thus by his father, drinking water for eight months,

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāsaṃ samārabhya nityamāste sukhī jale ..
pītaṃ māsāṣṭakaṃ toyaṃ jaṭhare bhasmasādgatam ... .. 23 ..
meaning:
चैत्रमासं समारभ्य नित्यमास्ते सुखी जले ..
पीतं मासाष्टकं तोयं जठरे भस्मसाद्गतम् ... .. 23 ..
text_mt: beginning with the month of Caitra, he remains ever happy in the water. / The water drunk for eight months is reduced to ash in his belly.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtkṛtya māsām̐ścaturaḥ śiśirākhye mahītale ..
nityaṃ himoghaṃ sṛjati tasmādapi samīraṇaḥ ..24 ..
meaning:
कृत्कृत्य मासाम्̐श्चतुरः शिशिराख्ये महीतले ..
नित्यं हिमोघं सृजति तस्मादपि समीरणः ..24 ..
text_mt: Having done this for four months, on the surface of the earth called the cold season, / he constantly emits a flood of snow; and from that also the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
himācale pātayati pravāho nāma pārthiva ..
eṣā toyāddhimotpattirhimatau yasya saṃbhavaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
हिमाचले पातयति प्रवाहो नाम पार्थिव ..
एषा तोयाद्धिमोत्पत्तिर्हिमतौ यस्य संभवः .. 25 ..
text_mt: named Pravāha, casts it down upon the Himācala, O king. / This is the origin of snow from water, whose generation is in the cold season;

sanskrit_iast: vṛddhikṣayavihīnasya kathitaṃ tava dhārmika .. 26 ..
meaning: वृद्धिक्षयविहीनस्य कथितं तव धार्मिक .. 26 ..
text_mt: it has been told to you, O righteous one, devoid of increase and decay.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattireṣā tava vāḍavāgneḥ proktā mayā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
śrutvā'pi yāṃ muñcati mohajālaṃ saṃsārajāteśca yathā prabuddhaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
उत्पत्तिरेषा तव वाडवाग्नेः प्रोक्ता मया भूमिपतिप्रधान ..
श्रुत्वाऽपि यां मुञ्चति मोहजालं संसारजातेश्च यथा प्रबुद्धः .. 27 ..
text_mt: This origin of the mare-faced submarine fire has been told to you by me, foremost of kings; / even hearing which, one casts off the snare of delusion and the cycle of worldly existence like an awakened man.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
aurvasya bhāryā dharmajñā nāmnā satyavatī śubhā ..
vane paryacaradbhaktyā gādhijā bhṛgunandanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
और्वस्य भार्या धर्मज्ञा नाम्ना सत्यवती शुभा ..
वने पर्यचरद्भक्त्या गाधिजा भृगुनन्दनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Aurva's wife was knower of dharma, named auspicious Satyavatī; / born of Gādhi, she attended upon the delight of the Bhṛgus in the forest with devotion.
title: Caruviparyāsaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā paramayā bhaktyā bhartā toṣamupāgataḥ ..
uvāca tāṃ varārohāmṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
तस्या परमया भक्त्या भर्ता तोषमुपागतः ..
उवाच तां वरारोहामृचीको भृगुनन्दनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Her husband came to be pleased by her supreme devotion; / Ṛcīka, the delight of the Bhṛgus, spoke to that woman of lovely hips:

sanskrit_iast:
.. ṛcīka uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya suśroṇi yatte manasi vartate ..
toṣito'haṃ tvayā bhadre vane śuśrūṣayā vada .. 3 ..
meaning:
.. ऋचीक उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय सुश्रोणि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ..
तोषितोऽहं त्वया भद्रे वने शुश्रूषया वद .. 3 ..
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'Choose a boon, O woman of beautiful hips, whatever is in your mind! / I am pleased by you through your service in the forest, O gentle one; speak!'

sanskrit_iast:
satyavatyuvāca ..
mātuḥ prayaccha me putraṃ bhagavanvīryavattaram..
putraṃ mama ca dharmajñaṃ yutaṃ brāhmaṇatejasā .. 4 ..
meaning:
सत्यवत्युवाच ..
मातुः प्रयच्छ मे पुत्रं भगवन्वीर्यवत्तरम्..
पुत्रं मम च धर्मज्ञं युतं ब्राह्मणतेजसा .. 4 ..
text_mt: Satyavatī said: / 'Grant a son of greater valor to my mother, O lord, / and a son to me, a knower of dharma endowed with brahminical radiance.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca ..
carudvayaṃ kariṣyāmi māturarthe tathā tava ..
yasya saṃprāśanātputraṃ tvaṃ caiva janayiṣyasi .. 5 ..
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच ..
चरुद्वयं करिष्यामि मातुरर्थे तथा तव ..
यस्य संप्राशनात्पुत्रं त्वं चैव जनयिष्यसि .. 5 ..
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'I shall prepare two offerings of boiled rice, for your mother's sake and for yours, / by the eating of which you and she shall bear a son.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā tadā cakre ṛcīkastu carudvayam ..
ekasminsakalaṃ kṣātraṃ tejaścakre savaiṣṇavam .. 6 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा तदा चक्रे ऋचीकस्तु चरुद्वयम् ..
एकस्मिन्सकलं क्षात्रं तेजश्चक्रे सवैष्णवम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, Ṛcīka then made the two offerings of boiled rice; / into one he placed all the martial power along with the Vaiṣṇava power.

sanskrit_iast:
śvaśrvarthe taṃ caruṃ kṛtvā dvitīye sa nyaveśayat ..
brāhmaṃ raudrañca yattejaḥ patnyarthe kṛtavāñcarum ..7..
meaning:
श्वश्र्वर्थे तं चरुं कृत्वा द्वितीये स न्यवेशयत् ..
ब्राह्मं रौद्रञ्च यत्तेजः पत्न्यर्थे कृतवाञ्चरुम् ..7..
text_mt: Having made that boiled rice for his mother-in-law, into the second he deposited / the power belonging to Brahmā and Rudra; he made that boiled rice for his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca ..
ayaṃ prāśyastvayā bhadre tvayaṃ mātrā carustava ..
aśvatthāliṅganaṃ kāryaṃ mātrā tatra tadā śubhe .. 8...
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच ..
अयं प्राश्यस्त्वया भद्रे त्वयं मात्रा चरुस्तव ..
अश्वत्थालिङ्गनं कार्यं मात्रा तत्र तदा शुभे .. 8...
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'This is to be eaten by you, O gentle one, and this your offering by your mother; / an embracing of the sacred fig tree is to be performed by your mother at that time, O auspicious one,

sanskrit_iast: tathaivaudumbarasyā'pi tvayā rājīvalocane .. 9 ..
meaning: तथैवौदुम्बरस्याऽपि त्वया राजीवलोचने .. 9 ..
text_mt: and likewise that of the cluster fig tree by you, O lotus-eyed one.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktā tato gatvā mātre sarvaṃ nyavedayat .. 1.33.10 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्ता ततो गत्वा मात्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् .. 1.33.10 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Addressed thus, she then went and reported everything to her mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāmabravīnmātā gādheḥ patnī yaśasvinī ..
dhruvaṃ bhagavatā putrastava putracikīrṣayā .. 11 ..
meaning:
ततस्तामब्रवीन्माता गाधेः पत्नी यशस्विनी ..
ध्रुवं भगवता पुत्रस्तव पुत्रचिकीर्षया .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then her mother, the illustrious wife of Gādhi, said to her: / 'Surely, with the desire to make your son prominent, the lord

sanskrit_iast:
śreṣṭhena tejasā yuktaścarureṣa kṛtaḥ śubhe ..
tasmāccaruviparyāsaṃ madarthe kuru mā ciram..12..
meaning:
श्रेष्ठेन तेजसा युक्तश्चरुरेष कृतः शुभे ..
तस्माच्चरुविपर्यासं मदर्थे कुरु मा चिरम्..12..
text_mt: has prepared this boiled rice endowed with superior power, O auspicious one; / therefore, make an exchange of the boiled rice for my sake without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
aliṅgane viparyāsaṃ drumayoḥ kriyatāṃ tathā ..
sā māturvacanaṃ sarvaṃ cakre gauravayantritā ..13..
meaning:
अलिङ्गने विपर्यासं द्रुमयोः क्रियतां तथा ..
सा मातुर्वचनं सर्वं चक्रे गौरवयन्त्रिता ..13..
text_mt: Likewise let an exchange be made in the embracing of the two trees.' / Bound by respect, she did all according to her mother's word.

sanskrit_iast: sagarbhāṃ sa gate kāle bhartā vacanamabravīt .. 14 ..
meaning: सगर्भां स गते काले भर्ता वचनमब्रवीत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: When time had passed, her husband spoke this word to her who was pregnant:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca ..
dhruvaṃ caruviparyāso drumayośca tvayā kṛtam ..
yena tvamasitāpāṅgi yuktā kṣatriyatejasā .. 15 ..
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच ..
ध्रुवं चरुविपर्यासो द्रुमयोश्च त्वया कृतम् ..
येन त्वमसितापाङ्गि युक्ता क्षत्रियतेजसा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'Surely an exchange of the boiled rice and of the two trees was made by you, / whereby you are endowed with kṣatriya power, O dark-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmeṇa tejasā yuktaṃ kṛtavānasmi te carum ..
mātuste cārusarvāṃgi tathā kṣattriyatejasā .. 16 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मेण तेजसा युक्तं कृतवानस्मि ते चरुम् ..
मातुस्ते चारुसर्वांगि तथा क्षत्त्रियतेजसा .. 16 ..
text_mt: I prepared your boiled rice endowed with brahminical power, / and your mother's, O lovely-limbed one, with kṣatriya power.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ caruviparyāsaṃ sā vipraṃ janayiṣyati ..
kṣatradharmarataṃ putraṃ vipraṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi ..17..
meaning:
कृतं चरुविपर्यासं सा विप्रं जनयिष्यति ..
क्षत्रधर्मरतं पुत्रं विप्रं त्वं जनयिष्यसि ..17..
text_mt: An exchange of the boiled rice having been made, she will give birth to a brahmin, / while you will give birth to a brahmin son devoted to kṣatriya duty.'

sanskrit_iast:
satyavatyuvāca.. māturmatātkṛtamidaṃ bhagavankṣantumarhasi ..
kṣatradharmarataḥ putro na me bhavitumarhati .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
सत्यवत्युवाच.. मातुर्मतात्कृतमिदं भगवन्क्षन्तुमर्हसि ..
क्षत्रधर्मरतः पुत्रो न मे भवितुमर्हति .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: Satyavatī said: / 'This was done at my mother's opinion, O lord; you ought to forgive me. / My son ought not to be devoted to kṣatriya duty.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca ..
evamastu na te putraḥ kṣatradharmā bhaviṣyati ..
pautrastvavaśyaṃ bhavitā bhāvyarthavidhicoditaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच ..
एवमस्तु न ते पुत्रः क्षत्रधर्मा भविष्यति ..
पौत्रस्त्ववश्यं भविता भाव्यर्थविधिचोदितः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'So be it; your son will not follow kṣatriya duty; / but your grandson will inevitably become so, impelled by the decree of destiny.'

sanskrit_iast:
satyavatyuvāca ..
sarveśvaratvaṃ bhagavankimarthaṃ pautrasya me kṣatriyabhāvamugram..
nivartituṃ necchasi mātulena vadasva tanme yadi te na guhyam .. 1.33.20 ..
meaning:
सत्यवत्युवाच ..
सर्वेश्वरत्वं भगवन्किमर्थं पौत्रस्य मे क्षत्रियभावमुग्रम्..
निवर्तितुं नेच्छसि मातुलेन वदस्व तन्मे यदि ते न गुह्यम् .. 1.33.20 ..
text_mt: Satyavatī said: / 'O lord of all, why do you not wish the fierce nature of a kṣatriya to be averted / from my grandson along with his maternal uncle? Tell me that, if it is not a secret to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca ..
brahmaṇo'triḥ sutaḥ saumyaḥ sutastasyā'pi candramāḥ ..
somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhaputraḥ purūravāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच ..
ब्रह्मणोऽत्रिः सुतः सौम्यः सुतस्तस्याऽपि चन्द्रमाः ..
सोमस्य तु बुधः पुत्रो बुधपुत्रः पुरूरवाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Ṛcīka said: / 'The gentle son of Brahmā is Atri; his son also is the Moon. / The son of Soma is Budha; Budha's son is Purūravas.
title: Kuśikavarapradānam

sanskrit_iast:
śrutāyustanayastasya putrastasyāpi nagnajit ..
tasyā'pi kāñcanaḥ putraḥ suhotrastasya cā''tmajaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
श्रुतायुस्तनयस्तस्य पुत्रस्तस्यापि नग्नजित् ..
तस्याऽपि काञ्चनः पुत्रः सुहोत्रस्तस्य चा'ऽत्मजः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śrutāyus is his son; his son also is Nagnajit. / His son is Kāñcana; and Suhotra is his son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya jahnuḥ smṛtaḥ śrīmānyena gaṅgā tu jāhnavī ..
suvratastanayastasya cālarkastasya cātmajaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तस्य जह्नुः स्मृतः श्रीमान्येन गङ्गा तु जाह्नवी ..
सुव्रतस्तनयस्तस्य चालर्कस्तस्य चात्मजः .. 3 ..
text_mt: His [son] is remembered as glorious Jahnu, through whom the Gaṅgā became Jāhnavī. / His son is Suvrata; and Alarka is his son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro balākaśca kuśikastasya cā''tmajaḥ ..
mahodayapuravare sa tu nityaṃ kṛtālayaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो बलाकश्च कुशिकस्तस्य चा'ऽत्मजः ..
महोदयपुरवरे स तु नित्यं कृतालयः .. 4 ..
text_mt: His son is Balāka, and Kuśika is his son; / he made his permanent residence in the excellent city of Mahodaya.'

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu śvasuraḥ cyavanastava ..
svavaṃśasaṃkaraṃ buddhvā kuśikebhyo mahāyaśāḥ ..5..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु श्वसुरः च्यवनस्तव ..
स्ववंशसंकरं बुद्ध्वा कुशिकेभ्यो महायशाः ..5..
text_mt:
At that very time, Cyavana, your father-in-law,
having understood the intermixture of his lineage from the Kuśikas, O highly renowned one,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśikānāṃ samucchityai kuśikaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau ..
pūjitaḥ kuśikenāpi kuśikaṃ vākyamabravīt..6..
meaning:
कुशिकानां समुच्छित्यै कुशिकं नृपतिं ययौ ..
पूजितः कुशिकेनापि कुशिकं वाक्यमब्रवीत्..6..
text_mt:
went to King Kuśika in order to exterminate the Kuśikas.
Being honored by Kuśika, he spoke these words to Kuśika:

sanskrit_iast:
rājanvakṣyāmi kāryaṃ te yadi śuśrūṣasenagha ..
sabhāryeṇa ca kartavyaṃ rājañchuśrūṣaṇaṃ tvayā ..7..
meaning:
राजन्वक्ष्यामि कार्यं ते यदि शुश्रूषसेनघ ..
सभार्येण च कर्तव्यं राजञ्छुश्रूषणं त्वया ..7..
text_mt:
"O king, I will tell you what is to be done, if you wish to serve, O sinless one.
And service must be performed by you together with your wife, O king."

sanskrit_iast:
kuśika uvāca ..
svamevedaṃ tava gṛhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vasa bhārgava..
śaktitastava śuśrūṣāṃ kariṣye bhāryayā saha..8..
meaning:
कुशिक उवाच ..
स्वमेवेदं तव गृहं यथेष्टं वस भार्गव..
शक्तितस्तव शुश्रूषां करिष्ये भार्यया सह..8..
text_mt:
Kuśika said:
"This house of yours is indeed your own; dwell here as you please, O Bhārgava.
Together with my wife, I shall perform your service to the best of my ability."

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcīka uvāca..
gṛhoṣitaṃ taṃ cyavanaṃ śuśrūṣuranahaṃkṛtaḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa satataṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhibhiḥ..9..
meaning:
ऋचीक उवाच..
गृहोषितं तं च्यवनं शुश्रूषुरनहंकृतः ..
पूजयामास सततं सर्वकामसमृद्धिभिः..9..
text_mt:
Ṛcīka said:
Desiring to serve that Cyavana who was residing in his home, free from egotism,
he continuously honored him with an abundance of all desired objects.

sanskrit_iast:
bahusaṃkhyāndinagaṇāṃścyavano nāvabuddhyati ..
nirāhāraḥ sabhāryastaṃ paryupāste mahīpatiḥ .. 1.34.10 ..
meaning:
बहुसंख्यान्दिनगणांश्च्यवनो नावबुद्ध्यति ..
निराहारः सभार्यस्तं पर्युपास्ते महीपतिः .. 1.34.10 ..
text_mt:
For hosts of days without number, Cyavana did not wake up.
Without food, together with his wife, the ruler of the earth attended upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
akāle prāśayatyannaṃ kadācidapi dularbham ..
kṛtamityeva tadrājā nivedayati satvaram ..11..
meaning:
अकाले प्राशयत्यन्नं कदाचिदपि दुलर्भम् ..
कृतमित्येव तद्राजा निवेदयति सत्वरम् ..11..
text_mt:
At an improper time, he would make him eat food that was at times even hard to obtain;
the king would promptly offer it, saying merely, 'It is prepared.'

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidbahu bhuṅktennaṃ na bhuṅkte divasānbahūn ..
dhanena ca tadīyena tarpayāmāsa vai dvijān .. 12 ..
meaning:
कदाचिद्बहु भुङ्क्तेन्नं न भुङ्क्ते दिवसान्बहून् ..
धनेन च तदीयेन तर्पयामास वै द्विजान् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Sometimes he would eat much food, and for many days he would not eat at all;
and with his wealth he satisfied the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kadāciddīpayatyeva vahniṃ tātagṛhodbhavam ..
kadācicca rathe yuktaṃ sabhāryo rājapuṅgavam .. 13 ..
meaning:
कदाचिद्दीपयत्येव वह्निं तातगृहोद्भवम् ..
कदाचिच्च रथे युक्तं सभार्यो राजपुङ्गवम् .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Sometimes he would even kindle a fire produced in his father's house;
and sometimes he yoked that bull among kings together with his wife to a chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
rājamārge pratodena tudanyati yathecchayā..
tasyā'sau hitamevedaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā .. 14 ..
meaning:
राजमार्गे प्रतोदेन तुदन्यति यथेच्छया..
तस्याऽसौ हितमेवेदं कर्मणा मनसा गिरा .. 14 ..
text_mt:
and struck him at will with a goad on the royal highway.
Yet the king did only what was beneficial to him in deed, thought, and speech,

sanskrit_iast:
samācarati yatnena bhārgavapriyakāmyayā ..
yadā na vṛjinaṃ kiṃciddṛṣṭavāṃstasya bhārgava .. 15 ..
meaning:
समाचरति यत्नेन भार्गवप्रियकाम्यया ..
यदा न वृजिनं किंचिद्दृष्टवांस्तस्य भार्गव .. 15 ..
text_mt:
acting with exertion out of a desire to please the Bhārgava.
When the Bhārgava saw no crookedness at all in him,

sanskrit_iast: tadā tasya varaṃ prādādvaraṃ yanmanasepsitam .. 16 ..
meaning: तदा तस्य वरं प्रादाद्वरं यन्मनसेप्सितम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: then he granted him a boon—whatever boon his mind desired.

sanskrit_iast:
cyavana uvāca ..
vara varaya bhadraṃ te prasanno'haṃ tavānagha ..
nirvyājaṃ te'nayā rājassevayā'naghayā sadā .. 17 ..
meaning:
च्यवन उवाच ..
वर वरय भद्रं ते प्रसन्नोऽहं तवानघ ..
निर्व्याजं तेऽनया राजस्सेवयाऽनघया सदा .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Cyavana said:
"Choose a boon, may good fortune be yours; I am pleased with you, O sinless one,
at all times by this sincere, faultless service of yours, O king."

sanskrit_iast:
kuśika uvāca ..
yadi me tvaṃ prasanno'si bhṛgūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhana ..
vaṃśo brāhmaṇatāṃ yātu varametadvṛṇomyaham .. 18 ..
meaning:
कुशिक उवाच ..
यदि मे त्वं प्रसन्नोऽसि भृगूणां वंशवर्धन ..
वंशो ब्राह्मणतां यातु वरमेतद्वृणोम्यहम् .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Kuśika said:
"If you are pleased with me, O increaser of the lineage of the Bhṛgus,
let my lineage attain brahminhood; this is the boon I choose."

sanskrit_iast:
cyavana uvāca ..
etadeva dhruvaṃ bhāvī nanmāṃ varayase nṛpa ..
asmadvaṃśānuvaṃśasya brāhmaṇyaṃ te bhaviṣyati..19..
meaning:
च्यवन उवाच ..
एतदेव ध्रुवं भावी नन्मां वरयसे नृप ..
अस्मद्वंशानुवंशस्य ब्राह्मण्यं ते भविष्यति..19..

sanskrit_iast:
tava vaṃśakṛto'smākaṃ kṣatradharmmo dvijottamaḥ..
bhaviṣyati narendrendra caitatsuviditaṃ mama .. 1.34.20 ..
meaning:
तव वंशकृतोऽस्माकं क्षत्रधर्म्मो द्विजोत्तमः..
भविष्यति नरेन्द्रेन्द्र चैतत्सुविदितं मम .. 1.34.20 ..
text_mt:
The foremost of twice-born [born] of our [lineage] will take up the duty of a kṣatriya because of your lineage,
O ruler of kings, and this is well known to me.

sanskrit_iast:
etajjñātvā samutsedhaṃ cikīrṣuḥ svakulasya te ..
vikāraiḥ krodhanārthaṃ te gṛhe'hamavasaṃ ciram .. 21..
meaning:
एतज्ज्ञात्वा समुत्सेधं चिकीर्षुः स्वकुलस्य ते ..
विकारैः क्रोधनार्थं ते गृहेऽहमवसं चिरम् .. 21..
text_mt:
Knowing this, desiring to bring about the destruction of your family
through provocative behavior to anger you, I lived in your house for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
vikāraṃ na tato dṛṣṭaṃ mayā bhāvyarthacoditam ..
tasmānmātusvayā prāptaṃ varametatsudurlabham ..22..
meaning:
विकारं न ततो दृष्टं मया भाव्यर्थचोदितम् ..
तस्मान्मातुस्वया प्राप्तं वरमेतत्सुदुर्लभम् ..22..
text_mt:
Yet no agitation was seen in you by me, impelled as you were by what is destined to be;
therefore, by you this boon, so difficult to obtain, has been gained.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāsyanāmā putrastu bhavitā'ti svadhārmikaḥ ..
tasyāpi bhavitā putro gādhirityeva viśrutaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
कुशास्यनामा पुत्रस्तु भविताऽति स्वधार्मिकः ..
तस्यापि भविता पुत्रो गाधिरित्येव विश्रुतः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
You will have a son named Kuśāśva, who will be exceedingly righteous;
and he too will have a son famous as Gādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitraḥ sutastasya brāhmaṇyamupalapsyati ..
kṛtvā vairaṃ vasiṣṭhena tapasā mahatā nṛpa .. 24 ..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रः सुतस्तस्य ब्राह्मण्यमुपलप्स्यति ..
कृत्वा वैरं वसिष्ठेन तपसा महता नृप .. 24 ..
text_mt:
His son Viśvāmitra will attain brahminhood,
having made enmity with Vasiṣṭha, through great asceticism, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ caruviparyāsādviśvāmitrasya saṃbhavaḥ ..
asmadvaṃśānubhavitā nirvṛtto bhava pārthiva .. 25..
meaning:
स्त्रीणां चरुविपर्यासाद्विश्वामित्रस्य संभवः ..
अस्मद्वंशानुभविता निर्वृत्तो भव पार्थिव .. 25..
text_mt:
Because of the exchange of sacrificial caru by the women, the birth of Viśvāmitra
will be experienced from our lineage; be at peace, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yatte vināśitaṃ dagdhaṃ bhavitā tadviśeṣavat ..
bhāryayā sahitaścaiva jarāhīno bhaviṣyasi ..26..
meaning:
यत्ते विनाशितं दग्धं भविता तद्विशेषवत् ..
भार्यया सहितश्चैव जराहीनो भविष्यसि ..26..
text_mt:
Whatever of yours has been destroyed or burnt will become even better;
and together with your wife, you will become free from old age."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā gate vipre rājā pūrṇamanorathaḥ ..
uvāca sumukhīṃ bhadre jarāśoka vivarjitām ..27 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा गते विप्रे राजा पूर्णमनोरथः ..
उवाच सुमुखीं भद्रे जराशोक विवर्जिताम् ..27 ..
text_mt:
When the brahmin had departed after speaking thus, the king, his desires fulfilled,
spoke to that fair-faced lady, O auspicious one, who was freed from old age and grief:

sanskrit_iast:
etatsunetre cyavasya vākyaṃ kasyā'sti śaktirbhuvi mānavasya ..
kartuṃ mṛṣā tena varorumadhye pautrastavogro bhavitā nṛloke .. .. 28 ..
meaning:
एतत्सुनेत्रे च्यवस्य वाक्यं कस्याऽस्ति शक्तिर्भुवि मानवस्य ..
कर्तुं मृषा तेन वरोरुमध्ये पौत्रस्तवोग्रो भविता नृलोके .. .. 28 ..
text_mt:
"This was the word of Cyavana, O fair-eyed one; what human on earth has the power
to make it false? Therefore, O lady with lovely thighs, your grandson will be fierce in the world of men."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktā satyavatī kāle pūrṇe dvijottamam ..
janayāmāsa dharmajñaṃ jamadagniṃ tapodhanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्ता सत्यवती काले पूर्णे द्विजोत्तमम् ..
जनयामास धर्मज्ञं जमदग्निं तपोधनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed, Satyavatī, when the time was complete,
gave birth to a foremost of the twice-born, Jamadagni, who knew dharma and possessed ascetic wealth.
title: adhyāyaḥ 035

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca janayāmāsa vātsyaṃ bhṛgukulodvaham ..
tatoṣṭanavatiṃ putrāngotrakārānpṛthakpṛthak .. 2 ..
meaning:
ततश्च जनयामास वात्स्यं भृगुकुलोद्वहम् ..
ततोष्टनवतिं पुत्रान्गोत्रकारान्पृथक्पृथक् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
And then she gave birth to Vātsya, who exalted the family of the Bhṛgus,
and after that ninety-eight sons, each an originator of a gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
gādherapi tadā bhāryā janayāmāsa putrakam ..
viśvāmitramiti khyātaṃ yutaṃ brāhmaṇatejasā .. 3 ..
meaning:
गाधेरपि तदा भार्या जनयामास पुत्रकम् ..
विश्वामित्रमिति ख्यातं युतं ब्राह्मणतेजसा .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Then the wife of Gādhi also gave birth to a son
famous as Viśvāmitra, endowed with the splendor of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
jito yuddhe vasiṣṭhena manyunā yaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ tapasā lebhe dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ ..4..
meaning:
जितो युद्धे वसिष्ठेन मन्युना यः स पार्थिवः ..
ब्राह्मण्यं तपसा लेभे धर्मात्मा संशितव्रतः ..4..
text_mt:
That righteous king of firm vows, defeated in battle by Vasiṣṭha,
attained brahminhood through asceticism out of indignation.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā prasenajinnāma sutāṃ tasyā'tha reṇukām ..
patnyarthe pratijagrāha jamadagnirmahātapāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
राजा प्रसेनजिन्नाम सुतां तस्याऽथ रेणुकाम् ..
पत्न्यर्थे प्रतिजग्राह जमदग्निर्महातपाः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
There was a king named Prasenajit; his daughter, Reṇukā,
Jamadagni of great austerities accepted as his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sā taṃ vanagataṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ paryacaradvane ..
kadācidatha gharmartau madhyaṃ prāpte divākare .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
सा तं वनगतं भक्त्या नित्यं पर्यचरद्वने ..
कदाचिदथ घर्मर्तौ मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे .. .. 6 ..
text_mt:
With devotion she constantly attended upon him when he went into the forest.
Then once, in the hot season, when the sun had reached the meridian,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍārthaṃ prāsyati ciraṃ jamadagnirmahātapāḥ ..
kṣiptāḥkṣiptāḥ śarāstena reṇukā cārulocanā ..7 ..
meaning:
क्रीडार्थं प्रास्यति चिरं जमदग्निर्महातपाः ..
क्षिप्ताःक्षिप्ताः शरास्तेन रेणुका चारुलोचना ..7 ..
text_mt:
Jamadagni of great austerities shot arrows for a long time in play;
and as the arrows were shot one by one by him, the lovely-eyed Reṇukā,

sanskrit_iast:
ānayāmāsa dharmajñā bharturvacanakāriṇī ..
