athā'rkatāpasaṃtaptā dahyamānāṃghripaṅkajā .. 8 ..
meaning:
आनयामास धर्मज्ञा भर्तुर्वचनकारिणी ..
अथाऽर्कतापसंतप्ता दह्यमानांघ्रिपङ्कजा .. 8 ..
text_mt:
knowing dharma and doing the bidding of her husband, brought them back.
Then, scorched by the heat of the sun, her lotus-feet burning,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpitasya ca vṛkṣasya chāyāmāsādya viṣṭhitā ..
viśramya tu muhūrtaṃ sā bharturninye śarottamam ..9..
meaning:
पुष्पितस्य च वृक्षस्य छायामासाद्य विष्ठिता ..
विश्रम्य तु मुहूर्तं सा भर्तुर्निन्ये शरोत्तमम् ..9..
text_mt:
having reached the shade of a flowering tree, she stood still;
and resting for a moment, she brought the excellent arrow to her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ prāptāṃ kupito bhartā jamadagnirabhāṣata ..
krīḍato me śarairbhadre vighnaṃ kiṃ kṛtavatyasi ..1 0..
meaning:
तां प्राप्तां कुपितो भर्ता जमदग्निरभाषत ..
क्रीडतो मे शरैर्भद्रे विघ्नं किं कृतवत्यसि ..1 0..
text_mt:
When she arrived, her husband Jamadagni, enraged, said:
"Why have you caused an obstacle to me while I was playing with arrows, O auspicious one?

sanskrit_iast: na bibheṣi ca māṃ bhadre tvatha vāpyavamanyase .. 11 ..
meaning: न बिभेषि च मां भद्रे त्वथ वाप्यवमन्यसे .. 11 ..
text_mt: Do you not fear me, O auspicious one, or do you despise me?"

sanskrit_iast:
reṇukovāca ..
arkāgnitāpasaṃtaptā kṣaṇamātraṃ mahāvrata ..
apārayaṃtī viśrānto tasmāttvaṃ kṣantumarhasi .. 12 ..
meaning:
रेणुकोवाच ..
अर्काग्नितापसंतप्ता क्षणमात्रं महाव्रत ..
अपारयंती विश्रान्तो तस्मात्त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Reṇukā said:
"Tormented by the heat of the fire of the sun, O you of great vows,
I, being unable [to proceed], rested for just a moment; therefore you ought to forgive me."

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
reṇukāyā vacaḥ śrutvā jamadagnirmahātapāḥ ..
jātaroṣastadā sūrye sāyakānkṣeptumudyataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
रेणुकाया वचः श्रुत्वा जमदग्निर्महातपाः ..
जातरोषस्तदा सूर्ये सायकान्क्षेप्तुमुद्यतः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Hearing the words of Reṇukā, Jamadagni of great austerities,
having become enraged, was then prepared to shoot arrows at the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu viprarūpo divākaraḥ ..
śīghramāgamya tejasvī jamadagnimabhāṣata .. 14 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु विप्ररूपो दिवाकरः ..
शीघ्रमागम्य तेजस्वी जमदग्निमभाषत .. 14 ..
text_mt:
At that very time, the radiant sun, assuming the form of a brahmin,
came quickly and spoke to Jamadagni.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya uvāca .. ..
svabhāva eṣa me brahman yadahaṃ dahanātmakaḥ ..
vartataśca svabhāvena na me tvaṃ kroddhumarhasi .. 15 ..
meaning:
सूर्य उवाच .. ..
स्वभाव एष मे ब्रह्मन् यदहं दहनात्मकः ..
वर्ततश्च स्वभावेन न मे त्वं क्रोद्धुमर्हसि .. 15 ..

sanskrit_iast:
putraste'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi tvasyāmeva dvijottama ..
surakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi lokānāñca hitaṃ mahat .. 16 ..
meaning:
पुत्रस्तेऽहं भविष्यामि त्वस्यामेव द्विजोत्तम ..
सुरकार्यं करिष्यामि लोकानाञ्च हितं महत् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
I shall become your son through this very woman, O foremost of the twice-born;
I will accomplish the purpose of the gods and great welfare for the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
iyañca patnī dharmajñā reṇukā tava sāṃpratam ..
chatropānahametanme gṛhṇātu varavarṇinī .. 17 ..
meaning:
इयञ्च पत्नी धर्मज्ञा रेणुका तव सांप्रतम् ..
छत्रोपानहमेतन्मे गृह्णातु वरवर्णिनी .. 17 ..
text_mt:
And now, this righteous wife of yours, Reṇukā,
let this fair-complexioned lady receive an umbrella and sandals from me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā'nukampayā chatraṃ tathā brahmanmupānahau ..
mayā sṛṣṭau jagatyasminnityameva bhaviṣyataḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
तस्याऽनुकम्पया छत्रं तथा ब्रह्मन्मुपानहौ ..
मया सृष्टौ जगत्यस्मिन्नित्यमेव भविष्यतः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Out of compassion for her, an umbrella and sandals, O brahmin,
have been created by me; they shall exist perpetually in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
chatropānahayordānaṃ loke śreṣṭhaṃ bhaviṣyati..
chatropānahadānena naraḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati .. 19 ..
meaning:
छत्रोपानहयोर्दानं लोके श्रेष्ठं भविष्यति..
छत्रोपानहदानेन नरः स्वर्गं गमिष्यति .. 19 ..
text_mt:
The gift of an umbrella and sandals will be the highest in the world;
by the gift of an umbrella and sandals, a person will go to heaven."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu sūryeṇa jamadagnirmahātapāḥ ..
saṃpūjya sūryaṃ jagrāha savituḥ sakalaṃ vacaḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु सूर्येण जमदग्निर्महातपाः ..
संपूज्य सूर्यं जग्राह सवितुः सकलं वचः .. 20 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by the sun, Jamadagni of great austerities / worshipped the sun and accepted all the words of Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sūrye gate devī sūryaputrā purā satī ..
putraṃ kanīyasaṃ rāmaṃ janayāmāsa reṇukā ..
tamanvāvasuṣeṇaśca vasurviśvāvasustathā .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततः सूर्ये गते देवी सूर्यपुत्रा पुरा सती ..
पुत्रं कनीयसं रामं जनयामास रेणुका ..
तमन्वावसुषेणश्च वसुर्विश्वावसुस्तथा .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then, after the sun had departed, the noble lady Reṇukā, the daughter of the sun, / gave birth of old to a younger son, Rāma. / Following him were Vasuṣeṇa, Vasu, and Viśvāvasu.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ jaghanyajo rāmo viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk .. 22 ..
meaning: तेषां जघन्यजो रामो विष्णुर्मानुषरूपधृक् .. 22 ..
text_mt: The youngest of them was Rāma, Viṣṇu wearing a human form.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena jāte bhuvi devadeve sunirvṛtā bhūmiratho babhūva ..
hṛtāñca mene ditijaprajātāṃ pīḍāṃ nṛṇāṃ svasya ca sā dharitrī .. 23 ..
meaning:
अंशेन जाते भुवि देवदेवे सुनिर्वृता भूमिरथो बभूव ..
हृताञ्च मेने दितिजप्रजातां पीडां नृणां स्वस्य च सा धरित्री .. 23 ..
text_mt: When the god of gods was born on earth by a portion of himself, the earth became deeply content; / and that earth considered the distress of men and of herself, born from the sons of Diti, to have been removed.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
atha bālyaṃ samuttīrṇo rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ..
śuśrūṣamāṇaḥ pitaraṃ nityamāste mahāyaśāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
अथ बाल्यं समुत्तीर्णो रामो भृगुकुलोद्वहः ..
शुश्रूषमाणः पितरं नित्यमास्ते महायशाः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now, having passed beyond childhood, Rāma, the uplifter of the family of Bhṛgu, / of great renown, continually remained serving his father.
title: Maheśvarādeśaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu rāme vanagate tadā ..
ājagāma mahātejā rājā citrāṅgado vanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रामे वनगते तदा ..
आजगाम महातेजा राजा चित्राङ्गदो वनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: At that very time, while Rāma had gone to the forest, / King Citrāṅgada of great majesty came to the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
vihartuṃ saha rāmābhirdevarājasamadyutiḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā reṇukā cakre spṛhāṃ bhogeṣu bhāminī .. 3 ..
meaning:
विहर्तुं सह रामाभिर्देवराजसमद्युतिः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा रेणुका चक्रे स्पृहां भोगेषु भामिनी .. 3 ..
text_mt: To sport with lovely women, having a splendor equal to the king of the gods. / Seeing him, the passionate Reṇukā felt desire for [worldly] pleasures.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma manasā taṃ sā rājānaṃ kāmasannibham ..
tasminneva kṣaṇe sā tu bhraṣṭā brāhmaṇatejasā .. 4 ..
meaning:
जगाम मनसा तं सा राजानं कामसन्निभम् ..
तस्मिन्नेव क्षणे सा तु भ्रष्टा ब्राह्मणतेजसा .. 4 ..
text_mt: In her mind she went to that king, who resembled the god of love. / At that very moment, she fell [from grace], stripped of her brahminical luster.

sanskrit_iast:
gataśriyaṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jamadagnirmahātapāḥ ..
putrānuvāca tānkrodhāddhanyatāṃ jananīṃ svakāṃ .. 5 ..
meaning:
गतश्रियं तु तां दृष्ट्वा जमदग्निर्महातपाः ..
पुत्रानुवाच तान्क्रोधाद्धन्यतां जननीं स्वकां .. 5 ..
text_mt: Seeing her deprived of her splendor, Jamadagni of great austerities / spoke to his sons in anger: 'Let your mother be slain!'

sanskrit_iast:
te vicārya tataḥ sarve māturgauravamuttamam ..
naiva cakruḥ piturvākyaṃ tāñchaśāpa sa bhārgavaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
ते विचार्य ततः सर्वे मातुर्गौरवमुत्तमम् ..
नैव चक्रुः पितुर्वाक्यं ताञ्छशाप स भार्गवः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Then, having considered the supreme dignity of a mother, they all / did not carry out their father's command; so that Bhārgava cursed them:

sanskrit_iast:
yūyaṃ tiryaksadharmāṇo naṣṭasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatha ..
idhmabhāramupādāya rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ .. .. 7 ..
meaning:
यूयं तिर्यक्सधर्माणो नष्टसंज्ञा भविष्यथ ..
इध्मभारमुपादाय रामो रतिकरः पितुः .. .. 7 ..
text_mt: 'You shall share the nature of beasts, devoid of consciousness!' / Then Rāma, bringing a load of firewood, who gave delight to his father,

sanskrit_iast:
athā''śramamanuprāptaḥ pitā taṃ samacodayat ..
jahīmāṃ mātaraṃ kṣudrāṃ rāma mā tvaṃ ciraṃ kṛthāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
अथा'ऽश्रममनुप्राप्तः पिता तं समचोदयत् ..
जहीमां मातरं क्षुद्रां राम मा त्वं चिरं कृथाः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Arrived at the hermitage. His father urged him: / 'Kill this vile mother, Rāma; do not delay!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa pitrā tu tadvākya samanantaram ..
śiraściccheda tīkṣṇena rāmaḥ paraśunā tadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स पित्रा तु तद्वाक्य समनन्तरम् ..
शिरश्चिच्छेद तीक्ष्णेन रामः परशुना तदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by his father, immediately upon his words, / Rāma then cut off her head with his sharp axe.

sanskrit_iast: tutoṣātha pitā tasya tato dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ .. . 10 ..
meaning: तुतोषाथ पिता तस्य ततो धर्मभृतां वरः .. . 10 ..
text_mt: Then his father, the best among upholders of dharma, was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca ..
svacchandamaraṇaṃ putra tuṣṭe tvaṃ mayi lapsyase ..
yāvacca vaiṣṇavaṃ tejastvayi tiṣṭhati putraka..11..
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच ..
स्वच्छन्दमरणं पुत्र तुष्टे त्वं मयि लप्स्यसे ..
यावच्च वैष्णवं तेजस्त्वयि तिष्ठति पुत्रक..11..
text_mt: Jamadagni said: / 'Son, since I am pleased, you shall obtain death at will, / and as long as the Vaiṣṇava luster remains in you, my child,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadaiva na te yuddhe kaścijjetā bhaviṣyati..
bhaviṣyati ca dharmātmā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ..
raghuvaṃśe samutpanno viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk .. 12 ..
meaning:
तावदैव न ते युद्धे कश्चिज्जेता भविष्यति..
भविष्यति च धर्मात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः ..
रघुवंशे समुत्पन्नो विष्णुर्मानुषरूपधृक् .. 12 ..
text_mt: For that long indeed no one shall be your conqueror in battle. / And there will be the righteous Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, / born in the lineage of Raghu, Viṣṇu wearing a human form.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā sameṣyate tena tadā vaiṣṇavatejasā ..
kṛtakarmā vimuktastvaṃ sa ca yukto bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
meaning:
यदा समेष्यते तेन तदा वैष्णवतेजसा ..
कृतकर्मा विमुक्तस्त्वं स च युक्तो भविष्यति .. 13 ..
text_mt: When he joins with that Vaiṣṇava luster, / then you, your deed accomplished, will be freed [from it], and he will be endowed [with it].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paraṃ tvayā putra na kāryaṃ śastradhāraṇam ..
ārtatrāṇamṛte vīra strībrāhmaṇakṛte'tha vā ..
yathepsitaṃ cā'pyaparaṃ varaṃ varaya putraka .. 14 ..
meaning:
ततः परं त्वया पुत्र न कार्यं शस्त्रधारणम् ..
आर्तत्राणमृते वीर स्त्रीब्राह्मणकृतेऽथ वा ..
यथेप्सितं चाऽप्यपरं वरं वरय पुत्रक .. 14 ..
text_mt: After that, my son, you must not bear arms, / except for the protection of the distressed, O hero, or for the sake of women and brahmins. / Choose also another boon according to your desire, my child.'

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
guruśreṣṭha samutthānaṃ jananyāḥ kathayāmyaham ..
asmṛtiñca tathā tasyāṃ bhrātṝṇāñca tathā 'smṛtim ..15..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
गुरुश्रेष्ठ समुत्थानं जनन्याः कथयाम्यहम् ..
अस्मृतिञ्च तथा तस्यां भ्रातॄणाञ्च तथा ऽस्मृतिम् ..15..
text_mt: Rāma said: / 'O best of elders, I ask for the resurrection of my mother / and also her lack of memory [of the event], and likewise the lack of memory of my brothers.'

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca ..
evamastu mahābhāga tapasā mahatā tathā ..
samārādhaya deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam..16 ..
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच ..
एवमस्तु महाभाग तपसा महता तथा ..
समाराधय देवेशं शङ्करं नीललोहितम्..16 ..
text_mt: Jamadagni said: / 'So be it, O fortunate one! And likewise, by great austerity, / worship the lord of gods, Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamukte samuttasthau reṇukā cāruhāsinī ..
rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve muktaśāpāstathaiva te ..17..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्ते समुत्तस्थौ रेणुका चारुहासिनी ..
रामस्य भ्रातरः सर्वे मुक्तशापास्तथैव ते ..17..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When this was spoken, Reṇukā of lovely smile stood up, / and all the brothers of Rāma were likewise freed from the curse.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā rāmastathoktastu himavatyacalottame ..
tapastepe mahātejā rudrārādhanakāmyayā .. 18 ..
meaning:
पित्रा रामस्तथोक्तस्तु हिमवत्यचलोत्तमे ..
तपस्तेपे महातेजा रुद्राराधनकाम्यया .. 18 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by his father, Rāma of great majesty / practiced austerity on the Himavat, the best of mountains, desiring to propitiate Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ ..
saiṃhikeyabhayatrastāḥ śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः ..
सैंहिकेयभयत्रस्ताः शङ्करं शरणं गताः .. 19 ..
text_mt: At that very time, the gods, led by Indra, / terrified by fear of the Saiṃhikeyas, went to Śaṅkara for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavan devadeveśa praṇatārtivināśana ..
saiṃhikeyairvayaṃ sarvaiḥ sthānebhyastvavaropitāḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
भगवन् देवदेवेश प्रणतार्तिविनाशन ..
सैंहिकेयैर्वयं सर्वैः स्थानेभ्यस्त्ववरोपिताः .. 20 ..
text_mt: The gods said: / 'O Lord, lord of the gods of gods, destroyer of the distress of those who bow [to you], / we have all been driven from our places by the Saiṃhikeyas.

sanskrit_iast:
saiṃhikeyānathā''śritya daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ..
sarve vasanti satataṃ teṣāṃ yatnaṃ vadhe kuru .. 21 ..
meaning:
सैंहिकेयानथा'ऽश्रित्य दैत्याः शतसहस्रशः ..
सर्वे वसन्ति सततं तेषां यत्नं वधे कुरु .. 21 ..
text_mt: Depending upon the Saiṃhikeyas, daityas by hundreds of thousands / dwell constantly; make an effort for their destruction!'

sanskrit_iast:
.. mahādeva uvāca .. ..
śṛṇvantu devatāḥ sarvā dānavā devakaṇṭakāḥ ..
rāmeṇā''haṃ vadhiṣyāmi narabuddhyā yatastu tān .. 22 ..
meaning:
.. महादेव उवाच .. ..
शृण्वन्तु देवताः सर्वा दानवा देवकण्टकाः ..
रामेणा'ऽहं वधिष्यामि नरबुद्ध्या यतस्तु तान् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / 'Let all the deities listen: since the dānavas are a thorn to the gods, / I shall slay them by means of Rāma, through [their] regarding him as a mere man.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu devadevaḥ pinākabhṛt ..
āhūya bhārgavaṃ rāmamidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 23 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
गतेषु देवसंघेषु देवदेवः पिनाकभृत् ..
आहूय भार्गवं राममिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the hosts of gods had departed, the god of gods who bears the Pināka, / having summoned the Bhārgava Rāma, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca ..
saiṃhikeyāndurācārānasurāñjahi putraka ..
samarthastānbhavānhantuṃ nā'nyaḥ kaścana vidyate .. 24 ..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच ..
सैंहिकेयान्दुराचारानसुराञ्जहि पुत्रक ..
समर्थस्तान्भवान्हन्तुं नाऽन्यः कश्चन विद्यते .. 24 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / 'Slay the wicked asuras, the Saiṃhikeyas, my child! / You are capable of slaying them; no other exists.'

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
astragrāmaṃ samagraṃ me prayaccha bhagasūdana ..
yena tānsudurācārānghātayiṣyāmi dānavān .. 25 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
अस्त्रग्रामं समग्रं मे प्रयच्छ भगसूदन ..
येन तान्सुदुराचारान्घातयिष्यामि दानवान् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / 'Grant me the entire collection of supernatural weapons, O destroyer of Bhaga, / by which I shall cause those utterly wicked dānavas to be slain.'

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva uvāca ..
kiṃ tavāstrairbhūguśreṣṭha viṣṇustvaṃ nāsi mānuṣaḥ ..
vyastrasyā'pi na te śaktā yoddhuṃ pramukhatastava ..26..
meaning:
महादेव उवाच ..
किं तवास्त्रैर्भूगुश्रेष्ठ विष्णुस्त्वं नासि मानुषः ..
व्यस्त्रस्याऽपि न ते शक्ता योद्धुं प्रमुखतस्तव ..26..
text_mt: Mahādeva said: / 'What need have you of weapons, O best of the Bhṛgus? You are Viṣṇu, you are not a mortal! / Even if you are weaponless, they are not able to fight facing you.'

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
ghātayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvānsaiṃhikeyāndurāsadān ..
tripurāre mahābhāga tvadājñāparibṛṃhitaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
घातयिष्याम्यहं सर्वान्सैंहिकेयान्दुरासदान् ..
त्रिपुरारे महाभाग त्वदाज्ञापरिबृंहितः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / 'I shall slay all the unassailable Saiṃhikeyas, / O enemy of Tripura, O fortunate one, strengthened by your command.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktastripurāntakena rāmastrinetrapratima prabhāvaḥ ..
ādāya tīkṣṇaṃ paraśuṃ jagāma yatra sthitāste ca ripupradhānāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्रिपुरान्तकेन रामस्त्रिनेत्रप्रतिम प्रभावः ..
आदाय तीक्ष्णं परशुं जगाम यत्र स्थितास्ते च रिपुप्रधानाः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Spoken to in this way by the destroyer of Tripura, Rāma, whose power equaled that of the Three-Eyed One, / took his sharp axe and went where those chief enemies were staying.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu kāṣṭhodarkāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ..
babhūvuḥ sumahotpātāḥ saiṃhikeyaniveśane .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु काष्ठोदर्काः सुदारुणाः ..
बभूवुः सुमहोत्पाताः सैंहिकेयनिवेशने .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / At that very time, exceedingly dreadful portents, / bearing consequences up to the ends of the quarters, arose in the dwelling of the Saiṃhikeyas.
title: Autpātikam

sanskrit_iast:
cacāla śabdaṃ kurvāṇā mahī savanakānanā ..
papāta mahatī colkā madhyenā''dityamaṇḍalāt .. 2 ..
meaning:
चचाल शब्दं कुर्वाणा मही सवनकानना ..
पपात महती चोल्का मध्येना'ऽदित्यमण्डलात् .. 2 ..
text_mt: The earth with its groves and forests shook, making a sound; / and a great meteor fell right through the orb of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
aparvaṇi śaśāṅkārkau saṃchannau tamasā tathā ..
pravṛṣṭāśca tathā raktaṃ bhūri meghā bhayāvaham .. 3 ..
meaning:
अपर्वणि शशाङ्कार्कौ संछन्नौ तमसा तथा ..
प्रवृष्टाश्च तथा रक्तं भूरि मेघा भयावहम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Out of season, the moon and the sun were covered with darkness, / and clouds rained down abundant, fearsome blood.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāṇi mumucurdhūmamasakṛdaśruvāhanāḥ ..
indracāpasavarṇena pariveśena bhāskaraḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
शस्त्राणि मुमुचुर्धूममसकृदश्रुवाहनाः ..
इन्द्रचापसवर्णेन परिवेशेन भास्करः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Weapons repeatedly emitted smoke, as did horses with tears [in their eyes]. / The sun was surrounded at both twilights by a halo

sanskrit_iast:
pariviṣṭa ubhe sandhye candraśca sakalāṃ niśam ..
saiṃhikeyo vipatnyopi sālvasya sumahātmanaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
परिविष्ट उभे सन्ध्ये चन्द्रश्च सकलां निशम् ..
सैंहिकेयो विपत्न्योपि साल्वस्य सुमहात्मनः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having the color of a rainbow, and the moon for the entire night. / The great planet Ketu, hostile to the wives of the Saiṃhikeyas,

sanskrit_iast:
ākramyajanmana kṣatraṃ ketustasthau mahāgrahaḥ ..
vavustīkṣṇā mahāvātāḥ kṣobhayanto diśo daśa .. 6 ..
meaning:
आक्रम्यजन्मन क्षत्रं केतुस्तस्थौ महाग्रहः ..
ववुस्तीक्ष्णा महावाताः क्षोभयन्तो दिशो दश .. 6 ..
text_mt: Stationed itself, assailing the birth-star of the high-souled Sālva. / Fierce, great winds blew, agitating the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānuścā''sītkabandhāṅgo mṛgāścāsannasasvanāḥ ..
nyalīyanta dhvajāgreṣu dānavānāṃ durātmanām ..7..
meaning:
भानुश्चा'ऽसीत्कबन्धाङ्गो मृगाश्चासन्नसस्वनाः ..
न्यलीयन्त ध्वजाग्रेषु दानवानां दुरात्मनाम् ..7..
text_mt: The sun became headless-bodied, and beasts cried out with unmelodious sounds. / [Birds of ill omen] settled on the banner-tips of the evil-minded dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādapakṣisaṃghātā hyapasavyaṃ bhayānakāḥ ..
śuṣkendhanasamṛddho'pi na jajvāla hutāśanaḥ ..8..
meaning:
क्रव्यादपक्षिसंघाता ह्यपसव्यं भयानकाः ..
शुष्केन्धनसमृद्धोऽपि न जज्वाल हुताशनः ..8..
text_mt: Flocks of carnivorous birds, truly terrifying, flew toward the left, / and fire did not burn even when supplied with dry fuel.

sanskrit_iast:
vapūṃṣi dānavendrāṇāṃ na prākāśaṃta yādava ..
uṣṇaśītaviparyāsa ṛtūnāmapyadṛśyata .. 9 ..
meaning:
वपूंषि दानवेन्द्राणां न प्राकाशंत यादव ..
उष्णशीतविपर्यास ऋतूनामप्यदृश्यत .. 9 ..
text_mt: The bodies of the lords of the dānavas lost their radiance, O Yādava, / and an inversion of heat and cold was seen in the seasons.

sanskrit_iast:
prasusravurdrumā raktaṃ vyaśīryanta ca bhūṣaṇāḥ ..
kharā goṣu vyajāyanta mārjārā mūṣikāsu ca .. 10 ..
meaning:
प्रसुस्रवुर्द्रुमा रक्तं व्यशीर्यन्त च भूषणाः ..
खरा गोषु व्यजायन्त मार्जारा मूषिकासु च .. 10 ..
text_mt: Trees oozed blood, ornaments shattered, / donkeys were born from cows, and cats from mice.

sanskrit_iast:
akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣā akāle phalitā drumāḥ ..
vinā varṣaṃ mahānadyaḥ pratīpaṃ jagmurojasā .. 11 ..
meaning:
अकाले पुष्पिता वृक्षा अकाले फलिता द्रुमाः ..
विना वर्षं महानद्यः प्रतीपं जग्मुरोजसा .. 11 ..
text_mt: Trees blossomed out of season, and trees bore fruit out of season; / without rain, the great rivers flowed backwards with force.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayānakāñjātabhayaḥ sughorānutpātasaṃghānprasamīkṣya rājā ..
sālvaḥ samāhūya bhṛgostastanūjaṃ daityaiḥ sameto'tha cakāra mantram .. 12 ..
meaning:
भयानकाञ्जातभयः सुघोरानुत्पातसंघान्प्रसमीक्ष्य राजा ..
साल्वः समाहूय भृगोस्तस्तनूजं दैत्यैः समेतोऽथ चकार मन्त्रम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Terrified on beholding these dreadful and most frightful hosts of omens, / King Sālva summoned the son of Bhṛgu and, together with the daityas, took counsel.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
ratnacitrāṃ suvipulāṃ samāsādya sabhāṃ tadā ..
siṃhikātanayaḥ sālvaḥ śukraṃ vacanamabravīt .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
रत्नचित्रां सुविपुलां समासाद्य सभां तदा ..
सिंहिकातनयः साल्वः शुक्रं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having then entered the very vast assembly hall adorned with gems, / Sālva, the son of Siṃhikā, spoke these words to Śukra.
title: adhyāyaḥ 038

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
dṛśyanta ete bhagavannutpātā ghoradarśanāḥ ..
ācakṣāṇā mahāyuddhaṃ vināśamapi dāruṇam .. 2 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
दृश्यन्त एते भगवन्नुत्पाता घोरदर्शनाः ..
आचक्षाणा महायुद्धं विनाशमपि दारुणम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Sālva said: / 'O venerable one, these portents of terrible appearance are seen, / foretelling a great war and also terrible destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
ripuṃ na caiva paśyāmo yena yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
sarvajñatvādbhavānvetti tannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām .. 3 ..
meaning:
रिपुं न चैव पश्यामो येन युद्धं भविष्यति ..
सर्वज्ञत्वाद्भवान्वेत्ति तन्नः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Yet we do not see an enemy with whom there will be war. / Because you are omniscient, you know it; tell that to us who are asking.'

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
ārādhya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tapasā siṃhikā purā ..
tridaśebhyo hyavadhyatvaṃ svasutānāmalabdha sā .. 4 ..
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच ..
आराध्य देवं ब्रह्माणं तपसा सिंहिका पुरा ..
त्रिदशेभ्यो ह्यवध्यत्वं स्वसुतानामलब्ध सा .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śukra said: / 'Formerly, having propitiated the god Brahmā with austerities, / Siṃhikā obtained invulnerability from the gods for her sons.

sanskrit_iast:
varadānakṛtotsāhairbhavadbhirvidyayā mama ..
nirjitāstridaśāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
वरदानकृतोत्साहैर्भवद्भिर्विद्यया मम ..
निर्जितास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे शंकरं शरणं गताः .. 5 ..
text_mt: Filled with energy by the granting of that boon and through my knowledge, / all the gods were conquered by you and went to Śaṃkara for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tena yuṣmadvadhārthāya viṣṇurmānuṣarūpadhṛk ..
jamadagnisuto rāmaḥ preṣito raṇakarkaśaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तेन युष्मद्वधार्थाय विष्णुर्मानुषरूपधृक् ..
जमदग्निसुतो रामः प्रेषितो रणकर्कशः .. 6 ..
text_mt: For the purpose of slaying you, he has sent Viṣṇu, who has assumed human form: / Rāma, the son of Jamadagni, fierce in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā devo mahātejā mānuṣaṃ sa tu sāmpratam ..
manuṣyācca bhayaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhyasvā'surasattama .. 7 ..
meaning:
सदा देवो महातेजा मानुषं स तु साम्प्रतम् ..
मनुष्याच्च भयं घोरं युद्ध्यस्वाऽसुरसत्तम .. 7 ..
text_mt: Always a god of great splendour, he is now a human being; / and terrible fear [comes] from a mortal! Fight, O best of asuras!'

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
bhagavansarvadevānāmīśvaro madhusūdanaḥ ..
tasmātparataraṃ devaṃ nā'nyaṃ kañcana śuśruma .. 8 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
भगवन्सर्वदेवानामीश्वरो मधुसूदनः ..
तस्मात्परतरं देवं नाऽन्यं कञ्चन शुश्रुम .. 8 ..
text_mt: Sālva said: / 'O venerable one, Madhusūdana is the lord of all the gods; / we have heard of no other god higher than him.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ sa mahātejāḥ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
ājñākārī bhṛguśreṣṭha saiṃhikeyaṃ jighāṃsati ..9..
meaning:
किमर्थं स महातेजाः शंकरस्य महात्मनः ..
आज्ञाकारी भृगुश्रेष्ठ सैंहिकेयं जिघांसति ..9..
text_mt: Why would that one of great splendour, carrying out the command / of the great-souled Śaṃkara, wish to slay the son of Siṃhikā, O best of the Bhṛgus?'

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati dānava ..
abhyutthānamadharmasya tadā''tmānaṃ sṛjatyasau ..10..
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच ..
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति दानव ..
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदा'ऽत्मानं सृजत्यसौ ..10..
text_mt: Śukra said: / 'Whenever there is a decline of dharma, O dānava, / and an uprising of adharma, then he manifests himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kadāciddaityadeveṣu kadācinmanujeṣu ca ..
kadācidatha tiryakṣu jñātvā kāryabalābalam .. 11 ..
meaning:
कदाचिद्दैत्यदेवेषु कदाचिन्मनुजेषु च ..
कदाचिदथ तिर्यक्षु ज्ञात्वा कार्यबलाबलम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sometimes among daityas and gods, sometimes among human beings, / and sometimes among animals, after discerning the strengths and weaknesses of the task.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā bhavati deveṣu devavacceṣṭate tadā ..
tiryakṣu ca yadā devastiryagvacceṣṭate tadā ..
yadā bhavati mānuṣye tadā bhavati martyavat..
mānuṣyaṃ rūpamāsādya tapasā tripurāntakam..13..
meaning:
यदा भवति देवेषु देववच्चेष्टते तदा ..
तिर्यक्षु च यदा देवस्तिर्यग्वच्चेष्टते तदा ..
यदा भवति मानुष्ये तदा भवति मर्त्यवत्..
मानुष्यं रूपमासाद्य तपसा त्रिपुरान्तकम्..13..
text_mt: When he is among gods, he acts like a god; / and when the god is among animals, he acts like an animal. / When he is in a human state, he is like a mortal; / having assumed human form, through asceticism [he propitiated] the destroyer of Tripura.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayāmāsa haraṃ svadehe paramaṃ nṛpa ..
sa tu devavarasyājñāṃ puraskṛtya mahātapāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
आराधयामास हरं स्वदेहे परमं नृप ..
स तु देववरस्याज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य महातपाः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Within his own body, O king, he worshipped Hara as supreme; / and he, of great austerity, placing first the command of the best of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmadvadhārthamāyāti rāmeṇa kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ..
tasmācchakreṇa saṃdhānaṃ bhavato mama rocate .. 15 ..
meaning:
युष्मद्वधार्थमायाति रामेण कृतलक्षणः ..
तस्माच्छक्रेण संधानं भवतो मम रोचते .. 15 ..
text_mt: comes to slay you, designated under the name of Rāma. / Therefore, making peace with Śakra pleases me for you.

sanskrit_iast:
triviṣṭapañca devānāṃ bhavatvasurasattama ..
pātālanilayā yūyaṃ nivasadhvaṃ gatajvarāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
त्रिविष्टपञ्च देवानां भवत्वसुरसत्तम ..
पातालनिलया यूयं निवसध्वं गतज्वराः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Let the three worlds belong to the gods, O best of asuras; / dwell free from anxiety with the netherworld as your abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ nivārayiṣyāmi śaṃkareṇa ca bhārgavam ..
anyathā niviśadhvaṃ ca manuṣyeṇa nirākṛtāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अहं निवारयिष्यामि शंकरेण च भार्गवम् ..
अन्यथा निविशध्वं च मनुष्येण निराकृताः .. 17 ..
text_mt: Through Śaṃkara, I will ward off the descendant of Bhṛgu; / otherwise, enter [it] having been defeated by a mortal.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktāstu śukreṇa buddhvā daiteyadānavāḥ ..
ūcurvākyaṃ susaṃrabdhāḥ śukraṃ bhṛgukulodvaham ..18 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्तास्तु शुक्रेण बुद्ध्वा दैतेयदानवाः ..
ऊचुर्वाक्यं सुसंरब्धाः शुक्रं भृगुकुलोद्वहम् ..18 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having been spoken to thus by Śukra, and having understood, the daityas and dānavas, / greatly enraged, spoke words to Śukra, the bearer of the lineage of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
daityā ūcuḥ .. ekatrā'dhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ..
yadyasmātpratiyudhyeta na bhīstatrā'pi vidyate ..19..
meaning:
दैत्या ऊचुः .. एकत्राऽधिष्ठितं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ..
यद्यस्मात्प्रतियुध्येत न भीस्तत्राऽपि विद्यते ..19..
text_mt: The daityas said: 'Even if the entire world of moving and unmoving beings stood on one side / and fought against us, even then there would be no fear.

sanskrit_iast:
te kathaṃ mānuṣādbhītā nākaṃ tyakṣyāma śatrave ..
śaṃkaraṃ taṃ vijeṣyāmo yenā'sau preṣito dvijaḥ .. 20 ..
meaning:
ते कथं मानुषाद्भीता नाकं त्यक्ष्याम शत्रवे ..
शंकरं तं विजेष्यामो येनाऽसौ प्रेषितो द्विजः .. 20 ..
text_mt: How should we, afraid of a mortal, surrender heaven to our enemy? / We shall conquer that Śaṃkara by whom this twice-born has been sent!'

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca ..
ekatra piṃḍitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ..
ekatra bhagavānviṣṇurjagataḥ so'tiricyate .. 21 ..
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच ..
एकत्र पिंडितं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ..
एकत्र भगवान्विष्णुर्जगतः सोऽतिरिच्यते .. 21 ..
text_mt: Śukra said: / 'Gather the entire world of moving and unmoving beings on one side; / on the other is the blessed Viṣṇu, who outweighs the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sa na śakyo yudhā jetuṃ naiva devo maheśvaraḥ ..
te yūyaṃ prākṛtīṃ buddhiṃ tyaktvā sarve mahāsurāḥ ..
saṃdhiṃ kuruta devena śakreṇā'mitraghātinā .. 22 ..
meaning:
स न शक्यो युधा जेतुं नैव देवो महेश्वरः ..
ते यूयं प्राकृतीं बुद्धिं त्यक्त्वा सर्वे महासुराः ..
संधिं कुरुत देवेन शक्रेणाऽमित्रघातिना .. 22 ..
text_mt: He cannot be conquered in battle, nor can the god Maheśvara. / Giving up your common intellect, all of you great asuras / make peace with the god Śakra, the slayer of his foes.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrakārye sadodyukto devadevo janārdanaḥ ..
yena daityā vinihatāḥ pūrve pūrvatarāśca ye .. 23 ..
meaning:
शक्रकार्ये सदोद्युक्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः ..
येन दैत्या विनिहताः पूर्वे पूर्वतराश्च ये .. 23 ..
text_mt: Janārdana, the god of gods, is ever zealous in the work of Śakra; / by him the daityas of earlier times, and those earlier still, were slain:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbaro namuciḥ śambuḥ kārtavīryaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ ..
hiraṇyakaśipuḥ keśī hiraṇyākṣo madotkaṭaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
शंबरो नमुचिः शम्बुः कार्तवीर्यः कृतागमः ..
हिरण्यकशिपुः केशी हिरण्याक्षो मदोत्कटः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Śambara, Namuci, Śambu, Kārtavīrya proficient in scriptures, / Hiraṇyakaśipu, Keśin, Hiraṇyākṣa intoxicated with pride,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśca kaiṭabhaścaiva viṭo dhūmo'ti'kopanaḥ ..
hayagrīvo nisundaśca sundaścandrārkalocanaḥ .. 25 ..'
meaning:
मधुश्च कैटभश्चैव विटो धूमोऽतिऽकोपनः ..
हयग्रीवो निसुन्दश्च सुन्दश्चन्द्रार्कलोचनः .. 25 ..'
text_mt: and Madhu and Kaiṭabha, Viṭa, Dhūma who was exceedingly wrathful, / Hayagrīva, Nisunda, Sunda, Candrārkalocana,

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkamardanaścaiva candrahartā raṇapriyaḥ ..
sūryaśatrurjitāmitro yajñahā yajñatāpanaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रार्कमर्दनश्चैव चन्द्रहर्ता रणप्रियः ..
सूर्यशत्रुर्जितामित्रो यज्ञहा यज्ञतापनः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Candrārkamardana, Candrahartṛ fond of battle, / Sūryaśatru, Jitāmitra, Yajñahan, Yajñatāpana,

sanskrit_iast:
meghanādo mahāromā meghavādo bhayānakaḥ ..
daśagrīvaḥ śatagrīvo mahāgrīvaśca dānavaḥ ..27..
meaning:
मेघनादो महारोमा मेघवादो भयानकः ..
दशग्रीवः शतग्रीवो महाग्रीवश्च दानवः ..27..
text_mt: Meghanāda, Mahāroman, Meghavāda, Bhayānaka, / Daśagrīva, Śatagrīva, and the dānava Mahāgrīva,

sanskrit_iast:
kālakaḥ kālakeyaśca kālanemi sulocanaḥ ..
kālaśca kālakalpaśca makarākṣo janāntakaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
कालकः कालकेयश्च कालनेमि सुलोचनः ..
कालश्च कालकल्पश्च मकराक्षो जनान्तकः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Kālaka, Kālakeya, Kālanemi, Sulocana, / Kāla, Kālakalpa, Makarākṣa, Janāntaka,

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ keśamano bhīmo devāntakanarāntakau ..
krodhahā bahunetraśca mahākālo jalāntakaḥ ..29..
meaning:
अन्तः केशमनो भीमो देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ..
क्रोधहा बहुनेत्रश्च महाकालो जलान्तकः ..29..
text_mt: Antaḥ, Keśamanas, Bhīma, Devāntaka and Narāntaka, / Krodhahan, Bahunetra, Mahākāla, Jalāntaka,

sanskrit_iast:
ekalavyaḥ sa cādhāro durmukho durdharo vaḍiḥ ..
indutāpanarambho ca raṇacaṇḍaharapriyau .. 30 ..
meaning:
एकलव्यः स चाधारो दुर्मुखो दुर्धरो वडिः ..
इन्दुतापनरम्भो च रणचण्डहरप्रियौ .. 30 ..
text_mt: Ekalavya, and Ādhāra, Durmukha, Durdhara, Vaḍi, / Indutāpana, Rambha, Raṇacaṇḍa, Harapriya,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭī gajavaktraśca mahāsālo vilohitaḥ ..
hrādānuhrādaprahrādavṛkṣarakṣaradāruṇāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
किरीटी गजवक्त्रश्च महासालो विलोहितः ..
ह्रादानुह्रादप्रह्रादवृक्षरक्षरदारुणाः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Kirīṭin, Gajavaktra, Mahāsāla, Vilohita, / Hrāda, Anuhrāda, Prahrāda, Vṛkṣa, Rakṣas, and Dāruṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
śatabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva kūpanaśca mahāsuraḥ ..
vipracittiḥ śivaḥ śaṅkarayaḥ śaṅkustathaiva ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
शतभः शलभश्चैव कूपनश्च महासुरः ..
विप्रचित्तिः शिवः शङ्करयः शङ्कुस्तथैव च .. 32 ..
text_mt: Śatabha, Śalabha, and the great asura Kūpana, / Vipracitti, Śiva, Śaṅkaraya, and Śaṅku,

sanskrit_iast:
ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā bhīmadakṣo guhāśayaḥ ..
vegavānketumānugraḥ sogravigro mahāsuraḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
अयःशिरा अश्वशिरा भीमदक्षो गुहाशयः ..
वेगवान्केतुमानुग्रः सोग्रविग्रो महासुरः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Ayaḥśiras, Aśvaśiras, Bhīmadakṣa, Guhāśaya, / Vegavat, Ketumat, Ugra, and the great asura Ugravigra,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkaraḥ puṣkalaścaiva sālvośvapatireva ca ..
kumbho nikumbhaḥ śatadā saṃgraho gaganapriyaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
पुष्करः पुष्कलश्चैव साल्वोश्वपतिरेव च ..
कुम्भो निकुम्भः शतदा संग्रहो गगनप्रियः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Puṣkara, Puṣkala, Sālva, and Aśvapati, / Kumbha, Nikumbha, Śatadā, Saṃgraha, Gaganapriya —

sanskrit_iast:
ete cā'nye ca vikhyātā daiteyā samaroddhatāḥ ..
sarve labdhavarāḥ śūrāḥ sarve ca gatamanyavaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
एते चाऽन्ये च विख्याता दैतेया समरोद्धताः ..
सर्वे लब्धवराः शूराः सर्वे च गतमन्यवः .. 35 ..
text_mt: these and other renowned daiteyas arrogant in battle, / all of whom had obtained boons, were heroic, and were devoid of grief,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaistridaśarājyāni kāritāni baloddhataiḥ ..
te hatāstena devena vāsavapriyakāmyayā .. 36 ..
meaning:
सर्वैस्त्रिदशराज्यानि कारितानि बलोद्धतैः ..
ते हतास्तेन देवेन वासवप्रियकाम्यया .. 36 ..
text_mt: by all of whom the realms of the thirty gods had been subjected when swollen with power: / they were slain by that god desiring what is dear to Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
kecinmanuṣyarūpeṇa tiryagrūpeṇa cā'pare ..
kecicca devarūpeṇa nihatā bhūritejasā .. 37 ..
meaning:
केचिन्मनुष्यरूपेण तिर्यग्रूपेण चाऽपरे ..
केचिच्च देवरूपेण निहता भूरितेजसा .. 37 ..
text_mt: Some in human form, others in animal form, / and some in divine form, were slain by him of vast splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
jānāmi tasya māhātmyaṃ devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ..
ahaṃ svamaraṇaṃ matvā tena yotsyāmi bhārgava .. 38 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
जानामि तस्य माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः ..
अहं स्वमरणं मत्वा तेन योत्स्यामि भार्गव .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Sālva said:
I know the majesty of that god of gods who holds the Śārṅga bow.
Knowing my death [is certain], I shall fight with him, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
viśiṣṭānmaraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na hīnādvijayo raṇe ..
viṣṇoḥ karavinaṣṭānāṃ bhūyo rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 39 ..
meaning:
विशिष्टान्मरणं श्रेष्ठं न हीनाद्विजयो रणे ..
विष्णोः करविनष्टानां भूयो राज्यं भविष्यति .. 39 ..
text_mt:
Death at the hands of a superior is better; victory over an inferior in battle is not.
Those destroyed by the hand of Viṣṇu will have kingship again.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktastvasurādhipena bhṛgupradhāno bhagavān sa śukraḥ ..
jñātvā sa daityānsakalānvinaṣṭāñjagāma kāṣṭhāmaparāmabhīṣṭām .. 40 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्तस्त्वसुराधिपेन भृगुप्रधानो भगवान् स शुक्रः ..
ज्ञात्वा स दैत्यान्सकलान्विनष्टाञ्जगाम काष्ठामपरामभीष्टाम् .. 40 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Addressed thus by the ruler of the asuras, that venerable Śukra, foremost of the Bhṛgus,
knowing all the daityas were destroyed, went to another, desired direction.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā gate śukre gaviṣṭho vākyamabravīt ..
rājañchukrasya vacanaṃ kriyatāmavicārayan..1..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा गते शुक्रे गविष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
राजञ्छुक्रस्य वचनं क्रियतामविचारयन्..1..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
When Śukra had departed after speaking thus, Gaviṣṭha spoke these words:
‘O king, let the word of Śukra be carried out without hesitation.
title: Svapnādhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
svapnā hi sumahāghorā dṛśyante bhayavardhanāḥ .'
bhavatāṃ hi vināśāya rātryante satataṃ vibho ..2..
meaning:
स्वप्ना हि सुमहाघोरा दृश्यन्ते भयवर्धनाः .'
भवतां हि विनाशाय रात्र्यन्ते सततं विभो ..2..
text_mt:
For exceedingly terrible dreams that increase fear are seen,
portending your destruction, constantly at the end of the night, O mighty lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānsvapne mayā dṛṣṭo rakta sraganulepanaḥ ..
uṣṭreṇa śiśumāreṇa varāheṇa tathā vrajan..3..
meaning:
भवान्स्वप्ने मया दृष्टो रक्त स्रगनुलेपनः ..
उष्ट्रेण शिशुमारेण वराहेण तथा व्रजन्..3..
text_mt:
You were seen by me in a dream, adorned with red garlands and unguent,
going upon a camel, a dolphin, and a boar;

sanskrit_iast:
tailāktāścāpare daityāḥ kharayānamupāśritāḥ ..
patantaḥ parvatā dṛṣṭā rājam̐ste bhayakāraṇam..4..
meaning:
तैलाक्ताश्चापरे दैत्याः खरयानमुपाश्रिताः ..
पतन्तः पर्वता दृष्टा राजम्̐स्ते भयकारणम्..4..
text_mt:
and other daityas, smeared with oil, mounted on donkey-chariots.
Mountains were seen falling, O king, a cause of terror for you.

sanskrit_iast:
kecitkṛṣṇāṃbaradharāḥ kecitkṛsarabhojinaḥ..
kecitpaṅkagatā dṛṣṭāḥ kecidbhasmaśayā gatāḥ..5..
meaning:
केचित्कृष्णांबरधराः केचित्कृसरभोजिनः..
केचित्पङ्कगता दृष्टाः केचिद्भस्मशया गताः..5..
text_mt:
Some wore black clothes, some were eating rice with pulse;
some were seen sunk in mud, some had gone to a bed of ashes;

sanskrit_iast:
kecidvivastrayā nāryā kṛṣyante dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ..
kācidraktāmbarā nārī nīyate dakṣiṇāṃ diśam..6..
meaning:
केचिद्विवस्त्रया नार्या कृष्यन्ते दक्षिणां दिशम् ..
काचिद्रक्ताम्बरा नारी नीयते दक्षिणां दिशम्..6..
text_mt:
some were dragged toward the southern direction by a naked woman;
a certain woman dressed in red garments was being led toward the southern direction;

sanskrit_iast:
kecinnṛtyanti bhūpālā hasanti ca tathā'pare ..
kecinmuṇḍā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kecitkāṣāyavāsasaḥ .. 7..
meaning:
केचिन्नृत्यन्ति भूपाला हसन्ति च तथाऽपरे ..
केचिन्मुण्डा मया दृष्टाः केचित्काषायवाससः .. 7..
text_mt:
some kings were dancing and others were laughing;
some were seen by me with shaven heads, some in ochre robes;

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālaskandhagāḥ kecitkecitkiṃśukasaṃsthitāḥ ..
gajāśvapattisainyena sarveṇa ca bhavānyutaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
चण्डालस्कन्धगाः केचित्केचित्किंशुकसंस्थिताः ..
गजाश्वपत्तिसैन्येन सर्वेण च भवान्युतः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
some were mounted on the shoulders of caṇḍālas, some standing among kiṃśuka trees;
and you, accompanied by your entire army of elephants, horses, and foot soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīṃ sukaluṣāṃ prāpya nimagno gomaye hrade ..
rājaśrīśca mayā dṛṣṭā śakrāliṅganatatparā .. 9 ..
meaning:
वापीं सुकलुषां प्राप्य निमग्नो गोमये ह्रदे ..
राजश्रीश्च मया दृष्टा शक्रालिङ्गनतत्परा .. 9 ..
text_mt:
having reached an exceedingly foul step-well, were plunged into a pool of cow dung;
and the royal fortune was seen by me devoted to embracing Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya me rocate sandhistava śakreṇa pārthiva ..
prāṇānrakṣata bho rājañjīvanbhadrāṇyupāśnute .. 10 ..
meaning:
तस्य मे रोचते सन्धिस्तव शक्रेण पार्थिव ..
प्राणान्रक्षत भो राजञ्जीवन्भद्राण्युपाश्नुते .. 10 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, a treaty with Śakra pleases me, O ruler of the earth.
Protect your life, O king! He who lives experiences good fortune.’

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
yadaiva bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śrutaḥ śatrurmayā'nagha ..
tatraiva deva tacchrutvā rājyaṃ tyaktaṃ tathā mayā .. 11 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
यदैव भगवान्विष्णुः श्रुतः शत्रुर्मयाऽनघ ..
तत्रैव देव तच्छ्रुत्वा राज्यं त्यक्तं तथा मया .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Sālva said:
‘As soon as the venerable Viṣṇu was heard by me to be my enemy, O sinless one,
at that very moment, hearing that, I abandoned the kingdom, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭaṃ yajñaistapastaptaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtamakaṇṭakam ..
mūrdhni sthitamamitrāṇāṃ suhṛdaḥ paripālitāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
इष्टं यज्ञैस्तपस्तप्तं राज्यं कृतमकण्टकम् ..
मूर्ध्नि स्थितममित्राणां सुहृदः परिपालिताः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
I have sacrificed with sacrifices, practiced austerities, and made the kingdom free of thorns;
I have stood upon the heads of my enemies, and my friends have been protected;

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛto bhṛtyajanaḥ sarvaḥ kṛtakṛtyāstato vayam ..
govindānmaraṇaṃ prāpya bhūyo rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
meaning:
धृतो भृत्यजनः सर्वः कृतकृत्यास्ततो वयम् ..
गोविन्दान्मरणं प्राप्य भूयो राज्यं भविष्यति .. 13 ..
text_mt:
all my servants have been maintained; thus we have accomplished our purpose.
Meeting death from Govinda, kingship will be mine again.’

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityeva vākyaṃ tu niśamya rājño mene tadāyuktatamaṃ gaviṣṭhaḥ ..
tūṣṇīṃ babhūvā'tha suniścitātmā mene ca daityānsamare vinaṣṭān .. 14 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येव वाक्यं तु निशम्य राज्ञो मेने तदायुक्ततमं गविष्ठः ..
तूष्णीं बभूवाऽथ सुनिश्चितात्मा मेने च दैत्यान्समरे विनष्टान् .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having heard these words of the king, Gaviṣṭha then considered it most inappropriate.
With a firmly resolved mind, he then fell silent, and regarded the daityas as already destroyed in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
etasminneva kāle tu sālvasya ca mahātmanaḥ ..
śīrṣamātrāvaśiṣṭastu dadṛśe cāgrajasya ca .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु साल्वस्य च महात्मनः ..
शीर्षमात्रावशिष्टस्तु ददृशे चाग्रजस्य च .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
At that very time, the elder brother of the great-souled Sālva,
with only his head remaining, was seen.
title: Lakṣmīsamudbhavaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
rāhurityeva vikhyātaḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ nṛpaḥ ..
yathārhaṃ pūjito rājñā niṣaṇṇo vākyamabravīt .. 2 ..
meaning:
राहुरित्येव विख्यातः पूजयामास तं नृपः ..
यथार्हं पूजितो राज्ञा निषण्णो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
He was renowned as Rāhu. The king worshipped him.
Worshipped suitably by the king, he sat down and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuruvāca..
na hi me rocate vairaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā..
yasya krodhādanaṅgohaṃ jātaḥ parabalārdanaḥ..3..
meaning:
राहुरुवाच..
न हि मे रोचते वैरं विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना..
यस्य क्रोधादनङ्गोहं जातः परबलार्दनः..3..

sanskrit_iast:
prasādācca tathā yasya grahatvamupalabdhavān ..
kimanyaiḥ kīrtitaistasya karmabhiste'surātmaja .. 4 ..
meaning:
प्रसादाच्च तथा यस्य ग्रहत्वमुपलब्धवान् ..
किमन्यैः कीर्तितैस्तस्य कर्मभिस्तेऽसुरात्मज .. 4 ..
text_mt:
and by whose grace I attained the status of a planet.
Why should his other deeds be recounted to you, O son of an asura?

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kathaṃ tena mahātmanā ..
anaṃgastvaṃ kṛto vīra graheśaśca kathaṃ kṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कथं तेन महात्मना ..
अनंगस्त्वं कृतो वीर ग्रहेशश्च कथं कृतः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Sālva said:
O venerable one, I wish to hear how you were made bodiless by that great-souled one,
O hero, and how you were made a lord of the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuruvāca ..
amaratvamabhīpsaṃtaḥ purā devā savāsavāḥ
keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
राहुरुवाच ..
अमरत्वमभीप्संतः पुरा देवा सवासवाः
केशवं शरणं गताः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Rāhu said:
In ancient times, the gods accompanied by Vāsava, desiring immortality,
went to Keśava for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ ..
bhagavan devadeveśa jagatāmārtināśana ..
nirviśeṣā vayaṃ martyaistrātā tatrāstu no bhavān .. 7 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः ..
भगवन् देवदेवेश जगतामार्तिनाशन ..
निर्विशेषा वयं मर्त्यैस्त्राता तत्रास्तु नो भवान् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
The gods said:
O venerable one, lord of the god of gods, destroyer of the distress of the worlds!
We are no different from mortals; let you be our protector in this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
kṣīrodamathane yatnaṃ tridaśāḥ kartumarhatha ..
dānavaiḥ sahitā bhūtvā tataḥ śreyo'pyavāpsyatha .. 8 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
क्षीरोदमथने यत्नं त्रिदशाः कर्तुमर्हथ ..
दानवैः सहिता भूत्वा ततः श्रेयोऽप्यवाप्स्यथ .. 8 ..

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuruvāca ..
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve devadevena śārṅgiṇā ..
dānavaiḥ sahitā bhūtvā mamanthurvaruṇālayam .. 9 ..
meaning:
राहुरुवाच ..
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे देवदेवेन शार्ङ्गिणा ..
दानवैः सहिता भूत्वा ममन्थुर्वरुणालयम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
Rāhu said:
Addressed thus by the god of gods who holds the Śārṅga bow, all the gods,
joined with the dānavas, churned the abode of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhāyyamakarotteṣāṃ tatra karmaṇi pārthiva ..
vinā viṣṇusahāyena na śaktāḥ sasurāsurāḥ .. 1.40.10 ..
meaning:
साहाय्यमकरोत्तेषां तत्र कर्मणि पार्थिव ..
विना विष्णुसहायेन न शक्ताः ससुरासुराः .. 1.40.10 ..
text_mt:
He gave them assistance in that task, O ruler of the earth;
without the help of Viṣṇu, neither the gods nor the asuras were capable.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaḥ sa tato bhūtvā cāṃśaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasya ca ..
utpāṭya maṃdiraṃ dorbhyāṃ cikṣepa payasāṃ nidhau .. 11 ..
meaning:
अनन्तः स ततो भूत्वा चांशः संकर्षणस्य च ..
उत्पाट्य मंदिरं दोर्भ्यां चिक्षेप पयसां निधौ .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Then, having become Ananta, a portion of Saṃkarṣaṇa,
he uprooted Mount Mandara with both arms and cast it into the ocean of waters.

sanskrit_iast:
akūpāre tato bhūtvā kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
mandaraṃ dhārayāmāsa kṣīrābdhigatamañjasā .. 12 ..
meaning:
अकूपारे ततो भूत्वा कूर्मरूपी जनार्दनः ..
मन्दरं धारयामास क्षीराब्धिगतमञ्जसा .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Then Janārdana, having assumed the form of a tortoise in the deep ocean,
swiftly supported Mandara as it entered the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
svanaiva tejasā nāgaṃ tathā saṃyojya vāsukim ..
cakre sa netratāṃ tatra tatra karmaṇi dānava .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्वनैव तेजसा नागं तथा संयोज्य वासुकिम् ..
चक्रे स नेत्रतां तत्र तत्र कर्मणि दानव .. 13 ..
text_mt:
And attaching the serpent Vāsuki with his own radiance,
he made him the churning-rope for that task, O dānava.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mamanthuḥ sahasā samudraṃ devadānavāḥ ..
yato mukhaṃ tato daityā yataḥ pucchaṃ tataḥ surāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
ततो ममन्थुः सहसा समुद्रं देवदानवाः ..
यतो मुखं ततो दैत्या यतः पुच्छं ततः सुराः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Then the gods and dānavas quickly churned the ocean;
where the mouth was, there were the daityas; where the tail was, there were the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukerabhavaddaityā mathyamāne mahodadhau ..
mukhaśca nāgarājasya kareṇa dhṛtavānsvayam .. 15 ..
meaning:
वासुकेरभवद्दैत्या मथ्यमाने महोदधौ ..
मुखश्च नागराजस्य करेण धृतवान्स्वयम् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
As the great ocean was being churned, the daityas were at Vāsuki’s [mouth],
and he himself held the mouth of the king of serpents with his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā devadevo janārdanaḥ ..
mukhe niḥśvāsavātena saviṣeṇa hi bhūpate .. 16 ..
meaning:
आकाशाभिमुखं कृत्वा देवदेवो जनार्दनः ..
मुखे निःश्वासवातेन सविषेण हि भूपते .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Turning it toward the sky, the god of gods, Janārdana,
[warded off] the breath of the wind from the mouth, full of poison, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā daityasaṃghānāṃ vināśamabhaviṣyata ..
himācalābhāḥ kāllolāḥ kṣīrābdhergaganaspṛśaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
अन्यथा दैत्यसंघानां विनाशमभविष्यत ..
हिमाचलाभाः काल्लोलाः क्षीराब्धेर्गगनस्पृशः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
otherwise, destruction would have come upon the hosts of daityas.
Surges from the Ocean of Milk, resembling the Himālaya, touching the sky,

sanskrit_iast: utpeturmathyamānasya balibhidevadānavaiḥ .. 18 ..
meaning: उत्पेतुर्मथ्यमानस्य बलिभिदेवदानवैः .. 18 ..
text_mt: flew up as it was being churned by the slayer of Bala, the gods, and the dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgāṇi nipatanti sma mandarasya mahodadhau ..
ratnacitrāṇi ramyāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
शृङ्गाणि निपतन्ति स्म मन्दरस्य महोदधौ ..
रत्नचित्राणि रम्याणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Peaks of Mount Mandara, delightful and variegated with jewels,
fell down into the great ocean by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
drumāśca śataśaḥ peturmṛgāḥ petuḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
trailokyaṃ pūrayannādai rarāsa payasāṃ nidhiḥ .. 1.40.20 ..
meaning:
द्रुमाश्च शतशः पेतुर्मृगाः पेतुः सहस्रशः ..
त्रैलोक्यं पूरयन्नादै ररास पयसां निधिः .. 1.40.20 ..
text_mt:
Trees fell by the hundreds, and wild beasts fell by the thousands;
filling the three worlds with roaring sounds, the ocean of waters resounded.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrakallolavasanaḥ śvetameghakṛtāṃśukaḥ ..
rājate mandarādrissa nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ .. 21 .
meaning:
क्षीरकल्लोलवसनः श्वेतमेघकृतांशुकः ..
राजते मन्दराद्रिस्स नानाधातुविभूषितः .. 21 .
text_mt:
Clothed in garments of milk-surges, having upper garments made of white clouds,
that Mount Mandara shone, adorned with various minerals.

sanskrit_iast:
calanmeghāṃśuko ghūrṇannatyarthaṃ vāyupūritaiḥ ..
guhāmukhaiḥ sapraṇataṃ girirmattairivārṇavaḥ ..22 ..
meaning:
चलन्मेघांशुको घूर्णन्नत्यर्थं वायुपूरितैः ..
गुहामुखैः सप्रणतं गिरिर्मत्तैरिवार्णवः ..22 ..
text_mt:
With moving garments of clouds, reeling exceedingly, through its cave-mouths
filled with wind, the bowed mountain was like an intoxicated ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjharāśrurmahānādaḥ śṛṅgocchritamahābhujaḥ ..
aniśaṃ sa giriśreṣṭhaḥ sthānahānyeva roditi .. 23 ..
meaning:
निर्झराश्रुर्महानादः शृङ्गोच्छ्रितमहाभुजः ..
अनिशं स गिरिश्रेष्ठः स्थानहान्येव रोदिति .. 23 ..
text_mt:
With waterfalls as tears, uttering a great roar, with raised mountain-peaks as its great arms,
that foremost of mountains constantly wept, as if at the loss of its place.

sanskrit_iast:
devopabhogyānsakalānmahānta iti cintayan ..
vādyatsu devavādyeṣu nṛtyatīva sa mandaraḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
देवोपभोग्यान्सकलान्महान्त इति चिन्तयन् ..
वाद्यत्सु देववाद्येषु नृत्यतीव स मन्दरः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Thinking, ‘All these great things are to be enjoyed by the gods,’
as divine musical instruments played, that Mandara seemed to dance.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi mathyamānasya kṣīrābdheḥ sumahātmanaḥ ..
prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ kālānalasamaprabham .. 25 ..
meaning:
एवं हि मथ्यमानस्य क्षीराब्धेः सुमहात्मनः ..
प्रादुर्भूतं विषं घोरं कालानलसमप्रभम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: As that great ocean of milk was thus being churned, / a terrible poison arose, equal in brilliance to the fire of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
yena prodbhūtamātreṇa viṣaṇṇā devadānavāḥ ..
tatpapau bhagavāñchaṃbhustrailokyahitakāmyayā ..26..
meaning:
येन प्रोद्भूतमात्रेण विषण्णा देवदानवाः ..
तत्पपौ भगवाञ्छंभुस्त्रैलोक्यहितकाम्यया ..26..
text_mt: As soon as it sprang forth, the gods and Dānavas grew despondent; / [then] the blessed Sambhu drank it, desiring the welfare of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣe kaṇṭhamanuprāpte nīlakaṇṭhatvamāgataḥ ..
dhārayāmāsa tatkaṇṭhe śobhārthaṃ suravāritaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
विषे कण्ठमनुप्राप्ते नीलकण्ठत्वमागतः ..
धारयामास तत्कण्ठे शोभार्थं सुरवारितः .. 27 ..
text_mt: When the poison reached his throat, he acquired blueness of the neck; / restrained by the gods, he kept it in his throat for decoration.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścandrakalā jātā trailokyasyaiva sundarī ..
jaṭājūṭena tāṃ cakre devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
ततश्चन्द्रकला जाता त्रैलोक्यस्यैव सुन्दरी ..
जटाजूटेन तां चक्रे देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Then the crescent moon was born, lovely to the three worlds; / Maheśvara, the god of gods, placed it upon his matted hair.

sanskrit_iast:
raśmijvālāvalīpuñjavibhāsitajagattrayam ..
vaiḍūryakaustubhaṃ jātaṃ yaṃ babhāra hṛdā hariḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
रश्मिज्वालावलीपुञ्जविभासितजगत्त्रयम् ..
वैडूर्यकौस्तुभं जातं यं बभार हृदा हरिः .. 29 ..
text_mt: The cat's-eye Kaustubha gem was born, illuminating the three worlds / with a mass of flaming rays; Hari bore it upon his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
vātaraṃho mahākāyaḥ śaśāṅkasadṛśacchaviḥ ..
uccaiśravāhayo jātassa ca devānupāśritaḥ .. 1.40.30 ..
meaning:
वातरंहो महाकायः शशाङ्कसदृशच्छविः ..
उच्चैश्रवाहयो जातस्स च देवानुपाश्रितः .. 1.40.30 ..
text_mt: With the speed of the wind, a gigantic body, and the radiance of the moon, / the horse named Uccaiḥśravas was born, and he took refuge with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ surā samutpannā sā ca pītā mahāsuraiḥ ..
tatastvapsaraso jātā devarāmā manoramāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
ततः सुरा समुत्पन्ना सा च पीता महासुरैः ..
ततस्त्वप्सरसो जाता देवरामा मनोरमाः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then wine arose, and it was drunk by the great asuras; / then arose the apsarases, the charming women of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: devī lakṣmīstato jātā rūpeṇā'pratimā śubhā..32..
meaning: देवी लक्ष्मीस्ततो जाता रूपेणाऽप्रतिमा शुभा..32..
text_mt: Then the goddess Lakṣmī was born, auspicious and incomparable in beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ śubhau tāmarasaprakāśau pādāmbujau spṛṣṭatalāṅgulīkau ..
jaṅghe śubhe romavivarjite ca gūḍhāsthikaṃ jānuyugaṃ suramyam .. 33 ..
meaning:
यस्याः शुभौ तामरसप्रकाशौ पादाम्बुजौ स्पृष्टतलाङ्गुलीकौ ..
जङ्घे शुभे रोमविवर्जिते च गूढास्थिकं जानुयुगं सुरम्यम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Her auspicious lotus feet shone like red water lilies, the toes touching the soles; / her shanks were auspicious and free of hair, and her knees lovely, with concealed bones.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇadaṇḍapratimau tathorū cābhogyaramyaṃ jaghanaṃ ghanaṃ ca ..
madhyaṃ suvṛttaṃ kuliśodarābhaṃ valitrayaṃ cāru śubhaṃ dadhānam ..34 ..
meaning:
सुवर्णदण्डप्रतिमौ तथोरू चाभोग्यरम्यं जघनं घनं च ..
मध्यं सुवृत्तं कुलिशोदराभं वलित्रयं चारु शुभं दधानम् ..34 ..
text_mt: Her thighs were like golden rods, and her expansive hips were lovely and solid; / her waist was well rounded, resembling the hollow of a vajra, bearing three lovely, auspicious folds.

sanskrit_iast:
uttuṅgamābhogi samaṃ viśālaṃ stanadvayaṃ cārusuvarṇavarṇam ..
bāhū suvṛttāvatikomalau ca karadvayaṃ padmadalāgrakānti .. 35 ..
meaning:
उत्तुङ्गमाभोगि समं विशालं स्तनद्वयं चारुसुवर्णवर्णम् ..
बाहू सुवृत्तावतिकोमलौ च करद्वयं पद्मदलाग्रकान्ति .. 35 ..
text_mt: Her pair of breasts was elevated, expansive, symmetrical, broad, and the colour of fine gold; / her arms were well rounded and very tender, and her hands had the lustre of lotus petals.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhañca śaṅkhāgranibhaṃ suramyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ samaṃ cāru sirāvihīnam ..
karṇau śubhau cāruśubhapramāṇau sampūrṇacandrapratimañca vaktram .. 36 ..
meaning:
कण्ठञ्च शङ्खाग्रनिभं सुरम्यं पृष्ठं समं चारु सिराविहीनम् ..
कर्णौ शुभौ चारुशुभप्रमाणौ सम्पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमञ्च वक्त्रम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Her lovely neck resembled the tip of a conch shell; her back was even, beautiful, and devoid of visible veins; / her auspicious ears were of fine and auspicious proportion, and her face resembled the full moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kundendutulyā daśanāstathoṣṭhau pravālakānāṃ pratipakṣabhūtau ..
spaṣṭā ca nāsā cibukaṃ ca ramyaṃ kapolayugmaṃ śaśitulyakānti .. 37 ..
meaning:
कुन्देन्दुतुल्या दशनास्तथोष्ठौ प्रवालकानां प्रतिपक्षभूतौ ..
स्पष्टा च नासा चिबुकं च रम्यं कपोलयुग्मं शशितुल्यकान्ति .. 37 ..
text_mt: Her teeth were like jasmine buds and the moon; her lips rivalled corals; / her nose was well defined, her chin lovely, and her two cheeks possessed radiance equal to the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
unnidranīlotpalasannikāśaṃ trivarṇamākarṇikamakṣiyugmam ..
śiroruhāḥ kuñcitanīladīrghā vīṇeva vāṇī madhurā śubhā ca .. 38 ..
meaning:
उन्निद्रनीलोत्पलसन्निकाशं त्रिवर्णमाकर्णिकमक्षियुग्मम् ..
शिरोरुहाः कुञ्चितनीलदीर्घा वीणेव वाणी मधुरा शुभा च .. 38 ..
text_mt: Her two eyes, extending to her ears, had three colours and resembled blooming blue lotuses; / her hair was curly, black, and long, and her voice was sweet and auspicious like a vīṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
vastre susūkṣme vimale dadhānā candrāṃśutulye'timanobhirāme ..
śrotradvayenāpyatha kuṇḍale ca saṃtānakānāṃ śirasā ca mālām .. 39 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रे सुसूक्ष्मे विमले दधाना चन्द्रांशुतुल्येऽतिमनोभिरामे ..
श्रोत्रद्वयेनाप्यथ कुण्डले च संतानकानां शिरसा च मालाम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Wearing two extremely fine, spotless garments resembling moonlight and exceedingly enchanting to the mind, / she wore two earrings in her ears and a garland of saṃtānaka flowers on her head.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāpravāhapratimañca hāraṃ kaṇṭhena śubhraṃ dadhatī suvṛttam .. 40 ..
tathāṅgadau ratnasahasracitrau haṃsasvanau cā'pyatha nūpūrau ca ..1.40.40..
meaning:
गङ्गाप्रवाहप्रतिमञ्च हारं कण्ठेन शुभ्रं दधती सुवृत्तम् .. 40 ..
तथाङ्गदौ रत्नसहस्रचित्रौ हंसस्वनौ चाऽप्यथ नूपूरौ च ..1.40.40..
text_mt:
Around her neck she wore a white, well-rounded necklace / that resembled the flow of the Ganges.
Likewise, [she wore] armlets bright with thousands of jewels, / and anklets that sounded like swans.

sanskrit_iast:
kareṇa padmaṃ bhramaropagītaṃ vaiḍūryanālañca śubhaṃ gṛhītvā ..
svarūpamūḍheṣu surāsureṣu dṛṣṭiṃ dadau cārumanobhirāmā ..41..
meaning:
करेण पद्मं भ्रमरोपगीतं वैडूर्यनालञ्च शुभं गृहीत्वा ..
स्वरूपमूढेषु सुरासुरेषु दृष्टिं ददौ चारुमनोभिरामा ..41..
text_mt: Holding in her hand an auspicious lotus with a lapis stem, sung to by bees, / she, enchanting and captivating to the mind, cast her gaze upon the gods and asuras who were bewildered by her form.

sanskrit_iast:
sā devasaṃghānasurāṃśca dṛṣṭvā dadarśa devaṃ jagatāṃ pradhānam ..
devāsurebhyastvatiriktarūpaṃ sūryāyutābhaṃ bhuvaneṣvajeyam ..42 ..
meaning:
सा देवसंघानसुरांश्च दृष्ट्वा ददर्श देवं जगतां प्रधानम् ..
देवासुरेभ्यस्त्वतिरिक्तरूपं सूर्यायुताभं भुवनेष्वजेयम् ..42 ..
text_mt: Looking upon the hosts of gods and asuras, she saw the god, the foremost of the worlds, / surpassing the gods and asuras in beauty, radiant as ten thousand suns, invincible across the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
unnidranīlanalinadyuticāruvarṇaṃ saṃtaptahāṭakanibhe vasane vasānam ..
dṛṣṭvaiva jātapulakodgamamātrakampā kṣīrābdhijā madanabāṇavaśaṃ jagāma .. 43..
meaning:
उन्निद्रनीलनलिनद्युतिचारुवर्णं संतप्तहाटकनिभे वसने वसानम् ..
दृष्ट्वैव जातपुलकोद्गममात्रकम्पा क्षीराब्धिजा मदनबाणवशं जगाम .. 43..
text_mt: Having seen him whose lovely complexion had the brilliance of a blooming blue lotus, who was clad in garments resembling heated gold, / the ocean-born [goddess], trembling merely from the rising of goosebumps that arose [in her], fell under the sway of Love’s arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuruvāca ..
sā kāmabāṇābhihatā samīkṣya madhusūdanam ..
svayaṃ vṛtavatī nāthaṃ bhartāramaparājitam ..1..
meaning:
राहुरुवाच ..
सा कामबाणाभिहता समीक्ष्य मधुसूदनम् ..
स्वयं वृतवती नाथं भर्तारमपराजितम् ..1..
text_mt: Rāhu said: / Struck by Love's arrows upon beholding Madhusūdana, / she herself chose the lord, the unconquered husband.
title: Mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'mṛtamanthanam

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtissā vinirdiṣṭā puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ..
tayā viyujyate nā'sau kadācidapi śatruhā ..2..
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्सा विनिर्दिष्टा पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमः ..
तया वियुज्यते नाऽसौ कदाचिदपि शत्रुहा ..2..
text_mt: She is designated as Prakṛti, and the Cosmic Person is Puruṣottama; / never is he, the slayer of foes, separated from her.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkaraḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiḥ pārvatī smṛtā ..
puruṣaḥ pākahā proktaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā śacī ..3.
meaning:
शंकरः पुरुषः प्रोक्तः प्रकृतिः पार्वती स्मृता ..
पुरुषः पाकहा प्रोक्तः प्रकृतिश्च तथा शची ..3.
text_mt: Śaṃkara is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and Pārvatī is remembered as Prakṛti; / the slayer of Pāka is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and likewise Śacī is Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśanaśca puruṣaḥ svāhā ca prakṛtiḥ smṛtā ..
yamaśca puruṣaḥ prokto dhūmorṇā prakṛtiḥ smṛtā .. 4 ..
meaning:
हुताशनश्च पुरुषः स्वाहा च प्रकृतिः स्मृता ..
यमश्च पुरुषः प्रोक्तो धूमोर्णा प्रकृतिः स्मृता .. 4 ..
text_mt: The fire-consumer is the Cosmic Person, and Svāhā is remembered as Prakṛti; / Yama is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and Dhūmorṇā is remembered as Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
virūpākṣaśca puruṣaḥ prakṛtirnirṛtiḥ smṛtā ..
varuṇaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto gaurī ca prakṛtistathā .. 5 ..
meaning:
विरूपाक्षश्च पुरुषः प्रकृतिर्निरृतिः स्मृता ..
वरुणः पुरुषः प्रोक्तो गौरी च प्रकृतिस्तथा .. 5 ..
text_mt: Virūpākṣa is the Cosmic Person, and Nirṛti is remembered as Prakṛti; / Varuṇa is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and likewise Gaurī is Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuśca puruṣo jñeyaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā śivā ..
puruṣaśca dharmo vṛkṣastadviśvaprakṛtiḥ smṛtā .. 6 ..
meaning:
वायुश्च पुरुषो ज्ञेयः प्रकृतिश्च तथा शिवा ..
पुरुषश्च धर्मो वृक्षस्तद्विश्वप्रकृतिः स्मृता .. 6 ..
text_mt: Vāyu is to be known as the Cosmic Person, and Śivā is likewise Prakṛti; / Dharma is the tree as the Cosmic Person, and the entire universe is remembered as Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
candramā puruṣaḥ prokto jyotsnā ca prakṛtistathā..
dharmaśca puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiśca karīṣiṇī.. 7 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रमा पुरुषः प्रोक्तो ज्योत्स्ना च प्रकृतिस्तथा..
धर्मश्च पुरुषः प्रोक्तः प्रकृतिश्च करीषिणी.. 7 ..
text_mt: The moon is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and moonlight is likewise Prakṛti; / Dharma is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and Karīṣiṇī is Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaśca puruṣaḥ prokto dakṣiṇā prakṛtistathā ..
divasaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto prakṛtiśca tathā niśā .. 8 ..
meaning:
यज्ञश्च पुरुषः प्रोक्तो दक्षिणा प्रकृतिस्तथा ..
दिवसः पुरुषः प्रोक्तो प्रकृतिश्च तथा निशा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Sacrifice is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and dakṣiṇā is likewise Prakṛti; / the day is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and night is likewise Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśaḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ prakṛtiśca tathā mahī ..
oṃkāraḥ puruṣaḥ proktaḥ sāvitrī prakṛtiḥ smṛtāḥ ..9..
meaning:
आकाशः पुरुषः प्रोक्तः प्रकृतिश्च तथा मही ..
ओंकारः पुरुषः प्रोक्तः सावित्री प्रकृतिः स्मृताः ..9..
text_mt: The sky is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and the earth is likewise Prakṛti; / the Praṇava is declared to be the Cosmic Person, and Sāvitrī is remembered as Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiḥ sā śubhā lakṣmīrviṣṇuḥ puruṣa ucyate ..
sā sadehā videhā sā saguṇā nirguṇā ca sā .. 1.41.10 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतिः सा शुभा लक्ष्मीर्विष्णुः पुरुष उच्यते ..
सा सदेहा विदेहा सा सगुणा निर्गुणा च सा .. 1.41.10 ..
text_mt: The auspicious Lakṣmī is Prakṛti, and Viṣṇu is called the Cosmic Person; / she is embodied and disembodied, endowed with qualities and free of qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ..
sā kāntiḥ sā dhṛtiḥ sā śrīḥ sā prabhā ca sanātanī .. 11 ..
meaning:
तया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ..
सा कान्तिः सा धृतिः सा श्रीः सा प्रभा च सनातनी .. 11 ..
text_mt: By her all this three worlds, moving and unmoving, is pervaded; / she is splendour, she is resolve, she is fortune, and she is eternal radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
sā nidrā sā śubhā vāṇī sā ca devī sarasvatī ..
ratiḥ prītiḥ kṣitirdyauśca sā gaṃgā sā sarasvatī .. 12 ..
meaning:
सा निद्रा सा शुभा वाणी सा च देवी सरस्वती ..
रतिः प्रीतिः क्षितिर्द्यौश्च सा गंगा सा सरस्वती .. 12 ..
text_mt: She is sleep, she is auspicious speech, and she is the goddess Sarasvatī; / [she is] pleasure, affection, earth, and heaven; she is the Ganges and she is Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirvapuḥ prajñā svadhā medhā sarasvatī ..
saiva nadyaḥ śubhā sarvāḥ saiva devī vanaspatī .. 13 ..
meaning:
तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्वपुः प्रज्ञा स्वधा मेधा सरस्वती ..
सैव नद्यः शुभा सर्वाः सैव देवी वनस्पती .. 13 ..
text_mt: Contentment, nourishment, bodily form, wisdom, the ancestral oblation, intelligence, Sarasvatī— / she alone is all the auspicious rivers, and she is the goddess of trees.

sanskrit_iast:
sā vāstudevatā dīkṣā sā bhaktirvaiṣṇavī smṛtā ..
buddhirlajjā dhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ sudhā śobhā jayā tvirā .. 14 ..
meaning:
सा वास्तुदेवता दीक्षा सा भक्तिर्वैष्णवी स्मृता ..
बुद्धिर्लज्जा धृतिः शान्तिः सुधा शोभा जया त्विरा .. 14 ..
text_mt: She is the deity of the dwelling, initiation, and she is remembered as Vaiṣṇava devotion; / discernment, shame, resolve, peace, nectar, splendour, Jayā, and Irā.

sanskrit_iast:
sinīvālī kuhū rākā tvevaṃ cānumatiḥ śubhā ..
kātyāyanī bhadrakālī suprabhā vijayā tathā .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
सिनीवाली कुहू राका त्वेवं चानुमतिः शुभा ..
कात्यायनी भद्रकाली सुप्रभा विजया तथा .. .. 15 ..
text_mt: Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Rākā, and likewise auspicious Anumati; / Kātyāyanī, Bhadrakālī, Suprabhā, and likewise Vijayā;

sanskrit_iast:
aditirditirdanuḥ kālā snāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ ..
kadrū krodhā tvirā prāvā vinatā surabhiḥ khagā .. 16 ..
meaning:
अदितिर्दितिर्दनुः काला स्नायुः सिंहिका मुनिः ..
कद्रू क्रोधा त्विरा प्रावा विनता सुरभिः खगा .. 16 ..
text_mt: Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kālā, Snāyu, Siṃhikā, Muni, / Kadrū, Krodhā, Irā, Prāvā, Vinatā, Surabhi, Khagā;

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā kṣamā śraddhā kriyā ratiḥ ..
anasūyā satī bhūtirvibhūtirvāruṇī tathā .. 17 ..
meaning:
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्धृतिर्मेधा क्षमा श्रद्धा क्रिया रतिः ..
अनसूया सती भूतिर्विभूतिर्वारुणी तथा .. 17 ..
text_mt: Fame, fortune, resolve, intelligence, patience, faith, action, pleasure, / Anasūyā, Satī, prosperity, abundance, and likewise Vāruṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatī vasurjāmī lobhā bhānurarundhatī ..
saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā tathaiva ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
अरुन्धती वसुर्जामी लोभा भानुररुन्धती ..
संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वा तथैव च .. 18 ..
text_mt: Arundhatī, Vasu, Jāmī, Lobhā, Bhānu, Arundhatī, / Saṃkalpā, Muhūrtā, Sādhyā, and likewise Viśvā;

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgā ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā yuvā tviḍā ..
bhūtā ca kapilā daṃṣṭrī saramā suramā tathā .. 19 ..
meaning:
मृगा च मृगमन्दा च हरिभद्रा युवा त्विडा ..
भूता च कपिला दंष्ट्री सरमा सुरमा तथा .. 19 ..
text_mt: Mṛgā, Mṛgamandā, Haribhadrā, Yuvā, Iḍā, / Bhūtā, Kapilā, Daṃṣṭrī, Saramā, and likewise Suramā.

sanskrit_iast:
rājaśrīrbhūmipālānāṃ brahmaśrīstadvidāṃ śubhā ..
puṣpaśrīḥ kānanānāṃ sā jayaśrīrjayināṃ raṇe .. 1.41.20 ..
meaning:
राजश्रीर्भूमिपालानां ब्रह्मश्रीस्तद्विदां शुभा ..
पुष्पश्रीः काननानां सा जयश्रीर्जयिनां रणे .. 1.41.20 ..
text_mt: She is the royal fortune of kings, the auspicious fortune of sacred lore among those who know it, / the floral fortune of forests, and the fortune of victory for victors in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaśrīḥ svargatānāṃ sā dīkṣā sā yajñayājinām ..
buddhirbuddhimatāṃ devī kṣamā devī kṣamāvatām .. 21 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गश्रीः स्वर्गतानां सा दीक्षा सा यज्ञयाजिनाम् ..
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतां देवी क्षमा देवी क्षमावताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: She is the heavenly fortune of those who have reached heaven; she is the initiation of sacrifice-performers; / she is the goddess of discernment among the discerning, and the goddess of forgiveness among the forgiving.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhā vahnau prabhā sūrye jyotsnā candre prakīrtitā ..
kāntistārāgaṇasyoktā sā siddhiḥ sarvakarmaṇām .. 22 ..
meaning:
शिखा वह्नौ प्रभा सूर्ये ज्योत्स्ना चन्द्रे प्रकीर्तिता ..
कान्तिस्तारागणस्योक्ता सा सिद्धिः सर्वकर्मणाम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: She is proclaimed as the flame in fire, radiance in the sun, moonlight in the moon, / the splendour of the stars, and the success of all undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasranetrajā dṛṣṭiḥ sahasranayanasya sā ..
upatyakā parvatānāṃ phalaśrīḥ sā ca śākhinām .. 23 ..
meaning:
सहस्रनेत्रजा दृष्टिः सहस्रनयनस्य सा ..
उपत्यका पर्वतानां फलश्रीः सा च शाखिनाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: She is the thousand-eyed vision of the thousand-eyed [Indra], / the valley of mountains, and the wealth of fruit on trees.

sanskrit_iast:
mahodadheśca sā velā nakṣatrāṇāñca kṛttikā ..
dhanurlatā ca mantrāṇāṃ hetīnāṃ cāpyaserlatā .. 24 ..
meaning:
महोदधेश्च सा वेला नक्षत्राणाञ्च कृत्तिका ..
धनुर्लता च मन्त्राणां हेतीनां चाप्यसेर्लता .. 24 ..
text_mt: She is the shore of the great ocean and the Kṛttikās among constellations, / the slender bow of mantras, and the creeping blade of swords among weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
gāndhārī sarvavidyānāṃ vṛṣṭiḥ sā jagatītale ..
kārṣakāṇāṃ tathā sītā sasya śobhā mahītale .. 25 ..
meaning:
गान्धारी सर्वविद्यानां वृष्टिः सा जगतीतले ..
कार्षकाणां तथा सीता सस्य शोभा महीतले .. 25 ..
text_mt: She is the Gāndhārī among all sciences, the rain upon the surface of the earth, / the furrow of farmers, and the beauty of crops on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
madalekhā ca nāgānāṃ bhogināñca phaṇāvalī ..
ratnāvalī ca śeṣasya dhṛtirbhūmaṇḍalasya sā .. 26 ..
meaning:
मदलेखा च नागानां भोगिनाञ्च फणावली ..
रत्नावली च शेषस्य धृतिर्भूमण्डलस्य सा .. 26 ..
text_mt: She is the rutting streak of elephants, the row of hoods of serpents, / the row of jewels of Śeṣa, and the support of the earthly orb.

sanskrit_iast:
sā sthitā satataṃ candre bilve nīlotpale vṛṣe ..
kuñjare turage siṃhe khaṅge ca vimale śubhe .. 27 ..
meaning:
सा स्थिता सततं चन्द्रे बिल्वे नीलोत्पले वृषे ..
कुञ्जरे तुरगे सिंहे खङ्गे च विमले शुभे .. 27 ..
text_mt: She is ever present in the moon, the bilva tree, the blue lotus, the bull, / the elephant, the horse, the lion, and the spotless, auspicious sword;

sanskrit_iast:
cāmare vyajane chatre bhṛṃgāre gomaye vane ..
sahasrakiraṇe sūrye śakre vaiśravaṇe yame .. 28 ..
meaning:
चामरे व्यजने छत्रे भृंगारे गोमये वने ..
सहस्रकिरणे सूर्ये शक्रे वैश्रवणे यमे .. 28 ..
text_mt: in the fly-whisk, the fan, the umbrella, the water-jar, cow dung, the forest, / in the thousand-rayed sun, Śakra, Vaiśravaṇa, and Yama;

sanskrit_iast:
kamale rajate hemni śaṃkhe bhadrāsane śubhe ..
gomūtre sarpiṣi kṣīre dadhi kṣīraphaleṣu ca .. 29 ..
meaning:
कमले रजते हेम्नि शंखे भद्रासने शुभे ..
गोमूत्रे सर्पिषि क्षीरे दधि क्षीरफलेषु च .. 29 ..
text_mt: in the lotus, silver, gold, the conch shell, the auspicious throne, / cow's urine, clarified butter, milk, curd, and milky fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇe ca jalādhyakṣe samudreṣu jaleṣu ca ..
kusumeṣu ca śukleṣu prāsādeṣu siteṣu ca .. 1.41.30 ..
meaning:
वरुणे च जलाध्यक्षे समुद्रेषु जलेषु च ..
कुसुमेषु च शुक्लेषु प्रासादेषु सितेषु च .. 1.41.30 ..
text_mt: in Varuṇa, the lord of waters, in the oceans and waters, / in white flowers, and in white palaces;

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśane prajvalite pārthive cāruśobhite ..
ratneṣu ca vicitreṣu tathaivāmalakeṣu ca .. 31 ..
meaning:
हुताशने प्रज्वलिते पार्थिवे चारुशोभिते ..
रत्नेषु च विचित्रेषु तथैवामलकेषु च .. 31 ..
text_mt: in blazing fire, in a beautifully adorned king, / in multicolored jewels, and likewise in āmalaka fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ devadevena śārṅgiṇā ..
tathā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ rājan kṣīrābdhikanyayā .. 32 ..
meaning:
यथा व्याप्तं जगत्सर्वं देवदेवेन शार्ङ्गिणा ..
तथा व्याप्तं जगत्सर्वं राजन् क्षीराब्धिकन्यया .. 32 ..
text_mt: Just as the entire universe is pervaded by the god of gods who wields the Śārṅga bow, / so too, O king, is the entire universe pervaded by the daughter of the ocean of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuve'ntare devī bhṛgoḥ sā duhitā smṛtā ..
svārociṣe tathā jātā saiva devī hutāśanāt .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्वायंभुवेऽन्तरे देवी भृगोः सा दुहिता स्मृता ..
स्वारोचिषे तथा जाता सैव देवी हुताशनात् .. 33 ..
text_mt: In the Svāyambhuva manvantara, that goddess was known as the daughter of Bhṛgu; / and in the Svārociṣa, the same goddess was born from fire.

sanskrit_iast:
auttamasyāntare jātā salilādvimalācchubhā ..
tāmasasyāntare rājan bhūtalātsā samutthitā .. 34 ..
meaning:
औत्तमस्यान्तरे जाता सलिलाद्विमलाच्छुभा ..
तामसस्यान्तरे राजन् भूतलात्सा समुत्थिता .. 34 ..
text_mt: In the manvantara of Auttama, she was born, pure and auspicious, from water; / in the manvantara of Tāmasa, O king, she arose from the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvātsamutthitā devī raivatasyāntare tathā ..
utphullakamalodbhūtā cākṣuṣe'pi tathāntare .. 35 ..
meaning:
बिल्वात्समुत्थिता देवी रैवतस्यान्तरे तथा ..
उत्फुल्लकमलोद्भूता चाक्षुषेऽपि तथान्तरे .. 35 ..
text_mt: In the manvantara of Raivata, the goddess arose from a bilva tree; / and likewise in the Cākṣuṣa manvantara, she was born from a blooming lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvate'ntare jātā tathaivā'mṛtamanthanāt ..
kṣīrābdhijātāṃ tāṃ prāpya hṛdayena janārdanaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे जाता तथैवाऽमृतमन्थनात् ..
क्षीराब्धिजातां तां प्राप्य हृदयेन जनार्दनः .. 36 ..
text_mt: In the Vaivasvata manvantara, she was born from the churning of the nectar. / Having obtained her who was born from the ocean of milk, Janārdana / held her against his chest—

sanskrit_iast:
dadhāra durdharāṃ devīṃ trailokye tamṛte prabhum ..
ādāya sā'mṛtaṃ śuddhaṃ śubhamarkakamaṇḍalum .. 37 ..
meaning:
दधार दुर्धरां देवीं त्रैलोक्ये तमृते प्रभुम् ..
आदाय साऽमृतं शुद्धं शुभमर्ककमण्डलुम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: the goddess hard to bear in the three worlds by anyone except that Lord. / Holding the pure, auspicious nectar in a sun-bright water-pot,

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare jāto vaidyo dhanvantaristathā ..
amṛte jātamātre tu daityasaṃghāḥ samākulāḥ .. .. 38 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जातो वैद्यो धन्वन्तरिस्तथा ..
अमृते जातमात्रे तु दैत्यसंघाः समाकुलाः .. .. 38 ..
text_mt: at that moment the physician Dhanvantari was born. / But as soon as the nectar appeared, the hosts of Daityas were agitated.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvantarimathonmathya paribhūya ca devatāḥ ..
amṛtaṃ ca samādāya jagmurdaityā niveśanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
धन्वन्तरिमथोन्मथ्य परिभूय च देवताः ..
अमृतं च समादाय जग्मुर्दैत्या निवेशनम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Then, having harassed Dhanvantari and overpowered the deities, / the Daityas seized the nectar and departed for their abode.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtāmṛtāndevagaṇānvipānānāśvāsya devo bhuvanasya goptā ..
sthāne ca vinyasya girīndramukhyaṃ jagāma devo'suranāthaveśma .. 1.41.40 ..
meaning:
हृतामृतान्देवगणान्विपानानाश्वास्य देवो भुवनस्य गोप्ता ..
स्थाने च विन्यस्य गिरीन्द्रमुख्यं जगाम देवोऽसुरनाथवेश्म .. 1.41.40 ..
text_mt: Comforting the hosts of gods, whose nectar had been stolen and who were denied their drink, / the god who protects the universe, having set the foremost of majestic mountains back in its place, went to the abode of the lord of the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
.. rāhuruvāca .. ..
babhūva nārī kalyāṇī sa devo madhusūdanaḥ ..
anirdeśyavayorūpā sarvalakṣaṇapūjitā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. राहुरुवाच .. ..
बभूव नारी कल्याणी स देवो मधुसूदनः ..
अनिर्देश्यवयोरूपा सर्वलक्षणपूजिता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāhu said: / That god, the slayer of Madhu, became an auspicious woman / of indescribable youth and form, endowed with every auspicious mark.
title: Mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'mṛtavibhāgaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
samāṃgulitalau ślakṣṇau raktatuṃganakhā śubhau ..
vibhṛte caraṇau śubhrau gūḍhagulpho manoharau .. .. 2 ..
meaning:
समांगुलितलौ श्लक्ष्णौ रक्ततुंगनखा शुभौ ..
विभृते चरणौ शुभ्रौ गूढगुल्फो मनोहरौ .. .. 2 ..
text_mt: She possessed two feet: charming and fair, with even toes and soles, smooth, / with raised red nails, auspicious, and with ankles concealed.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṃghe manohare śubhre spaṣṭe lomavivarjite ..
gṛhasaṃdhyasthike ślakṣṇe jānunī ca tathā śubhe .. 3 ..
meaning:
जंघे मनोहरे शुभ्रे स्पष्टे लोमविवर्जिते ..
गृहसंध्यस्थिके श्लक्ष्णे जानुनी च तथा शुभे .. 3 ..
text_mt: Her shanks were captivating, fair, well-proportioned, free of hair, / with smooth bones hidden at the joints, and her knees likewise were auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrū karikarākārau kadalīdalakomalau ..
ghanamābhogi jaghanaṃ madhyaṃ kuliśasannibham .. 4 ..
meaning:
ऊरू करिकराकारौ कदलीदलकोमलौ ..
घनमाभोगि जघनं मध्यं कुलिशसन्निभम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Her thighs were shaped like an elephant's trunk, tender as plantain leaves; / her hips were plump and expansive, and her waist resembled a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
trivalītripathādhārinābhīpuṣkaramaṃḍitam ..
gūḍhasphike same pārśve samaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ manoramam .. 5 ..
meaning:
त्रिवलीत्रिपथाधारिनाभीपुष्करमंडितम् ..
गूढस्फिके समे पार्श्वे समं पृष्ठं मनोरमम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: She was adorned with a lotus-like navel holding the three folds [of the belly] like three streams; / her buttocks were concealed, her flanks symmetrical, and her back even and charming.

sanskrit_iast:
samau susaṃhatau pīnau komalāvagracūcukau ..
ābhoginau maṇḍalinau stanau kanakasannibhau .. .. 6 ..
meaning:
समौ सुसंहतौ पीनौ कोमलावग्रचूचुकौ ..
आभोगिनौ मण्डलिनौ स्तनौ कनकसन्निभौ .. .. 6 ..
text_mt: Her breasts were even, closely set, plump, tender, with prominent nipples, / expansive, rounded, and golden in hue.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṇālasadṛśau bāhū karau komalakomalau ..
kambutulyaṃ śubhaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ connatā ca kṛkāṭikā .. 7 ..
meaning:
मृणालसदृशौ बाहू करौ कोमलकोमलौ ..
कम्बुतुल्यं शुभं कण्ठं चोन्नता च कृकाटिका .. 7 ..
text_mt: Her arms resembled lotus stalks, and her hands were exceedingly tender; / her throat was auspicious and conch-like, and the nape of her neck was elevated.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaṃ pūrṇendusaṃkāśaṃ dvijāḥ kundasamaprabhāḥ ..
adharau vidrumākārau nāsā spaṣṭamanoramā .. 8 ..
meaning:
मुखं पूर्णेन्दुसंकाशं द्विजाः कुन्दसमप्रभाः ..
अधरौ विद्रुमाकारौ नासा स्पष्टमनोरमा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Her face resembled the full moon, her teeth shone like jasmine flowers, / her lips had the shape of coral, and her nose was prominent and charming.

sanskrit_iast:
madhūkapuṣpasaṃkāśau kapolau lalitāvubhau ..
bhrūyugmaṃ kāmacāpāntasadṛśaṃ sumanoharam .. 9 ..
meaning:
मधूकपुष्पसंकाशौ कपोलौ ललितावुभौ ..
भ्रूयुग्मं कामचापान्तसदृशं सुमनोहरम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Both her cheeks were lovely, resembling madhūka blossoms; / her pair of eyebrows, resembling the tips of the bow of Kāma, was exceedingly alluring.

sanskrit_iast:
nātipralambau śravaṇau nātyacārū ca kuṇḍalau ..
cibukaṃ ca manohāri lalāṭaṃ śaśisuprabham .. 1.42.10 ..
meaning:
नातिप्रलम्बौ श्रवणौ नात्यचारू च कुण्डलौ ..
चिबुकं च मनोहारि ललाटं शशिसुप्रभम् .. 1.42.10 ..
text_mt: Her ears were not overly long, her earrings were exceedingly beautiful, / her chin was captivating, and her forehead had the fair radiance of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamadhye suraktānte nayane śvetabhūmike ..
nīlotpaladalākāre dīrghe cā'timanorame .. 11 ..
meaning:
कृष्णमध्ये सुरक्तान्ते नयने श्वेतभूमिके ..
नीलोत्पलदलाकारे दीर्घे चाऽतिमनोरमे .. 11 ..
text_mt: Her eyes had black centres, bright red corners, and white sclera; / shaped like blue lotus petals, they were long and exceedingly charming.

sanskrit_iast:
kokilā'likulākāraṃ bhinnāñjanacayaprabham ..
keśapāśaṃ tathā kiṃciddadhāra kuṭilaṃ śubham .. 12 ..
meaning:
कोकिलाऽलिकुलाकारं भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रभम् ..
केशपाशं तथा किंचिद्दधार कुटिलं शुभम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: She bore an auspicious mass of hair that was slightly curly, / having the hue of a cuckoo or a swarm of bees, and glowing like crushed collyrium.

sanskrit_iast: candraraśmiprakāśena vastrayugmena bhūṣitā .. 13
meaning: चन्द्ररश्मिप्रकाशेन वस्त्रयुग्मेन भूषिता .. 13
text_mt: She was adorned with a pair of garments shining like moonbeams.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpeṇāpratimā rājansarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā ..
yatrayatra padanyāsaṃ karoti gajagāminī .. 14 ..
meaning:
रूपेणाप्रतिमा राजन्सर्वालंकारभूषिता ..
यत्रयत्र पदन्यासं करोति गजगामिनी .. 14 ..
text_mt: Incomparable in beauty, O king, and adorned with every ornament, / wherever that woman who walked like an elephant placed her foot,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatraiva vasudhā sapadmevopalakṣyate ..
yatrayatrā'timadhurāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipati bhāmini .. 15 ..
meaning:
तत्र तत्रैव वसुधा सपद्मेवोपलक्ष्यते ..
यत्रयत्राऽतिमधुरां दृष्टिं क्षिपति भामिनि .. 15 ..
text_mt: there indeed the earth appeared as though covered with lotuses; / and wherever that lovely woman cast her exceedingly sweet glance,

sanskrit_iast:
sitāsitotpalaistatra kiratīva vasuṃdharām ..
yatrayatra sthitā bhāti deśe kanakavarṇinī .. 16 ..
meaning:
सितासितोत्पलैस्तत्र किरतीव वसुंधराम् ..
यत्रयत्र स्थिता भाति देशे कनकवर्णिनी .. 16 ..
text_mt: there she seemed to strew the earth with white and blue lotuses; / and in whatever place that golden-complexioned woman stood shining,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatraiva sauvarṇaṃ sā karoti nabhastalam ..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṃgī manmathāviṣṭacetasaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
तत्र तत्रैव सौवर्णं सा करोति नभस्तलम् ..
तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वांगी मन्मथाविष्टचेतसः .. 17 ..
text_mt: there indeed she turned the vault of the sky golden. / Seeing her whose every limb was beautiful, their minds overcome by desire,

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādarahitāḥ sarve babhūvurdānavāstadā ..
pādayoḥ pṛthivīṃ tasyā dhṛtiṃ devīṃ ca jaṅghayoḥ ..18..
meaning:
प्रह्लादरहिताः सर्वे बभूवुर्दानवास्तदा ..
पादयोः पृथिवीं तस्या धृतिं देवीं च जङ्घयोः ..18..
text_mt: all the Dānavas then became devoid of joy [except Prahlāda]. / Prahlāda saw the earth in her two feet, the goddess Dhṛti in her shanks,

sanskrit_iast:
jānubhyāṃ ca tathā kṣāntiṃ kāntimūruyuge śubhe ..
āyatiṃ niyatiṃ lakṣmīṃ velāṃ tu jaghane tathā ..19..
meaning:
जानुभ्यां च तथा क्षान्तिं कान्तिमूरुयुगे शुभे ..
आयतिं नियतिं लक्ष्मीं वेलां तु जघने तथा ..19..
text_mt: and likewise Kṣānti in her knees, beauty in her two auspicious thighs, / Āyati, Niyati, Lakṣmī, and Velā in her hips,

sanskrit_iast:
madhye vāhāṃ satīṃ pṛṣṭhe pārśvayośca sudhāṃ mukhe ..
ratiṃ prītiṃ kucayuge kaṇṭhe vāṇīṃ tathaiva ca .. 1.42.20 ..
meaning:
मध्ये वाहां सतीं पृष्ठे पार्श्वयोश्च सुधां मुखे ..
रतिं प्रीतिं कुचयुगे कण्ठे वाणीं तथैव च .. 1.42.20 ..
text_mt: Vāhā in her waist, Satī on her back, nectar in her cheeks and mouth, / Rati and Prīti upon her pair of breasts, and speech in her throat;

sanskrit_iast:
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva karayorbhujayostathā ..
śobhāṃ prabhāṃ vakṣasi ca śriyaṃ devīṃ manoramām .. 21 ..
meaning:
जयां च विजयां चैव करयोर्भुजयोस्तथा ..
शोभां प्रभां वक्षसि च श्रियं देवीं मनोरमाम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Jayā and Vijayā in her hands and arms, / Śobhā, Prabhā, and the charming goddess Śrī upon her chest;

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatīṃ ca cibuke jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatīm ..
jyotsnāṃ kapolayordevīṃ nidrāṃ netrayuge tathā .. 22 ..
meaning:
