अरुन्धतीं च चिबुके जिह्वायां च सरस्वतीम् ..
ज्योत्स्नां कपोलयोर्देवीं निद्रां नेत्रयुगे तथा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Arundhatī on her chin, Sarasvatī on her tongue, / the goddess Jyotsnā on her cheeks, and Nidrā in her pair of eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
keśapāśe tathā rātriṃ diśaṃ śrotrayuge tathā ..
bhadrakālīṃ lalāṭe ca nāsāyāṃ ca tathā śacīm .. 23 ..
meaning:
केशपाशे तथा रात्रिं दिशं श्रोत्रयुगे तथा ..
भद्रकालीं ललाटे च नासायां च तथा शचीम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Night in her mass of hair, the directions in her pair of ears, / Bhadrakālī on her forehead, and Śacī on her nose;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgasandhigā nadyo lomasvatha vanaspatim ..
pārśvayoḥ parvatāścaiva daityeśaḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गसन्धिगा नद्यो लोमस्वथ वनस्पतिम् ..
पार्श्वयोः पर्वताश्चैव दैत्येशः सर्वदेवताः .. 24 ..
text_mt: rivers in all the joints of her limbs, trees in her body hairs, / and mountains on her flanks—that lord of the Daityas [saw] all the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavānstrītanuṃ tatra prahlādo'rikulāntakaḥ ..
viśvarūpadharāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahlādastāśca yoṣitam .. 25 ..
meaning:
दृष्टवान्स्त्रीतनुं तत्र प्रह्लादोऽरिकुलान्तकः ..
विश्वरूपधरां दृष्ट्वा प्रह्लादस्ताश्च योषितम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Prahlāda, the slayer of hosts of foes, saw that female form; / seeing that woman who bore the universal form, Prahlāda...

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ matvā viśālākṣīṃ jñātvā caivā'mṛtārthinīm ..
kāmārttadaityānumataḥ prahlādo daityasattama .. 26 ..
meaning:
विष्णुं मत्वा विशालाक्षीं ज्ञात्वा चैवाऽमृतार्थिनीम् ..
कामार्त्तदैत्यानुमतः प्रह्लादो दैत्यसत्तम .. 26 ..
text_mt: Recognising that wide-eyed one as Viṣṇu and knowing she desired the nectar, / approved by the lust-afflicted daityas, Prahlāda, best of daityas,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadāvamṛtaṃ tasyai praṇipatya prasādya ca ..
strīrūpamāsthitaidevaistrailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रददावमृतं तस्यै प्रणिपत्य प्रसाद्य च ..
स्त्रीरूपमास्थितैदेवैस्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: bowed down, propitiated her, and gave the nectar to her. / Taking on a female form, by the gods the three worlds with mobile and immobile beings

sanskrit_iast:
strīceṣṭamabhavatsarvaṃ tasminkāla upasthite ..
uvāca sā strī prahrādaṃ daitya tvamamṛtaṃ vinā .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्त्रीचेष्टमभवत्सर्वं तस्मिन्काल उपस्थिते ..
उवाच सा स्त्री प्रह्रादं दैत्य त्वममृतं विना .. 28 ..
text_mt: all became moved by the woman, when that time arrived. / That woman spoke to Prahlāda: "O daitya, even without the nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmamekamaha saumya jīvitānna vimokṣyase ..
yoddhumabhyuditā daityadevairditijakāraṇāt .. 29 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्ममेकमह सौम्य जीवितान्न विमोक्ष्यसे ..
योद्धुमभ्युदिता दैत्यदेवैर्दितिजकारणात् .. 29 ..
text_mt: you will not be parted from life for one single day of Brahmā, gentle one. / The daityas have risen up to fight with the gods on account of Diti’s sons;

sanskrit_iast:
na prabodhyāstamoyuktāstvayā daitya janārdanā ..
bhaktosi me sadā vatsa sadaiva vijitendriyaḥ .. 1.42.30 ..
meaning:
न प्रबोध्यास्तमोयुक्तास्त्वया दैत्य जनार्दना ..
भक्तोसि मे सदा वत्स सदैव विजितेन्द्रियः .. 1.42.30 ..
text_mt: engrossed in darkness, they must not be awakened by you, O daitya Janārdana! / You are always devoted to me, my child, and forever self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
tena te darśitā saumya prakṛtiryā parā mama ..
ityevamuktvā prahlādaṃ somamādāya satvarā .. 31 ..
meaning:
तेन ते दर्शिता सौम्य प्रकृतिर्या परा मम ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा प्रह्लादं सोममादाय सत्वरा .. 31 ..
text_mt: Therefore my supreme nature has been revealed to you, gentle one." / Having thus spoken to Prahlāda and swiftly taken the soma,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmārttānditijām̐styaktvā jagāma suramandiram ..
strīrūpaṃ tatra saṃtyajya devarūpamupāśritaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
कामार्त्तान्दितिजाम्̐स्त्यक्त्वा जगाम सुरमन्दिरम् ..
स्त्रीरूपं तत्र संत्यज्य देवरूपमुपाश्रितः .. 32 ..
text_mt: she abandoned the passion-stricken sons of Diti and went to the dwelling of the gods. / Renouncing the female form there, adopting the divine form,

sanskrit_iast:
pāyayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ surānsarvānsamāhitān ..
mayā'pi madhye devānāṃ pītaṃ tatsūryarūpiṇā .. 33 ..
meaning:
पाययामास तत्सर्वं सुरान्सर्वान्समाहितान् ..
मयाऽपि मध्ये देवानां पीतं तत्सूर्यरूपिणा .. 33 ..
text_mt: he made all the gods drink it entirely, attentive [in their ranks]. / In the midst of the gods it was drunk by me as well, assuming the form of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityarūpe daityo'yaṃ jñāto'haṃ śaśibhāskaraiḥ ..
niveditaśca devāya tenā'pi laghukāriṇā .. 34 ..
meaning:
आदित्यरूपे दैत्योऽयं ज्ञातोऽहं शशिभास्करैः ..
निवेदितश्च देवाय तेनाऽपि लघुकारिणा .. 34 ..
text_mt: "This is a daitya in the form of the sun!"—I was recognized by the moon and the sun, / and reported to the god, who was swift to act.

sanskrit_iast:
cakreṇa pātitaṃ vatsa sabhujaṃ mastakaṃ mama ..
amṛtaprāśanātprāṇairna viyukto'smi dānava .. 35 ..
meaning:
चक्रेण पातितं वत्स सभुजं मस्तकं मम ..
अमृतप्राशनात्प्राणैर्न वियुक्तोऽस्मि दानव .. 35 ..
text_mt: With his discus, my child, my head along with my arms was struck down. / Because I had tasted the nectar, I was not separated from my life, O dānava.

sanskrit_iast:
na me kaṇṭhādadhobhāgamāgataṃ mama cakriṇā ..
śiracchinnaṃ mahārāja tatra prāṇāstataḥ sthitāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
न मे कण्ठादधोभागमागतं मम चक्रिणा ..
शिरच्छिन्नं महाराज तत्र प्राणास्ततः स्थिताः .. 36 ..
text_mt: It had not descended below my throat when my head was severed / by the Discus-bearer, O great king; therefore my vital breaths remained there.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasaśchedanāddīnaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā madhusūdanaḥ ..
jātānukampo bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 37 ..
meaning:
शिरसश्छेदनाद्दीनं मां दृष्ट्वा मधुसूदनः ..
जातानुकम्पो भगवानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Seeing me wretched from the severing of my head, Madhusūdana, / the blessed Lord, filled with compassion, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
pītāmṛtasya daityasya maraṇaṃ nā'sti karhicit ..
mama hastavinaṣṭānāṃ gatirbhavati śobhanā .. 38 ..
meaning:
पीतामृतस्य दैत्यस्य मरणं नाऽस्ति कर्हिचित् ..
मम हस्तविनष्टानां गतिर्भवति शोभना .. 38 ..
text_mt: "For a daitya who has drunk the nectar there is never death; / and those slain by my hand attain an auspicious destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
amaratvaṃ tvamāsādya varaṃ varaya kāṃkṣitam ..
tato mayokto bhagavānpraṇamya madhusūdanaḥ .. .. 39 ..
meaning:
अमरत्वं त्वमासाद्य वरं वरय कांक्षितम् ..
ततो मयोक्तो भगवान्प्रणम्य मधुसूदनः .. .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having attained immortality, choose the boon you desire!" / Then the blessed Madhusūdana was addressed by me with a bow:

sanskrit_iast:
labheyātāṃ hi somārkau matto deva parābhavam ..
pūjāñca prārthaye lokādgrahatvañca janārdana .. 1.42.40 ..
meaning:
लभेयातां हि सोमार्कौ मत्तो देव पराभवम् ..
पूजाञ्च प्रार्थये लोकाद्ग्रहत्वञ्च जनार्दन .. 1.42.40 ..
text_mt: "May the moon and sun suffer defeat at my hands, O Lord! / And I request worship from the world, and the status of a planet, O Janārdana!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānmāmuvāca tadā hariḥ ..
grahatvaṃ bhavitā daitya pūjāṃ caivopalapsyase .. 41 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स भगवान्मामुवाच तदा हरिः ..
ग्रहत्वं भविता दैत्य पूजां चैवोपलप्स्यसे .. 41 ..
text_mt: Thus addressed, the blessed Lord Hari then said to me: / "The status of a planet will be yours, O daitya, and you shall obtain worship.

sanskrit_iast: parvakāle ca saṃprāpte candrārkau chādayiṣyati .. 42 ..
meaning: पर्वकाले च संप्राप्ते चन्द्रार्कौ छादयिष्यति .. 42 ..
text_mt: And when the time of the syzygy arrives, you will overshadow the moon and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tamo mūrttiradṛśyaśca viparītaṃ cariṣyasi..
bhūmicchāyāgataścandraṃ candrago'rkaṃ ca dānavaḥ ..43..
meaning:
तमो मूर्त्तिरदृश्यश्च विपरीतं चरिष्यसि..
भूमिच्छायागतश्चन्द्रं चन्द्रगोऽर्कं च दानवः ..43..
text_mt: A form of darkness and invisible, you will move in reverse: / entering the earth’s shadow [you will eclipse] the moon, and going to the moon [you will eclipse] the sun, O dānava.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyodayiṣyasi yadā tadā bhāgamavāpsyasi ..
snāne jāpye tathā home dāne śrāddhe surārcane .. 44 ..
meaning:
यस्योदयिष्यसि यदा तदा भागमवाप्स्यसि ..
स्नाने जाप्ये तथा होमे दाने श्राद्धे सुरार्चने .. 44 ..
text_mt: Whichever [luminary] you rise against and when, then you will receive your share / during bathing, chanting of mantras, fire sacrifices, gift-giving, ancestral rites, and worship of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaḥ sa kālo bhavitā nityamevā'sureśvara ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ..45..
meaning:
पुण्यः स कालो भविता नित्यमेवाऽसुरेश्वर ..
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..45..
text_mt: That time will always be auspicious, O lord of the asuras." / Having spoken thus, the blessed Lord vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
pīta śeṣamathādāya saumaṃ suragaṇeśvaraḥ ..
suraloke sannihitaṃ cakāra balavṛtrahā..46..
meaning:
पीत शेषमथादाय सौमं सुरगणेश्वरः ..
सुरलोके सन्निहितं चकार बलवृत्रहा..46..
text_mt: Then taking the remainder of the soma that had been drunk, the slayer of Bala and Vṛtra, / the lord of the hosts of gods, placed it safely in the realm of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
macchīrṣapātābhivivṛddhakopā hṛtā'mṛtā daityagaṇāḥ samastāḥ ..
vyarthabhramā devagaṇānnihantuṃ sannaddhasainyāḥ prayayustadānīm ..47..
meaning:
मच्छीर्षपाताभिविवृद्धकोपा हृताऽमृता दैत्यगणाः समस्ताः ..
व्यर्थभ्रमा देवगणान्निहन्तुं सन्नद्धसैन्याः प्रययुस्तदानीम् ..47..
text_mt: Their fury heightened by the falling of my head, deprived of the nectar, their delusion in vain, / all the hosts of daityas, with their armies arrayed, then marched out to slay the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
.. rāhuruvāca ..
balibāṇamahākūrma śambarāvartabhīṣaṇam ..
anuhrādamahāgrāhaṃ kālakeyamahājalam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. राहुरुवाच ..
बलिबाणमहाकूर्म शम्बरावर्तभीषणम् ..
अनुह्रादमहाग्राहं कालकेयमहाजलम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāhu said: / With Bali and Bāṇa as its great turtles, terrifying with Śambara as its whirlpool, / with Anuhrāda as its great sea monster, with the Kālakeyas as its vast waters,
title: Devadānavayuddhavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣamahāratnaṃ prahrādācalaniścalam ..
tathā namucikallolaṃ hrādasaṃhrādaśabdavat ..2..
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षमहारत्नं प्रह्रादाचलनिश्चलम् ..
तथा नमुचिकल्लोलं ह्रादसंह्रादशब्दवत् ..2..
text_mt: with Hiraṇyākṣa as its great jewel, motionless with Prahlāda as its mountain, / with Namuci as its wave, resounding with the cries of Hrāda and Saṃhrāda,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipūdyotaṃ kālanemibalāhakam ..
amṛtāharaṇakṣubdhaṃ tadā daityamahārṇavam 3 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपूद्योतं कालनेमिबलाहकम् ..
अमृताहरणक्षुब्धं तदा दैत्यमहार्णवम् 3 ..
text_mt: with Hiraṇyakaśipu as its splendor, with Kālanemi as its cloud— / thus agitated by the theft of the nectar was the great ocean of the daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣubdhaṃ daityārṇavaṃ śrutvā nirgataṃ samarāya ca ..
niryayustridaśāḥ sarve sannaddhā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
क्षुब्धं दैत्यार्णवं श्रुत्वा निर्गतं समराय च ..
निर्ययुस्त्रिदशाः सर्वे सन्नद्धा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Hearing that the ocean of daityas was stirred and had set forth for battle, / all the thirty gods came out in full armor, longing for war.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravartate yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ bhīrubhayaṃkaram ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca parasparavadhaiṣiṇām..5..
meaning:
ततः प्रवर्तते युद्धं घोरं भीरुभयंकरम् ..
देवानां दानवानां च परस्परवधैषिणाम्..5..
text_mt: Then began a fierce battle, terrifying to cowards, / between the gods and the dānavas, who sought to slay one another.

sanskrit_iast:
pātyamāneṣu śastreṣu kavaceṣu mahātmanām..
devānāṃ dānavānāñca hyutpeturjvalanārciṣaḥ ..6..
meaning:
पात्यमानेषु शस्त्रेषु कवचेषु महात्मनाम्..
देवानां दानवानाञ्च ह्युत्पेतुर्ज्वलनार्चिषः ..6..
text_mt: As weapons fell upon the armor of the great-souled / gods and dānavas, flames of fire indeed flew up.

sanskrit_iast:
gajavājikhurakṣuṇṇamuttasthau sumahadrajaḥ ..
yugāntānaladhūmābhaṃ trailokasyeva dahyataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
गजवाजिखुरक्षुण्णमुत्तस्थौ सुमहद्रजः ..
युगान्तानलधूमाभं त्रैलोकस्येव दह्यतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: A vast dust arose, pounded up by the hooves of elephants and horses, / resembling the smoke of the fire at the end of the aeon, as if the three worlds were burning.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminpravṛtte rajasi ghore bhīrubhayaṃkare ..
nirmaryādamabhūdyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..8..
meaning:
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते रजसि घोरे भीरुभयंकरे ..
निर्मर्यादमभूद्युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह..8..
text_mt: When that terrifying dust arose, striking fear into the faint-hearted, / an unrestricted battle took place between the gods and the dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daityasamutthena tathā devodbhavena ca ..
rudhireṇa mahī vyāptā praśāntañca rajaḥ kṣaṇāt..9..
meaning:
ततो दैत्यसमुत्थेन तथा देवोद्भवेन च ..
रुधिरेण मही व्याप्ता प्रशान्तञ्च रजः क्षणात्..9..
text_mt: Then with the blood pouring from the daityas as well as that arising from the gods, / the earth was covered, and the dust was quelled in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvaje cchatre rathe nāge cāmare vyajane haye..
sarvatra dṛśyate daityaraktaṃ lākṣārasaprabham ..1.43.10 ..
meaning:
ध्वजे च्छत्रे रथे नागे चामरे व्यजने हये..
सर्वत्र दृश्यते दैत्यरक्तं लाक्षारसप्रभम् ..1.43.10 ..
text_mt: On banners, parasols, chariots, elephants, chowries, fans, and horses, / everywhere was seen the blood of the daityas, radiant as liquid red lac.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminyuddhe mahāraudre daityadānavanāśane ..
babhramuḥ kuñjarā mattā mahāmātrapracoditāḥ ..11..
meaning:
तस्मिन्युद्धे महारौद्रे दैत्यदानवनाशने ..
बभ्रमुः कुञ्जरा मत्ता महामात्रप्रचोदिताः ..11..
text_mt: In that most dreadful battle, which brought destruction to daityas and dānavas, / rutting elephants roamed about, urged on by their mahouts.

sanskrit_iast:
hatairvīraistathai vā'nyaiḥ kuñjarāḥ parvatopamāḥ ..
kurvantaḥ svānyanīkāni dṛśyante śataśo raṇe .. 12 ..
meaning:
हतैर्वीरैस्तथै वाऽन्यैः कुञ्जराः पर्वतोपमाः ..
कुर्वन्तः स्वान्यनीकानि दृश्यन्ते शतशो रणे .. 12 ..
text_mt: By other heroes slain, mountain-like elephants / were seen by the hundreds on the battlefield, throwing their own battle ranks into disorder.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnadantā bhinnadhvajā vihastacaraṇāstathā ..
śailābhāpatitāstatra śobhayanto raṇājiram .. 13 ..
meaning:
छिन्नदन्ता भिन्नध्वजा विहस्तचरणास्तथा ..
शैलाभापतितास्तत्र शोभयन्तो रणाजिरम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: With broken tusks, shattered banners, and severed trunks and feet, / fallen there like mountains, they adorned the field of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
babhramuḥ sādibhirhīnā hayāḥ sūryahayopamāḥ ..
mṛtāśca śataśastatra dṛśyante vikṛtānanāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
बभ्रमुः सादिभिर्हीना हयाः सूर्यहयोपमाः ..
मृताश्च शतशस्तत्र दृश्यन्ते विकृताननाः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Horses resembling the horses of the sun wandered stripped of their riders, / and dead ones were seen there by the hundreds with disfigured faces.

sanskrit_iast:
āgulphamavasīdanti daityāḥ śoṇitakardame ..
rathibhirnihatā nāgā nāgaiśca nihatā rathāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
आगुल्फमवसीदन्ति दैत्याः शोणितकर्दमे ..
रथिभिर्निहता नागा नागैश्च निहता रथाः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The daityas sank ankle-deep in the mire of blood; / elephants were slain by charioteers, and chariots were smashed by elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
hayāśca viddhā nāgaistu sādibhiḥ kuñjarā hatāḥ ..
rathasādigajārohairnihatāśca padātayaḥ ..16..
meaning:
हयाश्च विद्धा नागैस्तु सादिभिः कुञ्जरा हताः ..
रथसादिगजारोहैर्निहताश्च पदातयः ..16..
text_mt: Horses were pierced by elephants, and elephants were slain by horsemen; / and foot soldiers were slain by charioteers, horsemen, and elephant riders.

sanskrit_iast:
pattinā mahatā sādī kuñjaro ratha eva ca ..
tataḥ prāvartata nadī rudhiraughataraṅgiṇī ..17..
meaning:
पत्तिना महता सादी कुञ्जरो रथ एव च ..
ततः प्रावर्तत नदी रुधिरौघतरङ्गिणी ..17..
text_mt: A horseman, an elephant, and even a chariot [were brought down] by a single mighty foot soldier. / Then there surged forth a river undulating with torrents of blood,

sanskrit_iast:
astragrāhā dhanurmīnā cakrakūrmā mahāsvarā ..
chatrahaṃsā nāgavatī keśaśaivalaśādvalā .. 18 ..
meaning:
अस्त्रग्राहा धनुर्मीना चक्रकूर्मा महास्वरा ..
छत्रहंसा नागवती केशशैवलशाद्वला .. 18 ..
text_mt: with missiles for crocodiles, bows for fish, and discuses for tortoises, roaring loudly, / with parasols for swans, elephants for banks, and hair for moss and water-grass,

sanskrit_iast:
daityaśīrṣopalā raudrā tathā bhīrubhayāvahā ..
bāhusarpā mahāvartā śarāṇāṃ harṣavarddhinī .. 19 ..
meaning:
दैत्यशीर्षोपला रौद्रा तथा भीरुभयावहा ..
बाहुसर्पा महावर्ता शराणां हर्षवर्द्धिनी .. 19 ..
text_mt: with daitya heads for stones, terrible and terrifying to the faint-hearted, / with arms for serpents, great whirlpools, gladdening [the wielders] of arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
apāragamyā pattīnāṃ phenapuñjasamākulā ..
tasminyuddhe mahāghore tumule lomaharṣaṇe .. 1.43.20 ..
meaning:
अपारगम्या पत्तीनां फेनपुञ्जसमाकुला ..
तस्मिन्युद्धे महाघोरे तुमुले लोमहर्षणे .. 1.43.20 ..
text_mt: impassable to foot soldiers, crowded with masses of foam, / in that battle exceedingly terrible, chaotic, and hair-raising.

sanskrit_iast:
ākīrṇā vasudhā bhāti vadanaiḥ kamalopamaiḥ ..
vivṛttaiśca mahādaṃṣṭairdānavānāṃ mahātmanām .. 21 ..
meaning:
आकीर्णा वसुधा भाति वदनैः कमलोपमैः ..
विवृत्तैश्च महादंष्टैर्दानवानां महात्मनाम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: The earth shone strewn with faces resembling lotuses / and with rolled-back eyes and huge fangs of the great-souled dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhubhiścāṅgadaiścaiva raktacandanarūṣitaiḥ ..
hastihastairmahāprāsairasibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
बाहुभिश्चाङ्गदैश्चैव रक्तचन्दनरूषितैः ..
हस्तिहस्तैर्महाप्रासैरसिभिश्च महाधनैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: and with arms wearing armlets and smeared with red sandalwood, / with elephant trunks, huge spears, swords, and magnificent bows.

sanskrit_iast:
tālavṛntaistathā chatraiścāmarairyaṣṭibhistathā..
mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalaiścaiva śuśubhe bhūrvibhūṣitā ..23..
meaning:
तालवृन्तैस्तथा छत्रैश्चामरैर्यष्टिभिस्तथा..
मुकुटैः कुण्डलैश्चैव शुशुभे भूर्विभूषिता ..23..
text_mt: With palm-leaf fans and umbrellas, with chowries and poles, / and with diadems and ear-rings, the earth shone adorned.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste dānavāḥ kruddhāḥ svayuddhena dievepsavaḥ ..
abhidravanti deveśaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ puraṃdaram..24..
meaning:
ततस्ते दानवाः क्रुद्धाः स्वयुद्धेन दिएवेप्सवः ..
अभिद्रवन्ति देवेशं सहस्राक्षं पुरंदरम्..24..
text_mt: Then those Dānavas, enraged and desiring to conquer heaven in their own combat, / rushed against the lord of the gods, the thousand-eyed Puraṃdara.

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāṃ patatāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahrādaṃ devasūdanam..
pratyudyayau gajenā ''jau devarājo mahābalaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
दैत्यानां पततां दृष्ट्वा प्रह्रादं देवसूदनम्..
प्रत्युद्ययौ गजेना 'ऽजौ देवराजो महाबलः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Seeing Prahrāda, the destroyer of gods, rushing forth among the charging Daityas, / the king of the gods, of great might, advanced on an elephant in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśano'pi namucimanuhrādaṃ tathā śaśī..
varuṇaśca tathā bāṇaṃ yamo devastathā balim ..26..
meaning:
हुताशनोऽपि नमुचिमनुह्रादं तथा शशी..
वरुणश्च तथा बाणं यमो देवस्तथा बलिम् ..26..
text_mt: Fire [advanced] against Namuci, and the Moon likewise against Anuhrāda, / Varuṇa likewise against Bāṇa, and the god Yama against Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ rudro vāyurvṛtrāsuraṃ raṇe ..
virūpākṣaṃ tathā śaṃbhurhiraṇyākṣaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ ..27..
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपुं रुद्रो वायुर्वृत्रासुरं रणे ..
विरूपाक्षं तथा शंभुर्हिरण्याक्षं धनेश्वरः ..27..
text_mt: Rudra against Hiraṇyakaśipu, Vāyu against the asura Vṛtra in battle, / Śaṃbhu likewise against Virūpākṣa, and the lord of wealth against Hiraṇyākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
anye ca daityāḥ śataśaḥ saṃyuktā devatāgaṇaiḥ ..
dvandvayuddhasahasreṣu teṣvavartata dānavaiḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
अन्ये च दैत्याः शतशः संयुक्ता देवतागणैः ..
द्वन्द्वयुद्धसहस्रेषु तेष्ववर्तत दानवैः .. 28 ..
text_mt: And hundreds of other Daityas were joined with the hosts of deities; / among thousands of single combats it went on with the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaśo vijitā devā yayurbhagnā diśo daśa ..
dānavāśca jayaṃ labdhvā devānanuyayurbalāt ..29 ..
meaning:
प्रायशो विजिता देवा ययुर्भग्ना दिशो दश ..
दानवाश्च जयं लब्ध्वा देवाननुययुर्बलात् ..29 ..
text_mt: For the most part, the conquered gods fled broken in the ten directions; / and having gained victory, the Dānavas pursued the gods by force.

sanskrit_iast:
te bhagnāstridaśāḥ sarve dānavaiścāpyabhidrutā ..
trāṇārthamatha saṃprāptā naranārāyaṇāśramam .. 1.43.30 ..
meaning:
ते भग्नास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे दानवैश्चाप्यभिद्रुता ..
त्राणार्थमथ संप्राप्ता नरनारायणाश्रमम् .. 1.43.30 ..
text_mt: All those broken thirty [gods], pursued by the Dānavas, / then reached the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa for protection.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāmabhayaṃ dattvā naranārāyaṇau tadā ..
śaṃkhacakrāyudhadharau yuddhāya samavasthitau .. 31 ..
meaning:
देवानामभयं दत्त्वा नरनारायणौ तदा ..
शंखचक्रायुधधरौ युद्धाय समवस्थितौ .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having granted safety to the gods, Nara and Nārāyaṇa then, / bearing the weapons of conch and discus, stood ready for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā tatkṣubdhaṃ daityasāgaram ..
sarvāyudhavisargeṇa tayoryuddhaṃ vyavasthitam .. 32 ..
meaning:
नरनारायणौ दृष्ट्वा तत्क्षुब्धं दैत्यसागरम् ..
सर्वायुधविसर्गेण तयोर्युद्धं व्यवस्थितम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Seeing Nara and Nārāyaṇa, that ocean of Daityas was agitated; / their battle was engaged with the discharge of all manner of weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
gajābhrajālasaṃchannaṃ śaradhāraughavarṣaṇam ..
calankhaḍgalatāvidyuddaityadurdinamābabhau .. 33 ..
meaning:
गजाभ्रजालसंछन्नं शरधारौघवर्षणम् ..
चलन्खड्गलताविद्युद्दैत्यदुर्दिनमाबभौ .. 33 ..
text_mt: Covered by a mass of cloud-like elephants, raining down a torrent of streams of arrows, / with flashing sword-creepers as lightning, the foul weather of Daityas shone forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śarai rukmavibhūṣitāgraiḥ sunetrapuṃkhairjvalanārkavarṇaiḥ ..
bibheda gātrāṇi naro ripūṇāṃ jahāra śīrṣāṇi sakuṇḍalāni .. 34 ..
meaning:
ततः शरै रुक्मविभूषिताग्रैः सुनेत्रपुंखैर्ज्वलनार्कवर्णैः ..
बिभेद गात्राणि नरो रिपूणां जहार शीर्षाणि सकुण्डलानि .. 34 ..
text_mt: Then, with arrows tipped with gold, well-feathered, with the color of fire and the sun, / Nara pierced the limbs of the enemies and cut off their heads adorned with ear-rings.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇopyuttamavīryatejāścakreṇa cakre ditinandanānām ..
vidārayāmāsa mahānubhāvastasminraṇe ghoratare tadānīm .. 35 ..
meaning:
नारायणोप्युत्तमवीर्यतेजाश्चक्रेण चक्रे दितिनन्दनानाम् ..
विदारयामास महानुभावस्तस्मिन्रणे घोरतरे तदानीम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: And Nārāyaṇa, of supreme heroism and majesty, with his discus rent the sons of Diti; / the high-souled one tore them asunder in that most terrible battle then.

sanskrit_iast:
vīryaṃ tayorapratimaṃ nirīkṣya te dānavā bhagnanikṛttayodhāḥ ..
hatāmṛtā jīvitamātraśeṣā vegena yātā varuṇādhivāsam ..36 ..
meaning:
वीर्यं तयोरप्रतिमं निरीक्ष्य ते दानवा भग्ननिकृत्तयोधाः ..
हतामृता जीवितमात्रशेषा वेगेन याता वरुणाधिवासम् ..36 ..
text_mt: Beholding their peerless heroism, those Dānavas, their warriors broken and cut down, / their dead left behind, with life alone remaining, swiftly fled to the dwelling of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā jayaṃ devapatirmahātmā prahrādamājau ca tathā vijitya ..
saṃpūjayāmāsa mahānubhāvau dharmātmajau tāpasasaṃghamukhyau .. 37 ..
meaning:
लब्ध्वा जयं देवपतिर्महात्मा प्रह्रादमाजौ च तथा विजित्य ..
संपूजयामास महानुभावौ धर्मात्मजौ तापससंघमुख्यौ .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having obtained victory and likewise conquered Prahrāda in battle, the high-souled lord of gods / worshipped the two noble sons of Dharma, the foremost of the assembly of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya tau dharmasutau jitārirdevaiḥ prahṛṣṭairanuyāsyamānaḥ ..
jagāma nākaṃ tridaśapradhānaḥ sukhī babhūvātha gatajvaraśca .. 38 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य तौ धर्मसुतौ जितारिर्देवैः प्रहृष्टैरनुयास्यमानः ..
जगाम नाकं त्रिदशप्रधानः सुखी बभूवाथ गतज्वरश्च .. 38 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped those two sons of Dharma, his enemies conquered, followed by the delighted gods, / the chief of the thirty [gods] went to heaven and became happy, free of sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhāvo bhagavānsa viṣṇurvairaṃ na me rocati tena nityam ..
sandhiṃ kuruṣvā''tmahitāya rājañchakreṇa tenāriniṣūdanena .. 39 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रभावो भगवान्स विष्णुर्वैरं न मे रोचति तेन नित्यम् ..
सन्धिं कुरुष्वा'ऽत्महिताय राजञ्छक्रेण तेनारिनिषूदनेन .. 39 ..
text_mt: Such is the power of the blessed Viṣṇu; enmity with him does not ever please me. / Make peace, O king, for your own welfare, with Śakra, that destroyer of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
evamuktastadā sālvo rāhuṇā bhīmavikramaḥ ..
jagāda bhrātaraṃ vākyaṃ sārabhūtamahetumat .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा साल्वो राहुणा भीमविक्रमः ..
जगाद भ्रातरं वाक्यं सारभूतमहेतुमत् .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed at that time by Rāhu, Sālva of terrible prowess / spoke to his brother words of essential truth, free from irrationality:
title: Sālvavākyam

sanskrit_iast:
sālva uvāca ..
asāre graha saṃsāre nitye satatayāyini ..
bhavakṣaye matiḥ kāryā rujopakaraṇeṣu vā ..
jantavastrividhā loke tridhā yeṣāṃ viceṣṭitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
साल्व उवाच ..
असारे ग्रह संसारे नित्ये सततयायिनि ..
भवक्षये मतिः कार्या रुजोपकरणेषु वा ..
जन्तवस्त्रिविधा लोके त्रिधा येषां विचेष्टितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Sālva said:
In this worthless saṃsāra, O planet, which is continuous and ever passing away, / one's mind should be directed either to the cessation of existence or to the means for [overcoming] suffering. / Living beings in the world are of three kinds, whose behavior is threefold:

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasārājasāścaiva sāttvikāśca graheśvara ..
bhavakṣaye ye vimukhā bhavopakaraṇeṣu ca .. 3 ..
meaning:
तामसाराजसाश्चैव सात्त्विकाश्च ग्रहेश्वर ..
भवक्षये ये विमुखा भवोपकरणेषु च .. 3 ..
text_mt: Tāmasic, rājasic, and sāttvic, O lord of planets. / Those who are averse to the cessation of existence and also to the means of existence,

sanskrit_iast:
lokadvitayavibhraṣṭāstāmasāste prakītitāḥ ..
bhavakṣayamatibhraṣṭā bhavopakaraṇe sthitāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
लोकद्वितयविभ्रष्टास्तामसास्ते प्रकीतिताः ..
भवक्षयमतिभ्रष्टा भवोपकरणे स्थिताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: fallen from both worlds, are proclaimed as tāmasic. / Those fallen from the resolution for the cessation of existence and fixed on the means of existence,

sanskrit_iast:
rājasāste vinirdiṣṭā madhyasthāḥ sarvajantuṣu ..
bhavopakaraṇe daitya matiyerṣāṃ na vidyate .. 5 ..
meaning:
राजसास्ते विनिर्दिष्टा मध्यस्थाः सर्वजन्तुषु ..
भवोपकरणे दैत्य मतियेर्षां न विद्यते .. 5 ..
text_mt: are designated as rājasic, standing in the middle among all living beings. / Those who have no concern for the means of existence, O Daitya,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavakṣaye matiryeṣāṃ sāttvikāste prakīrtitāḥ ..
tāmasatvānmayā daitya matiḥ pūrvaṃ bhavakṣaye .. 6 ..
meaning:
भवक्षये मतिर्येषां सात्त्विकास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः ..
तामसत्वान्मया दैत्य मतिः पूर्वं भवक्षये .. 6 ..
text_mt: and whose mind is set on the cessation of existence, are proclaimed as sāttvic. / Because of my tāmasic nature, O Daitya, previously my mind on the cessation of existence

sanskrit_iast:
na kṛtā tena tapyāmi rājyatantramanuṣṭhitam ..
manvantare'pi sampūrṇe mṛtiryeṣāṃ grahottama .. 7 ..
meaning:
न कृता तेन तप्यामि राज्यतन्त्रमनुष्ठितम् ..
मन्वन्तरेऽपि सम्पूर्णे मृतिर्येषां ग्रहोत्तम .. 7 ..
text_mt: was not set; therefore I grieve, having administered the system of kingship. / Even at the completion of a manvantara, those who must die, O best of planets,

sanskrit_iast:
udvijantyeva te mṛtyormahanmṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam ..
avaśyaṃ daitya marttavyaṃ sarveṇeha śarīriṇā .. 8 ..
meaning:
उद्विजन्त्येव ते मृत्योर्महन्मृत्युकृतं भयम् ..
अवश्यं दैत्य मर्त्तव्यं सर्वेणेह शरीरिणा .. 8 ..
text_mt: tremble before death; great is the fear caused by death. / Inevitably, O Daitya, death must be undergone by every embodied being here.

sanskrit_iast:
so'haṃ mokṣaparibhraṣṭaḥ kāmaye keśavādvadham ..
iṣṭaṃ yajñaistapastaptaṃ ripūṇāṃ mūrdhani sthitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
सोऽहं मोक्षपरिभ्रष्टः कामये केशवाद्वधम् ..
इष्टं यज्ञैस्तपस्तप्तं रिपूणां मूर्धनि स्थितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: I, who have fallen from liberation, desire death at the hands of Keśava. / Sacrifices have been offered, austerities practiced, and I have stood on the heads of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
marttavye ca dhruve gamānmaraṇaṃ kāmayāmyaham ..
saṃprāpya keśavānmṛtyuṃ gatiṃ prāpsyāmyanuttamām .. 1.44.10 ..
meaning:
मर्त्तव्ये च ध्रुवे गमान्मरणं कामयाम्यहम् ..
संप्राप्य केशवान्मृत्युं गतिं प्राप्स्याम्यनुत्तमाम् .. 1.44.10 ..
text_mt: And when death is certain, I desire death through an encounter [with him]. / Having met death from Keśava, I shall attain an unsurpassed state.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo rājyamavāpsyāmi nākabhraṣṭo grahottama ..
vivāsya vāsavaṃ svargātparibhūya punaḥpunaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
भूयो राज्यमवाप्स्यामि नाकभ्रष्टो ग्रहोत्तम ..
विवास्य वासवं स्वर्गात्परिभूय पुनःपुनः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having fallen from heaven, O best of planets, I shall regain kingship once more, / after exiling Vāsava from heaven and humiliating him again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sandhiṃ kariṣyāmi tenā'haṃ jīvitapriyaḥ ..
praṇāmaṃ deva rājasya keśavānmaraṇaṃ varam ...12..
meaning:
कथं सन्धिं करिष्यामि तेनाऽहं जीवितप्रियः ..
प्रणामं देव राजस्य केशवान्मरणं वरम् ...12..
text_mt: How can I, fond of life, make peace with him? / Rather than bowing to the king of the gods, death from Keśava is better.

sanskrit_iast:
samīkṣya sādhu paśyāmi keśavānmaraṇaṃ raṇe ..
śakreṇa kṛtasandhānaṃ pātālanilayaṃ tathā .. 13 ..
meaning:
समीक्ष्य साधु पश्यामि केशवान्मरणं रणे ..
शक्रेण कृतसन्धानं पातालनिलयं तथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Considering properly, I see death from Keśava in battle as excellent. / Having made an alliance with Śakra and dwelling in the netherworld,

sanskrit_iast:
tyakṣanti māṃ daityagaṇā vṛddhaṃ patimivā'ṅganāḥ ..
divi bhūmau tathā svarge pātāle gagane jale..14..
meaning:
त्यक्षन्ति मां दैत्यगणा वृद्धं पतिमिवाऽङ्गनाः ..
दिवि भूमौ तथा स्वर्गे पाताले गगने जले..14..
text_mt: the hosts of Daityas would abandon me like women an aged husband. / In heaven, on earth, in paradise, in the netherworld, in the sky, or in water,

sanskrit_iast:
dehināṃ mṛtyurabhyeti tasya nā'sti palāyanam ..
sarve kṣayāntā nicayāḥ patanāntāḥ samucchrayāḥ..15..
meaning:
देहिनां मृत्युरभ्येति तस्य नाऽस्ति पलायनम् ..
सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचयाः पतनान्ताः समुच्छ्रयाः..15..
text_mt: death approaches embodied beings; there is no running away from it. / All accumulations end in depletion; all lofty rises end in a fall;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntaṃ hi jīvitam ..
avaśyabhāvinyarthe'sminsarveṣāṃ graha sarvadā .. 16 ..
meaning:
संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं हि जीवितम् ..
अवश्यभाविन्यर्थेऽस्मिन्सर्वेषां ग्रह सर्वदा .. 16 ..
text_mt: all unions end in separation; for life ends in death. / In this matter which is unavoidable for everyone at all times, O planet,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyabhājo hi maraṇaṃ saṃgrāme yadi jāyate ..
so'haṃ kṣatriyadharmeṇa saṃpūjya samare harim .. 17..
meaning:
पुण्यभाजो हि मरणं संग्रामे यदि जायते ..
सोऽहं क्षत्रियधर्मेण संपूज्य समरे हरिम् .. 17..
text_mt: death is indeed for the meritorious if it happens in battle. / Therefore, worshipping Hari in battle according to the duty of a kṣatriya,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmṛtyumanuprāpya gatiṃ prāpsyāmi śobhanām..
naivedyaiḥ puppadhūpādyairna tathā pūjito hariḥ ..18..
meaning:
तस्मान्मृत्युमनुप्राप्य गतिं प्राप्स्यामि शोभनाम्..
नैवेद्यैः पुप्पधूपाद्यैर्न तथा पूजितो हरिः ..18..
text_mt: and attaining death from him, I shall reach an auspicious state. / Hari is not so pleased by offerings of food, flowers, incense, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
toṣamāyāti daityendra sa dharmeṇa yathā nṛṇām ..
bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena yadvācyaṃ suhṛdā hitamicchatā ..19..
meaning:
तोषमायाति दैत्येन्द्र स धर्मेण यथा नृणाम् ..
भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेन यद्वाच्यं सुहृदा हितमिच्छता ..19..
text_mt: as he attains satisfaction, O lord of Daityas, through the [proper] duty of men. / What ought to be said by an elder brother, a friend wishing for one's welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
tadukto'smi tvayā nātha devāttanme na rocate ..
sa tvaṃ gaccha mahābhāga dividraṣṭāsi māṃ punaḥ .. 1.44.20 ..
meaning:
तदुक्तोऽस्मि त्वया नाथ देवात्तन्मे न रोचते ..
स त्वं गच्छ महाभाग दिविद्रष्टासि मां पुनः .. 1.44.20 ..
text_mt: that has been spoken by you to me, O master; yet because of destiny it does not please me. / Therefore go, O fortunate one; you shall see me again in heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
dehāntaramanuprāptaṃ graha divyena cakṣuṣā ..
..mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
ityeva sālvasya niśamya vākyaṃ kālānurūpaṃ ca tathā viditvā..
na kiñciduktvaiva jagāma rāhurdivaṃ mahātmā jagatāṃ pradhānaḥ ..21..
meaning:
देहान्तरमनुप्राप्तं ग्रह दिव्येन चक्षुषा ..
..मार्कण्डेय उवाच..
इत्येव साल्वस्य निशम्य वाक्यं कालानुरूपं च तथा विदित्वा..
न किञ्चिदुक्त्वैव जगाम राहुर्दिवं महात्मा जगतां प्रधानः ..21..
text_mt:
having attained another body, O planet, with your divine eye.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having thus heard the words of Sālva, and recognizing them as suited to the time, / high-souled Rāhu, chief among the worlds, departed for heaven without saying anything at all.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
rāhau divamasaṃprāpte sālve rājñi sabhāṃ gate ..
rāmeṇa preṣito dūtaḥ saṃprāptastvakṛtavraṇaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
राहौ दिवमसंप्राप्ते साल्वे राज्ञि सभां गते ..
रामेण प्रेषितो दूतः संप्राप्तस्त्वकृतव्रणः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Before Rāhu had reached heaven, when King Sālva entered his assembly,
a messenger sent by Rāma arrived, named Akṛtavraṇa.
title: Sālvaniryāṇam

sanskrit_iast:
sa praviṣṭaḥ sabhāṃ ramyāṃ sālvarājñā ca pūjitaḥ ..
pādyārghyācamanīyādyairniṣaṇṇo vākyamabravīt .. 2 ..
meaning:
स प्रविष्टः सभां रम्यां साल्वराज्ञा च पूजितः ..
पाद्यार्घ्याचमनीयाद्यैर्निषण्णो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Having entered the splendid assembly and been honored by King Sālva
with water for the feet, guest-offering, water for sipping, and other respects, he sat down and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇa uvāca ..
dūto'haṃ preṣitaḥ sālva rāmeṇā'kliṣṭakarmmaṇā..
śrutvā rāmasya vacanaṃ tataḥ kuru yathepsitam ..3..
meaning:
अकृतव्रण उवाच ..
दूतोऽहं प्रेषितः साल्व रामेणाऽक्लिष्टकर्म्मणा..
श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनं ततः कुरु यथेप्सितम् ..3..
text_mt:
Akṛtavraṇa said:
I have been sent as a messenger, O Sālva, by Rāma of untiring deeds.
Having heard the words of Rāma, then do as you wish.

sanskrit_iast:
āha tvāṃ bhārgavo rāmastryambakeṇa visarjitaḥ..
tvayā yuddhāya daityendra saṃgrāme kriyatāṃ kṣaṇam..4..
meaning:
आह त्वां भार्गवो रामस्त्र्यम्बकेण विसर्जितः..
त्वया युद्धाय दैत्येन्द्र संग्रामे क्रियतां क्षणम्..4..
text_mt:
Rāma, the descendant of Bhṛgu, dispatched by Tryambaka, says to you:
‘O lord of Daityas, grant a moment in battle for a fight with you.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāsya vāsavaṃ svargāddevāñjitvā sadā''have..
anayasyā'sya ghorasya phalaṃ prāpnuhi durmate ..5..
meaning:
विवास्य वासवं स्वर्गाद्देवाञ्जित्वा सदा'ऽहवे..
अनयस्याऽस्य घोरस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते ..5..
text_mt:
Having driven Vāsava from heaven and always conquered the gods in battle,
receive the fruit of this terrible injustice, O evil-minded one!

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ pramatte viśvaste praharāmi kadācana..
tena te preṣito dūtastasmādyuddhe sthiro bhava ..6..
meaning:
नाहं प्रमत्ते विश्वस्ते प्रहरामि कदाचन..
तेन ते प्रेषितो दूतस्तस्माद्युद्धे स्थिरो भव ..6..
text_mt:
I never strike one who is off-guard or trusting.
Therefore a messenger has been sent to you; hence be steadfast in battle.’

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktastadā sālvo brāhmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt ..
nā'haṃ rāmakṛte brahmansannahyāmi kadācana .. 7 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा साल्वो ब्राह्मणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
नाऽहं रामकृते ब्रह्मन्सन्नह्यामि कदाचन .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed, Sālva then said to the brahmin:
‘I will never arm myself on account of Rāma, O brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu sainyena sarveṇa sannaddhena varūthinā ..
mahādevaṃ vijeṣyāmi yena rāmo visarjitaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
किन्तु सैन्येन सर्वेण सन्नद्धेन वरूथिना ..
महादेवं विजेष्यामि येन रामो विसर्जितः .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Rather, with my entire army armed and organized in chariots,
I shall conquer Mahādeva, by whom Rāma was dispatched.

sanskrit_iast:
sannaddhasainyasahitaṃ mahādevajayaiṣiṇam ..
yadi māṃ yotsyate rāmo hantāsmi tamahaṃ mṛdhe .. 9..
meaning:
सन्नद्धसैन्यसहितं महादेवजयैषिणम् ..
यदि मां योत्स्यते रामो हन्तास्मि तमहं मृधे .. 9..
text_mt:
If Rāma fights me while I am accompanied by an armed army
and seeking to conquer Mahādeva, I shall kill him in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ gaccha yathākāmaṃ rāmāya vinivedaya ..
etadvacanamādāya sālvasya sa mahātmanaḥ .. 1.45.10 ..
meaning:
स त्वं गच्छ यथाकामं रामाय विनिवेदय ..
एतद्वचनमादाय साल्वस्य स महात्मनः .. 1.45.10 ..
text_mt:
Go as you please and report [this] to Rāma.’
Taking these words of the great-souled Sālva,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma rāmaṃ dharmajñaṃ sālvavākyaniveditaḥ ..
gatvā śaśaṃsa rāmāya saiṃhikeyaviceṣṭitam .. 11 ..
meaning:
जगाम रामं धर्मज्ञं साल्ववाक्यनिवेदितः ..
गत्वा शशंस रामाय सैंहिकेयविचेष्टितम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
he went to Rāma, who knows dharma, having the words of Sālva to report.
Having gone, he reported the conduct of the son of Siṃhikā to Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
tena vākyena rāmo'pi roṣāddaityapuraṃ yayau ..
rāmadūte gate tasmin daityānsālvaḥ pracodayat .. 12 ..
meaning:
तेन वाक्येन रामोऽपि रोषाद्दैत्यपुरं ययौ ..
रामदूते गते तस्मिन् दैत्यान्साल्वः प्रचोदयत् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
At those words, Rāma too went in anger to the city of the Daityas.
When that messenger of Rāma had departed, Sālva urged the Daityas:

sanskrit_iast:
sannahyadhvaṃ vijeṣyāmaḥ sagaṇaṃ bhagasūdanam ..
tataste dānavāḥ sarve sālvavākyapracoditāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
सन्नह्यध्वं विजेष्यामः सगणं भगसूदनम् ..
ततस्ते दानवाः सर्वे साल्ववाक्यप्रचोदिताः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
‘Arm yourselves! We shall conquer the destroyer of Bhaga along with his host!’
Then all those Dānavas, urged by the words of Sālva,

sanskrit_iast:
sannaddhā svagṛhebhyastu rājadvāramupāgatāḥ..
kuñjarāṇāṃ ninādena śaṅkhabherīraveṇa ca..14..
meaning:
सन्नद्धा स्वगृहेभ्यस्तु राजद्वारमुपागताः..
कुञ्जराणां निनादेन शङ्खभेरीरवेण च..14..
text_mt:
armed themselves and went from their homes to the royal gate.
With the roaring of elephants and the sound of conches and drums,

sanskrit_iast:
rājadvāre mahāñchabdastumulaḥ samapadyata..
hutvā hutāśanaṃ snātaḥ sālva saṃpūjya ca dvijān .. 15 ..
meaning:
राजद्वारे महाञ्छब्दस्तुमुलः समपद्यत..
हुत्वा हुताशनं स्नातः साल्व संपूज्य च द्विजान् .. 15 ..
text_mt:
a great and tumultuous noise arose at the royal gate.
Having offered oblations into the fire, bathed, and honored the twice-born, Sālva

sanskrit_iast: āruroha gajaṃ mattaṃ śailāgraṃ savitā yathā .. 16 ..
meaning: आरुरोह गजं मत्तं शैलाग्रं सविता यथा .. 16 ..
text_mt: mounted an elephant in rut, like the sun mounting a mountain summit.

sanskrit_iast:
vinirgataṃ daityapatiṃ samīkṣya daityeśvarāḥ kālasamānadarpāḥ ..
ūcustadā taṃ samareṣvajeyama jayasva śambhuṃ yudhi saṃpragṛhya ..17..
meaning:
विनिर्गतं दैत्यपतिं समीक्ष्य दैत्येश्वराः कालसमानदर्पाः ..
ऊचुस्तदा तं समरेष्वजेयम जयस्व शम्भुं युधि संप्रगृह्य ..17..
text_mt:
Beholding the lord of Daityas set out, the Daitya chiefs, equal in arrogance to Kāla,
then said to him, invincible in battles: ‘Conquer Śambhu in combat, seizing him!’

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vyaspandatā'tha sālvasya rājanbāhuradakṣiṇaḥ ..
hadayañca tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ nayanañcāpya dakṣiṇam ..1..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
व्यस्पन्दताऽथ साल्वस्य राजन्बाहुरदक्षिणः ..
हदयञ्च तथा पृष्ठं नयनञ्चाप्य दक्षिणम् ..1..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, O king, Sālva’s left arm throbbed,
as did his chest, back, and his left eye.
title: Sālvasenādurnimittadarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyacittaśca vimanāḥ kampate ca muhurmuhuḥ .
papāta nāyakaścā'pi kirīṭāttārakaprabhaḥ..2..
meaning:
शून्यचित्तश्च विमनाः कम्पते च मुहुर्मुहुः .
पपात नायकश्चाऽपि किरीटात्तारकप्रभः..2..
text_mt:
Absent-minded and dejected, he trembled again and again,
and the central gem, bright as a star, fell from his diadem.

sanskrit_iast:
ākramanti gajāḥ pādaṃ tathā vāmena dakṣiṇam ..
kareṇa veṣṭayanti sma tathā dantamadakṣiṇam ..
madaṃ tyajanti ye mattāsturagāśca muhurmuhuḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
आक्रमन्ति गजाः पादं तथा वामेन दक्षिणम् ..
करेण वेष्टयन्ति स्म तथा दन्तमदक्षिणम् ..
मदं त्यजन्ति ये मत्तास्तुरगाश्च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Elephants crossed their right leg over their left,
twined their trunk around their left tusk,
and those in rut repeatedly lost their temporal discharge; and the horses

sanskrit_iast:
saṃspṛśanti tathā vāmaṃ pārśvaṃ prothena vāmunā..
vṛkāḥ śṛgālāḥ śārdūlā viḍālā gardabhāḥ śaśāḥ ..4..
meaning:
संस्पृशन्ति तथा वामं पार्श्वं प्रोथेन वामुना..
वृकाः शृगालाः शार्दूला विडाला गर्दभाः शशाः ..4..
text_mt:
touched their left flank with their snouts.
Wolves, jackals, tigers, cats, donkeys, and hares,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmībhūtvā dānavānāṃ yānti dakṣiṇatastataḥ ..
eṇā varāhāḥ pṛṣato yānti teṣāñca vāmataḥ..5..
meaning:
वामीभूत्वा दानवानां यान्ति दक्षिणतस्ततः ..
एणा वराहाः पृषतो यान्ति तेषाञ्च वामतः..5..
text_mt:
standing on the left of the Dānavas, then moved to the right;
stags, boars, and spotted deer moved to their left.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptāyāṃ diśi vāśanti mṛgāsteṣāmapasvanam ..
tailapaṅkaguḍāṅgāracarmakeśatṛṇāni ca.6..
meaning:
दीप्तायां दिशि वाशन्ति मृगास्तेषामपस्वनम् ..
तैलपङ्कगुडाङ्गारचर्मकेशतृणानि च.6..
text_mt:
In the blazing direction birds and beasts shrieked discordant cries before them;
and oil, mud, molasses, charcoal, skin, hair, and grass

sanskrit_iast:
dānavānāṃ prayātānāṃ saṃbhavantyagratastathā ..
evaṃvidhā durnimittā jātāḥ sālvasya paśyataḥ ..7..
meaning:
दानवानां प्रयातानां संभवन्त्यग्रतस्तथा ..
एवंविधा दुर्निमित्ता जाताः साल्वस्य पश्यतः ..7..
text_mt:
appeared before the marching Dānavas.
Such ill omens arose before Sālva's eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
matiḥ suniścitaivā''sīnmaraṇaṃ prati yādava ..
sa yayau saha sainyena mahatā caturaṅgiṇā...
kailāsaparvataṃ yoddhuṃ mahādevena śūlinā .. 9 ..
meaning:
मतिः सुनिश्चितैवा'ऽसीन्मरणं प्रति यादव ..
स ययौ सह सैन्येन महता चतुरङ्गिणा...
कैलासपर्वतं योद्धुं महादेवेन शूलिना .. 9 ..
text_mt:
His mind was firmly set on death, O descendant of Yadu.
He marched with a vast fourfold army
to Mount Kailāsa to fight Mahādeva, the trident-wielder.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhotsuke daityapatau prayāte vyadṛśyatāgrecaracaṇḍavegaḥ ..
rāmaḥ pravālāruṇakomalena dīptapratāpena virājamānaḥ .. 1.46.10 ..
meaning:
युद्धोत्सुके दैत्यपतौ प्रयाते व्यदृश्यताग्रेचरचण्डवेगः ..
रामः प्रवालारुणकोमलेन दीप्तप्रतापेन विराजमानः .. 1.46.10 ..
text_mt:
As the Daitya lord, eager for battle, set out, there appeared before him one of fierce speed:
Rāma, shining with blazing splendor, tender like a coral sprout.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vahnijvālāgravarṇena jaṭājūṭena rājitam ..
gaganārddhamivā''rūḍhaṃ nidāghe ravimaṇḍalam .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
वह्निज्वालाग्रवर्णेन जटाजूटेन राजितम् ..
गगनार्द्धमिवा'ऽरूढं निदाघे रविमण्डलम् .. 1 ..
title: Bhārgavarāmadarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraṃ sarvadevānāṃ tapasā dyotitaprabham ..
sevamānamavasanaṃ pītagātramarindamam .. 2 ..
meaning:
आधारं सर्वदेवानां तपसा द्योतितप्रभम् ..
सेवमानमवसनं पीतगात्रमरिन्दमम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
the refuge of all gods, his splendor glowing with ascetic heat,
clothed in tree bark, with a yellow body, the subduer of enemies;

sanskrit_iast:
ekamekākinaṃ vīraṃ sahasraśatamaṇḍitam ..
piṇḍitaṃ sakalaṃ dhāma brahmakṣatriyatejasām .. 3 ..
meaning:
एकमेकाकिनं वीरं सहस्रशतमण्डितम् ..
पिण्डितं सकलं धाम ब्रह्मक्षत्रियतेजसाम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
solitary, a lone hero adorned as if by a hundred thousand,
the concentrated mass of all the fiery splendor of brahmins and kṣatriyas;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinottarāsaṅgabhrājamānaṃ baloddhatam ..
snigdhayā rañjitamiva prāyeṇa pārvatīdṛśā .. 4 ..
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गभ्राजमानं बलोद्धतम् ..
स्निग्धया रञ्जितमिव प्रायेण पार्वतीदृशा .. 4 ..
text_mt:
shining with an upper garment of black antelope skin, haughty with strength,
as though continuously gladdened by Pārvatī's affectionate glance;

sanskrit_iast:
virājamānaṃ dordaṇḍarukmadaṇḍena bhāsvatā..
paraśvadhena tīkṣṇena vimalākāśavarcasā .. 5 ..
meaning:
विराजमानं दोर्दण्डरुक्मदण्डेन भास्वता..
परश्वधेन तीक्ष्णेन विमलाकाशवर्चसा .. 5 ..
text_mt:
resplendent with an arm staff holding a radiant, golden-shafted
sharp axe that possessed the brilliance of a spotless sky;

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvinamanādṛśyaṃ yamakālāntakopamam ..
kampamānaṃ padanyāsairvasudhāṃ sakalāṃ tathā ..6..
meaning:
तपस्विनमनादृश्यं यमकालान्तकोपमम् ..
कम्पमानं पदन्यासैर्वसुधां सकलां तथा ..6..
text_mt:
an ascetic dreadful to behold, resembling Yama the ender, Kāla,
shaking the entire earth with the placing of his feet;

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṇantaṃ sarvatejāṃsi prabhāte ravimaṇḍalam..
prāṃśuṃ kanakavarṇāṅgaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ..7..
meaning:
मुष्णन्तं सर्वतेजांसि प्रभाते रविमण्डलम्..
प्रांशुं कनकवर्णाङ्गं सितयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ..7..
text_mt:
eclipsing all brilliance like the solar orb at dawn,
tall, with limbs of golden hue, wearing a white sacrificial thread,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyāḥ pravaheṇaiva meruśṛṃgaṃ virājitam..
tejasā dahanākāraṃ prajāsaṃhārakārakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
गङ्गायाः प्रवहेणैव मेरुशृंगं विराजितम्..
तेजसा दहनाकारं प्रजासंहारकारकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
like the peak of Meru adorned by the flow of the Gaṅgā,
having the appearance of a fire by his splendor, the cause of the destruction of creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamaṃ pramatheśasya tṛtīyamiva locanam ..
aprasahyamanāvāryaṃ durlaṅghyaṃ jīvitacchidam .. 9 ..
meaning:
विषमं प्रमथेशस्य तृतीयमिव लोचनम् ..
अप्रसह्यमनावार्यं दुर्लङ्घ्यं जीवितच्छिदम् .. 9 ..
text_mt:
terrible, like the third eye of the lord of Pramathas,
unbearable, irresistible, impassable, cutting off life,

sanskrit_iast:
kāleneva bhujaṃ savyaṃ daityahetoḥ prasāritam ..
rāme dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāpte dānavānāṃ samantataḥ .. 1.47.10 ..
meaning:
कालेनेव भुजं सव्यं दैत्यहेतोः प्रसारितम् ..
रामे दृष्टिपथं प्राप्ते दानवानां समन्ततः .. 1.47.10 ..
text_mt:
like the left arm of Kāla extended for the sake of the Daityas—
when Rāma came into the range of vision of the Dānavas on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
hāhākāro mahānāsīttamekaṃ nighnatāṃ raṇe ..
śastradhāraṇavibhraṣṭabrāhmaṇyaṃ svapathāccyutam .. 11 ..
meaning:
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तमेकं निघ्नतां रणे ..
शस्त्रधारणविभ्रष्टब्राह्मण्यं स्वपथाच्च्युतम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
there arose a great clamor as they sought to kill that lone one in battle:
‘One fallen from his brahminhood by bearing weapons, strayed from his own path!

sanskrit_iast:
ghātayadhvaṃ durācāramenamūcuḥ parasparam ..
evamādravatāṃ teṣāṃ bahūnāmātatāyinām .. 12 ..
meaning:
घातयध्वं दुराचारमेनमूचुः परस्परम् ..
एवमाद्रवतां तेषां बहूनामाततायिनाम् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Kill this evil-doer!’ they shouted to one another.
As they, numerous assailants, rushed forward in this way,

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha vegaṃ sarveṣāṃ marutāmiva parvataḥ ..
sa hanyamāno nārācaistomarairmuśalaistathā ..13..
meaning:
जग्राह वेगं सर्वेषां मरुतामिव पर्वतः ..
स हन्यमानो नाराचैस्तोमरैर्मुशलैस्तथा ..13..
text_mt:
he checked the momentum of them all, like a mountain checking the winds.
Struck with iron arrows, javelins, and clubs,

sanskrit_iast:
gadābhirasibhiḥ pāśairbhuśuṇḍībhirayoguḍaiḥ ..
paṭṭiśairbhindipālaiśca hutaiḥ śūlaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ..14..
meaning:
गदाभिरसिभिः पाशैर्भुशुण्डीभिरयोगुडैः ..
पट्टिशैर्भिन्दिपालैश्च हुतैः शूलैः परश्वधैः ..14..
text_mt:
maces, swords, nooses, bhuśuṇḍīs, iron balls,
paṭṭiśas, bhindipālas, thrown tridents, and axes,

sanskrit_iast: na vivyathe hyameyātmā dharādhara ivā'nilaiḥ ..15..
meaning: न विव्यथे ह्यमेयात्मा धराधर इवाऽनिलैः ..15..
text_mt: the immeasurable-souled one did not waver, like a mountain before the winds.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃveṣṭitaṃ sarvata eva sainyairadṛṣṭayuddho'pi raṇe mahātmā..
daityārṇavaṃ goṣpadatulyamātramamanyatā''jau raṇacaṇḍavegaḥ ..16 ..
meaning:
संवेष्टितं सर्वत एव सैन्यैरदृष्टयुद्धोऽपि रणे महात्मा..
दैत्यार्णवं गोष्पदतुल्यमात्रममन्यता'ऽजौ रणचण्डवेगः ..16 ..
text_mt: Surrounded on all sides by armies, though he had never witnessed [such] battle before, that great-souled one, furious in speed of combat, / considered the ocean of Daityas in the fight as merely equal to a cow's footprint.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
siṃhikāputrasainyena hanyamānastadā raṇe ..
gocarābhyāgatānsarvānrāmo ninye yamakṣayama .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
सिंहिकापुत्रसैन्येन हन्यमानस्तदा रणे ..
गोचराभ्यागतान्सर्वान्रामो निन्ये यमक्षयम .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Struck then in battle by the army of the son of Siṃhikā, / Rāma dispatched all who came into range to the abode of Yama.
title: adhyāyaḥ 048

sanskrit_iast:
tena kṛttāḥ paraśunā yathā paraśunā mṛgāḥ ..
āliṅgya śerate kṣoṇīṃ dānavāste madoddhatāḥ ..2..
meaning:
तेन कृत्ताः परशुना यथा परशुना मृगाः ..
आलिङ्ग्य शेरते क्षोणीं दानवास्ते मदोद्धताः ..2..
text_mt: Cut down by his axe as wild beasts by an axe, / those Dānavas, haughty with pride, lay embracing the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇadhārāgraduṣprekṣyakuṭhāracchinnamastakaiḥ ..
ātatāra tadā bhūmiṃ kuśairvedimivādhvare .. 3 ..
meaning:
तीक्ष्णधाराग्रदुष्प्रेक्ष्यकुठारच्छिन्नमस्तकैः ..
आततार तदा भूमिं कुशैर्वेदिमिवाध्वरे .. 3 ..
text_mt: With their heads severed by his axe, dreadful to behold with its sharp edge, / he then strewed the ground as with kuśa grass at a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
paraśvadhāgrasaṃbhinnadaityadehasamudbhavam ..
prasusrāva tadā raktaṃ yenā''sītkardamaṃ mahat .. 4 ..
meaning:
परश्वधाग्रसंभिन्नदैत्यदेहसमुद्भवम् ..
प्रसुस्राव तदा रक्तं येना'ऽसीत्कर्दमं महत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Blood, flowing from the bodies of the Daityas pierced by the edge of his battle-axe, / gushed out then, producing a great mire.

sanskrit_iast:
te hanyamānā rāmeṇa rāmamevā'bhidudruvuḥ ..
paripūrṇe yathā kāle śalabhā jātavedasam .. 5 ..
meaning:
ते हन्यमाना रामेण राममेवाऽभिदुद्रुवुः ..
परिपूर्णे यथा काले शलभा जातवेदसम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Struck by Rāma, they rushed straight towards Rāma, / as moths to a fire when their time is fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya pramukhe daityāstadā tiṣṭhanti ye nṛpa ..
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa te prayānti yamakṣayam .. 6 ..
meaning:
रामस्य प्रमुखे दैत्यास्तदा तिष्ठन्ति ये नृप ..
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण ते प्रयान्ति यमक्षयम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Whatever Daityas then stood before Rāma, O king, / departed to the abode of Yama in mere the blink of an eye.

sanskrit_iast:
kuñjarasturagaḥ pattirnājau yādava dṛśyate ..
dvitīyaṃ pradadau yasya prahāraṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
कुञ्जरस्तुरगः पत्तिर्नाजौ यादव दृश्यते ..
द्वितीयं प्रददौ यस्य प्रहारं भृगुनन्दनः .. 7 ..
text_mt: No elephant, horse, or foot-soldier was seen in battle, O Yādava, / upon whom the descendant of Bhṛgu struck a second blow.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaprahārābhigatāndānavānparvatopamān..
apaśyāma raṇe tatra brahmaṇā sahitā vayam ..8..
meaning:
एकप्रहाराभिगतान्दानवान्पर्वतोपमान्..
अपश्याम रणे तत्र ब्रह्मणा सहिता वयम् ..8..
text_mt: Together with Brahmā, we saw in that battle / Dānavas resembling mountains felled by a single blow.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa hanyamānānāṃ dānavānāṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
ārāvaḥ śrūyate ghoro vanānāmiva dahyatām .. 9 ..
meaning:
रामेण हन्यमानानां दानवानां मुहुर्मुहुः ..
आरावः श्रूयते घोरो वनानामिव दह्यताम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Of the Dānavas continuously struck by Rāma, / a terrible roar was heard, like that of burning forests.

sanskrit_iast:
ākramya padbhyāṃ tarasā rathasthānāmathāharat ..
śīrṣāṇi tena tīkṣṇena tathā paraśunā raṇe .. 1.48.10 ..
meaning:
आक्रम्य पद्भ्यां तरसा रथस्थानामथाहरत् ..
शीर्षाणि तेन तीक्ष्णेन तथा परशुना रणे .. 1.48.10 ..
text_mt: Having swiftly stepped upon the chariot-warriors with his feet, he then took / their heads with that sharp battle-axe in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇā''kramyamāṇeṣu ratheṣu rathayūthapāḥ ..
bhūmau niviṣṭamūrddhānastatyajurjīvitaṃ hayāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
रामेणा'ऽक्रम्यमाणेषु रथेषु रथयूथपाः ..
भूमौ निविष्टमूर्द्धानस्तत्यजुर्जीवितं हयाः .. 11 ..
text_mt: As the chariots were stepped upon by Rāma, the commanders of the chariot divisions / and their horses, their heads bowed to the earth, abandoned their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpipeṣa rathasthānāṃ dārayankuñjarānraṇe ..
babhrame tatra tatraikaḥ kālotsṛṣṭa ivāntakaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
निष्पिपेष रथस्थानां दारयन्कुञ्जरान्रणे ..
बभ्रमे तत्र तत्रैकः कालोत्सृष्ट इवान्तकः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Crushing chariot-warriors and tearing apart elephants in battle, / he wandered here and there alone, like Death unleashed at the end of time.

sanskrit_iast:
vicchindanyodhaśīrṣāṇi raṇe rāmo rathādratham ..
vrajanbhāti viśālākṣo vṛkṣādavṛkṣamivā'ṇḍaja .. 13 ..
meaning:
विच्छिन्दन्योधशीर्षाणि रणे रामो रथाद्रथम् ..
व्रजन्भाति विशालाक्षो वृक्षादवृक्षमिवाऽण्डज .. 13 ..
text_mt: Severing the heads of warriors in battle as he went from chariot to chariot, / the large-eyed Rāma shone like a bird [flying] from tree to tree.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śarāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ śoṇitena samukṣitaḥ ..
rarāja rāmaḥ samare raśmimāniva bhāskaraḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
स शराञ्चितसर्वाङ्गः शोणितेन समुक्षितः ..
रराज रामः समरे रश्मिमानिव भास्करः .. 14 ..
text_mt: With his whole body bristling with arrows, sprinkled with blood, / Rāma shone in combat like the sun endowed with rays.

sanskrit_iast:
daityabāhuvinirmuktānāyudhāñchataśastathā ..
paraśvadhāgreṇa raṇe ciccheda raṇakarkaśaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दैत्यबाहुविनिर्मुक्तानायुधाञ्छतशस्तथा ..
परश्वधाग्रेण रणे चिच्छेद रणकर्कशः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Fierce in combat, he cleaved in battle with the tip of his battle-axe / hundreds of weapons hurled from the arms of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃchidyamānānāṃ prādurāsīddhutāśanaḥ ..
yena tāneva tarasā kṣitau cakre sa bhasmasāt .. 16 ..
meaning:
तेषां संछिद्यमानानां प्रादुरासीद्धुताशनः ..
येन तानेव तरसा क्षितौ चक्रे स भस्मसात् .. 16 ..
text_mt: As they were being cleaved, a blazing fire burst forth, / with which he swiftly reduced them to ashes on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
bahutvāddaityayodhānāṃ rāmassaṃchādito raṇe ..
hetipuñjena mahatā śailābhena na dṛśyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
बहुत्वाद्दैत्ययोधानां रामस्संछादितो रणे ..
हेतिपुञ्जेन महता शैलाभेन न दृश्यते .. 17 ..
text_mt: Because of the great number of Daitya warriors, Rāma was covered in battle; / he was not seen beneath the vast, mountain-like heap of weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
hetipuñjaṃ vidhūyogramabhrapuñjaṃ yathā raviḥ ..
punardarśanamāyāti saṃharttā daityatejasām .. 18 ..
meaning:
हेतिपुञ्जं विधूयोग्रमभ्रपुञ्जं यथा रविः ..
पुनर्दर्शनमायाति संहर्त्ता दैत्यतेजसाम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Shaking off the fierce mass of weapons as the sun scatters a mass of clouds, / the destroyer of the Daityas' splendour came into view again.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārddhamṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa tadyuddhaṃ sādhuvādena yādava .. 19 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्द्धमृषिभिश्च महात्मभिः ..
पूजयामास तद्युद्धं साधुवादेन यादव .. 19 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, together with the hosts of gods and the great-souled sages, / honoured that combat with acclamations of praise, O Yādava.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavantaśca dhanuṣā yuddhāni ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
tathaivā''ścaryabhūtāni lokānāṃ khaḍgacarmaṇā .. 1.48.20 ..
meaning:
दृष्टवन्तश्च धनुषा युद्धानि च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
तथैवा'ऽश्चर्यभूतानि लोकानां खड्गचर्मणा .. 1.48.20 ..
text_mt: “And we have seen battles with bows again and again, / as well as those with sword and shield that were wonders to the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
apūrva eṣa saṃgrāmo rāmasya bahubhiḥ saha ..
paraśvadhāyudhasyogra iti devāstathā'bruvan .. 21 ..
meaning:
अपूर्व एष संग्रामो रामस्य बहुभिः सह ..
परश्वधायुधस्योग्र इति देवास्तथाऽब्रुवन् .. 21 ..
text_mt: unprecedented is this battle of Rāma with so many, / fierce with his battle-axe as weapon,” so indeed spoke the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyamānaḥ sa rāmo'pi devapuṣpotkaraistadā ..
ciccheda yudhi daityānāṃ śirāṃsi śataśo raṇe .. 22 ..
meaning:
पूज्यमानः स रामोऽपि देवपुष्पोत्करैस्तदा ..
चिच्छेद युधि दैत्यानां शिरांसि शतशो रणे .. 22 ..
text_mt: Rāma, even while being worshipped then by showers of flowers from the gods, / severed the heads of the Daityas by the hundreds in the fray.

sanskrit_iast:
daityaśoṇitadigdhāṅgaṃ bhārgavaṃ laghuvikramam ..
alātacakrapratimaṃ tadā paśyati yādava .. 23 ..
meaning:
दैत्यशोणितदिग्धाङ्गं भार्गवं लघुविक्रमम् ..
अलातचक्रप्रतिमं तदा पश्यति यादव .. 23 ..
text_mt: One saw then the descendant of Bhṛgu, his limbs smeared with Daitya blood, / swift in stride, resembling a whirling firebrand, O Yādava.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramatā'nena raudreṇa raṇe kālāgnivarccasā ..
kṛtāḥ samaraśauṇḍena bhīmā rudhiranimnagāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
भ्रमताऽनेन रौद्रेण रणे कालाग्निवर्च्चसा ..
कृताः समरशौण्डेन भीमा रुधिरनिम्नगाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: RoOption as he wandered in battle, fierce, with the lustre of the cosmic fire at the end of time, / dreadful rivers of blood were made by him who was skilled in war.

sanskrit_iast:
paraśvadhāgravikṣepagatajīvitakuñjaraiḥ ..
pādopalaiśca samare pratastāra sa bhārgavaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
परश्वधाग्रविक्षेपगतजीवितकुञ्जरैः ..
पादोपलैश्च समरे प्रतस्तार स भार्गवः .. 25 ..
text_mt: With elephants whose lives were ended by the stroke of the tip of his axe / and with rocks as footstones, that descendant of Bhṛgu paved [the field] in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dantidantapadanyāsaprāptaṃ kuñjaramastakam ..
vinighnansa gajārohācchyenavadvicaran laghu .. 26 ..
meaning:
दन्तिदन्तपदन्यासप्राप्तं कुञ्जरमस्तकम् ..
विनिघ्नन्स गजारोहाच्छ्येनवद्विचरन् लघु .. 26 ..
text_mt: Stepping onto elephant-heads by placing his feet on their tusks, / he struck riders down from elephants, moving lightly like a falcon.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya kuṃjarañcaikaṃ kuñjarātkuñjarāntaram ..
apaśyāma raṇe rāmaṃ vicarantaṃ yathāsukham .. 27 ..
meaning:
आरुह्य कुंजरञ्चैकं कुञ्जरात्कुञ्जरान्तरम् ..
अपश्याम रणे रामं विचरन्तं यथासुखम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Mounting one elephant, and from that elephant to another, / we saw Rāma moving at his ease in the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo bhūmigato rāmaḥ kuñjarāṇāṃ paraśvadhā ..
cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ pralayāgnirivotthitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
भूयो भूमिगतो रामः कुञ्जराणां परश्वधा ..
चकार कदनं घोरं प्रलयाग्निरिवोत्थितः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Returning to the ground, Rāma wrought terrible slaughter / upon the elephants with his axe, like the fire of dissolution arisen.

sanskrit_iast:
chinnāgrahastānviradāndviradāñchoṇitokṣitān ..
kṣitau gatā na paśyāmaḥ śyāmīkṛtadigantarān.. 29 ..
meaning:
छिन्नाग्रहस्तान्विरदान्द्विरदाञ्छोणितोक्षितान् ..
क्षितौ गता न पश्यामः श्यामीकृतदिगन्तरान्.. 29 ..
text_mt: Elephants with severed trunks, smeared with blood, / falling to the earth, darkened the quarters of the sky before our eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi yudhyatā tena raṇe kālāgnivarcasā ..
hatāni dānavendrāṇāṃ prayutānyarbudāni ca .. 1.48.30 ..
meaning:
एवं हि युध्यता तेन रणे कालाग्निवर्चसा ..
हतानि दानवेन्द्राणां प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च .. 1.48.30 ..
text_mt: By him thus fighting in battle with the lustre of the fire of dissolution, / millions and hundreds of millions of lords of the Dānavas were slain.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ prahāraṃ saṃsoḍhuṃ neyaṃ śaktā vasundharā ..
teṣāṃ prahārabhinnāṅgo naiva rāmo vyakampata .. 31 ..
meaning:
येषां प्रहारं संसोढुं नेयं शक्ता वसुन्धरा ..
तेषां प्रहारभिन्नाङ्गो नैव रामो व्यकम्पत .. 31 ..
text_mt: Though his limbs were struck by the blows of those whose impact / this earth was not able to endure, Rāma did not waver at all.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā prahāravaiklavyaṃ nihatāṃśca mahāsurān ..
pradudruvurdaityagaṇāḥ sālvaṃ śaraṇamāhave .. 32 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा प्रहारवैक्लव्यं निहतांश्च महासुरान् ..
प्रदुद्रुवुर्दैत्यगणाः साल्वं शरणमाहवे .. 32 ..
text_mt: Seeing the helplessness under his blows and the great asuras slain, / the hosts of Daityas fled in battle to Sālva for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
alpāvaśiṣṭānditijānpranaṣṭānsaṃvīkṣya sālvaḥ svahite niviṣṭān ..
rāmaṃ yayau tena gajena yuddhe rāmādraṇe yuddhamabhīpsamānaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
अल्पावशिष्टान्दितिजान्प्रनष्टान्संवीक्ष्य साल्वः स्वहिते निविष्टान् ..
रामं ययौ तेन गजेन युद्धे रामाद्रणे युद्धमभीप्समानः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Seeing the remaining few sons of Diti fleeing, intent on saving themselves, / Sālva approached Rāma in battle on that elephant, desiring combat with Rāma in the fight.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sālvo mahātejāḥ kuñjareṇa tarasvinā ..
arpayāmāsa dharmajña reṇukānandavardhanam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
ततः साल्वो महातेजाः कुञ्जरेण तरस्विना ..
अर्पयामास धर्मज्ञ रेणुकानन्दवर्धनम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then Sālva, of great splendour, attacked the one who increases the joy of Reṇukā / with his swift elephant, O knower of dharma.
title: Sālvavadhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
stabdhakarṇo vivṛttākṣaḥ kṛtvā kuṇḍalinaṃ karam ..
grīvāṃ sañcālayannāgo yayau gajamadoddhatam .. 2 ..
meaning:
स्तब्धकर्णो विवृत्ताक्षः कृत्वा कुण्डलिनं करम् ..
ग्रीवां सञ्चालयन्नागो ययौ गजमदोद्धतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: With stiffened ears and rolling eyes, curling its trunk / and tossing its neck, the elephant advanced, arrogant with rut.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaivāpatatastasya vegaṃ rāmo'pi taṃ gajam ..
huṃkāramātreṇa raṇe stambhayāmāsa vegitam .. 3 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैवापततस्तस्य वेगं रामोऽपि तं गजम् ..
हुंकारमात्रेण रणे स्तम्भयामास वेगितम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Seeing the fury of that elephant as it charged, Rāma / halted it in battle in its rush with a mere roar.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhayāmāsa nāgendraṃ śailendraśikharopamam ..
tasthau sa puratastasya sālvasya samarapriyaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
स्तम्भयामास नागेन्द्रं शैलेन्द्रशिखरोपमम् ..
तस्थौ स पुरतस्तस्य साल्वस्य समरप्रियः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having halted that lord of elephants resembling the peak of a lordly mountain, / he, fond of battle, stood before Sālva.

sanskrit_iast:
paraśuṃ rudhirāktāṅgaṃ sakalaṅkamalaṃ kare ..
dhārayan viṣṇuvadyāti sakalaṃ kamalaṅkare .. 5 ..
meaning:
परशुं रुधिराक्ताङ्गं सकलङ्कमलं करे ..
धारयन् विष्णुवद्याति सकलं कमलङ्करे .. 5 ..
text_mt: Holding in his hand the axe with its edge stained with blood, free of fault, / he went like Viṣṇu, who holds the complete lotus in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
dantinā dantinaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ rāmasyā''roḍhumicchataḥ ..
jahāra vegavānvegaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
दन्तिना दन्तिनः पृष्ठं रामस्या'ऽरोढुमिच्छतः ..
जहार वेगवान्वेगं शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः .. 6 ..
text_mt: As Rāma was wishing to mount the back of the elephant from [another] elephant, / the swift [Sālva] checked his momentum with straight-jointed arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
sālvasāyakasaṃghātavimukhīkṛtavikramam ..
rāmaṃ raṇe daityagaṇāśchādayanti varāyudhaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
साल्वसायकसंघातविमुखीकृतविक्रमम् ..
रामं रणे दैत्यगणाश्छादयन्ति वरायुधैः .. 7 ..
text_mt: When his prowess was turned away by the barrage of Sālva's arrows, / the hosts of Daityas covered Rāma in battle with choice weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā so'strapuṃjena rāmaḥ saṃchādito raṇe ..
nimīlitākṣaścikṣepa sālvāya paraśuṃ tadā .. 8 ..
meaning:
महता सोऽस्त्रपुंजेन रामः संछादितो रणे ..
निमीलिताक्षश्चिक्षेप साल्वाय परशुं तदा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Completely covered in battle by that vast mass of missiles, / Rāma, closing his eyes, then hurled his axe at Sālva.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchamānaṃ vegena sālvastaṃ paraśuṃ raṇe ..
āyudhairvārayāmāsa na śaśāka ca śatruhā .. 9 ..
meaning:
आगच्छमानं वेगेन साल्वस्तं परशुं रणे ..
आयुधैर्वारयामास न शशाक च शत्रुहा .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the battle, Sālva warded off with weapons that axe coming with speed, / but the slayer of enemies could not [stop it].

sanskrit_iast:
sa sālvāyudhasaṃghātaṃ bhaṅktvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..
jahāra śīrṣaṃ sālvasya mukuṭottamabhūṣitam .. 1.49.10 ..
meaning:
स साल्वायुधसंघातं भङ्क्त्वा सर्वमशेषतः ..
जहार शीर्षं साल्वस्य मुकुटोत्तमभूषितम् .. 1.49.10 ..
text_mt: Having shattered all of Sālva's mass of weapons without exception, / it carried off Sālva's head, adorned with an excellent crown.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo'pi bhūtalātprāpya gadāṃ hemavibhūṣitām ..
āvidhya nijaghānograṃ sālvaṃ kuñjarasaṃsthitam .. 11 ..
meaning:
रामोऽपि भूतलात्प्राप्य गदां हेमविभूषिताम् ..
आविध्य निजघानोग्रं साल्वं कुञ्जरसंस्थितम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Rāma too, seizing a gold-adorned mace from the ground, / swung it and struck down the fierce Sālva who was mounted on his elephant,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāvaṅkuśadharau śreṣṭhau dvau ca carmāsidhāriṇau ..
patākādhāriṇaṃ caikaṃ gajasya jaghane sthitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
द्वावङ्कुशधरौ श्रेष्ठौ द्वौ च चर्मासिधारिणौ ..
पताकाधारिणं चैकं गजस्य जघने स्थितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Two excellent hook-bearers, two shield-and-sword-bearers, / and one banner-bearer who stood on the elephant’s rump,

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ ca tasya sālvasya patākāṃ ca manoramām ..
etadādāya sakalamājagāma vasundharām .. 13 ..
meaning:
देहं च तस्य साल्वस्य पताकां च मनोरमाम् ..
एतदादाय सकलमाजगाम वसुन्धराम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: As well as the body of that Sālva and his charming banner; / having seized all this, he came to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhanādena rāmasya vitrasto gajayūthapaḥ ..
ārttanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā pradudrāva narādhipa .. 14 ..
meaning:
सिंहनादेन रामस्य वित्रस्तो गजयूथपः ..
आर्त्तनादं महत्कृत्वा प्रदुद्राव नराधिप .. 14 ..
text_mt: Terrified by the lion-roar of Rāma, the lord of the elephant herd / uttered a great cry of distress and fled, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmakarmaṇi vṛtte tu bhūtalātparaśuṃ raṇe ..
jagrāha vegāvānvegāddānavāntacikīrṣayā .. 15 ..
meaning:
रामकर्मणि वृत्ते तु भूतलात्परशुं रणे ..
जग्राह वेगावान्वेगाद्दानवान्तचिकीर्षया .. 15 ..
text_mt: When Rāma's deed was done, the swift one swiftly seized the axe / from the ground in the battle, desiring to bring about the destruction of the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saparaśuṃ rāmaṃ sālvaṃ ca vinipātitam ..
hataśeṣāstu te daityāḥ praviṣṭā varuṇālayam ..16..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सपरशुं रामं साल्वं च विनिपातितम् ..
हतशेषास्तु ते दैत्याः प्रविष्टा वरुणालयम् ..16..
text_mt: Seeing Rāma holding the axe and Sālva struck down, / the remaining Daityas, who had survived the slaughter, entered the abode of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ ..
āyodhanamupājagmuḥ puraskṛtya pitāmaham .. 17 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः ..
आयोधनमुपाजग्मुः पुरस्कृत्य पितामहम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: At that very time, the gods, with Indra at their head, / placed the Grandfather in front and approached the battlefield.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmamakarotteṣāṃ rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ ..
pūjayitvā tu te rāmaṃ yayurdevāḥ svamālayam .. 18 ..
meaning:
प्रणाममकरोत्तेषां रामो रतिकरः पितुः ..
पूजयित्वा तु ते रामं ययुर्देवाः स्वमालयम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Rāma, who brings delight to his father, bowed down to them. / Having worshipped Rāma, the gods went to their own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
śakro'pi labdhvā tridivaṃ rāmabāhuprasādhitam ..
vijahāra divaṃ rājanpālayāno jagattrayam .. 19 ..
meaning:
शक्रोऽपि लब्ध्वा त्रिदिवं रामबाहुप्रसाधितम् ..
विजहार दिवं राजन्पालयानो जगत्त्रयम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Śakra, too, having regained heaven, made secure by Rāma's arm, / wandered freely in heaven, O king, protecting the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
rathena siṃhayuktena mahādevo'pi bhārgavam..
ādāya prayayau śīghraṃ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam .. 1.49.20 ..
meaning:
रथेन सिंहयुक्तेन महादेवोऽपि भार्गवम्..
आदाय प्रययौ शीघ्रं कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम् .. 1.49.20 ..
text_mt: Mahādeva as well, having taken the Bhārgava on his chariot yoked with lions, / departed swiftly for Kailāsa, the foremost of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
snehena cā'sya gātrāṇāṃ cakre sammārjanaṃ haraḥ ..
yenā''sīdbalavān rāmo nirvraṇaśca mahāśayāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
स्नेहेन चाऽस्य गात्राणां चक्रे सम्मार्जनं हरः ..
येना'ऽसीद्बलवान् रामो निर्व्रणश्च महाशयाः .. 21 ..
text_mt: And out of affection Hara wiped his limbs, / whereby Rāma became strong, woundless, and noble-minded.

sanskrit_iast:
gatavraṇaṃ śriyopetaṃ jayaṃ labdhvā hyupasthitam ..
rāmaṃ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt. 22 ..
meaning:
गतव्रणं श्रियोपेतं जयं लब्ध्वा ह्युपस्थितम् ..
रामं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठं शंकरो वाक्यमब्रवीत्. 22 ..
text_mt: To Rāma, whose wounds were gone, endowed with splendour, who had attained victory and was standing before him, / the best among strikers, Śaṅkara spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
rāmarāma mahābhāga tvayā'haṃ paritoṣitaḥ ..
tasmāttavā'haṃ dāsyāmi cāstragrāmaṃ hyanuttamam .. 23 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
रामराम महाभाग त्वयाऽहं परितोषितः ..
तस्मात्तवाऽहं दास्यामि चास्त्रग्रामं ह्यनुत्तमम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / "Rāma, Rāma, O highly fortunate one, I am thoroughly pleased by you. / Therefore I shall give you the unsurpassed collection of divine weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe śaktastvameko bhuvi bhārgava ..
tava dhairyamanaupamyaṃ tava sattvamanuttamam .. 24 ..
meaning:
अस्त्राणां धारणे शक्तस्त्वमेको भुवि भार्गव ..
तव धैर्यमनौपम्यं तव सत्त्वमनुत्तमम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: You alone on earth, O Bhārgava, are capable of bearing divine weapons. / Your fortitude is incomparable; your strength of character is unsurpassed.

sanskrit_iast:
astrayogamihasthastvaṃ kṛtvā putra śanaiḥśanaiḥ ..
sarvāstravittato rāma gantāsi pitaraṃ svakam .. 25 ..
meaning:
अस्त्रयोगमिहस्थस्त्वं कृत्वा पुत्र शनैःशनैः ..
सर्वास्त्रवित्ततो राम गन्तासि पितरं स्वकम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having practiced the yoga of divine weapons right here, my son, gradually / knowing all divine weapons, O Rāma, you shall then go to your own father.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaiva paraśurdivyaḥ pitrā dattastavā'nagha ..
adya prabhṛti te kṣiptaḥ karaṃ bhūyaḥ sameṣyati .. 26 ..
meaning:
यश्चैव परशुर्दिव्यः पित्रा दत्तस्तवाऽनघ ..
अद्य प्रभृति ते क्षिप्तः करं भूयः समेष्यति .. 26 ..
text_mt: And the divine axe that was given to you by your father, O sinless one, / from this day onward, when cast, will return back to your hand.

sanskrit_iast:
upalakṣaṇametacca tathā tava bhaviṣyati ..
chetsyāmi te saṃśayāṃśca nirvṛto bhava putraka .. 27 ..
meaning:
उपलक्षणमेतच्च तथा तव भविष्यति ..
छेत्स्यामि ते संशयांश्च निर्वृतो भव पुत्रक .. 27 ..
text_mt: And this will likewise be a distinguishing mark for you. / I shall also cut away your doubts; be at ease, my dear son."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ityevamuktaḥ paripūrṇakāmo rāmo mahātmā jitasainyanāvaḥ ..
uvāsa tatra pramathaiḥ sametaḥ sarvāṇyathāstrāṇyanuśikṣamāṇaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्तः परिपूर्णकामो रामो महात्मा जितसैन्यनावः ..
उवास तत्र प्रमथैः समेतः सर्वाण्यथास्त्राण्यनुशिक्षमाणः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having been addressed thus, with his desires completely fulfilled, the great-souled Rāma, who had overcome the boat of the [enemy] army, / dwelt there together with the Pramathas, learning all the divine weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
brahmāstraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramāgneyamatha vāsavam ..
astrañca nairṛtaṃ yāmyaṃ kauberamatha vāruṇam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रं वैष्णवं रौद्रमाग्नेयमथ वासवम् ..
अस्त्रञ्च नैरृतं याम्यं कौबेरमथ वारुणम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Brahmā-weapon, the Vaiṣṇava, the Raudra, the Āgneya, and then the Vāsava; / and the Nairṛta weapon, the Yāmya, the Kaubera, and then the Vāruṇa;
title: Pradānam

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyamatha saumyañca sauraṃ pārvatameva ca ..
cakrāstramatha vajrāstraṃ pāśāstraṃ sārpameva ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
वायव्यमथ सौम्यञ्च सौरं पार्वतमेव च ..
चक्रास्त्रमथ वज्रास्त्रं पाशास्त्रं सार्पमेव च .. 2 ..
text_mt: The Vāyavya, and then the Saumya, the Saura, and also the Pārvata; / the Cakra-weapon, and then the Vajra-weapon, the Pāśa-weapon, and also the Sārpa;

sanskrit_iast:
gāndharvaṃ svāpanaṃ bhautaṃ tathā pāśupataṃ śubham ..
aiṣīkaṃ tarjanaṃ prāsaṃ bhāruṇḍaṃ nartanaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
गान्धर्वं स्वापनं भौतं तथा पाशुपतं शुभम् ..
ऐषीकं तर्जनं प्रासं भारुण्डं नर्तनं तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: The Gāndharva, the Svāpana, the Bhauta, and the auspicious Pāśupata; / the Aiṣīka, the Tarjana, the Prāsa, the Bhāruṇḍa, and also the Nartana;

sanskrit_iast:
astrarodhanamādityaṃ raivataṃ mānavaṃ tathā ..
akṣisaṃtarjanaṃ bhīmaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ rodhanaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
अस्त्ररोधनमादित्यं रैवतं मानवं तथा ..
अक्षिसंतर्जनं भीमं जृम्भणं रोधनं तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: The Astra-rodhana, the Āditya, the Raivata, and also the Mānava; / the terrifying Akṣi-saṃtarjana, the Jṛmbhaṇa, and also the Rodhana;

sanskrit_iast:
sauparṇamatha pārjanyaṃ rākṣasaṃ mohanaṃ tathā ..

rāma uvāca ..

text_mt: Rāma said: / "O god of gods, O Mahādeva, whose hair is tossed by the Gaṅgā, / who are joined with the crescent of the moon, exceedingly resplendent with a mass of matted locks,

pārvatīdattadehārdha kāmakālāṅganāśana ..

भगनेत्रान्तकाचिन्त्य पूष्णो दशनशातन .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: Who have given half of your body to Pārvatī, destroyer of Kāma, Kāla, and the body [of Smara], / destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, inconceivable one, crusher of the teeth of Pūṣan!

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ parataraṃ devaṃ nā'nyaṃ paśyāmi kañcana ..

text_mt: I see no other god higher than you. / The gods, along with Indra, always worship your liṅga.

stuvanti tvāmṛṣigaṇā dhyāyanti ca muhurmuhuḥ ..

text_mt: The hosts of sages praise you and meditate upon you again and again; / and with devotion they worship you, the boon-giver, O Supreme Lord.

text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, indefinable, the cause of the causes of the universe, / with hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and faces everywhere,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃllokāḥ sphurantīme jāle śakunayo yathā ..
ṛtamekākṣaraṃ brahma yattatsadasataḥ param .. 25 ..
meaning:
यस्मिंल्लोकाः स्फुरन्तीमे जाले शकुनयो यथा ..
ऋतमेकाक्षरं ब्रह्म यत्तत्सदसतः परम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: in whom these worlds flutter like birds in a net; / the truth, the single-syllabled brahman, which is beyond being and non-being,

sanskrit_iast:
anādimadhyaparyantaṃ na devā narṣayo viduḥ ..
yaṃ surāsuragandharvāssaṃsiddharṣimahoragāḥ..26..
meaning:
अनादिमध्यपर्यन्तं न देवा नर्षयो विदुः ..
यं सुरासुरगन्धर्वास्संसिद्धर्षिमहोरगाः..26..
text_mt: without beginning, middle, or end, whom neither gods nor seers know; / whom gods, asuras, gandharvas, perfected ones, seers, and great serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
prayatā nityamarcanti paramaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam ..
anādinidhanaṃ devamātmayoniṃ sanātanam .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रयता नित्यमर्चन्ति परमं दुःखभेषजम् ..
अनादिनिधनं देवमात्मयोनिं सनातनम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: striving, ever worship, the supreme medicine for sorrow; / the God without beginning or end, self-originated, eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ..
ativāyvindrakarmāṇaṃ cā'tisūryāgnitejasam .. 28 ..
meaning:
अप्रतर्क्यमविज्ञेयं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम् ..
अतिवाय्विन्द्रकर्माणं चाऽतिसूर्याग्नितेजसम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: inconceivable, unknowable, Hari, Nārāyaṇa, the Lord, / whose deeds surpass Vāyu and Indra, whose splendour surpasses the sun and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
atibuddhīndriyagrāmaṃ taṃ prapadye prajāpatim ..
yaṃ vai viśvasya karttāraṃ jagatastasthuṣāṃ patim .. 29 ..
meaning:
अतिबुद्धीन्द्रियग्रामं तं प्रपद्ये प्रजापतिम् ..
यं वै विश्वस्य कर्त्तारं जगतस्तस्थुषां पतिम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: who transcends the collection of intellect and senses—in that Prajāpati I take refuge; / whom indeed they call the maker of all, the Lord of the moving and unmoving world,

sanskrit_iast:
vadanti jagato'dhyakṣamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam ..
yasyāgnirāsyaṃ dyaurmūrdhā khaṃ nābhiścaraṇau kṣitiḥ .. 1.52.30 ..
meaning:
वदन्ति जगतोऽध्यक्षमक्षरं परमं पदम् ..
यस्याग्निरास्यं द्यौर्मूर्धा खं नाभिश्चरणौ क्षितिः .. 1.52.30 ..
text_mt: the overseer of the world, imperishable, the supreme abode; / whose mouth is fire, whose head is heaven, whose navel is space, whose feet are the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
candrādityau ca nayane taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ..
yasya trilokī jaṭhare yasya kāṣṭhāśca vāhanāḥ ..31..
meaning:
चन्द्रादित्यौ च नयने तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम् ..
यस्य त्रिलोकी जठरे यस्य काष्ठाश्च वाहनाः ..31..
text_mt: and whose eyes are the moon and the sun—I meditate upon that God; / in whose belly are the three worlds, whose mounts are the cardinal points,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śvāsaśca pavanastaṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ..
viṣaye vartamānānāṃ yaṃ taṃ vaiśeṣikairguṇaiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
यस्य श्वासश्च पवनस्तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम् ..
विषये वर्तमानानां यं तं वैशेषिकैर्गुणैः .. 32 ..
text_mt: and whose breath is the wind—I meditate upon that God; / whom, for those existing in the realm of sense-objects, through distinguishing qualities

sanskrit_iast:
prāhurviṣayagoptāraṃ taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ..
paraḥ kālātparo yajñātparassadasataśca yaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
प्राहुर्विषयगोप्तारं तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम् ..
परः कालात्परो यज्ञात्परस्सदसतश्च यः .. 33 ..
text_mt: they call the protector of sense-objects—I meditate upon that God; / who is beyond time, beyond sacrifice, and beyond being and non-being,

sanskrit_iast:
anādirādirviśvasya taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ..
padbhyāṃ yasya kṣitirjātā śrotrābhyāñca tathā diśaḥ ..34..
meaning:
अनादिरादिर्विश्वस्य तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम् ..
पद्भ्यां यस्य क्षितिर्जाता श्रोत्राभ्याञ्च तथा दिशः ..34..
text_mt: the beginningless origin of the universe—I meditate upon that God; / from whose feet was born the earth, and likewise from his ears the directions,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvabhāge divaṃ yasya taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham..
nābhyāṃ yasyāntarikṣasya nāsābhyāṃ pavanasya ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
पूर्वभागे दिवं यस्य तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम्..
नाभ्यां यस्यान्तरिक्षस्य नासाभ्यां पवनस्य च .. 35 ..
text_mt: from whose upper part [came] heaven—I meditate upon that God; / from whose navel came the atmosphere, and from his nostrils the wind,

sanskrit_iast: prasvedādambhasāṃ janma taṃ devaṃ cintayāmyaham ..36..
meaning: प्रस्वेदादम्भसां जन्म तं देवं चिन्तयाम्यहम् ..36..
text_mt: from whose sweat was the birth of the waters—I meditate upon that God,

sanskrit_iast:
varāhaśīrṣaṃ narasiṃharūpaṃ deveśvaraṃ vāmanarūparūpam..
trailokyanāthaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ rāma nityaṃ manasā nato'smi..37..
meaning:
वराहशीर्षं नरसिंहरूपं देवेश्वरं वामनरूपरूपम्..
त्रैलोक्यनाथं वरदं वरेण्यं तं राम नित्यं मनसा नतोऽस्मि..37..
text_mt: who has the head of a boar, the form of Narasiṃha, the Lord of gods, who took the form of the Dwarf, / the Lord of the three worlds, the giver of boons, the choice—to him, O Rāma, I bow down constantly in my mind;

sanskrit_iast:
vāktrādyasya brāhmaṇāssaṃprasūtā yadvakṣasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ saṃprasūtāḥ ..
yasyoruyugmācca tathaiva vaiśyāḥ padbhyāṃ tathā yasya śūdrāḥ prasūtāḥ ..38..
meaning:
वाक्त्राद्यस्य ब्राह्मणास्संप्रसूता यद्वक्षसः क्षत्रियाः संप्रसूताः ..
यस्योरुयुग्माच्च तथैव वैश्याः पद्भ्यां तथा यस्य शूद्राः प्रसूताः ..38..
text_mt: from whose mouth brahmins were born, from whose chest kṣatriyas were born, / from whose pair of thighs likewise vaiśyas, and from whose feet śūdras were born,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptaṃ tathā yena jagatsamagraṃ vibhūtibhirbhūtabhavodbhavena ..
devādhināthaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ rāma nityaṃ manasā nato'smi..39..
meaning:
व्याप्तं तथा येन जगत्समग्रं विभूतिभिर्भूतभवोद्भवेन ..
देवाधिनाथं वरदं वरेण्यं तं राम नित्यं मनसा नतोऽस्मि..39..
text_mt: by whom likewise the entire world was pervaded through his divine powers, the source of what has been and what will be, / the Sovereign of gods, the giver of boons, the choice—to him, O Rāma, I bow down constantly in my mind.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
varāhaṃ narasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ ca maheśvara..
tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi prādurbhāvānmahātmanaḥ ..1..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
वराहं नरसिंहं च वामनं च महेश्वर..
त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रादुर्भावान्महात्मनः ..1..
text_mt: Rāma said: / The Boar, Narasiṃha, and the Dwarf, O Maheśvara— / I wish to hear from you about these manifestations of the Great Self.
title: Hiraṇyākṣavadhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca..
aditiśca ditiścaiva dve bhārye kaśyapasya ca ..
aditirjanayāmāsa devānindrapurogamān ..2..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच..
अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्य च ..
अदितिर्जनयामास देवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान् ..2..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Aditi and Diti were the two wives of Kaśyapa. / Aditi gave birth to the gods headed by Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
ditiśca janayāmāsa dvau putrau bhīmavikramau ..
hiraṇyākṣaṃ durādharṣaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
दितिश्च जनयामास द्वौ पुत्रौ भीमविक्रमौ ..
हिरण्याक्षं दुराधर्षं हिरण्यकशिपुं तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: and Diti gave birth to two sons of terrible prowess: / Hiraṇyākṣa, hard to assail, and likewise Hiraṇyakaśipu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'bhiṣiktavāñchakraṃ devarājye prajāpatiḥ ..
dānavānāṃ tathā rājye hiraṇyākṣaṃ balotkaṭam .. 4 ..
meaning:
ततोऽभिषिक्तवाञ्छक्रं देवराज्ये प्रजापतिः ..
दानवानां तथा राज्ये हिरण्याक्षं बलोत्कटम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Then Prajāpati consecrated Śakra to the kingship over the gods, / and likewise the excessively strong Hiraṇyākṣa to the kingship over the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣicya tayoḥ prādātsvargaṃ pātālameva ca..
pātālaṃ śāsati tathā hiraṇyākṣe mahāsure ..5..
meaning:
अभिषिच्य तयोः प्रादात्स्वर्गं पातालमेव च..
पातालं शासति तथा हिरण्याक्षे महासुरे ..5..
text_mt:
