Having consecrated them, he gave heaven and the netherworld to the two.
And as the great Asura Hiraṇyākṣa ruled the netherworld,

sanskrit_iast:
dharādhārā dharāṃ tyaktvā khamutpetū rayātpurā..
pakṣavanto mahābhāga nūnaṃ bhāvyarthacoditāḥ .. ..6..
meaning:
धराधारा धरां त्यक्त्वा खमुत्पेतू रयात्पुरा..
पक्षवन्तो महाभाग नूनं भाव्यर्थचोदिताः .. ..6..
text_mt:
the mountains formerly abandoned the earth and flew up into the sky with speed,
having wings, O fortunate one, surely impelled by destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
dharādharaparityaktā dharā calanibandhanā ..
yadā tadā daityapuraṃ sakalaṃ vyāptamambhasā .. 7 ..
meaning:
धराधरपरित्यक्ता धरा चलनिबन्धना ..
यदा तदा दैत्यपुरं सकलं व्याप्तमम्भसा .. 7 ..
text_mt:
When the earth, abandoned by the mountains, lost its stability,
then the entire city of the Daityas was flooded with water.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaiva svapuraṃ vyāptamambhasā ditijottamaḥ ..
sainyamudyojayāmāsa jātaśaṅkaḥ surānprati .. 8 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैव स्वपुरं व्याप्तमम्भसा दितिजोत्तमः ..
सैन्यमुद्योजयामास जातशङ्कः सुरान्प्रति .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Seeing his own city submerged in water, the foremost of Diti's sons,
aroused with suspicion toward the gods, mobilized his army.

sanskrit_iast:
udyuktena sa sainyena daityānāṃ caturaṃgiṇā ..
vijitya tridaśāñjanye ājahāra triviṣṭapam .. .. 9 ..
meaning:
उद्युक्तेन स सैन्येन दैत्यानां चतुरंगिणा ..
विजित्य त्रिदशाञ्जन्ये आजहार त्रिविष्टपम् .. .. 9 ..
text_mt:
With the prepared fourfold army of the Daityas,
he conquered the thirty [gods] in battle and seized heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtādhikārāstridaśā jagmuḥ śaraṇamañjasā ..
devarājaṃ puraskṛtya vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum .. 1.53.10 ..
meaning:
हृताधिकारास्त्रिदशा जग्मुः शरणमञ्जसा ..
देवराजं पुरस्कृत्य वासुदेवमजं विभुम् .. 1.53.10 ..
text_mt:
Deprived of their authority, the thirty [gods] straightaway went for refuge,
placing the king of the gods at their head, to Vāsudeva, the unborn, all-pervading Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tridaśāñcharaṇaṃ prāptā nhiraṇyākṣavivāsitān..
saṃyojyā'bhayadānena visasarja janārdanaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
त्रिदशाञ्छरणं प्राप्ता न्हिरण्याक्षविवासितान्..
संयोज्याऽभयदानेन विससर्ज जनार्दनः .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Having granted protection to the thirty [gods] who had sought refuge,
exiled by Hiraṇyākṣa, Janārdana dismissed them.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya tridaśānsarvāñcintayāmāsa keśavaḥ ..
kinnu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā ghātayiṣye surārdanam ..12..
meaning:
विसृज्य त्रिदशान्सर्वाञ्चिन्तयामास केशवः ..
किन्नु रूपमहं कृत्वा घातयिष्ये सुरार्दनम् ..12..
text_mt:
Having dismissed all the thirty [gods], Keśava reflected:
'What form should I assume to slay the tormentor of the gods?

sanskrit_iast:
tiryaṅmanuṣyadevānāmavadhyaḥ sa surāntakaḥ ..
brahmaṇo varadānena tasmāttasya vadhepsayā ..13..
meaning:
तिर्यङ्मनुष्यदेवानामवध्यः स सुरान्तकः ..
ब्रह्मणो वरदानेन तस्मात्तस्य वधेप्सया ..13..
text_mt:
That slayer of the gods is invulnerable to animals, men, and gods
by the boon granted by Brahmā; therefore, desiring his death,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛvarāho bhaviṣyāmi na devo na ca mānuṣaḥ ..
tiryagrūpeṇa caivāhaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi taṃ tataḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
नृवराहो भविष्यामि न देवो न च मानुषः ..
तिर्यग्रूपेण चैवाहं घातयिष्यामि तं ततः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
I shall become a man-boar—neither god nor human—
and in the form of an animal I shall then slay him.'

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā saṃgena nṛvarāho'bhavatprabhuḥ ..
cūrṇitāñjanaśailābhastapta jāmbūnadāmbaraḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा संगेन नृवराहोऽभवत्प्रभुः ..
चूर्णिताञ्जनशैलाभस्तप्त जाम्बूनदाम्बरः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord instantly became a man-boar,
resembling a mountain of powdered collyrium, clad in heated gold,

sanskrit_iast:
yamunāvarttakṛṣṇāṅgaḥ tadāvartatanūruhaḥ ..
tadogha iva durvāryyastatpitrā tejasā samaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
यमुनावर्त्तकृष्णाङ्गः तदावर्ततनूरुहः ..
तदोघ इव दुर्वार्य्यस्तत्पित्रा तेजसा समः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
with dark limbs like the eddies of the Yamunā, his body hair like its whirlpools,
irresistible like its current, equal in splendour to its father [the Sun],

sanskrit_iast:
tatpravāha ivākṣobhyasta tpravāha ivaughavān ..
tatpravāhāmalatanustatpravāhamanoharaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
तत्प्रवाह इवाक्षोभ्यस्त त्प्रवाह इवौघवान् ..
तत्प्रवाहामलतनुस्तत्प्रवाहमनोहरः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
unshakable like its flow, mighty like its rush,
with a spotless body like its stream, delightful like its flow,

sanskrit_iast:
sajalāñjanakṛṣṇāṅgaḥ sajalāmbudasacchaviḥ ..
pītavāsāstadā bhāti savi dyudiva toyadaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
सजलाञ्जनकृष्णाङ्गः सजलाम्बुदसच्छविः ..
पीतवासास्तदा भाति सवि द्युदिव तोयदः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
with limbs dark as wet collyrium, possessing the complexion of a rain-laden cloud;
wearing yellow garments, he then shone like a rain-cloud with lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
urasā dhārayanhāraṃ śaśāṅkasadṛśacchaviḥ ..
śuśubhe sarvabhūtātmā sabalāka ivāmbudaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
उरसा धारयन्हारं शशाङ्कसदृशच्छविः ..
शुशुभे सर्वभूतात्मा सबलाक इवाम्बुदः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Bearing a necklace on his chest, having a lustre like the moon,
the Self of all beings shone like a cloud accompanied by cranes.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṅkalekhāvimale daṃṣṭre tasya virejatuḥ ..
meghāntaritabimbasya dvau bhāgau śaśino yathā .. 1.53.20 ..
meaning:
शशाङ्कलेखाविमले दंष्ट्रे तस्य विरेजतुः ..
मेघान्तरितबिम्बस्य द्वौ भागौ शशिनो यथा .. 1.53.20 ..
text_mt:
His two tusks gleamed, pure as the crescent moon,
like two parts of the moon whose disk is veiled by clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
karābhyāṃ dhārayanbhāti śaṅkhacakre janārdanaḥ .
candrārkasadṛśe rāma pādacārīva parvataḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कराभ्यां धारयन्भाति शङ्खचक्रे जनार्दनः .
चन्द्रार्कसदृशे राम पादचारीव पर्वतः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Bearing the conch and discus in his hands, Janārdana shone,
like the moon and the sun, O Rāma, as if a mountain walking on foot,

sanskrit_iast:
mahājīmūtasaṃkāśo mahājīmūtasannibhaḥ ..
mahajīmūtavadvegī mahābalaparākramaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
महाजीमूतसंकाशो महाजीमूतसन्निभः ..
महजीमूतवद्वेगी महाबलपराक्रमः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
resembling a great rain-cloud, looking like a great rain-cloud,
having the speed of a great rain-cloud, endowed with great strength and prowess.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavendravadhākāṅkṣī hiraṇyākṣasabhāṃ yayau ..
hiraṇyākṣo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam .. 23 ..
meaning:
दानवेन्द्रवधाकाङ्क्षी हिरण्याक्षसभां ययौ ..
हिरण्याक्षोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा नृवराहं जनार्दनम् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
Desiring the death of the lord of the Dānavas, he went to Hiraṇyākṣa’s assembly hall.
And seeing Janārdana as the man-boar, Hiraṇyākṣa

sanskrit_iast:
dānavām̐ścodayāmāsa tiryagjātamapūrvakam ..
gṛhyatāṃ vadhyatāṃ caiva krīḍārthaṃ sthāpyatāṃ tathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
दानवाम्̐श्चोदयामास तिर्यग्जातमपूर्वकम् ..
गृह्यतां वध्यतां चैव क्रीडार्थं स्थाप्यतां तथा .. 24 ..
text_mt:
urged on the Dānavas against that unprecedented animal-born creature:
'Let it be seized, let it be killed, and let it be kept for sport!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktaḥ saṃrabdhaḥ pāśahastām̐stu dānavān ..
jighṛkṣamāṇāṃścakreṇa jaghāna śataśo raṇe .. 25 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तः संरब्धः पाशहस्ताम्̐स्तु दानवान् ..
जिघृक्षमाणांश्चक्रेण जघान शतशो रणे .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Addressed thus, the furious [Lord] struck down in battle with his discus by the hundreds
those Dānavas with nooses in hand who sought to seize him.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamāneṣu daityeṣu hiraṇyākṣo'tha dānavān ..
codayāmāsa saṃrabdhānvarāhādhikakāraṇāt .. 26 ..
meaning:
हन्यमानेषु दैत्येषु हिरण्याक्षोऽथ दानवान् ..
चोदयामास संरब्धान्वराहाधिककारणात् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
As the Daityas were being slain, Hiraṇyākṣa then urged on
the furious Dānavas on account of the extraordinary boar.

sanskrit_iast:
coditā dānavendreṇa dāna vā śastrapāṇayaḥ ..
pravavarṣustathā devaṃ śastravarṣeṇa keśavam .. 27 ..
meaning:
चोदिता दानवेन्द्रेण दान वा शस्त्रपाणयः ..
प्रववर्षुस्तथा देवं शस्त्रवर्षेण केशवम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
Urged by the lord of the Dānavas, the Dānavas with weapons in hand
rained down a shower of weapons upon the god Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
daityāḥ śastranipātena devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
naiva śekurvṛthā kartuṃ yatnavanto'pi nirbhayāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
दैत्याः शस्त्रनिपातेन देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ..
नैव शेकुर्वृथा कर्तुं यत्नवन्तोऽपि निर्भयाः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
With their shower of weapons, the Daityas, though striving and fearless,
were entirely unable to render the God of gods, the discus-wielder, ineffectual.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamāno'pi daityendrairdānavānmadhusūdanaḥ..
jaghāna cakreṇa tadā śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ..29..
meaning:
हन्यमानोऽपि दैत्येन्द्रैर्दानवान्मधुसूदनः..
जघान चक्रेण तदा शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ..29..
text_mt:
Though struck by the leaders of the Daityas, Madhusūdana
then slaughtered the Dānavas with his discus by hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamāneṣu sainyeṣu hiraṇyākṣaḥ svayaṃ tataḥ ..
utthāya dhanuṣā devaṃ pravavarṣa surottamam .. 1.53.30 ..
meaning:
हन्यमानेषु सैन्येषु हिरण्याक्षः स्वयं ततः ..
उत्थाय धनुषा देवं प्रववर्ष सुरोत्तमम् .. 1.53.30 ..
text_mt:
As his armies were being destroyed, Hiraṇyākṣa himself then
arose and showered arrows from his bow upon the god, the highest of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣastu tāndṛṣṭvā viphalām̐śca śilī mukhān ..
śilīmukhābhānsaṃpaśyansamapaśyanmahadbhayam .. 31 ..
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा विफलाम्̐श्च शिली मुखान् ..
शिलीमुखाभान्संपश्यन्समपश्यन्महद्भयम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
Hiraṇyākṣa, seeing those arrows rendered futile,
and seeing [arrows] resembling bees, beheld a great terror.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'strairyuyudhe tena devadevena cakriṇā ..
tānyasya phalahīnāni cakāra bhagavān svayam .. 32 ..
meaning:
ततोऽस्त्रैर्युयुधे तेन देवदेवेन चक्रिणा ..
तान्यस्य फलहीनानि चकार भगवान् स्वयम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Then he fought with divine weapons against that God of gods, the wielder of the discus;
the Blessed One himself rendered them all futile.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gadāṃ kāñcanapaṭṭanaddhāṃ vibhūṣitāṃ kiṃkiṇijālasaṃghaiḥ ..
cikṣepa daityādhipatiḥ sa ghorāṃ tāṃ cā'pi devo viphalīcakāra .. 33 ..
meaning:
ततो गदां काञ्चनपट्टनद्धां विभूषितां किंकिणिजालसंघैः ..
चिक्षेप दैत्याधिपतिः स घोरां तां चाऽपि देवो विफलीचकार .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Then the ruler of the Daityas hurled a terrible mace, bound with golden bands
and adorned with clusters of tinkling bells; and the god rendered that futile as well.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiṃ tataḥ paṭṭavinaddhamadhyāmulkānalābhāṃ tapanīyacitrām ..
cikṣepa daityassa varāhakāye huṅkāradagdhā nipapāta sā ca.. .. 34 ..
meaning:
शक्तिं ततः पट्टविनद्धमध्यामुल्कानलाभां तपनीयचित्राम् ..
चिक्षेप दैत्यस्स वराहकाये हुङ्कारदग्धा निपपात सा च.. .. 34 ..
text_mt:
Then the Daitya hurled a spear, its middle bound with silk bands,
blazing like a meteor's fire and bright with gold, at the boar's body; and consumed by his roar, it fell.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastriśūlaṃ jvalitāgraśūlaṃ sa śīghragaṃ devagaṇasya saṃkhye ..
daityādhipastasya sajarja vegādavekṣitaḥ so'pi jagāma bhūmim .. 35 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्रिशूलं ज्वलिताग्रशूलं स शीघ्रगं देवगणस्य संख्ये ..
दैत्याधिपस्तस्य सजर्ज वेगादवेक्षितः सोऽपि जगाम भूमिम् .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Then in battle the ruler of the Daityas swiftly hurled at him a trident
with blazing points, swift-flying, [feared by] the host of gods; but when merely looked at, it fell to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhasvanenā'pi janārdanaśca vidrāvya daityānsakalānmahātmā ..
sakuṇḍalaṃ daityagaṇādhipasya ciccheda cakreṇa śiraḥ prasahya .. 36 ..
meaning:
शङ्खस्वनेनाऽपि जनार्दनश्च विद्राव्य दैत्यान्सकलान्महात्मा ..
सकुण्डलं दैत्यगणाधिपस्य चिच्छेद चक्रेण शिरः प्रसह्य .. 36 ..
text_mt:
And routing all the Daityas with the blast of his conch,
the great-souled Janārdana forcibly cut off the earringed head of the ruler of the Daitya hosts with his discus.

sanskrit_iast:
nipātite daityapatau sa devaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ śakrapitāmahābhyām ..
mayā ca sarvaistridaśaiḥ sametaijargāma kāṣṭhāṃ manasā tvabhīṣṭām .. 37 ..
meaning:
निपातिते दैत्यपतौ स देवः संपूजितः शक्रपितामहाभ्याम् ..
मया च सर्वैस्त्रिदशैः समेतैजर्गाम काष्ठां मनसा त्वभीष्टाम् .. 37 ..
text_mt:
When the ruler of the Daityas was struck down, that god, worshipped by Śakra and the Grandfather,
and by me together with all the thirty [gods], departed to the region desired in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śakropi labdhvā tridivaṃ mahātmā ciccheda pakṣāndharaṇīdharāṇām ..
rarakṣa cemāṃ sakalāṃ trilokīṃ dharmeṇa dharmajñabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ .. 38 .. ..
meaning:
शक्रोपि लब्ध्वा त्रिदिवं महात्मा चिच्छेद पक्षान्धरणीधराणाम् ..
ररक्ष चेमां सकलां त्रिलोकीं धर्मेण धर्मज्ञभृतां वरिष्ठः .. 38 .. ..
text_mt:
Śakra too, the great-souled, having regained heaven, severed the wings of the mountains
and protected all these three worlds with dharma, foremost among upholders of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
hiraṇyākṣe hate daitye bhrātā tasya mahātmanaḥ ..
hiraṇyakaśipurnāma cakārograṃ mahattapaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शङ्कर उवाच ..
हिरण्याक्षे हते दैत्ये भ्राता तस्य महात्मनः ..
हिरण्यकशिपुर्नाम चकारोग्रं महत्तपः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkara said:
When the Daitya Hiraṇyākṣa was slain, the brother of that great-souled one,
named Hiraṇyakaśipu, performed severe and great austerities.
title: Narasiṃhaprādurbhāvaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ..
japopavāsanirataḥ snānamaunāśritavrataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च ..
जपोपवासनिरतः स्नानमौनाश्रितव्रतः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
For ten thousand years and ten hundred years,
devoted to chanting and fasting, maintaining the vow of bathing and silence,

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥśamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa cā'nagha ..
brahmā prītamanāstasya svayamāgatya bhārgava .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
तपःशमदमाभ्यां च ब्रह्मचर्येण चाऽनघ ..
ब्रह्मा प्रीतमनास्तस्य स्वयमागत्य भार्गव .. .. 3 ..
text_mt:
through austerity, tranquility, self-restraint, and celibacy, O sinless one;
Brahmā, pleased in his heart, came in person to him, O descendant of Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānenā'rkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā ..
ādityaissahitaḥ sādhyaissahito marudaśvibhiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
विमानेनाऽर्कवर्णेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता ..
आदित्यैस्सहितः साध्यैस्सहितो मरुदश्विभिः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
in a brilliant aerial chariot having the colour of the sun and yoked with swans,
accompanied by the Ādityas, the Sādhyas, the Maruts, and the Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrairviśvasahāyaiśca yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ ..
digbhirvidigbhiśca tathā khecaraiśca mahāgrahaiḥ ..5 ..
meaning:
रुद्रैर्विश्वसहायैश्च यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः ..
दिग्भिर्विदिग्भिश्च तथा खेचरैश्च महाग्रहैः ..5 ..
text_mt:
along with the Rudras and the Viśvedevas, the Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and Pannagas,
the directions, intermediate directions, celestial wanderers, and great planets,

sanskrit_iast:
nimnagābhiḥ samudraiśca māsartvayanasaṃdhibhiḥ ..
nakṣatraiśca muhūrttaiśca kālasyāvayavaistathā .. 6 ..
meaning:
निम्नगाभिः समुद्रैश्च मासर्त्वयनसंधिभिः ..
नक्षत्रैश्च मुहूर्त्तैश्च कालस्यावयवैस्तथा .. 6 ..
text_mt:
the rivers and oceans, the junctures of months, seasons, and solstices,
the lunar mansions, muhūrtas, and divisions of time,

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamaiḥ siddhaiḥ saptarṣibhistathā ..
rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamairgandharvairapsarogaṇaiḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
देवर्षिभिः पुण्यतमैः सिद्धैः सप्तर्षिभिस्तथा ..
राजर्षिभिः पुण्यतमैर्गन्धर्वैरप्सरोगणैः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
the most holy divine seers, the Siddhas, and the seven seers,
the most holy royal seers, the Gandharvas, and the hosts of Apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
carācaraguruḥ śrīmānvṛtaḥ sarverdivaukasaiḥ ..
brahmā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho daityaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 8 ..
meaning:
चराचरगुरुः श्रीमान्वृतः सर्वेर्दिवौकसैः ..
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो दैत्यं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Surrounded by all the gods, the glorious teacher of the moving and unmoving, / Brahmā, the foremost of the knowers of Brahman, spoke these words to the Daitya:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca .. prītosmi tava bhaktasya tapasā'nena suvrata ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi .. 9 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच .. प्रीतोस्मि तव भक्तस्य तपसाऽनेन सुव्रत ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यथेष्टं काममाप्नुहि .. 9 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / I am pleased with this penance of yours, [my] devotee, O you of noble vows! / Choose a boon, good fortune to you! Obtain your desire as you wish!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipuruvāca .. na devāsuragandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ ..
na mānuṣāḥ piśācā vā hanyurmāṃ devasattama ..1.54.10..
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपुरुवाच .. न देवासुरगन्धर्वा न यक्षोरगराक्षसाः ..
न मानुषाः पिशाचा वा हन्युर्मां देवसत्तम ..1.54.10..
text_mt: Hiraṇyakaśipu said: / May neither gods, Asuras, nor Gandharvas, nor Yakṣas, Uragas, nor Rākṣasas, / nor humans, nor Piśācas slay me, O best of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayopi na māṃ śāpaṃ kruddhā lokapitāmaha ..
śapeyustapasā yuktā varametadvṛṇomyaham .. 11 ..
meaning:
ऋषयोपि न मां शापं क्रुद्धा लोकपितामह ..
शपेयुस्तपसा युक्ता वरमेतद्वृणोम्यहम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Nor may the sages endowed with penance curse me when enraged, O grandfather of the worlds! / This is the boon I choose.

sanskrit_iast:
na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena ca ..
na śuṣkena na cā''rdreṇa vadhaṃ me syātkathañcana .. 12 ..
meaning:
न शस्त्रेण न चास्त्रेण गिरिणा पादपेन च ..
न शुष्केन न चा'ऽर्द्रेण वधं मे स्यात्कथञ्चन .. 12 ..
text_mt: May my death not come by weapon or missile, by mountain or tree, / nor by what is dry, nor by what is moist, in any manner whatever!

sanskrit_iast:
bhaveyamahamevārkaḥ somo vāyurhutāśanaḥ ..
salilaṃ cā'ntarikṣañca nakṣatrāṇi diśo daśa .. 13 ..
meaning:
भवेयमहमेवार्कः सोमो वायुर्हुताशनः ..
सलिलं चाऽन्तरिक्षञ्च नक्षत्राणि दिशो दश .. 13 ..
text_mt: May I alone become the sun, the moon, the wind, the sacrificial fire, / the water, the intermediate space, the lunar mansions, and the ten directions!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ krodhaśca kāmaśca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ ..
dhanadaśca tathādhyakṣo yakṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
अहं क्रोधश्च कामश्च वरुणो वासवो यमः ..
धनदश्च तथाध्यक्षो यक्षः किंपुरुषाधिपः .. 14 ..
text_mt: May I be anger and desire, Varuṇa, Vāsava, Yama, / Kubera, the superintendent, the Yakṣa, and the lord of the Kiṃpuruṣas!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
ete divyavarāstāta mayā dattāstavādbhutāḥ ..
sarvānkāmānimām̐stasmātprāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
एते दिव्यवरास्तात मया दत्तास्तवाद्भुताः ..
सर्वान्कामानिमाम्̐स्तस्मात्प्राप्स्यसि त्वं न संशयः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / These wonderful, divine boons have been granted by me to you, my dear child. / Therefore, you shall attain all these desires; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavāñjagāmā''kāśameva hi ..
vairājaṃ devasadanaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam .. 16 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाञ्जगामा'ऽकाशमेव हि ..
वैराजं देवसदनं महर्षिगणसेवितम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having spoken thus, the Lord went directly to the sky, / to the Vairāja abode of the gods, frequented by the multitudes of great sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devāśca nāgāśca gandharvā munayastathā ..
varapradānaṃ śrutvaiva pitāmahamupasthitāḥ .. .. 17 ..
meaning:
ततो देवाश्च नागाश्च गन्धर्वा मुनयस्तथा ..
वरप्रदानं श्रुत्वैव पितामहमुपस्थिताः .. .. 17 ..
text_mt: Then the gods, Nāgas, Gandharvas, and sages, / hearing of the granting of the boon, approached the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ ..
vareṇā'nena bhagavānvadhiṣyati sa no'suraḥ ..
tannaḥ prasīda bhagavanvadho'pyasya vicintyatām .. 18 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः ..
वरेणाऽनेन भगवान्वधिष्यति स नोऽसुरः ..
तन्नः प्रसीद भगवन्वधोऽप्यस्य विचिन्त्यताम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: The gods said: / By this boon, O Lord, that Asura will slay us. / Therefore, be gracious to us, O Lord, and let his destruction be devised!

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānsarvabhūtānāṃ svayambhūrādikṛtprabhuḥ ..
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāṃ cā'vyaktaḥ prakṛtirdhruvaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
भगवान्सर्वभूतानां स्वयम्भूरादिकृत्प्रभुः ..
स्रष्टा च हव्यकव्यानां चाऽव्यक्तः प्रकृतिर्ध्रुवः .. 19 ..
text_mt: You are the Lord of all beings, the self-existent, the primeval creator, the master, / the maker of oblations to gods and ancestors, the unmanifest, primal matter, eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
sarvalokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
provāca varado vākyaṃ sarvāndevagaṇāṃstataḥ .. 1.54.20 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
सर्वलोकहितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा देवः प्रजापतिः ..
प्रोवाच वरदो वाक्यं सर्वान्देवगणांस्ततः .. 1.54.20 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having heard the speech that aimed at the welfare of all worlds, the divine Prajāpati, / the grantor of boons, then spoke words to all the hosts of gods:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ..
tatastasya vadhaṃ viṣṇustapaso'nte kariṣyati .. 21 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
अवश्यं त्रिदशास्तेन प्राप्तव्यं तपसः फलम् ..
ततस्तस्य वधं विष्णुस्तपसोऽन्ते करिष्यति .. 21 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Inevitably, O thirty [gods], the fruit of his penance must be attained by him. / Thereafter, at the end of his penance, Viṣṇu will carry out his death.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evaṃ śrutvā surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ paṅkajajanmanaḥ ..
svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmuste vai mudānvitāḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवं श्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं पङ्कजजन्मनः ..
स्वानि स्थानानि दिव्यानि जग्मुस्ते वै मुदान्विताः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having thus heard the words of the lotus-born [Brahmā], all the gods, / filled with joy, went to their own divine realms.

sanskrit_iast:
laghumātre vare tasminsarvāḥ so'bādhata prajāḥ ..
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo varadānena darpitaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
लघुमात्रे वरे तस्मिन्सर्वाः सोऽबाधत प्रजाः ..
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो वरदानेन दर्पितः .. 23 ..
text_mt: With merely that slight boon, he oppressed all the creatures; / the Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was proud because of the granting of the boon.

sanskrit_iast:
āśrameṣu mahātmāno munīndrānsaṃśitavratān ..
satyadharmaratāndāntāndurādharṣobhavaṃstu saḥ..24..
meaning:
आश्रमेषु महात्मानो मुनीन्द्रान्संशितव्रतान् ..
सत्यधर्मरतान्दान्तान्दुराधर्षोभवंस्तु सः..24..
text_mt: In the hermitages, he became irresistible to the high-souled lords of munis, / who were resolute in their vows, devoted to truth and dharma, and self-restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
devāstribhuvasthāṃśca parājitya mahāsuraḥ.. .
trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya svarge vasati dānavaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
देवास्त्रिभुवस्थांश्च पराजित्य महासुरः.. .
त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय स्वर्गे वसति दानवः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Having conquered the gods dwelling in the three worlds, / and bringing the three worlds under his sway, the great Asura, the Dānava, dwelt in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā varamadonmatto hyāvāsaṃ kṛtavān divi ..
yājñiyānkṛtavāndaityānayājñeyāśca devatā .. 26 ..
meaning:
यदा वरमदोन्मत्तो ह्यावासं कृतवान् दिवि ..
याज्ञियान्कृतवान्दैत्यानयाज्ञेयाश्च देवता .. 26 ..
text_mt: When, intoxicated with pride over the boon, he made his dwelling in heaven, / he made the Daityas eligible to receive sacrifices and made the deities ineligible for sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathā'śvinau ..
bhṛgavo'ṅgirasaḥ sādhyā marutaśca savāsavāḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवास्तथाऽश्विनौ ..
भृगवोऽङ्गिरसः साध्या मरुतश्च सवासवाः .. 27 ..
text_mt: The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Viśvedevas, as well as the two Aśvins, / the Bhṛgus, Aṅgirases, Sādhyas, and the Maruts along with Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurmahābalam ..
devaṃ brahmamayaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmabhūtaṃ sanātanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
शरण्यं शरणं विष्णुमुपतस्थुर्महाबलम् ..
देवं ब्रह्ममयं विष्णुं ब्रह्मभूतं सनातनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: approached Viṣṇu of great power, worthy of refuge, as their refuge— / the god Viṣṇu, who is composed of Brahman, who has become Brahman, the eternal one,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokaparāyaṇam ..
nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devāḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..29..
meaning:
भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य प्रभुं लोकपरायणम् ..
नारायणं विभुं देवाः शरण्यं शरणं गताः ..29..
text_mt: the Lord of the past, present, and future, the ultimate refuge of the world. / The gods went for refuge to the all-pervading Nārāyaṇa, the protector.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ..
trāyasva no'dya deveśa hiraṇyakaśiporvadhāt ..
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devo brahmādīnāṃ surottama .. 1.54.30 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः..
त्रायस्व नोऽद्य देवेश हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधात् ..
त्वं हि नः परमो देवो ब्रह्मादीनां सुरोत्तम .. 1.54.30 ..
text_mt: The gods said: / Protect us today, O Lord of gods, from slaughter by Hiraṇyakaśipu! / For you are our supreme god, the foremost of gods, above Brahmā and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
protphullāmalapatrākṣa śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkara ..
kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhavasva naḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
प्रोत्फुल्लामलपत्राक्ष शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकर ..
क्षयाय दितिवंशस्य शरणं त्वं भवस्व नः .. 31 ..
text_mt: O lotus-eyed one, O destroyer of the enemies' party! / For the destruction of Diti's lineage, become our refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
bhayaṃ tyajadhvamamarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmyaham ..
tathaiva tridivaṃ devāḥ pratipadyata mā ciram .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
भयं त्यजध्वममरा अभयं वो ददाम्यहम् ..
तथैव त्रिदिवं देवाः प्रतिपद्यत मा चिरम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: The holy Lord said: / Cast off fear, O immortals! I grant you freedom from fear. / In that very way, O gods, regain the third heaven without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
eṣo'muṃ sabalaṃ daityaṃ varadānena darpitam..
avadhyamamareṃdrāṇāṃ dānavendraṃ nihanmyaham .. 33 ..
meaning:
एषोऽमुं सबलं दैत्यं वरदानेन दर्पितम्..
अवध्यममरेंद्राणां दानवेन्द्रं निहन्म्यहम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: I shall slay that Daitya along with his army, who is arrogant from the granting of the boon, / that lord of Dānavas who cannot be slain by the lords of the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktvā sa bhagavānvisṛjya tridiveśvarān ..
nārasiṃhaṃ vapuścakra sahasrāṃśusamaprabham .. 34 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्विसृज्य त्रिदिवेश्वरान् ..
नारसिंहं वपुश्चक्र सहस्रांशुसमप्रभम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having spoken thus and dismissed the lords of the third heaven, the Lord / assumed the form of Narasiṃha, radiant as a thousand suns,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṃśuṃ kanakaśailābhaṃ jvālāpuñjavibhūṣitam ..
daityasainyamahāmbhodhi vaḍavānalavarcasam .. 35 ..
meaning:
प्रांशुं कनकशैलाभं ज्वालापुञ्जविभूषितम् ..
दैत्यसैन्यमहाम्भोधि वडवानलवर्चसम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: tall, resembling a mountain of gold, adorned with a mass of flames, / possessing the brilliance of the submarine fire against the great ocean of the Daitya army,

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyānuraktameghābhaṃ nīlavāsasamacyutam ..
devadāruvanacchannaṃ yathā meruṃ mahāgirim .. 36 ..
meaning:
सन्ध्यानुरक्तमेघाभं नीलवाससमच्युतम् ..
देवदारुवनच्छन्नं यथा मेरुं महागिरिम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: resembling a cloud reddened by twilight, clad in blue garments, the imperishable one, / like Mount Meru, the great mountain, covered by a forest of deodars,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇavaktradaśanaiḥ śaśāṅkaśakalopamaiḥ ..
pūrṇaṃ muktāphalaiḥ śubhraiḥ samudramiva kāñcanam .. 37 ..
meaning:
संपूर्णवक्त्रदशनैः शशाङ्कशकलोपमैः ..
पूर्णं मुक्ताफलैः शुभ्रैः समुद्रमिव काञ्चनम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: filled with teeth in his mouth resembling pieces of the moon, / like a golden ocean filled with white pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
nakhairvidrumasaṃkāśairvirājitakaradvayam ..
daityanāthakṣayakaraiḥ krodhasyaiva yathāṅkuraiḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
नखैर्विद्रुमसंकाशैर्विराजितकरद्वयम् ..
दैत्यनाथक्षयकरैः क्रोधस्यैव यथाङ्कुरैः .. 38 ..
text_mt: with his two hands adorned with claws resembling coral, / which brought destruction to the lord of the Daityas, like sprouts of wrath itself,

sanskrit_iast:
saṭābhāraṃ sakuṭilaṃ vahnijvālāgrapiṃgalam ..
dhārayanbhāti sarvātmā dāvānalamivācalaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
सटाभारं सकुटिलं वह्निज्वालाग्रपिंगलम् ..
धारयन्भाति सर्वात्मा दावानलमिवाचलः .. 39 ..
text_mt: bearing a mass of curved manes, reddish-brown like the tips of blazing fires, / the Self of all shone like a mountain [wrapped in] a forest fire.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyādṛśyamukhe tasya jihvābhyuditacañcalā ..
pralayāntāmbudasyeva cañcalā tu taḍillatā .. 1.54.40 ..
meaning:
दृश्यादृश्यमुखे तस्य जिह्वाभ्युदितचञ्चला ..
प्रलयान्ताम्बुदस्येव चञ्चला तु तडिल्लता .. 1.54.40 ..
text_mt: In his barely visible mouth, his restless tongue emerged, / fluttering like a flash of lightning from a cloud at the dissolution of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
āvarttibhirlomaghanairvyāptaṃ vigrahamūrjitam ..
mahākaṭitaṭaskandhamalātapratimekṣaṇam .. 41 ..
meaning:
आवर्त्तिभिर्लोमघनैर्व्याप्तं विग्रहमूर्जितम् ..
महाकटितटस्कन्धमलातप्रतिमेक्षणम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: His mighty body was covered with whirlpools of dense hair, / with broad hips and shoulders, and eyes resembling burning coals.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpāntameghanirghoṣajvālāniḥśvāsamārutam ..
durnirīkṣyaṃ durādharṣaṃ vajramadhyavibhīṣaṇam .. 42 ..
meaning:
कल्पान्तमेघनिर्घोषज्वालानिःश्वासमारुतम् ..
दुर्निरीक्ष्यं दुराधर्षं वज्रमध्यविभीषणम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: His breath was a wind of fire sounding like the clouds at the end of the aeon, / hard to look at, unassailable, terrifying as the middle of a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā mūrtiṃ nṛsiṃhasya dānaveṃdrasabhāṃ yayau ..
tāmbabhañja tu vegena daityānāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ.. 43 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा मूर्तिं नृसिंहस्य दानवेंद्रसभां ययौ ..
ताम्बभञ्ज तु वेगेन दैत्यानां भयवर्धनः.. 43 ..
text_mt: Having assumed the form of Nṛsiṃha, he went to the assembly of the lord of the Dānavas; / and with fury he shattered it, increasing the terror of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajyamānāṃ sabhāṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhena mahātmanā ..
hiraṇyakaśipū rājā dānavānsamacodayat .. 44 ..
meaning:
भज्यमानां सभां दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहेन महात्मना ..
हिरण्यकशिपू राजा दानवान्समचोदयत् .. 44 ..
text_mt: Seeing the assembly being smashed by the great-souled Nṛsiṃha, / King Hiraṇyakaśipu commanded the Dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
sattvajātamidaṃ ghoraṃ cāpūrvaṃ punarāgatam ..
ghātayadhvaṃ durādharṣaṃ yena me nāśitā sabhā ..45..
meaning:
सत्त्वजातमिदं घोरं चापूर्वं पुनरागतम् ..
घातयध्वं दुराधर्षं येन मे नाशिता सभा ..45..
text_mt: This terrifying, unprecedented creature has come again! / Kill this unassailable being by whom my assembly hall has been destroyed!

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ..
āyudhairvividhairjaghnurdevadevaṃ janārdanam .. 46 ..
meaning:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दैत्याः शतसहस्रशः ..
आयुधैर्विविधैर्जघ्नुर्देवदेवं जनार्दनम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Hearing those words of his, the Daityas in their hundreds and thousands / struck Janārdana, the god of gods, with various weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāyudhasahasrāṇi tasya gātreṣu bhārgava ..
viśīrṇānyeva dṛśyante mṛlloṣṭānīva parvate .. 47 ..
meaning:
नानायुधसहस्राणि तस्य गात्रेषु भार्गव ..
विशीर्णान्येव दृश्यन्ते मृल्लोष्टानीव पर्वते .. 47 ..
text_mt: O descendant of Bhṛgu, the thousands of various weapons upon his limbs / were seen to shatter like clods of earth upon a mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
daityāyudhānāṃ vaiphalyaṃ kṛtvā hatvā ca dānavān ..
karapādaprahāraiśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
दैत्यायुधानां वैफल्यं कृत्वा हत्वा च दानवान् ..
करपादप्रहारैश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 48 ..
text_mt: Rendering the weapons of the Daityas futile and striking down the Dānavas / in their hundreds and thousands with blows of his hands and feet,

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha vegāddaiteyaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ tataḥ ..
nṛsiṃhahetorvikrāntamastravarṣamahāmbudam .. 49 ..
meaning:
जग्राह वेगाद्दैतेयं हिरण्यकशिपुं ततः ..
नृसिंहहेतोर्विक्रान्तमस्त्रवर्षमहाम्बुदम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: he then violently seized the Daiteya Hiraṇyakaśipu, / who was rushing forward on account of Nṛsiṃha, a great cloud [raining] a shower of missiles.

sanskrit_iast:
vegenotsaṃgamāropya kadalīdalalīlayā ..
dārayāmāsa daityeśaṃ vakṣatsthalamahāgirim .. 1.54.50 ..
meaning:
वेगेनोत्संगमारोप्य कदलीदललीलया ..
दारयामास दैत्येशं वक्षत्स्थलमहागिरिम् .. 1.54.50 ..
text_mt: Placing him swiftly upon his lap, as easily as a plantain leaf, / he tore open the great mountain of the chest of that lord of Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tamasubhirhīnaṃ daityeśaṃ keśavaḥ svayam ..
asurāṇāṃ vināśaṃ ca kruddho naraharirvyadhāt .. 51 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा तमसुभिर्हीनं दैत्येशं केशवः स्वयम् ..
असुराणां विनाशं च क्रुद्धो नरहरिर्व्यधात् .. 51 ..
text_mt: Having deprived that lord of the Daityas of life, Keśava himself, / the enraged Narahari, brought about the destruction of the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā'suraṃ śoṇitabinducitraṃ saṃpūjya devāḥ saha vāsavena ..
jagmussvadhiṣṇyāni mudā sametā devopyathāntarhitamūrtirāsa .. 52 ..
meaning:
हत्वाऽसुरं शोणितबिन्दुचित्रं संपूज्य देवाः सह वासवेन ..
जग्मुस्स्वधिष्ण्यानि मुदा समेता देवोप्यथान्तर्हितमूर्तिरास .. 52 ..
text_mt: Having slain the asura, the gods together with Vāsava, spotted with drops of blood, / worshipped him and went joyfully to their own abodes, and the god vanished from sight.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
hate hiraṇyakaśipau dānave devakaṇṭake ..
hataśeṣāstu daiteyāḥ pātālatalamāśritāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
हते हिरण्यकशिपौ दानवे देवकण्टके ..
हतशेषास्तु दैतेयाः पातालतलमाश्रिताः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / When Hiraṇyakaśipu, the Dānava who was a thorn in the side of the gods, was slain, / the surviving Daiteyas took refuge in the depths of Pātāla.
title: Prādurbhāvaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
pātālatalasaṃstheṣu dānaveṣu mahāyaśāḥ ..
prahrādapautro dharmātmā virocanasuto baliḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पातालतलसंस्थेषु दानवेषु महायशाः ..
प्रह्रादपौत्रो धर्मात्मा विरोचनसुतो बलिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: While the Dānavas resided in the depths of Pātāla, the illustrious, / righteous Bali, grandson of Prahrāda and son of Virocana,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya tapasogreṇa varaṃ lebhe pitāmahāt ..
avadhyatvamajeyatvaṃ samareṣu surāsuraiḥ .. .. 3 ..
meaning:
आराध्य तपसोग्रेण वरं लेभे पितामहात् ..
अवध्यत्वमजेयत्वं समरेषु सुरासुरैः .. .. 3 ..
text_mt: worshipped with fierce austerity and obtained a boon from his grandfather: / invulnerability and unconquerability in battles by gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
varalabdhaṃ baliṃ jñātvā punaścakrurditeḥ sutāḥ ..
prahṛṣṭā daityarājānaṃ prahrādānumaterbalim .. 4 ..
meaning:
वरलब्धं बलिं ज्ञात्वा पुनश्चक्रुर्दितेः सुताः ..
प्रहृष्टा दैत्यराजानं प्रह्रादानुमतेर्बलिम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Knowing that Bali had obtained the boon, the sons of Diti, rejoiced, / made Bali king of the Daityas once more, with Prahrāda's consent.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya daityarājyaṃ tu balena caturaṃgiṇā ..
jitvā deveśvaraṃ śakramājahārā'marāvatīm .. 5 ..
meaning:
संप्राप्य दैत्यराज्यं तु बलेन चतुरंगिणा ..
जित्वा देवेश्वरं शक्रमाजहाराऽमरावतीम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Having attained the kingship of the Daityas, with a fourfold army, / he defeated Śakra, the lord of the gods, and seized Amarāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānabhraṣṭo mahendro'pi kaśyapaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ..
kaśyapena tadā sārdhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्थानभ्रष्टो महेन्द्रोऽपि कश्यपं शरणं गतः ..
कश्यपेन तदा सार्धं ब्रह्माणं शरणं गतः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Deprived of his realm, Mahendra took refuge with Kaśyapa; / then together with Kaśyapa, he took refuge with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā'bhihito devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ harim ..
amṛtādhmātameghābhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam .. 7 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणाऽभिहितो देवं जगाम शरणं हरिम् ..
अमृताध्मातमेघाभं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Directed by Brahmā, he went for refuge to the god Hari, / who resembles a cloud swollen with nectar, holding the conch, discus, and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
devo'pyabhayadānena saṃyojya balasūdanam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā..8..
meaning:
देवोऽप्यभयदानेन संयोज्य बलसूदनम् ..
उवाच वचनं काले मेघगम्भीरया गिरा..8..
text_mt: The god, too, assuring the slayer of Bala of safety, / spoke these words at that time in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca..
gaccha śakra bhaviṣyāmi trātā te balasūdana ..
devarūpadharo bhūtvā vañcayiṣyāmi taṃ balim ..9 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच..
गच्छ शक्र भविष्यामि त्राता ते बलसूदन ..
देवरूपधरो भूत्वा वञ्चयिष्यामि तं बलिम् ..9 ..
text_mt: The holy Lord said: / Go, Śakra; I shall be your protector, O slayer of Bala! / Assuming the form of a god, I shall deceive that Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktastadā śakraḥ prayayau kaśyapāśramam..
ādideśā'dittergarbhaṃ cāṃśenā'tha ca sarvadā ..1.55.1 0..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा शक्रः प्रययौ कश्यपाश्रमम्..
आदिदेशाऽदित्तेर्गर्भं चांशेनाऽथ च सर्वदा ..1.55.1 0..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Having been addressed thus, Śakra then went to the hermitage of Kaśyapa; / and [Viṣṇu] entered the womb of Aditi by a portion [of himself] forever.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhastha eva tejāṃsi dānavebhyaḥ sa ādade ..
tataḥ kālena suṣuve aditirvāmanākṛtim .. 11 ..
meaning:
गर्भस्थ एव तेजांसि दानवेभ्यः स आददे ..
ततः कालेन सुषुवे अदितिर्वामनाकृतिम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Even while in the womb, he took away the energies of the Dānavas; / then in due time Aditi gave birth to [him in] the form of a dwarf.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiñjāte suragaṇāḥ praharṣamatulaṃ gatāḥ ..
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstraikālyāmaladarśinaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
यस्मिञ्जाते सुरगणाः प्रहर्षमतुलं गताः ..
ऋषयश्च महाभागास्त्रैकाल्यामलदर्शिनः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Upon whose birth the hosts of gods attained unequalled joy, / as did the illustrious ṛṣis, who perceive the three times without blemish.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ ..
balirdaityapatiḥ śrīmānspāligrāmamupāśritaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु हयमेधाय दीक्षितः ..
बलिर्दैत्यपतिः श्रीमान्स्पालिग्राममुपाश्रितः .. 13 ..
text_mt: At that very time, consecrated for a horse-sacrifice, / the glorious Bali, lord of the Daityas, was staying at Śāligrāma.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmaskandhe tamādāya tasya yajñe bṛhaspatiḥ ..
anayadbhṛguśārdūla nūnaṃ tasyaiva māyayā .. 14 ..
meaning:
वामस्कन्धे तमादाय तस्य यज्ञे बृहस्पतिः ..
अनयद्भृगुशार्दूल नूनं तस्यैव मायया .. 14 ..
text_mt: Taking him upon his left shoulder, Bṛhaspati led him / to his sacrifice, O tiger among the Bhṛgus, surely through his own divine illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñavāṭaṃ sa saṃprāpya yajñaṃ tuṣṭāva vāmanaḥ ..
ātmānamātmanā brahmanbhasmacchanna ivā'nalaḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
यज्ञवाटं स संप्राप्य यज्ञं तुष्टाव वामनः ..
आत्मानमात्मना ब्रह्मन्भस्मच्छन्न इवाऽनलः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having reached the sacrificial enclosure, the dwarf praised the sacrifice, / [concealing] himself by himself, O brahmin, like fire covered with ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
praveśayāmāsa ca taṃ balirdharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ..
dadarśa ca mahābhāgaṃ vāmanaṃ sumanoharam .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रवेशयामास च तं बलिर्धर्मभृतां वरः ..
ददर्श च महाभागं वामनं सुमनोहरम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And Bali, the foremost of the upholders of dharma, ushered him in, / and saw the illustrious, exceedingly charming dwarf,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyuktasarvāvayavaiḥ pīnaiḥ saṃkṣiptaparvabhiḥ ..
kṛṣṇājinajaṭādaṇḍakamaṇḍaluvirājitam ...17..
meaning:
संयुक्तसर्वावयवैः पीनैः संक्षिप्तपर्वभिः ..
कृष्णाजिनजटादण्डकमण्डलुविराजितम् ...17..
text_mt: with all limbs fully formed, plump, with compact joints, / resplendent with a black antelope skin, matted hair, staff, and water pot,

sanskrit_iast:
vikramiṣyanyathā vyāghro līyati sma svavigrahe ..
vikramiṣyam̐stathaivorvīṃ līnagātraḥ svavigrahe .. 18 ..
meaning:
विक्रमिष्यन्यथा व्याघ्रो लीयति स्म स्वविग्रहे ..
विक्रमिष्यम्̐स्तथैवोर्वीं लीनगात्रः स्वविग्रहे .. 18 ..
text_mt: who crouched within his own body like a tiger about to pounce, / limbs retracted within his own body, about to stride across the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
etanminneva kāle tu hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ ..
tasmāttu prārthayadrājandehi mahyaṃ kramatrayam .. 19 ..
meaning:
एतन्मिन्नेव काले तु हयमेधाय दीक्षितः ..
तस्मात्तु प्रार्थयद्राजन्देहि मह्यं क्रमत्रयम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: At that very time, [Bali] consecrated for the horse-sacrifice; / from him, O king, he requested: "Grant me three strides!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu devena balirdaityagaṇādhipaḥ ..
pradadāvudakaṃ tasya pāvayasveti cābravīt .. 1.55.20 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन बलिर्दैत्यगणाधिपः ..
प्रददावुदकं तस्य पावयस्वेति चाब्रवीत् .. 1.55.20 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus by the god, Bali, the lord of the hosts of Daityas, / gave water to him and said: "Purify [me]!

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca yadabhīṣṭaṃ te tadgṛhāṇa dvijottama ..
pratijagrāha ca jalaṃ pravātyeva tadā hariḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
अन्यच्च यदभीष्टं ते तद्गृहाण द्विजोत्तम ..
प्रतिजग्राह च जलं प्रवात्येव तदा हरिः .. 21 ..
text_mt: And whatever else is desired by you, take that, O foremost of the twice-born!" / And Hari accepted the water as it flowed then.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukherdaityavarairvīkṣyamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ ..
ākramattu harirlokāndānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
उदङ्मुखेर्दैत्यवरैर्वीक्ष्यमाण इवाम्बुदः ..
आक्रमत्तु हरिर्लोकान्दानवाः शस्त्रपाणयः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Watched by the foremost Daityas facing north like a cloud [in the sky], / Hari strode over the worlds, [while] the Dānavas with weapons in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
abhidravanti vegena nānavaktraśirodharāḥ ..
garuḍānanāḥ khaḍgamukhā mayūravadanāstathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
अभिद्रवन्ति वेगेन नानवक्त्रशिरोधराः ..
गरुडाननाः खड्गमुखा मयूरवदनास्तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt: with diverse faces and necks, rushed forward with speed: / some with faces of Garuḍas, with sword-like mouths, and with peacock faces;

sanskrit_iast:
ghorā makaravaktrāśca kroṣṭuvaktrāśca dānavā. ..
ākhudarduravaktrāśca ghora vṛkamukhāstathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
घोरा मकरवक्त्राश्च क्रोष्टुवक्त्राश्च दानवा. ..
आखुदर्दुरवक्त्राश्च घोर वृकमुखास्तथा .. 24 ..
text_mt: and terrible Dānavas with crocodile faces and jackal faces, / with rat and frog faces, and terrible wolf faces;

sanskrit_iast:
mārjāraśaśavaktrāśca haṃsakākānanāstathā ..
godhāśalyakavaktrāśca ajāvimahiṣānanāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
मार्जारशशवक्त्राश्च हंसकाकाननास्तथा ..
गोधाशल्यकवक्त्राश्च अजाविमहिषाननाः .. 26 ..
text_mt: with faces of cats and hares, and faces of swans and crows, / with faces of monitor lizards and porcupines, and faces of goats, sheep, and buffaloes;

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghraśṛgālānāṃ dvīpivānarapakṣiṇām ..
hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrāṇāṃ bhujagānāṃ samānanāḥ .. 26..
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रशृगालानां द्वीपिवानरपक्षिणाम् ..
हस्त्यश्वगोखरोष्ट्राणां भुजगानां समाननाः .. 26..
text_mt: having faces resembling lions, tigers, and jackals; leopards, monkeys, and birds; / elephants, horses, cattle, donkeys, and camels; and serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahajalaṃ prāpya vyavardhata tadā hariḥ ..
udaṅmukhairdevagaṇairīkṣyamāṇa ivāmbudaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहजलं प्राप्य व्यवर्धत तदा हरिः ..
उदङ्मुखैर्देवगणैरीक्ष्यमाण इवाम्बुदः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Having received the water of acceptance, Hari then expanded, / like a cloud watched by the hosts of gods facing north.

sanskrit_iast:
vikramantaṃ hariṃ lokāndānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ..
matsyakacchapavaktrāṇāṃ dardurāṇāṃ samānanāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
विक्रमन्तं हरिं लोकान्दानवाः शस्त्रपाणयः ..
मत्स्यकच्छपवक्त्राणां दर्दुराणां समाननाः .. 28 ..
text_mt: As Hari strode across the worlds, the Dānavas, weapons in hand, / having faces like those of fish, tortoises, and frogs,

sanskrit_iast:
sthūladantā vivṛttākṣā lamboṣṭhajaṭharāstathā ..
piṅgalākṣo vivṛttāsyā nānābāhuśirodharāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स्थूलदन्ता विवृत्ताक्षा लम्बोष्ठजठरास्तथा ..
पिङ्गलाक्षो विवृत्तास्या नानाबाहुशिरोधराः .. 29 ..
text_mt: with large teeth, rolled-back eyes, pendulous lips and bellies, / reddish-brown eyes, wide-open mouths, and diverse arms and necks,

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlāgranāsāścipiṭā mahāhanukapālinaḥ ..
cīnāṃśukottarāsaṃgāḥ kecitkṛṣṇājināmbarāḥ .. 1.55.30 ..
meaning:
स्थूलाग्रनासाश्चिपिटा महाहनुकपालिनः ..
चीनांशुकोत्तरासंगाः केचित्कृष्णाजिनाम्बराः .. 1.55.30 ..
text_mt: with broad-tipped, flat noses, large jaws and skulls, / some wearing upper garments of Chinese silk, some clad in black antelope skins,

sanskrit_iast:
bhujaṅgābharaṇāścānye kecinmukuṭabhūṣitāḥ ..
sakuṇḍalāḥ sakaṭakāḥ saśirastrāṇamastakāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
भुजङ्गाभरणाश्चान्ये केचिन्मुकुटभूषिताः ..
सकुण्डलाः सकटकाः सशिरस्त्राणमस्तकाः .. 31 ..
text_mt: others with serpent ornaments, some adorned with diadems, / wearing earrings, bracelets, and helmets on their heads,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurbāṇadharāścā'nye tathā tomarapāṇayaḥ ..
khaḍgacarmadharāścā'nye tathā parighapāṇayaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
धनुर्बाणधराश्चाऽन्ये तथा तोमरपाणयः ..
खड्गचर्मधराश्चाऽन्ये तथा परिघपाणयः .. 32 ..
text_mt: others carrying bows and arrows, as well as javelins in hand, / others bearing swords and shields, as well as iron bars in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
śataghnīcakrahastāśca gadāmuśalapāṇayaḥ ..
aśmayantrāyudhopetā bhiṇḍipālāyudhāstathā .. 33 ..
meaning:
शतघ्नीचक्रहस्ताश्च गदामुशलपाणयः ..
अश्मयन्त्रायुधोपेता भिण्डिपालायुधास्तथा .. 33 ..
text_mt: holding hundred-killers and discuses in their hands, clubs and pestles in hand, / equipped with stone-throwing catapults as weapons, and slings as weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlolūkhalahastāśca paraśvadhadharāstathā ..
mahāvṛkṣapravahaṇā mahāparvatayodhinaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
शूलोलूखलहस्ताश्च परश्वधधरास्तथा ..
महावृक्षप्रवहणा महापर्वतयोधिनः .. 34 ..
text_mt: holding spears and pestles in their hands, and bearing battle-axes, / carrying great trees, warriors fighting with huge mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
kramamāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśamupāvarttanta sarvaśaḥ ..
sa tānmamarda sarvātmā tanmukhāndaityadānavān .. 35 ..
meaning:
क्रममाणं हृषीकेशमुपावर्त्तन्त सर्वशः ..
स तान्ममर्द सर्वात्मा तन्मुखान्दैत्यदानवान् .. 35 ..
text_mt: approached Hṛṣīkeśa from all sides as he strode. / He, the self of all, crushed those Daityas and Dānavas having those faces,

sanskrit_iast:
sarasīva mahāpadmānmahāhastīva dānavān ..
pramathya sarvāndaiteyānhastapādatalaistataḥ ..36 ..
meaning:
सरसीव महापद्मान्महाहस्तीव दानवान् ..
प्रमथ्य सर्वान्दैतेयान्हस्तपादतलैस्ततः ..36 ..
text_mt: like a great elephant crushing large lotuses in a lake. / Having crushed all the Daiteyas with the soles of his hands and feet,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahābhīmamājahārā''śu medinīm..
tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare .. 37 ..
meaning:
रूपं कृत्वा महाभीममाजहारा'ऽशु मेदिनीम्..
तस्य विक्रमतो भूमिं चन्द्रादित्यौ स्तनान्तरे .. 37 ..
text_mt: and assuming an immensely terrifying form, he swiftly seized the earth. / As he strode over the earth, the moon and the sun were between his breasts;

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ prakramamāṇasya nābhideśe vyavasthitau ..
tataḥ prakramamāṇasya jānudeśe vyavasthitau .. 38 ..
meaning:
परं प्रक्रममाणस्य नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितौ ..
ततः प्रक्रममाणस्य जानुदेशे व्यवस्थितौ .. 38 ..
text_mt: as he strode further, the two were situated at his navel; / then as he strode onward, the two were situated at his knees;

sanskrit_iast:
tatopi kramamāṇasya padbhyāṃ devau vyavasthitau ..
jitvā sa medinīṃ kṛtsnāṃ hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān .. 39 ..
meaning:
ततोपि क्रममाणस्य पद्भ्यां देवौ व्यवस्थितौ ..
जित्वा स मेदिनीं कृत्स्नां हत्वा चासुरपुंगवान् .. 39 ..
text_mt: and as he strode still further, the two gods were situated at his feet. / Having conquered the entire earth and slain the foremost of the asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau śakrāya vasudhāṃ viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ ..
svaṃ rūpañca tathā''sādya dānavendramabhāṣata .. 1.55.40 ..
meaning:
ददौ शक्राय वसुधां विष्णुर्बलवतां वरः ..
स्वं रूपञ्च तथा'ऽसाद्य दानवेन्द्रमभाषत .. 1.55.40 ..
text_mt: Viṣṇu, the foremost among the strong, gave the earth to Śakra; / and resuming his own form, he addressed the lord of the Dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
yajñavāṭaṃ tvadīye'sminsāligrāme mahāsura ..
mayā niviṣṭapādena māpiteyaṃ vasundharā .. 41 ..
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
यज्ञवाटं त्वदीयेऽस्मिन्सालिग्रामे महासुर ..
मया निविष्टपादेन मापितेयं वसुन्धरा .. 41 ..
text_mt: The holy Lord said: / In this sacrificial enclosure of yours at Śāligrāma, O great asura, / this earth has been measured by me with placed feet.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ tu padaṃ jātaṃ naurbandhaśikhare mama ..
dvitīyaṃ meruśikhare tṛtīyaṃ nā'bhavatkvacit .. 42 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं तु पदं जातं नौर्बन्धशिखरे मम ..
द्वितीयं मेरुशिखरे तृतीयं नाऽभवत्क्वचित् .. 42 ..
text_mt: My first step was placed on the peak of Naubandha; / the second on the peak of Meru; the third could find no place at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tanme varaya daityendra yanmayāptaṃ pratigraham..
baliruvāca ..
yāvatī vasudhā deva tvayaiva parinirmitā .. 43 ..
meaning:
तन्मे वरय दैत्येन्द्र यन्मयाप्तं प्रतिग्रहम्..
बलिरुवाच ..
यावती वसुधा देव त्वयैव परिनिर्मिता .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, O lord of Daityas, choose for me that which I obtained as acceptance of gifts.
Bali said:
As much as the earth is, O God, created by you alone,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatī te na saṃpūrṇā devadeva kramatrayam ..
na kṛtaṃ yattvayā deva kutastanme maheśvara .. 44 ..
meaning:
तावती ते न संपूर्णा देवदेव क्रमत्रयम् ..
न कृतं यत्त्वया देव कुतस्तन्मे महेश्वर .. 44 ..
text_mt: so much, O God of gods, was not sufficient for your three paces. / Since that was not done by you, O God, whence can it come from me, O Maheśvara?

sanskrit_iast:
na ca tadvidyate deva tathaivā'nyasya kasyacit ..
śrībhagavānuvāca ..
na me tvayāpūryate me dānavendra yathāśrutam .. 45 ..
meaning:
न च तद्विद्यते देव तथैवाऽन्यस्य कस्यचित् ..
श्रीभगवानुवाच ..
न मे त्वयापूर्यते मे दानवेन्द्र यथाश्रुतम् .. 45 ..
text_mt:
Nor does it exist, O God, for anyone else in that way.
The Holy One said:
My [vow] has not been fulfilled by you, O lord of Dānavas, as promised.

sanskrit_iast:
sutalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra susaṃyataḥ ..
mayaiva nirmitā tatra manasā śobhanā purī ..46..
meaning:
सुतलं नाम पातालं वस तत्र सुसंयतः ..
मयैव निर्मिता तत्र मनसा शोभना पुरी ..46..
text_mt: There is a subterranean realm named Sutala; dwell there with utmost self-restraint. / There I myself, by my mind, have fashioned a splendid city.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātibhiḥ sahadharmiṣṭhairvasa tatra yathāsukham..
tatra tvaṃ bhokṣyase bhogānviśiṣṭānbalasūdanāt ..47..
meaning:
ज्ञातिभिः सहधर्मिष्ठैर्वस तत्र यथासुखम्..
तत्र त्वं भोक्ष्यसे भोगान्विशिष्टान्बलसूदनात् ..47..
text_mt: Dwell there in comfort together with your righteous kinsmen. / There you shall enjoy pleasures superior to [those of] the Slayer of Bala.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpsyasi tathā bhogām̐lokādvidhivivarjitān..
prākāmyayuktaśca tathā lokeṣu vihariṣyasi ..48..
meaning:
अवाप्स्यसि तथा भोगाम्̐लोकाद्विधिविवर्जितान्..
प्राकाम्ययुक्तश्च तथा लोकेषु विहरिष्यसि ..48..
text_mt: You shall also obtain pleasures from the world that are exempt from ritual rules; / and endowed with irresistible will, you shall wander through the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantare dvitīye ca mahendratvaṃ kariṣyasi ..
tejasā ca madīyena śakratve yokṣyase bale .. 49 ..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरे द्वितीये च महेन्द्रत्वं करिष्यसि ..
तेजसा च मदीयेन शक्रत्वे योक्ष्यसे बले .. 49 ..
text_mt: And in the second Manu-period you shall exercise the sovereignty of Mahendra; / and by my splendor you will be endowed with the state of Śakra, O Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
tava śatrugaṇānsarvānghātayiṣyāmyahaṃ tadā ..
brahmaṇyastvaṃ śaraṇyastvaṃ yajñaśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ .. 1.55.50 ..
meaning:
तव शत्रुगणान्सर्वान्घातयिष्याम्यहं तदा ..
ब्रह्मण्यस्त्वं शरण्यस्त्वं यज्ञशीलः प्रियंवदः .. 1.55.50 ..
text_mt: At that time I will slay all your hosts of enemies. / You are devoted to brahmins, a refuge [for others], observant of sacrifice, sweet-spoken,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvī dānaśīlaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
tasmādyaśobhivṛddhyarthaṃ mayā tvamabhisandhitaḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
तपस्वी दानशीलश्च वेदवेदांगपारगः ..
तस्माद्यशोभिवृद्ध्यर्थं मया त्वमभिसन्धितः .. 51 ..
text_mt: an ascetic, generous, and one who has mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. / Therefore, for the increase of your fame, you have been thus addressed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
devarājādhikānbhogānpātālastho'pi bhokṣyase ..
sannidhānaśca tatrāhaṃ kariṣyāmyasurādhipa ..52..
meaning:
देवराजाधिकान्भोगान्पातालस्थोऽपि भोक्ष्यसे ..
सन्निधानश्च तत्राहं करिष्याम्यसुराधिप ..52..
text_mt: Even while residing in the underworld, you will enjoy pleasures surpassing those of the king of gods. / And I will maintain my presence there, O ruler of Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā ca raṃsyase sārdhaṃ spṛhaṇīyaḥ surairapi..
śakratvaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā bhāvye sāvarṇike'ntare .. 53 ..
meaning:
मया च रंस्यसे सार्धं स्पृहणीयः सुरैरपि..
शक्रत्वं च तथा कृत्वा भाव्ये सावर्णिकेऽन्तरे .. 53 ..
text_mt: And you shall take delight with me, an object of longing even for the gods. / And having exercised the state of Śakra in the future Sāvarṇi Manu-period,

sanskrit_iast: sarvasaṃdhivinirmukto mayaiva saha raṃsyase ..54..
meaning: सर्वसंधिविनिर्मुक्तो मयैव सह रंस्यसे ..54..
text_mt: freed from all bonds, you will take delight with me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
ityevamuktvā sajalāmbudābhaḥ prataptacāmīkaradhautavastraḥ ..
adarśanaṃ devavaro jagāma śakraśca lebhe sakalāṃ trilokīm .. 55 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सजलाम्बुदाभः प्रतप्तचामीकरधौतवस्त्रः ..
अदर्शनं देववरो जगाम शक्रश्च लेभे सकलां त्रिलोकीम् .. 55 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkara said:
Having spoken thus, [the Lord], radiant as a water-laden cloud, clothed in washed garments of purified gold, / the foremost of gods vanished from sight; and Śakra obtained the entire threefold world.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
tasya devātidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi divyā ātmavibhūtayaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
तस्य देवातिदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ..
त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि दिव्या आत्मविभूतयः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Rāma said:
I wish to hear from you the divine manifestations of the self / belonging to that God of gods, Viṣṇu of boundless splendor.
title: Vibhūtivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
na śakyā vistarādvaktuṃ devadevasya bhūtayaḥ ..
prādhānyataste vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā dvija ..2 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
न शक्या विस्तराद्वक्तुं देवदेवस्य भूतयः ..
प्राधान्यतस्ते वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना द्विज ..2 ..
text_mt:
Śaṅkara said:
The manifestations of the God of gods cannot be described in full detail. / I will tell them to you by their preeminence; listen with a single-minded focus, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sarge brahmā sthitau viṣṇuḥ saṃhāre ca tathā haraḥ ..
varuṇo vāyurākāśo jyotiśca pṛthivī tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
सर्गे ब्रह्मा स्थितौ विष्णुः संहारे च तथा हरः ..
वरुणो वायुराकाशो ज्योतिश्च पृथिवी तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: In creation [he is] Brahmā, in preservation Viṣṇu, and in destruction Hara; / he is Varuṇa, Vāyu, ether, light, and also the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
diśaśca vidiśaścā'pi tathā ye ca digīśvarāḥ ..
ādityā vasavo rudrā bhṛgavoṃ'girasastathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
दिशश्च विदिशश्चाऽपि तथा ये च दिगीश्वराः ..
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा भृगवोंऽगिरसस्तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: and the cardinal directions, intermediate directions, and those who are lords of the directions; / the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, the Bhṛgus and the Aṅgirases;

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyāśca maruto devā viśvedevāstathaiva ca ..
aśvinau puruhūtaśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
साध्याश्च मरुतो देवा विश्वेदेवास्तथैव च ..
अश्विनौ पुरुहूतश्च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः .. 5 ..
text_mt: and the Sādhyas, the Maruts, the Viśvedevas; / the two Aśvins, Puruhūta, and the hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases;

sanskrit_iast:
parvatodadhipātālā lokā dvīpāśca bhārgava ..
tiryagūrdhvamadhaścaiva tviṅgitaṃ yaśca neṅgate .. 6 ..
meaning:
पर्वतोदधिपाताला लोका द्वीपाश्च भार्गव ..
तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव त्विङ्गितं यश्च नेङ्गते .. 6 ..
text_mt: mountains, oceans, subterranean realms, worlds, and islands, O Bhārgava; / whatever is horizontal, above, or below, that which moves and that which does not move;

sanskrit_iast:
saccā'sacca mahābhāga prakṛtirvikṛtiśca yaḥ ..
kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ vayasāṃ yonayastathā .. 7 ..
meaning:
सच्चाऽसच्च महाभाग प्रकृतिर्विकृतिश्च यः ..
कृमिकीटपतङ्गानां वयसां योनयस्तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt: the real and the unreal, O fortunate one, Prakṛti and Vikṛti; / the wombs of worms, insects, winged creatures, and birds;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādharāstathā yakṣā nāgāḥ sarpāḥ sakinnarāḥ ..
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca pitaraḥ kālasaṃdhayaḥ . .8 ..
meaning:
विद्याधरास्तथा यक्षा नागाः सर्पाः सकिन्नराः ..
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च पितरः कालसंधयः . .8 ..
text_mt: Vidyādharas, Yakṣas, Nāgas, snakes with Kinnaras, / Rākṣasas, Piśācas, the ancestors, and the junctures of time;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca dharmadvārāṇi yāni ca ..
yajñāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham..9..
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाश्च धर्मद्वाराणि यानि च ..
यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वाणि भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्..9..
text_mt: dharma, wealth, pleasure, liberation, and the gateways of dharma; / all the constituents of sacrifice, and the fourfold assemblage of beings:

sanskrit_iast:
jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva saṃsvedajamathodbhijam ..
ekajyotiḥ sa marutāṃ vasūnāṃ sa ca pāvakaḥ..1.56.1 0..
meaning:
जरायुजाण्डजाश्चैव संस्वेदजमथोद्भिजम् ..
एकज्योतिः स मरुतां वसूनां स च पावकः..1.56.1 0..
text_mt: the womb-born, egg-born, sweat-born, and sprout-born. / He is Ekajyotis among the Maruts, and he is Fire among the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
ahirbudhnyaśca rudrāṇāṃ nādaivāśvinayostathā ..
nārāyaṇaśca sādhyānāṃ bhṛgūṇāñca tathā kratuḥ ..11..
meaning:
अहिर्बुध्न्यश्च रुद्राणां नादैवाश्विनयोस्तथा ..
नारायणश्च साध्यानां भृगूणाञ्च तथा क्रतुः ..11..
text_mt: he is Ahirbudhnya among the Rudras, and Nāsatya among the two Aśvins; / Nārāyaṇa among the Sādhyas, and Kratu among the Bhṛgus;

sanskrit_iast:
ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇurāyuraṅgirasāṃ tathā ..
viśveṣāñcaiva devānāṃ rocamānaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ ..12..
meaning:
आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुरायुरङ्गिरसां तथा ..
विश्वेषाञ्चैव देवानां रोचमानः स कीर्तितः ..12..
text_mt: Viṣṇu among the Ādityas, and Āyus among the Aṅgirases; / and he is declared Rocamāna among all the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsavaḥ sarvadevānāṃ jyotiṣāṃ ca hutāśanaḥ ..
yamaḥ saṃyamaśīlānāṃ virūpākṣaḥ kṣamābhṛtām .. 13 ..
meaning:
वासवः सर्वदेवानां ज्योतिषां च हुताशनः ..
यमः संयमशीलानां विरूपाक्षः क्षमाभृताम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Vāsava among all the deities, and Fire among luminous bodies; / Yama among those of restrained nature, Virūpākṣa among the supporters of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
yādasāṃ varuṇaścaiva pavanaḥ plavatāṃ tathā ..
dhanādhyakṣaśca yakṣāṇāṃ rudro raudrastathāntaraḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
यादसां वरुणश्चैव पवनः प्लवतां तथा ..
धनाध्यक्षश्च यक्षाणां रुद्रो रौद्रस्तथान्तरः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Varuṇa among aquatic creatures, and the Wind among those that move; / Kubera among the Yakṣas, Rudra the terrible among those within;

sanskrit_iast:
anantaḥ sarvanāgānāṃ sūryastejasvināṃ tathā ..
grahāṇāñca tathā candro nakṣatrāṇāñca kṛttikā .. 15 ..
meaning:
अनन्तः सर्वनागानां सूर्यस्तेजस्विनां तथा ..
ग्रहाणाञ्च तथा चन्द्रो नक्षत्राणाञ्च कृत्तिका .. 15 ..
text_mt: Ananta among all Nāgas, the Sun among luminous entities; / the Moon among planets, and Kṛttikā among lunar mansions;

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ kalayatāṃ śreṣṭho yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yugam ..
kalpaṃ manvantareśāśca manavaśca caturdaśa .. 16 ..
meaning:
कालः कलयतां श्रेष्ठो युगानां च कृतं युगम् ..
कल्पं मन्वन्तरेशाश्च मनवश्च चतुर्दश .. 16 ..
text_mt: Time, the highest among reckoning forces, and the Kṛta age among ages; / an aeon, the lords of Manu-periods, and the fourteen Manus;

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva devaḥ sarvātmā ye ca deveśvarāstathā ..
saṃvatsarastu varṣāṇāṃ cāyanānāṃ tathottaraḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
स एव देवः सर्वात्मा ये च देवेश्वरास्तथा ..
संवत्सरस्तु वर्षाणां चायनानां तथोत्तरः .. 17 ..
text_mt: he is that God who is the Self of all, and those who are lords of the gods; / the year among years, and the northern course among solstices;

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣastu māsānāṃ ṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ ..
śuklapakṣastu pakṣāṇāṃ tithīnāṃ pūrṇimā tithiḥ ...18..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षस्तु मासानां ऋतूनां कुसुमाकरः ..
शुक्लपक्षस्तु पक्षाणां तिथीनां पूर्णिमा तिथिः ...18..
text_mt: Mārgaśīrṣa among months, and spring among seasons; / the bright fortnight among fortnights, and the full moon among lunar days;

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇānāṃ vadhaḥ prokto muhūrttānāṃ tathā'bhijit ..
pātālānāṃ sutalaśca samudrāṇāṃ payodadhiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
कारणानां वधः प्रोक्तो मुहूर्त्तानां तथाऽभिजित् ..
पातालानां सुतलश्च समुद्राणां पयोदधिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Vadha is proclaimed among instruments, and Abhijit among muhūrtas; / Sutala among subterranean realms, and the ocean of milk among seas;

sanskrit_iast:
jambūdvīpaśca dvīpānāṃ lokānāṃ satya ucyate ..
meruḥ śiloccayānāṃ ca varṣeṣvapi ca bhāratam .. 1.56.20 ...
meaning:
जम्बूद्वीपश्च द्वीपानां लोकानां सत्य उच्यते ..
मेरुः शिलोच्चयानां च वर्षेष्वपि च भारतम् .. 1.56.20 ...
text_mt: Jambūdvīpa among islands, and Satyaloka among worlds; / Meru among mountain ranges, and Bhārata among regions;

sanskrit_iast:
himālayaḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ jāhnavī saritāṃ tathā ..
puṣkaraḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā .. 21 ..
meaning:
हिमालयः स्थावराणां जाह्नवी सरितां तथा ..
पुष्करः सर्वतीर्थानां गरुडः पक्षिणां तथा .. 21 ..
text_mt: the Himālaya among immovable things, and the Gaṅgā among rivers; / Puṣkara among all sacred bathing places, and Garuḍa among birds;

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ..
ṛṣīṇāñca bhṛgurdevo devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ..22..
meaning:
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः..
ऋषीणाञ्च भृगुर्देवो देवर्षीणां च नारदः ..22..
text_mt: Citraratha among Gandharvas, Kapila the sage among perfected beings; / the divine Bhṛgu among ṛṣis, and Nārada among celestial sages;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā brahmaṛṣīṇāñca aṃgirāḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
vidyādharāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ devaścitrāṃgadastathā ..23..
meaning:
तथा ब्रह्मऋषीणाञ्च अंगिराः परिकीर्तितः ..
विद्याधराणां सर्वेषां देवश्चित्रांगदस्तथा ..23..
text_mt: and Aṅgiras is declared among divine sages; / among all Vidyādharas, the god Citrāṅgada;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃbaraḥ kinnarāṇāṃ ca sarpāṇāmatha vāsukiḥ ..
prahrādaḥ sarvadaityānāṃ rambhā cāpsarasāṃ tathā .. 24 ..
meaning:
कंबरः किन्नराणां च सर्पाणामथ वासुकिः ..
प्रह्रादः सर्वदैत्यानां रम्भा चाप्सरसां तथा .. 24 ..
text_mt: Kambara among Kinnaras, and Vāsuki among snakes; / Prahrāda among all Daityas, and Rambhā among Apsarases;

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ dhenūnāṃ caiva kāmadhuk ..
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgādhipaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां धेनूनां चैव कामधुक् ..
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां मृगाणां च मृगाधिपः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Uccaiḥśravas among horses, and Kāmadhenu among cows; / Airāvata among lordly elephants, and the lion among beasts;

sanskrit_iast:
āyudhānāṃ tathā vajro narāṇāñca narādhipaḥ ..
kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ devo buddhirbuddhimatāmapi .. 26 ..
meaning:
आयुधानां तथा वज्रो नराणाञ्च नराधिपः ..
क्षमा क्षमावतां देवो बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामपि .. 26 ..
text_mt: the thunderbolt among weapons, and the king among men; / forgiveness, the divine, among the forgiving, and intellect among the intelligent;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāviruddhaḥ kāmaśca tathā dharmabhṛtāṃ nṛṇām ..
dharmmo dharmabhṛtāṃ devastapaścaiva tapasvinām..27..
meaning:
धर्माविरुद्धः कामश्च तथा धर्मभृतां नृणाम् ..
धर्म्मो धर्मभृतां देवस्तपश्चैव तपस्विनाम्..27..
text_mt: desire not opposed to dharma among men who uphold dharma; / dharma among upholders of dharma, the divine, and asceticism among ascetics;

sanskrit_iast:
yajñānāṃ japayajñaśca satyaḥ satyavatāṃ tathā ..
vedānāṃ sāmā vedaśca aṃśūnāṃ jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ .. 28..
meaning:
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञश्च सत्यः सत्यवतां तथा ..
वेदानां सामा वेदश्च अंशूनां ज्योतिषां पतिः .. 28..
text_mt: the sacrifice of recitation among sacrifices, and truth among the truthful; / the Sāmaveda among Vedas, and the lord of lights among radiant beings;

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrī sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ vācaḥ pravadatāṃ tathā ..
akṣarāṇāmakāraśca yantrāṇāñca tathā dhanuḥ..29..
meaning:
गायत्री सर्वमंत्राणां वाचः प्रवदतां तथा ..
अक्षराणामकारश्च यन्त्राणाञ्च तथा धनुः..29..
text_mt: Gāyatrī among all mantras, and speech among speakers; / the letter 'a' among syllables, and the bow among weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ ..
cetanā sarvabhūtānāmindriyāṇāṃ manastathā .. 1.56.30 ..
meaning:
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां कवीनामुशना कविः ..
चेतना सर्वभूतानामिन्द्रियाणां मनस्तथा .. 1.56.30 ..
text_mt: Among sciences [I am] the science of the inner self; among poets, the poet Uśanas. / [I am] the consciousness of all beings, and likewise the mind among the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā brahmavidāṃ devo jñānaṃ jñānavatāṃ tathā ..
kīrtiḥ śrīrvāk ca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā tathā kṣamā .. 31 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां देवो ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतां तथा ..
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक् च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा तथा क्षमा .. 31 ..
text_mt: Among knowers of the Brahman [I am] the god Brahmā; and knowledge among the knowledgeable. / Among women [I am] fame, fortune, speech, memory, intellect, and patience.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramāṇāṃ caturthaśca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇastathā ..
skandaḥ senāpraṇetṝṇāṃ sadayaśca dayā vatām .. 32 ..
meaning:
आश्रमाणां चतुर्थश्च वर्णानां ब्राह्मणस्तथा ..
स्कन्दः सेनाप्रणेतॄणां सदयश्च दया वताम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Among the stages of life [I am] the fourth; and among castes, the brahmin. / Among commanders of armies [I am] Skanda; and the compassionate among those who have compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśca vyavasāyaśca tathotsāhavatāṃ prabhuḥ ..
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ tathā yavaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
जयश्च व्यवसायश्च तथोत्साहवतां प्रभुः ..
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणामोषधीनां तथा यवः .. 33 ..
text_mt: I am victory, resolve, and the lord of the energetic. / Among all trees [I am] the sacred fig tree; and barley among plants.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuḥ sa eva mriyatāmudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām ..
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścaiva dyūtaṃ chalayatāṃ tathā .. 34 ..
meaning:
मृत्युः स एव म्रियतामुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ..
झषाणां मकरश्चैव द्यूतं छलयतां तथा .. 34 ..
text_mt: He alone is death for those who die, and origin for those yet to be. / Among aquatic monsters [I am] the makara; and dice among cheats.

sanskrit_iast:
mānaśca sarvaguhyānāṃ ratnānāṃ kanakaṃ tathā ..
dhṛtirbhūmau rasastejastejaścaiva hutāśane .. 35 ..
meaning:
मानश्च सर्वगुह्यानां रत्नानां कनकं तथा ..
धृतिर्भूमौ रसस्तेजस्तेजश्चैव हुताशने .. 35 ..
text_mt: And silence among all secrets, and gold among gems. / [I am] firmness in the earth, taste [in water], and radiance in fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuḥ sparśaguṇānāṃ ca khañca śabdaguṇastathā ..
evaṃ vibhūtibhiḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati bhārgava .. 36 ..
meaning:
वायुः स्पर्शगुणानां च खञ्च शब्दगुणस्तथा ..
एवं विभूतिभिः सर्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठति भार्गव .. 36 ..
text_mt: [I am] wind among the qualities of touch, and ether among the quality of sound. / Pervading everything thus with his divine powers, O Bhārgava, he remains.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃśena bhṛguśreṣṭha tasyāṃśatritayaṃ divi ..
devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva brahmā cā'haṃ ca bhārgava .. 37 ..
meaning:
एकांशेन भृगुश्रेष्ठ तस्यांशत्रितयं दिवि ..
देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव ब्रह्मा चाऽहं च भार्गव .. 37 ..
text_mt: With one portion, O best of the Bhṛgus, [while] his three-portioned [nature] is in heaven. / The gods, the ṛṣis, Brahmā, and myself, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣuṣā yanna paśyaṃti vinā jñānagatiṃ dvija ..
jñātā jñeyastathā dhyātā dhyeyaścokto janārdanaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
चक्षुषा यन्न पश्यंति विना ज्ञानगतिं द्विज ..
ज्ञाता ज्ञेयस्तथा ध्याता ध्येयश्चोक्तो जनार्दनः .. 38 ..
text_mt: do not see him with the physical eye without the path of knowledge, O twice-born. / Janārdana is declared to be the knower, the object of knowledge, the meditator, and the object of meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
yajño yaṣṭā ca govindaḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajña eva ca ..
annamannāda evoktaḥ sa eva ca guṇatrayam .. 39 ..
meaning:
यज्ञो यष्टा च गोविन्दः क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च ..
अन्नमन्नाद एवोक्तः स एव च गुणत्रयम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Govinda is the sacrifice and the sacrificer, the field and the knower of the field. / He is declared to be the food and the eater of food, and he is the three qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayatyojasā vibhuḥ ..
puṣṇāti cauṣadhīḥ sarvā somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ .. 1.56.40 ..
meaning:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयत्योजसा विभुः ..
पुष्णाति चौषधीः सर्वा सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः .. 1.56.40 ..
text_mt: Entering the earth, the all-pervading lord sustains living beings by his vigour; / and becoming the sap-rich moon, he nourishes all plants.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇināṃ jaṭharastho'gnirbhuktapācī sa bhārgava ..
ceṣṭākṛtprāṇināṃ brahmansa ca vāyuḥ śarīragaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
प्राणिनां जठरस्थोऽग्निर्भुक्तपाची स भार्गव ..
चेष्टाकृत्प्राणिनां ब्रह्मन्स च वायुः शरीरगः .. 41 ..
text_mt: He is the fire in the belly of living beings that digests what is eaten, O Bhārgava; / and he is the bodily wind causing movement in living beings, O brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
yathādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam ..
yaccandramasi yaccā'gnau tattejastatra kīrtitam .. 42 ..
meaning:
यथादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् ..
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाऽग्नौ तत्तेजस्तत्र कीर्तितम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: The splendour that, situated in the sun, illumines the entire universe, / and that which is in the moon and in fire—that splendour is proclaimed to be his.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasya cā'sau hṛdi sanniviṣṭastasmātsmṛtirjñānamapohanañca ..
sarvaiśca devaiśca sa eva vandyo vedāntakṛdvedakṛdeva cā'sau .. 43 ..
meaning:
सर्वस्य चाऽसौ हृदि सन्निविष्टस्तस्मात्स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च ..
सर्वैश्च देवैश्च स एव वन्द्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदकृदेव चाऽसौ .. 43 ..
text_mt: He is seated in the heart of all: from him come memory, knowledge, and loss [of both]; / he alone is to be praised by all the gods, the maker of the Vedānta, and the maker of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
.. rāma uvāca .. ..
ārādhyate sa bhagavānkarmaṇā yena śaṅkara ..
tatsamācakṣva bhagavansarvasattvasukhapradam .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. राम उवाच .. ..
आराध्यते स भगवान्कर्मणा येन शङ्कर ..
तत्समाचक्ष्व भगवन्सर्वसत्त्वसुखप्रदम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / By what rite is that Lord worshipped, O Śaṅkara? / Declare that, O Lord, which bestows happiness upon all beings.
title: Bhaktiphalapradarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
sādhu rāma mahābhāga sādhu dānavanāśana ..
yanmāṃ pṛcchasi dharmajña keśavārādhanaṃ prati .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. शङ्कर उवाच ..
साधु राम महाभाग साधु दानवनाशन ..
यन्मां पृच्छसि धर्मज्ञ केशवाराधनं प्रति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Well said, O fortunate Rāma, well said, O destroyer of Dānavas, / that you ask me, O knower of dharma, about the worship of Keśava!

sanskrit_iast:
divasaṃ divasārdhaṃ vā muhūrttamekameva vā ..
nāśaścā'śeṣapāpasya bhaktirbhavati keśave .. 3 ..
meaning:
दिवसं दिवसार्धं वा मुहूर्त्तमेकमेव वा ..
नाशश्चाऽशेषपापस्य भक्तिर्भवति केशवे .. 3 ..
text_mt: [Even for] a day, half a day, or a single muhūrta, / devotion toward Keśava is the destruction of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
anekajanmasāhasrairnānāyonyantareṣu ca ..
jantoḥ kalmaṣahīnasya bhaktirbhavati keśave .. .. 4 ..
meaning:
अनेकजन्मसाहस्रैर्नानायोन्यन्तरेषु च ..
जन्तोः कल्मषहीनस्य भक्तिर्भवति केशवे .. .. 4 ..
text_mt: Through many thousands of births and in various wombs, / devotion toward Keśava arises in a living being free of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
nā'dhanyaḥ keśavaṃ stauti nā'dhanyorcayati prabhum ..
namatyadhanyaśca hariṃ nā'dhanyo vetti mādhavam .. 5 ..
meaning:
नाऽधन्यः केशवं स्तौति नाऽधन्योर्चयति प्रभुम् ..
नमत्यधन्यश्च हरिं नाऽधन्यो वेत्ति माधवम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The unfortunate does not praise Keśava, the unfortunate does not worship the Lord, / the unfortunate bows not to Hari, nor does the unfortunate know Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
manaśca taddhi dharmajña keśave yatpravartate ..
sā buddhistadvratāyaiva satataṃ pratitiṣṭhati .. 6 ..
meaning:
मनश्च तद्धि धर्मज्ञ केशवे यत्प्रवर्तते ..
सा बुद्धिस्तद्व्रतायैव सततं प्रतितिष्ठति .. 6 ..
text_mt: That is indeed mind, O knower of dharma, which engages with Keśava; / that is intellect which remains constantly resolved upon vows unto him.

sanskrit_iast:
sā vāṇī keśavaṃ devaṃ yā stauti bhṛgunandana ..
śravaṇau tau śrutā yābhyāṃ satataṃ tatkathāḥ śubhāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
सा वाणी केशवं देवं या स्तौति भृगुनन्दन ..
श्रवणौ तौ श्रुता याभ्यां सततं तत्कथाः शुभाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: That is voice which praises the god Keśava, O delight of the Bhṛgus; / those are ears by which auspicious narratives of him are constantly heard.

sanskrit_iast:
avehi dharmajña tathā tatpūjākaraṇātkarau ..
tadekaṃ saphalaṃ karma keśavārthāya yatkṛtam .. 8 ..
meaning:
अवेहि धर्मज्ञ तथा तत्पूजाकरणात्करौ ..
तदेकं सफलं कर्म केशवार्थाय यत्कृतम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Know the two hands to be such, O knower of dharma, from performing worship of him; / that alone is fruitful action which is done for the sake of Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
yato mukhyaphalāvāptau karaṇaṃ saprayojanam ..
manasā tena kiṃ kāryyaṃ yanna tiṣṭhati keśave .. 9 ..
meaning:
यतो मुख्यफलावाप्तौ करणं सप्रयोजनम् ..
मनसा तेन किं कार्य्यं यन्न तिष्ठति केशवे .. 9 ..
text_mt: Since an instrument has purpose [only] in the attainment of the principal fruit, / what use is that mind which does not rest upon Keśava?

sanskrit_iast:
buddhyā vā bhārgavaśreṣṭha tayā nāsti prayojanam ..
rogaḥ sā rasanā vā'pi yayā na stūyate hariḥ .. 1.57.10 ..
meaning:
बुद्ध्या वा भार्गवश्रेष्ठ तया नास्ति प्रयोजनम् ..
रोगः सा रसना वाऽपि यया न स्तूयते हरिः .. 1.57.10 ..
text_mt: Or what purpose is there with that intellect, O best of the Bhārgavas? / That tongue is a disease by which Hari is not praised.

sanskrit_iast:
gartau brahmavratau karṇau yābhyāṃ tatkarma na śrutam ..
bhārabhūtaiḥ karaiḥ kāryaṃ ki tasya nṛpaśordvija .. 11 ..
meaning:
गर्तौ ब्रह्मव्रतौ कर्णौ याभ्यां तत्कर्म न श्रुतम् ..
भारभूतैः करैः कार्यं कि तस्य नृपशोर्द्विज .. 11 ..
text_mt: Ears by which his deeds are not heard are mere pits, O observer of holy vows; / what use are hands that are merely a burden to that beast of a man, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
yairna saṃpūjito devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ ..
pādau tau saphalau rāma keśavālayagāminau .. 12 ..
meaning:
यैर्न संपूजितो देवः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः ..
पादौ तौ सफलौ राम केशवालयगामिनौ .. 12 ..
text_mt: by which the god bearing the conch, discus, and mace is not worshipped? / Those feet are fruitful, O Rāma, that walk to the abode of Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
te ca netre mahābhāga yābhyāṃ saṃdṛśyate hariḥ ..
kiṃ tasya caraṇaiḥ kāryaṃ kṛtasya nipuṇairdvija .. 13 ..
meaning:
ते च नेत्रे महाभाग याभ्यां संदृश्यते हरिः ..
किं तस्य चरणैः कार्यं कृतस्य निपुणैर्द्विज .. 13 ..
text_mt: And those eyes, O fortunate one, are the ones by which Hari is seen. / What use has that man, fashioned skilfully, of his feet, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
yābhyāṃ na vrajate jantuḥ keśavālayadarśane ..
jātyandhatulyaṃ taṃ manye puruṣaṃ puruṣottama .. 14 ..
meaning:
याभ्यां न व्रजते जन्तुः केशवालयदर्शने ..
जात्यन्धतुल्यं तं मन्ये पुरुषं पुरुषोत्तम .. 14 ..
text_mt: by which a creature does not go to see the abode of Keśava? / I consider that man equal to one born blind, O best among men,

sanskrit_iast:
yo na paśyati dharmajña keśavārcāṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
kleśasaṃjananaṃ karma vṛthā tadbhṛgunandana .. 15 ..
meaning:
यो न पश्यति धर्मज्ञ केशवार्चां पुनःपुनः ..
क्लेशसंजननं कर्म वृथा तद्भृगुनन्दन .. 15 ..
text_mt: who does not behold the image of Keśava again and again, O knower of dharma. / An action that causes distress is in vain, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
keśavaṃ prati yadrāma kriyate'hani sarvadā ..
paśya keśavamārādhya modamānaṃ śacīpatim .. 16 ..
meaning:
केशवं प्रति यद्राम क्रियतेऽहनि सर्वदा ..
पश्य केशवमाराध्य मोदमानं शचीपतिम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: [Fruitful is] what is done daily toward Keśava at all times, O Rāma. / Behold the lord of Śacī rejoicing after having worshipped Keśava,

sanskrit_iast:
yamañca varuṇañcaiva tathā vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum ..
devendratvamatisphītaṃ sarvabhūtismitaṃ padam .. 17 '.
haribhaktidrumātpuṣpaṃ rājasātsāttvikaṃ phalam ..
aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ laghimā tathā .. 18 ..
meaning:
यमञ्च वरुणञ्चैव तथा वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् ..
देवेन्द्रत्वमतिस्फीतं सर्वभूतिस्मितं पदम् .. 17 '.
हरिभक्तिद्रुमात्पुष्पं राजसात्सात्त्विकं फलम् ..
अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं लघिमा तथा .. 18 ..
text_mt: and Yama, Varuṇa, and the lord Vaiśravaṇa as well; / the sovereign state of the gods, exceedingly flourishing, a position radiant with all prosperity! / From the tree of devotion to Hari, the flower is rājasika, and the fruit is sāttvika: / lightness, greatness, reach, freedom of will, lightness,

sanskrit_iast:
īthitvañca vaśitvañca yatra kāmāvasāyitā ..
ārādhya keśavaṃ devaṃ prāpyante nā'tra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ईथित्वञ्च वशित्वञ्च यत्र कामावसायिता ..
आराध्य केशवं देवं प्राप्यन्ते नाऽत्र संशयः .. 19 ..
text_mt: lordship, subjugation, and where desires are accomplished at will— / these are attained by worshipping the god Keśava, there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast:
hatapratyaṅgamātaṅgo rudhirāruṇabhūtale ..
saṃgrāme vijayaṃ rāma prāpyate tatprasādataḥ .. .. 1.57.20 ..
meaning:
हतप्रत्यङ्गमातङ्गो रुधिरारुणभूतले ..
संग्रामे विजयं राम प्राप्यते तत्प्रसादतः .. .. 1.57.20 ..
text_mt: Upon the earth reddened with blood, with elephants having their limbs destroyed, / victory in battle is obtained, O Rāma, through his grace.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākaṭitaṭaśroṇyaḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ ..
akalaṅkaśaśāṅkābhavadanā nīlamūrdhajāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
महाकटितटश्रोण्यः पीनोन्नतपयोधराः ..
अकलङ्कशशाङ्काभवदना नीलमूर्धजाः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Possessing broad hips and buttocks, full and elevated breasts, / faces resembling the spotless moon, and dark black hair,

sanskrit_iast:
ramayanti naraṃ svapne devarāmā manoharāḥ ..
sakṛdyenārcito devo helayā vā namaskṛtaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
रमयन्ति नरं स्वप्ने देवरामा मनोहराः ..
सकृद्येनार्चितो देवो हेलया वा नमस्कृतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: charming celestial women delight a man even in sleep, / by whom the god has been worshipped once, or saluted even playfully.

sanskrit_iast:
vedavedāṅgavapuṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..
ṛṣitvamapi dharmajña vijñeyaṃ tatprasādajam .. 23 ..
meaning:
वेदवेदाङ्गवपुषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ..
ऋषित्वमपि धर्मज्ञ विज्ञेयं तत्प्रसादजम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: The status of being an inspired seer among sages who embody the Vedas and auxiliary sciences and who are purified in self / is also to be known as born of his grace, O knower of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ramante saha rāmābhiḥ prāpya vaidyādharaṃ padam ..
anyabhāvatayā nāmnaḥ kīrtanādapi bhārgava .. 24 ..
meaning:
रमन्ते सह रामाभिः प्राप्य वैद्याधरं पदम् ..
अन्यभावतया नाम्नः कीर्तनादपि भार्गव .. 24 ..
text_mt: Attaining the status of Vidyādharas, they delight with women, / even from reciting his name with a distracted mind, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnaparyaṅkaśayitā mahābhogāśca bhoginaḥ ..
vījyante saha rāmābhiḥ keśavasmaraṇādapi .. 25 ..
meaning:
रत्नपर्यङ्कशयिता महाभोगाश्च भोगिनः ..
वीज्यन्ते सह रामाभिः केशवस्मरणादपि .. 25 ..
text_mt: Lying upon jewelled couches, experiencing great pleasures, sensualists / are fanned together with lovely women merely from remembering Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
saugandhike vane ramye kailāsaparvate dvija ..
yadyakṣā viharanti sma tatprāhuḥ kusumaṃ nateḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सौगन्धिके वने रम्ये कैलासपर्वते द्विज ..
यद्यक्षा विहरन्ति स्म तत्प्राहुः कुसुमं नतेः .. 26 ..
text_mt: That the Yakṣas disport in the charming Saugandhika forest on Mount Kailāsa, / that, O twice-born, they call the flower of prostration [to him].

sanskrit_iast:
ratnacitrāsu ramyāsu nandanodyānabhūmiṣu ..
krīḍanti ca saha strībhirgandharvībhiḥ kathāśruteḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
रत्नचित्रासु रम्यासु नन्दनोद्यानभूमिषु ..
क्रीडन्ति च सह स्त्रीभिर्गन्धर्वीभिः कथाश्रुतेः .. 27 ..
text_mt: In the delightful grounds of the Nandana garden, varied with jewels, / they play with Gandharva women from having heard his stories.

sanskrit_iast:
catussamudravelāyāṃ meruvindhyapayodharām ..
dharāṃ ye bhuñjate bhūpāḥ praṇipātasya tatphalam .. 28 ..
meaning:
चतुस्समुद्रवेलायां मेरुविन्ध्यपयोधराम् ..
धरां ये भुञ्जते भूपाः प्रणिपातस्य तत्फलम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Those kings who enjoy the earth, whose breasts are Meru and Vindhya, / bounded by the shores of the four oceans—that is the fruit of bowing down to him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttavā'haṃ vakṣyāmi yadyadācarataḥ sadā ..
puruṣasyeha bhagavānsutoṣastuṣyate hariḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्तवाऽहं वक्ष्यामि यद्यदाचरतः सदा ..
पुरुषस्येह भगवान्सुतोषस्तुष्यते हरिः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Therefore, I will tell you what, when practiced constantly / by a man here, pleases the Lord Hari, who is easily pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyaḥ sa nityaṃ varado mahātmā stavyaḥ sa nityaṃ jagadekavandyaḥ ..
dhyeyaḥ sa nityaṃ sakalāghahartā caitāvaduktaṃ tava rāma guhyam .. 1.57.30 ..
meaning:
पूज्यः स नित्यं वरदो महात्मा स्तव्यः स नित्यं जगदेकवन्द्यः ..
ध्येयः स नित्यं सकलाघहर्ता चैतावदुक्तं तव राम गुह्यम् .. 1.57.30 ..
text_mt: He, the granter of boons, the great-souled one, is always to be worshipped; he, the sole object of praise for the world, is always to be praised; / he, the remover of all sins, is always to be meditated upon. This much secret [truth] has been spoken to you, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ dayā bhūteṣvanugraham ..
yasyaitāni sadā rāma tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शङ्कर उवाच ..
अहिंसा सत्यवचनं दया भूतेष्वनुग्रहम् ..
यस्यैतानि सदा राम तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Non-violence, speaking truth, compassion, [and] kindness toward living beings— / he who always possesses these, O Rāma, Keśava is pleased with him.
title: adhyāyaḥ 058

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitṛgurūṇāñca yaḥ samyagiha varttate ..
varjako madhumāṃsasya tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
