मातापितृगुरूणाञ्च यः सम्यगिह वर्त्तते ..
वर्जको मधुमांसस्य तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 2 ..
text_mt: He who conducts himself properly here toward mother, father, and teachers, / [and] who abstains from liquor and meat, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhamatsyamāṃsāni yo nātti bhṛgunandana ..
virato madyapānācca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
वराहमत्स्यमांसानि यो नात्ति भृगुनन्दन ..
विरतो मद्यपानाच्च तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: He who does not eat the flesh of boar or fish, O son of Bhṛgu, / and who desists from drinking liquor, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
na dhārayati nirmālyamanyadevoddhṛtaṃ tu yaḥ ..
bhuṃkte na cānyanaivedyaṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
न धारयति निर्माल्यमन्यदेवोद्धृतं तु यः ..
भुंक्ते न चान्यनैवेद्यं तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 4 ..
text_mt: He who does not wear the floral offerings taken from another deity, / and does not eat another [deity's] food offering, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
avaiṣṇave devadhṛtaṃ nirmālyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
naivedyaṃ vā mahābhāga tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
अवैष्णवे देवधृतं निर्माल्यं यः प्रयच्छति ..
नैवेद्यं वा महाभाग तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 5 ..
text_mt: He who gives to a non-Vaiṣṇava the floral offering worn by a deity, / or the food offering, O fortunate one, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
bibharti mūrdhni nirmālyaṃ keśavārcādhṛtaṃ tu yaḥ..
anivedya na cāśnāti tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 6..
meaning:
बिभर्ति मूर्ध्नि निर्माल्यं केशवार्चाधृतं तु यः..
अनिवेद्य न चाश्नाति तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 6..
text_mt: He who wears upon his head the floral offering borne by an image of Keśava, / and does not eat without having [first] offered, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
parapīḍākaraṃ karma yasya nā'sti mahātmanaḥ..
saṃvibhāgī ca bhūtānāṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
परपीडाकरं कर्म यस्य नाऽस्ति महात्मनः..
संविभागी च भूतानां तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 7 ..
text_mt: That great-souled one who has no action causing harm to others, / and who shares [his food] with living beings, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇute sarvadharmāṃśca sarvāndevānnamasyati ..
anasūyurjitakrodhastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
शृणुते सर्वधर्मांश्च सर्वान्देवान्नमस्यति ..
अनसूयुर्जितक्रोधस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 8 ..
text_mt: He who listens to all dharmas, bows to all deities, / is free from envy, and has conquered anger, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthopavāsasevī ca dvijātigaṇasevakaḥ ..
pūjako viṣṇubhaktānāṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
तीर्थोपवाससेवी च द्विजातिगणसेवकः ..
पूजको विष्णुभक्तानां तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 9 ..
text_mt: He who frequents sacred bathing places and observes fasts, serves the company of the twice-born, / and worships the devotees of Viṣṇu, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarātravido mukhyānyastu saṃpūjayetsadā ..
devavadbhṛguśārdūla tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 1.58.10 ..
meaning:
पञ्चरात्रविदो मुख्यान्यस्तु संपूजयेत्सदा ..
देववद्भृगुशार्दूल तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 1.58.10 ..
text_mt: He who always worships the foremost knowers of the Pañcarātra / like gods, O tiger among the Bhṛgus, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevārcanarataḥ svadāranirataḥ sadā ..
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..11..
meaning:
पितृदेवार्चनरतः स्वदारनिरतः सदा ..
ऋतुकालाभिगामी च तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..11..
text_mt: Devoted to worshipping the ancestors and deities, always devoted to his own wife, / and approaching [her only] at the proper time of her season, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tathā yaśca gāyati tanmanāḥ ..
satataṃ kalyamutthāya tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..12..
meaning:
नाम्नां सहस्रेण तथा यश्च गायति तन्मनाः ..
सततं कल्यमुत्थाय तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..12..
text_mt: And he who, with his mind fixed on him, sings with the thousand names [of Viṣṇu], / having risen early in the morning every day, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena japyahomādikaṃ sadā..
yaḥ karotyamitaprajñastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पौरुषेण च सूक्तेन जप्यहोमादिकं सदा..
यः करोत्यमितप्रज्ञस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 13 ..
text_mt: And he who, endowed with immeasurable wisdom, always performs recitation, oblation, and the like / with the hymn to the Cosmic Person, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
mitrasvāmigurudroho yasya nā'sti mahātmanaḥ ..
paradāradhanecchā na tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
मित्रस्वामिगुरुद्रोहो यस्य नाऽस्ति महात्मनः ..
परदारधनेच्छा न तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 14 ..
text_mt: That great-souled one who has no treachery toward friend, master, or teacher, / and no desire for another's wife or wealth, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā śāstropadeśena rājyaṃ yaśca praśāsati ..
rājadharmaratirnityaṃ tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ..15..
meaning:
राजा शास्त्रोपदेशेन राज्यं यश्च प्रशासति ..
राजधर्मरतिर्नित्यं तस्य तुष्यति केशवः..15..
text_mt: A king who governs his realm according to the teaching of the treatises, / and always takes delight in the duties of kings, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
yā tu nārī patiprāṇā patibhaktā pativratā ..
tasyāḥ sutoṣo bhagavām̐stoṣamāyāti keśavaḥ..16..
meaning:
या तु नारी पतिप्राणा पतिभक्ता पतिव्रता ..
तस्याः सुतोषो भगवाम्̐स्तोषमायाति केशवः..16..
text_mt: As for that woman whose husband is her very life, devoted to her husband, faithful to her husband, / the Lord Keśava, easily pleased, attains satisfaction through her.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraparo vidvānyajñairnityamatandritaḥ ..
yastu tarpayate devāṃstasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ..17..
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रपरो विद्वान्यज्ञैर्नित्यमतन्द्रितः ..
यस्तु तर्पयते देवांस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः..17..
text_mt: The learned man devoted to the agnihotra fire, who, ever untiring, / pleases the deities with sacrifices, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇāśramadharmasthaḥ pūjayanmadhusūdanam ..
kālaṃ nayati yo brahmam̐stasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..18..
meaning:
स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मस्थः पूजयन्मधुसूदनम् ..
कालं नयति यो ब्रह्मम्̐स्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..18..
text_mt: Standing in the dharma of his own class and stage of life, worshipping Madhusūdana, / he who passes his time [thus], O holy one, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsastu pakṣānte dvādaśyāṃ vā bhṛgūttama ..
baudhe'hni śravaṇarkṣe vā tṛtīyāyāntu vā punaḥ ..
sopavāso'rcayati yastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सोपवासस्तु पक्षान्ते द्वादश्यां वा भृगूत्तम ..
बौधेऽह्नि श्रवणर्क्षे वा तृतीयायान्तु वा पुनः ..
सोपवासोऽर्चयति यस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Fasting at the end of a fortnight, or on the twelfth day [of a lunar fortnight], O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / or on a Wednesday, or under the asterism Śravaṇa, or again on the third day [of a lunar fortnight], / he who worships while fasting, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ vinā hariṃ prāpya phalī ratnaṃ kṣumāpi vā ..
nivedayati yaḥ kṛṣṇe tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ..1.58.20..
meaning:
पुष्पं विना हरिं प्राप्य फली रत्नं क्षुमापि वा ..
निवेदयति यः कृष्णे तस्य तुष्यति केशवः..1.58.20..
text_mt: Having approached Hari without flowers, he who, bearing fruit, offers / a jewel or even flax to Kṛṣṇa, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇe paśyati yatsarvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvatra paśyati ..
mahātmā buddhisampannastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
कृष्णे पश्यति यत्सर्वं कृष्णं सर्वत्र पश्यति ..
महात्मा बुद्धिसम्पन्नस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 21 ..
text_mt: He who sees everything in Kṛṣṇa, and sees Kṛṣṇa everywhere, / that great-souled one endowed with discernment, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathāyāñca ramate tatkathāṃ yaḥ karoti ca ..
tanmanāstadgataprāṇastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..22..
meaning:
तत्कथायाञ्च रमते तत्कथां यः करोति च ..
तन्मनास्तद्गतप्राणस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..22..
text_mt: He who delights in narratives about him, and tells narratives about him, / his mind fixed on him, his life-breath dedicated to him, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ..
sarvabhūtānukampī ca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वभूतहिते युक्तः सर्वभूतहिते रतः ..
सर्वभूतानुकम्पी च तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Dedicated to the welfare of all beings, delighting in the welfare of all beings, / and compassionate toward all beings, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
apraṇamya kriyāṃ kāṃcidyastu nā''rabhate harim ..
asaṃbhinnārthamaryādastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
अप्रणम्य क्रियां कांचिद्यस्तु ना'ऽरभते हरिम् ..
असंभिन्नार्थमर्यादस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 24 ..
text_mt: He who does not begin any rite without having bowed to Hari, / and does not transgress the bounds of righteousness, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ kṣuta praskhalanādiṣu ..
yaḥ karoti mahābhāgastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
नामसंकीर्तनं नित्यं क्षुत प्रस्खलनादिषु ..
यः करोति महाभागस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 25 ..
text_mt: He who, O fortunate one, constantly chants the names [of the Lord] / upon sneezing, stumbling, and the like, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
navaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ nivedya madhusūdane ..
paścādbhuṅkte svayaṃ yaśca tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 26
meaning:
नवं पत्रं फलं पुष्पं निवेद्य मधुसूदने ..
पश्चाद्भुङ्क्ते स्वयं यश्च तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 26
text_mt: Having offered a fresh leaf, fruit, or flower to Madhusūdana, / he who afterwards eats [it] himself, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ deveśaśapathaṃ naraḥ ..
na karoti hi yo brahmaṃstasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
आपद्यपि च कष्टायां देवेशशपथं नरः ..
न करोति हि यो ब्रह्मंस्तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Even in severe distress, that man who never swears / an oath by the Lord of the gods, O holy one, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
devāduddhṛtya nirmālyaṃ chāyāṃ nākramate ca yaḥ ..
dhūpāgnibhasma ca tathā tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ ..28..
meaning:
देवादुद्धृत्य निर्माल्यं छायां नाक्रमते च यः ..
धूपाग्निभस्म च तथा तस्य तुष्यति केशवः ..28..
text_mt: Having removed the floral offering from the deity, he who does not step on its shadow, / and likewise on the incense, fire, or ashes, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjitāmarcā yaśca bhaktyābhinandati ..
svayaṃ saṃpūjayedyastu tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा संपूजितामर्चा यश्च भक्त्याभिनन्दति ..
स्वयं संपूजयेद्यस्तु तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 29 ..
text_mt: He who, seeing an image that has been worshipped, rejoices with devotion, / and who worships [it] himself, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ saṃpūjayedyastu devadevasya bhaktitaḥ ..
yathāśaktyā mahābhāga tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 1.58.30 ..
meaning:
नित्यं संपूजयेद्यस्तु देवदेवस्य भक्तितः ..
यथाशक्त्या महाभाग तस्य तुष्यति केशवः .. 1.58.30 ..
text_mt: He who, O fortunate one, constantly worships with devotion / the God of gods according to his ability, Keśava is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
na rāma vividhairdānairna ratnadhanasaṃcayaiḥ ..
toṣamāyāti deveśo bhaktyā tuṣyati keśavaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
न राम विविधैर्दानैर्न रत्नधनसंचयैः ..
तोषमायाति देवेशो भक्त्या तुष्यति केशवः .. 31 ..
text_mt: Not by manifold gifts, O Rāma, nor by heaps of jewels and wealth / does the Lord of the gods attain satisfaction; Keśava is pleased by devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
dānairbhṛguśreṣṭha bahuprakāraistīrthopavāsavratadarśanaiśca ..
tathā na toṣaṃ bhagavānprayāti bhaktyā yathā tadgatamānasānām .. 32 ..
meaning:
दानैर्भृगुश्रेष्ठ बहुप्रकारैस्तीर्थोपवासव्रतदर्शनैश्च ..
तथा न तोषं भगवान्प्रयाति भक्त्या यथा तद्गतमानसानाम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Not by gifts of many kinds, O best of the Bhṛgus, nor by visits to sacred bathing places, fasts, and vows, / does the Lord attain such satisfaction as by the devotion of those whose minds are fixed on him.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktaṃ tava rāma guhyaṃ na deyametadbhuvi matsarāṇām ..
na tarkaśāstrākulamānasānāṃ nā'vaiṣṇavānāṃ na ca nāstikānām .. 33 ..
meaning:
एतावदुक्तं तव राम गुह्यं न देयमेतद्भुवि मत्सराणाम् ..
न तर्कशास्त्राकुलमानसानां नाऽवैष्णवानां न च नास्तिकानाम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: This much secret [truth] has been spoken to you, O Rāma; on earth this is not to be given to the envious, / nor to those whose minds are bewildered by the treatises of logic, nor to non-Vaiṣṇavas, nor to materialists.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāma uvāca..
upoṣitena yeneha yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ prayacchati ..
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi gadataste vṛṣadhvaja .. 1 ..
meaning:
श्रीराम उवाच..
उपोषितेन येनेह यंयं कामं प्रयच्छति ..
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि गदतस्ते वृषध्वज .. 1 ..
text_mt: Glorious Rāma said: / Which specific desire he grants here to one who has fasted— / that I wish to hear as you tell it, O god who has a bull for his emblem.
title: adhyāyaḥ 059

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca..
pūjitaḥ prayataiḥ snānaiḥ sopavāsairdine raveḥ..
saṃvatsaraṃ mahābhāga dīrghamāyuḥ prayacchati .. 2 ..
meaning:
शंकर उवाच..
पूजितः प्रयतैः स्नानैः सोपवासैर्दिने रवेः..
संवत्सरं महाभाग दीर्घमायुः प्रयच्छति .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Worshipped with restrained baths and with fasts on the day of the Sun / for a year, O fortunate one, he grants a long life.

sanskrit_iast:
somavāre mahābhāga cārogyaṃ saṃprayacchati ..
tathā bhaumadine rāma vaiśvaryaṃ saṃprayacchati .. 3 ..
meaning:
सोमवारे महाभाग चारोग्यं संप्रयच्छति ..
तथा भौमदिने राम वैश्वर्यं संप्रयच्छति .. 3 ..
text_mt: On a Monday, O fortunate one, he grants health; / likewise on a Tuesday, O Rāma, he grants sovereign power.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsare somaputrasya sarvānkāmānprayacchati ..
abhīṣṭāñca tathā vidyāmākhaṇḍalagurordine .. 4 ..
meaning:
वासरे सोमपुत्रस्य सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति ..
अभीष्टाञ्च तथा विद्यामाखण्डलगुरोर्दिने .. 4 ..
text_mt: On the day of the Moon's son, he grants all desires; / and on the day of Indra's teacher, he grants desired knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyamatulaṃ loke bhārgavāhni prayacchati ..
tathā śanaiścarasyāhni ripūnsarvānvyapohati .. 5 ..
meaning:
सौभाग्यमतुलं लोके भार्गवाह्नि प्रयच्छति ..
तथा शनैश्चरस्याह्नि रिपून्सर्वान्व्यपोहति .. 5 ..
text_mt: On the day of Bhṛgu's descendant, he grants peerless good fortune in the world; / likewise on the day of Saturn, he drives away all enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikāsu tathā'bhyarcya yajñānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
prājāpatye tathā'bhyarcya prajāṃ prāpnoti śobhanām .. 6 ..
meaning:
कृत्तिकासु तथाऽभ्यर्च्य यज्ञान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ..
प्राजापत्ये तथाऽभ्यर्च्य प्रजां प्राप्नोति शोभनाम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: And by worshipping [Him] during Kṛttikā, one obtains unsurpassed sacrifices; / and by worshipping during Prājāpatya (Rohiṇī), one obtains noble offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
vindate brahmavarcasyaṃ mṛgaśīrṣe'rcayanharim ..
raudrakarmatvamāpnoti siddhiṃ raudre samarcayan .. 7 ..
meaning:
विन्दते ब्रह्मवर्चस्यं मृगशीर्षेऽर्चयन्हरिम् ..
रौद्रकर्मत्वमाप्नोति सिद्धिं रौद्रे समर्चयन् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Hari during Mṛgaśīrṣa, one finds spiritual splendour; / worshipping during Raudra (Ārdrā), one obtains the power to perform fierce deeds and succeeds.

sanskrit_iast:
cyutaḥ sthānamavāpnoti pūjayānaḥ punarvasau ..
puṣye saṃpūjito devaḥ puṣṭimagryāṃ prayacchati ..8 ..
meaning:
च्युतः स्थानमवाप्नोति पूजयानः पुनर्वसौ ..
पुष्ये संपूजितो देवः पुष्टिमग्र्यां प्रयच्छति ..8 ..
text_mt: One who has fallen gains a high place by worshipping during Punarvasu; / worshipped during Puṣya, the Lord grants supreme nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
aśleṣāyāṃ tathā'bhyarcya śriyaṃ vindati mānavaḥ ..
pitṛprasādamāpnoti pitrye saṃpūjanharim .. 9 ..
meaning:
अश्लेषायां तथाऽभ्यर्च्य श्रियं विन्दति मानवः ..
पितृप्रसादमाप्नोति पित्र्ये संपूजन्हरिम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: And by worshipping during Āśleṣā, a person finds prosperity; / worshipping Hari during Pitrya (Maghā), one attains the grace of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti phālgunīṣvarcayaṃstathā ..
tathaiva cottarāyoge gatiṃ vindati śobhanām .. 1.59.10 ..
meaning:
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति फाल्गुनीष्वर्चयंस्तथा ..
तथैव चोत्तरायोगे गतिं विन्दति शोभनाम् .. 1.59.10 ..
text_mt: Worshipping during the Phālgunīs, one obtains great good fortune; / and similarly, during the conjunction of Uttarā, one finds an auspicious destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
haste saṃpūjayandevaṃ gajānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
citrāsu ca tathā'bhyarcya vastrāṇyāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
हस्ते संपूजयन्देवं गजान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ..
चित्रासु च तथाऽभ्यर्च्य वस्त्राण्याप्नोति मानवः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Worshipping the Lord during Hasta, one obtains unsurpassed elephants; / and by worshipping during Citrā, a person obtains garments.

sanskrit_iast:
āpye samarcayandevaṃ ratnabhāgī bhavennaraḥ ..
tathottarāsvāṣāḍhāsu kīrtiṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm .. 12 ..
meaning:
आप्ये समर्चयन्देवं रत्नभागी भवेन्नरः ..
तथोत्तरास्वाषाढासु कीर्तिं प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Worshipping the Lord during Āpya (Pūrvāṣāḍhā), a man becomes an owner of jewels; / and during Uttarāṣāḍhā, one attains everlasting fame.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti śravaṇe'bhyarcayanharim ..
dhaniṣṭhāsu tathā vittamārogyaṃ vāruṇe tathā .. 13 ..
meaning:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति श्रवणेऽभ्यर्चयन्हरिम् ..
धनिष्ठासु तथा वित्तमारोग्यं वारुणे तथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Hari during Śravaṇa, one obtains all desires; / during Dhaniṣṭhā, wealth; and during Vāruṇa (Śatabhiṣaj), health.

sanskrit_iast:
āje paśūnavāpnoti gāvaśca tadanantaram ..
pauṣṇe śīlamavāpnoti cāśvānprāpnoti cā'śvine .. 14 ..
meaning:
आजे पशूनवाप्नोति गावश्च तदनन्तरम् ..
पौष्णे शीलमवाप्नोति चाश्वान्प्राप्नोति चाऽश्विने .. 14 ..
text_mt: During Āja (Pūrvabhādrapadā), one obtains livestock, and immediately thereafter cows; / during Pauṣṇa (Revatī), one obtains virtuous character; and during Aśvinī, horses.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghajīvitamāpnoti bharaṇīṣu mahābhuja ..
pratipadyarthamāpnoti kupyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamama .. 15 ..
meaning:
दीर्घजीवितमाप्नोति भरणीषु महाभुज ..
प्रतिपद्यर्थमाप्नोति कुप्यं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम .. 15 ..
text_mt: O large-armed one, during Bharaṇī, one attains a long life; / on the first lunar day, one obtains wealth and unsurpassed base metals.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoni tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayan ..
paśūm̐ścaturthyāmāpnoti pañcamyāṃ śriyamuttamām .. 16 ..
meaning:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोनि तृतीयायां समर्चयन् ..
पशूम्̐श्चतुर्थ्यामाप्नोति पञ्चम्यां श्रियमुत्तमाम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Worshipping on the third lunar day, one obtains all desires; / on the fourth, one obtains livestock; and on the fifth, supreme prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhayāṃ prāpnotyathā''rogyaṃ saptamyāṃ suhṛdastathā ..
aṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā bhṛtyānnavamyāṃ ca tathā yaśaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
षष्ठयां प्राप्नोत्यथा'ऽरोग्यं सप्तम्यां सुहृदस्तथा ..
अष्टम्यां च तथा भृत्यान्नवम्यां च तथा यशः .. 17 ..
text_mt: On the sixth, one obtains health; and on the seventh, friends; / and on the eighth, servants; and on the ninth, fame.

sanskrit_iast:
karmasiddhimavāpnoti daśamyāṃ pūjayanharim ..
ekādaśyāṃ pūjayānaḥ śrībhāgī sa sadā bhaveta .. 18 ..
meaning:
कर्मसिद्धिमवाप्नोति दशम्यां पूजयन्हरिम् ..
एकादश्यां पूजयानः श्रीभागी स सदा भवेत .. 18 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Hari on the tenth, one obtains success in action; / worshipping on the eleventh, one always shares in good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
abhīṣṭāṃ gatimāpnoti dvādaśyāṃ pūjayanharim ..
trayodaśyāṃ pūjayāno rūpaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 19 ..
meaning:
अभीष्टां गतिमाप्नोति द्वादश्यां पूजयन्हरिम् ..
त्रयोदश्यां पूजयानो रूपं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Hari on the twelfth, one obtains a desired destiny; / worshipping on the thirteenth, one attains unsurpassed beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
na durgatimavāpnoti pūjayānaścaturdaśīma ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pañcadaśyāṃ mahāmune .. 1.59.20 ..
meaning:
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति पूजयानश्चतुर्दशीम ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति पञ्चदश्यां महामुने .. 1.59.20 ..
text_mt: Worshipping on the fourteenth, one meets no misfortune; / on the fifteenth, O great sage, one obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetaduktaṃ tava mānavānāṃ kāmyaṃ phalaṃ samyagupoṣitānām ..
deveśvaraṃ pūjayatāṃ yathāvatparaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ vareṇyam .. 21 ..
meaning:
इत्येतदुक्तं तव मानवानां काम्यं फलं सम्यगुपोषितानाम् ..
देवेश्वरं पूजयतां यथावत्परं पुराणं पुरुषं वरेण्यम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Thus has been declared to you the desired fruit for men who have fasted properly, / worshipping the Lord of gods, the supreme, ancient, and most excellent Cosmic Person as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
.. rāma uvāca ..
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ kiṃ syādekamupoṣitam ..
mahāphalaṃ mahādeva tatsamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ..1..
meaning:
.. राम उवाच ..
उपवासासमर्थानां किं स्यादेकमुपोषितम् ..
महाफलं महादेव तत्समाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ..1..
text_mt: Rāma said: / For those unable to observe [regular] fasts, what single fast / would yield great fruit? O Mahādeva, explain that to me who am asking.
title: adhyāyaḥ 060

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṅkara uvāca ..
yā rāma śravaṇopetā dvādaśī mahatī ca sā ..
tasyāmupoṣitaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam .. 2 ..
meaning:
.. शङ्कर उवाच ..
या राम श्रवणोपेता द्वादशी महती च सा ..
तस्यामुपोषितः स्नातः पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / O Rāma, that twelfth lunar day which is joined with the Śravaṇa asterism is indeed great; / fasting on it, bathed and having worshipped Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnotyayatnāddharmajña dvādaśadvādaśīphalam ..
dadhyodanayutaṃ tasyāṃ jalapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dvije .. 3 ..
meaning:
प्राप्नोत्ययत्नाद्धर्मज्ञ द्वादशद्वादशीफलम् ..
दध्योदनयुतं तस्यां जलपूर्णं घटं द्विजे .. 3 ..
text_mt: one effortlessly obtains the fruit of twelve twelfth days, O knower of dharma. / On that day, giving a water-filled pot with curd-rice to a twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrasaṃveṣṭitaṃ dattvā chatropānahameva ca ..
na durgatimavāpnoti gatimanyāñca vindati .. 4 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रसंवेष्टितं दत्त्वा छत्रोपानहमेव च ..
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति गतिमन्याञ्च विन्दति .. 4 ..
text_mt: wrapped in cloth, along with an umbrella and sandals, / one does not meet misfortune and attains the highest destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayyaṃ sthānamāpnoti nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge budhavāro bhavedyadi .. 5 ..
meaning:
अक्षय्यं स्थानमाप्नोति नाऽत्र कार्या विचारणा ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे बुधवारो भवेद्यदि .. 5 ..
text_mt: One attains an imperishable station; no doubt should be entertained on this. / If a Wednesday occurs during the conjunction of the twelfth day and Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
atyantaṃ mahatī nāma dvādaśī sā prakīrtitā ..
snānaṃ japyaṃ tathā dānaṃ homaṃ śrāddhaṃ surārcanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
अत्यन्तं महती नाम द्वादशी सा प्रकीर्तिता ..
स्नानं जप्यं तथा दानं होमं श्राद्धं सुरार्चनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: that twelfth day is renowned as "Extremely Great." / Bathing, reciting mantras, making gifts, offering oblations, ancestral rites, and worshipping the gods—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamakṣayyamāpnoti tasya bhṛgukulodvaha ..
tasmindine tathā snāto yatra kvacana saṃgame .. 7 ..
meaning:
सर्वमक्षय्यमाप्नोति तस्य भृगुकुलोद्वह ..
तस्मिन्दिने तथा स्नातो यत्र क्वचन संगमे .. 7 ..
text_mt: all become imperishable for him, O scion of Bhṛgu's lineage. / Bathed on that day at any confluence [of rivers],

sanskrit_iast:
sa kratusnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
śravaṇe saṃgamāḥ sarve phalapuṣṭipradāḥ sadā .. 8 ..
meaning:
स क्रतुस्नानजं पुण्यं फलमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ..
श्रवणे संगमाः सर्वे फलपुष्टिप्रदाः सदा .. 8 ..
text_mt: he undoubtedly attains the meritorious fruit born of bathing at a Vedic sacrifice. / Confluences during Śravaṇa always bestow fruit and nourishment,

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣāddvādaśīyukte budhayukte viśeṣataḥ ..
yathaiva dvādaśī proktā budhaśravaṇasaṃyutā .. 9 ..
meaning:
विशेषाद्द्वादशीयुक्ते बुधयुक्ते विशेषतः ..
यथैव द्वादशी प्रोक्ता बुधश्रवणसंयुता .. 9 ..
text_mt: especially when combined with the twelfth day, and even more so when combined with Wednesday. / Just as the twelfth day joined with Wednesday and Śravaṇa has been described,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyā ca tathā jñeyā sarvakāmasamanvitā ..
yathā tṛtīyā dharmajña tathā pañcadaśī śubhā .. 1.60.10 ..
meaning:
तृतीया च तथा ज्ञेया सर्वकामसमन्विता ..
यथा तृतीया धर्मज्ञ तथा पञ्चदशी शुभा .. 1.60.10 ..
text_mt: so too the third day is to be known as fulfilling all desires; / just as the third day, O knower of dharma, so also the auspicious fifteenth day.

sanskrit_iast:
tryahaḥspṛśe'pi divase copavāse mahāphalaḥ ..
keśavābhyarcane rāma dānajapyādikeṣu ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
त्र्यहःस्पृशेऽपि दिवसे चोपवासे महाफलः ..
केशवाभ्यर्चने राम दानजप्यादिकेषु च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Fasting even on a day that touches three days yields great fruit, / O Rāma, in the worship of Keśava, and in gifts, recitation of mantras, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
tryahaḥspṛgdivasaḥ kīdṛkkadā bhavati vā prabho ..
tasya me saṃśayaṃ brūhi devadeva vṛṣadhvaja .. 12 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
त्र्यहःस्पृग्दिवसः कीदृक्कदा भवति वा प्रभो ..
तस्य मे संशयं ब्रूहि देवदेव वृषध्वज .. 12 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / What kind of day is a day that touches three days, or when does it occur, O Lord? / Clear that doubt of mine, O God of gods, O You whose banner bears a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
divā vinirgatā yatra vyatītā syāttithirdvija ..
rātri śeṣe tathāveśya bhaviṣyā spṛśatī tithiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
शंकर उवाच ..
दिवा विनिर्गता यत्र व्यतीता स्यात्तिथिर्द्विज ..
रात्रि शेषे तथावेश्य भविष्या स्पृशती तिथिः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Śaṃkara said: / Where one lunar day passes during daylight, O twice-born, / and having entered at the remainder of the night, the subsequent lunar day touches it—

sanskrit_iast:
tithitritayasaṃsparśādahorātre bhṛgūttama ..
tryahaspṛksa vinirdiṣṭaḥ puṇyaḥ paramapāvana .. 14 ..
meaning:
तिथित्रितयसंस्पर्शादहोरात्रे भृगूत्तम ..
त्र्यहस्पृक्स विनिर्दिष्टः पुण्यः परमपावन .. 14 ..
text_mt: because of the contact of three lunar days within a single day and night, O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / it is designated as touching three days; it is auspicious and supremely purifying.

sanskrit_iast:
tatropoṣya śiraḥsnātaiḥ karttavyaṃ devatārcanam ..
japaṃ homaṃ tathā dānaṃ kāmayadbhirmahatphalam .. 15 ..
meaning:
तत्रोपोष्य शिरःस्नातैः कर्त्तव्यं देवतार्चनम् ..
जपं होमं तथा दानं कामयद्भिर्महत्फलम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Having fasted there with heads washed, the worship of deities should be performed / by those desiring great fruit, along with recitation of mantras, oblations, and gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇāṃ pariśeṣāṇāmakarmmaṇyaṃ hi taddinam ..
bhojyaṃ trimadhuraṃ rāma brāhmaṇām̐statra bhojayet .. 16..
meaning:
कर्मणां परिशेषाणामकर्म्मण्यं हि तद्दिनम् ..
भोज्यं त्रिमधुरं राम ब्राह्मणाम्̐स्तत्र भोजयेत् .. 16..
text_mt: For all remaining duties, that day is indeed unsuitable. / There, O Rāma, one should feed brahmins food containing the three sweets.

sanskrit_iast:
mahatpūrṇā bhavatyekā paurṇamāsī dvijottama ..
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tasyāṃ sopavāso janārdanam ...37..
meaning:
महत्पूर्णा भवत्येका पौर्णमासी द्विजोत्तम ..
प्रतिसंवत्सरं तस्यां सोपवासो जनार्दनम् ...37..
text_mt: There is one full-moon day called Mahāpūrṇā, O best of the twice-born; / each year, fasting on it and [worshipping] Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pūjayati dharmajña tena saṃvatsaraṃ hari ..
pūjitaḥ paurṇamāsīṣu bhavatīti ha niścayaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
यः पूजयति धर्मज्ञ तेन संवत्सरं हरि ..
पूजितः पौर्णमासीषु भवतीति ह निश्चयः .. 18 ..
text_mt: he who worships, O knower of dharma, by him Hari is worshipped / on all full-moon days throughout the year—this is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ dānaṃ svalpamapi mahadbhavati bhārgava ..
dānaṃ japyaṃ tato homo yaścānyatsukṛtaṃ bhavet .. 39 ..
meaning:
तस्यां दानं स्वल्पमपि महद्भवति भार्गव ..
दानं जप्यं ततो होमो यश्चान्यत्सुकृतं भवेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: A gift on that day, even if very small, becomes immense, O descendant of Bhṛgu: / gifts, recitation of mantras, then oblations, and whatever other good deed there may be.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
saṃvatsare paurṇamāsī mahatpūrvā vṛṣadhvaja ..
kathaṃ jñeyā jagannātha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1.60.20 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
संवत्सरे पौर्णमासी महत्पूर्वा वृषध्वज ..
कथं ज्ञेया जगन्नाथ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1.60.20 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / How is that full-moon day called Mahāpūrvā in a year / to be recognised, O Lord of the universe, O You whose banner bears a bull? Tell me who am asking.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
yasyāṃ pūrṇeṃdunā yogaṃ yāyājjīvo mahābalaḥ ..
paurṇamāsī tu sā jñeyā mahatpūrvā dvijottama .. 21 ..
meaning:
शंकर उवाच ..
यस्यां पूर्णेंदुना योगं यायाज्जीवो महाबलः ..
पौर्णमासी तु सा ज्ञेया महत्पूर्वा द्विजोत्तम .. 21 ..
text_mt: Śaṃkara said: / That on which very powerful Jupiter enters conjunction with the full moon— / that full-moon day is to be known as Mahāpūrvā, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityagrahaṇe rāma grahaṇe vā niśābhṛtaḥ ..
upavāsādavāpnoti sarvakilviṣanāśanam .. 22 ..
meaning:
आदित्यग्रहणे राम ग्रहणे वा निशाभृतः ..
उपवासादवाप्नोति सर्वकिल्विषनाशनम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: During a solar eclipse, O Rāma, or during an eclipse of the moon, / by fasting one attains the destruction of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā japyaṃ cā kṣayyaṃ parikīrttitam ..
śrāddhañca bhārgavaśreṣṭha vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ tathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
स्नानं दानं तथा जप्यं चा क्षय्यं परिकीर्त्तितम् ..
श्राद्धञ्च भार्गवश्रेष्ठ वह्निसंपूजनं तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt: Bathing, giving gifts, and recitation of mantras are declared imperishable, / as are ancestral rites and the worship of fire, O best of the descendants of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
nakṣatraṃ devadeveśa tithiñcātra vinirgatām ..
dṛṣṭvā yathāvatkartavyaṃ tithiṃ śaṅkara jānatā .. 24 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
नक्षत्रं देवदेवेश तिथिञ्चात्र विनिर्गताम् ..
दृष्ट्वा यथावत्कर्तव्यं तिथिं शङ्कर जानता .. 24 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / Seeing the asterism, O Lord of the god of gods, and the lunar day that has departed here, / how should a man who knows the lunar day perform [his duties], O Śaṅkara?

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
sā tithistadahorātraṃ yasyāmevodito raviḥ ..
tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhirna kāraṇam ..25..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
सा तिथिस्तदहोरात्रं यस्यामेवोदितो रविः ..
तया कर्माणि कुर्वीत ह्रासवृद्धिर्न कारणम् ..25..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / That lunar day in which the sun has risen is [the lunar day for] that day and night; / by that day one should perform the rites; decrease or increase is no cause [for change].

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe tithirjñeyā yasyāmabhyudito raviḥ ..
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे तिथिर्ज्ञेया यस्यामभ्युदितो रविः ..
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं येनास्तं याति भास्करः .. 26 ..
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, that lunar day is to be known on which the sun rises; / [and] that lunar mansion is to be observed for fasting under which the sun sets,

sanskrit_iast: yaśca vā yujyate rāma niśīthe śaśinā saha ..27..
meaning: यश्च वा युज्यते राम निशीथे शशिना सह ..27..
text_mt: or that which, O Rāma, is joined with the moon at midnight.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
tasya māyāśarīrasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
prāpnuvanti kathaṃ sthānaṃ nityamakṣayyamavyayam .. 1 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
तस्य मायाशरीरस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ..
प्राप्नुवन्ति कथं स्थानं नित्यमक्षय्यमव्ययम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / How do [men] attain the eternal, imperishable, and immutable abode / of that Viṣṇu of boundless splendour, whose body is māyā?
title: Śaṅkaragītāsvabhigamakālaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
akhaṇḍakāriṇo rāma viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
prāpnuvanti paraṃ sthānaṃ nityamakṣayyamavyayam .. 2 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
अखण्डकारिणो राम विष्णोरमिततेजसः ..
प्राप्नुवन्ति परं स्थानं नित्यमक्षय्यमव्ययम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Those who perform without interruption, O Rāma, attain the supreme, / eternal, imperishable, and immutable abode of Viṣṇu of boundless splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
akhaṇḍakārī bhagavankathaṃ bhavati śaṅkara ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi devadeva vṛṣadhvaja .. 3 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
अखण्डकारी भगवन्कथं भवति शङ्कर ..
एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि देवदेव वृषध्वज .. 3 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / O Lord, how does one become an uninterrupted performer, O Śaṅkara? / Tell me this doubt, O God of gods whose emblem is the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
pañcakālavidhānajñastatkarmakaraṇe rataḥ ..
akhaṇḍakārī bhavati rāma dānavanāśana .. 4 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
पञ्चकालविधानज्ञस्तत्कर्मकरणे रतः ..
अखण्डकारी भवति राम दानवनाशन .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / He who knows the ritual of the five times and is devoted to the performance of its rites / becomes an uninterrupted performer, O Rāma, destroyer of the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
bhagavanpañca ke kālāḥ kathaṃ teṣāṃ tathā vidhiḥ ..
etanme devadeveśa kautūhalamapānuda .. 5 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
भगवन्पञ्च के कालाः कथं तेषां तथा विधिः ..
एतन्मे देवदेवेश कौतूहलमपानुद .. 5 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / O Lord, what are the five times, and how is their rule? / Dispel this curiosity of mine, O God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
rāmābhigamanaṃ pūrvamupādānamataḥ param ..
ijyāsvādhyāyakālau ca yogakālastathaiva ca ..6..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
रामाभिगमनं पूर्वमुपादानमतः परम् ..
इज्यास्वाध्यायकालौ च योगकालस्तथैव च ..6..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / O Rāma, the first is approaching (abhigamana), next to that is gathering materials (upādāna), / and the times of worship (ijyā) and self-study (svādhyāya), and likewise the time of union (yoga).

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ pratyekaśo vakṣye vidhiṃ te bhṛgunandana ..
tannibodha mahābhāga prayatenāntarātmanā .. 7 ..
meaning:
तेषां प्रत्येकशो वक्ष्ये विधिं ते भृगुनन्दन ..
तन्निबोध महाभाग प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना .. 7 ..
text_mt: I shall speak their rule to you individually, O son of Bhṛgu; / understand that, O fortunate one, with a restrained inner self.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma kalye samutthāya dantadhāvanapūrvakam ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
राम कल्ये समुत्थाय दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् ..
स्नानं कृत्वा यथाशास्त्रं स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः .. 8 ..
text_mt: O Rāma, having risen at dawn, preceded by the cleansing of the teeth, / having bathed according to the scriptures, having sipped water properly, highly concentrated,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśceha bhagavanmantraṃ paṭhandevagṛhaṃ viśet ..
pravindyādrāma jānubhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ śirasā tathā .. 9 ..
meaning:
यश्चेह भगवन्मन्त्रं पठन्देवगृहं विशेत् ..
प्रविन्द्याद्राम जानुभ्यां पाणिभ्यां शिरसा तथा .. 9 ..
text_mt: and reciting the mantra of the Lord here, one should enter the house of the deity; / one should bow, O Rāma, with both knees, both hands, and the head.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkāraṃ sanamaskāraṃ prayujya susamāhitaḥ ..
yogakālaṃ tu sandadhyādupādadhyādanantaram..1.61.10..
meaning:
ओंकारं सनमस्कारं प्रयुज्य सुसमाहितः ..
योगकालं तु सन्दध्यादुपादध्यादनन्तरम्..1.61.10..
text_mt: Having applied the syllable Om together with obeisance, highly concentrated, / one should contemplate the time of union, and then take up [the ritual].

sanskrit_iast:
rāmābhigamakālaṃ tu tatra mantraṃ tathārpayet..
bhagavato baleneti vīryeṇaitena tejasā..11..
meaning:
रामाभिगमकालं तु तत्र मन्त्रं तथार्पयेत्..
भगवतो बलेनेति वीर्येणैतेन तेजसा..11..
text_mt: At the time of approaching, O Rāma, one should offer the mantra there: / 'By the power, by this valour, by the splendour of the Lord.'

sanskrit_iast:
suprakīrtitatoyena vediṃ prakṣālayedbudhaḥ ..
sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ tāmrīṃ mṛnmayīmāyasīṃ tathā..12..
meaning:
सुप्रकीर्तिततोयेन वेदिं प्रक्षालयेद्बुधः ..
सौवर्णीं राजतीं ताम्रीं मृन्मयीमायसीं तथा..12..
text_mt: The wise man should wash the altar with well-renowned water, / [an altar] made of gold, silver, copper, clay, or iron,

sanskrit_iast:
śilāṃ candanajāṃ vāpi devadārubhavāmathā.
śiṃśapākṣoṭasaralakadambārjunajāmathā. ..13..
meaning:
शिलां चन्दनजां वापि देवदारुभवामथा.
शिंशपाक्षोटसरलकदम्बार्जुनजामथा. ..13..
text_mt: or stone, or made of sandalwood, or made of deodar, / or made of śiṃśapā, walnut, sarala, kadamba, or arjuna;

sanskrit_iast:
sālvāśvakarṇajāṃ rāma tvāyāmena tathaiva ca ..
vāmapravāṇāṃ prakṣālya pūrṇakumbhānnavāṃstataḥ..14..
meaning:
साल्वाश्वकर्णजां राम त्वायामेन तथैव च ..
वामप्रवाणां प्रक्षाल्य पूर्णकुम्भान्नवांस्ततः..14..
text_mt: or made of sāl or aśvakarṇa, O Rāma, in the same dimension; / having washed [it] sloping to the left, [he should place] fresh full water-pots.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpanīyāstu kalaśāścatvāro bhṛgunandana..
sauvarṇā rājatāstāmrā athavāpi ha rītijāḥ..15..
meaning:
कल्पनीयास्तु कलशाश्चत्वारो भृगुनन्दन..
सौवर्णा राजतास्ताम्रा अथवापि ह रीतिजाः..15..
text_mt: Four jars are to be prepared, O son of Bhṛgu: / made of gold, silver, copper, or indeed of brass.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca tvarghyaṃ snānīyameva ca ..
pādyātpādyaṃ tu dātavyaṃ snānīyātsnānameva ca..16..
meaning:
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च त्वर्घ्यं स्नानीयमेव च ..
पाद्यात्पाद्यं तु दातव्यं स्नानीयात्स्नानमेव च..16..
text_mt: Water for the feet, water for sipping, water of honour, and bath water: / water for the feet is to be given from the foot-vessel, and the bath itself from the bath-vessel;

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyācamanīyākhyāddeyamācamanaṃ bhavet ..
dānaṃ praṇayanaṃ prītirvisargaṃ vistaraṃ tathā ..17..
meaning:
तथाप्याचमनीयाख्याद्देयमाचमनं भवेत् ..
दानं प्रणयनं प्रीतिर्विसर्गं विस्तरं तथा ..17..
text_mt: likewise water for sipping must be given from that named the sipping-vessel. / Giving, bringing near, delight, dismissal, and spreading out,

sanskrit_iast:
tarpaṇaṃ cārhaṇaṃ caiva tvarghyādetāni kārayet ..
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ tato japtvā samāhitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
तर्पणं चार्हणं चैव त्वर्घ्यादेतानि कारयेत् ..
द्वादशाक्षरकं मन्त्रं ततो जप्त्वा समाहितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: satiation and honoring—one should perform these through the water of honour. / Then, having muttered the twelve-syllable mantra with concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pavitramantreṇa vedimabhyukṣayeddvija ..
ātmānaṃ ca tathā bhogānkuryānmārgatrayaṃ tataḥ..19..
meaning:
ततः पवित्रमन्त्रेण वेदिमभ्युक्षयेद्द्विज ..
आत्मानं च तथा भोगान्कुर्यान्मार्गत्रयं ततः..19..
text_mt: the twice-born should then sprinkle the altar with the purifying mantra, / and [sprinkle] himself and the offerings, and then make the three paths:

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā jñānaṃ tataḥ karma brahmacakraṃ tathaiva ca ..
mārgatrayañca kartavyaṃ nāmārghyakalaśānsadā .. 1.61.20 ..
meaning:
विद्या ज्ञानं ततः कर्म ब्रह्मचक्रं तथैव च ..
मार्गत्रयञ्च कर्तव्यं नामार्घ्यकलशान्सदा .. 1.61.20 ..
text_mt: knowledge (vidyā), gnosis (jñāna), and then action (karma), and likewise the wheel of Brahmā. / And the three paths should always be made: the jars of the water of honour with their names,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇimārgaṃ kūrcamārgaṃ madhumārgaṃ tathaiva ca ..
uśīramūlajaṃ kūrcaṃ jīva nnopālasambhavam ..21..
meaning:
पाणिमार्गं कूर्चमार्गं मधुमार्गं तथैव च ..
उशीरमूलजं कूर्चं जीव न्नोपालसम्भवम् ..21..
text_mt: the hand-path, the brush-path, and likewise the honey-path. / The brush is made from the root of uśīra, or arising from jīvannopāla;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvaśca maraṇaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana ..
pratisnānaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ samānānāṃ kramādbhavet..22..
meaning:
जीवश्च मरणं चापि कर्तव्यं भृगुनन्दन ..
प्रतिस्नानं ततः कार्यं समानानां क्रमाद्भवेत्..22..
text_mt: living and dying are also to be performed, O son of Bhṛgu. / Then reciprocal bathing is to be done, which should be in sequence for identical [vessels].

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva pādapīṭhānāṃ prabhāvena mahābhujaḥ ..
āsanānyatha kāryāṇi ratnacitrāṇi bhārgava .. 23 ..
meaning:
तथैव पादपीठानां प्रभावेन महाभुजः ..
आसनान्यथ कार्याणि रत्नचित्राणि भार्गव .. 23 ..
text_mt: Likewise, by the power of the footstools, O mighty-armed one, / seats should then be made, adorned with varied gems, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:

भूयस्त्वाचमनं देयं तर्पणं चाप्यन्न्तरम् .. 1.61.30..

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ dīpamalaṅkāraṃ dhūpaprakarameva ca .

पुष्पं दीपमलङ्कारं धूपप्रकरमेव च .

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyalābhe payaḥ kāryaṃ madhvalābhe tathā guḍam ..

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṇaṃ tu tato dadyāttato nirbhartsanaṃ budhaḥ ..
tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ ..39..
meaning:
दर्पणं तु ततो दद्यात्ततो निर्भर्त्सनं बुधः ..
ततस्त्वाचमनीयं च विधिवत्सुसमाहितः ..39..
text_mt: The wise man should then give a mirror, then a threatening [gesture/substance]; / then water for sipping, according to rule, highly concentrated.

ततोऽग्निशरणं गत्वा वह्निं संतर्पदेद्बुधः ..
ब्राह्मणानां यथाशक्ति दानं दद्यादनन्तरम् .. 1.61.40..

sanskrit_iast: etanmayā te kathitaṃ samagraṃ yathānupūrvyābhigamasya kālam .. gacchedupādānakṛtaprayatnastato yathāvadbhṛguvaṃśacandra .. 41 ..
meaning: एतन्मया ते कथितं समग्रं यथानुपूर्व्याभिगमस्य कालम् .. गच्छेदुपादानकृतप्रयत्नस्ततो यथावद्भृगुवंशचन्द्र .. 41 ..

sanskrit_iast:

udakaṃ cārcanīyaṃ syāttasminnahani bhārgav .. 3 ..

text_mt: of seeds to be cooked, O Rāma, and of animals properly prepared, / and of vegetables and side-dishes procured on the preceding day,

deśe śucau suprayātā susahāyaguṇānvitā .. 6 ..
meaning:

text_mt: should always prepare what she is able with fire and by cooking; / in a clean place, very attentive, accompanied by virtuous helpers,

bhūmāvanupaliptāyāṃ sthāpyaṃ rāma na kiñcana ..7..

sanskrit_iast:

सर्वं साध्यमथान्नाद्यं गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् ..
नित्यं परिपचेद्राम नास्वाद्यं केनचित् क्वचित् ..8..

meaning:
सुप्रक्षाल्य तथा भागं पवित्रेण समुत्क्षिपेत् ..

प्रविश्य देवतावेश्म प्राग्वद्भृगुकुलोद्वह .. 11 ..

upādānānusaṃdhānaṃ tvādānaṃ cāpyanantaram .. 12 ..

उपादानानुसंधानं त्वादानं चाप्यनन्तरम् .. 12 ..

क्रोधं नियम्यात्महिते निविष्टस्तद्भावभावोपहितश्च नित्यम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having the offerings ready, restrained in his inner self, he should then perform worship, O you of fierce speed in battle, / restraining anger, intent on his own welfare, and constantly absorbed in devotion to Him.

तैलमुद्वर्तनं चैव चमसीं चाप्यनन्तरम् .. 2 ..

śubhānāṃ tīrthasaritāṃ rāma puṇyajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ.. ..7..
meaning:
पुष्पगन्धयुता राम पवित्रेण पवित्रिताः ..
शुभानां तीर्थसरितां राम पुण्यजलैः शुभैः.. ..7..
text_mt: supplied with flowers and scents, O Rāma, purified with a strainer, / [filled] with the auspicious holy waters of sacred rivers, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvibhavatasteṣāṃ bahutvamapi kārayet ..
tasminkāle tathā kārye kṣveḍitotkṛṣṭaniḥsvanam ..8..
meaning:
यथाविभवतस्तेषां बहुत्वमपि कारयेत् ..
तस्मिन्काले तथा कार्ये क्ष्वेडितोत्कृष्टनिःस्वनम् ..8..
text_mt: According to his means, he may also provide many of them; / at that time and in that rite, loud cheers and shouting,

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśabdaṃ ca vipulaṃ śaṅkhabherīvimiśritam..
udakagrahaṇārthīya tato dadyācca śāṭakam .. 9 ..
meaning:
जयशब्दं च विपुलं शङ्खभेरीविमिश्रितम्..
उदकग्रहणार्थीय ततो दद्याच्च शाटकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: and great cries of victory mixed with the sound of conches and kettledrums [should be made]; / then he should present a cloth for absorbing the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rāma pradātavyaṃ dhautavāsāyugaṃ śubham ..
tatastu pūrṇakalaśamāsanānāṃ pradakṣiṇam ..1.63.1 0..
meaning:
ततो राम प्रदातव्यं धौतवासायुगं शुभम् ..
ततस्तु पूर्णकलशमासनानां प्रदक्षिणम् ..1.63.1 0..
text_mt: Then, O Rāma, a pair of auspicious clean garments must be given; / then, having carried a full pitcher circumambulating the seats from left to right,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā rāma kṣipedvedyāṃ puṣpapallavaśobhitam..
tatastvācamanīyaṃ ca pūrvavadvinivedayet..11..
meaning:
कृत्वा राम क्षिपेद्वेद्यां पुष्पपल्लवशोभितम्..
ततस्त्वाचमनीयं च पूर्ववद्विनिवेदयेत्..11..
text_mt: adorned with flowers and sprouts, O Rāma, he should place it upon the altar; / then he should offer water for sipping as before.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalāni ca mukhyāni tato dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
satyāsanasthaṃ deveśamarcayiṣyāmyataḥ param .. 12 ..
meaning:
मङ्गलानि च मुख्यानि ततो दद्याद्विचक्षणः ..
सत्यासनस्थं देवेशमर्चयिष्याम्यतः परम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Then the wise man should offer the principal auspicious items: / "Henceforth I will worship the Lord of the gods seated on the true seat;

sanskrit_iast:
snānāsanāni tyajyantāmityevaṃ parikīrtayet ..
mārgatrayādathārabhya pādapīṭhāntakaṃ punaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्नानासनानि त्यज्यन्तामित्येवं परिकीर्तयेत् ..
मार्गत्रयादथारभ्य पादपीठान्तकं पुनः .. 13 ..
text_mt: let the bathing seats be removed"—thus he should proclaim; / then, beginning from the three paths up to the footstool again,

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ sakalaṃ karma tvāvāhanavisarjanam ..
tato'nulepanaṃ dadyādvyajanena ca vījayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यं सकलं कर्म त्वावाहनविसर्जनम् ..
ततोऽनुलेपनं दद्याद्व्यजनेन च वीजयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: the entire rite, with invocation and dismissal, should be performed; / then he should apply unguent and fan Him with a fan.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca vīṭakaṃ dadyāttathā kūrcaprasādanam ..
vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ caiva puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
ततश्च वीटकं दद्यात्तथा कूर्चप्रसादनम् ..
वस्त्रं विभूषणं चैव पुष्पाणि विविधानि च .. 15 ..
text_mt: Then he should offer betel, and a comb for the beard, / garments, ornaments, and various kinds of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭanaṃ ca srajaṃ caiva kaṅkaṇaṃ ca manoharam ..
tathā ramyaṃ pratisaraṃ supiṣṭaṃ ca tathāñjanam .. 16 ..
meaning:
वेष्टनं च स्रजं चैव कङ्कणं च मनोहरम् ..
तथा रम्यं प्रतिसरं सुपिष्टं च तथाञ्जनम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: a turban, a garland, and a charming bracelet, / and an attractive protective amulet-thread, and finely ground collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
darpaṇaṃ copacāraṃ ca pradīpaṃ dhūpameva ca ..
tathaivācamanīyaṃ ca gītavādyasvaraṃ tathā .. 17..
meaning:
दर्पणं चोपचारं च प्रदीपं धूपमेव च ..
तथैवाचमनीयं च गीतवाद्यस्वरं तथा .. 17..
text_mt: a mirror, respectful service, a lamp, and incense, / and likewise water for sipping, and the sound of vocal and instrumental music,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāhajayaśabdaṃ ca stotrodīraṇameva ca ..
tathaivopānahau deye chatraṃ cāmarameva ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
पुण्याहजयशब्दं च स्तोत्रोदीरणमेव च ..
तथैवोपानहौ देये छत्रं चामरमेव च .. 18 ..
text_mt: declarations of an auspicious day, cries of victory, and the recitation of hymns; / likewise two sandals should be given, an umbrella, and a flywhisk,

sanskrit_iast:
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ caiva patākāśca dhvajāni ca ..
bhogānāṃ pūraṇārthīyāṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
यानं च वाहनं चैव पताकाश्च ध्वजानि च ..
भोगानां पूरणार्थीयां ततो मात्रां निवेदयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: a carriage, a mount, banners, and flags; / then he should present a measuring portion to supply all offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogānāṃ sarjanaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktayā dvijottama ..
avidyamānā ye bhogā mātrāsveva prakalpayet .. 1.63.20 ..
meaning:
भोगानां सर्जनं कृत्वा यथाशक्तया द्विजोत्तम ..
अविद्यमाना ये भोगा मात्रास्वेव प्रकल्पयेत् .. 1.63.20 ..
text_mt: Having produced offerings according to his ability, O best of the twice-born, / whatever offerings are not available he should mentally project into the measuring portions.

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ sarvabhogaissamāhitaḥ ..
arcayenmadhuparkeṇa paśuyāgo na cedbhavet .. 21 ..
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्च्य देवेशं सर्वभोगैस्समाहितः ..
अर्चयेन्मधुपर्केण पशुयागो न चेद्भवेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the Lord of the gods with all offerings, concentrated, / he should worship Him with honey-mixture if there is no animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
paśuyāgābhigamane madhuparko vidhīyate ..
abhyarcya madhuparkeṇa tatastvanyena pūjayet .. 22 ..|
meaning:
पशुयागाभिगमने मधुपर्को विधीयते ..
अभ्यर्च्य मधुपर्केण ततस्त्वन्येन पूजयेत् .. 22 ..|
text_mt: If approaching with an animal sacrifice, the honey-mixture is prescribed; / having worshipped with the honey-mixture, he should then worship with other things.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāsanānyapīcchanti kecidapyaparāṇi tu ..
ādau sthālīṃ ca tenātha pradadyādarhaṇīṃ tataḥ .. 23..
meaning:
अत्रासनान्यपीच्छन्ति केचिदप्यपराणि तु ..
आदौ स्थालीं च तेनाथ प्रदद्यादर्हणीं ततः .. 23..
text_mt: Here, some desire other seats as well; / first the vessel, and with that he should then present the offering of hospitality.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ haritakopetaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vyañjanasaṃyutam ..
nivedya darpaṇaṃ dadyāttathā niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
अन्नं हरितकोपेतं भक्ष्यं व्यञ्जनसंयुतम् ..
निवेद्य दर्पणं दद्यात्तथा निष्पुंसनं ततः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Food accompanied by fresh greens, edible delicacies along with side-dishes; / having offered them, he should present a mirror and then a wiping cloth;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā hyācamanīyaṃ tu mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram ..
tatastu saṃvibhāgārthaṃ dātavyaṃ tvarhaṇaṃ tataḥ 9..
meaning:
कृत्वा ह्याचमनीयं तु मात्रां च तदनन्तरम् ..
ततस्तु संविभागार्थं दातव्यं त्वर्हणं ततः 9..
text_mt: having then provided water for sipping, and immediately thereafter a measuring portion; / then, for the sake of distribution, the offering of hospitality should be presented.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo nivedayedannaṃ pūrvavatsusamāhitaḥ ..
darpaṇaṃ ca tato dadyātpādyaṃ niṣpuṃsanaṃ tataḥ .. 26 ...
meaning:
भूयो निवेदयेदन्नं पूर्ववत्सुसमाहितः ..
दर्पणं च ततो दद्यात्पाद्यं निष्पुंसनं ततः .. 26 ...
text_mt: He should again offer food as before, well-concentrated; / then he should present a mirror, water for washing the feet, and then a wiping cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā cācamanīyaṃ ca śāṭakaṃ ca nivedayet ..
hastaniṣpuṃsanārthāya mātrāṃ ca tadanantaram .. 27..
meaning:
दत्त्वा चाचमनीयं च शाटकं च निवेदयेत् ..
हस्तनिष्पुंसनार्थाय मात्रां च तदनन्तरम् .. 27..
text_mt: Having given water for sipping, he should present a cloth / for the sake of wiping the hands, and immediately thereafter a measuring portion.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedya paścāttāmbūlaṃ devaṃ vahnau samarcayet ..
vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā kāryakārisamarpaṇam .. 28 ..
meaning:
निवेद्य पश्चात्ताम्बूलं देवं वह्नौ समर्चयेत् ..
वह्निसंपूजनं कृत्वा कार्यकारिसमर्पणम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Having presented betel afterwards, he should worship the God in the fire; / having performed the worship in the fire, he should present [the food] to the servants.

sanskrit_iast:
atithīnāṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhartavyānāṃ ca bhārgava ..
tato'nuyāgakāle tu pavitreṇa samutkṣipet .. 29 ..
meaning:
अतिथीनां ततः कार्यं भर्तव्यानां च भार्गव ..
ततोऽनुयागकाले तु पवित्रेण समुत्क्षिपेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then, O descendant of Bhṛgu, [the feeding] of guests and dependents must be performed; / then, at the time of the follow-up sacrifice, he should lift it up with a strainer.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva sānnaṃ prayatamānasaḥ ..
upaviśya tataḥ paścātprabhavenāpyayena ca .. 1.63.30 ..
meaning:
आसनं भाजनं चैव सान्नं प्रयतमानसः ..
उपविश्य ततः पश्चात्प्रभवेनाप्ययेन च .. 1.63.30 ..
text_mt: With an attentive mind, [he should offer] a seat and a vessel with food. / Then, having sat down, through [the contemplation of] emergence and dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
idamagnetimantreṇa prācyāṃ grāsāṣṭakaṃ bhavet ..
tatastu prayato bhūtvā viśeddevagṛhaṃ tataḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
इदमग्नेतिमन्त्रेण प्राच्यां ग्रासाष्टकं भवेत् ..
ततस्तु प्रयतो भूत्वा विशेद्देवगृहं ततः .. 31 ..
text_mt: with the mantra beginning 'idam agne', eight mouthfuls should be offered toward the east. / Thereupon, having become purified, he should then enter the house of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ijyākālānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ..
kuryātsvanyāyakālasya copādānamanantaram .. 32 ..
meaning:
इज्याकालानुसंधानं ततः कुर्यात्समाहितः ..
कुर्यात्स्वन्यायकालस्य चोपादानमनन्तरम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Then, collected in mind, he should undertake the contemplation for the time of worship (ijyākāla). / Immediately afterwards he should undertake his own appropriate period [of practice].

sanskrit_iast:
visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprayatenāntarātmanā ..
ijyākālavidhistveṣa mayā te rāma kīrtitaḥ .. 33..
meaning:
विसर्जनं ततः कुर्यात्प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना ..
इज्याकालविधिस्त्वेष मया ते राम कीर्तितः .. 33..
text_mt: Then, with a restrained inner self, he should perform the dismissal. / Thus, O Rāma, has the rule for the time of worship been proclaimed to you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānvāsudevastu devassaṃkarṣaṇastataḥ ..
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca prabhāvo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ..34 ..
meaning:
भगवान्वासुदेवस्तु देवस्संकर्षणस्ततः ..
प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धश्च प्रभावोऽयमुदाहृतः ..34 ..
text_mt: The Lord is Vāsudeva, and next the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, / Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; this manifestation has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkarṣaṇastathāvyakta ātmā pradyumna ucyate ..
devastattvagatassarvaṃ aniruddho mahāyaśāḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
संकर्षणस्तथाव्यक्त आत्मा प्रद्युम्न उच्यते ..
देवस्तत्त्वगतस्सर्वं अनिरुद्धो महायशाः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Saṃkarṣaṇa is unmanifest, and the self is called Pradyumna; / the deity Aniruddha, endowed with great renown, pervades all principles.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nāthassarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ..
(puruṣo'pi tathā satya acyutaśca dvijottama .. 36..
meaning:
स नाथस्सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिसंहारकारकः..
(पुरुषोऽपि तथा सत्य अच्युतश्च द्विजोत्तम .. 36..
text_mt: He is the lord of all worlds, the cause of creation and destruction. / (Likewise, the Cosmic Person, Satya, and Acyuta, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānvāsudevaśca tvavyayo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ..
catvāra ete dharmajña vāsudevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..37..
meaning:
भगवान्वासुदेवश्च त्वव्ययोऽयमुदाहृतः ..
चत्वार एते धर्मज्ञ वासुदेवाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..37..
text_mt: and the Lord Vāsudeva—this imperishable one is declared. / These four, O knower of dharma, are proclaimed as Vāsudevas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavacchabdavācyāśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavāḥ ..
yaḥ paraḥ puruṣo rāma vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
भगवच्छब्दवाच्याश्च सर्वभूतभवोद्भवाः ..
यः परः पुरुषो राम वासुदेवः प्रकीर्तितः .. 38 ..
text_mt: denoted by the word 'Lord', the source of the coming into being of all beings. / The supreme Cosmic Person who has been proclaimed as Vāsudeva, O Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavacchabdavācyaśca sarvabhūtabhavodbhavaḥ ..
śeṣatattvaṃ gataḥ sarvamaniruddho mahāyaśāḥ .. 39 ...
meaning:
भगवच्छब्दवाच्यश्च सर्वभूतभवोद्भवः ..
शेषतत्त्वं गतः सर्वमनिरुद्धो महायशाः .. 39 ...
text_mt: denoted by the word 'Lord', the source of the coming into being of all beings, / the illustrious Aniruddha, has pervaded all the ultimate reality of Śeṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nāthaḥ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇaḥ .. )
tadetatpaṭhyate sūkte pauruṣe dvijasattama .. 1.63.40 ..
meaning:
स नाथः सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिसंहारकारणः .. )
तदेतत्पठ्यते सूक्ते पौरुषे द्विजसत्तम .. 1.63.40 ..
text_mt: He is the lord of all worlds, the cause of creation and destruction.) / This very thing is recited in the Hymn to the Cosmic Person (Puruṣasūkta), O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ..
bhujiḥ prītistathaivārciḥ prāṇastarpaṇamarhaṇam .. 41 ..
meaning:
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ..
भुजिः प्रीतिस्तथैवार्चिः प्राणस्तर्पणमर्हणम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: 'A quarter of him is all beings; three-quarters of him are the immortal in heaven.' / Eating, affection, and likewise radiance, breath, satisfying, worship,

sanskrit_iast:
nivedanañcācamanamaṣṭadhā mantranirṇayaḥ ..
mantreṇa cārhaṇāntena pradadyādarhaṇaṃ punaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
निवेदनञ्चाचमनमष्टधा मन्त्रनिर्णयः ..
मन्त्रेण चार्हणान्तेन प्रदद्यादर्हणं पुनः .. 42 ..
text_mt: presentation of offerings, and sipping of water—eightfold is the determination of mantras. / With the mantra ending in 'arhaṇa' he should once again present the offering of honor;

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivācamanāntena deyamācamanaṃ bhavet ..
prāśanāntena mantreṇa tarpaṇaṃ vinivedayet .. 43 ..
meaning:
तथैवाचमनान्तेन देयमाचमनं भवेत् ..
प्राशनान्तेन मन्त्रेण तर्पणं विनिवेदयेत् .. 43 ..
text_mt: likewise with the one ending in 'ācamana', water for sipping is to be given. / With the mantra ending in 'prāśana' he should offer satisfying water.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigraheṣu mātrāsu pādukāsu ca darpaṇe ..
chatre ca vālavyajane tālavṛnte tathaiva ca .. 44 ..
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहेषु मात्रासु पादुकासु च दर्पणे ..
छत्रे च वालव्यजने तालवृन्ते तथैव च .. 44 ..
text_mt: In spittoons, measuring vessels, wooden sandals, and mirrors, / in umbrellas, yak-tail whisks, and palm fans as well,

sanskrit_iast:
upānatsu tathā yāne vāhaneṣu bhṛgūttama ..
abdhidhvajeṣu ca tathā patākāsu ca kīrtitāḥ ..45..
meaning:
उपानत्सु तथा याने वाहनेषु भृगूत्तम ..
अब्धिध्वजेषु च तथा पताकासु च कीर्तिताः ..45..
text_mt: in leather shoes, likewise in litters and vehicles, O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / and so also in ocean-standard banners and flags, they are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāṇāṃ kāmabhogānāṃ nityaṃ saṃkīrtayettu vai ..
sarvatraprīṇanaṃ kāryametāvānmantranirṇayaḥ ..46..
meaning:
शेषाणां कामभोगानां नित्यं संकीर्तयेत्तु वै ..
सर्वत्रप्रीणनं कार्यमेतावान्मन्त्रनिर्णयः ..46..
text_mt: He should constantly recite [the mantras] of the remaining objects of sensory pleasure; / pleasing is to be performed everywhere; so great is the determination of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ pādapīṭhānāṃ kalaśānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
vahnestathāsanānāṃ ca catuṣṭvaṃ vinivartate .. 47 ..
meaning:
देवानां पादपीठानां कलशानां तथैव च ..
वह्नेस्तथासनानां च चतुष्ट्वं विनिवर्तते .. 47 ..
text_mt: Of deities, footstools, and water-jars as well, / and of fire, and seats, the group of four ceases.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśāsanavahnīnāṃ saṃkaraṃ tu na kārayet ..
tathaiva padapīṭhānāṃ teṣāṃ cihnaṃ ca kārayet .. 48 ..
meaning:
कलशासनवह्नीनां संकरं तु न कारयेत् ..
तथैव पदपीठानां तेषां चिह्नं च कारयेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: One should not cause an intermixture of water-jars, seats, and fires, / nor likewise of footstools; one should make an identifying mark for them.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpaṇe madhuparke ca mātrāsu ca bhṛgūttama ..
sumanastu sadā rāma yatnaḥ kāryaḥ samarcane .. 49 ..
meaning:
प्रापणे मधुपर्के च मात्रासु च भृगूत्तम ..
सुमनस्तु सदा राम यत्नः कार्यः समर्चने .. 49 ..
text_mt: In fetching, in the honey-mixture, and in measuring vessels, O foremost of the Bhṛgus, / an effort should always be made with flowers (sumanas) during worship, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
saumanasyaṃ paraṃ rāma devadeve niveditam ..
yasmāttu vartate tasmātproktāḥ sumanasaḥ sadā .. 1.63.50 ..
meaning:
सौमनस्यं परं राम देवदेवे निवेदितम् ..
यस्मात्तु वर्तते तस्मात्प्रोक्ताः सुमनसः सदा .. 1.63.50 ..
text_mt: Because supreme well-mindedness (saumanasya) offered to the God of gods / is present, therefore they are always called flowers (sumanas).

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ trāsyati bhayādghorāttasmānmātrā prakīrtitā ..
prāpayiṣyati ca sthāne nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjite .. 51 ..
meaning:
मां त्रास्यति भयाद्घोरात्तस्मान्मात्रा प्रकीर्तिता ..
प्रापयिष्यति च स्थाने नित्यं दुःखविवर्जिते .. 51 ..
text_mt: 'It will protect me from terrible fear'—therefore it is proclaimed as a measuring vessel (mātrā); / and 'it will cause [one] to reach a state perpetually devoid of sorrow,'

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttasmāddvijaśreṣṭha proktaṃ prāpaṇakaṃ sadā ..
paramaṃ yatparaṃ rāma madhusaṃjñaṃ taducyate .. 52 ..
meaning:
यस्मात्तस्माद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रोक्तं प्रापणकं सदा ..
परमं यत्परं राम मधुसंज्ञं तदुच्यते .. 52 ..
text_mt: for which reason, O best of the twice-born, it is always called fetching (prāpaṇaka). / That which is highest and supreme, O Rāma, is called honey (madhu);

sanskrit_iast:
tadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkastadā smṛtaḥ ..
ijyāvidhāno'yamudīritaste samāsato bhārgavavaṃśacandra ..
ataḥ paraṃ rāma nibodha puṇyaṃ svādhyāyakāle gadato mamādya .. 53 ..
meaning:
तदाप्यते यदा तेन मधुपर्कस्तदा स्मृतः ..
इज्याविधानोऽयमुदीरितस्ते समासतो भार्गववंशचन्द्र ..
अतः परं राम निबोध पुण्यं स्वाध्यायकाले गदतो ममाद्य .. 53 ..
text_mt: since it is obtained by that, it is therefore remembered as the honey-mixture (madhuparka). / This procedure for worship has been declared to you in brief, O moon of the Bhṛgu lineage; / hereafter, understand the meritorious [procedure] during the time of self-study, as I tell it today, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
.. śaṅkara uvāca .. ..
ādau deśe tathā rāma prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
svādhyāyenārcayeddevaṃ prayatenāntarātmanā .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. शङ्कर उवाच .. ..
आदौ देशे तथा राम प्रयतः सुसमाहितः ..
स्वाध्यायेनार्चयेद्देवं प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना .. 1 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / First in that place, O Rāma, purified and very composed, / with a restrained inner self, one should worship the deity through self-study (svādhyāya).
title: Svādhyāyakālakathanam

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatkāryaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha svādhyāyaṃ vidhivatsadā ..
yāvadastaṃ gato rāma savitā dīptadīdhitiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
तावत्कार्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठ स्वाध्यायं विधिवत्सदा ..
यावदस्तं गतो राम सविता दीप्तदीधितिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Self-study is always to be performed according to rule, O best of the twice-born, / until the sun of blazing rays has set, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvastaṃ gate sūrye svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
praviśya devatāveśma nairājyaṃ karma kārayet .. 3 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्वस्तं गते सूर्ये स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः ..
प्रविश्य देवतावेश्म नैराज्यं कर्म कारयेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Then, when the sun has set, having sipped water and being well-composed, / having entered the shrine of the deity, he should have the waving of lights (nīrājana) performed.

sanskrit_iast:
pādapīṭhāntakaṃ karma kṛtvā prāguktamañjasā ..
arghyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā pādyaṃ ca bhārgava .. 4 ..
meaning:
पादपीठान्तकं कर्म कृत्वा प्रागुक्तमञ्जसा ..
अर्घ्यमाचमनीयं च दत्त्वा पाद्यं च भार्गव .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having quickly performed the rite ending with the footstool, as stated previously, / and having given water for hospitality, water for sipping, and water for the feet, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
sthālīmaklinnanaivedyādārabhyābhihitaṃ tataḥ ..
kartavyamanuyāgāntaṃ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
स्थालीमक्लिन्ननैवेद्यादारभ्याभिहितं ततः ..
कर्तव्यमनुयागान्तं प्रयतः सुसमाहितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: beginning from the pot of unmoistened food-offering, what was stated thereafter / is to be performed up to the follow-up worship, pure and well-composed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvānuyāgaṃ vidhivatpraviśya suramandiram ..
svādhyāyasyānusaṃdhānaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
कृत्वानुयागं विधिवत्प्रविश्य सुरमन्दिरम् ..
स्वाध्यायस्यानुसंधानं ततः कुर्यात्समाहितः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having performed the follow-up worship according to rule and entered the temple of the gods, / collected in mind, he should then undertake the practice of self-study.

sanskrit_iast:
yogakālamupādāya paścātkuryādvisarjanam ..
kṛtvā visarjanaṃ yuktastiṣṭhedyāmamatandritaḥ ..7 ..
meaning:
योगकालमुपादाय पश्चात्कुर्याद्विसर्जनम् ..
कृत्वा विसर्जनं युक्तस्तिष्ठेद्याममतन्द्रितः ..7 ..
text_mt: Having taken up the time for yoga, he should afterwards perform the dismissal. / Having performed the dismissal, concentrated, he should remain vigilant for a watch [of the night].

sanskrit_iast:
yogādanantaraṃ svapyādevaṃ yuktasya bhārgava..
svayaṃ kālo'pi satataṃ yogamadhye'bhidhīyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
योगादनन्तरं स्वप्यादेवं युक्तस्य भार्गव..
स्वयं कालोऽपि सततं योगमध्येऽभिधीयते .. 8 ..
text_mt: After yoga, he should sleep; for one who is thus concentrated, O Bhārgava, / his very period [of sleep] is also perpetually counted as within yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
snānārhakatvaṃ yadi nāsti tasya yāme vibuddhastu tathā caturthe ..
yuñjīta yogaṃ ripukālabhūtaṃ yogena buddhiḥ samupaiti sargam ..9..
meaning:
स्नानार्हकत्वं यदि नास्ति तस्य यामे विबुद्धस्तु तथा चतुर्थे ..
युञ्जीत योगं रिपुकालभूतं योगेन बुद्धिः समुपैति सर्गम् ..9..
text_mt: If he does not have fitness for bathing, having awakened in the fourth watch [of the night], / he should apply himself to yoga, which has become the destroyer of enemies; through yoga the intellect attains creation.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
jānutulyaṃ mṛduśubhaṃ cailājinakuśottaram ..
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ .. 1..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
जानुतुल्यं मृदुशुभं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ..
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः .. 1..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Knee-high, soft, auspicious, covered with cloth, deerskin, and kuśa grass, / establishing his own firm seat in a pure place,
title: adhyāyaḥ 065

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmāsanānāṃ ca baddhvā tatraikamāsanam ..
yogaṃ yuñjīta vidhivadyathāvadunupūrvaśaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
चतुर्णामासनानां च बद्ध्वा तत्रैकमासनम् ..
योगं युञ्जीत विधिवद्यथावदुनुपूर्वशः .. 2 ..
text_mt: and assuming one posture out of the four postures there, / he should practice yoga according to rule, properly and in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ..
yogāsanāni catvāri bhagavankāni brūhi me ..
yeṣāmekamathāsthāya yogaṃ yuñjīta mānavaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ..
योगासनानि चत्वारि भगवन्कानि ब्रूहि मे ..
येषामेकमथास्थाय योगं युञ्जीत मानवः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / O Lord, tell me what are the four yoga postures, / assuming one of which a man should practice yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
svastikaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ paryaṅkaṃ kamalāsanam ..
yogāsanāni catvāri teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam .. 4 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
स्वस्तिकं सर्वतोभद्रं पर्यङ्कं कमलासनम् ..
योगासनानि चत्वारि तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Svastika, sarvatobhadra, paryaṅka, and kamalāsana— / these are the four yoga postures; I shall declare their characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanne jānunī kṛtvā yathāvatsusamāhitaḥ ..
vāmaṃ kṛtvetare pāde vāmajaṅghorupīḍitam .. 5..
meaning:
आसन्ने जानुनी कृत्वा यथावत्सुसमाहितः ..
वामं कृत्वेतरे पादे वामजङ्घोरुपीडितम् .. 5..
text_mt: Having brought the two knees close, properly and well-composed, / placing the left [foot] on the other foot, pressed between the left shank and thigh,

sanskrit_iast:
svastikaṃ nāma tatproktamāsanaṃ prathamaṃ śubham ..
ūrū ca jānunī jaṅghe yatrāsanagataḥ samam ..6..
meaning:
स्वस्तिकं नाम तत्प्रोक्तमासनं प्रथमं शुभम् ..
ऊरू च जानुनी जङ्घे यत्रासनगतः समम् ..6..
text_mt: that is proclaimed as the first auspicious posture, named svastika. / Where the two thighs, the two knees, and the two shanks, seated on the posture, are level,

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ tadviddhi manujottama ..
paryaṅke yogapaṭṭena badhnīyātpṛṣṭhayogataḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
आसनं सर्वतोभद्रं तद्विद्धि मनुजोत्तम ..
पर्यङ्के योगपट्टेन बध्नीयात्पृष्ठयोगतः .. 7 ..
text_mt: know that posture to be sarvatobhadra, O best of men. / In paryaṅka, one should bind [oneself] with a yoga strap across the back.

sanskrit_iast:
ākuñcya jānunī samyakpādaṃ kṛtvā ca bāhyataḥ ..
dakṣiṇaṃ vāmajaṅghāyāṃ paryaṅkāsanakāraṇam .. 8..
meaning:
आकुञ्च्य जानुनी सम्यक्पादं कृत्वा च बाह्यतः ..
दक्षिणं वामजङ्घायां पर्यङ्कासनकारणम् .. 8..
text_mt: Having bent both knees completely and placed the foot outside, / the right one on the left shank, forms the paryaṅka posture.

sanskrit_iast:
āsane sarvatobhadre yadā bhavati mānavaḥ ..
ūrusthottānacaraṇastadā syātkamalāsanam .. 9 ..
meaning:
आसने सर्वतोभद्रे यदा भवति मानवः ..
ऊरुस्थोत्तानचरणस्तदा स्यात्कमलासनम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: When a man sits in the sarvatobhadra seat / with his feet upturned on his thighs, that becomes the lotus seat.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanasthasya karaṇaṃ nibodha gadato mama..
samānīyorumūlena hastau bhārgava tiryagau..1.65.10..
meaning:
आसनस्थस्य करणं निबोध गदतो मम..
समानीयोरुमूलेन हस्तौ भार्गव तिर्यगौ..1.65.10..
text_mt: Hear from me as I describe the bodily posture of one sitting in that seat: / bringing the hands level with the root of the thighs across them, O descendant of Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvottānau samau vidvānvāmasyopari dakṣiṇam..
aṅgulīcchādakaṃ vidvānaṅgulī nāṃ tu vinyaset .. 11 ...
meaning:
कृत्वोत्तानौ समौ विद्वान्वामस्योपरि दक्षिणम्..
अङ्गुलीच्छादकं विद्वानङ्गुली नां तु विन्यसेत् .. 11 ...
text_mt: the wise man, having turned both upward and level, / should place the right above the left, covering the fingers with the fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidākuñcitāṅguṣṭhau kartavyau ca tathā karau ..
uraścotthāpya vitataṃ kṛtvā rāma pariślatham .. 12..
meaning:
किञ्चिदाकुञ्चिताङ्गुष्ठौ कर्तव्यौ च तथा करौ ..
उरश्चोत्थाप्य विततं कृत्वा राम परिश्लथम् .. 12..
text_mt: The two hands should have the thumbs slightly bent; / and raising the chest, making it broad and relaxed, O Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhamākuñcayetskandhe dehamunnāmayetsudhīḥ ..
niṣkampāṃ sudṛḍhāmṛjvīṃ nātistabdhāṃ na kuñcitām .. 13..
meaning:
पृष्ठमाकुञ्चयेत्स्कन्धे देहमुन्नामयेत्सुधीः ..
निष्कम्पां सुदृढामृज्वीं नातिस्तब्धां न कुञ्चिताम् .. 13..
text_mt: the wise man should contract the back at the shoulder and elevate the body, / holding the neck steady, very firm, straight, neither too rigid nor bent,

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāṃ vidhārayedyatnācchiraḥ kāryaṃ samaṃ sadā ..
saṃpasyannāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan .. 14..
meaning:
ग्रीवां विधारयेद्यत्नाच्छिरः कार्यं समं सदा ..
संपस्यन्नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् .. 14..
text_mt: with effort; the head should always be held straight, / looking at the tip of one's own nose and not looking at the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcinnimīlite netre dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet ..
tālumadhyagatenaiva jihvāgreṇa samāhitaḥ .. 19..
meaning:
किञ्चिन्निमीलिते नेत्रे दन्तैर्दन्तान्न संस्पृशेत् ..
तालुमध्यगतेनैव जिह्वाग्रेण समाहितः .. 19..
text_mt: With eyes slightly closed, he should not touch teeth to teeth; / concentrated, with the tip of the tongue placed at the middle of the palate,

sanskrit_iast:
sa baddhakaraṇo vidvānabhyāsātpavanaṃ jayet ..
jitvā vāyuṃ yathāśakti yogaṃ yuñjīta buddhimān .. 16 ..
meaning:
स बद्धकरणो विद्वानभ्यासात्पवनं जयेत् ..
जित्वा वायुं यथाशक्ति योगं युञ्जीत बुद्धिमान् .. 16 ..
text_mt: having formed this posture, the wise man should master the breath through practice. / Having conquered the breath according to his capacity, the intelligent man should apply yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau tu cintayetsthūlāṃ bhūmiṃ pañcaguṇānvitām ..
labdhalakṣo mahāyogī bhūmiyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 17 ..
meaning:
आदौ तु चिन्तयेत्स्थूलां भूमिं पञ्चगुणान्विताम् ..
लब्धलक्षो महायोगी भूमियोगं समुत्सृजेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: First, however, he should meditate on the gross earth, endowed with five qualities; / having attained his aim, the great yogin should abandon yoga on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścaturguṇaṃ dhyānaṃ kartavyamudake dvija ..
labdhalakṣa apāṃ yogī jalayogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 18 ...
meaning:
ततश्चतुर्गुणं ध्यानं कर्तव्यमुदके द्विज ..
लब्धलक्ष अपां योगी जलयोगं समुत्सृजेत् .. 18 ...
text_mt: Then, O twice-born, meditation endowed with four qualities should be performed on water; / having attained his aim regarding the waters, the yogin should abandon yoga on water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta triguṇaṃ dvija tejasi ..
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vahniyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 19 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु योगं युञ्जीत त्रिगुणं द्विज तेजसि ..
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि वह्नियोगं समुत्सृजेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Then, O twice-born, he should apply yoga endowed with three qualities to fire; / and having attained his aim there as well, he should abandon yoga on fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu yogaṃ yuñjīta pavane dviguṇaṃ dvija ....
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi vāyuyogaṃ samutsṛjet .. 1.65.20 ...
meaning:
ततस्तु योगं युञ्जीत पवने द्विगुणं द्विज ....
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि वायुयोगं समुत्सृजेत् .. 1.65.20 ...
text_mt: Then, O twice-born, he should apply yoga endowed with two qualities to wind; / and having attained his aim there as well, he should abandon yoga on wind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvekaguṇaṃ yogaṃ yuñjīta gagane budhaḥ ..
labdhalakṣaśca tatrāpi manoyogagatirbhavet .. 21 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्वेकगुणं योगं युञ्जीत गगने बुधः ..
लब्धलक्षश्च तत्रापि मनोयोगगतिर्भवेत् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then the wise man should apply yoga endowed with one quality to space; / and having attained his aim there as well, his practice becomes yoga of the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
manasaścandramāḥ proktaḥ prathamaṃ candramaṇḍale ..
ūrdhvalakṣaṃ budhaḥ kṛtvā candramaṇḍalamadhyage .. 22 ..
meaning:
मनसश्चन्द्रमाः प्रोक्तः प्रथमं चन्द्रमण्डले ..
ऊर्ध्वलक्षं बुधः कृत्वा चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगे .. 22 ..
text_mt: The moon is said to belong to the mind; first, in the lunar orb, / having fixed his aim above, in the middle of the lunar orb,

sanskrit_iast:

then having reached another birth, refined by the yoga of devotion, / becomes one who acts continuously, and then attains that state.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This much was spoken to Rāma by the exalted god Tryambaka, / who was pleased at that time—a secret revered by the sages.
This must not be spoken to one devoid of strength, O best of the Yadus, / nor to an atheist, a fool, or one corrupted by disputation.
This, however, should be spoken to a disciple who listens and to a son, / or to one who would give the entire earth with its mountains and forests.
This is a supreme secret, meritorious, purifying, destroying sin, / granting long life and renown, and destroying bad dreams in the Kali age.

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ...
evamuktvā dadau cāsya tūṇamakṣayasāyakam ..
dattvā ca bhagavānāha rāmaṃ parabalārdanam .. 1.66.10 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ...
एवमुक्त्वा ददौ चास्य तूणमक्षयसायकम् ..
दत्त्वा च भगवानाह रामं परबलार्दनम् .. 1.66.10 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, he gave him a quiver of inexhaustible arrows; / and having given it, the Lord said to Rāma, the crusher of the enemy's armies:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
tūṇametatpradātavyaṃ tvayāgastyāya bhārgava ..
cāparatnaṃ ca rāmāya kṛte karmaṇi suvrata .. 11 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
तूणमेतत्प्रदातव्यं त्वयागस्त्याय भार्गव ..
चापरत्नं च रामाय कृते कर्मणि सुव्रत .. 11 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / This quiver should be given by you to Agastya, O Bhārgava, / and the jewel of a bow to Rāma, when the deed is accomplished, O you of noble vows.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyo'pi mahātejāstūṇamakṣayasāyakam ..
rāghavāyātiyaśase rāmāyaiva pradāsyati .. 12..
meaning:
अगस्त्योऽपि महातेजास्तूणमक्षयसायकम् ..
राघवायातियशसे रामायैव प्रदास्यति .. 12..
text_mt: Agastya also, of great splendour, will give the quiver of inexhaustible arrows / to Rāma, the descendant of Raghu, who possesses supreme fame.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasaṃdarśanādūrdhvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śastradhāraṇam ..
rāmasaṃdarśane rāma tava tejo hi vaiṣṇavam .. 13 ..
meaning:
रामसंदर्शनादूर्ध्वं मा कृथाः शस्त्रधारणम् ..
रामसंदर्शने राम तव तेजो हि वैष्णवम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: After seeing Rāma, do not bear weapons; / for upon seeing Rāma, your Vaiṣṇava splendour, O Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ pravekṣyati tadā surakāryārthamūrjitam ..
yāvattvaṃ tejasā yukto vaiṣṇavena paraṃtapa .. 14 ..
meaning:
रामं प्रवेक्ष्यति तदा सुरकार्यार्थमूर्जितम् ..
यावत्त्वं तेजसा युक्तो वैष्णवेन परंतप .. 14 ..
text_mt: will then enter Rāma, mighty for the sake of the gods' purpose. / As long as you are endowed with the Vaiṣṇava splendour, O scorcher of foes,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvacchatrugaṇānsarvānsamareṣu vijeṣyasi ..
sthātuṃ na śaktāstava daityasenā astāyudhasya pramukhe dvijendra ..
ādāya cāpaṃ yudhi vaiṣṇavaṃ tattūṇaṃ tathemaṃ jahi devaśatrūn .. 19 ..
meaning:
तावच्छत्रुगणान्सर्वान्समरेषु विजेष्यसि ..
स्थातुं न शक्तास्तव दैत्यसेना अस्तायुधस्य प्रमुखे द्विजेन्द्र ..
आदाय चापं युधि वैष्णवं तत्तूणं तथेमं जहि देवशत्रून् .. 19 ..
text_mt: so long will you conquer all hosts of enemies in battles. / The army of the daityas is not able to stand before you who have cast your weapons, O foremost of twice-born; / taking that Vaiṣṇava bow in battle and likewise this quiver, slay the enemies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca ...
vaiṣṇavaṃ cāparatnaṃ tatkimarthaṃ bhavatā kare ..
nyastaṃ ca tanme bhagavaṃścāparatnaṃ ca kīdṛśam .. 1 ..
meaning:
राम उवाच ...
वैष्णवं चापरत्नं तत्किमर्थं भवता करे ..
न्यस्तं च तन्मे भगवंश्चापरत्नं च कीदृशम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / For what reason was that jewel of a Vaiṣṇava bow placed in the hand [of my father] by you, / and of what kind is that jewel of a bow, O Lord? Tell me that.
title: Vaiṣṇavadhanuḥprādurbhāvaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
māyā hi vaiṣṇavī rāma yayā saṃmohitāḥ purā ..
devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva gatvāntaḥ praṇatāḥ sthitā .. 2 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
माया हि वैष्णवी राम यया संमोहिताः पुरा ..
देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव गत्वान्तः प्रणताः स्थिता .. 2 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / The māyā of Viṣṇu, O Rāma, by which they were formerly deluded— / the gods and the ṛṣis, having gone inside, stood bowing down

sanskrit_iast:
yajatāṃ paramādhāraṃ devaṃ kamalasaṃbhavam ..
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtaḥ .. .. 3..
meaning:
यजतां परमाधारं देवं कमलसंभवम् ..
भूतभव्यभविष्यस्य प्रभुं लोकनमस्कृतः .. .. 3..
text_mt: to the god born of the lotus, the supreme foundation of those who sacrifice, / the master of past, present, and future, reverenced by the world.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ ..
vāsudevasya devasya mahādevasya cāpyatha ..
antaraṃ jñātumicchāmaḥ kaḥ kasmādatiricyate ..4 ..
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः ..
वासुदेवस्य देवस्य महादेवस्य चाप्यथ ..
अन्तरं ज्ञातुमिच्छामः कः कस्मादतिरिच्यते ..4 ..
text_mt: The gods said: / We wish to know the difference between the god Vāsudeva / and Mahādeva: who surpasses whom?

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktassuraiḥ sarvairṛṣibhiśca pitāmahaiḥ ..
vihasyovāca tānsarvāṃstayorgatvā parasparam .. 5 ..
meaning:
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्तस्सुरैः सर्वैरृषिभिश्च पितामहैः ..
विहस्योवाच तान्सर्वांस्तयोर्गत्वा परस्परम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Śaṅkara said: / Addressed thus by all the gods, the ṛṣis, and the ancestors, / having laughed, he spoke to them all, having approached one another:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
janayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve virodhamṛṣibhissaha ..
virodhe tu samutpanne tayoryuddhaṃ upasthite .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
जनयध्वं सुराः सर्वे विरोधमृषिभिस्सह ..
विरोधे तु समुत्पन्ने तयोर्युद्धं उपस्थिते .. 6 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / All you gods, generate enmity [between them] together with the ṛṣis; / when enmity has arisen and their battle is at hand,

sanskrit_iast:
jñāsyadhvamantaraṃ devāstayornāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve sārdhamṛṣigaṇaistadā .. 7 ..
meaning:
ज्ञास्यध्वमन्तरं देवास्तयोर्नास्त्यत्र संशयः ..
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे सार्धमृषिगणैस्तदा .. 7 ..
text_mt: you will know the difference between the two, O gods; there is no doubt of this. / Śaṅkara said: / Thus addressed, all the gods together with the hosts of ṛṣis then,

sanskrit_iast:
āvayorjanayāmāsurvirodhaṃ bhṛgunandana ..
viṣṇorādhikyamanvicchaṃstasya māyāvimohitāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
आवयोर्जनयामासुर्विरोधं भृगुनन्दन ..
विष्णोराधिक्यमन्विच्छंस्तस्य मायाविमोहिताः .. 8 ..
text_mt: O delight of the Bhṛgus, generated enmity between us, / seeking the superiority of Viṣṇu, deluded by his māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtavānasmi daivena deva vākyena vigraham ..
prabhāvadarśanārthāya tvāvayorvigrahe tadā .. 9 ..
meaning:
कृतवानस्मि दैवेन देव वाक्येन विग्रहम् ..
प्रभावदर्शनार्थाय त्वावयोर्विग्रहे तदा .. 9 ..
text_mt: By divine [design], through the word of the god, I engaged in strife. / In order to display our power, in our strife then,

sanskrit_iast:
āsannamabhavadyuddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaram ..
āvayorbhṛguśārdūla tadā yuddhe upasthite .. 1.67.10 ..
meaning:
आसन्नमभवद्युद्धं सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करम् ..
आवयोर्भृगुशार्दूल तदा युद्धे उपस्थिते .. 1.67.10 ..
text_mt: a battle was imminent, terrifying to all living beings. / When the battle between us was at hand, O tiger of the Bhṛgus,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagāmātha taṃ deśaṃ brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ ..
devā brahmarṣayaścaiva tathā rājarṣayo'malāḥ ..1 1 ..
meaning:
आजगामाथ तं देशं ब्रह्मा शुभचतुर्मुखः ..
देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव तथा राजर्षयोऽमलाः ..1 1 ..
text_mt: Brahmā of the four auspicious faces then came to that region, / as well as the gods, the celestial ṛṣis, and the stainless royal ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ samavetānāmāvayoryuddhasaṃgare ..
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषां समवेतानामावयोर्युद्धसंगरे ..
उवाच वचनं ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: When all were assembled at the encounter of our battle, / Brahmā, reverenced by all the worlds, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca ..
na kartavyaṃ jagannāthau yuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam ..
yuṣmadyuddhena sakalaṃ naśyatīdaṃ jagattrayam .. 13 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच ..
न कर्तव्यं जगन्नाथौ युद्धं परमदारुणम् ..
युष्मद्युद्धेन सकलं नश्यतीदं जगत्त्रयम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Brahmā said: / You two lords of the world must not fight an exceedingly terrible battle; / by your battle, this entire triple world will perish.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītaṃ cāparatnaṃ yatsvayaṃ devena cakriṇā ..
tadāropayatāṃ śūlī śūlicāpaṃ janārdanaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
गृहीतं चापरत्नं यत्स्वयं देवेन चक्रिणा ..
तदारोपयतां शूली शूलिचापं जनार्दनः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Let the trident-bearer string the jewel of a bow which was taken up by the discus-bearing god himself, / and let Janārdana [string] the bow of the trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
jñāsyāmi cāntaraṃ devau cāpāropaṇakarmaṇā ..
śaṅkara uvāca ..
evamukte mama karāddhanurjagrāha keśavaḥ ..
āropituṃ na me śaktiḥ sarvayatnena cābhavat .. 15 ..
meaning:
ज्ञास्यामि चान्तरं देवौ चापारोपणकर्मणा ..
शङ्कर उवाच ..
एवमुक्ते मम कराद्धनुर्जग्राह केशवः ..
आरोपितुं न मे शक्तिः सर्वयत्नेन चाभवत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: I will know the difference between the two gods through the act of stringing the bow. / Śaṅkara said: / When this was said, Keśava took the bow from my hand; / and I had no power to string [his], even with every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca gatamohena mayā jñāto maheśvaraḥ ..
jñātvā visṛṣṭacāpena stutaśca bhagavāṃstadā .. 16 ..
meaning:
ततश्च गतमोहेन मया ज्ञातो महेश्वरः ..
ज्ञात्वा विसृष्टचापेन स्तुतश्च भगवांस्तदा .. 16 ..
