text_mt: He who was the disciple of Vyāsa, his son Śuka born from the fire-stick, / [and] by that very god of gods, the all-powerful Viṣṇu—

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyuge caturviṃśe bhṛguvaṃśodbhavena tu ..
vālmīkinā tu racitaṃ svameva caritaṃ śubham .. 38 ..
meaning:
त्रेतायुगे चतुर्विंशे भृगुवंशोद्भवेन तु ..
वाल्मीकिना तु रचितं स्वमेव चरितं शुभम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: in the twenty-fourth Tretā age, by Vālmīki, / born in the lineage of Bhṛgu, his own auspicious story was composed,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmākhyānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ viṣṇulokadam ..
vartamāne kaliyuge kṣīṇe nṛpatisattam .. 39 ..
meaning:
रामाख्यानं महापुण्यं श्रोतॄणां विष्णुलोकदम् ..
वर्तमाने कलियुगे क्षीणे नृपतिसत्तम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: the story of Rāma, of great merit, which grants the world of Viṣṇu to its hearers. / When the present Kali age is exhausted, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
kalkī viṣṇuyaśo nāma bhaviṣyati jagatpatiḥ..
ghātayiṣyati sarvānsa mlecchānparabalārdanaḥ..1.74.40..
meaning:
कल्की विष्णुयशो नाम भविष्यति जगत्पतिः..
घातयिष्यति सर्वान्स म्लेच्छान्परबलार्दनः..1.74.40..
text_mt: Kalkī Viṣṇuyaśas by name will arise as the Lord of the universe; / he, the crusher of the enemy's forces, will slay all the barbarians.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchākrāntāṃ vasumatīṃ kṛtvā mlecchāvivarjitām ..
dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā svasthānamupayāsyati .. 41 ...
meaning:
म्लेच्छाक्रान्तां वसुमतीं कृत्वा म्लेच्छाविवर्जिताम् ..
धर्मसंस्थापनं कृत्वा स्वस्थानमुपयास्यति .. 41 ...
text_mt: Having made the earth, which had been overrun by barbarians, free of barbarians, / and having firmly established dharma, he will go to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāsu dharmayuktāsu tatassaṃpatsyate kṛtam ..
ityevaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuryuge kṣīṇe'bhi jāyate .. 42 ...
meaning:
प्रजासु धर्मयुक्तासु ततस्संपत्स्यते कृतम् ..
इत्येवं भगवान्विष्णुर्युगे क्षीणेऽभि जायते .. 42 ...
text_mt: When the subjects are endowed with dharma, then the Kṛta [age] will begin. / In this very way the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu is born when an age has waned,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya nityameva yadūdvaha ..
prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītānyanekaśaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय नित्यमेव यदूद्वह ..
प्रादुर्भावसहस्राणि समतीतान्यनेकशः .. 43 ..
text_mt: always for the sake of establishing dharma, O leader of the Yadus. / His manifestations in the past are thousands in number, manifold,

sanskrit_iast: bhaviṣyati tathā tasya yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ..44...
meaning: भविष्यति तथा तस्य येषां संख्या न विद्यते ..44...
text_mt: and so will there be of him [manifestations] in the future whose number is not known.

sanskrit_iast:
etattavoktaṃ hi narendracandra kṣīṇe yuge yadbhavatīha loke ..
ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha prabrūhi kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan..49..
meaning:
एतत्तवोक्तं हि नरेन्द्रचन्द्र क्षीणे युगे यद्भवतीह लोके ..
अतः परं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ प्रब्रूहि किं ते कथयामि राजन्..49..
text_mt: This indeed has been told to you, O moon among kings, which happens in this world when an age has waned. / Beyond this, O foremost of the upholders of dharma, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
manvantare parikṣīṇe yādṛśī dvija
jāyate .. samavasthā mahābhāga tādṛśīṃ vaktumarhasi .. 1 ...
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
मन्वन्तरे परिक्षीणे यादृशी द्विज
जायते .. समवस्था महाभाग तादृशीं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 1 ...
text_mt: Vajra said: / When a manvantara has waned, of what sort, O twice-born, / does the state [of the world] become? You ought to tell of such a [state], O fortunate one.
title: Manvantaravarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
manvantare parikṣīṇe devā manvantareśvarāḥ ..
maharlokamathāsādya tiṣṭhanti gatakalmaṣāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मन्वन्तरे परिक्षीणे देवा मन्वन्तरेश्वराः ..
महर्लोकमथासाद्य तिष्ठन्ति गतकल्मषाः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When a manvantara has waned, the gods, the lords of the manvantara, / having then reached Maharloka, dwell there, free from taint.

sanskrit_iast:
manuśca saha śakreṇa devāśca yadunandana ..
brahmalokaṃ prapadyante punarāvṛttidurlabham .. 3 ..
meaning:
मनुश्च सह शक्रेण देवाश्च यदुनन्दन ..
ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यन्ते पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: And Manu together with Śakra and the gods, O joy of the Yadus, / proceed to the world of Brahmā, from which return is hard to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaśca tathā sapta tatra tiṣṭhanti te sadā ..
adhikāraṃ vinā sarve sadṛśāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
ऋषयश्च तथा सप्त तत्र तिष्ठन्ति ते सदा ..
अधिकारं विना सर्वे सदृशाः परमेष्ठिनः .. 4 ..
text_mt: And likewise the seven seers dwell there always, / all of them without office, equal to Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtalaṃ sakalaṃ vajra toyarūpī maheśvaraḥ ..
ūrmimālī mahāvegaḥ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati .. 9 ..
meaning:
भूतलं सकलं वज्र तोयरूपी महेश्वरः ..
ऊर्मिमाली महावेगः सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति .. 9 ..
text_mt: The Great Lord, taking the form of water, O Vajra, / garlanded with waves and of great velocity, stands covering the entire surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūlokamāśritaṃ sarvaṃ tadā naśyati yādava ..
na vinaśyanti rājendra viśrutāḥ kulaparvatāḥ .. 6..
meaning:
भूलोकमाश्रितं सर्वं तदा नश्यति यादव ..
न विनश्यन्ति राजेन्द्र विश्रुताः कुलपर्वताः .. 6..
text_mt: Everything residing in the world of the earth then perishes, O Yādava; / yet the famous principal mountains do not perish, O king of kings:

sanskrit_iast:
mahendro malayassahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣavānapi ..
vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca mālyavāngandhamādanaḥ .. 7 ...
meaning:
महेन्द्रो मलयस्सह्यः शुक्तिमानृक्षवानपि ..
विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च माल्यवान्गन्धमादनः .. 7 ...
text_mt: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimat, and Ṛkṣavat, / Vindhya, Pāriyātra, Mālyavat, and Gandhamādana,

sanskrit_iast:
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca ..
śvetaśca śṛṅgavānmerurna vinaśyanti parvatāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो नील एव च ..
श्वेतश्च शृङ्गवान्मेरुर्न विनश्यन्ति पर्वताः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Himavat, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, and Nīla, / Śveta, Śṛṅgavat, and Meru—these mountains do not perish.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ vinaśyati jagatsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yat ..
naurbhūtvā tu satī devī tadā yadukulodvaha ! .. 9 ..
meaning:
शेषं विनश्यति जगत्स्थावरं जङ्गमं च यत् ..
नौर्भूत्वा तु सती देवी तदा यदुकुलोद्वह ! .. 9 ..
text_mt: The rest of the world perishes, whatever is immovable and movable. / But the virtuous goddess [Earth], having become a boat then, O scion of Yadu's lineage,

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayatyatha bījāni sarvāṇyevā viśeṣataḥ ..
bhaviṣyaśca manustasyāṃ bhaviṣyā ṛṣayastathā .. 1.75.10..
meaning:
धारयत्यथ बीजानि सर्वाण्येवा विशेषतः ..
भविष्यश्च मनुस्तस्यां भविष्या ऋषयस्तथा .. 1.75.10..
text_mt: then bears all the seeds without distinction. / And the future Manu and the future seers

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanti rājaśārdūla sapta ye prathitā bhuvi ..
matsyarūpadharo viṣṇuḥ śṛṅgī bhūtvā jagatpatiḥ ..11..
meaning:
तिष्ठन्ति राजशार्दूल सप्त ये प्रथिता भुवि ..
मत्स्यरूपधरो विष्णुः शृङ्गी भूत्वा जगत्पतिः ..11..
text_mt: stand upon it, O tiger among kings, those seven who are renowned on earth. / Viṣṇu, bearing the form of a fish, having grown a horn, the Lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣati tu tāṃ nāvaṃ sthānātsthānaṃ sa līlayā ..
karṣamāṇantu tāṃ nāvaṃ devadevaṃ jagatpatim..12..
meaning:
आकर्षति तु तां नावं स्थानात्स्थानं स लीलया ..
कर्षमाणन्तु तां नावं देवदेवं जगत्पतिम्..12..
text_mt: pulls that boat in sport from place to place. / As he pulls that boat, that God of gods, the Lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti ṛṣayaḥ sarve divyaiḥ karmabhiracyutam ..
ghūrṇamānastadā matsyo jalavegormisaṃkule .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति ऋषयः सर्वे दिव्यैः कर्मभिरच्युतम् ..
घूर्णमानस्तदा मत्स्यो जलवेगोर्मिसंकुले .. 13 ..
text_mt: is praised by all the seers, Acyuta [extolled] for his celestial deeds. / Then, rolling in the turmoil of the water’s surging waves,

sanskrit_iast:
ghūrṇamānāṃ tu tāṃ nāvaṃ nayatyamitavikramaḥ ..
himādriśikharaṃ nāvaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
घूर्णमानां तु तां नावं नयत्यमितविक्रमः ..
हिमाद्रिशिखरं नावं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः .. 14 ..
text_mt: the fish of boundless valor leads that rolling boat— / that God of gods, the Lord of the world, [brings] the boat to the peak of the mountain of snow.

sanskrit_iast: matsyastvadṛśyo bhavati te ca tiṣṭhanti tatragāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning: मत्स्यस्त्वदृश्यो भवति ते च तिष्ठन्ति तत्रगाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Then the fish becomes invisible, and they remain stationed there.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtatulyaṃ tadā kālaṃ tāvatprakṣālanaṃ smṛtam ..
āpassāmyamatho yānti yathāpūrvaṃ narādhipa ..
ṛṣayaśca manuścaiva sarvaṃ kurvanti te tadā .. 16 ..
meaning:
कृततुल्यं तदा कालं तावत्प्रक्षालनं स्मृतम् ..
आपस्साम्यमथो यान्ति यथापूर्वं नराधिप ..
ऋषयश्च मनुश्चैव सर्वं कुर्वन्ति ते तदा .. 16 ..
text_mt: That time equal to the Kṛta [age] is known as the washing. / Then the waters subside as before, O ruler of men, / and the seers and Manu then perform all [actions].

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarānte jagatāmavasthā mayeritā te yaduvṛndanātha .
ataḥ paraṃ yattava kīrtanīyaṃ samāsatastadvada bhūmipāla..17..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरान्ते जगतामवस्था मयेरिता ते यदुवृन्दनाथ .
अतः परं यत्तव कीर्तनीयं समासतस्तद्वद भूमिपाल..17..
text_mt: The state of the worlds at the end of a manvantara has been told to you by me, O lord of the Yadu host. / Beyond this, what should be declared to you, speak that in brief, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
brāhmasya divasasyānte yādṛśī dvija jāyate ..
jagato'sya samāvasthā tādṛśīṃ vaktumarhasi .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
ब्राह्मस्य दिवसस्यान्ते यादृशी द्विज जायते ..
जगतोऽस्य समावस्था तादृशीं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Of what sort, O twice-born, does the state of this world / become at the end of a day of Brahmā? You ought to tell of such a [state].
title: Kalpāntavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vṛtte prakṣālane rājankalpasyānte caturdiśam ..
uttiṣṭhaṃti tadā ghorā divi sapta divākarāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
वृत्ते प्रक्षालने राजन्कल्पस्यान्ते चतुर्दिशम् ..
उत्तिष्ठंति तदा घोरा दिवि सप्त दिवाकराः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the washing has taken place at the end of an aeon, O king, / seven terrible suns then rise in the sky in the four directions.

sanskrit_iast:
te tu pītvā jalaṃ sarvaṃ śoṣayanti jagattrayam ..
vināśe sarvabhūtānāmayoguḍasamā tadā .. 3 ..
meaning:
ते तु पीत्वा जलं सर्वं शोषयन्ति जगत्त्रयम् ..
विनाशे सर्वभूतानामयोगुडसमा तदा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having drunk all the water, they dry up the three worlds. / At the destruction of all beings, then, like an iron ball,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirbhavati bhūpāla dagdhāssarve ca jantavaḥ ..
vinaṣṭakilbiṣāssarve jīvamātrāvaśeṣakāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
भूमिर्भवति भूपाल दग्धास्सर्वे च जन्तवः ..
विनष्टकिल्बिषास्सर्वे जीवमात्रावशेषकाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: the earth becomes, O protector of the earth, and all creatures are scorched. / All with their sins destroyed, with life alone remaining,

sanskrit_iast:
janalokamathāsādyatatra tiṣṭhanti nirbhayāḥ..
bhūrbhuvassvarmahaścaiva tadā naśyanti pārthiva..5..
meaning:
जनलोकमथासाद्यतत्र तिष्ठन्ति निर्भयाः..
भूर्भुवस्स्वर्महश्चैव तदा नश्यन्ति पार्थिव..5..
text_mt: reaching Janaloka, dwell there without fear. / Bhūrloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka, and Maharloka then perish, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
janalokādayo lokā na tu naśyanti pārthiva..
tato'rkāste tu naśyanti saṃhitā rudratejasā .. 6..
meaning:
जनलोकादयो लोका न तु नश्यन्ति पार्थिव..
ततोऽर्कास्ते तु नश्यन्ति संहिता रुद्रतेजसा .. 6..
text_mt: The worlds beginning with Janaloka, however, do not perish, O ruler of the earth. / Then those suns perish, combined with the splendor of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
uttiṣṭhanti mahāraudrāstato divicarā ghanāḥ ..
kecidañjanapuñjābhāḥ kecidgajakulopamāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
उत्तिष्ठन्ति महारौद्रास्ततो दिविचरा घनाः ..
केचिदञ्जनपुञ्जाभाः केचिद्गजकुलोपमाः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then clouds roaming the sky, exceedingly terrible, arise, / some resembling heaps of collyrium, some like herds of elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
kecitpuravarākārāḥ keciddhāridrasannibhāḥ..
haritālāñjanaprakhyāstathā hiṅgulakaprabhāḥ..8..
meaning:

हरितालाञ्जनप्रख्यास्तथा हिङ्गुलकप्रभाः..8..
text_mt: some shaped like great cities, some resembling turmeric, / looking like orpiment and collyrium, and with the luster of cinnabar,

sanskrit_iast:
śukapatranibhāḥ kecitkecinnīlotpalaprabhāḥ..
vidyunmālā vinaddhāṅgā garjanto'tha balāhakāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
शुकपत्रनिभाः केचित्केचिन्नीलोत्पलप्रभाः..
विद्युन्माला विनद्धाङ्गा गर्जन्तोऽथ बलाहकाः .. 9 ..
text_mt: some resembling the wings of parrots, some with the luster of blue lotuses, / their forms entwined with garlands of lightning, thundering storm clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
ākramya gaganaṃ rājanpūrayanti mahītalam ..
gaṅgāpravāhapratimairdhārāpātaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 1.76.10 ..
meaning:
आक्रम्य गगनं राजन्पूरयन्ति महीतलम् ..
गङ्गाप्रवाहप्रतिमैर्धारापातैः पुनःपुनः .. 1.76.10 ..
text_mt: Pervading the sky, O king, they fill the surface of the earth / again and again with torrents of rain resembling the currents of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatassamudrā bhūpāla velodbhedataraṅgiṇaḥ ..
chādayanti mahīṃ sarvāṃ dagdhāṃ sūryagabhastibhiḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
ततस्समुद्रा भूपाल वेलोद्भेदतरङ्गिणः ..
छादयन्ति महीं सर्वां दग्धां सूर्यगभस्तिभिः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Then the oceans, O protector of the earth, undulating as they break their shores, / cover the whole earth that was burnt by the rays of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tatassaṃvartako vāyurghanānārujati kṣaṇāt ..
tato vāyuṃ samādāya svaśarīre pitāmahaḥ .. 12 ...
meaning:
ततस्संवर्तको वायुर्घनानारुजति क्षणात् ..
ततो वायुं समादाय स्वशरीरे पितामहः .. 12 ...
text_mt: Then the cosmic wind breaks the clouds in an instant. / Then, drawing the wind into his own body, the Grandfather

sanskrit_iast:
svapityekārṇave loke naṣṭasthāvarajaṅgame ..
naṣṭacandrārkapavane grahanakṣatratārake .. 13 ..
meaning:
स्वपित्येकार्णवे लोके नष्टस्थावरजङ्गमे ..
नष्टचन्द्रार्कपवने ग्रहनक्षत्रतारके .. 13 ..
text_mt: sleeps upon the single ocean of the world, when the movable and immovable are destroyed, / when the moon, the sun, the wind, the planets, lunar mansions, and stars are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
suptvā yugasahasraṃ tu devadevo jagatpatiḥ ..
punarvibuddhaḥ kurute sṛṣṭiṃ prāgvatpitāmahaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सुप्त्वा युगसहस्रं तु देवदेवो जगत्पतिः ..
पुनर्विबुद्धः कुरुते सृष्टिं प्राग्वत्पितामहः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Having slept for a thousand yugas, the God of gods, the Lord of the world, / the Grandfather, awakened again, performs creation as before.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭiṃ karoti dharmajña kalpekalpe punaḥpunaḥ ..
pitāmahasya rātryante tasmāddhi sṛjati prajāḥ..19..
meaning:
सृष्टिं करोति धर्मज्ञ कल्पेकल्पे पुनःपुनः ..
पितामहस्य रात्र्यन्ते तस्माद्धि सृजति प्रजाः..19..
text_mt: He performs creation, O knower of dharma, in aeon after aeon again and again. / At the end of the Grandfather’s night, he therefore creates the creatures.

sanskrit_iast: jantūnāṃ jananādrājañjana ityabhidhīyate ..16..
meaning: जन्तूनां जननाद्राजञ्जन इत्यभिधीयते ..16..
text_mt: [That world] is called Jana, O king, because of the generating of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktaṃ tava bhūmipāla kalpe gate yadbhavatīha loke ..
ataḥ paraṃ sarvayadupradhāna vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan .. 17 ..
meaning:
एतावदुक्तं तव भूमिपाल कल्पे गते यद्भवतीह लोके ..
अतः परं सर्वयदुप्रधान वदस्व किं ते कथयामि राजन् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Thus much has been told to you, O protector of the earth, of what happens in this world when an aeon has elapsed. / Beyond this, O foremost of all Yadus, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
mahākalpakṣaye brahmansamavasthāṃ vadasva me ..
bhavāñjñānanidhiḥ sphīto yathā brahmā pitāmahaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
महाकल्पक्षये ब्रह्मन्समवस्थां वदस्व मे ..
भवाञ्ज्ञाननिधिः स्फीतो यथा ब्रह्मा पितामहः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Tell me, O holy one, of the state [of the world] at the end of a great aeon. / You are an abundant treasure of knowledge, like Brahmā the Grandfather.
title: Mahākalpavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
pūrṇe saṃvatsaraśate saṃhṛtya sakalaṃ jagat .
śete brahmā mahārāja prāgvadekārṇave tadā . 2 .
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच..
पूर्णे संवत्सरशते संहृत्य सकलं जगत् .
शेते ब्रह्मा महाराज प्राग्वदेकार्णवे तदा . 2 .
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When a hundred years are complete, having withdrawn the entire world, / Brahmā then sleeps upon the single ocean as before, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyasya dehaṃ yogena puruṣaṃ pratipadyate ..
mokṣasthānamanuprāpte devadeve pitāmahe .. 3 ..
meaning:
संन्यस्य देहं योगेन पुरुषं प्रतिपद्यते ..
मोक्षस्थानमनुप्राप्ते देवदेवे पितामहे .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having cast off his body through yoga, he attains the Cosmic Person. / When the God of gods, the Grandfather, has attained the abode of liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
ye gatā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ mucyante sarva eva te ..
aṇḍasyābhyantaraṃ sarvaṃ tadāmbhobhiḥ prapūryate .. 4 ..|
meaning:
ये गता ब्रह्मणः स्थानं मुच्यन्ते सर्व एव ते ..
अण्डस्याभ्यन्तरं सर्वं तदाम्भोभिः प्रपूर्यते .. 4 ..|
text_mt: All those who have reached the abode of Brahmā are liberated. / Then the entire interior of the cosmic egg is filled with water.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīradhāriṇassarve tadā naśyanti pārthiva ..
antargatena toyena bhinnamaṇḍe jagatpate .. 5 ..
meaning:
शरीरधारिणस्सर्वे तदा नश्यन्ति पार्थिव ..
अन्तर्गतेन तोयेन भिन्नमण्डे जगत्पते .. 5 ..
text_mt: All embodied beings perish then, O earthly king, / when the egg is broken by the water within it, O lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe brahmāyuṣi tadā bāhyasthe'mbhasi līyate ..
evaṃ sā jagadādhārā dhārā toye pralīyate .. 6 ..
meaning:
पूर्णे ब्रह्मायुषि तदा बाह्यस्थेऽम्भसि लीयते ..
एवं सा जगदाधारा धारा तोये प्रलीयते .. 6 ..
text_mt: When Brahmā's lifespan is complete, it dissolves into the external water. / Thus that earth, the supporter of the world, dissolves into water.

ज्योतिष्यापः प्रलीयन्ते ज्योतिर्वायौ प्रलीयते ..
खे वायुः प्रलयं याति मनस्याकाशमेव च .. 7 ..

manaḥ pralīyate buddhau buddhiścātmani līyate ..

अव्यक्ते लीयते चात्मा अव्यक्तः पुरुषे परे .. 8 ..
text_mt: Mind dissolves into intellect, and intellect dissolves into the self; / the self dissolves into the unmanifest, and the unmanifest into the supreme Cosmic Person.

sanskrit_iast:
anantāni tathoktāni yānyaṇḍāni mayā purā ..
sarvāṇi tāni saṃhṛtya samakālaṃ jagatpatiḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
अनन्तानि तथोक्तानि यान्यण्डानि मया पुरा ..
सर्वाणि तानि संहृत्य समकालं जगत्पतिः .. 9 ..
text_mt: The endless cosmic eggs that were described by me before— / having withdrawn all of them at that same time, the Lord of the world

prakṛtau tiṣṭhati tadā sā rātristasya kīrtitā ..
brāhme samāśate pūrṇe punareva jagatpatiḥ .. 1.77.10 ..
meaning:
प्रकृतौ तिष्ठति तदा सा रात्रिस्तस्य कीर्तिता ..
ब्राह्मे समाशते पूर्णे पुनरेव जगत्पतिः .. 1.77.10 ..
text_mt: remains then in nature; that is called his night. / When a hundred years of Brahmā are complete, once again the Lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
( sarvaṃ vidhatte dharmajña yathāpūrvamudāhṛtam ..
avyaktādikrameṇātha vidhāyāṇḍaṃ maheśvaraḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
( सर्वं विधत्ते धर्मज्ञ यथापूर्वमुदाहृतम् ..
अव्यक्तादिक्रमेणाथ विधायाण्डं महेश्वरः .. 11 ..
text_mt: O knower of dharma, arranges everything just as was related before. / Then, having formed the cosmic egg through the order beginning with the unmanifest, the Great Lord

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍe śarīre bhavati svayaṃbhūramṛtadyutiḥ .. )
svayaṃ sa eva dharmajña brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
अण्डे शरीरे भवति स्वयंभूरमृतद्युतिः .. )
स्वयं स एव धर्मज्ञ ब्रह्मा शुभचतुर्मुखः .. 12 ..
text_mt: becomes the self-born one of immortal radiance in the body of the cosmic egg. / He himself is Brahmā, O knower of dharma, auspicious and four-faced.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣvaṇḍeṣu dharmajñassamakālaṃ jagatpatiḥ ..
svayaṃ śarīre bhavati prākāmyānmanujeśvara .. 13 ..
meaning:
सर्वेष्वण्डेषु धर्मज्ञस्समकालं जगत्पतिः ..
स्वयं शरीरे भवति प्राकाम्यान्मनुजेश्वर .. 13 ..
text_mt: In all cosmic eggs, O knower of dharma, at the same time the Lord of the world / becomes embodied of his own accord through his irresistible will, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāyuṣonte jagatāmavasthā mayeritā te yaduvṛndanātha ..
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa .. 14 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मायुषोन्ते जगतामवस्था मयेरिता ते यदुवृन्दनाथ ..
अतः परं किं कथयामि तुभ्यं तन्मे वदस्वायतलोहिताक्ष .. 14 ..
text_mt: The state of the worlds at the end of Brahmā’s life has been told to you by me, O leader of the host of the Yadus. / What more shall I tell you beyond this? Speak that to me, O you with long, reddish eyes!

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 mahākalpavarṇano nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 77 ..
meaning: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0 सं0 महाकल्पवर्णनो नाम सप्तसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः.. .. 77 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Great Aeon,' in the conversation of Mārkaṇḍeya, in the first book of the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
saptamaste mahābhāga jātasya divasastvayam ..
vartate brahmaṇo brahmam̐statra manvantarakṣaye .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
सप्तमस्ते महाभाग जातस्य दिवसस्त्वयम् ..
वर्तते ब्रह्मणो ब्रह्मम्̐स्तत्र मन्वन्तरक्षये .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / This is the seventh day of your life, O fortunate one, / since the birth of Brahmā, O brahmin; there, at the destruction of a manvantara,
title: adhyāyaḥ 78

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ kālastvayā nītaḥ purā kalpakṣaye tadā ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ samaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
कथं कालस्त्वया नीतः पुरा कल्पक्षये तदा ..
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि त्वं समः परमेष्ठिनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: how was time spent by you formerly at the end of an aeon? / Dispel this doubt of mine; you are equal to Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
naugatena mayā nītaḥ kālo manvantarakṣaye ..
bhūyobhūyo mahābhāga devadevaprasādataḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
नौगतेन मया नीतः कालो मन्वन्तरक्षये ..
भूयोभूयो महाभाग देवदेवप्रसादतः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Sitting in a boat, time was spent by me at the destruction of a manvantara / again and again, O fortunate one, by the grace of the God of gods.

कल्पक्षयनुप्राप्य दाहकाल उपस्थिते ..
जनलोकगतेनाथ कालो नीतस्स वै मया .. 4 ..
text_mt: When the end of an aeon arrived and the time of burning was present, / having gone to Janaloka, that time was indeed spent by me.

sanskrit_iast:
dāhakāle tadā vṛtte pralayāmbhodhisaṃplave ..
janalokādahaṃ bhraṣṭaḥ patito dharaṇītale .. 5 ..
meaning:
दाहकाले तदा वृत्ते प्रलयाम्भोधिसंप्लवे ..
जनलोकादहं भ्रष्टः पतितो धरणीतले .. 5 ..
text_mt: When the time of burning was over, in the inundation of the ocean of dissolution, / I fell from Janaloka and landed upon the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
nūnaṃ tasyaiva devasya sā māyā bhīmavikramā ..
ekārṇave bhūmitale patitasyāpi me nṛpa .. 6 ..
meaning:
नूनं तस्यैव देवस्य सा माया भीमविक्रमा ..
एकार्णवे भूमितले पतितस्यापि मे नृप .. 6 ..
text_mt: Surely that was the wondrous power of terrible might belonging to that very God: / though I had fallen to the surface of the earth in the single vast ocean, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitaṃ na paribhraṣṭaṃ nūnaṃ tasya prasādataḥ ..
tadāhaṃ naṣṭavijñānaḥ patitoṃ'bhasi dāruṇe .. 7 ..
meaning:
जीवितं न परिभ्रष्टं नूनं तस्य प्रसादतः ..
तदाहं नष्टविज्ञानः पतितोंऽभसि दारुणे .. 7 ..
text_mt: my life was not lost, surely by his grace. / Then, my consciousness lost, I fell into the dreadful water.

sanskrit_iast:
ūhyamānombukallolairitaścetaśca yādava ..
apaśyamāno jagatīṃ saśailavanakānanām .. 8 ..
meaning:
ऊह्यमानोम्बुकल्लोलैरितश्चेतश्च यादव ..
अपश्यमानो जगतीं सशैलवनकाननाम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Carried hither and thither by the billows of water, O descendant of Yadu, / seeing no land with mountains, woods, and forests,

sanskrit_iast:
nirvedaṃ jīvite dīrghe tadā bhūtosmi śatruhan ..
so'hamārto'tha nirviṇṇastasmiṃstūdakasaṃplave .. 9 ..
meaning:
निर्वेदं जीविते दीर्घे तदा भूतोस्मि शत्रुहन् ..
सोऽहमार्तोऽथ निर्विण्णस्तस्मिंस्तूदकसंप्लवे .. 9 ..
text_mt: I became despondent with my long life then, O slayer of foes! / In that deluge of water, distressed and dejected,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāmi jalamadhyasthaṃ vipulaṃ vaṭapādapam ..

atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam ..
padmapatrābhacaraṇaṃ tadākārakaraṃ tathā .. 13 ..

अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं पीतवाससमच्युतम् ..
पद्मपत्राभचरणं तदाकारकरं तथा .. 13 ..
text_mt: resembling an atasī flower, clad in yellow garments, the Imperishable One, / his feet resembling lotus petals, his hands formed in the same likeness,

sanskrit_iast:

ekaṃ sāhasramadhyasthaṃ bhrājamānamiva śriyā .. 14 ..
meaning:
अलङ्कृतं चाभरणैः शिखण्डैकविभूषितम् ..
एकं साहस्रमध्यस्थं भ्राजमानमिव श्रिया .. 14 ..
text_mt: adorned with ornaments and decorated with a single crest of hair, / alone in the midst of a thousand, shining as if with splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā bālaḥ smitapūrvamuvāca ha ..
yadi śrānto'si dharmajña vigrahaṃ vadanena me .. 15 ..
meaning:
स मां दृष्ट्वा तदा बालः स्मितपूर्वमुवाच ह ..
यदि श्रान्तोऽसि धर्मज्ञ विग्रहं वदनेन मे .. 15 ..
text_mt: Seeing me then, that child said with a smile: / 'If you are tired, O knower of dharma, enter my body

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya viśramasvādya yāvadvā rucitaṃ tava ..
evamuktasya sañjātā vrīḍā yadukulodvaha .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रविश्य विश्रमस्वाद्य यावद्वा रुचितं तव ..
एवमुक्तस्य सञ्जाता व्रीडा यदुकुलोद्वह .. 16 ..
text_mt: through my mouth and rest today, for as long as you please.' / When he spoke thus, modesty arose in me, O uplifter of the Yadu race.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'hamavaśastasya praviṣṭo nṛpa vigraham ..
jagatīṃ tatra paśyāmi saśailavanakānanām .. 17 ..
meaning:
ततोऽहमवशस्तस्य प्रविष्टो नृप विग्रहम् ..
जगतीं तत्र पश्यामि सशैलवनकाननाम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Then, helpless, I entered his body, O king. / There I saw the earth with its mountains, woods, and forests,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāpūrvaṃ mahābhāga nagarākāraśālinīm ..
devadaityoragākīrṇāṃ samudravarabhūṣaṇām .. 18 ..
meaning:
यथापूर्वं महाभाग नगराकारशालिनीम् ..
देवदैत्योरगाकीर्णां समुद्रवरभूषणाम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: just as before, O fortunate one, endowed with the form of cities, / filled with gods, Daityas, and serpents, adorned with the excellent oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛparāṣṭrasamākīrṇāṃ vaṇigbhirupaśobhitām ..
dvijādhyayanasaṃghuṣṭāṃ varṇāśramasamākulām ..19..
meaning:
नृपराष्ट्रसमाकीर्णां वणिग्भिरुपशोभिताम् ..
द्विजाध्ययनसंघुष्टां वर्णाश्रमसमाकुलाम् ..19..
text_mt: crowded with kings and kingdoms, graced by merchants, / resounding with the Vedic study of brahmins, filled with the classes and stages of life,

sanskrit_iast:
saritparvatavṛkṣāḍhyāṃ yajñotsavasamākulām ..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kautukaṃ jātaṃ tasya bālasya karmaṇā..1.78.20..
meaning:
सरित्पर्वतवृक्षाढ्यां यज्ञोत्सवसमाकुलाम् ..
तां दृष्ट्वा कौतुकं जातं तस्य बालस्य कर्मणा..1.78.20..
text_mt: abounding in rivers, mountains, and trees, crowded with sacrifices and festivals. / Seeing it, wonder arose in me at the deed of that child.

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭumicchāmi tasyāntaṃ bhramamāṇastatastataḥ ..
yadā nāsādayāmyatra tasya bālasya ceṣṭitam ..21..
meaning:
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि तस्यान्तं भ्रममाणस्ततस्ततः ..
यदा नासादयाम्यत्र तस्य बालस्य चेष्टितम् ..21..
text_mt: I wished to see its end, wandering here and there. / When I could not comprehend the act of that child,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe yugasahasre'pi tamevāhaṃ tadā śiśum ..
saṃprāptaḥ śaraṇaṃ rājannahaṃ bhāvyarthena coditaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
पूर्णे युगसहस्रेऽपि तमेवाहं तदा शिशुम् ..
संप्राप्तः शरणं राजन्नहं भाव्यर्थेन चोदितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: even when a thousand ages were complete, urged by what was destined, / I then took refuge in that very infant, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ vadanāttasya nirgataśśaśisannibhāt ..
yadā tasyodare'paśyaṃ trailosya sacarācaram ..23 ..
meaning:
ततोऽहं वदनात्तस्य निर्गतश्शशिसन्निभात् ..
यदा तस्योदरेऽपश्यं त्रैलोस्य सचराचरम् ..23 ..
text_mt: Then I emerged from his moon-like mouth. / Just as I had seen the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings in his belly,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā paśyāmi sakalaṃ bahirbhūmipasattama ..
tato'haṃ patitastasya pādayossumahātmanaḥ..24..
meaning:
तथा पश्यामि सकलं बहिर्भूमिपसत्तम ..
ततोऽहं पतितस्तस्य पादयोस्सुमहात्मनः..24..
text_mt: so I saw everything outside, O best of earthly kings. / Then I fell at the feet of that great-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasso'ntarhito bālassaha tenaiva śākhinā..
evaṃ mayā tasya niśā narendra saṃprāpya puṇyaṃ jaṭhare hi nītā.
mahāśarīrasya mahānubhāva mahāprameyasya pitāmahasya..29..
meaning:
ततस्सोऽन्तर्हितो बालस्सह तेनैव शाखिना..
एवं मया तस्य निशा नरेन्द्र संप्राप्य पुण्यं जठरे हि नीता.
महाशरीरस्य महानुभाव महाप्रमेयस्य पितामहस्य..29..
text_mt: Then that child vanished along with that very tree. / Thus, O ruler of men, having attained his belly, that auspicious night was spent by me / inside the grandfather of vast body, of great majesty and immeasurable greatness.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ... ..
kastvasau bālaveṣeṇa kalpānteṣu punaḥpunaḥ ..
dṛṣṭo'pi na tvayā jñātastatra kautūhalaṃ mahat ..1..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ... ..
कस्त्वसौ बालवेषेण कल्पान्तेषु पुनःपुनः ..
दृष्टोऽपि न त्वया ज्ञातस्तत्र कौतूहलं महत् ..1..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Who was that one in the guise of a child who, though seen again and again / at the ends of aeons, was not recognized by you? Great is my curiosity about this.
title: Padmanābhopākhyānaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhūyobhūyastvasau dṛṣṭo mayā devo jagatpatiḥ ..
kalpakṣaye na vijñātastanmāyāmohitena vai ..2..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
भूयोभूयस्त्वसौ दृष्टो मया देवो जगत्पतिः ..
कल्पक्षये न विज्ञातस्तन्मायामोहितेन वै ..2..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / That God, the Lord of the world, was seen by me again and again; / but at the end of the aeon he was not recognized, deluded as I was by his wondrous power.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakṣaye vyatīte tu taṃ tu devaṃ pitāmahāt ..
aniruddhaṃ vijānāmi pitaraṃ te jagatpatim .. 3 ..
meaning:
कल्पक्षये व्यतीते तु तं तु देवं पितामहात् ..
अनिरुद्धं विजानामि पितरं ते जगत्पतिम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: When the end of the aeon had passed, from the Grandfather I came to know that God, / Aniruddha, the Lord of the world, who is your father.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
jñātavānasi taṃ devaṃ kathaṃ devātpitāmahāt ..
durvijñeyaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam .. 4 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
ज्ञातवानसि तं देवं कथं देवात्पितामहात् ..
दुर्विज्ञेयं जगद्योनिं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / How did you come to know that God from the divine Grandfather— / him who is difficult to discern, the source of the world, the origin of the existence of all beings?

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
māyayā mohitastasya bālasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvodare jagatkṛtsnaṃ vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मायया मोहितस्तस्य बालस्यामिततेजसः ..
दृष्ट्वोदरे जगत्कृत्स्नं विस्मयाविष्टचेतनः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Deluded by the wondrous power of that child of boundless splendor, / having seen the entire world in his belly, with my mind overcome with astonishment,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvāhaṃ brahmasadanaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐staṃ pitāmaham ..
ekārṇave mayā loke devadeve jagatpatau .. 6 ...
meaning:
गत्वाहं ब्रह्मसदनं पृष्टवाम्̐स्तं पितामहम् ..
एकार्णवे मया लोके देवदेवे जगत्पतौ .. 6 ...
text_mt:
I went to the abode of Brahmā and asked the Grandfather:
“When the world was one ocean, [I saw] the God of gods, the Lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭo bālo mahātejāstasyāhamavaśastataḥ ..
praviṣṭo jaṭhare tasya deva sarvaṃ carācaram .. 7 ..
meaning:
दृष्टो बालो महातेजास्तस्याहमवशस्ततः ..
प्रविष्टो जठरे तस्य देव सर्वं चराचरम् .. 7 ..
text_mt:
a child of great radiance was seen [by me]; then, helpless, I
entered into his belly, O god, and all the moving and unmoving [creation]

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ na ca jānāmi bālakam ..
dhruvaṃ taṃ bhagavānvetti sarvajñatvājjagadguruḥ .. 8..
meaning:
मया दृष्टं जगत्सर्वं न च जानामि बालकम् ..
ध्रुवं तं भगवान्वेत्ति सर्वज्ञत्वाज्जगद्गुरुः .. 8..
text_mt:
the entire world was seen by me, and yet I do not know that child.
Surely the Lord knows him, being omniscient, the guru of the world.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pṛṣṭo mayā brahmā māmuvāca jagadguruḥ ..
mārkaṇḍeya vijānāmi hyaniruddhaṃ jagadgurum .. 9..
meaning:
एवं पृष्टो मया ब्रह्मा मामुवाच जगद्गुरुः ..
मार्कण्डेय विजानामि ह्यनिरुद्धं जगद्गुरुम् .. 9..
text_mt:
Thus questioned by me, Brahmā, the guru of the world, said to me:
“Mārkaṇḍeya, I indeed know him as Aniruddha, the guru of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca taṃ vettha tattvena na ca kalpakṣaye mune ..
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tasya jaṭhare bhuvanaṃ mune .. 1.79.10 ..
meaning:
त्वं च तं वेत्थ तत्त्वेन न च कल्पक्षये मुने ..
त्वया दृष्टं यथा तस्य जठरे भुवनं मुने .. 1.79.10 ..
text_mt:
And you do not know him in truth at the end of the aeon, O sage.
Just as the world was seen by you in his belly, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tasya jagadyonermahātmanaḥ ..
madīyasya dinasyānte kadācidbhṛgunandana .. 11 ..
meaning:
तथा दृष्टं मया तस्य जगद्योनेर्महात्मनः ..
मदीयस्य दिनस्यान्ते कदाचिद्भृगुनन्दन .. 11 ..
text_mt:
so was it seen by me [within] that great-souled source of the world,
at the end of my day, once upon a time, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekārṇave tadā loke naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame ..
nāgaparyaṅkaśayane paśyāmi puruṣaṃ tadā .. 12 ..
meaning:
एकार्णवे तदा लोके नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ..
नागपर्यङ्कशयने पश्यामि पुरुषं तदा .. 12 ..
text_mt:
When the world then became one ocean and all moving and unmoving things were lost,
I beheld at that time the Cosmic Person lying upon the bed of the serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminkāle na jānāmi tamahaṃ tena mohitaḥ ..
tataḥ pṛcchāmi taṃ devaṃ ko bhavāniti vismitaḥ .. 13 ...
meaning:
तस्मिन्काले न जानामि तमहं तेन मोहितः ..
ततः पृच्छामि तं देवं को भवानिति विस्मितः .. 13 ...
text_mt:
At that time I did not know him, being deluded by him;
then, astonished, I asked that god, ‘Who are you?’

sanskrit_iast:
sa māmuvāca prahasanmamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
na tu māṃ vetsi tattvena jagatāmīśvareśvaram .. 14 ...
meaning:
स मामुवाच प्रहसन्ममेदं सकलं जगत् ..
न तु मां वेत्सि तत्त्वेन जगतामीश्वरेश्वरम् .. 14 ...
text_mt:
Laughing, he said to me: ‘All this world is mine,
but you do not know me in truth, the Lord of lords of the worlds.’

sanskrit_iast:
mayāpyuktaḥ sa deveśo mamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat .. .
vṛthā pralayamadhye te matsamīpe viśeṣataḥ .. 15 ....
meaning:
मयाप्युक्तः स देवेशो ममेदं सकलं जगत् .. .
वृथा प्रलयमध्ये ते मत्समीपे विशेषतः .. 15 ....
text_mt:
And I also said to the Lord of gods: ‘All this world is mine;
your [claim] in the midst of dissolution, especially in my presence, is in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
vipratyayaśca yadi te praviśya jaṭharaṃ mama ..
trailokyamakhilaṃ paśya saṃhṛtaṃ yanmayā svayam .. 16 ..
meaning:
विप्रत्ययश्च यदि ते प्रविश्य जठरं मम ..
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं पश्य संहृतं यन्मया स्वयम् .. 16 ..
text_mt:
And if you have disbelief, enter my belly
and behold the entire three worlds, which have been withdrawn by me myself.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktassa tu mayā tadā kenāpi hetunā ..
praviśya jaṭharaṃ me sa kṣaṇamātrādvinirgataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्स तु मया तदा केनापि हेतुना ..
प्रविश्य जठरं मे स क्षणमात्राद्विनिर्गतः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Having been spoken to thus by me, he, for some reason,
entered my belly and emerged after only a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgamya māmabravīcca dṛṣṭaṃ tribhuvanaṃ mayā..
tavodare jagannātha tvaṃ ca paśya mamodare..18..
meaning:
निर्गम्य मामब्रवीच्च दृष्टं त्रिभुवनं मया..
तवोदरे जगन्नाथ त्वं च पश्य ममोदरे..18..
text_mt:
Having emerged, he said to me: ‘The three worlds were seen by me
in your belly, O Lord of the world; you too look in my belly.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa suṣvāpa bhogibhogāsane tadā..
ahamapyavaśastasya praviṣṭo jaṭharaṃ tadā ..19..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स सुष्वाप भोगिभोगासने तदा..
अहमप्यवशस्तस्य प्रविष्टो जठरं तदा ..19..
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, he then slept on the serpent’s coils;
and I too, helpless, entered his belly at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāmi jagatīṃ brahmansaśailavanakānanām..
sasamudrasariddvīpalokapātālabhūṣitām..1.79.20..
meaning:
पश्यामि जगतीं ब्रह्मन्सशैलवनकाननाम्..
ससमुद्रसरिद्द्वीपलोकपातालभूषिताम्..1.79.20..
text_mt:
I beheld the earth, O brahmin, endowed with mountains, woods, and forests,
adorned with oceans, rivers, continents, worlds, and the nether regions.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pṛthivīṃ tasya tathā jaṭharasaṃsthitām ..
nirgamiṣyanna paśyāmi śarīraṃ tasya bhārgava ..21 ...
meaning:
दृष्ट्वाहं पृथिवीं तस्य तथा जठरसंस्थिताम् ..
निर्गमिष्यन्न पश्यामि शरीरं तस्य भार्गव ..21 ...
text_mt:
Having seen the earth thus situated within his belly,
as I wished to emerge, I could not see his body, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣaṃ prapaśyāmi nirālambaṃ paribhraman ..
paribhramaṇakhinno'smi tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षं प्रपश्यामि निरालम्बं परिभ्रमन् ..
परिभ्रमणखिन्नोऽस्मि तमेव शरणं गतः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
Wandering about, I beheld only the sky without support;
wearied from wandering, I took refuge in him alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tasya paśyāmi randhrahīnaṃ tu vigraham ...
tasya dehādvinirgantuṃ śaktināsīttathā ca me ..23..
meaning:

Then, however, I beheld his body devoid of any aperture,
and thus there was no power for me to emerge from his body.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
रन्ध्रहीनान्महाभाग तमेव शरणं गतः ..
ततोऽहं गतवान्ब्रह्मन्रंन्ध्रं प्राप्तं मयानघ .. 24..
text_mt:
[Finding it] devoid of apertures, O fortunate one, I took refuge in him alone;
then I moved, O brahmin, and an aperture was found by me, O sinless one:

sanskrit_iast:
bālāgrādapi sūkṣmaṃ tattato'haṃ tena nirgataḥ ..
padmanālena niṣkrāntaṃ paśyāmyātmānamātmanā .. 29 ..
meaning:
बालाग्रादपि सूक्ष्मं तत्ततोऽहं तेन निर्गतः ..
पद्मनालेन निष्क्रान्तं पश्याम्यात्मानमात्मना .. 29 ..
text_mt:
finer than the tip of a hair; then I emerged through it.
I beheld myself emerged by myself along the lotus stalk.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhisarasi tatpadmaṃ jātaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ..
śeṣaratnārkaśaivāli vikāsitadalaṃ mahat .. 26 ..
meaning:
नाभिसरसि तत्पद्मं जातं देवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः ..
शेषरत्नार्कशैवालि विकासितदलं महत् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
That lotus was born in the lake of the navel of the god who bears the bow Śārṅga,
with Śeṣa’s jewels as its solar moss, great, with blossomed petals.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'haṃ padmajanmeti loke khyātimupāgataḥ ..||
nābhijātaṃ ca yatpadmaṃ tasya devasya bhārgava .. 27..
meaning:
ततोऽहं पद्मजन्मेति लोके ख्यातिमुपागतः ..||
नाभिजातं च यत्पद्मं तस्य देवस्य भार्गव .. 27..
text_mt:
Then I attained fame in the world as the Lotus-Born.
And the lotus that was born from the navel of that god, O Bhārgava—

sanskrit_iast:
tanmahāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ merustasya ca karṇikā ..
tatrāhaṃ tasya saṃbhūto devadevasya cakriṇaḥ..28..
meaning:
तन्महामण्डलं कृत्स्नं मेरुस्तस्य च कर्णिका ..
तत्राहं तस्य संभूतो देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः..28..
text_mt:
that is the entire great circle of the earth, and Mount Meru is its pericarp.
There I was born from that god of gods, the wielder of the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
devassa viṣṇurjagatāmadhīśaḥ sarveśvaraḥ sarvajagatpradhānaḥ ..
yò bālarūpī bhavatāntakāle dṛṣṭo'sya sarvasya carācarasya .. 29..
meaning:
देवस्स विष्णुर्जगतामधीशः सर्वेश्वरः सर्वजगत्प्रधानः ..
य्ò बालरूपी भवतान्तकाले दृष्टोऽस्य सर्वस्य चराचरस्य .. 29..
text_mt:
That god is Viṣṇu, the sovereign of the worlds, the Lord of all, the chief of the whole universe,
who was seen by you in the form of a child at the time of the dissolution of all this moving and unmoving [creation].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi tasyodarasaṃsthitena mayoṣitaṃ jātakutūhalena ..

meaning:
एवं हि तस्योदरसंस्थितेन मयोषितं जातकुतूहलेन ..
तस्यैव मायापरिमोहितेन कल्पान्तकालेषु सदा नरेन्द्र .. 1.79.30 ..
text_mt:
Thus, dwelling within his belly, I lived filled with wonder,
deluded by his power of illusion at all times of the end of the aeon, O lord of men.”

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
ब्रह्मणोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिमारभ्य सुमहाद्युते ..
कालस्य गतिमिच्छामि श्रोतुं भृगुकुलोद्वह..1..
text_mt:
Vajra said:
“Beginning from this origin of Brahmā, O one of very great splendor,
I wish to hear the course of time, O uplifter of the Bhṛgu race.”
title: adhyāyaḥ 80

sanskrit_iast:

svenāhorātramānena brahmaṇo'sya jagatpateḥ..
samāṣṭakaṃ gataṃ rājanpañcamāsāstathaiva ca.. .. 2..
meaning:

समाष्टकं गतं राजन्पञ्चमासास्तथैव च.. .. 2..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“By his own measure of day and night, of this Brahmā, the Lord of the world,
eight years have passed, O king, and likewise five months,

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātracatuṣkaṃ ca vartamānadinādgatam ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 3 ..
meaning:
अहोरात्रचतुष्कं च वर्तमानदिनाद्गतम् ..
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु .. 3 ..
text_mt:
and four days and nights have passed from the current day.
Hereafter I shall speak; listen to me as I proclaim it:

sanskrit_iast:
manavaḥ ṣaḍ gatāssapta sandhayaśca tathā gatāḥ ..
saptaviṃśadvyatītāśca tathaiva ca caturyugāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
मनवः षड् गतास्सप्त सन्धयश्च तथा गताः ..
सप्तविंशद्व्यतीताश्च तथैव च चतुर्युगाः .. 4 ..
text_mt:
six Manus have passed, and seven twilight intervals have likewise passed,
and twenty-seven four-age cycles have similarly elapsed;

sanskrit_iast:
yugatrayaṃ tathātītaṃ vartamānacaturyugāt ..
saṃvatsarāṇāṃ daśakaṃ tathā kaliyugādgatam .. 5 ..
meaning:
युगत्रयं तथातीतं वर्तमानचतुर्युगात् ..
संवत्सराणां दशकं तथा कलियुगाद्गतम् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
likewise three ages have passed from the current four-age cycle,
and ten years have passed from the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
vātāśvameghakāle'sminsaha yakṣeṇa yādava ..
bhaviṣyāṇāmatītānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ bhūridakṣiṇa .. 6 ..
meaning:
वाताश्वमेघकालेऽस्मिन्सह यक्षेण यादव ..
भविष्याणामतीतानां ब्रह्मणां भूरिदक्षिण .. 6 ..
text_mt:
In this time of the wind, horse, and clouds, together with the yakṣa, O Yādava,
of the past and future Brahmās, O giver of lavish sacrificial gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
anādimattvātkālasya saṃkhyāṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate ..
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsavaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
अनादिमत्त्वात्कालस्य संख्यां वक्तुं न शक्यते ..
गङ्गायाः सिकता धारा यथा वर्षति वासवः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
on account of the beginninglessness of time, it is not possible to state the number.
Just as the sands of the Gaṅgā, or the streams [of rain] when Indra showers,

sanskrit_iast:
śakyā gaṇayituṃ rājanna vyatītā pitāmahāḥ
antavattāṃ budho buddhvā sarvasya jagatīpate .. 8..
meaning:
शक्या गणयितुं राजन्न व्यतीता पितामहाः
अन्तवत्तां बुधो बुद्ध्वा सर्वस्य जगतीपते .. 8..
text_mt:
can be counted, O king, but not the past Grandfathers.
Having understood the finite nature of everything, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmārgaṃ parimārgante yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ..
vajra uvāca .. kiyatkālaparīmāṇaṃ mayā śāsyā vasundharā..9..
meaning:
तन्मार्गं परिमार्गन्ते यद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ..
वज्र उवाच .. कियत्कालपरीमाणं मया शास्या वसुन्धरा..9..
text_mt:
the wise seek that path which is the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.”
Vajra said:
“For what length of time is the earth to be ruled by me

sanskrit_iast:
parikṣitā ca dharmajña tanme brūhi bhṛgūttama..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
adyaprabhṛti rājendra samā pañcāśakaṃ gate..1.80.10..
meaning:
परिक्षिता च धर्मज्ञ तन्मे ब्रूहि भृगूत्तम..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच..
अद्यप्रभृति राजेन्द्र समा पञ्चाशकं गते..1.80.10..
text_mt:
and by Parīkṣit, O knower of dharma? Tell me that, O foremost of the Bhṛgus.”
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“From this day onward, O chief of kings, when fifty years have elapsed,

sanskrit_iast:
parīkṣiti mahārāje divaṃ prāpte kurūddhahe ..
parīkṣiddhīne lokesminprāṇituṃ tvaṃ tu śakyase .. 13 ..
meaning:
परीक्षिति महाराजे दिवं प्राप्ते कुरूद्धहे ..
परीक्षिद्धीने लोकेस्मिन्प्राणितुं त्वं तु शक्यसे .. 13 ..
text_mt:
when the great king Parīkṣit, the uplifter of the Kurus, has attained heaven,
will you be able to live in this world devoid of Parīkṣit?

sanskrit_iast:
mahāprasthānamāviśya nāgalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ..
svargate tvayi rājendra parīkṣiti tathā nṛpe .. 12..
meaning:
महाप्रस्थानमाविश्य नागलोकं गमिष्यसि ..
स्वर्गते त्वयि राजेन्द्र परीक्षिति तथा नृपे .. 12..
text_mt:
Embarking upon the Great Departure, you will go to the world of the serpents.
When you have gone to heaven, O chief of kings, and King Parīkṣit likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
rājā nāgapure bhāvī pārīkṣijjanamejayaḥ ..
mathurāyāṃ tathā bhāvī tava putro'calo nṛpaḥ .. 13 ...
meaning:
राजा नागपुरे भावी पारीक्षिज्जनमेजयः ..
मथुरायां तथा भावी तव पुत्रोऽचलो नृपः .. 13 ...
text_mt:
the son of Parīkṣit, Janamejaya, will become king in the City of the Serpent [Hāstinapura];
and in Mathurā your son, King Acala, will reign.

sanskrit_iast:
nagaraṃ khāṇḍavaprasthaṃ bhayādivinivarjitam ..
pālayiṣyati dharmātmā putraste bhīmavikramaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
नगरं खाण्डवप्रस्थं भयादिविनिवर्जितम् ..
पालयिष्यति धर्मात्मा पुत्रस्ते भीमविक्रमः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Your righteous son of terrible valor will protect
the city of Khāṇḍavaprastha, freed from fear and danger.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavendro mayaḥ pūrvaṃ phālgunena prayāsyatā ..
mahāprasthānamityukto rājaṃstvatpriyakāmyayā .. 15..
meaning:
दानवेन्द्रो मयः पूर्वं फाल्गुनेन प्रयास्यता ..
महाप्रस्थानमित्युक्तो राजंस्त्वत्प्रियकाम्यया .. 15..
text_mt:
Maya, the lord of the Dānavas, was formerly addressed by Arjuna when he was about to set out
upon the Great Departure, O king, out of a desire to do what was pleasing to you:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvajro mahīṃ bhuṅkte khāṇḍavaprasthamāśritaḥ ..
tāvatsabheyaṃ saṃrakṣyā tvayā maduparodhataḥ..16..
meaning:
यावद्वज्रो महीं भुङ्क्ते खाण्डवप्रस्थमाश्रितः ..
तावत्सभेयं संरक्ष्या त्वया मदुपरोधतः..16..
text_mt:
‘As long as Vajra enjoys the earth, having resorted to Khāṇḍavaprastha,
so long must this assembly hall be protected by you at my insistence.’

sanskrit_iast:
seyaṃ saṃrakṣyate tena pratijñāya dhanañjaye ..
tvayi nākamanuprāpte sabheyaṃ mayaśāsanāt .. 17 ..
meaning:
सेयं संरक्ष्यते तेन प्रतिज्ञाय धनञ्जये ..
त्वयि नाकमनुप्राप्ते सभेयं मयशासनात् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Having made that promise to Arjuna, it is protected by him;
when you have reached heaven, by the command of Maya,

sanskrit_iast:
himācalaṃ tu neṣyanti yatra bindusaraṃ saraḥ ..
rākṣasāḥ kiṅkarā nāma yattasmānnirmitā purā .. 18 ..
meaning:
हिमाचलं तु नेष्यन्ति यत्र बिन्दुसरं सरः ..
राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम यत्तस्मान्निर्मिता पुरा .. 18 ..
text_mt:
the rākṣasas named Kiṅkaras will carry this assembly hall to the Himālaya,
where Lake Bindusaras is, because it was constructed from there long ago.”

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ hi te kālagataṃ mayaitadāyuḥpramāṇaṃ ca tathā tavoktam ..
ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan .. 19 ..
meaning:
उक्तं हि ते कालगतं मयैतदायुःप्रमाणं च तथा तवोक्तम् ..
अतः परं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ वदस्व किं ते कथयामि राजन् .. 19 ..
text_mt: For this passage of time has been spoken to you by me, and the measure of life has likewise been told to you. / Beyond this, O best of the upholders of dharma, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
tvayoditānāṃ dharmajña samāsena pṛthakpṛthak ..
kālasyāvayavānāṃ ca śrotumicchāmi devatāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
त्वयोदितानां धर्मज्ञ समासेन पृथक्पृथक् ..
कालस्यावयवानां च श्रोतुमिच्छामि देवताः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / O knower of dharma, I wish to hear, one by one, [about] the deities / of the parts of time described by you in brief.
title: Kalpasādṛśyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pauruṣaṃ yadahorātraṃ śrutavānasi yādava ..
kālātmā puruṣastasya sarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
पौरुषं यदहोरात्रं श्रुतवानसि यादव ..
कालात्मा पुरुषस्तस्य सर्वभूतपतिः प्रभुः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The day and night of the Cosmic Person that you have heard of, O descendant of Yadu— / its sovereign is the Cosmic Person whose self is time, the lord of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpasya daivataṃ brahmā yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
kramānmanvantarāṇāṃ tu manavastu caturdaśa .. 3 ..
meaning:
कल्पस्य दैवतं ब्रह्मा यस्येदं सकलं जगत् ..
क्रमान्मन्वन्तराणां तु मनवस्तु चतुर्दश .. 3 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, to whom this entire world belongs, is the deity of the aeon. / And of the manvantaras in due order, the deities are the fourteen Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyambhuvastu prathamo manuḥ svārociṣastathā ..
vaivasvato'tha sāvarṇirbrahmaputrastathaiva ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
स्वायम्भुवस्तु प्रथमो मनुः स्वारोचिषस्तथा ..
वैवस्वतोऽथ सावर्णिर्ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तथैव च .. 4 ..
text_mt: Svāyambhuva is the first Manu, and likewise Svārociṣa, / then Vaivasvata, Sāvarṇi, and likewise Brahmaputra,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaputro rudraputro dakṣaputraśca yādava ..
raucyo bhautyaśca viśvātmā manavastu caturdaśa ..5..
meaning:
धर्मपुत्रो रुद्रपुत्रो दक्षपुत्रश्च यादव ..
रौच्यो भौत्यश्च विश्वात्मा मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ..5..
text_mt: Dharmaputra, Rudraputra, and Dakṣaputra, O descendant of Yadu, / Raucya, Bhautya, and Viśvātman—the fourteen Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca..
ya ete bhavatā proktā manavaśca caturdaśa ..
nityaṃ brāhme dine prāpte eta eva kramāddvija ..6..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच..
य एते भवता प्रोक्ता मनवश्च चतुर्दश ..
नित्यं ब्राह्मे दिने प्राप्ते एत एव क्रमाद्द्विज ..6..
text_mt: Vajra said: / These fourteen Manus that have been mentioned by you— / when the day of Brahmā constantly arrives, do these very ones in order, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantyutānye dharmajña etanme cchindhi saṃśayam ..
athavā varttamāne'sminbhavatā mama kīrtitāḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
भवन्त्युतान्ये धर्मज्ञ एतन्मे च्छिन्धि संशयम् ..
अथवा वर्त्तमानेऽस्मिन्भवता मम कीर्तिताः .. 7 ..
text_mt: arise, or others, O knower of dharma? Cut away this doubt of mine! / Or were these recounted to me by you [only] in this present [aeon]?

eta eva mahārāja manavastu caturdaśa ..
kalpekalpe tvayā jñeyā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..8..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एत एव महाराज मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ..
कल्पेकल्पे त्वया ज्ञेया नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..8..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / These very fourteen Manus, O great king, / are to be known by you in aeon after aeon; no doubt should be made here.

sanskrit_iast:

kvacitkiṃcidvibhinnāśca māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ ..9 ..
meaning:
एकरूपास्त्रयः कल्पा ज्ञातव्यास्सर्व एव हि ..
क्वचित्किंचिद्विभिन्नाश्च मायया परमेष्ठिनः ..9 ..
text_mt: All three kinds of aeons are to be known as identical in form, / yet slightly different in some respects through the illusory power of Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātavyamekarūpatvamabdānāṃ ca tathā tvayā ..

meaning:
ज्ञातव्यमेकरूपत्वमब्दानां च तथा त्वया ..
कल्पेकल्पे महाराज मनूनां च विशेषतः .. 1.81.10 ..

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ janasādṛśye yuktinaivopapadyate ..
kadācidapi dharmaja tatra paśyāmi kāraṇam .. 11 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
कल्पानां जनसादृश्ये युक्तिनैवोपपद्यते ..
कदाचिदपि धर्मज तत्र पश्यामि कारणम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / In the case of the similarity of living beings across aeons, logic simply does not hold. / O knower of dharma, I never see a reason for that.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminnantare muktiṃ kalpekalpe gate dvija ..
prabhaviṣyajjagacchūnyaṃ kālasyāderabhāvataḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिन्नन्तरे मुक्तिं कल्पेकल्पे गते द्विज ..
प्रभविष्यज्जगच्छून्यं कालस्यादेरभावतः .. 12 ..
text_mt: If in every aeon [even] one [person] attained liberation in an interval, O twice-born, / the world would become empty, since time has no beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
jīvasyānyasya sargeṇa nare muktimupāgate ..
acintyaśaktirbhagavāñjaganpūrayate sadā .. 13 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
जीवस्यान्यस्य सर्गेण नरे मुक्तिमुपागते ..
अचिन्त्यशक्तिर्भगवाञ्जगन्पूरयते सदा .. 13 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When a man attains liberation, through the creation of another living being / the Lord of inconceivable power always fills up the world.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā saha mucyante brahmalokamupāgatāḥ ..
sṛjyante ca mahākalpe tadvidhāścāpare janāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा सह मुच्यन्ते ब्रह्मलोकमुपागताः ..
सृज्यन्ते च महाकल्पे तद्विधाश्चापरे जनाः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Those who have reached the world of Brahmā are liberated along with Brahmā, / and in the great aeon other people of that sort are created.

sanskrit_iast:
te prāptāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yeṣāṃ janma na vidyate ..
samajīvapramāṇāśca sarve kalpāstathā nṛpa ..
brahmaloke viṣṇuloke rudraloke ca ye gatāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
ते प्राप्ताः परमं स्थानं येषां जन्म न विद्यते ..
समजीवप्रमाणाश्च सर्वे कल्पास्तथा नृप ..
ब्रह्मलोके विष्णुलोके रुद्रलोके च ये गताः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Those who have attained the supreme abode have no rebirth. / And all aeons have an equal measure of living beings, O king, / as do those who have gone to the world of Brahmā, the world of Viṣṇu, and the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇulokāssubahavo rudralokāstathaiva ca ..
śvetadvīpagatā ye ca teṣāṃ janma na vidyate .. 16 ..
meaning:
विष्णुलोकास्सुबहवो रुद्रलोकास्तथैव च ..
श्वेतद्वीपगता ये च तेषां जन्म न विद्यते .. 16 ..
text_mt: Very many are the worlds of Viṣṇu, and likewise the worlds of Rudra. / And those who have gone to Śvetadvīpa have no rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
na tu sarveṣu rājendra teṣu muktiḥ prakīrtitā ..
brahmalokopariṣṭācca ye lokā raudravaiṣṇavāḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
न तु सर्वेषु राजेन्द्र तेषु मुक्तिः प्रकीर्तिता ..
ब्रह्मलोकोपरिष्टाच्च ये लोका रौद्रवैष्णवाः .. 17 ..
text_mt: However, liberation is not declared in all of them, O king of kings. / The worlds of Rudra and Viṣṇu that are above the world of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
mayoditāstayorgatvā punarjanma na vidyate ..
mahākalpakṣaye jīvāḥ sarve taṃ parameśvaram .. 18 ..
meaning:
मयोदितास्तयोर्गत्वा पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ..
महाकल्पक्षये जीवाः सर्वे तं परमेश्वरम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: which were declared by me—having gone to those two, there is no rebirth. / At the destruction of the great aeon, all living beings, [merely] reaching that Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyāpi vinivartante vinā jñānena yādava ..
bhūya eva tadā lokānsarge sṛjati tānprabhuḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
प्राप्यापि विनिवर्तन्ते विना ज्ञानेन यादव ..
भूय एव तदा लोकान्सर्गे सृजति तान्प्रभुः .. 19 ..
text_mt: nevertheless return without knowledge, O descendant of Yadu. / Then the Lord creates those worlds again in creation.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpamadhyre tu kalpānte jñānojjhitakalevarāḥ ..
prāpnuvanti paraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 1.81.20 ..
meaning:
कल्पमध्य्रे तु कल्पान्ते ज्ञानोज्झितकलेवराः ..
प्राप्नुवन्ति परं परं स्थानं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 1.81.20 ..
text_mt: In the middle of an aeon or at the end of an aeon, those whose bodies are cast off with knowledge / reach the supreme, supreme abode, that highest step of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvabījānyasargeṇa tatsthānaṃ parameśvaraḥ ..
prapūrayati dharmajña rājankenāpi hetunā .. 21 ..
meaning:
जीवबीजान्यसर्गेण तत्स्थानं परमेश्वरः ..
प्रपूरयति धर्मज्ञ राजन्केनापि हेतुना .. 21 ..
text_mt: Through the creation of other seeds of living beings, the Supreme Lord / fills up that place, O knower of dharma, for a certain reason, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye yo bhedo bhṛgunandana ..
tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me kautukaṃ mahat .. 22 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये यो भेदो भृगुनन्दन ..
तमहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्र मे कौतुकं महत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Although there is similarity among the aeons, what difference there is, O son of Bhṛgu, / that I wish to hear; in that regard, my curiosity is great.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye śṛṇu bhedaṃ narādhipa..
samatīte yathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate .. 23 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये शृणु भेदं नराधिप..
समतीते यथा कल्पे षष्ठे मन्वन्तरे गते .. 23 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Although there is similarity among the aeons, hear the difference, O ruler of men: / in the past aeon, when the sixth manvantara had passed,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamasya caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā ..
yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ ..24..
meaning:
सप्तमस्य चतुर्विंशे राजंस्त्रेतायुगे तदा ..
यदा रामेण समरे सगणो रावणो हतः ..24..
text_mt: then in the twenty-fourth Tretā age of the seventh, O king, / when Rāvaṇa along with his host was slain in battle by Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇaiva tadā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ ..
vartamāne tu yadvṛttaṃ kalpe yadukulodvaha .. 29..
meaning:
रामेणैव तदा राजन्कुम्भकर्णो निपातितः ..
वर्तमाने तु यद्वृत्तं कल्पे यदुकुलोद्वह .. 29..
text_mt: Kumbhakarṇa was struck down then by Rāma alone, O king. / But as to what took place in the present aeon, O scion of the Yadu race:

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya caritaṃ baddhaṃ tadā vālmīkinā śubham ..
atītakalpe yadvṛttaṃ mayā tatkāmyake vane .. 26 ..
meaning:
रामस्य चरितं बद्धं तदा वाल्मीकिना शुभम् ..
अतीतकल्पे यद्वृत्तं मया तत्काम्यके वने .. 26 ..
text_mt: at that time the auspicious deeds of Rāma were composed [in verse] by Vālmīki. / What occurred in the past aeon was recounted by me in the Kāmyaka forest

sanskrit_iast:
yudhiṣṭhirāya kathitaṃ dharmaputrāya pārthiva ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye bheda eṣa taveritaḥ..27..
meaning:
युधिष्ठिराय कथितं धर्मपुत्राय पार्थिव ..
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये भेद एष तवेरितः..27..
text_mt: to Yudhiṣṭhirā, the son of Dharma, O ruler of the earth. / Although there is similarity among the aeons, this difference has been declared to you.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ ca tathā tathā rājannanukramam ..
brahmajanmanisargāśca tathā tasya pṛthagvidhāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
तेषां स्वरूपं च तथा तथा राजन्ननुक्रमम् ..
ब्रह्मजन्मनिसर्गाश्च तथा तस्य पृथग्विधाः .. 28 ..
text_mt: And likewise their essential nature, and likewise their sequence, O king, / and the various kinds of emissions at the birth of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikeyasya lakṣmyāśca tathā devasya śūlinaḥ ..
evamādyāḥ prabhedāstu tvayā jñeyā nu pārthiva ..
kalpādīnāṃ mahārāja cānyatrāpi yadūdvaha .. 29 ..
meaning:
कार्तिकेयस्य लक्ष्म्याश्च तथा देवस्य शूलिनः ..
एवमाद्याः प्रभेदास्तु त्वया ज्ञेया नु पार्थिव ..
कल्पादीनां महाराज चान्यत्रापि यदूद्वह .. 29 ..
text_mt: and of Kārtikeya, of Lakṣmī, and likewise of the trident-bearing god— / such differences are certainly to be known by you, O ruler of the earth, / regarding aeons and the rest, O scion of the Yadus, and elsewhere too, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
sādṛśyabhedāviha bhūmipāla kalpasyakalpasya mayoditau te ..
yugādibhinnasya ca daivatāni vakṣyāmyatastāni nibodha rājan ..1.81.30..
meaning:
सादृश्यभेदाविह भूमिपाल कल्पस्यकल्पस्य मयोदितौ ते ..
युगादिभिन्नस्य च दैवतानि वक्ष्याम्यतस्तानि निबोध राजन् ..1.81.30..
text_mt: The similarity and difference of each aeon have been spoken to you here, O protector of the earth. / Now I shall tell you the deities of [the divisions of time] differentiated into ages and the rest; understand them, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ... ..
bhagavānvāsudevaśca tathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
pradyumraścāniruddhaśca kṛtādīnāṃ ca daivatāḥ .. .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ... ..
भगवान्वासुदेवश्च तथा संकर्षणः प्रभुः ..
प्रद्युम्रश्चानिरुद्धश्च कृतादीनां च दैवताः .. .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Blessed Vāsudeva, and likewise the lord Saṃkarṣaṇa, / Pradyumna, and Aniruddha are the deities of the Kṛta and following [ages].
title: Abdaphalanirdeśaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
tathā khaṇḍayugānīha dvādaśoktāni bhūpate..
ṣaṣṭhābde ca vivartante pañcābdāni pṛthakpṛthak .. 2 ..
meaning:
तथा खण्डयुगानीह द्वादशोक्तानि भूपते..
षष्ठाब्दे च विवर्तन्ते पञ्चाब्दानि पृथक्पृथक् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Likewise, twelve partial ages are spoken of here, O lord of the earth; / in sixty years, they revolve separately as five-year periods.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tava pravakṣyāmi daivatāṃstu pṛthakpṛthak ..
viṣṇurbṛhaspatiśśakro vahnistvaṣṭā tathaiva ca .. 3..
meaning:
तेषां तव प्रवक्ष्यामि दैवतांस्तु पृथक्पृथक् ..
विष्णुर्बृहस्पतिश्शक्रो वह्निस्त्वष्टा तथैव च .. 3..
text_mt: I shall declare their deities to you, each separately: / Viṣṇu, Bṛhaspati, Śakra, Agni, and likewise Tvaṣṭṛ,

sanskrit_iast:
ahirbudhnyaśca pitaro viśvedevā niśākaraḥ ..
indrāgnī caiva nāsatyau bhagaścaiva mahābalaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
अहिर्बुध्न्यश्च पितरो विश्वेदेवा निशाकरः ..
इन्द्राग्नी चैव नासत्यौ भगश्चैव महाबलः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Ahirbudhnya, the ancestors, the Viśvedevas, the moon, / Indra and Agni, the two Nāsatyas, and Bhaga of great might.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dvādaśa te proktā mayā khaṇḍayugeśvarāḥ..
atha ṣaṣṭyabdanāmāni nibodha gadato mama .. 9 ..
meaning:
इति द्वादश ते प्रोक्ता मया खण्डयुगेश्वराः..
अथ षष्ट्यब्दनामानि निबोध गदतो मम .. 9 ..
text_mt: Thus the twelve lords of the partial ages have been told to you by me. / Now understand from me as I recite the names of the sixty years.

sanskrit_iast:
vartamāne tathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate..
tasyaiva ca caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā .. 6 ...
meaning:
वर्तमाने तथा कल्पे षष्ठे मन्वन्तरे गते..
तस्यैव च चतुर्विंशे राजंस्त्रेतायुगे तदा .. 6 ...
text_mt: And in the present aeon, when the sixth manvantara had passed, / then in the twenty-fourth Tretā age of that very one, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ ..
lakṣmaṇena tathā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
यदा रामेण समरे सगणो रावणो हतः ..
लक्ष्मणेन तथा राजन्कुम्भकर्णो निपातितः .. 7 ..
text_mt: when Rāvaṇa along with his host was slain in battle by Rāma, / Kumbhakarṇa was struck down then by Lakṣmaṇa, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklaṃ samārabhya candrārkau vāsavarkṣagau ..
jīvayuktau yadā syātāṃ ṣaṣṭyabdādistadā smṛtaḥ .. 8..
meaning:
माघशुक्लं समारभ्य चन्द्रार्कौ वासवर्क्षगौ ..
जीवयुक्तौ यदा स्यातां षष्ट्यब्दादिस्तदा स्मृतः .. 8..
text_mt: Beginning with the bright [fortnight] of Māgha, when the moon and the sun are in the asterism of the Vasus / together with Jupiter, that is commemorated as the beginning of the sixty-year cycle.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodaśca prajāpatiḥ..
vaiṣṇave tu yuge pañca proktāssaṃvatsarāśśubhāḥ . 9
meaning:
प्रभवो विभवः शुक्लः प्रमोदश्च प्रजापतिः..
वैष्णवे तु युगे पञ्च प्रोक्तास्संवत्सराश्शुभाः . 9
text_mt: Prabhava, Vibhava, Śukla, Pramoda, and Prajāpati— / five auspicious years are declared in the age of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirā śrīmukho bhāvo yuvā dhātā tathaiva ca..
abdo jīvayuge pañca yeṣāmādyāśśubhāstrayaḥ..1.82.10..
meaning:
अङ्गिरा श्रीमुखो भावो युवा धाता तथैव च..
अब्दो जीवयुगे पञ्च येषामाद्याश्शुभास्त्रयः..1.82.10..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Śrīmukha, Bhāva, Yuvan, and likewise Dhātṛ:
these are the five years in the cycle of Jīva, of which the first three are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaro bahudhānyaśca pramāthī vikramo vaśaḥ..
śakrābdāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā yeṣāmādyāvubhau śubhau..11..
meaning:
ईश्वरो बहुधान्यश्च प्रमाथी विक्रमो वशः..
शक्राब्दाः पञ्च निर्दिष्टा येषामाद्यावुभौ शुभौ..11..
text_mt:
Īśvara, Bahudhānya, Pramāthin, Vikrama, and Vaśa:
these are designated as the five years of Śakra, of which the first two are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnissvabhānustaraṇo vāridaśca tathā'vyayaḥ ..
āgneyāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā dvitīyaṃ teṣvaśobhanam .. 12 ..
meaning:
वह्निस्स्वभानुस्तरणो वारिदश्च तथाऽव्ययः ..
आग्नेयाः पञ्च निर्दिष्टा द्वितीयं तेष्वशोभनम् .. 12 ..
text_mt:
Vahni, Svabhānu, Tāraṇa, Vārida, and Avyaya:
these are designated as the five belonging to Agni; among them, the second is inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajitsarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtiḥ kharaḥ ..
tvāṣṭre pañca་ yuge teṣāṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śubhapradam .. 13 ...
meaning:
सर्वजित्सर्वधारी च विरोधी विकृतिः खरः ..
त्वाष्ट्रे पञ्च་ युगे तेषां द्वितीयं तु शुभप्रदम् .. 13 ...
text_mt:
Sarvajit, Sarvadhārin, Virodhin, Vikṛti, and Khara:
these five are in the cycle of Tvaṣṭṛ; among them, the second bestows auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
nandano vijayaścaiva jayaḥ kāmaśca durmukhaḥ ..
āhirbudhnye yuge pañca yeṣāmādyā hitāstrayaḥ ..14 ..
meaning:
नन्दनो विजयश्चैव जयः कामश्च दुर्मुखः ..
आहिर्बुध्न्ये युगे पञ्च येषामाद्या हितास्त्रयः ..14 ..
text_mt:
Nandana, Vijaya, Jaya, Kāma, and Durmukha:
these five are in the cycle of Ahirbudhnya, of which the first three are beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
hemamālī vilambī ca vikārī śarvarī plavaḥ ..
paitrye pañcayuge teṣāṃ pañcamaśca śubhapradaḥ .. 19..
meaning:
हेममाली विलम्बी च विकारी शर्वरी प्लवः ..
पैत्र्ये पञ्चयुगे तेषां पञ्चमश्च शुभप्रदः .. 19..
text_mt:
Hemamālin, Vilambin, Vikārin, Śarvarī, and Plava:
these five are in the cycle of the Pitṛs; among them, the fifth bestows auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
śokakṛcchubhakṛtkrodhī viśvāvasuparāvasū ..
vaiśve pañca śubhā vaiṣāmabdau rājandvipaṃcamau ..16..
meaning:
शोककृच्छुभकृत्क्रोधी विश्वावसुपरावसू ..
वैश्वे पञ्च शुभा वैषामब्दौ राजन्द्विपंचमौ ..16..
text_mt:
Śokakṛt, Śubhakṛt, Krodhin, Viśvāvasu, and Parāvasu:
these five belong to the Viśvedevas; among these, O king, the second and fifth are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
plavaṅgaḥ kīlakassaumyassomo rodhakṛdeva ca ..
saumye pañca śubhāveṣāṃ prathamānantarāvubhau ..17..
meaning:
प्लवङ्गः कीलकस्सौम्यस्सोमो रोधकृदेव च ..
सौम्ये पञ्च शुभावेषां प्रथमानन्तरावुभौ ..17..
text_mt:
Plavaṅga, Kīlaka, Saumya, Soma, and Rodhakṛt:
these five belong to Soma; among these, the two immediately following the first are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāvanaṃ mathanaṃ vīraṃ rākṣasaṃ cānalaṃ tathā ..
indrāgnidaivate pañca sarve eva śubhapradāḥ ..18..
meaning:
धावनं मथनं वीरं राक्षसं चानलं तथा ..
इन्द्राग्निदैवते पञ्च सर्वे एव शुभप्रदाः ..18..
text_mt:
Dhāvana, Mathana, Vīra, Rākṣasa, and Anala:
these five belong to the dual deity Indrāgnī; all of them bestow auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
piṅgalaḥ kālayuktaśca siddhārtho raudradurmatī ..
āśvine'pi yuge pañca caturthasteṣu śasyate ..19..
meaning:
पिङ्गलः कालयुक्तश्च सिद्धार्थो रौद्रदुर्मती ..
आश्विनेऽपि युगे पञ्च चतुर्थस्तेषु शस्यते ..19..
text_mt:
Piṅgala, Kālayukta, Siddhārtha, Raudra, and Durmati:
these five are in the cycle of the Aśvins; among them, the fourth is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
dundubhyaṅgārakau raktaḥ krodhaścāpi kṣayastathā ..
bhāgye pañca śubhāssarve viśeṣeṇa tu pañcamaḥ .. 1.82.20 ...
meaning:
दुन्दुभ्यङ्गारकौ रक्तः क्रोधश्चापि क्षयस्तथा ..
भाग्ये पञ्च शुभास्सर्वे विशेषेण तु पञ्चमः .. 1.82.20 ...
text_mt:
Dundubhi, Aṅgāraka, Rakta, Krodha, and Kṣaya:
these five belong to Bhaga; all are auspicious, but especially the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ cāravaśāddevācāryasya pārthiva ..
dvādaśābdādhipāṃstubhyaṃ kathayāmi phalānvitān .. 21 ..
meaning:
अतः परं चारवशाद्देवाचार्यस्य पार्थिव ..
द्वादशाब्दाधिपांस्तुभ्यं कथयामि फलान्वितान् .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Beyond this, according to the transit of the preceptor of the gods, O ruler of the earth,
I shall tell you of the lords of the twelve years, along with their fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyakṣage jīve varṣaṃ syādvahnidaivatam ..
ahitaṃ tadvinirdiṣṭaṃ godvijāgnyupajīvinām ..22..
meaning:
आग्नेयक्षगे जीवे वर्षं स्याद्वह्निदैवतम् ..
अहितं तद्विनिर्दिष्टं गोद्विजाग्न्युपजीविनाम् ..22..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Agni, the year belongs to the deity Vahni;
it is declared harmful to those who subsist by cattle, twice-born, and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyaraudropage jīve saumyavarṣamudāhṛtam ..
ītayassakalā yatra cānāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ tathā .. 23 ..
meaning:
सौम्यरौद्रोपगे जीवे सौम्यवर्षमुदाहृतम् ..
ईतयस्सकला यत्र चानावृष्टिभयं तथा .. 23 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Soma and Rudra, it is spoken of as a year of Soma,
in which there are all manner of pestilences and fear of drought.

sanskrit_iast:
adityapuṣyage cābdo vijñeyo guru daivataḥ ..
śubhaṅkarī hito loke kṣemārogyasubhikṣadaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
अदित्यपुष्यगे चाब्दो विज्ञेयो गुरु दैवतः ..
शुभङ्करी हितो लोके क्षेमारोग्यसुभिक्षदः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
When it enters the asterisms of Aditi and Puṣya, the year is known to have Guru as its deity;
it creates good, is beneficial to the world, and grants security, health, and abundance of food.

sanskrit_iast:
sārpapaitryopage jīve paitryaṃ varpamudāhatam ..
hārdaṃ vṛṣṭipradaṃ loke śivasaubhikṣyakārakam .. 25 ..
meaning:
सार्पपैत्र्योपगे जीवे पैत्र्यं वर्पमुदाहतम् ..
हार्दं वृष्टिप्रदं लोके शिवसौभिक्ष्यकारकम् .. 25 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of the Serpents and the Pitṛs, the year is spoken of as belonging to the Pitṛs;
it is beloved, brings rain to the world, and causes auspiciousness and abundance of food.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunīdvayahastasthe varṣaṃ bhāgyamudāhṛtam ..
cauraprābalyakaṃ ghoraṃ nārīdaurbalyakārakam .. 26 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुनीद्वयहस्तस्थे वर्षं भाग्यमुदाहृतम् ..
चौरप्राबल्यकं घोरं नारीदौर्बल्यकारकम् .. 26 ..
text_mt:
When it stands in the two Phālgunīs and Hasta, the year is spoken of as belonging to Bhaga;
it brings a terrible prevalence of thieves and causes weakness in women.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāsvātigate jīve tvāṣṭraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
śūkadhānyakṣayakaraḥ śibidhānyavivardhanaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
चित्रास्वातिगते जीवे त्वाष्ट्रः संवत्सरः शुभः ..
शूकधान्यक्षयकरः शिबिधान्यविवर्धनः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters Citrā and Svātī, the year belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ is auspicious;
it causes the destruction of awned grains and increases leguminous grains.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāgnidaivataṃ jīve viśākhāmaitrasaṃsthite ..
yajñakriyāpravṛttānāṃ hitaṃ muditamānavam .. 28 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राग्निदैवतं जीवे विशाखामैत्रसंस्थिते ..
यज्ञक्रियाप्रवृत्तानां हितं मुदितमानवम् .. 28 ..
text_mt:
The year belonging to Indrāgnī occurs when Jīva stands in Viśākhā and Maitra;
it is beneficial to those engaged in sacrificial rites and makes humanity glad.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhāmūlagate jīve śāktamabdamudāhṛtam ..
śūkadhānyakṣayakaraṃ bhūtānāṃ bhayavardhanam .. 29 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठामूलगते जीवे शाक्तमब्दमुदाहृतम् ..
शूकधान्यक्षयकरं भूतानां भयवर्धनम् .. 29 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters Jyeṣṭhā and Mūla, the year is spoken of as belonging to Śakra;
it causes the destruction of awned grains and increases fear among living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhādvayage jīve vaiśvadevamudāhṛtam ..
nāśubhaṃ na śubhaṃ loke rājñāṃ vigrahakārakam .. 1.82.30 ..
meaning:
आषाढाद्वयगे जीवे वैश्वदेवमुदाहृतम् ..
नाशुभं न शुभं लोके राज्ञां विग्रहकारकम् .. 1.82.30 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the two Āṣāḍhās, it is spoken of as belonging to the Viśvedevas;
it is neither inauspicious nor auspicious in the world, and causes conflict among kings.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuvāsavasaṃsthe tu vaiṣṇavaṃ parikīrtitam ..
kṣemasaubhikṣadaṃ loke pāṣaṃḍiparipīḍanam .. 31 ..
meaning:
विष्णुवासवसंस्थे तु वैष्णवं परिकीर्तितम् ..
क्षेमसौभिक्षदं लोके पाषंडिपरिपीडनम् .. 31 ..
text_mt:
When it stands in the asterisms of Viṣṇu and the Vasus, it is proclaimed to belong to Viṣṇu;
it grants security and abundance of food in the world, and torments heretics.

sanskrit_iast:
proṣṭhapadādvayagate jīve vāruṇasaṃsthite ..
pūrvadhānyapradaṃ tvājaṃ paścāddhānyavināśanam .. 32 ..
meaning:
प्रोष्ठपदाद्वयगते जीवे वारुणसंस्थिते ..
पूर्वधान्यप्रदं त्वाजं पश्चाद्धान्यविनाशनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the two Proṣṭhapadās and stands in the asterism of Varuṇa,
the year belonging to Aja grants the early grains, but afterwards destroys the crops.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇāśviyāmyage jīve varṣaṃ syādaśvidaivatam ..
suvṛṣṭikṣemadaṃ loke sarvātaṅkavivarjitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
पौष्णाश्वियाम्यगे जीवे वर्षं स्यादश्विदैवतम् ..
सुवृष्टिक्षेमदं लोके सर्वातङ्कविवर्जितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Pūṣan, the Aśvins, and Yama, the year has the Aśvins as its deities;
it brings abundant rain and security to the world, and is devoid of all distress.

sanskrit_iast:
caitraśuklasamārambhe jagatāṃ jagadīśvara ..
sarvaṃ cakre tadā rājam̐statastasminsadā dine .. 34 ..
meaning:
चैत्रशुक्लसमारम्भे जगतां जगदीश्वर ..
सर्वं चक्रे तदा राजम्̐स्ततस्तस्मिन्सदा दिने .. 34 ..
text_mt:
At the beginning of the bright [half] of Caitra, O lord of the world,
Brahmā fashioned all the worlds then, O king; therefore on that day always,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsareśaḥ kriyate brahmaṇā tu sadā grahaḥ ..
nāgo yajñaśca dharmajña gandharvaśca tathaiva ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरेशः क्रियते ब्रह्मणा तु सदा ग्रहः ..
नागो यज्ञश्च धर्मज्ञ गन्धर्वश्च तथैव च .. 35 ..
text_mt:
the lord of the year is always appointed by Brahmā as a planet,
as well as a serpent, a sacrifice, O knower of dharma, and likewise a gandharva.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta cchinne tu yaḥ śleṣaḥ kalipātasamāgaṇe ..
ādityādissa boddhavyo grahaḥ saṃvatsarādhipaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
सप्त च्छिन्ने तु यः श्लेषः कलिपातसमागणे ..
आदित्यादिस्स बोद्धव्यो ग्रहः संवत्सराधिपः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
When divided by seven, whatever is the remainder in the sum of elapsed years of Kali,
that planet, beginning with the Sun, should be understood as the ruler of the year.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityena sahānanto nāgo bhavati bhūmipa ..
citrāṅgadaśca gandharvo dīrghabhadro niśācaraḥ ..37..
meaning:
आदित्येन सहानन्तो नागो भवति भूमिप ..
चित्राङ्गदश्च गन्धर्वो दीर्घभद्रो निशाचरः ..37..
text_mt:
Together with the Sun, the serpent is Ananta, O ruler of the earth,
the gandharva is Citrāṅgada, and the night-wanderer is Dīrghabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyena vāsukirnāgaḥ pūrṇabhadro niśācaraḥ ..
citrasenaśca gandharvaḥ samāścāmī prakīrtitāḥ ..38..
meaning:
सौम्येन वासुकिर्नागः पूर्णभद्रो निशाचरः ..
चित्रसेनश्च गन्धर्वः समाश्चामी प्रकीर्तिताः ..38..
text_mt:
With the Moon, the serpent is Vāsuki, the night-wanderer is Pūrṇabhadra,
and the gandharva is Citrasena; these are proclaimed for that year.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumena takṣako nāgo maṇibhadro niśācaraḥ ..
tadā citraratho nāma gandharvaścābhiṣicyate .. 39 ..
meaning:
भौमेन तक्षको नागो मणिभद्रो निशाचरः ..
तदा चित्ररथो नाम गन्धर्वश्चाभिषिच्यते .. 39 ..
text_mt:
With Mars, the serpent is Takṣaka, and the night-wanderer is Maṇibhadra;
then the gandharva named Citraratha is consecrated.

sanskrit_iast:
budhena nāgaḥ kārkoṭo yakṣabhadro niśācaraḥ ..
tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate..1.82.40..
meaning:
बुधेन नागः कार्कोटो यक्षभद्रो निशाचरः ..
तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वः समास्वाम्यभिषिच्यते..1.82.40..
text_mt:
With Mercury, the serpent is Kārkoṭa, and the night-wanderer is Yakṣabhadra;
the gandharva named Tumburu is consecrated as master of the year.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvena nāgaḥ padmastu dīrghabāhurniśācaraḥ ..
gandharvaśca mahātejāstathā śāliśiraḥ prabhuḥ .. .. 41 ..
meaning:
जीवेन नागः पद्मस्तु दीर्घबाहुर्निशाचरः ..
गन्धर्वश्च महातेजास्तथा शालिशिरः प्रभुः .. .. 41 ..
text_mt:
With Jīva, the serpent is Padma, and the night-wanderer is Dīrghabāhu;
and the gandharva is the lord Śāliśiras, possessed of great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpadmastu śukreṇa nāgo bhavati bhūpate ..
nāradaścaiva gandharvo mahābāhurniśācaraḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
महापद्मस्तु शुक्रेण नागो भवति भूपते ..
नारदश्चैव गन्धर्वो महाबाहुर्निशाचरः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
With Venus, O king, the serpent is Mahāpadma,
the gandharva is Nārada, and the night-wanderer is Mahābāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
saureṇa nāgaḥ śaṅkhastu mahākarṇo niśācaraḥ ..
ūrṇāyuścaiva gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate .. 43 ..
meaning:
सौरेण नागः शङ्खस्तु महाकर्णो निशाचरः ..
ऊर्णायुश्चैव गन्धर्वः समास्वाम्यभिषिच्यते .. 43 ..
text_mt:
With Saturn, the serpent is Śaṅkha, and the night-wanderer is Mahākarṇa;
and the gandharva Ūrṇāyu is consecrated as master of the year.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi samārūpaṃ mahīpate ..
grahasvāmibhavaṃ tubhyaṃ śeṣāssarve tadāśrayāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि समारूपं महीपते ..
ग्रहस्वामिभवं तुभ्यं शेषास्सर्वे तदाश्रयाः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Hereafter I shall tell you, O king, the nature of the year
arising from the planetary lord; all the rest depend upon that.

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇārkastvalpamatsyaśca gatamegho'tibhāskaraḥ ..
bahunāgavyādhigaṇo bhāskarābdo raṇākulaḥ..45..
meaning:
तीक्ष्णार्कस्त्वल्पमत्स्यश्च गतमेघोऽतिभास्करः ..
बहुनागव्याधिगणो भास्कराब्दो रणाकुलः..45..
text_mt:
The year of the Sun has fierce sunshine, few fish, departed clouds, intense light,
and hosts of many serpents and hunters, and is troubled by war.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvarṣo'tisasyaśca gavākṣīrapradāyakaḥ..
candrābdaḥ kāmināmiṣṭaḥ cityaṅkitamahītalaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
बहुवर्षोऽतिसस्यश्च गवाक्षीरप्रदायकः..
चन्द्राब्दः कामिनामिष्टः चित्यङ्कितमहीतलः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
The year of the Moon brings much rain, abundant crops, yields milk from cows,
is dear to lovers, and has the surface of the earth marked by sacrificial altars.

sanskrit_iast:
agnitaskararogāḍhyo nṛpavigrahadāyakaḥ ..
gatasasyo bahuvyālo bhaumābdo bālahā bhṛśam ..47..
meaning:
अग्नितस्कररोगाढ्यो नृपविग्रहदायकः ..
गतसस्यो बहुव्यालो भौमाब्दो बालहा भृशम् ..47..
text_mt:
The year of Mars is filled with fire, thieves, and diseases, causes conflicts among kings,
has perished crops, many wild beasts, and severely slays children.

sanskrit_iast:
viprakṣatriyasasyānāṃ janānāṃ ca kalābhṛtām ..
buddhiprado'bdo bauddhastu bahusasyākaraḥ kṣitau .. 48 ..
meaning:
विप्रक्षत्रियसस्यानां जनानां च कलाभृताम् ..
बुद्धिप्रदोऽब्दो बौद्धस्तु बहुसस्याकरः क्षितौ .. 48 ..
text_mt:
The year of Mercury grants intellect to brahmins, kṣatriyas, and people who practice the arts,
and produces an abundance of crops upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuyajño'tisasyaśca gogajāśvahitastathā ..
bahuvṛṣṭipradaḥ saumyo jīvābdo dvijapuṣṭidaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
बहुयज्ञोऽतिसस्यश्च गोगजाश्वहितस्तथा ..
बहुवृष्टिप्रदः सौम्यो जीवाब्दो द्विजपुष्टिदः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
The year of Jīva has many sacrifices, abundant crops, benefits cows, elephants, and horses,
brings much rain, is gentle, and nourishes the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sasyāḍhyo dharmabahulo gatātaṃko bahūdakaḥ ..
kāmināṃ kāmadaḥ kāmaḥ sitābdo nṛpaśarmadaḥ .. 1.82.50 ..
meaning:
सस्याढ्यो धर्मबहुलो गतातंको बहूदकः ..
कामिनां कामदः कामः सिताब्दो नृपशर्मदः .. 1.82.50 ..
text_mt:
The year of Venus is rich in crops, full of dharma, free of distress, has abundant water,
fulfills desires for lovers, is desirable, and grants comfort to kings.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣamarakānrogānkaroti pavanastathā ..
śanaiścarābdaḥ śokāṃśca vigrahāṇi ca bhūbhujām .. 51 ..
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षमरकान्रोगान्करोति पवनस्तथा ..
शनैश्चराब्दः शोकांश्च विग्रहाणि च भूभुजाम् .. 51 ..
text_mt:
The year of Saturn causes famine, pestilences, diseases, winds,
sorrows, and conflicts among rulers of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa parivarttante pañca yādava vatsarāḥ ..
teṣāmadhipatīnvakṣye nāmāni ca phalāni ca .. 52 ..
meaning:
क्रमेण परिवर्त्तन्ते पञ्च यादव वत्सराः ..
तेषामधिपतीन्वक्ष्ये नामानि च फलानि च .. 52 ..
text_mt:
In succession, O Yādava, the five years revolve;
I shall tell of their lords, their names, and their fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca bhakte tu yaccheṣaṃ tiṣṭhedabdagaṇe gate ..
saṃvatsarādyaḥ saṃjñeyo nityaṃ saṃvatsaro budhaiḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
पञ्च भक्ते तु यच्छेषं तिष्ठेदब्दगणे गते ..
संवत्सराद्यः संज्ञेयो नित्यं संवत्सरो बुधैः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
When divided by five, whatever remainder stands from the group of elapsed years,
the wise should always understand the first year beginning with Saṃvatsara.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaḥ saṃvatsaro nāma dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ ..
iḍākhyaśca tṛtīyo'tra caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ ..
idvatsarākhyaḥ kathitaḥ tathā caivātra pañcamaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
आद्यः संवत्सरो नाम द्वितीयः परिवत्सरः ..
इडाख्यश्च तृतीयोऽत्र चतुर्थश्चानुवत्सरः ..
इद्वत्सराख्यः कथितः तथा चैवात्र पञ्चमः .. 54 ..
text_mt: The first is named Saṃvatsara, the second is Parivatsara, / and the third here is named Iḍā, while the fourth is Anuvatsara; / and the fifth here is declared to be named Idvatsara.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaro'gniḥ parivatsaro'rka iḍābhidhāno bhagavāñchaśāṅkaḥ ..
brahmā svayaṃbhūranuvatsaro'pi idvatsaraḥ śailasutāpatiśca .. 55 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरोऽग्निः परिवत्सरोऽर्क इडाभिधानो भगवाञ्छशाङ्कः ..
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरनुवत्सरोऽपि इद्वत्सरः शैलसुतापतिश्च .. 55 ..
text_mt: Saṃvatsara is Agni, Parivatsara is the Sun, the one named Iḍā is the lord Moon, / Anuvatsara is Brahmā the Self-existent, and Idvatsara is the husband of the daughter of the Mountain [Śiva].

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣṭiḥ samākhye kathitā dvitīye prabhūtatoyā kathitā tṛtīye ..
paścājjalaṃ muñcati yaścaturthaḥ svalpodakaṃ paṃcamamabdamuktam .. 56 ..
meaning:
वृष्टिः समाख्ये कथिता द्वितीये प्रभूततोया कथिता तृतीये ..
पश्चाज्जलं मुञ्चति यश्चतुर्थः स्वल्पोदकं पंचममब्दमुक्तम् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Rain is declared in the second, named [Parivatsara]; abundant water is declared in the third; / the fourth is one that releases water late; and the fifth year is said to have very little water.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
uttaraṃ tvayanaṃ divyaṃ paitryaṃ syāddakṣiṇāyanam ..
vasantaścāgnidaivatyaḥ śākro grīṣma udāhṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
उत्तरं त्वयनं दिव्यं पैत्र्यं स्याद्दक्षिणायनम् ..
वसन्तश्चाग्निदैवत्यः शाक्रो ग्रीष्म उदाहृतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The northern course of the sun (uttarāyaṇa) is divine, while the southern course (dakṣiṇāyana) belongs to the ancestors; / spring has Agni as its deity, and summer is declared to belong to Śakra;
title: Māhātmyavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevī tathā prāvṛṭprājāpatyā śaratsmṛtā ..
hemanto vaiṣṇavaḥ prokto mārutaḥ śiśiraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवी तथा प्रावृट्प्राजापत्या शरत्स्मृता ..
