हेमन्तो वैष्णवः प्रोक्तो मारुतः शिशिरः स्मृतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: the rainy season belongs to the Viśvedevas, autumn is remembered as belonging to Prajāpati, / winter (hemanta) is declared to belong to Viṣṇu, and the cold season (śiśira) is remembered as belonging to Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṣṭraścaitrastu vaiśākho māsaścaivāgnidaivataḥ ..
jyeṣṭhaśśākrassmṛto māsa āṣāḍho vaiśvadaivataḥ ..3..
meaning:
त्वाष्ट्रश्चैत्रस्तु वैशाखो मासश्चैवाग्निदैवतः ..
ज्येष्ठश्शाक्रस्स्मृतो मास आषाढो वैश्वदैवतः ..3..
text_mt: Caitra belongs to Tvaṣṭṛ, and the month of Vaiśākha has Agni as its deity; / Jyeṣṭha is remembered as belonging to Śakra, and Āṣāḍha has the Viśvedevas as its deities;

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇo viśvadaivatya ājo bhādrapadastathā..
aśvayuktāśvino māsa āgneyaḥ kārttikaḥ smṛtaḥ 4...
meaning:
श्रावणो विश्वदैवत्य आजो भाद्रपदस्तथा..
अश्वयुक्ताश्विनो मास आग्नेयः कार्त्तिकः स्मृतः 4...
text_mt: Śrāvaṇa has the Viśvedevas as its deity, and Bhādrapada belongs to Aja Ekapād; / the month of Āśvina belongs to the Aśvins, and Kārttika is remembered as belonging to Agni;

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣastathā saumyaḥ pauṣasyājjīvadaivataḥ..
paitryo māsassmṛto māghaḥ phālguno bhagadaivataḥ..5..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षस्तथा सौम्यः पौषस्याज्जीवदैवतः..
पैत्र्यो मासस्स्मृतो माघः फाल्गुनो भगदैवतः..5..
text_mt: Mārgaśīrṣa likewise belongs to Soma, Pauṣa belongs to Bṛhaspati, / the month of Māgha is remembered as belonging to the ancestors, and Phālguna has Bhaga as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
māseṣu māsadaivatyā śuklapakṣāḥ prakīrttitāḥ..
vakṣyāmi kṛṣṇapakṣāṇāṃ daivatāni tavānagha .. 6 ..
meaning:
मासेषु मासदैवत्या शुक्लपक्षाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः..
वक्ष्यामि कृष्णपक्षाणां दैवतानि तवानघ .. 6 ..
text_mt: Among the months, the bright fortnights are proclaimed to have the deities of those months; / I will tell you, O sinless one, the deities of the dark fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
caitro yāmyassmṛto rājannāgneyaścāpyanantaraḥ ..
jyeṣṭho raudraḥ smṛtaḥ pakṣastvāṣāḍhaḥ sārpa ucyate .. 7 ..
meaning:
चैत्रो याम्यस्स्मृतो राजन्नाग्नेयश्चाप्यनन्तरः ..
ज्येष्ठो रौद्रः स्मृतः पक्षस्त्वाषाढः सार्प उच्यते .. 7 ..
text_mt: Caitra is remembered as belonging to Yama, O king, and the subsequent one belongs to Agni; / the fortnight of Jyeṣṭha is remembered as belonging to Rudra, and Āṣāḍha is said to belong to the Serpents;

sanskrit_iast:
paitraśca śrāvaṇo māsaḥ sāvitraścāpyanantaraḥ ..
maitraścāśvayujo māsaḥ śākraścāpyagnidaivataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
पैत्रश्च श्रावणो मासः सावित्रश्चाप्यनन्तरः ..
मैत्रश्चाश्वयुजो मासः शाक्रश्चाप्यग्निदैवतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: the month of Śrāvaṇa belongs to the ancestors, and the subsequent one belongs to Savitṛ; / the month of Āśvina belongs to Mitra, and [the dark fortnight of] Kārttika has Agni as its deity;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca nairṛtaḥ saumyaḥ pauṣaḥ syādviṣṇudaivataḥ ..
vāruṇaśca tathā paitraḥ phālgunaḥ pauṣṇa ucyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
तथा च नैरृतः सौम्यः पौषः स्याद्विष्णुदैवतः ..
वारुणश्च तथा पैत्रः फाल्गुनः पौष्ण उच्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt: Mārgaśīrṣa belongs to Nirṛti, Pauṣa belongs to Viṣṇu, / Māgha belongs to Varuṇa, and Phālguna is said to belong to Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaddevo yadgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
agnirarkassmṛtassomo varuṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ..1.83.10..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्देवो यद्ग्रहः स्मृतः ..
अग्निरर्कस्स्मृतस्सोमो वरुणः परिकीर्तितः..1.83.10..
text_mt: Hereafter I shall declare which planet is considered to correspond to which deity: / the Sun is remembered as Agni, and the Moon is proclaimed to be Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgārakaḥ kumāraśca budhaśca bhagavānhariḥ ..
bṛhaspatissmṛtaḥ śakraḥ śukro devī ca pārvatī .. 11 ..
meaning:
अङ्गारकः कुमारश्च बुधश्च भगवान्हरिः ..
बृहस्पतिस्स्मृतः शक्रः शुक्रो देवी च पार्वती .. 11 ..
text_mt: Mars is Kumāra, and Mercury is the blessed Hari; / Jupiter is remembered as Śakra, and Venus is the goddess Pārvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatiśśanaiścāro rāhujñeṃyo gaṇādhipaḥ ..
viśvakarmā smṛtaḥ keturye grahāste puraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रजापतिश्शनैश्चारो राहुज्ञेंयो गणाधिपः ..
विश्वकर्मा स्मृतः केतुर्ये ग्रहास्ते पुरः स्मृताः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Saturn is Prajāpati, Rāhu is known as the lord of the Gaṇas [Gaṇeśa], / and Ketu is remembered as Viśvakarman; these are remembered above as the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava nakṣatradaivatāḥ ..
kṛttikā cāgnidaivatyā rohiṇyarkeśvarā smṛtā .. 13 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव नक्षत्रदैवताः ..
कृत्तिका चाग्निदैवत्या रोहिण्यर्केश्वरा स्मृता .. 13 ..
text_mt: Hereafter I shall declare to you the deities of the lunar mansions (nakṣatras): / Kṛttikā has Agni as its deity, and Rohiṇī is remembered as having Prajāpati as its lord;

sanskrit_iast:
indvarkṣaḥ saumyadaivatyo raudrī ārdrā tathā smṛtā ..
punarvasustathādityo puṣyaśca gurudaivataḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
इन्द्वर्क्षः सौम्यदैवत्यो रौद्री आर्द्रा तथा स्मृता ..
पुनर्वसुस्तथादित्यो पुष्यश्च गुरुदैवतः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Mṛgaśīrṣa has Soma as its deity, and Ārdrā is likewise remembered as belonging to Rudra; / Punarvasu belongs to Aditi, and Puṣya has Guru [Bṛhaspati] as its deity;

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣā sarpadaivatyā maghā ca pitṛdaivatā ..
bhāgyāśca pūrvaphālgunya āryamāśca tathottarāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
आश्लेषा सर्पदैवत्या मघा च पितृदैवता ..
भाग्याश्च पूर्वफाल्गुन्य आर्यमाश्च तथोत्तराः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Āśleṣā has the Serpents as deities, and Maghā has the ancestors as deities; / Pūrvaphālgunī belongs to Bhaga, and Uttaraphālgunī belongs to Aryaman;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitraśca tathā hastaścitrā tvāṣṭrī prakīrtitā ..
svātiśca vāyudaivatyā nakṣatre parikīrtitā .. 16 ..
meaning:
सावित्रश्च तथा हस्तश्चित्रा त्वाष्ट्री प्रकीर्तिता ..
स्वातिश्च वायुदैवत्या नक्षत्रे परिकीर्तिता .. 16 ..
text_mt: Hasta belongs to Savitṛ, Citrā is proclaimed to belong to Tvaṣṭṛ, / and the lunar mansion Svātī is proclaimed to have Vāyu as its deity;

sanskrit_iast:
indrāgnīdaivatā proktā viśākhā yadunandana ..
maitramṛkṣamanūrādhā śākraṃ jyeṣṭhā prakīrtitā .. 17 ..
meaning:
इन्द्राग्नीदैवता प्रोक्ता विशाखा यदुनन्दन ..
मैत्रमृक्षमनूराधा शाक्रं ज्येष्ठा प्रकीर्तिता .. 17 ..
text_mt: Viśākhā is declared to have Indra and Agni as deities, O delight of the Yadus; / Anurādhā is the mansion belonging to Mitra, and Jyeṣṭhā is proclaimed to belong to Śakra;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā nairṛtyadaivatyo mūlañca tadudāhṛtam ..
āpyastvāṣāḍhapūrvāḥ syuścottarā vaiśvadaivatāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
तथा नैरृत्यदैवत्यो मूलञ्च तदुदाहृतम् ..
आप्यस्त्वाषाढपूर्वाः स्युश्चोत्तरा वैश्वदैवताः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Mūla is declared to have Nirṛti as its deity; / Pūrvāṣāḍhā belongs to Āpas (the Waters), and Uttarāṣāḍhā has the Viśvedevas as deities;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī caivābhijitproktā śravaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
vāsavaṃ ca tathā ṛkṣaṃ dhaniṣṭhā procyate budhaiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मी चैवाभिजित्प्रोक्ता श्रवणो वैष्णवः स्मृतः ..
वासवं च तथा ऋक्षं धनिष्ठा प्रोच्यते बुधैः .. 19 ..
text_mt: Abhijit is declared to belong to Brahmā, Śravaṇa is remembered as belonging to Viṣṇu, / and Dhaniṣṭhā is proclaimed by the wise to be the mansion belonging to the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śatabhiṣakproktaṃ nakṣatre vāruṇaṃ nṛpa ..
ājaṃ bhadrāpadāpūrvā āhirbudhnyaṃ tathottarā .. 1.83.20 ..
meaning:
तथा शतभिषक्प्रोक्तं नक्षत्रे वारुणं नृप ..
आजं भद्रापदापूर्वा आहिर्बुध्न्यं तथोत्तरा .. 1.83.20 ..
text_mt: Śatabhiṣaj is declared to be the lunar mansion belonging to Varuṇa, O king; / Pūrvabhādrapadā belongs to Aja Ekapād, and Uttarabhādrapadā belongs to Ahirbudhnya;

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇaṃ ca revatī cārkṣamaśvinī cāśvidaivatam ..
bharaṇyaśca tathā yāmya proktāste ṛkṣadaivatāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
पौष्णं च रेवती चार्क्षमश्विनी चाश्विदैवतम् ..
भरण्यश्च तथा याम्य प्रोक्तास्ते ऋक्षदैवताः .. 21 ..
text_mt: the mansion Revatī belongs to Pūṣan, and Aśvinī has the Aśvins as deities; / Bharaṇī belongs to Yama: thus are declared the deities of the lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā prajāpatirviṣṇuryamassomastathaiva ca ..
kumāro munayassapta hyaṣṭau ca manavastathā .. 22 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिर्विष्णुर्यमस्सोमस्तथैव च ..
कुमारो मुनयस्सप्त ह्यष्टौ च मनवस्तथा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Brahmā, Prajāpati, Viṣṇu, Yama, and likewise Soma, / Kumāra, the seven sages, and the eight Manus,

sanskrit_iast:
piśācaśca tathā dharmo rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ..
ādityā dvādaśa tathā kāmadevastathaiva ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
पिशाचश्च तथा धर्मो रुद्राश्चैकादश स्मृताः ..
आदित्या द्वादश तथा कामदेवस्तथैव च .. 23 ..
text_mt: Piśāca, Dharma, and the eleven Rudras are remembered, / as well as the twelve Ādityas, and Kāmadeva,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣāśca pitaraścaiva pratipatprabhṛtirnṛpa ..
tithīśvarāstathā proktā karaṇānnāmataḥ śṛṇu .. 24 ..
meaning:
यक्षाश्च पितरश्चैव प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिर्नृप ..
तिथीश्वरास्तथा प्रोक्ता करणान्नामतः शृणु .. 24 ..
text_mt: and the Yakṣas, and the ancestors, beginning with the first lunar day (pratipad), O king, / are thus declared to be the lords of the lunar days (tithis). Now hear the divisions of the half-day (karaṇas) by name.

sanskrit_iast:
tithyardhabhogi karaṇaṃ sadā bhavati pārthiva ..
sthirāṇi teṣāṃ catvāri sapta viddhi carāṇi ca .. 25 ..
meaning:
तिथ्यर्धभोगि करणं सदा भवति पार्थिव ..
स्थिराणि तेषां चत्वारि सप्त विद्धि चराणि च .. 25 ..
text_mt: A karaṇa always endures for half a lunar day, O earth-ruler; / know that four of them are fixed and seven are movable.

sanskrit_iast:
ante kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ dvitīye śakuniḥ smṛtaḥ ..
prathame pañcadaśyardhe kṛṣṇe proktaṃ catuṣpadam .. 26 ..
meaning:
अन्ते कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां द्वितीये शकुनिः स्मृतः ..
प्रथमे पञ्चदश्यर्धे कृष्णे प्रोक्तं चतुष्पदम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: At the end, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, in the second half, Śakuni is remembered; / in the first half of the fifteenth day in the dark fortnight, Catuṣpada is declared;

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva cāpare rājannāgākhyaṃ karaṇaṃ matam ..
śuklapratipadārdhe tu kiṃstughnaṃ karaṇaṃ matam ..27..
meaning:
तस्यैव चापरे राजन्नागाख्यं करणं मतम् ..
शुक्लप्रतिपदार्धे तु किंस्तुघ्नं करणं मतम् ..27..
text_mt: and in the second half of that same [day], O king, the karaṇa named Nāga is accepted; / in the first half of the bright pratipad, the karaṇa Kiṃstughna is accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni rājanproktāni sthirāṇi karaṇāni tu ..
kalirdharmastathā sarpo yeṣāṃ vāyuśca daivatama..28..
meaning:
एतानि राजन्प्रोक्तानि स्थिराणि करणानि तु ..
कलिर्धर्मस्तथा सर्पो येषां वायुश्च दैवतम..28..
text_mt: These, O king, are declared to be the fixed karaṇas, / whose deities are Kali, Dharma, the Serpent, and Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: śuklapratipādārdhe tu dvitīye yadunandana..29..
meaning: शुक्लप्रतिपादार्धे तु द्वितीये यदुनन्दन..29..
text_mt: Now, in the second half of the bright pratipad, O delight of the Yadus,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ ca tathā hyardhe tvaṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā pare ..
dvādaśyardhe tathā pūrve paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā pare..1.83.30..
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां च तथा ह्यर्धे त्वष्टम्यां च तथा परे ..
द्वादश्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे पौर्णमास्यां तथा परे..1.83.30..
text_mt: and likewise in the [first] half of the fifth, and in the second [half] of the eighth, / and in the first half of the twelfth, and in the second [half] of the full-moon day,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣacaturthyāṃ tu prathame'rdhe tathaiva ca ..
saptamyāṃ cāpare tvardhe hyekādaśyāṃ tathādyake..31..
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षचतुर्थ्यां तु प्रथमेऽर्धे तथैव च ..
सप्तम्यां चापरे त्वर्धे ह्येकादश्यां तथाद्यके..31..
text_mt: and on the fourth day of the dark fortnight, in the first half likewise, / and in the second half of the seventh, and in the first [half] of the eleventh:

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇaṃ tu bavaṃ nāma kathitaṃ śakradaivatam ..
dvitīyārdhe tathādye tu pañcamyarthe tathā pare .. 32 ..
meaning:
करणं तु बवं नाम कथितं शक्रदैवतम् ..
द्वितीयार्धे तथाद्ये तु पञ्चम्यर्थे तथा परे .. 32 ..
text_mt: the karaṇa named Bava is declared to have Śakra as its deity. / In the second half of the second [lunar day], and in the first half of the third, and in the second half of the fifth,

sanskrit_iast:
naktasyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare ..
kṛṣṇapratipadādyārdhe caturthyardhe tathā pare..33..
meaning:
नक्तस्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे द्वादश्यर्धे तथा परे ..
कृष्णप्रतिपदाद्यार्धे चतुर्थ्यर्धे तथा परे..33..
text_mt: and in the first half of the ninth, and in the second half of the twelfth, / in the first half of the dark pratipad, and in the second half of the fourth,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyardhe tathā pūrve hyekādaśyāṃ tathāpare ..
bālavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ brahmadaivatam .. 34 ..
meaning:
अष्टम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे ह्येकादश्यां तथापरे ..
बालवं नाम करणं कथितं ब्रह्मदैवतम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: and in the first half of the eighth, and in the second [half] of the eleventh: / the karaṇa named Bālava is declared to have Brahmā as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe dvitīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathame tathā ..
navamyardhe tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake .. 35 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे द्वितीयार्धे षष्ठ्यर्थे प्रथमे तथा ..
नवम्यर्धे तथैवान्ते त्रयोदश्यां तथाद्यके .. 35 ..
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, in the second half [of the third day], and in the first half of the sixth, / and in the second half of the ninth, and in the first [half] of the thirteenth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapratipadārdhe tu pañcamyāṃ prathame tathā ..
dvitīyārdhe tathāṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ prathame tathā ..36..
meaning:
कृष्णप्रतिपदार्धे तु पञ्चम्यां प्रथमे तथा ..
द्वितीयार्धे तथाष्टम्यां द्वादश्यां प्रथमे तथा ..36..
text_mt: and in the second half of the dark pratipad, and in the first half of the fifth, / and in the second half of the eighth, and in the first [half] of the twelfth:

sanskrit_iast:
kaulavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mitradaivatam ..
ādye śuklaṃ tṛtīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare .. 37 ..
meaning:
कौलवं नाम करणं कथितं मित्रदैवतम् ..
आद्ये शुक्लं तृतीयार्धे षष्ठ्यर्धे च तथा परे .. 37 ..
text_mt: the karaṇa named Kaulava is declared to have Mitra as its deity. / In the first half of the bright third, and in the second half of the sixth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadvitīyāprathame pañcamyardhe tathā pare ..
navamyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare ..38..
meaning:
कृष्णद्वितीयाप्रथमे पञ्चम्यर्धे तथा परे ..
नवम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे द्वादश्यर्धे तथा परे ..38..
text_mt: and in the first [half] of the dark second, and in the second half of the fifth, / and in the first half of the ninth, and in the second half of the twelfth:

sanskrit_iast:
tautilaṃ nāma karaṇamāryamṇaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ..
ante śuklatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā..39..
meaning:
तौतिलं नाम करणमार्यम्णं कथितं बुधैः ..
अन्ते शुक्लतृतीयार्धे सप्तम्यां प्रथमे तथा..39..
text_mt: the karaṇa named Taitila is declared by the wise to belong to Aryaman. / In the second half of the bright third, and in the first [half] of the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyardhe tathaivānte caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake ..
kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyānte ṣaṣṭhyardhe prathame tathā..1.83.40..
meaning:
दशम्यर्धे तथैवान्ते चतुर्दश्यां तथाद्यके ..
कृष्णपक्षद्वितीयान्ते षष्ठ्यर्धे प्रथमे तथा..1.83.40..
text_mt: In the second half of the tenth, and likewise in the second [half of the eleventh], and in the first of the fourteenth, / in the second [half] of the second of the dark fortnight, and in the first half of the sixth,

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ ca tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake..
garābhidhānaṃ karaṇaṃ pṛthivīdaivataṃ smṛtam..41..
meaning:
नवम्यां च तथैवान्ते त्रयोदश्यां तथाद्यके..
गराभिधानं करणं पृथिवीदैवतं स्मृतम्..41..
text_mt: and likewise in the second [half] of the ninth, and in the first of the thirteenth— / the karaṇa named Gara is stated to have the Earth as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣacaturthyardhe saptamyāṃ ca tathā pare ..
ekādaśyāṃ tathā pūrve caturdaśyāṃ tathā pare .. 42 ..
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षचतुर्थ्यर्धे सप्तम्यां च तथा परे ..
एकादश्यां तथा पूर्वे चतुर्दश्यां तथा परे .. 42 ..
text_mt: In the [first] half of the fourth of the bright fortnight, and in the second [half] of the seventh, / in the first [half] of the eleventh, and in the second of the fourteenth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇatṛtīyāprathame ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare ..
daśamyardhe tathā pūrve trayodaśyāṃ tathā pare .. 43 ..
meaning:
कृष्णतृतीयाप्रथमे षष्ठ्यर्धे च तथा परे ..
दशम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे त्रयोदश्यां तथा परे .. 43 ..
text_mt: in the first [half] of the third of the dark fortnight, and in the second half of the sixth, / in the first half of the tenth, and in the second [half] of the thirteenth—

sanskrit_iast:
vaṇijaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ śrīdevamabhidhīyate ..
śuklapakṣe caturthyante hyaṣṭamyāṃ prathame tathā .. 44 ..
meaning:
वणिजं नाम करणं श्रीदेवमभिधीयते ..
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यन्ते ह्यष्टम्यां प्रथमे तथा .. 44 ..
text_mt: the karaṇa named Vaṇij is proclaimed to have Śrī as its deity. / At the end of the fourth in the bright fortnight, and in the first [half] of the eighth,

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyapare cārdhe paurṇamāsyāṃ tathādyake ..
ante kṛṣṇatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā .. 45 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यपरे चार्धे पौर्णमास्यां तथाद्यके ..
अन्ते कृष्णतृतीयार्धे सप्तम्यां प्रथमे तथा .. 45 ..
text_mt: and in the second half of the eleventh, and in the first of the full moon day, / at the end of the half of the third of the dark fortnight, and in the first of the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye ca daśamyardhe caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake..
viṣṭirityeva karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mṛtyudaivatam .. 46 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये च दशम्यर्धे चतुर्दश्यां तथाद्यके..
विष्टिरित्येव करणं कथितं मृत्युदैवतम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: and in the second half of the tenth, and in the first [half] of the fourteenth— / the karaṇa [called] Viṣṭi is stated to have Death as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakarmasu rājendra sarvadā garhitaṃ ca tat ..
caturviṃśatyahorātre rājanhorāḥ prakīrttitāḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
सर्वकर्मसु राजेन्द्र सर्वदा गर्हितं च तत् ..
चतुर्विंशत्यहोरात्रे राजन्होराः प्रकीर्त्तिताः .. 47 ..
text_mt: And that is always censured in all actions, O king of kings. / In a day and night, O king, twenty-four horās are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
graheśadevagandharvanāgayakṣeśvaraprabhāḥ ..
sūryodayādathārabhya dinapādyāḥ krameṇa tāḥ..48..
meaning:
ग्रहेशदेवगन्धर्वनागयक्षेश्वरप्रभाः ..
सूर्योदयादथारभ्य दिनपाद्याः क्रमेण ताः..48..
text_mt: They have the splendours of planetary lords, gods, gandharvas, nāgas, and yakṣa lords. / Beginning from sunrise, they are headed by the lord of the day in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhakrameṇa ca tathā kramaṃ tāsāṃ nibodha me..
arkaśukrarkṣarātrīśa saurajīvakujeśvarāḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
षष्ठक्रमेण च तथा क्रमं तासां निबोध मे..
अर्कशुक्रर्क्षरात्रीश सौरजीवकुजेश्वराः .. 49 ..
text_mt: And learn from me their order according to the sixth [day's lord]: / the lords of the Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāṃ ca tathā kālaṃ rāhurbhuṅkte mahāgrahaḥ ..
kulikaśca tathā nāgo yakṣaḥ padmo'tiviśrutaḥ .. 1.83.50 ..
meaning:
सर्वासां च तथा कालं राहुर्भुङ्क्ते महाग्रहः ..
कुलिकश्च तथा नागो यक्षः पद्मोऽतिविश्रुतः .. 1.83.50 ..
text_mt: And the great planet Rāhu consumes a portion of time of all of them; / so too the nāga Kulika, and the yakṣa Padma celebrated by many,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāraparṇaśca tathā gandharvaścābhidhīyate ..
kulikasya tu yā velā sā varjyā sarvakarmasu .. 51 ..
meaning:
अङ्गारपर्णश्च तथा गन्धर्वश्चाभिधीयते ..
कुलिकस्य तु या वेला सा वर्ज्या सर्वकर्मसु .. 51 ..
text_mt: and the gandharva designated as Aṅgāraparṇa. / But the period of Kulika is to be avoided in all undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ bhukte bhavedvyādhirviṣaṃ bhuktaṃ na jīryate ..
pratyakṣamapi tārkṣyasya tasyāṃ daṣṭo na jīvati .. 52 ..
meaning:
तस्यां भुक्ते भवेद्व्याधिर्विषं भुक्तं न जीर्यते ..
प्रत्यक्षमपि तार्क्ष्यस्य तस्यां दष्टो न जीवति .. 52 ..
text_mt: Disease occurs from eating during it; poison consumed [then] is not digested. / Even in the presence of Tārkṣya, one bitten during it does not live.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktaṃ tasyāṃ tu bhaiṣajyaṃ na tu kāryakaraṃ bhavet ..
sā tu kulividā jñeyā mantriṇā bhiṣajā tathā .. 53 ..
meaning:
भुक्तं तस्यां तु भैषज्यं न तु कार्यकरं भवेत् ..
सा तु कुलिविदा ज्ञेया मन्त्रिणा भिषजा तथा .. 53 ..
text_mt: Medicine taken during it will not be effective. / That should be known by one versed in birds, and by a minister, and by a physician.

sanskrit_iast:
avijñāya tu tāṃ velāṃ trayaste rājapuṅgava ..
vaiphalyakaraṇānmūḍhāḥ prāpnuvantyayaśo mahat..54..
meaning:
अविज्ञाय तु तां वेलां त्रयस्ते राजपुङ्गव ..
वैफल्यकरणान्मूढाः प्राप्नुवन्त्ययशो महत्..54..
text_mt: Not knowing that period, O bull among kings, these three, / deluded due to bringing about failure, attain great dishonour.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekasyaiva velāyāṃ rāhorbhāgaṃ nibodha me ..
ekaikā tu bhaveddhorā sārdhaṃ vighaṭikāśatam ..55..
meaning:
प्रत्येकस्यैव वेलायां राहोर्भागं निबोध मे ..
एकैका तु भवेद्धोरा सार्धं विघटिकाशतम् ..55..
text_mt: Learn from me the share of Rāhu in each individual period: / each horā is one hundred and fifty vighaṭikās.

sanskrit_iast:
vināḍikāḥ saptaṣaṣṭyā raveḥ ṣoḍaśa kīrttitāḥ ..
horākulikavelastu śeṣaḥ kālo ravessmṛtaḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
विनाडिकाः सप्तषष्ट्या रवेः षोडश कीर्त्तिताः ..
होराकुलिकवेलस्तु शेषः कालो रवेस्स्मृतः .. 56 ..
text_mt: The vināḍikās of the Sun are stated as sixteen out of sixty-seven; / the remaining time of the Sun is remembered as the horā-kulika period.

sanskrit_iast:
svahorānte tathā velāścatasrastu vināḍikāḥ ..
rāhoścakrasya kathitāḥ śeṣaḥ kālaḥ sitasya ca ..57..
meaning:
स्वहोरान्ते तथा वेलाश्चतस्रस्तु विनाडिकाः ..
राहोश्चक्रस्य कथिताः शेषः कालः सितस्य च ..57..
text_mt: At the end of his own horā, four vināḍikās / are declared for the cycle of Rāhu; the remaining time belongs to Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyahorāsamārambha capakau dvau prakīrtitau..
horā kulikavelā tu śeṣaḥ kālo budhasya ca .. 58 ..
meaning:
सौम्यहोरासमारम्भ चपकौ द्वौ प्रकीर्तितौ..
होरा कुलिकवेला तु शेषः कालो बुधस्य च .. 58 ..
text_mt: At the beginning of the horā of Mercury, two caṣakas are proclaimed; / the remaining time of Mercury is the horā-kulika period.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasaptatimullaṅghya horāyāṃ tu niśābhṛtaḥ ..
aṣṭau tu kulikasyoktāḥ śeṣaḥ kālo niśābhṛtaḥ .. 59 ..
meaning:
एकसप्ततिमुल्लङ्घ्य होरायां तु निशाभृतः ..
अष्टौ तु कुलिकस्योक्ताः शेषः कालो निशाभृतः .. 59 ..
text_mt: Having passed seventy-one [caṣakas] in the horā of the Moon, / eight are declared for Kulika; the remaining time belongs to the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītimatikramya caṣakānravijasya tu ..
yaccheṣastadvinirdiṣṭaḥ kālastu kulikasya ca .. 1.83.60 ..
meaning:
षडशीतिमतिक्रम्य चषकान्रविजस्य तु ..
यच्छेषस्तद्विनिर्दिष्टः कालस्तु कुलिकस्य च .. 1.83.60 ..
text_mt: Having passed eighty-six caṣakas of the son of the Sun, / what remains is declared as the time of Kulika.

sanskrit_iast:
saptasaptatyatikramya sārdhāṃstu caṣakāngurau ..
rāhostu caṣako horā śeṣakālo gurormataḥ ..61..
meaning:
सप्तसप्तत्यतिक्रम्य सार्धांस्तु चषकान्गुरौ ..
राहोस्तु चषको होरा शेषकालो गुरोर्मतः ..61..
text_mt: Having passed seventy-seven and a half caṣakas in [the horā of] Jupiter, / a caṣaka is Rāhu's horā; the remaining time is considered to be Jupiter's.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumahorāsamārambhe dvātriṃśattu vināḍikāḥ ..
velā tu kulikasyoktā śeṣaḥ kālaḥ kujasya tu .. 62 ..
meaning:
भौमहोरासमारम्भे द्वात्रिंशत्तु विनाडिकाः ..
वेला तु कुलिकस्योक्ता शेषः कालः कुजस्य तु .. 62 ..
text_mt: At the beginning of the horā of Mars, thirty-two vināḍikās / are declared as the period of Kulika; the remaining time belongs to Mars.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvajñaśukrahorāsu sarvakarmāṇi kārayet ..
krūrāsu ca tathānyāsu na kiñcitkulikasya ca .. 63 ..
meaning:
जीवज्ञशुक्रहोरासु सर्वकर्माणि कारयेत् ..
क्रूरासु च तथान्यासु न किञ्चित्कुलिकस्य च .. 63 ..
text_mt: One should carry out all rites in the horās of Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus; / in fierce ones, and in other [malefic] ones, nothing [should be done], nor in that of Kulika.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ muhūrtānāṃ daivatāni nibodha me ..
sarvarkṣāṇi vivartante hyahorātreṇa pārthiva ..64..
meaning:
अतः परं मुहूर्तानां दैवतानि निबोध मे ..
सर्वर्क्षाणि विवर्तन्ते ह्यहोरात्रेण पार्थिव ..64..
text_mt: Next, learn from me the presiding deities of the muhūrtas. / All constellations revolve in a day and night, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ te vinirdiṣṭā muhurtāstriṃśadeva tu ..
vajra uvāca ..
aṣṭāviṃśatiruktāni tvayā tāni mamānagha .. 65 ..
meaning:
सततं ते विनिर्दिष्टा मुहुर्तास्त्रिंशदेव तु ..
वज्र उवाच ..
अष्टाविंशतिरुक्तानि त्वया तानि ममानघ .. 65 ..
text_mt: Always thirty muhūrtas indeed are assigned to them. / Vajra said: / Twenty-eight of them were declared by you to me, O sinless one;

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśanmuhūrtāśca kathaṃ ta eva dvijasattama ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dinarātryossamāraṃbhe hyardhaṃ bhavati pārthiva .. 66 ..
meaning:
त्रिंशन्मुहूर्ताश्च कथं त एव द्विजसत्तम ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
दिनरात्र्योस्समारंभे ह्यर्धं भवति पार्थिव .. 66 ..
text_mt: and how are there thirty muhūrtas, O best of the twice-born? / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / At the commencement of day and night there is a half [muhūrta], O protector of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhye ca satatamabhijiccābhidhīyate ..
tayordvitvānmayā triṃśanmuhūrtā vihitāstava .. 67 ..
meaning:
तयोर्मध्ये च सततमभिजिच्चाभिधीयते ..
तयोर्द्वित्वान्मया त्रिंशन्मुहूर्ता विहितास्तव .. 67 ..
text_mt: and between the two, Abhijit is always proclaimed. / Because of the duality of those two, thirty muhūrtas have been laid down for you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrairdaivataisteṣāṃ devatāḥ parikīrttitāḥ ..
kevalaṃ kramahāniśca kramasteṣāṃ nibodha me .. 68 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रैर्दैवतैस्तेषां देवताः परिकीर्त्तिताः ..
केवलं क्रमहानिश्च क्रमस्तेषां निबोध मे .. 68 ..
text_mt: Their presiding deities are proclaimed according to the asterisms [and their] deities; / only the order is altered; learn their order from me.

sanskrit_iast:
raudrassārpastathā maitraḥ paitro vāsava eva ca ..
āpyo vaiśvastathā rājankeśvaraḥ śakradaivataḥ .. 69 ..
meaning:
रौद्रस्सार्पस्तथा मैत्रः पैत्रो वासव एव च ..
आप्यो वैश्वस्तथा राजन्केश्वरः शक्रदैवतः .. 69 ..
text_mt: Raudra, Sārpa, Maitra, Paitra, and Vāsava, / Āpya, Vaiśva, O king, Ka-īśvara, that having Śakra as deity,

sanskrit_iast:
aindrāgneyau nairṛtastu vāruṇaśca mahīpate ..
āryamṇastu tathā bhogyo muhūrttāstu divācarāḥ .. 1.83.70 ..
meaning:
ऐन्द्राग्नेयौ नैरृतस्तु वारुणश्च महीपते ..
आर्यम्णस्तु तथा भोग्यो मुहूर्त्तास्तु दिवाचराः .. 1.83.70 ..
text_mt: Aindrāgneya, Nairṛta, and Vāruṇa, O lord of the earth, / and Āryamṇa, and Bhāgya: these are the muhūrtas that move by day.

sanskrit_iast:
raudrā'jadevohirbudhnyāḥ pauṣṇaścāśvina eva ca..
yāmyo'gnidaivataścaiva brāhmassaumyastathaiva ca .. 71 ..
meaning:
रौद्राऽजदेवोहिर्बुध्न्याः पौष्णश्चाश्विन एव च..
याम्योऽग्निदैवतश्चैव ब्राह्मस्सौम्यस्तथैव च .. 71 ..
text_mt: Raudra, Ajadeva, Ahirbudhnya, Pauṣṇa, and Āśvina, / Yāmya, Agnidaivata, and Brāhma, and Saumya,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityo jīvadaivatyo vaiṣṇavaḥ sūryadaivataḥ ..
tvāṣṭraścaivātha vāyavyoḥ muhūrtā rātricāriṇaḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
आदित्यो जीवदैवत्यो वैष्णवः सूर्यदैवतः ..
त्वाष्ट्रश्चैवाथ वायव्योः मुहूर्ता रात्रिचारिणः .. 72 ..
text_mt: Āditya, Jīvadaivatya, Vaiṣṇava, Sūryadaivata, / Tvāṣṭra, and Vāyavya: these are the muhūrtas that move by night.

sanskrit_iast:
ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgo rātreśca yadunandana ..
muhūrtasaṃjñaḥ kathito munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
अह्नः पञ्चदशो भागो रात्रेश्च यदुनन्दन ..
मुहूर्तसंज्ञः कथितो मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः .. 73 ..
text_mt: A fifteenth part of the day and of the night, O joy of the Yadus, / is termed a muhūrta by sages who perceive the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākalyādathārabhya kālāvayavadaivatāḥ ..
uktāstava muhūrtāśca teṣāṃ kāle svake'rcanam .. 74 ..
meaning:
महाकल्यादथारभ्य कालावयवदैवताः ..
उक्तास्तव मुहूर्ताश्च तेषां काले स्वकेऽर्चनम् .. 74 ..
text_mt: Beginning from early dawn, the presiding deities of the divisions of time / have been spoken of to you as muhūrtas; worship [of them] in their own time

sanskrit_iast:
mahāphalaṃ hi nidiṣṭaṃ syādviyoge viśeṣataḥ ..
svakāle devatāḥ pūjyāḥ sopacārairviśeṣataḥ ..
tasyāssakāśāddharmajña kāmayadbhirmahatphalam .. 75 ..
meaning:
महाफलं हि निदिष्टं स्याद्वियोगे विशेषतः ..
स्वकाले देवताः पूज्याः सोपचारैर्विशेषतः ..
तस्यास्सकाशाद्धर्मज्ञ कामयद्भिर्महत्फलम् .. 75 ..
text_mt: is declared to have great fruit, especially at the time of conjunction. / The deities should be worshipped in their own time especially with offerings, / by those desiring great fruit from them, O knower of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle svake yaḥ prayatastu bhaktyā devānyathāvatsamupaiti rājan ..
saparyayā tasya diśanti devāḥ phalānabhīṣṭānnṛṣu lohitākṣa ..76..
meaning:
काले स्वके यः प्रयतस्तु भक्त्या देवान्यथावत्समुपैति राजन् ..
सपर्यया तस्य दिशन्ति देवाः फलानभीष्टान्नृषु लोहिताक्ष ..76..
text_mt: O red-eyed king, to him who, restrained, with devotion duly approaches the gods / with worship in their proper time, the gods grant desired fruits among men.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
lagnāni dvādaśoktāni dinarātreṇa nityaśaḥ ..
yatrādityaḥ sthito rāśau tadādyāni narādhipa .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
लग्नानि द्वादशोक्तानि दिनरात्रेण नित्यशः ..
यत्रादित्यः स्थितो राशौ तदाद्यानि नराधिप .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Twelve lagnas are proclaimed, occurring constantly throughout day and night. / Beginning with that sign in which the Sun is situated, O lord of men:
title: Lagnavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
meṣo vṛṣotha mithunaḥ kulīrassiṃha eva ca ..
kanyā tulā tathā kīṭo dhanvī makara eva ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
मेषो वृषोथ मिथुनः कुलीरस्सिंह एव च ..
कन्या तुला तथा कीटो धन्वी मकर एव च .. 2 ..
text_mt: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, / Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Capricorn,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbho mīnaśca rājendra lagnā dvādaśa kīrttitāḥ ..
kujaśśukro budhaścandraḥ sūryaścāndrissitastathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
कुम्भो मीनश्च राजेन्द्र लग्ना द्वादश कीर्त्तिताः ..
कुजश्शुक्रो बुधश्चन्द्रः सूर्यश्चान्द्रिस्सितस्तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Aquarius, and Pisces, O king of kings, are proclaimed as the twelve lagnas. / Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumo jīvaśca sauraśca śanirjīvistathaiva ca ..
meṣādīnāṃ krameṇoktāḥ prabhāvaḥ pṛthivīpate ..4 ..
meaning:
भौमो जीवश्च सौरश्च शनिर्जीविस्तथैव च ..
मेषादीनां क्रमेणोक्ताः प्रभावः पृथिवीपते ..4 ..
text_mt: Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn, and Jupiter / are declared in order as their rulers, beginning with Aries, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
lagrasyārdhaṃ smṛtā horā tayorviṣamarāśiṣu ..
ādityacandrau candrārkāvīśvarau samarāśiṣu .. 5 ..
meaning:
लग्रस्यार्धं स्मृता होरा तयोर्विषमराशिषु ..
आदित्यचन्द्रौ चन्द्रार्कावीश्वरौ समराशिषु .. 5 ..
text_mt: A half of a lagna is considered a horā. In odd signs, / the Sun and the Moon [rule them]; in even signs, the Moon and the Sun are the rulers.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnatribhāgo dreṣkāṇaḥ kramātteṣāṃ tatheśvarāḥ ..
lagneśaḥ paṃcameśaśca navameśastathaiva ca ..6..
meaning:
लग्नत्रिभागो द्रेष्काणः क्रमात्तेषां तथेश्वराः ..
लग्नेशः पंचमेशश्च नवमेशस्तथैव च ..6..
text_mt: The third part of the ascendant is the decan. In order, their lords are / the lord of the ascendant, the lord of the fifth [house], and likewise the lord of the ninth [house].

sanskrit_iast:
meṣādyāḥ kathitā nityaṃ meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ ..
makarādyāstathā proktā vṛṣakanyāmṛgāstathā..7..
meaning:
मेषाद्याः कथिता नित्यं मेषसिंहधनुर्धराः ..
मकराद्यास्तथा प्रोक्ता वृषकन्यामृगास्तथा..7..
text_mt: Those beginning with Aries are always declared to be Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. / Those beginning with Capricorn are said to be Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn.

sanskrit_iast:
tulādyā mithunastaulī kumbhaśca vasudhādhipa ..
kulīrādyāḥ kulīraśca kīṭo mīnastathaiva ca ..8..
meaning:
तुलाद्या मिथुनस्तौली कुम्भश्च वसुधाधिप ..
कुलीराद्याः कुलीरश्च कीटो मीनस्तथैव च ..8..
text_mt: Those beginning with Libra are Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, O lord of the earth; / and those beginning with Cancer are Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyuktarāśiprabhṛti gaṇanīyā navāṃśakāḥ..
rāśīnāṃ tu yathoktānāṃ kramānnava naveśvarāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
आद्युक्तराशिप्रभृति गणनीया नवांशकाः..
राशीनां तु यथोक्तानां क्रमान्नव नवेश्वराः .. 9 ..
text_mt: The ninefold divisions are to be counted beginning from the aforementioned signs. / For the specified signs, there are nine lords for each of the nine [divisions] in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
svarāśitastathārabhya krameṇaiva naveśvarāḥ ..
rāśīśvareśvarāḥ proktā rāśīnāṃ dvādaśāṃśakāḥ .. 1.84.10 ..
meaning:
स्वराशितस्तथारभ्य क्रमेणैव नवेश्वराः ..
राशीश्वरेश्वराः प्रोक्ता राशीनां द्वादशांशकाः .. 1.84.10 ..
text_mt: Beginning from one's own sign in sequence are the nine lords. / The lords of the signs are declared to be the lords of the twelvefold divisions of the signs.

sanskrit_iast:
paṃca bhaumasya saurasya paṃca triṃśāṃśakā matāḥ ..
jīvasyāṣṭau vinirdiṣṭāḥ sapta proktā budhasya tu .. 11 ..
meaning:
पंच भौमस्य सौरस्य पंच त्रिंशांशका मताः ..
जीवस्याष्टौ विनिर्दिष्टाः सप्त प्रोक्ता बुधस्य तु .. 11 ..
text_mt: Five [degrees] of the thirtyfold divisions are considered Mars's, and five Saturn's; / eight are assigned to Jupiter, and seven are stated for Mercury;

sanskrit_iast:
śukrasyoktāstathā pañca rāśau viṣama saṃjñake ..
ādyāstu pañca śukrasya tatassapta budhasya ca .. 12 ..
meaning:
शुक्रस्योक्तास्तथा पञ्च राशौ विषम संज्ञके ..
आद्यास्तु पञ्च शुक्रस्य ततस्सप्त बुधस्य च .. 12 ..
text_mt: five are stated for Venus in an odd-numbered sign. / But the first five belong to Venus, then seven to Mercury,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvasyāṣṭau tathā proktāḥ pañca saurasya cāpyatha ..
kujasya tu tathā pañca rāśau tu samasaṃkhyake .. 13 ..
meaning:
जीवस्याष्टौ तथा प्रोक्ताः पञ्च सौरस्य चाप्यथ ..
कुजस्य तु तथा पञ्च राशौ तु समसंख्यके .. 13 ..
text_mt: eight are likewise stated for Jupiter, then five for Saturn, / and five for Mars in an even-numbered sign.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnaṃ ca horā ca tathā drikāṇaṃ navāṃśakaṃ dvādaśabhāgasaṃjñam ..
triṃśāṃśakaṃ cāpyatha ṣaṣṭhamatra ṣaḍbhedamāhurmunayaśca lagnam .. 14 ..
meaning:
लग्नं च होरा च तथा द्रिकाणं नवांशकं द्वादशभागसंज्ञम् ..
त्रिंशांशकं चाप्यथ षष्ठमत्र षड्भेदमाहुर्मुनयश्च लग्नम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The ascendant, the hour, the decan, the ninefold division, that designated the twelvefold division, / and the thirtyfold division as the sixth here—sages declare the ascendant to have six divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
śubho vāpyaśubho vāpi kathaṃ kālo mahītale ..
jñāyate bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
शुभो वाप्यशुभो वापि कथं कालो महीतले ..
ज्ञायते भार्गवश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / How on the surface of the earth is time known / to be auspicious or inauspicious, O best of the Bhṛgus? Tell me who am asking this.
title: adhyāyaḥ 85

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛttikā yāmyavāyavye nāgavīthyuttarottare ..
gajavīthīhyudaṅmadhye prājāpatyādayastrayaḥ ..2..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
कृत्तिका याम्यवायव्ये नागवीथ्युत्तरोत्तरे ..
गजवीथीह्युदङ्मध्ये प्राजापत्यादयस्त्रयः ..2..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Kṛttikā is in the southern and north-western [part], in the northern-most Serpent Path. / In the Elephant Path, in the north-central [part], are the three beginning with Prājāpatya;

sanskrit_iast:
airāvaṇe hyudagbhāge ahorātracatuṣṭayam..
madhye vare tathā vīthī phalgunī ṛkṣayordvayoḥ ..3 ..
meaning:
ऐरावणे ह्युदग्भागे अहोरात्रचतुष्टयम्..
मध्ये वरे तथा वीथी फल्गुनी ऋक्षयोर्द्वयोः ..3 ..
text_mt: in the Airāvata [Path], in the northern region, is a set of four day-and-nights. / In the excellent middle is the path in the two Phalgunī constellations.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyemadhye tu govīthī ajādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam ..
madhyayāme jaradgaḥ syāttritayaṃ śravaṇādikam .. 4 ..
meaning:
मध्येमध्ये तु गोवीथी अजाद्यं भचतुष्टयम् ..
मध्ययामे जरद्गः स्यात्त्रितयं श्रवणादिकम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: In the very middle is the Cow Path, the quartet of constellations beginning with the Goat. / In the middle-southern [part] is the Old Bull [Path], the triad beginning with Śravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyottareṇa tu mṛgā hastacitre prakīrtite ..
ajādakṣiṇamadhye tu viśākhā maitrayossmṛtāḥ ..5..
meaning:
याम्योत्तरेण तु मृगा हस्तचित्रे प्रकीर्तिते ..
अजादक्षिणमध्ये तु विशाखा मैत्रयोस्स्मृताः ..5..
text_mt: To the south-north are the Deer, Hasta and Citrā are proclaimed; / in the south-central of the Goat are Viśākhā and Maitra.

sanskrit_iast:
āvikāyāmyayāmye tu śakrādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam ..
vaiśvānarapathaṃ prāhustamevātyantadāruṇam ..6..
meaning:
आविकायाम्ययाम्ये तु शक्राद्यं भचतुष्टयम् ..
वैश्वानरपथं प्राहुस्तमेवात्यन्तदारुणम् ..6..
text_mt: In the southernmost Sheep [Path] is the quartet of constellations beginning with Śakra. / They call that the Fire Path, which is exceedingly terrible.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca cāreṇa ca tathā grahāḥ ..
uttarāsu śubhāḥ proktā dakṣiṇāstvaśubhāvahāḥ ..7..
meaning:
उदयास्तमयाभ्यां च चारेण च तथा ग्रहाः ..
उत्तरासु शुभाः प्रोक्ता दक्षिणास्त्वशुभावहाः ..7..
text_mt: Through rising and setting, and likewise through their course, / planets in the northern [paths] are said to be auspicious, while those in the southern bring misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
suprabhāraśmimantaśca nāgavīthyāṃ yadā grahāḥ ..
na tadasti śubhaṃ loke yatra paśyanti mānavāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
सुप्रभारश्मिमन्तश्च नागवीथ्यां यदा ग्रहाः ..
न तदस्ति शुभं लोके यत्र पश्यन्ति मानवाः .. 8 ..
text_mt: When planets in the Serpent Path are brilliant and endowed with rays, / there is no good in the world where men see them.

sanskrit_iast:
viraśmayo vivarṇāśca vaiśvānarapathāśritāḥ ..
na tadasti śubhaṃ rāma yanna kuryurjagattraye .. 9 ..
meaning:
विरश्मयो विवर्णाश्च वैश्वानरपथाश्रिताः ..
न तदस्ति शुभं राम यन्न कुर्युर्जगत्त्रये .. 9 ..
text_mt: Devoid of rays, discoloured, and positioned in the Fire Path, / there is no good, O Rāma, that they do not destroy in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇīśakaṭaṃ bhindyurgrahā yadi bhavettadā ..
nāśaḥ prajānāṃ kūraśca viśeṣeṇātra lakṣyate..1.85.10..
meaning:
रोहिणीशकटं भिन्द्युर्ग्रहा यदि भवेत्तदा ..
नाशः प्रजानां कूरश्च विशेषेणात्र लक्ष्यते..1.85.10..
text_mt: If planets should cleave the cart of Rohiṇī, then / especially cruel destruction of the subjects is observed here.

sanskrit_iast:
saurārasūryāḥ krūrāstu tathā kṣīṇaśca candramāḥ..
kūrairyukto budhaścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca..11..
meaning:
सौरारसूर्याः क्रूरास्तु तथा क्षीणश्च चन्द्रमाः..
कूरैर्युक्तो बुधश्चैव राहुः केतुस्तथैव च..11..
text_mt: Saturn, Mars, and the Sun are malefic, as is the waning Moon; / Mercury joined with malefics is also [malefic], as are Rāhu and Ketu.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāssaumyagrahāḥ proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
rohiṇī kṛttikā pitryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ maitrameva ca..12..
meaning:
शेषास्सौम्यग्रहाः प्रोक्ता मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ..
रोहिणी कृत्तिका पित्र्यं वैष्णवं मैत्रमेव च..12..
text_mt: The rest are declared benefic planets by sages who perceive the truth. / Rohiṇī, Kṛttikā, the constellation of the Fathers, the constellation of Viṣṇu, and that of Mitra—

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍayanto grahā hanyurdiśaṃ varuṇapālitām..
pūrvasyāṃ diśi dṛśyante sarvatārāgrahā yadi .. 13 ..
meaning:
पीडयन्तो ग्रहा हन्युर्दिशं वरुणपालिताम्..
पूर्वस्यां दिशि दृश्यन्ते सर्वताराग्रहा यदि .. 13 ..
text_mt: planets afflicting these destroy the direction guarded by Varuṇa. / If all stellar planets are seen in the eastern quarter,

sanskrit_iast:
prācyānāṃ tu tadā rājñāṃ bhavetpīḍā sudāruṇā ..
madhye ca yadi dṛśyante madhyadeśanivāsi nām .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्राच्यानां तु तदा राज्ञां भवेत्पीडा सुदारुणा ..
मध्ये च यदि दृश्यन्ते मध्यदेशनिवासि नाम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: then exceedingly severe affliction will befall the kings of the easterners; / and if they are seen in the centre, [affliction will befall] the inhabitants of the central country.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇyāṃ yadi dṛśyaṃte tāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti ca ..
hīnādhikaṃ carantaśca vyabhre vā'darśanaṃ gatāḥ ..15..
meaning:
वारुण्यां यदि दृश्यंते तां दिशं पीडयन्ति च ..
हीनाधिकं चरन्तश्च व्यभ्रे वाऽदर्शनं गताः ..15..
text_mt: If they are seen in the western quarter, they afflict that direction. / Moving abnormally, or disappearing in a cloudless sky,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmāyanto jvalanto vā vedayanti mahadbhayam ..
ekāntaritanakṣatragatāḥ syuścedgrahā divi .. 16..
meaning:
धूमायन्तो ज्वलन्तो वा वेदयन्ति महद्भयम् ..
एकान्तरितनक्षत्रगताः स्युश्चेद्ग्रहा दिवि .. 16..
text_mt: smoking or blazing, they announce great danger. / If the planets in the sky should occupy alternate constellations,

sanskrit_iast:
mālānāma bhavedyogo madhyadeśakṣitīśahā ..
prāsaścakraṃ dhanurvajraṃ sasyānāṃ kṣudravṛṣṭidāḥ .. .. 17..
meaning:
मालानाम भवेद्योगो मध्यदेशक्षितीशहा ..
प्रासश्चक्रं धनुर्वज्रं सस्यानां क्षुद्रवृष्टिदाः .. .. 17..
text_mt: a planetary combination named 'Garland' occurs, which slays the kings of the central country. / The Dart, the Discus, the Bow, the Thunderbolt bring poor rain for crops.

sanskrit_iast:
grahā bhayāvahā nityaṃ śṛṅgāṭakapurogamāḥ ..
bhaveyurekarkṣagatāstribhirūrddhvaṃ yadā grahāḥ .. 18..
meaning:
ग्रहा भयावहा नित्यं शृङ्गाटकपुरोगमाः ..
भवेयुरेकर्क्षगतास्त्रिभिरूर्द्ध्वं यदा ग्रहाः .. 18..
text_mt: Planets headed by the Triangle always bring danger. / When more than three planets come to occupy a single constellation,

sanskrit_iast:
vināśāyaiva lokānāṃ vijñeyāssumahīkṣitām ..
ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ grahābhyāṃ sahito guruḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
विनाशायैव लोकानां विज्ञेयास्सुमहीक्षिताम् ..
एकेन यदि वा द्वाभ्यां ग्रहाभ्यां सहितो गुरुः .. 19 ..
text_mt: they must be known to bring destruction to the worlds of great kings. / If Jupiter is accompanied by one or by two planets,

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaro vā dṛśyeta tadā durbhikṣamādiśet ..
citrāyāṃ lohito yatra mūle devagurustathā .. .. 1.85.20 ..
meaning:
शनैश्चरो वा दृश्येत तदा दुर्भिक्षमादिशेत् ..
चित्रायां लोहितो यत्र मूले देवगुरुस्तथा .. .. 1.85.20 ..
text_mt: or if Saturn is seen [thus], then one should predict famine. / Where Mars is in Citrā, Jupiter is in Mūla,

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavaśca śraviṣṭhāsu tadā ghoraṃ bhayaṃ bhavet ..
kṛttikāsu śanaiścārī viśākhāsu bṛhaspatiḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
भार्गवश्च श्रविष्ठासु तदा घोरं भयं भवेत् ..
कृत्तिकासु शनैश्चारी विशाखासु बृहस्पतिः .. 21 ..
text_mt: and Venus is in Śraviṣṭhā, then terrible danger will arise. / Saturn staying in Kṛttikā and Jupiter in Viśākhā

sanskrit_iast:
sthitau prajānāṃ pīḍāyai vṛṣṭimantardivaṃ bhavet ..
prāgdvāreṣu caranbheṣu sauro vakrabhiyādyadi .. 22 ..
meaning:
स्थितौ प्रजानां पीडायै वृष्टिमन्तर्दिवं भवेत् ..
प्राग्द्वारेषु चरन्भेषु सौरो वक्रभियाद्यदि .. 22 ..
text_mt: bring affliction to the subjects and rain ceases from the sky. / If Saturn, moving through the constellations of the eastern gate, goes retrograde out of fear,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ pīḍayetsarvāṃ pūrvadeśaṃ viśeṣata ..
raudre haste tathaivāpye āhirbudhnye śanaiścaraḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
पृथिवीं पीडयेत्सर्वां पूर्वदेशं विशेषत ..
रौद्रे हस्ते तथैवाप्ये आहिर्बुध्न्ये शनैश्चरः .. 23 ..
text_mt: it will afflict the entire earth, especially the eastern region. / When Saturn attains its rising in Raudra, Hasta,

sanskrit_iast:
yadodayaṃ prapadyeta tadā naśyanti pārthivāḥ ..
saumye tvāṣṭre śraviṣṭhāsu sthite saurai mahīkṣitaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
यदोदयं प्रपद्येत तदा नश्यन्ति पार्थिवाः ..
सौम्ये त्वाष्ट्रे श्रविष्ठासु स्थिते सौरै महीक्षितः .. 24 ..
text_mt: in Āpya, or in Āhirbudhnya, then rulers perish. / When Saturn stands in Saumya, Tvāṣṭra, or Śraviṣṭhā, kings

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapīḍāṃ samarhanti yayā yānti yamāntikam ..
pūrvāṃ parāśāṃ saṃprāpto bhṛgujīvau parasparam .. 25 ..
meaning:
सर्वपीडां समर्हन्ति यया यान्ति यमान्तिकम् ..
पूर्वां पराशां संप्राप्तो भृगुजीवौ परस्परम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: suffer all afflictions by which they go to the presence of Yama. / When Venus and Jupiter, having reached the eastern and western horizons opposite each other,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamarkṣagatau syātāṃ tadatra devo na varṣati ..
aparvaṇi śaśāṅkārkau tvaṣṭānāma mahāgrahaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
सप्तमर्क्षगतौ स्यातां तदत्र देवो न वर्षति ..
अपर्वणि शशाङ्कार्कौ त्वष्टानाम महाग्रहः .. 26 ..
text_mt: occupy the seventh constellation [from each other], then the god does not rain here. / Outside the conjunction, the great planet named Tvaṣṭṛ,

sanskrit_iast:
āvṛṇoti tamaḥ śyāmaḥ sarvalokavipattaye ..
udayāstamaye bhānoścandrasya ca yadā bhavet .. 27 ..
meaning:
आवृणोति तमः श्यामः सर्वलोकविपत्तये ..
उदयास्तमये भानोश्चन्द्रस्य च यदा भवेत् .. 27 ..
text_mt: a dark darkness, covers the Sun and the Moon, causing ruin to all the worlds. / When at the rising or setting of the Sun and of the Moon

sanskrit_iast:
pariveṣastadā rājā kṣipraṃ vadhamavāpnuyāt ..
sakalaṃ cedahassūyo rātriṃ cetsakalāṃ śaśī .. 28 ..
meaning:
परिवेषस्तदा राजा क्षिप्रं वधमवाप्नुयात् ..
सकलं चेदहस्सूयो रात्रिं चेत्सकलां शशी .. 28 ..
text_mt: there is a halo, then the king quickly meets death. / If the Sun is haloed for the entire day, or the Moon for the entire night,

sanskrit_iast:
pariveṣī bhavedrājā tatrāpi vadhamarhati ..
dvisūrye gagane vṛddhiṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ vinirdiśet .. 29 ..
meaning:
परिवेषी भवेद्राजा तत्रापि वधमर्हति ..
द्विसूर्ये गगने वृद्धिं क्षत्त्रियाणां विनिर्दिशेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: the king also deserves death in that case. / If there are two Suns in the sky, one should predict increase for kṣatriyas;

sanskrit_iast:
dvicandre brāhmaṇānāṃ tu cādhikyaṃ pralayāya tu ..
udayāstamayau yatra somārkau raktamaṇḍalau .. 1.85.30 ..
meaning:
द्विचन्द्रे ब्राह्मणानां तु चाधिक्यं प्रलयाय तु ..
उदयास्तमयौ यत्र सोमार्कौ रक्तमण्डलौ .. 1.85.30 ..
text_mt: if there are two Moons, [increase] for brahmins, but excess brings dissolution. / Where the Moon and Sun at rising and setting have red orbs

sanskrit_iast:
na cātrābhrāṇi dṛśyante tanmahābhayalakṣaṇam ..
candramā janmanakṣatraṃ parityajati yasya tu .. 31 ..
meaning:
न चात्राभ्राणि दृश्यन्ते तन्महाभयलक्षणम् ..
चन्द्रमा जन्मनक्षत्रं परित्यजति यस्य तु .. 31 ..
text_mt: and no clouds are seen, that is a mark of great danger. / When the Moon leaves a person's birth-constellation,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāvo rūkṣopasavyaṃ tu tasya vidyādupadravam ..
atyantā darśane rāhostathā cātyantadarśane .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्यावो रूक्षोपसव्यं तु तस्य विद्यादुपद्रवम् ..
अत्यन्ता दर्शने राहोस्तथा चात्यन्तदर्शने .. 32 ..
text_mt: turning dark, rough, and passing to the left, one should recognise calamity for him. / At the extreme invisibility of Rāhu, or at its extreme visibility,

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpīḍā vinirdeśyā vyādhidurbhikṣataskaraiḥ ..
yannakṣatragato rāhurgrasate candrabhāskarau .. 33 ..
meaning:
प्रजापीडा विनिर्देश्या व्याधिदुर्भिक्षतस्करैः ..
यन्नक्षत्रगतो राहुर्ग्रसते चन्द्रभास्करौ .. 33 ..
text_mt: affliction of the subjects through disease, famine, and thieves is to be predicted. / In whichever constellation Rāhu stands when it eclipses the Moon and Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tajjātānāṃ bhavetpīḍā ye narāśśāntivarjitāḥ ..
grahopasṛṣṭe nakṣatre grahaṇaṃ tu yadā bhavet .. 34 ..
meaning:
तज्जातानां भवेत्पीडा ये नराश्शान्तिवर्जिताः ..
ग्रहोपसृष्टे नक्षत्रे ग्रहणं तु यदा भवेत् .. 34 ..
text_mt: affliction will befall those born in it, men who are devoid of propitiatory rites. / But when an eclipse occurs in a constellation afflicted by a planet,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pīḍā vinirdeśyā sainikānāṃ nṛpaissaha ..
gṛhīto rāhuṇā candraḥ sūryo vā gaganāccyutaḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
तदा पीडा विनिर्देश्या सैनिकानां नृपैस्सह ..
गृहीतो राहुणा चन्द्रः सूर्यो वा गगनाच्च्युतः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Then suffering should be indicated for soldiers along with kings. / If the moon or the sun, eclipsed by Rāhu, falls from the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
ulkāni hanyāttatrānyo rājā rājyaṃ kariṣyati ..
gṛhītau pariveṣe tau yadā candradivākarau..36..
meaning:
उल्कानि हन्यात्तत्रान्यो राजा राज्यं करिष्यति ..
गृहीतौ परिवेषे तौ यदा चन्द्रदिवाकरौ..36..
text_mt: or if a meteor strikes it, another king will rule the kingdom there. / When the sun and moon are seized within a halo,

sanskrit_iast:
samantātpīḍyate deśaḥ śastrakopaśca jāyate ..
meghaissaṃchādyate rāhustvativarṣati vā yadā .. 37 ..
meaning:
समन्तात्पीड्यते देशः शस्त्रकोपश्च जायते ..
मेघैस्संछाद्यते राहुस्त्वतिवर्षति वा यदा .. 37 ..
text_mt: the country is tormented all around, and fury of weapons arises. / When Rāhu is covered by clouds, or when it rains excessively,

sanskrit_iast:
akālajaistadā rājño bhayaṃ vidyādupasthitam ..
yanna kṣatrāgate sūrye chidraṃ vai saṃprapadyate .. 38 ..
meaning:
अकालजैस्तदा राज्ञो भयं विद्यादुपस्थितम् ..
यन्न क्षत्रागते सूर्ये छिद्रं वै संप्रपद्यते .. 38 ..
text_mt: one should know that untimely danger has arrived for the king. / When a flaw occurs while the sun is in a constellation,

sanskrit_iast:
tajjātaḥ pārthivaḥ kṣipraṃ yamalokaṃ gamiṣyati ..
tāmrakuṅkumarūkṣābho ghṛtahāridrasannibhaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
तज्जातः पार्थिवः क्षिप्रं यमलोकं गमिष्यति ..
ताम्रकुङ्कुमरूक्षाभो घृतहारिद्रसन्निभः .. 39 ..
text_mt: the king born under it will swiftly go to the realm of Yama. / Having the rough luster of copper or saffron, or resembling ghee and turmeric,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhujīvanibho bhānuḥ śiśirādyeṣu śasyate ..
asvacchavarṇaḥ paruṣo vepanaḥ khaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ ..1.85.40..
meaning:
बन्धुजीवनिभो भानुः शिशिराद्येषु शस्यते ..
अस्वच्छवर्णः परुषो वेपनः खण्डमण्डलः ..1.85.40..
text_mt: or resembling the bandhujīva flower, the sun is praised in the seasons beginning with Śiśira. / Unclear in color, harsh, trembling, with its disk broken,

sanskrit_iast:
sacchidre rajasā dhvasta ulkādyupahatopi vā ..
maṇḍalādanyasaṃsthānaṃ meghaiścāyudhasannibhaiḥ..41..
meaning:
सच्छिद्रे रजसा ध्वस्त उल्काद्युपहतोपि वा ..
मण्डलादन्यसंस्थानं मेघैश्चायुधसन्निभैः..41..
text_mt: having holes, obscured by dust, or struck by meteors and the like, / possessing a shape other than a disk, or covered with clouds resembling weapons

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamaye cchannaḥ pārthivānāṃ na śasyate..
pakṣādau cāpasaṃsthāne yuddhaṃ śaśini nirdiśet..42..
meaning:
उदयास्तमये च्छन्नः पार्थिवानां न शस्यते..
पक्षादौ चापसंस्थाने युद्धं शशिनि निर्दिशेत्..42..
text_mt: at rising or setting, it is not auspicious for kings. / At the beginning of a fortnight, if the moon has the shape of a bow, one should indicate war.

sanskrit_iast:
lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ yatra dṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ tataḥ ..
samakoṭiviśālaśca kiṃcidvāpyuttaronnataḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
लाभस्तेषां जयस्तेषां यत्र दृष्टं भयं ततः ..
समकोटिविशालश्च किंचिद्वाप्युत्तरोन्नतः .. 43 ..
text_mt: Gain belongs to them, victory belongs to them, from where fear is seen. / Having even horns and broad, or slightly elevated to the north,

sanskrit_iast:
māsādau candramāḥ śasto vāma eva viparyayaḥ ..
maṇḍalenāntarīkurvañśṛṅge sā yadi vā spṛśet .. 44 ..
meaning:
मासादौ चन्द्रमाः शस्तो वाम एव विपर्ययः ..
मण्डलेनान्तरीकुर्वञ्शृङ्गे सा यदि वा स्पृशेत् .. 44 ..
text_mt: the moon at the beginning of the month is auspicious; the reverse is just unfavourable. / If, obscuring with its disk, or if it touches with its horns

sanskrit_iast:
tārāgrahaṃ tadā kuryādbhayaṃ janapade śaśī ..
śuklapakṣasya yā vṛddhirloke kṣemasubhikṣadā..45 ..
meaning:
ताराग्रहं तदा कुर्याद्भयं जनपदे शशी ..
शुक्लपक्षस्य या वृद्धिर्लोके क्षेमसुभिक्षदा..45 ..
text_mt: a planet, then the moon will cause danger in the countryside. / The increase of the bright fortnight brings safety and abundance to the world;

sanskrit_iast:
sā sitetarapakṣasya pṛthivyāṃ naiva gamyate ..
śravaṇebhyudito bhaumaḥ puṣye vakramiyādyadi .. 46 ..
meaning:
सा सितेतरपक्षस्य पृथिव्यां नैव गम्यते ..
श्रवणेभ्युदितो भौमः पुष्ये वक्रमियाद्यदि .. 46 ..
text_mt: that of the dark fortnight is not perceived [as such] on earth. / If Mars, having risen in Śravaṇa, goes retrograde in Puṣya,

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyuditaścandro nāśāya syānmahīkṣitāma ..
gatāgataṃ yadā kuryānmaghāmadhyena lohitaḥ.. 47 ..
meaning:
प्राजापत्युदितश्चन्द्रो नाशाय स्यान्महीक्षिताम ..
गतागतं यदा कुर्यान्मघामध्येन लोहितः.. 47 ..
text_mt: or if the moon rises in Rohiṇī, it will cause the destruction of kings. / When the Red Planet moves forward and backward through the middle of Maghā,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā bhavatyanāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṇḍyo rājā vinaśyati ..
phalgunyorudayaṃ kṛtvā vakraḥ syādvaiśvadaivake..48..
meaning:
तदा भवत्यनावृष्टिः पाण्ड्यो राजा विनश्यति ..
फल्गुन्योरुदयं कृत्वा वक्रः स्याद्वैश्वदैवके..48..
text_mt: then drought occurs, and the Pāṇḍya king perishes. / Having risen in the two Phalgunīs, if it should turn retrograde in Uttarāṣāḍhā,

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatye pravāsaśca trailokyaṃ tatra pīḍyate ..
dhruveṣu vaiṣṇave mūle śākre ca vicarankujaḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
प्रजापत्ये प्रवासश्च त्रैलोक्यं तत्र पीड्यते ..
ध्रुवेषु वैष्णवे मूले शाक्रे च विचरन्कुजः .. 49 ..
text_mt: and stay in Rohiṇī, the three worlds are afflicted there. / When Mars wanders in the fixed [constellations], Śravaṇa, Mūla, and Jyeṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
ghorāṃ karotyanāvṛṣṭiṃ kṛttikāsu maghāsu ca ..
kārttike'śvayuje pauṣe cāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe budhaḥ ..1.85.50..
meaning:
घोरां करोत्यनावृष्टिं कृत्तिकासु मघासु च ..
कार्त्तिकेऽश्वयुजे पौषे चाषाढे श्रावणे बुधः ..1.85.50..
text_mt: it causes severe drought, as also in Kṛttikā and Maghā. / In Kārttika, Āśvina, Pauṣa, Āṣāḍha, and Śrāvaṇa, Mercury,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭo loke bhayāya syānmāghavaiśākhayostathā ..
akasmādyatra dṛśyeta divā devapurohitaḥ..51..
meaning:
दृष्टो लोके भयाय स्यान्माघवैशाखयोस्तथा ..
अकस्माद्यत्र दृश्येत दिवा देवपुरोहितः..51..
text_mt: when seen, brings fear to the world, and likewise in Māgha and Vaiśākha. / Where the priest of the gods is suddenly seen by day,

sanskrit_iast:
rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati ..
ahassarvaṃ yadā śukro dṛśyate'tha mahāgrahaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
राजा वा म्रियते तत्र स वा देशो विनश्यति ..
अहस्सर्वं यदा शुक्रो दृश्यतेऽथ महाग्रहः .. 52 ..
text_mt: either the king dies there, or that country perishes. / When Venus, the great planet, is seen for the entire day,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tvagnyādibhirgrāmānbādhate nagarāṇi ca ..
kārttike tu yadā māsi kurvāte'stamayādayau .. 53 ..
meaning:
तदा त्वग्न्यादिभिर्ग्रामान्बाधते नगराणि च ..
कार्त्तिके तु यदा मासि कुर्वातेऽस्तमयादयौ .. 53 ..
text_mt: then it afflicts villages and cities with fire and other [calamities]. / But when they set and rise in the month of Kārttika,

sanskrit_iast:
tadahnāṃ navati pūrṇaṃ bhuvi devo na varṣati ..
śanaiścaro deśapīḍāṃ deśanakṣatrapīḍane .. 54 ..
meaning:
तदह्नां नवति पूर्णं भुवि देवो न वर्षति ..
शनैश्चरो देशपीडां देशनक्षत्रपीडने .. 54 ..
text_mt: then for ninety full days the god does not rain upon the earth. / Saturn causes affliction to a country when the country's constellation is afflicted,

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ karoti rājendra nityaṃ cāravaśena tu ..
saptāhāntargatā ye vai divyapārthivanābhasāḥ ..
grahoparāge tīvrāssyurutpātāḥ svaphaleṣu te .. 55 ..
meaning:
ध्रुवं करोति राजेन्द्र नित्यं चारवशेन तु ..
सप्ताहान्तर्गता ये वै दिव्यपार्थिवनाभसाः ..
ग्रहोपरागे तीव्रास्स्युरुत्पाताः स्वफलेषु ते .. 55 ..
text_mt: certainly, O best of kings, constantly through its movement. / Portents of the heavens, the earth, and the atmosphere that occur within seven days

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminyadi māse syādgrahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ ..
brahmakṣatravirodhāya viparītavivṛddhaye .. 56 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिन्यदि मासे स्याद्ग्रहणं चन्द्रसूर्ययोः ..
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविरोधाय विपरीतविवृद्धये .. 56 ..
text_mt: of an eclipse of a planet become severe in their effects. / If an eclipse of the sun and moon should occur in a single month,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmindṛśyeta nakṣatre viśākhāyāṃ pradhūpavat ..
taddeśajātā pīḍā syādbudhaketumahāgrahāḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
यस्मिन्दृश्येत नक्षत्रे विशाखायां प्रधूपवत् ..
तद्देशजाता पीडा स्याद्बुधकेतुमहाग्रहाः .. 57 ..
text_mt: it leads to conflict between brahmins and kṣatriyas and to an increase of adversity. / In whichever constellation, [or] in Viśākhā, Mercury, Ketu, [or] the great planets

sanskrit_iast:
ulkādyabhihate sūrye ketubhirvā vidhūmite ..
agastye vā dhruve vāpi prajāpīḍāṃ vinirdiśeta .. 58 ..
meaning:
उल्काद्यभिहते सूर्ये केतुभिर्वा विधूमिते ..
अगस्त्ये वा ध्रुवे वापि प्रजापीडां विनिर्दिशेत .. 58 ..
text_mt: are seen like smoke, affliction will arise for those born in that country. / When the sun is struck by meteors and the like, or obscured by smoke from comets,

sanskrit_iast:
ulkayābhihatā rūkṣā sphuraṇā rajasā yutāḥ ..
ṛṣayassapta lokānāṃ vināśāya ca bhūbhṛtām .. 59 ..
meaning:
उल्कयाभिहता रूक्षा स्फुरणा रजसा युताः ..
ऋषयस्सप्त लोकानां विनाशाय च भूभृताम् .. 59 ..
text_mt: or when Agastya or Dhruva [are so struck], one should declare affliction for the subjects. / Struck by a meteor, rough, flickering, and accompanied by dust,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikābhissahodeti śāṃkarī diśamāśritaḥ ..
kumārīprītito hanyālloke nṛpakumārakān .. 1.85.60 ..
meaning:
कृत्तिकाभिस्सहोदेति शांकरी दिशमाश्रितः ..
कुमारीप्रीतितो हन्याल्लोके नृपकुमारकान् .. 1.85.60 ..
text_mt: the Seven Sages [bring] destruction to the worlds and to kings. / Rising with the Kṛttikās, situated in the northeastern direction,

sanskrit_iast:
samāgame grahāṇāṃ tu candramāḥ śasyate hyudak ..
nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca rājendra dakṣiṇena na śasyate .. 61 ..
meaning:
समागमे ग्रहाणां तु चन्द्रमाः शस्यते ह्युदक् ..
नक्षत्राणां च राजेन्द्र दक्षिणेन न शस्यते .. 61 ..
text_mt: out of love for Kumārī, it kills royal princes in the world. / In the conjunction of planets, the moon is indeed praised in the north;

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuḥ ketuḥ kujaḥ śakraścandreṇa sahayāyinaḥ ..
budho jīvaśca sauraśca nāgarā raviṇā saha..62..
meaning:
राहुः केतुः कुजः शक्रश्चन्द्रेण सहयायिनः ..
बुधो जीवश्च सौरश्च नागरा रविणा सह..62..
text_mt: and to the south of the constellations, O best of kings, it is not praised. / Rāhu, Ketu, Mars, and Saturn are marchers along with the moon; / Mercury, Jupiter, and Saturn are city-dwellers along with the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yāyinā vijite paure rājñāṃ syādyāyināṃ jayaḥ ..
yāyigrahe paurajite purā rājñāṃ jayo mṛdhe .. 63 ..
meaning:
यायिना विजिते पौरे राज्ञां स्याद्यायिनां जयः ..
यायिग्रहे पौरजिते पुरा राज्ञां जयो मृधे .. 63 ..
text_mt: When a city-dweller is conquered by a marcher, victory will belong to marching kings. / When a marching planet is conquered by a city-dweller, victory belongs to city kings in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
paureṇa vijite paure pauraiḥ paurakṣayaṃ vadet ..
yāyinā yāyini hate yāyibhyo yāyināṃ kṣayaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
पौरेण विजिते पौरे पौरैः पौरक्षयं वदेत् ..
यायिना यायिनि हते यायिभ्यो यायिनां क्षयः .. 64 ..
text_mt: When a city-dweller is conquered by a city-dweller, one should declare the destruction of city-dwellers by city-dwellers. / When a marcher is struck down by a marcher, there is destruction of marchers from marchers.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ cedbhavetsāmyaṃ sāmyaṃ rājñāṃ vinirdiśet ..
jayājayau narendrāṇāṃ nirdeśyo grahavadbudhaiḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
ग्रहाणां चेद्भवेत्साम्यं साम्यं राज्ञां विनिर्दिशेत् ..
जयाजयौ नरेन्द्राणां निर्देश्यो ग्रहवद्बुधैः .. 65 ..
text_mt: If there is equality among the planets, one should declare equality among the kings. / Victory and defeat of rulers of men should be indicated by the wise according to the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
grahārūḍhaścyutassthānātsphureṇa vijito grahaḥ ..
vijito jayaliṅgaiśca kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmadyutistathā .. 66 ..
meaning:
ग्रहारूढश्च्युतस्स्थानात्स्फुरेण विजितो ग्रहः ..
विजितो जयलिङ्गैश्च कृष्णः श्यामद्युतिस्तथा .. 66 ..
text_mt: A planet mounted by another planet, fallen from its place, [or] conquered by trembling, / is conquered, as is one with the marks of victory [reversed], black, or of dark brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmārgagatiḥ snigdho vimalo vimalaprabhaḥ ..
bṛhadrūpotiśukraśca vijayī kathito grahaḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
उदङ्मार्गगतिः स्निग्धो विमलो विमलप्रभः ..
बृहद्रूपोतिशुक्रश्च विजयी कथितो ग्रहः .. 67 ..
text_mt: Moving on a northern path, glossy, spotless, of clean brilliance, / large in form, and very bright, a planet is declared victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
na deyametaccapalasya loke na nāstikasyādhamapūruṣasya ..
guhyaṃ munīnāmapi pārthivendra mayeritaṃ kālaviniścayaṃ te..68..
meaning:
न देयमेतच्चपलस्य लोके न नास्तिकस्याधमपूरुषस्य ..
गुह्यं मुनीनामपि पार्थिवेन्द्र मयेरितं कालविनिश्चयं ते..68..
text_mt: This must not be given to an unsteady man in the world, nor to an atheist, the lowest of men. / This secret even of the sages, the determination of time, has been spoken by me to you, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 grahaśubhāśubhaparijñānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamoyāyaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0सं0 ग्रहशुभाशुभपरिज्ञानवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमोयायः .. 85 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Knowledge of Auspicious and Inauspicious Planetary Signs,' in the First Book of the venerable Viṣṇudharmottara, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
pratideśaṃ mahābhāga kathaṃ prāptamupadravam ..
vijñāyate dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
प्रतिदेशं महाभाग कथं प्राप्तमुपद्रवम् ..
विज्ञायते द्विजश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / In each region, O fortunate one, how is an impending calamity / recognized, O best of the twice-born? Tell me that as I ask.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛttikāṃ rohiṇīṃ saumyaṃ madhyadeśasya nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye'tasminmadhyadeśaḥ prapīḍyate .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
कृत्तिकां रोहिणीं सौम्यं मध्यदेशस्य निर्दिशेत् ..
पीडिते त्रितयेऽतस्मिन्मध्यदेशः प्रपीड्यते .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / One should assign Kṛttikā, Rohiṇī, and Mṛgaśīrṣa to the central country. / When this triad is afflicted, the central country is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdrāṃ punarvasuṃ puṣyaṃ pūrvadeśasya nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminpūrvadeśaḥ prapīḍyate .. 3 ..
meaning:
आर्द्रां पुनर्वसुं पुष्यं पूर्वदेशस्य निर्दिशेत् ..
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पूर्वदेशः प्रपीड्यते .. 3 ..
text_mt: One should assign Ārdrā, Punarvasu, and Puṣya to the eastern country. / When this triad is afflicted, the eastern country is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāṃ tu maghāṃ pūrvāṃ cāgneyyāṃ diśi nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnāgneyī pīḍyate'tha dik .. 4 ..
meaning:
आश्लेषां तु मघां पूर्वां चाग्नेय्यां दिशि निर्दिशेत् ..
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नाग्नेयी पीड्यतेऽथ दिक् .. 4 ..
text_mt: One should assign Āśleṣā, Maghā, and Pūrvaphalgunī to the southeastern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, then the southeastern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
āryamṇamatha hastaṃ ca tvāṣṭraṃ syāddiśi dakṣiṇe ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate dakṣiṇā ca dik .. 5 ..
meaning:
आर्यम्णमथ हस्तं च त्वाष्ट्रं स्याद्दिशि दक्षिणे ..
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पीड्यते दक्षिणा च दिक् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Uttarāphalgunī, Hasta, and Citrā pertain to the southern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the southern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
svātiṃ viśākhāṃ maitraṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ diśi nirdiśet .
pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate nairṛtī ca dik .. 6 ..
meaning:
स्वातिं विशाखां मैत्रं च नैरृत्यां दिशि निर्दिशेत् .
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पीड्यते नैरृती च दिक् .. 6 ..
text_mt: One should assign Svātī, Viśākhā, and Anurādhā to the southwestern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the southwestern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyāṃ diśi nirdiṣṭā vaiśvavaiṣṇavavāsavāḥ .
pīḍite tritaye tasminvāyavī pīḍyate ca dik .. 7 ..
