वायव्यां दिशि निर्दिष्टा वैश्ववैष्णववासवाः .
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्वायवी पीड्यते च दिक् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Uttarāṣāḍhā, Śravaṇa, and Dhaniṣṭhā are assigned to the northwestern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the northwestern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇaṃ cājadaivatyaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ tathottare ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnuttarā dikprapīḍyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
वारुणं चाजदैवत्यं चाहिर्बुध्न्यं तथोत्तरे ..
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नुत्तरा दिक्प्रपीड्यते .. 8 ..
text_mt: Śatabhiṣaj, Pūrvabhādrapadā, and Uttarabhādrapadā [belong] likewise to the north. / When this triad is afflicted, the northern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
revatī cāśvinī yāmyamaiśānī dik prapīḍitā ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnīśānī dik prapīḍyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
रेवती चाश्विनी याम्यमैशानी दिक् प्रपीडिता ..
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नीशानी दिक् प्रपीड्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt: Revatī, Aśvinī, and Bharaṇī are afflicted for the northeastern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the northeastern direction is afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityo bhṛgujo bhaumo rāhussauro niśākaraḥ ..
budho bṛhaspatiścaiva prācyādīśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. .. 1.86.10 ..
meaning:
आदित्यो भृगुजो भौमो राहुस्सौरो निशाकरः ..
बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चैव प्राच्यादीशाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. .. 1.86.10 ..
text_mt: The Sun, Venus, Mars, Rāhu, Saturn, the Moon, / Mercury, and Jupiter are declared to be the lords of the directions beginning with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhvastavapuṣaste ca grahayuddhe parājitāḥ ..
nīcāḥ pitṛgṛhasthāśca svāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti te .. 11 ..
meaning:
विध्वस्तवपुषस्ते च ग्रहयुद्धे पराजिताः ..
नीचाः पितृगृहस्थाश्च स्वां दिशं पीडयन्ति ते .. 11 ..
text_mt: When their bodies are destroyed, defeated in planetary war, / debilitated, or situated in the house of the deceased, they afflict their own direction.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
svadeśapīḍanaṃ kuryānnakṣatraḥ pīḍitaḥ katham ..
sarvametanmamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 12 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
स्वदेशपीडनं कुर्यान्नक्षत्रः पीडितः कथम् ..
सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर .. 12 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / How does an afflicted asterism cause affliction to its own region? / Tell me all this, O best among all upholders of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śanaiścarārkau cāreṇa vakreṇāṅgārako grahaḥ ..
uparāgeṇa rāhuśca ketuścādhūmanodayaiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
शनैश्चरार्कौ चारेण वक्रेणाङ्गारको ग्रहः ..
उपरागेण राहुश्च केतुश्चाधूमनोदयैः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Saturn and the Sun [afflict] by their transit, the planet Mars by retrograde motion, / Rāhu by eclipse, and Ketu by smoky risings;

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca jīvaśukraśaśāṅkajāḥ ..
saṃcchādanena ca śaśī hyagastyaścaiva yogataḥ .. 14 ...
meaning:
उदयास्तमयाभ्यां च जीवशुक्रशशाङ्कजाः ..
संच्छादनेन च शशी ह्यगस्त्यश्चैव योगतः .. 14 ...
text_mt: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury by their rising and setting, / the Moon by occultation, and Agastya by conjunction.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yasmim̐śca nakṣatre divyapārthivanābhasāḥ ..
dṛśyante tu mahotpātāḥ svāṃ diśaṃ saṃprapīḍayet .. 15 ..
meaning:
तथा यस्मिम्̐श्च नक्षत्रे दिव्यपार्थिवनाभसाः ..
दृश्यन्ते तु महोत्पाताः स्वां दिशं संप्रपीडयेत् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Likewise, in whichever asterism celestial, terrestrial, and atmospheric / great portents are seen, it afflicts its own direction.

sanskrit_iast:
deśeṣu sarveṣu mayeritaṃ te śubhāśubhaṃ yādava mukhyanātha ..
ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan ..16..
meaning:
देशेषु सर्वेषु मयेरितं ते शुभाशुभं यादव मुख्यनाथ ..
अतः परं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ वदस्व किं ते कथयामि राजन् ..16..
text_mt: I have explained to you the good and evil concerning all countries, O foremost lord of the Yādavas; / beyond this, O supreme among upholders of dharma, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ bhagavanpuruṣaṃ prati ..
tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
शुभाशुभपरिज्ञानं भगवन्पुरुषं प्रति ..
त्वत्तोहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / O lord, I wish to hear from you the discernment / of good and evil with respect to an individual; tell that to me who am asking.
title: adhyāyaḥ 87

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaśca saptamo daśamastathā ..
ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣāṃ tadā teṣāṃ śubhaṃ bhavet..2..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच..
जन्माश्रितस्त्रिषष्ठश्च सप्तमो दशमस्तथा ..
एकादशः शशी येषां तदा तेषां शुभं भवेत्..2..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Moon is in the natal [sign], third, sixth, seventh, tenth, / or eleventh for them, then they will have good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
janmanyatha caturthe ca sāṣṭame daśame tathā ..
ekādeśe budho yeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet .. 3 ..
meaning:
जन्मन्यथ चतुर्थे च साष्टमे दशमे तथा ..
एकादेशे बुधो येषां तेषामपि शुभं वदेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: When Mercury is in the natal [sign], fourth, eighth, tenth, / or eleventh for them, one should state that they also have good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipañcamagato jīvassaptamo navamastathā ..
ekādaśastathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet.. .. 4 ..
meaning:
द्विपञ्चमगतो जीवस्सप्तमो नवमस्तथा ..
एकादशस्तथा ह्येषां तेषामपि शुभं वदेत्.. .. 4 ..
text_mt: When Jupiter is in the second, fifth, seventh, ninth, / or eleventh for them, one should state that they also have good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhasaptamagaḥ śukro daśame na ca śobhanaḥ ..
dvādaśaśca tathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ pīḍāṃ vinirdiśet .. 5 ..
meaning:
षष्ठसप्तमगः शुक्रो दशमे न च शोभनः ..
द्वादशश्च तथा ह्येषां तेषां पीडां विनिर्दिशेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Venus in the sixth or seventh, and in the tenth, is not auspicious; / and likewise in the twelfth for them—one should predict affliction for them.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye daśame ṣaṣṭhe tathā caikādaśe śubhā ..
saurāratīkṣṇakiraṇā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śubhaṃ vadet .. 6 ..
meaning:
तृतीये दशमे षष्ठे तथा चैकादशे शुभा ..
सौरारतीक्ष्णकिरणा येषां तेषां शुभं वदेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Saturn, Mars, and the Sun are auspicious in the third, tenth, sixth, / and eleventh; for those who have them thus, one should declare good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminhi jananaṃ yasya janmarkṣaṃ tasya tatsmṛtam ..
caturthaṃ mānasaṃ tasmāddaśamaṃ karmasaṃjñitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
यस्मिन्हि जननं यस्य जन्मर्क्षं तस्य तत्स्मृतम् ..
चतुर्थं मानसं तस्माद्दशमं कर्मसंज्ञितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: The asterism in which one's birth takes place is called one's natal asterism. / The fourth from it is the mental [asterism], and the tenth is called the action [asterism].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgātakaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ syādviṃśaṃ syātsāmudāyikam ..
vaināśakaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ karmarkṣaṃ yattrayodaśam .. 8 ...
meaning:
संगातकं षोडशं स्याद्विंशं स्यात्सामुदायिकम् ..
वैनाशकं तु नक्षत्रं कर्मर्क्षं यत्त्रयोदशम् .. 8 ...
text_mt: The sixteenth is the collective [asterism], the twentieth is the gathering [asterism], / while the destructive asterism is the thirteenth from the action asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇṇakṣatrastu puruṣassarvaḥ prokto mahīpate ..
rājā ca navanakṣatro nakṣatratritayaṃ śṛṇu .. 9 ..
meaning:
षण्णक्षत्रस्तु पुरुषस्सर्वः प्रोक्तो महीपते ..
राजा च नवनक्षत्रो नक्षत्रत्रितयं शृणु .. 9 ..
text_mt: Every man, O lord of the earth, is said to have six asterisms, / but a king has nine asterisms; hear the triad of asterisms

sanskrit_iast:
nityamabhyadhikaṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ pārthivasya nṛpottama ...
deśābhiṣekanakṣatrau jātinakṣatrameva ca .. 1.87.10 ..
meaning:
नित्यमभ्यधिकं षड्भ्यः पार्थिवस्य नृपोत्तम ...
देशाभिषेकनक्षत्रौ जातिनक्षत्रमेव च .. 1.87.10 ..
text_mt: that is always in addition to the six for an earthly ruler, O best of kings: / the country asterism, the coronation asterism, and the caste asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
jātyāśritāni vakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha ..
pūrvātrayamathāgneyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prakīrtitam .. 11 ...
meaning:
जात्याश्रितानि वक्ष्यामि नक्षत्राणि तवानघ ..
पूर्वात्रयमथाग्नेयं ब्राह्मणानां प्रकीर्तितम् .. 11 ...
text_mt: I shall declare to you the asterisms associated with castes, O sinless one: / the triad of Pūrva [asterisms] and the one sacred to Agni are proclaimed for brahmins;

sanskrit_iast:
uttarātritayaṃ puṣyaṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ prakīrttitam ..
pauṣṇaṃ maitraṃ tathā pitryaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśāṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
meaning:
उत्तरात्रितयं पुष्यं क्षत्त्रियाणां प्रकीर्त्तितम् ..
पौष्णं मैत्रं तथा पित्र्यं प्राजापत्यं विशां स्मृतम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: the triad of Uttara [asterisms] and Puṣya are proclaimed for kṣatriyas; / Pauṣṇa, Maitra, that sacred to the Ancestors, and that sacred to Prajāpati are remembered for vaiśyas;

sanskrit_iast:
ādityamāśvinaṃ hastaḥ śūdrāṇāmabhijittathā ..
sārpaṃ viśākhā yāmyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca narādhipa .. 13 ..
meaning:
आदित्यमाश्विनं हस्तः शूद्राणामभिजित्तथा ..
सार्पं विशाखा याम्यं च वैष्णवं च नराधिप .. 13 ..
text_mt: that sacred to Aditi, that sacred to the Aśvins, Hasta, and Abhijit are for śūdras; / and that sacred to the Serpents, Viśākhā, that sacred to Yama, and that sacred to Viṣṇu, O lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
pratilomabhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitam ..
īhāde hyarthahānissyājjanmarkṣe copatāpite .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्रतिलोमभवानां च सर्वेषां परिकीर्तितम् ..
ईहादे ह्यर्थहानिस्स्याज्जन्मर्क्षे चोपतापिते .. 14 ..
text_mt: are proclaimed for all those born against the natural order of castes. / When the natal asterism is afflicted, there is loss of wealth in this world;

sanskrit_iast:
karmarkṣe karmaṇāṃ hāniḥ pīḍā manasi mānase ..
mūrttidraviṇabandhūnāṃ hānissaṃghātike hate .. 15 ..
meaning:
कर्मर्क्षे कर्मणां हानिः पीडा मनसि मानसे ..
मूर्त्तिद्रविणबन्धूनां हानिस्संघातिके हते .. 15 ..
text_mt: when the action asterism is afflicted, there is loss of actions; when the mental is afflicted, distress in the mind; / when the collective is struck, loss of bodily health, wealth, and kinsmen;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtapte sāmudāyarkṣe mitrabhṛtyārthasaṃkṣayaḥ ..
vaināśike vināśassyāddehadraviṇasaṃpadām .. 16 ..
meaning:
संतप्ते सामुदायर्क्षे मित्रभृत्यार्थसंक्षयः ..
वैनाशिके विनाशस्स्याद्देहद्रविणसंपदाम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: when the gathering asterism is scorched, destruction of friends, servants, and wealth; / when the destructive asterism is afflicted, there is destruction of the body, wealth, and fortunes;

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe rājyabhraṃśaṃ vinirdiśet ..
deśarkṣe pīḍite pīḍāṃ deśasya ca purasya ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
पीडिते चाभिषेकर्क्षे राज्यभ्रंशं विनिर्दिशेत् ..
देशर्क्षे पीडिते पीडां देशस्य च पुरस्य च .. 17 ..
text_mt: when the coronation asterism is afflicted, one should predict fall from the kingdom; / when the country asterism is afflicted, distress for the country and city;

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍite jātinakṣatre rājño vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet .. 18 ..
graharkṣajātā samavāpya pīḍāṃ pūjā tu kāryā vidhinā svakena ..
tataśśubhaṃ vindati rājasiṃha vidhūtapāpaḥ puruṣassadaiva ..15
meaning:
पीडिते जातिनक्षत्रे राज्ञो व्याधिं विनिर्दिशेत् .. 18 ..
ग्रहर्क्षजाता समवाप्य पीडां पूजा तु कार्या विधिना स्वकेन ..
ततश्शुभं विन्दति राजसिंह विधूतपापः पुरुषस्सदैव ..15
text_mt:
and when the caste asterism is afflicted, one should predict illness for the king.
Having encountered affliction born of planets and asterisms, worship should be performed according to its own rule; / then, O lion among kings, the person, freed from evil, always attains good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
grahāṇāṃ bhṛguśārdūla nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..
pūjane vidhimācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
ग्रहाणां भृगुशार्दूल नक्षत्राणां तथैव च ..
पूजने विधिमाचक्ष्व तत्र मे संशयो महान् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / O tiger among the Bhṛgus, tell me the rule for worshiping / the planets and likewise the asterisms; I have great doubt in that matter.
title: adhyāyaḥ 88

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
grahassādhipatiḥ kāryo nityaṃ maṇḍalake budhaiḥ ..
nakṣatraścandrasahitastathā sādhipatirnṛpa .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ग्रहस्साधिपतिः कार्यो नित्यं मण्डलके बुधैः ..
नक्षत्रश्चन्द्रसहितस्तथा साधिपतिर्नृप .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The planet along with its presiding deity should always be drawn by the wise in a sacred diagram; / and the asterism together with the Moon and its presiding deity, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyātā tārakāstasya yathāvanmanujeśvara ..
teṣāṃ tārakasaṃkhyānaṃ nibodha gadato mama .. 3 ..
meaning:
संख्याता तारकास्तस्य यथावन्मनुजेश्वर ..
तेषां तारकसंख्यानं निबोध गदतो मम .. 3 ..
text_mt: Its stars are counted properly, O lord of men; / learn the count of those stars from me as I speak.

sanskrit_iast:
raudraṃ puṣyaṃ tathā tvāṣṭraṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā ..
pauṣṇaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha kathitaṃ tvekatārakam..4..
meaning:
रौद्रं पुष्यं तथा त्वाष्ट्रं वायव्यं वारुणं तथा ..
पौष्णं च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ कथितं त्वेकतारकम्..4..
text_mt: Raudra, Puṣya, Tvāṣṭra, Vāyavya, Vāruṇa, / and Pauṣṇa are declared to have one star, O best of earthly rulers.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitāraṃ phalgunīyugmaṃ tathā bhādrapadādvayam..
ādityaṃ ca tathā mūlaṃ caindrāgnaṃ cāśvinaṃ tathā..5..
meaning:
द्वितारं फल्गुनीयुग्मं तथा भाद्रपदाद्वयम्..
आदित्यं च तथा मूलं चैन्द्राग्नं चाश्विनं तथा..5..
text_mt: The two Phalgunīs have two stars, as do the two Bhādrapadās, / Āditya, Mūla, Aindrāgna, and Āśvina.

sanskrit_iast:
tritāraṃ bharaṇī saumyamaindraṃ brāhmaṃ savaiṣṇavam ..
catustāramathāṣāḍhe dve maitraṃ yadunandana .. 6 ..
meaning:
त्रितारं भरणी सौम्यमैन्द्रं ब्राह्मं सवैष्णवम् ..
चतुस्तारमथाषाढे द्वे मैत्रं यदुनन्दन .. 6 ..
text_mt: Bharaṇī, Saumya, Aindra, Brāhma, and Vaiṣṇava have three stars; / both the Āṣāḍhās and Maitra have four stars, O joy of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcatāraḥ smṛto hastaḥ prājāpatyaṃ ca vāsavam ..
sārpaṃ pitryamathāgneyaṃ ṣaṭtāraṃ parikīrtitam .. 7 ..
meaning:
पञ्चतारः स्मृतो हस्तः प्राजापत्यं च वासवम् ..
सार्पं पित्र्यमथाग्नेयं षट्तारं परिकीर्तितम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Hasta, Prājāpatya, and Vāsava are recorded as having five stars; / that sacred to the Serpents, that sacred to the Ancestors, and that sacred to Agni are proclaimed to have six stars.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityamaṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmavarṇaṃ narādhipa ..
śvetaṃ candramasaḥ kāryaṃ raktaṃ kāryaṃ kujasya ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
आदित्यमण्डलं कार्यं पद्मवर्णं नराधिप ..
श्वेतं चन्द्रमसः कार्यं रक्तं कार्यं कुजस्य च .. 8 ..
text_mt: The sacred diagram of the Sun should be made lotus-coloured, O lord of men; / that of the Moon should be made white, and that of Mars red.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlaṃ budhasya karttavyaṃ pītavarṇaṃ bṛhaspateḥ ..
śvetaṃ śukrasya karttavyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saurasya pārthiva .. 9 ..
meaning:
नीलं बुधस्य कर्त्तव्यं पीतवर्णं बृहस्पतेः ..
श्वेतं शुक्रस्य कर्त्तव्यं कृष्णं सौरस्य पार्थिव .. 9 ..
text_mt: That of Mercury should be made blue, that of Jupiter yellow, / that of Venus should be made white, and that of Saturn black, O earthly ruler.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ ketordhūmaprabhaṃ tathā ..
raktavarṇaṃ kṛttikānāṃ phalgunīdvitayasya ca .. 1.88.10 ..
meaning:
आकाशवर्णं तमसः केतोर्धूमप्रभं तथा ..
रक्तवर्णं कृत्तिकानां फल्गुनीद्वितयस्य च .. 1.88.10 ..
text_mt: That of Rāhu should be sky-coloured, and that of Ketu smoke-coloured; / the colour of Kṛttikā and the pair of Phalgunīs is red,

sanskrit_iast:
hastasya ca sapauṣṇasya maitrasya ca narādhipa ..
pītaṃ puṣyasya keśasya śākravāḍavayostathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
हस्तस्य च सपौष्णस्य मैत्रस्य च नराधिप ..
पीतं पुष्यस्य केशस्य शाक्रवाडवयोस्तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: and of Hasta along with Pauṣṇa and Maitra, O lord of men; / yellow is that of Puṣya, Keśa, and Śākravāḍava;

sanskrit_iast:
śvetaṃ saumyasya raudrasya āpyavāruṇayostathā ..
ādityasārpapitryāṇāṃ brāhmavāyavyayostathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
श्वेतं सौम्यस्य रौद्रस्य आप्यवारुणयोस्तथा ..
आदित्यसार्पपित्र्याणां ब्राह्मवायव्ययोस्तथा .. 12 ..
text_mt: white is that of Saumya, Raudra, Āpya, Vāruṇa, / Āditya, Sārpa, Pitrya, Brāhma, and Vāyavya;

sanskrit_iast:
proṣṭhapādadvayasyātha śvetamevābhidhīyate ..
vicitravarṇaṃ tvāṣṭrasya vaiśvadevasya cāpyatha .. 13 ..
meaning:
प्रोष्ठपादद्वयस्याथ श्वेतमेवाभिधीयते ..
विचित्रवर्णं त्वाष्ट्रस्य वैश्वदेवस्य चाप्यथ .. 13 ..
text_mt: and that of the two Proṣṭhapadās is declared to be white as well. / Variegated in colour is that of Tvāṣṭra and Vaiśvadeva;

sanskrit_iast:
āśvinasya tathā kāryaṃ nityameva narādhipa ..
kṛṣṇaṃ yāmyasya mūlasya pālāśaṃ śravaṇasya ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
आश्विनस्य तथा कार्यं नित्यमेव नराधिप ..
कृष्णं याम्यस्य मूलस्य पालाशं श्रवणस्य च .. 14 ..
text_mt: that of Āśvina should always be made likewise, O lord of men; / black is that of Yāmya and Mūla, and green that of Śravaṇa;

sanskrit_iast: viśākhāyāṃ pītaraktaṃ karttavyaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalam ..15..
meaning: विशाखायां पीतरक्तं कर्त्तव्यं नृपमण्डलम् ..15..
text_mt: for Viśākhā, O king, the sacred diagram should be made yellow-red.

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktavarṇena narendra kṛtvā pūrvaṃ grahasyānagha maṇḍalaṃ svam ..
ṛkṣasya vā pūjyatamasya rājanpūjā vidheyā tadanantaraṃ ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
यथोक्तवर्णेन नरेन्द्र कृत्वा पूर्वं ग्रहस्यानघ मण्डलं स्वम् ..
ऋक्षस्य वा पूज्यतमस्य राजन्पूजा विधेया तदनन्तरं च .. 16 ..
text_mt: Having first made the planet's own sacred diagram with the prescribed colour, O sinless lord of men, / or that of the asterism to be worshipped, O king, worship should be performed immediately thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śakṛnmūtraṃ tu saṃgṛhya śvetasya vṛṣabhasya ca ..
śvetagoḥ payasā sārdhaṃ snātavyaṃ kuśavāriṇā ..1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
शकृन्मूत्रं तु संगृह्य श्वेतस्य वृषभस्य च ..
श्वेतगोः पयसा सार्धं स्नातव्यं कुशवारिणा ..1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having collected dung and urine of a white bull, / along with the milk of a white cow, one should bathe with water infused with kuśa grass.
title: Nakṣatrasnānam

sanskrit_iast:
janmanakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ tasmāddoṣā dvimucyate ..
śirīṣacandanāśvatthatāṭanāgāmbubhirnaraḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
जन्मनक्षत्रपीडायां तस्माद्दोषा द्विमुच्यते ..
शिरीषचन्दनाश्वत्थताटनागाम्बुभिर्नरः .. 2 ..
text_mt: When the birth-asterism is afflicted, one is freed from that fault. / A man [bathed] with water [infused with] śirīṣa, sandalwood, aśvattha, tāṭa, and nāga,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaścenmānase tapte tasmāddoṣo vimucyate ..
siddhārthakānpriyaṅguṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्नानश्चेन्मानसे तप्ते तस्माद्दोषो विमुच्यते ..
सिद्धार्थकान्प्रियङ्गुं च शतपुष्पां शतावरीम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: when afflicted in mind, if he bathes, is freed from that fault. / Having cast white mustard seeds, priyaṅgu, dill, and śatāvarī

गुग्गुलुं हिंगुलं तालं शुभां चैव मनःशिलाम् ..
शृंगे च माहिषे न्यस्तं राहुपीडाविनाशनम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Guggulu, cinnabar, orpiment, and auspicious realgar / placed in a buffalo horn destroy the affliction of Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhanirhṛtāṃ rājanparvatāgramṛdaṃ tathā ..
chāgaṃ kṣīraṃ khaḍgapātre ketupīḍāvināśanam .. 9 ..
meaning:
वराहनिर्हृतां राजन्पर्वताग्रमृदं तथा ..
छागं क्षीरं खड्गपात्रे केतुपीडाविनाशनम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Earth brought up by a boar, O king, and soil from a mountain peak, / along with goat's milk in an iron or rhinoceros-horn vessel, destroys the affliction caused by Ketu.

sanskrit_iast:
grahasnānamidaṃ proktamṛkṣasnānamataḥ śṛṇu ..
yena samyakprayuktena mucyate kilviṣānnaraḥ .. .. 1.91.10 ..
meaning:
ग्रहस्नानमिदं प्रोक्तमृक्षस्नानमतः शृणु ..
येन सम्यक्प्रयुक्तेन मुच्यते किल्विषान्नरः .. .. 1.91.10 ..
text_mt: This bath for the planets has been described; hear now about the asterism bath, / by which, when properly performed, a man is freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭāśvatthaśirīṣāṇāṃ patrāṇi tu tilaissaha ..
sarvagandhopapannāni kṛttikāsu vidhīyate .. 11 ..
meaning:
वटाश्वत्थशिरीषाणां पत्राणि तु तिलैस्सह ..
सर्वगन्धोपपन्नानि कृत्तिकासु विधीयते .. 11 ..
text_mt: The leaves of the banyan, holy fig, and siris tree, together with sesame seeds / and endowed with all fragrances, are prescribed during [the asterism] Kṛttikā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabījodakasnānaṃ rohiṇīṣu praśasyate ..
sarvaratnodakasnānaṃ mṛgaśīrṣe vidhīyate .. 12 ..
meaning:
सर्वबीजोदकस्नानं रोहिणीषु प्रशस्यते ..
सर्वरत्नोदकस्नानं मृगशीर्षे विधीयते .. 12 ..
text_mt: A bath in water with all varieties of seeds is commended during Rohiṇī; / a bath in water with all kinds of gems is prescribed during Mṛgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vacā ca gandhā kāntābhiḥ snānaṃ raudre prakīrtitam ..
goṣṭhamṛdgomayasnānamāditye pāpanāśanam .. 13 ..
meaning:
वचा च गन्धा कान्ताभिः स्नानं रौद्रे प्रकीर्तितम् ..
गोष्ठमृद्गोमयस्नानमादित्ये पापनाशनम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Sweet flag and fragrances with priyaṅgu herbs are declared for the bath in Raudra (Ārdrā); / a bath with cowshed soil and cow dung during Āditya (Punarvasu) destroys sin.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvauṣadhyaḥ pañcagavyaṃ tathā gaurāśca śālayaḥ ..
siddhārthakāssarvagandhāṃstiṣyasnāne śubhapradāḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वौषध्यः पञ्चगव्यं तथा गौराश्च शालयः ..
सिद्धार्थकास्सर्वगन्धांस्तिष्यस्नाने शुभप्रदाः .. 14 ..
text_mt: All medicinal herbs, the five cow products, white winter rice, / and white mustard seeds with all fragrances bestow good fortune when bathing in Tiṣya (Puṣya).

sanskrit_iast:
valmīkāgramṛdā snānaṃ tathā sārpe śubhapradam ..
satilaṃ devanirmālyaṃ snānaṃ śastaṃ maghāsu ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
वल्मीकाग्रमृदा स्नानं तथा सार्पे शुभप्रदम् ..
सतिलं देवनिर्माल्यं स्नानं शस्तं मघासु च .. 15 ..
text_mt: A bath with soil from the top of an anthill brings good fortune during Sārpa (Āśleṣā); / a bath with remains of divine flower offerings along with sesame is commended during Maghā.

sanskrit_iast:
phalgunīṣu ca pūrvāsu śāḍvalaṃ lavaṇaṃ ghṛtam ..
uttarāsu tathā snānaṃ śimbimustāpriyaṃgubhiḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
फल्गुनीषु च पूर्वासु शाड्वलं लवणं घृतम् ..
उत्तरासु तथा स्नानं शिम्बिमुस्ताप्रियंगुभिः .. 16 ..
text_mt: During Pūrvaphalgunī, turf, salt, and clarified butter [are used]; / during Uttaraphalgunī, a bath with pods, nutgrass, and priyaṅgu.

sanskrit_iast:
haste snānaṃ praśaṃsanti parvatāgrasaromṛdā ..
citrāsu devanirmālyaṃ svātau puṣpairjalodbhavaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
हस्ते स्नानं प्रशंसन्ति पर्वताग्रसरोमृदा ..
चित्रासु देवनिर्माल्यं स्वातौ पुष्पैर्जलोद्भवैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: They praise bathing during Hasta with earth from mountain peaks and lakes; / during Citrā with remains of divine offerings; during Svāti with water-born flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhāsu praśaṃsanti raudracandanapadmakaiḥ ..
nadīkūladvayānmṛdbhirmaitre snānaṃ prakīrtitam .. 18 ..
meaning:
विशाखासु प्रशंसन्ति रौद्रचन्दनपद्मकैः ..
नदीकूलद्वयान्मृद्भिर्मैत्रे स्नानं प्रकीर्तितम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: During Viśākhā they praise [a bath] with rudrākṣa, sandalwood, and red lotuses; / a bath with earth from both banks of a river is proclaimed during Maitra (Anurādhā).

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhodakena jyeṣṭhāsu suvarṇasahitaṃ hitam ..
sarvamūlajalaiḥ snānamāpye muktāphalodakaiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठोदकेन ज्येष्ठासु सुवर्णसहितं हितम् ..
सर्वमूलजलैः स्नानमाप्ये मुक्ताफलोदकैः .. 19 ..
text_mt: During Jyeṣṭhā, [a bath] with the finest water together with gold is beneficial; / during Āpya (Pūrvāṣāḍhā), a bath with water of all roots and pearl-infused water.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadeve praśaṃsanti padmakośīracandanaiḥ ..
sarvauṣadhaiścābhijiti śravaṇe saṃgamodakaiḥ .. 1.91.20 ..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवे प्रशंसन्ति पद्मकोशीरचन्दनैः ..
सर्वौषधैश्चाभिजिति श्रवणे संगमोदकैः .. 1.91.20 ..
text_mt: During Vaiśvadeva (Uttarāṣāḍhā) they praise [a bath] with lotuses, vetiver, and sandalwood; / during Abhijit with all medicinal herbs; during Śravaṇa with waters from river confluences.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīvāpījalayutairvāruṇe tu praśasyate ..
āje śrīvāsakaṃ snānaṃ kāntā puruhitaṃ hitam .. 21 ..
meaning:
नदीवापीजलयुतैर्वारुणे तु प्रशस्यते ..
आजे श्रीवासकं स्नानं कान्ता पुरुहितं हितम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: During Vāruṇa (Śatabhiṣaj), [water] mixed with water from rivers and step-wells is praised; / during Āja (Pūrvabhādrapadā), a bath with turpentine resin, priyaṅgu, and turmeric is beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
āhirbudhnye tathā snānaṃ padmakośīracandanaiḥ ..
kuṅkumāgurukarpūraiḥ sahitaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
darbhermūlayutaiḥ pauṣṇe haridrādvayacandanaiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
आहिर्बुध्न्ये तथा स्नानं पद्मकोशीरचन्दनैः ..
कुङ्कुमागुरुकर्पूरैः सहितं पापनाशनम् ..
दर्भेर्मूलयुतैः पौष्णे हरिद्राद्वयचन्दनैः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Likewise, a bath during Āhirbudhnya (Uttarabhādrapadā) with lotuses, vetiver, and sandalwood, / together with saffron, agarwood, and camphor, destroys sin; / during Pauṣṇa (Revatī), [a bath] with darbha roots, both turmerics, and sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgāśvagandhā madavantikā ca kṣaudrānvitā cāśvinake pradiṣṭā ..
surāhva kāṣṭhaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca snānaṃ vacābhiḥ sahitaṃ ca yāmyam .. 23 ..
meaning:
नागाश्वगन्धा मदवन्तिका च क्षौद्रान्विता चाश्विनके प्रदिष्टा ..
सुराह्व काष्ठं रजनीद्वयं च स्नानं वचाभिः सहितं च याम्यम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: Indian ironwood, aśvagandhā, and madayantī mixed with honey are prescribed during Āśvina; / during Yāmya (Bharaṇī), a bath with deodar wood, both turmerics, and sweet flag [is prescribed].

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
prāktantrottaratantrau dvau sarveṣāmagnikarmaṇām ..
tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच .. ..
प्राक्तन्त्रोत्तरतन्त्रौ द्वौ सर्वेषामग्निकर्मणाम् ..
त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सर्वधर्मभृतां वर .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / The two preliminary and subsequent procedures of all fire rituals, / I wish to hear from you, O best of all maintainers of dharma.
title: adhyāyaḥ 92

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
uddhṛtyorvīmayīṃ śuddhe deśe vediṃ ca kārayet ..
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ śuddhāmāyāmātpadasaptakam .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
उद्धृत्योर्वीमयीं शुद्धे देशे वेदिं च कारयेत् ..
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां शुद्धामायामात्पदसप्तकम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having raised an earthen altar in a clean place, one should construct it, / pure, sloping towards the east and north, measuring seven paces in length.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvabhāge ca vijñeyā vistarātpadapañcakam ..
paścime ca tathā bhāge vistarātsyāccatuṣṭayam .. 3 ..
meaning:
पूर्वभागे च विज्ञेया विस्तरात्पदपञ्चकम् ..
पश्चिमे च तथा भागे विस्तरात्स्याच्चतुष्टयम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: In its eastern portion, it is to be known as five paces in width; / and in its western portion, it should be four [paces] in width.

sanskrit_iast:
āgāradeśe ca tathā vistṛtā sā padatrayam ..
pūrvabhāgādatikramya paścātpadacatuṣṭayam .. 4 ..
meaning:
आगारदेशे च तथा विस्तृता सा पदत्रयम् ..
पूर्वभागादतिक्रम्य पश्चात्पदचतुष्टयम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: And likewise in the fireplace area, it is extended to three paces; / having passed beyond the eastern part, towards the rear it is four paces.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyenottarataścaiva vijñeyaṃ tu padaṃ padam ..
āgārātpaścime bhāge vedī jñeyā padadvayam .. 5 ..
meaning:
याम्येनोत्तरतश्चैव विज्ञेयं तु पदं पदम् ..
आगारात्पश्चिमे भागे वेदी ज्ञेया पदद्वयम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Towards the south and towards the north, one pace should be known; / behind the hearth area, the altar is to be known as two paces.

sanskrit_iast:
vedimevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā snātvācamya prayatnataḥ ..
sauvarṇānrājatām̐stāmrānathavāpi mahīmayān .. 6 ..
meaning:
वेदिमेवंविधां कृत्वा स्नात्वाचम्य प्रयत्नतः ..
सौवर्णान्राजताम्̐स्ताम्रानथवापि महीमयान् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having made such an altar, having bathed and sipped water with concentrated effort, / [one should procure] golden, silver, copper, or earthen [pitchers].

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrārghyamālyairgandhaiśca saphalaiḥ pallavairyutān ..
pūrṇodakumbhāṃścaturo vidikṣu sudṛḍhaṃ nyaset .. 7 ..
meaning:
सूत्रार्घ्यमाल्यैर्गन्धैश्च सफलैः पल्लवैर्युतान् ..
पूर्णोदकुम्भांश्चतुरो विदिक्षु सुदृढं न्यसेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Endowed with cords, respectful offerings, garlands, fragrances, fruits, and sprouts, / four pitchers filled with water should be firmly placed in the intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
vedyāmullikhanaṃ kāryamaindrībhirnṛpasattama ..
udumbarasya śākhābhiḥ prāgagrābhiḥ samantataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
वेद्यामुल्लिखनं कार्यमैन्द्रीभिर्नृपसत्तम ..
उदुम्बरस्य शाखाभिः प्रागग्राभिः समन्ततः .. 8 ..
text_mt: The furrowing of the altar is to be performed with twigs of the udumbara tree / pointing toward the east, in the eastern quarter and all around, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
śuṣkendhanasamṛddhastu tataḥ kāryyo hutāśanaḥ ..
na dhamettālavṛntena na śūrpeṇa na vāsasā .. 9 ..
meaning:
शुष्केन्धनसमृद्धस्तु ततः कार्य्यो हुताशनः ..
न धमेत्तालवृन्तेन न शूर्पेण न वाससा .. 9 ..
text_mt: The fire is then to be built up, enriched with dry fuel; / one should not fan it with a palm leaf, nor with a winnowing basket, nor with a garment.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhenopadhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata ..
parisamuhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristaret .. 1.92.10 ..
meaning:
मुखेनोपधमेदग्निं मुखादग्निरजायत ..
परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य परिषिच्य परिस्तरेत् .. 1.92.10 ..
text_mt: One should fan the fire with the mouth, [for] fire was born from the mouth; / having swept around it, sprinkled it, sprinkled around it, one should strew [the grass around].

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśanaṃ bodhayitvā bhūyaścāvāhayedbudhaḥ ..
vakṣyāmi bodhane mantraṃ tathā cāvāhane nṛpa .. 11 ..
meaning:
हुताशनं बोधयित्वा भूयश्चावाहयेद्बुधः ..
वक्ष्यामि बोधने मन्त्रं तथा चावाहने नृप .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having awakened the fire, the wise one should further invoke it; / I will declare the mantra for awakening, and also for invocation, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
udbuddhyāgne bodhayanti devatāstāssavāsavāḥ ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
उद्बुद्ध्याग्ने बोधयन्ति देवतास्तास्सवासवाः ..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च स्कन्दो वैश्रवणो यमः .. 12 ..
text_mt: 'Awake, O Fire! Those deities headed by Indra awaken [you]: / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Skanda, Kubera, and Yama;

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇo vāyurākāśaṃ candrādityau prabhākarau ..
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstrailokyāmaladarśanāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
वरुणो वायुराकाशं चन्द्रादित्यौ प्रभाकरौ ..
ऋषयश्च महाभागास्त्रैलोक्यामलदर्शनाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Varuṇa, Vāyu, Space, the Sun and the Moon, makers of light; / and the fortunate sages of pure vision in the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
vedāśca vedamātā ca sāvitrī pāpanāśinī ..
oṣadhyo'tha vaṣaṭkāro mantrāśca vividhāstathā .. 14 ..
meaning:
वेदाश्च वेदमाता च सावित्री पापनाशिनी ..
ओषध्योऽथ वषट्कारो मन्त्राश्च विविधास्तथा .. 14 ..
text_mt: the Vedas, and the mother of the Vedas, Sāvitrī, destroyer of sin; / the plants, and the exclamation vaṣaṭ, and the various mantras;

sanskrit_iast:
kālasyāvayavāssarve diśaśca vidiśastathā ..
udabuddhya yajamānasya sarvānkāmānprayaccha vai .. 15 ..
meaning:
कालस्यावयवास्सर्वे दिशश्च विदिशस्तथा ..
उदबुद्ध्य यजमानस्य सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छ वै .. 15 ..
text_mt: all the divisions of time, and the directions and intermediate directions; / having awakened, grant indeed all the desires of the patron of the sacrifice!'

sanskrit_iast:
(om)āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam .. 16 ..
meaning:
(ओम्)आवाहयाम्यहं देवं देवदेवं हुताशनम् ..
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: 'Om! I invoke the god, the god of gods, Fire, / the cause of creation, maintenance, and destruction of this universe;

sanskrit_iast:
vedamūrtiṃ tadādhāraṃ sarvadevamukhaṃ vibhum ..
piṅgekṣaṇaṃ piṅgajaṭaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum .. 17 ..
meaning:
वेदमूर्तिं तदाधारं सर्वदेवमुखं विभुम् ..
पिङ्गेक्षणं पिङ्गजटं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: the embodiment of the Veda, its support, the mouth of all gods, the all-pervading lord, / yellow-eyed, with reddish-brown matted locks, the smoke-bannered shining one;

sanskrit_iast:
śukayānagamaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
sarvagaṃ varadaṃ bhānuṃ jaṭharasthaṃ ca dehinām .. 18 ..
meaning:
शुकयानगमं देवं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् ..
सर्वगं वरदं भानुं जठरस्थं च देहिनाम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: the god who moves in a parrot chariot, adorned with all ornaments, / omnipresent, granter of boons, radiant, residing in the stomach of embodied beings;

sanskrit_iast:
tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ saptajihvaṃ mahābalam ..
saptārciṣaṃ saptarṣikaṃ ca samitsaptakamacyutam .. 19 ..
meaning:
तेजोमूर्त्तिं दुराधर्षं सप्तजिह्वं महाबलम् ..
सप्तार्चिषं सप्तर्षिकं च समित्सप्तकमच्युतम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: the embodiment of splendour, invincible, seven-tongued, of great power, / seven-flamed, accompanied by the seven sages, possessing seven sacrificial sticks, the imperishable one;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoraṃśamanirdeśyaṃ bhāvanaṃ jātavedasam ..
pāvanaṃ puṣṭidaṃ saumyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhūtivardhanam .. 1.92.20 ..
meaning:
विष्णोरंशमनिर्देश्यं भावनं जातवेदसम् ..
पावनं पुष्टिदं सौम्यं भक्तानां भूतिवर्धनम् .. 1.92.20 ..
text_mt: the indefinable portion of Viṣṇu, creator, Jātavedas, / purifier, giver of nourishment, benevolent, increaser of the prosperity of devotees!

sanskrit_iast:
taddattamāhutigaṇaṃ saṃpratīccha jagadguro ..
tena bhāvaya deveśa yathāhaṃ devatāgaṇān .. 21 ..
meaning:
तद्दत्तमाहुतिगणं संप्रतीच्छ जगद्गुरो ..
तेन भावय देवेश यथाहं देवतागणान् .. 21 ..
text_mt: 'O teacher of the world, receive that host of oblations given by him; / O lord of the gods, satisfy through it the hosts of deities according to my wish!

sanskrit_iast:
yājakaṃ yajamānaṃ ca puṣṭyā vibhaja sarvaśaḥ ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pragṛhyatām .. 22 ..
meaning:
याजकं यजमानं च पुष्ट्या विभज सर्वशः ..
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपं दीपं प्रगृह्यताम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: Share out fully with nourishment both the officiating priest and the sacrificer; / let this respectful offering, this foot-water, incense, and lamp be received!'

sanskrit_iast:
evamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā pādyārghyaṃ vinivedayet ..
vedyāmeva na tau deyau vahnau yadukulodvaha .. 23 ..
meaning:
एवमावाहनं कृत्वा पाद्यार्घ्यं विनिवेदयेत् ..
वेद्यामेव न तौ देयौ वह्नौ यदुकुलोद्वह .. 23 ..
text_mt: Having thus performed the invocation, one should offer the foot-water and the respectful offering; / those two should be given on the altar itself, not in the fire, O descendant of the Yadu race.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ deyaṃ sakalañjātavedasi ..
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sanaivaidyaṃ vedyāmeva nivedayet .. 24 ..
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिकं देयं सकलञ्जातवेदसि ..
धूपं दीपं सनैवैद्यं वेद्यामेव निवेदयेत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Perfumes, flowers, and the like should all be given into the fire; / incense, lamp, and food offerings one should present on the altar itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu prastaredvedimakṣatāgraiḥ kuśairdvija ..
upamūlādadholūnaiḥ prāgagraiḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु प्रस्तरेद्वेदिमक्षताग्रैः कुशैर्द्विज ..
उपमूलादधोलूनैः प्रागग्रैः प्रयतः शुचिः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Then, O twice-born, the attentive and pure [sacrificer] should strew the altar / with kuśa grass with unbroken tips, cut below near the root, with points facing east.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve ca prāgdakṣiṇataḥ paścāccaivāpasavyataḥ ..
uttareṇa tataḥ kuryātprastarasya samāpanam .. 26 ..
meaning:
पूर्वे च प्राग्दक्षिणतः पश्चाच्चैवापसव्यतः ..
उत्तरेण ततः कुर्यात्प्रस्तरस्य समापनम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: In the east, [pointing] east; from the south; and in the west, counter-clockwise; / then from the north, he should complete the strewing of grass.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlacchinnantu dātavyaṃ prastare bhūbhṛtāṃ vara ..
oṣadhyaḥ phalavantyaśca parvavatyastathaiva ca .. 27 ..
meaning:
मूलच्छिन्नन्तु दातव्यं प्रस्तरे भूभृतां वर ..
ओषध्यः फलवन्त्यश्च पर्ववत्यस्तथैव च .. 27 ..
text_mt: Plants with cut roots are to be laid down in the strewing, O best of kings, / as well as those that bear fruit and possess joints.

sanskrit_iast:
darbhābhāve praśaṃsanti tisrastatra ca varjayet ..
rājasīravarūkaṃ ca paribādhamathotkaṭam .. 28 ..
meaning:
दर्भाभावे प्रशंसन्ति तिस्रस्तत्र च वर्जयेत् ..
राजसीरवरूकं च परिबाधमथोत्कटम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: In the absence of darbha grass, they praise [other grasses], but three should be avoided there: / rājasīra, varūka, and paribādha, as well as utkaṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurmanasā pūte sto mantreṇānena suvrata ..
dārbhaṃ pavitramutsajya tābhyāṃ ca tadanantaram .. 29 ..
meaning:
विष्णुर्मनसा पूते स्तो मन्त्रेणानेन सुव्रत ..
दार्भं पवित्रमुत्सज्य ताभ्यां च तदनन्तरम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: With this mantra, "Viṣṇu, by mind you two are purified," O one of good vows, / having thrown down the darbha strainer, and immediately after that with those two,

sanskrit_iast:
devova ityathaitena utpūyamudakaṃ śuci ..
sruksruvāvatha pālāśau śamīnyagrodhasaṃbhavau .. 1.92.30 ..
meaning:
देवोव इत्यथैतेन उत्पूयमुदकं शुचि ..
स्रुक्स्रुवावथ पालाशौ शमीन्यग्रोधसंभवौ .. 1.92.30 ..
text_mt: having purified pure water with "Devo vaḥ,"/ the sruc and sruva ladles should then be made of palāśa, or born of śamī or nyagrodha,

sanskrit_iast:
udumbaramayau tāmrau rūpyarukmamayau tathā ..
ājyasthālī ca kartavyā taijasadravyasambhavā ..31 ..
meaning:
उदुम्बरमयौ ताम्रौ रूप्यरुक्ममयौ तथा ..
आज्यस्थाली च कर्तव्या तैजसद्रव्यसम्भवा ..31 ..
text_mt: or made of udumbara, of copper, or made of silver or gold; / and the ghee-pot should be made from metallic material,

sanskrit_iast:
māheyī vāpi bhūpāla nityasarvāgnikarmasu ..
hastamātraḥ sruvaḥ kāryo sruva bāhusamaṃ tathā..32..
meaning:
माहेयी वापि भूपाल नित्यसर्वाग्निकर्मसु ..
हस्तमात्रः स्रुवः कार्यो स्रुव बाहुसमं तथा..32..
text_mt: or of clay, O king, in all regular fire rituals. / The sruva should be made one cubit long, and the sruc equal [in length] to the arm.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhamadhyapratimaṃ homasthānaṃ sruvasya tu..
ājyasthālyāḥ pramāṇantu yathākāmantu kārayet..33..
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठमध्यप्रतिमं होमस्थानं स्रुवस्य तु..
आज्यस्थाल्याः प्रमाणन्तु यथाकामन्तु कारयेत्..33..
text_mt: The cavity for offering in the sruva should match the middle of the thumb, / but one may have the size of the ghee-pot made according to desire.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmaṃ pṛścāpayosīti mantreṇājyaṃ narādhipa..
ājyasthālyāḥ payotpūtaṃ pañcānāmiti pañcakam .. 34 ..
meaning:
ग्रामं पृश्चापयोसीति मन्त्रेणाज्यं नराधिप..
आज्यस्थाल्याः पयोत्पूतं पञ्चानामिति पञ्चकम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: With the mantra, "grāmaṃ pṛścāpaya"... "you are milk," O ruler of men, / the milk purified from the ghee-pot... reciting the set of five beginning with "pañcānām",

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhangṛhṇīta rājendra arjetyagnāvadhiśrayet ..
ājyasyātha pavitreṇa kārya mutplavanaṃ dvija .. 35 ..
meaning:
पठन्गृह्णीत राजेन्द्र अर्जेत्यग्नावधिश्रयेत् ..
आज्यस्याथ पवित्रेण कार्य मुत्प्लवनं द्विज .. 35 ..
text_mt: one should take it, O king of kings, and with "arja" place it on the fire. / Then, O twice-born, the skimming of the ghee should be done with a strainer.

sanskrit_iast:
agnirjihveti satataṃ havirasyutpavanāntaram ..
akṣīṇantu na kartavyaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama .. 36 ..
meaning:
अग्निर्जिह्वेति सततं हविरस्युत्पवनान्तरम् ..
अक्षीणन्तु न कर्तव्यं सततं पार्थिवोत्तम .. 36 ..
text_mt: Constantly with "agnirjihvā"... and after the purification of the oblation, / it should never be made deficient, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhābhyāṃ sruksruvau rājanpratyuṣṭamiti bhāvaya ..
pavitrasyāgradarbheṇa āyurityeva mānada .. 37 ..
meaning:
शुभाभ्यां स्रुक्स्रुवौ राजन्प्रत्युष्टमिति भावय ..
पवित्रस्याग्रदर्भेण आयुरित्येव मानद .. 37 ..
text_mt: Regard the sruc and sruva ladles with auspicious [substances] as heated, O king, with "pratyuṣṭam." / With the tip-darbha of the strainer, with "āyuḥ," O giver of honour,

sanskrit_iast:
pratimārṣṭi bhuvaṃ paścāccakṣurityeva pārthiva ..
pratimārṣṭi sruvaṃ tām̐śca darbhānvahnāvathotsṛjet ..38..
meaning:
प्रतिमार्ष्टि भुवं पश्चाच्चक्षुरित्येव पार्थिव ..
प्रतिमार्ष्टि स्रुवं ताम्̐श्च दर्भान्वह्नावथोत्सृजेत् ..38..
text_mt: he wipes the earth behind, and with "cakṣuḥ," O king, / he wipes the sruva, and should then discard those darbhas into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
darbhotsarge paṭhenmantramimaṃ pārthivasattama ..
divi śilpamavatataṃ pṛthivyāḥ kakṣibhiḥ śritam .. 39..
meaning:
दर्भोत्सर्गे पठेन्मन्त्रमिमं पार्थिवसत्तम ..
दिवि शिल्पमवततं पृथिव्याः कक्षिभिः श्रितम् .. 39..
text_mt: At the discarding of the darbhas, one should recite this mantra, O best of kings: / "Art is spread out in heaven, resting on the sides of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
tena sahasrakāṇḍena dviṣantaṃ tāpayāmasi ..
dviṣantastapyatāṃ coktvā kṣipeddarbhānhutāśane ..1.92.40..
meaning:
तेन सहस्रकाण्डेन द्विषन्तं तापयामसि ..
द्विषन्तस्तप्यतां चोक्त्वा क्षिपेद्दर्भान्हुताशने ..1.92.40..
text_mt: with that thousand-jointed [grass] we torment him who hates us." / Having said, "May those who hate us be tormented," he should throw the darbhas into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
idhmadvayaṃ tato deyaṃ yājñiyadrumasambhavam ..
palāśaḥ khadiro bilvaḥ śamyaśvatthavaṭāstathā ..41..
meaning:
इध्मद्वयं ततो देयं याज्ञियद्रुमसम्भवम् ..
पलाशः खदिरो बिल्वः शम्यश्वत्थवटास्तथा ..41..
text_mt: Then two fuel-sticks derived from sacrificial trees are to be offered: / palāśa, khadira, bilva, śamī, aśvattha, and vaṭa,

sanskrit_iast:
udumbaramapāmārgaḥ phalguśca kramukastathā ..
candanaṃ devadāruśca drumā dvādaśa yājñiyāḥ ..42..
meaning:
उदुम्बरमपामार्गः फल्गुश्च क्रमुकस्तथा ..
चन्दनं देवदारुश्च द्रुमा द्वादश याज्ञियाः ..42..
text_mt: udumbara, apāmārga, phalgu, and kramuka, / sandalwood and devadāru: these twelve are sacrificial trees.

sanskrit_iast:
caturgṛhītaṃ vinyasya sruci pūrvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
idhmadvaye prajvalite saumyabhāge narādhipa ..43..
meaning:
चतुर्गृहीतं विन्यस्य स्रुचि पूर्वं विचक्षणः ..
इध्मद्वये प्रज्वलिते सौम्यभागे नराधिप ..43..
text_mt: Having first placed the fourfold oblation into the sruc, the wise man, / when the two fuel-sticks are ablaze, on the northern portion, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāmpataye tvādāvāhutiṃ manasā nyaset ..
caturgṛhīte mūrddheti deyā dakṣiṇato bhavet.. ..44..
meaning:
प्रजानाम्पतये त्वादावाहुतिं मनसा न्यसेत् ..
चतुर्गृहीते मूर्द्धेति देया दक्षिणतो भवेत्.. ..44..
text_mt: should first offer the oblation mentally to Prajāpati. / With the fourfold oblation, [an offering] is to be made on the south with "mūrdhā."

sanskrit_iast:
yuktaḥ parastādityādi pañcakaṃ juhuyāttataḥ ..
santatīśca jayādyāstāstathā rāṣṭrabhṛto nṛpa ..45..
meaning:
युक्तः परस्तादित्यादि पञ्चकं जुहुयात्ततः ..
सन्ततीश्च जयाद्यास्तास्तथा राष्ट्रभृतो नृप ..45..
text_mt: Then one should offer the group of five beginning with "yuktaḥ parastāt," / and the santatis, those beginning with jaya, and likewise the rāṣṭrabhṛts, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
vārtraghnau cājyabhāgau ca dātavyau pārthivottama ..
athaudumbarapatrāṇāṃ vedau dakṣiṇato nṛpa .. 46 ..
meaning:
वार्त्रघ्नौ चाज्यभागौ च दातव्यौ पार्थिवोत्तम ..
अथौदुम्बरपत्राणां वेदौ दक्षिणतो नृप .. 46 ..
text_mt: And the two vārtraghna portions of ghee are to be offered, O best of kings. / Then to the south of the altar, O king, on a collection of udumbara leaves

sanskrit_iast:
sañcaye padmapatrāṇāmathavāpi mahīpate ..
āvāhanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
सञ्चये पद्मपत्राणामथवापि महीपते ..
आवाहनं तु कर्तव्यं देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः .. 47 ..
text_mt: or indeed on lotus leaves, O lord of the earth, / the invocation of the god Parameṣṭhin is to be performed:

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam ..48..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् ..
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् ..48..
text_mt: "I invoke the god Brahmā, the Parameṣṭhin, / the maker of the creation, preservation, and dissolution of this universe,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvedaṃ caturvaktraṃ cāturvaṇyaprabhuṃ prabhum ..
caturāśramagoptāraṃ varadaṃ bhūtabhāvanam .. 49
meaning:
चतुर्वेदं चतुर्वक्त्रं चातुर्वण्यप्रभुं प्रभुम् ..
चतुराश्रमगोप्तारं वरदं भूतभावनम् .. 49
text_mt: who possesses the four Vedas, who has four faces, the master who is master of the four classes, / the protector of the four stages of life, the granter of boons, the source of beings,

sanskrit_iast:
padmayoniṃ jagadyoniṃ yajñayoniṃ jagatpatim ..
ātmayonimanādhṛṣyaṃ yajñavāhaṃ jagatpatim .. 1.92.50 ..
meaning:
पद्मयोनिं जगद्योनिं यज्ञयोनिं जगत्पतिम् ..
आत्मयोनिमनाधृष्यं यज्ञवाहं जगत्पतिम् .. 1.92.50 ..
text_mt: whose origin is the lotus, the origin of the universe, the origin of sacrifice, the lord of the universe, / whose origin is himself, unassailable, who conveys the sacrifice, the lord of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeśaṃ yajñamūrtiṃ ca trailokyasyaikakāraṇam ..
sarvagaṃ varadaṃ saumyaṃ paramaṃ parameśvaram .. 51 ..
meaning:
यज्ञेशं यज्ञमूर्तिं च त्रैलोक्यस्यैककारणम् ..
सर्वगं वरदं सौम्यं परमं परमेश्वरम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: the lord of sacrifice, the embodiment of sacrifice, the sole cause of the three worlds, / omnipresent, boon-granting, gentle, the supreme, the supreme lord,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhavaṃ nāthaṃ yogajñeyaṃ sanātanam ..
āgaccha bhagavanbrahmanyajamānasya vṛddhaye .. 52 ..
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवं नाथं योगज्ञेयं सनातनम् ..
आगच्छ भगवन्ब्रह्मन्यजमानस्य वृद्धये .. 52 ..
text_mt: the lord of the past, future, and present, who is known through yoga, eternal: / come, O venerable Brahmā, for the prosperity of the sacrificer!

sanskrit_iast:
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ cedaṃ pragṛhyatām ..
brahmaliṅgāṃstato mantrāñjapedbhaktyā samāhitaḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपं चेदं प्रगृह्यताम् ..
ब्रह्मलिङ्गांस्ततो मन्त्राञ्जपेद्भक्त्या समाहितः .. 53 ..
text_mt: This is water for hospitality, this is water for the feet, and this incense is to be accepted." / Then, concentrated, he should recite with devotion the mantras indicating Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa brahmaṇo'rghyaṃ nivedayet ..
śannodevīti pādyaṃ ca prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
आपोहिष्ठेति मन्त्रेण ब्रह्मणोऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ..
शन्नोदेवीति पाद्यं च प्रयतः सुसमाहितः .. 54 ..
text_mt: With the mantra "āpo hi ṣṭha" he should present water for hospitality to Brahmā, / and water for the feet with "śaṃ no devīḥ," pure and deeply concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbheti tathā dadyādācamanaṃ budhaḥ ..
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet .. 55 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भेति तथा दद्यादाचमनं बुधः ..
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण ह्यासनं विनिवेदयेत् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Likewise, the wise man should offer water for sipping with "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ," / and he should present the seat with the mantra "dhruvā dyauḥ."

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaṃ puṣpamalaṅkāraṃ vastraṃ dhūpaṃ sadīpakam ..
naivedyaṃ ca tathā deyaṃ sāvitreṇa narādhipa .. 56 ..
meaning:
गन्धं पुष्पमलङ्कारं वस्त्रं धूपं सदीपकम् ..
नैवेद्यं च तथा देयं सावित्रेण नराधिप .. 56 ..
text_mt: Sandal paste, flowers, ornaments, clothing, incense with a lamp, / and food offerings are likewise to be given with the Sāvitra mantra, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
prāktantrametaduktaṃ te mayā sarvāgnikarmasu ..
prāktantre tu kṛte kāryaṃ homamantramayāsakam .. 57 ..
meaning:
प्राक्तन्त्रमेतदुक्तं ते मया सर्वाग्निकर्मसु ..
प्राक्तन्त्रे तु कृते कार्यं होममन्त्रमयासकम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: This preliminary ritual procedure has been declared to you by me for all fire rituals; / but when the preliminary procedure is done, the homa consisting of mantras is to be performed effortlessly.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kāryaṃ mahīnātha sarveṣvevāgnikarmasu .. 58 ..
meaning: एवं कार्यं महीनाथ सर्वेष्वेवाग्निकर्मसु .. 58 ..
text_mt: In this way it is to be done, O lord of the earth, in all fire rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
homasya vihitasyānte tantraṃ kāryamathottaram ..
mahākalpasya kalpasya tathā manvantarasya ca .. 59 ..
meaning:
होमस्य विहितस्यान्ते तन्त्रं कार्यमथोत्तरम् ..
महाकल्पस्य कल्पस्य तथा मन्वन्तरस्य च .. 59 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the prescribed homa, the concluding ritual procedure is then to be performed: / for the great kalpa, for the kalpa, and likewise for the manvantara,

sanskrit_iast:
yugasyātha samāyāścāyanasya hi tathaiva ca ..
ṛtormāsasya pakṣasya grahanakṣatrayostathā .. 1.92.60 ..
meaning:
युगस्याथ समायाश्चायनस्य हि तथैव च ..
ऋतोर्मासस्य पक्षस्य ग्रहनक्षत्रयोस्तथा .. 1.92.60 ..
text_mt: and for the yuga, for the year, and likewise for the solstice, / for the season, the month, the fortnight, and likewise for the planet and the lunar mansion,

sanskrit_iast:
titheśca karaṇasyātha muhūrtasya ca pārthiva ..
varttamānasya sarvasya deyasyādhipatirbhavet .. 61 ..
meaning:
तिथेश्च करणस्याथ मुहूर्तस्य च पार्थिव ..
वर्त्तमानस्य सर्वस्य देयस्याधिपतिर्भवेत् .. 61 ..
text_mt: and for the lunar day, the karaṇa, and the muhūrta, O king; / he should become the overlord of everything that is present and to be given.

sanskrit_iast:
iha gāva ayaṃ yajña ānaḥ prajāstathaiva ca ..
dhṛtiṃ caivopadhṛtiṃ ca ihābhāgaṃ tathaiva ca .. 62 ..
meaning:
इह गाव अयं यज्ञ आनः प्रजास्तथैव च ..
धृतिं चैवोपधृतिं च इहाभागं तथैव च .. 62 ..
text_mt: [With the mantras] "iha gāvaḥ," "ayaṃ yajñaḥ," and likewise "ā naḥ prajāḥ," / and the dhṛti and upadhṛti, and likewise "ihābhāgaḥ,"

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ caturgṛhītena homadravyeṇa pārthiva ..
tvanno agne varuṇasya sa tvaṃno agna eva ca .. 63 ..
meaning:
देयं चतुर्गृहीतेन होमद्रव्येण पार्थिव ..
त्वन्नो अग्ने वरुणस्य स त्वंनो अग्न एव च .. 63 ..
text_mt: the offering is to be made with a fourfold gathering of the oblation substance, O king. / With "tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya" and "sa tvaṃ no agne",

sanskrit_iast:
ayāścāgnestathaiveti tathā vyāhṛtayo nṛpa ..
tvanno agneti ca tato hotavyamṛktrayaṃ punaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
अयाश्चाग्नेस्तथैवेति तथा व्याहृतयो नृप ..
त्वन्नो अग्नेति च ततो होतव्यमृक्त्रयं पुनः .. 64 ..
text_mt: and likewise "ayāś cāgneḥ," and likewise the vyāhṛtis, O king, / and then the triplet of verses beginning with "tvaṃ no agne" is to be offered again.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnaṃ tateti rikteti nyūne caivātiriktakam ..
samaṃ same tathā hutvā hotavyamṛktrayaṃ tataḥ .. 65 ..
meaning:
न्यूनं ततेति रिक्तेति न्यूने चैवातिरिक्तकम् ..
समं समे तथा हुत्वा होतव्यमृक्त्रयं ततः .. 65 ..
text_mt: With "nyūnaṃ tata," with "riktā," the deficient and the redundant, / and the balanced with what is balanced; having offered thus, the triplet of verses is then to be offered:

sanskrit_iast:
anājñātaṃ yadājñātaṃ sviṣṭiścāpyatha pārthiva ..
manorjyotistathaivātra trayastriṃśattathaiva ca .. 66 ..
meaning:
अनाज्ञातं यदाज्ञातं स्विष्टिश्चाप्यथ पार्थिव ..
मनोर्ज्योतिस्तथैवात्र त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तथैव च .. 66 ..
text_mt: "anājñātaṃ yad ājñātam" and the sviṣṭi oblation, O king, / and likewise "mano jyotiḥ" here, and likewise "trayastriṃśat,"

sanskrit_iast:
yanme ca manasā cchidraṃ viśvakarmā tathaiva ca ..
ayāścāgnestathā rājantvanno agne tathaiva ca ..
satvanno agne ityevaṃ hutvā pārthivasattama .. 67 ..
meaning:
यन्मे च मनसा च्छिद्रं विश्वकर्मा तथैव च ..
अयाश्चाग्नेस्तथा राजन्त्वन्नो अग्ने तथैव च ..
सत्वन्नो अग्ने इत्येवं हुत्वा पार्थिवसत्तम .. 67 ..
text_mt: and "yan me manasaś chidram," and likewise "viśvakarmā," / and "ayāś cāgneḥ," O king, and likewise "tvaṃ no agne" / and "sa tvaṃ no agne"—having offered thus, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast: āśrāviteti mantreṇa deyā pūrṇāhutirbhavet .. 68 ..
meaning: आश्रावितेति मन्त्रेण देया पूर्णाहुतिर्भवेत् .. 68 ..
text_mt: the final full oblation is to be made with the mantra beginning with "āśrāvita."

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭo hi yajño bhṛgubhirmaṃtreṇānena pārthiva ..
ājyasthālīṃ sruksruvau ca darbhaistu parimārjayet .. 69 ..
meaning:
इष्टो हि यज्ञो भृगुभिर्मंत्रेणानेन पार्थिव ..
आज्यस्थालीं स्रुक्स्रुवौ च दर्भैस्तु परिमार्जयेत् .. 69 ..
text_mt: With this mantra, "The sacrifice has indeed been offered by the Bhṛgus," O king, / he should wipe around the ghee-pot and the sruc and sruva with darbhas.

sanskrit_iast:
tām̐śca darbhānkṣipedvahnau prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
pūrṇamityeva ca sruvā kāryaṃ saṃvīkṣaṇaṃ tataḥ .. 1.92.70..
meaning:
ताम्̐श्च दर्भान्क्षिपेद्वह्नौ प्रयतः सुसमाहितः ..
पूर्णमित्येव च स्रुवा कार्यं संवीक्षणं ततः .. 1.92.70..
text_mt: And he should cast those darbhas into the fire, pure and deeply concentrated. / Then an inspection should be performed by the sruva with "pūrṇam."

sanskrit_iast:
yathādiśaṃ mahīpāla tathā kuryādvimocanam ..
tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 71 ..
meaning:
यथादिशं महीपाल तथा कुर्याद्विमोचनम् ..
ततो विसर्जनं कार्यं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः .. 71 ..
text_mt: He should perform the untying according to each direction, O protector of the earth. / Then the dismissal of Brahmā the Parameṣṭhin is to be performed:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa jagatāmārtināśana ..
vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca ..72..
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश जगतामार्तिनाशन ..
व्रजस्व पूजामादाय पुनरागमनाय च ..72..
text_mt: "O venerable one, O lord of the gods of gods, O destroyer of the affliction of the worlds, / having accepted the worship, depart in order to return again."

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānasya śāntyarthaṃ sarvasya jagatastathā ..
ārogyadhanadhānyena yajamānaṃ ca vardhaya ..73..
meaning:
यजमानस्य शान्त्यर्थं सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा ..
आरोग्यधनधान्येन यजमानं च वर्धय ..73..
text_mt: for the pacification of the sacrificer and of the entire world, / and make the sacrificer flourish with health, wealth, and grain!

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśanasya karttavyaṃ tato rājanvisarjanam ..
dravyabhuktvaṃ vareṇyastvaṃ praṇatārtivināśanaḥ ..74 ..
meaning:
हुताशनस्य कर्त्तव्यं ततो राजन्विसर्जनम् ..
द्रव्यभुक्त्वं वरेण्यस्त्वं प्रणतार्तिविनाशनः ..74 ..
text_mt: Then, O king, the dismissal of the fire should be performed: / "You consume the oblations, you are most choice, the destroyer of the distress of those who bow down;

sanskrit_iast:
vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca..
śāntyarthaṃ yajamānasya rāṣṭrasya ca vivṛddhaye ..75...
meaning:
व्रजस्व पूजामादाय पुनरागमनाय च..
शान्त्यर्थं यजमानस्य राष्ट्रस्य च विवृद्धये ..75...
text_mt: go, having accepted the worship, and for the sake of coming again, / for the pacification of the sacrificer and for the prosperity of the realm,

sanskrit_iast:
gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya jayāya ca mahīpateḥ ..
pūrṇapātramathādāya vācyaṃ svastyayanaṃ tataḥ ..76..
meaning:
गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय जयाय च महीपतेः ..
पूर्णपात्रमथादाय वाच्यं स्वस्त्ययनं ततः ..76..
text_mt: for the benefit of cows and brahmins, and for the victory of the ruler of the earth!" / Then, taking up the full vessel, the recitation for well-being should be pronounced.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā yathā proktā mayā purā ..
etaduttaratantraṃ tu proktaṃ sarvāgnikarmaṇām..77..
meaning:
ततस्तु दक्षिणा देया यथा प्रोक्ता मया पुरा ..
एतदुत्तरतन्त्रं तु प्रोक्तं सर्वाग्निकर्मणाम्..77..
text_mt: Then the sacrificial fee should be given, as was stated by me before. / This is declared to be the concluding ritual of all rites in the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānametatkathitaṃ tavādya sarvāgnikarmasvanaghopayogi..
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi rājaṃstanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa ..78..
meaning:
विधानमेतत्कथितं तवाद्य सर्वाग्निकर्मस्वनघोपयोगि..
अतः परं किं कथयामि राजंस्तन्मे वदस्वायतलोहिताक्ष ..78..
text_mt: This rule, useful in all rites in the fire, has today been related to you, O sinless one. / Beyond this, what shall I speak of, O king? Tell that to me, O you with wide red eyes!

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
vistarācchrotumicchāmi grahanakṣatrapūjanam ..
tvatto'haṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
विस्तराच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि ग्रहनक्षत्रपूजनम् ..
त्वत्तोऽहं भार्गवश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / I desire to hear in full about the worship of planets and asterisms / from you, O foremost of the Bhṛgus; tell that to me as I ask.
title: Grahapūjāvidhānam

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kalpite maṇḍale snātaḥ prāktantre ca tathā kṛte ..
maṇḍalasya tu śaucārthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
कल्पिते मण्डले स्नातः प्राक्तन्त्रे च तथा कृते ..
मण्डलस्य तु शौचार्थं पञ्चगव्यं प्रकल्पयेत् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the sacred diagram has been prepared and one has bathed, and when the preliminary ritual has been performed in the same way, / one should prepare the five products of the cow for the purification of the sacred diagram.

sanskrit_iast:
payaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāśca tathā ghṛtam ..
dadhi vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ..3..
meaning:
पयः काञ्चनवर्णाया नीलायाश्च तथा घृतम् ..
दधि वै कृष्णवर्णायाः श्वेतायाश्चैव गोमयम् ..3..
text_mt: Milk from a gold-coloured [cow], ghee from a dark-blue one, / curd from a black-coloured one, and cow dung from a white one,

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet ..
athaitāni samastāni kapilāyāssamāharet .. 4 ..
meaning:
गोमूत्रं ताम्रवर्णायाः पञ्चगव्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ..
अथैतानि समस्तानि कपिलायास्समाहरेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: cow urine from a copper-coloured one—thus one should prepare the five products of the cow. / Or, one may obtain all these from a tawny cow.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ rathe akṣeti gomayam ..
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi .. 5 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्या गृह्य गोमूत्रं रथे अक्षेति गोमयम् ..
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि .. 5 ..
text_mt: Taking the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with "Rathe akṣa…", / the milk with "Āpyāyasva…", and the curd with "Dadhikrāvṇaḥ…",

sanskrit_iast:
tejosi śukramityājyaṃ sāvitreṇa kuśodakam ..
aghamarṣaṇamantreṇa saṃyojya praṇavena tu .. 6 ..
meaning:
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्याज्यं सावित्रेण कुशोदकम् ..
अघमर्षणमन्त्रेण संयोज्य प्रणवेन तु .. 6 ..
text_mt: the ghee with "Tejo 'si śukram…", kuśa-water with the Sāvitra [mantra], / combining them with the Aghamarṣaṇa mantra and the praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalābhyukṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sāvitryā tadanantaram ..
pūrṇaṃ kṣīrākṣatopetaṃ sarṣapātaṇḍulairyutam .. 7 ..
meaning:
मण्डलाभ्युक्षणं कार्यं सावित्र्या तदनन्तरम् ..
पूर्णं क्षीराक्षतोपेतं सर्षपातण्डुलैर्युतम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: the sprinkling of the sacred diagram should immediately thereafter be performed with the Sāvitrī. / Filled, accompanied by milk and unbroken grains, and provided with mustard seeds and raw rice grains,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhe rajate tāmre vā kuryādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
rathe akṣeti mantreṇa draviṇena tathaiva ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
शङ्खे रजते ताम्रे वा कुर्यादर्घ्यं विचक्षणः ..
रथे अक्षेति मन्त्रेण द्रविणेन तथैव च .. 8 ..
text_mt: the wise man should prepare the respectful offering in a conch shell, in silver, or in copper, / with the mantra "Rathe akṣa…" and likewise with "Draviṇam…".

sanskrit_iast:
pādyasya kalpanā kāryā drupadāyāstathaiva ca ..
hiraṇyavarṇetyārabhya ṛktrayeṇa tathaiva ca .. 9 ..
meaning:
पाद्यस्य कल्पना कार्या द्रुपदायास्तथैव च ..
हिरण्यवर्णेत्यारभ्य ऋक्त्रयेण तथैव च .. 9 ..
text_mt: The preparation of water for washing the feet should be made, and likewise with the Drupadā, / and with the triad of verses beginning with "Hiraṇyavarṇāḥ…",

sanskrit_iast:
āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śannodevīti pārthiva ..
jīvadānaṃ tato deyaṃ maṇḍale nṛpapuṅgava .. 1.93.10 ..
meaning:
आपो हिष्ठेति तिसृभिः शन्नोदेवीति पार्थिव ..
जीवदानं ततो देयं मण्डले नृपपुङ्गव .. 1.93.10 ..
text_mt: and with the three verses "Āpo hi ṣṭhā…", and with "Śaṃ no devīḥ…", O ruler of the earth. / Then the bestowal of life should be offered in the sacred diagram, O bull among kings.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyodakaṃ pavitreṇa tatra mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
agnerāyurasītyevamanuvākaṃ narādhipa .. 11 ..
meaning:
अर्घ्योदकं पवित्रेण तत्र मन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
अग्नेरायुरसीत्येवमनुवाकं नराधिप .. 11 ..
text_mt: The respectful offering water is with a purifying strainer; the mantra pronounced therein, / O king of men, is the section beginning with "Agner āyur asi…".

sanskrit_iast:
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ taṃ ca vakṣyāmyataḥ param ..
om-āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ jīvaṃ sarvagataṃ vibhum .. 12 ..
meaning:
जीवस्यावाहनं कार्यं तं च वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ..
ओम्-आवाहयाम्यहं देवं जीवं सर्वगतं विभुम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: The invocation of the life-principle must be performed, and I shall describe it hereafter: / "Oṃ, I invoke the god, the life-principle, all-pervading, the lord,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhāvasthitaṃ dehaṃ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ punaḥ ..
pañcādhāvasthitaṃ bhūyaḥ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ tataḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
पञ्चधावस्थितं देहं पञ्चधावस्थितं पुनः ..
पञ्चाधावस्थितं भूयः पञ्चधावस्थितं ततः .. 13 ..
text_mt: abiding in fivefold manner in the body, again abiding in fivefold manner, / once more abiding in fivefold manner, and then abiding in fivefold manner:

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitassadā ..
āgneyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitastathā .. 14 ..
meaning:
वायव्येन तु भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितस्सदा ..
आग्नेयेन तु भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितस्तथा .. 14 ..
text_mt: always abiding in fivefold manner through the wind-like nature, / and likewise abiding in fivefold manner through the fire-like nature,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtātmakena tu tathā pañcadhāvasthitaṃ prabhum ..
vāruṇena ca bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitaṃ sadā .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
भूतात्मकेन तु तथा पञ्चधावस्थितं प्रभुम् ..
वारुणेन च भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितं सदा .. .. 15 ..
text_mt: the lord abiding in fivefold manner through that which consists of the gross elements, / and always abiding in fivefold manner through the water-like nature.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale'sminnadṛśyastvaṃ praviśādya namostu te ..
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā yathāvatpārthivottama .. 16 ..
meaning:
मण्डलेऽस्मिन्नदृश्यस्त्वं प्रविशाद्य नमोस्तु ते ..
जीवस्यावाहनं कृत्वा यथावत्पार्थिवोत्तम .. 16 ..
text_mt: You who are invisible, enter into this sacred diagram today; homage to you!" / Having properly performed the invocation of the life-principle, O best of rulers of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmyāvāhanādhyāyānpūjyasyāvāhanaṃ bhavet ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramityevamarghyaṃ deyaṃ narādhipa .. 17 ..
meaning:
वक्ष्याम्यावाहनाध्यायान्पूज्यस्यावाहनं भवेत् ..
तद्विष्णोः परमित्येवमर्घ्यं देयं नराधिप .. 17 ..
text_mt: I shall describe the chapters of invocation [by which] the invocation of the worshipful one occurs. / The respectful offering should be given with "Tad viṣṇoḥ paramam…", O king of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dhuvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet ..
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ pādyaṃ ca vinivedayet .. 18 ..
meaning:
धुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण ह्यासनं विनिवेदयेत् ..
आपोहिष्ठेति तिसृभिः पाद्यं च विनिवेदयेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: One should offer the seat with the mantra "Dhruvā dyauḥ…", / and one should offer water for washing the feet with the three verses "Āpo hi ṣṭhā…".

sanskrit_iast:
arghyodakādācamanaṃ gāyatryā vinivedayet ..
dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva madhuparkaṃ nivedayet .. 19 ..
meaning:
अर्घ्योदकादाचमनं गायत्र्या विनिवेदयेत् ..
दधि क्षौद्रं घृतं चैव मधुपर्कं निवेदयेत् .. 19 ..
text_mt: From the respectful offering water, one should present water for sipping with the Gāyatrī. / Curd, honey, and ghee—one should offer the honey-mixture.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra maṃtratrayaṃ jñeyaṃ dadhi krāvṇeti pārthiva ..
tejosi śukramityeva madhuvātā ṛtāyate .. 1.93.20 ..
meaning:
तत्र मंत्रत्रयं ज्ञेयं दधि क्राव्णेति पार्थिव ..
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्येव मधुवाता ऋतायते .. 1.93.20 ..
text_mt: The triad of mantras therein should be known, O ruler of the earth: "Dadhikrāvṇaḥ…", / "Tejo 'si śukram…", and "Madhu vātā ṛtāyate…".

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkikamaśvatthaṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet ..
sahiraṇyaṃ bījapātraṃ draviṇena sadaiva tu .. 21 ..
meaning:
मधुपर्किकमश्वत्थं ततो मात्रां निवेदयेत् ..
सहिरण्यं बीजपात्रं द्रविणेन सदैव तु .. 21 ..
text_mt: Then one should offer a measuring vessel of aśvattha wood for the honey-mixture, / and a seed vessel containing gold, always with "Draviṇena…".

sanskrit_iast:
paśuḥ kalau na kartavya ityāha bhagavānbhṛguḥ ..
rathe akṣeti mantreṇa dātavyamanulepanam .. 22 ..
meaning:
पशुः कलौ न कर्तव्य इत्याह भगवान्भृगुः ..
रथे अक्षेति मन्त्रेण दातव्यमनुलेपनम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: An animal [sacrifice] is not to be performed in the Kali age, so said the venerable Bhṛgu. / The anointing paste should be given with the mantra "Rathe akṣa…",

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca tenaiva tataḥ parataraṃ nṛpa ..
yajñopavītaṃ tu navaṃ tathā pratisaraṃ śubham .. 23 ..
meaning:
विभूषणं च तेनैव ततः परतरं नृप ..
यज्ञोपवीतं तु नवं तथा प्रतिसरं शुभम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: and the ornament with the very same, and after that, O king: / a fresh sacred thread, and likewise an auspicious protective thread;

sanskrit_iast:
vastraṃ patākāṃ ca tathā sāvitreṇa nivedayet ..
puṣpaṃ puṣpavatītyeva dhūpaṃ dhūrasi cāpyatha .. 24 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रं पताकां च तथा सावित्रेण निवेदयेत् ..
पुष्पं पुष्पवतीत्येव धूपं धूरसि चाप्यथ .. 24 ..
text_mt: one should present the cloth and the banner with the Sāvitra [mantra]; / the flower with "Puṣpavatīḥ…", and the incense with "Dhūr asi…".

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpamantramidaṃ cānyaṃ nibodha gadato mama ..
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
धूपमन्त्रमिदं चान्यं निबोध गदतो मम ..
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यो गन्ध उत्तमः .. 25 ..
text_mt: Learn also this other incense-mantra as I speak: / "Divine sap of the lords of the forest, rich in fragrance, the supreme perfume,

sanskrit_iast:
āhvānaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ..
tejosi śukramityeva dīpaṃ dadyānmahīpate .. 26 ..
meaning:
आह्वानं सर्वदेवानां धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ..
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्येव दीपं दद्यान्महीपते .. 26 ..
text_mt: an invitation to all the gods: may this incense be accepted!" / With "Tejo 'si śukram…", one should give the lamp, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhetyaṣṭarcaṃ deyaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayet ..
nibodha gadato mantramannapānanivedane .. 27 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भेत्यष्टर्चं देयं सर्वं निवेदयेत् ..
निबोध गदतो मन्त्रमन्नपाननिवेदने .. 27 ..
text_mt: Everything should be presented and offered with the eight verses "Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ…". / Learn the mantra as I speak it for the presentation of food and drink:

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraṃ hṛdyamāhāraṃ sarvadehinām ..
gṛhāṇa varadācintya pānaṃ bhaktyā mayoditam .. 28 ..
meaning:
तुष्टिपुष्टिकरं हृद्यमाहारं सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
गृहाण वरदाचिन्त्य पानं भक्त्या मयोदितम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: ["You who cause contentment and nourishment, the delightful food of all embodied beings, / accept with devotion, O giver of boons, O inconceivable one, the drink proclaimed by me!

sanskrit_iast:
pānenānena paramā tṛptirastu tavānagha ..
tṛptastarpaya kāmaistu yajamānaṃ namo'stu te .. 29 ..
meaning:
पानेनानेन परमा तृप्तिरस्तु तवानघ ..
तृप्तस्तर्पय कामैस्तु यजमानं नमोऽस्तु ते .. 29 ..
text_mt: May there be supreme satisfaction for you through this drink, O sinless one! / Being satisfied, satisfy the sacrificer with desired objects; homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
anuktamaṃtraṃ śrutvā'tha grahebhyo yaḥ prayacchati ..
sāvitraṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ mantraṃ pārthivasattama .. 1.93.30 ..
meaning:
अनुक्तमंत्रं श्रुत्वाऽथ ग्रहेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति ..
सावित्रं तस्य निर्दिष्टं मन्त्रं पार्थिवसत्तम .. 1.93.30 ..
text_mt: When one gives [oblations] to the planets having heard of an unstated mantra, / the Sāvitra mantra is prescribed for it, O best of rulers of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā rājendra dakṣiṇām ..
sāvitreṇa tu mantreṇa tataḥ kāryaṃ visarjanam .. 31 ..
meaning:
ततोऽग्निहवनं कृत्वा दत्त्वा राजेन्द्र दक्षिणाम् ..
सावित्रेण तु मन्त्रेण ततः कार्यं विसर्जनम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then, having performed the fire-oblation and given the sacrificial fee, O king of kings, / the dismissal should then be performed with the Sāvitra mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ pūjāṃ samādāya mayā bhaktyā niveditām ..
punarāgamanāyeha vrajadhvaṃ nākamuttamam .. 35 ..
meaning:
इमां पूजां समादाय मया भक्त्या निवेदिताम् ..
पुनरागमनायेह व्रजध्वं नाकमुत्तमम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: "Taking this worship presented by me with devotion, / go to the supreme heaven, in order to come here again!

sanskrit_iast:
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva praśamaṃ yāntu sarvaśaḥ ..
rakṣā cā'stu śivaṃ cāstu yajamānasya sarvataḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव प्रशमं यान्तु सर्वशः ..
रक्षा चाऽस्तु शिवं चास्तु यजमानस्य सर्वतः .. 33 ..
text_mt: May mental afflictions and physical illnesses go completely to rest; / and may there be protection and auspiciousness on all sides for the sacrificer!

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā dvijānāṃ rājñāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā prajānām ..
ātaṅkahīnaṃ jagadastu sarvaṃ doṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ sakalāḥ prayāntu .. 34 ..
meaning:
गवां शिवं चास्तु तथा द्विजानां राज्ञां शिवं चास्तु तथा प्रजानाम् ..
आतङ्कहीनं जगदस्तु सर्वं दोषाः प्रणाशं सकलाः प्रयान्तु .. 34 ..
text_mt: May there be auspiciousness for cows and likewise for the twice-born, and may there be auspiciousness for kings and likewise for the subjects! / May the entire world be free from distress, and may all faults go to destruction!"

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ dvijapūjane ..
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane vidhānaṃ mama kīrtaya .. 1 .. - ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच .. ..
एकैकस्येदमुक्तं ते विधानं द्विजपूजने ..
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने विधानं मम कीर्तय .. 1 .. - ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / This rule has been declared by you for the worship of each individual one among the twice-born; / declare to me the rule for the sacrifice to all the planets.
title: adhyāyaḥ 94

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ rājasattama ..
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane maṇḍalasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एकैकस्येदमुक्तं ते विधानं राजसत्तम ..
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने मण्डलस्य विधिं शृणु .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
This rule for the worship of each one [of the planets] has been told to you, O best of kings. / Hear the rule of the sacred diagram for the sacrifice to all the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
ādāveva naravyāghra yāgaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param ..
prāgāyataṃ tu kartavyamādau lekhādvayaṃ nṛpa .. 3 ..
meaning:
आदावेव नरव्याघ्र यागं वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ..
प्रागायतं तु कर्तव्यमादौ लेखाद्वयं नृप .. 3 ..
text_mt: First of all, O tiger among men, I shall declare the sacrifice hereafter. / At the outset, O king, two lines extending to the east are to be made.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari tathā kāryamaparaṃ tūttarāyatam ..
evaṃ kṛte yadutpannaṃ madhye tu caturasrakam .. 4 ..
meaning:
तस्योपरि तथा कार्यमपरं तूत्तरायतम् ..
एवं कृते यदुत्पन्नं मध्ये तु चतुरस्रकम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: Above that, another [pair] extending to the north should likewise be made. / When this is done, a square is produced in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
tato grahebhyaḥ kartavyaṃ tathā lekhācatuṣṭayam ..
tacchaktibhyaḥ prakartavyaṃ tathā rekhyā catuṣṭayam ..)
evaṃ kṛte sambhavati bhagaṇaṃ dvādaśakṣayam ..5..
meaning:
ततो ग्रहेभ्यः कर्तव्यं तथा लेखाचतुष्टयम् ..
तच्छक्तिभ्यः प्रकर्तव्यं तथा रेख्या चतुष्टयम् ..)
एवं कृते सम्भवति भगणं द्वादशक्षयम् ..5..
text_mt: Then four lines are to be drawn for the planets, / and likewise four lines should be drawn for their powers. / When this is done, the zodiac of twelve compartments comes into being.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśaṃ tathā tasya dhruvasthānaṃ tu madhyamam .. 6 ..
meaning: त्रयोदशं तथा तस्य ध्रुवस्थानं तु मध्यमम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: And the thirteenth is its central place of the Pole Star.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ diśi mahīnātha meṣaṃ tu parikalpayet ..
tadādyā gaṇanā kāryā pariśeṣeṣu rāśiṣu ..7..
meaning:
प्राच्यां दिशि महीनाथ मेषं तु परिकल्पयेत् ..
तदाद्या गणना कार्या परिशेषेषु राशिषु ..7..
text_mt: In the eastern direction, O lord of the earth, one should arrange Aries; / counting is to be done beginning with that through the remaining signs.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ śobhārthaṃ parikalpayet ..
rāśisthānāni sarvāṇi rāśivarṇena rañjayet..8..
meaning:
रेखाविधानं द्विगुणं शोभार्थं परिकल्पयेत् ..
राशिस्थानानि सर्वाणि राशिवर्णेन रञ्जयेत्..8..
text_mt: One should fashion a double arrangement of lines for the sake of beauty; / one should colour all the places of the signs with the colour of [each] sign.

sanskrit_iast:
rāśi varṇānyatho vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
aruṇaśca sitaścaiva haritaḥ pāṭalastathā ..9..
meaning:
राशि वर्णान्यथो वक्ष्ये यथावदनुपूर्वशः ..
अरुणश्च सितश्चैव हरितः पाटलस्तथा ..9..
text_mt: Next I shall declare the colours of the signs duly in proper order: / reddish-brown, white, green, and pale red;

sanskrit_iast:
āpāṇḍuśca vicitraśca kṛṣṇaśca kapilastathā ..
piṃgalaḥ karburo babhrurmalinaśca yathākramam ..1.94.10..
meaning:
आपाण्डुश्च विचित्रश्च कृष्णश्च कपिलस्तथा ..
पिंगलः कर्बुरो बभ्रुर्मलिनश्च यथाक्रमम् ..1.94.10..
text_mt: whitish, variegated, black, and tawny; / reddish-brown, speckled, brown, and dark, in successive order;

sanskrit_iast:
meṣādīnāṃ vinirdiṣṭā varṇāḥ pārthivasattama..
ākāśavarṇaṃ karttavyaṃ dhruvasthānaṃ tathaiva ca ..11..
meaning:
मेषादीनां विनिर्दिष्टा वर्णाः पार्थिवसत्तम..
आकाशवर्णं कर्त्तव्यं ध्रुवस्थानं तथैव च ..11..
text_mt: these are declared as the colours of Aries and the rest, O best of kings. / And the place of the Pole Star is likewise to be made sky-coloured.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvasthāne mahīnātha devatāsaptakaṃ nyaset ..
maṇḍalaiśśuklavarṇaistu digvibhāgaṃ nibodha me..12..
meaning:
ध्रुवस्थाने महीनाथ देवतासप्तकं न्यसेत् ..
मण्डलैश्शुक्लवर्णैस्तु दिग्विभागं निबोध मे..12..
text_mt: In the place of the Pole Star, O lord of the earth, one should deposit the seven deities. / Learn from me the division of the directions by means of white-coloured circles.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvasya maṇḍalaṃ madhye prāgbhāge maṇḍalatrayam ..
maṇḍalaṃ gaganasyātra bhāge prāguttare bhavet ..13..
meaning:
ध्रुवस्य मण्डलं मध्ये प्राग्भागे मण्डलत्रयम् ..
मण्डलं गगनस्यात्र भागे प्रागुत्तरे भवेत् ..13..
text_mt: The circle of the Pole Star is in the centre; in the eastern part are three circles. / Here, the circle of the sky should be in the north-eastern part.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgbhāge ca tathā rājanmaṇḍalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam ..
prāgdakṣiṇe tathā bhāge diśaṃ pūrvāṃ prakalpayet ..14..
meaning:
प्राग्भागे च तथा राजन्मण्डलं ब्रह्मणः स्मृतम् ..
प्राग्दक्षिणे तथा भागे दिशं पूर्वां प्रकल्पयेत् ..14..
text_mt: And in the eastern part, O king, the circle of Brahmā is taught; / and in the south-eastern part one should arrange the eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāge vai nerṛte kāryaṃ bhuvo bhūpāla maṇḍalam ..
śeṣasya ca tathā kāryaṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi maṇḍalam .. 15 ..
meaning:
भागे वै नेरृते कार्यं भुवो भूपाल मण्डलम् ..
शेषस्य च तथा कार्यं प्रतीच्यां दिशि मण्डलम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: In the south-western part, O king, the circle of the earth is to be made; / and in the western direction the circle of Śeṣa is to be made.

sanskrit_iast:
digadhastāttathā tasya maṇḍalaṃ paścimottare ..
grahaścāravaśādrājanyasminrāśau vyavasthitaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
दिगधस्तात्तथा तस्य मण्डलं पश्चिमोत्तरे ..
ग्रहश्चारवशाद्राजन्यस्मिन्राशौ व्यवस्थितः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Likewise, in the north-west is the circle of the downward direction. / According to the motion of the planets, O king, in whichever sign a planet is positioned,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ tasminneva yathāvidhi ..
nyāsaṃ kāryaṃ grahendrāṇāṃ devatābhiḥ sahānagha ..17 ..
meaning:
मण्डलं तस्य कर्तव्यं तस्मिन्नेव यथाविधि ..
न्यासं कार्यं ग्रहेन्द्राणां देवताभिः सहानघ ..17 ..
text_mt: its circle is to be made in that very [sign] according to rule. / The ritual placement of the lords of the planets is to be performed together with the deities, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityātsaptame rāśau ketoḥ kāryaṃ tu maṇḍalam ..
rāśau suvarṇe tadvarṇaṃ yasya syānmaṇḍalaṃ nṛpa ..18..
meaning:
आदित्यात्सप्तमे राशौ केतोः कार्यं तु मण्डलम् ..
राशौ सुवर्णे तद्वर्णं यस्य स्यान्मण्डलं नृप ..18..
text_mt: In the seventh sign from the Sun, the circle of Ketu is to be made. / In the sign of gold, its colour is whatever [is the colour of the planet] whose circle it is, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
utpādyaḥ paridhistasya raṃgenānyena pārthiva ..
gandhacūrṇayutā raṅgāḥ karttavyā bhūtimicchatā ..19..
meaning:
उत्पाद्यः परिधिस्तस्य रंगेनान्येन पार्थिव ..
गन्धचूर्णयुता रङ्गाः कर्त्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता ..19..
text_mt: Its boundary circle is to be produced with another colour, O ruler of the earth. / Colours mixed with fragrant powders should be prepared by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
rāśicakraṃ samagrantu rekhayā parivārayet ..
nakṣatrāṇāṃ tataḥ kāryo nyāsaḥ pārthivasattama..1.94.20..
meaning:
राशिचक्रं समग्रन्तु रेखया परिवारयेत् ..
नक्षत्राणां ततः कार्यो न्यासः पार्थिवसत्तम..1.94.20..
text_mt: One should surround the entire zodiac with a line. / Then the ritual placement of the lunar mansions is to be made, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
rāśau rāśau yathāsthānaṃ rekhayā parivāritam ..
rāśau rāśāvato vakṣye nakṣatrāṇāṃ samāśrayam ..21..
meaning:
राशौ राशौ यथास्थानं रेखया परिवारितम् ..
राशौ राशावतो वक्ष्ये नक्षत्राणां समाश्रयम् ..21..
text_mt: in each sign in its proper place, surrounded by a line. / Henceforth I shall declare the location of the lunar mansions in each sign.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikāṃśaṃ caturthakam ..
meṣarāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama .. 22 ..
meaning:
अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिकांशं चतुर्थकम् ..
मेषराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम .. 22 ..
text_mt: Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, and the fourth quarter of Kṛttikā / are constantly assigned to the sign of Aries, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pādatrayaṃ kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇī sakalā tathā ..
ilvalānāṃ tathaivārdhaṃ jñeyaṃ vṛṣasamāśrayam .. 23 .. ilvalā=mṛgaśirā
meaning:
पादत्रयं कृत्तिकानां रोहिणी सकला तथा ..
इल्वलानां तथैवार्धं ज्ञेयं वृषसमाश्रयम् .. 23 .. इल्वला=मृगशिरा
text_mt: Three quarters of Kṛttikā, all of Rohiṇī, / and half of the Ilvalās are to be known as located in Taurus.

sanskrit_iast:
ilvalārddhaṃ tathaivārdrā hyadityāścaraṇatrayam ..
nityameva samuddiṣṭaṃ mithunasya samāśrayam .. 24 ..
meaning:
इल्वलार्द्धं तथैवार्द्रा ह्यदित्याश्चरणत्रयम् ..
नित्यमेव समुद्दिष्टं मिथुनस्य समाश्रयम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Half of the Ilvalās, Ārdrā, and three quarters of Aditi's [mansion] / are taught as constantly located in Gemini.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaṃ punarvasoḥ puṣyaṃ sārpaṃ karkaṭakāśrayam ..
pitryaṃ bhāgyaṃ tathāryamṇaṃ prathamaṃ caraṇaṃ tathā .. 25 ..
meaning:
पादं पुनर्वसोः पुष्यं सार्पं कर्कटकाश्रयम् ..
पित्र्यं भाग्यं तथार्यम्णं प्रथमं चरणं तथा .. 25 ..
text_mt: One quarter of Punarvasu, Puṣya, and the serpent [mansion] are located in Cancer. / The ancestral [mansion], Bhāgya, and the first quarter of the mansion of Aryaman

sanskrit_iast:
siṃharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama ..
pādatrayamathāryamṇaṃ hastaścitrārdhameva ca .. 26 ..
meaning:
सिंहराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ..
पादत्रयमथार्यम्णं हस्तश्चित्रार्धमेव च .. 26 ..
text_mt: are constantly assigned to the sign of Leo, O best of kings. / Then three quarters of the mansion of Aryaman, Hasta, and half of Citrā

sanskrit_iast:
kanyārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama ..
citrārdhamatha vāyavyaṃ viśākhācaraṇatrayam .. 27 ..
meaning:
कन्याराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ..
चित्रार्धमथ वायव्यं विशाखाचरणत्रयम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: are constantly assigned to the sign of Virgo, O best of kings. / Half of Citrā, the mansion of Vāyu, and three quarters of Viśākhā

sanskrit_iast:
tulārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
viśākhācaraṇaṃ maitraṃ śākraṃ vṛścikabhe smṛtam .. 28 ..
meaning:
तुलाराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ..
विशाखाचरणं मैत्रं शाक्रं वृश्चिकभे स्मृतम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: are assigned to the sign of Libra by the sages who see reality. / One quarter of Viśākhā, the mansion of Mitra, and the mansion of Śakra are taught in the sign of Scorpio.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamāpyaṃ tathā pādaṃ vaiśvadevasya dhanvini ..
pādatrayaṃ vaiśvadevādrājanvaiṣṇavameva ca .. 29 ..
meaning:
मूलमाप्यं तथा पादं वैश्वदेवस्य धन्विनि ..
पादत्रयं वैश्वदेवाद्राजन्वैष्णवमेव च .. 29 ..
text_mt: Mūla, the watery [mansion], and one quarter of the Vaiśvadeva [mansion] are in Sagittarius. / Three quarters of the Vaiśvadeva [mansion], O king, and the Vaiṣṇava [mansion],

sanskrit_iast:
dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ ca makare nityameva prakīrtitam ..
dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ śatabhiṣagajapāccaraṇatrayam .. 1.94.30 ..
meaning:
धनिष्ठार्धं च मकरे नित्यमेव प्रकीर्तितम् ..
धनिष्ठार्धं शतभिषगजपाच्चरणत्रयम् .. 1.94.30 ..
text_mt: and half of Dhaniṣṭhā are constantly proclaimed in Capricorn. / Half of Dhaniṣṭhā, Śatabhiṣaj, and three quarters of the Ajaikapād [mansion]

sanskrit_iast:
kumbharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama ..
pādamājasya sakalaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ narādhipa .. 31 ..
meaning:
कुम्भराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं सततं पार्थिवोत्तम ..
पादमाजस्य सकलं चाहिर्बुध्न्यं नराधिप .. 31 ..
text_mt: are continually assigned to the sign of Aquarius, O best of kings. / One quarter of the Ajaikapād [mansion], the whole of Ahirbudhnya, O lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇantu kathitaṃ mīne munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
bhacakrapūjane rājannakṣatrasya pṛthakpṛthak .. 32 ..
meaning:
पौष्णन्तु कथितं मीने मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ..
भचक्रपूजने राजन्नक्षत्रस्य पृथक्पृथक् .. 32 ..
text_mt: and the Pauṣṇa [mansion] are declared in Pisces by the sages who see reality. / In the worship of the circle of constellations, O king, for each separate lunar mansion,

sanskrit_iast:
rāśicakrasya bāhye tu hyekaikatārakaṃ nyaset ..
prāguktavarṇairbhūpāla nyāsaḥ kāryo yathāvidhi .. 33 ..
meaning:
राशिचक्रस्य बाह्ये तु ह्येकैकतारकं न्यसेत् ..
प्रागुक्तवर्णैर्भूपाल न्यासः कार्यो यथाविधि .. 33 ..
text_mt: outside the circle of the signs one should place each single star. / The ritual placement should be performed according to rule with the previously stated colours, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tārācakrasya vinyāsaṃ rekhayā parivārya tam ..
nakṣatradaivatanyāsaṃ bahiḥ kāryaṃ samantataḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
ताराचक्रस्य विन्यासं रेखया परिवार्य तम् ..
नक्षत्रदैवतन्यासं बहिः कार्यं समन्ततः .. 34 ..
