text_mt: Having surrounded that arrangement of the circle of stars with a line, / the ritual placement of the deities of the lunar mansions should be performed all around on the outside,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nakṣatrasvāmī syādṛkṣavarṇaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
tasyāpi rekhā karttavyā vṛttā cāpyanu maṇḍalam .. 35 ..
meaning:
यथा नक्षत्रस्वामी स्यादृक्षवर्णैः पृथक्पृथक् ..
तस्यापि रेखा कर्त्तव्या वृत्ता चाप्यनु मण्डलम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: according to the presiding deity of the lunar mansion, individually with the colours of the mansions. / A circular line should also be made for it around the sacred diagram.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhābāhyena vinyāsaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet ..
diśaśca pārthivaśreṣṭha yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
रेखाबाह्येन विन्यासं दिगीशानां तु कारयेत् ..
दिशश्च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ यथावदनुपूर्वशः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Outside the line one should cause the arrangement of the lords of the directions / and of the directions themselves to be made, O best of kings, duly in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
svāśrayarkṣasamaṃ varṇaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet ..
uttarāyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ dhanadasya ca maṇḍalam ..37..
meaning:
स्वाश्रयर्क्षसमं वर्णं दिगीशानां तु कारयेत् ..
उत्तरायां च कर्त्तव्यं धनदस्य च मण्डलम् ..37..
text_mt: One should make the colour of the lords of the directions equal to their corresponding asterism. / And in the north, the circle of the giver of wealth should be made

sanskrit_iast:
rukmavarṇaṃ prayatnena diśo varṇamataḥ śuṇu ..
uttarā tu bhavecchuklā raktā prācī prakīrtitā .. 38 ..
meaning:
रुक्मवर्णं प्रयत्नेन दिशो वर्णमतः शुणु ..
उत्तरा तु भवेच्छुक्ला रक्ता प्राची प्रकीर्तिता .. 38 ..
text_mt: gold-coloured with care. Now hear the colour of the directions: / the north should be white, and the east is proclaimed red;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇā pītavarṇā syātkṛṣṇā jñeyā ca paścimā ..
padmavarṇā tathā jñeyā tāmrā syātpūrvadakṣiṇā .. 39 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणा पीतवर्णा स्यात्कृष्णा ज्ञेया च पश्चिमा ..
पद्मवर्णा तथा ज्ञेया ताम्रा स्यात्पूर्वदक्षिणा .. 39 ..
text_mt: the south should be yellow in colour, and the west is to be known as black; / the south-east is to be known as copper-coloured and lotus-coloured;

sanskrit_iast:
pālāśā ca vinirdiṣṭā tathā dakṣiṇapaścimā ..
nīlotpalasavarṇā tu vāyavyā parikīrtitā..1.94.40..
meaning:
पालाशा च विनिर्दिष्टा तथा दक्षिणपश्चिमा ..
नीलोत्पलसवर्णा तु वायव्या परिकीर्तिता..1.94.40..
text_mt: and the south-west is declared to be [green like] the palāśa leaf; / the north-west is proclaimed to have the colour of a blue water-lily;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavarṇā tathā jñeyā caiśānītattvadarśibhiḥ..
diṅmaṇḍalaṃ tu tadvidvām̐llekhayā parivārayet .. 41 ..
meaning:
शुक्लवर्णा तथा ज्ञेया चैशानीतत्त्वदर्शिभिः..
दिङ्मण्डलं तु तद्विद्वाम्̐ल्लेखया परिवारयेत् .. 41 ..
text_mt: and the north-east is to be known as white-coloured by those who see reality. / The learned man should surround the circle of the directions with a line.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttayā veṣṭayedvṛttāṃ lekhayā caturasrayā ..
tanmadhye śaṅkhapadmādyairmaṅgalairupaśobhayet .. 42 ..
meaning:
वृत्तया वेष्टयेद्वृत्तां लेखया चतुरस्रया ..
तन्मध्ये शङ्खपद्माद्यैर्मङ्गलैरुपशोभयेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: He should enclose the circular [diagram] with a circular line, [or] with a square line; / in its middle he should adorn it with auspicious symbols such as the conch and lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
lekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ sarvatraiva prakalpayet ..
maṇḍalasya tu koṇeṣu hyudakkumbhānnavāndṛḍhān .. 43 ..
meaning:
लेखाविधानं द्विगुणं सर्वत्रैव प्रकल्पयेत् ..
मण्डलस्य तु कोणेषु ह्युदक्कुम्भान्नवान्दृढान् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Everywhere one should provide a double arrangement of lines. / At the corners of the sacred diagram, new, sturdy water-jars

sanskrit_iast:
phalapallavasaṃchannāngandhapuṣpādisaṃyutān ..
caturo vinyasedvidvānnityameva vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
फलपल्लवसंछन्नान्गन्धपुष्पादिसंयुतान् ..
चतुरो विन्यसेद्विद्वान्नित्यमेव विचक्षणः .. 44 ..
text_mt: covered with fruits and sprouts, and provided with perfumes, flowers, and the like— / four [such jars] the wise, discerning man should constantly set down.

sanskrit_iast:
lekhāsu vinyasedrājanpatākāśca dhvajām̐stathā ..
chatrāṇi ca savarṇāni grahendrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 45 ..
meaning:
लेखासु विन्यसेद्राजन्पताकाश्च ध्वजाम्̐स्तथा ..
छत्राणि च सवर्णानि ग्रहेन्द्राणां पृथक्पृथक् .. 45 ..
text_mt: O king, one should place streamers and flags upon the lines, / as well as parasols of matching colours, separately for each of the chief planets.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānantu vijñāya yathāvadatra kāryaṃ yathā maṇḍalakapramāṇam ..
yathā mahattā nṛpa maṇḍalasya tathātathā vṛddhimupaiti kartā .. 46 ..
meaning:
स्थानन्तु विज्ञाय यथावदत्र कार्यं यथा मण्डलकप्रमाणम् ..
यथा महत्ता नृप मण्डलस्य तथातथा वृद्धिमुपैति कर्ता .. 46 ..
text_mt: Having duly recognised the proper position here, one should proceed according to the measure of the sacred diagram. / To whatever extent the sacred diagram is large, O king, to that same extent does its maker attain prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āvāhanānyato vakṣye sarveṣāṃ pārthivottama ..
sarvasyāvāhanasyānte śloko'yaṃ parikīrtyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
आवाहनान्यतो वक्ष्ये सर्वेषां पार्थिवोत्तम ..
सर्वस्यावाहनस्यान्ते श्लोकोऽयं परिकीर्त्यते .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Next I shall proclaim the invocations of all [the deities], O best of kings. / At the end of every invocation, this verse is recited:
title: Graharkṣāvāhanamantrādhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale sampraviśyāsminmayā bhaktyā niveditam ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2 ..
meaning:
मण्डले सम्प्रविश्यास्मिन्मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् ..
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: "Having entered into this sacred diagram, [what is] offered by me with devotion— / this water for guest-offering, this water for washing the feet, this incense—let it be accepted!"

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagrahagaṇeśvaram ..
niruddhaṃ bhrāmyate yena bhacakraṃ vātarajjubhiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
ध्रुवमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वग्रहगणेश्वरम् ..
निरुद्धं भ्राम्यते येन भचक्रं वातरज्जुभिः .. 3 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Dhruva, the lord of all the hosts of planets, / by whom the stellar sphere is held in check and revolved by cords of wind.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me dhruva deveśa keśavācintyavikrama ..
sarvagrahagaṇādhyakṣa sarvalokanamaskṛta .. 4 ..
meaning:
एहि मे ध्रुव देवेश केशवाचिन्त्यविक्रम ..
सर्वग्रहगणाध्यक्ष सर्वलोकनमस्कृत .. 4 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O Dhruva, lord of gods, O Keśava of unfathomable prowess, / overseer of all the hosts of planets, saluted by all the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣyāmyākāśaṃ vimānaśatamaṇḍitam ..
tṛtīyaṃ devadevasya padaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्याम्याकाशं विमानशतमण्डितम् ..
तृतीयं देवदेवस्य पदं विष्णोर्महात्मनः .. 5 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke space, adorned with hundreds of celestial chariots, / the third step of the great-souled Viṣṇu, god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me bhagavansaumya nirālamba nabhastala ..
aprameyātigambhīra nakṣatragrahamaṇḍita .. 6 ..
meaning:
एहि मे भगवन्सौम्य निरालम्ब नभस्तल ..
अप्रमेयातिगम्भीर नक्षत्रग्रहमण्डित .. 6 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O Lord, gentle, unsupported vault of the sky, / immeasurable, profoundly deep, adorned with constellations and planets!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं ब्रह्माणं जगतां पतिम् ..
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: I invoke the god Brahmā, the lord of the worlds, / the bringer of the origination, maintenance, and dissolution of this universe.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi sarvaprajādhyakṣa padmayone caturmukha ..
vedamūrte tadādhāra kālanirmāṇa tatpara .. 8 ..
meaning:
एहि सर्वप्रजाध्यक्ष पद्मयोने चतुर्मुख ..
वेदमूर्ते तदाधार कालनिर्माण तत्पर .. 8 ..
text_mt: Come, overseer of all creatures, lotus-born, four-faced one, / embodiment of the Vedas, their foundation, devoted to the fashioning of time!

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhvamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanantāṃ mahatīṃ diśam ..
aprameyāṃ nirālambāṃ candrasūryāṃśuvarjitām .. 9 ..
meaning:
ऊर्द्ध्वमावाहयिष्यामि ह्यनन्तां महतीं दिशम् ..
अप्रमेयां निरालम्बां चन्द्रसूर्यांशुवर्जिताम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the upward direction, endless and immense, / immeasurable, unsupported, devoid of the rays of the moon and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccheha mahābhāge satataṃ siddhasevite ..
anante vipule devi nirmale hitakāriṇi .. 1.95.10 ..
meaning:
आगच्छेह महाभागे सततं सिद्धसेविते ..
अनन्ते विपुले देवि निर्मले हितकारिणि .. 1.95.10 ..
text_mt: Come here, O fortunate one, constantly frequented by the Siddhas, / endless, vast goddess, spotless and beneficent!

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvasattvahite ratām ..
dharāṃ bhūmiṃ kṣamāṃ kṣoṇīṃ varadāṃ bhūtadhāriṇīm .. 11 ..
meaning:
पृथ्वीमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वसत्त्वहिते रताम् ..
धरां भूमिं क्षमां क्षोणीं वरदां भूतधारिणीम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the Earth, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / the supporter, soil, patient one, terrestrial realm, giver of boons, bearer of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me vasudhe devi vārāheṇa samuddhṛte ..
sarvabījadhare bhadre sarvabhūtāpahāriṇi .. 12 ..
meaning:
एहि मे वसुधे देवि वाराहेण समुद्धृते ..
सर्वबीजधरे भद्रे सर्वभूतापहारिणि .. 12 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O goddess who holds wealth, raised up by the Boar, / bearer of all seeds, auspicious one, sustainer of all beings!

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi mahīmaṇḍala dhāraṇam ..
phaṇāvalīratnajālamarīcivikasojjvalam .. 13 ..
meaning:
शेषमावाहयिष्यामि महीमण्डल धारणम् ..
फणावलीरत्नजालमरीचिविकसोज्ज्वलम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Śeṣa, who upholds the circle of the earth, / radiant with the expansion of rays from the mass of jewels upon the row of his hoods.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi śeṣa mahābhāga ehyanantādikeśava ..
āheyī tvaṃ tanustasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
एहि शेष महाभाग एह्यनन्तादिकेशव ..
आहेयी त्वं तनुस्तस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Come, O Śeṣa, highly fortunate one; come, O Keśava beginning with Ananta! / You are the serpentine body of that Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyadhastāttu diśaṃ śeṣeṇa pālitām ..
nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ ca niṣevitām .. 15 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यधस्तात्तु दिशं शेषेण पालिताम् ..
नागदैत्योरगगणैस्सततं च निषेविताम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: I invoke the nether direction protected by Śeṣa, / and constantly frequented by the hosts of nāgas, daityas, and serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me ratnabāhulye nityaṃ śeṣeṇa pālite ..
gambhīre vipule bhīme bahusthānābhimaṇḍite .. 16 ..
meaning:
एहि मे रत्नबाहुल्ये नित्यं शेषेण पालिते ..
गम्भीरे विपुले भीमे बहुस्थानाभिमण्डिते .. 16 ..
text_mt: Come to me, [O direction] abundant with jewels, perpetually protected by Śeṣa, / profound, vast, formidable, adorned with many realms!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ deveśaṃ jātavedasam ..
vedamūrttiṃ tadādhāraṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam .. 17 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं देवेशं जातवेदसम् ..
वेदमूर्त्तिं तदाधारं देवदेवं हुताशनम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Jātavedas, the boon-giving lord of gods, / the embodiment of the Veda and its foundation, the god of gods, the consumer of oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
ehyagre sarvadeveśa sarvadevamukhācyuta ..
sarvatrastha mahābhāga sarvabhūtahite rata .. 18 ..
meaning:
एह्यग्रे सर्वदेवेश सर्वदेवमुखाच्युत ..
सर्वत्रस्थ महाभाग सर्वभूतहिते रत .. 18 ..
text_mt: Come forward, O lord of all gods, mouth of all deities, unswerving one, / omnipresent, highly fortunate, devoted to the welfare of all creatures!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ divākaram ..
tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam .. 12 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं सहस्राक्षं दिवाकरम् ..
तेजोमूर्त्तिं दुराधर्षं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the boon-giving, thousand-eyed Maker of the Day, / the embodiment of brilliance, unassailable, the granter of fearlessness to his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi deva jagannātha ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate ..
trailokyamaṇḍaladvīpa sarvavyādhivināśana .. 1.95.20 ..
meaning:
एहि देव जगन्नाथ ऋक्सामयजुषां पते ..
त्रैलोक्यमण्डलद्वीप सर्वव्याधिविनाशन .. 1.95.20 ..
text_mt: Come, O god, lord of the world, master of the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajus [hymns], / island of the circle of the three worlds, destroyer of all diseases!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devamādityamudakeśayam ..
snigdhavaiḍūryasaṅkāśaṃ varuṇaṃ sumahādyutim .. 21 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवमादित्यमुदकेशयम् ..
स्निग्धवैडूर्यसङ्काशं वरुणं सुमहाद्युतिम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: I invoke the god Varuṇa, the Āditya reclining in the waters, / resembling smooth lapis lazuli, endowed with very great radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi deva jalādhyakṣa yādogaṇamaheśvara ..
nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ sevitānyuta .. 22 ..
meaning:
एहि देव जलाध्यक्ष यादोगणमहेश्वर ..
नागदैत्योरगगणैस्सततं सेवितान्युत .. 22 ..
text_mt: Come, O god, overseer of waters, great lord of the aquatic creatures, / constantly attended and served by the hosts of nāgas, daityas, and serpents!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ candraṃ śītāṃśumamṛtaprabham ..
oṣadhīśaṃ dvijādhyakṣaṃ nayanānandakārakam .. 23 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं चन्द्रं शीतांशुममृतप्रभम् ..
ओषधीशं द्विजाध्यक्षं नयनानन्दकारकम् .. 23 ..
text_mt: I invoke the moon of cool rays and nectarous lustre, / lord of medicinal herbs, sovereign of the twice-born, delighting the eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me bhagavam̐ścandra ehi me mṛgalācchana ..
bhaktānukampinsatataṃ sarvanakṣatrapūjita .. 24 ..
meaning:
एहि मे भगवम्̐श्चन्द्र एहि मे मृगलाच्छन ..
भक्तानुकम्पिन्सततं सर्वनक्षत्रपूजित .. 24 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O Lord Moon; come to me, hare-marked one, / ever compassionate to your devotees, worshipped by all the constellations!

sanskrit_iast:
skandamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṣaṇmukhaṃ varadaṃ śiśum ..
devārisenāmathanaṃ pārvatyānandavarddhanam .. 25 ..
meaning:
स्कन्दमावाहयिष्यामि षण्मुखं वरदं शिशुम् ..
देवारिसेनामथनं पार्वत्यानन्दवर्द्धनम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Skanda, the six-faced, boon-giving youth, / the crusher of the army of the gods' enemies, the increaser of Pārvatī's joy.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi devatamārādhya mahiṣāsurataskara ..
kārtikeya jagannātha mayūravaravāhana .. 26 ..
meaning:
एहि देवतमाराध्य महिषासुरतस्कर ..
कार्तिकेय जगन्नाथ मयूरवरवाहन .. 26 ..
text_mt: Come, you who are worthy of worship by the gods, destroyer of the demon Mahiṣa, / Kārtikeya, lord of the universe, whose excellent mount is the peacock!

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumamāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam ..
rudramūrtimanirdeśyavaktraṃ rudhirasaprabham .. 27 ..
meaning:
भौममावाहयिष्यामि तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ..
रुद्रमूर्तिमनिर्देश्यवक्त्रं रुधिरसप्रभम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Mars, an embodiment of brilliance, difficult to approach, / a form of Rudra, whose face is indescribable, having the radiance of blood.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me bhagavanbhauma aṅgāraka mahāprabha ..
tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ bhūtalesmiñchubhāśubham .. 28 ..
meaning:
एहि मे भगवन्भौम अङ्गारक महाप्रभ ..
त्वयि सर्वं समायत्तं भूतलेस्मिञ्छुभाशुभम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O Lord Bhauma, Aṅgāraka of great splendour! / In your power rests everything good and bad upon this earth.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇumāvāhayiṣyāmi śaṅkhacakragadādharam ..
atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam .. 29 ..
meaning:
विष्णुमावाहयिष्यामि शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ..
अतसीकुसुमश्यामं पीतवाससमच्युतम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Viṣṇu, bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, / dark as an atasī flower, clad in yellow garments, the infallible one.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me devadeveśa prajānirmāṇakāraka ..
nārāyaṇa suduṣpāra mahāśārṅgadhanurdhara .. 1.95.30 ..
meaning:
एहि मे देवदेवेश प्रजानिर्माणकारक ..
नारायण सुदुष्पार महाशार्ङ्गधनुर्धर .. 1.95.30 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O god of gods, creator of creatures, / Nārāyaṇa, difficult to cross, bearer of the great Śārṅga bow!

sanskrit_iast:
budhamāvāhayiṣyāmi bodhakaṃ jagadīśvaram ..
cāndriṃ grahagaṇādhyakṣaṃ tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam .. 31 ..
meaning:
बुधमावाहयिष्यामि बोधकं जगदीश्वरम् ..
चान्द्रिं ग्रहगणाध्यक्षं तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Mercury, the awakener, lord of the world, / son of the moon, overseer of the hosts of planets, an embodiment of brilliance, difficult to approach.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi śītāṃśujācintya jagajjiṣṇo janārdana ..
mahābala mahāsattva mahābāho mahādyute .. 32 ..
meaning:
एहि शीतांशुजाचिन्त्य जगज्जिष्णो जनार्दन ..
महाबल महासत्त्व महाबाहो महाद्युते .. 32 ..
text_mt: Come, son of the moon, unfathomable one, conqueror of the world, Janārdana, / of great strength, great essence, mighty arms, and great lustre!

sanskrit_iast:
śakramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ suragaṇeśvaram ..
vajrapāṇiṃ mahābāhuṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam .. 33 ..
meaning:
शक्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं सुरगणेश्वरम् ..
वज्रपाणिं महाबाहुं गोब्राह्मणहिते रतम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Śakra, the divine lord of the hosts of deities, / holding the thunderbolt in his hand, mighty-armed, devoted to the welfare of cows and brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi deva sahasrākṣa devāribalasūdana ..
airāvatasthadharmajña śacīhṛdayanandana .. 34 ..
meaning:
एहि देव सहस्राक्ष देवारिबलसूदन ..
ऐरावतस्थधर्मज्ञ शचीहृदयनन्दन .. 34 ..
text_mt: Come, O god, thousand-eyed one, slayer of the armies of the gods' enemies, / seated upon Airāvata, knower of dharma, delight of Śacī's heart!

sanskrit_iast:
jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deveśvarapurohitam ..
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadvācaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam .. 35 ..
meaning:
जीवमावाहयिष्यामि देवेश्वरपुरोहितम् ..
बृहस्पतिं बृहद्वाचं वेदवेदाङ्गपारगम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Jīva, the household priest of the lord of gods, / Bṛhaspati, of mighty speech, who has mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi jīva mahābhāgajīvabhūta mahītale ..
sasyavṛddhistavāyattā satataṃ bhūmivardhana .. 36 ..
meaning:
एहि जीव महाभागजीवभूत महीतले ..
सस्यवृद्धिस्तवायत्ता सततं भूमिवर्धन .. 36 ..
text_mt: Come, O Jīva, highly fortunate one, the very soul of life upon the earth! / The growth of crops is in your hands, O eternal replenisher of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi pārvatīṃ varadāmumām ..
harasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ cārvaṅgīṃ bhūtivardhinīm .. 37 ..
meaning:
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि पार्वतीं वरदामुमाम् ..
हरस्य दयितां भार्यां चार्वङ्गीं भूतिवर्धिनीम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the goddess, the boon-giving Umā, Pārvatī, / Hara's beloved wife, possessing lovely limbs, increaser of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi devi jagannāthe menāhṛdayanandini ..
pavitre varade saumye nityaṃ bhaktajanapriye .. 38 ..
meaning:
एहि देवि जगन्नाथे मेनाहृदयनन्दिनि ..
पवित्रे वरदे सौम्ये नित्यं भक्तजनप्रिये .. 38 ..
text_mt: Come, O goddess, mistress of the universe, delight of Menā's heart, / pure, boon-giving, gentle, ever beloved of your devotees!

sanskrit_iast:
śukramāvāhayiṣyāmi bhārgavaṃ jagadīśvaram ..
nityaṃ sarvajanādhyakṣaṃ tapasā dyotitaprabham ..39..
meaning:
शुक्रमावाहयिष्यामि भार्गवं जगदीश्वरम् ..
नित्यं सर्वजनाध्यक्षं तपसा द्योतितप्रभम् ..39..
text_mt: I shall invoke Venus, the Bhārgava, lord of the world, / the eternal overseer of all people, whose splendour is kindled by ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi śukra mahābhāga ṣoḍaśārcirvaraprada ..
prabhustvaṃ varadācintya varṣāvarṣasya nigrahe .. 1.95.40 ..
meaning:
एहि शुक्र महाभाग षोडशार्चिर्वरप्रद ..
प्रभुस्त्वं वरदाचिन्त्य वर्षावर्षस्य निग्रहे .. 1.95.40 ..
text_mt: Come, O Venus, highly fortunate one, of sixteen rays, giver of boons! / You are the master, boon-giving and unfathomable, in causing and withholding rain.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ prajādhyakṣamakalmaṣam ..
bhaktānukampinaṃ devaṃ prajānirmāṇakārakam .. 41 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं प्रजाध्यक्षमकल्मषम् ..
भक्तानुकम्पिनं देवं प्रजानिर्माणकारकम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: I invoke the spotless god who is the overseer of creatures, / the god compassionate to his devotees, the fashioner of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi deva prajādhyakṣa pūjānirmāṇakāraka ..
tvayi deva samāyuktaṃ prajānāmabhavodbhavam .. 42 ..
meaning:
एहि देव प्रजाध्यक्ष पूजानिर्माणकारक ..
त्वयि देव समायुक्तं प्रजानामभवोद्भवम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: Come, O god, overseer of creatures, inspirer of worship! / In you, O god, is joined the origination and dissolution of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me bhagavanbrahmanprajāpatimahādyute ..
saurimāvāhayiṣyāmi śanaiścāriṇamacyutam .. 43 ..
meaning:
एहि मे भगवन्ब्रह्मन्प्रजापतिमहाद्युते ..
सौरिमावाहयिष्यामि शनैश्चारिणमच्युतम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O Lord Brahmā, Prajāpati of great splendour! / I shall invoke the son of the Sun, the slow-moving, infallible one.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvinamanādhṛṣyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam ..
ehi tīkṣṇāṃśujācintya bhāvābhāvapradarśaka .. 44 ..
meaning:
तपस्विनमनाधृष्यं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ..
एहि तीक्ष्णांशुजाचिन्त्य भावाभावप्रदर्शक .. 44 ..
text_mt: practising austerities, unassailable, granter of fearlessness to devotees; / come, O son of the hot-rayed [Sun], inconceivable one, revealer of existence and non-existence.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ rājñāṃ bhūmau śubhāśubham ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ gaṇeśvaram .. 45 ..
meaning:
त्वयि सर्वं समायत्तं राज्ञां भूमौ शुभाशुभम् ..
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं गजवक्त्रं गणेश्वरम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Upon you all the good and evil of kings on earth depends. / I invoke the god with an elephant's face, the lord of the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vipreśaṃ viprahartāraṃ pārvatīhṛdayapriyam ..
ehi deva gaṇādhyakṣa lambodara mahābhuja .. 46 ..
meaning:
विप्रेशं विप्रहर्तारं पार्वतीहृदयप्रियम् ..
एहि देव गणाध्यक्ष लम्बोदर महाभुज .. 46 ..
text_mt: the lord of brahmins, the dispeller of obstacles, dear to Pārvatī's heart; / come, O god, leader of the gaṇas, pot-bellied, mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryasiddhiḥ samāyattā tvayi sarveśa dehinām ..
rāhumāvāhayiṣyāmi daityeśaṃ grahatāṅgatam .. 47 ..
meaning:
कार्यसिद्धिः समायत्ता त्वयि सर्वेश देहिनाम् ..
राहुमावाहयिष्यामि दैत्येशं ग्रहताङ्गतम् .. 47 ..
text_mt: The success of undertakings of embodied beings depends on you, O lord of all. / I shall invoke Rāhu, the lord of the Daityas who attained the status of a planet,

sanskrit_iast:
keśavāptavaraṃ vīraṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam ..
ehyehi daityapravara varadācintyavikrama .. 48 ..
meaning:
केशवाप्तवरं वीरं तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम् ..
एह्येहि दैत्यप्रवर वरदाचिन्त्यविक्रम .. 48 ..
text_mt: who obtained a boon from Keśava, the hero whose sins were burnt away by austerity; / come, come, foremost of the Daityas, boon-giver of inconceivable prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
tapomūrte durādharṣa viparītacarāmbare ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam .. 49 ..
meaning:
तपोमूर्ते दुराधर्ष विपरीतचराम्बरे ..
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: embodiment of austerity, difficult to overcome, who moves in opposite direction through the sky. / I invoke the imperishable god Viśvakarman,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu sadā śilpapravartakam ..
ehi devavarācintya sarvaśilpapravartaka .. 1.95.50 ..
meaning:
सर्वासां देवतानां तु सदा शिल्पप्रवर्तकम् ..
एहि देववराचिन्त्य सर्वशिल्पप्रवर्तक .. 1.95.50 ..
text_mt: who perpetually initiates the arts and crafts of all the gods; / come, O best of gods, inconceivable one, promoter of all crafts.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi sarvaiva sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmāśritā gatiḥ ..
ketumāvāhayiṣyāmi ketuṃ sarvadivaukasām .. 51 ..
meaning:
त्वयि सर्वैव सर्वेषां कर्मणामाश्रिता गतिः ..
केतुमावाहयिष्यामि केतुं सर्वदिवौकसाम् .. 51 ..
text_mt: In you alone is rooted the course of all actions of all beings. / I shall invoke Ketu, the banner of all the heaven-dwellers,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam ..
dhūmaketo ihābhyehi hutāśanasamaprabha .. 52 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ..
धूमकेतो इहाभ्येहि हुताशनसमप्रभ .. 52 ..
text_mt: beneficent to brahmins, knower of all dharma, granter of fearlessness to devotees; / O Dhūmaketu, come hither, you who equal the fire in brilliance,

sanskrit_iast:
śikhākarālavikaca pūjitāghavināśana ..
vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayānagha .. 53 ..
meaning:
शिखाकरालविकच पूजिताघविनाशन ..
वह्नेरावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मयानघ .. 53 ..
text_mt: whose crest is dread and radiant, who, when worshipped, destroys sins. / The invocation of Fire has already been spoken by me, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ kṛttikāṃ devapūjitām ..
ehi sādhāraṇe devi jyeṣṭhadakṣasute śubhe .. 54 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्यामि शुभां कृत्तिकां देवपूजिताम् ..
एहि साधारणे देवि ज्येष्ठदक्षसुते शुभे .. 54 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the auspicious Kṛttikā, worshipped by the gods; / come, O generic goddess, auspicious eldest daughter of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatestathā proktaṃ rohiṇyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
āvāhayāmi varadāṃ rohiṇīṃ candravallabhām .. 55 ..
meaning:
प्रजापतेस्तथा प्रोक्तं रोहिण्याः शृणु पार्थिव ..
आवाहयामि वरदां रोहिणीं चन्द्रवल्लभाम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: That of Prajāpati has likewise been spoken; hear now of Rohiṇī, O king: / I invoke the boon-granting Rohiṇī, the beloved of the Moon;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi rohiṇi dharmajñe dhruvakarmasu śobhane ..
candrasyāvāhanaṃ proktamilvalāyā nibodha me .. 56 ..
meaning:
एहि रोहिणि धर्मज्ञे ध्रुवकर्मसु शोभने ..
चन्द्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तमिल्वलाया निबोध मे .. 56 ..
text_mt: come, O Rohiṇī, knower of dharma, beautiful in steadfast rites. / The invocation of the Moon has been spoken; learn from me that of Ilvalā:

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmi varadāmilvalāṃ śaśivallabhām ..
ehi me ilvale devi mṛdukarmasu śobhane .. 57 ..
meaning:
आवाहयामि वरदामिल्वलां शशिवल्लभाम् ..
एहि मे इल्वले देवि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने .. 57 ..
text_mt: I invoke the boon-granting Ilvalā, beloved of the Moon; / come to me, O goddess Ilvalā, beautiful in gentle rites.

sanskrit_iast:
rudramāvāhayiṣyāmi trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam ..
ehi śaṅkara sarvātmanmahādeva gaṇeśvara .. 58 ..
meaning:
रुद्रमावाहयिष्यामि त्रिनेत्रं शूलपाणिनम् ..
एहि शङ्कर सर्वात्मन्महादेव गणेश्वर .. 58 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Rudra, three-eyed, trident in hand; / come, O Śaṅkara, Self of all, Mahādeva, lord of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ bāhusaṃjñikam ..
ehyārdre cārusarvāṅgi dāruṇe rudrasammate .. 59 ..
meaning:
आर्द्रामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं बाहुसंज्ञिकम् ..
एह्यार्द्रे चारुसर्वाङ्गि दारुणे रुद्रसम्मते .. 59 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Ārdrā, the asterism known as the Arm; / come, O Ārdrā, lovely in all limbs, fierce, esteemed by Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣyāmyaditiṃ tapasā dagdhakilviṣām ..
ādityāraṇi dharmajñe ehi devi mahāprabhe .. .. 1.95.60 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्याम्यदितिं तपसा दग्धकिल्विषाम् ..
आदित्यारणि धर्मज्ञे एहि देवि महाप्रभे .. .. 1.95.60 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Aditi, whose sins were burnt away by austerity; / O fire-stick of the Ādityas, knower of dharma, come, O goddess of great splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmajñaṃ tu punarvasum ..
punarvaso ihāgaccha carakarmaprasādaka .. 61 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि धर्मज्ञं तु पुनर्वसुम् ..
पुनर्वसो इहागच्छ चरकर्मप्रसादक .. 61 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the asterism Punarvasu, knower of dharma; / come hither, O Punarvasu, favourer of movable rites.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ puṣyasyātha pracakṣate ..
puṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ kṣiprasaṃjñikam .. 62 ..
meaning:
जीवस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं पुष्यस्याथ प्रचक्षते ..
पुष्यमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं क्षिप्रसंज्ञिकम् .. 62 ..
text_mt: The invocation of Jīva has been spoken; now they explain that of Puṣya: / I shall invoke Puṣya, the asterism known as swift;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi puṣya mahābhāga poṣaṃ vardhaya sarvataḥ ..
sarpānāvāhayiṣyāmi trailokyāntaragocarān .. .. 63 ..
meaning:
एहि पुष्य महाभाग पोषं वर्धय सर्वतः ..
सर्पानावाहयिष्यामि त्रैलोक्यान्तरगोचरान् .. .. 63 ..
text_mt: come, O illustrious Puṣya, increase nourishment everywhere. / I shall invoke the serpents who roam within the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
āyāntu sarvataḥ sarpāḥ saumyarūpā bhavantu ca ..
āvāhayiṣyāmyāśleṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ śrīvivarddhanām .. 64 ..
meaning:
आयान्तु सर्वतः सर्पाः सौम्यरूपा भवन्तु च ..
आवाहयिष्याम्याश्लेषां भक्तानां श्रीविवर्द्धनाम् .. 64 ..
text_mt: let the serpents come from every side, and let them assume gentle forms. / I shall invoke Āśleṣā, who increases the prosperity of her devotees;

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣe tvamihābhyehi dāruṇe vijayaprade ..
pitṝnāvāhayiṣyāmi mūrtyamūrtidharānaham .. 65 ..
meaning:
आश्लेषे त्वमिहाभ्येहि दारुणे विजयप्रदे ..
पितॄनावाहयिष्यामि मूर्त्यमूर्तिधरानहम् .. 65 ..
text_mt: come hither, O Āśleṣā, fierce one who bestows victory. / I shall invoke the ancestors, both embodied and formless;

sanskrit_iast:
āyāntu pitaraśśīghraṃ sudhākavyabhujo'vyayāḥ..
maghāmāvāhayiṣyāmi ugranakṣatramañjasā .. 66 ..
meaning:
आयान्तु पितरश्शीघ्रं सुधाकव्यभुजोऽव्ययाः..
मघामावाहयिष्यामि उग्रनक्षत्रमञ्जसा .. 66 ..
text_mt: let the imperishable ancestors quickly arrive, who partake of nectar and ancestral offerings. / I shall straightway invoke Maghā, the fierce asterism;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me subhage devi maghe'ghaviniṣūdane ..
bhagamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvaphalgunasaṃjñitam .. 67 ...
meaning:
एहि मे सुभगे देवि मघेऽघविनिषूदने ..
भगमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वफल्गुनसंज्ञितम् .. 67 ...
text_mt: come to me, O fortunate goddess, O Maghā, destroyer of sins. / I shall invoke Bhaga, known as Pūrvaphalgunī;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi bhāgye mahābhāge ugrakarmaprasādike ..
āvāhayiṣyāmyaryamṇamādityaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim .. 68 ..
meaning:
एहि भाग्ये महाभागे उग्रकर्मप्रसादिके ..
आवाहयिष्याम्यर्यम्णमादित्यं तेजसां निधिम् .. 68 ..
text_mt: come, O daughter of Bhaga, highly fortunate one who favours fierce rites. / I shall invoke Aryaman, the Āditya, a storehouse of splendours;

sanskrit_iast:
aryamam̐stvaṃ samamyehi bhaktapātakanāśana ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cottarāphalgunīṃ śubhām .. 69 ..
meaning:
अर्यमम्̐स्त्वं समम्येहि भक्तपातकनाशन ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चोत्तराफल्गुनीं शुभाम् .. 69 ..
text_mt: come forth together, O Aryaman, destroyer of devotees' sins. / And I shall invoke the auspicious asterism Uttaraphalgunī;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi dhruve sarvāṅgasundari ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ saviturdīptatejasaḥ .. 1.95.70 ..
meaning:
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि ध्रुवे सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि ..
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं सवितुर्दीप्ततेजसः .. 1.95.70 ..
text_mt: come, O fortunate goddess, steadfast one, beautiful in all limbs. / The invocation of Savitṛ of blazing splendour has been spoken by me;

sanskrit_iast:
hastamāvāhayiṣyāmi sāvitraṃ kṣipramañjasā ..
ehi sāvitra dharmajña bhaktānāṃ pāpanāśana .. 71 ..
meaning:
हस्तमावाहयिष्यामि सावित्रं क्षिप्रमञ्जसा ..
एहि सावित्र धर्मज्ञ भक्तानां पापनाशन .. 71 ..
text_mt: I shall straightway invoke Hasta, dedicated to Savitṛ, the swift one; / come, O [asterism] of Savitṛ, knower of dharma, destroyer of devotees' sins.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ tvaṣṭāramamitadyutim ..
ehi me bhagavam̐stvaṣṭaḥ prajāpālanatatpara .. 72 ..
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं त्वष्टारममितद्युतिम् ..
एहि मे भगवम्̐स्त्वष्टः प्रजापालनतत्पर .. 72 ..
text_mt: I invoke the god Tvaṣṭṛ of boundless splendour; / come to me, O lord Tvaṣṭṛ, intent on protecting creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi citrarūpāṃ manoharām ..
ehi me varade citre mṛdukarmaprasādhini .. 73 ..
meaning:
चित्रामावाहयिष्यामि चित्ररूपां मनोहराम् ..
एहि मे वरदे चित्रे मृदुकर्मप्रसाधिनि .. 73 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Citrā, of varied form, charming; / come to me, O boon-granting Citrā, accomplisher of gentle rites.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyumāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagaṃ dīptatejasam ..
deva vāyo tvamabhyehi sarvabhūtajagatpriya .. 74 ..
meaning:
वायुमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगं दीप्ततेजसम् ..
देव वायो त्वमभ्येहि सर्वभूतजगत्प्रिय .. 74 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Vāyu, all-pervading, of blazing splendour; / come hither, O god Vāyu, dear to all beings and the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
svātimāvāhayiṣyāmi nityamuttaramārgagām ..
devi svāte tvamabhyehi carakarmasu śobhane .. 75 ..
meaning:
स्वातिमावाहयिष्यामि नित्यमुत्तरमार्गगाम् ..
देवि स्वाते त्वमभ्येहि चरकर्मसु शोभने .. 75 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Svāti, who constantly moves along the northern path; / come hither, O goddess Svāti, beautiful in movable rites.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayiṣyāmīndrāgnī sahitau dīptatejasau ..
indrābhyehi jagannātha ehyagne vijayaprada .. 76 ..
meaning:
आवाहयिष्यामीन्द्राग्नी सहितौ दीप्ततेजसौ ..
इन्द्राभ्येहि जगन्नाथ एह्यग्ने विजयप्रद .. 76 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Indra and Agni together, both of blazing splendour; / come, O Indra, lord of the world; come, O Agni, granter of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi viśākhāṃ dīptatejasam ..
viśākhe tvamihābhyehi devi sādhāraṇe śubhe .. 77 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि विशाखां दीप्ततेजसम् ..
विशाखे त्वमिहाभ्येहि देवि साधारणे शुभे .. 77 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke the asterism Viśākhā of blazing splendour; / come hither, O Viśākhā, O generic, auspicious goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mitramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ dīptāṃśumūrjitam ..
ehi mitra mahābhāga bhaktāghapralayaṅkara .. 78 ..
meaning:
मित्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं दीप्तांशुमूर्जितम् ..
एहि मित्र महाभाग भक्ताघप्रलयङ्कर .. 78 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke Mitra, the mighty god of blazing rays; / come, O highly fortunate Mitra, destroyer of devotees' sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanurādhāṃ varapradām ..
anūrādhe tvamabhyehi mṛdukarmasu śobhane ..79 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि ह्यनुराधां वरप्रदाम् ..
अनूराधे त्वमभ्येहि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने ..79 ..
text_mt: And I shall invoke the asterism Anurādhā, bestower of boons; / come hither, O Anurādhā, beautiful in gentle rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
jyeṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ śakradaivatam .. 1.95.80 ..
meaning:
शक्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं ज्येष्ठायाः शृणु पार्थिव ..
ज्येष्ठामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं शक्रदैवतम् .. 1.95.80 ..
text_mt: The invocation of Śakra has been spoken; hear of Jyeṣṭhā, O king: / I shall invoke Jyeṣṭhā, the asterism presiding over by Śakra;

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe devi tvamabhyehi dāruṇe cārulocane ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ nirṛtijaṃ prabhum .. 81 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे देवि त्वमभ्येहि दारुणे चारुलोचने ..
देवमावाहयिष्यामि देवं निरृतिजं प्रभुम् .. 81 ..
text_mt: come hither, O goddess Jyeṣṭhā, fierce one with lovely eyes. / I shall invoke the god, the sovereign born of Nirṛti;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi deva virūpākṣa mahābalaparākrama ..
mūlamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ dāruṇaṃ mahat .. 82 ..
meaning:
एहि देव विरूपाक्ष महाबलपराक्रम ..
मूलमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं दारुणं महत् .. 82 ..
text_mt: come, O god of uneven eyes, of great strength and valour. / I shall invoke Mūla, the great and fierce asterism;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi mūla mahābhāga bhaktānāmabhayaprada ..
apastvāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagā varadāḥ śivāḥ .. .. 83 ..
meaning:
एहि मूल महाभाग भक्तानामभयप्रद ..
अपस्त्वावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगा वरदाः शिवाः .. .. 83 ..
text_mt: come, O highly fortunate Mūla, granter of fearlessness to devotees. / And I shall invoke the Waters, all-pervading, boon-giving, auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
āpastvāyāntu varadāḥ pavitrā maṅgalāvahāḥ ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvāṣāḍhetisaṃjñitam .. 84 ..
meaning:
आपस्त्वायान्तु वरदाः पवित्रा मङ्गलावहाः ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वाषाढेतिसंज्ञितम् .. 84 ..
text_mt: let the Waters come, boon-giving, pure, and bringing auspiciousness. / I shall invoke the asterism known as Pūrvāṣāḍhā;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi tvamugre varade cāṣāḍhe pūrva pūrvake ..
viśvānāvāhayiṣyāmi devānadbhutatejasaḥ .. 85 ..
meaning:
एहि त्वमुग्रे वरदे चाषाढे पूर्व पूर्वके ..
विश्वानावाहयिष्यामि देवानद्भुततेजसः .. 85 ..
text_mt: come, O fierce, boon-giving Aṣāḍhā, the earlier one. / I shall invoke the Viśvedevas of wondrous splendour;

sanskrit_iast:
āyāntu varadāḥ sarve viśvedevā mahābalāḥ ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi uttarāṣāḍhasaṃjñitam .. 86 ..
meaning:
आयान्तु वरदाः सर्वे विश्वेदेवा महाबलाः ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि उत्तराषाढसंज्ञितम् .. 86 ..
text_mt: let all the boon-giving Viśvedevas of great power come. / I shall invoke the asterism known as Uttarāṣāḍhā;

sanskrit_iast:
ehi tvamuttarāṣāḍhe sarvakarmasu śobhane ..
brahmaṇa āvāhanaṃ proktamabhijiti śṛṇu he prabho .. 87 ..
meaning:
एहि त्वमुत्तराषाढे सर्वकर्मसु शोभने ..
ब्रह्मण आवाहनं प्रोक्तमभिजिति शृणु हे प्रभो .. 87 ..
text_mt: come, O Uttarāṣāḍhā, beautiful in all rites. / The invocation of Brahmā has been spoken; hear now concerning Abhijit, O lord:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi yattadabhijiducyate ..
ehi dhiṣṇyavariṣṭhāya kṣiprakarmaprasādhaka .. 88 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि यत्तदभिजिदुच्यते ..
एहि धिष्ण्यवरिष्ठाय क्षिप्रकर्मप्रसाधक .. 88 ..
text_mt: I shall invoke that asterism which is called Abhijit; / come to the foremost of celestial seats, O accomplisher of swift rites.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇasya nibodha me ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi śravaṇaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 89 .. ..
meaning:
विष्णोरावाहनं प्रोक्तं श्रवणस्य निबोध मे ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि श्रवणं सर्वकामदम् .. 89 .. ..
text_mt: The invocation of Viṣṇu has been spoken; learn from me that of Śravaṇa: / I shall invoke the asterism Śravaṇa, granter of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvattha tvaṃ samabhyehi carakarmaprasādhaka ..
vasūnāvāhayiṣyāmi devānaṣṭau varapradān .. 1.95.90 ..
meaning:
अश्वत्थ त्वं समभ्येहि चरकर्मप्रसाधक ..
वसूनावाहयिष्यामि देवानष्टौ वरप्रदान् .. 1.95.90 ..
text_mt: Come forth, O sacred fig tree, accomplish mobile acts! / I will summon the Vasus, the eight boon-granting gods.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāntu varadā devā vasavaḥ pāpanāśanāḥ ..
dhaniṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ rāśivallabham .. 91 ..
meaning:
आयान्तु वरदा देवा वसवः पापनाशनाः ..
धनिष्ठामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं राशिवल्लभम् .. 91 ..
text_mt: May the boon-granting gods, the Vasus, destroyers of sin, arrive. / I will summon Dhaniṣṭhā, the asterism dear to the zodiacal sign.

sanskrit_iast:
dhaniṣṭhe tvamihāgaccha carakarmaprasādhake ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 92 ..
meaning:
धनिष्ठे त्वमिहागच्छ चरकर्मप्रसाधके ..
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वरुणस्य महात्मनः .. 92 ..
text_mt: Come here, O Dhaniṣṭhā, accomplisher of mobile acts! / The invocation of the great-souled Varuṇa has been spoken by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi nāmnā śatabhiṣaṃ śubham ..
āgaccha tvaṃ śatabhiṣe carakarmasu śobhane .. 93 ..
meaning:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि नाम्ना शतभिषं शुभम् ..
आगच्छ त्वं शतभिषे चरकर्मसु शोभने .. 93 ..
text_mt: I will summon the auspicious asterism named Śatabhiṣaj. / Come, O Śatabhiṣaj, fair one in mobile acts!

sanskrit_iast:
ajaikapādaṃ varadaṃ rudramāvāhayāmyaham ..
ahirbudhnya samabhyehi jaṭājūṭopaśobhita .. 94 ..
meaning:
अजैकपादं वरदं रुद्रमावाहयाम्यहम् ..
अहिर्बुध्न्य समभ्येहि जटाजूटोपशोभित .. 94 ..
text_mt: I summon the boon-granting Rudra Aja Ekapād. / Come forth, O Ahirbudhnya, adorned with matted locks!

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deśe bhādrapadottare ..
ehi tvaṃ sumahābhāge mama bhādrapadottare..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi revatīṃ cārudarśanām .. 95 ..
meaning:
ध्रुवमावाहयिष्यामि देशे भाद्रपदोत्तरे ..
एहि त्वं सुमहाभागे मम भाद्रपदोत्तरे..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि रेवतीं चारुदर्शनाम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: I will summon the fixed [asterism] in the region of Uttarabhādrapadā. / Come, O most fortunate one, my Uttarabhādrapadā! / I will summon the asterism Revatī of lovely appearance.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi revati dharmajñe mṛdukarmaprasādhake ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 96 ..
meaning:
एहि रेवति धर्मज्ञे मृदुकर्मप्रसाधके ..
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं पूषणं पापनाशनम् .. 96 ..
text_mt: Come, O Revatī, knower of dharma, accomplisher of gentle acts! / I summon the god Pūṣan, the destroyer of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
pūṣansamyagihābhyehi sarvakarmaprasādika ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devau nāsatyau sūryanandanau .. 97 ..
meaning:
पूषन्सम्यगिहाभ्येहि सर्वकर्मप्रसादिक ..
आवाहयाम्यहं देवौ नासत्यौ सूर्यनन्दनौ .. 97 ..
text_mt: O Pūṣan, come here duly, accomplisher of all acts! / I summon the two gods, the Nāsatyas, sons of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchetāṃ mahābhāgau varadāvaśvināvubhau ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cāśvinī sarvakāmadam .. 98 ..
meaning:
आगच्छेतां महाभागौ वरदावश्विनावुभौ ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चाश्विनी सर्वकामदम् .. 98 ..
text_mt: May both the most fortunate, boon-granting Aśvins arrive. / I will summon the asterism Aśvinī, which grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ bharaṇīmatha vai śṛṇu ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cograṃ bharaṇisaṃjñakam .. 99 ..
meaning:
यमस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं भरणीमथ वै शृणु ..
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चोग्रं भरणिसंज्ञकम् .. 99 ..
text_mt: The invocation of Yama has been spoken; now hear about Bharaṇī. / I will summon the fierce asterism called Bharaṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi tvaṃ devi bharaṇi subhage cārudarśini ..
śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā nṛpa .. 1.95.100..
meaning:
एहि त्वं देवि भरणि सुभगे चारुदर्शिनि ..
शक्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मया नृप .. 1.95.100..
text_mt: Come, O goddess Bharaṇī, auspicious and of lovely appearance! / The invocation of Śakra was already spoken earlier by me, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
prācīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryodayavibhūṣitām ..
ehi tvaṃ varade pūrve śubhakarmaprasādhike .. 101 ..
meaning:
प्राचीमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्योदयविभूषिताम् ..
एहि त्वं वरदे पूर्वे शुभकर्मप्रसाधिके .. 101 ..
text_mt: I will summon the eastern direction, adorned with the rising of the sun. / Come, O boon-granting eastern [direction], accomplisher of auspicious acts!

sanskrit_iast:
vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā tava ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi varadāṃ pūrvadakṣiṇām .. 102 ..
meaning:
वह्नेरावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मया तव ..
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वरदां पूर्वदक्षिणाम् .. 102 ..
text_mt: The invocation of Vahni was already spoken earlier by me to you. / I will summon the boon-granting south-eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnipriye samabhyehi varade pūrvadakṣiṇe ..
yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ yāmyāyāśca diśaḥ śṛṇu .. 103 ..
meaning:
वह्निप्रिये समभ्येहि वरदे पूर्वदक्षिणे ..
यमस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं याम्यायाश्च दिशः शृणु .. 103 ..
text_mt: Beloved of Vahni, come forth, O boon-granting south-eastern [direction]! / The invocation of Yama has been spoken; now hear about the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ..
dakṣiṇe tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane .. 104 ..
meaning:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि दक्षिणां दक्षिणां दिशम् ..
दक्षिणे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वकर्मसु शोभने .. 104 ..
text_mt: I will summon the bountiful southern direction. / Come forth, O southern [direction], fair in all acts!

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ virūpākṣasya dhīmataḥ ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām .. 105 ...
meaning:
पूर्वमावाहनं प्रोक्तं विरूपाक्षस्य धीमतः ..
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् .. 105 ...
text_mt: The invocation of the wise Virūpākṣa was spoken earlier. / I will summon the auspicious south-western direction.

sanskrit_iast:
ehi me nairṛtī devi satataṃ bhūtivardhini ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
एहि मे नैरृती देवि सततं भूतिवर्धिनि ..
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वरुणस्य महात्मनः .. 106 ..
text_mt: Come to me, O goddess Nairṛtī, constant promoter of prosperity! / The invocation of the great-souled Varuṇa has been spoken by me.

sanskrit_iast:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi vāruṇīṃ varuṇīṃ śubhām ..
āgaccha paścime devi varade varuṇapriye .. 107 ..
meaning:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वारुणीं वरुणीं शुभाम् ..
आगच्छ पश्चिमे देवि वरदे वरुणप्रिये .. 107 ..
text_mt: I will summon the auspicious western direction, belonging to Varuṇa. / Come, O western goddess, boon-granting one beloved of Varuṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ vāyoścaiva mahātmanaḥ ..
āvāhayāmi vidiśaṃ vāyavyāṃ paścimottarām .. .. 108 ..
meaning:
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वायोश्चैव महात्मनः ..
आवाहयामि विदिशं वायव्यां पश्चिमोत्तराम् .. .. 108 ..
text_mt: The invocation of the great-souled Vāyu too has been spoken by me. / I summon the intermediate direction, the north-western, sacred to Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
varade tvaṃ samabhyehi vāyavye paścimottare ..
āvāhayāmi dhanadaṃ devaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum .. 109 ..
meaning:
वरदे त्वं समभ्येहि वायव्ये पश्चिमोत्तरे ..
आवाहयामि धनदं देवं वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् .. 109 ..
text_mt: O boon-granting one, come forth, north-western [direction] sacred to Vāyu! / I summon the god who gives wealth, Lord Vaiśravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājarāja samabhyehi sarvayajñadhanādhipa ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi saumyāṃ dhanadapālitām .. 1.95.110 ..
meaning:
राजराज समभ्येहि सर्वयज्ञधनाधिप ..
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि सौम्यां धनदपालिताम् .. 1.95.110 ..
text_mt: Come forth, O king of kings, master of all sacrificial wealth! / I will summon the gentle northern direction, protected by the giver of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane ..
devasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ tryambakasya mahātmanaḥ .. .. 111 ..
meaning:
उत्तरे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वकर्मसु शोभने ..
देवस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं त्र्यम्बकस्य महात्मनः .. .. 111 ..
text_mt: Come forth, O northern [direction], fair in all acts! / The invocation of the great-souled god Tryambaka has been spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ prāguttarāmaham ..
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi satataṃ śivapālite .. 112 ..
meaning:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां प्रागुत्तरामहम् ..
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि सततं शिवपालिते .. 112 ..
text_mt: I will summon the auspicious north-eastern direction. / Come, O auspicious goddess, constantly protected by Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvakumbheṣu sāgarān ..
ratnādhyakṣāḥ samāyāntu catvāra iha sāgarāḥ .. 113 ..
meaning:
सर्वानावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वकुम्भेषु सागरान् ..
रत्नाध्यक्षाः समायान्तु चत्वार इह सागराः .. 113 ..
text_mt: I will summon all the oceans into the eastern water-jars. / May the four oceans, guardians of jewels, arrive here.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānyāṃ diśi yaḥ kumbhaḥ pūrvastasya tu sāgaraḥ ..
āgneyyāntu samāyātu dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaḥ śivaḥ .. 114 ..
meaning:
ईशान्यां दिशि यः कुम्भः पूर्वस्तस्य तु सागरः ..
आग्नेय्यान्तु समायातु दक्षिणे दक्षिणः शिवः .. 114 ..
text_mt: Into the jar that is in the north-eastern direction, [let] the eastern ocean [arrive]; / and into the south-eastern, let the southern ocean arrive, auspicious in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimastu samāyātu kumbhe dakṣiṇapaścime ..
uttaraśca tathā'bhyetu kumbhe vai paścimottare .. 115 ..
meaning:
पश्चिमस्तु समायातु कुम्भे दक्षिणपश्चिमे ..
उत्तरश्च तथाऽभ्येतु कुम्भे वै पश्चिमोत्तरे .. 115 ..
text_mt: Let the western [ocean] arrive into the jar in the south-west; / and likewise let the northern [ocean] arrive into the jar in the north-west.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhitānāṃ kartavyaṃ bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ ..
praṇāmamabhivādyaṃ ca tato mantramudīrayet .. 116 ..
meaning:
आवाहितानां कर्तव्यं भूमौ कृत्वा ततः शिरः ..
प्रणाममभिवाद्यं च ततो मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् .. 116 ..
text_mt: Placing one's head on the ground before those who have been summoned, / a respectful greeting and obeisance should be made; then one should recite the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatāṃ hi prasādena bhavatāṃ pratipūjanaiḥ ..
prayatiṣye yathāśaktyā tanme'nujñātumarhatha .. 117 ..
meaning:
भवतां हि प्रसादेन भवतां प्रतिपूजनैः ..
प्रयतिष्ये यथाशक्त्या तन्मेऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ .. 117 ..
text_mt: "Indeed, through your grace and through worship offered in return to you, / I shall strive according to my ability; therefore, you ought to grant me permission.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kartuṃ kena śakyaṃ yathāvidhi..
yuṣmatpūjāvihīnena kuto labhyaṃ mahatpadam .. 118 ..
meaning:
युष्माकं पूजनं कर्तुं केन शक्यं यथाविधि..
युष्मत्पूजाविहीनेन कुतो लभ्यं महत्पदम् .. 118 ..
text_mt: Who is able to perform your worship according to rule? / For one devoid of your worship, whence can the great state be attained?

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kartuṃ yathāśaktyā bhavatāṃ pratipūjane ..
varadāḥ prayatiṣyāmi tanmenujñātumarhatha .. 119 ..
meaning:
ततः कर्तुं यथाशक्त्या भवतां प्रतिपूजने ..
वरदाः प्रयतिष्यामि तन्मेनुज्ञातुमर्हथ .. 119 ..
text_mt: Therefore, O givers of boons, I shall strive according to my ability / to worship you in return; therefore, you ought to grant me permission.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatpūjāvidhāvasminbahuvijñaṃ sadaiva tu ..
svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya dikpālā dīptatejasaḥ ..1.95.120 ..
meaning:
भवत्पूजाविधावस्मिन्बहुविज्ञं सदैव तु ..
स्वांस्वां दिशमधिष्ठाय दिक्पाला दीप्ततेजसः ..1.95.120 ..
text_mt: In this rite of your worship there are always many obstacles; / standing each in his own direction, may the guardians of the directions, of blazing splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
utsādayantu sakalānvighnānme samupasthitān ..
asmāddeśātpraṇaśyantu yajñaghnā brahmarākṣasāḥ .. 121 ..
meaning:
उत्सादयन्तु सकलान्विघ्नान्मे समुपस्थितान् ..
अस्माद्देशात्प्रणश्यन्तु यज्ञघ्ना ब्रह्मराक्षसाः .. 121 ..
text_mt: destroy all obstacles that have arisen for me! / May the brahmarākṣasas, destroyers of sacrifices, perish from this place!

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakā vighnakarā mamogrā yajñadviṣo ye piśitāśanāśca ..
siddhārthakairvajrasamānakalpairmayā nirastāḥ svagṛhaṃ prayāntu .. 122..
meaning:
विनायका विघ्नकरा ममोग्रा यज्ञद्विषो ये पिशिताशनाश्च ..
सिद्धार्थकैर्वज्रसमानकल्पैर्मया निरस्ताः स्वगृहं प्रयान्तु .. 122..
text_mt: May the obstacle-making, fierce Vināyakas, enemies of sacrifice, and meat-eaters, / repelled by me with white mustard seeds equal to thunderbolts, depart to their own home!"

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā vikireta vidvānsiddhārthakāndikṣu tathā vidikṣu ..
rakṣohaṇaṃ cātra tathaiva maṃtraṃ vaktavyamuccairdvijapuṅgavena .. 123 ..
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा विकिरेत विद्वान्सिद्धार्थकान्दिक्षु तथा विदिक्षु ..
रक्षोहणं चात्र तथैव मंत्रं वक्तव्यमुच्चैर्द्विजपुङ्गवेन .. 123 ..
text_mt: Having said this much, the learned man should scatter white mustard seeds in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / and the foremost of the twice-born should likewise recite loudly here the mantra that slays rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane pradiṣṭaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ snānamadīnasattva ..
bījaiḥ samagraiśca tathaiva gandhairmṛdbhiśca ratnaiśca tathā jalaiśca .. 124 ..
meaning:
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने प्रदिष्टं सर्वौषधैः स्नानमदीनसत्त्व ..
बीजैः समग्रैश्च तथैव गन्धैर्मृद्भिश्च रत्नैश्च तथा जलैश्च .. 124 ..
text_mt: In the sacrifice to all the planets, a bath with all medicinal herbs has been prescribed, O you of steadfast mind, / and likewise with all seeds, perfumes, clays, jewels, and waters.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
sarveṣāṃ tu samācakṣva gandhamālyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
dhūpaṃ brahmansanaivedyaṃ pānaṃ caiva pṛthakpṛthak .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
सर्वेषां तु समाचक्ष्व गन्धमाल्यं तथैव च ..
धूपं ब्रह्मन्सनैवेद्यं पानं चैव पृथक्पृथक् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Declare, O brahmin, the perfume and garland, as well as / the incense, the food-offering, and the drink for all [of them] separately,
title: Anulepakathanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
homadravyaṃ tathā mantraṃ dakṣiṇāśca bhṛgūttama ..
ekastvaṃ sarvavidbrahmanbrahmā vā jagatāṃ patiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
होमद्रव्यं तथा मन्त्रं दक्षिणाश्च भृगूत्तम ..
एकस्त्वं सर्वविद्ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मा वा जगतां पतिः .. 2 ..
text_mt: as well as the oblation-substance, the mantra, and the sacrificial fees, O foremost of the Bhṛgus. / You alone are all-knowing, O brahmin, or Brahmā, the lord of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devānāṃ ca mahīpate ..
sarvāsāṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ nityameva pṛthakpṛthak.. 3..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवानां च महीपते ..
सर्वासां चन्दनं देयं नित्यमेव पृथक्पृथक्.. 3..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the gods who dwell in the northern polar region, O protector of the earth, / sandalwood is to be given always to all of them separately.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ karpūraṃ śaśine tathā ..
bhaumāya candanaṃ raktaṃ cāguruṃ śaśijāya ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
सूर्याय कुङ्कुमं देयं कर्पूरं शशिने तथा ..
भौमाय चन्दनं रक्तं चागुरुं शशिजाय च .. 4 ..
text_mt: Saffron is to be given to the Sun, and camphor likewise to the Moon; / red sandalwood to Mars, and aloe-wood to the son of the Moon [Mercury];

sanskrit_iast:
jīvāya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumena vimiśritam ..
śukrāya candanaṃ śvetaṃ saurāya ca mṛgodbhavam .. 5 ..
meaning:
जीवाय चन्दनं देयं कुङ्कुमेन विमिश्रितम् ..
शुक्राय चन्दनं श्वेतं सौराय च मृगोद्भवम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: sandalwood mixed with saffron is to be given to Jupiter; / white sandalwood to Venus; and musk to Saturn;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumena yutaṃ dadyāddānavāya mṛgodbhavam ..
aguruṃ kuṅkumaṃ cobhau sudeyau dhūmaketave .. 6 ..
meaning:
कुङ्कुमेन युतं दद्याद्दानवाय मृगोद्भवम् ..
अगुरुं कुङ्कुमं चोभौ सुदेयौ धूमकेतवे .. 6 ..
text_mt: one should give musk combined with saffron to Rāhu; / and aloe-wood and saffron are both well-given to Ketu;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu rohiṇīnāṃ mṛgodbhavam ..
ilvalānāṃ ca karpūraṃ raudre nāgamadaṃ tathā .. 7 ..
meaning:
कुङ्कुमं कृत्तिकानां तु रोहिणीनां मृगोद्भवम् ..
इल्वलानां च कर्पूरं रौद्रे नागमदं तथा .. 7 ..
text_mt: saffron to the Kṛttikās, and musk to the Rohiṇīs; / camphor to the Ilvalās [Mṛgaśiras], and snake-ichor [or musk] to the constellation of Rudra [Ārdrā].

sanskrit_iast:
ādityasya pradātavyāvubhau kuṅkumacandanau ..
uśīracandanau deyāvāśleṣāpaitryayostathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
आदित्यस्य प्रदातव्यावुभौ कुङ्कुमचन्दनौ ..
उशीरचन्दनौ देयावाश्लेषापैत्र्ययोस्तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt: To the Sun should be given both saffron and sandalwood; / and to Āśleṣā and the Ancestors' [lunar mansion] should be offered vetiver and sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṅgucandanau deyau tathā bhāgyasya pārthiva ..
aryamṇaśca pradātavyau candanau śvetaraktakau .. 9 ..
meaning:
प्रियङ्गुचन्दनौ देयौ तथा भाग्यस्य पार्थिव ..
अर्यम्णश्च प्रदातव्यौ चन्दनौ श्वेतरक्तकौ .. 9 ..
text_mt: Priyaṅgu and sandalwood should be given likewise to [the mansion of] Bhaga, O king; / and to [the mansion of] Aryaman should be given white and red sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrasya pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ pṛthivīpate ..
tvāṣṭrasya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ samṛgodbhavam .. 1.96.10 ..
meaning:
सावित्रस्य प्रदातव्यं कुङ्कुमं पृथिवीपते ..
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चन्दनं देयं कुङ्कुमं समृगोद्भवम् .. 1.96.10 ..
text_mt: To [the mansion of] Savitṛ saffron should be given, O lord of the earth; / to [the mansion of] Tvaṣṭṛ sandalwood should be given along with saffron and musk.

sanskrit_iast:
jātīphalayutaṃ deyaṃ vāyavyasya ca candanam ..
viśākhāyāḥ pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ tathā .. 11 ..
meaning:
जातीफलयुतं देयं वायव्यस्य च चन्दनम् ..
विशाखायाः प्रदातव्यं कुङ्कुमं चन्दनं तथा .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sandalwood mixed with nutmeg should be given to [the mansion of] Vāyu; / and saffron and sandalwood should be given to Viśākhā.

sanskrit_iast:
turuṣkasahitaṃ deyaṃ tathā maitrāya candanam ..
jyeṣṭhāyāśca pradātavyaṃ candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā .. 12 ..
meaning:
तुरुष्कसहितं देयं तथा मैत्राय चन्दनम् ..
ज्येष्ठायाश्च प्रदातव्यं चन्दनं कुङ्कुमं तथा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Sandalwood accompanied by olibanum should likewise be given to [the mansion of] Mitra; / and sandalwood and saffron should be given to Jyeṣṭhā.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāya śiṃśapāsāraṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam ..
āpyāya kuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ dātavyaṃ candanaṃ bhavet .. 13 ..
meaning:
मूलाय शिंशपासारं तथा देयं मृगोद्भवम् ..
आप्याय कुष्ठसंयुक्तं दातव्यं चन्दनं भवेत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: To Mūla [should be given] heartwood of śiṃśapā, and musk should likewise be offered; / to [the mansion of] the Waters sandalwood combined with costus should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevāya mṛgajaṃ candanāguruṇī tathā ..
brāhmāya candanaṃ deyaṃ vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ tathā ..14..
meaning:
वैश्वदेवाय मृगजं चन्दनागुरुणी तथा ..
ब्राह्माय चन्दनं देयं वैष्णवायागुरुं तथा ..14..
text_mt: To [the mansion of] the All-gods [should be given] musk, as well as sandalwood and agallochum; / to [the mansion of] Brahmā sandalwood should be given, and to [that of] Viṣṇu agallochum.

sanskrit_iast:
jātīlavaṅgau dātavyau supiṣṭau vāsavāya tau ..
vāruṇāya ca karpūramājāhirbudhnyayostathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
जातीलवङ्गौ दातव्यौ सुपिष्टौ वासवाय तौ ..
वारुणाय च कर्पूरमाजाहिर्बुध्न्ययोस्तथा .. 15 ..
text_mt: Well-ground nutmeg and clove should be given to [the mansion of] the Vasus; / and camphor to [that of] Varuṇa, as well as to [the two mansions of] Aja and Ahirbudhnya.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇāya candanaṃ raktamāśvināya tathā sitam ..
yāmyāyāgurusaṃyuktaṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam .. 16 ..
meaning:
पौष्णाय चन्दनं रक्तमाश्विनाय तथा सितम् ..
याम्यायागुरुसंयुक्तं तथा देयं मृगोद्भवम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: To [the mansion of] Pūṣan [should be given] red sandalwood, and white to [that of] the Aśvins; / to [that of] Yama musk mixed with agallochum should likewise be offered.

sanskrit_iast:
samānadevanakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ ca tathā diśam ..
uttarāyāstathā deye candanāguruṇī śubhe .. 17 ..
meaning:
समानदेवनक्षत्रं कथितं च तथा दिशम् ..
उत्तरायास्तथा देये चन्दनागुरुणी शुभे .. 17 ..
text_mt: The directions are declared to share the same deities as the lunar mansions; / and to the northern [direction] should be given auspicious sandalwood and agallochum.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāṇāṃ pradātavyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam ..
alābhe tu tathā deyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam.. 18 ..
meaning:
सागराणां प्रदातव्यं सर्वेषामेव चन्दनम् ..
अलाभे तु तथा देयं सर्वेषामेव चन्दनम्.. 18 ..
text_mt: To all the oceans without exception sandalwood should be given; / in the absence of [the specified unguent], sandalwood indeed should be given to all.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalyaṃ tatpavitraṃ ca devānāṃ dayitaṃ ca tat ..
dhāryaṃ ca deyaṃ tadrājam̐statra lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā .. 19 ..
meaning:
मङ्गल्यं तत्पवित्रं च देवानां दयितं च तत् ..
धार्यं च देयं तद्राजम्̐स्तत्र लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता .. 19 ..
text_mt: It is auspicious, purifying, and beloved of the gods; / it should be worn and it should be given, O king, for Fortune is established in it.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayaitadṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tadeva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 1.96.20 ..
meaning:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयैतदृक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ..
तद्देवतायाश्च तदेव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति .. 1.96.20 ..
text_mt: Whatever has been prescribed by me for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / precisely that should be given to its presiding deity, and likewise to the direction; herein there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
savarṇāni graharkṣāṇāṃ diśāṃ ca jagatīpate ..
nityaṃ deyāni vāsāṃsi patākāśca vijānatā .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
सवर्णानि ग्रहर्क्षाणां दिशां च जगतीपते ..
नित्यं देयानि वासांसि पताकाश्च विजानता .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Daily, O lord of the earth, one who knows should offer / garments and banners of matching colors to the planets, lunar mansions, and directions.
title: Graharkṣaviśeṣapuṣpadeyādeyādhyāyaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇāni ca deyāni kāñcanāni śubhāni ca ..
ratnacitrāṇi ramyāṇi yathāśaktyā narādhipa .. 2 ..
meaning:
भूषणानि च देयानि काञ्चनानि शुभानि च ..
रत्नचित्राणि रम्याणि यथाशक्त्या नराधिप .. 2 ..
text_mt: Auspicious ornaments of gold should also be given, / charming and adorned with various gems, according to one's capacity, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate ..
jātīpuṣpāṇi deyāni sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां महीपते ..
जातीपुष्पाणि देयानि सर्वेषामविशेषतः .. 3 ..
text_mt: To the deities established in fixed shrines, O protector of the earth, / jasmine blossoms should be given, to all without distinction.

sanskrit_iast:
raktapadmāni sūryasya śvetapadmāni cendave ..
bandhūkāni ca bhaumāya budhāyendīvarāṇi ca .. 4 ..
meaning:
रक्तपद्मानि सूर्यस्य श्वेतपद्मानि चेन्दवे ..
बन्धूकानि च भौमाय बुधायेन्दीवराणि च .. 4 ..
text_mt: Red lotuses to the Sun, and white lotuses to the Moon; / bandhūka blossoms to Mars, and blue waterlilies to Mercury;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvāya yūthikā pītā sitāya ca tathā sitā ..
bāṇapuṣpāṇi saurāya rāhave pāṭalāni ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
जीवाय यूथिका पीता सिताय च तथा सिता ..
बाणपुष्पाणि सौराय राहवे पाटलानि च .. 5 ..
text_mt: yellow jasmine to Jupiter, and white likewise to Venus; / bāṇa flowers to Saturn, and trumpet flowers to Rāhu;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā damanakaṃ deyaṃ ketave vasudhādhipa ..
kṛttikāsu ca deyāni rājanraktotpalāni ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
तथा दमनकं देयं केतवे वसुधाधिप ..
कृत्तिकासु च देयानि राजन्रक्तोत्पलानि च .. 6 ..
text_mt: likewise, damanaka should be given to Ketu, O ruler of the earth; / and red waterlilies should be given for the Kṛttikās, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
campakāni ca rohiṇyā ilvilāyāḥ sitotpalam ..
dhattūrakāṇyathārdrāyā ādityasya ca mallikā .. 7 ..
meaning:
चम्पकानि च रोहिण्या इल्विलायाः सितोत्पलम् ..
धत्तूरकाण्यथार्द्राया आदित्यस्य च मल्लिका .. 7 ..
text_mt: campaka flowers to Rohiṇī, white waterlily to Ilvilā; / dhattūra blossoms to Ārdrā, and Arabian jasmine to [the mansion of] the Sun;

sanskrit_iast:
campakānyeva puṣyasya jātī syātsārpapitryayoḥ ..
bhāgyasya kāntā dātavyā aryamṇaśca suvarcalā ..8 ..
meaning:
चम्पकान्येव पुष्यस्य जाती स्यात्सार्पपित्र्ययोः ..
भाग्यस्य कान्ता दातव्या अर्यम्णश्च सुवर्चला ..8 ..
text_mt: campakas to Puṣya, and jasmine for [the mansions of] the Serpents and the Ancestors; / kāntā should be given to [that of] Bhaga, and suvarcalā to [that of] Aryaman;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitratvāṣṭrayornityaṃ bandhūkakusumāni ca ..
vāyavyasya ca deyāni sindhuvārāṇi pārthiva .. 9 ..
meaning:
सावित्रत्वाष्ट्रयोर्नित्यं बन्धूककुसुमानि च ..
वायव्यस्य च देयानि सिन्धुवाराणि पार्थिव .. 9 ..
text_mt: and bandhūka blossoms always to [the mansions of] Savitṛ and Tvaṣṭṛ; / and chaste-tree blossoms should be given to [that of] Vāyu, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
aindrāgnyasya ca deyāni kuraṇḍakusumāni ca ..
raktāśokasya puṣpāṇi tathā maitrasya pārthiva .. 1.97.10 ..
meaning:
ऐन्द्राग्न्यस्य च देयानि कुरण्डकुसुमानि च ..
रक्ताशोकस्य पुष्पाणि तथा मैत्रस्य पार्थिव .. 1.97.10 ..
text_mt: kuraṇḍa blossoms should be given to [the mansion of] Indra and Agni; / and red aśoka flowers likewise to [that of] Mitra, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
campakāni ca śākrasya tathā deyāni bhūpate ..
mūlasya ca tathā deyaṃ rājankṛṣṇakuheṭakam ..11..
meaning:
चम्पकानि च शाक्रस्य तथा देयानि भूपते ..
मूलस्य च तथा देयं राजन्कृष्णकुहेटकम् ..11..
text_mt: and campaka flowers should likewise be given to [the mansion of] Śakra, O lord of the earth; / and black kuheṭaka should be offered, O king, to Mūla;

sanskrit_iast:
kahlārāṇi tathāpyasya vaiśvadevasya kubjakam..
brāhmasya jātīpuṣpāṇi vaiṣṇavasya ca campakam .. 12 ..
meaning:
कह्लाराणि तथाप्यस्य वैश्वदेवस्य कुब्जकम्..
ब्राह्मस्य जातीपुष्पाणि वैष्णवस्य च चम्पकम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: white waterlilies to [the mansion of] the Waters, and dwarf rose to [that of] the All-gods; / jasmine blossoms to [that of] Brahmā, and campaka to [that of] Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭalā vāsavasyāpi vāruṇasyotpalāni tu ..
arkapuṣpāṇyathāpyasya tathā deyāni pārthiva .. 13 ..
meaning:
पाटला वासवस्यापि वारुणस्योत्पलानि तु ..
अर्कपुष्पाण्यथाप्यस्य तथा देयानि पार्थिव .. 13 ..
text_mt: trumpet flowers to [the mansion of] the Vasus, and blue lotuses to [that of] Varuṇa; / and swallow-wort blossoms should likewise be given to [the mansion of] the Sun, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
āhirbudhnyasya deyāni dhattūrakusumāni ca ..
karavīrakapuṣpāṇi tathā pauṣṇasya pārthiva .. 14 ..
meaning:
आहिर्बुध्न्यस्य देयानि धत्तूरकुसुमानि च ..
करवीरकपुष्पाणि तथा पौष्णस्य पार्थिव .. 14 ..
text_mt: dhattūra flowers should be given to [the mansion of] Ahirbudhnya; / and oleander blossoms likewise to [that of] Pūṣan, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
cūtapuṣpāṇi deyāni āśvinasya narādhipa ..
nīlotpalāni yāmyasya tathā deyāni bhūpate .. 15 ..
meaning:
चूतपुष्पाणि देयानि आश्विनस्य नराधिप ..
नीलोत्पलानि याम्यस्य तथा देयानि भूपते .. 15 ..
text_mt: mango blossoms should be given to [the mansion of] the Aśvins, O ruler of men; / blue waterlilies should be offered to [that of] Yama, O lord of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
samānaveśanakṣatrakathitāni tathā diśām ..
uttarāyāśca deyāni nāgapuṣpāṇi pārthiva .. 16 ..
meaning:
समानवेशनक्षत्रकथितानि तथा दिशाम् ..
उत्तरायाश्च देयानि नागपुष्पाणि पार्थिव .. 16 ..
text_mt: and for the directions, those prescribed for their shared lunar mansions [should be given]; / and nāgapuṣpa flowers should be given to the northern [direction], O king.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāṇāṃ ca deyāni kamalāni mahīpate ..
uktālābhe pradeyāni savarṇāni narādhipa ..
svakālajāni puṣpāṇi sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सागराणां च देयानि कमलानि महीपते ..
उक्तालाभे प्रदेयानि सवर्णानि नराधिप ..
स्वकालजानि पुष्पाणि सर्वेषामविशेषतः .. 17 ..
text_mt: And lotuses should be given to the oceans, O lord of the earth; / in the absence of what has been stated, flowers of matching color, / grown in their proper season, should be given to all without distinction, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti ..18..
meaning:
यद्यद्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ..
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ..18..
text_mt: Whatever has been declared by me here for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / precisely that should likewise be given to its presiding deity, and to the direction; herein there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate ..
gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां महीपते ..
गुग्गुलुं घृतसंयुक्तं धूपं दद्याद्विचक्षणः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the deities established in fixed shrines, O protector of the earth, / a wise man should offer guggulu mixed with clarified butter as incense.
title: adhyāyaḥ 98

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaṃ tvagururarkāya nameruṃ ca tathendave ..
bhaumāya gugguluṃ dadyātsarjaṃ dayādbudhāya ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
धूपं त्वगुरुरर्काय नमेरुं च तथेन्दवे ..
भौमाय गुग्गुलुं दद्यात्सर्जं दयाद्बुधाय च .. 2 ..
text_mt: Agallochum as incense to the Sun, and nameru incense likewise to the Moon; / one should give guggulu to Mars, and one should offer resin to Mercury;

sanskrit_iast:
śilājatu tu jīvāya dātavyaṃ pārthivottama ..
śrīvāsakaṃ tu śukrāya nakhaṃ saurāya pārthiva ..
madaśca rāhave deyaṃ ketave ca vasā tathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
शिलाजतु तु जीवाय दातव्यं पार्थिवोत्तम ..
श्रीवासकं तु शुक्राय नखं सौराय पार्थिव ..
मदश्च राहवे देयं केतवे च वसा तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: bitumen should be given to Jupiter, O best of kings; / pine resin to Venus, and sweet-scented nail-shaped incense to Saturn, O king; / musk should be given to Rāhu, and fat likewise to Ketu;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikānāṃ ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ rohiṇīnāṃ ca candanam ..
ilvalānāṃ ca karpūramārdrāyāṃ ca nakhaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
कृत्तिकानां घृतं देयं रोहिणीनां च चन्दनम् ..
इल्वलानां च कर्पूरमार्द्रायां च नखं तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: clarified butter should be given to the Kṛttikās, and sandalwood to the Rohiṇīs; / camphor to the Ilvalās, and sweet-scented nail-shaped incense to Ārdrā;

sanskrit_iast:
punarvasoścāpyaguruṃ puṣyasya ca tathākṣatam ..
śrīvāsakaṃ ca sārpasya paitrasya ca tathā ghṛtam ..5 ..
meaning:
पुनर्वसोश्चाप्यगुरुं पुष्यस्य च तथाक्षतम् ..
श्रीवासकं च सार्पस्य पैत्रस्य च तथा घृतम् ..5 ..
text_mt: and agallochum to Punarvasu, and unbroken grains likewise to Puṣya; / pine resin to [the mansion of] the Serpents, and clarified butter likewise to [that of] the Ancestors;

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṅguṃ madhunā yuktaṃ bhāgyasya saghṛtaṃ bhavet ..
ghṛtena madhunā yuktamāryamṇasya śatāvarīm .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रियङ्गुं मधुना युक्तं भाग्यस्य सघृतं भवेत् ..
घृतेन मधुना युक्तमार्यम्णस्य शतावरीम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: priyaṅgu combined with honey and clarified butter should belong to [the mansion of] Bhaga; / asparagus combined with clarified butter and honey to [that of] Aryaman;

sanskrit_iast:
kunduruṃ caiva hastāya tvāṣṭrāya ca palaṃ bhavet ..
vāyavyāya ca karpūramaindrāgnyāya misirbhavet .. 7 ..
meaning:
कुन्दुरुं चैव हस्ताय त्वाष्ट्राय च पलं भवेत् ..
वायव्याय च कर्पूरमैन्द्राग्न्याय मिसिर्भवेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: frankincense to Hasta, and bdellium gum should belong to [the mansion of] Tvaṣṭṛ; / camphor to [that of] Vāyu, and aniseed should belong to [that of] Indra and Agni;

sanskrit_iast:
maitrāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ śākrāya mṛgajaṃ bhavet ..
śāṭīmūlaṃ ca mūlāya āpyāya naladaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
meaning:
मैत्राय कुङ्कुमं देयं शाक्राय मृगजं भवेत् ..
शाटीमूलं च मूलाय आप्याय नलदं तथा .. 8 ..
text_mt: saffron should be given to [the mansion of] Mitra, and musk should belong to [that of] Śakra; / zedoary root to Mūla, and spikenard likewise to [that of] the Waters;

sanskrit_iast:
gugguluṃ vaiśvadevāya brāhmāya ghṛtacandane ..
vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ dadyādvāsavāya tathā palam .. 9 ..
meaning:
गुग्गुलुं वैश्वदेवाय ब्राह्माय घृतचन्दने ..
वैष्णवायागुरुं दद्याद्वासवाय तथा पलम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: guggulu to [the mansion of] the All-gods, and clarified butter and sandalwood to [that of] Brahmā; / one should give agallochum to [that of] Viṣṇu, and bdellium gum likewise to [that of] the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇāya tathośīramājāya ca palaṃ bhavet ..
ahirbudhnyāya dātavyaṃ devadāruṃ narādhipa .. 1.98.10 ..
meaning:
वारुणाय तथोशीरमाजाय च पलं भवेत् ..
अहिर्बुध्न्याय दातव्यं देवदारुं नराधिप .. 1.98.10 ..
text_mt: vetiver likewise to [the mansion of] Varuṇa, and bdellium gum should belong to [that of] Aja; / deodar should be given to Ahirbudhnya, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṅkolakāni pauṣṇāya āśvināya ca candanam ..
yamyāya guggulurdeyaḥ satataṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 11 ..
meaning:
कङ्कोलकानि पौष्णाय आश्विनाय च चन्दनम् ..
यम्याय गुग्गुलुर्देयः सततं भूतिमिच्छता .. 11 ..
text_mt: Cubebs should be given to Pauṣṇa, and sandalwood to Āśvina; / bdellium is constantly to be given to Yāmya by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ mṛgajaṃ tathā ..
turuṣkamaguruṃ kāntāṃ gugguluṃ ca kramāddiśām .. 12 ..
meaning:
कर्पूरं कुङ्कुमं चैव चन्दनं मृगजं तथा ..
तुरुष्कमगुरुं कान्तां गुग्गुलुं च क्रमाद्दिशाम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Camphor, saffron, sandalwood, musk, / olibanum, agallochum, priyaṅgu, and bdellium, respectively, for the directions,

sanskrit_iast:
prācyādīnāṃ mahīnātha sāgarāṇāṃ ca candanam ..
sarvābhāve ca dātavyāḥ sarveṣāmeva guggulum .. 13..
meaning:
प्राच्यादीनां महीनाथ सागराणां च चन्दनम् ..
सर्वाभावे च दातव्याः सर्वेषामेव गुग्गुलुम् .. 13..
text_mt: beginning with the east, O lord of the earth; and sandalwood for the oceans. / In the absence of all [these], bdellium alone must be given to all.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ ..
āghrāṇaḥ sarvadevānāṃ guggulupravaraḥ śubhaḥ ..14..
meaning:
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यो गन्ध उत्तमः ..
आघ्राणः सर्वदेवानां गुग्गुलुप्रवरः शुभः ..14..
text_mt: A divine sap of trees, rich in scent, an excellent fragrance, / an aroma for all the gods, auspicious bdellium is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaścājyena dātavyaḥ sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ ..
tailena vā mahīnātha vasāḍhyena vivarjayet ..15..
meaning:
दीपश्चाज्येन दातव्यः सर्वेषामविशेषतः ..
तैलेन वा महीनाथ वसाढ्येन विवर्जयेत् ..15..
text_mt: A lamp should be given with ghee to all without distinction, / or with oil, O lord of the earth; one must avoid one rich in fat.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayātra ṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna..
taddevatāyāśca tathaiva deyaṃ diśāṃ tathā nātra vicāramasti..16..
meaning:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयात्र ऋक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान..
तद्देवतायाश्च तथैव देयं दिशां तथा नात्र विचारमस्ति..16..
text_mt: Whatever has been stated by me here for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / should likewise be given to its deity, and similarly for the directions; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde graharkṣadhūpadīpo nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 98 .. ..
meaning: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे ग्रहर्क्षधूपदीपो नामाष्टनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 98 .. ..
text_mt: Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, named 'Incense and Lamps for the Planets and Asterisms', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the First Book of the illustrious Viṣṇudharmottara.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devatānāṃ narādhipa ..
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ vinivedayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवतानां नराधिप ..
दध्योदनं पायसं च प्रत्येकं विनिवेदयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the deities established in the fixed position, O lord of men, / one should offer curd-rice and milk-rice individually.
title: adhyāyaḥ 99

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpāḥ phalāni guḍapāyasam ..
nivedanaṃ tu sūryāya dhānyalāje madhūtkaṭe .. 2 ..
meaning:
गुडौदनं गुडापूपाः फलानि गुडपायसम् ..
निवेदनं तु सूर्याय धान्यलाजे मधूत्कटे .. 2 ..
text_mt: Jaggery-rice, jaggery-cakes, fruits, and jaggery-milk-rice, / and grain-parched-paddy abundant in honey, is the offering to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sarpirdadhyodanaṃ caiva phalāni vividhāni ca ..
modakāni ca mukhyāni pāyasaṃ śaśinastathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
सर्पिर्दध्योदनं चैव फलानि विविधानि च ..
मोदकानि च मुख्यानि पायसं शशिनस्तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt: Curd-rice with clarified butter, various kinds of fruits, / choice modakas, and milk-rice likewise for the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ guḍāpūpā yāvakaṃ guḍapāyasam ..
kṛsaraṃ ca tathā deyaṃ bhūmiputrāya pārthiva .. 4 ..
meaning:
गुडौदनं गुडापूपा यावकं गुडपायसम् ..
कृसरं च तथा देयं भूमिपुत्राय पार्थिव .. 4 ..
text_mt: Jaggery-rice, jaggery-cakes, barley porridge, jaggery-milk-rice, / and kṛsara should likewise be given to the Son of the Earth, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṣīravṛkṣaphalāni ca ..
kṣīriṇyaśca tathoṣadhyo somaputrāya dāpayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
क्षीरौदनं ससर्पिष्कं क्षीरवृक्षफलानि च ..
क्षीरिण्यश्च तथोषध्यो सोमपुत्राय दापयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Rice cooked in milk with clarified butter, fruits of milk-exuding trees, / and milk-yielding herbs one should cause to be given to the Son of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
śimbidhānyavikārāṇi bilvānyāmalakāni ca ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca jīvāya dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 6 ..
meaning:
शिम्बिधान्यविकाराणि बिल्वान्यामलकानि च ..
घृतौदनं च जीवाय दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता .. 6 ..
text_mt: Preparations of podded grains, bilva fruits and āmalaka fruits, / and rice cooked in clarified butter should be given to Jīva by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca madhunā sarpiṣā yutam.. .
utkārikaṃ modakāṃśca bhārgavāya nivedayet ... 7 ..
meaning:
दध्योदनं पायसं च मधुना सर्पिषा युतम्.. .
उत्कारिकं मोदकांश्च भार्गवाय निवेदयेत् ... 7 ..
text_mt: Curd-rice and milk-rice combined with honey and clarified butter, / sweet pancakes, and modakas one should offer to Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
māṣaudanaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ kṛsaraṃ dadhi yāvakam..
nivedayettu saurāya kulatthaṃ caṇakaiḥ saha..8..
meaning:
माषौदनं ससर्पिष्कं कृसरं दधि यावकम्..
निवेदयेत्तु सौराय कुलत्थं चणकैः सह..8..
text_mt: Urad-bean rice with clarified butter, kṛsara, curds, barley porridge, / and horse-gram with chickpeas one should offer to Saura.

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣaṃ dadhitthaṃ ca tathā palalaṃ caiva rāhave..
māṣaudanaṃ tathā deyaṃ yavāpūpāṃstathaiva ca..9..
meaning:
प्लक्षं दधित्थं च तथा पललं चैव राहवे..
माषौदनं तथा देयं यवापूपांस्तथैव च..9..
text_mt: Plakṣa, kapittha fruit, and also sesamum paste to Rāhu; / rice cooked with urad beans is likewise to be given, and barley-cakes as well.

sanskrit_iast:
tallopikāstathā matsyāḥ ketave kṛsaraṃ tathā ..
vasāsarpīṃṣi ca tathā deyāni manujeśvara .. 1.99.10 ..
meaning:
तल्लोपिकास्तथा मत्स्याः केतवे कृसरं तथा ..
वसासर्पींषि च तथा देयानि मनुजेश्वर .. 1.99.10 ..
text_mt: Sweet rolled pastries, fish, and also kṛsara to Ketu, / and fat and clarified butter are likewise to be given, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
madhulāje kṛttikānāṃ kulmāṣaṃ dadhisarpiṣī ..
rohiṇīnāṃ ca bījāni dadhipiṣṭavṛṣāṇi ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
मधुलाजे कृत्तिकानां कुल्माषं दधिसर्पिषी ..
रोहिणीनां च बीजानि दधिपिष्टवृषाणि च .. 11 ..
text_mt: Honeyed parched paddy for the Kṛttikās; sour barley mash, curds, and clarified butter, / and seeds, curds, and bulls made of flour for the Rohiṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodakaṃ celvalānāṃ mṛgamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca ..
rudhiraṃ kṛsaraṃ cobhau raudrasya vinivedayet .. 12 ..
meaning:
दध्योदकं चेल्वलानां मृगमांसं तथैव च ..
रुधिरं कृसरं चोभौ रौद्रस्य विनिवेदयेत् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Curd-water for the Ilvalas, and deer meat likewise; / both blood and kṛsara one should offer to Raudra.

sanskrit_iast:
punarvasoḥ pradātavyaṃ palalaṃ savilāyanam ..
pāyasaṃ ca sasarpiṣkaṃ tiṣyāya vinivedayet .. 13 ..
meaning:
पुनर्वसोः प्रदातव्यं पललं सविलायनम् ..
पायसं च ससर्पिष्कं तिष्याय विनिवेदयेत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Sesamum paste with melting oil is to be given to Punarvasu, / and milk-rice with clarified butter one should offer to Tiṣya.

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭasarpāṇi sārpasya kṣaudraṃ dadhiyutaṃ tathā ..
tilaudanaṃ sapalalaṃ paitryasya vinivedayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
पिष्टसर्पाणि सार्पस्य क्षौद्रं दधियुतं तथा ..
तिलौदनं सपललं पैत्र्यस्य विनिवेदयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Flour serpents for Sārpa, and honey accompanied by curds; / sesamum-rice with sesamum paste one should offer to Paitrya.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ ca bhāgyasya madhusarpīṃṣi cāpyatha ..
āryamṇāya tilāpūpānṣaṣṭikānnaṃ tathaiva ca .. .. 15 ..
meaning:
षष्टिकान्नं च भाग्यस्य मधुसर्पींषि चाप्यथ ..
आर्यम्णाय तिलापूपान्षष्टिकान्नं तथैव च .. .. 15 ..
text_mt: Rice of sixty-day grain for Bhāgya, and honey and clarified butter as well; / sesamum-cakes and rice of sixty-day grain likewise for Āryamṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṃgutaṇḍulaiḥ siddhaṃ sāvitrāya ca pāyasam ..
tvāṣṭrasya caiva pīyūṣaṃ dvijā citrāṇḍajāstathā .. 16 ..
meaning:
प्रियंगुतण्डुलैः सिद्धं सावित्राय च पायसम् ..
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चैव पीयूषं द्विजा चित्राण्डजास्तथा .. 16 ..
text_mt: Milk-rice prepared with Italian millet grains for Sāvitra; / and biestings for Tvāṣṭra, twice-born [birds], and also multi-coloured egg-born creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyasya ca phalguni mūlakāni śubhāni ca ..
kulatthāni viśākhāsu yavāpūpāstathaiva ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
वायव्यस्य च फल्गुनि मूलकानि शुभानि च ..
कुलत्थानि विशाखासु यवापूपास्तथैव च .. 17 ..
text_mt: And auspicious radishes for the Phalgunī of Vāyu; / horse-gram and barley-cakes likewise for the Viśākhās.

sanskrit_iast:
kulatthabhaktaṃ mitrāya dadhikṣaudrānvitaṃ tathā ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ ca śākrāya phalāni vividhāni ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
कुलत्थभक्तं मित्राय दधिक्षौद्रान्वितं तथा ..
घृतौदनं च शाक्राय फलानि विविधानि च .. 18 ..
text_mt: Boiled horse-gram for Mitra, accompanied by curds and honey; / and rice cooked in clarified butter for Śākra, as well as various fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāni ca vicitrāṇi tathā mūlaphalāni ca ..
āpyasya saktavo deyā madhumiśrodakaiḥ saha .. 19 ..
meaning:
मूलानि च विचित्राणि तथा मूलफलानि च ..
आप्यस्य सक्तवो देया मधुमिश्रोदकैः सह .. 19 ..
text_mt: Various roots and edible root-fruits likewise; / barley meal with water mixed with honey is to be given to Āpya.

sanskrit_iast:
saktavo vaiśvadevāya madhulāje tathaiva ca ..
brāhmāya pāyasaṃ deyaṃ saguḍaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 1.99.20 ..
meaning:
सक्तवो वैश्वदेवाय मधुलाजे तथैव च ..
ब्राह्माय पायसं देयं सगुडं भूतिमिच्छता .. 1.99.20 ..
text_mt: Barley meal for Vaiśvadeva, and honeyed parched paddy likewise; / milk-rice with jaggery should be given to Brāhma by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca vaiṣṇavāya nivedayet ..
ghṛtodakaṃ ca śākāni vāsavāya nivedayet ..21..
meaning:
दध्योदनं पायसं च वैष्णवाय निवेदयेत् ..
घृतोदकं च शाकानि वासवाय निवेदयेत् ..21..
text_mt: Curd-rice and milk-rice one should offer to Vaiṣṇava; / clarified butter-water and leafy vegetables one should offer to Vāsava.

sanskrit_iast:
paiṣṭaṃ biḍālaṃ śākāṃśca vāruṇāya tathā dadhi ..
ādāya māṃsamājaṃ tu vyāghraṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ dadhi ..22..
meaning:
पैष्टं बिडालं शाकांश्च वारुणाय तथा दधि ..
आदाय मांसमाजं तु व्याघ्रं पिष्टकृतं दधि ..22..
text_mt: A flour cat, leafy vegetables, and curds for Vāruṇa; / having taken goat meat, a flour-made tiger, and curds,

sanskrit_iast:
āhirbudhnyāya māṃsāni tathaiva ca rasaudanam ..
pauṣṇāya saktavo māṣā māṣayuktāśca saktavaḥ ..23..
meaning:
आहिर्बुध्न्याय मांसानि तथैव च रसौदनम् ..
पौष्णाय सक्तवो माषा माषयुक्ताश्च सक्तवः ..23..
text_mt: meats, and likewise broth-rice, for Āhirbudhnya; / for Pauṣṇa, barley meal, urad beans, and barley meal mixed with urad beans.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaṃ piṣṭakṛtaṃ māṣānyāvakaṃ ca tathā dadhi ..
āśvinasyātha yāmyasya taṇḍulāni tilāni ca..24..
meaning:
अश्वं पिष्टकृतं माषान्यावकं च तथा दधि ..
आश्विनस्याथ याम्यस्य तण्डुलानि तिलानि च..24..
text_mt: A flour-made horse, urad beans, barley porridge, and curds / for Āśvina; and then husked grains and sesamum seeds for Yāmya.

sanskrit_iast:
rājanpaiṣṭāśca paśavo māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā..
pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ pūrvasyāṃ vinivedayet..25..
meaning:
राजन्पैष्टाश्च पशवो मांसं पक्वामकं तथा..
पायसं सघृतं क्षौद्रं पूर्वस्यां विनिवेदयेत्..25..
text_mt: Flour animals, O king, and cooked as well as raw meat, / milk-rice with clarified butter, and honey one should offer in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyyāṃ diśi rājendra kṛsaraṃ kṣīramiśritam..
dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca dātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ tailamiśritam.ā26.
nairṛtyāṃ ca pradātavyaṃ kṛsaraṃ matsyasaṃyutam.
kulmāṣāṃścaiva matsyāṃśca paścimasyāṃ nivedayet ..27..
meaning:
आग्नेय्यां दिशि राजेन्द्र कृसरं क्षीरमिश्रितम्..
दक्षिणस्यां च दातव्यं कृसरं तैलमिश्रितम्.आ26.
