text_mt: When one is slain, O auspicious one, [and] many thrive in happiness, / when that one is killed, there is neither major sin nor minor sin.

sanskrit_iast:
so'haṃ prajānimittaṃ tvāṃ vadhiṣyāmi vasundharām ..
ātmānaṃ prathayitvā tu dhārayiṣye prajāstvimāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
सोऽहं प्रजानिमित्तं त्वां वधिष्यामि वसुन्धराम् ..
आत्मानं प्रथयित्वा तु धारयिष्ये प्रजास्त्विमाः .. 28 ..
text_mt: So I, for the sake of the subjects, shall slay you, the earth! / And having expanded myself, I shall support these subjects,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtyupāyaṃ na cedāsāṃ prajānāṃ tvaṃ vidhāsyasi ..
vidhāsyasi yadā bhadre tadā tvaṃ sukhamāpsyasi .. 29 ..
meaning:
वृत्युपायं न चेदासां प्रजानां त्वं विधास्यसि ..
विधास्यसि यदा भद्रे तदा त्वं सुखमाप्स्यसि .. 29 ..
text_mt: if you do not arrange a means of livelihood for these subjects. / When you arrange it, O auspicious one, then you shall attain happiness.'

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyuvāca ..
prajānāṃ jīvanopāyaṃ vidhāsyāmi nareśvara ..
vidhatsva vatsaṃ dharmajña kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā .. 1.109.30 ..
meaning:
पृथिव्युवाच ..
प्रजानां जीवनोपायं विधास्यामि नरेश्वर ..
विधत्स्व वत्सं धर्मज्ञ क्षरेयं येन वत्सला .. 1.109.30 ..
text_mt: The earth said: / 'I shall provide the means of subsistence for the subjects, O lord of men. / Arrange a calf, O knower of dharma, by which I, full of affection, may yield milk.

sanskrit_iast:
samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra mama dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ..
yathā niṣyandamānaṃ vai kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvayet .. 31 ..
meaning:
समां च कुरु सर्वत्र मम धर्मभृतां वर ..
यथा निष्यन्दमानं वै क्षीरं सर्वत्र भावयेत् .. 31 ..
text_mt: And make my [surface] level everywhere, O best of the upholders of dharma, / so that the flowing milk may saturate everywhere.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
tata utsārayāmāsa śilājālāni sarvataḥ ..
puthurvainyo mahātejāstena śailā vivarddhitāḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
तत उत्सारयामास शिलाजालानि सर्वतः ..
पुथुर्वैन्यो महातेजास्तेन शैला विवर्द्धिताः .. 32 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then Pṛthu, son of Vena, of great splendour, cast away the heaps of stones on all sides; / by him the mountains were piled high.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca ..
kṛṣyādikaṃ ca sakalaṃ bhuvi karma pravartitam .. 33 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति राजेन्द्र ग्रामाश्च नगराणि च ..
कृष्यादिकं च सकलं भुवि कर्म प्रवर्तितम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: From that time forward, O king of kings, villages and cities, / and all agricultural activities on earth were inaugurated.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ sasyāni sā dugdhā pṛthunā pṛthivī kṣitā ..
vatsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ kṛtvā manuṃ vai dakṣiṇe kare .. 34 ..
meaning:
तस्याः सस्यानि सा दुग्धा पृथुना पृथिवी क्षिता ..
वत्सं स्वायंभुवं कृत्वा मनुं वै दक्षिणे करे .. 34 ..
text_mt: By Pṛthu, the ruler of the earth, that earth was milked for crops, / having made Svāyambhuva Manu the calf, [milked] with his right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu ṛṣibhirdugdhā cchandaḥpātre vasundharā ..
vatsaḥ somobhavatteṣāṃ dogdhā caiva bṛhaspatiḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु ऋषिभिर्दुग्धा च्छन्दःपात्रे वसुन्धरा ..
वत्सः सोमोभवत्तेषां दोग्धा चैव बृहस्पतिः .. 35 ..
text_mt: Then the earth was milked by the sages into a vessel of Vedic metres; / Soma became their calf, and Bṛhaspati was the milker.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjaṃ devagaṇairdugdhā rukmapātre vasundharā ..
vatsastu maghavānāsīddogdhā ca savitā tathā .. 36 ..
meaning:
ऊर्जं देवगणैर्दुग्धा रुक्मपात्रे वसुन्धरा ..
वत्सस्तु मघवानासीद्दोग्धा च सविता तथा .. 36 ..
text_mt: The earth was milked for vitality by the hosts of gods into a golden vessel; / Maghavan was the calf, and Savitṛ was the milker.

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāṃ ca pitṛbhirdugdhā raupyapātre vasundharā..
antakaścābhavaddogdhā vatso vaivasvato yamaḥ ..37..
meaning:
सुधां च पितृभिर्दुग्धा रौप्यपात्रे वसुन्धरा..
अन्तकश्चाभवद्दोग्धा वत्सो वैवस्वतो यमः ..37..
text_mt: And the earth was milked for nectar by the ancestors into a silver vessel; / Antaka was the milker, and Yama Vaivasvata was the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
payaścaivāyase pātre dugdhā daityairvasundharā ..
dogdhā gaganamūrdhā sā vatsaṃ kṛtvā virocanam ..38..
meaning:
पयश्चैवायसे पात्रे दुग्धा दैत्यैर्वसुन्धरा ..
दोग्धा गगनमूर्धा सा वत्सं कृत्वा विरोचनम् ..38..
text_mt: And the earth was milked for milk by the Daityas into an iron vessel; / Gaganamūrdhan was the milker, having made Virocana the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
alābupātre sarpaiśca viṣaṃ dugdhā dharā tathā ..
teṣāṃ ca vāsukirdogdhā vatsaścāsīcca takṣakaḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
अलाबुपात्रे सर्पैश्च विषं दुग्धा धरा तथा ..
तेषां च वासुकिर्दोग्धा वत्सश्चासीच्च तक्षकः .. 39 ..
text_mt: So too the earth was milked for poison by the serpents into a bottle-gourd vessel; / Vāsuki was their milker, and Takṣaka was the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
antardhānaṃ yadā yakṣe rāmapātre vasundharā ..
dugdhā rajatanābhena vatsaṃ kṛtvā dhaneśvaram..1.109.40..
meaning:
अन्तर्धानं यदा यक्षे रामपात्रे वसुन्धरा ..
दुग्धा रजतनाभेन वत्सं कृत्वा धनेश्वरम्..1.109.40..
text_mt: When the earth [was milked] for invisibility into a vessel of unbaked clay by the Yakṣas, / she was milked by Rajatanābha, having made the Lord of Wealth the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
kapāle rudhiraṃ dugdhā rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ ..
hetiḥ prahetiśca tathā dogdhā vatsastathā'bhavat.. ..41..
meaning:
कपाले रुधिरं दुग्धा राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमैः ..
हेतिः प्रहेतिश्च तथा दोग्धा वत्सस्तथाऽभवत्.. ..41..
text_mt: She was milked for blood into a skull by the Rākṣasas of terrible prowess; / Heti was the milker, and Praheti became the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhā gandhānpadmapātre gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ..
vatsaścitrarathasteṣāṃ dogdhā vasurucistathā..42..
meaning:
दुग्धा गन्धान्पद्मपात्रे गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः ..
वत्सश्चित्ररथस्तेषां दोग्धा वसुरुचिस्तथा..42..
text_mt: She was milked for fragrances into a lotus vessel by the hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases; / Citraratha was their calf, and Vasuruci was the milker.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhyaśca tathā śailairdugdhā pātre śilāmaye..
vatsastu himavānāsīddogdhā merurmahāgiriḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
ओषध्यश्च तथा शैलैर्दुग्धा पात्रे शिलामये..
वत्सस्तु हिमवानासीद्दोग्धा मेरुर्महागिरिः .. 43 ..
text_mt: And herbs were milked by the mountains into a stone vessel; / Himavat was the calf, and Mount Meru was the milker.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśapātre vṛkṣaistu dugdhā puṣpaphalaṃ śubham ..
kāmadhukca tataḥ sālaṃ plakṣo vatsastu vai smṛtaḥ .. ..44..
meaning:
पलाशपात्रे वृक्षैस्तु दुग्धा पुष्पफलं शुभम् ..
कामधुक्च ततः सालं प्लक्षो वत्सस्तु वै स्मृतः .. ..44..
text_mt: She was milked by the trees for auspicious flowers and fruit into a palāśa vessel; / the wishing-cow was then the sāl tree, and the plakṣa tree is remembered as the calf.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmadughā dogdhrī pṛthivī bhūtabhāvinī ..
saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca jananī bhāvanī tathā ..45..
meaning:
सर्वकामदुघा दोग्ध्री पृथिवी भूतभाविनी ..
सैषा धात्री विधात्री च जननी भावनी तथा ..45..
text_mt: Yielding all desires, the earth is the milch-cow that nurtures beings; / she is the supporter, ordainer, mother, and creator,

sanskrit_iast:
carācarasya lokasya pratiṣṭhotpattireva ca ..
sarvabhūtahiraṇyā ca sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇī .. 46 ..
meaning:
चराचरस्य लोकस्य प्रतिष्ठोत्पत्तिरेव च ..
सर्वभूतहिरण्या च सर्वभूतहितैषिणी .. 46 ..
text_mt: the foundation and origin of the moving and unmoving world, / the gold of all beings, and well-wisher of all beings;

sanskrit_iast:
vargadā medinī bhūmiḥ kṣamā kṣoṇī vasundharā ..
sarvabhūtaśarīrasthā sarvānugrahakāriṇī .. 47 ..
meaning:
वर्गदा मेदिनी भूमिः क्षमा क्षोणी वसुन्धरा ..
सर्वभूतशरीरस्था सर्वानुग्रहकारिणी .. 47 ..
text_mt: bestower of the classes of life, the soil, the ground, forbearance, the wide domain, bearer of treasures, / abiding in the bodies of all beings, granting grace to all.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantare'sminsaṃprāpte vainyena pṛthivīkṣitā ..
prathamaṃ vasudhā dugdhā tato dugdhā yathoditaiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेऽस्मिन्संप्राप्ते वैन्येन पृथिवीक्षिता ..
प्रथमं वसुधा दुग्धा ततो दुग्धा यथोदितैः .. 48 ..
text_mt: When this Manu period arrived, by the son of Vena, the ruler of the earth, / the earth was milked first, and then milked by those described as aforesaid.

sanskrit_iast:
duhitṛtvaṃ gatā tasya pṛthivī tena cocyate ..
evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa purā pṛthurāsīnmahīpatiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
दुहितृत्वं गता तस्य पृथिवी तेन चोच्यते ..
एवंप्रभावः स पुरा पृथुरासीन्महीपतिः .. 49 ..
text_mt: She attained daughterhood to him, and because of him she is called Pṛthivī. / Such was the power of King Pṛthu in ancient times.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā'parañjitāstasya prajāssenānurāñjanāḥ ..
prajānāṃ rañjanāttasya nāma rājeti kīrtitam .. 1.109.50 ..
meaning:
पित्राऽपरञ्जितास्तस्य प्रजास्सेनानुराञ्जनाः ..
प्रजानां रञ्जनात्तस्य नाम राजेति कीर्तितम् .. 1.109.50 ..
text_mt: His subjects, alienated by his father, were delighted by him; / and because of delighting his subjects, he was celebrated with the title 'rājā'.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā bhojo virāṭ samrāṭ gopatiḥ pārthivastathā ..
sa evokto mahīnātha śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
राजा भोजो विराट् सम्राट् गोपतिः पार्थिवस्तथा ..
स एवोक्तो महीनाथ शब्दैः पर्यायवाचकैः .. 51 ..
text_mt: Rājā, bhoja, virāṭ, samrāṭ, gopati, and pārthiva— / he alone, O lord of the earth, is addressed by these synonymous terms.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskārastu kartavyastasya nityaṃ dvijottamaiḥ ..
vedakāmairvedavidbhiḥ prārthayadbhirmahadyaśaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
नमस्कारस्तु कर्तव्यस्तस्य नित्यं द्विजोत्तमैः ..
वेदकामैर्वेदविद्भिः प्रार्थयद्भिर्महद्यशः .. 52 ..
text_mt: Homage should always be paid to him by the foremost twice-born / who desire the Vedas, know the Vedas, and seek great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
pārthivaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ prārthayadbhirmahadyaśaḥ ..
vṛttidātā tathā vaiśyairnamaskāryastathā pṛthuḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
पार्थिवैश्च महाभागैः प्रार्थयद्भिर्महद्यशः ..
वृत्तिदाता तथा वैश्यैर्नमस्कार्यस्तथा पृथुः .. 53 ..
text_mt: And by fortunate kings seeking great renown, / and by vaiśyas, Pṛthu, the giver of livelihood, should be venerated;

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrairapi namaskāryo dharmakāmairmahīpatiḥ ..
kṣemepsubhistathā dhyāne namaskāryaḥ pṛthurnṛpaḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
शूद्रैरपि नमस्कार्यो धर्मकामैर्महीपतिः ..
क्षेमेप्सुभिस्तथा ध्याने नमस्कार्यः पृथुर्नृपः .. 54 ..
text_mt: and by śūdras desiring dharma, the king should be venerated; / by those desiring safety, King Pṛthu should be venerated in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hi yodho raṇe yāti kīrtayitvā pṛthuṃ nṛpam ..
sa ghorarūpātsaṃgrāmātkṣemī bhavati pārthiva .. 55 ..
meaning:
यो हि योधो रणे याति कीर्तयित्वा पृथुं नृपम् ..
स घोररूपात्संग्रामात्क्षेमी भवति पार्थिव .. 55 ..
text_mt: Indeed, whatever warrior marches into battle having invoked King Pṛthu, / he returns safe from terrible combat, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthoḥ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ sarvatra vijayī bhavet ..
tasmāttasya namaskāraḥ sadā kāryo jayepsunā .. 56 ..
meaning:
पृथोः कृत्वा नमस्कारं सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् ..
तस्मात्तस्य नमस्कारः सदा कार्यो जयेप्सुना .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having paid homage to Pṛthu, one will be victorious everywhere; / therefore, homage must always be paid to him by one who desires victory.

sanskrit_iast:
vainyasya bhūpālavarasya rājañchrutvābhiṣekaṃ prayato manuṣyaḥ ..
pāpaṃ samagraṃ vijahāti śīghraṃ jayaṃ tathāpnoti yaśaśca loke .. 57..
meaning:
वैन्यस्य भूपालवरस्य राजञ्छ्रुत्वाभिषेकं प्रयतो मनुष्यः ..
पापं समग्रं विजहाति शीघ्रं जयं तथाप्नोति यशश्च लोके .. 57..
text_mt: A human being who, restrained, hears the coronation of the son of Vena, the foremost of kings, O king, / quickly abandons all sin and obtains victory and fame in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
antardhānaḥ pṛthoḥ putro havirdhānastadātmajaḥ ..
prācīnabarhistatputraḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अन्तर्धानः पृथोः पुत्रो हविर्धानस्तदात्मजः ..
प्राचीनबर्हिस्तत्पुत्रः पृथिव्यामेकराड् बभौ .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Antardhāna was the son of Pṛthu; Havirdhāna was his son; / his son was Prācīnabarhis, who shone as sole sovereign over the earth.
title: Dakṣavaṃśavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
upayeme samudrasya lavaṇasya sa vai sutām..
suvarṇāyāṃ tu sāmudryāṃ daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
उपयेमे समुद्रस्य लवणस्य स वै सुताम्..
सुवर्णायां तु सामुद्र्यां दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः .. 2 ..
text_mt: He indeed married the daughter of the salt ocean; / and in Suvarṇā, born of the ocean, ten sons of Prācīnabarhis [were born],

sanskrit_iast:
sarve prācetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragāḥ ..
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste'tapyanta mahattapaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
सर्वे प्राचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः ..
अपृथग्धर्मचरणास्तेऽतप्यन्त महत्तपः .. 3 ..
text_mt: all named the Pracetases, masters of the science of archery; / practicing dharma together, they performed severe austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ ..
samudrageṣu daśasu tapasyatsu mahīruhāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः ..
समुद्रगेषु दशसु तपस्यत्सु महीरुहाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Lying in the waters of the ocean for ten thousand years, / while the ten were dwelling in the ocean performing austerities, trees

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣamāṇāṃ gāṃ vavrurbabhūvetthaṃ prajākṣayaḥ ..
na śakyo māruto vātuṃ vṛttaṃ khamabhavaddrumaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
अरक्षमाणां गां वव्रुर्बभूवेत्थं प्रजाक्षयः ..
न शक्यो मारुतो वातुं वृत्तं खमभवद्द्रुमैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: covered the unprotected earth; thus destruction of creatures occurred: / the wind could not blow, and the sky was enveloped by trees.

sanskrit_iast:
tadupaśrutya rājānaḥ sarve yuktāḥ pracetasaḥ ..
mukhebhyo vāyumagniṃ ca sasṛjurjātamanyavaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तदुपश्रुत्य राजानः सर्वे युक्ताः प्रचेतसः ..
मुखेभ्यो वायुमग्निं च ससृजुर्जातमन्यवः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having heard of that, all those kings, the Pracetases, assembled; / filled with rage, they released wind and fire from their mouths.

sanskrit_iast: nirmūlānatha vṛkṣāṃstānkṛtvā vāyuraśoṣayat ..7..
meaning: निर्मूलानथ वृक्षांस्तान्कृत्वा वायुरशोषयत् ..7..
text_mt: Then, uprooting those trees, the wind dried them up;

sanskrit_iast:
tānagniradahatkruddha evamāsīdrumakṣayaḥ ..
drumakṣayamatho dṛṣṭvā kiñciddagdheṣu śākhiṣu ..
upagamyābravīdetānsomo rājā pracetasaḥ .. 8...
meaning:
तानग्निरदहत्क्रुद्ध एवमासीद्रुमक्षयः ..
द्रुमक्षयमथो दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिद्दग्धेषु शाखिषु ..
उपगम्याब्रवीदेतान्सोमो राजा प्रचेतसः .. 8...
text_mt: enraged, the fire burned them; thus occurred the destruction of the trees. / Then, seeing the destruction of the trees when the branches were partially burned, / King Soma approached and spoke to these Pracetases:

sanskrit_iast:
kopaṃ tyajata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ ..
kṛtā mahī vṛkṣaśūnyā śāmyetāmagnimārutau .. 9 ..
meaning:
कोपं त्यजत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः ..
कृता मही वृक्षशून्या शाम्येतामग्निमारुतौ .. 9 ..
text_mt: “Abandon your anger, O kings, all you sons of Prācīnabarhis! / The earth has been stripped of trees; let the fire and wind be pacified!

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhūtā ca kanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavaṇiṃnī ..
bhaviṣyaṃ jānatā hyeṣā dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā .. 1.110.10 ..
meaning:
रत्नभूता च कन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवणिंनी ..
भविष्यं जानता ह्येषा धृता गर्भेण वै मया .. 1.110.10 ..
text_mt: And this jewel of a maiden, fair-complexioned, belongs to the trees; / knowing what was to come, she was indeed held in the womb by me.

sanskrit_iast:
māriṣā nāma bhavatāṃ patnyarthe pradadāmyaham ..
tataḥ somasya vacanājjagṛhuste pracetasaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
मारिषा नाम भवतां पत्न्यर्थे प्रददाम्यहम् ..
ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगृहुस्ते प्रचेतसः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Named Māriṣā, I give her to you to be your wife.” / Then, at the word of Soma, those Pracetases accepted her.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhṛtya kopaṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ patnīdharmeṇa māriṣām ..
manasā ca dadhustasyāṃ garbhaṃ sarve pracetasaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
संहृत्य कोपं वृक्षेभ्यः पत्नीधर्मेण मारिषाम् ..
मनसा च दधुस्तस्यां गर्भं सर्वे प्रचेतसः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Having restrained their anger toward the trees, [they accepted] Māriṣā according to the law of marriage; / and all the Pracetases mentally placed an embryo in her.

sanskrit_iast:
daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ ..
bhavaśāpena saṃbhūto bhūyo dakṣaprajāpatiḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
दशभ्यस्तु प्रचेतोभ्यो मारिषायां प्रजापतिः ..
भवशापेन संभूतो भूयो दक्षप्रजापतिः .. 13 ..
text_mt: From the ten Pracetases, through the curse of Bhava, Prajāpati Dakṣa / was born again as Prajāpati in Māriṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
asṛjanmanasā dakṣaḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṃ caturvidhāḥ ..
notpadyante ca tāstasya apadhyātā hareṇa tu.. 14 ..
meaning:
असृजन्मनसा दक्षः प्रजाः पूर्वं चतुर्विधाः ..
नोत्पद्यन्ते च तास्तस्य अपध्याता हरेण तु.. 14 ..
text_mt: Previously, Dakṣa had created the fourfold creatures by mind, / but they did not propagate, because they were ill-willed toward Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
maithunena tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kartumicchanprajāpatiḥ ..
asiknīmavahadbhāryāṃ vīraṇasya prajāpate. .. 15 ..
meaning:
मैथुनेन ततः सृष्टिं कर्तुमिच्छन्प्रजापतिः ..
असिक्नीमवहद्भार्यां वीरणस्य प्रजापते. .. 15 ..
text_mt: Then Prajāpati, desiring to produce creation through sexual union, / took Asiknī as his wife, the daughter of Prajāpati Vīraṇa—

sanskrit_iast:
sutāṃ sumahatīṃ yuktāṃ tapasā lokadhāriṇīm ..
tasya putrasahasraṃ tu vīriṇyāṃ samapadyata .. 16 ..
meaning:
सुतां सुमहतीं युक्तां तपसा लोकधारिणीम् ..
तस्य पुत्रसहस्रं तु वीरिण्यां समपद्यत .. 16 ..
text_mt: a very great daughter, endowed with austerity, sustainer of the worlds. / A thousand sons were born to him in Vīriṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā mahātejā vivardhayiṣavaḥ prajāḥ .
tānuvāca mahātejā brahmaputraḥ sa nāradaḥ..17..
meaning:
तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा महातेजा विवर्धयिषवः प्रजाः .
तानुवाच महातेजा ब्रह्मपुत्रः स नारदः..17..
text_mt:
Seeing them eager to multiply creatures,
that son of Brahmā, Nārada, of great splendour, spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ pramāṇaṃ tu medinyāṃ sraṣṭavyasya tathaiva ca..
ajñānāttu kathaṃ sargaṃ bhavantaḥ kartumudyatāḥ..18..
meaning:
किं प्रमाणं तु मेदिन्यां स्रष्टव्यस्य तथैव च..
अज्ञानात्तु कथं सर्गं भवन्तः कर्तुमुद्यताः..18..
text_mt:
"What is the measure of the earth, and likewise of what is to be created?
Out of ignorance, how are you prepared to undertake creation?"

sanskrit_iast:
mahīmānamathānveṣṭuṃ gatā dakṣasutāstataḥ ..
lokālokasya parato garbhodasya tathopari ..19..
meaning:
महीमानमथान्वेष्टुं गता दक्षसुतास्ततः ..
लोकालोकस्य परतो गर्भोदस्य तथोपरि ..19..
text_mt:
Then the sons of Dakṣa went to seek the measure of the earth,
beyond Lokāloka and above the waters of the womb [of the universe].

sanskrit_iast:
vāyumaṇḍalamāsādya bhramaṇānnāśamāgatāḥ ..
dakṣo'pi teṣu naṣṭeṣu vīriṇyāmeva dharmavit .. 1.110.20 ..
meaning:
वायुमण्डलमासाद्य भ्रमणान्नाशमागताः ..
दक्षोऽपि तेषु नष्टेषु वीरिण्यामेव धर्मवित् .. 1.110.20 ..
text_mt:
Reaching the realm of wind, they came to destruction by wandering.
When they were lost, Dakṣa, knower of dharma, upon Vīriṇī herself

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ janayāmāsa putrāṇāmaparaṃ tataḥ ..
vivardhayiṣavaste tu śabalāśvāḥ punaḥ prajāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
सहस्रं जनयामास पुत्राणामपरं ततः ..
विवर्धयिषवस्ते तु शबलाश्वाः पुनः प्रजाः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
then begot another thousand sons.
They, the Śabalāśvas, also wishing to multiply creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamuktaṃ vacastadvai śrāvatā nāradena tu ..
anyonyamūcuste sarve samyagāha mahānṛṣiḥ ..22..
meaning:
पूर्वमुक्तं वचस्तद्वै श्रावता नारदेन तु ..
अन्योन्यमूचुस्ते सर्वे सम्यगाह महानृषिः ..22..
text_mt:
were told by Nārada those very words spoken before.
They all said to one another, "The great sage has spoken correctly.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṝṇāṃ padavīṃ caiva gantavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ..
gate'pi haryaśvamārgeṇa prayātāḥ pṛthivīmimām .. 23 ..
meaning:
भ्रातॄणां पदवीं चैव गन्तव्या नात्र संशयः..
गतेऽपि हर्यश्वमार्गेण प्रयाताः पृथिवीमिमाम् .. 23 ..
text_mt:
The path of our brothers must indeed be traversed; there is no doubt of this."
Though [they] had gone, following the track of the Haryaśvas, they set out over this earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tameva vāyumāsādya vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīssamāḥ ..
tadāprabhṛti vai bhrāntā bhrāturanveṣaṇe ratāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
तमेव वायुमासाद्य विनष्टाः शाश्वतीस्समाः ..
तदाप्रभृति वै भ्रान्ता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे रताः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
Reaching that very wind, they were destroyed for all time.
From then on, wandering about, intent upon searching for their brother,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāto naśyati vibho tannaḥ kāryaṃ vijānatā ..
atha teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu dakṣaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ ..25..
meaning:
प्रयातो नश्यति विभो तन्नः कार्यं विजानता ..
अथ तेषु विनष्टेषु दक्षः कोपसमन्वितः ..25..
text_mt:
[whoever] departs is lost, O lord; therefore that is our duty, understanding it."
Then, when they were destroyed, Dakṣa was filled with wrath;

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa nāradaṃ kruddhaḥ tulyaṃ janma na cāpsyasi ..
dehaṃ tyaktvā saśāpena tena dakṣasya nāradaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
शशाप नारदं क्रुद्धः तुल्यं जन्म न चाप्स्यसि ..
देहं त्यक्त्वा सशापेन तेन दक्षस्य नारदः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
enraged, he cursed Nārada: "You shall not attain an equal birth!"
Leaving his body through that curse of Dakṣa, Nārada

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo munisuto jātaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ..
aśvamedhaṃ ca vitataṃ dakṣasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
भूयो मुनिसुतो जातः कश्यपस्य महात्मनः ..
अश्वमेधं च विततं दक्षस्याद्भुतकर्मणः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
was born again as a son of the sage, the great-souled Kaśyapa.
And the horse-sacrifice of Dakṣa of wondrous deeds, being extended,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhvaṃsayāmāsa haraḥ pūrvavaireṇa bhrāvitaḥ ..
dakṣo'pi śaptavānudraṃ śaptāste brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..28 ..
meaning:
विध्वंसयामास हरः पूर्ववैरेण भ्रावितः ..
दक्षोऽपि शप्तवानुद्रं शप्तास्ते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..28 ..
text_mt:
was destroyed by Hara, impelled by ancient enmity.
Dakṣa too cursed Rudra, and those foremost of brahmins were cursed:

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti yakṣyanti natvā sārdhaṃ divaukasaiḥ ..
janmāntare'pi vairāṇi vinaśyanti na pārthiva .. 29 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति यक्ष्यन्ति नत्वा सार्धं दिवौकसैः ..
जन्मान्तरेऽपि वैराणि विनश्यन्ति न पार्थिव .. 29 ..
text_mt:
"From this day forth, they shall sacrifice without you together with the dwellers of heaven."
Even in another birth, enmities do not perish, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvairaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācidapi kenacit ..
haryaśveṣvapi naṣṭeṣu mahātmasu purā tadā .. 1.110.30 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्वैरं न कर्तव्यं कदाचिदपि केनचित् ..
हर्यश्वेष्वपि नष्टेषु महात्मसु पुरा तदा .. 1.110.30 ..
text_mt:
Therefore enmity must never be made by anyone with anyone.
Long ago, when those great-souled Haryaśvas were lost,

sanskrit_iast:
asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa dakṣo duhitarastadā ..
ṣaṣṭiḥ kanyā rūpayuktāstapasā mahatā yutāḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
असिक्न्यां जनयामास दक्षो दुहितरस्तदा ..
षष्टिः कन्या रूपयुक्तास्तपसा महता युताः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
Dakṣa then begot daughters upon Asiknī:
sixty maidens endowed with beauty and endowed with great ascetic power.

sanskrit_iast:
dve dadau bāhuputrāya catasro'riṣṭanemine ..
dve prādātsa kṛśāśvāya daśa dharmāya cāpyatha .. 32 ..
meaning:
द्वे ददौ बाहुपुत्राय चतस्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने ..
द्वे प्रादात्स कृशाश्वाय दश धर्माय चाप्यथ .. 32 ..
text_mt:
He gave two to Bāhuputra, four to Ariṣṭanemi,
he gave two to Kṛśāśva, and then ten to Dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśa kaśyapāya cāṣṭāviṃśatimindave ..
pradadau bāhuputrāya suprabhāṃ bhāminīṃ tadā .. 33 ..
meaning:
चतुर्दश कश्यपाय चाष्टाविंशतिमिन्दवे ..
प्रददौ बाहुपुत्राय सुप्रभां भामिनीं तदा .. 33 ..
text_mt:
fourteen to Kaśyapa, and twenty-eight to the Moon.
He then gave to Bāhuputra Suprabhā and Bhāminī;

sanskrit_iast:
manoramāṃ bhānumatīṃ viśālāṃ bāhudāmatha ..
dakṣaḥ prādānmahābhāgaścatasro'riṣṭanemine..34..
meaning:
मनोरमां भानुमतीं विशालां बाहुदामथ ..
दक्षः प्रादान्महाभागश्चतस्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने..34..
text_mt:
then Manoramā, Bhānumatī, Viśālā, and Bāhudā—
the illustrious Dakṣa gave these four to Ariṣṭanemi.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛśāśvāya ca prādātsuprabhāṃ ca tathā jayām ..
arundhatīṃ vasuṃ jāmiṃ lambāṃ bhānumirāvatīm ..35..
meaning:
स कृशाश्वाय च प्रादात्सुप्रभां च तथा जयाम् ..
अरुन्धतीं वसुं जामिं लम्बां भानुमिरावतीम् ..35..
text_mt:
And to Kṛśāśva he gave Suprabhā and likewise Jayā.
Arundhatī, Vasu, Jāmi, Lambā, Bhānu, Irāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpāṃ ca muhūrtāṃ ca sādhyāṃ viśvāṃ tathaiva ca ..
dadau sa daśa dharmāya mahātmā lokaviśrutaḥ..36..
meaning:
संकल्पां च मुहूर्तां च साध्यां विश्वां तथैव च ..
ददौ स दश धर्माय महात्मा लोकविश्रुतः..36..
text_mt:
Saṃkalpā, Muhūrtā, Sādhyā, and likewise Viśvā—
the great-souled one, renowned in the world, gave these ten to Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
aditirditirdanuḥ kālā danāyuḥ siṃhikā muniḥ ..
kadrūḥ krodhā irā prādhā vinatā surabhiḥ khagā .. 37 ..
meaning:
अदितिर्दितिर्दनुः काला दनायुः सिंहिका मुनिः ..
कद्रूः क्रोधा इरा प्राधा विनता सुरभिः खगा .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kālā, Danāyu, Siṃhikā, Muni,
Kadrū, Krodhā, Irā, Prādhā, Vinatā, Surabhi, and Khagā—

sanskrit_iast:
caturddaśaitāḥ pradadau kaśyapāya prajāpatiḥ ..
nāmabhiḥ pūrva vikhyātāḥ kṛttikādyāstathaiva ca .. 38 ..
meaning:
चतुर्द्दशैताः प्रददौ कश्यपाय प्रजापतिः ..
नामभिः पूर्व विख्याताः कृत्तिकाद्यास्तथैव च .. 38 ..
text_mt:
the Prajāpati gave these fourteen to Kaśyapa.
And those known earlier by name, beginning with Kṛttikā,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau nakṣatrayoginya aṣṭāviṃśatimindave ..
devatāstvabhimāninyo nakṣatrāṇāṃ mahīpate .. 39 ..
meaning:
ददौ नक्षत्रयोगिन्य अष्टाविंशतिमिन्दवे ..
देवतास्त्वभिमानिन्यो नक्षत्राणां महीपते .. 39 ..
text_mt:
the twenty-eight associated with the constellations, he gave to the Moon—
the presiding deities of the constellations, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktaṃ tava dakṣavaṃśamṛkṣodbhavaṃ cāpyatha bhūmipāla ..
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vāsvāyata lohitākṣa ..1.110.40..
meaning:
एतावदुक्तं तव दक्षवंशमृक्षोद्भवं चाप्यथ भूमिपाल ..
अतः परं किं कथयामि तुभ्यं तन्मे वास्वायत लोहिताक्ष ..1.110.40..
text_mt:
Thus much has been told to you of the lineage of Dakṣa and the origin of the stars, O protector of the earth.
Beyond this, what shall I tell you? Say that to me, O red-eyed one whose eyes are wide as a lotus.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 dakṣavaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 110 .. ..
meaning: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0 सं0 दक्षवंशवर्णनं नाम दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 110 .. ..
text_mt: Thus ends the hundred and tenth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Lineage of Dakṣa," in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the First Book of the Śrīviṣṇudharmottara.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
mahādevena ṛṣayaḥ śaptāḥ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare ..
teṣāṃ vaivasvate prāpte saṃbhavaṃ mama kīrtaya .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच .. ..
महादेवेन ऋषयः शप्ताः स्वायंभुवेऽन्तरे ..
तेषां वैवस्वते प्राप्ते संभवं मम कीर्तय .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Vajra said:
The sages were cursed by Mahādeva in the Svāyambhuva interval.
Now that the Vaivasvata [interval] has arrived, recount to me their birth.
title: Bhṛguvaṃśānukīrtanam

sanskrit_iast:
dākṣāyaṇī ca tathā pra kīrtaya me vibho ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā vaṃśaṃ bhṛguvaṃśa vivardhana .. 2 ..
meaning:
दाक्षायणी च तथा प्र कीर्तय मे विभो ..
ऋषीणां च तथा वंशं भृगुवंश विवर्धन .. 2 ..
text_mt:
And likewise recount to me the daughters of Dakṣa, O lord,
and the lineage of the sages, O increaser of the lineage of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
manvantare'sminsaṃprāpte rājanvaivasvate purā ..
aśvamedhe tu vitate brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मन्वन्तरेऽस्मिन्संप्राप्ते राजन्वैवस्वते पुरा ..
अश्वमेधे तु वितते ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
When this Vaivasvata manvantara had arrived of old, O king,
at the horse-sacrifice being extended by Brahmā Parameṣṭhin,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasya śāpena tyaktvā dehānsvayaṃ tataḥ ..
ṛṣayastu samudbhūtā drute śukre prajepsayā .. 4 ..
meaning:
महादेवस्य शापेन त्यक्त्वा देहान्स्वयं ततः ..
ऋषयस्तु समुद्भूता द्रुते शुक्रे प्रजेप्सया .. 4 ..
text_mt:
having abandoned their bodies by the curse of Mahādeva, of their own accord then
the sages were born from the semen emitted out of a desire for offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ mātaro dṛṣṭvā devapatnīstathaiva ca ..
skannaṃ śukraṃ mahārāja brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
देवानां मातरो दृष्ट्वा देवपत्नीस्तथैव च ..
स्कन्नं शुक्रं महाराज ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः .. 5 ..
text_mt:
Beholding the mothers of the gods and likewise the wives of the gods,
the semen of Brahmā Parameṣṭhin fell, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjuhāva tato brahmā tato jāto hutāśanāt ..
tato jāto mahātejā bhṛguḥ sa tapasāṃ nidhiḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तज्जुहाव ततो ब्रह्मा ततो जातो हुताशनात् ..
ततो जातो महातेजा भृगुः स तपसां निधिः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Then Brahmā offered it as an oblation, and from the fire [the sage] was born.
From it was born the intensely splendid Bhṛgu, that repository of austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāresvaṃgirā jātassabhāryo'tristathaiva ca ..
marīcibhyo marīciśca tato jāto mahātapāḥ ..7..
meaning:
अङ्गारेस्वंगिरा जातस्सभार्योऽत्रिस्तथैव च ..
मरीचिभ्यो मरीचिश्च ततो जातो महातपाः ..7..
text_mt:
From the burning coals Aṅgiras was born, and likewise Atri with a wife;
and from the rays Marīci was born, a sage of great ascetic power.

sanskrit_iast:
vasumadhyātsamutpanno vasiṣṭhaśca mahātapāḥ ..
bhṛguḥ pulomnaśca sutāṃ divyāṃ bhāryāmavindata .. 8 ..
meaning:
वसुमध्यात्समुत्पन्नो वसिष्ठश्च महातपाः ..
भृगुः पुलोम्नश्च सुतां दिव्यां भार्यामविन्दत .. 8 ..
text_mt:
And from the midst of the wealth Vasiṣṭha was born, of great ascetic power.
Bhṛgu obtained as his divine wife the daughter of Puloman,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ tasya sutā jātā devā dvādaśa yājñikāḥ ..
bhuvano bhāvanaścaiva sujanyaḥ sujanastathā ..9..
meaning:
यस्यां तस्य सुता जाता देवा द्वादश याज्ञिकाः ..
भुवनो भावनश्चैव सुजन्यः सुजनस्तथा ..9..
text_mt:
in whom were born his twelve sons, gods entitled to sacrifices:
Bhuvana, Bhāvana, Sujanya, and Sujana,

sanskrit_iast:
kratuḥ suvaśca pūgaśca vyājaśca vyaśnujaśca ha ..
prasavaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣo dvādaśamastathā .. 1.111.10 ..
meaning:
क्रतुः सुवश्च पूगश्च व्याजश्च व्यश्नुजश्च ह ..
प्रसवश्चाव्ययश्चैव दक्षो द्वादशमस्तथा .. 1.111.10 ..
text_mt:
Kratu, Suva, Pūga, Vyāja, and Vyaśnuja,
Prasava, Avyaya, and Dakṣa as the twelfth.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete bhṛgavo nāma devā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
paulomyajanayadvipra devānāṃ tu kanīyasam .. 11 ..
meaning:
इत्येते भृगवो नाम देवा द्वादश कीर्तिताः ..
पौलोम्यजनयद्विप्र देवानां तु कनीयसम् .. 11 ..
text_mt:
Thus these twelve gods called the Bhṛgus are proclaimed.
Upon the daughter of Puloman he begot the youngest of the gods, O brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
cyavanaṃ tu mahābhāgamātmavantaṃ tathāpyasau ..
ātmavānātmajastvaurvo jamadagnistadātmajaḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
च्यवनं तु महाभागमात्मवन्तं तथाप्यसौ ..
आत्मवानात्मजस्त्वौर्वो जमदग्निस्तदात्मजः .. 12 ..
text_mt:
the illustrious Cyavana, self-controlled, and likewise he [begot] Ātmavant;
and Ātmavant's son was Aurva, and Jamadagni was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
aurvo gotrakarastasya bhārgavānāṃ mahātmanām ..
tatra gotrakarānvakṣye bhṛgordīptojasastvaham .. 13 ..
meaning:
और्वो गोत्रकरस्तस्य भार्गवानां महात्मनाम् ..
तत्र गोत्रकरान्वक्ष्ये भृगोर्दीप्तोजसस्त्वहम् .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Aurva was the founder of his clan among the great-souled Bhārgavas.
I shall declare the founders of the clans of Bhṛgu of radiant energy:

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva ātmavāṃstu tathaiva ca ..
aurvaśca jamadagniśca vātsyo daṃbhirnaḍāyanaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
भृगुश्च च्यवनश्चैव आत्मवांस्तु तथैव च ..
और्वश्च जमदग्निश्च वात्स्यो दंभिर्नडायनः .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Bhṛgu, Cyavana, and likewise Ātmavant,
Aurva, Jamadagni, Vātsya, Dambhi, Naḍāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgāyano vahetiśca peluścerānuśātikaḥ ..
śaunakāyanajīvantiḥ kauyodhaḥ pārṣatistathā .. 15 ..
meaning:
नागायनो वहेतिश्च पेलुश्चेरानुशातिकः ..
शौनकायनजीवन्तिः कौयोधः पार्षतिस्तथा .. 15 ..
text_mt:
Nāgāyana, Vaheti, Pelu, Erānuśātika,
Śaunakāyana, Jīvanti, Kauyodha, and Pārṣati,

sanskrit_iast:
vaihīnarirvirūpākṣo rohiṇyāyanireva ca ..
vaiśvānarirupārīrurvaśāvaṇirvṛkāsvakaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
वैहीनरिर्विरूपाक्षो रोहिण्यायनिरेव च ..
वैश्वानरिरुपारीरुर्वशावणिर्वृकास्वकः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Vaihīnari, Virūpākṣa, and Rohiṇyāyani,
Vaiśvānari, Upārīru, Vaśāvaṇi, Vṛkāsvaka,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuḥ paureyavālākitaulikenāntabhāginaḥ ..
mṛta bhāgeyamarkaṇḍajihitodīdhinastathā .. 17 ..
meaning:
विष्णुः पौरेयवालाकितौलिकेनान्तभागिनः ..
मृत भागेयमर्कण्डजिहितोदीधिनस्तथा .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Viṣṇu, Paureyavālāki, Taulikena, Antabhāgin,
Mṛtabhāgeya, Mārkaṇḍa, Jihita, Udīdhina,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍūmāṇḍavyamaṇḍūkasphenasāṅkṛtinastathā ..
sthālipiṇḍiḥ śilāpattiḥ śārkarākṣistathaiva ca ..18..
meaning:
मण्डूमाण्डव्यमण्डूकस्फेनसाङ्कृतिनस्तथा ..
स्थालिपिण्डिः शिलापत्तिः शार्कराक्षिस्तथैव च ..18..
text_mt:
Maṇḍūmāṇḍavya, Maṇḍūka, Sphena, Sāṅkṛti,
Sthālipiṇḍi, Śilāpatti, and Śārkarākṣi,

sanskrit_iast:
sṛkāyaṇo devamatiḥ ṣāṇḍharāyiḥ sigālavaḥ ..
sakṛtvaścātakiḥ kāyiryājño dārbhistrilāyaniḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सृकायणो देवमतिः षाण्ढरायिः सिगालवः ..
सकृत्वश्चातकिः कायिर्याज्ञो दार्भिस्त्रिलायनिः .. 19 ..
text_mt:
Sṛkāyaṇa, Devamati, Ṣāṇḍharāyi, Sigālava,
Sakṛtva, Cātaki, Kāyi, Yājña, Dārbhi, and Trilāyani.

sanskrit_iast:
gārgyāyaṇo hvāyanaśca ṛṣirgehāyana stathā ..
goṣṭhyāyano vāhyāyano vaiśampāyana eva ca .. 1.111.20 ..
meaning:
गार्ग्यायणो ह्वायनश्च ऋषिर्गेहायन स्तथा ..
गोष्ठ्यायनो वाह्यायनो वैशम्पायन एव च .. 1.111.20 ..
text_mt: Gārgyāyaṇa, Hvāyana, the sage Gehāyana, / Goṣṭhyāyana, Vāhyāyana, and also Vaiśampāyana;

sanskrit_iast:
vaikarṇeyiḥ śārṅgaravo yājñeyirbhrāṣṭakāyanaḥ ..
lalāṭirlakuṭiścaiva lākṣmyāyāḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
वैकर्णेयिः शार्ङ्गरवो याज्ञेयिर्भ्राष्टकायनः ..
ललाटिर्लकुटिश्चैव लाक्ष्म्यायाः परिमण्डलः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Vaikarṇeyi, Śārṅgarava, Yājñeyi, Bhrāṣṭakāyana, / Lalāṭi, Lakuṭi, Lākṣmyāyāḥ, [and] Parimaṇḍala;

sanskrit_iast:
ūlumbiḥ śailukiḥ koṣṭistathānyaḥ paippalāyaniḥ ..
satyāyanirmālayaniḥ koṭāliḥ kaucahastikaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
ऊलुम्बिः शैलुकिः कोष्टिस्तथान्यः पैप्पलायनिः ..
सत्यायनिर्मालयनिः कोटालिः कौचहस्तिकः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Ūlumbi, Śailuki, Koṣṭi, and another Paippalāyani, / Satyāyani, Mālayani, Koṭāli, [and] Kaucahastika;

sanskrit_iast:
śokriḥ śaukliḥ sa kaucākṣiḥ kausiścāndramasistathā ..
jaikahihmirjihvaśūnyavāpayaleḍhikavairiṇaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
शोक्रिः शौक्लिः स कौचाक्षिः कौसिश्चान्द्रमसिस्तथा ..
जैकहिह्मिर्जिह्वशून्यवापयलेढिकवैरिणः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Śokri, Śaukli, Kaucākṣi, Kausi, Cāndramasi, / Jaikahi, Hmirjihva, Śūnyavāpa, Yaleḍhika, [and] Vairiṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
śāradvatikare nityau loṣṭhākṣiścala vairiṇaḥ ..
nāgāyaniścānumatiḥ paurṇabhāgadhikāśikṛt .. 24 ..
meaning:
शारद्वतिकरे नित्यौ लोष्ठाक्षिश्चल वैरिणः ..
नागायनिश्चानुमतिः पौर्णभागधिकाशिकृत् .. 24 ..
text_mt: Śāradvati and Kari, the two constant ones, Loṣṭhākṣi, Cala, Vairiṇa, / Nāgāyani, Anumati, Paurṇabhāgadhi, [and] Kāśikṛt.

sanskrit_iast:
samākhyātāstathaiteṣāṃ pañca tu pravarā matāḥ ..
bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva ātmavānastathaiva ca ..25..
meaning:
समाख्यातास्तथैतेषां पञ्च तु प्रवरा मताः ..
भृगुश्च च्यवनश्चैव आत्मवानस्तथैव च ..25..
text_mt: These have been proclaimed, and their pravaras are held to be five: / Bhṛgu, Cyavana, and Ātmavān;

sanskrit_iast:
aurvaśca jamadagniśca pañcaite pravarā matāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
और्वश्च जमदग्निश्च पञ्चैते प्रवरा मताः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Aurva and Jamadagni—these five are considered their pravaras. / These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
vājyāvājyo na vaivāhyā jñeyāstripravarāstu te ..
bhṛguśca jamadagniśca tathaivorvaśca pārthiva .. 27 ..
meaning:
वाज्यावाज्यो न वैवाह्या ज्ञेयास्त्रिप्रवरास्तु ते ..
भृगुश्च जमदग्निश्च तथैवोर्वश्च पार्थिव .. 27 ..
text_mt: The Vājya and Avājya should be known as not to intermarry; they have three pravaras: / Bhṛgu, Jamadagni, and Aurva, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cānyānbhṛgūdvahān ..
jamadagnirvidaścaiva paulastyo vaijabhṛttathā .. 28 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु चान्यान्भृगूद्वहान् ..
जमदग्निर्विदश्चैव पौलस्त्यो वैजभृत्तथा .. 28 ..
text_mt: Beyond this I shall speak; hear of the other descendants of Bhṛgu: / Jamadagni, Vida, Paulastya, and Vaijabhṛt;

sanskrit_iast:
prācīnayogyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ krauñcāyanastathā..
ṛṣibhayaścājātaśca ekāyanavaṭāyanau .. 29 ..
meaning:
प्राचीनयोग्यो भगवानृषिः क्रौञ्चायनस्तथा..
ऋषिभयश्चाजातश्च एकायनवटायनौ .. 29 ..
text_mt: the venerable Prācīnayogya, the sage Krauñcāyana, / Ṛṣibhaya, Ajāta, Ekāyana, and Vaṭāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
ātreyo'bhimataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
bhṛguśca cyavanaścaiva hyātmavānastathaiva ca .. 1.111.30 ..
meaning:
आत्रेयोऽभिमतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः स्मृतः ..
भृगुश्च च्यवनश्चैव ह्यात्मवानस्तथैव च .. 1.111.30 ..
text_mt: Ātreya is approved, and their pravaras for all of them are recalled as: / Bhṛgu, Cyavana, and Ātmavān.

sanskrit_iast:
paramparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
ṛgvedīyā mārgapathe grāmāyaṇirathāyaniḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
परम्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
ऋग्वेदीया मार्गपथे ग्रामायणिरथायनिः .. 31 ..
text_mt: These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another. / Belonging to the Ṛgveda: Mārgapathe, Grāmāyaṇi, Rathāyani;

sanskrit_iast:
āpastambistathā tālvirnekaṭhiḥ kaṇṭhireva ca ..
ārṣṭiṣeṇo gārdabhiśca kārddamāyaṇireva ca ..32 ..
meaning:
आपस्तम्बिस्तथा ताल्विर्नेकठिः कण्ठिरेव च ..
आर्ष्टिषेणो गार्दभिश्च कार्द्दमायणिरेव च ..32 ..
text_mt: Āpastambi, Tālvi, Nekaṭhi, and Kaṇṭhi, / Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, Gārdabhi, and Kārddamāyaṇi;

sanskrit_iast:
aśvāyanirathānnāpi paṃcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 33.
meaning:
अश्वायनिरथान्नापि पंचार्षेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 33.
text_mt: Aśvāyani, and Annāpi. They are proclaimed to have five ancestral sages. / These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
yovirādho vītahavyo nāsāthaścaṇḍamo damaḥ ..
jīvaṃtyāyanimaudgaśca viliścaiva khalistathā .. 34 ..
meaning:
योविराधो वीतहव्यो नासाथश्चण्डमो दमः ..
जीवंत्यायनिमौद्गश्च विलिश्चैव खलिस्तथा .. 34 ..
text_mt: Yovirādha, Vītahavya, Nāsātha, Caṇḍama, Dama, / Jīvantyāyani, Maudga, Vili, and Khali;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvilirbhāgavittiśca kauśāmbeyirvṛkāścakiḥ ..
vāleyiḥ samadā geyirgaurakṣitirathaiva ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
भाविलिर्भागवित्तिश्च कौशाम्बेयिर्वृकाश्चकिः ..
वालेयिः समदा गेयिर्गौरक्षितिरथैव च .. 35 ..
text_mt: Bhāvili, Bhāgavitti, Kauśāmbeyi, Vṛkāścaki, / Vāleyi, Samadā, Geyi, and Gaurakṣiti;

sanskrit_iast:
gaurgajiśca savaṃśālastathā pauṣṇāyano muniḥ ..
romādaśca tathaiteṣāmārṣeyāḥ pravarā matāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
गौर्गजिश्च सवंशालस्तथा पौष्णायनो मुनिः ..
रोमादश्च तथैतेषामार्षेयाः प्रवरा मताः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Gaurgaji, Savaṃśāla, the sage Pauṣṇāyana, / and Romāda. The ancestral pravaras of these are held to be:

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguśca vītahavyaśca tathā caiva sadevasaḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..37..
meaning:
भृगुश्च वीतहव्यश्च तथा चैव सदेवसः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..37..
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Vītahavya, and Sadevasa. / These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
khālāyaniḥ śākaṭākhyo maitreyaḥ sātayastathā ..
droṇāyano naukmāyana āśiṣiśca pikāyaniḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
खालायनिः शाकटाख्यो मैत्रेयः सातयस्तथा ..
द्रोणायनो नौक्मायन आशिषिश्च पिकायनिः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Khālāyani, the one named Śākaṭa, Maitreya, and Sātaya, / Droṇāyana, Naukmāyana, Āśiṣi, and Pikāyani;

sanskrit_iast:
homajihvistathaiteṣāmārṣeyāḥ pravarā matāḥ ..
bhṛguścaivātha vadhnyaśvo divodāsastathaiva ca ..39..
meaning:
होमजिह्विस्तथैतेषामार्षेयाः प्रवरा मताः ..
भृगुश्चैवाथ वध्न्यश्वो दिवोदासस्तथैव च ..39..
text_mt: Homajihvi. The ancestral pravaras of these are held to be: / Bhṛgu, Vadhryaśva, and Divodāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
sakāyano yajñapacirmadhyagandhistathaiva ca .. 1.111.40 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
सकायनो यज्ञपचिर्मध्यगन्धिस्तथैव च .. 1.111.40 ..
text_mt: These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another. / Sakāyana, Yajñapaci, and Madhyagandhi;

sanskrit_iast:
pratyūhaśca tathā śraubhyakṣokṣirvaikādaśāyaniḥ ..
tathā gṛtsamado rājañśunakaśca mahānṛṣiḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यूहश्च तथा श्रौभ्यक्षोक्षिर्वैकादशायनिः ..
तथा गृत्समदो राजञ्शुनकश्च महानृषिः .. 41 ..
text_mt: Pratyūha, Śraubhyakṣa, Ukṣi, Vaikādaśāyani, / and Gṛtsamada, O king, and the great sage Śunaka.

sanskrit_iast:
pravarastu yathoktānāṃ dvyārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
bhṛgurgṛtsamadaścaiva dvāvetau parikīrtitau ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ ..42 ..
meaning:
प्रवरस्तु यथोक्तानां द्व्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
भृगुर्गृत्समदश्चैव द्वावेतौ परिकीर्तितौ ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या इत्येते परिकीर्तिताः ..42 ..
text_mt: The pravaras of those mentioned are proclaimed to have two ancestral sages: / Bhṛgu and Gṛtsamada—these two are proclaimed. / These are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tavoktā bhṛguvaṃśa jātā mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ ca nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ vijahāti jantuḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
एते तवोक्ता भृगुवंश जाता महानुभावा नृप गोत्रकाराः ..
येषां च नाम्नां परिकीर्तनेन पापं समग्रं विजहाति जन्तुः .. 43 ..
text_mt: These have been declared to you, O king, born in the lineage of Bhṛgu, majestic founders of gotras, / by the celebration of whose names a creature completely casts off evil.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
marīcitanayā rājansurūpā nāma viśrutā .. .
bhāryā hyaṅgiraso divyā yasyāḥ putrā daśa smṛtāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मरीचितनया राजन्सुरूपा नाम विश्रुता .. .
भार्या ह्यङ्गिरसो दिव्या यस्याः पुत्रा दश स्मृताः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The daughter of Marīci, O king, renowned by the name Surūpā, / was the divine wife of Aṅgiras, of whom ten sons are remembered:
title: Vaṃśānukīrtivarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā hyāyurmanurdakṣo madaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca ..
haviṣmāṃścāgaviṣṭhaśca ṛtaḥ satyaśca te daśa .. .. 2 ..
meaning:
आत्मा ह्यायुर्मनुर्दक्षो मदः प्राणस्तथैव च ..
हविष्मांश्चागविष्ठश्च ऋतः सत्यश्च ते दश .. .. 2 ..
text_mt: Ātmā, Āyus, Manu, Dakṣa, Mada, Prāṇa, / Haviṣmat, Gaviṣṭha, Ṛta, and Satya—those ten.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete'ṅgiraso nāma devā vai somapīthinaḥ ..
surūpā janayāmāsa ṛṣīnsarveśvarānimān .. 3 ..
meaning:
इत्येतेऽङ्गिरसो नाम देवा वै सोमपीथिनः ..
सुरूपा जनयामास ऋषीन्सर्वेश्वरानिमान् .. 3 ..
text_mt: These are the gods by the name of Aṅgirases, drinkers of soma. / Surūpā gave birth to these sages who are lords of all:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiṃ gautamaṃ ca saṃvartaṃ ca mahāṛṣim ..
ayasyaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca utathyamuśijaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिं गौतमं च संवर्तं च महाऋषिम् ..
अयस्यं वामदेवं च उतथ्यमुशिजं तथा .. 4 ..
text_mt: Bṛhaspati, Gautama, and the great sage Saṃvarta, / Ayasya, Vāmadeva, Utathya, and Uśij.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete ṛṣayaḥ sarve gotrakārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ gotrasamutpannāngotrakārānnibodha me .. 5 ..
meaning:
इत्येते ऋषयः सर्वे गोत्रकाराः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
तेषां गोत्रसमुत्पन्नान्गोत्रकारान्निबोध मे .. 5 ..
text_mt: All these sages are proclaimed as founders of gotras. / Learn from me the gotra founders who arose from their gotras:

sanskrit_iast:
utathyo gautamaścaiva tailajo'bhijitistathā ..
bauddhinaiṣiḥ salaugākṣiḥ kṣorojo ṭāṃkireva ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
उतथ्यो गौतमश्चैव तैलजोऽभिजितिस्तथा ..
बौद्धिनैषिः सलौगाक्षिः क्षोरोजो टांकिरेव च .. 6 ..
text_mt: Utathya, Gautama, Tailaja, Abhijiti, / Bauddhinaiṣi, Laugākṣi, Kṣoroja, and Ṭāṅki;

sanskrit_iast:
rāhohakiḥ sauṣuriśca kairatiḥ śārilaumakiḥ ..
pauṇyajirbhānubhāvaśca ṛṣiścaiva baḍobaḍaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
राहोहकिः सौषुरिश्च कैरतिः शारिलौमकिः ..
पौण्यजिर्भानुभावश्च ऋषिश्चैव बडोबडः .. 7 ..
text_mt: Rāhohaki, Sauṣuri, Kairati, Śārilaumaki, / Pauṇyaji, Bhānubhāva, and the sage Baḍobaḍa;

sanskrit_iast:
karāṭakaśca mācīyaḥ upabindurathaiṣiṇiḥ ..
rauhiṇyāyanijārgāliḥ kroṣṭā caivāruṇāyaniḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
कराटकश्च माचीयः उपबिन्दुरथैषिणिः ..
रौहिण्यायनिजार्गालिः क्रोष्टा चैवारुणायनिः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Karāṭaka, Mācīya, Upabindu, Eiṣiṇi, / Rauhiṇyāyani, Jārgāli, Kroṣṭā, and Aruṇāyani;

sanskrit_iast:
somo ḍāyanikāśekaḥ kauṭilyaḥ pārthivastathā ..
gehiṇyāyanirauvāyurmūlayovāṃśureva ca.......
tathā ca gulmayovāṃśu stambayoṣāṃśureva ca ..
kāvākṣiḥ puṣpadhaścaiva kṣīrakāraṇḍireva ca .. 1.112.10 ..
meaning:
सोमो डायनिकाशेकः कौटिल्यः पार्थिवस्तथा ..
गेहिण्यायनिरौवायुर्मूलयोवांशुरेव च.......
तथा च गुल्मयोवांशु स्तम्बयोषांशुरेव च ..
कावाक्षिः पुष्पधश्चैव क्षीरकारण्डिरेव च .. 1.112.10 ..
text_mt: Soma, Ḍāyanikāśeka, Kauṭilya, Pārthiva, / Gehiṇyāyani, Rauvāyu, Mūlayovāṃśu, / Gulmayovāṃśu, Stambayoṣāṃśu, / Kāvākṣi, Puṣpadha, and Kṣīrakāraṇḍi;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣapādiśca kareriśca pārikārīrireva ca ..
ityārṣeyāstu sarveṣāṃ pravarāḥ parikīrttitāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
क्षपादिश्च करेरिश्च पारिकारीरिरेव च ..
इत्यार्षेयास्तु सर्वेषां प्रवराः परिकीर्त्तिताः .. 11 ..
text_mt: Kṣapādi, Kareri, and Pārikārīri. / Thus are the ancestral pravaras proclaimed for all [of them]:

sanskrit_iast:
āṃgirāśca tathotathyo munirdīrghatapāstathā ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
आंगिराश्च तथोतथ्यो मुनिर्दीर्घतपास्तथा ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या इत्येते परिकीर्तिताः .. 12 ..
text_mt: Āṅgirasa, Utathya, and the sage Dīrghatapas. / These are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭājiṣṭa ayasyaśca kakṣīvāngotamastathā ..
ārṣeyāḥ pravarāścaiva teṣāṃ ca pravarāñśṛṇu .. 13 ..
meaning:
उष्टाजिष्ट अयस्यश्च कक्षीवान्गोतमस्तथा ..
आर्षेयाः प्रवराश्चैव तेषां च प्रवराञ्शृणु .. 13 ..
text_mt: Uṣṭājiṣṭa, Ayasya, Kakṣīvat, and Gautama / are the ancestral pravaras; hear the pravaras among them:

sanskrit_iast:
aṃgiraśca tatotaśca uṣājiśca mahānṛṣiḥ ..
saumastambhirvitambhiśca sālubhirvālubhistathā .. 14 ..
meaning:
अंगिरश्च ततोतश्च उषाजिश्च महानृषिः ..
सौमस्तम्भिर्वितम्भिश्च सालुभिर्वालुभिस्तथा .. 14 ..
text_mt: Aṅgiras, Tathota, and the great sage Uṣāji. / Saumastambhi, Vitambhi, Sālubhi, and Vālubhi;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāradvājiḥ saubuddhiśca meghī devamatistathā ..
ādryayāyaṇasāviṣṭyau hyagniveśaḥ śalāthaliḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
भारद्वाजिः सौबुद्धिश्च मेघी देवमतिस्तथा ..
आद्र्ययायणसाविष्ट्यौ ह्यग्निवेशः शलाथलिः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Bhāradvāji, Saubuddhi, Meghī, Devamati, / Ādryayāyaṇa, Sāviṣṭi, Agniveśa, Śalāthali;

sanskrit_iast:
vāliśeyaniśśaikeyi vārāhirvākalistathā ..
śāṭiśca ṛṣivarṇaśca prāvāhiścāśvalāyaniḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ.. 16 ..
meaning:
वालिशेयनिश्शैकेयि वाराहिर्वाकलिस्तथा ..
शाटिश्च ऋषिवर्णश्च प्रावाहिश्चाश्वलायनिः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः.. 16 ..
text_mt: Vāliśeyani, Śaikeyi, Vārāhi, Vākali, / Śāṭi, Ṛṣivarṇa, Prāvāhi, and Āśvalāyani. / These sages are proclaimed as not to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
kāvākiśca sabhākāyistathā cāṃśumatiḥ prabhuḥ ..
bhāvīkaiyūrinaibhulviḥ puṣpānveṣī tathaiva ca ..17..
meaning:
कावाकिश्च सभाकायिस्तथा चांशुमतिः प्रभुः ..
भावीकैयूरिनैभुल्विः पुष्पान्वेषी तथैव च ..17..
text_mt: Kāvāki, Sabhākāyi, and the lord Aṃśumat, / Bhāvī, Kaiyūri, Naibhūlvi, and Puṣpānveṣin;

sanskrit_iast:
bādhyo vicchindiśāṭīkiḥ khāragrīvistathaiva ca ..
devādyārirdevasthānirharikarṇiḥ sabhrāṅgikaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
बाध्यो विच्छिन्दिशाटीकिः खारग्रीविस्तथैव च ..
देवाद्यारिर्देवस्थानिर्हरिकर्णिः सभ्राङ्गिकः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Bādhya, Vicchindi, Śāṭīki, Khāragrīvi, / Devādyāri, Devasthāni, Harikarṇi, Sabhrāṅgika;

sanskrit_iast:
dhauvāyiḥ sābhimugriśca tathā gomadagandhikaḥ ..
mātsyakvāthaḥ sālaharo hyalo hārastathaiva ca .. 19 ..
meaning:
धौवायिः साभिमुग्रिश्च तथा गोमदगन्धिकः ..
मात्स्यक्वाथः सालहरो ह्यलो हारस्तथैव च .. 19 ..
text_mt: Dhauvāyi, Sābhimugri, Gomadagandhika, / Mātsyakvātha, Sālahara, and Alohāra.

sanskrit_iast:
gāgodayiḥ kautapatiḥ kaurukṣetristathaiva ca ..
tāṭākirjainyadroṇiśca jaivālāyanireva ca ..1.112.20..
meaning:
गागोदयिः कौतपतिः कौरुक्षेत्रिस्तथैव च ..
ताटाकिर्जैन्यद्रोणिश्च जैवालायनिरेव च ..1.112.20..
text_mt:
Gāgodayi, Kautapati, and Kaurukṣetri,
Tāṭāki, Jainyadroṇi, and Jaivālāyani,

sanskrit_iast:
āpastadharmojadṛṣṭiḥ kārṣṇapiṅgalireva ca ..
paulaścaiva mahātejāḥ śaṅkalāyanireva ca .. 21 ..
meaning:
आपस्तधर्मोजदृष्टिः कार्ष्णपिङ्गलिरेव च ..
पौलश्चैव महातेजाः शङ्कलायनिरेव च .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Āpastadharma, Ojadṛṣṭi, and Kārṣṇapiṅgali,
the highly splendid Paula, and Śaṅkalāyani—

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣeyo nāmataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaro nṛpa ..
aṅgirāḥ pravarasteṣāṃ dvitīyaśca bṛhaspatiḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
आर्षेयो नामतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरो नृप ..
अङ्गिराः प्रवरस्तेषां द्वितीयश्च बृहस्पतिः .. 22 ..
text_mt:
their ancestral pravara by name, O king, for all of them [is as follows]:
Aṅgiras is their [first] pravara, and the second is Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaśca bharadvājaḥ pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
तृतीयश्च भरद्वाजः प्रवराः परिकीर्तिताः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या इत्येते परिकीर्तिताः .. 23 ..
text_mt:
and the third is proclaimed to be Bharadvāja; these are proclaimed as the pravaras.
These are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇāyanāḥ kaupayavāstathā vātsyaparāyaṇāḥ ..
bhrāṣṭrakṛd bhrāṣṭravindī ca nendrālissayakāyanaḥ ..24..
meaning:
काणायनाः कौपयवास्तथा वात्स्यपरायणाः ..
भ्राष्ट्रकृद् भ्राष्ट्रविन्दी च नेन्द्रालिस्सयकायनः ..24..
text_mt:
The Kāṇāyanas, Kaupayavas, and Vātsyaparāyaṇas,
Bhrāṣṭrakṛt, Bhrāṣṭravindin, Nendrāli, Sayakāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
kroḍiḥ śākrī ca kārṣī ca tālakṛnmāthurāvatāḥ ..
lāpakṛdbhālavipreṣo markaṭaḥ pailukāyanaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
क्रोडिः शाक्री च कार्षी च तालकृन्माथुरावताः ..
लापकृद्भालविप्रेषो मर्कटः पैलुकायनः .. 25 ..
text_mt:
Kroḍi, Śākrī, Kārṣī, Tālakṛt, Māthurāvata,
Lāpakṛt, Bhālavipreṣa, Markaṭa, Pailukāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtsaṃśaśca tathā cākrī gargaḥ śyāmāyanistathā ..
vālaliḥ sāhariścaiva pañcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
मृत्संशश्च तथा चाक्री गर्गः श्यामायनिस्तथा ..
वाललिः साहरिश्चैव पञ्चार्षेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 26 ..
text_mt:
Mṛtsaṃśa, Cākrī, Garga, Śyāmāyani,
Vālali, and Sāhari are proclaimed to have five ancestral sages.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāstu mahātejā devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ ..
bharadvājastathā gargaścaityaśca bhagavānṛṣiḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिरास्तु महातेजा देवाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः ..
भरद्वाजस्तथा गर्गश्चैत्यश्च भगवानृषिः .. 27 ..
text_mt:
The highly splendid Aṅgiras, the teacher of the gods Bṛhaspati,
Bharadvāja, Garga, and the venerable sage Caitya—

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
kapītaraḥ svastitaro darbhaḥ śaktiḥ patañjaliḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
कपीतरः स्वस्तितरो दर्भः शक्तिः पतञ्जलिः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
these sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Kapītara, Svastitara, Darbha, Śakti, Patañjali,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyasī jalasandhiśca bindudaṇḍiḥ kuśītakiḥ ..
bhṛgustu rājakeśī ca śaumbāṭiḥ śāṃśibistathā .. 29 ..
meaning:
भूयसी जलसन्धिश्च बिन्दुदण्डिः कुशीतकिः ..
भृगुस्तु राजकेशी च शौम्बाटिः शांशिबिस्तथा .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Bhūyasī, Jalasandhi, Bindudaṇḍi, Kuśītaki,
Bhṛgu, Rājakeśin, Śaumbāṭi, Śāṃśibi,

sanskrit_iast:
śāliśca śakalaḥ kāṇvo muniḥ kerīrayistathā ..
kādyo vādhyāyaniścaiva sāvasyāyanireva ca .. 1.112.30 ..
meaning:
शालिश्च शकलः काण्वो मुनिः केरीरयिस्तथा ..
काद्यो वाध्यायनिश्चैव सावस्यायनिरेव च .. 1.112.30 ..
text_mt:
Śāli, Śakala, the sage Kāṇva, Kerīrayi,
Kādya, Vādhyāyani, and Sāvasyāyani—

sanskrit_iast:
tyārṣeyo nāmatasteṣāṃ pravaro bhūmipottama ..
aṅgirādamavāhyaśca tathā caivāpyatatkṣayaḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
त्यार्षेयो नामतस्तेषां प्रवरो भूमिपोत्तम ..
अङ्गिरादमवाह्यश्च तथा चैवाप्यतत्क्षयः .. 31 ..
text_mt:
their pravara by name consists of three ancestral sages, O best of kings:
Aṅgiras, Dāmavāhya, and Atatkṣaya.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ ..
sakṛtiśca trimārṣṭiśca śedhūḥ śaipavireva ca .. 32 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्याः सर्व एव प्रकीर्तिताः ..
सकृतिश्च त्रिमार्ष्टिश्च शेधूः शैपविरेव च .. 32 ..
text_mt:
All of them are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Sakṛti, Trimārṣṭi, Śedhu, Śaipavi,

sanskrit_iast:
taṇḍiśca jānakiścaiva tailakādravya eva ca ..
nārāyaṇiścārṣabhiśca laukṣirgārgirhalastathā .. 33 ..
meaning:
तण्डिश्च जानकिश्चैव तैलकाद्रव्य एव च ..
नारायणिश्चार्षभिश्च लौक्षिर्गार्गिर्हलस्तथा .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Taṇḍi, Jānaki, Tailakādravya,
Nārāyaṇi, Ārṣabhi, Laukṣi, Gārgi, Hala,

sanskrit_iast:
gālaviścāpi tryārṣeyaḥ sarveṣāṃ pravarā matāḥ ..
aṃgirāḥ saṃkṛtiścaiva gaurivītistathaiva ca..34..
meaning:
गालविश्चापि त्र्यार्षेयः सर्वेषां प्रवरा मताः ..
अंगिराः संकृतिश्चैव गौरिवीतिस्तथैव च..34..
text_mt:
and Gālavi—the pravaras for all of them are considered to consist of three ancestral sages:
Aṅgiras, Saṃkṛti, and Gaurivīti.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyāḥ ṛṣaya parikīrtitāḥ ..
kāṇvāyano haritakaḥ kautsyaḥ pauṃgyastathaiva ca .. 35 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्याः ऋषय परिकीर्तिताः ..
काण्वायनो हरितकः कौत्स्यः पौंग्यस्तथैव च .. 35 ..
text_mt:
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Kāṇvāyana, Haritaka, Kautsya, Pauṃgya,

sanskrit_iast:
hastidamo vātsyamālirmāndrirgālirgaveraṇaḥ ..
bhīmaveśaḥ śāṃkhyadarbhiḥ sarve tripravarā matāḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
हस्तिदमो वात्स्यमालिर्मान्द्रिर्गालिर्गवेरणः ..
भीमवेशः शांख्यदर्भिः सर्वे त्रिप्रवरा मताः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
Hastidama, Vātsyamāli, Māndri, Gāli, Gaveraṇa,
Bhīmaveśa, and Śāṅkhyadarbi are all considered to have three pravaras:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāstu tamasyuśca purukutsastathaiva ca ..
kutsāḥ kutsairavaivāhyā evamāhuḥ purātanāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिरास्तु तमस्युश्च पुरुकुत्सस्तथैव च ..
कुत्साः कुत्सैरवैवाह्या एवमाहुः पुरातनाः .. 37 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Tamasyu, and Purukutsa.
The ancients have declared thus: the Kutsas must not intermarry with the Kutsas.

sanskrit_iast:
rathītarāṇāṃ pravarāḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
aṅgirāśca surūpāśca tathaiva ca rathetaraḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
रथीतराणां प्रवराः त्र्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
अङ्गिराश्च सुरूपाश्च तथैव च रथेतरः .. 38 ..
text_mt:
The pravaras of the Rathītaras are proclaimed to consist of three ancestral sages:
Aṅgiras, Surūpas, and Rathetara.

sanskrit_iast:
rathetarā avaivāhyā nitarāśca rathetaraiḥ ..
viṣṇuvṛddhiḥ śage madrirjatriṇaḥ kartriṇastathā .. 39 ..
meaning:
रथेतरा अवैवाह्या नितराश्च रथेतरैः ..
विष्णुवृद्धिः शगे मद्रिर्जत्रिणः कर्त्रिणस्तथा .. 39 ..
text_mt:
The Rathetaras must not marry at all with the Rathetaras.
Viṣṇuvṛddhi, Śage, Madri, the Jatriṇas, the Kartriṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
praḍivaśca mahātejāstathā caiva parāyaṇaḥ ..
tryārṣeyaśca matasteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ ..1.112.40..
meaning:
प्रडिवश्च महातेजास्तथा चैव परायणः ..
त्र्यार्षेयश्च मतस्तेषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः शुभः ..1.112.40..
text_mt:
the highly splendid Praḍiva, and Parāyaṇa—
the auspicious pravara for all of them is considered to consist of three ancestral sages:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāśca virūpāśca pṛthudaśvastathaiva ca ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिराश्च विरूपाश्च पृथुदश्वस्तथैव च ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या इत्येते परिकीर्तिताः .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Virūpas, and Pṛthudaśva.
These are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
sāntyamugdhirmahātejā hiraṇyastambimudgalo ..
tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaro nṛpa .. 42 ..
meaning:
सान्त्यमुग्धिर्महातेजा हिरण्यस्तम्बिमुद्गलो ..
त्र्यार्षेयोऽपि मतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरो नृप .. 42 ..
text_mt:
The highly splendid Sāntyamugdhi, Hiraṇyastambi, and Mudgala—
the pravara for all of them, O king, is considered to consist of three ancestral sages:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirā gṛtsadaśvaśca mudgalaśca mahātapāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ityete parikīrtitāḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिरा गृत्सदश्वश्च मुद्गलश्च महातपाः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या इत्येते परिकीर्तिताः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Gṛtsadaśva, and Mudgala of great asceticism.
These are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
mohajihvo devajihvo agnijihvavirāḍayaḥ ..
apāneyastryagrayaśca vairiṇyāstāvimaudgalāḥ .. 44 ..
meaning:
मोहजिह्वो देवजिह्वो अग्निजिह्वविराडयः ..
अपानेयस्त्र्यग्रयश्च वैरिण्यास्ताविमौद्गलाः .. 44 ..
text_mt:
Mohajihva, Devajihva, the Agnijihvas, Virāj and others,
Apāneya, and the Tryagrayas, the Vairiṇyas, and the Tāvimaudgalas—

sanskrit_iast:
tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
aṅgirāścaiva tāviśca maudgalyaśca mahātapāḥ .. .. 45 ..
meaning:
त्र्यार्षेयोऽपि मतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः शुभः ..
अङ्गिराश्चैव ताविश्च मौद्गल्यश्च महातपाः .. .. 45 ..
text_mt:
their auspicious pravara is considered to consist of three ancestral sages:
Aṅgiras, Tāvi, and Maudgalya of great asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
uruṇḍaśca bhuruṇḍaśca tṛtīyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
उरुण्डश्च भुरुण्डश्च तृतीयः शाकटायनः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Uruṇḍa, Bhuruṇḍa, and the third, Śākaṭāyana;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prāgadhamo nārī markaṭo ramaṇaḥ śaṇaḥ ..
kāṇvamārkaṭayaścaiva tayā rāmavaṇo muniḥ .. 47 ..
meaning:
ततः प्रागधमो नारी मर्कटो रमणः शणः ..
काण्वमार्कटयश्चैव तया रामवणो मुनिः .. 47 ..
text_mt:
then Prāgadhama, Nārī, Markaṭa, Ramaṇa, Śaṇa,
the Kāṇvamārkaṭis, and the sage Rāmavaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāyanastathaiteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ ..
aṅgirāścājamīḍhaśca kāṇvaścaiva mahātapāḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
श्यामायनस्तथैतेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो मतः ..
अङ्गिराश्चाजमीढश्च काण्वश्चैव महातपाः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
and Śyāmāyani—for these, the pravara is considered to consist of three ancestral sages:
Aṅgiras, Ajamīḍha, and Kāṇva of great asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
paramparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
tittiriḥ kapibhūścaiva gārgyaścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
परम्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
तित्तिरिः कपिभूश्चैव गार्ग्यश्चैव महानृषिः .. 49 ..
text_mt:
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Tittiri, Kapibhū, and the great sage Gārgya—

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
ārṣeyo nāmataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ..1.112.50..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
आर्षेयो नामतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः शुभः..1.112.50..
text_mt:
these sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.
Their auspicious ancestral pravara by name for all of them [is]:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirāstittiriścaiva kapibhūśca mahānṛṣiḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrttitāḥ .. 51 ..
meaning:
अङ्गिरास्तित्तिरिश्चैव कपिभूश्च महानृषिः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्त्तिताः .. 51 ..
text_mt:
Aṅgiras, Tittiri, and the great sage Kapibhū.
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājo ṛṣirvāndanavastathā .. 52 ..
meaning: अङ्गिराः सभरद्वाजो ऋषिर्वान्दनवस्तथा .. 52 ..
text_mt: Aṅgiras along with Bharadvāja, and the sage Vāndanava;

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatirmaitravacāḥ pañcārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājastathā caiva bṛhaspatiḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
बृहस्पतिर्मैत्रवचाः पञ्चार्षेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
अङ्गिराः सभरद्वाजस्तथा चैव बृहस्पतिः .. 53 ..
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati and Maitravacas: these are proclaimed to have five ancestral sages:
Aṅgiras along with Bharadvāja, as well as Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirmitravacaścaiva ṛṣirvāndatavastathā ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
ऋषिर्मित्रवचश्चैव ऋषिर्वान्दतवस्तथा ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 54 ..
text_mt:
the sage Mitravacas, and the sage Vāndatava.
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāradvājaḥ kaṭāśauṅgaḥ śaithireyastathaiva ca ..
ityete kathitāḥ sarve dvyāmuṣyāyaṇanotrajāḥ ..55..
meaning:
भारद्वाजः कटाशौङ्गः शैथिरेयस्तथैव च ..
इत्येते कथिताः सर्वे द्व्यामुष्यायणनोत्रजाः ..55..
text_mt:
The Bhāradvājas, the Kaṭas, the Śauṅgas, and the Śaithireyas—
all these are declared to be born of lineages belonging to two fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāgneyāstathāpyeṣāṃ pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
aṅgirāḥ sabharadvājastathaiva ca bṛhaspatiḥ .. 56 ..
meaning:
पञ्चाग्नेयास्तथाप्येषां प्रवराः परिकीर्तिताः ..
अङ्गिराः सभरद्वाजस्तथैव च बृहस्पतिः .. 56 ..
text_mt:
Their pravaras are likewise proclaimed to consist of five sages:
Aṅgiras along with Bharadvāja, and Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
sauṅgaśca śaiśaviścaiva pravarāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..57..
meaning:
सौङ्गश्च शैशविश्चैव प्रवराः परिकीर्तिताः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..57..
text_mt:
Śauṅga, and Śaiśavi are proclaimed as their pravaras.
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tavoktāṅgirasastu vaṃśe mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ ca nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti .. 58 ..
meaning:
एते तवोक्ताङ्गिरसस्तु वंशे महानुभावा नृप गोत्रकाराः ..
येषां च नाम्नां परिकीर्तनेन पापं समग्रं पुरुषो जहाति .. 58 ..
text_mt:
These eminent founders of gotras in the lineage of Aṅgiras have been declared to you, O king,
by the recital of whose names a person casts off all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrivaṃśasamutpannāngotrakārānnibodha me ..
karpūrāyaṇaśākheyāstathā śārāhaṇāśca ye ..
śaivālakī śaunavarṇiraghosaudrutayaśca ye .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अत्रिवंशसमुत्पन्नान्गोत्रकारान्निबोध मे ..
कर्पूरायणशाखेयास्तथा शाराहणाश्च ये ..
शैवालकी शौनवर्णिरघोसौद्रुतयश्च ये .. 1 ..
title: Atrivaṃśānukīrtanam

sanskrit_iast:
gauragrīvaḥ sakārañjiratha maitrāyaṇāśca ye ..
ātmayanyā vāmarathyā gaupanāstākibindavaḥ ..2..
meaning:
गौरग्रीवः सकारञ्जिरथ मैत्रायणाश्च ये ..
आत्मयन्या वामरथ्या गौपनास्ताकिबिन्दवः ..2..
text_mt:
Gauragrīva, Sakārañji, and then those who are Maitrāyaṇas;
the Ātmayanīs, Vāmarathyas, Gaupanas, and Tākibindus;

sanskrit_iast:
hvānajidbāhurindroviraindrāliḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ..
taileyaścaiva bauleyaścātrigauṇī matistathā .. 3 ..
meaning:
ह्वानजिद्बाहुरिन्द्रोविरैन्द्रालिः शाकटायनः ..
तैलेयश्चैव बौलेयश्चात्रिगौणी मतिस्तथा .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Hvānajit, Bāhu, Indrovir, Aindrāli, Śākaṭāyana,
Taileya, Bauleya, Atrigauṇi, and Mati;

sanskrit_iast:
jalado bhagapādaśca sopuṣpiśca mahātapāḥ ..
chāndogeyastathaiteṣāmārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ ..4..
meaning:
जलदो भगपादश्च सोपुष्पिश्च महातपाः ..
छान्दोगेयस्तथैतेषामार्षेयः प्रवरो मतः ..4..
text_mt:
Jalada, Bhagapāda, Sopuṣpi of great asceticism,
and Chāndogeya—for these, the ancestral pravara is considered to be:

sanskrit_iast:
dhyārāśvāśca tathātriśca ṛcanānasa eva ca ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ..5..
meaning:
ध्याराश्वाश्च तथात्रिश्च ऋचनानस एव च ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः..5..
text_mt:
Dhyārāśva, Atri, and Ṛcanānasa.
These sages are proclaimed as having no intermarriage among themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣirbaliḥ pālakṛcca aurṇanābhiḥ silirmiliḥ ..
bījavāpī śirīṣaśca mauṃjakeśagaviṣṭhirau..6..
meaning:
दक्षिर्बलिः पालकृच्च और्णनाभिः सिलिर्मिलिः ..
बीजवापी शिरीषश्च मौंजकेशगविष्ठिरौ..6..
text_mt: Dākṣi, Bali, Pālakṛt, Aurṇanābhi, Sili, Mili, / Bījavāpin, Śirīṣa, Mauñjakeśa, and Gaviṣṭhira,

sanskrit_iast:
balandhanasttathaiteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro mataḥ ..
atrirgaviṣṭhiraścaiva tathā pūrvātithiḥ smṛtāḥ..7
meaning:
बलन्धनस्त्तथैतेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो मतः ..
अत्रिर्गविष्ठिरश्चैव तथा पूर्वातिथिः स्मृताः..7
text_mt: and Balandhana—their ancestral formula is considered to have three ṛṣis; / Atri, Gaviṣṭhira, and Pūrvātithi are traditionally taught [as the three].

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
ātreyānputrikāputrānata ūrdhvaṃ nibodha me ..8..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
आत्रेयान्पुत्रिकापुत्रानत ऊर्ध्वं निबोध मे ..8..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / Hear from me henceforth of the sons of daughters born in Atri's lineage:

sanskrit_iast:
hāleyaśca savāleyo vāmamathyastathaiva ca ..
gotreyaścaiva gotreyāḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
हालेयश्च सवालेयो वाममथ्यस्तथैव च ..
गोत्रेयश्चैव गोत्रेयाः त्र्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः .. 9 ..
text_mt: Hāleya, Vāleya, and likewise Vāmarathya, / Gotreya, and the Gotreyas are declared to have three ṛṣis;

sanskrit_iast:
atriśca vāmarathyaśca potriścaiva mahānṛṣiḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 1.113.10 ..
meaning:
अत्रिश्च वामरथ्यश्च पोत्रिश्चैव महानृषिः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 1.113.10 ..
text_mt: Atri, Vāmarathya, and the great sage Potri / are the sages declared ineligible for intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast:
ityatrivaṃśaprabhavāstavoktā mahānubhāvā nṛpa gotrakārāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ tu nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti .. 11 ..
meaning:
इत्यत्रिवंशप्रभवास्तवोक्ता महानुभावा नृप गोत्रकाराः ..
येषां तु नाम्नां परिकीर्तनेन पापं समग्रं पुरुषो जहाति .. 11 ..
text_mt: Thus, O king, have been declared to you the high-souled founders of lineages born from the lineage of Atri, / through the recitation of whose names a person casts off all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrerevāparaṃ vaṃśaṃ tava vakṣyāmi pārthiva ..
atreḥ somaḥ sutaḥ śrīmāṃstasya vaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अत्रेरेवापरं वंशं तव वक्ष्यामि पार्थिव ..
अत्रेः सोमः सुतः श्रीमांस्तस्य वंशोद्भवो नृपः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall declare to you another lineage of Atri, O ruler of the earth: / to Atri was born the glorious son Soma; and born in his lineage was the king
title: Viśvāmitravaṃśānukīrtanam

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrastu tapasā brāhmaṇyaṃ samavāptavān ..
tasya vaṃśamahaṃ vakṣye tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 2 ..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्तु तपसा ब्राह्मण्यं समवाप्तवान् ..
तस्य वंशमहं वक्ष्ये तन्मे निगदतः शृणु .. 2 ..
text_mt: Viśvāmitra, who by ascetic heat attained the status of a brahmin. / I shall speak of his lineage; listen to me as I proclaim it:

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro devarātastathā cekitigālavau ..
vataṇḍaśca śalaṅgaśca tathā cāśvāta tāyanaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रो देवरातस्तथा चेकितिगालवौ ..
वतण्डश्च शलङ्गश्च तथा चाश्वात तायनः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Viśvāmitra, Devarāta, and likewise Cekiti, Gālava, / Vataṇḍa, Śalaṅga, and also Āśvātāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāyano yājñavalkyo jābāliḥ saindhanāyanaḥ ..
dābhravyāśca kārīṣī ca sauśrutyā atha sauśrutāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
श्यामायनो याज्ञवल्क्यो जाबालिः सैन्धनायनः ..
दाभ्रव्याश्च कारीषी च सौश्रुत्या अथ सौश्रुताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Śyāmāyana, Yājñavalkya, Jābāli, Saindhanāyana, / the Dābhravyas, Kārīṣi, Sauśrutya, and the Sauśrutas,

sanskrit_iast:
aulūṣā aupagavayaḥ pāṇyodarayamāñcayaḥ ..
kharabādhā vahalayaḥ pāṇatambaḥ sakauśikāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
औलूषा औपगवयः पाण्योदरयमाञ्चयः ..
खरबाधा वहलयः पाणतम्बः सकौशिकाः .. 5 ..
text_mt: the Aulūṣas, Aupagavas, Pāṇyodaras, Yamāñcis, / Kharabādhas, Vahalis, Pāṇatambas, and the Kauśikas;

sanskrit_iast:
tryārṣeyāḥ pravarāsteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ..
viśvāmitro devarātaḥ uddālaśca mahāyakṣāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
त्र्यार्षेयाः प्रवरास्तेषां सर्वेषां परिकीर्तिताः ..
विश्वामित्रो देवरातः उद्दालश्च महायक्षाः .. 6 ..
text_mt: the ancestral formulas of all of these are declared to have three ṛṣis: / Viśvāmitra, Devarāta, and Uddāla of great fame.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
mārgamitrāstathādyāśca mādhucchandasa eva ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
मार्गमित्रास्तथाद्याश्च माधुच्छन्दस एव च .. 7 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / Likewise the Mārgamitras and their elders, and the Mādhucchandasa;

sanskrit_iast:
tryārṣeyāḥ pravarāstvete ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
viśvāmitrastathā jyeṣṭho madhucchandāstathaiva ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
त्र्यार्षेयाः प्रवरास्त्वेते ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
विश्वामित्रस्तथा ज्येष्ठो मधुच्छन्दास्तथैव च .. 8 ..
text_mt: these sages are declared to have ancestral formulas with three ṛṣis: / Viśvāmitra, the eldest, and likewise Madhucchandas.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
dhanañjayaḥ kapardeyaḥ parikuṣṭaśca pārthiva .. 9 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
धनञ्जयः कपर्देयः परिकुष्टश्च पार्थिव .. 9 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / Dhanañjaya, Kapardeya, and Parikuṣṭa, O ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇiniścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ sarva ete prakīrtitāḥ ..
viśvāmitro madhucchandastathā caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ .. 1.114.10 ..
meaning:
पाणिनिश्चैव त्र्यार्षेयाः सर्व एते प्रकीर्तिताः ..
विश्वामित्रो मधुच्छन्दस्तथा चैवाघमर्षणः .. 1.114.10 ..
text_mt: and Pāṇini—all these are declared to have three ṛṣis: / Viśvāmitra, Madhucchandas, and also Aghamarṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
kāmalāyanijāścaiva āśmarathyāstathaiva ca .. 11 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
कामलायनिजाश्चैव आश्मरथ्यास्तथैव च .. 11 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / Those born of Kāmalāyani, and likewise the Āśmarathyas,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhuliścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ sarveṣāṃ pravarā matāḥ ..
viśvāmitraścāśmaratho badhuliśca mahātapāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
बन्धुलिश्चैव त्र्यार्षेयाः सर्वेषां प्रवरा मताः ..
विश्वामित्रश्चाश्मरथो बधुलिश्च महातपाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: and Bandhuli—their ancestral formulas are considered by all to have three ṛṣis: / Viśvāmitra, Āśmaratha, and Bandhuli of great ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
pūraṇāḥ paridhāvantaḥ dvyārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
पूरणाः परिधावन्तः द्व्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः .. 13 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / The Pūraṇas and Paridhāvants are declared to have two ṛṣis:

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitraḥ pūraṇaśca tayordvau pravarau smṛtau ..
parivartā avaivāhyāḥ pūraṇāśca parasparam .. 14 ..
meaning:
विश्वामित्रः पूरणश्च तयोर्द्वौ प्रवरौ स्मृतौ ..
परिवर्ता अवैवाह्याः पूरणाश्च परस्परम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Viśvāmitra and Pūraṇa—these two are remembered as their ancestral names. / The Parivartas and Pūraṇas are ineligible for intermarriage with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
lohitā aṣṭakāścaiva tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
viśvāmitro lohitaśca aṣṭakaśca mahātapāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
लोहिता अष्टकाश्चैव त्र्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
विश्वामित्रो लोहितश्च अष्टकश्च महातपाः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The Lohitas and Aṣṭakas are declared to have three ṛṣis: / Viśvāmitra, Lohita, and Aṣṭaka of great ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭakā lohitairnityamavaivāhyāḥ parasparam ..
udareṇḍaḥ kanyakaśca ṛṣiścodāvahistathā ..16..
meaning:
अष्टका लोहितैर्नित्यमवैवाह्याः परस्परम् ..
उदरेण्डः कन्यकश्च ऋषिश्चोदावहिस्तथा ..16..
text_mt: The Aṣṭakas and the Lohitas are never to intermarry with one another. / Udareṇḍa, Kanyaka, and the sage Udāvahi;

sanskrit_iast:
tryārṣeyo'pi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
ṛṇavāngrathitaścaiva viśvāmitrastathaiva ca .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्र्यार्षेयोऽपि मतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः शुभः ..
ऋणवान्ग्रथितश्चैव विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च .. 17 ..
text_mt: their auspicious ancestral formula is also considered to have three ṛṣis: / Ṛṇavant, Grathita, and likewise Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
audumbariḥ śaiśiraṭirṛṣistārkṣāyaṇastathā .. 18 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..
औदुम्बरिः शैशिरटिरृषिस्तार्क्षायणस्तथा .. 18 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / Audumbari, Śaiśiraṭi, and the sage Tārkṣāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
ṭaikāyanistaikāyanistārkṣāyaṇirathaiva ca..
kātyāyaniḥ karīrāmiḥ śālaṅkāyanilāvakī..19..
meaning:
टैकायनिस्तैकायनिस्तार्क्षायणिरथैव च..
कात्यायनिः करीरामिः शालङ्कायनिलावकी..19..
text_mt: Ṭaikāyani, Taikāyani, and then Tārkṣāyaṇi, / Kātyāyani, Karīrāmi, Śālaṅkāyani, Lāvakī,

sanskrit_iast:
mauñjāyaniśca bhagavāṃstryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
kiliḥ kalistathā vidvānviśvāmitrastathaiva ca ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..1.114.20 ..
meaning:
मौञ्जायनिश्च भगवांस्त्र्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
किलिः कलिस्तथा विद्वान्विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः ..1.114.20 ..
text_mt: and the venerable Mauñjāyani are declared to have three ṛṣis: / Kili, the wise Kali, and likewise Viśvāmitra. / These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tavoktāḥ kuśikā narendra mahānubhāvāḥ satataṃ dvijendrāḥ ..
yeṣāṃ tu nāmnāṃ parikīrtanena pāpaṃ samagraṃ puruṣo jahāti .. 21 ..
meaning:
एते तवोक्ताः कुशिका नरेन्द्र महानुभावाः सततं द्विजेन्द्राः ..
येषां तु नाम्नां परिकीर्तनेन पापं समग्रं पुरुषो जहाति .. 21 ..
text_mt: These are the Kuśikas spoken of to you, O king of men, high-souled foremost among twice-born, / through the recitation of whose names a person casts off all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ kaśyapasya tathā kule ..
gotrakārānṛṣīnvakṣye teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः कश्यपस्य तथा कुले ..
गोत्रकारानृषीन्वक्ष्ये तेषां नामानि मे शृणु .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To Marīci was born Kaśyapa. In the family of Kaśyapa, / I shall proclaim the sages who founded lineages; hear their names from me:
title: Kaśyapavaṃśānukīrtanam

sanskrit_iast:
āgrāyaṇā jhaṣagaṇā meṣakaurīṭikāyanāḥ ..
guruvrajī māṭharaśca gojāviratha lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
आग्रायणा झषगणा मेषकौरीटिकायनाः ..
गुरुव्रजी माठरश्च गोजाविरथ लक्ष्मणः .. 2 ..
text_mt: The Āgrāyaṇas, Jhaṣagaṇas, Meṣakaurīṭikāyanas, / Guruvrajin, Māṭhara, Gojāvi, Lakṣmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
śālāhaleyāḥ korijyāścaukanyāścāsurāyaṇāḥ ..
mandānyāvai mṛgayano śrotaso bhausatāyanāḥ ..3..
meaning:
शालाहलेयाः कोरिज्याश्चौकन्याश्चासुरायणाः ..
मन्दान्यावै मृगयनो श्रोतसो भौसतायनाः ..3..
text_mt: the Śālāhaleyas, Korijyas, Caukanyas, Asurāyaṇas, / Mandānyis, Mṛgayanas, Śrotasas, Bhausatāyanas,

sanskrit_iast:
devayātā gopayātā athocchāyatayaśca ye ..
tākayānāścitrahayā abhiryogā gadāyanāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
देवयाता गोपयाता अथोच्छायतयश्च ये ..
ताकयानाश्चित्रहया अभिर्योगा गदायनाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: the Devayātas, Gopayātas, and those who are Ucchāyatis, / Tākayānas, Citrahayas, Abhiryogas, Gadāyanas,

sanskrit_iast:
kātuvandirmahācakrirdākṣapāṇaya eva ca ..
grīvāyaṇā harkirayo hāstidāsāstathaiva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
कातुवन्दिर्महाचक्रिर्दाक्षपाणय एव च ..
ग्रीवायणा हर्किरयो हास्तिदासास्तथैव च .. 5 ..
text_mt: Kātuvandi, Mahācakri, and the Dākṣapāṇis, / Grīvāyaṇas, Harkirayas, and likewise Hāstidāsas,

sanskrit_iast:
vātsyā vālinyakṛtahā hāstalāyanisastathā ..
āgrāyaṇaḥ pelumūlī rāśvatātāya nastathā .. 6 ..
meaning:
वात्स्या वालिन्यकृतहा हास्तलायनिसस्तथा ..
आग्रायणः पेलुमूली राश्वताताय नस्तथा .. 6 ..
text_mt: the Vātsyas, Vālinis, Akṛtahas, and Hāstalāyanis, / Āgrāyaṇa, Pelumūlin, Rāśvatātāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
kauśītakāśca pākāntā agniśarmāyaṇāśca ye ..
maiṣayaḥ kaivameyāśca tathā caiva subabhravaḥ ..7..
meaning:
कौशीतकाश्च पाकान्ता अग्निशर्मायणाश्च ये ..
मैषयः कैवमेयाश्च तथा चैव सुबभ्रवः ..7..
text_mt: the Kauśītakas, Pākāntas, and those who are Agniśarmāyaṇas, / Maiṣis, Kaivameyas, and also the Subabhravas,

sanskrit_iast:
prācīthayo jñānagayā āgrāvamatha eva tu ..
śyāmocarā naimiṣayaḥ tatsthā ye śādvalāyanāḥ ..8..
meaning:
प्राचीथयो ज्ञानगया आग्रावमथ एव तु ..
श्यामोचरा नैमिषयः तत्स्था ये शाद्वलायनाः ..8..
text_mt: the Prācīthayas, Jñānagayas, Āgrāvamathas, / Śyāmocaras, Naimiṣis, and those Śādvalāyanas living among them,

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭahāyananāmārīcā ḍaujihāyanahāstikāḥ..
vaikarṇeyāḥ kāśyapāśca śāmiśā hāritāyanāḥ ..9..
meaning:
काष्टहायननामारीचा डौजिहायनहास्तिकाः..
वैकर्णेयाः काश्यपाश्च शामिशा हारितायनाः ..9..
text_mt: Kāṣṭahāyana, Nāmārīca, Ḍaujihāyana, Hāstika, / the Vaikarṇeyas, Kāśyapas, Śāmiśas, Hāritāyanas,

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṃgino babhrasavaḥ tryārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
vatsaraḥ kaśyapaścaiva nidhruvaśca mahātapāḥ .. 1.115.10 ..
meaning:
मातंगिनो बभ्रसवः त्र्यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
वत्सरः कश्यपश्चैव निध्रुवश्च महातपाः .. 1.115.10 ..
text_mt: Mātaṅgins, and Babhrasavas are declared to have three ṛṣis: / Vatsara, Kaśyapa, and Nidhruva of great ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparamavaivāhyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ purikīrtritāḥ ..
raihāśca sāṃkhyamitrāśca yārṣeyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
परस्परमवैवाह्याः ऋषयः पुरिकीर्त्रिताः ..
रैहाश्च सांख्यमित्राश्च यार्षेयाः परिकीर्तिताः .. 11 ..
text_mt: These sages are declared ineligible for intermarriage. / The Raihas and Sāṅkhyamitras are declared to have [two] ṛṣis:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsāraḥ kaśyapaścaiva raihāścaiva mahātapāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyau gotrau dvau parikīrtitau .. 12 ..
meaning:
वत्सारः कश्यपश्चैव रैहाश्चैव महातपाः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्यौ गोत्रौ द्वौ परिकीर्तितौ .. 12 ..
text_mt: Vatsāra, Kaśyapa, and Raiha of great ascetic heat; / both lineages are declared ineligible for intermarriage with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyāmuṣyāyaṇagotrajān ..
ānuṣṭubho bhāktarayaḥ svātayo rājavallayaḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि ह्यामुष्यायणगोत्रजान् ..
आनुष्टुभो भाक्तरयः स्वातयो राजवल्लयः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Henceforth I shall speak of those born of the Āmuṣyāyaṇa lineages: / Ānuṣṭubha, the Bhāktarayas, Svātis, Rājavallis,

sanskrit_iast:
śaireśiro devahiśca sairandhī raupasīvakiḥ ..
sāluliḥ kāṭuviṅgākṣiḥ śataśaṃbhistathaiva ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
शैरेशिरो देवहिश्च सैरन्धी रौपसीवकिः ..
सालुलिः काटुविङ्गाक्षिः शतशंभिस्तथैव च .. 14 ..
text_mt: Śaireśiras, Devahi, Sairandhī, Raupasīvaki, / Sāluli, Kāṭuviṅgākṣi, and Śataśaṃbi.

sanskrit_iast:
divā vasiṣṭhā ityete naktaṃ jñeyāśca kāśyapāḥ ..
tryārṣeyāśca tathā teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravarāḥ śubhāḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
दिवा वसिष्ठा इत्येते नक्तं ज्ञेयाश्च काश्यपाः ..
त्र्यार्षेयाश्च तथा तेषां सर्वेषां प्रवराः शुभाः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
By day these are known as Vasiṣṭhas, and by night as Kāśyapas.
Likewise, the auspicious pravaras of all of them consist of three sages:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsāraḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca mahātapāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
वत्सारः कश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठश्च महातपाः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
Vatsāra, Kaśyapa, and Vasiṣṭha of great ascetic heat.
These sages are proclaimed as unable to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
sā mātā baliputraśca bhaupyalo'tha jalatvaraḥ ..
muñjāmayūraḥ paryaśca so'ṣṭamo gardabhīmukhaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
सा माता बलिपुत्रश्च भौप्यलोऽथ जलत्वरः ..
मुञ्जामयूरः पर्यश्च सोऽष्टमो गर्दभीमुखः .. 17 ..
text_mt:
Sāmātā, Baliputra, Bhaupyala, and Jalatvara,
Muñjāmayūra, Parya, and the eighth, Gardabhīmukha;

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyabāhuḥ kairātaḥ ubhau kāśyapagobhilau ..
āhalo vṛṣakaṇḍaśca sṛketuśca tathottaraḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
हिरण्यबाहुः कैरातः उभौ काश्यपगोभिलौ ..
आहलो वृषकण्डश्च सृकेतुश्च तथोत्तरः .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Hiraṇyabāhu, Kairāta, both Kāśyapa and Gobhila,
Āhala, Vṛṣakaṇḍa, and Sṛketu, as well as Uttara;

sanskrit_iast:
udakebhastṛṇo vatsyo mahākeralayaśca ye ..
śāḍīlavaiśānavasau drāvolevalayātavaḥ ..19 ..
meaning:
उदकेभस्तृणो वत्स्यो महाकेरलयश्च ये ..
शाडीलवैशानवसौ द्रावोलेवलयातवः ..19 ..
text_mt:
Udakebha, Tṛṇa, Vatsya, and those who are Mahākeralayas,
Śāḍīlavaiśānavasas, Drāvolas, and Evali-Ātavas;

sanskrit_iast:
paippalādiḥ pūrvavarirvīravitthā varīnikaḥ..
tryārṣeyopi mataścaiṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pravaraḥ śubha .. 1.115.20 ..
meaning:
पैप्पलादिः पूर्ववरिर्वीरवित्था वरीनिकः..
त्र्यार्षेयोपि मतश्चैषां सर्वेषां प्रवरः शुभ .. 1.115.20 ..
text_mt:
Paippalādi, Pūrvavari, Vīravitthan, Varīnika—
the auspicious pravara of all of these is also considered to consist of three sages:

sanskrit_iast:
asito devalaścaiva kaśyapaśca mahātapāḥ ..
parasparamavaivāhyā ṛṣayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
असितो देवलश्चैव कश्यपश्च महातपाः ..
परस्परमवैवाह्या ऋषयः परिकीर्तिताः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Asita, Devala, and Kaśyapa of great ascetic heat.
These sages are proclaimed as unable to intermarry with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣipradhānasya tu kaśyapasya dākṣāyaṇābhyaḥ sakalaṃ prasūtam ..
jagatsamagraṃ yadusiṃhamukhya tatte ca vakṣyāmyahamuttaratra .. 22 ..
meaning:
ऋषिप्रधानस्य तु कश्यपस्य दाक्षायणाभ्यः सकलं प्रसूतम् ..
जगत्समग्रं यदुसिंहमुख्य तत्ते च वक्ष्याम्यहमुत्तरत्र .. 22 ..
text_mt:
From the daughters of Dakṣa, the entire world was born to Kaśyapa, foremost of sages;
all of that, O chief of lions among Yadus, I will declare to you later.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vasiṣṭhavaṃśajānviprānnibodha gadato mama ..
ekārṣeyaśca pravaro vasiṣṭhānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
वसिष्ठवंशजान्विप्रान्निबोध गदतो मम ..
एकार्षेयश्च प्रवरो वसिष्ठानां प्रकीर्तिताः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Learn from me as I declare the brahmins born of Vasiṣṭha's lineage.
The pravara of the Vasiṣṭhas is proclaimed as consisting of one sage.
title: Vasiṣṭhavaṃśānukīrtanam

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha eva vāsiṣṭhā avivāhyā vasiṣṭhajaiḥ ..
vyāghrapādā aupagavāḥ vaiklavā śādvalāyanāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
वसिष्ठ एव वासिष्ठा अविवाह्या वसिष्ठजैः ..
व्याघ्रपादा औपगवाः वैक्लवा शाद्वलायनाः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha alone is [the pravara] of the Vāsiṣṭhas; they cannot be married into by those born of Vasiṣṭha:
the Vyāghrapādas, Aupagavas, Vaiklavas, Śādvalāyanas,

sanskrit_iast:
kāpiṣṭhalā kṣaiṭalomā āśvalāḥ sarvaṭākarāḥ ..
gopāyanā bodhayaśca dvākalpā apavāhyakṛt .. 3 ..
meaning:
कापिष्ठला क्षैटलोमा आश्वलाः सर्वटाकराः ..
गोपायना बोधयश्च द्वाकल्पा अपवाह्यकृत् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Kāpiṣṭhalas, Kṣaiṭalomas, Āśvalas, Sarvaṭākaras,
Gopāyanas, Bodhas, Dvākalpas, Apavāhyakṛt,

sanskrit_iast:
