adya vedūmyadhikaṃ subhrūḥ śakrādātmānamātmanā..47..
meaning:
पुरूरवा उवाच ..
कामदेवः प्रसन्नोऽद्य ममोर्वशि वरावने ..
अद्य वेदूम्यधिकं सुभ्रूः शक्रादात्मानमात्मना..47..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / “The god of love is pleased today with me, O Urvaśī, O fair-faced one; / today I deem myself superior even to Śakra, O fair-browed lady.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyarājyalābhe'pi kutaḥ sā me śubhe ratiḥ ..
ājñākāritvamāsādya yā tavādya sulocane .. 48 ..
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यराज्यलाभेऽपि कुतः सा मे शुभे रतिः ..
आज्ञाकारित्वमासाद्य या तवाद्य सुलोचने .. 48 ..
text_mt: Even upon obtaining the sovereignty of the three worlds, whence would I find such delight, / O auspicious one, as I have today upon having become obedient to your command, O fair-eyed lady?”

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ vadati bhūpāle yayau rambhā varānanā ..
kṣaṇena meṣasahitā punaḥ prāptā nṛpāntikam .. 49 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवं वदति भूपाले ययौ रम्भा वरानना ..
क्षणेन मेषसहिता पुनः प्राप्ता नृपान्तिकम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / While the king was speaking thus, fair-faced Rambhā departed; / in a moment, accompanied by two rams, she returned to the king's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣau dattvā narendrasya rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt ..
rambhovāca ..
yāsyāmi laṅkāṃ rājendra tatra prāṇeśvaro mama ..1.133.50..
meaning:
मेषौ दत्त्वा नरेन्द्रस्य राजानं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
रम्भोवाच ..
यास्यामि लङ्कां राजेन्द्र तत्र प्राणेश्वरो मम ..1.133.50..
text_mt: Having given the two rams to the king, she spoke these words to the monarch; / Rambhā said: / “I shall go to Laṅkā, O king of kings; there is my life's lord,

sanskrit_iast:
matpratīkṣaḥ sthitaḥ śrīmāndhanadasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
nalakūbaranāmāsau trailokyaviditaḥ prabho ..51 ..
meaning:
मत्प्रतीक्षः स्थितः श्रीमान्धनदस्यात्मसंभवः ..
नलकूबरनामासौ त्रैलोक्यविदितः प्रभो ..51 ..
text_mt: the glorious son of Dhanada, waiting for me; / he is named Nalakūbara, renowned across the three worlds, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ceyaṃ sakhī mahyaṃ notkaṇṭhāṃ kurute śubhā ..
sakhījanasya svargyasya tathā kāryaṃ tvayānagha .. 52 ..
meaning:
यथा चेयं सखी मह्यं नोत्कण्ठां कुरुते शुभा ..
सखीजनस्य स्वर्ग्यस्य तथा कार्यं त्वयानघ .. 52 ..
text_mt: And you must act, O sinless one, in such a way that this auspicious friend of mine / does not feel longing for her friends in heaven.”

sanskrit_iast:
purūravā uvāca ..
yatiṣye'haṃ tathā kartuṃ nirvṛtā bhava mānade ..
ratnānyetānyupādāya nirgacchasva yathāsukham .. 53 ..
meaning:
पुरूरवा उवाच ..
यतिष्येऽहं तथा कर्तुं निर्वृता भव मानदे ..
रत्नान्येतान्युपादाय निर्गच्छस्व यथासुखम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / “I shall endeavor to do so; be at ease, O respectful lady; / taking these jewels, depart as you please.”

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktā tato rambhā nṛpateḥ prītikāraṇāt ..
ratnānyupādāya yayau khena laṅkāṃ mahāpurīm ..54..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्ता ततो रम्भा नृपतेः प्रीतिकारणात् ..
रत्नान्युपादाय ययौ खेन लङ्कां महापुरीम् ..54..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having been spoken to thus, Rambhā then, to please the king, / took the jewels and went through the sky to the great city of Laṅkā.

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvorvaśīṃ narendro'pi reme sa sahitastayā ..
yathā śacyā surārighno balavānpākaśāsanaḥ .. 55 ..
meaning:
लब्ध्वोर्वशीं नरेन्द्रोऽपि रेमे स सहितस्तया ..
यथा शच्या सुरारिघ्नो बलवान्पाकशासनः .. 55 ..
text_mt: Having obtained Urvaśī, that lord of men also disported with her, / just as the mighty slayer of Pāka, slayer of the enemies of the gods, did with Śacī.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnyastabhāraḥ sa tu mantrimukhye reme tayā yādavasiṃhamukhya..
lakṣmyā sameto bhagavānananto yathā sa devo bhuvanasya goptā .. 56 ..
meaning:
संन्यस्तभारः स तु मन्त्रिमुख्ये रेमे तया यादवसिंहमुख्य..
लक्ष्म्या समेतो भगवाननन्तो यथा स देवो भुवनस्य गोप्ता .. 56 ..
text_mt: Having consigned his burden to his chief minister, he disported with her, O chief lion of the Yādavas, / just as the blessed, endless God, protector of the world, does united with Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
prāsādeṣu vicitreṣu tathā maṇigṛheṣu ca ..
puṣpaveśmasu ramyeṣu tathā vastragṛheṣu ca .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
प्रासादेषु विचित्रेषु तथा मणिगृहेषु च ..
पुष्पवेश्मसु रम्येषु तथा वस्त्रगृहेषु च .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In variegated mansions, and likewise in jeweled houses, / in charming flower-pavilions, and likewise in cloth pavilions,
title: Urvaśīsambhogavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
ratnaveśmasu mukhyeṣu tathā citragṛheṣu ca ..
parvatānāṃ ca durgeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca .. 2 ..
meaning:
रत्नवेश्मसु मुख्येषु तथा चित्रगृहेषु च ..
पर्वतानां च दुर्गेषु नदीनां पुलिनेषु च .. 2 ..
text_mt: in choice gem-pavilions, and likewise in painted houses, / in the mountain strongholds, and on the sandbanks of rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
padminīṣu ca phullāsu tathā cotpalinīṣu ca ..
śayyāsu ca parārdhyāsu puṣpaśayyāsu cāpyatha.. 3..
meaning:
पद्मिनीषु च फुल्लासु तथा चोत्पलिनीषु च ..
शय्यासु च परार्ध्यासु पुष्पशय्यासु चाप्यथ.. 3..
text_mt: in blooming lotus pools, and likewise in blue-lotus pools, / and upon supreme couches, as well as couches of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
ramayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ tathā viraciteṣu ca ..
gṛheṣu bahuratneṣu dhūpodgāriṣu pārthiva ..4..
meaning:
रमयामास तां देवीं तथा विरचितेषु च ..
गृहेषु बहुरत्नेषु धूपोद्गारिषु पार्थिव ..4..
text_mt: he delighted that goddess, and likewise in houses / fashioned with many jewels, sending forth incense, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
reme sa tu tayā sārdhaṃ mānaseṣu punaḥpunaḥ ..
ramayam̐stāṃ varārohāṃ na tṛpyati sa nityaśaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
रेमे स तु तया सार्धं मानसेषु पुनःपुनः ..
रमयम्̐स्तां वरारोहां न तृप्यति स नित्यशः .. 5 ..
text_mt: He disported with her again and again in their minds; / delighting that woman of lovely hips, he was never satiated.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāsu ca sacandrāsu candrakāntataraṃ mukham ..
papau tasyā yathākāmaṃ narendraḥ sa narādhipa..6..
meaning:
निशासु च सचन्द्रासु चन्द्रकान्ततरं मुखम् ..
पपौ तस्या यथाकामं नरेन्द्रः स नराधिप..6..
text_mt: On moonlit nights, that lord of men, that king of mortals, / drank according to his desire her face that was lovelier than the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
niśāsu naṣṭacandrāsu tanmukho dyotitaprabhe ..
deśe tāṃ ramayāmāsa rājā rājīvalocanaḥ..7..
meaning:
निशासु नष्टचन्द्रासु तन्मुखो द्योतितप्रभे ..
देशे तां रमयामास राजा राजीवलोचनः..7..
text_mt: On moonless nights, in places illuminated by the splendor of her face, / the lotus-eyed king delighted her.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣayantī narendrasya sā tu kāmaṃ dinedine ..
adṛṣṭapūrveva śubhā bhavatyāyatalocanā ..8..
meaning:
वर्षयन्ती नरेन्द्रस्य सा तु कामं दिनेदिने ..
अदृष्टपूर्वेव शुभा भवत्यायतलोचना ..8..
text_mt: Raining desire upon the lord of men day after day, / that auspicious, large-eyed woman seemed as if never seen before.

sanskrit_iast:
rājño dṛḍhaṃ sā dayitā tasyāśca dviguṇo nṛpaḥ ..
tayā'sau prīyate rājā tena sāpi varāṅganā .. 9 ..
meaning:
राज्ञो दृढं सा दयिता तस्याश्च द्विगुणो नृपः ..
तयाऽसौ प्रीयते राजा तेन सापि वराङ्गना .. 9 ..
text_mt: She was deeply beloved of the king, and doubly so was the king of her; / the king was delighted by her, and that excellent woman was also [delighted] by him.

sanskrit_iast:
varacandanadigdhāṅgau nānābharaṇabhūṣitau ..
remāte dampatī hṛṣṭau nānāratnāvabhūṣitau .. 1.134.10 ..
meaning:
वरचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गौ नानाभरणभूषितौ ..
रेमाते दम्पती हृष्टौ नानारत्नावभूषितौ .. 1.134.10 ..
text_mt: Their limbs smeared with choice sandalwood, adorned with various ornaments, / the joyful couple disported, adorned with various jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkaroti tāṃ rājā svayameva kadācana ..
tayā'laṃkriyamāṇaśca prītimāpnotyanuttamām .. 11 ..
meaning:
अलङ्करोति तां राजा स्वयमेव कदाचन ..
तयाऽलंक्रियमाणश्च प्रीतिमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Sometimes the king would adorn her himself, / and being adorned by her, he attained unsurpassed joy.

sanskrit_iast:
vareṣu tau vicitreṣu remāte muditau bhṛśam ..
keśānsaṃśobhayantau tau kusumaistu parasparam .. 12 ..
meaning:
वरेषु तौ विचित्रेषु रेमाते मुदितौ भृशम् ..
केशान्संशोभयन्तौ तौ कुसुमैस्तु परस्परम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: In choice, variegated [places], the two disported, greatly delighted, / adorning each other's hair with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyabhyuditaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā ca grathitaṃ punaḥ ..
dhārayāmāsa śirasā premṇā pārthivasattamaḥ.. 13..
meaning:
उर्वश्यभ्युदितं पुष्पं तथा च ग्रथितं पुनः ..
धारयामास शिरसा प्रेम्णा पार्थिवसत्तमः.. 13..
text_mt: The flower presented and also woven by Urvaśī, / the best of kings wore on his head with love.

sanskrit_iast:
patracchedena yām̐ścakre tilakānsa narādhipaḥ ..
tām̐śca sā dhārayāmāsa lalāṭe cāruhāsinī .. 14..
meaning:
पत्रच्छेदेन याम्̐श्चक्रे तिलकान्स नराधिपः ..
ताम्̐श्च सा धारयामास ललाटे चारुहासिनी .. 14..
text_mt: The forehead-marks that the king made with leaf-patterns, / the sweet-smiling woman wore upon her forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃkrīḍato rājñastayā saha sumadhyayā ..
babhūvustanayāḥ pañca nāmatastānnibodha me .. 15 ..
meaning:
एवं संक्रीडतो राज्ञस्तया सह सुमध्यया ..
बभूवुस्तनयाः पञ्च नामतस्तान्निबोध मे .. 15 ..
text_mt: While the king thus sported with that slender-waisted woman, / five sons were born; learn them from me by name:

sanskrit_iast:
āyurjyeṣṭhastato dhīmām̐stataścānyastvanāmayaḥ ..
ayutāyuścaturtho'bhūcchatāyuścaiva pañcamaḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
आयुर्ज्येष्ठस्ततो धीमाम्̐स्ततश्चान्यस्त्वनामयः ..
अयुतायुश्चतुर्थोऽभूच्छतायुश्चैव पञ्चमः .. 16 ..
text_mt: Āyu was the eldest, then the wise [Amāvasu], and after him another, Anāmaya; / Ayutāyu was the fourth, and Śatāyu was the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tasyāḥ prasūtā vai yāti kāle manohare .. 17 ..
meaning: एवं तस्याः प्रसूता वै याति काले मनोहरे .. 17 ..
text_mt: As delightful time passed, she indeed gave birth [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvamukhyāstu tadā sametā tayā vihīnā bhṛśamutsukāstu ..
tadāgamāyātha surendraloke yatra tadā cakruradīnasattvāḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वमुख्यास्तु तदा समेता तया विहीना भृशमुत्सुकास्तु ..
तदागमायाथ सुरेन्द्रलोके यत्र तदा चक्रुरदीनसत्त्वाः .. 18 ..
text_mt: Then the foremost Gandharvas, having gathered, were exceedingly longing without her; / and those beings of undaunted spirit then made an effort in the world of the lord of gods for her return.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
urvaśyāgamane yatnaṃ cakruste mantramuttamam ..
gandharvastūgrasenākhyastadā mantramabhāṣata .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
उर्वश्यागमने यत्नं चक्रुस्ते मन्त्रमुत्तमम् ..
गन्धर्वस्तूग्रसेनाख्यस्तदा मन्त्रमभाषत .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / They formulated an excellent plan to bring about Urvaśī's return. / Then the Gandharva named Ugrasena spoke a counsel:
title: Purūravāpralāpavarṇanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
ugrasena uvāca ..
samayevasthitā tasminnurvaśī cārubhūṣaṇā ..
vyutkrāntasamayaṃ sā tu rājānaṃ tyakṣyate ca tam ..2 ..
meaning:
उग्रसेन उवाच ..
समयेवस्थिता तस्मिन्नुर्वशी चारुभूषणा ..
व्युत्क्रान्तसमयं सा तु राजानं त्यक्ष्यते च तम् ..2 ..
text_mt: Ugrasena said: / Urvaśī of beautiful ornaments stands bound by an agreement; / she will abandon that king if he breaches the agreement.

sanskrit_iast:
tamahaṃ vedmi samayaṃ tatra yāsyāmi cānagha ..
yuṣmatkāryaṃ kariṣyāmi sasahāyo na saṃśayaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
तमहं वेद्मि समयं तत्र यास्यामि चानघ ..
युष्मत्कार्यं करिष्यामि ससहायो न संशयः .. 3 ..
text_mt: I know that agreement; and I shall go there, O sinless one. / With companions, I shall accomplish your purpose, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā yayau tatra yatrāsau nṛpatiḥ sthitaḥ ..
rātrau jahāra meṣaṃ ca māyayā sa narādhipa .. 4 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ तत्र यत्रासौ नृपतिः स्थितः ..
रात्रौ जहार मेषं च मायया स नराधिप .. 4 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, he went to where that king was staying; / and at night, O ruler of men, he carried off a ram by means of illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣaṃ jñātvā hṛtaṃ devī rājānamidamabravīt ..
meṣo hṛto mahīpāla kenāpyaddhā suto mama .. 5 ..
meaning:
मेषं ज्ञात्वा हृतं देवी राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ..
मेषो हृतो महीपाल केनाप्यद्धा सुतो मम .. 5 ..
text_mt: Knowing the ram had been taken, the goddess said this to the king: / 'The ram, indeed my son, has been carried off by someone, O protector of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaśca hṛto rājam̐stamānaya sutaṃ mama ..
evamuktastayā rājā nagna evātha saṃbhramāt .. 6 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयश्च हृतो राजम्̐स्तमानय सुतं मम ..
एवमुक्तस्तया राजा नग्न एवाथ संभ्रमात् .. 6 ..
text_mt: And the second one has been carried off, O king! Bring back my son!' / Addressed thus by her, the king, in his haste, [went] naked as he was;

sanskrit_iast:
utthāyānveṣaṇaṃ cakre meṣayoḥ puruṣarṣabha ..
athāpaśyata sā nagnaṃ rājānamasitekṣaṇā .. 7 ..
meaning:
उत्थायान्वेषणं चक्रे मेषयोः पुरुषर्षभ ..
अथापश्यत सा नग्नं राजानमसितेक्षणा .. 7 ..
text_mt: rising up, he made a search for the two rams, O bull among men. / Then the dark-eyed woman saw the king naked.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmṛtya nāradavacastirobhūtā babhūva sā ..
gandharvāṇāṃ yayau sāpi samīpaṃ duḥkhitā tadā .. 8 ..
meaning:
संस्मृत्य नारदवचस्तिरोभूता बभूव सा ..
गन्धर्वाणां ययौ सापि समीपं दुःखिता तदा .. 8 ..
text_mt: Remembering Nārada's words, she vanished; / and she, sorrowful then, went near the Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ prāpya viśālākṣī nityaṃ nṛpaparāyaṇā ..
kāmanunnaśarīrāpi kālaṃ nayati sundarī .. 9..
meaning:
स्वर्गं प्राप्य विशालाक्षी नित्यं नृपपरायणा ..
कामनुन्नशरीरापि कालं नयति सुन्दरी .. 9..
text_mt: Having reached heaven, the wide-eyed woman, ever devoted to the king, / spent her time, her body stricken with desire, lovely as she was.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiśāpabhayādbhītā madanena vaśīkṛtā ..
nityamāsa varārohā niḥśvāsaparamā satī . 1.135.10 ..
meaning:
ऋषिशापभयाद्भीता मदनेन वशीकृता ..
नित्यमास वरारोहा निःश्वासपरमा सती . 1.135.10 ..
text_mt: Terrified by fear of the sage's curse, subdued by love, / that virtuous woman of lovely hips remained constantly given to deep sighs.

sanskrit_iast:
aprāpya meṣayugalaṃ vinivṛtto narādhipaḥ ..
nāpaśyacchayane devīṃ sasmāra samayaṃ tadā ..11..
meaning:
अप्राप्य मेषयुगलं विनिवृत्तो नराधिपः ..
नापश्यच्छयने देवीं सस्मार समयं तदा ..11..
text_mt: Not finding the pair of rams, the lord of men returned; / he did not see the goddess on the couch, and then he remembered the agreement.

sanskrit_iast:
viditvā tyaktamātmānaṃ smṛtvā samayamātmanaḥ ..
kāmabāṇārdito rājā tathāpi vijane vane..12..
meaning:
विदित्वा त्यक्तमात्मानं स्मृत्वा समयमात्मनः ..
कामबाणार्दितो राजा तथापि विजने वने..12..
text_mt: Knowing himself abandoned, remembering his own agreement, / the king, tormented by the arrows of desire, nonetheless in the desolate forest

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ mārgati varārohāmunmatta iva sarvataḥ ..
ekākī vijane rājā priyayā rahitastadā .. 13 ..
meaning:
तां मार्गति वरारोहामुन्मत्त इव सर्वतः ..
एकाकी विजने राजा प्रियया रहितस्तदा .. 13 ..
text_mt: sought that woman of lovely hips everywhere like one mad. / Alone in the desolate place, deprived of his beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
vilalāpa mahāsattvaḥ kusattva iva kaścana ..
purūravā uvāca ..
kva gatāsi viśālākṣi vihāya vijanetra mām..14..
meaning:
विललाप महासत्त्वः कुसत्त्व इव कश्चन ..
पुरूरवा उवाच ..
क्व गतासि विशालाक्षि विहाय विजनेत्र माम्..14..
text_mt: the king of great courage lamented like someone of weak spirit: / Purūravas said: / 'Where have you gone, O wide-eyed one, abandoning me here in the desolate place?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ pravekṣyāmi puraṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ vinā tvayā ..
prāṇāstyaktvā gamiṣyanti śarīraṃ mama sundari .. 15 ..
meaning:
कथं प्रवेक्ष्यामि पुरं प्रतिष्ठानं विना त्वया ..
प्राणास्त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यन्ति शरीरं मम सुन्दरि .. 15 ..
text_mt: How shall I enter the city of Pratiṣṭhāna without you? / Abandoning my body, my life-breaths will depart, O beautiful one!

sanskrit_iast:
anugantuṃ śarīreṇa na śaknomi varānane ..
tvaṃ hi me capalāpāṅgi prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī .. 16 ..
meaning:
अनुगन्तुं शरीरेण न शक्नोमि वरानने ..
त्वं हि मे चपलापाङ्गि प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी .. 16 ..
text_mt: I cannot follow you with my body, O fair-faced one! / For to me, O woman with glancing eyes, you are dearer than life itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā tyakto dhruvaṃ prāṇām̐styakṣyāmi varavarṇini ..
kvāsi kvāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kiṃ karomi vrajāmi kām .. 17 ..
meaning:
त्वया त्यक्तो ध्रुवं प्राणाम्̐स्त्यक्ष्यामि वरवर्णिनि ..
क्वासि क्वाहं गमिष्यामि किं करोमि व्रजामि काम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: Abandoned by you, I shall surely abandon my life-breaths, O woman of excellent complexion! / Where are you? Where shall I go? What shall I do? To whom shall I turn?

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ kāmataptasya ko me saṃdarśayetpriyām ..
kaṃ svitpṛcchāmi vijane kasya sā viditā bhavet .. 18 ..
meaning:
शरणं कामतप्तस्य को मे संदर्शयेत्प्रियाम् ..
कं स्वित्पृच्छामि विजने कस्य सा विदिता भवेत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: Who will show my beloved to me, afflicted by desire, seeking refuge? / Whom indeed shall I ask in this desolate place? To whom might she be known?

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemo vā mama kasya syādyo me saṃdarśayetpriyām ..
priyāvirahitasyaiṣa niśāśeṣo gato mama .. 39 ..
meaning:
क्षेमो वा मम कस्य स्याद्यो मे संदर्शयेत्प्रियाम् ..
प्रियाविरहितस्यैष निशाशेषो गतो मम .. 39 ..
text_mt: Or from whom could safety come to me, who would show my beloved to me? / Deprived of my beloved, this remainder of the night has passed for me.

sanskrit_iast:
antardhānaṃ gatāstārā yathā devī mamorvaśī ..
devo'ruṇakarasparśācchobhāṃ tyajati candramāḥ .. 1.135.20 ..
meaning:
अन्तर्धानं गतास्तारा यथा देवी ममोर्वशी ..
देवोऽरुणकरस्पर्शाच्छोभां त्यजति चन्द्रमाः .. 1.135.20 ..
text_mt: The stars have vanished, just as my goddess Urvaśī has; / touched by the rays of the dawn, the divine moon loses its splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
niśākṣaye kṣāmavapuryathāhaṃ tadvinākṛtaḥ ..
eṣā hyāvartate pūrvā sandhyā snātvā dvijātayaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
निशाक्षये क्षामवपुर्यथाहं तद्विनाकृतः ..
एषा ह्यावर्तते पूर्वा सन्ध्या स्नात्वा द्विजातयः .. 21 ..
text_mt: with an emaciated form at the end of night, just as I, deprived of her. / For this eastern twilight returns; having bathed, the twice-born

sanskrit_iast:
nūnaṃ niyamasaṃyuktāstiṣṭhanti vijitendriyāḥ ..
ayaṃ hyudayamāyāti savitā raktamaṇḍalaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
नूनं नियमसंयुक्तास्तिष्ठन्ति विजितेन्द्रियाः ..
अयं ह्युदयमायाति सविता रक्तमण्डलः .. 22 ..
text_mt: surely stand observing their vows, with their senses subdued. / For here rises the sun with its crimson disc.'

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasattvasamo devaḥ sarveṣāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ ..
uditaścāpyayaṃ sūryo vibhāti vimalembare .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वसत्त्वसमो देवः सर्वेषां पापनाशनः ..
उदितश्चाप्ययं सूर्यो विभाति विमलेम्बरे .. 23 ..
text_mt: The god who is impartial to all beings, the destroyer of sins for all, / and now this sun has risen and shines in the clear sky,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ phullaṃ mahāpadmaṃ sarasīvāmale yathā ..
uditaṃ bhāskaraṃ jñātvā nalinīpadmalocanā .. 24 ..
meaning:
एकं फुल्लं महापद्मं सरसीवामले यथा ..
उदितं भास्करं ज्ञात्वा नलिनीपद्मलोचना .. 24 ..
text_mt: like a single, great blooming lotus in a clear lake. / Having known that the sun has risen, lotus-eyed woman, the lotus cluster,

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlyālokate sarvaṃ vinā tena nimīlitā ..
tīkṣṇārkaḥ saṃpravṛtto'yaṃ divasaḥ kāmavardhanaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
उन्मील्यालोकते सर्वं विना तेन निमीलिता ..
तीक्ष्णार्कः संप्रवृत्तोऽयं दिवसः कामवर्धनः .. 25 ..
text_mt: opening, beholds everything; without him, she is closed. / This day of the fierce sun has begun, increasing love.

sanskrit_iast:
naidāgho māṃ viśeṣeṇa santāpayati tāṃ vinā ..
kaṃ pṛcchāmi varārohāṃ saṃtaptakanakaprabhām .. 26 ..
meaning:
नैदाघो मां विशेषेण सन्तापयति तां विना ..
कं पृच्छामि वरारोहां संतप्तकनकप्रभाम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: The summer heat torments me especially, without her. / Whom shall I ask about the fair-hipped woman, radiant as molten gold?

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭā mayeti sā devī ko māṃ vakṣyati kānane ..
karīndrastvayamabhyeti tatkucābhau samudvahan .. 27 ..
meaning:
दृष्टा मयेति सा देवी को मां वक्ष्यति कानने ..
करीन्द्रस्त्वयमभ्येति तत्कुचाभौ समुद्वहन् .. 27 ..
text_mt: 'She has been seen by me,' who will tell me thus of that lady in the forest? / Here comes the lordly elephant, bearing [two frontal globes] resembling her breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhau kaṭhorau sumukhaṃ pṛcchāmyenaṃ mataṅgajam ..
tvaddantayugalaprakhyaṃ yadūruyugalaṃ hyabhūt .. 28 ..
meaning:
कुम्भौ कठोरौ सुमुखं पृच्छाम्येनं मतङ्गजम् ..
त्वद्दन्तयुगलप्रख्यं यदूरुयुगलं ह्यभूत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: two firm frontal lobes; I ask this handsome-faced elephant: / 'Her pair of thighs was indeed like your pair of tusks;

sanskrit_iast:
gatāṃ tāṃ yadi jānīṣe kathayasva mamorvaśīm ..
eṣa hastī gatastrāsātsiṃhasyāsya mahātmanaḥ .. 29..
meaning:
गतां तां यदि जानीषे कथयस्व ममोर्वशीम् ..
एष हस्ती गतस्त्रासात्सिंहस्यास्य महात्मनः .. 29..
text_mt: if you know where she has gone, tell me of my Urvaśī.' / This elephant has fled out of fear from this mighty lion.

sanskrit_iast:
adattvaivottaraṃ mahyaṃ siṃhaṃ pṛcchāmyahaṃ vane ..
madhyastvadupamastasyāḥ kva sā samprati kesarin ..1.135.30..
meaning:
अदत्त्वैवोत्तरं मह्यं सिंहं पृच्छाम्यहं वने ..
मध्यस्त्वदुपमस्तस्याः क्व सा सम्प्रति केसरिन् ..1.135.30..
text_mt: Without giving me any answer at all! I will ask the lion in the forest: / 'Her waist is like yours; where is she now, O maned beast?

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī dayitā mahyaṃ yadi jānāsi kathyatām ..
adattvaivottaraṃ siṃhaḥ kathameṣa gato mama .. 31 ..
meaning:
उर्वशी दयिता मह्यं यदि जानासि कथ्यताम् ..
अदत्त्वैवोत्तरं सिंहः कथमेष गतो मम .. 31 ..
text_mt: If you know of Urvaśī, my beloved, let it be told!' / Without giving me any answer, how has this lion departed?

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭā kathaya he bimba devīṃ bimbaphalādharām ..
anenāpi na cākhyātā pṛṣṭena sudatī mama .. 32 ..
meaning:
दृष्टा कथय हे बिम्ब देवीं बिम्बफलाधराम् ..
अनेनापि न चाख्याता पृष्टेन सुदती मम .. 32 ..
text_mt: Tell me, O bimba fruit, have you seen the lady whose lips are like a bimba fruit? / Even questioned by me, he too has not told me of my sweet-toothed love.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūra yadi jānīṣe bālāṃ bālamṛgekṣaṇām ..
urvaśīṃ kathayasvādya kva priyā mama vartate .. 33 ..
meaning:
मयूर यदि जानीषे बालां बालमृगेक्षणाम् ..
उर्वशीं कथयस्वाद्य क्व प्रिया मम वर्तते .. 33 ..
text_mt: O peacock, if you know the young maiden with eyes like a young deer, / tell me today of Urvaśī: where does my beloved dwell?

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥśarīraṃ kāmāgnirbahirdahati bhāskaraḥ ..
tāpārttā niḥśvasantyete siṃhā giriguhāgatāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
अन्तःशरीरं कामाग्निर्बहिर्दहति भास्करः ..
तापार्त्ता निःश्वसन्त्येते सिंहा गिरिगुहागताः .. 34 ..
text_mt: The fire of love burns within my body; the sun burns outside. / Tormented by the heat, these lions residing in mountain caves gasp for breath,

sanskrit_iast:
nirastajihvāḥ srastāṅgā vivṛtāsyā muhurmuhuḥ ..
yūthāni mahiṣīṇāṃ ca śerate nalinījale .. 35 ..
meaning:
निरस्तजिह्वाः स्रस्ताङ्गा विवृतास्या मुहुर्मुहुः ..
यूथानि महिषीणां च शेरते नलिनीजले .. 35 ..
text_mt: with tongues hanging out, limbs limp, mouths gaping repeatedly. / And herds of buffalo cows lie in the lotus-covered water;

sanskrit_iast:
sūryoddhatajalāsvanye paṅkaśeṣā su śerate ..
gaganaṃ cātakaścāyaṃ tṛṣṇārto lokate muhuḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
सूर्योद्धतजलास्वन्ये पङ्कशेषा सु शेरते ..
गगनं चातकश्चायं तृष्णार्तो लोकते मुहुः .. 36 ..
text_mt: others lie where the water has been dried up by the sun, where only mud remains. / And this cātaka bird, afflicted with thirst, gazes repeatedly at the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
su bhṛśaṃ toyapānārthī urvaśyarthe yathā tvaham ..
yāntyete padminī khaṇḍānkuñjarāstāparūṣitāḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
सु भृशं तोयपानार्थी उर्वश्यर्थे यथा त्वहम् ..
यान्त्येते पद्मिनी खण्डान्कुञ्जरास्तापरूषिताः .. 37 ..
text_mt: greatly longing to drink water, just as I yearn for Urvaśī. / Smeared with the heat, these elephants go to clumps of lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
suhastamuktaiśca jalaiḥ siṃcantyātmānamātmanā ..
mahādrumāṇāṃ skandheṣu viṣaṇṇāścāpare gajāḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
सुहस्तमुक्तैश्च जलैः सिंचन्त्यात्मानमात्मना ..
महाद्रुमाणां स्कन्धेषु विषण्णाश्चापरे गजाः .. 38 ..
text_mt: with waters released by their trunks, they sprinkle themselves by themselves. / And other dejected elephants at the trunks of great trees

sanskrit_iast:
tāpaṃ nayanti madhyāhne muñcantaḥ śīkaraṃ muhuḥ ..
śākhāparṇāntarāṇyete vihagāstāpatāpitāḥ .. 39 ..
meaning:
तापं नयन्ति मध्याह्ने मुञ्चन्तः शीकरं मुहुः ..
शाखापर्णान्तराण्येते विहगास्तापतापिताः .. 39 ..
text_mt: endure the heat at midday, repeatedly discharging spray. / Scorched by the heat, these birds

sanskrit_iast:
viśanti caiva trāṇārthaṃ madhyāhnasamaye bhṛśam ..
drumaśākhāgatā hyete vihagānāṃ ca bālakāḥ .. 1.135.40 ..
meaning:
विशन्ति चैव त्राणार्थं मध्याह्नसमये भृशम् ..
द्रुमशाखागता ह्येते विहगानां च बालकाः .. 1.135.40 ..
text_mt: enter the space between the leafy branches exceedingly for protection at midday. / Resting upon the branches of trees, these young of birds,

sanskrit_iast:
raktāntacakrāḥ subhṛśaṃ viśantīha muhurmuhuḥ ..
tyaktāhārakriyāścaite mṛgayūthā mahāvane .. 41 ..
meaning:
रक्तान्तचक्राः सुभृशं विशन्तीह मुहुर्मुहुः ..
त्यक्ताहारक्रियाश्चैते मृगयूथा महावने .. 41 ..
text_mt: having circles with red edges, enter here repeatedly in great numbers. / And abandoning the act of grazing, these herds of deer in the great forest

sanskrit_iast:
drumacchāyāsu tiṣṭhanti romanthaṃ kurvuto muhuḥ ..
anveṣamāṇo dayitāṃ śrīto'smi vijaye bhṛśam .. 42 ..
meaning:
द्रुमच्छायासु तिष्ठन्ति रोमन्थं कुर्वुतो मुहुः ..
अन्वेषमाणो दयितां श्रीतोऽस्मि विजये भृशम् .. 42 ..
text_mt: stand in the shade of the trees, chewing the cud again and again. / Searching for my beloved, I am exceedingly exhausted in my quest.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāyāṃ viśramiṣyāmi śirīṣasyāsya sāmpratam ..
tadgātrasukumārāṇi puṣpāṇyasya vanaspateḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
छायायां विश्रमिष्यामि शिरीषस्यास्य साम्प्रतम् ..
तद्गात्रसुकुमाराणि पुष्पाण्यस्य वनस्पतेः .. 43 ..
text_mt: I shall rest now in the shade of this śirīṣa tree; / the flowers of this lord of the forest are as delicate as her limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
śirīṣavṛkṣo ramyo'yaṃ manohṛdayanandanaḥ..
kintu māṃ pīḍayatyeṣa śirīṣastadvinākṛtam .. 44 ..
meaning:
शिरीषवृक्षो रम्योऽयं मनोहृदयनन्दनः..
किन्तु मां पीडयत्येष शिरीषस्तद्विनाकृतम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: This charming śirīṣa tree brings delight to mind and heart; / but this śirīṣa torments me who am deprived of her.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaścāstamupāyāti kva gamiṣyāmi śarvarīm ..
astaṃ yātaḥ sahasrāṃśurniśā prāptā sudāruṇā..45..
meaning:
सूर्यश्चास्तमुपायाति क्व गमिष्यामि शर्वरीम् ..
अस्तं यातः सहस्रांशुर्निशा प्राप्ता सुदारुणा..45..
text_mt: And the sun goes to setting; where shall I spend the night? / The thousand-rayed one has set; the very dreadful night has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrimenāṃ vivatsyāmi nyagrodhe'sminmahādrume ..
urvaśyā ṛddhiracite varaveśmani pārthivaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
रात्रिमेनां विवत्स्यामि न्यग्रोधेऽस्मिन्महाद्रुमे ..
उर्वश्या ऋद्धिरचिते वरवेश्मनि पार्थिवः .. 46 ..
text_mt: I will spend this night in this great banyan tree. / In the excellent palace fashioned by Urvaśī's supernatural power, the king

sanskrit_iast:
sa krīḍati tayā sārdhaṃ sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ ..
nūnaṃ māṃ sa jano vetti pratiṣṭhānapure tu me .. 47 ..
meaning:
स क्रीडति तया सार्धं सर्वकामैः सुपूजितः ..
नूनं मां स जनो वेत्ति प्रतिष्ठानपुरे तु मे .. 47 ..
text_mt: plays with her, thoroughly honoured with all desired pleasures: / surely those people in my city of Pratiṣṭhāna think of me [in that way].

sanskrit_iast:
etāmavasthāṃ kaścinme na vijānāti sāmpratam ..
pauro jānapadaḥ kaścijjano me dayitaḥ sadā .. 48 ..
meaning:
एतामवस्थां कश्चिन्मे न विजानाति साम्प्रतम् ..
पौरो जानपदः कश्चिज्जनो मे दयितः सदा .. 48 ..
text_mt: No one now knows this state of mine— / whether citizen or countryman, who are always dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
nidre bhajasva mannetre dhruvaṃ svapne varānanāma ..
tāṃ tu prāpsyāmyahaṃ saumyāṃ manasaḥ prītivardhinīm .. 49 ..
meaning:
निद्रे भजस्व मन्नेत्रे ध्रुवं स्वप्ने वराननाम ..
तां तु प्राप्स्याम्यहं सौम्यां मनसः प्रीतिवर्धिनीम् .. 49 ..
text_mt: O Sleep, visit my eyes! Surely in a dream that fair-faced lady, / gentle, increasing the delight of my mind, will be reached by me.

sanskrit_iast:
kathamabhyuditaścandraḥ pīḍāṃ janayate mama ..
tadvaktravijitaḥ pūrvaṃ vikarotyadhunā mayi .. 1.135.50 ..
meaning:
कथमभ्युदितश्चन्द्रः पीडां जनयते मम ..
तद्वक्त्रविजितः पूर्वं विकरोत्यधुना मयि .. 1.135.50 ..
text_mt: How is it that the risen moon produces torment in me? / Conquered by her face formerly, he now wreaks hostility upon me.

sanskrit_iast:
tuda candra yathākāmaṃ mama dehaṃ vinākṛtam ..
tvayā tu nāthaṃ saṃprāpya sāpatnyaṃ mama darśaya .. 51 ..
meaning:
तुद चन्द्र यथाकामं मम देहं विनाकृतम् ..
त्वया तु नाथं संप्राप्य सापत्न्यं मम दर्शय .. 51 ..
text_mt: Pierce, O moon, at will, my body that is bereft [of her]! / Having found a protector in you, show your rivalry towards me!

sanskrit_iast:
hā hato'smi vinaṣṭo'smi urvaśyā rahito vane ..
candra pautre kuru dayāṃ darśayasva mama priyām .. 52 ..
meaning:
हा हतोऽस्मि विनष्टोऽस्मि उर्वश्या रहितो वने ..
चन्द्र पौत्रे कुरु दयां दर्शयस्व मम प्रियाम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: Alas, I am undone! I am ruined, bereft of Urvaśī in the forest! / O moon, show mercy to your grandson; show me my beloved!

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṅka deva śītāṃśo nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭimanohara ..
ākrandāmi tavādyāhaṃ darśayasva priyāṃ mama .. 53 ..
meaning:
शशाङ्क देव शीतांशो नृणां दृष्टिमनोहर ..
आक्रन्दामि तवाद्याहं दर्शयस्व प्रियां मम .. 53 ..
text_mt: O god Moon, cool-rayed one, captivating the sight of men! / I cry out to you today: show me my beloved!

sanskrit_iast:
atṛpta darśanasyaiva sā gatā sundarī mama ..
antardhānaṃ viśālākṣī tāṃ darśaya mamorvaśīm ..54 ..
meaning:
अतृप्त दर्शनस्यैव सा गता सुन्दरी मम ..
अन्तर्धानं विशालाक्षी तां दर्शय ममोर्वशीम् ..54 ..
text_mt: While my sight was yet unsated, that beautiful woman of mine vanished, / the large-eyed one! Show me that Urvaśī of mine!

sanskrit_iast:
kadā'dhararasaṃ tasyāḥ pāsyāmyamṛtasannibham ..
kadā draṣṭāsmi tāṃ bhūyaḥ kamalodarasannibhām ..55..
meaning:
कदाऽधररसं तस्याः पास्याम्यमृतसन्निभम् ..
कदा द्रष्टास्मि तां भूयः कमलोदरसन्निभाम् ..55..
text_mt: When shall I drink the nectar of her lip, which is like ambrosia? / When shall I see her again, whose colour is like the interior of a lotus?

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṇālabāhuyugalāṃ padmavaktrāṃ kadā priyām ..
nīlotpalākṣīmāliṅgya tāpaṃ tyakṣyāmyanaṅgajam..56..
meaning:
मृणालबाहुयुगलां पद्मवक्त्रां कदा प्रियाम् ..
नीलोत्पलाक्षीमालिङ्ग्य तापं त्यक्ष्याम्यनङ्गजम्..56..
text_mt: When, embracing my beloved who has lotus-stalk arms, / a lotus face, and eyes like blue water-lilies, shall I cast off the heat born of the Bodiless One?

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgaśaranunnasya bāle bhava gatirmama ..
dadasva darśanaṃ subhrūḥ kā mamānyā gatirbhavet ..57 ..
meaning:
अनङ्गशरनुन्नस्य बाले भव गतिर्मम ..
ददस्व दर्शनं सुभ्रूः का ममान्या गतिर्भवेत् ..57 ..
text_mt: O young woman, be the refuge of me struck by the arrows of the Bodiless One! / Grant your sight, O fair-browed one! What other refuge could there be for me?

sanskrit_iast:
kāmamohagṛhītasya tvamevābhūrgatirmama ..
bhūyastvameva subhage gatirbhava mamānaghe .. 58 ..
meaning:
काममोहगृहीतस्य त्वमेवाभूर्गतिर्मम ..
भूयस्त्वमेव सुभगे गतिर्भव ममानघे .. 58 ..
text_mt: For me seized by the infatuation of love, you alone were my refuge. / Once more, O fortunate one, be my refuge, O faultless lady!

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā viralitā rātrirmama varṣaśatopamā ..
anveṣṭuṃ kva gamiṣyāmi nirghṛṇāṃ tāṃ mamopari .. 59 ..
meaning:
एषा विरलिता रात्रिर्मम वर्षशतोपमा ..
अन्वेष्टुं क्व गमिष्यामि निर्घृणां तां ममोपरि .. 59 ..
text_mt: This night has faded, which was like a hundred years to me. / Where shall I go to search for her who is pitiless toward me?

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ kopaṃ na jānāmi svapne'pi varavarṇini ..
daivenopahatasyādya tyaktā sā subhagā gatā .. 1.135.60 ..
meaning:
यस्याः कोपं न जानामि स्वप्नेऽपि वरवर्णिनि ..
दैवेनोपहतस्याद्य त्यक्ता सा सुभगा गता .. 1.135.60 ..
text_mt: Whose anger I did not know even in a dream, O fair-complexioned one! / Struck down by fate today, that lovely woman has left and gone.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ sa vilapanrājā tyaktāhāraḥ paribhraman .
āsasāda kurukṣetraṃ dvādaśāhena pārthiva..61..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवं स विलपन्राजा त्यक्ताहारः परिभ्रमन् .
आससाद कुरुक्षेत्रं द्वादशाहेन पार्थिव..61..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus that king, lamenting, giving up food, wandering about, / reached Kurukṣetra in twelve days, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkariṇyāstaṭaplakṣe puṣkarairupaśobhite .
niṣasāda tadā śrāntaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamanvitaḥ..
vilalāpa sa tatrāpi madanena vaśīkṛtaḥ .. 62 ..
meaning:
पुष्करिण्यास्तटप्लक्षे पुष्करैरुपशोभिते .
निषसाद तदा श्रान्तः क्षुत्पिपासासमन्वितः..
विललाप स तत्रापि मदनेन वशीकृतः .. 62 ..
text_mt: On the plakṣa tree on the bank of a lotus pond, adorned with blue lotuses, / he sat down then, exhausted, beset with hunger and thirst; / there too he lamented, overpowered by love:

sanskrit_iast:
kadā nu taccandramaso'nukānti mukhaṃ smitaṃ cāruvilocanāyāḥ..
unnāmya pāsyāmyadharaṃ tṛṣārto vārīva pānthaḥ pathi kṛcchralabhyam .. 63 ..
meaning:
कदा नु तच्चन्द्रमसोऽनुकान्ति मुखं स्मितं चारुविलोचनायाः..
उन्नाम्य पास्याम्यधरं तृषार्तो वारीव पान्थः पथि कृच्छ्रलभ्यम् .. 63 ..
text_mt: "When indeed, having lifted up the smiling face resembling the beauty of the moon of that lady of lovely eyes, / shall I, afflicted by thirst, drink her lower lip, as a traveler on a path drinks water obtained with difficulty?"

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
urvaśyapi varārohā madanenābhipīḍitā ..
jagāda nāradasyātha svāmavasthāṃ nṛpaṃ vinā .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
उर्वश्यपि वरारोहा मदनेनाभिपीडिता ..
जगाद नारदस्याथ स्वामवस्थां नृपं विना .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Urvaśī also, the fair-hipped lady, intensely tormented by love, / then spoke of her own condition without the king to Nārada:
title: adhyāyaḥ 136

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāṃ nāradaḥ prāha subhage gaccha pārthivam ..
tasyāpyavasthā mahatī tvadvihīnasya sundari ..2 ..
meaning:
ततस्तां नारदः प्राह सुभगे गच्छ पार्थिवम् ..
तस्याप्यवस्था महती त्वद्विहीनस्य सुन्दरि ..2 ..
text_mt: Then Nārada said to her: "O fortunate woman, go to the king. / Great also is his plight, deprived of you, O beautiful woman.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃ rātriṃ narendreṇa sahoṣya varavarṇini ..
svargalokamupāgaccha śreyaḥ prāpsyasi vai tataḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
एकां रात्रिं नरेन्द्रेण सहोष्य वरवर्णिनि ..
स्वर्गलोकमुपागच्छ श्रेयः प्राप्स्यसि वै ततः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having spent one night with the lord of men, O fair-complexioned woman, / return to heaven; thence you will surely attain the highest good."

sanskrit_iast:
nāradenaivamuktā sā sakhībhirbahubhirvṛtā ..
puṣkariṇyāstaruplakṣe yayau snātuṃ varānanā .. 4 ..
meaning:
नारदेनैवमुक्ता सा सखीभिर्बहुभिर्वृता ..
पुष्करिण्यास्तरुप्लक्षे ययौ स्नातुं वरानना .. 4 ..
text_mt: Spoken to thus by Nārada, that fair-faced woman, surrounded by many companions, / went to bathe in a lotus pool beside a plakṣa tree.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu nidrayopahṛto nṛpaḥ ..
apsarobhiravajñātastatra suṣvāpa pārthiva .. 5 ..
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु निद्रयोपहृतो नृपः ..
अप्सरोभिरवज्ञातस्तत्र सुष्वाप पार्थिव .. 5 ..
text_mt: At that very time, the king, overcome by sleep, / disregardful of the apsarases, slept there, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
adya yāsyāmi rājānamiti hṛṣṭā tadorvaśī..
krīḍantyatra jale tasminsakhīgaṇavṛtā tadā .. 6 ..
meaning:
अद्य यास्यामि राजानमिति हृष्टा तदोर्वशी..
क्रीडन्त्यत्र जले तस्मिन्सखीगणवृता तदा .. 6 ..
text_mt: Joyful that 'Today I will go to the king', Urvaśī then, / playing in that water, surrounded by her troop of friends,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktanidro narendro'pi vilalāpa ciraṃ punaḥ ..
śuśrāva vilapantaṃ sā sakhībhiḥ sahitā nṛpam .. 7 ..
meaning:
त्यक्तनिद्रो नरेन्द्रोऽपि विललाप चिरं पुनः ..
शुश्राव विलपन्तं सा सखीभिः सहिता नृपम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Waking from sleep, the lord of men lamented again for a long time. / Accompanied by her companions, she heard the king lamenting.

sanskrit_iast:
darśayāmāma cātmānaṃ pārthivasya śubhā tataḥ ..
uvāca ca varārohā nāradoktamaśeṣataḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
दर्शयामाम चात्मानं पार्थिवस्य शुभा ततः ..
उवाच च वरारोहा नारदोक्तमशेषतः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Then the auspicious woman showed herself to the king, / and the shapely woman related everything spoken by Nārada without omission.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraivovāsa tāṃ rātriṃ saha tena varānanā ..
rātrikṣaye visaṃjñaṃ sā rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 9 ..
meaning:
तत्रैवोवास तां रात्रिं सह तेन वरानना ..
रात्रिक्षये विसंज्ञं सा राजानं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Right there that fair-faced woman spent that night with him. / At the end of the night, she spoke these words to the unconscious king:

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyuvāca ..
ārādhayasva gandharvānmohaṃ tyaktvā nareśvara ..
teṣāṃ prārthaya māṃ saumya tataḥ prāpsyasi mā ciram .. 1.136.10..
meaning:
उर्वश्युवाच ..
आराधयस्व गन्धर्वान्मोहं त्यक्त्वा नरेश्वर ..
तेषां प्रार्थय मां सौम्य ततः प्राप्स्यसि मा चिरम् .. 1.136.10..
text_mt: Urvaśī said: / "Worship the Gandharvas, casting off delusion, O lord of men! / Ask them for me, gentle one; then you will attain me without delay."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā yayau svargaṃ rājā tatraiva pārthiva ..
tapaḥ sa vipulaṃ cakre tadgatenaiva cetasā ..11 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ स्वर्गं राजा तत्रैव पार्थिव ..
तपः स विपुलं चक्रे तद्गतेनैव चेतसा ..11 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, she went to heaven. Right there, O ruler of the earth, / the king performed severe asceticism with his mind fixed solely on her.

sanskrit_iast:
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe sūryasyodayanaṃ prati ..
nāradaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā gandharvā darśanaṃ daduḥ ..12..
meaning:
अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति ..
नारदं पुरतः कृत्वा गन्धर्वा दर्शनं ददुः ..12..
text_mt: Then, when a full year had passed, toward the rising of the sun, / having placed Nārada at their head, the Gandharvas revealed themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā ūcuḥ ..
varaṃ varaya rājendra yadicchasi mahābhuja ..
vayaṃ hi tava dāsyāmaḥ sarva evāmaraprabhāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वा ऊचुः ..
वरं वरय राजेन्द्र यदिच्छसि महाभुज ..
वयं हि तव दास्यामः सर्व एवामरप्रभाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: The Gandharvas said: / "Choose a boon, O chief of kings, whatever you desire, O mighty-armed one! / For all of us, possessing the splendour of immortals, will grant it to you."

sanskrit_iast:
purūravā uvāca ..
bhavantaścetprasannā me yadi me rocate varam ..
urvaśī seha cārvaṅgī bhavadbhirmama dīyatām..14..
meaning:
पुरूरवा उवाच ..
भवन्तश्चेत्प्रसन्ना मे यदि मे रोचते वरम् ..
उर्वशी सेह चार्वङ्गी भवद्भिर्मम दीयताम्..14..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / "If you are pleased with me, if my boon pleases you, / let that lovely-limbed Urvaśī here be given to me by you."

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā ūcuḥ ..
sthālīṃ pūrṇāmimāṃ rājangṛhāṇāgnermahābhuja ..
asmādagniṃ tridhā kṛtvā yajasva vigatajvaraḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वा ऊचुः ..
स्थालीं पूर्णामिमां राजन्गृहाणाग्नेर्महाभुज ..
अस्मादग्निं त्रिधा कृत्वा यजस्व विगतज्वरः .. 15 ..
text_mt: The Gandharvas said: / "Take this vessel full of fire, O king, O mighty-armed one! / Dividing the fire from this into three parts, sacrifice, freed from anxiety.

sanskrit_iast:
vedoktena vidhānena gandharvatvamavāpsyasi ..
tretāgnipūrvasya vidherasminmanvantare bhavān ..16..
meaning:
वेदोक्तेन विधानेन गन्धर्वत्वमवाप्स्यसि ..
त्रेताग्निपूर्वस्य विधेरस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे भवान् ..16..
text_mt: By the rite prescribed in the Veda, you will attain the state of a Gandharva. / In this manvantara, you will be the revealer

sanskrit_iast:
bhavitā darśitā loke guruśca jagatīpatiḥ ..
gandharvatvamavāpyātha rājanprāpsyasyathorvaśīm .. 17 ..
meaning:
भविता दर्शिता लोके गुरुश्च जगतीपतिः ..
गन्धर्वत्वमवाप्याथ राजन्प्राप्स्यस्यथोर्वशीम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: and the teacher in the world of the rite preceded by the three fires, O ruler of the earth. / Having attained the state of a Gandharva, O king, you will then obtain Urvaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaramimaṃ sarvaṃ rantā ca tvaṃ tayā saha ..
manvantare gate rājannurvaśyā sahito bhavān .. 18 ..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरमिमं सर्वं रन्ता च त्वं तया सह ..
मन्वन्तरे गते राजन्नुर्वश्या सहितो भवान् .. 18 ..
text_mt: And you will delight with her through this entire manvantara. / When the manvantara has passed, O king, together with Urvaśī

sanskrit_iast:
pravekṣyati niśānāthaṃ somaṃ śītāṃśumujvalam ..
ādhāraṃ sarvalokasya pitṝṇāṃ sthānamuttamam .. 19 ..
meaning:
प्रवेक्ष्यति निशानाथं सोमं शीतांशुमुज्वलम् ..
आधारं सर्वलोकस्य पितॄणां स्थानमुत्तमम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: you will enter the bright, cool-rayed Soma, the lord of the night, / the support of all the worlds, the supreme abode of the ancestors."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
agnisthālīṃ nṛpe dattvā gandharvāstridivaṃ yayuḥ ...
athā''jagāma taṃ deśaṃ bālamādāya corvaśī .. 1.136.20 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अग्निस्थालीं नृपे दत्त्वा गन्धर्वास्त्रिदिवं ययुः ...
अथा'ऽजगाम तं देशं बालमादाय चोर्वशी .. 1.136.20 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having given the vessel of fire to the king, the Gandharvas went to heaven. / Then Urvaśī came to that place, bringing a boy.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyuvāca ..
tasminsamāgame saumya jāto'yaṃ tanayaḥ prabho ..
tamādāya pratiṣṭhānaṃ vraja pārthiva māciram .. 21 ..
meaning:
उर्वश्युवाच ..
तस्मिन्समागमे सौम्य जातोऽयं तनयः प्रभो ..
तमादाय प्रतिष्ठानं व्रज पार्थिव माचिरम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: Urvaśī said: / "From that union, O gentle one, this son was born, O lord. / Taking him, go to Pratiṣṭhāna without delay, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ nāmāsya gandharvairviśvāyurati bhūmipa ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evaṃ dattvā nṛpe bālaṃ sā prayātā triviṣṭapam .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृतं नामास्य गन्धर्वैर्विश्वायुरति भूमिप ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवं दत्त्वा नृपे बालं सा प्रयाता त्रिविष्टपम् .. 22 ..
text_mt: His name, Viśvāyus, was given by the Gandharvas, O ruler of the earth." / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having thus given the boy to the king, she departed for heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākī cintayāmāsa budhaputropyanantaram ..
kinnu bālamupādāya gamiṣyāmi puraṃ svakam ..23..
meaning:
एकाकी चिन्तयामास बुधपुत्रोप्यनन्तरम् ..
किन्नु बालमुपादाय गमिष्यामि पुरं स्वकम् ..23..
text_mt: Alone, the son of Budha then thought: / 'Shall I take the boy and go to my own city,

sanskrit_iast:
athādāya gamiṣyāmi sthālīmetāṃ vibhāvasoḥ..
śvāpadebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ bālasyeha bhaviṣyati .. 24 ..
meaning:
अथादाय गमिष्यामि स्थालीमेतां विभावसोः..
श्वापदेभ्यो भयं घोरं बालस्येह भविष्यति .. 24 ..
text_mt: or shall I take this vessel of fire and go? / For the boy there will be dreadful fear of wild beasts here.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā vihīnasya bhayaṃ nāsti kiñcidvibhāvasoḥ ..
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā bālamādāya satvaraḥ. .. 25 ..
meaning:
मया विहीनस्य भयं नास्ति किञ्चिद्विभावसोः ..
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा बालमादाय सत्वरः. .. 25 ..
text_mt: Left without me, there is no fear at all for the fire.' / Making this decision, he took the boy and quickly

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma svapuraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ sasainyaścāgamatpunaḥ ..
sthālīṃ dadarśa hīnāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
जगाम स्वपुरं हृष्टः ससैन्यश्चागमत्पुनः ..
स्थालीं ददर्श हीनां तु दृष्ट्वा मोहमुपागतः .. 26 ..
text_mt: went rejoicing to his city, and returned again with his army. / But he saw the vessel was empty; seeing it, he fell into delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
tridivādetya gandharvā mūḍhaṃ pārthivasattamam ..
utthāpayitvā vacanamūcustaddhitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ .. 27 ..
meaning:
त्रिदिवादेत्य गन्धर्वा मूढं पार्थिवसत्तमम् ..
उत्थापयित्वा वचनमूचुस्तद्धितकाङ्क्षिणः .. 27 ..
text_mt: Descending from heaven, the Gandharvas, wishing for his welfare, / raised up the bewildered, best of kings and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
rājannasmiñchamīgarbhe praviṣṭaḥ sa hutāśanaḥ ..
asmāttvamaraṇiṃ kṛtvā janayasva hutāśanam .. 28 ..
meaning:
राजन्नस्मिञ्छमीगर्भे प्रविष्टः स हुताशनः ..
अस्मात्त्वमरणिं कृत्वा जनयस्व हुताशनम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: "O king, that fire has entered into the womb of this śamī tree. / Having made a kindling stick from this, generate the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā kṛtvā tu taṃ vīra yajasva vidhivattadā ..
tamiṣṭvā prāpsyase vīra gandharvatmasaṃśayam .. 29 ..
meaning:
त्रिधा कृत्वा तु तं वीर यजस्व विधिवत्तदा ..
तमिष्ट्वा प्राप्स्यसे वीर गन्धर्वत्मसंशयम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Dividing it into three parts, O hero, sacrifice then according to the rule. / Having offered that, O hero, you will attain the state of a Gandharva, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tretāgniṃ te narendreha hoṣyanti satataṃ dvijāḥ ..
saptavarṣāṇi te'pyevaṃ yāsyatyasmatsalokatām .. 1.136.30 ..
meaning:
त्रेताग्निं ते नरेन्द्रेह होष्यन्ति सततं द्विजाः ..
सप्तवर्षाणि तेऽप्येवं यास्यत्यस्मत्सलोकताम् .. 1.136.30 ..
text_mt: The twice-born will constantly sacrifice into the three fires for you here, O lord of men. / In seven years, [your time] will pass thus to dwell in the same realm as us.

sanskrit_iast:
trayo'gnayaścopasadaṃ tava rājanprakīrtitāḥ ..
agnirāhavanīyastu vāsudevo narādhipa .. 31 ..
meaning:
त्रयोऽग्नयश्चोपसदं तव राजन्प्रकीर्तिताः ..
अग्निराहवनीयस्तु वासुदेवो नराधिप .. 31 ..
text_mt: Three fires and the upasada rite are proclaimed for you, O king: / The āhavanīya fire, O ruler of men, is Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāgnistathā jñeyo nityaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo budhaiḥ ..
tathā ca gārhapatyo'gniḥ pradyumnaḥ paripaṭhyate ..32..
meaning:
दक्षिणाग्निस्तथा ज्ञेयो नित्यं संकर्षणो बुधैः ..
तथा च गार्हपत्योऽग्निः प्रद्युम्नः परिपठ्यते ..32..
text_mt: The dakṣiṇa fire should be known constantly by the wise as Saṃkarṣaṇa. / And likewise the gārhapatya fire is recited as Pradyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivaupasado rājannaniruddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
tasmādeva varo viṣṇuścaturātmā narādhipa .. 33 ..
meaning:
तथैवौपसदो राजन्ननिरुद्धः प्रकीर्तितः ..
तस्मादेव वरो विष्णुश्चतुरात्मा नराधिप .. 33 ..
text_mt: Likewise, the upasada fire, O king, is proclaimed as Aniruddha. / Therefore, Viṣṇu, who has four forms, is the supreme giver of boons, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
phalābhisandhānahuto gandharvatvaṃ prayacchati ..
kāmaṃ vināgnihotreṇa huto rājañjanārdanaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
फलाभिसन्धानहुतो गन्धर्वत्वं प्रयच्छति ..
कामं विनाग्निहोत्रेण हुतो राजञ्जनार्दनः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Sacrificed to with longing for fruits, he grants the state of a Gandharva. / Sacrificed to without desire through the agnihotra, O king, Janārdana

sanskrit_iast:
prayacchati paraṃ sthānamamṛtaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam ..
agnihotrādṛte rājangandharvatvaṃ na vidyate .. 35 ..
meaning:
प्रयच्छति परं स्थानममृतं शाश्वतं ध्रुवम् ..
अग्निहोत्रादृते राजन्गन्धर्वत्वं न विद्यते .. 35 ..
text_mt: bestows the supreme, immortal, eternal, and firm state. / Without the agnihotra, O king, the state of a Gandharva cannot be found.

sanskrit_iast:
suhutenāgnihotreṇa prāpyate saṃśayaṃ vinā ..
evamuktvā yayuḥ sarve gandharvāstridivaṃ tataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
सुहुतेनाग्निहोत्रेण प्राप्यते संशयं विना ..
एवमुक्त्वा ययुः सर्वे गन्धर्वास्त्रिदिवं ततः .. 36 ..
text_mt: Through the properly offered agnihotra it is attained without doubt." / Having spoken thus, all the Gandharvas then went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāpyaraṇimādāya śamīgarbhādgṛhaṃ yayau..
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra śamīgarbhāddhutāśanam...
janayanti dvijaśreṣṭhāstatra sannihitastvasau .. 37 ..
meaning:
राजाप्यरणिमादाय शमीगर्भाद्गृहं ययौ..
ततः प्रभृति राजेन्द्र शमीगर्भाद्धुताशनम्...
जनयन्ति द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तत्र सन्निहितस्त्वसौ .. 37 ..
text_mt: The king also, taking the fire-drill from the womb of the śamī tree, went home. / From that time forth, O chief of kings, the foremost of the twice-born / generate fire from the womb of the śamī tree, for it is present there.

sanskrit_iast:
eko'gnirāsīnnṛpavarya pūrvaṃ vaivasvatasyāsya tathāntare'smin ..
tridhākṛtastena mahānubhāva saṃmaṃtrivipraiḥ kratuśāstravijñaiḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
एकोऽग्निरासीन्नृपवर्य पूर्वं वैवस्वतस्यास्य तथान्तरेऽस्मिन् ..
त्रिधाकृतस्तेन महानुभाव संमंत्रिविप्रैः क्रतुशास्त्रविज्ञैः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Formerly there was one fire, O best of kings, in this period of Vaivasvata; / it was made threefold by that noble one, consulting with brahmins skilled in the sacrificial treatises.

sanskrit_iast: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tretāgnyutpattirnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 136 ..
meaning: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे त्रेताग्न्युत्पत्तिर्नाम षट्त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 136 ..
text_mt: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-sixth chapter, entitled 'The Origin of the Three Fires', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the first book of the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
tataḥ sa svapuraṃ prāpya cāgnyupāsanatatparaḥ ..
īje bahuvidhairyajñaiḥ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ततः स स्वपुरं प्राप्य चाग्न्युपासनतत्परः ..
ईजे बहुविधैर्यज्ञैः प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, having reached his city, dedicated to the worship of fire, / he sacrificed with diverse sacrifices, protecting his subjects with dharma.
title: adhyāyaḥ 137

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhaśatairiṣṭvā vājapeyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
agniṣṭomaiścātirātrairdvādaśāhaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
अश्वमेधशतैरिष्ट्वा वाजपेयैः सहस्रशः ..
अग्निष्टोमैश्चातिरात्रैर्द्वादशाहैः पुनःपुनः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Having sacrificed with hundreds of horse sacrifices, with thousands of Vājapeyas, / with Agniṣṭomas, Atirātras, and twelve-day sacrifices again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau ..
amānuṣairvṛtaḥ sattvaiḥ sa vijigye mahītalam .. 3 ..
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् बभौ ..
अमानुषैर्वृतः सत्त्वैः स विजिग्ये महीतलम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: he shone as sole sovereign over the earth with its seven continents and oceans. / Surrounded by non-human beings, he conquered the terrestrial world.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ vyādhirnābhavatkasyacitkvacit ..
sarvo dharmaparo lokaḥ sarva eva sukhī janaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षं मरणं व्याधिर्नाभवत्कस्यचित्क्वचित् ..
सर्वो धर्मपरो लोकः सर्व एव सुखी जनः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Famine, death, or disease did not befall anyone anywhere. / All people were devoted to dharma; everyone was happy.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve caiva samṛddhārthāstasmiñjanapadeśvare ..
nāsītpaśuvadhārhāṇāṃ vadhastasminvṛthā tadā .. 5 ..
meaning:
सर्वे चैव समृद्धार्थास्तस्मिञ्जनपदेश्वरे ..
नासीत्पशुवधार्हाणां वधस्तस्मिन्वृथा तदा .. 5 ..
text_mt: And all people had abundant wealth when he was lord of the realm; / no slaughter of animals deserving to be killed was done in vain at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtāni rājānaṃ bhāvenopagatāni tam ..
sarvasya ca jananyāsītsa rājā pitṛsannibhaḥ ..6..
meaning:
सर्वभूतानि राजानं भावेनोपगतानि तम् ..
सर्वस्य च जनन्यासीत्स राजा पितृसन्निभः ..6..
text_mt: All living beings approached that king with devotion; / and that king, like a father, was like a mother to everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ svapne prasīdanti janāstadā ..
yadā niryātyasau rājā caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ ..7..
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं भूपतिं स्वप्ने प्रसीदन्ति जनास्तदा ..
यदा निर्यात्यसौ राजा चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः ..7..
text_mt: Seeing that ruler of the earth even in a dream, the people rejoiced then, / whenever that king set forth endowed with his fourfold army.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhacaryāratā nāryastadā paśyanti taṃ sadā ..
puṣpaiścandanadhūpaiśca tathaiva vikiranti tam .. 8 ..
meaning:
गृहचर्यारता नार्यस्तदा पश्यन्ति तं सदा ..
पुष्पैश्चन्दनधूपैश्च तथैव विकिरन्ति तम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Women engaged in household duties constantly watched him then, / and they scattered flowers, sandalwood, and incense over him.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī kṛtapuṇyā sā devī nārāyaṇātmajā ..
yayā krīḍitamasyāṅke vadantyevaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
उर्वशी कृतपुण्या सा देवी नारायणात्मजा ..
यया क्रीडितमस्याङ्के वदन्त्येवं च योषितः .. 9 ..
text_mt: “Blessed is that divine Urvaśī, daughter of Nārāyaṇa, / who has played on his lap!” Thus the women spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
ayamāyātyasau rājā yadā śṛṇvanti yoṣitaḥ ..
gṛhakāryāṇyapi tyaktvā tadā yānti ,gavākṣakān .. 1.137.10 ..
meaning:
अयमायात्यसौ राजा यदा शृण्वन्ति योषितः ..
गृहकार्याण्यपि त्यक्त्वा तदा यान्ति ,गवाक्षकान् .. 1.137.10 ..
text_mt: When the women heard, “Here comes the king!”, / abandoning even their household chores, they ran to the latticed windows.

sanskrit_iast:
abhrāṇi śāradānīva bahucandrāṇi yoṣitām ..
mukhai rājanti veśmāni niryāte pṛthivīśvare .. 11 ..
meaning:
अभ्राणि शारदानीव बहुचन्द्राणि योषिताम् ..
मुखै राजन्ति वेश्मानि निर्याते पृथिवीश्वरे .. 11 ..
text_mt: Like autumnal clouds containing many moons, / the mansions shone with the faces of the women when the lord of the earth went forth.

sanskrit_iast:
yā na paśyati taṃ yāntaṃ sā taṃ jñātvā tirohitam ..
muṣitaṃ caiva sā''tmānaṃ vetti nindati sā bhṛśam .. 12 ..
meaning:
या न पश्यति तं यान्तं सा तं ज्ञात्वा तिरोहितम् ..
मुषितं चैव सा'ऽत्मानं वेत्ति निन्दति सा भृशम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: She who did not see him passing by, knowing that he had disappeared from sight, / considered herself robbed and blamed herself intensely.

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca paśyati taṃ yāntaṃ kandarpasadṛśaṃ nṛpam ..
tadgatena hradā sāpi śūnyā tiṣṭhati veśmani .. 13 ..
meaning:
या च पश्यति तं यान्तं कन्दर्पसदृशं नृपम् ..
तद्गतेन ह्रदा सापि शून्या तिष्ठति वेश्मनि .. 13 ..
text_mt: And she who saw the king passing by, looking like Kandarpa, / remained in her house with an empty mind, her heart fixed on him.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yajati yajñaiśca tadā śūnyā vasundharā ..
sarvā bhavati rājānaṃ tadā gacchati vai janaḥ .. .. 14 ..
meaning:
यदा यजति यज्ञैश्च तदा शून्या वसुन्धरा ..
सर्वा भवति राजानं तदा गच्छति वै जनः .. .. 14 ..
text_mt: When he performed sacrifices, the whole earth became empty; / everyone then went to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca yāti janastasya yajñe rājño mahātmanaḥ ..
kimicchakaistadā rājñā sarvaḥ saṃpūjyate tadā .. 15 ..
meaning:
यश्च याति जनस्तस्य यज्ञे राज्ञो महात्मनः ..
किमिच्छकैस्तदा राज्ञा सर्वः संपूज्यते तदा .. 15 ..
text_mt: And whichever person went to the sacrifice of that great-souled king, / everyone was honored by the king with whatever they desired.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāsaṃsthasya vai rājñaḥ pratīhāro dine dine ..
udghoṣayati kāryārthī tasya rājye kathaṃcana .. 16 ..
meaning:
सभासंस्थस्य वै राज्ञः प्रतीहारो दिने दिने ..
उद्घोषयति कार्यार्थी तस्य राज्ये कथंचन .. 16 ..
text_mt: Day after day, as the king sat in his assembly hall, the doorkeeper / would proclaim [to see] if anyone in his kingdom had any petition.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ śāsato rājyaṃ gataḥ kālo mahīpateḥ ..
sa kadāciddvijānāha darśayadhvaṃ mamorvaśīm .. 17 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं शासतो राज्यं गतः कालो महीपतेः ..
स कदाचिद्द्विजानाह दर्शयध्वं ममोर्वशीम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: As he ruled the kingdom in this way, time passed for the ruler of the earth. / Once, he said to the twice-born: “Show me Urvaśī!”

sanskrit_iast:
drakṣyase tāṃ svayaṃ rājanna vayaṃ darśayāmahe ..
tatasteṣāṃ dhane lobhaṃ cakre kāmanipīḍitaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
द्रक्ष्यसे तां स्वयं राजन्न वयं दर्शयामहे ..
ततस्तेषां धने लोभं चक्रे कामनिपीडितः .. 18 ..
text_mt: “You will see her yourself, O King; we cannot show her.” / Thereupon, tormented by lust, he coveted their wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
hriyamāṇe dhane vipraiḥ śaptaḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ ..
jīvitaścāparairviprairgataroṣairmahīpatiḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
ह्रियमाणे धने विप्रैः शप्तः पञ्चत्वमागतः ..
जीवितश्चापरैर्विप्रैर्गतरोषैर्महीपतिः .. 19 ..
text_mt: As their wealth was being seized, he was cursed by the vipras and died; / and he was brought back to life by other vipras whose anger had passed.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ garhayitvā'sau labdhasaṃjño mahīpatiḥ ..
āyuṃ rājye'bhiṣicyaiva pratiṣṭhānapure svake .. 1.137.20 ..
meaning:
आत्मानं गर्हयित्वाऽसौ लब्धसंज्ञो महीपतिः ..
आयुं राज्येऽभिषिच्यैव प्रतिष्ठानपुरे स्वके .. 1.137.20 ..
text_mt: Rebuking himself, the ruler of the earth regained consciousness, / consecrated Āyu to the kingdom in his city of Pratiṣṭhāna,

sanskrit_iast:
sāgnihotrastato rājā yayau nārāyaṇāśramam ..
tasyāśrame tapaścakre rājā saṃvatsaratrayam .. 21 ..
meaning:
साग्निहोत्रस्ततो राजा ययौ नारायणाश्रमम् ..
तस्याश्रमे तपश्चक्रे राजा संवत्सरत्रयम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: and then the king, taking his sacred fires, went to the hermitage of Nārāyaṇa. / In his hermitage, the king performed austerities for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nārāyaṇaḥ prāha taṃ nṛpaṃ tapasi sthitam ..
adya prāpsyasi tāṃ rājanyatkṛte paritapyase .. 22 ..
meaning:
ततो नारायणः प्राह तं नृपं तपसि स्थितम् ..
अद्य प्राप्स्यसि तां राजन्यत्कृते परितप्यसे .. 22 ..
text_mt: Then Nārāyaṇa spoke to the king who was engaged in austerity: / “Today you shall obtain her for whose sake you suffer, O King.

sanskrit_iast:
saśarīro'dya gantāsi tridivaṃ rājasattama ..
evaṃ dvijendre vadati vimānaṃ pratyadṛśyata .. 23 ..
meaning:
सशरीरोऽद्य गन्तासि त्रिदिवं राजसत्तम ..
एवं द्विजेन्द्रे वदति विमानं प्रत्यदृश्यत .. 23 ..
text_mt: In your own body, O best of kings, you shall go to heaven today.” / As the foremost of the twice-born was speaking thus, a celestial chariot appeared,

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyadhiṣṭhitaṃ ramyaṃ gandharvaiśca sahasraśaḥ ..
yasminyuktaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ sahasraṃ candravarcasām .. 24 ..
meaning:
उर्वश्यधिष्ठितं रम्यं गन्धर्वैश्च सहस्रशः ..
यस्मिन्युक्तं तुरङ्गाणां सहस्रं चन्द्रवर्चसाम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: occupied by Urvaśī, delightful, and attended by Gandharvas in their thousands, / yoked with a thousand horses possessing the splendour of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānādavaruhyātha gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
urvaśī ca vavandainamṛṣiṃ jvalanatejasam .. 25 ..
meaning:
विमानादवरुह्याथ गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः ..
उर्वशी च ववन्दैनमृषिं ज्वलनतेजसम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Then, having descended from the celestial chariot, the hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases / and Urvaśī bowed to that sage of blazing splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñāto'tha ṛṣiṇā tadā rājā purūravāḥ ..
kṛtvāgnihotramātmasthaṃ vimānaṃ taṃ samāsthitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
अनुज्ञातोऽथ ऋषिणा तदा राजा पुरूरवाः ..
कृत्वाग्निहोत्रमात्मस्थं विमानं तं समास्थितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: Permitted then by the sage, King Purūravas / took his sacred fires within himself and boarded that celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tridivaṃ sa nṛpo gataḥ ..
saśarīro nṛpaḥ svargaṃ tadā prāpya sudurlabham .. 57 ..
meaning:
ऋषिं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य त्रिदिवं स नृपो गतः ..
सशरीरो नृपः स्वर्गं तदा प्राप्य सुदुर्लभम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: Having circumambulated the sage, the king went to heaven. / Having attained heaven, very difficult to reach in bodily form, the king

sanskrit_iast:
śakreṇābhyarcitaḥ kāle vijahāra yathāsukham..
devodyāneṣu sarveṣu urvaśyā sahitastadā .. 28 ..
meaning:
शक्रेणाभ्यर्चितः काले विजहार यथासुखम्..
देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु उर्वश्या सहितस्तदा .. 28 ..
text_mt: was honored by Śakra at the proper time and sported as he pleased / in all the divine gardens together with Urvaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsau viyujyate sākṣātkadācidapi pārthivaḥ ..
amāvasyāmamāvasyāṃ niyataṃ candrabhāskarau .. 29 ..
meaning:
नासौ वियुज्यते साक्षात्कदाचिदपि पार्थिवः ..
अमावस्याममावस्यां नियतं चन्द्रभास्करौ .. 29 ..
text_mt: That king is never separated [from her] in bodily form. / On every new-moon day, the moon and the sun invariably

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭuṃ yātau mahīpālamekarāśigatau sadā ..
urvaśyā sahitaṃ pautraṃ yadā paśyati candramāḥ ..1.137.30..
meaning:
द्रष्टुं यातौ महीपालमेकराशिगतौ सदा ..
उर्वश्या सहितं पौत्रं यदा पश्यति चन्द्रमाः ..1.137.30..
text_mt: come together in a single zodiacal sign to see the ruler of the earth. / When the Moon sees his grandson accompanied by Urvaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sudhārasaṃ devaḥ snehātsravati mānada ..
sudhāmṛtarasaṃ taṃ ca pibanti pitaraḥ sadā .. 31 ..
meaning:
तदा सुधारसं देवः स्नेहात्स्रवति मानद ..
सुधामृतरसं तं च पिबन्ति पितरः सदा .. 31 ..
text_mt: then out of affection, O bestower of honor, the god exudes the nectar of immortality; / and the ancestors constantly drink that essence of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakālastadāpyukto nṛṇāṃ nṛpavarottama ..
tadā śrāddhaṃ hi yaddattaṃ sudhārasavimiśritam .. 32 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धकालस्तदाप्युक्तो नृणां नृपवरोत्तम ..
तदा श्राद्धं हि यद्दत्तं सुधारसविमिश्रितम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: That is also declared to be the time of śrāddha for men, O best of excellent kings; / for the śrāddha that is offered then is mixed with the essence of nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaśnanti mahīpāla pitaro'mṛtasannibham ..
amāvasyāmamāvasyāṃ tadā śrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ .. .. 33 ..
meaning:
तदश्नन्ति महीपाल पितरोऽमृतसन्निभम् ..
अमावस्याममावस्यां तदा श्राद्धं प्रयत्नतः .. .. 33 ..
text_mt: The ancestors consume that, O ruler of the earth, as equivalent to nectar. / Therefore, diligently perform the śrāddha / on every new-moon day,

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva bhūmipaśreṣṭha sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi ..
ye'pi śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti tadā cānye narādhipa .. 34 ..
meaning:
कुरुष्व भूमिपश्रेष्ठ सर्वान्कामानवाप्स्यसि ..
येऽपि श्राद्धं करिष्यन्ति तदा चान्ये नराधिप .. 34 ..
text_mt: O best of kings, and you will obtain all desired objects. / And whatever other men perform the śrāddha then, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmāyuryaśaḥ saukhyaṃ dāsyanti prapitāmahāḥ ..
devakāryādapi śreṣṭhaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ pracakṣate .. 35 ..
meaning:
तेषामायुर्यशः सौख्यं दास्यन्ति प्रपितामहाः ..
देवकार्यादपि श्रेष्ठं पितृकार्यं प्रचक्षते .. 35 ..
text_mt: their great-grandfathers will grant them long life, fame, and happiness. / The rite for the ancestors is declared to be even superior to the rite for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaro nāma rājendra devānāmapi devatāḥ ..
rājyakāmaḥ svargakāmaḥ puṣṭikāmastathaiva ca .. 336 ..
meaning:
पितरो नाम राजेन्द्र देवानामपि देवताः ..
राज्यकामः स्वर्गकामः पुष्टिकामस्तथैव च .. 336 ..
text_mt: The ancestors, O king of kings, are indeed the deities even of the gods. / One who desires a kingdom, one who desires heaven, and likewise one who desires prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnsantarpayecchrāddhe candrasūryasamāgame ..
vasanti satataṃ rājanpitaraścandramaṇḍale .. 37 ..
meaning:
पितॄन्सन्तर्पयेच्छ्राद्धे चन्द्रसूर्यसमागमे ..
वसन्ति सततं राजन्पितरश्चन्द्रमण्डले .. 37 ..
text_mt: should gratify the ancestors with a śrāddha at the conjunction of the sun and moon. / The ancestors constantly dwell, O King, in the lunar orb.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ māsamahorātraṃ vibhāgaṃ tatra me śṛṇu ..
kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī madhye teṣāmudayate raviḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
तेषां मासमहोरात्रं विभागं तत्र मे शृणु ..
कृष्णपक्षाष्टमी मध्ये तेषामुदयते रविः .. 38 ..
text_mt: Hear from me their division of day and night through the month: / for them, the sun rises in the middle of the eighth day of the dark fortnight;

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathaivāstaṃ teṣāṃ yāti divākaraḥ ..
amāvasyā tadā teṣāṃ madhyāhnaṃ jāyate nṛpa ..
tasmācchrāddhāni deyāni tasminkāle prayatnataḥ .. 39..
meaning:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां तथैवास्तं तेषां याति दिवाकरः ..
अमावस्या तदा तेषां मध्याह्नं जायते नृप ..
तस्माच्छ्राद्धानि देयानि तस्मिन्काले प्रयत्नतः .. 39..
text_mt: likewise, the sun sets for them on the eighth day of the bright fortnight. / The new-moon day then becomes their midday, O King; / therefore, offerings of śrāddha should be made at that time with great effort.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktaṃ nṛpavarya tasya dharmātmajasyā'pratimasya vṛttam ...
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ pāpaharaṃ sukhañca .. 1.137.40 ..
meaning:
एतावदुक्तं नृपवर्य तस्य धर्मात्मजस्याऽप्रतिमस्य वृत्तम् ...
धन्यं यशस्यं रिपुनाशनं च सौभाग्यदं पापहरं सुखञ्च .. 1.137.40 ..
text_mt: This much has been told, O best of kings, of the life of that peerless son of Dharma, / which brings prosperity, fame, destroys enemies, grants good fortune, removes sin, and brings happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
vartante pitaraḥ svarge keṣāṃcinnarake tathā ..
narakasthāḥ phalaṃ dātuṃ kathaṃ śaktā vadasva me .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
वर्तन्ते पितरः स्वर्गे केषांचिन्नरके तथा ..
नरकस्थाः फलं दातुं कथं शक्ता वदस्व मे .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / The ancestors reside in heaven, and some in hell; / tell me, how are those residing in hell able to grant results?
title: adhyāyaḥ 138

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pitṝṇāṃ tu gaṇāḥ sapta nāmatastānnibodha me ..
trayo'mūrtimataścaiṣāṃ catvāraśca samūrtayaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
पितॄणां तु गणाः सप्त नामतस्तान्निबोध मे ..
त्रयोऽमूर्तिमतश्चैषां चत्वारश्च समूर्तयः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / There are seven groups of ancestors; learn them from me by name: / three of them are formless, and four have form.

sanskrit_iast:
subhāsurā barhiṣado'gniṣvāttāstathaiva ca ..
trayo mūrtimataścaiṣāṃ catvāraścāpyamūrtayaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
सुभासुरा बर्हिषदोऽग्निष्वात्तास्तथैव च ..
त्रयो मूर्तिमतश्चैषां चत्वारश्चाप्यमूर्तयः .. 3 ..
text_mt: The Subhāsvaras, the Barhiṣads, and likewise the Agniṣvāttas; / three of them have form, and four are formless.

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādāścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ ..
mūrtimantaḥ pitṛgaṇāścatvāraśca prakīrtitāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
क्रव्यादाश्चोपहूताश्च आज्यपाश्च सुकालिनः ..
मूर्तिमन्तः पितृगणाश्चत्वारश्च प्रकीर्तिताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: The Kravyāds, the Upahūtas, the Ājyapas, and the Sukālins / are proclaimed to be the four groups of ancestors who have form.

sanskrit_iast:
subhāsvarā brahmasutāḥ somamāpyāyayanti ye ..
brahmalokacarā rājannityaṃ mūrtivivarjitāḥ ..5..
meaning:
सुभास्वरा ब्रह्मसुताः सोममाप्याययन्ति ये ..
ब्रह्मलोकचरा राजन्नित्यं मूर्तिविवर्जिताः ..5..
text_mt: The Subhāsvaras are sons of Brahmā, who cause Soma to swell; / moving in the world of Brahmā, O King, they are eternally devoid of form.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā barhiṣado nāma rājaputrā marīcinaḥ ..
āpyāyayanti te devām̐lloke somapade sthitāḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
तथा बर्हिषदो नाम राजपुत्रा मरीचिनः ..
आप्याययन्ति ते देवाम्̐ल्लोके सोमपदे स्थिताः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Likewise, those named Barhiṣads are sons of kings, descendants of Marīci; / stationed in the world of the lunar abode, they nourish the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhrājaloke tiṣṭhanti agniṣvāttā narādhipa ..
pulastyasya ṛṣeḥ putrā bhaviṣyanti jaganti te .. 7 ..
meaning:
विभ्राजलोके तिष्ठन्ति अग्निष्वात्ता नराधिप ..
पुलस्त्यस्य ऋषेः पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति जगन्ति ते .. 7 ..
text_mt: The Agniṣvāttas dwell in the Vibhrāja world, O lord of men; / the sons of the sage Pulastya, they will be the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dānavānyakṣagandharvānpiśācoragarākṣasān ..
daityānbhūtapiśācāṃśca vidyādharagaṇāṃstathā ..8 ..
meaning:
दानवान्यक्षगन्धर्वान्पिशाचोरगराक्षसान् ..
दैत्यान्भूतपिशाचांश्च विद्याधरगणांस्तथा ..8 ..
text_mt: The Dānavas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Piśācas, Uragas, Rākṣasas, / Daityas, Bhūtas, and Piśācas, as well as the hosts of Vidyādharas,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgānsarpānsuparṇāṃśca parvatānsaritastathā ..
kravyādām̐ścopahūtāṃśca ajyapām̐śca sukālinaḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
नागान्सर्पान्सुपर्णांश्च पर्वतान्सरितस्तथा ..
क्रव्यादाम्̐श्चोपहूतांश्च अज्यपाम्̐श्च सुकालिनः .. 9 ..
text_mt: nāgas, sarpas, suparṇas, mountains, and rivers, / as well as the Kravyādas, Upahūtas, Ājyapas, and Sukālins,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānkṣatriyānvaiśyānbhāvayantyantyajām̐stathā ..
kaverāṅgirasaścaiva kardamasya prajāpateḥ.. 1.138.10 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियान्वैश्यान्भावयन्त्यन्त्यजाम्̐स्तथा ..
कवेराङ्गिरसश्चैव कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः.. 1.138.10 ..
text_mt: nourish brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and outcastes. / The sons of Kavi, of Aṅgiras, and of the Prajāpati Kardama,

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhasya tathā putrāḥ krameṇaite prakīrtitāḥ ..
jyotirbhāsaḥ smṛtā loke ye ca lokā marīcinaḥ ..11..
meaning:
वसिष्ठस्य तथा पुत्राः क्रमेणैते प्रकीर्तिताः ..
ज्योतिर्भासः स्मृता लोके ये च लोका मरीचिनः ..11..
text_mt: and likewise of Vasiṣṭha are proclaimed in order. / Those known in the world as Jyotirbhāsas and the worlds of Marīci,

sanskrit_iast:
tejesvino māna sāśca krameṇaite prakīrtitāḥ ..
ete śrāddhasya bhoktāro viśvedevaiḥ sadā saha .. 12 ..
meaning:
तेजेस्विनो मान साश्च क्रमेणैते प्रकीर्तिताः ..
एते श्राद्धस्य भोक्तारो विश्वेदेवैः सदा सह .. 12 ..
text_mt: the Tejasvins and the Mānasas are proclaimed in order. / These are the enjoyers of the śrāddha, ever together with the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast:
ete śrāddhaṃ sadā bhuktvā pitṝnsaṃtarpayantyataḥ ..
yatra kvacana dharmajña vartamānā hi yogataḥ ..13 ..
meaning:
एते श्राद्धं सदा भुक्त्वा पितॄन्संतर्पयन्त्यतः ..
यत्र क्वचन धर्मज्ञ वर्तमाना हि योगतः ..13 ..
text_mt: Always having enjoyed the śrāddha, they then gratify the ancestors / wherever they may be existing through yoga, O knower of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ete ca puṣṭyā viniyojayanti śrāddhasya dātāramadīnasattvāḥ ..
tṛptāstathaite viniyojayanti dātuḥ pitṝnsarvagatānmahīpa ..14..
meaning:
एते च पुष्ट्या विनियोजयन्ति श्राद्धस्य दातारमदीनसत्त्वाः ..
तृप्तास्तथैते विनियोजयन्ति दातुः पितॄन्सर्वगतान्महीप ..14..
text_mt: And these [beings] of undaunted spirit endow the giver of the śrāddha with nourishment; / satisfied, they likewise direct the omnipresent ancestors of the giver [to him], O king.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
vaivasvate'ntare prāpte prathame bhṛgunandana ..
śrāddhaṃ pradarśitaṃ kena tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे प्राप्ते प्रथमे भृगुनन्दन ..
श्राद्धं प्रदर्शितं केन तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / When the first Vaivasvata period arrived, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / by whom was the śrāddha first revealed? Explain that to me as I ask.
title: adhyāyaḥ 139

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
hiraṇyākṣavadhe pūrvaṃ yadā tyaktvā dharādharāḥ ..
dharāṃ sapakṣā khagamāḥ khaṃ gatā manujeśvara .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
हिरण्याक्षवधे पूर्वं यदा त्यक्त्वा धराधराः ..
धरां सपक्षा खगमाः खं गता मनुजेश्वर .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Formerly, at the slaying of Hiraṇyākṣa, when the mountains, / possessing wings and moving in the sky, abandoned the earth and went into the firmament, O lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
dharādharaparityaktā tadā calitabandhanā ..
dharā sthānāccyutā vegātpraviveśa rasātalam .. 3 ..
meaning:
धराधरपरित्यक्ता तदा चलितबन्धना ..
धरा स्थानाच्च्युता वेगात्प्रविवेश रसातलम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: the earth, abandoned by the mountains, with her fastenings shaken, / fallen from her place, swiftly entered the underworld.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣaṃ tadā hatvā nṛvarāho janārdanaḥ .
prothena ca karābhyāṃ ca vidhārya vasudhāṃ balāt ..4 ..
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षं तदा हत्वा नृवराहो जनार्दनः .
प्रोथेन च कराभ्यां च विधार्य वसुधां बलात् ..4 ..
text_mt: Having then slain Hiraṇyākṣa, Janārdana as the Man-Boar, / violently tearing apart the earth with his snout and two hands,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjyamānastridaśaiḥ praviveśa rasātalam ..
rasātalatalaṃ gatvā śeṣamūrtau svake sthitaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
संपूज्यमानस्त्रिदशैः प्रविवेश रसातलम् ..
रसातलतलं गत्वा शेषमूर्तौ स्वके स्थितः .. 5 ..
text_mt: entered the underworld while being worshipped by the thirty [gods]. / Having gone to the bottom of the underworld, he stood upon his own form, Śeṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrāgreṇa samuddhṛtya mahīṃ dadhre tadā bhuje ..
vāmabāhuniviṣṭāṃtāṃ kṛtvā tridaśapuṅgavaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
दंष्ट्राग्रेण समुद्धृत्य महीं दध्रे तदा भुजे ..
वामबाहुनिविष्टांतां कृत्वा त्रिदशपुङ्गवः .. 6 ..
text_mt: Lifting up the earth with the tip of his tusk, he then supported her upon his arm; / placing her on his left arm, the bull among the thirty [gods],

sanskrit_iast:
ujjahāra mahātejā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
ratnajvālāvalīpuñjadurvibhāvyamukhāmbujaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
उज्जहार महातेजा लोकानां हितकाम्यया ..
रत्नज्वालावलीपुञ्जदुर्विभाव्यमुखाम्बुजः .. 7 ..
text_mt: possessing great splendour, desiring the welfare of the worlds, lifted her up, / his lotus-face difficult to discern amidst a mass of blazing jewel-flames.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣastuṣṭāva deveśaṃ tasminkāle jagadgurum..
puraṃdhriveśā vasudhā devaṃ tadbāhusaṃsthitā..8..
meaning:
शेषस्तुष्टाव देवेशं तस्मिन्काले जगद्गुरुम्..
पुरंध्रिवेशा वसुधा देवं तद्बाहुसंस्थिता..8..
text_mt: At that time, Śeṣa praised the lord of the gods, the guru of the universe; / the earth, in the attire of a married woman, resting on his arm,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tuṣṭāva bhūpāla ramaṇīyatamākṛtiḥ ..
uddhṛtya vasudhāṃ sthāne sthāpayitvā tathā svake..9..
meaning:
तदा तुष्टाव भूपाल रमणीयतमाकृतिः ..
उद्धृत्य वसुधां स्थाने स्थापयित्वा तथा स्वके..9..
text_mt: then praised the god, O protector of the earth, possessing a most lovely form. / Having raised the earth and placed her in her proper place,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma bhūmau dharmajña varāhaṃ nāma parvatam ..
kalpārambhe varāhasya paramūrteḥ saśailatām .. 1.139.10 ..
meaning:
जगाम भूमौ धर्मज्ञ वराहं नाम पर्वतम् ..
कल्पारम्भे वराहस्य परमूर्तेः सशैलताम् .. 1.139.10 ..
text_mt: the knower of dharma went upon the earth to the mountain named Varāha; / at the beginning of the aeon, to the mountainous state of Varāha, his supreme form.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ samāsādya dharmātmā devaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ ..
daṃṣṭāgralagnaṃ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare.. 11 ..
meaning:
तां समासाद्य धर्मात्मा देवः सर्वगतः प्रभुः ..
दंष्टाग्रलग्नं मृत्पिण्डं गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे करे.. 11 ..
text_mt: Having reached that, the righteous, all-pervading god, the lord, / took in his right hand a lump of clay clinging to the tip of his tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
prasvedācca tilānkṛtvā darbhānromabhya eva ca ..
jalaprasravaṇābhyāśe tasmingirivare tadā .. 12 ..
meaning:
प्रस्वेदाच्च तिलान्कृत्वा दर्भान्रोमभ्य एव च ..
जलप्रस्रवणाभ्याशे तस्मिन्गिरिवरे तदा .. 12 ..
text_mt: And having produced sesamum seeds from his sweat and darbha grass from his body-hairs, / near a stream of water on that best of mountains at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāgrām̐stu vinyasya darbhāṃstānmadhusūdanaḥ ..
mṛtpiṇḍānsatilām̐steṣu dattavām̐strīnnarādhipa .. 13 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणाग्राम्̐स्तु विन्यस्य दर्भांस्तान्मधुसूदनः ..
मृत्पिण्डान्सतिलाम्̐स्तेषु दत्तवाम्̐स्त्रीन्नराधिप .. 13 ..
text_mt: laying down those darbha grasses with their tips pointing south, Madhusūdana / offered three lumps of clay mixed with sesamum upon them, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā ca gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ ..
pūjayitvā ca maryādāṃ kṛtavānsa narādhipa .. 14 ..
meaning:
दत्त्वा च गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः पूजयामास धार्मिकः ..
पूजयित्वा च मर्यादां कृतवान्स नराधिप .. 14 ..
text_mt: And having offered them, the righteous one worshipped them with perfumes, flowers, and the like; / and having worshipped them, he established the rule, O lord of men:

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti lokeṣu pretānuddiśya vai pitṝn ..
ye tu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyanti teṣāṃ puṣṭirbhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति लोकेषु प्रेतानुद्दिश्य वै पितॄन् ..
ये तु श्राद्धं करिष्यन्ति तेषां पुष्टिर्भविष्यति .. 15 ..
text_mt: "From this day forward, among the worlds, for those who perform a śrāddha / dedicated to the departed ancestors, there shall be nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakāle tathā tena piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā ..
pitṝṇāṃ ye kariṣyanti teṣāṃ puṣṭirbhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धकाले तथा तेन पिण्डनिर्वपणं तथा ..
पितॄणां ये करिष्यन्ति तेषां पुष्टिर्भविष्यति .. 16 ..
text_mt: Likewise, for those who make an offering of piṇḍas / to the ancestors at the time of śrāddha, there shall be nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ..
pūjayā te bhaviṣyanti svayaṃ piṇḍeṣu nityadā .. 17 ..
meaning:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः ..
पूजया ते भविष्यन्ति स्वयं पिण्डेषु नित्यदा .. 17 ..
text_mt: The father, the grandfather, and likewise the great-grandfather / shall always be present in person in the piṇḍas through this worship.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ trayaḥ pūjitāśca bhaviṣyanti tathāgnayaḥ ..
trayo lokāstrayo devāstathaiva ca yugatrayam .. 18 ..
meaning:
तेषां त्रयः पूजिताश्च भविष्यन्ति तथाग्नयः ..
त्रयो लोकास्त्रयो देवास्तथैव च युगत्रयम् .. 18 ..
text_mt: And the three fires shall be worshipped through them, / as shall the three worlds, the three gods, and likewise the three ages.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitāśca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ..
pūjitaistairbhaviṣyāmi caturātmā tathāpyaham.. 19..
meaning:
पूजिताश्च त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ..
पूजितैस्तैर्भविष्यामि चतुरात्मा तथाप्यहम्.. 19..
text_mt: And the three gods—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara—shall be worshipped; / and when they are worshipped, I myself, possessing four forms, shall also be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ paitāmahaḥ piṇḍo vāsudevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
paitāmahaśca nirdiṣṭastathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ .. 1.139.20 ..
meaning:
पितुः पैतामहः पिण्डो वासुदेवः प्रकीर्तितः ..
पैतामहश्च निर्दिष्टस्तथा संकर्षणः प्रभुः .. 1.139.20 ..
text_mt: The great-grandfather's piṇḍa is declared to be Vāsudeva; / and the grandfather's [piṇḍa] is stated to be the lord Saṃkarṣaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛpiṇḍaśca vijñeyaḥ pradyumnaścāparājitaḥ ..
ātmā'niruddho vijñeyaḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ budhaiḥ..21..
meaning:
पितृपिण्डश्च विज्ञेयः प्रद्युम्नश्चापराजितः ..
आत्माऽनिरुद्धो विज्ञेयः पिण्डनिर्वपणं बुधैः..21..
text_mt: and the father's piṇḍa is to be known as the unconquered Pradyumna; / the self is to be known as Aniruddha by the wise in the offering of piṇḍas.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ śakyaṃ vinā vaiṣṇavatejasā ..
evaṃ saṃpūjitastena caturātmā tvahaṃ sthitaḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धं कर्तुं कथं शक्यं शक्यं विना वैष्णवतेजसा ..
एवं संपूजितस्तेन चतुरात्मा त्वहं स्थितः .. 22 ..
text_mt: How can a śrāddha be performed without Vaiṣṇava splendour? / Thus worshipped by him, I, standing with four forms,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyāmi pradāsyāmi tasya kāmānyathepsitān..
catvāraḥ pūjitā vedāścatvāraśca tathāgnayaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
भविष्यामि प्रदास्यामि तस्य कामान्यथेप्सितान्..
चत्वारः पूजिता वेदाश्चत्वारश्च तथाग्नयः .. 23 ..
text_mt: shall exist and grant his desired wishes. / The four Vedas shall be worshipped, as well as the four fires;

sanskrit_iast:
catvāraśca yugāstena catasraśca diśastathā ..
catvāraśca tathā varṇāścatvāraśca tathāśramāḥ.. 24 ..
meaning:
चत्वारश्च युगास्तेन चतस्रश्च दिशस्तथा ..
चत्वारश्च तथा वर्णाश्चत्वारश्च तथाश्रमाः.. 24 ..
text_mt: and through this the four ages, and the four directions, / as well as the four castes, and the four stages of life,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro lokapālāśca bhaviṣyantīha pūjitāḥ ..
evaṃ kṛtvā sa maryādāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata ..
tataḥ prabhṛti loke'smiñchrāddhaṃ sadbhiḥ prakīrtitam ..25 ..
meaning:
चत्वारो लोकपालाश्च भविष्यन्तीह पूजिताः ..
एवं कृत्वा स मर्यादां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..
ततः प्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिञ्छ्राद्धं सद्भिः प्रकीर्तितम् ..25 ..
text_mt: and the four guardians of the world shall be worshipped here." / Having thus established the rule, he vanished right there; / from then on, the śrāddha has been proclaimed by the virtuous in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca yaśaḥ sukhāni rājyaṃ ca putrānatha bhūmipāla ..
striyaśca mukhyā vividhāṃśca kāmāndeveśvaraḥ śrāddhakṛto vidhatte .. 26 ..
pārvaṇa śrāddha vidhi
meaning:
स्वर्गं च मोक्षं च यशः सुखानि राज्यं च पुत्रानथ भूमिपाल ..
स्त्रियश्च मुख्या विविधांश्च कामान्देवेश्वरः श्राद्धकृतो विधत्ते .. 26 ..
पार्वण श्राद्ध विधि
text_mt:
Heaven, liberation, renown, happiness, kingdom, and sons, O protector of the earth, / and excellent wives and various desires—the lord of the gods bestows all these on the performer of a śrāddha.
Rule for the Pārvaṇa Śrāddha

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kathyamānamahaṃ tvayā ..
vidhiṃ śrāddhasya dharmajña tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यमानमहं त्वया ..
विधिं श्राद्धस्य धर्मज्ञ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / O venerable one, I wish to hear related by you / the rule of the śrāddha, O knower of dharma; explain that to me as I ask.
title: Śrāddhavivaraṇaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vakṣyamāṇaguṇānviprānpūrvedyurupamantrayet ..
kartrā sametaistairbhāvyaṃ saṃyataiśca nimantritaiḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
वक्ष्यमाणगुणान्विप्रान्पूर्वेद्युरुपमन्त्रयेत् ..
कर्त्रा समेतैस्तैर्भाव्यं संयतैश्च निमन्त्रितैः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the preceding day, one should invite brahmins endowed with the qualities to be described; / those invited should remain restrained together with the performer.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhāhe prayataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
śuklavāsāḥ samabhyarcya nṛvarāhaṃ janārdanam .. 3 ..
meaning:
श्राद्धाहे प्रयतः स्नातः स्वाचान्तः सुसमाहितः ..
शुक्लवासाः समभ्यर्च्य नृवराहं जनार्दनम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: On the day of the śrāddha, purified, having bathed, having properly sipped water, very collected, / dressed in white garments, having worshipped Janārdana as the Man-Boar,

sanskrit_iast:
āmaśrāddheṣu kāmyeṣu hutvā prathamapañcakam ..
(madhyamaṃ pañcakaṃ hutvā paśuśrāddheṣvasaṃśayam .. 4 ..
meaning:
आमश्राद्धेषु काम्येषु हुत्वा प्रथमपञ्चकम् ..
(मध्यमं पञ्चकं हुत्वा पशुश्राद्धेष्वसंशयम् .. 4 ..
