विविधैश्चैव नीवारैर्मुनिभोज्यैर्नराधिप ..
न तद्धान्यं न तत्सस्यं न तच्छाकं न तत्फलम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: and with diverse wild grains fit for the food of sages, O ruler of men. / There was no grain, no crop, no vegetable, no fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
na tanmūlaṃ na tatkandaṃ na tatpuṣpaṃ narādhipa ..
nāgalokodbhavaṃ yacca nākalokodbhavaṃ ca yat .. 39 ..
meaning:
न तन्मूलं न तत्कन्दं न तत्पुष्पं नराधिप ..
नागलोकोद्भवं यच्च नाकलोकोद्भवं च यत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: no root, no tuber, no flower, O ruler of men, / born in the world of nāgas or born in the heavenly realm,

sanskrit_iast:
anūpabandhanotthaṃ ca tanna yatrāsti yādava ..
sadā puṣpaphalaṃ sarvamajasramṛtuyogataḥ .. 1.151.40 ..
meaning:
अनूपबन्धनोत्थं च तन्न यत्रास्ति यादव ..
सदा पुष्पफलं सर्वमजस्रमृतुयोगतः .. 1.151.40 ..
text_mt: or growing tied to marshes, that was not found there, O Yādava. / Everything bore flowers and fruit at all times, constantly through the union of the seasons.

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvaraḥ sa dadṛśe tapaso'rthāya vo gataḥ ..
dadṛśe ca tathā tatra nānārūpānpatatriṇaḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
महेश्वरः स ददृशे तपसोऽर्थाय वो गतः ..
ददृशे च तथा तत्र नानारूपान्पतत्रिणः .. 41 ..
text_mt: He, a great lord, was seen gone there for the purpose of ascetic penance. / And there he likewise saw birds of various forms:

sanskrit_iast:
mayūrāñśatapatrām̐śca kalavācakakokilān ..
tathā kādambakānhaṃsānkukkuṭāñjalakukkuṭān ..82..
meaning:
मयूराञ्शतपत्राम्̐श्च कलवाचककोकिलान् ..
तथा कादम्बकान्हंसान्कुक्कुटाञ्जलकुक्कुटान् ..82..
text_mt: peacocks, woodpeckers, sweet-singing cuckoos, / as well as teal, geese, roosters, and water fowl,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛkarānbarkaśāñśyāmāṃstittirānsakapiñjalān ..
dhārtarāṣṭrānplavānmadgūnkalaviṅkāñchukānbakān .. 43 ..
meaning:
कृकरान्बर्कशाञ्श्यामांस्तित्तिरान्सकपिञ्जलान् ..
धार्तराष्ट्रान्प्लवान्मद्गून्कलविङ्काञ्छुकान्बकान् .. 43 ..
text_mt: kṛkara partridges, barkaśas, syāmā birds, francolins with kapiñjala francolins, / dhārtarāṣṭra geese, plava water-birds, cormorants, sparrows, parrots, and herons,

sanskrit_iast:
caṭakāṃścakravākāṃśca āṭakāṃṣṭiṭṭibhānsaṭān ..
putrapriyāṃllohapṛṣṭāngonandagirivartakān .. 44 ..
meaning:
चटकांश्चक्रवाकांश्च आटकांष्टिट्टिभान्सटान् ..
पुत्रप्रियांल्लोहपृष्टान्गोनन्दगिरिवर्तकान् .. 44 ..
text_mt: house sparrows and ruddy sheldrakes, āṭis, lapwings, saṭas, / putrapriyas, lohapṛṣṭhas, gonandas, and mountain quail,

sanskrit_iast:
pārāvatānkāmalāṃśca śārakāñjīvajīvakān ..
lāvavartakavattīrānraktadharmaprabhadrakān ..45..
meaning:
पारावतान्कामलांश्च शारकाञ्जीवजीवकान् ..
लाववर्तकवत्तीरान्रक्तधर्मप्रभद्रकान् ..45..
text_mt: pigeons, kāmalas, starlings, jīvañjīvaka birds, / lāvaka and vartaka quail, and vattīras, raktadharmas, and prabhadrakas,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmracūḍānvarṇacūḍānkoyaṣṭīnkhañjarīṭakān ..
ṛṣiputrānsahārītānkukkuṭānkāṣṭhakukkuṭān .. 46 ..
meaning:
ताम्रचूडान्वर्णचूडान्कोयष्टीन्खञ्जरीटकान् ..
ऋषिपुत्रान्सहारीतान्कुक्कुटान्काष्ठकुक्कुटान् .. 46 ..
text_mt: red-crested cocks, variegated-crested birds, lapwings, wagtails, / ṛṣiputras, along with green pigeons, roosters, and woodpeckers,

sanskrit_iast:
laṭvām̐llaṭeṣūngokṣveḍāṃstathā kuṅkumacūḍakān ..
bhṛṅgarājāñchārapādānbhūliṅgānpiṇḍimālavān..47..
meaning:
लट्वाम्̐ल्लटेषून्गोक्ष्वेडांस्तथा कुङ्कुमचूडकान् ..
भृङ्गराजाञ्छारपादान्भूलिङ्गान्पिण्डिमालवान्..47..
text_mt: laṭvā sparrows, laṭeṣus, gokṣveḍas, as well as saffron-crested birds, / racket-tailed drongos, spotted-legged birds, bhūliṅgas, and piṇḍimālavs,

sanskrit_iast:
maṃjūlīyakadātyūhagopaputrāntsavañjulān ..
bhāradvājāṃstathā cāṣānsuvarṇānrajanīyakān ..48..
meaning:
मंजूलीयकदात्यूहगोपपुत्रान्त्सवञ्जुलान् ..
भारद्वाजांस्तथा चाषान्सुवर्णान्रजनीयकान् ..48..
text_mt: maṃjūlīyakas, watercocks, cowherd-boys' birds, along with vañjulas, / bhāradvāja larks, and rollers, golden oriole-like birds, and nightjars.

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃścānyāṃśca hi bahūnpakṣisaṃghānmanoharān ..
śvāpadānvividhākārānmṛgāṃścaiva mahāmṛgān .. 49 ..
meaning:
एतांश्चान्यांश्च हि बहून्पक्षिसंघान्मनोहरान् ..
श्वापदान्विविधाकारान्मृगांश्चैव महामृगान् .. 49 ..
text_mt: These and many other delightful flocks of birds [he saw], / and beasts of prey of diverse shapes, and deer and large wild animals:

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrānkesariṇaḥ siṃhānvīcinaḥ śarabhānvṛkān ..
ṛkṣāṃstarakṣūnbandhūkāngolāṅgūlānsavānarān .. 1.151.50 ..
meaning:
व्याघ्रान्केसरिणः सिंहान्वीचिनः शरभान्वृकान् ..
ऋक्षांस्तरक्षून्बन्धूकान्गोलाङ्गूलान्सवानरान् .. 1.151.50 ..
text_mt: tigers, maned lions, leopards, śarabhas, wolves, / bears, hyenas, bandhūkas, langurs, along with monkeys,

sanskrit_iast:
śaśām̐llokācchaśapalānmārjārānmāyavaḥ śunaḥ ..
mṛṣikānnākulānkācānsiṃhānnoḍrasuromakān .. 51 ..
meaning:
शशाम्̐ल्लोकाच्छशपलान्मार्जारान्मायवः शुनः ..
मृषिकान्नाकुलान्काचान्सिंहान्नोड्रसुरोमकान् .. 51 ..
text_mt: hares, foxes, jackals, cats, wild dogs, / mice, mongooses, kācas, lions, otters, and suromakas,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā mattāṃśca mātaṅgānmahiṣāngavayānvṛ ṣān..
caramānsṛmarāṃścaiva tathā gorānnakhānapi ..52..
meaning:
तथा मत्तांश्च मातङ्गान्महिषान्गवयान्वृ षान्..
चरमान्सृमरांश्चैव तथा गोरान्नखानपि ..52..
text_mt: as well as intoxicated elephants, buffaloes, gavaya oxen, bulls, / carama and sṛmara antelopes, as well as wild oxen and nakhas,

sanskrit_iast:
urabhrāṃśca tathā meṣānsāraṅgānatha karkaśān ..
rurūnjamṛṣpadānṛṣpānmarkaṭānkarkaṭānmṛgān ..
nīlāṃścaiva mahānīlānkarālamṛgamārdakān ..53..
meaning:
उरभ्रांश्च तथा मेषान्सारङ्गानथ कर्कशान् ..
रुरून्जमृष्पदानृष्पान्मर्कटान्कर्कटान्मृगान् ..

meaning:
सुशीतामलपानीया जलजैश्च विराजिता ..
आकाशविमला राजंश्चतुरस्रा मनोहरा .. 22 ..
text_mt: with very cool, pure water, adorned with lotuses, / pure as the sky, O king, four-cornered and delightful.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstadudakaṃ svādu laghu śītaṃ sugandhi ca ..
na kṣiṇoti tathā kāyaṃ kukṣimāpūrayatyapi ..23..
meaning:
तस्यास्तदुदकं स्वादु लघु शीतं सुगन्धि च ..
न क्षिणोति तथा कायं कुक्षिमापूरयत्यपि ..23..
text_mt: Its water is sweet, light, cool, and fragrant; / it does not emaciate the body, and it fills the belly;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛptiṃ vidhatte paramāṃ śarīre ca mahatsukham ..
madhye ca tasyāḥ sukṛtaṃ prāsādaṃ tapasātriṇā .. 24 ..
meaning:
तृप्तिं विधत्ते परमां शरीरे च महत्सुखम् ..
मध्ये च तस्याः सुकृतं प्रासादं तपसात्रिणा .. 24 ..
text_mt: it produces supreme contentment and great comfort in the body. / In the middle of it is a well-made temple fashioned by Atri through ascetic power,

sanskrit_iast:
rukmasetupraveśaṃ tatsarvaratnamayaṃ śubham ..
śaśāṅkaraśmisaṅkāśaṃ prāsādaṃ rājataṃ hitam ..25..
meaning:
रुक्मसेतुप्रवेशं तत्सर्वरत्नमयं शुभम् ..
शशाङ्करश्मिसङ्काशं प्रासादं राजतं हितम् ..25..
text_mt: approached by an entrance bridge of gold, auspicious and made of every gem, / a beneficial silver temple resembling the rays of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
ramyaṃ vaidūryasopānaṃ vidrumāmalatārakam ..
indranīlamahācakrañjātarūpavibhūṣitam..26..
meaning:
रम्यं वैदूर्यसोपानं विद्रुमामलतारकम् ..
इन्द्रनीलमहाचक्रञ्जातरूपविभूषितम्..26..
text_mt: with delightful steps of cat's eye and spotless studs of coral, / having a great discus of sapphire adorned with gold,

sanskrit_iast:
padmarāgamahāstaṃbhaṃ tathā marakatavedikam ..
vajrāṃśujālaiśchuritaṃ ramyaṃ dṛṣṭimanoharam ..27..
meaning:
पद्मरागमहास्तंभं तथा मरकतवेदिकम् ..
वज्रांशुजालैश्छुरितं रम्यं दृष्टिमनोहरम् ..27..
text_mt: with great pillars of ruby and a pedestal of emerald, / inlaid with webs of diamond rays, delightful and charming to the sight.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsāde tatra bhagavāndevadevo janārdanaḥ ..
bhogibhogāvalīsuptaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
प्रासादे तत्र भगवान्देवदेवो जनार्दनः ..
भोगिभोगावलीसुप्तः सर्वालङ्कारभूषितः .. 28 ..
text_mt: In that temple, the blessed God of gods, Janārdana, / is asleep upon the coils of the serpent, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
jānumākuñcitastvekaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
phaṇīndrasanniviṣṭāṃghri dvitīyaśca tathā nṛpa .. 29 ..
meaning:
जानुमाकुञ्चितस्त्वेकं देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ..
फणीन्द्रसन्निविष्टांघ्रि द्वितीयश्च तथा नृप .. 29 ..
text_mt: One knee of the God of gods who holds the discus is bent, / and His second foot rests upon the king of serpents, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyutsaṅgagatāṃghristu śeṣabhogaprasāritaḥ ..
phaṇīndrabhogavinyastabāhukūrparaśobhitaḥ .. 1.152.30 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्म्युत्सङ्गगतांघ्रिस्तु शेषभोगप्रसारितः ..
फणीन्द्रभोगविन्यस्तबाहुकूर्परशोभितः .. 1.152.30 ..
text_mt: the [other] foot is placed in Lakṣmī's lap, extended along the serpent's coil; / He is adorned with His arm and elbow resting on the coils of the serpent king,

sanskrit_iast:
svāṅgulīpṛṣṭhavinyasta devaśīrṣadharaṃ vibhum..
ekaṃ tu devadevasya dvitīyaṃ saṃprasāritam .. 31 ..
meaning:
स्वाङ्गुलीपृष्ठविन्यस्त देवशीर्षधरं विभुम्..
एकं तु देवदेवस्य द्वितीयं संप्रसारितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: the all-pervading Lord supporting His divine head placed upon the back of His fingers. / One [arm] of the God of gods is extended,

sanskrit_iast:
samākuñcitajānusthamaṇibandhasuśobhitam ..
kiñcidākuñcitaṃ caiva nābhideśe karasthitam ..32..
meaning:
समाकुञ्चितजानुस्थमणिबन्धसुशोभितम् ..
किञ्चिदाकुञ्चितं चैव नाभिदेशे करस्थितम् ..32..
text_mt: splendid with its wrist placed on the bent knee; / slightly bent, His hand rests in the region of His navel.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ ca bhujaṃ tasya caturthaṃ tu tathā śṛṇu ..
āttasantānakusumaṃ prāṇadeśānusarpiṇam ..33..
meaning:
तृतीयं च भुजं तस्य चतुर्थं तु तथा शृणु ..
आत्तसन्तानकुसुमं प्राणदेशानुसर्पिणम् ..33..
text_mt: That is His third arm; now hear of the fourth: / holding a Santāna blossom, moving toward the region of His heart.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmyā saṃvāhyamānāṃghriḥ phullapadmanibhaiḥ karaiḥ ..
santānamālāmukuṭahārakeyūrabhūṣitam.. 34 ..
meaning:
लक्ष्म्या संवाह्यमानांघ्रिः फुल्लपद्मनिभैः करैः ..
सन्तानमालामुकुटहारकेयूरभूषितम्.. 34 ..
text_mt: His feet are massaged by Lakṣmī with hands like blooming lotuses; / He is adorned with a garland of Santāna flowers, a diadem, a necklace, and armlets;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣitaṃ ca tathā devamaṅgulīyakaiḥ ..
phaṇīndraphaṇavinyastacāruratnaśikhojjvalam .. 35 ..
meaning:
भूषितं च तथा देवमङ्गुलीयकैः ..
फणीन्द्रफणविन्यस्तचारुरत्नशिखोज्ज्वलम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: and the God is adorned with rings, / radiant with the crested jewels of lovely gems placed on the hoods of the serpent king,

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātavastucaritaṃ pratiṣṭhitamathātriṇā ..
siddhāntapūjyaṃ satataṃ samantātkusumārcitam..36..
meaning:
अज्ञातवस्तुचरितं प्रतिष्ठितमथात्रिणा ..
सिद्धान्तपूज्यं सततं समन्तात्कुसुमार्चितम्..36..
text_mt: whose real nature and deeds are unknown, consecrated there by Atri, / ever worthy of worship according to Siddhānta, worshipped all around with flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
divyagandhāvaliptāṅgaṃ divyadhūpena dhūpitam ..
gorasaiḥ saphalairhṛdyaiḥ siddhairupahṛtaiḥ sadā .. 37 ..
meaning:
दिव्यगन्धावलिप्ताङ्गं दिव्यधूपेन धूपितम् ..
गोरसैः सफलैर्हृद्यैः सिद्धैरुपहृतैः सदा .. 37 ..
text_mt: His limbs anointed with divine fragrant paste, perfumed with divine incense, / and with delightful dairy foods accompanied by fruits, continually offered by the Siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśobhitaṃ puraḥpārśvaṃ devamuttamaśīrṣakam..
tathā paścānmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vavande sa narādhipaḥ ..38..
meaning:
संशोभितं पुरःपार्श्वं देवमुत्तमशीर्षकम्..
तथा पश्चान्मुखं दृष्ट्वा ववन्दे स नराधिपः ..38..
text_mt: Having seen the God adorned in front and at the sides, with His supreme head / and His face turned toward the west, the ruler of men bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
jānubhyāṃ śirasā caiva gatvā bhūmiṃ yathāvidhi ..
nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa tathā tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
जानुभ्यां शिरसा चैव गत्वा भूमिं यथाविधि ..
नाम्नां सहस्रेण तथा तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Having touched the ground according to rule with his knees and head, / he praised Madhusūdana with the thousand names.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇamatho cakre sa tūtthāya punaḥ punaḥ ..
ramyamāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrovāsāśrame nṛpaḥ .. 1.152.40 ..
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणमथो चक्रे स तूत्थाय पुनः पुनः ..
रम्यमायतनं दृष्ट्वा तत्रोवासाश्रमे नृपः .. 1.152.40 ..
text_mt: Then, rising up again and again, he performed circumambulation. / Having seen that delightful abode, the king dwelt there in the hermitage,

sanskrit_iast:
viśālāṃ hi guhāṃ kāñcidāśritya sumanoharām ..
tapaścacāra tatraiva pūjayāno janārdanam ..41..
meaning:
विशालां हि गुहां काञ्चिदाश्रित्य सुमनोहराम् ..
तपश्चचार तत्रैव पूजयानो जनार्दनम् ..41..
text_mt: having taken shelter in a spacious, most delightful cave. / He performed austerities right there, worshipping Janārdana

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhaiḥ sadā puṣpaiḥ phalairmūlaiḥ sagorasaiḥ ..
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī vahnipūjāparāyaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
नानाविधैः सदा पुष्पैः फलैर्मूलैः सगोरसैः ..
नित्यं त्रिषवणस्नायी वह्निपूजापरायणः .. 42 ..
text_mt: always with flowers of various kinds, with fruits, roots, and dairy foods, / constantly bathing at the three junctures of the day, devoted to the worship of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
devavāpījalaiḥ kurvansatataṃ prāṇadhāraṇam ..
sarvāhāraparityāgaṃ sa kṛtvā manujeśvaraḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
देववापीजलैः कुर्वन्सततं प्राणधारणम् ..
सर्वाहारपरित्यागं स कृत्वा मनुजेश्वरः .. 43 ..
text_mt: always sustaining his life with the waters of the divine pond. / Having abandoned all food, the lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
anāśritaguhāśāyī kālaṃ nayati pārthivaḥ ..
tyaktāhārakriyasyāsya kevalāmbho'śinastathā ..
glānistasya samāyāti na śarīre tadadbhutam ..44..
meaning:
अनाश्रितगुहाशायी कालं नयति पार्थिवः ..
त्यक्ताहारक्रियस्यास्य केवलाम्भोऽशिनस्तथा ..
ग्लानिस्तस्य समायाति न शरीरे तदद्भुतम् ..44..
text_mt: sleeping in that unbuilt cave, passed his time, the ruler of the earth. / Although he had given up the practice of eating and consumed only water, / no exhaustion came upon his body—that was a wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa rājā tapasi prasaktaḥ sampūjayandevavaraṃ sadaiva ..
tatrāśrame kālamuvāsa kaścitsvargopame duḥkhamavindamānaḥ .. 45..
meaning:
एवं स राजा तपसि प्रसक्तः सम्पूजयन्देववरं सदैव ..
तत्राश्रमे कालमुवास कश्चित्स्वर्गोपमे दुःखमविन्दमानः .. 45..
text_mt: Thus that king, intent on ascetic practice, constantly worshipping the supreme God, / lived for some time in that hermitage resembling heaven, experiencing no sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
gatvāśramapade rājā tyaktāhāraparicchadaḥ ..
krīḍāvihārairgandharvaiḥ paśyatyapsarasassaha .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
गत्वाश्रमपदे राजा त्यक्ताहारपरिच्छदः ..
क्रीडाविहारैर्गन्धर्वैः पश्यत्यप्सरसस्सह .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having gone to the hermitage site, the king, having abandoned food and retinue, / watched the apsarases along with the gandharvas engaged in sportive amusements.
title: Jalakrīḍāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā puṣpoccayaṃ bhūri grathayitvā tathā srajaḥ ..
agre nivedya devāya gandharvebhyastathā dadau ..2 ..
meaning:
कृत्वा पुष्पोच्चयं भूरि ग्रथयित्वा तथा स्रजः ..
अग्रे निवेद्य देवाय गन्धर्वेभ्यस्तथा ददौ ..2 ..
text_mt: Gathering an abundance of flowers and weaving garlands, / having offered them first to the God, he then gave them to the gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpoccayaprasaktānāṃ krīḍantīnāṃ yathāsukham ..
ceṣṭā nānāvidhākārāḥ paśyannapi na paśyati .. 3 ..
meaning:
पुष्पोच्चयप्रसक्तानां क्रीडन्तीनां यथासुखम् ..
चेष्टा नानाविधाकाराः पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति .. 3 ..
text_mt: Though looking at the various forms of activities / of those women intent on gathering flowers and playing at their ease, he did not [really] see them:

sanskrit_iast:
kāścitpuṣpoccaye saktā latājālena veṣṭitāḥ ..
sakhījanena santyaktāḥ kāntena paramokṣitāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
काश्चित्पुष्पोच्चये सक्ता लताजालेन वेष्टिताः ..
सखीजनेन सन्त्यक्ताः कान्तेन परमोक्षिताः .. 4 ..
text_mt: some engaged in gathering flowers were caught in a thicket of creepers; / left behind by their companions, they were freed by their lovers;

sanskrit_iast:
makarandasamākrāntanayanāḥ kāścidaṅganāḥ ..
kāntaniḥśvāsavātena nīrajaskīkṛtekṣaṇāḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
मकरन्दसमाक्रान्तनयनाः काश्चिदङ्गनाः ..
कान्तनिःश्वासवातेन नीरजस्कीकृतेक्षणाः .. 5 ..
text_mt: the eyes of some women were clouded with floral nectar; / their eyes were cleared of dust by the breath of their lovers.

sanskrit_iast:
kāciduccitya puṣpāṇi dadau kāntasya bhāminī ..
kāntasaḍgrathitaistaiśca rarāja kṛtaśekharā .. 6 ..
meaning:
काचिदुच्चित्य पुष्पाणि ददौ कान्तस्य भामिनी ..
कान्तसड्ग्रथितैस्तैश्च रराज कृतशेखरा .. 6 ..
text_mt: One passionate woman, having gathered flowers, gave them to her lover; / and she shone, wearing a chaplet woven from them by her beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamuccitya saṅgranthya ramaṇakṛtaśekharā ..
kṛtakṛtyamivā''tmānaṃ mene manmathavardhinī .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्वयमुच्चित्य सङ्ग्रन्थ्य रमणकृतशेखरा ..
कृतकृत्यमिवा'ऽत्मानं मेने मन्मथवर्धिनी .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having gathered and strung them herself, her crest made by her beloved, / that woman, increasing desire, considered herself to have accomplished her purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
anyasmingahane kuñje viśeṣakusumā latā ..
kācidevaṃ raho nītā ramaṇena riraṃsunā .. 8 ..
meaning:
अन्यस्मिन्गहने कुञ्जे विशेषकुसुमा लता ..
काचिदेवं रहो नीता रमणेन रिरंसुना .. 8 ..
text_mt: In another dense bower, a certain creeper bore extraordinary blossoms; / one woman was led thither in secret by her lover eager for pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
kāntasannāmitalatākusumāni vicinvatī ..
sarvābhyaḥ kācidātmānaṃ mene sarvaguṇādhikam .. 9 ..
meaning:
कान्तसन्नामितलताकुसुमानि विचिन्वती ..
सर्वाभ्यः काचिदात्मानं मेने सर्वगुणाधिकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Gathering flowers from a creeper bent down by her beloved, / a certain woman considered herself superior in all virtues to all [the others].

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitpaśyati bhūpālo nalinīṣu pṛthakpṛthak ..
krīḍyamānāstu gandharvaidaivarāmā manoramāḥ .. 1.153.10 ..
meaning:
क्वचित्पश्यति भूपालो नलिनीषु पृथक्पृथक् ..
क्रीड्यमानास्तु गन्धर्वैदैवरामा मनोरमाः .. 1.153.10 ..
text_mt: Here and there the king saw, in the lotus pools, / delightful divine damsels sporting separately with the Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
kāciccātāḍayatkāntamudakena śucismitā ..
tāḍyamānā tathaivānyā kāntena ratimāyayau .. 11 ..
meaning:
काचिच्चाताडयत्कान्तमुदकेन शुचिस्मिता ..
ताड्यमाना तथैवान्या कान्तेन रतिमाययौ .. 11 ..
text_mt: A woman of bright smiles struck her lover with water; / another, struck likewise by her lover, felt sexual delight.

sanskrit_iast:
kāntā tu tāḍayāmāsa jātakhedā varāṅganā ..
adṛśyata varārohā śvāsanṛtyatpayodharā .. 12 ..
meaning:
कान्ता तु ताडयामास जातखेदा वराङ्गना ..
अदृश्यत वरारोहा श्वासनृत्यत्पयोधरा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Becoming fatigued, an excellent maiden struck back at her lover; / that fair-hipped woman was seen with breasts dancing as she breathed.

sanskrit_iast:
kāntāmbutāḍana bhraṣṭakeśapāśanibandhanā ..
śvāsākulamukhī bhāti madhupairiva padminī .. 13 ..
meaning:
कान्ताम्बुताडन भ्रष्टकेशपाशनिबन्धना ..
श्वासाकुलमुखी भाति मधुपैरिव पद्मिनी .. 13 ..
text_mt: With the binding of her hair-braid loosened by the lover striking her with water, / her face agitated by breath, she shone like a lotus pool [encircled] by bees.

sanskrit_iast:
svavaktrasadṛśaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃchannanalinīvane ..
channā kāciccirātprāptā kāntenānviṣya yatnataḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्ववक्त्रसदृशैः पुष्पैः संछन्ननलिनीवने ..
छन्ना काचिच्चिरात्प्राप्ता कान्तेनान्विष्य यत्नतः .. 14 ..
text_mt: In a lotus clump covered with flowers resembling her face, / one woman who had concealed herself was found after a long time by her lover searching diligently.

sanskrit_iast:
snātā śītāpadeśena kācitprauḍhāṅganā bhṛśam ..
ramaṇāliṅganaṃ cakre manobhi'laṣitaṃ ciram .. 15 ..
meaning:
स्नाता शीतापदेशेन काचित्प्रौढाङ्गना भृशम् ..
रमणालिङ्गनं चक्रे मनोभिऽलषितं चिरम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: A certain mature woman, having bathed, on the pretext of feeling cold, / embraced her lover intensely, as she had long desired in her heart.

sanskrit_iast:
jalārdraṃ vasanaṃ sūkṣmamaṅgalīnaṃ śucismitā ..
dhārayantī janaṃ cakre kācittatra samanmatham ..16..
meaning:
जलार्द्रं वसनं सूक्ष्ममङ्गलीनं शुचिस्मिता ..
धारयन्ती जनं चक्रे काचित्तत्र समन्मथम् ..16..
text_mt: Wearing a fine garment, wet with water and clinging to her limbs, / a woman of bright smiles aroused desire in a man there.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhamālyaguṇaiḥ kācitkānttenākṛṣya cāmbhasi ..
truṭyatsragdāmapatitaṃ ramaṇaṃ prāhasacciram ..17..
meaning:
गन्धमाल्यगुणैः काचित्कान्त्तेनाकृष्य चाम्भसि ..
त्रुट्यत्स्रग्दामपतितं रमणं प्राहसच्चिरम् ..17..
text_mt: Having pulled her lover into the water by strings of fragrant garlands, / a woman laughed for a long time at her beloved who had fallen as the garland broke.

sanskrit_iast:
kācinmagnasakhīdattajānudeśanakhakṣatā ..
sambhramātkāntaramaṇamagnā sāpi nyamajjata .. 18 ..
meaning:
काचिन्मग्नसखीदत्तजानुदेशनखक्षता ..
सम्भ्रमात्कान्तरमणमग्ना सापि न्यमज्जत .. 18 ..
text_mt: A woman, scratched on the knee by the nails of her friend who had submerged, / plunged [him] in agitation, and, having sunk down, submerged her beloved as well.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitpṛṣṭhīkṛtādityā keśanistoyakāriṇī ..
śilātalagatā bhartrā dṛṣṭā kāmārtacakṣuṣā ..19..
meaning:
काचित्पृष्ठीकृतादित्या केशनिस्तोयकारिणी ..
शिलातलगता भर्त्रा दृष्टा कामार्तचक्षुषा ..19..
text_mt: A woman who had turned her back to the sun, squeezing water from her hair / while sitting on a flat rock, was gazed upon by her husband with eyes full of desire.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtamālyaṃ sulalitaṃ saṃkrāntakucakuṅkumam ..
ratāntaklāntakāntābhamabhavattatsarodakam ..1.153.20..
meaning:
हृतमाल्यं सुललितं संक्रान्तकुचकुङ्कुमम् ..
रतान्तक्लान्तकान्ताभमभवत्तत्सरोदकम् ..1.153.20..
text_mt: With garlands carried away, charmingly lovely, smeared with saffron from breasts, / the water of that lake came to resemble a beloved exhausted after lovemaking.

sanskrit_iast:
susnātadevagandharvadevarāmāgaṇena ca ..
pūjyamānaṃ sa dadṛśe devadevaṃ janārdanam .. 21 ..
meaning:
सुस्नातदेवगन्धर्वदेवरामागणेन च ..
पूज्यमानं स ददृशे देवदेवं जनार्दनम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: He saw the god of gods, Janārdana, being worshipped / by a host of well-bathed gods, Gandharvas, and divine women.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacicca dadṛśe rājā latāgṛhagatāḥ striyaḥ ..
maṇḍayantyaḥ svagātrāṇi kāntasanyastamānasāḥ ..22..
meaning:
क्वचिच्च ददृशे राजा लतागृहगताः स्त्रियः ..
मण्डयन्त्यः स्वगात्राणि कान्तसन्यस्तमानसाः ..22..
text_mt: And here and there the king saw women in creepers' bowers / adorning their limbs, their minds fixed on their lovers.

sanskrit_iast:
kācidādarśasuvyagrakarā dūtīmukhodgatam ..
śṛṇvatī kāntavacanamatiklāntamukhā babhau ..23 ..
meaning:
काचिदादर्शसुव्यग्रकरा दूतीमुखोद्गतम् ..
शृण्वती कान्तवचनमतिक्लान्तमुखा बभौ ..23 ..
text_mt: A woman whose hands were occupied with a mirror, listening / to the beloved's words spoken through the mouth of a female messenger, shone with an intensely weary face.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitsatvaritā dūtyā bhūṣaṇānāṃ viparyayam ..
kurvāṇā naiva bubudhe manmathāviṣṭacetanā .. 24 ..
meaning:
काचित्सत्वरिता दूत्या भूषणानां विपर्ययम् ..
कुर्वाणा नैव बुबुधे मन्मथाविष्टचेतना .. 24 ..
text_mt: A woman, hurried along by a messenger, / putting on her ornaments in reverse order, was not even aware of it, her mind seized by love.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyununnāṃtasurabhi kusumotkaramaṇḍite ..
kvacitpibantyo dadṛśe pradeśe nīlaśādvale ..29.
meaning:
वायुनुन्नांतसुरभि कुसुमोत्करमण्डिते ..
क्वचित्पिबन्त्यो ददृशे प्रदेशे नीलशाद्वले ..29.
text_mt: In some spot, on green turf adorned with heaps of fragrant flowers / carried along by the wind, [women] were seen drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyayāmāsa ramaṇaṃ svayaṃ kācidvarāṅganā ..
kācitpapau varārohā kāntapāṇi samarpitam..26..
meaning:
पाययामास रमणं स्वयं काचिद्वराङ्गना ..
काचित्पपौ वरारोहा कान्तपाणि समर्पितम्..26..
text_mt: A fair maiden herself made her lover drink; / another shapely-hipped woman drank what was offered from her beloved's hand.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitsvanetrasaṃkrāntanīlotpalayutaṃ vadhūḥ..
pītvā papraccha ramaṇaṃ kva gate te mahotpale..27..
meaning:
काचित्स्वनेत्रसंक्रान्तनीलोत्पलयुतं वधूः..
पीत्वा पप्रच्छ रमणं क्व गते ते महोत्पले..27..
text_mt: A young bride, drinking [wine] reflected with her own eyes as blue lotuses, / asked her beloved, "Where have your two great lotuses gone?"

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva pīte te nūnamityuktā ramaṇena sā ..
satyaṃ viditvā mugdhatvādbabhūva vrīḍitā ciram ..28..
meaning:
त्वयैव पीते ते नूनमित्युक्ता रमणेन सा ..
सत्यं विदित्वा मुग्धत्वाद्बभूव व्रीडिता चिरम् ..28..
text_mt: Told by her lover, "Surely they have been drunk by you alone," / and believing it to be true out of innocence, she became bashful for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
kācitkāntārpitaṃ subhrūḥ kāntapītāvaśeṣitam ..
saviśeṣarasaṃ pānaṃ papau manmathavardhanam..29..
meaning:
काचित्कान्तार्पितं सुभ्रूः कान्तपीतावशेषितम् ..
सविशेषरसं पानं पपौ मन्मथवर्धनम्..29..
text_mt: A fair-browed woman drank the beverage offered by her lover, left over after he drank, / possessing an extraordinary flavor and increasing desire.

sanskrit_iast:
āpānagoṣṭhīṣu tadā tāsāṃ sa narapuṅgavaḥ ..
śuśrāva vividhaṃ gītaṃ tantrīsvaravimiśritam .. 1.153.30 ..
meaning:
आपानगोष्ठीषु तदा तासां स नरपुङ्गवः ..
शुश्राव विविधं गीतं तन्त्रीस्वरविमिश्रितम् .. 1.153.30 ..
text_mt: Then, in their drinking assemblies, that bull among men / heard various songs mixed with the music of stringed instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
pradoṣasamaye tāśca devadevaṃ janārdanam ..
rājansadopanṛtyanti nānāvādyapuraḥsarāḥ .. 31..
meaning:
प्रदोषसमये ताश्च देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ..
राजन्सदोपनृत्यन्ति नानावाद्यपुरःसराः .. 31..
text_mt: At twilight, O king, those [women] continually dance before / the god of gods, Janārdana, accompanied by various musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātre gate rātrau vinirgatya guhāmukhāt ..
āyānti saṃyutāḥ kāntaiḥ svaṛddhiracitāngṛhān ..32..
meaning:
याममात्रे गते रात्रौ विनिर्गत्य गुहामुखात् ..
आयान्ति संयुताः कान्तैः स्वऋद्धिरचितान्गृहान् ..32..
text_mt: When only one watch of the night has passed, emerging from the mouth of the cave, / they go with their lovers to their houses built with their own supernatural powers,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāgandhārcitatalānnānāgandhasugandhinaḥ ..
nānāvicitraśayanānkusumotkaramaṇḍitān .. 33 ..
meaning:
नानागन्धार्चिततलान्नानागन्धसुगन्धिनः ..
नानाविचित्रशयनान्कुसुमोत्करमण्डितान् .. 33 ..
text_mt: whose floors are sprinkled with various perfumes, fragrant with different scents, / having diverse, wondrous couches adorned with heaps of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
evamapsarasāṃ paśyankrīḍitāni sa parvate ..
tapastepe mahārājaḥ keśavārpitamānasaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
एवमप्सरसां पश्यन्क्रीडितानि स पर्वते ..
तपस्तेपे महाराजः केशवार्पितमानसः .. 34 ..
text_mt: Watching thus the sports of the Apsarases on the mountain, / the great king practiced austerities, his mind devoted to Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
tamūcurnṛpatiṃ gatvā gandharvāpsaraṇāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
rājansvargopamaṃ deśaṃ prāptastvamarimardana .. 35..
meaning:
तमूचुर्नृपतिं गत्वा गन्धर्वाप्सरणां गणाः ..
राजन्स्वर्गोपमं देशं प्राप्तस्त्वमरिमर्दन .. 35..
text_mt: Approaching that king, hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases spoke to him: / "O King, crusher of foes, you have reached a realm equal to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ hi te pradāsyāmo manasaḥ kāṅkṣitānvarān ..
tānādāya gṛhaṃ gaccha tiṣṭheha yadi vā punaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
वयं हि ते प्रदास्यामो मनसः काङ्क्षितान्वरान् ..
तानादाय गृहं गच्छ तिष्ठेह यदि वा पुनः .. 36 ..
text_mt: We will grant you boons desired by your mind; / take them and go home, or else remain here."

sanskrit_iast:
purūravā uvāca..
amoghadarśanāḥ sarve bhavantastvamitaujasaḥ ..
varaṃ vitarādyaiva prasādaṃ madhusūdanāt .. 37 ..
meaning:
पुरूरवा उवाच..
अमोघदर्शनाः सर्वे भवन्तस्त्वमितौजसः ..
वरं वितराद्यैव प्रसादं मधुसूदनात् .. 37 ..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / "All of you are beings whose sight is never fruitless, possessed of unmeasured splendor; / grant today as a boon the grace of Madhusūdana."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamastvityathoktastaiḥ sa tu rājā purūravāḥ ..
tatrovāsa sukhī māsaṃ pūjayāno janārdanam .. 38 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमस्त्वित्यथोक्तस्तैः स तु राजा पुरूरवाः ..
तत्रोवास सुखी मासं पूजयानो जनार्दनम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Addressed by them with "So be it," King Purūravas / dwelt there happily for a month, worshipping Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
priya eva sadaivāsīdgandharvāpsarasāṃ nṛpa ..
tutoṣa sa jano rājñastasyālaulyena karmaṇā .. 39 ..
meaning:
प्रिय एव सदैवासीद्गन्धर्वाप्सरसां नृप ..
तुतोष स जनो राज्ञस्तस्यालौल्येन कर्मणा .. 39 ..
text_mt: He was always dear to the Gandharvas and Apsarases, O king; / those people were pleased with the king on account of his ungreedy conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
maghasya madhye sa nṛpaḥ praviṣṭastadāśramaṃ ratnasahasracitram..
toyāśanastatra uvāsa māsaṃ yāvatsitāntaṃ nṛpa phālgunasya .. 1.153.40 ..
meaning:
मघस्य मध्ये स नृपः प्रविष्टस्तदाश्रमं रत्नसहस्रचित्रम्..
तोयाशनस्तत्र उवास मासं यावत्सितान्तं नृप फाल्गुनस्य .. 1.153.40 ..
text_mt: In the middle of Māgha, that king entered that hermitage wondrous with thousands of jewels; / living on water, he dwelt there for a month, until the end of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
phālgunāmalapakṣānte rājā svapne purūravāḥ ..
tasyaiva devadevasya śuśrāva gaditaṃ śubham ..1..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
फाल्गुनामलपक्षान्ते राजा स्वप्ने पुरूरवाः ..
तस्यैव देवदेवस्य शुश्राव गदितं शुभम् ..1..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / At the end of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, King Purūravas in a dream / heard an auspicious proclamation of that very god of gods:
title: Purūravaso'tridarśanam

sanskrit_iast:
rātryāmasyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ mantriṇā tvaṃ sameṣyasi..
tena rājansamāgamya kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi .. 2..
meaning:
रात्र्यामस्यां व्यतीतायां मन्त्रिणा त्वं समेष्यसि..
तेन राजन्समागम्य कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि .. 2..
text_mt: "When this night has passed, you will meet with your minister; / having met with him, O king, you will achieve your purpose."

sanskrit_iast:
svapnamevaṃ sa rājarṣirdṛṣṭvā vipulavikramaḥ ..
pratyūṣakāle vidhivatsnātaḥ prāgvadatandritaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
स्वप्नमेवं स राजर्षिर्दृष्ट्वा विपुलविक्रमः ..
प्रत्यूषकाले विधिवत्स्नातः प्राग्वदतन्द्रितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Having seen such a dream, that royal sage of vast prowess, / diligently bathed at dawn according to rule, as before.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyo yathākāmaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam ..
svapnaṃ taddevadevasya nyavedayata dhārmikaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
कृतकृत्यो यथाकामं पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् ..
स्वप्नं तद्देवदेवस्य न्यवेदयत धार्मिकः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Having fulfilled his purpose and worshipped Janārdana according to his wish, / the righteous one related that dream to the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuśrāva vacanaṃ devatārcāsamīritam ..
evametanmahīpāla nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
.. 5 .. evaṃ prasādaṃ saṃprāpya devadevājjanārdanāt ..
meaning:
ततः शुश्राव वचनं देवतार्चासमीरितम् ..
एवमेतन्महीपाल नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..
.. 5 .. एवं प्रसादं संप्राप्य देवदेवाज्जनार्दनात् ..
text_mt: Then he heard a voice spoken by the divine image: / "It is so, O ruler of earth; no doubt should be entertained here." / Having thus received favor from the god of gods, Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene sa narapuṅgavaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning: कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मेने स नरपुङ्गवः .. 6 ..
text_mt: that bull among men considered himself to have achieved his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtadevārcano rājā tadā hutahutāśanaḥ ..
jagāda suhṛdāṃ teṣāṃ prasādaṃ madhusūdanāt .. 7 ..
meaning:
कृतदेवार्चनो राजा तदा हुतहुताशनः ..
जगाद सुहृदां तेषां प्रसादं मधुसूदनात् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Having performed worship of the deity and offered oblation into the fire, / the king then related to those friends the favor [received] from Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tamūcuśca tadā sarve rājānamaparājitam ..
vidadhātu prasannaste devadevo janārdanaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
तमूचुश्च तदा सर्वे राजानमपराजितम् ..
विदधातु प्रसन्नस्ते देवदेवो जनार्दनः .. 8 ..
text_mt: And then they all said to that unconquered king: / "May the gracious god of gods, Janārdana, grant [this] to you.

sanskrit_iast:
aprasanne jagannāthe deśe'sminnṛpa kasyacit ..
na gatirvidyate rājaṃstvaṃ ca deśamihāgataḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
अप्रसन्ने जगन्नाथे देशेऽस्मिन्नृप कस्यचित् ..
न गतिर्विद्यते राजंस्त्वं च देशमिहागतः .. 9 ..
text_mt: When the Lord of the World is not gracious, O king, no one / has any access to this region; and yet you, O king, have come to this realm."

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ prāpnuhi bhadrante bhūya eva hitepsitān ..
sa sādayitvā te kāmāndevaḥ sarvagataḥ prabhuḥ .. 1.154.10 ..
meaning:
सुखं प्राप्नुहि भद्रन्ते भूय एव हितेप्सितान् ..
स सादयित्वा ते कामान्देवः सर्वगतः प्रभुः .. 1.154.10 ..
text_mt: "Attain happiness, blessings to you! Moreover, fulfilling your desired wishes, / having brought about your desires, the all-pervading Lord God [blesses you]."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā narendraṃ taṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
jagmuḥ krīḍāvihārārthaṃ yathāpūrvamarindama .. 11 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा नरेन्द्रं तं गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः ..
जग्मुः क्रीडाविहारार्थं यथापूर्वमरिन्दम .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having spoken thus to that lord of men, O tamer of foes, the hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases / departed for sport and amusement just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
athājagāma taṃ deśaṃ brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ..
trijagadyaśasāṃ sthānamatriḥ suragaṇārcitaḥ .. 12..
meaning:
अथाजगाम तं देशं ब्रह्मणो मानसः सुतः ..
त्रिजगद्यशसां स्थानमत्रिः सुरगणार्चितः .. 12..
text_mt: Then there came to that place the mind-born son of Brahmā, / Atri, the abode of the fame of the three worlds, worshipped by the hosts of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ munivaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā purūravāḥ ..
pādyārghyācamanīyādyairāsanenābhyapūjayat .. 13 ..
meaning:
तमागतं मुनिवरं दृष्ट्वा राजा पुरूरवाः ..
पाद्यार्घ्याचमनीयाद्यैरासनेनाभ्यपूजयत् .. 13 ..
text_mt: Seeing that excellent sage arrived, King Purūravas / worshipped [him] with water for the feet, guest-water, water for sipping, and a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya ca mahābhāgamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ..
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
सम्पूज्य च महाभागमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ..
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः .. 14 ..
text_mt: And having worshipped that fortunate one, he spoke this word: / "Today my birth is fruitful; today my asceticism is fruitful,

sanskrit_iast:
yatte devagaṇairvandyau vanditau caraṇau mayā ..
śreyaḥ prasūtivṛkṣasya prarohastava darśanama .. 15 ..
meaning:
यत्ते देवगणैर्वन्द्यौ वन्दितौ चरणौ मया ..
श्रेयः प्रसूतिवृक्षस्य प्ररोहस्तव दर्शनम .. 15 ..
text_mt: in that your two feet, worthy of worship by the hosts of gods, have been venerated by me. / The sight of you is the sprouting of the tree that brings forth good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpāntakaraṇaṃ sarvakalyāṇakāraṇam ..
kiṃ vā na labhyamastīha teṣāṃ dvijavarottama .. 16 ..
meaning:
सर्वपापान्तकरणं सर्वकल्याणकारणम् ..
किं वा न लभ्यमस्तीह तेषां द्विजवरोत्तम .. 16 ..
text_mt: bringing an end to all sins and causing all auspiciousness. / What indeed is unobtainable in this world, O best among foremost twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
amoghadarśane dṛṣṭe bhavatyamitatejasi ..
evamuktastadā rājñā saṃprasanno jagāda tam .. 17 ..
meaning:
अमोघदर्शने दृष्टे भवत्यमिततेजसि ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा राज्ञा संप्रसन्नो जगाद तम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: when you of unfailing sight and boundless splendour are beheld?" / Spoken to thus by the king, [the sage], thoroughly pleased, said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu rājanvaco mahyaṃ yatte vakṣyāmi suvrata ..
devadevasamādeśāddattaṃ te darśanaṃ mayā .. 18 ..
meaning:
शृणु राजन्वचो मह्यं यत्ते वक्ष्यामि सुव्रत ..
देवदेवसमादेशाद्दत्तं ते दर्शनं मया .. 18 ..
text_mt: "Listen to my words, O king, which I shall speak to you, O you of virtuous vows. / By command of the God of gods, my vision has been granted to you.

sanskrit_iast:
suprasanno hi bhagavāndevaste madhusūdanaḥ ..
dvādaśīṣu sadā rājansopavāsena nityaśa .. 19..
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नो हि भगवान्देवस्ते मधुसूदनः ..
द्वादशीषु सदा राजन्सोपवासेन नित्यश .. 19..
text_mt: For the Lord God Madhusūdana is exceedingly pleased with you. / Always, O king, on the twelfth days [of the fortnights], constantly with fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjito bhagavānviṣṇusttvayātīte tu janmani ..
rājasena tu bhāvena tvayā devaḥ samarcitaḥ .. 1.154.20 ..
meaning:
पूजितो भगवान्विष्णुस्त्त्वयातीते तु जन्मनि ..
राजसेन तु भावेन त्वया देवः समर्चितः .. 1.154.20 ..
text_mt: the Lord Viṣṇu was worshipped by you in a past life. / But with a passionate disposition the God was worshipped by you,

sanskrit_iast:
avaraṃ kāmamāśritya rājannihatakaṇṭakam ..
sāttvikena tu bhāvena pūjayitvā janārdanama .. 21 ..
meaning:
अवरं काममाश्रित्य राजन्निहतकण्टकम् ..
सात्त्विकेन तु भावेन पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम .. 21 ..
text_mt: resorting to a lower desire, O king, [for a kingdom] cleared of rivals. / But having worshipped Janārdana with a pure, sattvic disposition,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ madreṣu saṃprāptaṃ nipkaṇṭakamarindama ..
dvādaśyarcāprasannena devadevena cakriṇā .. 22 ..
meaning:
राज्यं मद्रेषु संप्राप्तं निप्कण्टकमरिन्दम ..
द्वादश्यर्चाप्रसन्नेन देवदेवेन चक्रिणा .. 22 ..
text_mt: sovereignty among the Madras, free from rivals, has been attained [by you], O tamer of foes. / Pleased by your worship on the twelfth day, by the God of gods, the discus-wielder,

sanskrit_iast:
pradarśitamidaṃ sthānaṃ madīyaṃ svargasannibham ..
iha rājam̐stapastaptvā devadevaṃ janārdanam ..23..
meaning:
प्रदर्शितमिदं स्थानं मदीयं स्वर्गसन्निभम् ..
इह राजम्̐स्तपस्तप्त्वा देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ..23..
text_mt: this abode of mine, resembling heaven, has been shown [to you]. / Performing asceticism here, O king, having worshipped the God of gods, Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya dṛṣṭavānasmi purā vararṣagaṇānbahūn ..
prāpyānujñāṃ hṛṣīkeṣāttatkṛte vivare śubhe ..24..
meaning:
आराध्य दृष्टवानस्मि पुरा वरर्षगणान्बहून् ..
प्राप्यानुज्ञां हृषीकेषात्तत्कृते विवरे शुभे ..24..
text_mt: in ancient times I beheld many hosts of excellent sages. / Having obtained permission from Hṛṣīkeśa, in an auspicious cave made for that [purpose],

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ sannihitā rājaṃstasyaivārcā vinirmitā ..
niyogāddevadevasya pūjyate siddhamattamaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
नित्यं सन्निहिता राजंस्तस्यैवार्चा विनिर्मिता ..
नियोगाद्देवदेवस्य पूज्यते सिद्धमत्तमैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: an image of him was fashioned, O king, ever-present [there]. / By the command of the God of gods, it is worshipped by the greatest among the Siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
neyaṃ dṛṣṭā manuṣyendra manuṣyairna ca rākṣasaiḥ ..
piśitāśaistathaivānyairdṛṣṭapūrvā kathañcana .. 26 ..
meaning:
नेयं दृष्टा मनुष्येन्द्र मनुष्यैर्न च राक्षसैः ..
पिशिताशैस्तथैवान्यैर्दृष्टपूर्वा कथञ्चन .. 26 ..
text_mt: This has not been seen by mortals, O lord of men, nor by Rākṣasas / or flesh-eaters, nor by any others ever seen before.

sanskrit_iast:
asminsvargopame deśe tvayā laulyena karmaṇā.
ārādhito jagannātho devaścakragadādharaḥ..27..
meaning:
अस्मिन्स्वर्गोपमे देशे त्वया लौल्येन कर्मणा.
आराधितो जगन्नाथो देवश्चक्रगदाधरः..27..
text_mt: In this realm resembling heaven, with ardent longing by [such] deed / the Lord of the universe, the God who bears the discus and mace, has been worshipped by you.

sanskrit_iast:
āsannaphalamūle'pi bahugorasasaṃyute..
kṣaudrayuktaśilāprāye samākṣikaphalairyute..28..
meaning:
आसन्नफलमूलेऽपि बहुगोरससंयुते..
क्षौद्रयुक्तशिलाप्राये समाक्षिकफलैर्युते..28..
text_mt: Even though fruits and roots were at hand, filled with abundant cow's milk, / abundant with rocks bearing wild honey and filled with honeyed fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
kevalāmbhośinā taptaṃ yattvayā paramaṃ tapaḥ..
tena te'haṃ varaṃ dadmi yadabhīṣṭaṃ tavānagha..29..
meaning:
केवलाम्भोशिना तप्तं यत्त्वया परमं तपः..
तेन तेऽहं वरं दद्मि यदभीष्टं तवानघ..29..
text_mt: since supreme asceticism was performed by you subsisting only on water, / therefore I grant you a boon that is desired by you, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
acireṇaiva kālena tvayā rājankṛtaṃ tapaḥ..
rūpārthaṃ rūpalābhāya prāptaṃ me gadataḥ śṛṇu..1.154.30..
meaning:
अचिरेणैव कालेन त्वया राजन्कृतं तपः..
रूपार्थं रूपलाभाय प्राप्तं मे गदतः शृणु..1.154.30..
text_mt: Asceticism was performed by you, O king, in not a very long time; / for the sake of beauty, to gain beauty, listen to what was attained as I tell it:

sanskrit_iast:
tadvrataṃ ye kariṣyanti manujeśvara mānavāḥ..
striyo vāpi naraśreṣṭha prāpsyante rūpamuttamam..31..
meaning:
तद्व्रतं ये करिष्यन्ति मनुजेश्वर मानवाः..
स्त्रियो वापि नरश्रेष्ठ प्राप्स्यन्ते रूपमुत्तमम्..31..
text_mt: Those men who will perform that vow, O lord of men, / or women too, O best of men, will attain supreme beauty,

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyamatulaṃ loke lāvaṇyamapi cottamam..
dharmiṣṭatāṃ tathārogyaṃ kule janma tathottame..32..
meaning:
सौभाग्यमतुलं लोके लावण्यमपि चोत्तमम्..
धर्मिष्टतां तथारोग्यं कुले जन्म तथोत्तमे..32..
text_mt: incomparable good fortune in the world, and also supreme charm, / righteousness, likewise health, and birth in an excellent family.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntaramathāsādya svargalokaṃ tathāvidham..
svargalokātparibhraṣṭā mānuṣye guṇasaṃyutāḥ..33..
meaning:
जन्मान्तरमथासाद्य स्वर्गलोकं तथाविधम्..
स्वर्गलोकात्परिभ्रष्टा मानुष्ये गुणसंयुताः..33..
text_mt: Then, having attained another birth in such a heavenly world, / falling from the heavenly world, endowed with virtues in human existence,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā dhanasampannā bhaviṣyantyathavā nṛpāḥ..
janmāntaramathāsādya sarvesyaiva phalapradāḥ..34..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा धनसम्पन्ना भविष्यन्त्यथवा नृपाः..
जन्मान्तरमथासाद्य सर्वेस्यैव फलप्रदाः..34..
text_mt: they will become wealthy brahmins or kings. / Then, having attained another birth, all [these vows] yield fruit;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpavaṃto mahārāja ihāmutra ca te'naghāḥ..
yasmāttvayā tapastaptaṃ keśavaścātha pūjitaḥ..35..
meaning:
रूपवंतो महाराज इहामुत्र च तेऽनघाः..
यस्मात्त्वया तपस्तप्तं केशवश्चाथ पूजितः..35..
text_mt: they become handsome, O great king, here and in the hereafter, sinless. / Because asceticism was performed by you and Keśava was worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā samāgataścāpi gaṃdharvaiśca sahasraśaḥ..
ihaiva kṛtvā dharmajña rūpasatraṃ mahāphalam..
divyarūpadharo bhūtvā svarāṣṭraṃ gantumarhasi..36..
meaning:
मया समागतश्चापि गंधर्वैश्च सहस्रशः..
इहैव कृत्वा धर्मज्ञ रूपसत्रं महाफलम्..
दिव्यरूपधरो भूत्वा स्वराष्ट्रं गन्तुमर्हसि..36..
text_mt: and you have met with me and with Gandharvas by the thousands, / having performed right here, O knower of dharma, the Beauty Sacrifice that yields great fruit, / assuming a celestial form you ought to return to your own realm."

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktaḥ sa tu madranātho mahātmanā tena narendrasiṃha..
papraccha taṃ dharmabhṛtāmvariṣṭhaḥ satrasya tasyānuśayaṃ vidhānam..37..
meaning:
एतावदुक्तः स तु मद्रनाथो महात्मना तेन नरेन्द्रसिंह..
पप्रच्छ तं धर्मभृताम्वरिष्ठः सत्रस्य तस्यानुशयं विधानम्..37..
text_mt: Spoken to thus by that great soul, that lion among kings, the ruler of the Madras, / foremost among upholders of dharma, asked him the traditional rule and procedure of that sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast:
purūravā uvāca..
śrotumicchāmi bhagavanrūpasatraṃ mahāphalam..
yatsamāptau bhaviṣyāmi divyarūpadharo mune..1..
meaning:
पुरूरवा उवाच..
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन्रूपसत्रं महाफलम्..
यत्समाप्तौ भविष्यामि दिव्यरूपधरो मुने..1..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / "I wish to hear, O venerable one, of the Beauty Sacrifice that yields great fruit, / upon whose completion, O sage, I shall become one endowed with a celestial form."
title: Rūpasatravarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
atriruvāca .. tatsatraṃ kartukāmena cānveṣyo brāhmaṇo guruḥ ..
jyotiṣaṃ yo vijānāti itihāsāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..2 ..
meaning:
अत्रिरुवाच .. तत्सत्रं कर्तुकामेन चान्वेष्यो ब्राह्मणो गुरुः ..
ज्योतिषं यो विजानाति इतिहासांश्च कृत्स्नशः ..2 ..
text_mt: Atri said: / "By one wishing to perform that sacrificial session, a brahmin guru should be sought out / who thoroughly understands astronomy and astrology, and the epic histories in their entirety.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpradiṣṭena vidhinā pādarkṣātprabhṛti kramāt ..
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ pratyekaṃ tannibodha me .. 3 ..
meaning:
तत्प्रदिष्टेन विधिना पादर्क्षात्प्रभृति क्रमात् ..
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं प्रत्येकं तन्निबोध मे .. 3 ..
text_mt: According to the procedure prescribed by him, beginning from the asterism of the feet in proper sequence, / a fast should be observed for each asterism; learn that from me.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī tu yā ..
samūlāṃ tāṃ tu samprāpya vrataṃ gṛhṇīta mānavaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
फाल्गुन्यां समतीतायां कृष्णपक्षाष्टमी तु या ..
समूलां तां तु सम्प्राप्य व्रतं गृह्णीत मानवः .. 4 ..
text_mt: When the full moon day of Phālguna has passed, the eighth day of the dark fortnight— / having reached that [tithi] conjoined with Mūla, a person should undertake the vow.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ nakṣatrasya ca daivatam .
varuṇaṃ ca tathā candraṃ pūjayedvidhinā naraḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं नक्षत्रस्य च दैवतम् .
वरुणं च तथा चन्द्रं पूजयेद्विधिना नरः .. 5 ..
text_mt: One should fast on that asterism, and the deity of the asterism, / as well as Varuṇa and the moon, a man should worship according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ janārdanam ..
upoṣya saṅgaṃ devasya prayatnena ca pūjayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् ..
उपोष्य सङ्गं देवस्य प्रयत्नेन च पूजयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: He should worship the Lord of the gods of gods, the venerable Janārdana. / Having fasted, he should diligently worship the body of the God.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tathā gurum ..
upavāsastu kartavyo dvitīye'hani pārthiva .. 7 ..
meaning:
ततोऽग्निहवनं कृत्वा पूजयित्वा तथा गुरुम् ..
उपवासस्तु कर्तव्यो द्वितीयेऽहनि पार्थिव .. 7 ..
text_mt: Then, having offered oblations into the fire and worshipped the guru, / a fast must indeed be observed on the second day, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya ṛkṣe vigate snātvā sampūjya keśavam ..
kṛtvāgnihavanaṃ śaktyā pūjayitvā dvijottamān .. 8 ..
meaning:
उपोष्य ऋक्षे विगते स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य केशवम् ..
कृत्वाग्निहवनं शक्त्या पूजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having fasted, when the asterism has passed, having bathed and worshipped Keśava, / having made fire-oblations according to his ability and honoured the foremost of twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyamannaṃ bhoktavyaṃ śṛṇu cāṅgakramaṃ mama ..
pādayoḥ kathitaṃ mūlaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu jaṅghayoḥ .. 9 ..
meaning:
हविष्यमन्नं भोक्तव्यं शृणु चाङ्गक्रमं मम ..
पादयोः कथितं मूलं प्राजापत्यं तु जङ्घयोः .. 9 ..
text_mt: sacrificial food should be eaten; and hear from me the sequence of the limbs: / Mūla is declared for the two feet, and Rohiṇī for the two shanks;

sanskrit_iast:
āśvinaṃ jānuyugalaṃ coruyugmaṃ ca pārthiva ..
sahite dve tathāṣāḍhe guhye ca sahite smṛte .. 1.155.10 ..
meaning:
आश्विनं जानुयुगलं चोरुयुग्मं च पार्थिव ..
सहिते द्वे तथाषाढे गुह्ये च सहिते स्मृते .. 1.155.10 ..
text_mt: Aśvinī is the pair of knees, and the pair of thighs, O king, / the two Āṣāḍhās together, and the private parts are remembered as the same two together;

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvottare ca phālgunyau kṛttikāsu kaṭirbhavet ..
pārśvayoḥ kukṣiyutayornakṣatratritayaṃ matam .. 11 ..
meaning:
पूर्वोत्तरे च फाल्गुन्यौ कृत्तिकासु कटिर्भवेत् ..
पार्श्वयोः कुक्षियुतयोर्नक्षत्रत्रितयं मतम् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Pūrva-phālgunī and Uttara-phālgunī, and at Kṛttikā is the waist. / For the two sides along with the belly, a triad of asterisms is held [to apply]:

sanskrit_iast:
ubhe proṣṭhapade rājanrevatī ca tathā bhaveta ..
uro'nurādhāsu tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ niṣṭyāsu kīrtitam .. 12 ..
meaning:
उभे प्रोष्ठपदे राजन्रेवती च तथा भवेत ..
उरोऽनुराधासु तथा पृष्ठं निष्ट्यासु कीर्तितम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: both Proṣṭhapadās, O king, and Revatī likewise. / The chest is in Anurādhā, and the back is declared in Niṣṭyā [Svātī];

sanskrit_iast:
bhujau jñeyau viśākhāsu haste proktau tathā karau ..
aṅgulyaśca tathā proktā rājasiṃha punarvasau .. 13 ..
meaning:
भुजौ ज्ञेयौ विशाखासु हस्ते प्रोक्तौ तथा करौ ..
अङ्गुल्यश्च तथा प्रोक्ता राजसिंह पुनर्वसौ .. 13 ..
text_mt: the two arms are to be known in the Viśākhās, and the two hands are stated in Hasta; / and the fingers are declared in Punarvasu, O lion among kings;

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāyāṃ tathā proktā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ nṛpa kandharā ..
śravaṇau śravaṇau jñeye mukhaṃ puṣye prakīrtitam .. 14 ..
meaning:
आश्लेषायां तथा प्रोक्ता ज्येष्ठायां नृप कन्धरा ..
श्रवणौ श्रवणौ ज्ञेये मुखं पुष्ये प्रकीर्तितम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: the [nails] are declared in Āśleṣā, the neck, O king, in Jyeṣṭhā; / Śravaṇa is known for the two ears, and the face is proclaimed in Puṣya.

sanskrit_iast:
dantāḥ svātau śatabhiṣā hanū proktau tathā nṛpa ..
maghāyāṃ nāsikā proktā mṛgaśīrṣe ca locane .. 15 ..
meaning:
दन्ताः स्वातौ शतभिषा हनू प्रोक्तौ तथा नृप ..
मघायां नासिका प्रोक्ता मृगशीर्षे च लोचने .. 15 ..
text_mt: The teeth are stated to be in Svāti, the jaws in Śatabhiṣā, O king; / the nose is stated to be in Maghā, and the eyes in Mṛgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
citrā lalāṭe vijñeyā bharaṇyaśca tathā śiraḥ ..
śiroruhāstathārdrāsu batasyānte narādhipa .. 16 ..
meaning:
चित्रा ललाटे विज्ञेया भरण्यश्च तथा शिरः ..
शिरोरुहास्तथार्द्रासु बतस्यान्ते नराधिप .. 16 ..
text_mt: Citrā should be known as the forehead, and Bharaṇī as the head; / the hair is likewise in Ārdrā at the end of the vow, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklāvasāne tu satraṃ parisamāpyate ..
yadyantarāyaṃ na bhavetkiñcicchaucanimittajam .. 17 ..
meaning:
माघशुक्लावसाने तु सत्रं परिसमाप्यते ..
यद्यन्तरायं न भवेत्किञ्चिच्छौचनिमित्तजम् .. 17 ..
text_mt: At the end of the bright fortnight of Māgha, however, the sacrificial session is concluded, / if there should be no impediment arising from ritual impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
antarāyaṃ mahārāja yadi śaucanimittajam ..
upoṣyamevopavasennakṣatramaparaṃ punaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
अन्तरायं महाराज यदि शौचनिमित्तजम् ..
उपोष्यमेवोपवसेन्नक्षत्रमपरं पुनः .. 18 ..
text_mt: If there is an impediment arising from ritual impurity, O great king, / one should fast again during another lunar mansion that is to be fasted upon.

sanskrit_iast:
kramaprāptaṃ hi nakṣatraṃ cāśuddhyāmapavarjitam ..
ullaṅghayanmahīpāla pratyavāyaṃ samaśnute ...39...
meaning:
क्रमप्राप्तं हि नक्षत्रं चाशुद्ध्यामपवर्जितम् ..
उल्लङ्घयन्महीपाल प्रत्यवायं समश्नुते ...39...
text_mt: For, skipping a lunar mansion arrived at in due order / that was omitted because of impurity, O protector of the earth, one incurs sin.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgakrameṇa sakalamṛkṣavargamupoṣitaḥ..
vratānte prayataḥ snātvā pūjayenmadhusūdanam .. 1.155.20 ..
meaning:
अङ्गक्रमेण सकलमृक्षवर्गमुपोषितः..
व्रतान्ते प्रयतः स्नात्वा पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम् .. 1.155.20 ..
text_mt: Having fasted upon the entire group of asterisms in the order of the limbs, / one should, subdued and bathed at the end of the vow, worship Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūramṛgadarpaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ ..
jātīphalaiḥ sakaṃkolairlavaṅgakusumaistathā .. 21 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूरमृगदर्पैः सकुङ्कुमैः ..
जातीफलैः सकंकोलैर्लवङ्गकुसुमैस्तथा .. 21 ..
text_mt: with sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, musk, along with saffron, / nutmegs, cubebs, and clove flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
bolaguggulaniryāsaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
dhūpo narendrāguruṇā candanena sugandhinā .. 22 ..
meaning:
बोलगुग्गुलनिर्यासैः पुष्पैः कालोद्भवैः शुभैः ..
धूपो नरेन्द्रागुरुणा चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना .. 22 ..
text_mt: with myrrh and bdellium resins, and auspicious seasonal flowers; / incense [should be offered], O ruler of men, with fragrant agallochum and sandalwood.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpāśca deyā rājendra tilatailaprapūritāḥ ..
dīpeṣu vartayaḥ kāryyā mahārañjanarañjitāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
दीपाश्च देया राजेन्द्र तिलतैलप्रपूरिताः ..
दीपेषु वर्तयः कार्य्या महारञ्जनरञ्जिताः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Lamps filled with sesame oil should also be given, O king of kings; / the wicks in the lamps should be dyed with safflower.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ ca tathā kāryaṃ paramānnena bhūriṇā ..
dadhnā kṣīrāmṛtābhyāṃ ca madhunā ca guḍena ca .. 24 ..
meaning:
नैवेद्यं च तथा कार्यं परमान्नेन भूरिणा ..
दध्ना क्षीरामृताभ्यां च मधुना च गुडेन च .. 24 ..
text_mt: And food offerings should be prepared with abundant sweet milk-rice, / curds, milk, and butter, and honey and jaggery,

sanskrit_iast:
sitayā ca tathā bhakṣyaiḥ phalamūlairyathāvidhi..
apūpaiḥ pānakairhṛdyaiḥ śītalaiśca sugandhibhiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
सितया च तथा भक्ष्यैः फलमूलैर्यथाविधि..
अपूपैः पानकैर्हृद्यैः शीतलैश्च सुगन्धिभिः .. 25 ..
text_mt: and white sugar, and similarly with eatables, fruits, and roots according to rule, / with cakes and pleasing, cool, fragrant beverages.

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇasya ca pātrāṇi kṛsaraṃ ca nivedayet ..
sarvabījāni rājendra bhūṣaṇāni ca śaktitaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
लवणस्य च पात्राणि कृसरं च निवेदयेत् ..
सर्वबीजानि राजेन्द्र भूषणानि च शक्तितः .. 26 ..
text_mt: One should offer vessels of salt and rice-pulse porridge, / all kinds of grains, O king of kings, and ornaments according to one's means,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārhāṇi ca vastrāṇi bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ ..
tadviṣṇoḥ pagmamiti homaḥ kāryo hyanantaram .. 27 ..
meaning:
महार्हाणि च वस्त्राणि भक्त्या प्रयतमानसः ..
तद्विष्णोः पग्ममिति होमः कार्यो ह्यनन्तरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: and costly garments with devotion and a concentrated mind. / Immediately after, a fire sacrifice should be performed with the mantra beginning 'tad viṣṇoḥ paramam padam'.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdreṣu vidhīyate ..
ghṛtaṃ mākṣikasaṃyuktaṃ juhuyātttilataṇḍusam .. 28 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाक्षरकं मन्त्रं स्त्रीशूद्रेषु विधीयते ..
घृतं माक्षिकसंयुक्तं जुहुयात्त्तिलतण्डुसम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: For women and śūdras, the twelve-syllable mantra is prescribed. / One should offer ghee mixed with honey, along with sesame seeds and unbroken rice grains.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā gurave nṛpasattama ..
nāgāśca madamattā vai grāmāśca vividhāstathā .. 29 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु दक्षिणा देया गुरवे नृपसत्तम ..
नागाश्च मदमत्ता वै ग्रामाश्च विविधास्तथा .. 29 ..
text_mt: Then sacrificial fee should be given to the guru, O best of kings: / rutting elephants indeed, and various villages,

sanskrit_iast:
turagāśca tathā mukhyā ratnāni vividhāni ca ..
brāhmaṇaśca pitā jñeyo rūpasatrapradarśakaḥ .. 1.155.30 ..
meaning:
तुरगाश्च तथा मुख्या रत्नानि विविधानि च ..
ब्राह्मणश्च पिता ज्ञेयो रूपसत्रप्रदर्शकः .. 1.155.30 ..
text_mt: and prime horses, and various jewels. / The brahmin who reveals this sacrificial session for beauty should be regarded as a father,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyajanmabhogapradāyakaḥ ..
rājyasya vā dvijatvasya bahuvittasya dāyakaḥ .... 31 ..
meaning:
रूपसौभाग्यलावण्यजन्मभोगप्रदायकः ..
राज्यस्य वा द्विजत्वस्य बहुवित्तस्य दायकः .... 31 ..
text_mt: as one who bestows beauty, good fortune, charm, birth, and pleasures of life, / or bestows royalty, status of the twice-born, and immense wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā gantuṃ dānena bhūriṇā ..
guruprasāda evātra dakṣiṇānāṃ tu kāraṇam .. 32 ..
meaning:
न तस्य निष्कृतिः शक्या गन्तुं दानेन भूरिणा ..
गुरुप्रसाद एवात्र दक्षिणानां तु कारणम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: No compensation can be made to him through lavish gifts; / the guru's favor alone is the cause behind the sacrificial fees here.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprasādamākāṅkṣedrūpasatra pradarśakāta ..
avaśyaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tu bhājanam .. 33 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रसादमाकाङ्क्षेद्रूपसत्र प्रदर्शकात ..
अवश्यं तस्य दातव्यं घृतपूर्णं तु भाजनम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: Therefore one should desire favor from the revealer of the sacrificial session for beauty. / Inevitably, a vessel filled with clarified butter must be given to him,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpalaṃ tu kāṃsyasya suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca ..
tataḥ paraṃ bhojanīyāḥ svaśaktyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ ..34..
meaning:
चतुष्पलं तु कांस्यस्य सुवर्णं काञ्चनस्य च ..
ततः परं भोजनीयाः स्वशक्त्या द्विजपुङ्गवाः ..34..
text_mt: made of four palas of bell-metal, and a suvarṇa weight of gold. / Thereafter, foremost twice-borns should be fed according to one's capacity,

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇakṣīramadhvājyaguḍabhakṣyasitotkaṭam ..
bhojanaṃ pānakopetaṃ paścāddeyā ca dakṣiṇā .. 3083 ..
meaning:
लवणक्षीरमध्वाज्यगुडभक्ष्यसितोत्कटम् ..
भोजनं पानकोपेतं पश्चाद्देया च दक्षिणा .. 3083 ..
text_mt: a meal rich in salt, milk, honey, clarified butter, jaggery, eatables, and white sugar, / accompanied by beverages; and afterward sacrificial fee should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrayugmaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya navaṃ śubham ..
brāhmaṇāya ca dātavyaṃ mahārājatarañjitam .. 36 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रयुग्मं प्रदातव्यं ब्राह्मणाय नवं शुभम् ..
ब्राह्मणाय च दातव्यं महाराजतरञ्जितम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: A pair of new, auspicious garments should be given to a brahmin, / dyed with saffron, it should be given to a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
saptabījāni deyāni lavaṇaṃ rūpyameva ca ..
yaccānyadapyabhīṣṭaṃ syācchatropānatkameva ca .. 37 ..
meaning:
सप्तबीजानि देयानि लवणं रूप्यमेव च ..
यच्चान्यदप्यभीष्टं स्याच्छत्रोपानत्कमेव च .. 37 ..
text_mt: Seven seeds should be given, salt, silver, / and whatever else may be desired, including an umbrella and sandals.

sanskrit_iast:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ satradāne mahīpate ..
avaśyadeyaṃ satre'sminghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam .. 38 ..
meaning:
वित्तशाठ्यं न कर्तव्यं सत्रदाने महीपते ..
अवश्यदेयं सत्रेऽस्मिन्घृतपूर्णं च भाजनम् .. 38 ..
text_mt: One should not practice deceit regarding wealth in the giving for the sacrificial session, O protector of the earth. / In this sacrificial session, a vessel filled with clarified butter must certainly be given,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpalaṃ tu kāṃsyasya suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca ..
vratenānena cīrṇena dehatyāge dinaṃ gataḥ ..39..
meaning:
चतुष्पलं तु कांस्यस्य सुवर्णं काञ्चनस्य च ..
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन देहत्यागे दिनं गतः ..39..
text_mt: made of four palas of bell-metal, and a suvarṇa weight of gold. / Having performed this vow, upon giving up the body, one goes to the realm of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ mānuṣye yadi jāyate ..
rājā bhavati dharmātmā brāhmaṇo vā dhanānvitaḥ .. 1.155.40 ..
meaning:
तत्रोष्य सुचिरं कालं मानुष्ये यदि जायते ..
राजा भवति धर्मात्मा ब्राह्मणो वा धनान्वितः .. 1.155.40 ..
text_mt: Dwelling there for a very long time, if born in the human world, / he becomes a righteous king or a wealthy brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
kule mahati sambhūto rūpeṇā'pratimo bhuvi ..
ārogyaṃ mahadāpnoti saubhāgyamapi cottamam .. 41 ..
meaning:
कुले महति सम्भूतो रूपेणाऽप्रतिमो भुवि ..
आरोग्यं महदाप्नोति सौभाग्यमपि चोत्तमम् .. 41 ..
text_mt: born in a great lineage, peerless in beauty on earth; / he obtains great health and also the highest good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
lāvaṇyaṃ buddhi medhe ca matiṃ dharme ca śāśvatīm ..
sampūrṇacandrapratimaḥ sarvasattvavaśaṅkaraḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
लावण्यं बुद्धि मेधे च मतिं धर्मे च शाश्वतीम् ..
सम्पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमः सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्करः .. 42 ..
text_mt: charm, intellect, wisdom, and an eternal mind fixed on dharma. / Resembling the full moon, subduing all living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
naro bhavati rājendra nārī cāpsarasopamā ..
subhagā darśanīyā ca lāvaṇyaguṇasaṃyutā .. 43 ..
meaning:
नरो भवति राजेन्द्र नारी चाप्सरसोपमा ..
सुभगा दर्शनीया च लावण्यगुणसंयुता .. 43 ..
text_mt: the man becomes, O king of kings; and a woman becomes like an apsaras, / fortunate, lovely to behold, endowed with charm and virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
bahudhānyā bahudhanā bahubhūpaṇasaṃyutā ..
bhartuścātyantadayitā loke khyātā ca sadguṇaiḥ ..
nityārogyavatī śāntā sarvadoṣavivarjitā ..44..
meaning:
बहुधान्या बहुधना बहुभूपणसंयुता ..
भर्तुश्चात्यन्तदयिता लोके ख्याता च सद्गुणैः ..
नित्यारोग्यवती शान्ता सर्वदोषविवर्जिता ..44..
text_mt: having much grain, much wealth, endowed with many ornaments, / exceedingly beloved by her husband, famed in the world for good virtues, / endowed with constant health, tranquil, free from all flaws,

sanskrit_iast: candrānanā nīlasarojanetrā trailokyakāntā pativallabhā ca ..45..
meaning: चन्द्रानना नीलसरोजनेत्रा त्रैलोक्यकान्ता पतिवल्लभा च ..45..
text_mt: moon-faced, with eyes like blue lotuses, beloved of the three worlds, dear to her husband.

sanskrit_iast: bhavatyavaśyaṃ subhagā sunīlā lāvaṇyayuktā yaśasā śriyā ca .. 46 ..
meaning: भवत्यवश्यं सुभगा सुनीला लावण्ययुक्ता यशसा श्रिया च .. 46 ..
text_mt: She inevitably becomes fortunate, dark and radiant, endowed with charm, fame, and splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
.. purūravā uvāca ..
bhagavansarvadharmajña pitāmaha mahādyute ..
gurutvaṃ me vrate tasminkartumarhasi mānada .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. पुरूरवा उवाच ..
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ पितामह महाद्युते ..
गुरुत्वं मे व्रते तस्मिन्कर्तुमर्हसि मानद .. 1 ..
text_mt: Purūravas said: / O lord, knower of all dharma, grandsire of great radiance, / O honor-giver, be pleased to act as my guru in this vow,
title: Purūravasassvapuragamanam

sanskrit_iast:
vratāvasāne ca tathā sāmagryaṃ dvijapuṅgava ..
evaṃ śakyosmyaraṇyesminkartuṃ brahmanmahadvratam .. 2 ..
meaning:
व्रतावसाने च तथा सामग्र्यं द्विजपुङ्गव ..
एवं शक्योस्म्यरण्येस्मिन्कर्तुं ब्रह्मन्महद्व्रतम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: and also [supply] the ritual paraphernalia at the conclusion of the vow, O foremost among the twice-born. / In this way, O brahmin, I shall be able to perform this great vow in this forest.

sanskrit_iast:
atriruvāca .. tava prasādaṃ bhagavānsarvātmā madhusūdanaḥ ..
kurute'haṃ kariṣyāmi gurutvamaparājitaḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
अत्रिरुवाच .. तव प्रसादं भगवान्सर्वात्मा मधुसूदनः ..
कुरुतेऽहं करिष्यामि गुरुत्वमपराजितः .. 3 ..
text_mt: Atri said: / The holy Madhusūdana, the soul of all, extends his favor to you. / I, invincible, will act as the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
vratāvasāne ca tathā sāmagryaṃ dvijapuṅgavaiḥ ..
kāmāssannihitāścānyairdeśe'sminnṛpa sarvadā .. 4 ..
meaning:
व्रतावसाने च तथा सामग्र्यं द्विजपुङ्गवैः ..
कामास्सन्निहिताश्चान्यैर्देशेऽस्मिन्नृप सर्वदा .. 4 ..
text_mt: and likewise [provide] the ritual paraphernalia along with foremost twice-borns at the conclusion of the vow; / all desires are made present by others in this region at all times, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktvā sa dharmātmā saptame ca dine tadā ..
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ saptamīyoge grāhayāmāsa taṃ vratam .. 5 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एवमुक्त्वा स धर्मात्मा सप्तमे च दिने तदा ..
ज्येष्ठायां सप्तमीयोगे ग्राहयामास तं व्रतम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus, that righteous-souled one on the seventh day then, / on the conjunction of the seventh lunar day with Jyeṣṭhā, initiated him into that vow.

sanskrit_iast:
pādarkṣāttu prabhṛtyevamṛkṣeṛkṣe narādhipaḥ ..
kārayāmāsa devasya kathitāṅgādipūjanam .. 6 ..
meaning:
पादर्क्षात्तु प्रभृत्येवमृक्षेऋक्षे नराधिपः ..
कारयामास देवस्य कथिताङ्गादिपूजनम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Beginning from the asterism presiding over the feet, under each successive asterism, the ruler of men / had worship performed of the respective limbs and other parts of the deity as prescribed,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ nakṣatranirdiṣṭaṃ nakṣatrasya ca pūjanam ..
nakṣatradaivatasyāpi somasya varuṇasya ca .. 7 ..
meaning:
स्नानं नक्षत्रनिर्दिष्टं नक्षत्रस्य च पूजनम् ..
नक्षत्रदैवतस्यापि सोमस्य वरुणस्य च .. 7 ..
text_mt: the bath prescribed for the lunar mansion, and worship of the lunar mansion, / of the deity of the lunar mansion, of Soma, and of Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ ca tathā viṣṇordevadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
homaṃ tathaiva sarveṣāṃ yathāvanmanujeśvara .. 8 ..
meaning:
पूजनं च तथा विष्णोर्देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ..
होमं तथैव सर्वेषां यथावन्मनुजेश्वर .. 8 ..
text_mt: and likewise the worship of Viṣṇu, the god of gods who holds the discus, / and similarly a fire sacrifice for all of them properly, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklamaghāṃ prāpya dvādaśīṃ ca tathā tithim ..
atrirvratāvasāne tamāgato brāhmaṇaiḥ saha .. 9 ..
meaning:
माघशुक्लमघां प्राप्य द्वादशीं च तथा तिथिम् ..
अत्रिर्व्रतावसाने तमागतो ब्राह्मणैः सह .. 9 ..
text_mt: When the asterism Maghā and the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Māgha arrived, / Atri came to him together with brahmins at the conclusion of the vow.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāvasāne saṃpūjya kethavāṅgārcisomajāna ..
rājyaṃ nivedayāmāsa so'treḥ sakalameva hi .. 1.156.10 ..
meaning:
व्रतावसाने संपूज्य केथवाङ्गार्चिसोमजान ..
राज्यं निवेदयामास सोऽत्रेः सकलमेव हि .. 1.156.10 ..
text_mt: At the conclusion of the vow, having worshipped the limbs of Keśava, the fire, and the deities born of Soma, / he offered the entire kingdom to Atri.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigṛhya ca tadrājyaṃ tasmādvai mantravinnṛpa ..
bhūyaḥ prādātsa tasyaiva vacanañcedamabravīt .. 11 ..
meaning:
प्रतिगृह्य च तद्राज्यं तस्माद्वै मन्त्रविन्नृप ..
भूयः प्रादात्स तस्यैव वचनञ्चेदमब्रवीत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Having accepted that kingdom from him, that knower of mantras, O king, / gave it back to him once more and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
na me rājyena kartavyaṃ kiñcidevāsti pārthiva ..
na dhanena na kāmena yājitā dhruvayājñiyāḥ .. 12 ..
meaning:
न मे राज्येन कर्तव्यं किञ्चिदेवास्ति पार्थिव ..
न धनेन न कामेन याजिता ध्रुवयाज्ञियाः .. 12 ..
text_mt: "I have no need of a kingdom whatsoever, O king, / nor of wealth, nor of desire; the permanent sacrificers have been made to sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
samatvaṃ rājaśārdūla svasti gaccha gṛhānprati ..
evamuktvā yayāvatrirantardhānamatheśvaraḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
समत्वं राजशार्दूल स्वस्ति गच्छ गृहान्प्रति ..
एवमुक्त्वा ययावत्रिरन्तर्धानमथेश्वरः .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Having attained equanimity, O tiger among kings, go home safely!"
Having spoken thus, the lord Atri vanished then and there.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairdvijagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tadā gatvā sa pārthivaḥ ..
devapuṣkāraṇītoye snātamātro babhūva ha .. 14 ..
meaning:
सर्वैर्द्विजगणैः सार्धं तदा गत्वा स पार्थिवः ..
देवपुष्कारणीतोये स्नातमात्रो बभूव ह .. 14 ..
text_mt:
Then, having gone along with all the hosts of twice-born, that king,
the moment he bathed in the water of the divine pond, became indeed

sanskrit_iast:
taptajāmbūnadākāro nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ ..
pṛthuvakṣā mahābāhustanukukṣirmahākaṭiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
तप्तजाम्बूनदाकारो नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजः ..
पृथुवक्षा महाबाहुस्तनुकुक्षिर्महाकटिः .. 15 ..
text_mt:
endowed with the appearance of heated gold, with dark, curling hair,
broad-chested, mighty-armed, slender-waisted, and broad-hipped,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvarājapratimaḥ sarvasattvavaśaṅkaraḥ ..
rūpaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā gandharvasattamāḥ .. 16 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमः सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्करः ..
रूपं तु तादृशं तस्य दृष्ट्वा गन्धर्वसत्तमाः .. 16 ..
text_mt:
resembling a king of the Gandharvas, subduing all creatures.
Seeing such a form of his, the foremost Gandharvas

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivāpsaraso mukhyā diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti te'buvan ..
sabhājya pārthivaṃ tena pūjitāḥ prayayuḥ sukham .. 17 ..
meaning:
तथैवाप्सरसो मुख्या दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्येति तेऽबुवन् ..
सभाज्य पार्थिवं तेन पूजिताः प्रययुः सुखम् .. 17 ..
text_mt:
and likewise the principal apsarases exclaimed, "Joy! Joy!"
Having honoured the king and being honoured by him, they departed happily.

sanskrit_iast:
nītvā saṃvatsaraṃ tatra pūrṇe saṃvatsaraṃ nṛpaḥ ..
devatāṃścāpyathāmantrya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi .. 18 ..
meaning:
नीत्वा संवत्सरं तत्र पूर्णे संवत्सरं नृपः ..
देवतांश्चाप्यथामन्त्र्य पूजयित्वा यथाविधि .. 18 ..
text_mt:
Having spent a year there, when the full year had elapsed, the king,
having taken leave of the deities and worshipped them in accordance with rule,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā puṣkariṇīṃ puṇyāṃ guhāṃ padmasarastathā ..
āśramaṃ śailamukhyaṃ ca tathaiva ca vanaspatim .. 19 ..
meaning:
तथा पुष्करिणीं पुण्यां गुहां पद्मसरस्तथा ..
आश्रमं शैलमुख्यं च तथैव च वनस्पतिम् .. 19 ..
text_mt:
and likewise [bidding farewell to] the sacred lotus-pond, the cave, the lotus-lake,
the hermitage, the foremost mountain, and the great tree,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva prayayau svapuraṃ tataḥ ..
uccasaṅgamasamprāptā dṛṣṭo vaiṣayikaistataḥ .. 1.156.20 ..
meaning:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव प्रययौ स्वपुरं ततः ..
उच्चसङ्गमसम्प्राप्ता दृष्टो वैषयिकैस्ततः .. 1.156.20 ..
text_mt:
and to the Gandharvas and apsarases, then set out for his own city.
Reaching a high assembly, he was seen by the provincial inhabitants.

sanskrit_iast:
stuto devaprasādācca bhaktyā taiścābhinanditaḥ ..
sattvaraiśca tathā kaiścidamātyānāṃ niveditaḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
स्तुतो देवप्रसादाच्च भक्त्या तैश्चाभिनन्दितः ..
सत्त्वरैश्च तथा कैश्चिदमात्यानां निवेदितः .. 21 ..
text_mt:
Praised on account of divine grace and greeted by them with devotion,
he was also announced to his ministers by some who went swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
amātyāścāgataṃ śrutvā labdhakāmaṃ narādhipam ..
niryayurnagarāttasmāccaturaṅgabalānvitāḥ ..22..
meaning:
अमात्याश्चागतं श्रुत्वा लब्धकामं नराधिपम् ..
निर्ययुर्नगरात्तस्माच्चतुरङ्गबलान्विताः ..22..
text_mt:
Hearing that the ruler of men had returned, having attained his desire,
the ministers came forth from that city accompanied by a fourfold army.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaḥ pratigrahārthaṃ te gaṇamukhyapuraḥsarāḥ ..
taiḥ sametya sa rājarṣiryathāvanmanujeśvara ..23..
meaning:
राज्ञः प्रतिग्रहार्थं ते गणमुख्यपुरःसराः ..
तैः समेत्य स राजर्षिर्यथावन्मनुजेश्वर ..23..
text_mt:
Led by the chiefs of their corps to receive the king,
meeting with them, that royal seer, O lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpitena gajendreṇa patākādhvajaśobhinā ..
praviveśa puraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ śākalaṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
कल्पितेन गजेन्द्रेण पताकाध्वजशोभिना ..
प्रविवेश पुरं हृष्टः शाकलं नाम नामतः .. 24 ..
text_mt:
delighted, mounted upon an appointed lordly elephant adorned with banners and flags,
entered the city known by the name of Śākala.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaḥ praveśe tatpauraiḥ sitacandanavāriṇā ..
bahuvarṇaistathā puṣpaiyathāsthāne vibhūṣitam .. 25..
meaning:
राज्ञः प्रवेशे तत्पौरैः सितचन्दनवारिणा ..
बहुवर्णैस्तथा पुष्पैयथास्थाने विभूषितम् .. 25..
text_mt:
At the entrance of the king, it was adorned by its citizens in every place
with white sandalwood-water and multi-coloured flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurusārāṇāṃ dhūpanaiḥ surabhīkṛtam ..
mahocchritapatākāḍhyaṃ mālyadāmapariṣkṛtam.. 26 ..
meaning:
चन्दनागुरुसाराणां धूपनैः सुरभीकृतम् ..
महोच्छ्रितपताकाढ्यं माल्यदामपरिष्कृतम्.. 26 ..
text_mt:
made fragrant by fumigations of essences of sandalwood and agallochum,
rich in lofty flags, and decorated with garlands and wreaths,

sanskrit_iast:
mālyamodakahastaiśca paurajānapadairyutam ..
atīva janasaṃbādhamatīva sumanoharam .. 27 ..
meaning:
माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्च पौरजानपदैर्युतम् ..
अतीव जनसंबाधमतीव सुमनोहरम् .. 27 ..
text_mt:
filled with citizens and country folk bearing garlands and sweetmeats in their hands,
exceedingly crowded with people, and exceedingly enchanting.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādavarasaṃsthāśca gavākṣakagatāstathā ..
vedikāsthāśca paśyanti striyastaṃ manmathārditāḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
प्रासादवरसंस्थाश्च गवाक्षकगतास्तथा ..
वेदिकास्थाश्च पश्यन्ति स्त्रियस्तं मन्मथार्दिताः .. 28 ..
text_mt:
Standing upon excellent mansions, stationed at the lattice windows,
and standing on balconies, the women, afflicted by love, looked upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
sa muṣṇanyoṣitāṃ cittaṃ dṛśaśca manujādhipaḥ ..
lājācandanacūrṇaiśca kīryamāṇaḥ samantataḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
स मुष्णन्योषितां चित्तं दृशश्च मनुजाधिपः ..
लाजाचन्दनचूर्णैश्च कीर्यमाणः समन्ततः .. 29 ..
text_mt:
Stealing the hearts and eyes of the women, that ruler of men,
strewed on all sides with parched grain and sandalwood-powder,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiśca strīkaronmuktaiḥ pūryamāṇo narādhipaḥ ..
abhigamya ca tatrāsau devatāyatanāṃstataḥ .. 1.156.30 ..
meaning:
पुष्पैश्च स्त्रीकरोन्मुक्तैः पूर्यमाणो नराधिपः ..
अभिगम्य च तत्रासौ देवतायतनांस्ततः .. 1.156.30 ..
text_mt:
showered with flowers released from the hands of women, that ruler of men,
having approached the shrines of the deities there,

sanskrit_iast:
praviveśa gṛhaṃ śrīmacchāradābhracayopamam ..
tatrābhigamanaṃ kṛtvā devatānāṃ yathāvidhi .. 31 ..
meaning:
प्रविवेश गृहं श्रीमच्छारदाभ्रचयोपमम् ..
तत्राभिगमनं कृत्वा देवतानां यथाविधि .. 31 ..
text_mt:
entered his splendid palace resembling a mass of autumn clouds.
Having paid homage to the deities there according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā vividhairdhanasañcayaiḥ ..
sabhāsthaṃ sāntvayāmāsa paurajānapadaṃ janam .. 32 ..
meaning:
संपूज्य ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या विविधैर्धनसञ्चयैः ..
सभास्थं सान्त्वयामास पौरजानपदं जनम् .. 32 ..
text_mt:
and having honoured the brahmins with devotion with heaps of various riches,
he comforted the people of the city and country assembled in the court.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvāsya preṣayāmāsa gṛhānyodhajanaṃ tathā ..
janānurāgasaṃyuktastataḥ prabhṛti pārthivaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
आश्वास्य प्रेषयामास गृहान्योधजनं तथा ..
जनानुरागसंयुक्तस्ततः प्रभृति पार्थिवः .. 33 ..
text_mt:
Having cheered the warrior-folk, he dismissed them to their homes.
From then on, the king, endowed with the affection of his people,

sanskrit_iast:
rājaśāstropadeśena pālayāmāsa medinīm ..
reme ca saha rāmābhirgandharvapratimo yuvā .. 34 ..
meaning:
राजशास्त्रोपदेशेन पालयामास मेदिनीम् ..
रेमे च सह रामाभिर्गन्धर्वप्रतिमो युवा .. 34 ..
text_mt:
protected the earth according to the precepts of royal science,
and, resembling a Gandharva, the youth sported with lovely women.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu kālena mahatā rājā pañcatvamāgataḥ ..
uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
स तु कालेन महता राजा पञ्चत्वमागतः ..
उवास सुचिरं कालं पूज्यमानः सुरोत्तमैः .. 35 ..
text_mt:
Then, after a great length of time, the king met his death
and dwelt for a very long time worshipped by the foremost of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantare hyatīte tu cākṣuṣasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vaivasvate'tha samprāpte budhaputratvamāgataḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
मन्वन्तरे ह्यतीते तु चाक्षुषस्य महात्मनः ..
वैवस्वतेऽथ सम्प्राप्ते बुधपुत्रत्वमागतः .. 36 ..
text_mt:
When the manvantara of the great-souled Cākṣuṣa had passed away,
and when the Vaivasvata arrived, he became the son of Budha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tasya tu yadrūpaṃ saubhāgyādeva viśrutam ..
saśarīrasya ca tathā svarloke gamanaṃ nṛpa .. 37 ..
meaning:
तत्र तस्य तु यद्रूपं सौभाग्यादेव विश्रुतम् ..
सशरीरस्य च तथा स्वर्लोके गमनं नृप .. 37 ..
text_mt:
There indeed, his beauty was famed only through good fortune;
and likewise his going in his physical body to the heavenly world, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
svargato'pi sa rājarṣiḥ kṣīṇe vaivasvate'ntare ..
praviśyātipuraṃ viṣṇoścandramaṇḍalamadhyagam .. 38 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गतोऽपि स राजर्षिः क्षीणे वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ..
प्रविश्यातिपुरं विष्णोश्चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगम् .. 38 ..
text_mt:
Even having gone to heaven, when the Vaivasvata manvantara has expired, that royal seer,
entering the supreme city of Viṣṇu, will dwell within the lunar orb.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ karmaṇā yena pārthivaḥ ..
avāpa tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ saubhāgyamapi cottamam .. 39 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कर्मणा येन पार्थिवः ..
अवाप तादृशं रूपं सौभाग्यमपि चोत्तमम् .. 39 ..
text_mt:
All this has been told to you, by which deed the king
obtained such a form and also supreme good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayanti hariṃ devaṃ sāttvikāstu nirāśiṣaḥ ..
rājasāḥ kāmakāmāśca krūrakāmāśca tāmasāḥ .. 1.156.40 ..
meaning:
पूजयन्ति हरिं देवं सात्त्विकास्तु निराशिषः ..
राजसाः कामकामाश्च क्रूरकामाश्च तामसाः .. 1.156.40 ..
text_mt:
Those of the sattva nature, free from expectations, worship the god Hari;
those of the rajas nature seek their desires, and those of the tamas nature seek cruel ends.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ sampūjya manasā rājasena purūravāḥ ..
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ babhau .. 41 ..
meaning:
हरिं सम्पूज्य मनसा राजसेन पुरूरवाः ..
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् बभौ .. 41 ..
text_mt:
Purūravas, having worshipped Hari with a mind of rajas,
shone as sole sovereign over the earth with its seven continents and oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ sudurlabhaṃ prāpya sthānaṃ prāpsyati śāśvatam ..
nāsti viṣṇusamo nātho nāsti viṣṇusamā gatiḥ .. 42 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गं सुदुर्लभं प्राप्य स्थानं प्राप्स्यति शाश्वतम् ..
नास्ति विष्णुसमो नाथो नास्ति विष्णुसमा गतिः .. 42 ..
text_mt:
Having attained heaven, so difficult to reach, he will attain an eternal abode.
There is no protector equal to Viṣṇu, there is no refuge equal to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti viṣṇusamaṃ trāṇaṃ narasyārtasya bheṣajam ..
satkṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ devasya cakriṇaḥ .. 43 ..
meaning:
नास्ति विष्णुसमं त्राणं नरस्यार्तस्य भेषजम् ..
सत्कृतं पूजनं येन कृतं देवस्य चक्रिणः .. 43 ..
text_mt:
There is no protection equal to Viṣṇu, the medicine for afflicted man.
By whomsoever a reverent worship of the discus-bearing god is performed,

sanskrit_iast:
ārātrikaṃ kṛtaṃ tena saṃprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam ..
yena saṃkīrtitaṃ rājanharirityakṣaradvayam .. 44 ..
meaning:
आरात्रिकं कृतं तेन संप्राप्तं परमं पदम् ..
येन संकीर्तितं राजन्हरिरित्यक्षरद्वयम् .. 44 ..
text_mt:
and the waving of lights has been offered, the supreme abode is attained.
By whomsoever, O king, the two syllables 'Ha-ri' are chanted,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gaganaṃ prati ..
etatte budhaputrasya triṣu janmasu pārthiva ..
caritaṃ sakalaṃ proktaṃ yena sampūjito hariḥ .. 45 ..
meaning:
बद्धः परिकरस्तेन मोक्षाय गगनं प्रति ..
एतत्ते बुधपुत्रस्य त्रिषु जन्मसु पार्थिव ..
चरितं सकलं प्रोक्तं येन सम्पूजितो हरिः .. 45 ..
text_mt:
a belt is girded by him for liberation towards the skies.
Thus, O king, the entire account of the son of Budha through three births
has been told to you, by whom Hari was worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ puṣṭivivardhanaṃ ca ..
śrotavyametanniyataṃ ca sadbhirākhyānamūrjaskaramṛddhikāmaiḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यं रिपुनाशनं च सौभाग्यदं पुष्टिविवर्धनं च ..
श्रोतव्यमेतन्नियतं च सद्भिराख्यानमूर्जस्करमृद्धिकामैः .. 46 ..
text_mt:
Auspicious, bringing renown, destroying enemies, granting good fortune, and increasing prosperity,
this invigorating narrative must constantly be heard by the virtuous who desire abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
dvādaśīṣu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sopavāsena pūjitaḥ ..
rājyapradaḥ syāddharmajña tanme tvaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
द्वादशीषु कथं विष्णुः सोपवासेन पूजितः ..
राज्यप्रदः स्याद्धर्मज्ञ तन्मे त्वं ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Vajra said:
How is Viṣṇu, worshipped with fasting on the twelfth days,
a bestower of kingdom, O knower of dharma? Tell me that in truth.
title: adhyāyaḥ 157

sanskrit_iast:
paśya rājyasya māhātmyaṃ yatra dharmasakhāvubhau ..
śṛṇu tasya ca dharmasya phalabhāgdhārmiko nṛpaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पश्य राज्यस्य माहात्म्यं यत्र धर्मसखावुभौ ..
शृणु तस्य च धर्मस्य फलभाग्धार्मिको नृपः .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Behold the majesty of a kingdom, wherein both [the king and his subject] are companions in dharma;
hear, and the righteous king is a sharer in the fruit of that dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ ..
rājñā saṃrakṣitāḥ sarve śakyā dharmaṃ niṣevitum .. 3 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः ..
राज्ञा संरक्षिताः सर्वे शक्या धर्मं निषेवितुम् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
The student of the Veda, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the mendicant—
all these, protected by the king, are able to practice dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa rājā devavapurdharaḥ ..
kṣattriyo'pi sadā pūjyo brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām .. 4 ..
meaning:
मानुषेण शरीरेण राजा देववपुर्धरः ..
क्षत्त्रियोऽपि सदा पूज्यो ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
Though possessing a human body, the king bears the form of a god;
though a kṣatriya, he is ever worthy of worship by the great-souled brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā rājyaṃ hi yā lakṣmīḥ paratantrā hi sā matā ..
tasmādrājyaṃ praśaṃsanti tatrājñā na vihanyate .. 9 ..
meaning:
विना राज्यं हि या लक्ष्मीः परतन्त्रा हि सा मता ..
तस्माद्राज्यं प्रशंसन्ति तत्राज्ञा न विहन्यते .. 9 ..
text_mt:
For royal fortune without a kingdom is considered dependent on another;
therefore they praise kingdom, [for] therein one's command is not thwarted.

sanskrit_iast:
tulyadhātuśarīrāṇāṃ tulyāvayavajīvinām ..
narendrāṇāṃ narairbrahmandevavadbhuvi manyate .. 6 ..
meaning:
तुल्यधातुशरीराणां तुल्यावयवजीविनाम् ..
नरेन्द्राणां नरैर्ब्रह्मन्देववद्भुवि मन्यते .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Though having bodies of the same elements and living with the same limbs,
rulers of men, O brahmin, are regarded by men on earth like gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ tasmādvaktumarhati me bhavān ..
yāmupoṣya mahadrājyaṃ prāpnuyātsa tu vai dvijaḥ .. 7 ..
meaning:
राज्यदां द्वादशीं तस्माद्वक्तुमर्हति मे भवान् ..
यामुपोष्य महद्राज्यं प्राप्नुयात्स तु वै द्विजः .. 7 ..
text_mt:
Therefore, you ought to tell me of the twelfth-day rite that grants kingship,
fasting on which, a twice-born may indeed obtain a great kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanrājyadāṃ dvādaśīṃ śubhām ..
yāmupoṣya naro loke rājyamāpnotyakaṇṭakam .. 8 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
शृणुष्वावहितो राजन्राज्यदां द्वादशीं शुभाम् ..
यामुपोष्य नरो लोके राज्यमाप्नोत्यकण्टकम् .. 8 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
