Listen attentively, O King, to the auspicious Dvādaśī that grants kingdom, / by fasting on which a man in this world attains a kingdom free from thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣe narādhipa ..
daśamyāṃ prayataḥ kṛtvā snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam .. 9 ..
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य शुक्लपक्षे नराधिप ..
दशम्यां प्रयतः कृत्वा स्नानमभ्यङ्गपूर्वकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O ruler of men, / after taking a bath preceded by oil anointment on the tenth lunar day with controlled senses,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsasya saṃkalpaṃ śvobhūtasya tu kārayet ..
devāgāre kuśāstīrṇāmekavastrottaracchadām ..1.157.1 0..
meaning:
उपवासस्य संकल्पं श्वोभूतस्य तु कारयेत् ..
देवागारे कुशास्तीर्णामेकवस्त्रोत्तरच्छदाम् ..1.157.1 0..
text_mt: he should make the resolution for the fast of the following day. / In a temple, on the ground strewn with kuśa grass and covered with a single cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāsīta mahīṃ tatra tāṃ rātriṃ prayato nayet ..
dvitīye'hni tataḥ kuryādbahiḥ snānamatandritaḥ .. 11 ..
meaning:
अध्यासीत महीं तत्र तां रात्रिं प्रयतो नयेत् ..
द्वितीयेऽह्नि ततः कुर्याद्बहिः स्नानमतन्द्रितः .. 11 ..
text_mt: he should lie down and spend that night with self-restraint. / Then, on the second day, unflagging, he should bathe in open water.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ devadevasya sarvaṃ śuklena kārayet ..
karpūraṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ mallikā śvetayūthikā ..12..
meaning:
पूजनं देवदेवस्य सर्वं शुक्लेन कारयेत् ..
कर्पूरं चन्दनं देयं मल्लिका श्वेतयूथिका ..12..
text_mt: He should perform the entire worship of the God of gods with white materials: / camphor and sandalwood should be offered, [along with] jasmine and white jasmine,

sanskrit_iast:
jātyā ca śuklā rājendra dhūpe karpūrameva ca ..
ghṛtena dīpā dātavyā śuklavartisamanvitā . .. 13 ..
meaning:
जात्या च शुक्ला राजेन्द्र धूपे कर्पूरमेव च ..
घृतेन दीपा दातव्या शुक्लवर्तिसमन्विता . .. 13 ..
text_mt: and white Spanish jasmine, O best of kings; and camphor in the incense. / Lamps provided with white wicks should be offered with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtaudanaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva ca ..
ikṣumikṣuvikārāṃśca devadeve nivedayet .. 14 ..
meaning:
घृतौदनं दधि क्षीरं परमान्नं तथैव च ..
इक्षुमिक्षुविकारांश्च देवदेवे निवेदयेत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: Rice cooked with clarified butter, curd, milk, and sweet rice-milk, / as well as sugarcane and sugarcane products, he should present to the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kālodbhavaṃ mūlaphalaṃ varṇaṃ tatra na cintayeta ..
yathālābhena taddeyaṃ śuklaṃ cetsyādviśeṣataḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
कालोद्भवं मूलफलं वर्णं तत्र न चिन्तयेत ..
यथालाभेन तद्देयं शुक्लं चेत्स्याद्विशेषतः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Seasonal roots and fruits—he need not consider their colour; / whatever is obtained should be offered, but if it is white, it is especially [laudable].

sanskrit_iast:
havanaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ paramānnena pārthiva ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paraṃ ityevaṃ homamantro vidhīyate .. 16 ..
meaning:
हवनं च ततः कार्यं परमान्नेन पार्थिव ..
तद्विष्णोः परं इत्येवं होममन्त्रो विधीयते .. 16 ..
text_mt: Then an oblation into the fire should be made with sweet rice-milk, O king; / 'Tad viṣṇoḥ paramam' is prescribed as the mantra for the fire offering.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ mantraṃ strīśūdrasya vidhīyate ..
tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā sampūjya ca dvijān .. 17 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाक्षरकं मन्त्रं स्त्रीशूद्रस्य विधीयते ..
ततोऽग्निहवनं कृत्वा शक्त्या सम्पूज्य च द्विजान् .. 17 ..
text_mt: The twelve-syllable mantra is prescribed for women and śūdras. / Having then made the offering into the fire and worshipped the twice-born according to one's capacity,

sanskrit_iast:
sitaraṃgena kartavyā bhūmiśobhā surālaye ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gīta nṛtyaṃ ca pārthiva .. 18 ..
meaning:
सितरंगेन कर्तव्या भूमिशोभा सुरालये ..
रात्रौ जागरणं कार्यं गीत नृत्यं च पार्थिव .. 18 ..
text_mt: decoration of the floor should be made in the temple with white colour. / A vigil should be kept at night with song and dance, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā caiva devasya kartavyaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ..
dvādaśyāṃ vidhinā'nena bhūyaḥ pūjyo janārdanaḥ ... .. 19 ..
meaning:
कर्मणा चैव देवस्य कर्तव्यं श्रवणं तथा ..
द्वादश्यां विधिनाऽनेन भूयः पूज्यो जनार्दनः ... .. 19 ..
text_mt: and listening [to stories] of the deeds of the god should be performed. / On the twelfth day, according to this rule, Janārdana should be worshipped again.

sanskrit_iast:
rājaliṅgaṃ pradātavyamekaṃ viprāya dakṣiṇā ..
tatastu paścādbhoktavyaṃ haviṣyaṃ pārthivottama ..1.157.20..
meaning:
राजलिङ्गं प्रदातव्यमेकं विप्राय दक्षिणा ..
ततस्तु पश्चाद्भोक्तव्यं हविष्यं पार्थिवोत्तम ..1.157.20..
text_mt: A single royal emblem should be given to a brahmin as the sacrificial fee. / Then, afterwards, haviṣya food should be eaten, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī yathā madhye snānayorantare nṛpa ..
kaṣṭaṃ maunaṃ tu kartavyaṃ japyaṃ kāryaṃ tu mānasam .. 21 ..
meaning:
एकादशी यथा मध्ये स्नानयोरन्तरे नृप ..
कष्टं मौनं तु कर्तव्यं जप्यं कार्यं तु मानसम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: On the eleventh day falling in the middle between the two baths, O king, / strict silence must be observed, and mental recitation performed.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśīṣveva śuklāsu sarvāsvevāviśeṣataḥ ..
vidhistavāyaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsveva ca kārayet .. 22 ..
meaning:
द्वादशीष्वेव शुक्लासु सर्वास्वेवाविशेषतः ..
विधिस्तवायं निर्दिष्टः कृष्णास्वेव च कारयेत् .. 22 ..
text_mt: On all the bright Dvādaśīs without distinction, / this rule is prescribed for you; and he should also perform it on the dark ones.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣaṃ te pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ..
raktavarṇena kartavyā devapūjā yathāvidhi .. 23 ..
meaning:
विशेषं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ..
रक्तवर्णेन कर्तव्या देवपूजा यथाविधि .. 23 ..
text_mt: I will tell you the distinctive feature; hear it as I speak: / worship of the god should be performed according to rule with red colour.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ ca deyaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpagandhānulepanam ..
tilatailena dīpāśca mahārañjanarañjitāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
रक्तं च देयं नैवेद्यं पुष्पगन्धानुलेपनम् ..
तिलतैलेन दीपाश्च महारञ्जनरञ्जिताः .. 24 ..
text_mt: Red food offering should be given, as well as flowers, perfumes, and ointments; / and lamps with sesame oil dyed with safflower.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpeṣu vartayo deyā homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ ..
bhūmiśobhā ca kartavyā raktairbhūpālavarṇakaiḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
दीपेषु वर्तयो देया होमः कार्यस्तथा तिलैः ..
भूमिशोभा च कर्तव्या रक्तैर्भूपालवर्णकैः .. 25 ..
text_mt: In the lamps, wicks should be supplied, and an oblation should be made with sesame seeds; / and decoration of the floor should be made with red pigments, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā kṛtvā rājansaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ ..
kārtikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet .. 26 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना कृत्वा राजन्संवत्सरं ततः ..
कार्तिक्यां समतीतायां कृष्णा या द्वादशी भवेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: Having performed it according to this rule for a year, O King, / on the dark Dvādaśī that comes when Kārttikā has passed,

sanskrit_iast:
vratāvasāne tasyāṃ tu mahāvartiṃ tu dāpayet ..
vāsasā ca samagreṇa tulayā ca ghṛtasya vai .. 27 ..
meaning:
व्रतावसाने तस्यां तु महावर्तिं तु दापयेत् ..
वाससा च समग्रेण तुलया च घृतस्य वै .. 27 ..
text_mt: at the conclusion of the vow on that [day], he should present a great wick, / along with a whole piece of cloth and a tulā of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā dhenuḥ kāṃsyopadohanā ..
hemaśṛṅgrī raupyakhurā muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitā .. 28 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्या धेनुः कांस्योपदोहना ..
हेमशृङ्ग्री रौप्यखुरा मुक्तालांगूलभूषिता .. 28 ..
text_mt: A cow equipped with a bronze milking vessel should be given to a brahmin, / with gold-tipped horns, silver hooves, and a tail adorned with pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrottarīyā dātavyā śaktyā draviṇasaṃyutā ..
saṃvatsareṇa rājā syānnaraḥ parvatagahvare .. 29 ..
meaning:
वस्त्रोत्तरीया दातव्या शक्त्या द्रविणसंयुता ..
संवत्सरेण राजा स्यान्नरः पर्वतगह्वरे .. 29 ..
text_mt: clothed with an upper garment, and accompanied by wealth according to capacity. / After one year, a man would become a king in a mountain glen;

sanskrit_iast:
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ pūrṇairjāyate saphalaṃ tataḥ ..
tathā dvādaśabhiḥ pūrṇe rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ .. 1.157.30 ..
meaning:
त्रिभिः संवत्सरैः पूर्णैर्जायते सफलं ततः ..
तथा द्वादशभिः पूर्णे राजा भवति पार्थिवः .. 1.157.30 ..
text_mt: when three full years have elapsed, it becomes fruitful thereafter; / and when twelve years are complete, he becomes an earthly king.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyapradā te'bhihitā mayaiṣā sudvādaśī pāpaharā variṣṭhā ..
upoṣya yāṃ bhūmitale narendro bhavatyajeyaśca raṇe'risaṃghaiḥ .. 31 ..
meaning:
राज्यप्रदा तेऽभिहिता मयैषा सुद्वादशी पापहरा वरिष्ठा ..
उपोष्य यां भूमितले नरेन्द्रो भवत्यजेयश्च रणेऽरिसंघैः .. 31 ..
text_mt: This excellent, sin-destroying, supreme Dvādaśī that grants kingdom has been related to you by me, / by fasting on which a king on earth becomes invincible in battle against hosts of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya śuklapakṣājjanādhipa ..
āra'bhyābhyarcayeddevaṃ dvādaśīṣu sadaiva tu .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य शुक्लपक्षाज्जनाधिप ..
आरऽभ्याभ्यर्चयेद्देवं द्वादशीषु सदैव तु .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Beginning from the bright fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O ruler of people, / one should worship the god always on the Dvādaśīs,
title: adhyāyaḥ 158

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣayorubhayornityaṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
phalaiḥ puṣpairyathākāmaṃ naivedyairhomakarmaṇā .. 2 ..
meaning:
पक्षयोरुभयोर्नित्यं सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
फलैः पुष्पैर्यथाकामं नैवेद्यैर्होमकर्मणा .. 2 ..
text_mt: constantly in both fortnights, fasting and with senses subdued, / with fruits, flowers, offerings according to desire, and the rite of fire offering,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjane brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śaktyā dānaṃ ca pārthiva ..
abhīṣṭanāmajapyena pūrṇātsaṃvansarānnaraḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
पूजने ब्राह्मणानां च शक्त्या दानं च पार्थिव ..
अभीष्टनामजप्येन पूर्णात्संवन्सरान्नरः .. 3 ..
text_mt: and with worship of brahmins and gifts according to one's capacity, O king. / By reciting the beloved name, after a full year, a man

sanskrit_iast:
tadevāpnoti rājendra yatra gatvā na śocati ..
akāmāḥ sāttvikā devaṃ pūjayanti janārdanam .. 4 ..
meaning:
तदेवाप्नोति राजेन्द्र यत्र गत्वा न शोचति ..
अकामाः सात्त्विका देवं पूजयन्ति जनार्दनम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: attains that state going to which he grieves no more, O best of kings. / Desireless persons endowed with sattva worship the god Janārdana;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādakāmena narendracanda saṃpūjanīyo bhuvanasya goptā ..
tyaktvā vaṇijyaṃ naradeva loke deveśvaro viṣṇurupāsanīyaḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्मादकामेन नरेन्द्रचन्द संपूजनीयो भुवनस्य गोप्ता ..
त्यक्त्वा वणिज्यं नरदेव लोके देवेश्वरो विष्णुरुपासनीयः .. 5 ..
text_mt: therefore, O moon among kings, the protector of the world is to be worshipped without desire. / Giving up all commerce in this world, O ruler of men, the lord of gods, Viṣṇu, is to be revered.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dvādaśīṣu pṛthakpṛthak ..
upoṣya ki phalaṃ loke śuklapakṣe vidhīyate .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच .. ..
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि द्वादशीषु पृथक्पृथक् ..
उपोष्य कि फलं लोके शुक्लपक्षे विधीयते .. 1 ..
text_mt:
Vajra said:
O venerable one, I wish to hear about the Dvādaśīs individually: / having fasted in the bright fortnight, what fruit is declared in the world?
title: adhyāyaḥ 159

sanskrit_iast:
anekajanmasāhasrairyeṣāṃ pāpaṃ kṣaya gatam ..
akāmāste pravartante devadevārcane narāḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
अनेकजन्मसाहस्रैर्येषां पापं क्षय गतम् ..
अकामास्ते प्रवर्तन्ते देवदेवार्चने नराः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Those men whose sin has been destroyed over many thousands of births / engage without desire in the worship of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya śuklapakṣe upoṣitaḥ ..
nāmnā keśavamabhyarcya vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
द्वादश्यां मार्गशीर्षस्य शुक्लपक्षे उपोषितः ..
नाम्ना केशवमभ्यर्च्य वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the Dvādaśī of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa / and worshipping Keśava by name, one obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ tathābhyarcya pauṣe māse jagatpatim ..
atyagniṣṭomamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 4 ..
meaning:
नारायणं तथाभ्यर्च्य पौषे मासे जगत्पतिम् ..
अत्यग्निष्टोममाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 4 ..
text_mt: Likewise, worshipping Nārāyaṇa, the lord of the world, in the month of Pauṣa, / one attains an Atyagniṣṭoma; no doubt should be had here.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe mādhavamabhyarcya dvādaśābdaphalaṃ labhet ..
govindaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā mahī dhara .. 5 ..
meaning:
माघे माधवमभ्यर्च्य द्वादशाब्दफलं लभेत् ..
गोविन्दं फाल्गुने मासि पूजयित्वा मही धर .. 5 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Mādhava in Māgha, one obtains the fruit of a twelve-year sacrifice. / Having worshipped Govinda in the month of Phālguna, O supporter of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
caitre viṣṇumathābhyarcya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
meaning:
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ..
चैत्रे विष्णुमथाभ्यर्च्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: one undoubtedly obtains the fruit of the Atirātra sacrifice. / Then, worshipping Viṣṇu in Caitra, one obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ māsi vaiśākhe sampūjya madhusūdanam ..
gosavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 7 ..
meaning:
द्वादश्यां मासि वैशाखे सम्पूज्य मधुसूदनम् ..
गोसवस्य तु यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: Worshipping Madhusūdana on the Dvādaśī in the month of Vaiśākha, / one obtains the unsurpassed fruit of the Gosava sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe māse tathābhyarcya devadevaṃ trivikramam ..
puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे मासे तथाभ्यर्च्य देवदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ..
पुण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं विन्दति मानवः .. 8 ..
text_mt: Likewise, worshipping the God of gods, Trivikrama, in the month of Jyeṣṭha, / a person finds the fruit of the Puṇḍarīka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe vāmanaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagatpatim ..
kṣiprameva samāpnoti yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇakam .. 9 ..
meaning:
आषाढे वामनं देवं पूजयित्वा जगत्पतिम् ..
क्षिप्रमेव समाप्नोति यज्ञं बहुसुवर्णकम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the god Vāmana, the lord of the world, in Āṣāḍha, / one quickly attains [the fruit of] the Bahusuvarṇaka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdharaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayitvā maheśvaram ..
vaiṣṇavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ vindatyasaṃśayam .. 1.159.10 ..
meaning:
श्रीधरं श्रावणे मासि पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
वैष्णवस्य तु यज्ञस्य फलं विन्दत्यसंशयम् .. 1.159.10 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the great lord Śrīdhara in the month of Śrāvaṇa, / one undoubtedly finds the fruit of the Vaiṣṇava sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māse bhādrapade devaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ samarcayan ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet .. 11 ..
meaning:
मासे भाद्रपदे देवं हृषीकेशं समर्चयन् ..
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Worshipping the god Hṛṣīkeśa in the month of Bhādrapada, / one attains an Aśvamedha sacrifice and saves his family.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine māsi saṃprāpte padmanābhaṃ samarcayan ..
rājasūyamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
meaning:
आश्विने मासि संप्राप्ते पद्मनाभं समर्चयन् ..
राजसूयमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 12 ..
text_mt: When the month of Āśvina arrives, worshipping Padmanābha, / he obtains [the fruit of] a Rājasūya sacrifice; there should be no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodaramathābhyarcya kārtike māsi yādava ..
sarvamedhamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 13 ..
meaning:
दामोदरमथाभ्यर्च्य कार्तिके मासि यादव ..
सर्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति .. 13 ..
text_mt: Then, having worshipped Dāmodara in the month of Kārtika, O Yādava, / he obtains [the fruit of] a Sarvamedha sacrifice and goes to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
māsoktena sadā nāmnā śuklapakṣe hyupoṣitaḥ ..
dvādaśīṣu sadā kuryājjapyahomānsamāhitaḥ .. 14 ..
meaning:
मासोक्तेन सदा नाम्ना शुक्लपक्षे ह्युपोषितः ..
द्वादशीषु सदा कुर्याज्जप्यहोमान्समाहितः .. 14 ..
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth [lunar days] in the bright fortnight, / with concentrated mind he should constantly perform recitations and oblations using the name declared for that month.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarānte dātavyaṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam ..
kāṃsyasya vainateyaṃ ca rukmapatraniveśitam .. 15 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरान्ते दातव्यं घृतपूर्णं च भाजनम् ..
कांस्यस्य वैनतेयं च रुक्मपत्रनिवेशितम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: At the end of the year, a vessel made of bell-metal filled with clarified butter / and [an image of] Vainateya placed upon a leaf of gold should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
kramopavāsatastvete proktā yajñaphalā nṛpa ..
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametannarādhipa .. 16 ..
meaning:
क्रमोपवासतस्त्वेते प्रोक्ता यज्ञफला नृप ..
पूर्णं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतमेतन्नराधिप .. 16 ..
text_mt: These sacrifices are proclaimed to bear fruit according to the order of fasts, O king. / Having performed this vow for a full year, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
svargalokamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet ..
devarāmāgaṇasthena vīṇāgurujanādinā .. 17 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ..
देवरामागणस्थेन वीणागुरुजनादिना .. 17 ..
text_mt: he attains the world of heaven and also delivers his family. / Abiding among hosts of divine women, with the resounding sounds of lutes and elders,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasārasayuktena vimānenārkavarcasā ..
kiṅkiṇīśataghoṣeṇa viharatyamaraprabhaḥ .. 18 ..
meaning:
हंससारसयुक्तेन विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ..
किङ्किणीशतघोषेण विहरत्यमरप्रभः .. 18 ..
text_mt: in an aerial chariot yoked with swans and cranes, having the splendour of the sun / and echoing with the sound of hundreds of tiny bells, he sports, shining like an immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvaṃ naraḥ kuryādvratametatsamāhitaḥ ..
śvetadvīpamavāpnoti yatra candraprabhā narāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
यावज्जीवं नरः कुर्याद्व्रतमेतत्समाहितः ..
श्वेतद्वीपमवाप्नोति यत्र चन्द्रप्रभा नराः .. 19 ..
text_mt: If a man should perform this vow with a concentrated mind for as long as he lives, / he reaches Śvetadvīpa, where the men possess the lustre of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā mahāsattvā nityatṛptāḥ sugandhinaḥ ..
aniṣyandā nirāhārāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ .. 1.159.20 ..
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा महासत्त्वा नित्यतृप्ताः सुगन्धिनः ..
अनिष्यन्दा निराहाराः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः .. 1.159.20 ..
text_mt: four-armed, of great strength, perpetually satisfied, fragrant, / free from exudation, taking no food, omniscient, all-seeing.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ narendra bhittvārkabimbaṃ sahasā prayāti ..
sthānaṃ puro devavarasya viṣṇornityasya tasyānagha sarvagamya .. 21 ..
meaning:
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं नरेन्द्र भित्त्वार्कबिम्बं सहसा प्रयाति ..
स्थानं पुरो देववरस्य विष्णोर्नित्यस्य तस्यानघ सर्वगम्य .. 21 ..
text_mt: Having dwelt there for a very long time, O ruler of men, having suddenly pierced the disc of the sun, / he goes to the foremost realm of the eternal, supreme god Viṣṇu, accessible to all, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
kevalaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśīṣu janārdanam ..
kadāprabhṛti dharmajña vidhinā kena cārcayet .. 1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
केवलं कृष्णपक्षस्य द्वादशीषु जनार्दनम् ..
कदाप्रभृति धर्मज्ञ विधिना केन चार्चयेत् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Beginning from when, O knower of dharma, and by what rule / should one worship Janārdana only on the twelfth [lunar days] of the dark fortnight?
title: adhyāyaḥ 160

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mārgyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ dvādaśī yā bhavennṛpa ..
tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyaṃ vratamevamupoṣitaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मार्ग्यां तु समतीतायां द्वादशी या भवेन्नृप ..
ततः प्रभृति कर्तव्यं व्रतमेवमुपोषितः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Mārgaśīrṣa has passed, whatever twelfth [lunar day] occurs, O king, / from then on, having fasted, this vow is to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśīṣu ca kṛṣṇāsu nāma kṛṣṇasya kīrtayet ..
tenaiva nāmnā kartavyau japahomau tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
meaning:
द्वादशीषु च कृष्णासु नाम कृष्णस्य कीर्तयेत् ..
तेनैव नाम्ना कर्तव्यौ जपहोमौ तथैव च .. 3 ..
text_mt: And on the twelfth [lunar days] of the dark [fortnight], he should recite the name of Kṛṣṇa; / with that very name, recitation and oblation are likewise to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
tilairnivedanaṃ kāryaṃ homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ ..
pauṣyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet .. 4 ..
meaning:
तिलैर्निवेदनं कार्यं होमः कार्यस्तथा तिलैः ..
पौष्यां तु समतीतायां कृष्णा या द्वादशी भवेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: An offering should be made with sesame seeds, and the oblation is likewise to be made with sesame seeds. / When the full moon of Pauṣa has passed, on whichever dark twelfth [day] occurs,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ vratāvasāne tu tilāndadyāddvijātiṣu ..
suvarṇaṃ ca mahīpāla raktavastraṃ tathaiva ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
तस्यां व्रतावसाने तु तिलान्दद्याद्द्विजातिषु ..
सुवर्णं च महीपाल रक्तवस्त्रं तथैव च .. 5 ..
text_mt: on that [day], at the conclusion of the vow, he should bestow sesame seeds on the twice-born, / and gold, O protector of the earth, as well as red cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
samvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ manujapuṅgava ..
tiryagyoniṃ na cāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 6 ..
meaning:
सम्वत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं मनुजपुङ्गव ..
तिर्यग्योनिं न चाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति .. 6 ..
text_mt: Having performed this vow for a year, O best among men, / he does not enter an animal womb and goes to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvaṃ vratamidaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
na sa dukhaṃ samāpnoti narakaṃ na narādhipa .. 7 ..
meaning:
यावज्जीवं व्रतमिदं यः करोति समाहितः ..
न स दुखं समाप्नोति नरकं न नराधिप .. 7 ..
text_mt: Whoever performs this vow with a concentrated mind as long as he lives, / he does not experience suffering, nor hell, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vaitaraṇī durgā kṣuradhārāśca parvatāḥ ..
pāpānāṃ yātanā yatra tatrāsau na gamiṣyati .. 8 ..
meaning:
यत्र वैतरणी दुर्गा क्षुरधाराश्च पर्वताः ..
पापानां यातना यत्र तत्रासौ न गमिष्यति .. 8 ..
text_mt: Where the impassable Vaitaraṇī flows and mountains are sharp as razor-edges, / where the torments of sinners [take place], thither he shall not go.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ gaṇāḥ bhīmabalā mahogrā daṃṣṭrākarālā vikaṭograveṣāḥ ..
vidrāvaṇāḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇāṃ na yena tasyā nṛpa yanti mārgam .. 9 ..
meaning:
यस्यां गणाः भीमबला महोग्रा दंष्ट्राकराला विकटोग्रवेषाः ..
विद्रावणाः पापकृतां नराणां न येन तस्या नृप यन्ति मार्गम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: On which [road] hordes of terrible might, exceedingly fierce, with frightful fangs and hideous, terrible forms, / routing sinful men, [abide], along its path they do not go, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ śuklapakṣe dvijottama ..
ekā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha ..1..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच ..
उपवासासमर्थानां शुक्लपक्षे द्विजोत्तम ..
एका या द्वादशी पुण्या तां वदस्व ममानघ ..1..
text_mt: Vajra said: / For those incapable of fasting during the bright fortnight, O best of the twice-born, / tell me of that single meritorious twelfth [day], O sinless one.
title: Śrāvaṇādvādaśīpraśaṃsāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā..
mahatī dvādaśī jñeyā upavāse mahāphalā .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
मासि भाद्रपदे शुक्ला द्वादशी श्रवणान्विता..
महती द्वादशी ज्ञेया उपवासे महाफला .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the month of Bhādrapada, the bright twelfth [day] conjoined with the Śravaṇa asterism / is to be known as the Great Twelfth; it bears great fruit for one who fasts.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgame saritoḥ puṇye dvādaśīṃ tāmupoṣitaḥ ..
ayatnādevamāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam .. 3 ..
meaning:
सङ्गमे सरितोः पुण्ये द्वादशीं तामुपोषितः ..
अयत्नादेवमाप्नोति द्वादशद्वादशीफलम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Fasting on that twelfth [day] at the holy confluence of two rivers, / one effortlessly obtains the fruit of twelve twelfth [days].

sanskrit_iast:
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ceddvādaśī bhavet ..
atyantamahatī yasyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtamathākṣayam .. 4 ..
meaning:
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता सैव चेद्द्वादशी भवेत् ..
अत्यन्तमहती यस्यां सर्वं कृतमथाक्षयम् .. 4 ..
text_mt: If that very twelfth [day] is conjoined with Wednesday and the Śravaṇa asterism, / it is an exceedingly great [day], on which everything done becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati pārthiva ...
saṅgame tu tadā snātvā sattīrthasnānajaṃ phalam ..5..
meaning:
द्वादशी श्रवणोपेता यदा भवति पार्थिव ...
सङ्गमे तु तदा स्नात्वा सत्तीर्थस्नानजं फलम् ..5..
text_mt: When the twelfth [day] is attended by Śravaṇa, O king, / then, having bathed at a confluence, the fruit born of bathing in an excellent holy ford

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
vāridhānīṃ tadā dattvā jalapūrṇāṃ dvijātaye ..6..
meaning:
सोपवासः समाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..
वारिधानीं तदा दत्त्वा जलपूर्णां द्विजातये ..6..
text_mt: one who observes a fast attains; there should be no doubt about this. / Giving then a water-vessel filled with water to a twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
channāṃ vastrayutāṃ rājañchatropānahasaṃyutām ..
svargalokamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam .. 7 ..
meaning:
छन्नां वस्त्रयुतां राजञ्छत्रोपानहसंयुताम् ..
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: covered and provided with cloth, O king, together with an umbrella and sandals, / he attains the world of heaven and delivers his own family.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ samāsādya ciraṃ ca bhogānbhuktvā mahendropama devatulyān ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo dhanānvito dharmaparo manasvī ..8..
meaning:
स्वर्गं समासाद्य चिरं च भोगान्भुक्त्वा महेन्द्रोपम देवतुल्यान् ..
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो धनान्वितो धर्मपरो मनस्वी ..8..
text_mt: Having reached heaven and for a long time enjoyed pleasures equal to those of the gods, resembling great Indra, / upon attaining human birth he becomes free of disease, endowed with wealth, devoted to dharma, and wise.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
mahatyaraṇye yadvṛttaṃ bhūmipāla purātanam ..1..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
महत्यरण्ये यद्वृत्तं भूमिपाल पुरातनम् ..1..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Regarding this, they also cite this ancient narrative / of what occurred in a great wilderness in former times, O protector of the earth.
title: Śravaṇadvādaśīmāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
deśā dāśerakā nāma teṣāṃ bhāge tu paścime ..
asti rājanmarurdeśaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ..2..
meaning:
देशा दाशेरका नाम तेषां भागे तु पश्चिमे ..
अस्ति राजन्मरुर्देशः सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करः ..2..
text_mt: There are lands named Dāśeraka, and in their western part, / O king, there is a desert region terrifying to all living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sutaptasikatā bhūmiryatra duṣṭa mahoragā ..
svalpacchāyāsamākīrṇā mṛtaprāṇisamākulā..3..
meaning:
सुतप्तसिकता भूमिर्यत्र दुष्ट महोरगा ..
स्वल्पच्छायासमाकीर्णा मृतप्राणिसमाकुला..3..
text_mt: where the ground has burning sand, where there are wicked, great serpents, / strewn with meager shade, and crowded with dead creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
śamīkhadiraphullāsakarīrāḥ pailubhiḥ saha ..
tatra bhīmā drumagaṇāḥ kaṇṭakairāvṛtāḥ samam..4..
meaning:
शमीखदिरफुल्लासकरीराः पैलुभिः सह ..
तत्र भीमा द्रुमगणाः कण्टकैरावृताः समम्..4..
text_mt: Śamī, khadira, phullāsa, and karīra trees together with pīlu trees— / there stand terrible clusters of trees, entirely covered with thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā tatra bhūmistathā kvacit ..
atyantatāpaviṣamā nistṛṇā paruṣopalā .. 5 ..
meaning:
चण्डप्राणिगणाकीर्णा तत्र भूमिस्तथा क्वचित् ..
अत्यन्ततापविषमा निस्तृणा परुषोपला .. 5 ..
text_mt: In places the ground there is crowded with hosts of fierce creatures, / made uneven by extreme heat, devoid of grass, and strewn with rough stones.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśrayastatra nāhāro jvalitāgnisame bhṛśam ..
tathāpi tatra jīvanti janāḥ karmanibandhanāt .. 6 ..
meaning:
नाश्रयस्तत्र नाहारो ज्वलिताग्निसमे भृशम् ..
तथापि तत्र जीवन्ति जनाः कर्मनिबन्धनात् .. 6 ..
text_mt: There is no shelter there and no food, as if [in the midst of] a blazingly kindled fire; / even so, people live there due to the bondage of their past deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
nodakaṃ nodakadharā rājaṃstatra balāhakāḥ ..
kadācidapi dṛśyante deśe nirayasannibhe .. 7 ..
meaning:
नोदकं नोदकधरा राजंस्तत्र बलाहकाः ..
कदाचिदपि दृश्यन्ते देशे निरयसन्निभे .. 7 ..
text_mt: Neither water nor water-bearing clouds, O king, / are ever seen there in that land resembling hell.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pakṣāntaragataistṛṣitaiḥ śiśubhiḥ saha ..
utkrāntajīvitā rājandṛśyante'tha vihaṅgamāḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
तत्र पक्षान्तरगतैस्तृषितैः शिशुभिः सह ..
उत्क्रान्तजीविता राजन्दृश्यन्तेऽथ विहङ्गमाः .. 8 ..
text_mt: There, birds with their thirsty fledglings resting under their wings / are seen, O king, with their lives departed.

sanskrit_iast:
utplutyotplutya sahasā mṛgāḥ saikatamālayāta ..
saikateṣveva naśyanti jale saikatasetuvat ..9..
meaning:
उत्प्लुत्योत्प्लुत्य सहसा मृगाः सैकतमालयात ..
सैकतेष्वेव नश्यन्ति जले सैकतसेतुवत् ..9..
text_mt: Deer, leaping up again and again suddenly from the expanse of sand, / perish in the very sands like a causeway of sand in water.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃstathāvidhe deśe kaściddaivavaśādvaṇik ..
vanamātapavibhraṣṭaḥ praviṣṭastu paribhraman ..1.162.10..
meaning:
तस्मिंस्तथाविधे देशे कश्चिद्दैववशाद्वणिक् ..
वनमातपविभ्रष्टः प्रविष्टस्तु परिभ्रमन् ..1.162.10..
text_mt: In such a land, a certain merchant, through the power of fate, / wandering about having lost his way in the heat, entered the wilderness.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra dadṛśe pretānkṣuttṛṣṇāvyākulendriyān ..
utkacānmalinānrūkṣānnirmāṃsānbhīmadarśanān .. 11 ..
meaning:
स तत्र ददृशे प्रेतान्क्षुत्तृष्णाव्याकुलेन्द्रियान् ..
उत्कचान्मलिनान्रूक्षान्निर्मांसान्भीमदर्शनान् .. 11 ..
text_mt: There he saw pretas whose senses were agitated by hunger and thirst, / with dishevelled hair, filthy, dry, fleshless, and terrible to behold,

sanskrit_iast:
snāyubaddhasthirākāyāndhāvamānānitasstaḥ ..
kañcitsamāṃsaṃ tatraikaṃ pretaskandhagataṃ tadā .. 12 ..
meaning:
स्नायुबद्धस्थिराकायान्धावमानानितस्स्तः ..
कञ्चित्समांसं तत्रैकं प्रेतस्कन्धगतं तदा .. 12 ..
text_mt: with firm bodies bound by sinews, running here and there. / Then [he saw] one certain [being] endowed with flesh upon the shoulder of a preta,

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa bahubhiḥ pretaiḥ samantātparivāritam ..
tatskandhādaparaṃ skaṃdhaṃ nīyamānaṃ kramātkamāt ..13..
meaning:
ददर्श बहुभिः प्रेतैः समन्तात्परिवारितम् ..
तत्स्कन्धादपरं स्कंधं नीयमानं क्रमात्कमात् ..13..
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by many pretas, / being carried by turns from one shoulder to another.

sanskrit_iast:
preto'pi dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ naramāgatam ..
pretaskandhānmahīṃ gatvā tasyāntikamupāgamat .. 14 ..
meaning:
प्रेतोऽपि दृष्ट्वा तां घोरामटवीं नरमागतम् ..
प्रेतस्कन्धान्महीं गत्वा तस्यान्तिकमुपागमत् .. 14 ..
text_mt: The deceased, seeing a man who had entered that dreadful forest, / descended to the earth from the shoulders of the deceased and approached him.

sanskrit_iast:
so'bhivādya vaṇikachreṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ..
asminghore mahāraṇye praveśo bhavataḥ katham .. 15 ..
meaning:
सोऽभिवाद्य वणिकछ्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ..
अस्मिन्घोरे महारण्ये प्रवेशो भवतः कथम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Greeting that best of merchants, he spoke these words: / 'How did you enter this terrible, great wilderness?'

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca vaṇigdhīmānsārthabhraṣṭasya me vane ..
praveśo daivayogena pūrvakarmakṛtena tu .. 16 ..
meaning:
तमुवाच वणिग्धीमान्सार्थभ्रष्टस्य मे वने ..
प्रवेशो दैवयोगेन पूर्वकर्मकृतेन तु .. 16 ..
text_mt: The wise merchant said to him: 'Having strayed from my caravan, my entry / into the forest has occurred through the working of fate, brought about by past deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣṇā me bādhate'tyarthaṃ kṣutkṣāmaśca bhṛśaṃ tathā ..
prāṇāḥ kaṇṭhamanuprāptā vadanaṃ bhraśyate ca me .. 17 ..
meaning:
तृष्णा मे बाधतेऽत्यर्थं क्षुत्क्षामश्च भृशं तथा ..
प्राणाः कण्ठमनुप्राप्ता वदनं भ्रश्यते च मे .. 17 ..
text_mt: Thirst torments me exceedingly, and I am utterly wasted with hunger; / my breath has reached my throat, and my mouth is parched.

sanskrit_iast:
atropāyaṃ na paśyāmi dhriye'haṃ yena kena cit ..
ityevamuktaḥ pretastu vaṇijaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 18 ..
meaning:
अत्रोपायं न पश्यामि ध्रियेऽहं येन केन चित् ..
इत्येवमुक्तः प्रेतस्तु वणिजं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 18 ..
text_mt: I see no means here by which I may somehow be kept alive.' / Addressed in this way, the deceased said these words to the merchant:

sanskrit_iast:
punnāgamimamāśritya pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ mama ..
kṛtātithyo mayā yāvadgamiṣyasi yathāsukham ..19 ..
meaning:
पुन्नागमिममाश्रित्य प्रतीक्षस्व क्षणं मम ..
कृतातिथ्यो मया यावद्गमिष्यसि यथासुखम् ..19 ..
text_mt: 'Relying on this punnāga tree, wait for me a moment, / until, having been received as a guest by me, you may depart at ease.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastadā cakre sa vaṇiktṛṣṇayānvitaḥ ..
madhyāhnasamaye prāpte pretastaṃ deśamāgamat .. 1.162.20 ..
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तदा चक्रे स वणिक्तृष्णयान्वितः ..
मध्याह्नसमये प्राप्ते प्रेतस्तं देशमागमत् .. 1.162.20 ..
text_mt: Addressed thus, the merchant, filled with thirst, did so then; / when midday arrived, the deceased came to that place,

sanskrit_iast:
punnāgavṛkṣācchītodāṃ vāridhānīṃ manoramām ..
dadhyodanasuyuktena vardhamānena saṃyutām .. 21 ..
meaning:
पुन्नागवृक्षाच्छीतोदां वारिधानीं मनोरमाम् ..
दध्योदनसुयुक्तेन वर्धमानेन संयुताम् .. 21 ..
text_mt: [bringing] down from the punnāga tree a charming water vessel with cold water, / accompanied by an earthenware platter filled with curd and boiled rice.

sanskrit_iast:
avatārya tatastvagraṃ pradadāti ca yattadā ..
tato'gramātreṇa vaṇikparāṃ tṛptimupāgataḥ .. 22 ..
meaning:
अवतार्य ततस्त्वग्रं प्रददाति च यत्तदा ..
ततोऽग्रमात्रेण वणिक्परां तृप्तिमुपागतः .. 22 ..
text_mt: Having brought it down, he then gave him the first portion; / from that first portion alone, the merchant attained supreme satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
vitṛṣṇo vijvaraścaivaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata ..
tataḥ preteṣu sarveṣu kramādbhāgaṃ tadā dadau .. 23 ..
meaning:
वितृष्णो विज्वरश्चैवं क्षणेन समपद्यत ..
ततः प्रेतेषु सर्वेषु क्रमाद्भागं तदा ददौ .. 23 ..
text_mt: Thus, in an instant, he became free of thirst and free of burning fever; / then [the deceased] gave a share in turn to all the deceased.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanātsapānīyātte'pi tṛptiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ ..
atha santarpayitvā tu pretāṃstānsa tu sarvaśaḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
दध्योदनात्सपानीयात्तेऽपि तृप्तिं परां ययुः ..
अथ सन्तर्पयित्वा तु प्रेतांस्तान्स तु सर्वशः .. 24 ..
text_mt: From the curd and boiled rice along with water, they too attained supreme satisfaction; / then, having fully gratified those deceased ones on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
pretādhipaḥ sa bubhuje paścādannaṃ yathāsukham ..
tasya bhuktavatastvannaṃ pānīyaṃ ca kṣayaṃ yayau .. 25 ..
meaning:
प्रेताधिपः स बुभुजे पश्चादन्नं यथासुखम् ..
तस्य भुक्तवतस्त्वन्नं पानीयं च क्षयं ययौ .. 25 ..
text_mt: that lord of the deceased ate the food afterwards at ease; / when he had eaten, the food and water came to an end.

sanskrit_iast:
pretādhipaṃ tatastṛptaṃ vaṇigvacanamabravīt ..
āścaryametatparamaṃ vane'sminpratibhāti me .. 26 ..
meaning:
प्रेताधिपं ततस्तृप्तं वणिग्वचनमब्रवीत् ..
आश्चर्यमेतत्परमं वनेऽस्मिन्प्रतिभाति मे .. 26 ..
text_mt: Then the merchant said these words to the satisfied lord of the deceased: / 'This appears to me as a supreme marvel in this forest!

sanskrit_iast:
annapānasya samprāptiḥ paramasya kutastava ..
stokena ca tathānnena bibharṣi ca bahūnkatham .. 27 ..
meaning:
अन्नपानस्य सम्प्राप्तिः परमस्य कुतस्तव ..
स्तोकेन च तथान्नेन बिभर्षि च बहून्कथम् .. 27 ..
text_mt: Whence comes your attainment of supreme food and drink, / and how do you sustain so many with such little food?

sanskrit_iast:
tṛptā api kathaṃ sarve nirmāṃsā bhinnakukṣayaḥ ..
kaścittvamasyāṃ ghorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
तृप्ता अपि कथं सर्वे निर्मांसा भिन्नकुक्षयः ..
कश्चित्त्वमस्यां घोरायामटव्यां तु कृतालयः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Why are all of them, though satisfied, fleshless with burst bellies? / And who are you who have made your abode in this dreadful forest?

sanskrit_iast:
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ..
evamuktaḥ sa vaṇijā preto vacanamabravīt .. 29 ..
meaning:
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि परं कौतूहलं हि मे ..
एवमुक्तः स वणिजा प्रेतो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Dispel this doubt of mine, for my curiosity is great.' / Addressed in this way by the merchant, the deceased spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇijyasaktasya purā kālo 'tīto mamānagha ..
śākale nagare ramye nāstikasya durātmanaḥ .. 1.162.30 ..
meaning:
वाणिज्यसक्तस्य पुरा कालो ऽतीतो ममानघ ..
शाकले नगरे रम्ये नास्तिकस्य दुरात्मनः .. 1.162.30 ..
text_mt: 'Formerly, blameless one, when devoted to commerce, my time passed / in the delightful city of Śākala as an atheist and an evil-minded man.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanalobhānmayā tatra na kadācidapi prabho ..
dattāsīdbhikṣave bhikṣā kṛpaṇena kathañcana .. 31 ..
meaning:
धनलोभान्मया तत्र न कदाचिदपि प्रभो ..
दत्तासीद्भिक्षवे भिक्षा कृपणेन कथञ्चन .. 31 ..
text_mt: Out of greed for wealth, O lord, never at any time was alms / given to a beggar by me, miserable as I was, in any manner.

sanskrit_iast:
prātiveśyaśca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tadā .. 32 ..
meaning:
प्रातिवेश्यश्च तत्रासीद्ब्राह्मणो गुणवान्मम ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे मासि भाद्रपदे तदा .. 32 ..
text_mt: I had a neighbor there, a virtuous brahmin; / then, at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī in the month of Bhādrapada,

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ tauṣīṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau..
tasyāśca saṅgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā ..33..
meaning:
स कदाचिन्मया सार्धं तौषीं नाम नदीं ययौ..
तस्याश्च सङ्गमः पुण्यो यत्रासीच्चन्द्रभागया ..33..
text_mt: he once went with me to the river named Tauṣī, / where its holy confluence with the Candrabhāgā is,

sanskrit_iast:
candrabhāgāsaricchreṣṭhā yatra śītāmalodakā ..
mahādevajaṭājūṭe gaṅgā nipatitā purā ..34..
meaning:
चन्द्रभागासरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यत्र शीतामलोदका ..
महादेवजटाजूटे गङ्गा निपतिता पुरा ..34..
text_mt: where the Candrabhāgā, foremost of rivers, has cold, pure waters; / formerly, Gaṅgā fell onto the matted hair of Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
candreṇa bhāgato nyastā candrabhāgā smṛtā tataḥ ..
tatkālataptasalilā tauṣī tatrārkanandinī .. 35 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रेण भागतो न्यस्ता चन्द्रभागा स्मृता ततः ..
तत्कालतप्तसलिला तौषी तत्रार्कनन्दिनी .. 35 ..
text_mt: [and part of her] was placed by the moon into a portion (bhāga); hence she is remembered as Candrabhāgā; / there the Tauṣī, daughter of the sun, has waters heated at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
śītoṣṇe codake tasminsaṃgame sumanohare..
taṃ sa deśaṃ samāsādya prātiveśyamasau dvijaḥ..36..
meaning:
शीतोष्णे चोदके तस्मिन्संगमे सुमनोहरे..
तं स देशं समासाद्य प्रातिवेश्यमसौ द्विजः..36..
text_mt: In the cold and hot waters at that most enchanting confluence, / having reached that place, that brahmin neighbor of mine,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snānārcana upoṣitaḥ..
cāndrabhāgasya toyasya vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā ..37..
meaning:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे स्नानार्चन उपोषितः..
चान्द्रभागस्य तोयस्य वारिधानी नवा दृढा ..37..
text_mt: having fasted for the bathing and worship on the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī, / [gave] a new, sturdy water vessel filled with the water of the Candrabhāgā,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ sampūrṇairvardhamānakaiḥ ..
chatraiścopānahai ramyairvastraiśca vividhairyutā.38..
meaning:
दध्योदनयुतैः सार्धं सम्पूर्णैर्वर्धमानकैः ..
छत्रैश्चोपानहै रम्यैर्वस्त्रैश्च विविधैर्युता.38..
text_mt: together with filled earthenware bowls containing curd and boiled rice, / accompanied by delightful umbrellas, shoes, and various garments—

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau vipramukhyebhyo rahasyajño mahīpatiḥ..
cittasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya tasyāpi ca tadā mayā ..39..
meaning:
प्रददौ विप्रमुख्येभ्यो रहस्यज्ञो महीपतिः..
चित्तसंरक्षणार्थाय तस्यापि च तदा मया ..39..
text_mt: the king, knower of secrets, gave [them] to foremost brahmins; / then, for the sake of guarding my [own] mind as well, by me,

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāsena dattaikā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā..
cāndrabhāgasya toyasya dadhyodanayutā tadā..1.162.40..
meaning:
सोपवासेन दत्तैका वारिधानी नवा दृढा..
चान्द्रभागस्य तोयस्य दध्योदनयुता तदा..1.162.40..
text_mt: fasting, was given one new, sturdy water vessel / of Candrabhāgā water along with curd and boiled rice.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā gṛhamanuprāpya tataḥ kālena kenacit..
pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ..41..
meaning:
गत्वा गृहमनुप्राप्य ततः कालेन केनचित्..
पञ्चत्वमहमासाद्य नास्तिक्यात्प्रेततां गतः..41..
text_mt: Having returned home, after some time, / I met my death and, because of atheism, became a deceased spirit (preta).

sanskrit_iast:
asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yo vā hyakuśalastadā ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge dattā yāsau mayānagha.. .42.
meaning:
अस्यामटव्यां घोरायां यो वा ह्यकुशलस्तदा ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे दत्ता यासौ मयानघ.. .42.
text_mt: In this dreadful forest, as one who was unskilful at that time, / that which was given by me, blameless one, at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī—

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyodanayutā ramyā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā..
seyaṃ madhyāhnasamaye divase divase mama..43..
meaning:
दध्योदनयुता रम्या वारिधानी नवा दृढा..
सेयं मध्याह्नसमये दिवसे दिवसे मम..43..
text_mt: that delightful, new, sturdy water vessel with curd and boiled rice— / it is that which, at the time of midday, day after day,

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhetsadaiveha yathā dṛṣṭā tvayānagha ..
brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ ..44..
meaning:
उपतिष्ठेत्सदैवेह यथा दृष्टा त्वयानघ ..
ब्रह्मस्वहारिणस्त्वेते पापाः प्रेतत्वमागताः ..44..
text_mt: always presents itself here to me, just as seen by you, blameless one. / But these sinful ones who stole brahmins' property have become deceased spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
paridāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatā pare..
mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe'sminbhṛśadāruṇe..45..
meaning:
परिदाररताः केचित्स्वामिद्रोहरता परे..
मित्रद्रोहरताः केचिद्देशेऽस्मिन्भृशदारुणे..45..
text_mt: some were devoted to other men's wives, others were devoted to treason against their master, / some were devoted to betraying friends in this exceedingly dreadful land.

sanskrit_iast:
mamānuyānaṃ kurvanti annapāna kṛte'nagha ..
akṣayo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ..46..
meaning:
ममानुयानं कुर्वन्ति अन्नपान कृतेऽनघ ..
अक्षयो भगवान्विष्णुः परमात्मा सनातनः ..46..
text_mt: They follow me, blameless one, for the sake of food and drink; / eternal is the lord Viṣṇu, the supreme soul, everlasting.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuddiśya tu yaddattaṃ tadakṣayyaṃ prakīrtitam..
akṣayyena tathānnena tṛptā api hi mānada .. 47 ..
meaning:
तमुद्दिश्य तु यद्दत्तं तदक्षय्यं प्रकीर्तितम्..
अक्षय्येन तथान्नेन तृप्ता अपि हि मानद .. 47 ..
text_mt: What is given dedicated to him is proclaimed to be inexhaustible; / yet even though satisfied by such inexhaustible food, O respectful one,

sanskrit_iast:
pretabhāvena daurbalyaṃ na vimuñcanti karhicit ..
ahaṃ ca pūjayitvā tvāmatithiṃ samupasthitam .. 48 ..
meaning:
प्रेतभावेन दौर्बल्यं न विमुञ्चन्ति कर्हिचित् ..
अहं च पूजयित्वा त्वामतिथिं समुपस्थितम् .. 48 ..
text_mt: they never cast off weakness because of their condition as deceased spirits. / And I, having honored you, a guest who has arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
pretabhāvādvinirmukto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim ..
mayā vihīnāḥ pretāstu vane'sminbhṛśadāruṇe .. 49 ..
meaning:
प्रेतभावाद्विनिर्मुक्तो यास्यामि परमां गतिम् ..
मया विहीनाः प्रेतास्तु वनेऽस्मिन्भृशदारुणे .. 49 ..
text_mt: freed from the condition of a deceased spirit, shall attain the highest state; / but the deceased spirits, deprived of me in this exceedingly dreadful forest,

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍāmanubhaviṣyanti dāruṇāṃ karmayogajām..
eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga bhadanugrahakāmyayā .. 1.162.50 ..
meaning:
पीडामनुभविष्यन्ति दारुणां कर्मयोगजाम्..
एतेषां त्वं महाभाग भदनुग्रहकाम्यया .. 1.162.50 ..
text_mt: will experience severe torment born of the working of past deeds. / For their sake, O highly fortunate one, wishing to favor me,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ gotranāmāni gṛhṇīṣva likhitena ca ..
asti kakṣyāgataveṣā tava sā pustikā śubhā .. 51 ..
meaning:
प्रत्येकं गोत्रनामानि गृह्णीष्व लिखितेन च ..
अस्ति कक्ष्यागतवेषा तव सा पुस्तिका शुभा .. 51 ..
text_mt: take down the names and gotras of each one in writing; / that auspicious small booklet is there in your waistband.

sanskrit_iast:
himavantamathāsādya tatra tvaṃ lapsyase nidhim ..
gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ..52..
meaning:
हिमवन्तमथासाद्य तत्र त्वं लप्स्यसे निधिम् ..
गयाशीर्षे ततो गत्वा श्राद्धं कुरु महामते ..52..
text_mt: Then, having reached the Himavat, you will find a treasure there; / going then to Gayāśīrṣa, perform the śrāddha, O highly intelligent one,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ tvamathoddiśya pretaṃ pretaṃ yathāsukham ..
tatastu te vimokṣyanti preta bhāvamasaṃśayam .. 53 ..
meaning:
एकैकं त्वमथोद्दिश्य प्रेतं प्रेतं यथासुखम् ..
ततस्तु ते विमोक्ष्यन्ति प्रेत भावमसंशयम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: designating each individual deceased spirit one by one, at ease; / then they will undoubtedly be released from the condition of deceased spirits.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ sa vadanneva taptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ ..
vimānavaramāsthāya svargalokaṃ tato gataḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
इत्येवं स वदन्नेव तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रभः ..
विमानवरमास्थाय स्वर्गलोकं ततो गतः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Even as he was speaking thus, shining with the radiance of melted gold, / he mounted an excellent celestial chariot and went to the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
svarcite pretanāthe tu pretānāṃ sa vaṇikkramāt ..
nāmagotrāṇi saṅgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himālayam .. 55 ..
meaning:
स्वर्चिते प्रेतनाथे तु प्रेतानां स वणिक्क्रमात् ..
नामगोत्राणि सङ्गृह्य प्रयातः स हिमालयम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: When the lord of the deceased had thus attained heaven, that merchant, in order, / recorded the names and gotras of the deceased and set out for the Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā nikṣipya ca tathā gṛhe ..
dhanaṃ kiñcidupādāya gayāśīrṣaṃ tato yayau .. 56 ..
meaning:
तत्र प्राप्य निधिं गत्वा निक्षिप्य च तथा गृहे ..
धनं किञ्चिदुपादाय गयाशीर्षं ततो ययौ .. 56 ..
text_mt: There, having obtained the treasure, he went and deposited it at home; / taking some wealth, he then went to Gayāśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine ..
yasyayasya yadā śrāddhaṃ karoti sa mahānvaṇik .. 57 ..
meaning:
प्रेतानां क्रमशस्तत्र चक्रे श्राद्धं दिनेदिने ..
यस्ययस्य यदा श्राद्धं करोति स महान्वणिक् .. 57 ..
text_mt: There, day after day, he performed the śrāddha for the deceased in order; / whenever that great merchant performed the śrāddha for any particular one,

sanskrit_iast:
sasa tasya tadā svapne darśayatyātmanastanum ..
bravīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha .. 58 ..
meaning:
सस तस्य तदा स्वप्ने दर्शयत्यात्मनस्तनुम् ..
ब्रवीति च महाभाग प्रसादेन तवानघ .. 58 ..
text_mt: that one would then show his form to him in a dream / and say: 'O highly fortunate, blameless one, by your grace!'

sanskrit_iast:
pretabhāvo mayā tyaktaḥ prāpto'smi tridivaṃ dhuvam ..
kṛtvā sa dhanadānena pretānāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ vaṇik .. 59 ..
meaning:
प्रेतभावो मया त्यक्तः प्राप्तोऽस्मि त्रिदिवं धुवम् ..
कृत्वा स धनदानेन प्रेतानां निष्कृतिं वणिक् .. 59 ..
text_mt: "I have abandoned the state of a deceased spirit and have surely reached heaven." / Having thus accomplished the release of the deceased spirits by gifts of wealth, that merchant

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tadā ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam .. 1.162.60 ..
meaning:
जगाम स्वगृहं तत्र मासि भाद्रपदे तदा ..
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् .. 1.162.60 ..
text_mt: went to his own home. Then, in the month of Bhādrapada, / having worshiped Janārdana at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ ca dattvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
puṇyeṣu satataṃ rājannadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ..61..
meaning:
धनं च दत्त्वा विप्रेभ्यः सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
पुण्येषु सततं राजन्नदीनां सङ्गमेषु च ..61..
text_mt: and having given wealth to the brahmins, fasting and with senses controlled, / constantly at the sacred confluences of rivers, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāsarayvorgaṅgāyāḥ śoṇasya ca mahāmatiḥ ..
ikṣumatyāśca gaṅgāyā gaṅgāyamunayostathā .. 62 ..
meaning:
गङ्गासरय्वोर्गङ्गायाः शोणस्य च महामतिः ..
इक्षुमत्याश्च गङ्गाया गङ्गायमुनयोस्तथा .. 62 ..
text_mt: of the Gaṅgā and the Sarayū, and of the Gaṅgā and the Śoṇa, the wise man; / of the Ikṣumatī and the Gaṅgā, and likewise of the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā;

sanskrit_iast:
gomatyāśca sarayvāśca kauśikīgaṇḍakyostathā ..
vipāśayā devahradā yatra yogaṃ prapadyate .. 63 ..
meaning:
गोमत्याश्च सरय्वाश्च कौशिकीगण्डक्योस्तथा ..
विपाशया देवह्रदा यत्र योगं प्रपद्यते .. 63 ..
text_mt: of the Gomatī and the Sarayū, and likewise of the Kauśikī and the Gaṇḍakī; / where the Devahrada joins with the Vipāśā;

sanskrit_iast:
vipāśā ca tathā yogaṃ yatra yāti śatadruṇā ..
irāvatī tathā yogaṃ yatra vrajati sindhunā .. 64 ..
meaning:
विपाशा च तथा योगं यत्र याति शतद्रुणा ..
इरावती तथा योगं यत्र व्रजति सिन्धुना .. 64 ..
text_mt: and where the Vipāśā joins with the Śatadru; / where the Irāvatī joins with the Sindhu;

sanskrit_iast:
candrabhāgā ca vrajati yatra yogaṃ vitastayā ..
mahāsindhuśca saṃyogaṃ yatra yāti vitastayā .. 65 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रभागा च व्रजति यत्र योगं वितस्तया ..
महासिन्धुश्च संयोगं यत्र याति वितस्तया .. 65 ..
text_mt: and where the Candrabhāgā joins with the Vitastā; / and where the great Sindhu joins with the Vitastā—

sanskrit_iast:
pratyabdaṃ yāvadeteṣu saṃgameṣu mahāvaṇik ..
karoti vidhivaddānaṃ yāvaddiṣṭāntamāgataḥ .. 66 ..
meaning:
प्रत्यब्दं यावदेतेषु संगमेषु महावणिक् ..
करोति विधिवद्दानं यावद्दिष्टान्तमागतः .. 66 ..
text_mt: every year, at these confluences, the great merchant / made gifts according to rule, until he reached the end of his appointed lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ yattu jantubhiḥ ..
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ .. 67 ..
meaning:
अवाप परमं स्थानं दुर्लभं यत्तु जन्तुभिः ..
यत्र कामफला वृक्षा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः .. 67 ..
text_mt: He attained the supreme realm, which is difficult for living beings to reach, / where the trees yield every wish and the rivers have milk-rice for mud,

sanskrit_iast:
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ ..
suvarṇasikatā rājanmaṇisopānabhūṣitāḥ ..68..
meaning:
शीतलामलपानीयाः पुष्करिण्यो मनोहराः ..
सुवर्णसिकता राजन्मणिसोपानभूषिताः ..68..
text_mt: with charming lotus-ponds of cool, pure water, / having golden sands, O king, and adorned with jewelled steps.

sanskrit_iast:
ānantyāya sa saṃprāpto deśaṃ taṃ bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ..
taṃ deśamāsādya vaṇiṅmahātmā sutaptajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgaḥ ..
kalpaṃ samagraṃ mudito yadātmā reme sa rāmābhiyutaḥ kṛtātmā .. 69 ..
meaning:
आनन्त्याय स संप्राप्तो देशं तं भूरिदक्षिणः ..
तं देशमासाद्य वणिङ्महात्मा सुतप्तजाम्बूनदभूषिताङ्गः ..
कल्पं समग्रं मुदितो यदात्मा रेमे स रामाभियुतः कृतात्मा .. 69 ..
text_mt: He reached that realm for eternity, having given abundant sacrificial fees. / Having reached that realm, the noble merchant, his limbs adorned with well-refined gold, / delighted, his mind at peace, sporting with beautiful women, his self perfected, rejoiced for an entire aeon.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānairapsarobhiśca siddhagandharvasevitaḥ ..
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam..1.162.70..
meaning:
विमानैरप्सरोभिश्च सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः ..
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्..1.162.70..
text_mt: Attended by celestial cars and Apsarases, and served by Siddhas and Gandharvas, / he attains the world of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
rājasūyādibhiryajñairyatphalaṃ samavāpyate ..
śravaṇadvādaśīṃ kṛtvā tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ..71..
meaning:
राजसूयादिभिर्यज्ञैर्यत्फलं समवाप्यते ..
श्रवणद्वादशीं कृत्वा तत्फलं लभते नरः..71..
text_mt: Whatever fruit is obtained through sacrifices such as the Rājasūya, / a man obtains that fruit by observing Śravaṇadvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca..
ekāmupoṣya kṛṣṇāṃ yāṃ dvādaśīṃ vidhinā naraḥ ..
mahatphalamavāpnoti tāṃ samācakṣva bhārgava ..1 ..
meaning:
वज्र उवाच..
एकामुपोष्य कृष्णां यां द्वादशीं विधिना नरः ..
महत्फलमवाप्नोति तां समाचक्ष्व भार्गव ..1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / Having fasted according to rule on which single dark Dvādaśī / does a man obtain great fruit? Describe that, O descendant of Bhṛgu.
title: Tiladvādaśīpraśaṃsāvarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pauṣyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā ..
dvādaśī yā bhavetkṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
पौष्यान्तु समतीतायां श्रवणेन तु संयुता ..
द्वादशी या भवेत्कृष्णा प्रोक्ता सा तिलद्वादशी .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Pauṣa has passed, the dark Dvādaśī / that is joined with Śravaṇa is called Tiladvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaiḥ snānaṃ tilairhomaṃ naivedyaṃ tilamodakaiḥ ..
dīpāśca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakam .. 3 ..
meaning:
तिलैः स्नानं तिलैर्होमं नैवेद्यं तिलमोदकैः ..
दीपाश्च तिलतैलेन तथा देयं तिलोदकम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Bathing with sesame seeds, offering sesame seeds into the fire, food offering with sesame-seed sweets, / lamps with sesame oil, and likewise water with sesame seeds should be offered.

sanskrit_iast:
tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva ..
upavāsadine rājanhotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
तिलाश्च देया विप्रेभ्यस्तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव ..
उपवासदिने राजन्होतव्याश्च तथा तिलाः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Sesame seeds should be given to brahmins on that day, O ruler of the earth. / On the day of fasting, O king, sesame seeds must also be offered into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitenāpare'hni hotavyāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
indhanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathā'nagha ..5..
meaning:
उपोषितेनापरेऽह्नि होतव्याश्च विशेषतः ..
इन्धनं च प्रदातव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तथाऽनघ ..5..
text_mt: By one who has fasted, they must especially be offered into the fire on the following day. / Firewood should also be given to brahmins, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaprasthaṃ tadā hutvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
na durgatimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..6 ..
meaning:
तिलप्रस्थं तदा हुत्वा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..6 ..
text_mt: Then, having offered a prastha of sesame seeds into the fire, fasting and with senses controlled, / he does not go to a bad state; no doubt should be entertained on this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
pauruṣaṃ ca tā sūktaṃ śrīsūktena ca saṃyutama..7..
meaning:
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं होममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
पौरुषं च ता सूक्तं श्रीसूक्तेन च संयुतम..7..
text_mt: "Tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" is proclaimed as the mantra for the fire offering, / and the Puruṣasūkta combined with the Śrīsūkta.

sanskrit_iast:
homaḥ kāryo'tha rājendra sāvitryā ca yatātmanā ..
etatproktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ strīśūdreṣu tathā śṛṇu .. 8 ..
meaning:
होमः कार्योऽथ राजेन्द्र सावित्र्या च यतात्मना ..
एतत्प्रोक्तं द्विजातीनां स्त्रीशूद्रेषु तथा शृणु .. 8 ..
text_mt: The fire offering should then be performed with the Sāvitrī by one who is self-controlled, O king of kings. / This is declared for the twice-born. Now hear concerning women and śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṣṭākṣaro maṃtrasteṣāṃ prokto mahātmanām ..
hitau tau ca dvijātīnāṃ mantraśreṣṭhau narādhipa .. 9 ..
meaning:
द्वादशाष्टाक्षरो मंत्रस्तेषां प्रोक्तो महात्मनाम् ..
हितौ तौ च द्विजातीनां मन्त्रश्रेष्ठौ नराधिप .. 9 ..
text_mt: A twelve-syllabled and an eight-syllabled mantra are declared for those noble ones. / Those two supreme mantras are also beneficial for the twice-born, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāmabhyadhiko mantro vidyate neha kutracit ..
vajra uvāca ..
dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau mantrau kathayasva mamānagha .. 1.163.10 ..
meaning:
ताभ्यामभ्यधिको मन्त्रो विद्यते नेह कुत्रचित् ..
वज्र उवाच ..
द्वादशाष्टाक्षरौ मन्त्रौ कथयस्व ममानघ .. 1.163.10 ..
text_mt: There is no mantra superior to these two anywhere in this world. / Vajra said: / Tell me the twelve-syllabled and eight-syllabled mantras, O sinless one,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyau pavitrau maṅgalyau sarvapāpapraṇāśanau ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya..
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya .. 11 ..
meaning:
पुण्यौ पवित्रौ मङ्गल्यौ सर्वपापप्रणाशनौ ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय..
ओं नमो नारायणाय .. 11 ..
text_mt: meritorious, purifying, auspicious, destroyers of all sins. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya." / "Oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya."

sanskrit_iast:
etau mayā te kathitau pavitrau mantrottamau pāpaharau vareṇyau ..
pārāyaṇau sarvatapasvināṃ ca rahasyabhūtau bhuvaneṣu nityam .. 12 ..
meaning:
एतौ मया ते कथितौ पवित्रौ मन्त्रोत्तमौ पापहरौ वरेण्यौ ..
पारायणौ सर्वतपस्विनां च रहस्यभूतौ भुवनेषु नित्यम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: These two purifying, excellent mantras, destroyers of sin, most worthy of choice, / have been told to you by me; they are the ultimate refuge of all ascetics and are forever a secret in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tithiste śravaṇena yuktā māghasya māsasya tathā tavoktā ..
kāryā tatheyaṃ nṛpate viśeṣādyoge pavitre saritordvayasya .. 13 ..
meaning:
यथा तिथिस्ते श्रवणेन युक्ता माघस्य मासस्य तथा तवोक्ता ..
कार्या तथेयं नृपते विशेषाद्योगे पवित्रे सरितोर्द्वयस्य .. 13 ..
text_mt: Just as the lunar day joined with Śravaṇa in the month of Māgha has been told to you, / so this must especially be observed, O king, at the sacred confluence of two rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
māgadheṣu tu yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
मागधेषु तु यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On this subject, they also cite this ancient legendary account. / Hear what happened among the Magadhas, O lord of men.
title: Śīmāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva māgadho rājā caṇḍavega iti śrutaḥ ..
tasyāsīdrūpasaṃpannā bhāryā nayanasundarī .. 2 ..
meaning:
बभूव मागधो राजा चण्डवेग इति श्रुतः ..
तस्यासीद्रूपसंपन्ना भार्या नयनसुन्दरी .. 2 ..
text_mt: There was a king of Magadha renowned as Caṇḍavega. / He had a wife endowed with beauty named Nayanasundarī.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadharmānparityajya pratasaṃvatsaraṃ tu sā ..
tilānhomayate viprairjuhoti ca tathā svayam .. 3 ..
meaning:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य प्रतसंवत्सरं तु सा ..
तिलान्होमयते विप्रैर्जुहोति च तथा स्वयम् .. 3 ..
text_mt: Abandoning all other religious practices, every year / she had brahmins offer sesame seeds into the fire, and also offered them herself,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māghe māsi hutāśane ..
devasya caiva naivedyaṃ karoti tilamodakaiḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे माघे मासि हुताशने ..
देवस्य चैव नैवेद्यं करोति तिलमोदकैः .. 4 ..
text_mt: at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī in the month of Māgha, into the fire, / and made a food offering of sesame-seed sweets to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
arcanena ca vāsobhiḥ pūjayatyapi mādhavam ..
mahārañjitaraktāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca .. 5 ..
meaning:
अर्चनेन च वासोभिः पूजयत्यपि माधवम् ..
महारञ्जितरक्तानि वासांसि विविधानि च .. 5 ..
text_mt: She worshiped Mādhava with offerings and garments, / and diverse garments dyed deep red with safflower

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇīnāṃ ca geheṣu visarjayati tatparā ..
mahāvartipradānaṃ ca vidhatte keśavālaye .. 6 ..
meaning:
ब्राह्मणीनां च गेहेषु विसर्जयति तत्परा ..
महावर्तिप्रदानं च विधत्ते केशवालये .. 6 ..
text_mt: she distributed in the houses of brahmin women, intent on this practice; / and she presented large wicks in the temple of Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ kadācitsukhāsīnāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ tu vasantikā ..
papraccha sakhibhāvena rahasyaṃ nirjane sthitā .. 7 ..
meaning:
तां कदाचित्सुखासीनां ब्राह्मणीं तु वसन्तिका ..
पप्रच्छ सखिभावेन रहस्यं निर्जने स्थिता .. 7 ..
text_mt: Once, when she was sitting comfortably, a brahmin woman named Vasantikā / approached her in solitary seclusion and asked her out of friendship about the secret.

sanskrit_iast:
vasantikovāca ..
sarvadharmānparityajya māghe māsi śubhānane ..
dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya kasmādarcayase harim .. 8 ..
meaning:
वसन्तिकोवाच ..
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य माघे मासि शुभानने ..
द्वादश्यां कृष्णपक्षस्य कस्मादर्चयसे हरिम् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Vasantikā said: / Setting aside all other dharmas, O fair-faced woman, in the month of Māgha, / on the Dvādaśī of the dark fortnight, why do you worship Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
kasmāttathā bahutilaṃ hāvayasyanale tathā ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi rahasyaṃ cenna te śubhe .. 9 ..
meaning:
कस्मात्तथा बहुतिलं हावयस्यनले तथा ..
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि रहस्यं चेन्न ते शुभे .. 9 ..
text_mt: And why do you offer so many sesame seeds into the fire? / Dispel this doubt of mine, if it is not a secret from me, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
nayanasundaryuvāca ..
rahasyametatparamaṃ na rahasyaṃ tathā tvayi ..
tvaṃ me sakhīśvarī prāṇastvaṃ me prāṇadhaneśvarī .. 1.164.10 ..
meaning:
नयनसुन्दर्युवाच ..
रहस्यमेतत्परमं न रहस्यं तथा त्वयि ..
त्वं मे सखीश्वरी प्राणस्त्वं मे प्राणधनेश्वरी .. 1.164.10 ..
text_mt: Nayanasundarī said: / This is a supreme secret, yet it is no secret from you. / You are my friend and mistress, my very life-breath; you are the mistress of my life and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
asti vaitastiko nāma deśaḥ paramadhāmikaḥ ..
tatra grāmavaraṃ cāsīdvasatirme suśobhanā .. 11 ..
meaning:
अस्ति वैतस्तिको नाम देशः परमधामिकः ..
तत्र ग्रामवरं चासीद्वसतिर्मे सुशोभना .. 11 ..
text_mt: There is a most righteous region named Vaitastika. / In that region was an excellent village where I had a very lovely dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍavegaśca vipro'bhūdbhartā me pūrvajanmani ..
nāstiko niranukrośastarkaśāstrarataḥ sadā ..12..
meaning:
चण्डवेगश्च विप्रोऽभूद्भर्ता मे पूर्वजन्मनि ..
नास्तिको निरनुक्रोशस्तर्कशास्त्ररतः सदा ..12..
text_mt: Caṇḍavega was a brahmin, my husband in a previous birth, / an atheist, uncompassionate, and always devoted to logic.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva viṣaye rājā babhūva dadhivāhanaḥ ..
tasya bhāryāṃ vayasyā me babhūva kamalā śubhā .. 13 ..
meaning:
तत्रैव विषये राजा बभूव दधिवाहनः ..
तस्य भार्यां वयस्या मे बभूव कमला शुभा .. 13 ..
text_mt: In that very realm, there was a king named Dadhivāhana. / His wife, the auspicious Kamalā, was my companion.

sanskrit_iast:
sā kadācinmāmuvāca rahasyaṃ varavarṇinī ..
nārī bhartṛkṛtādardhaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti sundarī .. 14 ..
meaning:
सा कदाचिन्मामुवाच रहस्यं वरवर्णिनी ..
नारी भर्तृकृतादर्धं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति सुन्दरी .. 14 ..
text_mt: Once, that fair woman spoke to me in secret: / 'A woman receives half the merit produced by her husband, O beautiful one.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣitam ..
patiṃ śuśrūṣate yā tu tena svarge mahīyate .. 15 ..
meaning:
नास्ति स्त्रीणां पृथग्यज्ञो न व्रतं नाप्युपोषितम् ..
पतिं शुश्रूषते या तु तेन स्वर्गे महीयते .. 15 ..
text_mt: Women have no separate sacrifice, no vow, and no fasting; / but she who attends upon her husband is glorified in heaven on that account.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ yoṣitā puṇyaṃ pṛthagvāpi tadicchayā ..
patiste nāstiko bhadre kiñcinnācarate śubham .. 16 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यं योषिता पुण्यं पृथग्वापि तदिच्छया ..
पतिस्ते नास्तिको भद्रे किञ्चिन्नाचरते शुभम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: Merit may be performed by a woman separately only with his consent; / but your husband is an atheist, my dear, and performs nothing good.

sanskrit_iast:
na cācarasi dharmaṃ tvaṃ tathā ca tadanujñayā ..
kā gatiḥ paraloke te bhaviṣyati śubhānane ..17..
meaning:
न चाचरसि धर्मं त्वं तथा च तदनुज्ञया ..
का गतिः परलोके ते भविष्यति शुभानने ..17..
text_mt: Nor do you practice dharma, even with his permission; / what state will be yours in the next world, O lovely-faced one?

sanskrit_iast:
iha yatkriyate karma pretya tatropabhujyate ..
yenoptaṃ phalakāle tu sa evāśnāti bhāmini .. 18 ..
meaning:
इह यत्क्रियते कर्म प्रेत्य तत्रोपभुज्यते ..
येनोप्तं फलकाले तु स एवाश्नाति भामिनि .. 18 ..
text_mt: Whatever deed is done here is enjoyed after death in that [other] world; / whoever has sown, he alone eats at the time of fruit, O spirited lady.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vidyutsampātacañcalam ..
nācaranti śubhaṃ ye tu teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam .. 19 ..
meaning:
मानुष्यं दुर्लभं प्राप्य विद्युत्सम्पातचञ्चलम् ..
नाचरन्ति शुभं ये तु तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Having obtained human birth, which is rare to obtain and unsteady like a flash of lightning, / those who do not perform good have lived their life in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidapi vāmoru yoniṣvatha paribhraman ..
mānuṣyaṃ nāma jāyeta yatrāyattaṃ śubhāśubham .. .. 1.164.20 .
meaning:
कदाचिदपि वामोरु योनिष्वथ परिभ्रमन् ..
मानुष्यं नाम जायेत यत्रायत्तं शुभाशुभम् .. .. 1.164.20 .
text_mt: Only on occasion, O beautiful-thighed one, while wandering through wombs, / does one take birth as a human, upon which good and evil depend.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālatve'pi mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā sakhi durlabham ..
ātmā śakyastayā trātuṃ mānuṣyānnānyataḥ śubhe .. 21 ..
meaning:
चण्डालत्वेऽपि मानुष्यं सर्वथा सखि दुर्लभम् ..
आत्मा शक्यस्तया त्रातुं मानुष्यान्नान्यतः शुभे .. 21 ..
text_mt: Even in the state of an outcast, human birth is exceedingly rare, my friend; / the self can be rescued through human birth, not through anything else, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
tavopari tathā jātā sakhī bhāvena me kṛpā ..
kadaryyasyāsya bhāryā tvaṃ susvabhāvā pativratā .. 22 ..
meaning:
तवोपरि तथा जाता सखी भावेन मे कृपा ..
कदर्य्यस्यास्य भार्या त्वं सुस्वभावा पतिव्रता .. 22 ..
text_mt: Therefore, out of friendship, compassion has arisen in me towards you; / you are the wife of this miser, yet of good nature and devoted to your husband.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te'nugrahaṃ kiñcitkariṣyāmi nibodha tat ..
harasya dayitā bhāryā śailendratanayā umā .. 23 ..
meaning:
तत्र तेऽनुग्रहं किञ्चित्करिष्यामि निबोध तत् ..
हरस्य दयिता भार्या शैलेन्द्रतनया उमा .. 23 ..
text_mt: Therefore, I shall bestow a favor upon you; listen to it: / Hara's beloved wife is Umā, daughter of the king of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
vistāritamahākūlā sā vitastā mahānadī ..
avṛttikarṣitaḥ pāpaṃ kṛtvaiva ṛtupañcakam .. 24 ..
meaning:
विस्तारितमहाकूला सा वितस्ता महानदी ..
अवृत्तिकर्षितः पापं कृत्वैव ऋतुपञ्चकम् .. 24 ..
text_mt: She became the great river Vitastā with its wide, vast banks. / Even if one, worn down by lack of livelihood, has committed sin for five seasons,

sanskrit_iast:
snānenaikena sakalaṃ śaiśireṇa vyapohati ..
yasyāṃ yasyāṃ tithau snātaḥ svargamāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 25 ..
meaning:
स्नानेनैकेन सकलं शैशिरेण व्यपोहति ..
यस्यां यस्यां तिथौ स्नातः स्वर्गमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् .. 25 ..
text_mt: he wipes it all away by a single winter bath. / On whatever lunar day one bathes in her, he attains heaven without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ samvatsaraṃ snātvā mokṣopāyaṃ tu vindati ..
yā ca susvādusalilā yā ca pāpakṣayaṅkarī .. 26 ..
meaning:
तस्यां सम्वत्सरं स्नात्वा मोक्षोपायं तु विन्दति ..
या च सुस्वादुसलिला या च पापक्षयङ्करी .. 26 ..
text_mt: And having bathed in her for a year, one discovers the means to liberation. / Her waters are very sweet and she destroys sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstīre mayā nityaṃ prati samvatsaraṃ śubhe ..
upoṣya māghakṛṣṇasya dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe tathā .. 27 ..
meaning:
तस्यास्तीरे मया नित्यं प्रति सम्वत्सरं शुभे ..
उपोष्य माघकृष्णस्य द्वादश्यां श्रवणे तथा .. 27 ..
text_mt: On her bank every year, O auspicious one, / having fasted on the twelfth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha under the asterism Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjito bhagavānviṣṇurbrāhmaṇāśca hutāśanaḥ ..
tilaistasmāttu te khyātaṃ brāhmametadvrataṃ mama ..28 ..
meaning:
पूजितो भगवान्विष्णुर्ब्राह्मणाश्च हुताशनः ..
तिलैस्तस्मात्तु ते ख्यातं ब्राह्ममेतद्व्रतं मम ..28 ..
text_mt: the blessed Viṣṇu, the brahmins, and the fire were worshipped by me / with sesame seeds; therefore, this sacred vow of mine is celebrated for you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātskannaṃ tilaṃ yacca yadagnau patitaṃ na ca ..
tataḥ puṇyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ tvamāpnuhi varānane .. 29 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्स्कन्नं तिलं यच्च यदग्नौ पतितं न च ..
ततः पुण्यफलं सर्वं त्वमाप्नुहि वरानने .. 29 ..
text_mt: Whatever sesame fell aside and did not fall into the fire, / may you obtain all the meritorious fruit from that, O lovely-faced one!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktayā gatvā bhartā pṛṣṭastadā mayā ..
hasatā tena cāsmyuktā gaccha gṛhṇīṣva tatphalam .. 1.164.30 ..
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तया गत्वा भर्ता पृष्टस्तदा मया ..
हसता तेन चास्म्युक्ता गच्छ गृह्णीष्व तत्फलम् .. 1.164.30 ..
text_mt: Having been spoken to in this way, I went and asked my husband then; / laughing, he said to me: 'Go and take that fruit.'

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ kṛtvā śubhaṃ karma kamalā sā sakhī mama ..
saha bhartrā viśālākṣi viṣṇulokamito gatā .. 31 ..
meaning:
स्वयं कृत्वा शुभं कर्म कमला सा सखी मम ..
सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षि विष्णुलोकमितो गता .. 31 ..
text_mt: Having performed that good deed herself, my friend Kamalā, / along with her husband, O large-eyed one, went from here to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tallokamakṣayaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ vaivasvatānmayā ..
tasmāddṛṣṭaphalaṃ bhadre karomi tiladvādaśīm .. 32 ..
meaning:
तल्लोकमक्षयं तस्याः श्रुतं वैवस्वतान्मया ..
तस्माद्दृष्टफलं भद्रे करोमि तिलद्वादशीम् .. 32 ..
text_mt: I heard from Vaivasvata that her world is imperishable; / therefore, seeing its fruit, O gentle lady, I observe the Tiladvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchasi sundari ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ brāhmaṇyapi vasantikā .. 33 ..
meaning:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि सुन्दरि ..
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं ब्राह्मण्यपि वसन्तिका .. 33 ..
text_mt: All this has been related to you which you ask of me, O beautiful one.' / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having heard this auspicious speech, the brahmin woman Vasantikā also,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayāmāsa keśavam ..
māghakṛṣṇe mahābhāga tilairnityamatandritā .. 34 ..
meaning:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे पूजयामास केशवम् ..
माघकृष्णे महाभाग तिलैर्नित्यमतन्द्रिता .. 34 ..
text_mt: at the conjunction of Śravaṇa and the twelfth lunar day / in the dark fortnight of Māgha, O fortunate one, constantly worshipped Keśava with sesame seeds, free from sloth.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvāpi sā devaṃ śvetadvīpamito gatā ..
sāpi rājño mahābhāgā tathā nayanasundarī .. 35 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वापि सा देवं श्वेतद्वीपमितो गता ..
सापि राज्ञो महाभागा तथा नयनसुन्दरी .. 35 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped the god, she went from here to Śvetadvīpa; / and the fortunate [queen] Nayanasundarī, the wife of the king,

sanskrit_iast:
amalaṃ sthānamāsādya virarāja śaśiprabhā ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tadā pūjyo janārdanaḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
अमलं स्थानमासाद्य विरराज शशिप्रभा ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तदा पूज्यो जनार्दनः .. 36 ..
text_mt: having attained that spotless realm, shone with the luster of the moon. / Therefore, with all effort, Janārdana should be worshipped at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
tilairnityaṃ mahābhāga hotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ ..
tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva .. 37 .
meaning:
तिलैर्नित्यं महाभाग होतव्याश्च तथा तिलाः ..
तिलाश्च देया विप्रेभ्यस्तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव .. 37 .
text_mt: constantly with sesame seeds, O fortunate one, and sesame seeds should be offered into the fire, / and sesame seeds should be given to brahmins on that day, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasmāttilādrājaṃstilabījodbhave yathā ..
sukṛṣṭakṣetrajāddṛṣṭaṃ deve kālapravarṣiṇi .. 38 ..
meaning:
एकैकस्मात्तिलाद्राजंस्तिलबीजोद्भवे यथा ..
सुकृष्टक्षेत्रजाद्दृष्टं देवे कालप्रवर्षिणि .. 38 ..
text_mt: Just as from a single sesame seed, O king, there is the growth of sesame seeds, / as seen when springing from a well-ploughed field when the rain falls in due season,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasmāttilāttadvatphalamakṣayyamaśnute ..
svarloke viṣṇuloke vā mānuṣye yadi vā nṛpa ..
akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti ekaikasmāttilāttilāt .. 39 ..
meaning:
एकैकस्मात्तिलात्तद्वत्फलमक्षय्यमश्नुते ..
स्वर्लोके विष्णुलोके वा मानुष्ये यदि वा नृप ..
अक्षय्यं फलमाप्नोति एकैकस्मात्तिलात्तिलात् .. 39 ..
text_mt: so from each single sesame seed one enjoys imperishable fruit; / whether in heaven, or in the world of Viṣṇu, or in human birth, O king, / one obtains imperishable fruit from every single sesame seed.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprayatnena narendracandra tasyā samabhyarcaya vāsudevam ..
upoṣitaḥ prītamanā yathāvattrāṇaṃ sa devaḥ prathito narāṇām .. 1.164.40 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन नरेन्द्रचन्द्र तस्या समभ्यर्चय वासुदेवम् ..
उपोषितः प्रीतमना यथावत्त्राणं स देवः प्रथितो नराणाम् .. 1.164.40 ..
text_mt: Therefore, with effort, O moon among kings, properly worship Vāsudeva on that day, / having fasted, with a delighted mind; that god is celebrated as the protector of men.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
hotavye viṣṇudaivatye sāvitrī me tvayoditā ..
homakarmaṇi sandeho mahānme bhṛgunandana .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
होतव्ये विष्णुदैवत्ये सावित्री मे त्वयोदिता ..
होमकर्मणि सन्देहो महान्मे भृगुनन्दन .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / The Sāvitrī was declared by you to me for the oblation to be made to the deity Viṣṇu; / concerning the rite of the fire sacrifice, I have a great doubt, O son of Bhṛgu.
title: Gāyatrīmāhātmyavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
savitā daivataṃ tasyāḥ sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ ..
tayā kathaṃ tu kartavyaṃ homakarma ca vaiṣṇavam .. 2 ..
meaning:
सविता दैवतं तस्याः सावित्रीत्युच्यते ततः ..
तया कथं तु कर्तव्यं होमकर्म च वैष्णवम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: Savitṛ is its deity, and therefore it is called Sāvitrī; / how then can a Vaiṣṇava fire-sacrifice rite be performed with it?

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāvamārṣeśca tathā tasyāstvaṃ mama kīrtaya ..
vedamātā tu sā proktā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..3..
meaning:
प्रभावमार्षेश्च तथा तस्यास्त्वं मम कीर्तय ..
वेदमाता तु सा प्रोक्ता सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ..3..
text_mt: Tell me also of the power and the seer of that [verse]; / for she is declared to be the mother of the Vedas, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ravimadhye sthitaḥ somaḥ somamadhye hutāśanaḥ ..
tejomadhye sthitaṃ sattvaṃ sattvamadhye sthito'cyutaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
रविमध्ये स्थितः सोमः सोममध्ये हुताशनः ..
तेजोमध्ये स्थितं सत्त्वं सत्त्वमध्ये स्थितोऽच्युतः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the midst of the sun stands the moon, in the midst of the moon stands the fire; / in the midst of radiance stands sattva, and in the midst of sattva stands Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvameva mayeritaḥ ..
śaṅkareṇa tadā dṛṣṭaḥ prabhavaḥ sarvatejasām .. 5 ..
meaning:
अंगुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषः पूर्वमेव मयेरितः ..
शङ्करेण तदा दृष्टः प्रभवः सर्वतेजसाम् .. 5 ..
text_mt: The thumb-sized Cosmic Person was already spoken of by me earlier; / he was seen then by Śaṅkara as the source of all radiances.

sanskrit_iast:
sa viṣṇurbhuvanādhāro yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
vareṇyaṃ tacca saviturbhargavācyaṃ tu yoginām ..6..
meaning:
स विष्णुर्भुवनाधारो यस्येदं सकलं जगत् ..
वरेण्यं तच्च सवितुर्भर्गवाच्यं तु योगिनाम् ..6..
text_mt: He is Viṣṇu, the support of the worlds, to whom belongs this entire universe; / and he is the 'choicest radiance' of Savitṛ that is spoken of to yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
yeyaṃ paraṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ bahirantaśca yādava ..
dhīśabdavācyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pracodayati yaḥ sadā .. 7 ..
meaning:
येयं परं तदुद्दिष्टं बहिरन्तश्च यादव ..
धीशब्दवाच्यं ब्रह्माणं प्रचोदयति यः सदा .. 7 ..
text_mt: That which is supreme is designated as this, outside and inside, O descendant of Yadu; / he who constantly impels Brahmā, who is denoted by the word 'understanding'.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ savitā sa prakīrtitaḥ ..
sarvalokaprasavanātsavitā sa tu kīrtyate .. 8 ..
meaning:
सृष्ट्यर्थं भगवान्विष्णुः सविता स प्रकीर्तितः ..
सर्वलोकप्रसवनात्सविता स तु कीर्त्यते .. 8 ..
text_mt: For the purpose of creation, the blessed Viṣṇu is proclaimed as Savitṛ; / he is celebrated as Savitṛ because he brings forth all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yatastaddevadevatyā sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ ..
gānādvā trāyate yasmādgāyatrī vā tadā smṛtā .. 9 ..
meaning:
यतस्तद्देवदेवत्या सावित्रीत्युच्यते ततः ..
गानाद्वा त्रायते यस्माद्गायत्री वा तदा स्मृता .. 9 ..
text_mt: Since that god is its deity, it is therefore called Sāvitrī; / or, since it protects from singing, it is regarded then as Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmātkāraṇādrājansāvitrī kīrtitā mayā ..
tava dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha nityaṃ vaiṣṇavakarmasu .. 1.165.10 ..
meaning:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजन्सावित्री कीर्तिता मया ..
तव धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ नित्यं वैष्णवकर्मसु .. 1.165.10 ..
text_mt: For this reason, O king, best among upholders of dharma, / the Sāvitrī has always been declared by me to you in Vaiṣṇava rites.

sanskrit_iast:
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha ..
ye japanti sadā teṣāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit .. 11 ..
meaning:
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह ..
ये जपन्ति सदा तेषां न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् .. 11 ..
text_mt: Those who constantly chant the Gāyatrī together with the vyāhṛtis, the praṇava, and the head, / have no fear anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
daśakṛtvā prajaptā sā rātryahnā yatkṛtaṃ laghu ..
tatpāpaṃ praṇudatyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
meaning:
दशकृत्वा प्रजप्ता सा रात्र्यह्ना यत्कृतं लघु ..
तत्पापं प्रणुदत्याशु नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 12 ..
text_mt: Repeated ten times, it quickly dispels whatever minor sin / has been committed by night or by day; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ japtā tu sā devī pāpopaśamanā smṛtā ..
sahasrajaptā sā devī copapātakanāśinī .. 13 ..
lakṣajāpena ca tathā mahāpātakanāśinī .. 13 ..
meaning:
शतं जप्ता तु सा देवी पापोपशमना स्मृता ..
सहस्रजप्ता सा देवी चोपपातकनाशिनी .. 13 ..
लक्षजापेन च तथा महापातकनाशिनी .. 13 ..
text_mt:
Chanted a hundred times, that goddess is regarded as pacifying sins; / chanted a thousand times, that goddess destroys minor offenses;
and by a hundred thousand repetitions, she destroys the great mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast: koṭijāpyena rājendra yadicchati tadāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
meaning: कोटिजाप्येन राजेन्द्र यदिच्छति तदाप्नुयात् .. 14 ..
text_mt: By ten million repetitions, O best of kings, one obtains whatever one desires:

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādharatvaṃ yakṣatvaṃ gandharvatvamathāpi vā ..
devatvamathavā rājyaṃ bhūrloke hatakaṇṭakam .. 15 ..
meaning:
विद्याधरत्वं यक्षत्वं गन्धर्वत्वमथापि वा ..
देवत्वमथवा राज्यं भूर्लोके हतकण्टकम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: the state of a vidyādhara, a yakṣa, or a gandharva, / or godhood, or an unhindered kingdom on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭisāhasrajāpyena niṣkāmaḥ puruṣottama ..
vidhinā rājaśārdūla prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 16 ..
meaning:
कोटिसाहस्रजाप्येन निष्कामः पुरुषोत्तम ..
विधिना राजशार्दूल प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: By reciting [it] ten thousand times ten million, one free from desire, O Puruṣottama, / according to the prescribed rule, O tiger among kings, attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā kathañcijjaptaiṣā devī paramapāvanī ..
sarvakāmapradā proktā vidhinā kimpunarnṛpa .. 17 ...
meaning:
यथा कथञ्चिज्जप्तैषा देवी परमपावनी ..
सर्वकामप्रदा प्रोक्ता विधिना किम्पुनर्नृप .. 17 ...
text_mt: Even when recited in any manner whatsoever, this goddess is the supreme purifier, / declared to grant all desires; how much more so according to rule, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
vidhinā kena japtavyā gāyatrī pāpanāśinī ..
mahāpavitrā paramā sarvakalyāṇakāritā. .. 18 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
विधिना केन जप्तव्या गायत्री पापनाशिनी ..
महापवित्रा परमा सर्वकल्याणकारिता. .. 18 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / According to what rule should the Gāyatrī be recited—she who destroys sin, / who is supremely pure, excellent, and the bringer of all auspiciousness?

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kuśaśayyāṃ niviṣṭastu kuśapāṇi jitendriyaḥ ..
arkamadhyagataṃ dhyāyetpuruṣaṃ taṃ mahādyutim .. 19 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
कुशशय्यां निविष्टस्तु कुशपाणि जितेन्द्रियः ..
अर्कमध्यगतं ध्यायेत्पुरुषं तं महाद्युतिम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Seated upon a bed of kuśa grass, with kuśa in hand, having conquered the senses, / one should meditate on that Person of great splendour dwelling in the midst of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
athavārkaṃ mahīpāla bahiḥ snātastvatandritaḥ ..
ananyacitto medhāvī pūrvāhne tu viśeṣataḥ .. 1.165.20 ..
meaning:
अथवार्कं महीपाल बहिः स्नातस्त्वतन्द्रितः ..
अनन्यचित्तो मेधावी पूर्वाह्ने तु विशेषतः .. 1.165.20 ..
text_mt: Or else [standing] outside, O protector of the earth, having bathed, unwearied, / with undivided mind and wise, especially in the forenoon,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī payomūlāśano'thavā ..
phalapuṣpāśano vāpi naktaṃ vāpi haviṣyabhuk .. 21 ..
meaning:
भैक्ष्ययावकशाकाशी पयोमूलाशनोऽथवा ..
फलपुष्पाशनो वापि नक्तं वापि हविष्यभुक् .. 21 ..
text_mt: subsisting on alms, barley gruel, or vegetables, or consuming milk and roots, / or feeding on fruits and flowers, or eating sacrificial food at night,

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā japyaṃ yaḥ karoti mahīpate ..
