sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān .. 22 ..
meaning:
अनेन विधिना जप्यं यः करोति महीपते ..
स याति परमं स्थानं वायुभूतः खमूर्तिमान् .. 22 ..
text_mt: he who undertakes the recitation according to this rule, O lord of the earth, / goes to the supreme abode, turned into wind, having the form of space.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmaḥ kāmakāmastu kāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam ..
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa .. 23 ..
meaning:
अकामः कामकामस्तु काममाप्नोत्यभीप्सितम् ..
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवाः प्राणायामास्तु षोडश .. 23 ..
text_mt: Free from desires, but if desiring, he obtains the desired wish. / Sixteen breath-restraints accompanied by the sacred utterances and the praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
api bhrūṇahaṇaṃ māsātpunantyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ ..
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha .. 24 ..
meaning:
अपि भ्रूणहणं मासात्पुनन्त्यहरहः कृताः ..
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह .. 24 ..
text_mt: performed day after day, purify even the killer of an embryo after a month. / The Gāyatrī accompanied by the sacred utterances and the praṇava, along with the [Gāyatrī-]head,

sanskrit_iast:
triḥ paṭhedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ..
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kāryaṃ kalyamutthāya vai dvijaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
त्रिः पठेदायतप्राणः प्राणायामः स उच्यते ..
प्राणायामत्रयं कार्यं कल्यमुत्थाय वै द्विजः .. 25 ..
text_mt: one should recite thrice with held breath; that is called a breath-restraint. / A twice-born, having risen at dawn, must perform three breath-restraints;

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttakṣaṇādeva mucyate ..
sarvadoṣaharaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ dvijanmanām .. 26 ..
meaning:
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापात्तक्षणादेव मुच्यते ..
सर्वदोषहरं प्रोक्तं प्राणायामं द्विजन्मनाम् .. 26 ..
text_mt: he is instantly freed from the sin committed day and night. / Breath-restraint is declared to remove all faults for the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvabhyadhikaṃ nāsti rājanparamapāvanam ..
prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ māsaṃ kuśāgracyutabindunā .. 27 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्वभ्यधिकं नास्ति राजन्परमपावनम् ..
प्राणसंधारणं मासं कुशाग्रच्युतबिन्दुना .. 27 ..
text_mt: There is nothing superior to that, O king, as a supreme purifier. / Maintaining life for a month with a drop falling from the tip of kuśa grass,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kuryādambhasāṃ pānaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tu tatsamam ..
nirodhājjāyate vāyustasmādagnistato jalam .. 28 ..
meaning:
यः कुर्यादम्भसां पानं प्राणायामं तु तत्समम् ..
निरोधाज्जायते वायुस्तस्मादग्निस्ततो जलम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: whoever should thus drink water, [the effect] is equal to breath-restraint. / From restraint arises wind; from that, fire; from that, water;

sanskrit_iast:
tribhiḥ śarīraṃ sakalaṃ prāṇāyāmaiśca śudhyati ..
ākeśāgrānnakhāgrācca tapastapyetsa uttamam .. 29 ..
meaning:
त्रिभिः शरीरं सकलं प्राणायामैश्च शुध्यति ..
आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच्च तपस्तप्येत्स उत्तमम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: and by three breath-restraints, the entire body is purified. / From the tips of the hair to the tips of the nails, he performs supreme austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ śodhayedyastu prāṇāyāmaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 1.165.30 ..
meaning:
आत्मानं शोधयेद्यस्तु प्राणायामैः पुनःपुनः ..
श्रावण्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .. 1.165.30 ..
text_mt: He who purifies himself again and again by breath-restraints, / fasting on the full-moon day of Śrāvaṇa, with conquered senses,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..
antarjale trirāvartya gāyatrīṃ prayato japan .. 31 ..
meaning:
प्राणायामशतं कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ..
अन्तर्जले त्रिरावर्त्य गायत्रीं प्रयतो जपन् .. 31 ..
text_mt: and performing a hundred breath-restraints, is freed from all sins. / Having submerged in water and repeatedly reciting Gāyatrī thrice, restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairyadi na brahmahā bhavet ..
nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti kṛṣṇasamā gatiḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्यदि न ब्रह्महा भवेत् ..
नास्ति सत्यात्परो धर्मो नास्ति कृष्णसमा गतिः .. 32 ..
text_mt: he is freed from all sins, provided he is not a killer of a brahmin. / There is no dharma higher than truth; there is no refuge equal to Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryāśca paraṃ nāsti divi ceha ca pāvanam ..
hutā ca varadā devī sarvakāmaphalapradā .. 33 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्याश्च परं नास्ति दिवि चेह च पावनम् ..
हुता च वरदा देवी सर्वकामफलप्रदा .. 33 ..
text_mt: and there is nothing purifying in heaven or on earth higher than the Gāyatrī. / When offered into the fire, the goddess grants boons and yields the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryāḥ sutilairhomaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ..
śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryādāyuṣkāmo ghṛtena ca .. 34 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्याः सुतिलैर्होमः सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ..
शान्तिकामो यवैः कुर्यादायुष्कामो घृतेन च .. 34 ..
text_mt: An oblation of the Gāyatrī with sesame completely destroys all sins. / One desiring peace should perform it with barley; one desiring longevity, with ghee;

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu kuryātsiddhārthakairnaraḥ..
brahmavarcasakāmastu payasā sa samācaret .. 35 ..
meaning:
कर्मणां सिद्धिकामस्तु कुर्यात्सिद्धार्थकैर्नरः..
ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्तु पयसा स समाचरेत् .. 35 ..
text_mt: a man desiring success in undertakings should perform it with white mustard; / one desiring spiritual lustre should do so with milk;

sanskrit_iast:
putrakāmastathā dadhnā dhānyakāmastu śālibhiḥ ..
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca grahapīḍāpraśāntaye .. 36 ..
meaning:
पुत्रकामस्तथा दध्ना धान्यकामस्तु शालिभिः ..
क्षीरवृक्षसमिद्भिश्च ग्रहपीडाप्रशान्तये .. 36 ..
text_mt: one desiring a son, likewise, with curd; one desiring grain, with rice; / and with kindling sticks of milky trees for the appeasement of planetary afflictions;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanakāmastathā bilvaiḥ śrīkāmaḥ kamalaistathā ..
ārogyakāmaḥ kṣīrāktaiḥ kuryāddūrvāṅkuraiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 37 ..
meaning:
धनकामस्तथा बिल्वैः श्रीकामः कमलैस्तथा ..
आरोग्यकामः क्षीराक्तैः कुर्याद्दूर्वाङ्कुरैः शुभैः .. 37 ..
text_mt: likewise, one desiring wealth with bilva leaves; one desiring fortune with lotuses; / one desiring health should perform it with auspicious dūrvā sprouts smeared with milk.

sanskrit_iast:
deśopasarge saṃprāpte tadeva ca vidhīyate ..
guggulorgulikābhistu kṛtvā homamatandritaḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
देशोपसर्गे संप्राप्ते तदेव च विधीयते ..
गुग्गुलोर्गुलिकाभिस्तु कृत्वा होममतन्द्रितः .. 38 ..
text_mt: When a calamity befalls the country, that very [offering] is prescribed. / Having performed the fire-offering unwearied with pellets of guggulu,

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
pāyasena tathā hutvā vidyāṃ samadhigacchati ..
yenayena tu kāmena lakṣahomaṃ samācaret .. 39 ..
meaning:
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..
पायसेन तथा हुत्वा विद्यां समधिगच्छति ..
येनयेन तु कामेन लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: one attains great good fortune; there is no doubt about this. / Likewise, having offered milk-rice, one acquires sacred knowledge. / With whatever desire one performs a hundred-thousand fire-offering,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva kāmamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
kṛcchreṇa śuddhimutpādya prāṇāyāmaśatena ca .. 1.165.40 ..
meaning:
तदेव काममाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..
कृच्छ्रेण शुद्धिमुत्पाद्य प्राणायामशतेन च .. 1.165.40 ..
text_mt: that very desire one attains; there is no doubt about this. / Having produced purification by means of a kṛcchra penance and a hundred breath-restraints,

sanskrit_iast:
antarjalena vā japtvā snāto nityamatandritaḥ ..
prāṇāyāmāṃstataḥ kṛtvā vidhinaiva sa ṣoḍaśa .. 41 ..
meaning:
अन्तर्जलेन वा जप्त्वा स्नातो नित्यमतन्द्रितः ..
प्राणायामांस्ततः कृत्वा विधिनैव स षोडश .. 41 ..
text_mt: or having recited underwater, having bathed, continually unwearied, / then having performed sixteen breath-restraints strictly according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhṇe juhuyādvahnau susamiddhe yathāvidhi ..
bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī phalamūlāśano'thavā .. .. 42 ..
meaning:
पूर्वाह्णे जुहुयाद्वह्नौ सुसमिद्धे यथाविधि ..
भैक्ष्ययावकशाकाशी फलमूलाशनोऽथवा .. .. 42 ..
text_mt: one should offer in the forenoon into a well-kindled fire according to the ordinance, / eating alms, barley gruel, or vegetables, or eating fruits and roots,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrasaktūghṛtāhārī bhavedatha vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
āhārāṇāṃ yathoktānāmekāhāraṃ samāśrayet .. 43 ..
meaning:
क्षीरसक्तूघृताहारी भवेदथ विचक्षणः ..
आहाराणां यथोक्तानामेकाहारं समाश्रयेत् .. 43 ..
text_mt: or the wise man should be one who subsists on milk, roasted barley flour, or ghee. / Among the diets as mentioned, he should adhere to a single diet,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsamāptirbhavati lakṣahomasya pārthiva ..
lakṣahomāvasāne tu brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dakṣiṇā .. 44 ..
meaning:
यावत्समाप्तिर्भवति लक्षहोमस्य पार्थिव ..
लक्षहोमावसाने तु ब्राह्मणानां तु दक्षिणा .. 44 ..
text_mt: until the completion of the hundred-thousand fire-offering, O ruler of the earth. / At the end of the hundred-thousand fire-offering, a sacrificial fee to brahmins

sanskrit_iast:
deyā bhavati rājendra gāvo vastrāṇi kāñcanam ..
sarvotpātasamutpattau brāhmaṇairanupūjitaiḥ .. 45..
meaning:
देया भवति राजेन्द्र गावो वस्त्राणि काञ्चनम् ..
सर्वोत्पातसमुत्पत्तौ ब्राह्मणैरनुपूजितैः .. 45..
text_mt: is to be given, O king of kings: cows, garments, and gold. / Upon the occurrence of all portents, by brahmins duly honoured,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhirdaśabhirvāpi lakṣahomaṃ samācaret ..
asaṅkīrṇaistathā hārairnṛpatistatpraśāntaye .. 46 ..
meaning:
पञ्चभिर्दशभिर्वापि लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् ..
असङ्कीर्णैस्तथा हारैर्नृपतिस्तत्प्रशान्तये .. 46 ..
text_mt: by five or even ten, the king should perform the hundred-thousand fire-offering / with unmixed diets for the appeasement thereof.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hyanena na śāmyati ..
maṅgalaṃ paramaṃ nāsti yattasmādatiricyate .. 47 ..
meaning:
नास्ति लोके स उत्पातो यो ह्यनेन न शाम्यति ..
मङ्गलं परमं नास्ति यत्तस्मादतिरिच्यते .. 47 ..
text_mt: There is no portent in the world that is not appeased by this. / There is no supreme auspiciousness that surpasses it.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭihomaṃ tu yo rājā kārayetpūrvavaddvijaiḥ ..
na tasya śatravaḥ saṅkhye jātu tiṣṭhanti karhicit .. 48 ..
meaning:
कोटिहोमं तु यो राजा कारयेत्पूर्ववद्द्विजैः ..
न तस्य शत्रवः सङ्ख्ये जातु तिष्ठन्ति कर्हिचित् .. 48 ..
text_mt: The king who causes a ten-million fire-offering to be performed by twice-borns as before, / his enemies never stand [against him] in battle at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya maraṇaṃ deśe na vyādhirjāyate tathā ..
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śakāḥ .. 49 ..
meaning:
न तस्य मरणं देशे न व्याधिर्जायते तथा ..
अतिवृष्टिरनावृष्टिर्मूषकाः शलभाः शकाः .. 49 ..
text_mt: In his realm, death does not occur, nor does disease arise. / Excessive rain, drought, mice, locusts, parrots,

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasāśca praśāmyanti sarvāstatra tathetayaḥ ..
rasavanti ca toyāni sasyāni svāduvanti ca .. 1.165.50 ..
meaning:
राक्षसाश्च प्रशाम्यन्ति सर्वास्तत्र तथेतयः ..
रसवन्ति च तोयानि सस्यानि स्वादुवन्ति च .. 1.165.50 ..
text_mt: and rākṣasas are appeased there, and likewise all agricultural calamities. / And the waters become savoury and the crops become sweet-tasting,

sanskrit_iast:
jāyante tasya deśe tu dharmiṣṭhaśca jano bhavet ..
koṭihome tu varayedbrāhmaṇānviṃśatīnnṛpa .. 51 ..
meaning:
जायन्ते तस्य देशे तु धर्मिष्ठश्च जनो भवेत् ..
कोटिहोमे तु वरयेद्ब्राह्मणान्विंशतीन्नृप .. 51 ..
text_mt: and they grow in his land, and the people become devoted to dharma. / For the ten-million fire-offering, one should appoint twenty brahmins, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ vātha sahasraṃ vā ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ..
koṭihomaṃ svayaṃ yastu kuryādbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ .. 52 ..
meaning:
शतं वाथ सहस्रं वा य इच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः ..
कोटिहोमं स्वयं यस्तु कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमः .. 52 ..
text_mt: or a hundred, or a thousand, whoever desires prosperity for himself. / But the foremost among brahmins who himself performs the ten-million fire-offering,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyo vāthavā vaiśyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ..
yadyadicchati kāmānāṃ tattadāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 53 ..
meaning:
क्षत्रियो वाथवा वैश्यस्तस्य पुण्यफलं महत् ..
यद्यदिच्छति कामानां तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयम् .. 53 ..
text_mt: or a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya, his reward of merit is great. / Whatever desires he wishes for, all those he obtains without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
saśarīro'pi cedgantuṃ divamicchettadāpnuyāt ..
sāvitrī paramā devī sāvitrī pāvanī param .. 54 ..
meaning:
सशरीरोऽपि चेद्गन्तुं दिवमिच्छेत्तदाप्नुयात् ..
सावित्री परमा देवी सावित्री पावनी परम् .. 54 ..
text_mt: Even if he should wish to go to heaven with his physical body, he would attain that. / Sāvitrī is the supreme goddess; Sāvitrī is the ultimate purifier;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradā devī sāvitrī kathitā tathā ..
abhicāreṣu tāṃ devīṃ viparītāṃ prayojayet ..55 ..
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदा देवी सावित्री कथिता तथा ..
अभिचारेषु तां देवीं विपरीतां प्रयोजयेत् ..55 ..
text_mt: likewise, the goddess Sāvitrī is declared to be the bestower of all desires. / In rituals of sorcery, one should employ that goddess in reverse.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryā vyāhṛtayaścātra viparītākṣarāstathā ..
viparītākṣaraṃ kāryaṃ śiraśca manujeśvara .. 56 ..
meaning:
कार्या व्याहृतयश्चात्र विपरीताक्षरास्तथा ..
विपरीताक्षरं कार्यं शिरश्च मनुजेश्वर .. 56 ..
text_mt: The sacred utterances must be made there with their syllables in reverse order; / and the [Gāyatrī-]head must be made with syllables reversed, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau śiraḥ prayoktavyaṃ praṇavānte ca yādava ..
svāhāsthāne ca phaṭkāraṃ sādhyanāmasamanvitam .. 57 ..
meaning:
आदौ शिरः प्रयोक्तव्यं प्रणवान्ते च यादव ..
स्वाहास्थाने च फट्कारं साध्यनामसमन्वितम् .. 57 ..
text_mt: The head must be employed at the beginning and at the end of the praṇava, O Yādava, / and in place of 'svāhā', the syllable 'phaṭ', joined with the name of the target.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ cintayettatra dīptānalasamaprabhām ..
ghātayantī ca śūlena keśeṣvākṛṣya vairiṇam .. 58 ..
meaning:
गायत्रीं चिन्तयेत्तत्र दीप्तानलसमप्रभाम् ..
घातयन्ती च शूलेन केशेष्वाकृष्य वैरिणम् .. 58 ..
text_mt: There one should contemplate Gāyatrī having a radiance equal to blazing fire, / striking the enemy with a trident, having dragged him by the hair,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdahantīṃ ca taṃ krodhādbhrukuṭībhīṣaṇānanām ..
uccāṭane ca tāṃ devīṃ vāyubhūtāṃ vicintayet .. 59 ..
meaning:
निर्दहन्तीं च तं क्रोधाद्भ्रुकुटीभीषणाननाम् ..
उच्चाटने च तां देवीं वायुभूतां विचिन्तयेत् .. 59 ..
text_mt: and burning him up in rage, her face terrible with knitted brows. / And in acts of expulsion, one should contemplate that goddess as wind.

sanskrit_iast:
vahamānāṃ tathā sādhyaṃ tasmāddeśātsudūrataḥ ..
abhicāre ca hotavyā rājikā viṣamiśritāḥ ..1.165.60 ..
meaning:
वहमानां तथा साध्यं तस्माद्देशात्सुदूरतः ..
अभिचारे च होतव्या राजिका विषमिश्रिताः ..1.165.60 ..
text_mt: carrying away the target far from that region. / And in destructive sorcery, mustard seeds mixed with poison should be offered into the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
svaraktamiśraṃ hotavyaṃ kaṭutailamathāpi vā ..
tatrāpi ca viṣaṃ deyaṃ homakāle ca yatnataḥ..61 ..
meaning:
स्वरक्तमिश्रं होतव्यं कटुतैलमथापि वा ..
तत्रापि च विषं देयं होमकाले च यत्नतः..61 ..
text_mt: or pungent oil mixed with one's own blood should be offered into the fire; / there too poison should be carefully added at the time of oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye jahyādyadi krodhaṃ dhruvaṃ naśyetsa eva tu ..
anāgasi na kartavyamabhicāramato budhaiḥ ..
alpāgasi na kartavyamabhicāraṃ tathaiva tu .. 62 ..
meaning:
मध्ये जह्याद्यदि क्रोधं ध्रुवं नश्येत्स एव तु ..
अनागसि न कर्तव्यमभिचारमतो बुधैः ..
अल्पागसि न कर्तव्यमभिचारं तथैव तु .. 62 ..
text_mt: If he should abandon his anger midway, he himself will surely be destroyed. / Therefore, the wise should not perform destructive sorcery against one who is guiltless; / likewise, destructive sorcery should not be performed against one whose fault is small.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāparādhaṃ balinaṃ devabrāhmaṇakaṇṭakam ..
abhicāreṇa yo hanyānna sa doṣeṇa lipyate .. 63 ..
meaning:
महापराधं बलिनं देवब्राह्मणकण्टकम् ..
अभिचारेण यो हन्यान्न स दोषेण लिप्यते .. 63 ..
text_mt: One who slays by destructive sorcery a powerful man of great transgression, / a thorn to gods and brahmins, is not stained by guilt.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmapradhāne tu nare alpāgasi tathaiva ca ..
abhicāraṃ na kurvīta bahūpāyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 64 ..
meaning:
धर्मप्रधाने तु नरे अल्पागसि तथैव च ..
अभिचारं न कुर्वीत बहूपायं विचक्षणः .. 64 ..
text_mt: Against a man who is devoted to dharma, and likewise one of small fault, / the discerning man of many expedients should not perform destructive sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
bahūnāṃ kaṇṭakaṃ yaṃ tu pāpātmānaṃ sudurmatim ..
hanyātprāptāparādhaṃ tu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ labhet .. 65 ..
meaning:
बहूनां कण्टकं यं तु पापात्मानं सुदुर्मतिम् ..
हन्यात्प्राप्तापराधं तु तस्य पुण्यफलं लभेत् .. 65 ..
text_mt: One who slays that wicked, extremely ill-minded man / who is a thorn to many and has incurred guilt, gains the fruit of merit.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhaktāḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam ..
na tānabhicarejjātu tatra tadviphalaṃ bhavet .. 66 ..
meaning:
ये भक्ताः पुण्डरीकाक्षं देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ..
न तानभिचरेज्जातु तत्र तद्विफलं भवेत् .. 66 ..
text_mt: Against those who are devoted to the lotus-eyed Janārdana, the god of gods, / one should never practice sorcery; there it would become futile.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi keśavabhaktānāmabhicāreṇa karhicit ..
vināśamabhipadyeta tasmāttatra samācaret .. 67 ..
meaning:
न हि केशवभक्तानामभिचारेण कर्हिचित् ..
विनाशमभिपद्येत तस्मात्तत्र समाचरेत् .. 67 ..
text_mt: For devotees of Keśava never suffer / destruction through sorcery; therefore, one should act properly in that regard.

sanskrit_iast:
seyaṃ dhātrī vidhātrī ca sāvitryaghavināśinī ..
prāṇāyāmena japyeta tathaivāntarjalena ca .. 68 ..
meaning:
सेयं धात्री विधात्री च सावित्र्यघविनाशिनी ..
प्राणायामेन जप्येत तथैवान्तर्जलेन च .. 68 ..
text_mt: She is the supporter and the ordainer, the Sāvitrī who destroys sins; / she should be recited with breath control, and likewise while submerged in water.

sanskrit_iast:
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavā japtavyā śirasā saha ..
praṇavena tathā'bhyastā vācyā vyāhṛtayaḥ pṛthak .. 69 ..
meaning:
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवा जप्तव्या शिरसा सह ..
प्रणवेन तथाऽभ्यस्ता वाच्या व्याहृतयः पृथक् .. 69 ..
text_mt: She should be recited with the vyāhṛtis and the praṇava, together with the head mantra; / and the vyāhṛtis, preceded by the praṇava, should be pronounced separately.

sanskrit_iast:
daivataṃ savitā tvasyā gāyatraṃ chanda eva ca ..
viśvāmitra ṛṣiścaiva procyate vasudhādhipa .. 1.165.70 ..
meaning:
दैवतं सविता त्वस्या गायत्रं छन्द एव च ..
विश्वामित्र ऋषिश्चैव प्रोच्यते वसुधाधिप .. 1.165.70 ..
text_mt: Her deity is Savitṛ, her metre is the gāyatrī, / and Viśvāmitra is proclaimed her seer, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca buddhīndriyāṇi ca ..
pañcendriyārthānmahatāṃ bhūtānāṃ caiva pañcakam .. 71 ..
meaning:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि पञ्चैव पञ्च बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि च ..
पञ्चेन्द्रियार्थान्महतां भूतानां चैव पञ्चकम् .. 71 ..
text_mt: The five organs of action and the five cognitive senses, / the five objects of the senses and the group of five great elements,

sanskrit_iast:
mano buddhistathaivātmā avyaktaṃ ca yadūttama ..
caturviṃśatyathaitāni gāyatryā akṣarāṇi tu .. 72 ..
meaning:
मनो बुद्धिस्तथैवात्मा अव्यक्तं च यदूत्तम ..
चतुर्विंशत्यथैतानि गायत्र्या अक्षराणि तु .. 72 ..
text_mt: mind, intellect, and the self, as well as the unmanifest, O best of Yadus— / these are the twenty-four syllables of the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaṃ puruṣaṃ viddhi sarvagaṃ pañcaviṃśakam ..
saptalokāni yānīha mahāvyāhṛtayastathā .. 73 ..
meaning:
प्रणवं पुरुषं विद्धि सर्वगं पञ्चविंशकम् ..
सप्तलोकानि यानीह महाव्याहृतयस्तथा .. 73 ..
text_mt: Know the praṇava to be the Cosmic Person, all-pervading, the twenty-fifth principle; / and the great vyāhṛtis are the seven worlds in this cosmos.

sanskrit_iast:
śirasaśca tathā vācyaḥ puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
evaṃvidhā sā sāvitrī japtavyā satataṃ budhaiḥ .. 74 ..
meaning:
शिरसश्च तथा वाच्यः पुरुषः परमेश्वरः ..
एवंविधा सा सावित्री जप्तव्या सततं बुधैः .. 74 ..
text_mt: And the Cosmic Person, the supreme Lord, is to be declared the head mantra. / Such is the Sāvitrī that should be constantly recited by the wise;

sanskrit_iast:
hotavyā ca tathā śaktyā sarvakāmasamṛddhidā ..
gāyatrīmātraśaraṇo varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ .. 75 ..
meaning:
होतव्या च तथा शक्त्या सर्वकामसमृद्धिदा ..
गायत्रीमात्रशरणो वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः .. 75 ..
text_mt: and she should be offered into the fire according to one's capacity, bestowing the fulfillment of all desires. / A restrained brahmin whose only refuge is the Gāyatrī is preferable

sanskrit_iast:
nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī ..
gāyatrīṃ japate yastu kalyamutthāya vai dvijaḥ .. 76 ..
meaning:
नायन्त्रितश्चतुर्वेदी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी ..
गायत्रीं जपते यस्तु कल्यमुत्थाय वै द्विजः .. 76 ..
text_mt: to an unrestrained master of the four Vedas who eats everything and sells everything. / A twice-born man who, having arisen at dawn, recites the Gāyatrī,

sanskrit_iast:
lipyate na sa pāpebhyaḥ padmapatramivāmbhasā ..
kāmakāmo labhetkāmaṃ gatikāmastu sadgatim ..
akāmastadavāpnoti yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 77 ..
meaning:
लिप्यते न स पापेभ्यः पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ..
कामकामो लभेत्कामं गतिकामस्तु सद्गतिम् ..
अकामस्तदवाप्नोति यद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 77 ..
text_mt: is not stained by sins, like a lotus leaf by water. / One desiring desires obtains his desire, one desiring a state of being obtains a good state; / one devoid of desire attains that which is the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhāvā varadā pavitrā gāyatryathoktā tava rājasiṃha ..
japanti ye tāṃ paramaṃ prayānti sthānaṃ parasyā'pratimasya puṃsaḥ .. 78 ..
meaning:
एवं प्रभावा वरदा पवित्रा गायत्र्यथोक्ता तव राजसिंह ..
जपन्ति ये तां परमं प्रयान्ति स्थानं परस्याऽप्रतिमस्य पुंसः .. 78 ..
text_mt: Thus the boon-granting, purifying Gāyatrī of such power has been described to you, O lion among kings; / those who recite her go to the supreme abode of the highest, incomparable Cosmic Person.

sanskrit_iast:
.. vajra uvāca ..
mahāvartipradānasya yatphalaṃ bhṛgunandana ..
tanmamācakṣva tattvena vidhiṃ kālaṃ tathaiva ca .. 1 ..
meaning:
.. वज्र उवाच ..
महावर्तिप्रदानस्य यत्फलं भृगुनन्दन ..
तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन विधिं कालं तथैव च .. 1 ..
text_mt: Vajra said: / The fruit of offering a great lamp-wick, O son of Bhṛgu— / tell me that accurately, as well as the procedure and the proper time.
title: adhyāyaḥ 166

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mahāvartiḥ sadā deyā bhūmipāla mahāphalā ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
महावर्तिः सदा देया भूमिपाल महाफला ..
कृष्णपक्षे विशेषेण तत्रापि च विशेषतः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / A great lamp-wick bringing great fruit should always be offered, O protector of the earth, / especially during the dark fortnight, and even there most especially

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyā ca nirdiṣṭā dvādaśī ca mahāphalā ..
āśvayujyāmatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya yā bhavet .. 3 ..
meaning:
अमावास्या च निर्दिष्टा द्वादशी च महाफला ..
आश्वयुज्यामतीतायां कृष्णपक्षस्य या भवेत् .. 3 ..
text_mt: the new moon day is designated, and the twelfth day brings great fruit. / When the month of Āśvina has passed, the new moon day

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyā tadā puṇyā dvādaśī vā viśeṣataḥ ..
devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve deyā tailatulā nṛpa .. 4 ..
meaning:
अमावस्या तदा पुण्या द्वादशी वा विशेषतः ..
देवस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे देया तैलतुला नृप .. 4 ..
text_mt: or the twelfth day of the dark fortnight that occurs then is particularly auspicious. / On the right side of the deity, O king, a balance-weight of oil should be given;

sanskrit_iast:
palāṣṭakayutāṃ rājanvartiṃ tatra tu dāpayet ..
mahārajanaraktena samagreṇa tu vāsasā .. 5 ..
meaning:
पलाष्टकयुतां राजन्वर्तिं तत्र तु दापयेत् ..
महारजनरक्तेन समग्रेण तु वाससा .. 5 ..
text_mt: a wick measuring eight palas should be placed there, O king, / made of an entire cloth dyed red with safflower.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapārśve ca devasya deyā ghṛtatulā nṛpa ..
palāṣṭakayutāṃ śuklāṃ vartiṃ tatra tu dāpayet .. 6 ..
meaning:
वामपार्श्वे च देवस्य देया घृततुला नृप ..
पलाष्टकयुतां शुक्लां वर्तिं तत्र तु दापयेत् .. 6 ..
text_mt: And on the left side of the deity, O king, a balance-weight of ghee should be given; / a white wick measuring eight palas should be placed there,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsasā tu samagreṇa sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
mahāvartidvayamidaṃ sakṛddattvā mahīpate .. 7 ..
meaning:
वाससा तु समग्रेण सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
महावर्तिद्वयमिदं सकृद्दत्त्वा महीपते .. 7 ..
text_mt: made of an entire cloth, while fasting and with senses conquered. / Having given this pair of great lamp-wicks even once, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
svarlokaṃ suciraṃ bhuktvā jāyate bhūtale yadā ..
tadā bhavati lakṣmīvānrūpasaubhāgyamāśritaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
स्वर्लोकं सुचिरं भुक्त्वा जायते भूतले यदा ..
तदा भवति लक्ष्मीवान्रूपसौभाग्यमाश्रितः .. 8 ..
text_mt: having enjoyed heaven for a very long time, when he is born on the surface of the earth, / he then becomes prosperous, endowed with beauty and good fortune;

sanskrit_iast:
rāṣṭre ca jāyate yasmindeśe ca nagare'thavā ..
kule ca rājaśārdūla tatra syāddīpavatprabhā .. 9 ..
meaning:
राष्ट्रे च जायते यस्मिन्देशे च नगरेऽथवा ..
कुले च राजशार्दूल तत्र स्याद्दीपवत्प्रभा .. 9 ..
text_mt: and in whatever realm, country, city, / or family he is born, O tiger among kings, his radiance there is like a lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
atyujjvalaśca bhavati yuddheṣu kalaheṣu ca ..
khyātiṃ yāti tathā loke sajjanānāṃ ca sadguṇaiḥ .. 1.166.10 ..
meaning:
अत्युज्ज्वलश्च भवति युद्धेषु कलहेषु च ..
ख्यातिं याति तथा लोके सज्जनानां च सद्गुणैः .. 1.166.10 ..
text_mt: He becomes intensely brilliant in battles and in disputes; / he also attains renown in the world and among good people through his noble virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāmapyatha yo dadyādabhīṣṭamanayordvayoḥ ..
mānuṣye sarvamāpnoti taduktaṃ te mayā'nagha .. 11 ..
meaning:
एकामप्यथ यो दद्यादभीष्टमनयोर्द्वयोः ..
मानुष्ये सर्वमाप्नोति तदुक्तं ते मयाऽनघ .. 11 ..
text_mt: Moreover, whoever should give even one of these two that is desired / obtains everything in human life; that has been told to you by me, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
svarge tathārdhamāpnoti bhāgaṃ kālaṃ ca yādava ..
sāmānyasya tu dīpasya rājandāne mahatphalam .. 12 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गे तथार्धमाप्नोति भागं कालं च यादव ..
सामान्यस्य तु दीपस्य राजन्दाने महत्फलम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Likewise in heaven he obtains half the share and the time, O Yādava. / From the gift of an ordinary lamp, O king, there is great fruit;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punarmahato yasya phalasyānto na vidyate ..
dīpadānaṃ paraṃ puṇyamanyadeveṣvapi dhruvam .. 13 ..
meaning:
किं पुनर्महतो यस्य फलस्यान्तो न विद्यते ..
दीपदानं परं पुण्यमन्यदेवेष्वपि ध्रुवम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: how much more from a great one, whose fruit knows no end! / The gift of a lamp to other deities is surely supreme merit;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punardeva devasya tvanantasya mahātmanaḥ ..
giriśṛṅgeṣu dātavyā nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca .. 14 ..
meaning:
किं पुनर्देव देवस्य त्वनन्तस्य महात्मनः ..
गिरिशृङ्गेषु दातव्या नदीनां पुलिनेषु च .. 14 ..
text_mt: how much more to the god of gods, the infinite, the great-souled! / Lamps should be given on mountain peaks and on sandbanks of rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛheṣu ca ..
vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca .. 15 ..
meaning:
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु ब्राह्मणानां गृहेषु च ..
वृक्षमूलेषु गोष्ठेषु कान्तारगहनेषु च .. 15 ..
text_mt: at crossroads, on highways, and in the houses of brahmins, / at the roots of trees, in cowpens, and in thick forests.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadānena sarvatra mahatphalamupāśnute ..
yāvantyakṣinimeṣāṇi dīpaḥ prajvālito nṛpa .. 16 ..
meaning:
दीपदानेन सर्वत्र महत्फलमुपाश्नुते ..
यावन्त्यक्षिनिमेषाणि दीपः प्रज्वालितो नृप .. 16 ..
text_mt: Through the gift of a lamp everywhere, one obtains great fruit. / For as many blinks of the eye as a lamp burns brightly, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvantyeva sa rājendra varṣāṇi divi modate ..
dīpadānena rājendra cakṣuṣmāniha jāyate .. 17 ..
meaning:
तावन्त्येव स राजेन्द्र वर्षाणि दिवि मोदते ..
दीपदानेन राजेन्द्र चक्षुष्मानिह जायते .. 17 ..
text_mt: for just so many years does he rejoice in heaven, O best of kings. / Through the gift of a lamp, O best of kings, one is born here with keen sight,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpasaubhāgyayuktāśca dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ ..
dīpamālāṃ prayacchanti ye narāḥ śārṅgiṇo gṛhe .. 18 ..
meaning:
रूपसौभाग्ययुक्ताश्च धनधान्यसमन्विताः ..
दीपमालां प्रयच्छन्ति ये नराः शार्ङ्गिणो गृहे .. 18 ..
text_mt: endowed with beauty and good fortune, and possessed of wealth and grain. / Those men who offer a row of lamps in the house of the bow-wielder,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti te candrasamāḥ svargamāsādya mānavāḥ ..
dīpāgāraṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kūṭāgāranibhaṃ śubham .. 19 ..
meaning:
भवन्ति ते चन्द्रसमाः स्वर्गमासाद्य मानवाः ..
दीपागारं नरः कृत्वा कूटागारनिभं शुभम् .. 19 ..
text_mt: those mortals, having reached heaven, become like the moon. / A man having made an auspicious house of lamps resembling a gabled pavilion

sanskrit_iast:
keśavālayamāsādya nāke bhāti sa śakravat ..
yathojjvalaḥ sadā dīpo dīpadātāpi yādava .. 1.166.20 ..
meaning:
केशवालयमासाद्य नाके भाति स शक्रवत् ..
यथोज्ज्वलः सदा दीपो दीपदातापि यादव .. 1.166.20 ..
text_mt: in the abode of Keśava, shines in heaven like Śakra. / Just as a lamp is always radiant, so too the giver of a lamp, O Yādava,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā nityojjvalo loke nākabhraṣṭo'bhi jāyate ..
samīpe tu yathā loke cakṣūṃṣi phalavanti hi .. 21 ..
meaning:
तथा नित्योज्ज्वलो लोके नाकभ्रष्टोऽभि जायते ..
समीपे तु यथा लोके चक्षूंषि फलवन्ति हि .. 21 ..
text_mt: falls from heaven and is born into the world always radiant. / For just as eyes are indeed fruitful when near [a lamp] in the world,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dīpasya dātāro bhavanti saphalekṣaṇāḥ ..
yathaivordhvagatirnityaṃ rājandīpaśikhā śubhā .. 22 ..
meaning:
तथा दीपस्य दातारो भवन्ति सफलेक्षणाः ..
यथैवोर्ध्वगतिर्नित्यं राजन्दीपशिखा शुभा .. 22 ..
text_mt: so the givers of a lamp become ones whose vision is fruitful. / Just as the auspicious flame of a lamp always moves upward, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadātustathaivordhvagatirbhavati śobhanā ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīpā deyā nareśvara.. 23 ..
meaning:
दीपदातुस्तथैवोर्ध्वगतिर्भवति शोभना ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दीपा देया नरेश्वर.. 23 ..
text_mt: so the upward journey of the giver of a lamp becomes splendid. / Therefore, with every effort, lamps should be given, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvayujyāmatītāyāṃ yāvadrājendra kārtikī ..
tāvaddīpapradasyoktaṃ phalaṃ rājanviśeṣataḥ ..24..
meaning:
आश्वयुज्यामतीतायां यावद्राजेन्द्र कार्तिकी ..
तावद्दीपप्रदस्योक्तं फलं राजन्विशेषतः ..24..
text_mt: From the passing of the full moon of Āśvina until the full moon of Kārttika, O king of kings, / the reward for the giver of a lamp is described as especially great, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatkālaṃ prayacchanti ye tu dīpaṃ sadā niśi ..
tuṃge deśe mahatteṣāṃ bahiḥ puṇyaphalaṃ bhavet .. ..25..
meaning:
तावत्कालं प्रयच्छन्ति ये तु दीपं सदा निशि ..
तुंगे देशे महत्तेषां बहिः पुण्यफलं भवेत् .. ..25..
text_mt: Those who constantly offer a lamp at night for that duration of time / on an elevated place outside, great shall be the fruit of their merit.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāndhakāre gahane prākāśyaṃ tena jāyate.
prākāśye yaduśārdūla tena yānti hi tatsukham ..26..
meaning:
यस्यान्धकारे गहने प्राकाश्यं तेन जायते.
प्राकाश्ये यदुशार्दूल तेन यान्ति हि तत्सुखम् ..26..
text_mt: By him who causes brightness in deep darkness, / because of that brightness, O tiger among the Yadus, they attain that very joy.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇe dīpakaṃ dattvā nadīdvitayasaṃgame ..
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca rūpavānabhijāyate .. 27 ..
meaning:
श्रवणे दीपकं दत्त्वा नदीद्वितयसंगमे ..
तेजस्वी च यशस्वी च रूपवानभिजायते .. 27 ..
text_mt: By giving a lamp under the constellation Śravaṇa at the confluence of two rivers, / one is born radiant, renowned, and handsome.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpā nadīṣu dātavyāḥ kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣasya yā tu pañcadaśī bhavet .. 28 ..
meaning:
दीपा नदीषु दातव्याः कार्तिक्यां च विशेषतः ..
आश्वयुक्कृष्णपक्षस्य या तु पञ्चदशी भवेत् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Lamps should be offered on rivers, and especially on the full moon of Kārttika; / and on what is the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight of Āśvina,

sanskrit_iast:
bilvadvāreṣu dātavyāstathā dīpā yathāvidhi ..
anyatrāpi tadā dīpairmahatpuṇyaphalaṃ labhet .. 29 ..
meaning:
बिल्वद्वारेषु दातव्यास्तथा दीपा यथाविधि ..
अन्यत्रापि तदा दीपैर्महत्पुण्यफलं लभेत् .. 29 ..
text_mt: lamps should also be offered according to rule at the entrances of bilva trees. / Elsewhere too, by means of lamps at that time, one obtains a great reward of merit.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge kṛṣṇapakṣe tathaiva ca ..
ghṛtena dīpā dātavyāstilairvā yadunandana .. 1.166.30 ..
meaning:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे कृष्णपक्षे तथैव च ..
घृतेन दीपा दातव्यास्तिलैर्वा यदुनन्दन .. 1.166.30 ..
text_mt: Likewise, upon the conjunction of the twelfth lunar day with Śravaṇa in the dark fortnight, / lamps should be offered with ghee or with sesame [oil], O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
vasāmajjādibhirdeyā na tu dīpāḥ kathañcana ..
dattvā dīpaṃ na kartavyaṃ tena karma vijānatā .. 31 ..
meaning:
वसामज्जादिभिर्देया न तु दीपाः कथञ्चन ..
दत्त्वा दीपं न कर्तव्यं तेन कर्म विजानता .. 31 ..
text_mt: Lamps must never be given with fat, marrow, and the like. / Having offered a lamp, a knowing person should not use it for secular tasks.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāpaṇaṃ ca dīpasya hiṃsanaṃ ca vigarhitam ..
yaḥ kuryāttena karmāṇi syādasau puṣpitekṣaṇaḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
निर्वापणं च दीपस्य हिंसनं च विगर्हितम् ..
यः कुर्यात्तेन कर्माणि स्यादसौ पुष्पितेक्षणः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Extinguishing a lamp and harming it is censured; / whoever performs [other] tasks with it will have clouded vision.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpahartā bhavedandhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet ..
dīpadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati .. 33 ..
meaning:
दीपहर्ता भवेदन्धः काणो निर्वापको भवेत् ..
दीपदानात्परं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति .. 33 ..
text_mt: A thief of a lamp will become blind; one who extinguishes it will become one-eyed. / There has been no gift higher than the gift of a lamp, nor will there ever be.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpadānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vipraveśmasu paṇḍitaiḥ..
dvijaveśmani yo dadyātkārtike māsi dīpakam .. 34 ..
meaning:
दीपदानं तु कर्तव्यं विप्रवेश्मसु पण्डितैः..
द्विजवेश्मनि यो दद्यात्कार्तिके मासि दीपकम् .. 34 ..
text_mt: The gift of a lamp should be made by wise men in the houses of brahmins. / Whoever offers a lamp in the dwelling of a twice-born in the month of Kārttika,

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ..
prāṇijāṃ nīlaraktāṃ ca dīpe vartiṃ vivarjayet.. 35 ..
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमफलं तस्य प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ..
प्राणिजां नीलरक्तां च दीपे वर्तिं विवर्जयेत्.. 35 ..
text_mt: the wise declare for him the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / One should avoid in a lamp a wick derived from animals or one that is blue or red.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣeṇa pradātavyā padmasūtrabhavā nṛpa ..
padmasūtrodbhavāṃ vartiṃ gandhatailena dīpake .. 36 ..
meaning:
विशेषेण प्रदातव्या पद्मसूत्रभवा नृप ..
पद्मसूत्रोद्भवां वर्तिं गन्धतैलेन दीपके .. 36 ..
text_mt: Especially, O king, a wick made from lotus fibres should be offered. / Offering in a lamp a wick made from lotus fibres with scented oil,

sanskrit_iast:
virogaḥ subhagaścaiva dattvā bhavati mānavaḥ ..
dātavyaṃ devadevasya karpūreṇa ca dīpakam..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet..37..
meaning:
विरोगः सुभगश्चैव दत्त्वा भवति मानवः ..
दातव्यं देवदेवस्य कर्पूरेण च दीपकम्..
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्..37..
text_mt: a man becomes free from illness and fortunate. / A lamp made with camphor should be offered to the God of gods; / one attains [the merit of] a horse sacrifice and uplifts his family.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmayoktaṃ tava dīpadāne phalaṃ samagraṃ yaduvaṃśacandra ..
śrutvā yathāvatsatataṃ tu deyā dīpāstvayā viprasurālayeṣu .. 38 ..
meaning:
एतन्मयोक्तं तव दीपदाने फलं समग्रं यदुवंशचन्द्र ..
श्रुत्वा यथावत्सततं तु देया दीपास्त्वया विप्रसुरालयेषु .. 38 ..
text_mt: This complete fruit regarding the gift of a lamp has been spoken by me to you, O moon of the Yadu lineage; / having heard it properly, lamps should constantly be offered by you in the dwellings of brahmins and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
dīpadānāllalitikā yadavāpa purā nṛpa .. 1 ..
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ..
दीपदानाल्ललितिका यदवाप पुरा नृप .. 1 ..
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Here they also cite this ancient story / of what Lalitikā obtained in former times through the gift of a lamp, O king.
title: Lalitikopākhyānam

sanskrit_iast:
āsīccitraratho nāma vidarbheṣu mahīpatiḥ ..
tasya putraśataṃ rājño jajñe pañcadaśottaram .. 2 ..
meaning:
आसीच्चित्ररथो नाम विदर्भेषु महीपतिः ..
तस्य पुत्रशतं राज्ञो जज्ञे पञ्चदशोत्तरम् .. 2 ..
text_mt: There was an earth-ruler named Citraratha among the Vidarbhas; / to that king were born one hundred and fifteen sons.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaiva kanyā tasyāsīllalitā nāma nāmataḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi .. 3 ..
meaning:
एकैव कन्या तस्यासील्ललिता नाम नामतः ..
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णा रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि .. 3 ..
text_mt: He had only one daughter, Lalitā by name, / endowed with all auspicious marks, peerless in beauty on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dadau kāśirājāya sa pitā cārudharmiṇe ..
śatāni tasya bhāryāṇāṃ trīṇyāsaṃścātra dharmiṇaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
तां ददौ काशिराजाय स पिता चारुधर्मिणे ..
शतानि तस्य भार्याणां त्रीण्यासंश्चात्र धर्मिणः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Her father gave her to the king of Kāśi, Cārudharmin; / three hundred wives belonged to that righteous one.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ madhye'gramahiṣī lalitāsya tadā'bhavat ..
viṣṇorāyatane tasyāḥ sahasaṃ rājasattama .. 5 ..
meaning:
तासां मध्येऽग्रमहिषी ललितास्य तदाऽभवत् ..
विष्णोरायतने तस्याः सहसं राजसत्तम .. 5 ..
text_mt: Among them, Lalitā then became his chief queen. / In the temple of Viṣṇu, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
pradīpānāṃ prajvalati divārātramarindama ..
tāmisramāśvayukpakṣaṃ śuklapakṣaṃ ca kārtikāt .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रदीपानां प्रज्वलति दिवारात्रमरिन्दम ..
तामिस्रमाश्वयुक्पक्षं शुक्लपक्षं च कार्तिकात् .. 6 ..
text_mt: a thousand lamps of hers burned day and night, O subduer of foes, / from the dark fortnight of Āśvina and the bright fortnight of Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ prajvalitaṃ dīpamuccasthānakṛtaṃ tathā ..
tasminkāle tathā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu sā ..7..
meaning:
तस्याः प्रज्वलितं दीपमुच्चस्थानकृतं तथा ..
तस्मिन्काले तथा नित्यं ब्राह्मणावसथेषु सा ..7..
text_mt: Her lamp blazed, set in a high place; / at that time, she was thus constantly [active] in the dwellings of brahmins;

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ bhavati sāyāhne dīpapreṣaṇatatparā ..
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu devatāyataneṣu ca .. 8 ..
meaning:
नित्यं भवति सायाह्ने दीपप्रेषणतत्परा ..
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु देवतायतनेषु च .. 8 ..
text_mt: every day at twilight she was intent upon sending lamps / to crossroads, streets, and temples of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
caityavṛkṣeṣu goṣṭheṣu parvatānāṃ ca mūrdhasu ..
pulineṣu nadīnāṃ ca kūpamūleṣu yādava .. 9 ..
meaning:
चैत्यवृक्षेषु गोष्ठेषु पर्वतानां च मूर्धसु ..
पुलिनेषु नदीनां च कूपमूलेषु यादव .. 9 ..
text_mt: to sacred trees, cowpens, and upon the peaks of mountains, / on the sandbanks of rivers, and at the foot of wells, O descendant of Yadu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminbhavati sākāle dīpadānaparāyaṇā ..
tāṃ sapatnyo'tha saṅgamya papracchuridamādṛtāḥ ..1.167.10..
meaning:
तस्मिन्भवति साकाले दीपदानपरायणा ..
तां सपत्न्योऽथ सङ्गम्य पप्रच्छुरिदमादृताः ..1.167.10..
text_mt: At that time she was devoted to the giving of lamps. / Then her co-wives gathered together and respectfully asked her this:

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnya ūcuḥ ..
sarvāndharmānparityajya lalite tvaṃ sadaiva tu ..
viṣṇorāyatane subhrūrdīpadānaparāyaṇā.. 11 ..
meaning:
सपत्न्य ऊचुः ..
सर्वान्धर्मान्परित्यज्य ललिते त्वं सदैव तु ..
विष्णोरायतने सुभ्रूर्दीपदानपरायणा.. 11 ..
text_mt: The co-wives said: / Abandoning all religious practices, O Lalitā, you are always, / O lovely-browed one, devoted to the gift of lamps in the temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ lalite kautukaṃ param ..
manyāmahe tvayāvaśyaṃ dīpadānaphalaṃ śrutam .. 12 ..
meaning:
तदेतत्कथयास्माकं ललिते कौतुकं परम् ..
मन्यामहे त्वयावश्यं दीपदानफलं श्रुतम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: Therefore tell us this, O Lalitā, our supreme wonder: / we think that you have surely heard the fruit of the gift of lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitikovāca ..
nāhaṃ matsariṇī bhadrā na ca rāgādidūṣitā ..
ekapatyāśrayā yātā bhavatyo mama mānadāḥ .. 13 ..
meaning:
ललितिकोवाच ..
नाहं मत्सरिणी भद्रा न च रागादिदूषिता ..
एकपत्याश्रया याता भवत्यो मम मानदाः .. 13 ..
text_mt: Lalitikā said: / I am not envious, good ladies, nor corrupted by passion and the like; / you, my respecters, have come under the protection of a single husband.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāḥ śṛṇvantu gaditaṃ mama ..
mayaitaddīpadānasya yathā vai bhujyate phalam .. 14 ..
meaning:
अपृथग्धर्मचरणाः शृण्वन्तु गदितं मम ..
मयैतद्दीपदानस्य यथा वै भुज्यते फलम् .. 14 ..
text_mt: You who observe undivided dharma, listen to what is spoken by me, / how this fruit of the gift of a lamp is indeed enjoyed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
harasya dayitā bhāryā śailarājasutā varā ..
umādevīti madreṣu devikā yā saridvarā .. ..15..
meaning:
हरस्य दयिता भार्या शैलराजसुता वरा ..
उमादेवीति मद्रेषु देविका या सरिद्वरा .. ..15..
text_mt: The beloved wife of Hara, the excellent daughter of the mountain king, / is the goddess Umā, [manifest as] the Devikā, that excellent river among the Madras,

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāmanukampārthaṃ brāhmaṇairavatāritā ..
tīrayorubhayostasyāḥ kṣetraṃ krośacatuṣṭayam .. 16 ..
meaning:
नराणामनुकम्पार्थं ब्राह्मणैरवतारिता ..
तीरयोरुभयोस्तस्याः क्षेत्रं क्रोशचतुष्टयम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: brought down by brahmins for the sake of compassion toward men. / On both of its banks, its sacred field extends for four krośas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmim̐stīrthe tu pānīyaṃ sarvatīrthaprakalpitam ..
tasmiṃstīrthe mṛtā martyāḥ prāpnuvanti śubhāṃ gatim ..17..
meaning:
तस्मिम्̐स्तीर्थे तु पानीयं सर्वतीर्थप्रकल्पितम् ..
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृता मर्त्याः प्राप्नुवन्ति शुभां गतिम् ..17..
text_mt: In that sacred ford, the water has the efficacy of all holy fords; / mortals who die in that holy ford attain an auspicious destination.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutābhilāṣitā dṛṣṭā devikā pāpanāśinī ..
tasyāṃ snātvā sakṛnmartyo gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt..18..
meaning:
श्रुताभिलाषिता दृष्टा देविका पापनाशिनी ..
तस्यां स्नात्वा सकृन्मर्त्यो गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्..18..
text_mt: Heard of, longed for, or seen, the Devikā destroys sins; / having bathed in it once, a mortal attains the status of Gaṇeśa's attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstīrthaṃ nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam..
nṛsiṃhavapuṣā snānaṃ kṛtaṃ yatra purā śubhā..19..
meaning:
तस्यास्तीर्थं नृसिंहाख्यं सर्वकल्मषनाशनम्..
नृसिंहवपुषा स्नानं कृतं यत्र पुरा शुभा..19..
text_mt: There is a holy ford on it named Nṛsiṃha, which destroys all impurities, / where of old, O auspicious ladies, bathing was performed in the form of Nṛsiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvīrarājasya purā maitreyo'bhūtpurohitaḥ..
tasmim̐stīrthe tadā tena viṣṇorāyatanaṃ kṛtam .. 1.167.20 ..
meaning:
सौवीरराजस्य पुरा मैत्रेयोऽभूत्पुरोहितः..
तस्मिम्̐स्तीर्थे तदा तेन विष्णोरायतनं कृतम् .. 1.167.20 ..
text_mt: In former times, Maitreya was the royal priest of the king of Sauvīra; / at that holy ford, he then made a temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ahanyahani śuśrūṣāṃ puṣpadhūpādilepanaiḥ ..
dīpadānādibhiścaiva cakre tatra sa vai dvijaḥ ..21..
meaning:
अहन्यहनि शुश्रूषां पुष्पधूपादिलेपनैः ..
दीपदानादिभिश्चैव चक्रे तत्र स वै द्विजः ..21..
text_mt: Day after day, with flowers, incense, ointments, and the like, / and with the offering of lamps, that twice-born indeed performed service there.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike dīpakāstatra pradattāstena caikadā ..
āsīnnirvāṇabhūyiṣṭho devārcāpurato niśi .. 22 ..
meaning:
कार्तिके दीपकास्तत्र प्रदत्तास्तेन चैकदा ..
आसीन्निर्वाणभूयिष्ठो देवार्चापुरतो निशि .. 22 ..
text_mt: Once in Kārttika, lamps were offered there by him; / at night, before the image of the god, [one lamp] was almost extinguished.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatane cāsaṃ tathāhamapi mūṣikā..
pradīpa vartiharaṇe kṛtabuddhirvarānanā ..23..
meaning:
देवतायतने चासं तथाहमपि मूषिका..
प्रदीप वर्तिहरणे कृतबुद्धिर्वरानना ..23..
text_mt: And I, O fair-faced ladies, was a mouse in that temple of the deity, / my mind resolved on stealing the wick of the lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītā ca mayā vartirvṛṣadaṃśo rurāva ca ..
naṣṭā cāhaṃ tadā tasya mārjārasya bhayāttadā .. 24 ..
meaning:
गृहीता च मया वर्तिर्वृषदंशो रुराव च ..
नष्टा चाहं तदा तस्य मार्जारस्य भयात्तदा .. 24 ..
text_mt: The wick was seized by me, and a cat cried out; / and then I fled out of fear of that cat.

sanskrit_iast:
vartiprāntena naśyantyā dīpakaḥ prerito mayā ..
jajvāla pūrvavaddīptyā tasminnāyatane punaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
वर्तिप्रान्तेन नश्यन्त्या दीपकः प्रेरितो मया ..
जज्वाल पूर्ववद्दीप्त्या तस्मिन्नायतने पुनः .. 25 ..
text_mt: As I fled with the end of the wick, the lamp was nudged by me; / in that temple it blazed again with brightness as before.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtā cāhaṃ tadā jātā vidarbharājakanyakā ..
jātismarā mahīpasya mahiṣī cārudharmiṇaḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
मृता चाहं तदा जाता विदर्भराजकन्यका ..
जातिस्मरा महीपस्य महिषी चारुधर्मिणः .. 26 ..
text_mt: And dying then, I was born as the daughter of the king of Vidarbha, / remembering past lives, the chief queen of King Cārudharmin.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya kārtike māsi śobhanāḥ ..
dattasyāyatane viṣṇoryasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā .. 27 ..
meaning:
एष प्रभावो दीपस्य कार्तिके मासि शोभनाः ..
दत्तस्यायतने विष्णोर्यस्येयं व्युष्टिरुत्तमा .. 27 ..
text_mt: Such is the power of a lamp in the month of Kārttika, O auspicious ladies, / offered in the temple of Viṣṇu, of which this is the supreme reward.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi vo nāsti mātsaryaṃ dīpo deyaḥ sadā śubhāḥ ..
asaṅkalpitamapyetatpreraṇaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mayā .. 28 ..
meaning:
यदि वो नास्ति मात्सर्यं दीपो देयः सदा शुभाः ..
असङ्कल्पितमप्येतत्प्रेरणं यत्कृतं मया .. 28 ..
text_mt: If you have no envy, a lamp should always be given, O auspicious ladies; / even this nudging [of the wick] was done by me without intention.

sanskrit_iast:
keśavālayadīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalam ..
etasmātkāraṇāddīpānahametānaharniśam .. 29 ..
meaning:
केशवालयदीपस्य तस्येदं भुज्यते फलम् ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्दीपानहमेतानहर्निशम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: This fruit is now enjoyed from that lamp in the abode of Keśava. / For this reason, day and night, I offer these lamps

sanskrit_iast:
prayacchāmi harerdhāmni jñātasya ca hi yatphalam ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
evamuktāḥ sapatnyastā dīpadānaparāyaṇāḥ .. 1.167.30 ..
meaning:

sanskrit_iast:
babhūvurdevadevasya keśavasya sadā gṛhe ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā tena rājñā mahātmanā ..
viṣṇulokamanuprāptāḥ pañcatvaṃ prāpya mānada .. 31 ..

विष्णुलोकमनुप्राप्ताः पञ्चत्वं प्राप्य मानद .. 31 ..

meaning:

रेमे महीपाल मुदा समेता दीपप्रदानाच्च्यवनाद्विमुक्ता .. 32 ..
text_mt: Having reached that world together with the king, that princess, whose beauty was like Lakṣmī's, / rejoiced with delight, O protector of the earth, freed from falling [from heaven] through the gift of lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca ..
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ hīnānāṃ draviṇena ca ..
karmaṇā kena dharmajña toṣamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ .. 1 ..
meaning:

कर्मणा केन धर्मज्ञ तोषमायाति शङ्करः .. 1 ..

यथालभ्येन राजेन्द्र यैस्तुष्यति जनार्दनः ..3..
text_mt: The moon is a universal lamp; what need is there for riches? / With whatever is available, O king of kings, Janārdana is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
phalamūlāśano'raṇye kusumairmadhusūdanam ..
sampūjya satataṃ kāmānabhīṣṭānpratipadyate .. 4 ..

text_mt: Subsisting on fruits and roots in the forest, constantly worshipping / Madhusūdana with blossoms, one obtains one's desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmastadavāpnoti yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ..
araṇyeṣu naraḥ kṛtvā devadevasya cārcanam ..5..

अकामस्तदवाप्नोति यद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ..
अरण्येषु नरः कृत्वा देवदेवस्य चार्चनम् ..5..
text_mt: Free of desire, he attains that highest step of Viṣṇu. / A man having performed the worship of the god of gods in forests,

sanskrit_iast:
atītamuddharedrājanphalena sa śataṃ nṛṇām ..
bhaviṣyāṇāṃ śataṃ caiva narāṇāṃ yadunandana .. 6 ..
meaning:
अतीतमुद्धरेद्राजन्फलेन स शतं नृणाम् ..
भविष्याणां शतं चैव नराणां यदुनन्दन .. 6 ..
text_mt: O king, would rescue a hundred past men through [that] fruit, / and indeed a hundred future men, O delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
nagare'pi vasanyastu bhaikṣyāśī saṃśitavrataḥ ..
araṇyādāhṛtaiḥ puṣpairmūlapatraphalāṅkuraiḥ..7..
meaning:
नगरेऽपि वसन्यस्तु भैक्ष्याशी संशितव्रतः ..
अरण्यादाहृतैः पुष्पैर्मूलपत्रफलाङ्कुरैः..7..
text_mt: Even living in a city, one who eats begged food, steadfast in his vows, / with flowers, roots, leaves, fruits, and shoots brought from the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
yathopapannaiḥ satatamabhyarcayati keśavam ..
sarvakāmaprado devastasya syānmadhusūdanaḥ .. 8 ..
meaning:
यथोपपन्नैः सततमभ्यर्चयति केशवम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदो देवस्तस्य स्यान्मधुसूदनः .. 8 ..
text_mt: constantly worships Keśava with whatever is available, / to him the god Madhusūdana will be the granter of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyakāmakāmasya paraṃ sthānaṃ prakīrtitam ..
yatra gatvā na śocanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padama......
svayamāhṛtya puṣpādyaibhaikṣyāśī keśavārcanam ..
kṛtaṃ yena sa rājendra vaṃśānuddharate śatam .. 1.168.10 ..
meaning:
तस्याप्यकामकामस्य परं स्थानं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम......
स्वयमाहृत्य पुष्पाद्यैभैक्ष्याशी केशवार्चनम् ..
कृतं येन स राजेन्द्र वंशानुद्धरते शतम् .. 1.168.10 ..
text_mt: For him too, free from desires, the supreme abode is proclaimed, / having gone where they do not grieve, that highest step of Viṣṇu. / By whom the worship of Keśava is performed with flowers and the like gathered by oneself, living on begged food, / he, O king of kings, rescues a hundred lineages:

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśānatītānpañcāśattāvataścāpyanāgatān ..
uddharedātmano rājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 11 ..
meaning:
वंशानतीतान्पञ्चाशत्तावतश्चाप्यनागतान् ..
उद्धरेदात्मनो राजन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 11 ..
text_mt: he would rescue fifty past lineages and as many future lineages / of his own, O king; there should be no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
(gṛhastho'pi naro rājandharmāgatadhanāgamaḥ ..

(गृहस्थोऽपि नरो राजन्धर्मागतधनागमः ..

text_mt: (Even a householder, O king, whose acquisition of wealth has come through dharma, / who would perform worship of Keśava with flowers brought from the forest,

एतदेव समाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..
धर्मार्जितधनः क्रीत्वा यः कुर्वन्केशवार्चनम् .. 13 .. )
text_mt: attains this very [fruit]; there should be no doubt about this. / One whose wealth is acquired through dharma, who buys [them] while performing worship of Keśava,

sanskrit_iast:

uddhariṣyatyasandehaṃ saptapūrvāparānnarān .. 14 ..
meaning:
स्वयमुप्तैश्च कुसुमैर्यः कुर्यात्केशवार्चनम् ..
उद्धरिष्यत्यसन्देहं सप्तपूर्वापरान्नरान् .. 14 ..
text_mt: or one who would perform worship of Keśava with blossoms sown by oneself, / will without doubt rescue seven preceding and succeeding men.

sanskrit_iast:

यथाकथञ्चिदाहृत्य कथञ्चित्पूजयेद्धरिम् ..

sanskrit_iast:

मानुष्ये च परां राजञ्छ्रियमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ..
वनादाहत्य कुसुमैः कर्तव्यं देवतार्चनम् .. 16 ..
text_mt: And in human birth, O king, he undoubtedly attains supreme prosperity. / Gathering blossoms from the forest, one should perform worship of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ dūrvāṅkuramathāpi vā ..
nivedayitvā kṛṣṇāya bhoktā nākamavāpnuyāta ..
akṣamaistūpavāsānāṃ tathā dhanavivarjitaiḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं दूर्वाङ्कुरमथापि वा ..
निवेदयित्वा कृष्णाय भोक्ता नाकमवाप्नुयात ..
अक्षमैस्तूपवासानां तथा धनविवर्जितैः .. 17 ..
text_mt: A leaf, a flower, a fruit, water, or even a blade of dūrvā grass— / having offered it to Kṛṣṇa, the enjoyer would attain heaven. / But by those incapable of fasts, and likewise destitute of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:

अरण्यादाहृतैः पुष्पैः सम्पूज्य मधुसूदनम् ..18..
text_mt: having brought blossoms from the forest, worship of the deity should be performed. / Having worshipped Madhusūdana with flowers brought from the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani samprāptaṃ rājyaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa ..
nṛgo yayātirnahuṣo viṣvagaśvaḥ karandhamaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि सम्प्राप्तं राज्यं शृणु नराधिप ..
नृगो ययातिर्नहुषो विष्वगश्वः करन्धमः .. 19 ..
text_mt: kingdom was obtained in a previous birth; hear [of them], O ruler of men: / Nṛga, Yayāti, Nahuṣa, Viṣvagaśva, Karandhama,

sanskrit_iast:

devarātaḥ kakutsthaśca vinīto vikrame raghuḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
रेवकः कालकाख्यश्च कृतवीर्यो गुणाकरः ..
देवरातः ककुत्स्थश्च विनीतो विक्रमे रघुः .. 21 ..
text_mt: Revaka, Kālakākhya, Kṛtavīrya, Guṇākara, / Devarāta, Kakutstha, and Raghu, modest in valor,
