meaning:
तिथिं च वर्जयेद्रिक्तामृक्षाणि शृणु भार्गव ..
उत्तरात्रितयं सौम्यं चाश्वत्थं शक्रदैवतम् .. 93 ..
text_mt: And one should avoid an empty lunar day; hear the lunar mansions, O Bhārgava: / the triad of Uttarās, that of Soma (Mṛgaśīrṣa), Aśvattha (Puṣya), that whose deity is Śakra (Jyeṣṭhā),

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ ca hastaṃ ca śastamāśvinadaivatam ..
varāhaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca dvijottama .. 94 ..
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं च हस्तं च शस्तमाश्विनदैवतम् ..
वराहं पूजयेद्देवं पृथिवीं च द्विजोत्तम .. 94 ..
text_mt: that belonging to Prajāpati (Rohiṇī), Hasta, and that whose deity is the Aśvins (Aśvinī) are commended. / One should worship the god Varāha and the Earth, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ sarvataḥ kṛtvā gurudevadvijanmanām ..
bhūbhāgamupalipyātha kṛtvā tatra tu maṇḍalam .. 95 ..
meaning:
पूजनं सर्वतः कृत्वा गुरुदेवद्विजन्मनाम् ..
भूभागमुपलिप्याथ कृत्वा तत्र तु मण्डलम् .. 95 ..
text_mt: Having performed worship everywhere of the gurus, gods, and twice-born, / and having smeared a patch of ground and made a maṇḍala there,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhapuṇyāhaśabdena bhūmau tamupaveśayet ..
mantraścātra bhavedrāma tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 96 ..
meaning:
शङ्खपुण्याहशब्देन भूमौ तमुपवेशयेत् ..
मन्त्रश्चात्र भवेद्राम तन्मे निगदतः शृणु .. 96 ..
text_mt: one should seat him upon the earth to the sound of conches and [proclamations of] an auspicious day. / And here there is a mantra, O Rāma; hear it from me as I speak it:

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣaṇaṃ vasudhe devi sadā sarvagataṃ śubhe ..
āyuḥpramāṇaṃ sakalaṃ nikṣepaste haripriye .. 97 ..
meaning:
रक्षणं वसुधे देवि सदा सर्वगतं शुभे ..
आयुःप्रमाणं सकलं निक्षेपस्ते हरिप्रिये .. 97 ..
text_mt: “O goddess Earth, auspicious one, protection everywhere is ever [yours]; / the full measure of life is your deposit, O beloved of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
antarādāyuṣastasya ye kecitparipanthinaḥ ..
jīvitārogyavitteṣu nirdahasvācireṇa tān .. 98 ..
meaning:
अन्तरादायुषस्तस्य ये केचित्परिपन्थिनः ..
जीवितारोग्यवित्तेषु निर्दहस्वाचिरेण तान् .. 98 ..
text_mt: Whoever are adversaries standing in the way of his life, / of his longevity, health, and wealth, burn them without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
vareṇyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ mātā tvamasi kāmadhuk ..
ajarā cāprameyā ca sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā .. 99 ..
meaning:
वरेण्याशेषभूतानां माता त्वमसि कामधुक् ..
अजरा चाप्रमेया च सर्वभूतनमस्कृता .. 99 ..
text_mt: You are the mother, the wish-fulfilling cow, the choice of all beings; / unaging and immeasurable, bowed to by all creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ pratiṣṭhā tvaṃ tvarhamasi ..
kumāraṃ pāhi mātastvaṃ bālaṃ tadanumanyatām .. 2.52.100 ..
meaning:
चराचराणां भूतानां प्रतिष्ठा त्वं त्वर्हमसि ..
कुमारं पाहि मातस्त्वं बालं तदनुमन्यताम् .. 2.52.100 ..
text_mt: you are indeed worthy to be the foundation of moving and unmoving beings. / Protect the boy, O Mother; may [she] show favor to the child!”

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmau brāhmaṇabhojanam ..
śaktyā kṛtvā tataḥ kāryaścotsavaḥ pūrvavaddvija .. 101 ..
meaning:
तस्योपवेशनं कृत्वा भूमौ ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ..
शक्त्या कृत्वा ततः कार्यश्चोत्सवः पूर्ववद्द्विज .. 101 ..
text_mt: Having seated him upon the earth, feeding of brahmins / should be done according to one's capacity, and then, O twice-born, a celebration should be held as before.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi kartavyaṃ bhaumavarjite ..
dinavāre tithiṃ riktāṃ varjanīyā tathaiva ca .. 102 ..
meaning:
षष्ठेऽन्नप्राशनं मासि कर्तव्यं भौमवर्जिते ..
दिनवारे तिथिं रिक्तां वर्जनीया तथैव च .. 102 ..
text_mt: In the sixth month, the first feeding of solid food should be performed on a day of the week / free from Mars; similarly, an empty lunar day is to be avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi tathaivātra dāruṇogrāṇi varjayet ..
sādhāraṇe tathā rāma jyeṣṭhānteṣvapi śasyate .. 103 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि तथैवात्र दारुणोग्राणि वर्जयेत् ..
साधारणे तथा राम ज्येष्ठान्तेष्वपि शस्यते .. 103 ..
text_mt: Likewise, on this occasion, harsh and fierce lunar mansions are to be avoided; / O Rāma, [those that are] common and those that end in Jyeṣṭhā are commended.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ candrārkau ca digīśvarān ..
bhuvaṃ diśaśca sampūjya hutvā vahnau tathā carum .. 104 ..
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं विष्णुं चन्द्रार्कौ च दिगीश्वरान् ..
भुवं दिशश्च सम्पूज्य हुत्वा वह्नौ तथा चरुम् .. 104 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped Brahmā, Śaṅkara, Viṣṇu, the sun and moon, the lords of the quarters, / the earth, and the directions, and having offered caru into the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam ..
devatāpuratastasya dhātryutsaṅgagatasya ca .. 105 ..
meaning:
एतेषामेव देवानां कृत्वा ब्राह्मणपूजनम् ..
देवतापुरतस्तस्य धात्र्युत्सङ्गगतस्य च .. 105 ..
text_mt: and having performed worship of brahmins for these very gods, / in front of the deity, while he rests in the lap of his nurse,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃkṛtasya dātavyaṃ vīra kāṃsye tu kāñcane ..
madhvājyakanakopetaṃ prāśayetpāyasaṃ tataḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
अलंकृतस्य दातव्यं वीर कांस्ये तु काञ्चने ..
मध्वाज्यकनकोपेतं प्राशयेत्पायसं ततः .. 106 ..
text_mt: and is adorned, [it] should be given, O hero, in a bronze or golden [vessel]; / then one should feed [him] milk-rice mixed with honey, clarified butter, and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvannapate rāma mantraścātra vidhīyate ..
kṛtaprāśaṃ tadotsaṅgāddhātrī bālaṃ tu vinyaset .. 107 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्वन्नपते राम मन्त्रश्चात्र विधीयते ..
कृतप्राशं तदोत्सङ्गाद्धात्री बालं तु विन्यसेत् .. 107 ..
text_mt: Then, O Rāma, the mantra “To the Lord of Food…” is prescribed here. / Once he has eaten, the nurse should place the child down from her lap.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgrato'tha vinyasya śilpabhaṇḍāni sarvaśaḥ ..
śastrāṇi caiva śāstrāṇi tataḥ paśyeta lakṣaṇam .. 105 ..
meaning:
देवाग्रतोऽथ विन्यस्य शिल्पभण्डानि सर्वशः ..
शस्त्राणि चैव शास्त्राणि ततः पश्येत लक्षणम् .. 105 ..
text_mt: Having placed all kinds of tools of craftsmen, / weapons, and scriptures before the deity, one should then observe the sign:

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ yaṃ spṛśedbālaḥ śilpabhāṇḍaṃ svayaṃ tathā ..
jīvikā tasya bālasya tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati .. 109 ..
meaning:
प्रथमं यं स्पृशेद्बालः शिल्पभाण्डं स्वयं तथा ..
जीविका तस्य बालस्य तेनैव तु भविष्यति .. 109 ..
text_mt: Whichever craftsman's tool the child touches first of his own accord, / by that very [profession] shall the child's livelihood be.

sanskrit_iast:
danta janmani bālānāṃ tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati ..
dantajanmani bālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu nibodha me .. 2.52.110 ..
meaning:
दन्त जन्मनि बालानां तेनैव तु भविष्यति ..
दन्तजन्मनि बालानां लक्षणं तु निबोध मे .. 2.52.110 ..
text_mt: [Such] will come to pass for children at the eruption of teeth; / learn from me the signs regarding the eruption of teeth in children:

sanskrit_iast:
upari prathamaṃ yasya jāyante ca śiśordvijāḥ ..
dantairvā saha yasya syājjanma bhārgava jāyate .. 111 ..
meaning:
उपरि प्रथमं यस्य जायन्ते च शिशोर्द्विजाः ..
दन्तैर्वा सह यस्य स्याज्जन्म भार्गव जायते .. 111 ..
text_mt: A child whose teeth appear first on top, / or one who is born with teeth, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi khādedātmānameva ca...
tatra śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ... ..112..
meaning:
मातरं पितरं वापि खादेदात्मानमेव च...
तत्र शान्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ... ..112..
text_mt: would devour his mother, his father, or even himself. / Concerning that, I shall declare the appeasement; hear it from me as I speak:

sanskrit_iast:
gajapṛṣṭhagataṃ bālaṃ nausthaṃ vā sthāpayeddvija ..
tadabhāve tu dharmajña kāñcane tu varāsane ..113..
meaning:
गजपृष्ठगतं बालं नौस्थं वा स्थापयेद्द्विज ..
तदभावे तु धर्मज्ञ काञ्चने तु वरासने ..113..
text_mt: One should place the child mounted upon an elephant's back or seated in a boat, O twice-born, / or, in the absence of that, O knower of dharma, upon an excellent golden seat.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairbījaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā ..
pañcagavye tu ratnaiśca patākābhiśca bhārgava ..114..
meaning:
सर्वौषधैः सर्वगन्धैर्बीजैः पुष्पैः फलैस्तथा ..
पञ्चगव्ये तु रत्नैश्च पताकाभिश्च भार्गव ..114..
text_mt: With all medicinal herbs, all fragrant substances, seeds, flowers, and fruits, / in the five products of the cow, with jewels and banners, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
sthālīpākena dhātāraṃ pūjayettadanantaram ..
saptāhaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam .. 115 ..
meaning:
स्थालीपाकेन धातारं पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् ..
सप्ताहं चात्र कर्तव्यं तथा ब्राह्मणभोजनम् .. 115 ..
text_mt: immediately thereafter one should worship the Creator with a cooked domestic offering. / And for seven days, the feeding of brahmins should be carried out here.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ tathā deyā ca dakṣiṇā ..
kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ gāśca bhuvaṃ cātmānameva vā .. 116 ..
meaning:
अष्टमेऽहनि विप्राणां तथा देया च दक्षिणा ..
काञ्चनं रजतं गाश्च भुवं चात्मानमेव वा .. 116 ..
text_mt: On the eighth day, a dakṣiṇā should be given to the brahmins: / gold, silver, cows, land, or even oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
dantajanmani māsānyasambhave saptamādapi ..
aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ śṛṇu snānamataḥ param ..117..
meaning:
दन्तजन्मनि मासान्यसम्भवे सप्तमादपि ..
अष्टमेऽहनि विप्राणां शृणु स्नानमतः परम् ..117..
text_mt: If the eruption of teeth occurs in another month, even from the seventh, / hear next about the bath of the brahmins on the eighth day:

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāsane niveśyainaṃ mṛdbhirmūlaiḥ phalaistathā ..
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ sarvabījaistathaiva ca ..118..
meaning:
भद्रासने निवेश्यैनं मृद्भिर्मूलैः फलैस्तथा ..
सर्वौषधैः सर्वगन्धैः सर्वबीजैस्तथैव च ..118..
text_mt: Having seated him upon an auspicious seat, with earths, roots, and fruits, / with all medicinal herbs, all fragrant substances, and likewise all seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayetpūjayeccātra vahniṃ somaṃ samīraṇam ..
pūrvataśca tathā khyātāndevadevaṃ ca keśavam ..119..
meaning:
स्नापयेत्पूजयेच्चात्र वह्निं सोमं समीरणम् ..
पूर्वतश्च तथा ख्यातान्देवदेवं च केशवम् ..119..
text_mt: one should bathe him and worship here Agni, Soma, and Vāyu, / and the [gods] mentioned before, as well as Keśava, the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmeva juhuyādghṛtamagnau yathāvidhi ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dātavyā tataḥ pūjā ca dakṣiṇā .. 2.52.120 ..
meaning:
एतेषामेव जुहुयाद्घृतमग्नौ यथाविधि ..
ब्राह्मणानां च दातव्या ततः पूजा च दक्षिणा .. 2.52.120 ..
text_mt: To these very [gods] one should offer clarified butter into the fire according to rule, / and then worship and a dakṣiṇā must be given to the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvalaṃkṛtaṃ bālaṃ cāsane tūpaveśayet ..
āsanaṃ chatramūrdhānaṃ bījaistaṃ snāpayettataḥ .. 121 ..
meaning:
ततस्त्वलंकृतं बालं चासने तूपवेशयेत् ..
आसनं छत्रमूर्धानं बीजैस्तं स्नापयेत्ततः .. 121 ..
text_mt: Then one should seat the adorned child upon a seat; / one should then bathe him with seeds over his seat, umbrella, and head.

sanskrit_iast:
susvinnairbālakānāṃ ca taiśca kāryaṃ ca pūjanam ..
pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryo brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdastathā .. 122 ..
meaning:
सुस्विन्नैर्बालकानां च तैश्च कार्यं च पूजनम् ..
पूज्याश्चाविधवा नार्यो ब्राह्मणाः सुहृदस्तथा .. 122 ..
text_mt: With [grains] well-steamed, and with those [preparations], worship of the children should be performed; / and women whose husbands are living, brahmins, and friends are to be honored.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte'tha pañcame varṣe tvaprasupte janārdane ..
pratipadāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā tathāṣṭamīm ..123..
meaning:
प्राप्तेऽथ पञ्चमे वर्षे त्वप्रसुप्ते जनार्दने ..
प्रतिपदां तथा षष्ठीं वर्जयित्वा तथाष्टमीम् ..123..
text_mt: When the fifth year has arrived, while Janārdana is not asleep, / avoiding the first, sixth, and eighth lunar days,

sanskrit_iast:
riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ caiva saurabhaumadine tathā ..
dhuvāṇi yāmyaṃ ca tathā nakṣatrāṇi vivarjayet..124..
meaning:
रिक्तां पञ्चदशीं चैव सौरभौमदिने तथा ..
धुवाणि याम्यं च तथा नक्षत्राणि विवर्जयेत्..124..
text_mt: the empty [lunar day], and the fifteenth, and likewise Saturday and Tuesday, / one should completely avoid the fixed and the southern (Bharaṇī) lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyavargaścare lagne hite tatra navāṃśake ..
trikoṇakendragāḥ saumyāḥ pāpāścopacaye śubhāḥ .. 125 ..
meaning:
सौम्यवर्गश्चरे लग्ने हिते तत्र नवांशके ..
त्रिकोणकेन्द्रगाः सौम्याः पापाश्चोपचये शुभाः .. 125 ..
text_mt: When the division of benefics is in a moveable ascendant, and the navāṃśa is auspicious there, / benefics situated in trines and angles and malefics in upacaya [houses] are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ vivarjyānāṃ muhūrtāśca vivarjayet ..
evaṃ suniścite kāle vidyārambhaṃ ca kārayet .. 126 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्राणां विवर्ज्यानां मुहूर्ताश्च विवर्जयेत् ..
एवं सुनिश्चिते काले विद्यारम्भं च कारयेत् .. 126 ..
text_mt: One should also avoid the muhūrtas of the lunar mansions that are to be avoided; / thus, at a well-determined time, one should have the commencement of education performed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā hariṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm ..
suvidyāṃ sūtrakārām̐śca svāṃ vidyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 127 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा हरिं लक्ष्मीं तथा देवीं सरस्वतीम् ..
सुविद्यां सूत्रकाराम्̐श्च स्वां विद्यां च विशेषतः .. 127 ..
text_mt: Having worshipped Hari, Lakṣmī, and the goddess Sarasvatī, / true learning, the authors of the sūtras, and especially one's own branch of learning,

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ nāmnā tu juhuyādghṛtam ..
dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ cātra pūjanam .. 128 ..
meaning:
एतेषामेव देवानां नाम्ना तु जुहुयाद्घृतम् ..
दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजेन्द्राणां कर्तव्यं चात्र पूजनम् .. 128 ..
text_mt: one should offer clarified butter in the names of these very deities; / and worship of the foremost of the twice-born should be performed here with sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātryutsaṅgādathādāya bālaṃ tu kṛtavāpanam ..
svalaṃkṛtaṃ pradātavyamutsaṅge tu tadā guroḥ .. 129 ..
meaning:
धात्र्युत्सङ्गादथादाय बालं तु कृतवापनम् ..
स्वलंकृतं प्रदातव्यमुत्सङ्गे तु तदा गुरोः .. 129 ..
text_mt: Then, having taken from the nurse's lap the child who has had his head shaved / and is well adorned, he should be placed into the lap of the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
guruścātra bhavedvidvānsnātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
pragṛhya taṃ tu nikṣepaṃ gururapyatha bhārgava .. 2.52.130 ..
meaning:
गुरुश्चात्र भवेद्विद्वान्स्नातः शुक्लाम्बरः शुचिः ..
प्रगृह्य तं तु निक्षेपं गुरुरप्यथ भार्गव .. 2.52.130 ..
text_mt: And the teacher here should be learned, bathed, wearing white garments, and pure; / and having received that deposit, the teacher too, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukhaḥ sumukhāsīno vāruṇāśāmukhaṃ śiśum ..
adhyāpayettu prathamaṃ kuryādbālo'pi vandanam .. 131 ..

2.53 / The illustrious Paraśurāma said: / O venerable one, describe the son-bestowing bath, and the son-bestowing Seventh [Tithi], / and also the son-bestowing Keśava observance.
Puṣkara said: / Having both fasted on the Kṛttikās, the patron and the family priest, / O Bhārgava, should perform the patron's bath on the Rohiṇī [nakṣatra].
He should worship five water jars adorned with white garlands and with sprouts of milky trees, / furnished with priyaṅgu and sandalwood.
He should consecrate him, seated facing east upon a heap of paddy, with those jars. / To Viṣṇu, the Moon, Varuṇa, Rohiṇī, and Prajāpati
he should offer worship with devotion and self-restraint, with perfumes, garlands, and ointments. / Incense must be offered to Prajāpati, as well as a mattress of grass;

sleeping on the ground, on the second day having bathed with water poured through a cow's horn / and having sat down in an auspicious place, [he should draw] a sacred diagram.
There he should set out an eight-petaled lotus with auspicious pigments. / In the middle of its pericarp, he should worship the Sun with red
sandalwood, with perfumes, garlands, and ointments, / with foods to chew, eat, and drink, and with incense and lamps.
Having thus performed the worship of the granter of all desires, / he should eat at night, O knower of dharma, having abandoned all other work.
Using his teeth as a mortar, having performed the observance for a year, / at the conclusion of the observance a sacrificial fee must be given to brahmins according to his capacity.
Likewise, a feeding of twice-born [men] should be performed, largely with the three sweets. / Sleeping on the ground constantly that [night], he should again become so.
This excellent son-bestowing observance has been declared to you by me, destroying sins; / this worship of the best of gods, O Rāma, is also said to remove all diseases.

2.55 / Puṣkara said: / When the full-moon day of Bhādrapada has passed, on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, / a man who is fasting, or a woman desiring a son,
having bathed in a pool, O knower of dharma, or in lotus water— / hear how one should perform the worship of Vāsudeva:
Having bathed Govinda, the teacher of the world, with a prastha of ghee, / and then with honey, one should then bathe [him] with curds;
having bathed [him] with milk, then after that as desired, / with all medicinal herbs, with perfumes, and with all seeds and fruits;
and having bathed him, one should anoint him with sandalwood, agallochum, and saffron, / with camphor, O Rāma, and with auspicious nutmegs.
Then having worshipped Janārdana with seasonal flowers, / having offered incense with agallochum, and having made an excellent food offering,
especially consisting mostly of milk products accompanied by punnāga fruits, / and having then offered an oblation of ghee with the Puruṣasūkta,

संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतमाप्नोत्यभीप्सितम् ..
पुत्रकामानवाप्नोति तथा सर्वानभीप्सितान् .. 11 ..
पुत्रीयमेतद्व्रतमुत्तमं ते मयेरितं यद्यपि धर्मनित्यम् ..
तथाप्यनेनैव समस्त कामान्कृतेन लोके पुरुषा लभन्ते .. 12 ..
text_mt:
a śūdra or a woman, having offered oblations to the teacher of the world by his name, / should give vessels of barley, and gold at the Phalguni [constellation].
For the sake of a son, one should consume auspicious fruits bearing masculine names, / and, if desiring a daughter, [fruits] bearing feminine names; then having eaten as desired,
one desiring a son obtains sons and everything desired. / One should offer sacrificial food to the god of gods and adorn the ground.
Having performed this observance for a year, one obtains the desired object; / one desiring a son obtains sons and all desired things.
Even though this excellent observance for obtaining a son has been proclaimed to you by me as constant in dharma, / nonetheless, through its performance, men in the world obtain all desires.

2.56
.. śrīparaśurāma uvāca ..

2.56
.. श्रीपरशुराम उवाच ..

तन्ममाचक्ष्व देवेश तत्र मे संशयो महान् .. 3 ..
text_mt: The venerable Paraśurāma said: / O Lord, I wish to hear the medical treatment of men. / Declare that to me, O Lord of gods; regarding that, I have great doubt.
title: Śatabhiṣāsnānavarṇanam

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca ..
rakṣanbalaṃ mahābhāga laṅghayejjvaritaṃ naram ..
saviśvaṃ lājamaṇḍaṃ tu laṃghitaṃ tattu bhojayet .. ..2..
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच ..
रक्षन्बलं महाभाग लङ्घयेज्ज्वरितं नरम् ..
सविश्वं लाजमण्डं तु लंघितं तत्तु भोजयेत् .. ..2..
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / Preserving the strength [of the patient], O fortunate one, one should make a fevered person fast; / and when he has fasted, one should feed him scum of parched grain with ginger.

sanskrit_iast:
mustaparpaṭakośīracandanoddīpyanāgaraiḥ ..
ghṛtaṃ śītaṃ payaścātra dātavyaṃ tṛṭpraśāntaye .. 3 ..
meaning:
मुस्तपर्पटकोशीरचन्दनोद्दीप्यनागरैः ..
घृतं शीतं पयश्चात्र दातव्यं तृट्प्रशान्तये .. 3 ..
text_mt: With nut grass, parpaṭaka, vetiver, sandalwood, caraway, and dry ginger, / boiled cold water and milk should be given here to quench thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍahe ca vyatikrānte tiktakaṃ pāyayedrasam ..
snehayetpākadoṣaṃ ca tatastaṃ ca virecayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
षडहे च व्यतिक्रान्ते तिक्तकं पाययेद्रसम् ..
स्नेहयेत्पाकदोषं च ततस्तं च विरेचयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt: And when six days have passed, one should make [him] drink a bitter juice; / one should apply oleation for the digestive disorder, and then purge him.

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇaṣaṣṭikanīvāraraktaśālipramodakāḥ ..
tadvidhāścaturaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ yavānāṃ vikṛtistathā .. 5 ..
meaning:
जीर्णषष्टिकनीवाररक्तशालिप्रमोदकाः ..
तद्विधाश्चतुरः श्रेष्ठाः यवानां विकृतिस्तथा .. 5 ..
text_mt: Aged ṣaṣṭika, nīvāra, red rice, and pramodaka— / four such varieties are best; and likewise dishes made from barley;

sanskrit_iast:
mudgā masūrāścaṇakāḥ kulatthāḥ samakuṇṭhakāḥ ..
āḍhakī ca phalaṃ mūle yūṣārthaṃ jvariṇāṃ hitam .. 6 ..
meaning:
मुद्गा मसूराश्चणकाः कुलत्थाः समकुण्ठकाः ..
आढकी च फलं मूले यूषार्थं ज्वरिणां हितम् .. 6 ..
text_mt: Mung beans, lentils, chickpeas, horse gram, along with makuṣṭha beans, / and pigeon peas, fruit, and roots are wholesome for the soup of fevered patients;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaśuklakavantīrkatittiraiṇakapiñjalāḥ ..
lāvādyā jāṅgalaśreṣṭhāḥ jvariṇāṃ tadvidhāśca ye .. 7 ..
meaning:
कृष्णशुक्लकवन्तीर्कतित्तिरैणकपिञ्जलाः ..
लावाद्या जाङ्गलश्रेष्ठाः ज्वरिणां तद्विधाश्च ये .. 7 ..
text_mt: Black-and-white grouse, partridges, deer, francolins, / quails and similar birds of the arid lands, and whatever is of that kind, are best for fevered patients.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭolaṃ saphalaṃ nimbaṃ karkoṭakakaṭillakam ..
śākaṃ parpaṭakaṃ cādyādamlārthe dāḍimaṃ hitam .. .. 8 ..
meaning:
पटोलं सफलं निम्बं कर्कोटककटिल्लकम् ..
शाकं पर्पटकं चाद्यादम्लार्थे दाडिमं हितम् .. .. 8 ..
text_mt: Pointed gourd, neem with fruit, karkoṭaka, bitter gourd, / greens, and parpaṭaka should be eaten; for sourness, pomegranate is wholesome.

sanskrit_iast:
ayoge vamanaṃ śastamūrddhage ca virecanam ..
raktapitte tathā pāne ṣaḍaṅgaṃ śuṇṭhivarjitam .. 9 ..
meaning:
अयोगे वमनं शस्तमूर्द्धगे च विरेचनम् ..
रक्तपित्ते तथा पाने षडङ्गं शुण्ठिवर्जितम् .. 9 ..
text_mt: In deficiency [of doshas], emesis is praised, and in upward [bleeding], purgation; / likewise in bleeding disease (raktapitta), the six-ingredient drink without dried ginger [is recommended].

sanskrit_iast:
lājā siñcati kāmaṃ tu yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ ..
masūramudgacaṇakāḥ khaṇḍitāḥ samakuṣṭhikāḥ .. 2.56.10 ..
meaning:
लाजा सिञ्चति कामं तु यवगोधूमशालयः ..
मसूरमुद्गचणकाः खण्डिताः समकुष्ठिकाः .. 2.56.10 ..
text_mt: Parched grain pours forth desire indeed; barley, wheat, rice, / split lentils, mung beans, and chickpeas, along with makuṣṭhikā beans;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyā godhūmikā bhakṣyā ghṛtakṣīropasādhitāḥ ..
sakṣaudraśarkaropetāstathā vṛṣaraso hitaḥ.. 11 ..
meaning:
हृद्या गोधूमिका भक्ष्या घृतक्षीरोपसाधिताः ..
सक्षौद्रशर्करोपेतास्तथा वृषरसो हितः.. 11 ..
text_mt: Wholesome, heart-pleasing wheat preparations prepared with ghee and milk, / accompanied by honey and sugar; likewise the juice of vāśā is beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
atīsāre purāṇānāṃ śālīnāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ hitam ..
anabhiṣyadi vā cānyadraudravatsakasaṃyutam .. 12 ..
meaning:
अतीसारे पुराणानां शालीनां भक्षणं हितम् ..
अनभिष्यदि वा चान्यद्रौद्रवत्सकसंयुतम् .. 12 ..
text_mt: In diarrhea, the eating of aged rice is wholesome, / or other non-slimy food combined with kurchi seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
mārutānāṃ jaye yatnaḥ kāryo gulmeṣu sarvathā ..
vāṭyakṣīreṇa cāśnīyādvastukaṃ ghṛtasādhitam .. 13 ..
meaning:
मारुतानां जये यत्नः कार्यो गुल्मेषु सर्वथा ..
वाट्यक्षीरेण चाश्नीयाद्वस्तुकं घृतसाधितम् .. 13 ..
text_mt: In abdominal tumors (gulma), effort should be made in every way to conquer the winds (vātas); / and one should eat bathua greens prepared with ghee along with barley broth and milk.

sanskrit_iast:
kukkuṭā barhiṇaḥ śreṣṭhāstiktā godhūmaśālayaḥ ..
hitā jaṭhariṇāṃ bhojye yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ ..14 ..
meaning:
कुक्कुटा बर्हिणः श्रेष्ठास्तिक्ता गोधूमशालयः ..
हिता जठरिणां भोज्ये यवगोधूमशालयः ..14 ..
text_mt: Cocks and peacocks are best; bitters, wheat, and rice; / for those suffering from abdominal enlargements (udara), barley, wheat, and rice are wholesome for eating;

sanskrit_iast:
mudgāḥ kulatthāḥ kaulāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ..
paṭolanimbadhānyāstu śuṣkamūlakasaindhavaiḥ .. 15 ..
meaning:
मुद्गाः कुलत्थाः कौलानि जाङ्गला मृगपक्षिणः ..
पटोलनिम्बधान्यास्तु शुष्कमूलकसैन्धवैः .. 15 ..
text_mt: Mung beans, horse gram, wild jujubes, and beasts and birds of arid lands; / pointed gourd, neem, coriander, along with dried radish and rock salt;

sanskrit_iast:
mātuluṅgarasā jātihiṅguvṛkṣāmlavetasaiḥ ..
āhāraṃ jaṭhare yuktyā yathādoṣaṃ prakalpayet.. 16 ..
meaning:
मातुलुङ्गरसा जातिहिङ्गुवृक्षाम्लवेतसैः ..
आहारं जठरे युक्त्या यथादोषं प्रकल्पयेत्.. 16 ..
text_mt: With citron juice, jasmine, asafoetida, garcinia, and cane reed, / one should carefully arrange the diet in abdominal enlargements according to the doshas.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṣṭhināṃ ca tathā śastaṃ pānārthe khadirodakam..
masūramudgau yūṣārthe bhojye jīrṇāśca śālayaḥ .. 17 ..
meaning:
कुष्ठिनां च तथा शस्तं पानार्थे खदिरोदकम्..
मसूरमुद्गौ यूषार्थे भोज्ये जीर्णाश्च शालयः .. 17 ..
text_mt: And likewise for those afflicted with skin diseases (kuṣṭha), khadira water is praised for drinking; / lentils and mung beans for soup, and aged rice for meals;

sanskrit_iast:
nimbaparpaṭakau śākau chāgalānāṃ tathā rasaḥ ..
viḍaṅgaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī kuṣṭhaṃ rodhraṃ sasarjikam.. 18 ..
meaning:
निम्बपर्पटकौ शाकौ छागलानां तथा रसः ..
विडङ्गं मरिचं शुण्ठी कुष्ठं रोध्रं ससर्जिकम्.. 18 ..
text_mt: Neem and parpaṭaka as greens, and likewise the broth of goats; / false black pepper, black pepper, dry ginger, costus, lodhra, along with natron;

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥśilaiḥ kṛto lepaḥ kuṣṭhahā mūtrapeṣitaḥ ..
apūpasaktukulmāṣavājyādyā mehināṃ hitāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
मनःशिलैः कृतो लेपः कुष्ठहा मूत्रपेषितः ..
अपूपसक्तुकुल्माषवाज्याद्या मेहिनां हिताः .. 19 ..
text_mt: An ointment made of realgar ground with urine destroys skin disease (kuṣṭha). / Cakes, roasted barley flour, boiled pulse, preparations of barley, and the like are beneficial for those suffering from urinary disease (meha);

sanskrit_iast:
yavānnavikṛtirmudgāḥ kulatthājīrṇaśālayaḥ ..
tiktarūkṣāṇi śākāni tiktāni haritāni ca .. 2.56.20 ..
meaning:
यवान्नविकृतिर्मुद्गाः कुलत्थाजीर्णशालयः ..
तिक्तरूक्षाणि शाकानि तिक्तानि हरितानि च .. 2.56.20 ..
text_mt: Barley preparations, mung beans, horse gram, aged rice, / bitter and unctuous greens, both bitter and fresh;

sanskrit_iast:
tilāni tilaśigrurvā bibhīteṅgudajāni tu ..
anabhiṣyandi yaccānyadbhojane tatpraśasyate .. 21 ...
meaning:
तिलानि तिलशिग्रुर्वा बिभीतेङ्गुदजानि तु ..
अनभिष्यन्दि यच्चान्यद्भोजने तत्प्रशस्यते .. 21 ...
text_mt: Sesame, or sesame with moringa, and products of baheda and inguda; / and whatever other food is non-obstructive is praised in eating.

sanskrit_iast:
mudgāḥ sayavagodhūmā dhānyaṃ varṣasthitaṃ ca yat ..
jāṅgālasvarasaḥ prokto bhojane rājayakṣmiṇām.. 22..
meaning:
मुद्गाः सयवगोधूमा धान्यं वर्षस्थितं च यत् ..
जाङ्गालस्वरसः प्रोक्तो भोजने राजयक्ष्मिणाम्.. 22..
text_mt: Mung beans with barley and wheat, and grain that has stood for a year, / and pure juice of wild arid-zone game is declared for the food of those with consumption (rājayakṣman);

sanskrit_iast:
kulatthamudgakālābuśuṣkamūlakajāṅgalaiḥ. ..
yūṣairvā vāṣkiraiḥ snigdhairdadhidāḍimasādhitaiḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
कुलत्थमुद्गकालाबुशुष्कमूलकजाङ्गलैः. ..
यूषैर्वा वाष्किरैः स्निग्धैर्दधिदाडिमसाधितैः .. 23 ..
text_mt: With horse gram, mung beans, bottle gourd, dried radish, and arid-zone game; / or with soups of birds, unctuous and prepared with curd and pomegranate;

sanskrit_iast:
mātuluṅgarasakṣaudradrākṣāvyoṣādisaṃskṛtaiḥ ..
yavagodhūmaśālyannairbhojayecchāvasaṃ param .. 24 ...
meaning:
मातुलुङ्गरसक्षौद्रद्राक्षाव्योषादिसंस्कृतैः ..
यवगोधूमशाल्यन्नैर्भोजयेच्छावसं परम् .. 24 ...
text_mt: Refined with citron juice, honey, grapes, the three pungents, and the like, / one should feed him meals of barley, wheat, and rice, which is superior in consumption (kṣaya).

sanskrit_iast:
daśamūlaphalārāsnākulatthairupasādhitaiḥ ..
payovyūṣarasakvāthaḥ śvāsahikkānivāraṇaḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
दशमूलफलारास्नाकुलत्थैरुपसाधितैः ..
पयोव्यूषरसक्वाथः श्वासहिक्कानिवारणः .. 25 ..
text_mt: A decoction of milk and peppery soup prepared with the ten roots, / fruits, rāsnā, and horse gram dispels dyspnea and hiccups.

sanskrit_iast:
śuṣkamūlakakaulatthamaudgajāṃgalajai rasaiḥ ..
yavagodhūmaśālyannaṃ jīrṇāśoṃ'śaṃ samācaret .. 26 ..
meaning:
शुष्कमूलककौलत्थमौद्गजांगलजै रसैः ..
यवगोधूमशाल्यन्नं जीर्णाशोंऽशं समाचरेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: With dried radish, horse gram, mung beans, and broths from arid-zone game, / one should consume a food of barley, wheat, and rice in aged piles (arśas).

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇa pakvarasaṃ śīdhumārdvīkām̐stvatha vā pibet ..
śothavānsaguḍāṃ pathyāṃ khādedvā guḍalāvanam .. .. 27 ..
meaning:
जीर्ण पक्वरसं शीधुमार्द्वीकाम्̐स्त्वथ वा पिबेत् ..
शोथवान्सगुडां पथ्यां खादेद्वा गुडलावनम् .. .. 27 ..
text_mt: Or one should drink aged fermented juice, rum, or grape wine; / one having swelling should eat chebulic myrobalan with jaggery, or jaggery with salt.

sanskrit_iast:
citraṃ vicitrakaṃ cobhau grahaṇīroganāśanau ..
purāṇayavagodhūmaśālayo jāṅgalaṃ rasam .. 28 ..
meaning:
चित्रं विचित्रकं चोभौ ग्रहणीरोगनाशनौ ..
पुराणयवगोधूमशालयो जाङ्गलं रसम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Plumbago and white plumbago both destroy malabsorption disorders (grahaṇī); / aged barley, wheat, and rice, and the broth of arid-zone game;

sanskrit_iast:
mudgāmalakakharjūramṛdvīkābadarāṇi ca ..
madhusarpiḥpayastakraṃ nimbaparpaṭakau vṛṣam .. 29 ..
meaning:
मुद्गामलकखर्जूरमृद्वीकाबदराणि च ..
मधुसर्पिःपयस्तक्रं निम्बपर्पटकौ वृषम् .. 29 ..
text_mt: Mung beans, emblic myrobalan, dates, grapes, and jujubes, / honey, clarified butter, milk, buttermilk, neem, parpaṭaka, and vāśā;

sanskrit_iast:
takravṛddhyānuśasyante satataṃ vātarogiṇām ..
hṛdrogiṇe pradātavyaṃ prayatnena virecanam ..2.56.30..
meaning:
तक्रवृद्ध्यानुशस्यन्ते सततं वातरोगिणाम् ..
हृद्रोगिणे प्रदातव्यं प्रयत्नेन विरेचनम् ..2.56.30..
text_mt: With increasing buttermilk, they are constantly praised for those suffering from vāta disorders. / To one suffering from heart disease, purgation should be given with care;

sanskrit_iast:
pippalīnāṃ prayogaśca pramṛte dharmiṇastathā ..
cakāra nāḍī śīdhūni yuktā ca śiśirāmbhasā .. 31 ..
meaning:
पिप्पलीनां प्रयोगश्च प्रमृते धर्मिणस्तथा ..
चकार नाडी शीधूनि युक्ता च शिशिराम्भसा .. 31 ..
text_mt: And the application of long pepper [is recommended] likewise when [a person] is overwhelmed. / One should prepare stalk-liquors, combined with cold water;

sanskrit_iast:
yuktasauvarcalājākṣimatha śastaṃ madātyaye ..
sakṣaudrapayasā lākṣāṃ pibeta kṣatavānnaraḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
युक्तसौवर्चलाजाक्षिमथ शस्तं मदात्यये ..
सक्षौद्रपयसा लाक्षां पिबेत क्षतवान्नरः .. 32 ..
text_mt: Soothed with sochal salt and goat's milk, [it is] praised in alcohol intoxication; / a man with chest wounds should drink lac with honey and milk.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayaṃ māṃsarasāhāro vahnisaṃrakṣaṇājjayet ..
śālayo bhojane śaktā nīvārakalamādayaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
क्षयं मांसरसाहारो वह्निसंरक्षणाज्जयेत् ..
शालयो भोजने शक्ता नीवारकलमादयः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Taking a diet of meat broth, one should conquer emaciation by protecting the digestive fire; / rices such as nīvāra, kalama, and the like are capable for food.

sanskrit_iast:
yavānnavikṛtirmāṃsaṃ śākaṃ sauvarcalaṃ sudhīḥ ..
pathyaṃ tathaiva tāsāṃ ca maṇḍaṃ takraṃ ca vāruṇī .. 34 ..
meaning:
यवान्नविकृतिर्मांसं शाकं सौवर्चलं सुधीः ..
पथ्यं तथैव तासां च मण्डं तक्रं च वारुणी .. 34 ..
text_mt: Barley preparations, meat, the wise person takes sochal greens; / that is wholesome, and likewise the scum, buttermilk, and distilled spirit for them;

sanskrit_iast:
mustābhyāsastathā lepaḥ citrakeṇa haridrayā ..
yavānnavikṛtiḥ śālirvāstukī ca suvarcalam .. 35 ..
meaning:
मुस्ताभ्यासस्तथा लेपः चित्रकेण हरिद्रया ..
यवान्नविकृतिः शालिर्वास्तुकी च सुवर्चलम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: The regular use of nut grass, likewise an ointment with plumbago and turmeric; / barley preparations, rice, bathua, and suvarcalā;

sanskrit_iast:
trapusī cārugodhūmāḥ kṣīrekṣughṛtasaṃyutāḥ ..
mūtrakṛcche ca śastāḥ syuḥ pāne maṇḍasurādayaḥ ... 36 ..
meaning:
त्रपुसी चारुगोधूमाः क्षीरेक्षुघृतसंयुताः ..
मूत्रकृच्छे च शस्ताः स्युः पाने मण्डसुरादयः ... 36 ..
text_mt: Cucumber and fine wheat, accompanied by milk, sugarcane [juice], and ghee; / and scum, beer, and the like are praised for drink in dysuria;

sanskrit_iast:
lājā saktu tathā kṣaudraṃ śālyaṃ māṃsaparūṣakam ..
vṛntākālābuśikhinaśchardighnāḥ pānakāni ca .. .. 37 ..
meaning:
लाजा सक्तु तथा क्षौद्रं शाल्यं मांसपरूषकम् ..
वृन्ताकालाबुशिखिनश्छर्दिघ्नाः पानकानि च .. .. 37 ..
text_mt: Parched grain, barley flour, and honey, rice, meat, and phalsa; / eggplant, bottle gourd, peacocks, and syrups destroy vomiting.

sanskrit_iast:
śālyannaṃ toyapayasī kevaloṣṇaśrite'pi vā ..
tṛṣṇāghnā mustaguḍayorgulikā vā mukhe dhṛtā .. 38 ..
meaning:
शाल्यन्नं तोयपयसी केवलोष्णश्रितेऽपि वा ..
तृष्णाघ्ना मुस्तगुडयोर्गुलिका वा मुखे धृता .. 38 ..
text_mt: Rice meal, water and milk, or plain hot boiled [water], / or a pill of nut grass and jaggery held in the mouth destroys thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
yavānnavikṛtiryūṣaṃ śuṣkamūlakajaṃ tathā ..
śākaṃ paṭolavetrāśramūrustambhavināśanam .. 39 ..
meaning:
यवान्नविकृतिर्यूषं शुष्कमूलकजं तथा ..
शाकं पटोलवेत्राश्रमूरुस्तम्भविनाशनम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: A dish made of barley, soup of dried radish, / greens of pointed gourd and cane-shoot destroy stiffness of the thighs (ūrustambha);

sanskrit_iast:
muktāḍhakamasūrāṇāmatīrairjāṅgalaistathā ..
sasaindhavaghṛtadrākṣāśuṇṭhyāmalakolajaiḥ .. 2.56.40 ..
meaning:
मुक्ताढकमसूराणामतीरैर्जाङ्गलैस्तथा ..
ससैन्धवघृतद्राक्षाशुण्ठ्यामलकोलजैः .. 2.56.40 ..
text_mt: With pigeon peas, lentils, and uninhibited game of arid lands, / with rock salt, ghee, grapes, dried ginger, and emblic myrobalan;

sanskrit_iast:
yūṣaiḥ purāṇagodhūmayavaśālyannamabhyaset ..
visarpaṃ sasitākṣaudramṛdvīkādāḍimodaraḥ .. 41 ..
meaning:
यूषैः पुराणगोधूमयवशाल्यन्नमभ्यसेत् ..
विसर्पं ससिताक्षौद्रमृद्वीकादाडिमोदरः .. 41 ..
text_mt: With soups, one should regularly take food of aged wheat, barley, and rice. / In erysipelas (visarpa), [food mixed] with sugar, honey, grapes, and pomegranate is wholesome;

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgādivallaghu ..
kācamācī ca vetrāgraṃ vāstukaṃ ca suvarcalā .. 42 ..
meaning:
रक्तषष्टिकगोधूमयवमुद्गादिवल्लघु ..
काचमाची च वेत्राग्रं वास्तुकं च सुवर्चला .. 42 ..
text_mt: Light [diet] such as red rice, ṣaṣṭika, wheat, barley, and mung beans, / and black nightshade, cane-shoots, bathua, and suvarcalā.

sanskrit_iast:
vātaśoṣitanāśāya toyaṃ śastaṃ sitā madhu ..
nāsāroge ca sahitaṃ ghṛtadūrvāprasādhitam .. 43 ..
meaning:
वातशोषितनाशाय तोयं शस्तं सिता मधु ..
नासारोगे च सहितं घृतदूर्वाप्रसाधितम् .. 43 ..
text_mt: Water with sugar and honey is commended for destroying [afflictions caused by] drying from wind, / and in nasal diseases, [it is applied] together with ghee prepared with dūrvā grass.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgarājarase siddhe tailaṃ dhātrīraso'pi vā ..
na syātsarvāmayeṣviṣṭaṃ mūrdhajatrūdbhaveṣvatha .. 44 ..
meaning:
भृङ्गराजरसे सिद्धे तैलं धात्रीरसोऽपि वा ..
न स्यात्सर्वामयेष्विष्टं मूर्धजत्रूद्भवेष्वथ .. 44 ..
text_mt: Oil prepared with the juice of bhṛṅgarāja or with the juice of āmalakī / is not unwholesome, [nay, it is] desired in all diseases arising in the head and above the collarbones.

sanskrit_iast:
śītatoyānvapatanaṃ tilānāṃ rāma bhakṣaṇam ..
dvijadārḍhyakaraṃ proktaṃ tathā puṣṭikaraṃ śubham .. 45 ..
meaning:
शीततोयान्वपतनं तिलानां राम भक्षणम् ..
द्विजदार्ढ्यकरं प्रोक्तं तथा पुष्टिकरं शुभम् .. 45 ..
text_mt: Pouring cold water [over oneself] and the eating of sesame seeds, O Rāma, / is said to strengthen the teeth and likewise to be auspicious and nourishing.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇḍūṣastilatailena dvijadārḍhyakaraḥ paraḥ ..
viḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ gomūtraṃ sarvatra kṛmināśanam .. 46 ..
meaning:
गण्डूषस्तिलतैलेन द्विजदार्ढ्यकरः परः ..
विडङ्गचूर्णं गोमूत्रं सर्वत्र कृमिनाशनम् .. 46 ..
text_mt: Gargling with sesame oil is supreme for strengthening the teeth. / Viḍaṅga powder with cow's urine destroys worms everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīphalānyathājyaṃ ca śirolepanamuttamam..
śirorogavināśāya snigdhaśītaṃ ca bhojanam..47..
meaning:
धात्रीफलान्यथाज्यं च शिरोलेपनमुत्तमम्..
शिरोरोगविनाशाय स्निग्धशीतं च भोजनम्..47..
text_mt: Āmalakī fruits and ghee make an excellent paste for the head. / For the destruction of head diseases, one's food should be unctuous and cooling.

sanskrit_iast:
tailaṃ vā vasti mūtraṃ vā karṇapūraṇamuttamam ..
karṇaśūlavināśāya śuddhaṃ tailaṃ niṣecayet .. 48 ..
meaning:
तैलं वा वस्ति मूत्रं वा कर्णपूरणमुत्तमम् ..
कर्णशूलविनाशाय शुद्धं तैलं निषेचयेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: Oil, or an enema, or urine is excellent for filling the ear. / To destroy earaches, one should pour in pure oil.

sanskrit_iast:
giribhṛccandanaṃ mālyaṃ mālatīkālikāstathā ..
saṃyojya yākṛtāvartiḥ kṣatacakraharītusā ..49 ..
meaning:
गिरिभृच्चन्दनं माल्यं मालतीकालिकास्तथा ..
संयोज्य याकृतावर्तिः क्षतचक्रहरीतुसा ..49 ..
text_mt: Mountain-borne sandalwood, a garland, and buds of the mālatī jasmine— / having combined these, a wick made with liver removes ocular injury.

sanskrit_iast:
vyoṣaṃ triphalayāyuktaṃ surūkaṃ ca rasāñjanam ..
sarvākṣirogaśamanaṃ tathā caiva rasāñjanam .. 2.56.50 ..
meaning:
व्योषं त्रिफलयायुक्तं सुरूकं च रसाञ्जनम् ..
सर्वाक्षिरोगशमनं तथा चैव रसाञ्जनम् .. 2.56.50 ..
text_mt: The three pungents joined with the three myrobalans, surūka, and rasāñjana— / likewise, rasāñjana soothes all eye diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
ājyabhṛṣṭaṃ śilāpiṣṭarothakāñjikasaindhavaiḥ ..
āścyotanavināśāya sarvarogāmayeṣu ca .. 51 ..
meaning:
आज्यभृष्टं शिलापिष्टरोथकाञ्जिकसैन्धवैः ..
आश्च्योतनविनाशाय सर्वरोगामयेषु च .. 51 ..
text_mt: Fried in ghee and ground on a stone with rotha, sour gruel, and rock salt, / [this is used] for the destruction of eye-drops and in all diseases and afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
giribhṛccandanairlepo bahirlepasya śasyate ..
netrāmayavighātārthaṃ triphalāṃ śīlayetsadā .. 52..
meaning:
गिरिभृच्चन्दनैर्लेपो बहिर्लेपस्य शस्यते ..
नेत्रामयविघातार्थं त्रिफलां शीलयेत्सदा .. 52..
text_mt: An external plaster of mountain-borne sandalwood is praised. / For the destruction of eye diseases, one should always use the three myrobalans.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau tu madhusarpibhyāṃ dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ ..
śatāvare rase siddhau vṛṣyau kṣīraghṛtau smṛtau..53..
meaning:
रात्रौ तु मधुसर्पिभ्यां दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः ..
शतावरे रसे सिद्धौ वृष्यौ क्षीरघृतौ स्मृतौ..53..
text_mt: At night, however, one wishing to live a long life [takes them] with honey and ghee. / Milk and ghee prepared in the juice of śatāvarī are traditionally considered aphrodisiacs.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaviṅkāni māṣāśca vṛṣau kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā ..
āyuṣyā triphalā caiva pūrvavanmadhukānvitā .. 54 ..
meaning:
कलविङ्कानि माषाश्च वृषौ क्षीरं घृतं तथा ..
आयुष्या त्रिफला चैव पूर्ववन्मधुकान्विता .. 54 ..
text_mt: Sparrows and black gram are aphrodisiacs, as are milk and ghee. / The three myrobalans promote longevity, combined with licorice as before.

sanskrit_iast:
madhukāyorajopetā valīpalitanāśinī ..
vacasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ rāma tadā bhūtavināśanam .. 55 ..
meaning:
मधुकायोरजोपेता वलीपलितनाशिनी ..
वचसिद्धं घृतं राम तदा भूतविनाशनम् .. 55 ..
text_mt: Joined with licorice and iron filings, it destroys wrinkles and gray hair. / Ghee prepared with calamus, O Rāma, then destroys evil spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe buddhipradaṃ caiva tathā sarvārthasādhakam ..
valgakalkakaṣāyeṇa siddhamabhyañjanaṃ hitam..56..
meaning:
कण्ठे बुद्धिप्रदं चैव तथा सर्वार्थसाधकम् ..
वल्गकल्ककषायेण सिद्धमभ्यञ्जनं हितम्..56..
text_mt: It grants intellect to the throat and accomplishes all aims. / An inunction prepared with the decoction and paste of valga is beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsnā sahacarairvāpi tailaṃ vātavikāriṇām ..
anabhiṣyandi yaccānyattadvraṇeṣu praśasyate .. 57 ..
meaning:
रास्ना सहचरैर्वापि तैलं वातविकारिणाम् ..
अनभिष्यन्दि यच्चान्यत्तद्व्रणेषु प्रशस्यते .. 57 ..
text_mt: Oil with rāsnā or sahacara is for those afflicted with wind disorders. / Whatever else does not cause clogging of the channels is praised for ulcers.

sanskrit_iast:
pakvasya ca tathā bhedaṃ nimbaśīlaṃ ca ropaṇe ..
tathā tasyopacāraśca balikarmārthiśeṣataḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
पक्वस्य च तथा भेदं निम्बशीलं च रोपणे ..
तथा तस्योपचारश्च बलिकर्मार्थिशेषतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: Likewise, the incision of what is ripe, and the habitual use of neem for healing; / and its treatment [should be done] especially by one seeking the ritual of oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtikā ca tathā rakṣā vraṇināṃ tu sadā hitā ..
jaṅgame viṣadaṃśe tu dātavyaṃ sthāvaraṃ viṣam .. ..59..
meaning:
सूतिका च तथा रक्षा व्रणिनां तु सदा हिता ..
जङ्गमे विषदंशे तु दातव्यं स्थावरं विषम् .. ..59..
text_mt: The protection [given to] a woman in childbed is likewise always beneficial for those with wounds. / In a bite from mobile venom, immobile poison should be administered.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvare sarpadaṣṭasya hitaṃ māṃsasya bhakṣaṇam ..
bhakṣaṇaṃ nimbapatrāṇāṃ sarpadaṣṭasya bheṣajam .. 2.56.60 ..
meaning:
स्थावरे सर्पदष्टस्य हितं मांसस्य भक्षणम् ..
भक्षणं निम्बपत्राणां सर्पदष्टस्य भेषजम् .. 2.56.60 ..
text_mt: In immobile [poison], the eating of meat is beneficial for one bitten by a snake. / The eating of neem leaves is a remedy for one bitten by a snake.

sanskrit_iast:
vandhyākārkoṭajaṃ mūlaṃ chāgamūtrābhibhāvitam ..
nasyaṃ kāñcikasaṃpiṣṭaṃ viṣavegavināśanam ..61..
meaning:
वन्ध्याकार्कोटजं मूलं छागमूत्राभिभावितम् ..
नस्यं काञ्चिकसंपिष्टं विषवेगविनाशनम् ..61..
text_mt: The root of sterile kārkoṭa infused with goat's urine, / ground with sour gruel and used as a nasal drop, destroys the onset of poison.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanāddūṣaṇaṃ chedadāhasrāvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
pūrvadaṣṭasya pāne ca hṛdayāvaraṇa ghṛtam .. ..62..
meaning:
बन्धनाद्दूषणं छेददाहस्रावाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
पूर्वदष्टस्य पाने च हृदयावरण घृतम् .. ..62..
text_mt: Vitiation through tying, incision, cautery, and bloodletting are prescribed. / For one bitten long before, drinking ghee covers the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tālanimbadalaṃ keśā jīrṇacailaṃ yavā ghṛtam ..
dhūpo vṛścikaviddhasya śikhipatraṃ ghṛtena vā..63..
meaning:
तालनिम्बदलं केशा जीर्णचैलं यवा घृतम् ..
धूपो वृश्चिकविद्धस्य शिखिपत्रं घृतेन वा..63..
text_mt: Palmyra leaves, neem leaves, hair, old cloth, barley, and ghee: / this is a fumigation for one stung by a scorpion, or peacock feathers with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
arkakṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ lepabījaṃ palāśajam..
vṛścikārttasya kṛṣṇā vā śirīṣaphalasaṃyutā .. 64 ..
meaning:
अर्कक्षीरेण संपिष्टं लेपबीजं पलाशजम्..
वृश्चिकार्त्तस्य कृष्णा वा शिरीषफलसंयुता .. 64 ..
text_mt: A paste of palāśa seeds ground with the milky sap of arka, / or long pepper joined with the fruit of śirīṣa, [is used] for one afflicted by a scorpion.

sanskrit_iast:
tilakāsphoṭayordūnaṃ girikarṇyāstilasya ca ..
śarkarāmadhusarpīṃṣi pānamākhuviṣāpaham .. ..65..
meaning:
तिलकास्फोटयोर्दूनं गिरिकर्ण्यास्तिलस्य च ..
शर्करामधुसर्पींषि पानमाखुविषापहम् .. ..65..
text_mt: Pounded tilaka and āsphoṭā, girikarṇī and sesame, / with sugar, honey, and ghee, as a drink, removes rat poison.

sanskrit_iast:
ārkakṣīraṃ tilāstailaṃ palalaṃ ca guru samam ..
pānājjayati durvāramaviṣaṃ śīghrameva ca..66..
meaning:
आर्कक्षीरं तिलास्तैलं पललं च गुरु समम् ..
पानाज्जयति दुर्वारमविषं शीघ्रमेव च..66..
text_mt: Milky sap of arka, sesame seeds, oil, and heavy ground sesame paste in equal parts / quickly conquers unstoppable poison through drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā mūlaṃ trivṛttulyaṃ taṇḍulīyasya sarpiṣā..
sarpakīṭaviṣāṇyāśu jayatyatibalānyapi .. 67 ..
meaning:
पीत्वा मूलं त्रिवृत्तुल्यं तण्डुलीयस्य सर्पिषा..
सर्पकीटविषाण्याशु जयत्यतिबलान्यपि .. 67 ..
text_mt: Having drunk the root of taṇḍulīya equal [in measure] to trivṛt with ghee, / one swiftly conquers even extremely potent snake and insect poisons.

sanskrit_iast:
candanaṃ padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ natāmbūśīrapāṭalāḥ ..
nirguṇḍīśākhiśailūṣalūtāviṣaharo'gadaḥ .. 68 ..
meaning:
चन्दनं पद्मकं कुष्ठं नताम्बूशीरपाटलाः ..
निर्गुण्डीशाखिशैलूषलूताविषहरोऽगदः .. 68 ..
text_mt: Sandalwood, padmaka, kuṣṭha, nata, ambu, uśīra, pāṭalā, / nirguṇḍī, tree-bark, and śailūṣa: this antidote removes spider poison.

sanskrit_iast:
śirovirecanaṃ śastaṃ guḍanāgarakaṃ dvija ..
nasyakarmaṇi vastau ca tathā bhṛṅge ca bhārgava .. 69 ..
meaning:
शिरोविरेचनं शस्तं गुडनागरकं द्विज ..
नस्यकर्मणि वस्तौ च तथा भृङ्गे च भार्गव .. 69 ..
text_mt: Purgation of the head with jaggery and dry ginger is praised, O twice-born, / in the procedure of nasal medication, in an enema, and in bhṛṅga, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
tailameva paraṃ vidyātsnehapāne tathā ghṛtam ..
svedanīyaḥ paro vahniḥ sitāmbhaḥstambhanaṃ param .. 2.56.70 ..
meaning:
तैलमेव परं विद्यात्स्नेहपाने तथा घृतम् ..
स्वेदनीयः परो वह्निः सिताम्भःस्तम्भनं परम् .. 2.56.70 ..
text_mt: One should know oil alone to be supreme, and likewise ghee in the drinking of unctuous substances. / Fire is the supreme sweating agent, and cold water is the supreme astringent.

sanskrit_iast:
trivṛddhi recane śreṣṭhā vamane madanaṃ tathā ..
vastirvireko vamanaṃ tailaṃ sarpistathā madhu ..71..
meaning:
त्रिवृद्धि रेचने श्रेष्ठा वमने मदनं तथा ..
वस्तिर्विरेको वमनं तैलं सर्पिस्तथा मधु ..71..
text_mt: Trivṛt is indeed best for purgation, and madana for emesis; / enema, purgation, and emesis [rely on] oil, ghee, and honey.

sanskrit_iast:
raktapitte balā rāsnā krameṇa paramauṣadham ..
śārīramānasāgraṃ tu sahajā vyādhayo matāḥ .. 72 ..
meaning:
रक्तपित्ते बला रास्ना क्रमेण परमौषधम् ..
शारीरमानसाग्रं तु सहजा व्याधयो मताः .. 72 ..
text_mt: In bleeding disorders, balā and rāsnā are, in order, the supreme medicine. / Diseases are considered innate, and foremost among bodily and mental ones.

sanskrit_iast:
śārīrajvarakuṣṭhādyāḥ krodhādyā mānasā matāḥ ..
āgantavo'bhighātotthāḥ sahajāḥ kṣuttṛṣādayaḥ .. 73 ..
meaning:
शारीरज्वरकुष्ठाद्याः क्रोधाद्या मानसा मताः ..
आगन्तवोऽभिघातोत्थाः सहजाः क्षुत्तृषादयः .. 73 ..
text_mt: Bodily [diseases] are fever, leprosy, and the like; mental ones are considered anger and the like; / exogenous ones arise from injury; innate ones are hunger, thirst, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
śārīrāgantunāśāya satataṃ sūryavāsare ..
guḍājyalavaṇopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye ..74..
meaning:
शारीरागन्तुनाशाय सततं सूर्यवासरे ..
गुडाज्यलवणोपेतं सहिरण्यं द्विजातये ..74..
text_mt: For the destruction of bodily and exogenous [diseases], constantly on Sunday / [one should give] to a twice-born jaggery, ghee, and salt, together with gold,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyācca dhūpaṃ dharmajña prīṇayecca divākaram ..
ārogyametenāpnoti kāmām̐śca manasepsitān .. 75 ..
meaning:
दद्याच्च धूपं धर्मज्ञ प्रीणयेच्च दिवाकरम् ..
आरोग्यमेतेनाप्नोति कामाम्̐श्च मनसेप्सितान् .. 75 ..
text_mt: and one should give incense, O knower of dharma, and please the Sun. / Through this, one attains health and the desires wished for in one's mind.

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ divase cāndre snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakan ..
yaḥ prayacchati viprāya so'pi rogairvimucyate .. ..76 ..
meaning:
सततं दिवसे चान्द्रे स्नानमभ्यङ्गपूर्वकन् ..
यः प्रयच्छति विप्राय सोऽपि रोगैर्विमुच्यते .. ..76 ..
text_mt: He who constantly offers a bath preceded by inunction / to a brahmin on Monday is also freed from diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaradine dattvā tailaṃ vipreṣu śaktitaḥ..
nityameva mahābhāga roganāśanamāpnuyāt .. 77 ..
meaning:
शनैश्चरदिने दत्त्वा तैलं विप्रेषु शक्तितः..
नित्यमेव महाभाग रोगनाशनमाप्नुयात् .. 77 ..
text_mt: Having given oil to brahmins on Saturday according to one's capacity, / O fortunate one, one will permanently attain the destruction of disease.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvinaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ pratyahaṃ gorasairdvijān ..
bhojayitvā mahābhāga roganāśanamāpnuyāt ..78..
meaning:
आश्विनं सकलं मासं प्रत्यहं गोरसैर्द्विजान् ..
भोजयित्वा महाभाग रोगनाशनमाप्नुयात् ..78..
text_mt: Having fed twice-born men with milk products every day for the entire month of Āśvina, / O fortunate one, one will attain the destruction of disease.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayitvā tathā liṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
ghṛtena payasā caiva sarvarogairvimucyate .. 79 ..
meaning:
स्नापयित्वा तथा लिङ्गं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
घृतेन पयसा चैव सर्वरोगैर्विमुच्यते .. 79 ..
text_mt: Likewise, having bathed the liṅga of the god of gods, the trident-bearer, / with ghee and milk, one is freed from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryāvāhayedvidvāndūrvāṃ trimadhunāplutām ..
pūtaśca brāhmaṇāśīrbhiḥ sarvarogairvimucyate .. 2.56.80 ..
meaning:
गायत्र्यावाहयेद्विद्वान्दूर्वां त्रिमधुनाप्लुताम् ..
पूतश्च ब्राह्मणाशीर्भिः सर्वरोगैर्विमुच्यते .. 2.56.80 ..
text_mt: The wise man should invoke with the Gāyatrī dūrvā grass immersed in the three sweets; / and purified by the blessings of brahmins, he is freed from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminbhe vyādhimāpnoti kṛtvā tasya balikriyām ..
bhapūjāvidhinā rāma tasmādrogādvimucyate..81..
meaning:
यस्मिन्भे व्याधिमाप्नोति कृत्वा तस्य बलिक्रियाम् ..
भपूजाविधिना राम तस्माद्रोगाद्विमुच्यते..81..
text_mt: Having performed the offering ritual for the asterism under which one contracts a disease, / in accordance with the rule for worshiping the asterisms, O Rāma, one is freed from that disease.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyamathavā snānaṃ tathārogyavivardhanam ..
ārogyadāṃ dvitīyāṃ vā pratipadvā bhṛgūttama .. 82 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यमथवा स्नानं तथारोग्यविवर्धनम् ..
आरोग्यदां द्वितीयां वा प्रतिपद्वा भृगूत्तम .. 82 ..
text_mt: Or a bath should be performed that increases health; / or on the second or first lunar day that grants health, O foremost of the Bhṛgus,

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi vratamārogyakārakam ..
mānasānāṃ nijānāṃ ca tathā caivāvipattaye ..83 ..
meaning:
कर्तव्यं वैष्णवं वापि व्रतमारोग्यकारकम् ..
मानसानां निजानां च तथा चैवाविपत्तये ..83 ..
text_mt: a Vaiṣṇava observance should also be performed which produces health, / for the non-ruin of mental and innate [faculties].

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ devadeveśaṃ vrajeta madhusūdanam ..
sarvagaṃ taṃ jagannāthamajeyaṃ puruṣottamam .. 84 ..
meaning:
शरणं देवदेवेशं व्रजेत मधुसूदनम् ..
सर्वगं तं जगन्नाथमजेयं पुरुषोत्तमम् .. 84 ..
text_mt: One should go for refuge to Madhusūdana, the lord of the gods of gods, / the all-pervading lord of the world, the invincible Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvannāmasahasreṇa vyādhīnsarvānvyapohati ..
doṣadhātumalādhāraṃ śarīraṃ prāṇināṃ dvija .. 85 ..
meaning:
स्तुवन्नामसहस्रेण व्याधीन्सर्वान्व्यपोहति ..
दोषधातुमलाधारं शरीरं प्राणिनां द्विज .. 85 ..
text_mt: Praising him with the Thousand Names, one drives away all diseases. / The body of living beings, O twice-born, is the receptacle of humors, bodily elements, and waste products.

sanskrit_iast:
vātapittakaphā doṣā dhātavaśca tathā śṛṇu ..
bhuktaṃ pakvāśayādannaṃ dvidhā yāti bhṛgūttama .. 86 ..
meaning:
वातपित्तकफा दोषा धातवश्च तथा शृणु ..
भुक्तं पक्वाशयादन्नं द्विधा याति भृगूत्तम .. 86 ..
text_mt: Wind, bile, and phlegm are the humors; and listen likewise to the bodily elements: / food that is eaten goes twofold from the organ of digestion, O foremost of the Bhṛgus.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśenaikena kiṭṭatvaṃ rasatāṃ cāpareṇa ca ..
kiṭṭabhāgo malastatra viṇmūtrasvedadūṣakaḥ .. 87 ..
meaning:
अंशेनैकेन किट्टत्वं रसतां चापरेण च ..
किट्टभागो मलस्तत्र विण्मूत्रस्वेददूषकः .. 87 ..
text_mt: By one portion it attains the state of waste, and by the other the state of chyle. / The waste portion there is the refuse that fouls feces, urine, and sweat.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsāmalaṃ dehamalaṃ tathā karṇamalaṃ ca yat ..
rasabhāge rasaṃ tatra samyakśoṇitatāṃ vrajet .. 88 ..
meaning:
नासामलं देहमलं तथा कर्णमलं च यत् ..
रसभागे रसं तत्र सम्यक्शोणिततां व्रजेत् .. 88 ..
text_mt: Nasal excretion, bodily waste, and earwax—all that [is waste]. / In the nutrient fluid portion, the nutrient fluid there properly becomes blood.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsaṃ raktantato medo medasosthnāṃ ca sambhavaḥ ..
asthno majjā tataḥ śukraṃ śukrādrāma tato rasaḥ ..89 ..
meaning:
मांसं रक्तन्ततो मेदो मेदसोस्थ्नां च सम्भवः ..
अस्थ्नो मज्जा ततः शुक्रं शुक्राद्राम ततो रसः ..89 ..
text_mt: From blood comes flesh, from that fat, and from fat arises bone; / from bone marrow, from that semen, and from semen, O Rāma, then comes nutrient fluid.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ sāramojaḥ prakīrtitam ..
deśaṃ sātmyaṃ ca yāṃ śaktiṃ kālaṃ prakṛtimeva ca ..2.56.90 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव धातूनां सारमोजः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
देशं सात्म्यं च यां शक्तिं कालं प्रकृतिमेव च ..2.56.90 ..
text_mt: Ojas is proclaimed as the essence of all the bodily elements. / Having understood the region, the suitability, the capacity, the time, and the bodily constitution,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā cikitsitaṃ kuryādbheṣajasya tathā balam ..
tithiṃ riktāṃ dineśaṃ ca tathaiva ca kujārkajau.. .. 91 ..
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा चिकित्सितं कुर्याद्भेषजस्य तथा बलम् ..
तिथिं रिक्तां दिनेशं च तथैव च कुजार्कजौ.. .. 91 ..
text_mt: as well as the strength of the medicine, one should undertake medical treatment. / [Avoiding] the empty lunar day, the [inauspicious] solar day, and Mars and Saturn,

sanskrit_iast:
dāruṇogrāṇi carkṣāṇi varjayedbheṣaje sadā ..
harigodvijacandrārkasurāgnīnpratipūjya ca.. 92 ..
meaning:
दारुणोग्राणि चर्क्षाणि वर्जयेद्भेषजे सदा ..
हरिगोद्विजचन्द्रार्कसुराग्नीन्प्रतिपूज्य च.. 92 ..
text_mt: one should always avoid cruel and fierce asterisms in administering medicine. / Having worshipped Viṣṇu, cows, the twice-born, the moon, the sun, the gods, and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā mantramimaṃ vidvānbheṣajārambhamācaret ..
brahmatryakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkanalānilāḥ .. 93 ..
meaning:
श्रुत्वा मन्त्रमिमं विद्वान्भेषजारम्भमाचरेत् ..
ब्रह्मत्र्यक्षाश्विरुद्रेन्द्रभूचन्द्रार्कनलानिलाः .. 93 ..
text_mt: and having recited this mantra, the wise one should commence the medicine: / 'May Brahmā, the Three-eyed [Śiva], the Aśvins, Rudra, Indra, the Earth, the Moon, the Sun, Fire, and Wind,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya oṣadhigrāmā bhūtasargāśca pāntu te..
rasāyanamivarṣīṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ yathā .. 94 ..
meaning:
ऋषय ओषधिग्रामा भूतसर्गाश्च पान्तु ते..
रसायनमिवर्षीणां देवानाममृतं यथा .. 94 ..
text_mt: the ṛṣis, the assemblies of medicinal plants, and the classes of beings protect you! / Just as rejuvenation therapy is for the ṛṣis, as ambrosia is for the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
svadhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamaśnute ..
vātaśleṣmātmako deśo bahuvṛkṣo bahūdakaḥ .. 95 ..
meaning:
स्वधेवोत्तमनागानां भैषज्यमिदमश्नुते ..
वातश्लेष्मात्मको देशो बहुवृक्षो बहूदकः .. 95 ..
text_mt: and as svadhā is for the noble nāgas, so may this medicine be effective [for you].' / A region characterized by wind and phlegm has many trees and much water;

sanskrit_iast:
anūpa iti vikhyāto jāṅgalastadvivarjitaḥ ..
kiṃñcidvṛkṣādhiko deśastathā sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ..96..
meaning:
अनूप इति विख्यातो जाङ्गलस्तद्विवर्जितः ..
किंञ्चिद्वृक्षाधिको देशस्तथा साधारणः स्मृतः ..96..
text_mt: it is renowned as humid marshland; the arid region is devoid of that. / A region with somewhat more trees is known as ordinary.

sanskrit_iast:
jāṅgalaḥ pittabahulo madhyaḥ sādhāraṇo mataḥ..
rūkṣaśītaścalo vātaḥ pittamuṣṇakaṭudravam .. 97 ..
meaning:
जाङ्गलः पित्तबहुलो मध्यः साधारणो मतः..
रूक्षशीतश्चलो वातः पित्तमुष्णकटुद्रवम् .. 97 ..
text_mt: The arid region has an abundance of bile; the intermediate is regarded as ordinary. / Wind is dry, cold, and mobile; bile is hot, pungent, and liquid.

sanskrit_iast:
sthirāmlasnigdhamadhuraṃ balāsaṃ ca pracakṣate ..
vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītairviparyayaḥ .. 98 ..
meaning:
स्थिराम्लस्निग्धमधुरं बलासं च प्रचक्षते ..
वृद्धिः समानैः सर्वेषां विपरीतैर्विपर्ययः .. 98 ..
text_mt: And phlegm is declared to be stable, sour, unctuous, and sweet. / The increase of all of them is caused by similar [qualities], and the reverse by opposite ones.

sanskrit_iast:
samāḥ svādvamlalavaṇāḥ śleṣmalā vāyunāśanāḥ ..
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāśca vātalāḥ śleṣmanāśanāḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
समाः स्वाद्वम्ललवणाः श्लेष्मला वायुनाशनाः ..
कटुतिक्तकषायाश्च वातलाः श्लेष्मनाशनाः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Even, sweet, sour, and salty [tastes] increase phlegm and destroy wind. / Pungent, bitter, and astringent [tastes] increase wind and destroy phlegm.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭvamlalavaṇā jñeyāstathā pittavivardhanāḥ ..
tiktāḥ svādukaṣāyāśca tathā pittavināśanāḥ .. 2.56.100 ..
meaning:
कट्वम्ललवणा ज्ञेयास्तथा पित्तविवर्धनाः ..
तिक्ताः स्वादुकषायाश्च तथा पित्तविनाशनाः .. 2.56.100 ..
text_mt: Pungent, sour, and salty [tastes] are to be known as aggravating bile; / bitter, sweet, and astringent [tastes] are likewise pacifiers of bile.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvatastathā karma te ca kurvanti bhārgava ..
śiśire ca vasante ca nidāghe ca tathā kramāt .. 101 ..
meaning:
स्वभावतस्तथा कर्म ते च कुर्वन्ति भार्गव ..
शिशिरे च वसन्ते च निदाघे च तथा क्रमात् .. 101 ..
text_mt: And they perform their action according to their inherent nature, O Bhārgava. / In the cool season, in spring, and in summer, respectively,

sanskrit_iast:
cayaprakopapraśamāstathā pittasya kīrtitāḥ ..
nidāghe vāridā rātre tathā śaradi bhārgava .. 102 ..
meaning:
चयप्रकोपप्रशमास्तथा पित्तस्य कीर्तिताः ..
निदाघे वारिदा रात्रे तथा शरदि भार्गव .. 102 ..
text_mt: the accumulation, aggravation, and pacification of bile are proclaimed. / In summer, during the rainy nights, and in autumn, O Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
cayaprakopapraśamāstathā vātasya kīrtitāḥ ..
cayaprakopapraśamāḥ śleṣmaṇaśca prakīrtitāḥ .. 103 ..
meaning:
चयप्रकोपप्रशमास्तथा वातस्य कीर्तिताः ..
चयप्रकोपप्रशमाः श्लेष्मणश्च प्रकीर्तिताः .. 103 ..
text_mt: the accumulation, aggravation, and pacification of wind are proclaimed. / [Likewise,] the accumulation, aggravation, and pacification of phlegm are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaro dvādaśāṅgo māsabhedena kīrtitaḥ ..
dvidhā tu matabhedena bhūya eva prakīrtitaḥ .. 104 ..
meaning:
संवत्सरो द्वादशाङ्गो मासभेदेन कीर्तितः ..
द्विधा तु मतभेदेन भूय एव प्रकीर्तितः .. 104 ..
text_mt: The year is proclaimed to have twelve limbs according to the division of months; / but it is further proclaimed as twofold according to a division of doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
ādānaśca visargaśca tatrāpi parikīrtitau ..
varṣādayo visargāśca hemantādyāḥ smṛtāstrayaḥ .. 105 ..
meaning:
आदानश्च विसर्गश्च तत्रापि परिकीर्तितौ ..
वर्षादयो विसर्गाश्च हेमन्ताद्याः स्मृतास्त्रयः .. 105 ..
text_mt: The period of drawing [heat] and the period of releasing [moisture] are also proclaimed therein; / releasing consists of the three beginning with the rainy season, while [the three] beginning with the early winter are known [as the other].

sanskrit_iast:
meghakāle ca śaradi hemante ca yathākramāt ..
cayaprakopapraśamastathā pittasya kīrtitaḥ .. 106 ..
meaning:
मेघकाले च शरदि हेमन्ते च यथाक्रमात् ..
चयप्रकोपप्रशमस्तथा पित्तस्य कीर्तितः .. 106 ..
text_mt: In the season of clouds, in autumn, and in winter, respectively, / the accumulation, aggravation, and pacification of bile are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśirādyāstathādānaṃ grīṣmāntā ṛtavastrayaḥ ..
saumyo visargastvādānaṃ cāgneyaṃ parikīrtitam .. 107 ..
meaning:
शिशिराद्यास्तथादानं ग्रीष्मान्ता ऋतवस्त्रयः ..
सौम्यो विसर्गस्त्वादानं चाग्नेयं परिकीर्तितम् .. 107 ..
text_mt: The three seasons beginning with the cool season and ending with summer are the period of drawing; / the period of releasing is lunar, while the period of drawing is proclaimed solar.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣādīnstrīnṛtūnrāma catuḥparyāyagorasān ..
vivardhayettathā tiktakaṣāyakaṭukānkramāt .. 108 ..
meaning:
वर्षादीन्स्त्रीनृतून्राम चतुःपर्यायगोरसान् ..
विवर्धयेत्तथा तिक्तकषायकटुकान्क्रमात् .. 108 ..
text_mt: During the three seasons beginning with the rainy season, O Rāma, one should increase / milk products in four intervals, and bitter, astringent, and pungent [tastes] in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rajanyo vardhante balamevaṃ vivardhate ..
kramaśo'tha manuṣyāṇāṃ hīyamānāsu hīyate .. 109 ..
meaning:
यथा रजन्यो वर्धन्ते बलमेवं विवर्धते ..
क्रमशोऽथ मनुष्याणां हीयमानासु हीयते .. 109 ..
text_mt: Just as the nights grow longer, in the same way the strength / of men gradually increases; when they decrease, it decreases.

sanskrit_iast:
rātribhuktaṃ dinānte tu divasasya tathaiva ca ..
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu kaphapittasamīraṇāḥ .. 2.56.110 ..
meaning:
रात्रिभुक्तं दिनान्ते तु दिवसस्य तथैव च ..
आदिमध्यावसानेषु कफपित्तसमीरणाः .. 2.56.110 ..
text_mt: What is eaten at night and at the end of day; likewise, of the day / at the beginning, middle, and end, phlegm, bile, and wind [respectively]

sanskrit_iast:
prakopaṃ yānti kopādau kāle yeṣāṃ cayaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
prakopāntaraje kāle śamasteṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ .. 111 ..
meaning:
प्रकोपं यान्ति कोपादौ काले येषां चयः स्मृतः ..
प्रकोपान्तरजे काले शमस्तेषां प्रकीर्तितः .. 111 ..
text_mt: become aggravated. For those whose accumulation is known to occur at the time of aggravation, / their pacification is proclaimed at the time arising after aggravation.

sanskrit_iast:
atibhojanato rāma tathā cābhojanena ca ..
sarve'pi rogā jāyante vegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ .. 112 ..
meaning:
अतिभोजनतो राम तथा चाभोजनेन च ..

2.57
Rāma said:
Tell me, indeed, the health-bestowing rite named "[Health-]Producer", as well as the Pratipad [and] Dvitīyā [rites],
and the Vaiṣṇava vow that bestows health. (1)
Puṣkara said:
When [the moon is in] Dhaniṣṭhā, O highly fortunate one, the patron and the priest,
having fasted, should cause the Vāruṇa bath to be performed for the patron. (2)
Having prepared fully a hundred jars with water [containing] conches and pearls,
seated on an auspicious seat, bathed with them and wearing unwashed [new] garments, (3)
controlled [in mind], O Rāma, he should worship Keśava, Vāruṇa, the moon, and likewise the asterism related to Varuṇa,
with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, (4)
with incenses, lamps, and prostrations, and likewise with an abundance of food.
In the same manner, he should perform an oblation to the aforesaid deities, (5)
with all medicinal herbs and with clarified butter, according to ability and rule.
Two garments should be given to the guru, as well as a jar of fluid and gold. (6)

text_mt:
And a sacrificial fee should be given to the brahmins according to one's wealth.
With leaves born of the śamī and the śālmali, and likewise with the tip of a bamboo, (7)
a three-fold offering should be made, which destroys all diseases.
Vegetables, a fresh green garland, all kinds of grain, and two garments—
having quickly cast [them] down for Varuṇa, he should present them with perfumes and incenses. (8)
For of one who does not transgress that Vāruṇa [rite],
through the bath and the gift performed properly,
all diseases go to cessation,
and one who is bound would obtain release. (9)
2.58
Puṣkara said:
On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa,
having bathed with water from the horns of cows, becoming clad in white garments when the sun has set, (1)
having performed worship of the young moon with perfumes, garlands, and unguents,
with incenses, lamps, and prostrations, and likewise with an abundance of food, (2)
with curds, fine rice-pudding, molasses, and salt,
and through acts of worship of brahmins, having worshipped the maker of the night [the moon], (3)
he should consume food consisting predominantly of cow-milk products only as long as the moon does not set;
[then] sleeping on the ground, he should pass the night. (4)

text_mt:
Then, when a year is completed, in the month of Saumya [Mārgaśīrṣa], O best of the twice-born,
having performed worship of the young moon and worship of brahmins, (5)
having given two garments, a jar of fluid, and gold to a twice-born man,
and having worshipped him, he becomes one who has crossed to the other side of the vow. (6)
By this vow, O knower of dharma, one dispels disease in this manner;
likewise [he obtains] all happiness, wealth, and nourishment, O best of men. (7)

Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, and likewise clarified butter—

to Lord Saṃkarṣaṇa, and also to Vāsudeva— (11)

must be given as a sacrificial fee to twice-born [brahmins] in order of the days. / And at night, one should eat what consists mostly of dairy, free of oil.
And purification of the ground should be performed before the deity; / one should worship for five days with song, instrumental music, and hymns of praise.
Doing thus for a year, one dispels all diseases; / and in taking up this observance, no restriction of time is recorded.
And through its constant practice, one is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / This excellent observance has been proclaimed to you by me, O joy of the Bhṛgus.

meaning:
दारिद्र्यमरणे चोभे केषांचित्सदृशे मते ..
सत्यं हासाद्दरिद्रस्य मृतः श्रेयान्मते मम .. 16 ..
text_mt: Both poverty and death are considered equal by some; / in truth, because of the mockery of a poor man, in my opinion a dead man is better.

sanskrit_iast:
kośaṃ rājyatarormūlaṃ tasmādyatnaṃ tadarjane ..
dharmeṇaiva tataḥ kuryānnādharmeṇa kathaṃcana .. 17 ..
meaning:
कोशं राज्यतरोर्मूलं तस्माद्यत्नं तदर्जने ..
धर्मेणैव ततः कुर्यान्नाधर्मेण कथंचन .. 17 ..
text_mt: The treasury is the root of the tree of the kingdom; therefore, one should strive to acquire it; / one should do so only through dharma, never through adharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanairadharmasamprāptairyaddṛḍhaṃ hi pidhīyate ..
tadeva yāti vistāraṃ vināśāya durātmanām ..18 ..
meaning:
धनैरधर्मसम्प्राप्तैर्यद्दृढं हि पिधीयते ..
तदेव याति विस्तारं विनाशाय दुरात्मनाम् ..18 ..
text_mt: Whatever is firmly concealed by means of wealth obtained through adharma / expands precisely for the destruction of the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
sukṛtasya purāṇasya balena balināṃ vara ..
yadyadharmātphalaṃ śīghraṃ nāpnuvanti durātmanaḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
सुकृतस्य पुराणस्य बलेन बलिनां वर ..
यद्यधर्मात्फलं शीघ्रं नाप्नुवन्ति दुरात्मनः .. 19 ..
text_mt: If, by the strength of former good deeds, O best among the strong, / wicked men do not swiftly obtain the fruit of adharma,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi pūrvakarmānte tena pāpena karmaṇā ..
vinaśyanti samūlāste saputradhanabāndhavāḥ .. 2.61.20 ..
meaning:
तथापि पूर्वकर्मान्ते तेन पापेन कर्मणा ..
विनश्यन्ति समूलास्ते सपुत्रधनबान्धवाः .. 2.61.20 ..
text_mt: even so, at the end of their previous karma, through that evil action / they perish together with their roots, along with their sons, wealth, and kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
narakeṣu tathā teṣāṃ yātanā vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi ye nṛpā rāṣṭrapīḍakāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
नरकेषु तथा तेषां यातना विविधाः स्मृताः ..
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि ये नृपा राष्ट्रपीडकाः .. 21 ..
text_mt: So too, various torments in hells are recorded for them / for many thousands of years—those kings who oppress their realm.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ rājñā tathā bhāvyaṃ garbhiṇīsahadharmiṇā ..
yathā svaṃ sukhamutsṛjya garbhasya sukhamāvahet . 22 ..
meaning:
नित्यं राज्ञा तथा भाव्यं गर्भिणीसहधर्मिणा ..
यथा स्वं सुखमुत्सृज्य गर्भस्य सुखमावहेत् . 22 ..
text_mt: The king should constantly behave like a pregnant woman: / just as she, giving up her own comfort, secures the comfort of her womb,

sanskrit_iast:
garbhiṇī tadvadeveha bhāvyaṃ bhūpatinā sadā ..
prajāsukhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sukhamuddiśya cātmanaḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
गर्भिणी तद्वदेवेह भाव्यं भूपतिना सदा ..
प्रजासुखं तु कर्तव्यं सुखमुद्दिश्य चात्मनः .. 23 ..
text_mt: just so must a ruler of the earth always be here; / he must bring about the happiness of his subjects, keeping his own happiness in view.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ yajñaistapasā tasya prajā yasya surakṣitāḥ ..
surakṣitāḥ prajāstasya svargastasya gṛhopamaḥ .. .. 24 ..
meaning:
किं यज्ञैस्तपसा तस्य प्रजा यस्य सुरक्षिताः ..
सुरक्षिताः प्रजास्तस्य स्वर्गस्तस्य गृहोपमः .. .. 24 ..
text_mt: What need of sacrifices or asceticism has he whose subjects are well protected? / He whose subjects are well protected has heaven like his home.

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣitāḥ prajā yasya narakaṃ tasya mandiram ..
rājā ṣaḍbhāgamādatte sukṛtādduṣkṛtādapi .. 25 ..
meaning:
अरक्षिताः प्रजा यस्य नरकं तस्य मन्दिरम् ..
राजा षड्भागमादत्ते सुकृताद्दुष्कृतादपि .. 25 ..
text_mt: He whose subjects are unprotected has hell as his abode; / a king takes a sixth share from good deeds and from bad deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmo nāma mahābhāga sampadrakṣaṇa tatparaḥ ..
arakṣitastathā sarvaṃ pāpamāpnoti bhārgava .. 26 ..
meaning:
धर्मो नाम महाभाग सम्पद्रक्षण तत्परः ..
अरक्षितस्तथा सर्वं पापमाप्नोति भार्गव .. 26 ..
text_mt: Dharma, O fortunate one, is intent on the protection of prosperity; / when it is unprotected, O Bhārgava, he incurs all the sin.

sanskrit_iast:
naiva kiñcidavāpnoti puṇyabhākpṛthivīpatiḥ ..
āpannamapi dharmiṣṭhaṃ prajā rakṣatyathāpadi. . 27 ..
meaning:
नैव किञ्चिदवाप्नोति पुण्यभाक्पृथिवीपतिः ..
आपन्नमपि धर्मिष्ठं प्रजा रक्षत्यथापदि. . 27 ..
text_mt: A lord of the earth who takes a share of merit receives nothing at all [of it]; / the righteous [king] who has fallen into misfortune, however, protects his subjects in misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddharmārthakāmena prajā rakṣyā mahīkṣitā ..
subhagaiścātha durvṛttarājavallabhataskaraiḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्धर्मार्थकामेन प्रजा रक्ष्या महीक्षिता ..
सुभगैश्चाथ दुर्वृत्तराजवल्लभतस्करैः .. 28 ..
text_mt: Therefore, desiring dharma and wealth, subjects must be protected by a ruler of the earth / from favorites, and from wicked royal favorites and thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyamāṇāḥ prajā rakṣyā kāyasthaiśca viśeṣataḥ ..
rakṣitāstadbhayebhyastu prajā rājñāṃ bhavanti tāḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
भक्ष्यमाणाः प्रजा रक्ष्या कायस्थैश्च विशेषतः ..
रक्षितास्तद्भयेभ्यस्तु प्रजा राज्ञां भवन्ति ताः .. 29 ..
text_mt: Subjects being devoured must be protected, especially from scribes; / protected from those fears, they become the subjects of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
arakṣitā sā bhavati teṣāmeveha bhojanam ..
sādhusaṃrakṣaṇārthāya rājā duṣṭa nibarhaṇam .. 2.61.30 ..
meaning:
अरक्षिता सा भवति तेषामेवेह भोजनम् ..
साधुसंरक्षणार्थाय राजा दुष्ट निबर्हणम् .. 2.61.30 ..
text_mt: Unprotected, they become the very food of those [oppressors] here; / for the sake of protecting the virtuous, the king should always bring about the destruction of the wicked,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇānāmiva nirmātā sadā kuryājjitendriyaḥ ..
śāstroktaṃ balimādadyāddharmaṃ tattasya jīvitam .. 31 ..
meaning:
तृणानामिव निर्माता सदा कुर्याज्जितेन्द्रियः ..
शास्त्रोक्तं बलिमादद्याद्धर्मं तत्तस्य जीवितम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: like a weeder of grasses, having his senses subdued; / he should take the tribute prescribed by the treatises: that dharma is his livelihood.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya santyajanaṃ rājā na samṛddhopi kārayet ..
ākārāṇi ca sarvāṇi śulkaṃ śāstrodito baliḥ .. 32 ..
meaning:
तस्य सन्त्यजनं राजा न समृद्धोपि कारयेत् ..
आकाराणि च सर्वाणि शुल्कं शास्त्रोदितो बलिः .. 32 ..
text_mt: The king, even if prosperous, should not abandon that; / and all mines, custom duties, and the tribute prescribed by the treatises,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍaṃ vinayanādrājño dharmyaṃ tattasya jīvitam ..
dhartā karāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhurukto mahīpatiḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
दण्डं विनयनाद्राज्ञो धर्म्यं तत्तस्य जीवितम् ..
धर्ता कराणां सर्वेषां प्रभुरुक्तो महीपतिः .. 33 ..
text_mt: and the fine derived from the king's administration of justice—that is his lawful livelihood; / the lord of the earth is declared to be the master and bearer of all taxes.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhiṃ purāṇaṃ saṃprāpya keśavaṃ tu praveśayet ..
arthaṃ brāhmaṇasātkuryāddharmakāmo mahīpatiḥ .. .. 34 ..
meaning:
निधिं पुराणं संप्राप्य केशवं तु प्रवेशयेत् ..
अर्थं ब्राह्मणसात्कुर्याद्धर्मकामो महीपतिः .. .. 34 ..
text_mt: Having found an ancient treasure, he should offer it to Keśava; / the lord of the earth who desires dharma should hand over the wealth to the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhiṃ dvijottamaḥ prāpya gṛhṇīyātsakalaṃ tathā ..
jagatosya samagrasya prabhurukto dvijottamaḥ .. 35..
meaning:
निधिं द्विजोत्तमः प्राप्य गृह्णीयात्सकलं तथा ..
जगतोस्य समग्रस्य प्रभुरुक्तो द्विजोत्तमः .. 35..
text_mt: An eminent twice-born, having found a treasure, may take it entirely; / for an eminent twice-born is declared to be the master of this entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhiṃ jñātvā purāṇaṃ tu kṣatraviṭśūdrayonayaḥ ..
nivedayeyurbhūpāya rājā labdhvāpi taṃ nidhim .. 36 ..
meaning:
निधिं ज्ञात्वा पुराणं तु क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनयः ..
निवेदयेयुर्भूपाय राजा लब्ध्वापि तं निधिम् .. 36 ..
text_mt: Those born of kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra wombs, having discovered an ancient treasure, / should report it to the king; and the king, having obtained that treasure,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthamaṣṭamaṃ cāṃśaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśamaṃ dvija ..
varṇakrameṇa visṛjedākhyātaṃ dharma kāraṇam .. 37 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थमष्टमं चांशं तथा षोडशमं द्विज ..
वर्णक्रमेण विसृजेदाख्यातं धर्म कारणम् .. 37 ..
text_mt: should release a fourth, an eighth, and a sixteenth share, O twice-born, / in order of the social classes: this is declared as the basis of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
te'pi labdhvā tadā tena saṃvibhajya dvijottamān ..
śeṣeṇa kuryuḥ kāmārthau viditau pṛthivīpateḥ .. 38 ..
meaning:
तेऽपि लब्ध्वा तदा तेन संविभज्य द्विजोत्तमान् ..
शेषेण कुर्युः कामार्थौ विदितौ पृथिवीपतेः .. 38 ..
text_mt: They too, having obtained it then from him, having shared it with eminent twice-born, / should pursue pleasure and wealth with the remainder, with the knowledge of the ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśavibhavo loke yasya rājñaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ ..
aprakāśadhano yastu narakaṃ tasya mandiram .. 39 ..
meaning:
प्रकाशविभवो लोके यस्य राज्ञः स भूपतिः ..
अप्रकाशधनो यस्तु नरकं तस्य मन्दिरम् .. 39 ..
text_mt: He alone is a king in this world whose wealth is made manifest; / but for him whose wealth is unmanifest [or illicit], hell is his dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
mamedamiti yo brūyānnidhiṃ satyena mānavaḥ ..
tasyādadīta nṛpatirbhāgamabrāhmaṇasya tu .. 2.61.40 ..
meaning:
ममेदमिति यो ब्रूयान्निधिं सत्येन मानवः ..
तस्याददीत नृपतिर्भागमब्राह्मणस्य तु .. 2.61.40 ..
text_mt: If a man should truthfully say of a treasure, "This is mine," / the king should take a share from him, provided he is not a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatikaṃ rāma dvādaśaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva ca ..
kṣatriyāśca tathā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca bhṛgunandana .. 41 ..
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिकं राम द्वादशं षष्ठमेव च ..
क्षत्रियाश्च तथा वैश्याः शूद्राश्च भृगुनन्दन .. 41 ..
text_mt: A twenty-fourth part, O Rāma, a twelfth part, and a sixth part / from kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, O son of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
anṛtaṃ ca vadandaṇḍyaḥ svavittasyāṃśamaṣṭakam ..
praṇaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ rājā tryabdaṃ nidhāpayet .. 42 ..
meaning:
अनृतं च वदन्दण्ड्यः स्ववित्तस्यांशमष्टकम् ..
प्रणष्टस्वामिकं रिक्थं राजा त्र्यब्दं निधापयेत् .. 42 ..
text_mt: And if he speaks an untruth, he should be fined an eighth part of his own wealth. / The king should cause ownerless property to be kept deposited for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
arvāktryabdāddharetsvāmī pareṇa nṛpatirharet ..
mamedamiti yo brūyādanuyukto yathāvidhi .. 43 ..
meaning:
अर्वाक्त्र्यब्दाद्धरेत्स्वामी परेण नृपतिर्हरेत् ..
ममेदमिति यो ब्रूयादनुयुक्तो यथाविधि .. 43 ..
text_mt: Within three years the owner may take it; after that, the king may take it. / If, upon being questioned according to rule, one should say, "This is mine,"

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpādya rūpaṃ dravyādīnsvāmī taddravyamarhati ..
avedayāno naṣṭasya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca tattvataḥ .. .. 44 ..
meaning:
संपाद्य रूपं द्रव्यादीन्स्वामी तद्द्रव्यमर्हति ..
अवेदयानो नष्टस्य देशं कालं च तत्त्वतः .. .. 44 ..
text_mt: the owner is entitled to that property after establishing its form, the substance, and so on. / If he fails to state accurately the place and time of its loss,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tatsamaṃ daṇḍamarhati ..
nidhivadbhāgamādadyātpranaṣṭādhigatānnṛpaḥ ..45..
meaning:
वर्णरूपं प्रमाणं च तत्समं दण्डमर्हति ..
निधिवद्भागमादद्यात्प्रनष्टाधिगतान्नृपः ..45..
text_mt: its colour, form, and quantity, he deserves a fine equal to it. / The king should take a share from lost property that has been recovered, just as from a treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
bāladāyādikaṃ rikthaṃ tāvadrājā tu pālayet ..
yāvatsa syātsamāvṛtto yāvadvātītaśaiśavaḥ .. 46 ..
meaning:
बालदायादिकं रिक्थं तावद्राजा तु पालयेत् ..
यावत्स स्यात्समावृत्तो यावद्वातीतशैशवः .. 46 ..
text_mt: The king should protect the inheritance of a minor heir / until he has returned from his studies, or until his childhood has passed.

sanskrit_iast:
bālaputreṣu caivaṃ syādrakṣaṇaṃ niṣkulāsu ca ..
pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhavāsvāturāsu ca .. .. 47 ..
meaning:
बालपुत्रेषु चैवं स्याद्रक्षणं निष्कुलासु च ..
पतिव्रतासु च स्त्रीषु विधवास्वातुरासु च .. .. 47 ..
text_mt: There should be similar protection for women with infant sons, for those without kin, / for faithful wives, and for widows who are afflicted with illness.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvantīnāṃ tu tāsāṃ ye dhārayeyuḥ svabāndhavāḥ ..
tāñchiṣyāccauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
जीवन्तीनां तु तासां ये धारयेयुः स्वबान्धवाः ..
ताञ्छिष्याच्चौरदण्डेन धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः .. 48 ..
text_mt: If their own kinsmen should seize [their wealth] while they are still living, / a righteous king should punish them with the punishment for a thief.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ caurairapahṛtaṃ dhanam ..
tatpramāṇaṃ svakātkośāddātavyamavidhārayan .. 49 ..
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां चौरैरपहृतं धनम् ..
तत्प्रमाणं स्वकात्कोशाद्दातव्यमविधारयन् .. 49 ..
text_mt: If wealth belonging to [members of] any of the classes has been stolen by thieves, / he must, without hesitating, give [them] that amount from his own treasury.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu paścātkartavyaṃ caurānveṣaṇamañjasā ..
caurarakṣādhikāribhyo rājāpi tadavāpnuyāt .. 2.61.50 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु पश्चात्कर्तव्यं चौरान्वेषणमञ्जसा ..
चौररक्षाधिकारिभ्यो राजापि तदवाप्नुयात् .. 2.61.50 ..
text_mt: Then, afterwards, a search for the thieves should be made swiftly. / The king too may recover that [amount] from the officers in charge of guarding against thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
ahṛte ca tathā vitte hṛtamityeva vādinam ..
nirdhanaṃ pārthivaḥ kṛtvā viṣayātsvādvivāsayet .. 51 ..
meaning:
अहृते च तथा वित्ते हृतमित्येव वादिनम् ..
निर्धनं पार्थिवः कृत्वा विषयात्स्वाद्विवासयेत् .. 51 ..
text_mt: And if wealth has not been taken, but one claims, "It has been taken," / the king should make him destitute and banish him from his realm.

sanskrit_iast:
na tadrājñā pradātavyaṃ gṛhe yatparicārakaiḥ ..
pracaradbhirhṛtaṃ dravyaṃ kāryaṃ tatrānvavekṣaṇam .. 52 ..
meaning:
न तद्राज्ञा प्रदातव्यं गृहे यत्परिचारकैः ..
प्रचरद्भिर्हृतं द्रव्यं कार्यं तत्रान्ववेक्षणम् .. 52 ..
text_mt: That property which has been stolen in the house by servants / moving about should not be paid out by the king; an investigation must be made into it.

sanskrit_iast:
svarāṣṭrapaṇyādādadyādrājā viṃśatimaṃ dvija ..
śulkāṃśaṃ paradeśācca nibodha gadato mama .. 53 ..
meaning:
स्वराष्ट्रपण्यादादद्याद्राजा विंशतिमं द्विज ..
शुल्कांशं परदेशाच्च निबोध गदतो मम .. 53 ..
text_mt: The king should take a twentieth part as a portion of customs duty / from merchandise of his own realm, O twice-born, and from a foreign land—listen as I speak:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayavyayapravāsāṃśca yathāyāmaṃ dvijottama! ..
jñātvā tu kalpayettatra śulkāṃśaṃ pṛthavīpatiḥ .. 54 ..
meaning:
क्षयव्ययप्रवासांश्च यथायामं द्विजोत्तम! ..
ज्ञात्वा तु कल्पयेत्तत्र शुल्कांशं पृथवीपतिः .. 54 ..
text_mt: Having ascertained the depreciation, expenses, and travel, as well as the distance, O foremost of the twice-born, / the king should determine the portion of customs duty in that matter.

sanskrit_iast:

2.62
Puṣkara said:
Dharma, wealth, and pleasure are regarded as the supreme ends of man. / They should be pursued by the ruler of the earth through protecting them mutually.
Dharma is the root, wealth the branch, and pleasure the great fruit; / through protecting that tree of the threefold group, he becomes a partaker of the fruit.
The pursuit of pleasure, however, should always be conducted without conflict with dharma; / if the root is cut, destruction of the branch and of the fruit ensues.
For one who is devoid of the pursuit of pleasure, even dharma and wealth are fruitless. / Just as a farmer makes effort for the sake of the fruit of plants,
so one seeking pleasure makes effort; passion is the [incentive] for dharma and wealth, O twice-born. / Women, moreover, intoxicated with passion and delight in dharma, are the highest [form] of pleasure.
For their sake exist treasures of jewels and other riches, / song, sweet instrumental music, food, drink, and garlands,
