Water-pot by name: a man carrying an empty water-pot on his shoulder, tawny, the shanks of Time, two-footed, domestic, facing west, and strong in the east by day, rising by the head, fixed, cruel, male, odd, the domicile of Saturn, and his trine.
Fishes by name: two fish with each other's tail facing the mouth, fish-colored, the feet of Time, aquatic creatures of the north, strong in the western direction at twilight, rising by the back and tail, dual-natured, gentle, even, a female sign, the debilitation of Mercury—at the fifteenth degree of that very Mercury is his deep debilitation—the exaltation of Venus, and at her twenty-seventh degree is her deep exaltation, the domicile of Jupiter.
Half of every sign is a horā; there, among odd signs, the first is of the Sun and the second of the Moon; in even signs, [the first] is of the Moon and the second of the Sun. In all signs, there are three decans; these [belong to] the lords of the first, fifth, and ninth signs.
Of the signs facing east, the navāṃśakas begin with the Ram; of those facing south, they begin with the Makara; of those facing west, they begin with the Scales; of those facing north, they begin with the Crab. The very first navāṃśaka of all is vargottama. The final degrees of Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces are gaṇḍāntas.
In sign after sign, there are twelve twelfth-parts, [each assigned] by pairs [of signs].
The thirty-degree divisions [triṃśāṃśakas]: five are of Mars, then five of Saturn, then eight of Jupiter, seven of Mercury, and eight of Venus in an odd sign; but in an even sign, eight are of Venus, then seven of Mercury, then eight of Jupiter, five of Saturn, and five of Mars.
Thus the ascendant has six factors. Conjoined with or aspected by its own lord, Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus, it becomes strong.
Free from them and aspected by the rest, it would be weak in strength.
And thus a planet situated in the seventh [house] aspects a sign with full aspect.
Those situated in the fourth and eighth should be known as [aspecting] with a quarter aspect, and in the fifth and ninth with a half aspect.
And in the third and tenth with a quarter aspect; situated in the first, second, eighth, and twelfth, it does not aspect.

Situated therein, the ascendant [or] rising sign is in the middle of the house; it is a center and a trine.
"Body" is the name of the ascendant; "grain" and "family" of the second; "growth," "warrior," "brother," and "duścikya" are the names of the third; "friend's house," "hibuka," "happiness," "vehicle," and "guardian of the center" are the names of the fourth; "son," "trine," and "intellect" are designations of the fifth; "growth" and "enemy" are designations of the sixth; "wife," "jāmitra," "setting," "path," "fall," and "dyūna" are designations of the seventh; "vulnerability" and "longevity" are designations of the eighth; "dharma," "trine," "third trine," and "vulnerability" are designations of the ninth; "action," "center," "sky," "meṣūraṇa," "growth," and "apānaya" are names of the tenth; "growth," "income," "gain," and "wealth" are names of the eleventh; and "riṣpha," "dyūna," and "expenditure" are names of the twelfth.

The second from all those designated as centers is the succedent; the second from every succedent is the cadent.
The second from the sign occupied by the sun is veśi, the twelfth is vosi, and if both [are occupied], it is ubhayacarī. The second from the moon is sunaphā,
the twelfth is anaphā,
and if both [are occupied], it is durudharā, along with the lord of the ascendant. Here, the sun possesses a thousand rays; he is not very tall, has the circular girth of a banyan tree, is bilious, has bone as his essence, is dark-red, is a malefic, is male, is a kṣatriya, is the soul of Time, is a king, has an eastern gate, or is strong in the southern direction, during the northward course of the sun, and in the dark fortnight. The moon has a thousand rays; therein he has rounded limbs, is handsome, has fine eyes, is of phlegmatic and windy nature, has blood as his essence, is fair, is a malefic when waning and a benefic when full, is a female planet, is a vaiśya, is the pacifier of Time, is a king, faces northeast, and is strong in the northern direction, at night, during the northward course of the sun, and in the bright fortnight.

Mars has nine rays, is short, has reddish-brown eyes, is tawny, is bilious, has marrow as his essence, is reddish-fair, is a malefic, is a male planet, is a kṣatriya, is the courage of Time, is a commander of an army, faces south, is retrograde, and is strong in the southern direction, in the dark fortnight, and at night.
Mercury has eight rays, is of medium form, has standard constitution, has skin as his essence, is dark as dūrvā grass, is a benefic, has a constitution resembling a banyan tree, is a neuter, is a śūdra, is the speech of Time, is a crown prince, faces north, and is strong in the northern direction, at all times, when retrograde, and in the bright fortnight.
Saturn has seven rays, is black, is tall, is of windy constitution, is a malefic, is a neuter, is the grief of Time, is a servant, faces the earth, and is strong in that same direction, at night, when retrograde, and in the bright fortnight.
And all planets are strong in their own year, their own solstice, their own season, their own month, their own fortnight, their own day, their own planetary hour, and their own division. A planet situated in the highest division, in its own exaltation, in its own trine, victorious in planetary war, and endowed with radiant rays becomes strong.
The moon, Mars, and Jupiter are friends of the sun; Mercury is neutral; Venus and Saturn are enemies.
The sun and Mercury are friends of the moon; the rest are neutral.
Jupiter, the moon, and the sun are friends of Mars; Mercury is an enemy; Venus and Saturn are neutral.
The sun and Venus are friends of Mercury; the cold-rayed [moon] is an enemy; Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn are neutral.
The sun, the moon, and Mars are friends of Jupiter; the son of the sun [Saturn] is neutral; Mercury and Venus are enemies.
Mercury and Saturn are friends of Venus; Mars and Jupiter are neutral; the sun and the moon are enemies.
Mercury and Venus are friends of Saturn; Jupiter is neutral; the sun, the moon, and Mars are enemies.
And at that time, a planet stands in a second or third [relation] from a planet: it enters a neutral, enemy, or friendly state according to its movement.
Therein, in the first month, the embryo is an unformed mass; in the second, it solidifies;

Whichever [planet] is afflicted at the time of conception causes distress to the fetus in its own month; whichever is conquered by another planet or struck by a comet or meteor causes miscarriage of the fetus in its own month. If the moon is in the natal ascendant, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, or ninth house joined by a malefic, or deprived of the aspect or conjunction of a benefic, it leads to the child's death. If [the moon] is in the ascendant, fourth, seventh, or eighth, situated between two malefics, or even if it is in the sixth or eighth aspected by a malefic; or if any one of Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, situated in either the sixth or eighth, is aspected by a retrograde malefic and not aspected by a benefic planet, it leads to death. If there is a malefic joined at the end of the western ascendant, or in whatever sign the ninth navāṃśa is [occupied by a malefic] at an inauspicious twilight and in a lunar horā; or if all four centers—Yama, the sun, the moon, Mars, and Saturn, or others—contain malefics in the eastern half of the zodiacal wheel and benefics in the western half, and with either Cancer or Scorpio rising, and [malefics] in the centers or the eighth [house];
and if at the rising of a waning moon [aspected] by malefics, or when the moon, Saturn, the sun, and Mars are situated in houses other than the ascendant, ninth, and eighth, and Jupiter is devoid of strength, death is caused by a lunar eclipse. When the moon is in the ascendant with a malefic and Mars is in the eighth, he dies together with his mother; when the sun is situated in such a manner, [he dies] by a weapon.
Thus one should recognize fatal afflictions occurring within eight years.
Now, the signs, degrees, and minutes of the planet at that time should be calculated by multiplying by one hundred and eight and dividing in half; when twelve remain from the revolutions, they become the years, months, days, and ghaṭikās.

[A planet] situated in the twelfth from the ascendant takes away all [longevity]; positioned in the eleventh, half; situated in the tenth, a third; situated in the ninth, a fourth; situated in the eighth, a fifth; situated in the seventh, a sixth. A malefic [does this]; a benefic, half of that. When many [planets] are in one sign, only the strongest one [reduces longevity], except Mars. Situated in an enemy's sign, it takes away a third; and combustion [reduces] everything, except for Venus and Saturn.
And when placed in Vargottama, its own sign, decanate, or navāṃśa, [there is] doubling, or loss and gain [respectively].
[When several apply,] it yields only one greatest [reduction or addition]. In this way longevity is determined. For as long a time as was given by a planet, that period should be known as its daśā. And from the ascendant, the daśā [is reckoned] like a planet; and a strong ascendant gives other years equal to the divided sign.
And the first daśā belongs to the strongest among the ascendant, the Sun, and the Moon; then to those situated in angles, in order of strength; then to those situated in succedent houses (paṇaphara); then to those situated in cadent houses (āpoklima).
Therein, [the period] of one situated in its exaltation, trine, own sign, or Vargottama is auspicious; of the opposite, inauspicious. In the ascendant-daśā, according to the ruling planet of the ascendant, a planet that has entered into a single sign … [regarding] the ninth, fifth, third, fourth, or seventh, when many are present, one [part governs]. Now, in the final daśā, one dies under the influence of the planet in the eighth house: therein by the Sun, through fire; by the Moon, through water; by Mars, through a weapon; by Mercury, through fever; by Jupiter, through disease; by Venus, through thirst; by Saturn, through hunger. Whichever strong planet aspects the eighth devoid of planets,
[the native] dies through the bodily humor [governed by] it. If the eighth is devoid of any conjunction or aspect of a planet, one dies through the death declared by the lord of the twenty-second decanate.

from Venus, in the second, fifth, sixth, ninth, tenth, and eleventh; from Saturn, in the third, fifth, seventh, tenth, and eleventh; from the ascendant, in the first, second, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, tenth, and eleventh; [Venus] from Jupiter, in the fifth, eighth, ninth, and eleventh; from its own, in the first, second, fourth, fifth, eighth, ninth, and eleventh; from Saturn, in the third, fourth, fifth, eighth, ninth, and eleventh; from the ascendant, in the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, eighth, ninth, and eleventh. In those [places] where it is not stated as auspicious, in all of them it is inauspicious.
And the distinction of auspicious and inauspicious yields fruit through transits. The fruit of the daśā is unfailing; the inauspicious fruit of the aṣṭakavarga is countered by pacifications and the like. And in this regard: / When the places of anaphā and sunaphā are devoid of planets, it is not praised; / and the emptiness of all the angles is certainly not praised. / The last portion of Cancer and of Pisces, / as well as situated in an enemy's sign or debilitated, is a blameworthy position for planets. / And planets situated in the solar orb are likewise not praised. / The lord of the birth[-star] and the lord of the ascendant, endowed with strength, are both excellent; / one whose two [lords] are devoid of strength should be designated unfortunate. / Even a single planet situated in its highest exaltation and aspected by a friend / produces kingship that destroys the enemy's side. / A planet situated in its own exaltation in the ascendant should be known as exceedingly well situated; / the measure of bhāva is said not to be praised in such a birth. / The Moon is certainly known to be auspicious when aspected by the lord of its sign, / and so too by a friend, O brahmin; [it is] praised [when aspected] by its enemies [only under specific conditions]. / When all four angles are occupied by planets situated in their exaltations, / then the one born is proclaimed a ruler of the entire earth; / or he who has three [so placed] has the earth along with the oceans under his sway.

text_mt:
One who has two planets positioned in the angles and the Moon in Cancer,
he too is declared a king, and likewise even by one, O twice-born.
With all planets in their highest exaltation, one would become the lord of the three worlds.
In a friendly sign, in one's own sign, and also in navāṃśas identical to their signs,
in one's own exaltation, or in one's own trine, the position of planets is praised.
A conjunction of four or more planets is condemned.
Kings in a royal lineage are produced by three or more planets situated in their own places,
and kings born in other lineages are produced by five or more, O twice-born,
especially when situated in trines and exaltations, O foremost of the twice-born.
Benefics modify the houses; malefics destroy the houses.
And in the third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh houses,
the position of malefic planets is proclaimed praiseworthy.
All planets in the sixth house are praiseworthy; those in the twelfth and eighth are not.
With the Moon in the ascendant, men are fools, except in Taurus and Cancer.
With the Sun in the ascendant, they should be known as having faces endowed with victory and power.
By planets endowed with strength, they should be known as acting like lords.
[By inauspicious planets], they should be known as fierce and devoid of good conduct.
Malefics are known to have malefic power; benefics likewise to have benefic power.
By planets situated in signs of growth from the Moon, they should be known as endowed with wealth.
Thus far have I told you the excellent essence, a summary of Horā.

text_mt:
2.168
Puṣkara said:
Then Bhṛgu, having approached the Blessed One, the maker of the creation, preservation, and dissolution of the world, the teacher of the moving and unmoving, possessing immense fame, made a request:
'Blessed Lord, astronomy is difficult to fathom without calculation; therefore explain the system of mathematics.'
To him the Blessed Lord said: 'Listen, my child, to the knowledge of calculation.
Time is without beginning and without end; it is Prajāpati Viṣṇu; knowledge of it according to the motions of planets is calculation.
There, the passage through a degree of the Sun is a solar day-and-night; a lunar day is lunar; a civil [day] is from one sunrise of the Sun to the next sunrise.
The Moon's passage through a lunar mansion is a sidereal [day].
A civil day-and-night belongs to mortals.
A solar day is their day; the three solar [units] make the night; a day-and-night of the ancestors belongs to the Moon.
For them, sunrise is on the eighth day of the dark fortnight;
noon is at the new moon;
sunset is on the eighth day of the bright fortnight;
midnight is at the full moon.
A revolution of the Sun through the zodiac is a celestial day-and-night.
For them, sunrise is upon the Sun's entry into Aries; midday upon entry into Cancer;
sunset upon entry into Libra; midnight upon entry into Capricorn.
When the mean Jupiter is at the beginning of Aries, years such as Āśvayuja occur according to Jupiter's measures.
At sunrise in Laṅkā, at the beginning of the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, at the beginning of Sunday, at the beginning of Aśvinī, at the beginning of the Kiṃstughna [karaṇa], at night or at sunrise, the commencement of time occurs,
and the commencement of the horā and so forth.
And along the meridian between Laṅkā and Meru, to its east and west, is the commencement of time measured by power and sunrise; that circle is the time of sunrise at Laṅkā.
From the equinox of one's own locality, the equinoctial circle of sunrise [is determined]; each day sunrise occurs by virtue of the ascensional difference.
The horizon is the circle.
There, a solar year is [completed] by a revolution of the Sun through the zodiac.
One [cycle] multiplied by three of those years is the Veda [four]; Kali age; twice that is Dvāpara; three times that is Tretā; four times that is Kṛta; four zeros, twins [2], fires [3], speed [4] [4,320,000] is the four ages.
Seventy-one four ages make a Manvantara.
Fourteen Manvantaras make an aeon.

Thus an aeon consists of the four ages.
In an aeon, seven zeros, the Vasus [8], fires [3], and Vedas [4] [4,320,000,000] are the revolutions of the Sun.
Five zeros, qualities [3], fires [3], five [5], seven [7], senses [5], Moon [1] [57,753,300,000] are those of the Moon.
Of Mars, the second, five, eight, nine, eight, nine, two, twin pair [2,296,898,522].

Of Jupiter, five, five, two, six, five, two, six, eyes [2], two, acts [4], flavors [6], qualities [3] [364,226,526,255].
Of Venus, twins [2], nine, Aśvins [2], nine, eight, fires [3], twins [2], void [0], mountains [7] [7,023,892,922].
Of Saturn, eight, nine, twins [2], mountains [7], flavors [6], five, Manus [14] [145,672,98].
The slow motion of the Sun has eight risings.
Of the Moon too, eight, senses [5], Vasus [8], senses [5], directions [10], eight, Vedas [4].
The slow [apogee] of Mars is twin, men [14], wings [2]; of the slow [apogee] of Mercury, two, three, qualities [3].
Of Jupiter, five, five, two, six, eyes [2], two, acts [4], flavors [6], qualities [3].
Of Venus, twins [2], nine, Aśvins [2], cows [9], eight, fires [3], twins [2], sky [0], mountains [7].

The slow motion of the Sun is sky, eight risings.
Of the Moon too, eight, senses [5], Vasus [8], senses [5], directions [10], eight, Vedas [4].
The slow [apogee] of Mars is twin, men [14], wings [2].
Of the slow [apogee] of Mercury, two, three, qualities [3].

Of Venus's slow [apogee], qualities [3], arrows [5], Vasus [8].

Of the Moon's node, Vasus [8], flavors [6], Moon [1], Rudras [11], fires [3], teeth [32], twins [2].

Eight zeros, dissolution, flavors [6], sky [0], Sun [12], sages [7], Vasus [8], Moon [1].
Of the nine planets moving eastward, when divided by the fraction of the revolution of that whose aeon is being computed, the yojanas of its orbit are obtained.
That which has many revolutions has its orbit above; that which has few orbits has its orbit [below]. The orbit is the square root of one-tenth of the square [of the diameter]; the hypotenuse, and half of it, is the orbital position of the planet situated above; the base orbit is the square root of ten times the square of the hypotenuse.

meaning:
एवं सर्ववृत्तानां परिधिव्यासानयनम्.
यत्र च सर्वग्रहाणामेकत्वमेव दृश्यते सा खरसेन्दुयमकक्षा .
तस्या योजनतलिप्ते मध्यमखखरसेन्दुयज्ञैर्यस्यैव कक्षा विभज्यन्ते तस्यैव लिप्तयोजनानि लभ्यन्ते . कल्पाद्ययोजनसमा वै कक्षाः .
यदनन्तरं वितिमिरं रविः करोति पक्षपक्षेश्वतवोदार्कमण्डलप्रमाणम् ..
वेदावेदाश्चन्द्रमसः .
पञ्चदश भौमस्य .
षष्टिर्बुधस्य .
खार्का जीवस्य .
खखयमाः शुक्रस्य .
त्रिंशत्सौरस्य .
द्वादश दृश्यादृश्यांशाश्चन्द्रमसः .
सप्तदश भौमस्य.
त्रयोदश बुधस्य .
एकादश जीवम्य .
नव च शुक्रस्य .
पञ्चदश सौरस्य .
त्रिभागोनाश्चतुर्दशभागाः सूर्यस्य .
एकत्रिंशद्भागाः षट्त्रिंशल्लिप्ताश्चन्द्रमसः .
सप्ततिर्भौमस्य .
वसुरामा बुधस्य .
गुणरामा जीवस्य .
भवाः शुक्रस्य .
त्रिंशच्छनैश्चरस्य .
एवं परिधयो भौमस्य .
शीघ्रपरिधिगुणवेराश्च संभागालिमाः चत्वारिंशद्बुधस्य .
भागा यमाग्निचन्द्राः अष्टगुणा जीवस्य .
वस्वर्थपक्षाः शुक्रस्य ..
पञ्चविंशतिः सौरस्य .
परिवेशेनोर्द्ध्वमधश्च ग्रहगतिर्ज्ञेया .
खखरसेन्दुयमलानां षण्नवतिभागः प्रथमा ज्या .
तदेवं प्रथमं ज्यान्तरा तस्य प्रथमजीवतया भागमुपहृत्याप्तं प्रथमज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य द्वितीयं ज्यान्तरं द्वितीयप्रथमज्यान्तरयोगे द्वितीयप्रथमं ज्यान्तरयोगो जीवा .
ततः प्रथमं जीवाप्तं सद्वितीयज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य तृतीयं ज्यान्तरम् .
ततः द्वितीयजीवयोगस्तृतीया .
ततः प्रथमजीवात्संशोध्य चतुर्थं ज्यान्तरम् ..
एवं तृतीयजीवायां दत्त्वा चतुर्थी ज्या .
text_mt:
Thus is the calculation of the circumference and diameter of all circles.
And where oneness of all planets is observed, that is the orbit of 21,600 [yojanas].
When its yojanas are converted to minutes, and the orbits of whichever planet are divided by the mean 21,600, that very planet's minutes and yojanas are obtained. Indeed, the orbits are equal to the yojanas from the beginning of the kalpa.
Next, the measure of the Sun's orb, which dispels darkness, in fortnight after fortnight, is [...].
[The diameter is] 44 for the Moon,
15 for Mars,
60 for Mercury,
120 for Jupiter,
200 for Venus,
30 for Saturn.
The degrees of visibility and invisibility are 12 for the Moon,
17 for Mars,
13 for Mercury,
11 for Jupiter,
9 for Venus,
15 for Saturn.
[The diameters of the apogees are] 14 degrees less by a third for the Sun,
31 degrees and 36 minutes for the Moon,
70 for Mars,
38 for Mercury,
33 for Jupiter,
11 for Venus,
30 for Saturn.
Thus are the circumferences for Mars.
And the circumferences of the fast [epicycles]: 40 parts for Mercury,
132 degrees, multiplied by eight, for Jupiter,
258 for Venus,
25 for Saturn.
The planetary motion is to be known above and below from the halo.
The ninety-sixth part of 21,600 is the first sine.
Thus, that is the first sine-difference; dividing it by that first sine as divisor, and subtracting the quotient from the first sine-difference, [one obtains] the second sine-difference; when the second and first sine-differences are added together, the sum of the second and first sine-differences is the [second] sine.
Then, subtracting from that [sine-difference] the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine, [one obtains] the third sine-difference.
Then, the sum with the second sine is the third [sine].
Then, subtracting [the quotient] from the first sine, [one obtains] the fourth sine-difference.
Thus, adding it to the third sine gives the fourth sine.

tasyāḥ prathamajīvāyāṃ bhāgamapahṛtyāptaṃ caturthājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya pañcamajyāntaram .
tataścaturthaṃ jīvāyāṃ dattvā ṣaṣṭhī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajīvāptaṃ pañcame jyāntaraṃ saṃśodhya ṣaṣṭhaṃ jyāntaraṃ pañcamajīvāyāṃ dattvā saptamī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajīvāptaṃ saptamajyāntarātsaṃśodhyāṣṭamam .
tatsaptamajīvāyāṃ dattvā navamī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajīvāntareṇāptaṃ daśamajyāntarātsaṃśodhya navamaṃ jyāntaram .
taṃ navamajīvāyāṃ dattvā daśamī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptama .
ekādaśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya dvādaśaṃ jyāntaram .
tadekādaśajīvāyāṃ dattvā dvādaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ dvādaśajyāntarātsaṃśodhya trayodaśaṃ jyāntaram .
tattrayodaśajīvāyāṃ dattvā caturdaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ caturdaśa jyāntarātsaṃśodhya pañcadaśajyāntaram .
tataścaturdaśajīvāyāṃ dattvā pañcadaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ pañcadaśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya ṣoḍaśaṃ jyāntaram .
tatpañcadaśajīvāyāṃ saṃśodhya ṣoḍaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ ṣoḍaśajyāntarātsaṃśodhya saptadaśaṃ jyāntaram .
tatṣoḍaśajīvāyāṃ dattvā saptadaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ saptadaśajyāntarātsaṃśodhyāṣṭādaśamaṃ jyāntaram ..
tatsaptadaśa jīvāyāṃ dattvāṣṭādaśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptam .
aṣṭādaśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya ekonaviṃśaṃ jyāntaram .
tadaṣṭādaśajīvāyāṃ dattvaikonaviṃśī jyā .
tataḥ prathamajyāvāptamekonaviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya viṃśatitamaṃ jyāntaram .
tadekonaviṃśajīvāyāṃ dattvā viṃśatitamī jyā .
tataḥ prathama jyāvāptaṃ viṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhyaikaviṃśaṃ jyāntaram .
tadviṃśatijīvāyāṃ dattvā ekaviṃśī jyā.
meaning:
तस्याः प्रथमजीवायां भागमपहृत्याप्तं चतुर्थाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य पञ्चमज्यान्तरम् .
ततश्चतुर्थं जीवायां दत्त्वा षष्ठी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमजीवाप्तं पञ्चमे ज्यान्तरं संशोध्य षष्ठं ज्यान्तरं पञ्चमजीवायां दत्त्वा सप्तमी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमजीवाप्तं सप्तमज्यान्तरात्संशोध्याष्टमम् .
तत्सप्तमजीवायां दत्त्वा नवमी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमजीवान्तरेणाप्तं दशमज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य नवमं ज्यान्तरम् .
तं नवमजीवायां दत्त्वा दशमी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तम .
एकादशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य द्वादशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तदेकादशजीवायां दत्त्वा द्वादशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं द्वादशज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य त्रयोदशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तत्त्रयोदशजीवायां दत्त्वा चतुर्दशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं चतुर्दश ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य पञ्चदशज्यान्तरम् .
ततश्चतुर्दशजीवायां दत्त्वा पञ्चदशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं पञ्चदशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य षोडशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तत्पञ्चदशजीवायां संशोध्य षोडशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं षोडशज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य सप्तदशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तत्षोडशजीवायां दत्त्वा सप्तदशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं सप्तदशज्यान्तरात्संशोध्याष्टादशमं ज्यान्तरम् ..
तत्सप्तदश जीवायां दत्त्वाष्टादशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तम् .
अष्टादशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य एकोनविंशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तदष्टादशजीवायां दत्त्वैकोनविंशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तमेकोनविंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य विंशतितमं ज्यान्तरम् .
तदेकोनविंशजीवायां दत्त्वा विंशतितमी ज्या .
ततः प्रथम ज्यावाप्तं विंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्यैकविंशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तद्विंशतिजीवायां दत्त्वा एकविंशी ज्या.

Dividing it by that first sine, and subtracting the quotient from the fourth sine-difference, [one obtains] the fifth sine-difference.
Then, adding it to the fourth sine gives the sixth sine.
Then, subtracting from the fifth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the sixth sine-difference; adding it to the fifth sine gives the seventh sine.
Then, subtracting from the seventh sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the eighth [sine-difference].
Adding that to the seventh sine gives the ninth sine.
Then, subtracting from the tenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine-difference gives the ninth sine-difference.
Adding that to the ninth sine gives the tenth sine.
Then, the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine,
subtracted from the eleventh sine-difference, gives the twelfth sine-difference.
Adding that to the eleventh sine gives the twelfth sine.
Then, subtracting from the twelfth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the thirteenth sine-difference.
Adding that to the thirteenth sine gives the fourteenth sine.
Then, subtracting from the fourteenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the fifteenth sine-difference.
Then, adding it to the fourteenth sine gives the fifteenth sine.
Then, subtracting from the fifteenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the sixteenth sine-difference.
Subtracting [or adding] that to the fifteenth sine gives the sixteenth sine.
Then, subtracting from the sixteenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the seventeenth sine-difference.
Adding that to the sixteenth sine gives the seventeenth sine.
Then, subtracting from the seventeenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the eighteenth sine-difference.
Adding that to the seventeenth sine gives the eighteenth sine.
Then, the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine,
subtracted from the eighteenth [sine-difference], gives the nineteenth sine-difference.
Adding that to the eighteenth sine gives the nineteenth sine.
Then, subtracting from the nineteenth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twentieth sine-difference.
Adding that to the nineteenth sine gives the twentieth sine.
Then, subtracting from the twentieth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twenty-first sine-difference.
Adding that to the twentieth sine gives the twenty-first sine.

meaning:
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं एकविंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य द्वाविंशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तदेकविंशजीवायां दत्त्वा द्वाविंशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं द्वाविंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य त्रयोविंशं ज्यान्तरम् ..
तद्द्वाविंश जीवायां दत्त्वा त्रयोविंशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमं ज्यावाप्तं त्रयोविंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य चतुर्विंशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तत्त्रयोविंशजीवायां दत्त्वा चतुर्विंशी ज्या .
ततः प्रथमज्यावाप्तं चतुर्विंशाज्ज्यान्तरात्संशोध्य पञ्चंविंशं ज्यान्तरम् .
तच्चतुर्विंशजीवायां दत्त्वा पञ्चविंशी ज्या .
खखरसेन्दुकक्षायां च व्यासारं तदेवानुपदन्यासायाम् .
ज्यान्तव्यस्तानामन्तरालयोगे चतुर्विंशतिः शरा भवन्ति .
क्रमज्याकृतिजीवाभिस्तस्तत्क्रमज्याकृतिः शरे यासां लिप्तानां जीवा क्रियते तत्केन्द्रस्तस्य च राशित्रये पदाख्या प्रथमपदस्थे तद्गमं चतुर्थपदस्थे चक्रादूनम् .
ज्याकेन्द्रलिप्ता राशिलिप्ताष्टविभागेन विभाज्या .
लब्धाङ्गसमाश्च स्थाप्याः .
अवशेषं तदनन्तरं ज्यान्तरेण गुणयेत्.
राशिलिप्ताष्टभागेन विभजेत्.
लब्धं स्थापितजीवायां दत्त्वेष्ट ज्यासिद्धिः .
कालक्षणेभ्यो लिप्तत्वेन परिकल्पितेभ्यो जीवा कार्या .
लिप्ताभ्यो यावन्ति ज्यान्तराणि संशुद्धन्ति तावन्ति संशोध्यावशिष्टभागलिप्ताष्टभागाहतमशुद्धज्यान्तरेण विभजेत्. लब्धहतासु आद्यष्टकभागलिप्तासु क्षिपेत्.
शरान्तरैरेवं शरचापः भागचतुर्विंशतिज्यापरमापक्रमज्या मेषादि स्थो विषुवल्लेखास्थो ग्रहो भवति.
कुलीरादिस्थश्चान्तरेण .
परमापक्रमान्तस्थो भवति.
तुलादिस्थो विषुवल्लेखास्थः मकरादिस्थो दक्षिणेन परमापक्रमहतां व्यासार्धेन विभजेत्.
लब्धं चन्द्रस्फुटविक्षेपः .
text_mt:
Then, subtracting from the twenty-first sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twenty-second sine-difference.
Adding that to the twenty-first sine gives the twenty-second sine.
Then, subtracting from the twenty-second sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twenty-third sine-difference.
Adding that to the twenty-second sine gives the twenty-third sine.
Then, subtracting from the twenty-third sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twenty-fourth sine-difference.
Adding that to the twenty-third sine gives the twenty-fourth sine.
Then, subtracting from the twenty-fourth sine-difference the quotient obtained by dividing by the first sine gives the twenty-fifth sine-difference.
Adding that to the twenty-fourth sine gives the twenty-fifth sine.
And in the orbit of 21,600, the radius is just that in step-by-step arrangement.
By the sum of the intervals of the reversed sines, there are twenty-four versed sines.
From the sines produced by the regular sine order, there is that calculation of the regular sine; in the versed sine, the minutes for which the sine is made are its anomaly; and in three signs of that, it is called a quadrant; when situated in the first quadrant, it is its traversed portion; when situated in the fourth quadrant, it is subtracted from the circle.
The minutes of the anomaly of the sine should be divided by an eighth part of the minutes of a sign.
And [the parts] equal to the obtained unit should be set down.
One should multiply the remainder by the subsequent sine-difference,
[and] divide by the eighth part of the minutes of a sign.
Adding the quotient to the sine set down, the desired sine is accomplished.
The sine should be made from the time-moments assumed in minutes.
Subtracting from the minutes as many sine-differences as can be subtracted, one should divide [the remainder] multiplied by the eighth part of the remaining degrees and minutes by the unsubtracted sine-difference; one should add the quotient to the minutes of the initial eighth part.
In this way, from the versine-differences [comes] the arc of the versed sine; the sine of twenty-four degrees is the sine of greatest declination; situated at the beginning of Aries, a planet is on the celestial equator;
situated at the beginning of Cancer, it is at the distance,
it stands at the end of the greatest declination;
situated at the beginning of Libra, it is on the celestial equator; situated at the beginning of Capricorn, to the south; one should divide [the product of it] multiplied by the greatest declination by the radius:
the result obtained is the true latitude of the Moon.

meaning:
तात्कालिकशीघ्रं स्फुटं सुपाते योज्यं बुधशुक्रयोः स्वमदाविक्षेपहतां स्फुटान्त्यकर्णेन विभजेत. लब्धं तयोः स्फुटविक्षेपः .
तात्कालिकस्फुटग्रहस्फुटपातयोगज्यां भौमजीवसौराणां मध्यविक्षेपहतां स्फुटान्त्यकर्णेन विभजेत्, लब्धं तेषां स्फुट विक्षेपः .
उत्क्रान्तिचापस्फुटविक्षेपयोर्दिशैको योगः तज्जीवस्यक्रान्तिः, तस्या नियोगः शिष्यते सा दिक् तद्गोलस्थश्च ग्रहो भवति .
एवं ग्रहाणामुत्तरेण दक्षिणेन गतिर्ज्ञेया .
भचक्रवशेनोदयास्तमयौ कुर्वंतः पश्चिमेन यान्ति .
पूर्वां व्रजन्तो भगणपरिवर्तान्कुर्वन्ति तत्र च सूर्याश्वपातैः सममेव लङ्कादक्षिणोत्तररेखायाः फाल्गुनान्ते सर्व एव कल्पादावर्कोदये मीनमेषसन्धिगा भवन्ति .
कल्पावसाने च मेषप्रवेशे वा भानोर्गगनमध्यवर्तिन्यादित्ये द्वादशाङ्गुलेन शंकुना समावनौ छाया ग्राह्या, तद्वर्गं व्यासार्धवर्गहते च्छायाशंकुवर्गयोगेन विभजेत्, लब्धमक्षज्यावर्गः .
तत्पदमक्षज्या तच्चापं स्वदेशाक्षः तं राशित्रयादपास्य स्वदेशावलम्बको भवति .
तज्ज्यावलम्बकज्या त्रिज्या वर्गस्य स्वक्रान्तिवर्गोनस्य पदं स्वाहर्व्यासार्धस्तस्य च स्वकान्तिवशेन दिक् . स्वक्रान्तिविषुवच्छायाहता शकुहृता क्षितिजा, सा त्रिज्याहता स्वाहर्न्यासार्धभाजिता क्षये वृद्धिज्या .
तद्धनुश्चरार्धं वा प्राणास्तद्घटिकाभिः पञ्चदशघटिकायुता दिनार्धम् .
ऊना रात्र्यर्धगा एवमुत्तरगोलस्था दक्षिणकारः स्वस्वभागापहारः अवामधनुषामबोधः .
शोधनं व्यक्षराश्युदयप्राणाः मेषवृषमिथुनानां क्रमेण कर्कटसिंहकन्यानामुत्क्रमेण .
मेषवृषमिधुनजीवादिः प्राग्वच्चरप्राणाः कर्तव्याः .
text_mt:
The instantaneous true motion of Mercury and Venus is to be added to their well-computed node; one should divide [the sine of that], multiplied by their own mean inclination, by the true hypotonuse of the apex. The result is their true celestial latitude.
One should multiply the sine of the sum of the instantaneous true planet and true node for Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn by their mean inclination, and divide by the true hypotenuse of the apex; the result is their true celestial latitude.
When the direction of the sine-difference of the arc and the true latitude is the same, their sum is the declination of that sine. Its application remains: that is the direction, and the planet resides in that hemisphere.
In this way, the northward and southward movement of the planets is to be understood.
Causing rising and setting by the force of the starry sphere, they proceed toward the west.
Going toward the east, they perform complete revolutions of the zodiac; and there, together with the nodes of the Sun's horses, precisely on the north-south meridian of Laṅkā at the end of Phālguna, all of them at sunrise at the beginning of the aeon are situated at the junction of Pisces and Aries.
At the end of the aeon, or upon the Sun's entry into Aries, when the Sun is at mid-sky, the shadow should be measured on level ground with a twelve-finger gnomon. One should divide the square of that, multiplied by the square of the radius, by the sum of the squares of the shadow and the gnomon; the result is the square of the sine of latitude.
Its square root is the sine of latitude, and its arc is the terrestrial latitude of one's own locality. Subtracting that from three signs yields the colatitude of one's own locality.
The sine of that is the sine of colatitude. The square root of the square of the radius diminished by the square of one's own declination is the radius of the diurnal circle, and its direction is determined by one's own declination. The sine of one's own declination multiplied by the equinoctial shadow and divided by the gnomon is the earth-sine (kṣitijā). That, multiplied by the radius and divided by the radius of the diurnal circle, is the sine of the ascensional difference in decrease or increase.
Its arc or respiro-moments (prāṇas) is half the ascensional difference. Half the day is [fifteen ghaṭikās] increased by those ghaṭikās [derived from them] added to fifteen ghaṭikās;
diminished by them, it pertains to half the night. Thus for those situated in the northern hemisphere; in the southern hemisphere, it is the reverse deduction of their respective parts, and understanding is without inverse arcs.
The deduction [and] respiro-moments of the rising of the signs at the equator are, in order, for Aries, Taurus, and Gemini, and in reverse order for Cancer, Leo, and Virgo.
The sines and so forth of Aries, Taurus, and Gemini are to be calculated as respiro-moments of the ascensional difference as before.

meaning:
तेषामवबोधः शोधनं च तेनैकद्वित्र्याक्षरप्राणाः तैः क्रमेण मेषवृषमिथुनाः प्राणहीनाः उत्क्रमेण कुलीरसिंहकन्यानाम् . युक्तस्वदेशे चरा व्युदयप्राणा भवन्ति त एवोत्क्रमेण तुलादीनां मीनादीनामपि अर्धदिनमध्याह्नच्छायाग्रमूलयाम्योत्तराग्रमूलाग्रपरिलेखमत्स्यमुखपुच्छरखा प्राच्यापरा आदित्यचन्द्रयोरन्यतमस्य देशान्तरकर्म विना ग्रहणं न कार्यम् .
तद्यथागते काले यदि भवति तदा रेखामध्ये स्वदेशो ज्ञेयः .
अथादौ रेखा पश्चाच्चेत्प्राक् तत्कालान्तरं षष्टिहतं पञ्चभिः सहस्रैर्विभजेत् .
लब्धदेशान्तरयोजनानि ग्रहस्यार्धं रात्रान्मध्याह्नं यावत्पूर्वः कालो मध्याह्नादपररात्रं यावदपरस्तत्रार्कस्य कालमविलङ्घयन् छायाद्वयं गृह्णीयात् .
तत्कर्णो व्यत्यासेन शंकुप्राच्यपरान्ते रहितौ तदनन्तरं विषुवच्छायाग्रहणमिष्टेऽह्नि इष्टदिनाक्षवैषुवताक्षान्तमेकदिगभिमुखीभ्यश्छायाभ्यो युक्तं स्वरापक्रमः तेन त्रिज्याहता परमापक्रमज्याया विभजेत् . लब्धचापमर्कः प्रथमे पदे द्वितीयाद्भावाच्छुद्धः .
तृतीयेन युक्तः चतुर्थे चक्राच्छुद्धः .
विषुवच्छाया तरुणा च हीयमाना च च्छाया प्रथम पदस्थेऽर्के भवति, ऊना वृद्धिमती द्वितीयस्थे, वृद्धिमत्यधिका तृतीयस्थे, हीयमानाधिका चतुर्थस्थे, एवमतीतदिवसार्कस्य तदर्कस्य च विवरं स्फुटभुक्तिः .
आदित्योदयास्तमयाद्वा चन्द्रोदयं दृष्ट्वा नग्रदद्धरितोऽर्कस्तेन कालेन चन्द्रमा भवति चन्द्रान्नक्षत्रज्ञानम्, चन्द्रार्कविवरात्तिथिज्ञानं तस्मादहर्गणः .
स्फुटार्काद्विपरीतकर्मणा मध्यमार्कः .
सौरजीवयोश्चारात्संवत्सरः .
text_mt:
Their comprehension and subtraction yield thereby the respiro-moments of the equator for one, two, and three signs. Diminished respectively by these respiro-moments, Aries, Taurus, and Gemini, and in reverse order Cancer, Leo, and Virgo, when combined with one's own locality, become the respiro-moments of rising with ascensional difference; and the very same in reverse order apply to Libra and the rest, and also to Pisces and the rest. The line drawn between the head and tail of the fish-figure traced between the tip and base of the midday shadow at midday and the south and north tips and bases is the east-west line. An eclipse of either the Sun or the Moon must not be calculated without the operation for difference in terrestrial longitude.
That is as follows: if it occurs at the elapsed time, then one's own locality is to be known as lying on the prime meridian.
Now, if the meridian is first and [the eclipse is] later, [one's locality is] to the east. One should multiply that time interval by sixty and divide by five thousand;
the result is the yojanas of difference in terrestrial longitude. The time from midnight to midday is the prior half for a planet, and from midday to the other part of the night is the later. There, without exceeding the Sun's time, one should take two shadows.
Its hypotenuse, inversely applied, diminished at the eastern and western ends of the gnomon—thereafter the equinoctial shadow is to be taken on the desired day. The difference between the latitude of the desired day and the equinoctial latitude, added from the shadows facing one direction, is the Sun's declination. Multiplying that by the radius, one should divide by the sine of maximum declination. The arc obtained is the Sun in the first quadrant; in the second quadrant it is subtracted from [six] signs;
added in the third, and in the fourth subtracted from the whole circle.
The equinoctial shadow, both young and waning, occurs when the Sun is in the first quadrant; diminished and waxing when it is in the second; waxing and greater when in the third; waning and greater when in the fourth. Thus, the difference between the Sun of the preceding day and that Sun is the true daily motion.
Or, having observed the rising of the Moon from the rising or setting of the Sun, the Sun is placed on the horizon; the Moon is determined by that time. From the Moon, knowledge of the lunar mansion is obtained; from the difference between the Sun and the Moon, knowledge of the lunar day; and from that, the sum of days.
From the true Sun, by inverse calculation, the mean Sun is found.
And from the course of Saturn and Jupiter, the year is determined.

स्वाति वैश्वदेवाभिजिच्छ्रवण धनिष्ठाजाहिर्बुध्न्य रेवतीनाम्.
उत्तरा रोहिणी सौम्यार्द्रा सार्प हस्त चित्रा विशाखा मैत्रेन्द्र मूलाप्यवारुणाना याम्याः .
रेवत्युदयः प्राची सर्वस्य महती योगतारा राशिद्वयं सप्तविंशतिर्भागाः अगस्त्यध्रुवकः सप्तभिर्मागैस्तस्य याम्यो विक्षेपः .
अथ भौमादीनां वक्रकेन्द्राणि राश्याद्यानि पञ्चमनवः खं वेदाः षड्यमाः खं पञ्च वेदाः खं पञ्च पञ्चदश खं वेदास्त्रयोदश खम् .
अथानुवक्रकेन्द्राणि षड्षोडश खं सप्त वेदाः खं षड्यमाः खं (षट्पञ्चविंशतिः खंखं मनवः खं षड्गुणाः खं) सप्तदश खम् .
text_mt:
The calculation for all planets is like that of the Moon; or, from the planets, knowledge of the elapsed time of the aeon is obtained. In this manner is the determination of time.
The longitudinal coordinates of the lunar mansions beginning with Aśvinī, starting with signs: zero, eight; zero, zero, zero, two; zero, one, seven, twenty-eight; one, nineteen, twenty-two; two, three; zero, two, seven; zero, three, three; zero, three, sixteen; zero, three, two, eighteen; zero, four, nine; zero, four, twenty-seven; zero, five, twenty; zero, six, twenty-four; zero, six, nineteen; zero, seven, two; five, seven, fourteen, five, and seven, nineteen, five; eight and zero, eight, two, zero, eight, twenty; zero, eight, four; zero, nine, eight; zero, seven, zero.
Now, their degrees of celestial latitude: ten, twelve, fifteen, eleven, six, zero, seven, zero, twelve, thirteen, eleven, two, thirty-eight, three and a half, four, eight and a half, five degrees, five, sixty-two, thirty, twenty-four degrees, twenty-six, and zero; namely of Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, Punarvasu, Puṣya, Maghā, Pūrvaphālgunī, Uttaraphālgunī,
Svātī, Viśvedevāḥ, Abhijit, Śravaṇa, Dhaniṣṭhā, Aja-Ekapād, Ahirbudhnya, and Revatī.
These are northern; those of Rohiṇī, Saumya, Ārdrā, Sārpa, Hasta, Citrā, Viśākhā, Maitra, Indra, Mūla, Āpya, and Vāruṇa are southern.
The rising of Revatī is the east; the junction-star of all of it is large; two signs and twenty-seven degrees is the coordinate of Agastya, and its southern latitude is by seventy degrees.
Now, the stations of retrograde motion of Mars and the others, beginning with signs: five, nine, zero; four, twenty-six, zero; five, four, zero; five, fifteen, zero; four, thirteen, zero.
Now, the stations of direct motion: six, sixteen, zero; seven, four, zero; six, twenty, zero; (six, twenty-five, zero, zero; fourteen, zero; six, three, zero;) seventeen, zero.

अथ पूर्वाद्वारोदयकेन्द्राणि खमष्टयमाः खं षट्पञ्चविंशतिः खं खं मनः खं षड्गुणाः खं खं सप्तदश खम् .
अथ पश्चार्धास्तमयकेन्द्राणि एकादश द्वौ खं पञ्चपञ्च खं एकादशषोडश खं पञ्चसप्तविंशति खं एकादश त्रयोदश खम् .
अथ बुधशुक्रयोः पूर्वार्धास्तमयकेन्द्रे दशदश खं एकादश षोडश खं चत्वारि शून्यानि चत्वारि शून्यानि पंचवेदरसाग्नियमपक्षाष्टशरेन्दवः कल्पनप्रतिनक्षत्रोदयः त एवार्कभगणोना दिवसाः .
अर्कभगणा द्वादशहतास्तं मासास्तैस्त्रिंशद्धतास्तद्दिवसाश्चन्द्रभगणाः सप्तविंशति हता नक्षत्रदिवसाः भगणांतरमर्केन्द्वोश्चन्द्रमसस्ते त्रिंशद्गुणास्तद्दिवसाश्चन्द्रमासः .

text_mt:
Now, the anomalies for heliacal rising in the eastern quadrant: zero, eight, two; zero, six, twenty-five; zero, zero, fourteen; zero, six, three; zero, zero, seventeen, zero.
Now, the anomalies for heliacal setting in the western half: eleven, two, zero; five, five, zero; eleven, sixteen, zero; five, twenty-seven, zero; eleven, thirteen, zero.
Now, the anomalies for heliacal setting in the eastern half for Mercury and Venus: ten, ten, zero; eleven, sixteen, zero; four zeros, four zeros. The risings of the asterisms in an aeon are one, five, eight, two, two, three, six, four, five; those very [numbers] diminished by the revolutions of the Sun are the [terrestrial] days.
The revolutions of the Sun multiplied by twelve are its months; multiplied by thirty, they are its days. The revolutions of the Moon multiplied by twenty-seven are sidereal days. The difference between the revolutions of the Sun and the Moon gives the lunar months; these multiplied by thirty are their lunar days.
[The lunar months] diminished by the solar months are the intercalary months; the difference between the lunar days and the [civil] days gives the omitted lunar days.

2.175
The illustrious Paraśurāma said:
O blessed one, knower of all dharmas, expert in all scriptures,
explain to me the time of military expeditions for kings who desire victory.
title: Yātrādhikāraḥ

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca ..
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ yātrākālaṃ nibodha me ..
adhikṛtya mahīnāthaṃ vijigīṣorguṇānvitam .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच ..
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां यात्राकालं निबोध मे ..
अधिकृत्य महीनाथं विजिगीषोर्गुणान्वितम् .. 2 ..
text_mt:
Puṣkara said:
Learn from me the time of military expeditions for all varnas,
with reference to an endowed king of the earth who desires victory.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve kapāle pauro'rke yāyī bhavati cāpare ..
yāyigrahau śukrakujau śeṣāḥ paurāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
पूर्वे कपाले पौरोऽर्के यायी भवति चापरे ..
यायिग्रहौ शुक्रकुजौ शेषाः पौराः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 3 ..
text_mt:
When the sun is in the eastern hemisphere, [a planet] is a defender, and in the other, it becomes an attacker.
Venus and Mars are attacking planets; the others are declared to be defending planets.

sanskrit_iast:
pauragrahairbalopetairna yātrāṃ samprayojayet ..
yāyigrahabale rājā nityaṃ yātrāṃ prayojayet .. 4 ..
meaning:
पौरग्रहैर्बलोपेतैर्न यात्रां सम्प्रयोजयेत् ..
यायिग्रहबले राजा नित्यं यात्रां प्रयोजयेत् .. 4 ..
text_mt:
One should not undertake a march when the defending planets are endowed with strength;
a king should always undertake a march when the attacking planets are strong.

sanskrit_iast:
(astaṃ gate nīcagate vivaśe ripurāśige ..
pratilomaṃ ca viddhvaste śukre yātrāṃ vivarjayet .. 5 ..
meaning:
(अस्तं गते नीचगते विवशे रिपुराशिगे ..
प्रतिलोमं च विद्ध्वस्ते शुक्रे यात्रां विवर्जयेत् .. 5 ..
text_mt:
When Venus has set, entered its debilitation, is powerless, entered an enemy's sign,
retrograde, or afflicted, one should avoid a military expedition.

sanskrit_iast:
pratilome budhe yātrā dikpatau ca tathā grahe ..
viṣṭo vṛṣṭyāṃ vāti vāte vātyāyāñca vivarjayeta .. 6 ..
meaning:
प्रतिलोमे बुधे यात्रा दिक्पतौ च तथा ग्रहे ..
विष्टो वृष्ट्यां वाति वाते वात्यायाञ्च विवर्जयेत .. 6 ..
text_mt:
When Mercury is retrograde, and likewise the planet that is the regent of the direction [of travel], an expedition [should be avoided];
and one should avoid [it] during Viṣṭi, during rain, when the wind blows hard, and in a whirlwind.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidhṛte ca vyatīpāte nāge ca śakunau tathā ..
catuṣpade ca kiṃstughne tathā yātrāṃ vivarjayet .. .. 7 ..
meaning:
वैधृते च व्यतीपाते नागे च शकुनौ तथा ..
चतुष्पदे च किंस्तुघ्ने तथा यात्रां विवर्जयेत् .. .. 7 ..
text_mt:
And during Vaidhṛta, Vyatīpāta, Nāga, Śakuni,
Catuṣpada, and Kiṃstughna, one should likewise avoid an expedition.

sanskrit_iast:
vipatkare naidhane ca pratyarau bhe ca janmani ..
gaṇe vivarjayedyātrāṃ riktāyāṃ ca tithāvapi .. 8 ..
meaning:
विपत्करे नैधने च प्रत्यरौ भे च जन्मनि ..
गणे विवर्जयेद्यात्रां रिक्तायां च तिथावपि .. 8 ..
text_mt:
During the asterisms that bring danger, that cause death, the adversary asterism, the birth asterism,
in the asterism group [so classified], and also on an empty lunar day, one should avoid an expedition.

sanskrit_iast:
udīcī ca tathā prācī tayoraikyaṃ prakīrtitam ..
paścimā dakṣiṇā yā diktayoraikyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 9 ..

उदीची च तथा प्राची तयोरैक्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
पश्चिमा दक्षिणा या दिक्तयोरैक्यं तथैव च .. 9 ..
text_mt:
The north and the east: their union is declared [concordant];
and that direction which is west and south, likewise their union.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyvagnidiksamudbhūtaṃ paridhintu na laṃghayet ..
rāma saṃvatsarādyeṣu sarveṣveva mahīpatiḥ .. 2.175.10 ..

वाय्वग्निदिक्समुद्भूतं परिधिन्तु न लंघयेत् ..

A king should not cross a solar or lunar halo arising in the northwest or southeast quarters,
O Rāma, at the beginning of the year and all [such occasions].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaramadikprācī paripūrvasya dakṣiṇā ..
tatpūrvasyāparā jñeyā cānupūrvasya dakṣiṇā .. 11 ..

sanskrit_iast:

sphuraṇo raśmihīnaśca na praśaṃsanti taddinam ..2.175.20..

समागमे जितो यस्तु जीवो मित्रगृहे स्थितः..

maitrādyāḥ paścimenātha vāsavādyāni cāpyudak .. 22 ..
meaning:
कृत्तिकाद्यानि पूर्वेण मघाद्यानि च याम्यतः..
मैत्राद्याः पश्चिमेनाथ वासवाद्यानि चाप्युदक् .. 22 ..
text_mt: The asterisms beginning with Kṛttikā are in the east, those beginning with Maghā in the south, / those beginning with Maitra (Anurādhā) in the west, and those beginning with Vāsava (Dhaniṣṭhā) in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadvārāṇi tatrāpi divādyāni vinirdiśet ..
bhavanti stambhasaṃjñāni tāni diṅmadhyagāni ca .. 23 ..
meaning:
सर्वद्वाराणि तत्रापि दिवाद्यानि विनिर्दिशेत् ..
भवन्ति स्तम्भसंज्ञानि तानि दिङ्मध्यगानि च .. 23 ..
text_mt: There too one should declare all gates beginning with the day; / those situated in the middle of a direction are called pillars (stambha).

sanskrit_iast:
stambharkṣādyāni pūrvāṇi tāni prāveśikāni tu ..
nirgamarkṣāṇi jānīyātstambharkṣāduttarāṇi tu..24..
meaning:
स्तम्भर्क्षाद्यानि पूर्वाणि तानि प्रावेशिकानि तु ..
निर्गमर्क्षाणि जानीयात्स्तम्भर्क्षादुत्तराणि तु..24..
text_mt: Those [asterisms] preceding the pillar asterisms are entering (prāveśika); / one should know those following the pillar asterisms to be departing (nirgama) asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
praveśabheṣu duṣṭeṣu yāyināṃ vijayaṃ vadet ..
stambhabheṣu tu duṣṭeṣu durgāṇāṃ grahaṇe tadā ..25..
meaning:
प्रवेशभेषु दुष्टेषु यायिनां विजयं वदेत् ..
स्तम्भभेषु तु दुष्टेषु दुर्गाणां ग्रहणे तदा ..25..
text_mt: When the entering asterisms are afflicted, one should predict victory for the invaders; / but when the pillar asterisms are afflicted, then in taking fortresses [victory is won].

sanskrit_iast:
nirgamarkṣeṣu duṣṭeṣu nāgarāṇāṃ jayaṃ vadet ..
ṛkṣe pāpagrahākrānte tathā cāstamite dvija .. 26 ..
meaning:
निर्गमर्क्षेषु दुष्टेषु नागराणां जयं वदेत् ..
ऋक्षे पापग्रहाक्रान्ते तथा चास्तमिते द्विज .. 26 ..
text_mt: When the departing asterisms are afflicted, one should predict victory for the city defenders. / When an asterism is occupied by a malefic planet, or eclipsed, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhe ca dhūmite vāpi rajasopahate'tha vā ..
ketunā dhūmite vāpi pariviṣṭe'thavā punaḥ '. .. 27 ..
meaning:
दग्धे च धूमिते वापि रजसोपहतेऽथ वा ..
केतुना धूमिते वापि परिविष्टेऽथवा पुनः '. .. 27 ..
text_mt: and when it is burned, or smoked, or struck by dust, / or smoked by a comet, or surrounded by a halo,

sanskrit_iast:
utpātadarśanaṃ ca syādyena carkṣeṇa bhārgava ..
saṃkrāntirvā grahasya syādyena cāstodayau tathā .. 28 ..
meaning:
उत्पातदर्शनं च स्याद्येन चर्क्षेण भार्गव ..
संक्रान्तिर्वा ग्रहस्य स्याद्येन चास्तोदयौ तथा .. 28 ..
text_mt: and by whichever asterism a portent is seen, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / or by which a planet undergoes ingress, setting, or rising,

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnaścandramasā yaśca graheṇānyena vā punaḥ ..
yannakṣatragatau grastau syātāṃ vā śaśibhāskarau .. 29 ..
meaning:
भिन्नश्चन्द्रमसा यश्च ग्रहेणान्येन वा पुनः ..
यन्नक्षत्रगतौ ग्रस्तौ स्यातां वा शशिभास्करौ .. 29 ..
text_mt: and that which is occulted by the Moon or by another planet, / or in which asterism the Moon and Sun are eclipsed,

sanskrit_iast:
na tena nṛpatiryāyānnakṣatreṇa kadācana ..
aṣṭavargānukūlastha candre yātrāṃ prayojayet .. 2.175.30 ..
meaning:
न तेन नृपतिर्यायान्नक्षत्रेण कदाचन ..
अष्टवर्गानुकूलस्थ चन्द्रे यात्रां प्रयोजयेत् .. 2.175.30 ..
text_mt: under that asterism a king should never set out on a march. / One should undertake an expedition when the moon is situated favorably according to the aṣṭakavarga.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadvārasthitānandā bhadrā dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā ..
jayā ca paścimadvārā riktā codakprakīrtitā .. 31 ..
meaning:
पूर्वद्वारस्थितानन्दा भद्रा दक्षिणतः स्थिता ..
जया च पश्चिमद्वारा रिक्ता चोदक्प्रकीर्तिता .. 31 ..
text_mt: Nandā is situated in the eastern gate, Bhadrā is situated in the south; / Jayā has a western gate, and Riktā is proclaimed to be in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇā tu sarvato dvārā tithiruktā mahābhuja ..
nakṣatradevatātulyā muhūrtānāṃ tu digbhavet .. 32 ..
meaning:
पूर्णा तु सर्वतो द्वारा तिथिरुक्ता महाभुज ..
नक्षत्रदेवतातुल्या मुहूर्तानां तु दिग्भवेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: Pūrṇā is stated to be a lunar day with gates in all directions, O mighty-armed one. / The direction of the muhūrtas is identical with that of their asterism-deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tridigdvārābhijijjñeyā dakṣiṇena vigarhitā ..
prāgdvārāḥ kathitā rāma meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
त्रिदिग्द्वाराभिजिज्ज्ञेया दक्षिणेन विगर्हिता ..
प्राग्द्वाराः कथिता राम मेषसिंहधनुर्धराः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Abhijit is to be known as having gates in three directions, censure attaching to it in the south. / Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius are declared to have eastern gates, O Rāma;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca paścimadvārāḥ kanyāmakaragovṛṣāḥ ..
tulāmakarakumbhāśca jñeyāḥ paścimadiṅmukhāḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
तथा च पश्चिमद्वाराः कन्यामकरगोवृषाः ..
तुलामकरकुम्भाश्च ज्ञेयाः पश्चिमदिङ्मुखाः .. 34 ..
text_mt: and Virgo, Capricorn, and Taurus have western gates; / Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius are to be known as facing the western direction;

sanskrit_iast:
kīṭavṛścikamīnāśca tathā codakprakīrtitāḥ ..
lagnena diṅmukhaṃ yatnājjñeyaṃ prāṅmukhamaṃśakam .. 35 ..
meaning:
कीटवृश्चिकमीनाश्च तथा चोदक्प्रकीर्तिताः ..
लग्नेन दिङ्मुखं यत्नाज्ज्ञेयं प्राङ्मुखमंशकम् .. 35 ..
text_mt: and Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces are proclaimed to face north. / By means of the ascendant, the direction of the face should be carefully known, with its division facing east.

sanskrit_iast:
saurāḥ sarve praśasyante kālarodhaṃ vivarjayet '.
viśākhādyaṃ bhatritayaṃ dīne sūrye vivarjayet .. 36 ..
meaning:
सौराः सर्वे प्रशस्यन्ते कालरोधं विवर्जयेत् '.
विशाखाद्यं भत्रितयं दीने सूर्ये विवर्जयेत् .. 36 ..
text_mt: All solar asterisms are praised; one should avoid obstruction of time (kālarodha). / When the sun is weakened, one should avoid the triad of asterisms beginning with Viśākhā;

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhātritayaṃ candre tathā brāhmaṇasaṃjñakam ..
dhaniṣṭhādyatrayaṃ bhaume pauṣṇādyatritayaṃ budhe. .. 37 ..
meaning:
आषाढात्रितयं चन्द्रे तथा ब्राह्मणसंज्ञकम् ..
धनिष्ठाद्यत्रयं भौमे पौष्णाद्यत्रितयं बुधे. .. 37 ..
text_mt: [in the case of] the moon, the triad of Āṣāḍhās, likewise termed brāhmaṇa; / [in the case of] Mars, the triad beginning with Dhaniṣṭhā; [in the case of] Mercury, the triad beginning with Pauṣṇa (Revatī);

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇyādyaṃ tathā jīve puṣyādyaṃ ca tathā site ..
aryamṇādya tathā saure prayatnena mahābhuja .. 38 ..
meaning:
रोहिण्याद्यं तथा जीवे पुष्याद्यं च तथा सिते ..
अर्यम्णाद्य तथा सौरे प्रयत्नेन महाभुज .. 38 ..
text_mt: likewise, [in the case of] Jupiter, that beginning with Rohiṇī; in the case of Venus, that beginning with Puṣya; / and in the case of Saturn, that beginning with Aryaman (Uttaraphalgunī), with great care, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ caiva āhirbudhnyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
āgneyamatha cādityaṃ bhāgyaṃ vāyavyameva vā .. 39 ..
meaning:
मूलं च श्रवणं चैव आहिर्बुध्न्यं तथैव च ..
आग्नेयमथ चादित्यं भाग्यं वायव्यमेव वा .. 39 ..
text_mt: Mūla, Śravaṇa, Āhirbudhnya (Uttarabhadrapadā), / Āgneya (Kṛttikā), Āditya (Punarvasu), Bhāgya (Pūrvaphalgunī), or Vāyavya (Svātī)—

sanskrit_iast:
ādityādidineṣvete siddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
siddhiyogānviśeṣeṇa tithiṣvapi nibodha me .. 2.175.40 ..
meaning:
आदित्यादिदिनेष्वेते सिद्धियोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
सिद्धियोगान्विशेषेण तिथिष्वपि निबोध मे .. 2.175.40 ..
text_mt: these on the days beginning with Sunday are proclaimed combinations for success (siddhiyoga). / Learn from me also the combinations for success particularly in the lunar days,

sanskrit_iast:
grahakrameṇa dharmajña sarvakarmasu siddhidān ..
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca pratipaccāṣṭamī tathā .. 41 ..
meaning:
ग्रहक्रमेण धर्मज्ञ सर्वकर्मसु सिद्धिदान् ..
द्वितीया च तृतीया च प्रतिपच्चाष्टमी तथा .. 41 ..
text_mt: which bestow success in all undertakings in the order of the planets, O knower of dharma: / the second, the third, the first, and the eighth,

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī ca caturthī ca pañcamī ca tathā tithiḥ ..
anyāśca siddhayogeṣu tithayastvaṃ śṛṇu kramāt .. 42 ..
meaning:
सप्तमी च चतुर्थी च पञ्चमी च तथा तिथिः ..
अन्याश्च सिद्धयोगेषु तिथयस्त्वं शृणु क्रमात् .. 42 ..
text_mt: the seventh, the fourth, and the fifth lunar day. / Hear the other lunar days in regular order in combinations for success:

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī ca daśamī navamī pañcadaśyapi ..
caturdaśī dvādaśī ca tathā rāma trayodaśī .. 43 ..
meaning:
एकादशी च दशमी नवमी पञ्चदश्यपि ..
चतुर्दशी द्वादशी च तथा राम त्रयोदशी .. 43 ..
text_mt: the eleventh, the tenth, the ninth, and the fifteenth; / the fourteenth, the twelfth, and likewise the thirteenth, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāpramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhiyogeṣvataḥ kramāt ..
tatra kāle kṛtaṃ karma sakṛtsaṃpaśyate dhruvam .. 44 ..
meaning:
छायाप्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि सिद्धियोगेष्वतः क्रमात् ..
तत्र काले कृतं कर्म सकृत्संपश्यते ध्रुवम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: I shall state the measure of the shadow hereafter in the combinations for success in order. / An action performed at that time is firmly seen to succeed at once.

sanskrit_iast:
āditye viṃśatirjñeyāścandre ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
bhaume pañcadaśaivoktāścaturdaśa tathā budhe .. 45 ..
meaning:
आदित्ये विंशतिर्ज्ञेयाश्चन्द्रे षोडश कीर्तिताः ..
भौमे पञ्चदशैवोक्ताश्चतुर्दश तथा बुधे .. 45 ..
text_mt: On Sunday twenty [feet] are to be known, on Monday sixteen are proclaimed, / on Tuesday fifteen are declared, and on Wednesday fourteen,

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśa tathā jīve śukre dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
uditenottarāṃ gacchetprācīṃ madhyasthite ravau .. 46 ..
meaning:
त्रयोदश तथा जीवे शुक्रे द्वादश कीर्तिताः ..
उदितेनोत्तरां गच्छेत्प्राचीं मध्यस्थिते रवौ .. 46 ..
text_mt: on Thursday thirteen, and on Friday twelve are proclaimed. / At sunrise one should go north; when the sun is at the meridian, to the east;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāmaparāhṇe tu ardharātre tu paścimām ..
janmarāśyudaye yātrā na praśastā mahābhuja .. 47 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणामपराह्णे तु अर्धरात्रे तु पश्चिमाम् ..
जन्मराश्युदये यात्रा न प्रशस्ता महाभुज .. 47 ..
text_mt: to the south in the afternoon, and at midnight to the west. / An expedition is not praised at the rising of the birth sign, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāmupacayarkṣe tu yātrā śastā tathā bhavet ..
śeṣeṣu varjayedyātrāṃ bhūtikāmo narādhipaḥ .. 48 ..
meaning:
ताभ्यामुपचयर्क्षे तु यात्रा शस्ता तथा भवेत् ..
शेषेषु वर्जयेद्यात्रां भूतिकामो नराधिपः .. 48 ..
text_mt: An expedition undertaken under the upacaya asterisms from them is auspicious; / during the rest, a ruler of men desiring prosperity should avoid an expedition.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrā śubhaphalā jñeyā saumyagrahanavāṃśake ..
pāpagrahāṃśake yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet .. 49 ..
meaning:
यात्रा शुभफला ज्ञेया सौम्यग्रहनवांशके ..
पापग्रहांशके यात्रां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् .. 49 ..
text_mt: An expedition is to be known as bearing auspicious fruit in the navāṃśa of a benefic planet; / one should diligently avoid an expedition in the navāṃśa of a malefic planet.

sanskrit_iast:
janmabhe naidhane caiva tathādhāne vipatkare ..
pratyarau bhagaṇe yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet .. 2.175.50 ..
meaning:
जन्मभे नैधने चैव तथाधाने विपत्करे ..
प्रत्यरौ भगणे यात्रां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् .. 2.175.50 ..
text_mt: One should diligently avoid an expedition in the birth asterism, in the naidhana, in the ādhāna, in the vipatkara, / and in the pratyari asterism of the zodiac;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣeme saṃpatkare maitre sādhake cātimaitrake ..
karmabhe ca tathā yātrā praśastā manujottama .. 51 ..
meaning:
क्षेमे संपत्करे मैत्रे साधके चातिमैत्रके ..
कर्मभे च तथा यात्रा प्रशस्ता मनुजोत्तम .. 51 ..
text_mt: an expedition is praised in the kṣema, the saṃpatkara, the maitra, the sādhaka, the atimaitra, / and in the karma asterism, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
divyāntarikṣakṣitije dṛṣṭe rāma mahādbhute ..
saptāhaṃ varjeyedyātrāṃ prayatnena mahābhuja .. 52 ..
meaning:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षक्षितिजे दृष्टे राम महाद्भुते ..
सप्ताहं वर्जेयेद्यात्रां प्रयत्नेन महाभुज .. 52 ..
text_mt: When a great portent of the sky, the atmosphere, or the earth is seen, O Rāma, / one should diligently avoid an expedition for seven days, O mighty-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
lagne tu vibale yātrāṃ śūnye kendre ca varjayet ..
janmape lagnape rāma balahīne viśeṣataḥ .. 53 ..
meaning:
लग्ने तु विबले यात्रां शून्ये केन्द्रे च वर्जयेत् ..
जन्मपे लग्नपे राम बलहीने विशेषतः .. 53 ..
text_mt: One should avoid an expedition when the ascendant is weak and the kendra empty, / especially, O Rāma, when the lord of the birth sign or the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpatāvanukūle tu śubhā yātrā prakīrtitā ..
sammukhe śakracāpe tu yātrāṃ yatnena varjayet .. 54 ..
meaning:
दिक्पतावनुकूले तु शुभा यात्रा प्रकीर्तिता ..
सम्मुखे शक्रचापे तु यात्रां यत्नेन वर्जयेत् .. 54 ..
text_mt: When the guardian of the direction is favorable, an expedition is proclaimed to be auspicious; / but when a rainbow faces directly ahead, one should diligently avoid an expedition.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca gacchettathā rāma dvārābhihatamastakaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā dravyamamaṅgalyaṃ khinnacetāstathaiva ca ..
tuṣṭe manasi gantavyaṃ prayatnena mahībhujā .. 55 ..
meaning:
न च गच्छेत्तथा राम द्वाराभिहतमस्तकः ..
दृष्ट्वा द्रव्यममङ्गल्यं खिन्नचेतास्तथैव च ..
तुष्टे मनसि गन्तव्यं प्रयत्नेन महीभुजा .. 55 ..
text_mt: And he should not set out, O Rāma, if his head has struck a doorframe, / or having seen an inauspicious object, or if his mind is distressed; / the king should set out with diligence only when his mind is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇa kendropagatāstu saumyāḥ pāpāstathā copacayarkṣasaṃsthāḥ ..
bhavanti lagnasya tu yasya tena yātrā prayuktā tu śubhāvahā syāt .. 56 ..
meaning:
त्रिकोण केन्द्रोपगतास्तु सौम्याः पापास्तथा चोपचयर्क्षसंस्थाः ..
भवन्ति लग्नस्य तु यस्य तेन यात्रा प्रयुक्ता तु शुभावहा स्यात् .. 56 ..
text_mt: Benefic planets situated in trines and angles, and malefic planets situated in the upacaya houses / of the ascendant—an expedition undertaken by one whose [chart has them so] will bring good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
2.176
.. rāma uvāca .. ..
yātrāvidhānamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃvara ..
jigīṣūṇāṃ narendrāṇāṃ siddhikāraṇamuttamam .. 1 ..
meaning:
2.176
.. राम उवाच .. ..
यात्राविधानमाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतांवर ..
जिगीषूणां नरेन्द्राणां सिद्धिकारणमुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
text_mt: Rāma said: / Explain the rite of an expedition, O best of all upholders of dharma, / which is the supreme cause of success for kings wishing to conquer.
title: Dhanurvedaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca ..
saptāhena yadā yātrā bhaviṣyati mahīpateḥ ..
tadā dine tu prathame pūjanīyo vināyakaḥ .. 2 ..
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच ..
सप्ताहेन यदा यात्रा भविष्यति महीपतेः ..
तदा दिने तु प्रथमे पूजनीयो विनायकः .. 2 ..
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / When a king’s expedition is to take place after seven days, / then on the first day Vināyaka should be worshipped

sanskrit_iast:
modakairakṣatairdadhnā kusumaiśca tathā phalaiḥ ..
gandharvāstrairalaṅkārairdhūpairdīpairmanoharaiḥ .. 3 ..
meaning:
मोदकैरक्षतैर्दध्ना कुसुमैश्च तथा फलैः ..
गन्धर्वास्त्रैरलङ्कारैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्मनोहरैः .. 3 ..
text_mt: with sweetmeats, unhusked rice grains, curd, flowers, and fruits, / with perfumes, garments, ornaments, and delightful incenses and lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye'nhi tataḥ kāryaṃ sarvadikpālapūjanam ..
dikpālapūjanaṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ ca purataḥ sthitaḥ .. 4 ..
meaning:
द्वितीयेऽन्हि ततः कार्यं सर्वदिक्पालपूजनम् ..
दिक्पालपूजनं कृत्वा तेषां च पुरतः स्थितः .. 4 ..
text_mt: Then on the second day, worship of all the guardians of the directions should be performed. / Having worshipped the guardians of the directions and standing before them,

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāṃ kuśābhiḥ kurvīta sitavastrottaracchadām ..
vikirennāgapuṣpaistāṃ tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 5 ..
meaning:
शय्यां कुशाभिः कुर्वीत सितवस्त्रोत्तरच्छदाम् ..
विकिरेन्नागपुष्पैस्तां तथा सिद्धार्थकैः शुभैः .. 5 ..
text_mt: he should make a bed with kuśa grass, covered with a white cloth, / and scatter it with nāgapuṣpa flowers and auspicious white mustard seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchīrṣake tu pūjyā śrīrbhadrakālī ca pādayoḥ ..
haraṃ dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāme brahmāṇameva ca .. 6 ..
meaning:
तच्छीर्षके तु पूज्या श्रीर्भद्रकाली च पादयोः ..
हरं दक्षिणपार्श्वे तु वामे ब्रह्माणमेव च .. 6 ..
text_mt: At its head, Śrī should be worshipped, and Bhadrakālī at the feet; / Hara on the right side, and Brahmā on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitaṃ kalaśaṃ hṛdyaṃ kuryāduṣṇīṣake dṛḍham ..
nīlapallavasaṃchannaṃ cārupuṣpojjvalaṃ śubham .. 7 ..
meaning:
पूजितं कलशं हृद्यं कुर्यादुष्णीषके दृढम् ..
नीलपल्लवसंछन्नं चारुपुष्पोज्ज्वलं शुभम् .. 7 ..
text_mt: He should firmly set a charming, consecrated water jar at the head of the bed, / covered with blue shoots, bright with lovely flowers, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ laghu bhuktvā mahīpatiḥ ..
svayaṃ dakṣiṇapārśve ca mantrametadudīrayet .. 8 ..
meaning:
एककालं हविष्यान्नं लघु भुक्त्वा महीपतिः ..
स्वयं दक्षिणपार्श्वे च मन्त्रमेतदुदीरयेत् .. 8 ..
text_mt: Having eaten once a light meal of sacrificial food, the king / should lie on his right side and himself recite this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śambho trinetrāya rudrāya varadāya ca ..
vāmanāya virūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ ..9..
meaning:
नमः शम्भो त्रिनेत्राय रुद्राय वरदाय च ..
वामनाय विरूपाय स्वप्नाधिपतये नमः ..9..
text_mt: “Homage to Śambhu, the three-eyed one, to Rudra, the granter of boons, / to the dwarf, to the deformed one, homage to the lord of dreams!

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavandevadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana ..
iṣṭāniṣṭaṃ samācakṣva svapne suptasya śāśvatam..2.176.10..
meaning:
भगवन्देवदेवेश शूलभृद्वृषवाहन ..
इष्टानिष्टं समाचक्ष्व स्वप्ने सुप्तस्य शाश्वतम्..2.176.10..
text_mt: O blessed Lord, ruler of the gods of gods, trident-bearer whose mount is the bull, / tell me, who am asleep in a dream, truly what is desirable and undesirable!”

sanskrit_iast:
yajjāgrato dūramiti mantramāvartayettataḥ ..
hṛdi nyasya kuśānrājñaḥ prayatastu purohitaḥ ..11..
meaning:
यज्जाग्रतो दूरमिति मन्त्रमावर्तयेत्ततः ..
हृदि न्यस्य कुशान्राज्ञः प्रयतस्तु पुरोहितः ..11..
text_mt: Then the attentive priest, having placed kuśa grass on the king’s chest, / should recite the mantra beginning with “yajjāgrato dūram.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svapne śubhe dṛṣṭe yātrā deyā tu nānyathā ..
tṛtīye'hani saṃprāpte devaṃ diṅnāthamarcayet..12..
meaning:
ततः स्वप्ने शुभे दृष्टे यात्रा देया तु नान्यथा ..
तृतीयेऽहनि संप्राप्ते देवं दिङ्नाथमर्चयेत्..12..
text_mt: Then, if an auspicious dream is seen, the expedition should be undertaken, but not otherwise. / When the third day arrives, he should worship the lord of the direction—

sanskrit_iast:
ekameva mahābhāga dinanāthaṃ tathā graham ..
yāṃ diśaṃ nṛpatirgacchennāthaṃ tasyāstathaiva tām..13..
meaning:
एकमेव महाभाग दिननाथं तथा ग्रहम् ..
यां दिशं नृपतिर्गच्छेन्नाथं तस्यास्तथैव ताम्..13..
text_mt: just that single one, O fortunate one, the lord of the day, and the planet [governing the direction]; / the king should worship the lord of that direction toward which he intends to go.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe'hani saṃprāpte grahayāgo vidhīyate..
pañcame'hani saṃprāpte sarvayāgastathaiva ca ..
devatānāṃ svanagare kṛtā yāsāṃ tathālayāḥ ..14..
meaning:
चतुर्थेऽहनि संप्राप्ते ग्रहयागो विधीयते..
पञ्चमेऽहनि संप्राप्ते सर्वयागस्तथैव च ..
देवतानां स्वनगरे कृता यासां तथालयाः ..14..
text_mt: When the fourth day arrives, a planetary sacrifice is prescribed; / and when the fifth day arrives, a universal sacrifice [is prescribed] / for the deities whose shrines are built in his own city.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ svapure ye tathā sthitāḥ ..
tatraiva rātrau bhūtānāṃ kartavyaṃ ca tathārcanam .. 15 ..
meaning:
तासां संपूजनं कार्यं स्वपुरे ये तथा स्थिताः ..
तत्रैव रात्रौ भूतानां कर्तव्यं च तथार्चनम् .. 15 ..
text_mt: Worship should be offered to those deities who dwell in his own city; / and in that very night, worship of the spirits should be performed:

sanskrit_iast:
ekavṛkṣeṣu caityeṣu catvarāṭṭālakeṣu ca ..
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca .. 16 ..
meaning:
एकवृक्षेषु चैत्येषु चत्वराट्टालकेषु च ..
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु पर्वतानां गुहासु च .. 16 ..
text_mt: at solitary trees, caityas, courtyards, watchtowers, / crossroads, streets, mountain caves,

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīreṣu śaileṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā svagṛhe tānsamarcayet .. 17 ..
meaning:
नदीतीरेषु शैलेषु देवतायतनेषु च ..
तेषां संपूजनं कृत्वा स्वगृहे तान्समर्चयेत् .. 17 ..
text_mt: riverbanks, rocky hills, and temples of deities. / Having worshipped them there, he should worship them in his own home.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kṛtvā tato vācyāḥ pramathā bhūbhujā svayam ..
vāsudevasya devasya tathā saṃkarṣaṇasya ca .. 18 ..
meaning:
तत्र कृत्वा ततो वाच्याः प्रमथा भूभुजा स्वयम् ..
वासुदेवस्य देवस्य तथा संकर्षणस्य च .. 18 ..
text_mt: Having performed it there, the Pramathas should then be addressed by the king himself: / “The troops of the god Vāsudeva and of Saṃkarṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnasyāniruddhasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṅkarasya ca ..
kīnāśaśakravaruṇadhaneśānāṃ tu ye gaṇāḥ .. 19 ..
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नस्यानिरुद्धस्य ब्रह्मणः शङ्करस्य च ..
कीनाशशक्रवरुणधनेशानां तु ये गणाः .. 19 ..
text_mt: of Pradyumna, of Aniruddha, of Brahmā, and of Śaṅkara; / and those troops of Yama, Indra, Varuṇa, and Kubera;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyośca nirṛtervahnestathā candrārkayośca ye ..
grahāṇāmatha ṛkṣāṇāṃ skandasya ca mahābalāḥ .. 2.176.20 ..
meaning:
वायोश्च निरृतेर्वह्नेस्तथा चन्द्रार्कयोश्च ये ..
ग्रहाणामथ ऋक्षाणां स्कन्दस्य च महाबलाः .. 2.176.20 ..
text_mt: and those of Vāyu, Nirṛti, Agni, and of the moon and sun; / and those mighty ones of the planets, asterisms, and of Skanda;

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya devasya devatānāṃ gaṇāśca ye ..
daityānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca sarveṣāmanugāśca ye .. 21 ..
meaning:
विनायकस्य देवस्य देवतानां गणाश्च ये ..
दैत्यानां राक्षसानां च सर्वेषामनुगाश्च ये .. 21 ..
text_mt: and the troops of the god Vināyaka, and of the gods; / and all those who follow the Daityas and Rākṣasas—

sanskrit_iast:
mahābalā mahākāyā mahāsattvā mahābratāḥ..
aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmyena ca saṃyutāḥ..22..
meaning:
महाबला महाकाया महासत्त्वा महाब्रताः..
अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्येन च संयुताः..22..
text_mt: mighty, huge-bodied, of great strength, of great vows, / endowed with lightness, greatness, reach, and freedom of will,

sanskrit_iast:
īśitvena vaśitvena prāptināmnā tathodaye ..
yatra kāmāvasāyitvāttathā yeṣāṃ ca vidyate .. 23 ..
meaning:
ईशित्वेन वशित्वेन प्राप्तिनाम्ना तथोदये ..
यत्र कामावसायित्वात्तथा येषां च विद्यते .. 23 ..
text_mt: with lordship, mastery, and the power of attainment, / and those in whom the power to suppress desire anywhere exists—

sanskrit_iast:
evamaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryasaṃyutā bhīmavikramāḥ ..
nānāsattvaśirogrīvā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ .. 24 ..
meaning:
एवमष्टगुणैश्वर्यसंयुता भीमविक्रमाः ..
नानासत्त्वशिरोग्रीवा नानाप्रहरणायुधाः .. 24 ..
text_mt: thus endowed with the eightfold superhuman powers, of terrifying valor, / having heads and necks of various creatures, bearing various weapons and arms,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvirāgavasanā nānāsattvavapurdharāḥ ..
tathā nānāvidhāhārā mahāceṣṭā mahābalāḥ .. 25 ..
meaning:
नानाविरागवसना नानासत्त्ववपुर्धराः ..
तथा नानाविधाहारा महाचेष्टा महाबलाः .. 25 ..
text_mt: dressed in garments of various colors, wearing the forms of various creatures, / eating various kinds of food, of great deeds and mighty strength,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānukampino vīrā varadāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ..
pramathāḥ parigṛhṇantu upakāraṃ namo'stu vaḥ ..
saputrāmātyabhṛtyo'haṃ sadāraḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 26 ..
meaning:
भक्तानुकम्पिनो वीरा वरदाः कामरूपिणः ..
प्रमथाः परिगृह्णन्तु उपकारं नमोऽस्तु वः ..
सपुत्रामात्यभृत्योऽहं सदारः शरणं गतः .. 26 ..
text_mt: compassionate to devotees, heroic, granters of boons, able to assume any form at will— / may the Pramathas accept this offering; homage be to you! / Together with my sons, ministers, servants, and wife, I have taken refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣantu māṃ mahābhāgā gṛhe yuddhe tathādhvani ..
camūnāṃ pṛṣṭhato gatvā nāśayadhvaṃ tathā ripūn .. 27 ..
meaning:
रक्षन्तु मां महाभागा गृहे युद्धे तथाध्वनि ..
चमूनां पृष्ठतो गत्वा नाशयध्वं तथा रिपून् .. 27 ..
text_mt: May the fortunate ones protect me at home, in battle, and on the road! / Going behind my armies, destroy my enemies!

sanskrit_iast:
svapne śubhāśubhaṃ vāpi kathayadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ..
vinivṛttaśca dāsyāmi dattādabhyadhikaṃ balim .. 28 ..
meaning:
स्वप्ने शुभाशुभं वापि कथयध्वं समाहिताः ..
विनिवृत्तश्च दास्यामि दत्तादभ्यधिकं बलिम् .. 28 ..
text_mt: Concentrated in mind, tell me in a dream what is auspicious or inauspicious. / And when I have returned, I will offer a sacrifice greater than what was given!”

sanskrit_iast:
vinivṛttena dātavyaḥ sa ca yatnena bhūbhujā ..
pūrvavacca tathā rātrau svapnaprārthanamiṣyate .. .. 29 ..
meaning:
विनिवृत्तेन दातव्यः स च यत्नेन भूभुजा ..
पूर्ववच्च तथा रात्रौ स्वप्नप्रार्थनमिष्यते .. .. 29 ..
text_mt: And that [offering] must diligently be given by the king upon his return; / and in the night, as before, prayer for a dream is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe'hani jayasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ ca tathā bhavet ..
vidhirasyābhiṣekārthaḥ sarva eva vidhīyate .. 2.176.30 ..
meaning:
षष्ठेऽहनि जयस्नानं कर्तव्यं च तथा भवेत् ..
विधिरस्याभिषेकार्थः सर्व एव विधीयते .. 2.176.30 ..
text_mt: On the sixth day, the victory-bath should be performed; / the entire procedure prescribed for royal consecration is enjoined for this.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yātrādine prāpte kṣaurakarma vivarjayet ..
mudraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ caiva tathā ca nakhakṛntanam .. 31 ..
meaning:
ततो यात्रादिने प्राप्ते क्षौरकर्म विवर्जयेत् ..
मुद्रणं भेदनं चैव तथा च नखकृन्तनम् .. 31 ..
text_mt: Then, when the day of the expedition arrives, he should avoid shaving, / sealing, perforating, and also clipping nails,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṅgaṃ gṛhakāryaṃ ca krodhaśokau ca kaṅkatam ..
yātavyaṃ yena tenātha taduktaṃ snānamācaret .. 32 ..
meaning:
अभ्यङ्गं गृहकार्यं च क्रोधशोकौ च कङ्कतम् ..
यातव्यं येन तेनाथ तदुक्तं स्नानमाचरेत् .. 32 ..
text_mt: anointing the body with oil, household chores, anger, sorrow, and combing the hair; / whichever bath is prescribed for the direction to be traversed, he should perform that.

sanskrit_iast:
snātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ sragvī tathā śvetānulepanaḥ ..
citrābharaṇavānrājā dūrvāpallavalācchanaḥ .. 33 ..
meaning:
स्नातः शुक्लाम्बरः स्रग्वी तथा श्वेतानुलेपनः ..
चित्राभरणवान्राजा दूर्वापल्लवलाच्छनः .. 33 ..
text_mt: Bathed, wearing white garments, garlanded, anointed with white unguents, / wearing various ornaments, adorned with dūrvā grass shoots,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā mahābhāgaṃ devadevaṃ trivikramam ..
juhuyācca tathā vahnau susamiddhe purohitaḥ .. 34 ..
meaning:
पूजयित्वा महाभागं देवदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ..
जुहुयाच्च तथा वह्नौ सुसमिद्धे पुरोहितः .. 34 ..
text_mt: having worshipped Trivikrama, the fortunate god of gods, / the priest should make offerings in the well-kindled fire:

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣyamabhayaṃ caiva tathā svastyayanaṃ gaṇam ..
śarmavarmagaṇaṃ caiva tathā pratirathaṃ śubhama .. 35 ..
meaning:
आयुष्यमभयं चैव तथा स्वस्त्ययनं गणम् ..
शर्मवर्मगणं चैव तथा प्रतिरथं शुभम .. 35 ..
text_mt: with the Āyuṣya, Abhaya, and Svastyayana hymn-groups, / with the Śarmavarman hymn-group, and the auspicious Pratiratha hymn,

sanskrit_iast:
śakunaṃ ca tathā sūktaṃ sūktaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca ..
tathāgnilakṣaṇotpattau śubhe yāyānmahīpatiḥ .. 36 ..
meaning:
शकुनं च तथा सूक्तं सूक्तं वैष्णवमेव च ..
तथाग्निलक्षणोत्पत्तौ शुभे यायान्महीपतिः .. 36 ..
text_mt: and the Śakuna hymn, and the Vaiṣṇava hymn; / and when auspicious omens appear in the fire, the king should set out.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrasya diśaścaiva naivedyaṃ yatprakīrtitam ..
tadeva nṛpatiḥ prāśya yātrāṃ vidyādyathāvidhi .. 37 ..
meaning:
नक्षत्रस्य दिशश्चैव नैवेद्यं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ..
तदेव नृपतिः प्राश्य यात्रां विद्याद्यथाविधि .. 37 ..
text_mt: Having eaten the food offering prescribed / for the lunar asterism and the direction, the king should undertake the expedition according to the ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
ahṛdyaṃ makṣikākeśakīṭayuktaṃ vivarjayet ..
dagdhe ca varjayedyātrāṃ deyā bhavati cānyathā .. 38 ..
meaning:
अहृद्यं मक्षिकाकेशकीटयुक्तं विवर्जयेत् ..
दग्धे च वर्जयेद्यात्रां देया भवति चान्यथा .. 38 ..
text_mt: He should avoid food that is disagreeable, contaminated with flies, hair, or worms; / and if it is burnt, he should abandon the expedition, which may be undertaken otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu rājaliṅgānāṃ cāyudhānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
nīrājanoktamantraistu sarvāṃstānabhimantrayet .. 39 ..
meaning:
ततस्तु राजलिङ्गानां चायुधानां तथैव च ..
नीराजनोक्तमन्त्रैस्तु सर्वांस्तानभिमन्त्रयेत् .. 39 ..
text_mt: Then, with the mantras prescribed for the waving of lights, / he should consecrate all the royal insignia and weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
daivavitprayato bhūtvā rājā vātha purohitaḥ ..
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā daivajñaṃ sapurohitam .. 2.176.40 ..
meaning:
दैववित्प्रयतो भूत्वा राजा वाथ पुरोहितः ..
तेषां संपूजनं कृत्वा दैवज्ञं सपुरोहितम् .. 2.176.40 ..

Then, having reached his own city in due course, he should make an offering greater than previously mentioned; / desiring the celestial world and the whole earth, he should mark the earth with sacrificial posts and temples of the gods.
Rāma said: / I wish to hear from you about what pertains to battle for an earth-ruler. / O fortunate one, divine being, you know everything like Parameṣṭhin.
Puṣkara said: / When battle is to take place on the second day, / then the king should bathe his elephants and horses with auspicious waters containing all herbs.
He should adorn them with scents and garlands and worship them according to the rule. / He should worship Nṛsiṃha Viṣṇu, and all the royal insignia without exception:
the umbrella, the standard, the banners, and the righteous laws, O mighty-armed one. / And all weapons likewise should be worshipped by the ruler of the earth.
Having performed their worship, having then worshipped the Pramathas at night, / the king should pray for victory as one other [would],
and [pray to] the Pramathas and the earth for assistance, O mighty-armed one. / He should then sleep amidst the physician, chaplain, ministers, and counselors,

restrained, celibate, and meditating on Nṛsiṃha Hari. / When an auspicious dream has been seen at night, he should initiate the battle.
Rising at the end of the night, bathed with waters containing all herbs, / and having worshipped Nṛsiṃha and all the mounts in full,
he should behold the blazed fire offered into by the chaplain. / The chaplain should then offer mantras there as before.
Pure, the lord of the earth should worship the brahmins with sacrificial fees. / Then the king should anoint his limbs with the 'Fragrant gate...' [mantra],
with auspicious sandal, agallochum, camphor, and kāntā-kālīyaka. / Having applied auspicious yellow orpiment onto his image and throat,
he should put on ornaments that give long life and radiance, consecrated with this mantra, / and a garland with 'The glory of the creator...';
he should put on auspicious herbs with 'Which herbs...', / and should put on an auspicious cotton garment with 'New and new...';

then [he should put on] armour with 'O Indra and Agni...', and indeed take up a bow with 'By the bow...'. / Then he should take for the king [the bow] with arrows consecrated with mantras.
He should mount an elephant, a chariot, or a horse consecrated with mantras. / Having mounted, the king, coming forth from the camp at an auspicious time,
invisible to the enemies in that region, should arrange his force. / He should make the few fight tightly packed, and may spread out the many at will.
The needle-faced array should be [used] for the few against the many. / Battle-arrays are formed in the shapes of living beings' limbs and in the forms of objects:
the eagle-array, crocodile-array, wheel, and likewise the falcon, / the half-moon, the full moon, and the cart-array,
and the array auspicious on all sides, and likewise the needle-array, / the lotus and the circle-array are proclaimed as the principal ones.
Now, the deployment of troops in all battle-arrays is fivefold: / two wings, two flanks, and the chest would be the fifth.
