An image made upside down or sideways brings death. / And in pillars one should avoid an inversion of the top and base;
if an inversion of the top and base is made, the house will go to ruin. / Moreover, timbers used in houses should have their tips to the east or north;
in major beams and rafters, inverted ones are censured; / those with their tips to the south or the west bring calamity to the master of the house.
Therefore, with every effort, he should have that tree marked / at the top and base, O knower of dharma, and then bring it in properly,
on a cart, O great king, or by men, or by bulls, / at a favorable lunar mansion and day, and an honored muhūrta.
Having brought it in properly, the wise master builder should employ it / as appropriate according to its assignment, O great king, endowed with characteristics.

3.90
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having gone by the rule previously stated, he should then examine stone. / Having gone to a mountain, O great king, the astrologer and the master builder:
White stone is commended for the twice-born, and red for kṣatriyas; / yellow is beneficial for vaiśyas, and black brings welfare to śūdras.
Of a single color, even, glossy, sunk deep in the ground, / splitting only under extreme blow, firm, smooth, pleasing,
soft, free of gravel, agreeable to the eye and mind, / washed by river water, pure, having dwelt in water,
embraced by the shade of trees, and associated with a sacred ford, / abundant in length and circumference—the wise say that such [stone] should be taken.
Unfit to be taken is that licked by fire, heated by the rays of the sun, / already used for another work, or touched by alkaline water,

and juice of bimba and wood-apple: [this] is proclaimed as adamantine paste. / Eight parts of lead and two parts of bell-metal, 9

and mixed with donkey hair, O king, is likewise diamond plaster. / Stone temples should be built, O king, joined with one of these [plasters].

3.93 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / But in the Kṛta [age], there was no ritual prescription on earth for temples; / for then [communion with the gods] was solely face-to-face, O ruler of men.
Even with their own eyes people see [the gods] in the Tretā and Dvāpara [ages]; / having made images of the gods, they worship them according to rule.
Consecration in the home was also introduced then in the Tretā [age]; / and in the Dvāpara, it was then performed in forests by sages.
Continual worship of them is performed by the perfected ones, O king; / but those sages were fulfilled by the mere act of consecration.
In the Kali [age], all this people has set about performing consecration. / Highest is knowledge in the Kṛta age, and highest is austerity in the Tretā;

should be constructed by kings desiring the world of heaven. / But a king should not build an entire city [himself], O best of kings;
that king who is not slain in battle is entitled to build a town. / Yet that king should also construct an image bearing an auspicious name.
A fortress must be constructed by every king, O best of rulers; / and he who, with gifts of land and the like, joyfully carries it out properly,
should perform the complete consecration; otherwise he becomes a sharer in sin. / If an image of the gods is made by such a one in the Kali age, it brings misfortune;
that which is done would bring misfortune even across hundreds of other births. / The fruit from performing consecration in the Kṛta, Tretā, and Dvāpara [ages is great],
since the perfected ones abundantly worship an image made in those [ages]; / when an image is made in the Kali [age], worship by the perfected ones does not occur.

text_mt: they therefore come at consecrations when invoked by brahmins. / Therefore, in the Kali age, the wise man should take great care to have a consecration performed.

sanskrit_iast:
arcāsthaistridaśairlokaḥ kalau sarvo hi pālyate..
arcāgatāśca gṛhṇanti kṛtadevapratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 21 ..
meaning:
अर्चास्थैस्त्रिदशैर्लोकः कलौ सर्वो हि पाल्यते..
अर्चागताश्च गृह्णन्ति कृतदेवप्रतिष्ठिताः .. 21 ..
text_mt: For in the Kali [age] the entire world is protected by the gods abiding in the images; / and abiding in the images, having been consecrated as deities, they receive [worship].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkalau prayatnena pratiṣṭhākaraṇaṃ hitam ..
yatnātsuvihitaṃ kuryādbhūmidānādibhissadā .. 22 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कलौ प्रयत्नेन प्रतिष्ठाकरणं हितम् ..
यत्नात्सुविहितं कुर्याद्भूमिदानादिभिस्सदा .. 22 ..
text_mt: Therefore, in the Kali [age], performing a consecration with effort is beneficial; / one should always make it well-provided with care, through gifts of land and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā yajñairyathā yānti mānavāstridivālayam ..
tathaiva rājan gacchanti kṛtadevapratiṣṭhakāḥ .. 23 ..
meaning:
इष्ट्वा यज्ञैर्यथा यान्ति मानवास्त्रिदिवालयम् ..
तथैव राजन् गच्छन्ति कृतदेवप्रतिष्ठकाः .. 23 ..
text_mt: Just as men go to the abode of heaven by offering sacrifices, / in the very same way, O king, go those who have performed the consecration of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkalau pratiṣṭhānaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam ..
yatnātsuvihitaṃ kṛtvā bhūmidānādibhiḥ śubhā .. 24 ..
meaning:
तस्मात्कलौ प्रतिष्ठानं कर्तव्यं भूरिदक्षिणम् ..
यत्नात्सुविहितं कृत्वा भूमिदानादिभिः शुभा .. 24 ..
text_mt: Therefore, in the Kali [age], a consecration with abundant sacrificial fees should be performed, / having made it auspicious and well-endowed with care, through gifts of land and other [grants].

sanskrit_iast:
durge pratiṣṭhā kartavyā nagare ca tathā śubhe ..
nityamāpaṇavīthyagre nānyatreti narādhipa .. 25 ..
meaning:
दुर्गे प्रतिष्ठा कर्तव्या नगरे च तथा शुभे ..
नित्यमापणवीथ्यग्रे नान्यत्रेति नराधिप .. 25 ..
text_mt: A consecration should be performed in a fortress, and likewise in an auspicious city, / always at the head of a street of shops, and not elsewhere, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
grāme vā yadi vā ghoṣe nāsti yatrāpaṇaṃ nṛpa ..
tatrodyāne bahiḥ kāryā grāmamadhye na kārayet .. 26 ..
meaning:
ग्रामे वा यदि वा घोषे नास्ति यत्रापणं नृप ..
तत्रोद्याने बहिः कार्या ग्राममध्ये न कारयेत् .. 26 ..
text_mt: In a village or in a pastoral settlement where there is no market, O king, / it should be built there outside, in a park; one should not have it built in the middle of the village.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīreṣu kartavyā vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca ..
sarasāṃ caiva tīreṣu girīṇāṃ śikhareṣu ca .. 57 ..
meaning:
नदीतीरेषु कर्तव्या वनेषूपवनेषु च ..
सरसां चैव तीरेषु गिरीणां शिखरेषु च .. 57 ..
text_mt: It should be built on riverbanks, in forests and groves, / and on the shores of lakes, and on mountain peaks,

sanskrit_iast:
upatyakāsu ramyāsu guhāsu ca viśeṣataḥ ..
eteṣu yānti sānnidhyaṃ sthāneṣu tridivaukasaḥ .. 28 ..
meaning:
उपत्यकासु रम्यासु गुहासु च विशेषतः ..
एतेषु यान्ति सान्निध्यं स्थानेषु त्रिदिवौकसः .. 28 ..
text_mt: in delightful valleys, and especially in caves; / in these places, the denizens of heaven manifest their presence.

sanskrit_iast:
jalāśayavihīneṣu deśeṣu manujottama ..
sānnidhyaṃ naiva kurvanti kadācittridivaukasaḥ .. 29 ..
meaning:
जलाशयविहीनेषु देशेषु मनुजोत्तम ..
सान्निध्यं नैव कुर्वन्ति कदाचित्त्रिदिवौकसः .. 29 ..
text_mt: In regions devoid of reservoirs of water, O best of men, / the denizens of heaven never manifest their presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā suragṛhaṃ kāryaṃ yathā vāme jalāśayam ..
purastādvā bhavettasya nānyathā manujādhipa .. 3.93.30 ..
meaning:
तथा सुरगृहं कार्यं यथा वामे जलाशयम् ..
पुरस्ताद्वा भवेत्तस्य नान्यथा मनुजाधिप .. 3.93.30 ..
text_mt: A temple of the gods should be built in such a way that a reservoir of water is on its left / or in front of it; not otherwise, O ruler of men.

sanskrit_iast:
samaṃtāttu jalaṃ śastaṃ dvīpe devagṛhe kṛte ..
yatra devagṛhaṃ kāryaṃ tatra bhūmiṃ parīkṣayeta .. 31 ..
meaning:
समंतात्तु जलं शस्तं द्वीपे देवगृहे कृते ..
यत्र देवगृहं कार्यं तत्र भूमिं परीक्षयेत .. 31 ..
text_mt: Water all around is praised when a temple of the gods is made on an island. / Where a temple of the gods is to be built, one should examine the ground there.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā varṇakramānvitā ..
kuśābhiśca śaraiḥ kāśairdūrvābhiśca tathā yutā .. 32 ...
meaning:
श्वेता रक्ता तथा पीता कृष्णा वर्णक्रमान्विता ..
कुशाभिश्च शरैः काशैर्दूर्वाभिश्च तथा युता .. 32 ...
text_mt: White, red, yellow, and black, according to the order of the social classes, / and covered with kuśa, śara, kāśa, and dūrvā grasses,

sanskrit_iast:
madhurā ca kaṣāyā ca tathā tu lavaṇā ca yā ..
varṇakramāddhitā bhūmiḥ sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvataḥ param .. 33 ..
meaning:
मधुरा च कषाया च तथा तु लवणा च या ..
वर्णक्रमाद्धिता भूमिः सर्वेषां शृण्वतः परम् .. 33 ..
text_mt: sweet, astringent, and saline [in taste]; / the ground is beneficial for each in the order of the social classes. Listen to what is further:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭakidrumasaṅkīrṇā śarkarāloṣṭasaṃyutā ..
aśubhrā viṣamā durgā savalmīkā tathā ca yā .. 34 ..
meaning:
कण्टकिद्रुमसङ्कीर्णा शर्करालोष्टसंयुता ..
अशुभ्रा विषमा दुर्गा सवल्मीका तथा च या .. 34 ..
text_mt: covered with thorny trees, full of gravel and clods of earth, / unpleasing, uneven, inaccessible, and with ant-hills,

sanskrit_iast:
mūṣikāvāsabahulā pipīlakaguṇānvitā ..
nityaṃ ca śakaṭacchinnā plutā yā ca purodakaiḥ .. 35 ..
meaning:
मूषिकावासबहुला पिपीलकगुणान्विता ..
नित्यं च शकटच्छिन्ना प्लुता या च पुरोदकैः .. 35 ..
text_mt: abounding in rat holes, full of ants, / constantly worn down by carts, and inundated by sudden floods,

sanskrit_iast:
aghātasūnā bhūmiśca bandhanāgārasaṃyutā ..
vasatiryatra dagdhā ca vidyutā vahnināpi vā .. 36 ..
meaning:
अघातसूना भूमिश्च बन्धनागारसंयुता ..
वसतिर्यत्र दग्धा च विद्युता वह्निनापि वा .. 36 ..
text_mt: ground that is a slaughterhouse or connected with a prison, / or where a dwelling has been burnt by lightning or by fire,

sanskrit_iast:
vasatāṃ dṛṣṭidoṣā ca kūrmapṛṣṭhā tathaiva ca ..
trikoṇā sragvihīnā ca śūrpākārā tathā ca yā .. 39..
meaning:
वसतां दृष्टिदोषा च कूर्मपृष्ठा तथैव च ..
त्रिकोणा स्रग्विहीना च शूर्पाकारा तथा च या .. 39..
text_mt: possessing defects offensive to the sight of those who live there, shaped like a tortoise shell, / triangular, lacking beauty, and shaped like a winnowing basket,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇena tathā nimnā nimnā pṛṣṭhata eva ca .
purāmbugrāhiṇī yā ca suśirā ca tathā nṛpa .. 38 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणेन तथा निम्ना निम्ना पृष्ठत एव च .
पुराम्बुग्राहिणी या च सुशिरा च तथा नृप .. 38 ..
text_mt: And [ground that is] sloping towards the south, and sloping from behind, / and that which collects old water, and that which is hollow, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
khātaṃ ca sumṛdā yatra pūryate na punastathā ..
khāte yatra kṛtaṃ dīpaṃ pramlānimupagacchati .. 39 ..
meaning:
खातं च सुमृदा यत्र पूर्यते न पुनस्तथा ..
खाते यत्र कृतं दीपं प्रम्लानिमुपगच्छति .. 39 ..
text_mt: and where a pit is not filled again by its good soil, / and where a lamp placed in the pit becomes dim,

sanskrit_iast:
mālyaṃ ca mlāyate khāte tāṃ bhūmiṃ parivarjayeta ..
khāte toyena pūrṇe ca yatra toyaṃ na tiṣṭhati .. 3.93.40 ..
meaning:
माल्यं च म्लायते खाते तां भूमिं परिवर्जयेत ..
खाते तोयेन पूर्णे च यत्र तोयं न तिष्ठति .. 3.93.40 ..
text_mt: and a garland withers in the pit—that ground one should avoid. / And where water does not remain when the pit is filled with water,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ bhūmiṃ varjayadyatnāddurgandhā ca tathāpi yā ..
prāgudakpravaṇā śastā snigdhā ca sudṛḍhā tathā .. 41 ..
meaning:
तां भूमिं वर्जयद्यत्नाद्दुर्गन्धा च तथापि या ..
प्रागुदक्प्रवणा शस्ता स्निग्धा च सुदृढा तथा .. 41 ..
text_mt: one should avoid that ground with effort; and likewise that which is foul-smelling. / [Ground that is] sloping towards the east or north is commended, and also smooth and very firm,

sanskrit_iast:
khāte'dhikāṃ ca mṛdyatra pūryamāṇe bhavennṛpa ..
dīpo na mlāyate yatra nyastaṃ ca kusumaṃ tathā .. 42..
meaning:
खातेऽधिकां च मृद्यत्र पूर्यमाणे भवेन्नृप ..
दीपो न म्लायते यत्र न्यस्तं च कुसुमं तथा .. 42..
text_mt: and where, O king, there is excess soil when the pit is filled; / where a lamp does not fade, and likewise a blossom placed there [does not wither];

sanskrit_iast:
toyaṃ santiṣṭhate khāte yatra kālāntaraṃ bahu ..
sā praśastā mahī jñeyā sugandhā susvanā tathā .. 43 ..
meaning:
तोयं सन्तिष्ठते खाते यत्र कालान्तरं बहु ..
सा प्रशस्ता मही ज्ञेया सुगन्धा सुस्वना तथा .. 43 ..
text_mt: where water remains in the pit for a long time— / that earth should be known as praised, sweet-smelling, and of pleasant sound.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ kuryāddivase'tiśubhe tathā ..
bhuvaḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ yatra maṅgalyadravyadarśanam .. 44 ..
meaning:
भुवः परीक्षणं कुर्याद्दिवसेऽतिशुभे तथा ..
भुवः परीक्षणं यत्र मङ्गल्यद्रव्यदर्शनम् .. 44 ..
text_mt: One should examine the ground on an exceedingly auspicious day. / Where, upon examining the ground, there is the sight of auspicious objects,

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇaṃ vā tathaiva syātsā śubhā syādvasundharā ..
na tāṃ rājanparīkṣeta praśastā sā prakīrtitā .. 45 ..
meaning:
श्रवणं वा तथैव स्यात्सा शुभा स्याद्वसुन्धरा ..
न तां राजन्परीक्षेत प्रशस्ता सा प्रकीर्तिता .. 45 ..
text_mt: or hearing [auspicious sounds], that earth is auspicious; / one need not examine it, O king: it is declared praised.

sanskrit_iast:
amaṅgalyaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā śrutaṃ vā nṛpasattama ..
bhuvaḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ tatra na kāryamaśubhā hi sā .. 46 ..
meaning:
अमङ्गल्यं तथा दृष्ट्वा श्रुतं वा नृपसत्तम ..
भुवः परीक्षणं तत्र न कार्यमशुभा हि सा .. 46 ..
text_mt: Seeing or hearing what is inauspicious there, O best of kings, / examination of the ground should not be conducted there, for it is indeed inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhā mahī yatra bhavennṛvīra kāryā pratiṣṭhā bhavatīha tatra ..
kṛtā bhavettatra narendracandra hitāya kartuḥ svavivṛddhaye ca .. 47 ..
3.94
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śubhāṃ parīkṣya vasudhāṃ tatra kuryātsurālayama ..
ādau tāṃ śodhayedvidvāndivase guṇasaṃyute .. 1 ..
tatra deśaṃ śubhaṃ vidvāngomayenopalepayeta ..
tataḥ sampūjayettatra devadevaṃ vināyakam .. 4 ..
tathā ca viśvakarmāṇaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ tadupayogi ca ..
palalollapikā bhakṣyakulmāṣaudanaparpaṭaiḥ .. 3 ..
paramānnena satyaiśca puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayitvā ca daivajñaṃ sāttvataṃ sthapatiṃ tathā .. 4 ..
bhuvaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ kuryādyathāvatpṛthivīpatiḥ ..
tāvatsaṃśodhayedbhūmiṃ nijāṃ yāvatpradṛśyate .. 5 ..
tadā saṃśodhayedvidvānyāvatsyācchalyavarjitā ..
tatastu pūrayetpaścāddṛḍhaṃ mṛttikayā punaḥ .. 6 ..
meaning:
शुभा मही यत्र भवेन्नृवीर कार्या प्रतिष्ठा भवतीह तत्र ..
कृता भवेत्तत्र नरेन्द्रचन्द्र हिताय कर्तुः स्वविवृद्धये च .. 47 ..
3.94
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच ..
शुभां परीक्ष्य वसुधां तत्र कुर्यात्सुरालयम ..
आदौ तां शोधयेद्विद्वान्दिवसे गुणसंयुते .. 1 ..
तत्र देशं शुभं विद्वान्गोमयेनोपलेपयेत ..
ततः सम्पूजयेत्तत्र देवदेवं विनायकम् .. 4 ..
तथा च विश्वकर्माणं भाण्डं तदुपयोगि च ..
पललोल्लपिका भक्ष्यकुल्माषौदनपर्पटैः .. 3 ..
परमान्नेन सत्यैश्च पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयित्वा च दैवज्ञं सात्त्वतं स्थपतिं तथा .. 4 ..
भुवः संशोधनं कुर्याद्यथावत्पृथिवीपतिः ..
तावत्संशोधयेद्भूमिं निजां यावत्प्रदृश्यते .. 5 ..
तदा संशोधयेद्विद्वान्यावत्स्याच्छल्यवर्जिता ..
ततस्तु पूरयेत्पश्चाद्दृढं मृत्तिकया पुनः .. 6 ..
text_mt:
Where the earth is auspicious, O heroic man, the consecration is to be performed there. / When performed there, O moon among kings, it brings welfare and self-prosperity to the maker.
3.94
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having examined the auspicious earth, one should build an abode of the gods there. / First, the wise man should clear it on a day endowed with good qualities.
There, the wise man should smear the auspicious place with cow dung. / Then he should worship Vināyaka, the god of gods, there,
and likewise Viśvakarman and the utensils useful for that work, / with meat, cakes, edibles, boiled beans, rice, and parched crisps,
with rice cooked in milk, truthful words, flowers, incense, and ointments. / Having also worshipped the astrologer, the Sāttvata, and the architect,
the lord of the earth should properly perform the clearing of the ground. / He should clear the ground until its natural [soil] is seen.
Then the wise man should clear it until it is free of foreign objects. / Thereafter, he should fill it firmly again with earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvarṇayā tayā śastā yasya varṇasya kīrtitā ..
aśalyayā mṛttikayā pūrayetsudṛḍhaṃ punaḥ .. 7 ..
kṛtvā tu pūritaṃ deśaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ susamantataḥ ..
susūkṣmaśalyajñānārthaṃ kuryācchalyaparīkṣaṇam .. 8 ..
yathā vakṣyāmyahaṃ rājaṃstathā yatnena buddhimān ..
yadi syācchalyasaṃyuktā śalyamuddhṛtya yatnataḥ .. 9 ..
punaḥ sampūrayedvidvānyatnācchubhamṛdā nṛpa ..
evaṃ saṃśodhya bhūmiṃ tu kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpayettataḥ .. 3.94.10 ..
śilānyāsaṃ tu kurvīta tatraivā'hni caturdiśam ..
pakveṣṭāracite kāryāstā eva tu caturdiśam .. 11 ..
mṛnmaye ceṣṭakānyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ na ca dāruṇe ..
śubhe divasanakṣatre muhūrte cābhipūjite .. 12 ..
kumbhākārāṃ śilāṃ kuryācchailadevagṛhe śubham ..
anyatra tāmrakalaśaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ yatra saṃyutam .. 13 ..
meaning:
तद्वर्णया तया शस्ता यस्य वर्णस्य कीर्तिता ..
अशल्यया मृत्तिकया पूरयेत्सुदृढं पुनः .. 7 ..
कृत्वा तु पूरितं देशं सुदृढं सुसमन्ततः ..
सुसूक्ष्मशल्यज्ञानार्थं कुर्याच्छल्यपरीक्षणम् .. 8 ..
यथा वक्ष्याम्यहं राजंस्तथा यत्नेन बुद्धिमान् ..
यदि स्याच्छल्यसंयुक्ता शल्यमुद्धृत्य यत्नतः .. 9 ..
पुनः सम्पूरयेद्विद्वान्यत्नाच्छुभमृदा नृप ..
एवं संशोध्य भूमिं तु कुम्भं संस्थापयेत्ततः .. 3.94.10 ..
शिलान्यासं तु कुर्वीत तत्रैवाऽह्नि चतुर्दिशम् ..
पक्वेष्टारचिते कार्यास्ता एव तु चतुर्दिशम् .. 11 ..
मृन्मये चेष्टकान्यासं कर्तव्यं न च दारुणे ..
शुभे दिवसनक्षत्रे मुहूर्ते चाभिपूजिते .. 12 ..
कुम्भाकारां शिलां कुर्याच्छैलदेवगृहे शुभम् ..
अन्यत्र ताम्रकलशं सुदृढं यत्र संयुतम् .. 13 ..
text_mt:

Having made a sacred diagram of sixty-four squares on level ground, / and having performed the ritual placement of the deities in that sacred diagram, O twice-born,
properly for all deities spoken of in architectural lore, / and having worshipped Śrī and also Vāsudeva,
the worship of the host of deities of the site should be performed in the sacred diagram, / and of the god Vināyaka, and of Viśvakarman,
and of the utensils, O great king, and of whatever is useful for it, / with perfumes, water offerings, flowers, food offerings, incense, and lamps, according to rule.
And he should offer clarified butter purified with the sacred syllable Om to Śrīdhara. / Then, having made the fire oblation to Śrī, he should cause it to be performed for Brahmā.
Having placed Brahmā in front, and also the retinue of Vāsudeva, / and then having placed the pot in the middle, he should perform the laying of the stones.
First, the stone installed in the northeast corner; / then, O king, the laying of the stones is prescribed in a clockwise direction.

And he should perform the laying out of cords on that very same day. / It should be done with certainty according to the plan of the temple.
Having made the layout of the cords, he should not make it excessive; / surely, O tiger among men, both [defects] bring harm to the patron.

he should then anoint them with fragrant sandalwood; / then covering [them] is to be done with cloths and flowers.
He should offer incense, a lamp, and good food offerings in their names. / Then worship of the lords of the twice-born with sacrificial fees is prescribed.
The astrologer and the architect should then be worshipped by the knowing [patron], O Rāma; / then the patron or the architect or the astrologer should mutter the mantra:

Then, O lord of the earth, the erection of the flagstaff should be performed; / demons desire to dwell in a temple of the gods that is devoid of a flag.

text_mt:
3.95
To the blessed one who was speaking thus, whose asceticism was stainless, whose fame was boundless, who lived for an aeon, the illustrious Mārkaṇḍeya, King Vajra asked:
"O venerable one, how is the knowledge of hidden extraneous substances determined?"
To him the blessed Mārkaṇḍeya said:
"Once, a great being sought the destruction of the three worlds.
Seizing that being in haste, the thirty [gods] threw him face down forcefully.
And afraid of his rising, the gods sat upon his limbs.
Upon his right bodily parts in order are Parjanya and others; in reverse order upon the left are the Nāgas and others; Parjanya and Hutāśana are on the head; Karagraha and [another] on the mouth; Yajña and Kāma on the two eyes; Mahendra and Aditi on the two breasts; Ravi and Aditi on the two ears; Satya, Bhṛśa, Antarikṣa, and Pavana on the chest and shoulders.
On one arm are the serpent kings headed by Candra and Bhallāṭa; on the second arm are Sāvitra and Savitṛ; Rudra and Vyādhi are on one hand, [and] on the second hand; Aryaman and Pṛthivīdhara are in the armpits; Puṣpa, Vitatha, and Bahukṣata are on the flank; Śoṣa, Śoka, and Yakṣa are on the second flank; Brahmā is in the heart; Vivasvat and Mitra are in the belly; Jayendra [and another] are in the penis; Yama and Varuṇa are in the testicles; Vṛṣa and Asura are on the buttocks; Gandharva and Puṣpadanta on the thighs; Mṛga and Grīva on the knees; Pitaraḥ and Dauvārika on the shanks; [and others] on the feet. Thus is this Vāstupuruṣa, with his head in the northeast direction and his feet in the southwest direction.
And there, whichever part of his own body the questioner touches, one should know that an extraneous substance is present precisely in that part of the site.
Or wherever on the body of the householder an illness repeatedly occurs.
Alternatively, one should offer clarified butter consecrated to each of the deities of the site.
Or where the characteristic of the fire becomes unfavorable while clarified butter is being offered, [the substance is] in that deity's place.
Now, I shall easily explain the knowledge of extraneous substances in the portion of these deities according to the division of sixty-four squares.
There, on the outside toward the east, is the lord of half a square.
Parjanya is the lord of one and a half squares; Karagraha is the lord of one and a half squares; Mahendra, Ravi, Satya, and Vṛṣa are respectively lords of two squares each; Antarikṣa is the lord of one and a half squares.
Pavana is the lord of half a square; and toward the south, Puṣpa is the lord of half a square.
Vitatha is the lord of one and a half squares.
Gṛharkṣata, Yava, Bhṛṅga, and Gandharva are lords of two squares; Kośa is the lord of one and a half squares.
Śeṣa is the lord of half a square, and here along with the serpent kings are lords of half a square.
Mukhya is the lord of half a square.
Bhallāṭa, Candra, and Aditi are lords of two squares.
Rāga is the lord of one and a half squares.
And Tadāśana is the lord of half a square, and between them toward the east is the lord of half a square.
Yakṣa is the lord of two squares; Aryaman is the lord of half a square; Sāvitra to the south is the lord of half a square; Savitṛ is the lord of two squares; Mitra is the lord of half a square; Rudra [is another].
To the north, Vyādhi is the lord of half a square.
Mahīśvara is the lord of two squares.
Kāma is the lord of half a square.
In the middle, Brahmā is the lord of four squares. Thus there are thirty-two deities on the outside.
There are thirteen inside.
Thus there are forty-five.
Now, at the time of questioning:
One should know that whichever [animal's] name is heard or whose cry is heard, it is present there; or from the first syllable of the questioner's speech: in the group of vowels beginning with 'a' are horse, man, dog, jackal, ram, donkey, and goat.
Of [the site] genuinely divided into nine parts, the letter 'va' is in the middle; 'a', 'ka', 'na', 'ta', 'sa', 'ga'—these letters are in order in the east and the other directions.
From the first hearing of a letter, an extraneous substance is in that direction of the site.
When the cardines are empty from the ascendant, it is firmly without any extraneous substance.
When joined with malefics, it has an extraneous substance; and in the cardine, the direction corresponds to the sign. When a planet is strong, there is a bone as the extraneous substance.
When it is weak, there are gravel, charcoal, wood, chaff, ash, and the like. There, among all of them, bones cause the death of the patron; when the extraneous substances are gravel, chaff, hair, charcoal, and ash, there are grief, disaster, illness, death, and distress from thieves; and when the temple of a deity has an extraneous substance, the presence of the deity does not take place.
Therefore, with every effort, one should make the site and the temple of the deity free of extraneous substances.
To the south of the temple of the deity is the treasury of the deity.
In its southeast is the kitchen.
To the south is the bathhouse.
In the southwest is the storehouse for base metals and household goods.
To the west is the waterhouse.
In the northwest is the storehouse for vessels.
To the north is the theater house.
In the northeast is the house for sacrifice.
To the east is the house for all workmen.
These also one should make free of extraneous substances; everywhere, an extraneous substance of treasure causes increase.
The recognition of it is as follows.
And here it is said:
When benefic planets are stationed aloft and located in a cardine, the extraneous substance is termed treasure;
the direction here too should be understood according to the sign in the cardine.

text_mt:
Where warmth shaped like an umbrella is observed anywhere upon the earth, / there one should know wealth to be, if the ground is hollow.
Endowed with flies that have blue bodies and white eyelashes, / and likewise foul-smelling ground—underneath there will be wealth.
Where two lotuses capable [of blooming] upon a single stalk are seen, / they repeatedly say that much wealth lies underneath there.
If milky trees are without sap and wound about with filaments, / and thorny trees are thornless, there too one should declare treasure [to be].
Where mistletoe is found upon another tree, O king, / there too treasure should be declared, and where there is a white kiṃśuka tree.
Where frost and water are not retained, and trees do not sprout, / [yet] trees bear flowers out of season, there underneath one should indicate wealth.
Where copulation takes place, or a conch-headed serpent / with a variegated hood is seen, O king of kings, there underneath one should indicate wealth.

पित्र्ये विनाशमाप्नोति कर्तुश्च मरणावहा ..6..
text_mt: In Ahirbudhnya's, it is always firm and confers grace upon the people; / in the Ancestors', it meets with destruction and brings death to the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśve lokahitā karturlokagamyā kṛtā bhaveta ..
saumyā saumye tathā kāntā varadā ca tathā bhavet .. 7 ..
meaning:
वैश्वे लोकहिता कर्तुर्लोकगम्या कृता भवेत ..
सौम्या सौम्ये तथा कान्ता वरदा च तथा भवेत् .. 7 ..
text_mt: In the All-Gods' [cycle], when made, it is beneficial to the world and approachable by people; / in Soma's, it is gentle, lovely, and granter of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
aindrāgne nāśamāpnoti kartuḥ kṛtvā vināśanam ..
aśvinī śrīmatī bhūtvā śīghraṃ nāśamavāpnuyāta .. 8 ..
meaning:
ऐन्द्राग्ने नाशमाप्नोति कर्तुः कृत्वा विनाशनम् ..
अश्विनी श्रीमती भूत्वा शीघ्रं नाशमवाप्नुयात .. 8 ..
text_mt: In Indrāgni's, it meets destruction after causing the patron's destruction; / in the Aśvins', becoming prosperous, it quickly meets destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
lokābhigamyā bhāgye syātkarturdoṃṣavatī bhaveta ..
aśubho'pi yuge kāryā pratiṣṭhā manujottama .. 9 ..
meaning:
लोकाभिगम्या भाग्ये स्यात्कर्तुर्दोंषवती भवेत ..
अशुभोऽपि युगे कार्या प्रतिष्ठा मनुजोत्तम .. 9 ..
text_mt: In Bhaga's, it would be approachable by people, but brings faults upon the patron. / Even in an inauspicious cycle, an installation may be made, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
yasminyasminyuge nātho yoyo devaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
dhanadhānyavatī sphītā kartuḥ śreyovahā tathā .. 3.96.10 ..
meaning:
यस्मिन्यस्मिन्युगे नाथो योयो देवः प्रकीर्तितः ..
धनधान्यवती स्फीता कर्तुः श्रेयोवहा तथा .. 3.96.10 ..
text_mt: if it is for whichever deity is declared the lord in that particular cycle; / [then] it possesses wealth and grain, is prosperous, and brings welfare to the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarākhye kartavyā nityamājñāyutā bhaveta ..
paripūrve tu bhūtaghnī lokakhyātā tathaiva ca.. 1 1..
meaning:
संवत्सराख्ये कर्तव्या नित्यमाज्ञायुता भवेत ..
परिपूर्वे तु भूतघ्नी लोकख्याता तथैव च.. 1 1..
text_mt: In [the year] named Saṃvatsara it should be made; it will always possess authority; / in Parivatsara, it slays evil spirits and is renowned in the world;

sanskrit_iast:
iḍāpūrve tathā saumyā varadā lokasundarī ..
anupūrve tu varadā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet. 12..
meaning:
इडापूर्वे तथा सौम्या वरदा लोकसुन्दरी ..
अनुपूर्वे तु वरदा धनधान्यवती भवेत्. 12..
text_mt: in Iḍāvatsara, it is gentle, granting boons, and fair to the world; / in Anuvatsara, it is granting boons, possessed of wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpūrve nāśamāpnoti karturnāśāvahā bhavet..
tatrāpi śaṃbhormṛtyośca yamasya ca hitā bhavet.. 13..
meaning:
तत्पूर्वे नाशमाप्नोति कर्तुर्नाशावहा भवेत्..
तत्रापि शंभोर्मृत्योश्च यमस्य च हिता भवेत्.. 13..
text_mt: In the year preceding that, it meets destruction and brings about the patron's destruction; / yet even there, it is beneficial for Śambhu, Mṛtyu, and Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare hyayane saumyā dhanavṛddhikarī bhavet..
dhanadhānyayutā sphītā lokānandakarī bhavet.. 14..
meaning:
उत्तरे ह्ययने सौम्या धनवृद्धिकरी भवेत्..
धनधान्ययुता स्फीता लोकानन्दकरी भवेत्.. 14..
text_mt: In the northern solstice, it is gentle and increases wealth; / filled with wealth and grain, prosperous, and causes joy to the people.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe tvayane kartuḥ pāpavṛddhikarī bhavet ..
tatrāpi supte deveśe sarvānarthavivarddhinī .. 15 ..
meaning:
दक्षिणे त्वयने कर्तुः पापवृद्धिकरी भवेत् ..
तत्रापि सुप्ते देवेशे सर्वानर्थविवर्द्धिनी .. 15 ..
text_mt: In the southern solstice, it increases the patron's sins; / especially while the Lord of the Gods is asleep, it increases all misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśire lokakāntā syād dṛḍhā ca vasudhādhipa ..
sphītā vasante saumyā ca varadā ca tathā bhavet .. 16 ..
meaning:
शिशिरे लोककान्ता स्याद् दृढा च वसुधाधिप ..
स्फीता वसन्ते सौम्या च वरदा च तथा भवेत् .. 16 ..
text_mt: In winter, it will be dear to the people and firm, O lord of the earth; / prosperous in spring, gentle, and granter of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣme tejasvinī kāntā bhūtanigrahakāriṇī..
prāvṛṭkāle kṛtā nāśaṃ kartrā saha samāpnuyāta .. 17..
meaning:
ग्रीष्मे तेजस्विनी कान्ता भूतनिग्रहकारिणी..
प्रावृट्काले कृता नाशं कर्त्रा सह समाप्नुयात .. 17..
text_mt: In summer, it is radiant, lovely, and restrains evil spirits; / made during the rainy season, it meets destruction along with the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
śaratkāle kṛtā nāśaṃ śīghrameva prapadyate..
hemante varadā saumyā dharmavṛddhikarī bhaveta .. .. 18 ..
meaning:
शरत्काले कृता नाशं शीघ्रमेव प्रपद्यते..
हेमन्ते वरदा सौम्या धर्मवृद्धिकरी भवेत .. .. 18 ..
text_mt: Made in autumn, it quickly meets destruction; / in late autumn, it is granter of boons, gentle, and increases dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe karturvināśāya phālgune subhagā bhaveta ..
lokānandakarī caitre vaiśākhe dhanasaṃyutā .. 19 ..
meaning:
माघे कर्तुर्विनाशाय फाल्गुने सुभगा भवेत ..
लोकानन्दकरी चैत्रे वैशाखे धनसंयुता .. 19 ..
text_mt: In Māgha, it is for the patron's destruction; in Phālguna, it will be auspicious; / bringing joy to the people in Caitra; endowed with wealth in Vaiśākha;

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāyutā tathā jyeṣṭhe āṣāḍhe kartṛvṛddhidā ..
śrāvaṇe dhanahīnā syātproṣṭhapāde vinaśyati .. 3.96.20 ..
meaning:
आज्ञायुता तथा ज्येष्ठे आषाढे कर्तृवृद्धिदा ..
श्रावणे धनहीना स्यात्प्रोष्ठपादे विनश्यति .. 3.96.20 ..
text_mt: endowed with authority in Jyeṣṭha; giving prosperity to the patron in Āṣāḍha; / lacking wealth in Śrāvaṇa; and in Prauṣṭhapada, it perishes;

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine nāśamāpnoti vahninā kārtike tathā ..
saumye saubhāgyamattulyaṃ pauṣe puṣṭiranuttamā ..21 ..
meaning:
आश्विने नाशमाप्नोति वह्निना कार्तिके तथा ..
सौम्ये सौभाग्यमत्तुल्यं पौषे पुष्टिरनुत्तमा ..21 ..
text_mt: in Āśvina, it meets destruction, and likewise by fire in Kārtika; / in Mārgaśīrṣa, unequalled good fortune; in Pauṣa, supreme nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣāvahādhimāse syātkartturātmana eva ca ..
kṛpṇapakṣatribhāge tu prathame syācchubhāvahā ..22..
meaning:
दोषावहाधिमासे स्यात्कर्त्तुरात्मन एव च ..
कृप्णपक्षत्रिभागे तु प्रथमे स्याच्छुभावहा ..22..
text_mt: In an intercalary month, it brings misfortune to the patron and to itself; / but in the first third of the dark fortnight, it brings good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyā dvitīye bhavati tṛtīye kartṛnāśinī..
śukle tribhāge prathame deśanāśāya kīrtitā ..23..
meaning:
मध्या द्वितीये भवति तृतीये कर्तृनाशिनी..
शुक्ले त्रिभागे प्रथमे देशनाशाय कीर्तिता ..23..
text_mt: In the second, it is mediocre; in the third, it destroys the patron; / in the first third of the bright fortnight, it is declared to cause the destruction of the land;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye madhyaphaladā tṛtīye ca śubhāvahā ..
dhanadhānyavatī sphītā varadā ca tathā bhaveta .. 24 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये मध्यफलदा तृतीये च शुभावहा ..
धनधान्यवती स्फीता वरदा च तथा भवेत .. 24 ..
text_mt: in the second, it yields mediocre fruit; and in the third, it brings good fortune: / it possesses wealth and grain, is prosperous, and granter of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya pakṣasya vṛddhiḥ syāttasmiñchubhavahā bhavet ..
tejasvinī sūryadeve candre kṣamāvahā bhavet .. 25 ..
meaning:
यस्य पक्षस्य वृद्धिः स्यात्तस्मिञ्छुभवहा भवेत् ..
तेजस्विनी सूर्यदेवे चन्द्रे क्षमावहा भवेत् .. 25 ..
text_mt: Whichever fortnight is waxing, it brings good fortune in that one. / On the day of the sun-god, it is radiant; on the moon's, it brings patience;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaume'gninā pradahyeta budhena dhanadā bhavet ..
guruṇā ca dṛḍhā nityaṃ lokānandakarī site .. 26..
meaning:
भौमेऽग्निना प्रदह्येत बुधेन धनदा भवेत् ..
गुरुणा च दृढा नित्यं लोकानन्दकरी सिते .. 26..
text_mt: on Mars's, it would be burned by fire; on Mercury's, it gives wealth; / on Jupiter's, it is always firm; on Venus's, it brings joy to the people;

sanskrit_iast:
ācandrārkasthirā saure pratiṣṭhā samudāhṛtā ..
tejasvinī kṛttikāsu bhūtanigrahakāriṇī.. ..27..
meaning:
आचन्द्रार्कस्थिरा सौरे प्रतिष्ठा समुदाहृता ..
तेजस्विनी कृत्तिकासु भूतनिग्रहकारिणी.. ..27..
text_mt: on Saturn's, an installation is declared to endure as long as moon and sun. / In Kṛttikā, it is radiant and restrains evil spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcidbhūtā tataḥ kāle punardahyati vahninā ..
vahneḥ sūryasya bhaumasya kumārasya ca mānada..28..
meaning:
किञ्चिद्भूता ततः काले पुनर्दह्यति वह्निना ..
वह्नेः सूर्यस्य भौमस्य कुमारस्य च मानद..28..
text_mt: after a short time, it is burned again by fire; / [except] for Agni, Sūrya, Mars, and Kumāra, O honor-giver.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyāṃ ca kṛtā tatra na dahyati ca vahninā ..
prājāpatye dṛḍhā nityaṃ lokānugrahakāriṇī .. 29 ..
meaning:
गङ्गायां च कृता तत्र न दह्यति च वह्निना ..
प्राजापत्ये दृढा नित्यं लोकानुग्रहकारिणी .. 29 ..
text_mt: And made on the Gaṅgā, it is not burned by fire. / In Rohiṇī, it is always firm and confers grace upon the people;

sanskrit_iast:
saumye tu varadā proktā mūṣakaistu vināśyate ..
ārdrāyāṃ kartrṛmaraṇaṃ kṣiprameva prayacchati ..3.96.30..
meaning:
सौम्ये तु वरदा प्रोक्ता मूषकैस्तु विनाश्यते ..
आर्द्रायां कर्त्रृमरणं क्षिप्रमेव प्रयच्छति ..3.96.30..
text_mt: in Mṛgaśīrṣa, it is declared to grant boons, but is destroyed by mice; / in Ārdrā, it quickly brings about the patron's death;

sanskrit_iast:
punarvasau vināśaśca saṃskāraṃ cāpnuyātpunaḥ ..
puṣṭiṃ puṣye samāpnoti dhanena yaśasā tathā .. 31 ..
meaning:
पुनर्वसौ विनाशश्च संस्कारं चाप्नुयात्पुनः ..
पुष्टिं पुष्ये समाप्नोति धनेन यशसा तथा .. 31 ..
text_mt: in Punarvasu, destruction, and it must undergo reconsecration; / in Puṣya, it attains flourishing through wealth and fame;

sanskrit_iast:
sārppe kartṛvināśaḥ syānnāgānāṃ ca hitā bhaveta ..
pitrye maraṇadā kartustathā nāśaṃ ca gacchati .. 32..
meaning:
सार्प्पे कर्तृविनाशः स्यान्नागानां च हिता भवेत ..
पित्र्ये मरणदा कर्तुस्तथा नाशं च गच्छति .. 32..
text_mt: in Āśleṣā, there is the patron's destruction, but it is beneficial for the snakes; / in Maghā, it brings death to the patron and also perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
lokagamyā bhavedbhāgye karturnāśāvahā tathā..
tatrāpi kāmadevasya kartuḥ saukhyāvahā bhavet ..33..
meaning:
लोकगम्या भवेद्भाग्ये कर्तुर्नाशावहा तथा..
तत्रापि कामदेवस्य कर्तुः सौख्यावहा भवेत् ..33..
text_mt: In Pūrvaphalgunī, it will be approachable by the people, yet brings destruction to the patron; / however, for Kāmadeva, it brings happiness to the patron;

sanskrit_iast:
aryamṇe sadṛḍhā sphītā lokānugrahakāriṇī ..
ājñāyutā kṛtā haste cirānnāśamavāpnuyāta .. 34 ..
meaning:
अर्यम्णे सदृढा स्फीता लोकानुग्रहकारिणी ..
आज्ञायुता कृता हस्ते चिरान्नाशमवाप्नुयात .. 34 ..
text_mt: in Uttaraphalgunī, it is firm, prosperous, and confers grace upon the people; / made in Hasta, it possesses authority, but after a long time meets destruction;

sanskrit_iast:
nityāścaryayutā loke citrāyāṃ ca hitapradā ..
svātau tu varadā saumyā lokānugrahakāriṇī .. 35 ..
meaning:
नित्याश्चर्ययुता लोके चित्रायां च हितप्रदा ..
स्वातौ तु वरदा सौम्या लोकानुग्रहकारिणी .. 35 ..
text_mt: in Citrā, it is ever filled with wonder in the world and gives welfare; / in Svātī, it is granter of boons, gentle, and confers grace upon the people;

sanskrit_iast:
aindrāgne kartṛnāśāya maitre maitrābhivṛddhaye..
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ tejasā yuktā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet.. 36..
meaning:
ऐन्द्राग्ने कर्तृनाशाय मैत्रे मैत्राभिवृद्धये..
ज्येष्ठायां तेजसा युक्ता धनधान्यवती भवेत्.. 36..
text_mt: in Viśākhā, it is for the patron's destruction; in Anurādhā, for the increase of friendship; / in Jyeṣṭhā, endowed with brilliance, it possesses wealth and grain;

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhā tathā mūle kintu bhūtasamāśrayā ..
āpye kleśamavāpnoti vaiśvadeve sukhapradā .. 37 ..
meaning:
तथाविधा तथा मूले किन्तु भूतसमाश्रया ..
आप्ये क्लेशमवाप्नोति वैश्वदेवे सुखप्रदा .. 37 ..
text_mt: likewise in Mūla, but it becomes an abode of evil spirits; / in Pūrvāṣāḍhā, it meets suffering; in Uttarāṣāḍhā, it gives happiness;

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇe dhanadhānyāḍhyā vāsave vasusaṃyutā ..
vāruṇe śīghranāśāya tathāje manujottama .. 38 ..
meaning:
श्रवणे धनधान्याढ्या वासवे वसुसंयुता ..
वारुणे शीघ्रनाशाय तथाजे मनुजोत्तम .. 38 ..
text_mt: in Śravaṇa, it is rich in wealth and grain; in Dhaniṣṭhā, endowed with riches; / in Śatabhiṣaj, it leads to rapid destruction, and likewise in Pūrvabhādrapadā, O best of men;

sanskrit_iast:
āhirbudhnye dṛḍhā sphītā karttussaukhyapradā tathā ..
dhanadhānyayutā pauṣṇe āśvine roganāśinī..39..
meaning:
आहिर्बुध्न्ये दृढा स्फीता कर्त्तुस्सौख्यप्रदा तथा ..
धनधान्ययुता पौष्णे आश्विने रोगनाशिनी..39..
text_mt: in Uttarabhādrapadā, it is firm, prosperous, and gives happiness to the patron; / endowed with wealth and grain in Revatī; in Aśvinī, it destroys disease;

sanskrit_iast:
yāmye maraṇadā karturyamasya tu hitapradā ..
nakṣatre savyatīpāte tathaiva ca savaidhṛte .. 3.96.40 ..
meaning:
याम्ये मरणदा कर्तुर्यमस्य तु हितप्रदा ..
नक्षत्रे सव्यतीपाते तथैव च सवैधृते .. 3.96.40 ..
text_mt: in Bharaṇī, it gives death to the patron, but gives benefit to Yama. / In an asterism accompanied by a Vyatīpāta, and likewise with a Vaidhṛta,

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyā maraṇadā karturātmanāśakarī tathā ..
sārke syācchokajananī sasaure mṛtyudāyinī ..41..
meaning:
ज्ञेया मरणदा कर्तुरात्मनाशकरी तथा ..
सार्के स्याच्छोकजननी ससौरे मृत्युदायिनी ..41..
text_mt: it should be known to bring death to the patron and cause its own destruction; / with the Sun, it produces grief; with Saturn, it gives death;

sanskrit_iast:
sabhaume vahnibhayadā satamaske sthirā na tu ..
ketunā bhūṣite ṛkṣe vahnidāhamavāpnuyāt .. 42 ..
meaning:
सभौमे वह्निभयदा सतमस्के स्थिरा न तु ..
केतुना भूषिते ऋक्षे वह्निदाहमवाप्नुयात् .. 42 ..
text_mt: with Mars, it causes danger of fire; with Rāhu, it is not enduring; / in an asterism adorned by a comet, it suffers burning by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
ketūdayaṃ bhavedyena tena durbhikṣamāpnuyāt ..
bhaumodayo bhavedyena tena dahyati vahninā .. 43 ..
meaning:
केतूदयं भवेद्येन तेन दुर्भिक्षमाप्नुयात् ..
भौमोदयो भवेद्येन तेन दह्यति वह्निना .. 43 ..
text_mt: If a comet rises at that time, famine will result; / if Mars rises, it is burned by fire;

sanskrit_iast:
saurodayo bhavedyena tena kalpaṃ vinaśyati ..
nakṣatre saparīveśe paracakrabhayaṃ vadet .. 44 ..
meaning:
सौरोदयो भवेद्येन तेन कल्पं विनश्यति ..
नक्षत्रे सपरीवेशे परचक्रभयं वदेत् .. 44 ..
text_mt: if Saturn rises, it perishes for an aeon. / In an asterism with a halo, one should declare danger from foreign armies;

sanskrit_iast:
ulkāhate vināśāya sabhūkampe bhayapradā ..
ulkāpāto bhavedyatra tatra vyādhikarī bhavet .. 45 ..
meaning:
उल्काहते विनाशाय सभूकम्पे भयप्रदा ..
उल्कापातो भवेद्यत्र तत्र व्याधिकरी भवेत् .. 45 ..
text_mt: struck by a meteor, it leads to destruction; accompanied by an earthquake, it causes fear; / where a meteor falls, it causes disease.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhotpātayukte bhe na śubhā tu prakīrtitā ..
divye kartṛvināśāya bhaume cātmavināśinī .. 46 ..
meaning:
त्रिविधोत्पातयुक्ते भे न शुभा तु प्रकीर्तिता ..
दिव्ये कर्तृविनाशाय भौमे चात्मविनाशिनी .. 46 ..
text_mt: In an asterism attended by three kinds of portents, it is declared inauspicious: / celestial portents lead to the patron's destruction, terrestrial to its own destruction,

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣe ca vijñeyā lokanāśakarī tathā ..
savaidhṛtavyatīpātamṛkṣamekaṃ vivarjayeta .. 47 ..
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षे च विज्ञेया लोकनाशकरी तथा ..
सवैधृतव्यतीपातमृक्षमेकं विवर्जयेत .. 47 ..
text_mt: and atmospheric ones should be known to cause the destruction of the people. / One must avoid the single asterism accompanied by Vaidhṛta and Vyatīpāta,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣairdoṣaistathā yuktaṃ yāvadāgamanādraveḥ ..
janmanakṣatravihitā kartuḥ śreyaskarī bhavet .. 48 ..
meaning:
शेषैर्दोषैस्तथा युक्तं यावदागमनाद्रवेः ..
जन्मनक्षत्रविहिता कर्तुः श्रेयस्करी भवेत् .. 48 ..
text_mt: and one afflicted by the remaining defects until the transit of the Sun; / performed in one's birth asterism, it brings welfare to the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
sampatkarī dvitīye syāttṛtīye'ribhayapradā ..
kṣemyā caturthe bhavati pañcame vyādhivardhinī .. 49 ..
meaning:
सम्पत्करी द्वितीये स्यात्तृतीयेऽरिभयप्रदा ..
क्षेम्या चतुर्थे भवति पञ्चमे व्याधिवर्धिनी .. 49 ..
text_mt: In the second [lunar mansion], it brings prosperity; in the third, it brings fear of enemies. / In the fourth, it brings well-being; in the fifth, it increases illness.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryavṛddhikarī ṣaṣṭhe saptame nidhanapradā..
aṣṭame varadā saumyā navame śrīvivardhinī .. 3.96.50 ..
meaning:
कार्यवृद्धिकरी षष्ठे सप्तमे निधनप्रदा..
अष्टमे वरदा सौम्या नवमे श्रीविवर्धिनी .. 3.96.50 ..
text_mt: In the sixth, it promotes undertakings; in the seventh, it causes death. / In the eighth, it grants boons and is auspicious; in the ninth, it increases fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇāṃ sādhakī proktā janmabhāddaśame tu bhe ..
ekādaśe bhūtikarī dvādaśe'ribhayapradā .. 51 ..
meaning:
कर्मणां साधकी प्रोक्ता जन्मभाद्दशमे तु भे ..
एकादशे भूतिकरी द्वादशेऽरिभयप्रदा .. 51 ..
text_mt: In the tenth constellation from the birth constellation, it is said to accomplish rites. / In the eleventh, it brings prosperity; in the twelfth, it brings fear of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyā trayodaśe kṣemyā rogadā tu caturdaśe ..
vṛddhidā pañcadaśake ṣoḍaśe nidhanapradā .. 52 ..
meaning:
ज्ञेया त्रयोदशे क्षेम्या रोगदा तु चतुर्दशे ..
वृद्धिदा पञ्चदशके षोडशे निधनप्रदा .. 52 ..
text_mt: In the thirteenth, it should be known to bring well-being; in the fourteenth, it causes sickness. / In the fifteenth, it brings growth; in the sixteenth, it causes death.

sanskrit_iast:
saptadaśe bhūtikarī śrīdā cāṣṭadaśe bhavet ..
ekonaviṃśatitame kartturmaraṇadāyinī .. 53 ..
meaning:
सप्तदशे भूतिकरी श्रीदा चाष्टदशे भवेत् ..
एकोनविंशतितमे कर्त्तुर्मरणदायिनी .. 53 ..
text_mt: In the seventeenth, it brings prosperity; in the eighteenth, it bestows fortune. / In the nineteenth, it causes death to the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvitīye dhanadā tṛtīye'ribhayapradā ..
caturthe kṣemajananī pañcame rogavardhinī .. 54 ..
meaning:
ततो द्वितीये धनदा तृतीयेऽरिभयप्रदा ..
चतुर्थे क्षेमजननी पञ्चमे रोगवर्धिनी .. 54 ..
text_mt: In the second from that, it gives wealth; in the third, it brings fear of enemies. / In the fourth, it produces well-being; in the fifth, it increases disease.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe lakṣmīkarī jñeyā dhanadhānyavivardhinī ..
dvitīye ca caturthe ca pañcame ca tathāṣṭame .. 55 ..
meaning:
षष्ठे लक्ष्मीकरी ज्ञेया धनधान्यविवर्धिनी ..
द्वितीये च चतुर्थे च पञ्चमे च तथाष्टमे .. 55 ..
text_mt: In the sixth, it is known to bestow Lakṣmī and increase wealth and grain. / When the Moon is in the second, fourth, fifth, eighth,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśe navame candre karturdoṣakarī bhaveta ..
janmasthaśca tṛtīyaśca ṣaṣṭhaścaikādaśastathā .. 56 ..
meaning:
द्वादशे नवमे चन्द्रे कर्तुर्दोषकरी भवेत ..
जन्मस्थश्च तृतीयश्च षष्ठश्चैकादशस्तथा .. 56 ..
text_mt: twelfth, or ninth [house], it causes harm to the patron. / When a planet is situated in the birth [house], or in the third, sixth, eleventh,

sanskrit_iast:
daśamaḥ saptamaścaiva yadā viddho bhavedgrahaḥ ..
pañcamairnavamaiścaiva dvādaśaiśca tathāṣṭamaiḥ .. 57 ..
meaning:
दशमः सप्तमश्चैव यदा विद्धो भवेद्ग्रहः ..
पञ्चमैर्नवमैश्चैव द्वादशैश्च तथाष्टमैः .. 57 ..
text_mt: tenth, or seventh, and becomes afflicted [by obstruction] / by [planets in] the fifth, ninth, twelfth, eighth,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe vā dvitīye vā kramātpādaphalo bhavet ..
viparyayeṇa vedhastho pāpo'pi śubhakṛtsmṛtaḥ .. 58 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थे वा द्वितीये वा क्रमात्पादफलो भवेत् ..
विपर्ययेण वेधस्थो पापोऽपि शुभकृत्स्मृतः .. 58 ..
text_mt: fourth, or second, its fruit is diminished by a quarter, respectively. / Conversely, even a malefic planet placed in obstruction is held to cause good.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāddvādaśamaḥ sūryo dvitīye vā bhayapradaḥ ..
dvādaśe'tha dvitīye ca bhaume dāhamavāpnuyāt .. 59 ..
meaning:
चन्द्राद्द्वादशमः सूर्यो द्वितीये वा भयप्रदः ..
द्वादशेऽथ द्वितीये च भौमे दाहमवाप्नुयात् .. 59 ..
text_mt: The Sun in the twelfth or second from the Moon brings fear. / With Mars in the twelfth or second, one incurs destruction by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśe ṣaḍdvitīye vā saure maraṇadā bhavet ..
pāpamadhyagate candre dhruvaṃ maraṇadā bhavet .. 3.96.60 ..
meaning:
द्वादशे षड्द्वितीये वा सौरे मरणदा भवेत् ..
पापमध्यगते चन्द्रे ध्रुवं मरणदा भवेत् .. 3.96.60 ..
text_mt: With Saturn in the twelfth or second, it brings death. / When the Moon is placed between malefics, it definitely brings death.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasmiṃstu yadā kendre candraḥ samyagvyavasthitaḥ ..
kendratrayamathānyaṃ syādyuktaṃ sūryārasūryajaiḥ .. 61 ..
meaning:
एकस्मिंस्तु यदा केन्द्रे चन्द्रः सम्यग्व्यवस्थितः ..
केन्द्रत्रयमथान्यं स्याद्युक्तं सूर्यारसूर्यजैः .. 61 ..
text_mt: When the Moon is positioned in one angle, / and the other three angles are occupied by the Sun, Mars, and Saturn,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā kartturvināśāya pratiṣṭhā syānnarādhipa ..
candre sārke vināśāya bhaume dāhamavāpnuyāt .. 6 2..
meaning:
तदा कर्त्तुर्विनाशाय प्रतिष्ठा स्यान्नराधिप ..
चन्द्रे सार्के विनाशाय भौमे दाहमवाप्नुयात् .. 6 2..
text_mt: then the installation leads to the patron's destruction, O king. / When the Moon is conjunct the Sun, it leads to destruction; with Mars, one incurs destruction by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
sasaure mṛtyudā jñeyā sarāhau nidhanapradā ..
nakṣatre soparāge tu karturmaraṇadāyinī .. 63 ..
meaning:
ससौरे मृत्युदा ज्ञेया सराहौ निधनप्रदा ..
नक्षत्रे सोपरागे तु कर्तुर्मरणदायिनी .. 63 ..
text_mt: With Saturn, it should be known to bring death; with Rāhu, it brings destruction. / When [performed] in a constellation during an eclipse, it brings death to the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
pariveṣṭe tathā candre maraṇaṃ tu prayacchati ..
sārpāntyapādage candre tathā jyeṣṭhāntapādage .. 64 ..
meaning:
परिवेष्टे तथा चन्द्रे मरणं तु प्रयच्छति ..
सार्पान्त्यपादगे चन्द्रे तथा ज्येष्ठान्तपादगे .. 64 ..
text_mt: When the Moon has a halo, it likewise brings death. / When the Moon is in the final quarter of Āśleṣā, or in the final quarter of Jyeṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇāntapādage caiva karturnidhanakāriṇī ..
yasminnṛkṣe yadevoktaṃ phalaṃ bhūpati sattama .. 65 ..
meaning:
पौष्णान्तपादगे चैव कर्तुर्निधनकारिणी ..
यस्मिन्नृक्षे यदेवोक्तं फलं भूपति सत्तम .. 65 ..
text_mt: or in the final quarter of Revatī, it causes the patron's death. / Whatever fruit has been declared for any constellation, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeveha phalaṃ proktaṃ tanmuhūrte'pi yādava ..
dinamadhyagate sūrye muhūrte'bhijite'ṣṭame .. 66 ..
meaning:
तदेवेह फलं प्रोक्तं तन्मुहूर्तेऽपि यादव ..
दिनमध्यगते सूर्ये मुहूर्तेऽभिजितेऽष्टमे .. 66 ..
text_mt: that very fruit is declared here for its muhūrta as well, O Yādava. / When the Sun is at midday, in the eighth muhūrta, Abhijit,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddhā syātsarvopadravavarjitā ..
gurāvastamayaṃ prāpte nīcasthe kartṛghātinī .. 67 ..
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धा स्यात्सर्वोपद्रववर्जिता ..
गुरावस्तमयं प्राप्ते नीचस्थे कर्तृघातिनी .. 67 ..
text_mt: it fulfills all desires and is free from all afflictions. / When Jupiter has set or is in its sign of debilitation, it destroys the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbalasthe jīve tu dhanadhānyakarī bhaveta ..
brāhme rāśye dṛḍhā jñeyā prājāpatye sukhāvahā .. 68 ..
meaning:
तस्माद्बलस्थे जीवे तु धनधान्यकरी भवेत ..
ब्राह्मे राश्ये दृढा ज्ञेया प्राजापत्ये सुखावहा .. 68 ..
text_mt: Therefore, when Jupiter is strong, it brings wealth and grain. / In the Brāhma sign [Aries], it is known to be firm; in the Prājāpatya [Taurus], it brings happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
svargalokapradā svargye cakre cakrapravartinī ..
vānaspatye tu varadā hyānne cānnavivardhinī .. 69 ..
meaning:
स्वर्गलोकप्रदा स्वर्ग्ये चक्रे चक्रप्रवर्तिनी ..
वानस्पत्ये तु वरदा ह्यान्ने चान्नविवर्धिनी .. 69 ..
text_mt: In the Svargya, it gives the heavenly realm; in the Cakra, it sets the sovereign wheel turning. / In the Vānaspatya, it grants boons; in the Ānna, it increases food.

sanskrit_iast:
vāse bhavati vastrāḍhyā kāle mṛtyupradāyinī ..
āgneye dāhamāpnoti kledamabdaivate tathā .. 3.96.70 ..
meaning:
वासे भवति वस्त्राढ्या काले मृत्युप्रदायिनी ..
आग्नेये दाहमाप्नोति क्लेदमब्दैवते तथा .. 3.96.70 ..
text_mt: In the Vāsa, it abounds in garments; in the Kāla, it causes death. / In the Āgneya, it incurs burning; likewise in the Abdaivata, moisture.

sanskrit_iast:
saure bhavati susphītā cāndre ca varadā tathā ..
naśyate śambhudaivatye godeve vṛddhimāpnuyāt .. 71 ..
meaning:
सौरे भवति सुस्फीता चान्द्रे च वरदा तथा ..
नश्यते शम्भुदैवत्ये गोदेवे वृद्धिमाप्नुयात् .. 71 ..
text_mt: In the Saura, it becomes very prosperous; in the Cāndra, it likewise grants boons. / In that dedicated to Śambhu, it is ruined; in that dedicated to the Cow, it attains growth.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇave puṣṭidā proktā tathā bhavati pūjitā ..
kāmāre vṛddhimāpnoti pitrye nāśaṃ tathaiva ca .. 72 ..
meaning:
वैष्णवे पुष्टिदा प्रोक्ता तथा भवति पूजिता ..
कामारे वृद्धिमाप्नोति पित्र्ये नाशं तथैव च .. 72 ..
text_mt: In the Vaiṣṇava, it is said to give nourishment and is honored. / In that of the enemy of Kāma [Śiva], it attains growth; in the Pitrya, destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇe rogadā proktā śubhā cānantadaivate ..
calā pavanadaivatye yāmye mṛtyupradā bhavet .. 73 ..
meaning:
वारुणे रोगदा प्रोक्ता शुभा चानन्तदैवते ..
चला पवनदैवत्ये याम्ये मृत्युप्रदा भवेत् .. 73 ..
text_mt: In the Vāruṇa, it is said to cause disease; in that dedicated to Ananta, it is auspicious. / In that dedicated to Pavana, it is unstable; in that dedicated to Yama, it brings death.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgdaivate sadā kāntā śrīrodhe śrīyutā bhavet ..
dhanade dhanasaṃyuktā sudṛḍhā śailadaivate ..74..
meaning:
वाग्दैवते सदा कान्ता श्रीरोधे श्रीयुता भवेत् ..
धनदे धनसंयुक्ता सुदृढा शैलदैवते ..74..
text_mt: In that dedicated to Vāc, it is always lovely; in Śrīrodha, it is endowed with fortune. / In that of Kubera, it brings wealth; in that dedicated to the Mountain, it is very firm.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvī devī dṛḍhā saumyā śubhā syādvedadaivate ..
pauruṣe tu tathā rauce bahudharmavivardhinī..75..
meaning:
पृथ्वी देवी दृढा सौम्या शुभा स्याद्वेददैवते ..
पौरुषे तु तथा रौचे बहुधर्मविवर्धिनी..75..
text_mt: In that of the goddess Earth, it is firm and gentle; in that dedicated to the Veda, it is auspicious. / In the Pauruṣa and in the Rauca, it greatly increases dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
kartuḥ sukhāvahā caiva tathā cājñāyutā bhavet..
dṛḍhā dhanayutā sphītā tathā pratipadi smṛtā..76..
meaning:
कर्तुः सुखावहा चैव तथा चाज्ञायुता भवेत्..
दृढा धनयुता स्फीता तथा प्रतिपदि स्मृता..76..
text_mt: It brings happiness to the patron and is endowed with command. / On the first tithi, it is remembered to be firm, endowed with wealth, and prosperous.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ dhanopetā tṛtīyāyāṃ varapradā..
caturthyāṃ nāśamāpnoti yamasya syātsukhāvahā..77..
meaning:
द्वितीयायां धनोपेता तृतीयायां वरप्रदा..
चतुर्थ्यां नाशमाप्नोति यमस्य स्यात्सुखावहा..77..
text_mt: On the second, it is endowed with wealth; on the third, it grants boons. / On the fourth, it meets with ruin, [though] for Yama it brings happiness;

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya devasya tathā tatra hitapradā ..
pañcamyāṃ śrīyutā kāntā varadā ca tathā bhavet .. 78 ..
meaning:
विनायकस्य देवस्य तथा तत्र हितप्रदा ..
पञ्चम्यां श्रीयुता कान्ता वरदा च तथा भवेत् .. 78 ..
text_mt: likewise, it brings benefit there for the god Vināyaka. / On the fifth, it is endowed with fortune, lovely, and grants boons.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ lakṣmīyutā nityaṃ saptamyāṃ roganāśinī ..
aṣṭamyāṃ dhānyabahulā navamyāṃ tu vinaśyati .. 79 ..
meaning:
षष्ठ्यां लक्ष्मीयुता नित्यं सप्तम्यां रोगनाशिनी ..
अष्टम्यां धान्यबहुला नवम्यां तु विनश्यति .. 79 ..
text_mt: On the sixth, it is always endowed with Lakṣmī; on the seventh, it destroys illness. / On the eighth, it abounds in grain; on the ninth, it is ruined.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrā kālyā kṛtā tatra karturbhavati puṣṭidā ..
dharmavṛddhikarī jñeyā daśamyāṃ tu tathā kṛtā .. 3.96.80 ..
meaning:
भद्रा काल्या कृता तत्र कर्तुर्भवति पुष्टिदा ..
धर्मवृद्धिकरी ज्ञेया दशम्यां तु तथा कृता .. 3.96.80 ..
text_mt: When made there for Bhadrā or Kālī, it gives nourishment to the patron. / Performed on the tenth, it should be known to increase dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ tathā yuktā dvādaśyāṃ sarvakāmadā ..
trayodaśyāṃ tathā jñeyā caturdaśyāṃ vinaśyati .. 81 ..
meaning:
एकादश्यां तथा युक्ता द्वादश्यां सर्वकामदा ..
त्रयोदश्यां तथा ज्ञेया चतुर्दश्यां विनश्यति .. 81 ..
text_mt: Likewise, on the eleventh it is auspicious; on the twelfth, it grants all desires. / It is known to be the same on the thirteenth; on the fourteenth, it is ruined.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇa pakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ kartuḥ kṣayakarī bhavet ..
pañcadaśyāṃ tathā śukle sarvakāmakarī bhavet .. 82 ..
meaning:
कृष्ण पक्षे पञ्चदश्यां कर्तुः क्षयकरी भवेत् ..
पञ्चदश्यां तथा शुक्ले सर्वकामकरी भवेत् .. 82 ..
text_mt: On the fifteenth of the dark fortnight, it brings decay to the patron. / On the fifteenth of the bright fortnight, it fulfills all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ūnarātre mahārāja karturmaraṇadā bhaveta ..
bṛhatspṛśā ca vijñeyā tathā doṣavatī nṛpa .. 83 ..
meaning:
ऊनरात्रे महाराज कर्तुर्मरणदा भवेत ..
बृहत्स्पृशा च विज्ञेया तथा दोषवती नृप .. 83 ..
text_mt: On an unarātra day, O great king, it brings death to the patron. / And on a bṛhatspṛś day, O king, it should be known to be faulty.

sanskrit_iast:
divyāntarikṣabhaumena cotpātena tu yā yutā ..
kartavyā viprayogāntā pratiṣṭhā tu kṛtā bhavet .. 84 ..
meaning:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षभौमेन चोत्पातेन तु या युता ..
कर्तव्या विप्रयोगान्ता प्रतिष्ठा तु कृता भवेत् .. 84 ..
text_mt: An installation performed when attended by celestial, atmospheric, or terrestrial / portents will result in separation.

sanskrit_iast:
tithihānau kṣayaṃ proktaṃ vṛddhau vṛddhiḥ prakīrtitā ..
śakunau doṣajananī catuṣpadi tathāvahā .. 85 ..
meaning:
तिथिहानौ क्षयं प्रोक्तं वृद्धौ वृद्धिः प्रकीर्तिता ..
शकुनौ दोषजननी चतुष्पदि तथावहा .. 85 ..
text_mt: On a decreased tithi, loss is declared; on an increased tithi, increase is proclaimed. / In the Śakuni karaṇa, it produces fault; in Catuṣpad, it likewise brings harm.

sanskrit_iast:
nāge bhavati śūnyā ca kiṃstughne tu śubhapradā ..
bave dṛḍhā tayā jñeyā bālave tu śubhapradā .. 86 ..
meaning:
नागे भवति शून्या च किंस्तुघ्ने तु शुभप्रदा ..
बवे दृढा तया ज्ञेया बालवे तु शुभप्रदा .. 86 ..
text_mt: In Nāga, it becomes void; in Kiṃstughna, it brings good fortune. / In Bava, it should be known to be firm; in Bālava, it brings good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
kaulave varadā proktā taitale roganāśinī ..
garādau rogajananī tathā vaṇiji puṣṭidā .. 87 ..
meaning:
कौलवे वरदा प्रोक्ता तैतले रोगनाशिनी ..
गरादौ रोगजननी तथा वणिजि पुष्टिदा .. 87 ..
text_mt: In Kaulava, it is said to grant boons; in Taitila, it destroys illness. / In Gara and the like, it produces sickness; in Vaṇij, it gives nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭau maraṇadā karturātmadoṣavatī tathā ..
janmarāśyudaye ketuḥ kṣipraṃ nāśavatī bhaveta .. 88 ..
meaning:
विष्टौ मरणदा कर्तुरात्मदोषवती तथा ..
जन्मराश्युदये केतुः क्षिप्रं नाशवती भवेत .. 88 ..
text_mt: In Viṣṭi, it brings death to the patron and is fraught with inherent faults. / When a comet rises in the natal sign, it quickly leads to ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye dhananāśāya tṛtīye kartṛvṛddhidā ..
caturthe gṛhanāśāya pañcame vyādhidā bhaveta .. 89 ..
meaning:
द्वितीये धननाशाय तृतीये कर्तृवृद्धिदा ..
चतुर्थे गृहनाशाय पञ्चमे व्याधिदा भवेत .. 89 ..
text_mt: In the second, it brings loss of wealth; in the third, it brings growth to the patron. / In the fourth, it destroys the home; in the fifth, it brings sickness.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe śatruvināśāya saptame dhananāśanī ..
aṣṭame mṛtyudā jñeyā navame dharmanāśanī .. 3.96.90 ..
meaning:
षष्ठे शत्रुविनाशाय सप्तमे धननाशनी ..
अष्टमे मृत्युदा ज्ञेया नवमे धर्मनाशनी .. 3.96.90 ..
text_mt: In the sixth, it destroys enemies; in the seventh, it destroys wealth. / In the eighth, it is known to bring death; in the ninth, it destroys dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
daśame karmaṇāṃ vṛddhyai lābhe lābhakarī bhavet ..
dvādaśe tu vyayāya syātpratiṣṭhā tu tathā kṛtā ..91..
meaning:
दशमे कर्मणां वृद्ध्यै लाभे लाभकरी भवेत् ..
द्वादशे तु व्ययाय स्यात्प्रतिष्ठा तु तथा कृता ..91..
text_mt: In the tenth, it leads to the increase of undertakings; in the house of gain, it brings gain. / An installation performed in the twelfth leads to expenditure.

sanskrit_iast:
janmalagrodaye śreṣṭhā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet ..
janma rāśiphalaṃ sarvaṃ śeṣasthāne tu nirdiśet .. 985 ..
meaning:
जन्मलग्रोदये श्रेष्ठा धनधान्यवती भवेत् ..
जन्म राशिफलं सर्वं शेषस्थाने तु निर्दिशेत् .. 985 ..
text_mt: When the natal ascendant is rising, it is auspicious and brings wealth and grain. / One should declare the fruit of all the remaining houses according to the natal sign.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣodaye kṛtā kṣipraṃ nāśamāpnoti pārthiva ..
vṛṣodaye sthirā proktā dhanadhānyavatī tathā .. 93 ..
meaning:
मेषोदये कृता क्षिप्रं नाशमाप्नोति पार्थिव ..
वृषोदये स्थिरा प्रोक्ता धनधान्यवती तथा .. 93 ..
text_mt: [An installation] made in the rising of Aries quickly meets with destruction, O king; / in the rising of Taurus it is said to be enduring, as well as rich in wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
lokakāntā ca mithune bahukalyāṇakāriṇī ..
kulīre kṣipranāśaḥ syātsiṃhe vasudṛḍhā bhavet .. 94 ..
meaning:
लोककान्ता च मिथुने बहुकल्याणकारिणी ..
कुलीरे क्षिप्रनाशः स्यात्सिंहे वसुदृढा भवेत् .. 94 ..
text_mt: And in Gemini, it is beloved by people and brings about abundant welfare; / in Cancer, there would be quick destruction; in Leo, it will be extremely steadfast.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyāṃ lokakāntā syāttule bhavati cāsthirā ..
vṛścike tu sthirā proktā kalyāṇāya dhanurdhare .. 95..
meaning:
कन्यायां लोककान्ता स्यात्तुले भवति चास्थिरा ..
वृश्चिके तु स्थिरा प्रोक्ता कल्याणाय धनुर्धरे .. 95..
text_mt: In Virgo, it will be beloved by people; and in Libra, it becomes unstable; / in Scorpio, it is said to be steadfast; in Sagittarius, it is for welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
makare kṣipranāśā syātkumbhalagne dṛḍhā bhaveta ..
mīne puṇyavahā kartuḥ kalpāśūnyā tathā bhavet .. 96 ..
meaning:
मकरे क्षिप्रनाशा स्यात्कुम्भलग्ने दृढा भवेत ..
मीने पुण्यवहा कर्तुः कल्पाशून्या तथा भवेत् .. 96 ..
text_mt: In Capricorn, it will be quickly destroyed; in the ascendant of Aquarius, it will be firm; / in Pisces, it brings merit to the maker and likewise endures through the aeons.

sanskrit_iast:
ugrā syātsūryahorāyāṃ saumyā somasya kīrtitā ..
pāpagrahasya dreṣkāṇe karturnāśāya kīrtitā .. 97 ..
meaning:
उग्रा स्यात्सूर्यहोरायां सौम्या सोमस्य कीर्तिता ..
पापग्रहस्य द्रेष्काणे कर्तुर्नाशाय कीर्तिता .. 97 ..
text_mt: In the horā of the Sun, it will be fierce; that of the Moon is declared gentle. / In the decan of a malefic planet, it is declared to lead to the destruction of the maker.

sanskrit_iast:
somagrahasya suśubhā karturbhavati vṛddhidā ..
phalaṃ yadeva lagneṣu navāṃśeṣu tadeva tu .. 98 ..
meaning:
सोमग्रहस्य सुशुभा कर्तुर्भवति वृद्धिदा ..
फलं यदेव लग्नेषु नवांशेषु तदेव तु .. 98 ..
text_mt: [In the decan] of a benefic planet, it is very auspicious and brings prosperity to the maker. / Whatever effect is in the ascendants, precisely that [is also] in the navāṃśas.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṃśeṣu vijñeyastadeva manujottama ..
karturnāśāya vijñeyā triṃśāṃśe bhaumasaurayoḥ .. 99 ..
meaning:
द्वादशांशेषु विज्ञेयस्तदेव मनुजोत्तम ..
कर्तुर्नाशाय विज्ञेया त्रिंशांशे भौमसौरयोः .. 99 ..
text_mt: Precisely that should be understood in the dvādaśāṃśas, O best of men. / In the triṃśāṃśa of Mars and Saturn, it should be known to cause the destruction of the maker.

sanskrit_iast:
sitajīvenduputrāṇāṃ kartuḥ kalyāṇadā bhaveta ..
śubhamaṃśaṃ mahārāja lagne pāpaphale śubham .. 3.96.100 ..
meaning:
सितजीवेन्दुपुत्राणां कर्तुः कल्याणदा भवेत ..
शुभमंशं महाराज लग्ने पापफले शुभम् .. 3.96.100 ..
text_mt: Of Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury, it brings welfare to the maker. / O great king, an auspicious sub-division is auspicious [even] when the ascendant has a malefic result;

sanskrit_iast:
lagne śubhatare jñeyaḥ pāpāṃśaḥ pāpado nṛṇāma ..
lagnasthe śaṅkarā kartuḥ kṛtā bhavati bhāskare .. 101 ..
meaning:
लग्ने शुभतरे ज्ञेयः पापांशः पापदो नृणाम ..
लग्नस्थे शङ्करा कर्तुः कृता भवति भास्करे .. 101 ..
text_mt: [and] in a more auspicious ascendant, a malefic sub-division should be known to bring evil to men. / When the Sun is stationed in the ascendant, [an installation] made causes auspiciousness for the maker.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye'rthasya hāniḥ syāttṛtīye dhanasaṃyutā ..
āyuḥkṣayaṃ caturthasthe pañcame svatvanāśanam ..102..
meaning:
द्वितीयेऽर्थस्य हानिः स्यात्तृतीये धनसंयुता ..
आयुःक्षयं चतुर्थस्थे पञ्चमे स्वत्वनाशनम् ..102..
text_mt: In the second [house], there would be loss of wealth; in the third, it is accompanied by wealth. / When it is in the fourth, it brings diminution of lifespan; in the fifth, loss of one's own property.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe śatruvighātaṃ tu dāridryaṃ saptame bhavet ..
maraṇaṃ cāṣṭame bhānau navame dharmapīḍanam.. ..103..
meaning:
षष्ठे शत्रुविघातं तु दारिद्र्यं सप्तमे भवेत् ..
मरणं चाष्टमे भानौ नवमे धर्मपीडनम्.. ..103..
text_mt: In the sixth, [it brings] destruction of enemies; but in the seventh, there would be poverty. / And when the Sun is in the eighth, death; in the ninth, harm to dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
daśame sutavṛddhiśca lābhe lābhayutā bhavet ..
dvādaśe vyayasaṃyuktā nirdhanā tu tathā bhavet..1 04..
meaning:
दशमे सुतवृद्धिश्च लाभे लाभयुता भवेत् ..
द्वादशे व्ययसंयुक्ता निर्धना तु तथा भवेत्..1 04..
text_mt: In the tenth, increase of sons; and in the [house of] gain, it will be accompanied by gain. / In the twelfth, it will be accompanied by expenditure and will likewise be destitute of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
candre lagnagate jñeyā sudṛḍhā manujottama ..
dhanānvitā dvitīye tu tṛtīye lābhasaṃyutā ..105..
meaning:
चन्द्रे लग्नगते ज्ञेया सुदृढा मनुजोत्तम ..
धनान्विता द्वितीये तु तृतीये लाभसंयुता ..105..
text_mt: When the Moon has entered the ascendant, it should be known to be very steadfast, O best of men; / in the second, accompanied by wealth; and in the third, accompanied by gain.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe bāndhavahitā pañcame sutavṛddhidā ..
ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśāya saptame ca dhanāvahā .. 106 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थे बान्धवहिता पञ्चमे सुतवृद्धिदा ..
षष्ठे रिपुविनाशाय सप्तमे च धनावहा .. 106 ..
text_mt: In the fourth, it is beneficial to kin; in the fifth, it gives an increase of sons; / in the sixth, for the destruction of foes; and in the seventh, it brings wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame maraṇāyoktā navame dharmapīḍanam ..
daśame karmadā proktā lābhe lābhapradā bhavet .. 107 ..
meaning:
अष्टमे मरणायोक्ता नवमे धर्मपीडनम् ..
दशमे कर्मदा प्रोक्ता लाभे लाभप्रदा भवेत् .. 107 ..
text_mt: In the eighth, it is said to lead to death; in the ninth, harm to dharma; / in the tenth, it is said to give [success in] actions; in the [house of] gain, it gives gain.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaye vyayavatī rājaṃstathā dhanavivarjitā ..
ardhabimbādhike kṣīṇe kramādatha nibodha me .. 108 ..
meaning:
व्यये व्ययवती राजंस्तथा धनविवर्जिता ..
अर्धबिम्बाधिके क्षीणे क्रमादथ निबोध मे .. 108 ..
text_mt: In the [house of] loss, it brings expenditure, O king, and is likewise devoid of wealth. / When [the Moon is] waning past half of its disc, hear now from me in order:

sanskrit_iast:
candre lagnagate jñeyā kṣipranāśā mahābhuja ..
dvitīye ca daridrā syāttṛtīye dhanasaṃyutā .. 109 ..
meaning:
चन्द्रे लग्नगते ज्ञेया क्षिप्रनाशा महाभुज ..
द्वितीये च दरिद्रा स्यात्तृतीये धनसंयुता .. 109 ..
text_mt: When [such a] Moon has entered the ascendant, it should be known to bring quick destruction, O mighty-armed one; / and in the second, it would bring poverty; in the third, it is accompanied by wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
bahvanarthā caturthe syātputranāśāya pañcame ..
ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśāya bhāryānāśāya saptame .. 3.96.110 ..
meaning:
बह्वनर्था चतुर्थे स्यात्पुत्रनाशाय पञ्चमे ..
षष्ठे रिपुविनाशाय भार्यानाशाय सप्तमे .. 3.96.110 ..
text_mt: In the fourth, there would be many misfortunes; in the fifth, for the destruction of sons; / in the sixth, for the destruction of enemies; in the seventh, for the destruction of the wife.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame maraṇāyoktā navame dharmaghātinī ..
dhanānvitā syāddaśame lābhe lābhavatī bhavet .. 111 ..
meaning:
अष्टमे मरणायोक्ता नवमे धर्मघातिनी ..
धनान्विता स्याद्दशमे लाभे लाभवती भवेत् .. 111 ..
text_mt: In the eighth, it is said to lead to death; in the ninth, it destroys dharma; / in the tenth, it will be accompanied by wealth; in the [house of] gain, it will bring gain.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaye vyayavatī nitye daridrā ca tathā bhavet ..
lagne mṛtyukaro bhaumastathā dāridryado dhane .. 112 ..
meaning:
व्यये व्ययवती नित्ये दरिद्रा च तथा भवेत् ..
लग्ने मृत्युकरो भौमस्तथा दारिद्र्यदो धने .. 112 ..
text_mt: In the [house of] expenditure, it constantly brings expenditure and likewise poverty. / Mars in the ascendant causes death, and likewise in the [house of] wealth it gives poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtiṃ tribhuvane śubhrāṃ tṛtīyasthaḥ karotyasau ..
caturthe bandhunāśaḥ syātsutanāśastathā sute .. 113 ..
meaning:
कीर्तिं त्रिभुवने शुभ्रां तृतीयस्थः करोत्यसौ ..
चतुर्थे बन्धुनाशः स्यात्सुतनाशस्तथा सुते .. 113 ..
text_mt: Stationed in the third, it makes bright fame throughout the three worlds; / in the fourth, there would be destruction of kin; and in [the house of] children, destruction of sons.

sanskrit_iast:
arināśastathā ṣaṣṭhe saptame'gnau vinaśyati ..
aṣṭame kartṛmaraṇaṃ navame deśavicyutiḥ .. 114 ..
meaning:
अरिनाशस्तथा षष्ठे सप्तमेऽग्नौ विनश्यति ..
अष्टमे कर्तृमरणं नवमे देशविच्युतिः .. 114 ..
text_mt: In the sixth, likewise, destruction of enemies; in the seventh, it is destroyed by fire; / in the eighth, death of the maker; in the ninth, displacement from one's country.

sanskrit_iast:
daśame karmasiddhiḥ syāllābhe lābhavatī bhavet ..
dhanajāyātmajairnityaṃ viyogo vyayage bhavet .. 115 ..
meaning:
दशमे कर्मसिद्धिः स्याल्लाभे लाभवती भवेत् ..
धनजायात्मजैर्नित्यं वियोगो व्ययगे भवेत् .. 115 ..
text_mt: In the tenth, there would be success in actions; in the [house of] gain, it will bring gain; / when it has entered the [house of] expenditure, there will constantly be separation from wealth, wife, and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
budho lagne dhanayuto dvitīye ca tathā bhavet ..
tṛtīye varadā proktā caturthe dhanasaṃyutā .. 116 ..
meaning:
बुधो लग्ने धनयुतो द्वितीये च तथा भवेत् ..
तृतीये वरदा प्रोक्ता चतुर्थे धनसंयुता .. 116 ..
text_mt: Mercury in the ascendant is endowed with wealth, and likewise in the second; / in the third, it is said to grant boons; in the fourth, it is accompanied by wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtiśca pañcame jñeyā ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśinī ..
sukhadā saptame jñeyā harṣadā ca tathāṣṭame .. 117 ..
meaning:
कीर्तिश्च पञ्चमे ज्ञेया षष्ठे रिपुविनाशिनी ..
सुखदा सप्तमे ज्ञेया हर्षदा च तथाष्टमे .. 117 ..
text_mt: In the fifth, it should be known to bring fame; in the sixth, it destroys foes; / in the seventh, it should be known to grant happiness; and likewise in the eighth, to grant joy.

sanskrit_iast:
saukhyadā navame rājandaśame karmavṛddhidā ..
sthirā lābhagate jñeyā vyaye dhanasamanvitā ..118..
meaning:
सौख्यदा नवमे राजन्दशमे कर्मवृद्धिदा ..
स्थिरा लाभगते ज्ञेया व्यये धनसमन्विता ..118..
text_mt: In the ninth, it grants comfort, O king; in the tenth, it increases actions; / stationed in the [house of] gain, it should be known to be stable; in the [house of] loss, accompanied by wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
jīve dhanāḍhyā lagnasthe dvitīye ca tathā bhavet ..
dṛḍhāspadā tṛtīye syāccaturthe dhanasaṃyutā .. 119 ..
meaning:
जीवे धनाढ्या लग्नस्थे द्वितीये च तथा भवेत् ..
दृढास्पदा तृतीये स्याच्चतुर्थे धनसंयुता .. 119 ..
text_mt: When Jupiter is stationed in the ascendant, it is rich in wealth, and likewise in the second; / in the third, it will have a firm foundation; in the fourth, accompanied by wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcame sutadā proktā ṣaṣṭhe śatruvināśinī ..
saptame rājyadā karturaṣṭame ca samṛddhidā .. 3.96.120 ..
meaning:
पञ्चमे सुतदा प्रोक्ता षष्ठे शत्रुविनाशिनी ..
सप्तमे राज्यदा कर्तुरष्टमे च समृद्धिदा .. 3.96.120 ..
text_mt: In the fifth, it is said to grant sons; in the sixth, it destroys enemies; / in the seventh, it grants kingdom to the maker; and in the eighth, it gives prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtidā navame jñeyā daśame ca samṛddhidā ..
lābhasthe lābhadā jñeyā vyaye lābhasamanvitā .. 121 ..
meaning:
कीर्तिदा नवमे ज्ञेया दशमे च समृद्धिदा ..
लाभस्थे लाभदा ज्ञेया व्यये लाभसमन्विता .. 121 ..
text_mt: In the ninth, it should be known to grant fame; and in the tenth, to give prosperity; / stationed in the [house of] gain, it should be known to grant gain; in the [house of] loss, accompanied by gain.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnasthe niścalā śukre sarvakāmapradā bhavet ..
dhanage ca dhanaṃ dadyāttṛtīye bhrātṛvṛddhidā .. 122 ..
meaning:
लग्नस्थे निश्चला शुक्रे सर्वकामप्रदा भवेत् ..
धनगे च धनं दद्यात्तृतीये भ्रातृवृद्धिदा .. 122 ..
text_mt: When Venus is stationed in the ascendant, it will be immovable and grant all desires; / and when entered into the [house of] wealth, it would grant wealth; in the third, it gives increase of brothers.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe subhagā jñeyā pañcame sutavṛddhidā ..
ṣaṣṭhe pūjyā tathā loke saptame dhanavṛddhidā .. 123 ..
meaning:
चतुर्थे सुभगा ज्ञेया पञ्चमे सुतवृद्धिदा ..
षष्ठे पूज्या तथा लोके सप्तमे धनवृद्धिदा .. 123 ..
text_mt: In the fourth, it should be known to be fortunate; in the fifth, it gives increase of sons; / in the sixth, it is likewise worshipped in the world; in the seventh, it gives increase of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame sukhadā proktā navame ca sukhārthadā ..
daśame lokakāntā syādarināśastathāyuge .. 124 ..
meaning:
अष्टमे सुखदा प्रोक्ता नवमे च सुखार्थदा ..
दशमे लोककान्ता स्यादरिनाशस्तथायुगे .. 124 ..
text_mt: In the eighth, it is said to grant happiness; and in the ninth, to grant happiness and wealth; / in the tenth, it will be beloved by people; and in the eleventh, destruction of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vyayasthe vijñeyā savyayā sadhanā tayā ..
mṛtyudā lagnage saurau daridrā syāddvitīyage .. 125 ..
meaning:
तथा व्ययस्थे विज्ञेया सव्यया सधना तया ..
मृत्युदा लग्नगे सौरौ दरिद्रा स्याद्द्वितीयगे .. 125 ..
text_mt: Likewise, when stationed in the [house of] loss, it should be known to be accompanied by expenditure, yet accompanied by wealth. / When Saturn is in the ascendant, it causes death; when entered into the second, it will be poor.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye dhanalābhāya caturthe kartṛmṛtyudā ..
sutage sutanāśaḥ syādarināśastathārige .. 126 ..
meaning:
तृतीये धनलाभाय चतुर्थे कर्तृमृत्युदा ..
सुतगे सुतनाशः स्यादरिनाशस्तथारिगे .. 126 ..
text_mt: In the third, it leads to gain of wealth; in the fourth, it gives death to the maker; / when entered into [the house of] children, there would be loss of sons; likewise, when entered into [the house of] enemies, destruction of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
jāyānāśastu jāyāsthe mṛtyurmṛtyugṛhopage ..
dharmage dharmahāniḥ syātkarmavṛddhistu karmage .. 127 ..
meaning:
जायानाशस्तु जायास्थे मृत्युर्मृत्युगृहोपगे ..
धर्मगे धर्महानिः स्यात्कर्मवृद्धिस्तु कर्मगे .. 127 ..
text_mt: When stationed in the [house of] the wife, destruction of the wife; when entering the house of death, death; / when entered into the [house of] dharma, there would be loss of dharma; but when entered into the [house of] actions, increase of actions.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīlābhastu lābhasthe vyayage ca vyayo bhavet ..
śūnyaṃ vivarjayetkendraṃ śubhākendre niyojayeta .. 128 ..
meaning:
महीलाभस्तु लाभस्थे व्ययगे च व्ययो भवेत् ..
शून्यं विवर्जयेत्केन्द्रं शुभाकेन्द्रे नियोजयेत .. 128 ..
text_mt: When stationed in the [house of] gain, there is acquisition of land; and when entered into the [house of] loss, there will be loss. / One should avoid an empty quadrant; one should employ benefics in a quadrant.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā śubhaṃ kālaṃ prayatnena tu daivavit ..
chāyāmbubhiḥ prayatnena gṛhṇīyādavadhānataḥ .. 129 ..
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा शुभं कालं प्रयत्नेन तु दैववित् ..
छायाम्बुभिः प्रयत्नेन गृह्णीयादवधानतः .. 129 ..
text_mt: Having thus ascertained the auspicious time with care, the astrologer, / with diligence and attentiveness, should determine [the time] by means of shadow and water [clocks].

sanskrit_iast:
śubhe'hni pūrvayantrasthaṃ tatkālaṃ pratimāṃ svayam ..
samāṃ tu pīṭhikāṃ garte sthapatirviniveśayet .. 3.96.130 ..
meaning:
शुभेऽह्नि पूर्वयन्त्रस्थं तत्कालं प्रतिमां स्वयम् ..
समां तु पीठिकां गर्ते स्थपतिर्विनिवेशयेत् .. 3.96.130 ..

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālameva kurvīta nāma cāsyāḥ samāhitaḥ ..

meaning:
तत्कालमेव कुर्वीत नाम चास्याः समाहितः ..
स्वस्थां तां तु स्वनां नान्ते वैष्णवी प्रतिमा भवेत .. 131 ..
text_mt: At that very time, composed in mind, he should give a name to it. / When established in its proper place, a Vaiṣṇava image should have its name ending in "svan" [or "svāmin"].

sanskrit_iast:
keśavāntāḥ striyaḥ kāryā nāthānto brāhmaṇo bhavet ..

text_mt: [Images of goddesses] should be made with names ending in "Keśava"; [an image for] a brahmin should end in "Nātha"; / those of Hara are said to end in "Īśvara"; those of the Sun are remembered as ending in "Mihira".

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
nityamambupradānaiśca vahnipūjābhireva ca ..

sanskrit_iast:

काले शुभे लोकसुखावहा स्यात्कर्तुः प्रशस्ता वरदानसौम्या .. 3.96.140 ..

भगवन्केन विधिना प्रतिष्ठा कृता भवति ..

एतद्यथा दैववित्स्थपतिः कल्पकः वाचकः यजुर्वेदविदर्घबाहुः यजुर्वेदविद्देवहोता यजुर्वेदविद्देवद्रव्यरक्षिता ऋग्वेदविद्यजुर्वेदवित्सामवेदविदथर्ववेदविदिति चत्वारः कलशाधाराः चत्वारः सात्त्वताः तेषामेको मूर्तिधरः द्वितीयो देवकर्मवित् ..

सर्व एव ऋत्विजोऽव्यंगा अकपिला अकेकरा अनधिकाङ्गाः स्वशास्त्रपरिनिष्ठिताः श्लक्ष्णाः अपौनर्भवाश्चेति ..
ततः प्रशस्तेऽह्नि तैः सहायैः सुस्नातैः स्वनुलिप्ताङ्गैर्माल्यवद्भिर्हविष्याशिभिश्च अहतास्वरसंवीतैः पवित्रपाणिभिः सह दीक्षां यजमानो गृह्णीयात् ..
तस्य स्नातस्याहतवसनसंवीतस्य गोमयेनोपलिप्ते देशे ब्राह्मणाः स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकवचनेन कल्पकः सितसूत्रेण सितवस्त्रेण सिद्धार्थकवचान् बद्ध्वा दक्षिणपाणौ प्रतिसरं कङ्कणं बध्नीयात् .
ततः प्रभृति यावत्प्रतिष्ठाकालं प्रतिष्ठाकालादुपरि च सप्तरात्रं तावन्मांस मद्यक्षाराब्रह्मचर्यक्रोधेर्ष्यामानानार्यत्ववर्जनीयानि भवन्ति ..
भवति चात्र ..
दीक्षादिनात्प्रभृत्येवं प्रतिष्ठा सप्तमे दिने ..
यावत्तावद्भवान्नित्यं यजमानः सुयन्त्रितः .. 1 ..
text_mt:
3.97
Vajra said:
O venerable one, by what rite is an installation performed?
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Now, in the installation of the gods there are sixteen priests.
Namely: the astrologer, the architect, the ritual director, the reciter, the arghabāhu who knows the Yajurveda, the divine invoker who knows the Yajurveda, the guardian of the divine materials who knows the Yajurveda; four water-pot bearers, [consisting of] one who knows the Ṛgveda, one who knows the Yajurveda, one who knows the Sāmaveda, and one who knows the Atharvaveda; four Sāttvatas, among whom one is the bearer of the image, the second knows the rites of the deity, / the third is the guardian of mantras, and the fourth is the guardian of materials.
There, assistants should be provided according to capacity for the water-pot bearers.
All the priests must be free from physical defects, not tawny-haired, not squint-eyed, not having redundant limbs, well-grounded in their own scriptures, gentle, and not born of a remarried woman.
Then, on an auspicious day, the sacrificer should take the consecration together with those assistants who have bathed well, have their limbs well-anointed, wear garlands, eat sacrificial food, are dressed in unwashed, intact garments, and have purified hands.
When he has bathed and is dressed in unwashed, intact garments in a place smeared with cow dung, the ritual director, accompanied by the utterance of blessings by the brahmins, should bind white mustard seeds [in an amulet] with a white cord and white cloth, and tie the protective cord as a bracelet on his right hand.
From then onwards until the time of installation, and for seven nights after the time of installation, meat, liquor, salt, unchastity, anger, envy, pride, and ignoble conduct must be avoided.
And on this point there is [the following verse]:
From the day of consecration onwards in this manner, until the installation on the seventh day, / you, as the patron, must constantly remain well-restrained,

तदुदग्धोमस्थण्डिलम् .
तत्राधिवासनास्थण्डिले चत्वारस्तोरणाः परिकल्प्यन्ते .
सर्वे स्थण्डिला चतुरस्राश्चतुर्हस्तोच्छ्रयास्तोरणत्रिभागविस्तीर्णाः ..
स्थण्डिलद्वय आर्द्राभिः पताकाभिः प्रतिसराभिश्च परिवारयेत् .
वनप्रवेशोक्तेन विधिना प्रशस्तवृक्षाणामन्यतमस्य वृक्षस्य तोरणार्थकाष्ठान्यानीय स्थण्डिलेभ्य उपस्थापयेत् .
न तोरणं काष्ठद्वयजं कुर्यात् .
न कुब्जम् .
तोरणाश्च सर्वे समप्रमाणाः .
आदावेवाधिवासनस्थण्डिलस्य पश्चिमभागे प्राङ्मुखः कल्पकः स्वामी न स्यात्.
कल्पकाद्दक्षिणे भागे प्राङ्मुख एव सात्त्वतः स्यात्.
तस्यापि दक्षिणे भागे प्राङ्मुख एव ऋग्वेदविद्भवेत् ..
कल्पकाद्वामभागे प्राङ्मुख एव यजमानः.
तस्य वामतः प्राङ्मुख एव अर्घबाहुः स्थण्डिलाश्रितो दक्षिणाभिमुखो यजुर्वेदवित् .
स्थण्डिले पूर्वतः पश्चिमाभिमुखः सामवेदवित् .
तस्य दक्षिणतो वंशवादकः .
तस्यापि दक्षिणतो वाचकः .
तस्योदग्गायनः.
पृष्ठे वादनकतन्तकाः .
स्थण्डिला द्दक्षिणतः उत्तराभिमुखोथर्ववेदवित् .
होमस्थण्डिले प्राङ्मुख अगारात्पश्चिमतो होता .
चतुरस्रः .
समन्ताद्धस्तमानश्चागारः समेखलः तस्योदङ्मन्त्ररक्षिता द्रव्यरक्षिता च . इज्यास्थण्डिले इज्याकृत्सात्त्वतः .
तद्दक्षिणतः उत्तराभिमुखो मन्त्ररक्षिता द्रव्यरक्षिता च .
संवत्सरो न्यत्रैकवित्तकालग्रहणावहितः स्यात् .
स्थपतेरनियमः .
