sanskrit_iast: 29 jānukaṭīsamasvābhāvikottuṅgamanayuddhapracārataporugautsukyādiṣu jānukaṭīsamādinānāgatipracāravarṇanam
meaning: 29 जानुकटीसमस्वाभाविकोत्तुङ्गमनयुद्धप्रचारतपोरुगौत्सुक्यादिषु जानुकटीसमादिनानागतिप्रचारवर्णनम्
text_mt: 29. A description of various movement gaits, such as level with the knees and waist, in circumstances of level knees and waist, natural gait, high-stepping, pride, movement in battle, asceticism, illness, longing, and so on.

sanskrit_iast: 30 śrṛṅgārādinavarasaprakathanaprasaṅgena śrṛṅgārāddhāsyasya raudrātkaruṇasya . vīrādadbhutasya bībhatsādbhayānakasyotpattimabhidhāya tattaddevatāvarṇabhedavyañjanādinirūpaṇam
meaning: 30 श्रृङ्गारादिनवरसप्रकथनप्रसङ्गेन श्रृङ्गाराद्धास्यस्य रौद्रात्करुणस्य . वीरादद्भुतस्य बीभत्साद्भयानकस्योत्पत्तिमभिधाय तत्तद्देवतावर्णभेदव्यञ्जनादिनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 30. In the context of explaining the nine aesthetic flavors beginning with the erotic: stating the emergence of the comic from the erotic, the pathetic from the furious, the wondrous from the heroic, and the terrifying from the loathsome; and the determination of their respective presiding deities, colors, and suggestiveness.

sanskrit_iast: 31. hāsaratiśokādyekonapañcāśadbhāvanirūpaṇam
meaning: 31. हासरतिशोकाद्येकोनपञ्चाशद्भावनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 31. An exposition of the forty-nine emotional states, beginning with laughter, love, and grief.

sanskrit_iast: 32 karāṃgulīnāṃ vividhavinyāsavaśādoṅkārājjhalavāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhādirahasyamudrāvarṇanam
meaning: 32 करांगुलीनां विविधविन्यासवशादोङ्काराज्झलवासुदेवसङ्कर्षणप्रद्युम्नानिरुद्धादिरहस्यमुद्रावर्णनम्
text_mt: 32. A description of the esoteric hand gestures, such as those of the Om̐kāra, water, Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha, by means of various arrangements of the fingers.

sanskrit_iast: 33 bhasmajaṭānantadharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryadevīskandādinṛttaśāstramudrāvarṇanam
meaning: 33 भस्मजटानन्तधर्मज्ञानवैराग्यैश्वर्यदेवीस्कन्दादिनृत्तशास्त्रमुद्रावर्णनम्
text_mt: 33. A description of the hand gestures from the dance treatise representing sacred ash, matted hair, Ananta, dharma, knowledge, dispassion, sovereignty, the Goddess, Skanda, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 34 nṛttotpattitatkaraṇakabhogamokṣādiphalavarṇanam
meaning: 34 नृत्तोत्पत्तितत्करणकभोगमोक्षादिफलवर्णनम्
text_mt: 34. A description of the origin of dance and its results, such as enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: 35 tapasyatā nārāyaṇenāpsarodarpabhaṃgāya citrakarmaṇorvaśīṃ nirmāya viśvakarmaṇe tatkarmaśikṣaṇaṃ, nṛttānusāraṃ citrepi trailokyānukaraṇaṃ-dṛṣṭibhā vāṃgopāṃgakaravinyāsādikaraṇam, haṃsādipañcapuruṣalakṣaṇāni ca
meaning: 35 तपस्यता नारायणेनाप्सरोदर्पभंगाय चित्रकर्मणोर्वशीं निर्माय विश्वकर्मणे तत्कर्मशिक्षणं, नृत्तानुसारं चित्रेपि त्रैलोक्यानुकरणं-दृष्टिभा वांगोपांगकरविन्यासादिकरणम्, हंसादिपञ्चपुरुषलक्षणानि च
text_mt: 35. Nārāyaṇa, while performing austerities, creating Urvaśī by the art of painting in order to curb the pride of the apsarases, and teaching that craft to Viśvakarman; the imitation of the three worlds even in painting in accordance with dance; the execution of glances, emotional states, major and minor limbs, and hand placements; and the characteristics of the five types of men, beginning with the Haṃsa.

sanskrit_iast: 36 citrasūtravarṇane mūrtyavayavapramāṇa tadanusāreṇa madhakṣahaṃsamālavyādivarṇanam
meaning: 36 चित्रसूत्रवर्णने मूर्त्यवयवप्रमाण तदनुसारेण मधक्षहंसमालव्यादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 36. In the exposition of the Citrasūtra, the proportions of the limbs of figures, and in accordance with them, the descriptions of the types such as Madhakṣa, Haṃsa, and Mālāvya.

sanskrit_iast: 37 citrakarmaṇyaṃgapratyaṃgamānena strīṇāṃ nirmāṇam
meaning: 37 चित्रकर्मण्यंगप्रत्यंगमानेन स्त्रीणां निर्माणम्
text_mt: 37. The fashioning of women in the art of painting according to the measurements of major and minor limbs.

sanskrit_iast: 38 citrakarmaṇi devatānetrādyaṃgavarṇanam
meaning: 38 चित्रकर्मणि देवतानेत्राद्यंगवर्णनम्
text_mt: 38. The description of limbs such as the eyes of deities in the art of painting.

sanskrit_iast: 39. nānāvarṇānugatāḥ śubhākāravihārā ṛjvāgatasācīkṛtadehādyanekopabhedasahitāścitrakarmaṇo nava bhedāḥ
meaning: 39. नानावर्णानुगताः शुभाकारविहारा ऋज्वागतसाचीकृतदेहाद्यनेकोपभेदसहिताश्चित्रकर्मणो नव भेदाः
text_mt: 39. The nine varieties of the art of painting, accompanied by numerous sub-varieties such as straight, turned sideways, and others, possessing auspicious forms and stances, and conforming to various colors.

sanskrit_iast: 40 citrakarmārhabhūmisam̐skārakathanapūrvakaṃ bahusamayasthāyiraṃga (varṇa ) nirmāṇaṃ, kanakarajatādiraṃgadravyakathanañca
meaning: 40 चित्रकर्मार्हभूमिसम्̐स्कारकथनपूर्वकं बहुसमयस्थायिरंग (वर्ण ) निर्माणं, कनकरजतादिरंगद्रव्यकथनञ्च
text_mt: 40. Preceded by an account of the preparation of the ground suitable for the art of painting, the preparation of colors that last for a long time, and an account of coloring materials such as gold and silver.

sanskrit_iast: 41 satyavaiṇikādibhedena salakṣaṇaṃ citracāturvidhyam, patrākṛtirekhābinduvartanādicitradoṣasthānapramāṇādicitraguṇabhūṣaṇadurāsanādicitranāśahetubhūmyādivarṇanañca
meaning: 41 सत्यवैणिकादिभेदेन सलक्षणं चित्रचातुर्विध्यम्, पत्राकृतिरेखाबिन्दुवर्तनादिचित्रदोषस्थानप्रमाणादिचित्रगुणभूषणदुरासनादिचित्रनाशहेतुभूम्यादिवर्णनञ्च
text_mt: 41. The fourfold division of painting along with their characteristics, distinguished into the realistic, the lyrical, and others; pictorial defects such as cross-hatching, linear shading, and stippling; pictorial merits such as correct posture and proportion; and the description of the ground and other causes that bring about the destruction of paintings, such as bad seats and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
42 citre devanṛparṣigandharvadaityadānavādīnāṃ sāyudhānāṃ saparicchadānāṃ nirmāṇadeśaviśeṣānurūpāsanaśayanayānaveśasaritsāgaravāhanaśailaśikhara
sadvīpabhūmaṇḍalaśaṃkhapadmādinidhisacandranakṣatrarātrisandhyādinirmāṇam
meaning:
42 चित्रे देवनृपर्षिगन्धर्वदैत्यदानवादीनां सायुधानां सपरिच्छदानां निर्माणदेशविशेषानुरूपासनशयनयानवेशसरित्सागरवाहनशैलशिखर
सद्वीपभूमण्डलशंखपद्मादिनिधिसचन्द्रनक्षत्ररात्रिसन्ध्यादिनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 42. The execution in painting of gods, kings, sages, gandharvas, daityas, dānavas, and others, armed with weapons and attended by retinue; the fashioning of seats, beds, vehicles, costumes, rivers, oceans, mounts, mountain peaks, the earth with its continents, treasures such as the conch and lotus, and night and twilight accompanied by the moon and lunar mansions, according to specific regions.

sanskrit_iast: 43 citre śrṛṃgārādinavarasapradarśanaṃ, devālayanṛpasabhayostadvimarśaḥ, nidhividyādharahanūmadādimaṃgalyacitrāṇāṃ gṛheṣu yatnāllekhanaṃ svahastenātmagṛhe citralekhananiṣedhacitradoṣaguṇavarṇanam, citrasūtrasamāptiḥ
meaning: 43 चित्रे श्रृंगारादिनवरसप्रदर्शनं, देवालयनृपसभयोस्तद्विमर्शः, निधिविद्याधरहनूमदादिमंगल्यचित्राणां गृहेषु यत्नाल्लेखनं स्वहस्तेनात्मगृहे चित्रलेखननिषेधचित्रदोषगुणवर्णनम्, चित्रसूत्रसमाप्तिः
text_mt: 43. The demonstration of the nine aesthetic flavors beginning with the erotic in painting; their evaluation in temples and royal courts; the careful depiction in houses of auspicious paintings such as treasures, vidyādharas, and Hanumat; the prohibition against painting with one's own hand in one's own house; the description of the defects and merits of painting; and the conclusion of the Citrasūtra.

sanskrit_iast: 44 brahmaviṣṇuśaṅkaracitranirmāṇaniyamavarṇanam
meaning: 44 ब्रह्मविष्णुशङ्करचित्रनिर्माणनियमवर्णनम्
text_mt: 44. A description of the rules for creating images of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast: 45 viṣṇupūjāyogyapadmānirmāṇavarṇanam
meaning: 45 विष्णुपूजायोग्यपद्मानिर्माणवर्णनम्
text_mt: 45. A description of the fashioning of the lotus suitable for the worship of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: 46 arūpasyāpi devasya vikṛtivaśātsākāratā, tatra ca brahmaṇaḥ sahetukaṃ caturvaktratādinirūpaṇam
meaning: 46 अरूपस्यापि देवस्य विकृतिवशात्साकारता, तत्र च ब्रह्मणः सहेतुकं चतुर्वक्त्रतादिनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 46. The embodied nature of God, though formless, through the power of transformation; and therein, the reasoned exposition of Brahmā's four-faced nature and the like.

sanskrit_iast: 47 viṣṇurūpanirmāṇe caturbāhūnāñcaturdiktvaṃ, caturvaktrāṇāñca balajñānaiśvaryaśaktirūpatā, balasyāpi vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnāniruddhatā, vāsudevasya prativaktraṃ sūryacandrarūpaṃ karadvayam, saṃkarṣaṇādirūpāṇāmapi musalalāṅgalādyāyudhatādivarṇanam
meaning: 47 विष्णुरूपनिर्माणे चतुर्बाहूनाञ्चतुर्दिक्त्वं, चतुर्वक्त्राणाञ्च बलज्ञानैश्वर्यशक्तिरूपता, बलस्यापि वासुदेवसङ्कर्षणप्रद्युम्नानिरुद्धता, वासुदेवस्य प्रतिवक्त्रं सूर्यचन्द्ररूपं करद्वयम्, संकर्षणादिरूपाणामपि मुसललाङ्गलाद्यायुधतादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 47. In the fashioning of the form of Viṣṇu, the four arms representing the four cardinal directions; the four faces being the forms of strength, knowledge, sovereignty, and energy; the identification of strength with Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; for each face of Vāsudeva, two hands in the form of the sun and the moon; and the description of the forms of Saṃkarṣaṇa and the others possessing weapons such as the pestle and the plough.

sanskrit_iast: 48 mahādevasya sadyojāta vāmadevādibhedena pañcavaktrāṇi prativaktraṃ somasūryāgninetratrayatvam, bhūmyāditatvāni, viśuddhajñānavairāgyādīnāmādarśādirūpatā
meaning: 48 महादेवस्य सद्योजात वामदेवादिभेदेन पञ्चवक्त्राणि प्रतिवक्त्रं सोमसूर्याग्निनेत्रत्रयत्वम्, भूम्यादितत्वानि, विशुद्धज्ञानवैराग्यादीनामादर्शादिरूपता
text_mt: 48. The five faces of Mahādeva, distinguished into Sadyojāta, Vāmadeva, and the rest; each face possessing the three eyes of the moon, sun, and fire; the cosmic elements beginning with earth; and pure knowledge, dispassion, and the rest taking forms such as the mirror.

sanskrit_iast: 49 nāsatyarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 49 नासत्यरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 49. The fashioning of the forms of the Nāsatyas.

sanskrit_iast: 50 śakraśacīrūpanirmāṇaṃ sahetukam
meaning: 50 शक्रशचीरूपनिर्माणं सहेतुकम्
text_mt: 50. The fashioning of the forms of Śakra and Śacī, along with its symbolic reasons.

sanskrit_iast: 51 sahetukaṃ yamarūpanirūpaṇaṃ tasya saṃkarṣaṇarūpatā, tadvāhanamahiṣasya moharūpatvaṃ dhūmorṇāsvarūpaṃ citraguptasvarūpakathanādi ca
meaning: 51 सहेतुकं यमरूपनिरूपणं तस्य संकर्षणरूपता, तद्वाहनमहिषस्य मोहरूपत्वं धूमोर्णास्वरूपं चित्रगुप्तस्वरूपकथनादि च
text_mt: 51. The reasoned determination of the form of Yama, his identity with Saṃkarṣaṇa, his buffalo mount having the nature of delusion, the nature of Dhūmorṇā, the account of the nature of Citragupta, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: 52 saśaktikasāyudhasavāhanavaruṇasvarūpaṃ, taddakṣiṇabhāge makaravāhanagaṅgāsvarūpam, vāmabhāge sacāmarakūrmasthayamunāsvarūpam, varuṇasya pradyumnatā tadbhāryāyā ratirūpatādikathanañca
meaning: 52 सशक्तिकसायुधसवाहनवरुणस्वरूपं, तद्दक्षिणभागे मकरवाहनगङ्गास्वरूपम्, वामभागे सचामरकूर्मस्थयमुनास्वरूपम्, वरुणस्य प्रद्युम्नता तद्भार्याया रतिरूपतादिकथनञ्च
text_mt: 52. The form of Varuṇa accompanied by his consort, weapons, and mount; on his right side, the form of Gaṅgā riding a makara; on his left side, the form of Yamunā standing on a tortoise, bearing a fly-whisk; and the account of Varuṇa being Pradyumna and his wife being Rati.

sanskrit_iast: 53 dhanadasvarūpanirmāṇam, tasya vāmāṃge ṛddhiḥ, śaṃkhapadmanidhyādi tatpārśve,
meaning: 53 धनदस्वरूपनिर्माणम्, तस्य वामांगे ऋद्धिः, शंखपद्मनिध्यादि तत्पार्श्वे,
text_mt: 53. The fashioning of the form of Dhanada, with Ṛddhi on his left side, and treasures such as the conch and lotus at his side.

sanskrit_iast: 54 garuḍarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 54 गरुडरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 54. The fashioning of the form of Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast: 55 gaurīśapratikṛtiracanam
meaning: 55 गौरीशप्रतिकृतिरचनम्
text_mt: 55. The fashioning of the image of Gaurīśa.

sanskrit_iast: 56 svāhāsahitāgnimūrtinirmāṇaṃ caturvedarūpiśukādicitrasahitam
meaning: 56 स्वाहासहिताग्निमूर्तिनिर्माणं चतुर्वेदरूपिशुकादिचित्रसहितम्
text_mt: 56. The fashioning of the form of Agni accompanied by Svāhā, together with representations such as parrots having the form of the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: 57 virūpākṣarūpanirmāṇaṃ saninṛtyādi
meaning: 57 विरूपाक्षरूपनिर्माणं सनिनृत्यादि
text_mt: 57. The fashioning of the form of Virūpākṣa, along with dance and the like.

sanskrit_iast: 58 ākāśavarṇasya vāyoḥ sasaktikasya nirmāṇam
meaning: 58 आकाशवर्णस्य वायोः ससक्तिकस्य निर्माणम्
text_mt: 58. The fashioning of Vāyu, sky-colored, accompanied by his consort.

sanskrit_iast: 59 bhairavamahākālayoḥ svarūpanirmāṇaprakāraḥ
meaning: 59 भैरवमहाकालयोः स्वरूपनिर्माणप्रकारः
text_mt: 59. The manner of fashioning the forms of Bhairava and Mahākāla.

sanskrit_iast: 60 ekacakradvibāhugadācakradharaviṣṇurūpamaparam
meaning: 60 एकचक्रद्विबाहुगदाचक्रधरविष्णुरूपमपरम्
text_mt: 60. Another form of Viṣṇu, who possesses a single wheel, has two arms, and holds a mace and a discus.

sanskrit_iast: 61 śuklavarṇacaturbhujaratnasasyauṣadhipadmahastādibhūdevīsvarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 61 शुक्लवर्णचतुर्भुजरत्नसस्यौषधिपद्महस्तादिभूदेवीस्वरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 61. The creation of the form of Bhūdevī, of white complexion, four-armed, holding in her hands jewels, crops, herbs, a lotus, and other [attributes].

sanskrit_iast: 62 nīlotpalābhāmbarayutamākāśasvarūpam
meaning: 62 नीलोत्पलाभाम्बरयुतमाकाशस्वरूपम्
text_mt: 62. The form of space (Ākāśa), possessing garments resembling a blue lotus.

sanskrit_iast: 63 brahmasāvitrīsvarūpayorviśeṣaḥ
meaning: 63 ब्रह्मसावित्रीस्वरूपयोर्विशेषः
text_mt: 63. The distinguishing characteristics of the forms of Brahmā and Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast: 64 dhyātuḥ sarvārthasādhakaṃ sarasvatīrūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 64 ध्यातुः सर्वार्थसाधकं सरस्वतीरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 64. The creation of the form of Sarasvatī, which accomplishes all aims for the meditator.

sanskrit_iast: 65 ananta ( śeṣa ) rūpanirūpaṇam
meaning: 65 अनन्त ( शेष ) रूपनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 65. The description of the form of Ananta (Śeṣa).

sanskrit_iast: 66 jayavijayājayantyaparājitādevīsahitasya mahādevavattumburornirmāṇam
meaning: 66 जयविजयाजयन्त्यपराजितादेवीसहितस्य महादेववत्तुम्बुरोर्निर्माणम्
text_mt: 66. The creation of Tumburu, like Mahādeva, accompanied by the goddesses Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, and Aparājitā.

sanskrit_iast: 67 prakāradvayena piṃgalātipiṃgalagaṇayuktasya revantādicatuṣputraiścatasṛbhiḥ patnībhiśca sahitasya rave rūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 67 प्रकारद्वयेन पिंगलातिपिंगलगणयुक्तस्य रेवन्तादिचतुष्पुत्रैश्चतसृभिः पत्नीभिश्च सहितस्य रवे रूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 67. The creation of the form of the Sun in two ways: endowed with the attendants Piṅgala and Atipiṅgala, and accompanied by his four sons, Revanta and the others, and by his four wives.

sanskrit_iast: 68 sitakumudahastasya kāntiśobhābhyāṃ bhāryābhyāṃ sahitasyāśvinyādyaṣṭāviṃśatibhāryābhirvā sahitasya candramaso nirmāṇam
meaning: 68 सितकुमुदहस्तस्य कान्तिशोभाभ्यां भार्याभ्यां सहितस्याश्विन्याद्यष्टाविंशतिभार्याभिर्वा सहितस्य चन्द्रमसो निर्माणम्
text_mt: 68. The creation of the Moon, who holds a white water-lily in his hand, accompanied by his two wives Kānti and Śobhā, or accompanied by his twenty-eight wives beginning with Aśvinī.

sanskrit_iast: 69 sāyudhasavāhanabhaumādigrahanirmāṇam
meaning: 69 सायुधसवाहनभौमादिग्रहनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 69. The creation of the planets, beginning with Mars, along with their weapons and mounts.

sanskrit_iast: 70 varttamānabhāviṣyamanurūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 70 वर्त्तमानभाविष्यमनुरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 70. The creation of the forms of the present and future Manus.

sanskrit_iast: 71 skandaviśākhaguhabhadrakālībrahmagaṇeśaviśvakarmarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 71 स्कन्दविशाखगुहभद्रकालीब्रह्मगणेशविश्वकर्मरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 71. The creation of the forms of Skanda, Viśākha, Guha, Bhadrakālī, Brahmā, Gaṇeśa, and Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast: 72 dharādivasūnāṃ viṣṇvindravaruṇādīnāñca rūpavarṇanam
meaning: 72 धरादिवसूनां विष्ण्विन्द्रवरुणादीनाञ्च रूपवर्णनम्
text_mt: 72. The description of the forms of the Vasus beginning with Dharā, and of Viṣṇu, Indra, Varuṇa, and the others.

sanskrit_iast: 73 kaśyapāditadanukāṣṭhādīnāṃ dhruvāgastyabhṛgudhanadādyanekadevānāṃ nirmāṇam
meaning: 73 कश्यपादितदनुकाष्ठादीनां ध्रुवागस्त्यभृगुधनदाद्यनेकदेवानां निर्माणम्
text_mt: 73. The creation of Kaśyapa and others, followed by Kāṣṭhā and others, and of numerous deities such as Dhruva, Agastya, Bhṛgu, and Kubera.

sanskrit_iast: 74 liṅgarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 74 लिङ्गरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 74. The creation of the form of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast: 75 vyomarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 75 व्योमरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 75. The creation of the form of the firmament.

sanskrit_iast: 76 badarīvṛkṣamanu naranārāyaṇarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 76 बदरीवृक्षमनु नरनारायणरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 76. The creation of the forms of Nara and Nārāyaṇa beside the jujube tree.

sanskrit_iast: 77 kīrtyādicaturdaśabhāryāyutadharmarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 77 कीर्त्यादिचतुर्दशभार्यायुतधर्मरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 77. The creation of the form of Dharma, accompanied by his fourteen wives beginning with Kīrti.

sanskrit_iast: 78 prakāratrayeṇa nṛsiṃhamūrtinirmāṇam
meaning: 78 प्रकारत्रयेण नृसिंहमूर्तिनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 78. The creation of the image of Nṛsiṃha in three ways.

sanskrit_iast: 79 anaiśvaryarūpihiraṇyākṣaśiracchedodyatasya dharaṇīdevīsanāthasyaiśvaryarūpanṛvarāhasya nirmāṇam
meaning: 79 अनैश्वर्यरूपिहिरण्याक्षशिरच्छेदोद्यतस्य धरणीदेवीसनाथस्यैश्वर्यरूपनृवराहस्य निर्माणम्
text_mt: 79. The creation of the man-boar (Nṛvarāha), who represents sovereignty, who is ready to sever the head of Hiraṇyākṣa representing absence of sovereignty, and who is accompanied by the goddess Earth (Dharaṇī).

sanskrit_iast: 80 hayagrīvarūpanirmāṇam ...
meaning: 80 हयग्रीवरूपनिर्माणम् ...
text_mt: 80. The creation of the form of Hayagrīva […].

sanskrit_iast: 81 śeṣaśāyirūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 81 शेषशायिरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 81. The creation of the form of [Viṣṇu] reclining upon Śeṣa.

sanskrit_iast: 82 viṣṇoḥ pārśve pṛthak ca lakṣmīcitranirmāṇaprakāra. ..
meaning: 82 विष्णोः पार्श्वे पृथक् च लक्ष्मीचित्रनिर्माणप्रकार. ..
text_mt: 82. The manner of creating the painted form of Lakṣmī, both at the side of Viṣṇu and separately […].

sanskrit_iast: 83 harerviśvarūpavarṇanam
meaning: 83 हरेर्विश्वरूपवर्णनम्
text_mt: 83. The description of the universal form of Hari.

sanskrit_iast: 84 aiḍūkarūpanirmāṇam
meaning: 84 ऐडूकरूपनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 84. The creation of the form of an aiḍūka.

sanskrit_iast: 85 vāsudevarūpanirmāṇe sāyudhasapārṣadasaśaktikasya viṣṇoścaturmukhādibhedena rūpanirmāṇaṃ tathā bhārgavarāmadāśarathirāmādi (devodyāna ) mūrtinirmāṇam
meaning: 85 वासुदेवरूपनिर्माणे सायुधसपार्षदसशक्तिकस्य विष्णोश्चतुर्मुखादिभेदेन रूपनिर्माणं तथा भार्गवरामदाशरथिरामादि (देवोद्यान ) मूर्तिनिर्माणम्
text_mt: 85. In the creation of the form of Vāsudeva, the creation of the form of Viṣṇu accompanied by weapons, attendants, and Śaktis according to the divisions of four faces and so forth; likewise, the creation of the images of Bhārgava Rāma, Dāśarathi Rāma, and others (in divine groves).

sanskrit_iast: 86 himavadādyabhidhaprāsādavarṇanaṃ tatra ca sarvatobhadra+keśavādimūrti sthāpanam
meaning: 86 हिमवदाद्यभिधप्रासादवर्णनं तत्र च सर्वतोभद्र+केशवादिमूर्ति स्थापनम्
text_mt: 86. The description of temples named Himavat and so forth, and the installation therein of images of Sarvatobhadra, Keśava, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 87 maṇḍapadvāraśikharādiyuktaprāsāde pūrvādikrameṇa vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇādi mūrtisthāpanam
meaning: 87 मण्डपद्वारशिखरादियुक्तप्रासादे पूर्वादिक्रमेण वासुदेवसङ्कर्षणादि मूर्तिस्थापनम्
text_mt: 87. The installation of images of Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, and others in order beginning from the east, in a temple equipped with a pavilion, doorway, spire, and other features.

sanskrit_iast: 88 catu:ṣaṣṭipade devatāyatane (sāmānyaprāsāde) dvārapratimāpiṇḍikākaṭivasudhāmaṃjarīgarbhadvārabhitti vasudhāsañcarasopānādipramāṇavarṇanam
meaning: 88 चतु:षष्टिपदे देवतायतने (सामान्यप्रासादे) द्वारप्रतिमापिण्डिकाकटिवसुधामंजरीगर्भद्वारभित्ति वसुधासञ्चरसोपानादिप्रमाणवर्णनम्
text_mt: 88. In a temple (standard temple) of sixty-four squares, the description of the measurements of the doorway, image, pedestal, waist, floor, spire, inner chamber, door, wall, floor, walkways, steps, and other parts.

sanskrit_iast: 89 devālayārthaṃ dāruparīkṣaṇam
meaning: 89 देवालयार्थं दारुपरीक्षणम्
text_mt: 89. The examination of timber for a temple.

sanskrit_iast: 90 dāruparīkṣoktavidhivacchaile daivajña purohitābhyāṃ devārcārhaśilāparīkṣaṇaṃ, śilānāmuttamamadhyamanikṛṣṭatādibhedena tāsāṃ phalāni pākena tāsāṃ dārḍhyakaraṇañca
meaning: 90 दारुपरीक्षोक्तविधिवच्छैले दैवज्ञ पुरोहिताभ्यां देवार्चार्हशिलापरीक्षणं, शिलानामुत्तममध्यमनिकृष्टतादिभेदेन तासां फलानि पाकेन तासां दार्ढ्यकरणञ्च
text_mt: 90. Just as in the rule stated for the examination of timber, the examination of stone fit for worship of the deity in the mountain by the astrologer and the royal priest; the results of the stones according to their classification as superior, middling, and inferior; and making them firm through firing.

sanskrit_iast: 91 brāhmaṇādajātibhedena mṛdamānīya brāhmaṇādibhirdevaprāsādārthāmiṣṭakākaraṇam
meaning: 91 ब्राह्मणादजातिभेदेन मृदमानीय ब्राह्मणादिभिर्देवप्रासादार्थामिष्टकाकरणम्
text_mt: 91. Bringing clay according to the distinction of the classes beginning with the brahmins, and the making of bricks for the temple of a deity by brahmins and the others.

sanskrit_iast: 92 bindukakapitthāmraśālmalīpuṣpādibhirdravyairvajralepakaraṇaprakārāḥ
meaning: 92 बिन्दुककपित्थाम्रशाल्मलीपुष्पादिभिर्द्रव्यैर्वज्रलेपकरणप्रकाराः
text_mt: 92. The methods of making adamant mortar (vajralepa) using substances such as binduka, wood-apple, mango, flowers of the silk-cotton tree, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 93 satyayuge devānāṃ pratyakṣapūjanaṃ tretādvāparayoḥ pratyakṣapūjā pratimāsu ca, tatrāpi tretāyuge gṛhe dvāpara cāraṇye kalau ca devāyatananirmitirnagareṣu samārabdhā, bhūmidānaṃ vidhāyeva devāyatanapratiṣṭhā kāryā, devālayayogyabhūmiḥ
meaning: 93 सत्ययुगे देवानां प्रत्यक्षपूजनं त्रेताद्वापरयोः प्रत्यक्षपूजा प्रतिमासु च, तत्रापि त्रेतायुगे गृहे द्वापर चारण्ये कलौ च देवायतननिर्मितिर्नगरेषु समारब्धा, भूमिदानं विधायेव देवायतनप्रतिष्ठा कार्या, देवालययोग्यभूमिः
text_mt: 93. The direct worship of the gods in the Kṛta age; direct worship and [worship] in images in the Tretā and Dvāpara ages; even then, [worship] in the home in the Tretā age, in the forest in the Dvāpara, and in the Kali age the building of temples was commenced in cities; the installation of a temple should only be performed after making a gift of land; land suitable for a temple.

sanskrit_iast: 94 brāhmaṇādivarṇoktamṛdi bhūśodhanapurassaraṃ śalyoddhārādi vidhāya śrī-viṣṇuvāstudevādipūjanaṃ kāryam, aiśānyāṃ śilāṃ vinyasya prādakṣiṇyena punastannyāsaṃ samācaret. tadahareva sūtranyāsanandādiśilārcanaṃ vidhāya citrakarma vidheyaṃ viṣṇavādiprāsāde garuḍādeṣuściddhānyapi kartavyāni.
meaning: 94 ब्राह्मणादिवर्णोक्तमृदि भूशोधनपुरस्सरं शल्योद्धारादि विधाय श्री-विष्णुवास्तुदेवादिपूजनं कार्यम्, ऐशान्यां शिलां विन्यस्य प्रादक्षिण्येन पुनस्तन्न्यासं समाचरेत्. तदहरेव सूत्रन्यासनन्दादिशिलार्चनं विधाय चित्रकर्म विधेयं विष्णवादिप्रासादे गरुडादेषुश्चिद्धान्यपि कर्तव्यानि.
text_mt: 94. Having purified the ground in clay prescribed for the classes beginning with the brahmins and having performed the extraction of subterranean faults and other rites, the worship of Śrī, Viṣṇu, Vāstudeva, and other deities is to be performed; having laid a stone in the northeast, one should then perform its placement in clockwise succession. On that very day, having performed the placement of the cord and the worship of the stone Nandā and others, painting should be undertaken; on a temple of Viṣṇu and others, marks of Garuḍa and the like must also be made.

sanskrit_iast: 95 vāstupuruṣe śalyajñānaṃ, śalyaṃ vihāya vāstudevāyatanaṃ kartavyam, devāyatanadīkṣaṇādibhāgeṣu devatākośabhavanādi, dhanaśalye labdhe vṛddhiḥ .
meaning: 95 वास्तुपुरुषे शल्यज्ञानं, शल्यं विहाय वास्तुदेवायतनं कर्तव्यम्, देवायतनदीक्षणादिभागेषु देवताकोशभवनादि, धनशल्ये लब्धे वृद्धिः .
text_mt: 95. Knowledge of subterranean faults in the site-person (vāstupuruṣa); avoiding subterranean faults, a temple for the site-deity is to be constructed; in the sections such as the viewing of the temple, the treasury-chamber of the deity and so forth; when a subterranean fault of wealth is obtained, there is increase.

sanskrit_iast: 96 vaiṣṇavādiyugeṣvāśvinyādinakṣatreṣu saṃvatsarādiṣu varṣeṣu vasantādyṛtuṣu māghādimāseṣu sūryādivāreṣu pratipadāditithiṣu śakunādikaraṇeṣu meṣādilagneṣu sūryādihorāsu pratiṣṭhāphalāni
meaning: 96 वैष्णवादियुगेष्वाश्विन्यादिनक्षत्रेषु संवत्सरादिषु वर्षेषु वसन्ताद्यृतुषु माघादिमासेषु सूर्यादिवारेषु प्रतिपदादितिथिषु शकुनादिकरणेषु मेषादिलग्नेषु सूर्यादिहोरासु प्रतिष्ठाफलानि
text_mt: 96. The fruits of installation in the ages beginning with the Vaiṣṇava, under the lunar asterisms beginning with Aśvinī, in years beginning with the saṃvatsara, in seasons beginning with spring, in months beginning with Māgha, on days of the week beginning with Sunday, on lunar days beginning with the first, in astrological divisions beginning with śakuni, in ascendants beginning with Aries, and in planetary hours beginning with that of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast: 97 pratiṣṭhāvidhikathane yajamānasyartvigbhiḥ saha dīkṣāgrahaṇaṃ svastivācanapūrvakaṃ pratisarakaṃkaṇabandhanamāṃsamadyādityāgahaviṣyāśanādiniyamavarṇanam
meaning: 97 प्रतिष्ठाविधिकथने यजमानस्यर्त्विग्भिः सह दीक्षाग्रहणं स्वस्तिवाचनपूर्वकं प्रतिसरकंकणबन्धनमांसमद्यादित्यागहविष्याशनादिनियमवर्णनम्
text_mt: 97. In the explanation of the rule of installation, the patron's taking of initiation together with the priests, preceded by the recitation of auspicious verses, the tying of the protective thread and bracelet, and the description of the vows such as giving up meat and liquor, and eating sacrificial food.

sanskrit_iast: 98 vidhivannirmitaprāsāde'dhivāsanasthaṇḍilapaścimādibhāgeṣu kalpakādipraveśapurassaraṃ kalaśasthāpanatoraṇanyāsadhvajavitānaghaṭipratīhārasthāpanaghaṇṭādarpaṇādinā susajjīkaraṇaṃ rakṣoghnamantrairyajñarakṣākaraṇañca
meaning: 98 विधिवन्निर्मितप्रासादेऽधिवासनस्थण्डिलपश्चिमादिभागेषु कल्पकादिप्रवेशपुरस्सरं कलशस्थापनतोरणन्यासध्वजवितानघटिप्रतीहारस्थापनघण्टादर्पणादिना सुसज्जीकरणं रक्षोघ्नमन्त्रैर्यज्ञरक्षाकरणञ्च
text_mt: 98. In a temple constructed according to rule, in the western and other sections of the preliminary-dwelling mound, preceded by the entry of the Kalpaka and other [priests], the installation of water-pots, setting up of archways, banners, canopies, water-clocks, and door-guardians, proper adornment with bells, mirrors, and so on, and the protection of the sacrifice with demon-slaying mantras.

sanskrit_iast: 99 pañcagavyasaṃskāraḥ
meaning: 99 पञ्चगव्यसंस्कारः
text_mt: 99. The consecration with the five bovine products.

sanskrit_iast: 100 arcāśaucavidhivarṇanam
meaning: 100 अर्चाशौचविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 100. The description of the rule of purification of the image.

sanskrit_iast: 101 adhivāsanavarṇanam
meaning: 101 अधिवासनवर्णनम्
text_mt: 101. The description of preliminary dwelling (adhivāsana).

sanskrit_iast: 102 samantrapratīkaṃ jīvādyadhivāsanavidhivarṇanam
meaning: 102 समन्त्रप्रतीकं जीवाद्यधिवासनविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 102. The description of the rule of preliminary dwelling of life and so forth, along with mantras and their initial words.

sanskrit_iast: 103 nāsatyādidevānāmāvāhanāni
meaning: 103 नासत्यादिदेवानामावाहनानि
text_mt: 103. The invocations of the gods beginning with the Nāsatyas.

sanskrit_iast: 104 brahmādidevānāmāvāhanārghyapādyadhūpādimantrakathanam
meaning: 104 ब्रह्मादिदेवानामावाहनार्घ्यपाद्यधूपादिमन्त्रकथनम्
text_mt: 104. The proclamation of the mantras for invocation, guest-water, foot-water, incense, and other [offerings] for the gods beginning with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: 105 lokavṛṣaśūlanandīśvarādyāvāhanam
meaning: 105 लोकवृषशूलनन्दीश्वराद्यावाहनम्
text_mt: 105. The invocation of the Bull of the Worlds, the Trident, Nandīśvara, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 106 śrīviṣṇvanekāvatārādidevānāṃ yudhiṣṭhirādipāṇḍavānāṃ yājñasenīsītā devakīyaśodārukmiṇīprabhṛtīnāmāvāhanādivarṇanam
meaning: 106 श्रीविष्ण्वनेकावतारादिदेवानां युधिष्ठिरादिपाण्डवानां याज्ञसेनीसीता देवकीयशोदारुक्मिणीप्रभृतीनामावाहनादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 106. The description of the invocation and worship of Śrī, Viṣṇu, his various incarnations, and other deities, of the Pāṇḍavas beginning with Yudhiṣṭhira, and of Draupadī, Sītā, Devakī, Yaśodā, Rukmiṇī, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 107 śrīvāsudevavibodhanamantrāḥ
meaning: 107 श्रीवासुदेवविबोधनमन्त्राः
text_mt: 107. The awakening mantras of Śrī Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast: 108 vyaktāvyaktamūrterviṣṇordhyānasaukaryāya bhogamokṣahetave ca mūrtikalpanāvāhane
meaning: 108 व्यक्ताव्यक्तमूर्तेर्विष्णोर्ध्यानसौकर्याय भोगमोक्षहेतवे च मूर्तिकल्पनावाहने
text_mt: 108. The fashioning of the image and the invocation of Viṣṇu, whose form is manifest and unmanifest, for ease of meditation and for the sake of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: 109 homavidhivarṇanam
meaning: 109 होमविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 109. The description of the rule of fire offerings.

sanskrit_iast: 110 śrībhagavadvibodhanamantravarṇanam
meaning: 110 श्रीभगवद्विबोधनमन्त्रवर्णनम्
text_mt: 110. The description of the awakening mantras of the Blessed Lord.

sanskrit_iast: 111 bṛhatsnapanadravyamantramāhātmyavarṇanam
meaning: 111 बृहत्स्नपनद्रव्यमन्त्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
text_mt: 111. The description of the materials, mantras, and greatness of the great bath.

sanskrit_iast: 112 gandhānulepanatālavṛntanivedanādi-(bhogadāna )-varṇanam
meaning: 112 गन्धानुलेपनतालवृन्तनिवेदनादि-(भोगदान )-वर्णनम्
text_mt: 112. The description of the offering of enjoyment, such as the anointing with perfumes and the presenting of a palm-leaf fan.

sanskrit_iast: 113 madhuparkanivedanam
meaning: 113 मधुपर्कनिवेदनम्
text_mt: 113. The offering of the honey-mixture.

sanskrit_iast: 114 śrīviṣṇaverhaṇānivedanapurassaraṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi-(ijyā )-nivedanam
meaning: 114 श्रीविष्णवेर्हणानिवेदनपुरस्सरं भक्ष्यभोज्यादि-(इज्या )-निवेदनम्
text_mt: 114. The offering of sacrificial food, such as edible and chewable things, preceded by the offering of hospitality to Śrī Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: 115 śaṅkaragītoktavidhinā sāttvatejyāvarṇanam
meaning: 115 शङ्करगीतोक्तविधिना सात्त्वतेज्यावर्णनम्
text_mt: 115. The description of the worship according to the Sātvata [tradition] by the rule proclaimed in the song of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast: 116 toraṇoddhāravidhivarṇanam ... .
meaning: 116 तोरणोद्धारविधिवर्णनम् ... .
text_mt: 116. The description of the rule for the removal of the archways […].

sanskrit_iast: 117 tattaddevatātithiṣu prathamādipañcamadivasaparyantaṃ vināyakagraharkṣanāgapramatha brāhmaṇapūjanāni ṣaṣṭhe'hni ca bṛhatsnapanaṃ kartavyam . tatra sarveṣāṃ nāgarikāṇāṃ rājñā saha mahanā vādyaghoṣeṇa nṛtyagītādimaṃgalaistutibhiścānugamanaṃ nimittadarśanañca
meaning: 117 तत्तद्देवतातिथिषु प्रथमादिपञ्चमदिवसपर्यन्तं विनायकग्रहर्क्षनागप्रमथ ब्राह्मणपूजनानि षष्ठेऽह्नि च बृहत्स्नपनं कर्तव्यम् . तत्र सर्वेषां नागरिकाणां राज्ञा सह महना वाद्यघोषेण नृत्यगीतादिमंगलैस्तुतिभिश्चानुगमनं निमित्तदर्शनञ्च
text_mt: 117. On the lunar days of the respective deities, up to the fifth day from the first, the worship of Vināyaka, the planets, the lunar asterisms, the serpent-deities, the Pramathas, and the brahmins [is to be performed], and on the sixth day the great bath is to be carried out; there, the following along of all the citizens together with the king with the loud sound of musical instruments, with auspicious songs, dances, and praises, and the observation of omens.

sanskrit_iast: 118 dharmārthakāmamokṣādikāmanānusāreṇāniruddhasaṃkarṣaṇapradyumnavāsudevādyarcanāni
meaning: 118 धर्मार्थकाममोक्षादिकामनानुसारेणानिरुद्धसंकर्षणप्रद्युम्नवासुदेवाद्यर्चनानि
text_mt: 118. The worship of Aniruddha, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, Vāsudeva, and others according to desires such as dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast: 119 samudrapotayātrānadyuttāravidyārambhādikāmānusāraṃ matsyavarāhahayagrīvādipūjanam .
meaning: 119 समुद्रपोतयात्रानद्युत्तारविद्यारम्भादिकामानुसारं मत्स्यवराहहयग्रीवादिपूजनम् .
text_mt: 119 Worship of Matsya, Varāha, Hayagrīva, and others according to desires such as voyages by sea vessels, crossing rivers, and beginning study.

sanskrit_iast: 120 hayagrīvādidevānāṃ pūjākālanirṇayaḥ
meaning: 120 हयग्रीवादिदेवानां पूजाकालनिर्णयः
text_mt: 120 Determination of the time of worship for Hayagrīva and other deities.

sanskrit_iast:
121 puṣkaraprayāgakālañjaraśakratīrthādiṣu brahmayogaśāyimahādevaśatakratvādidevapūjananiyamaḥ ..
.
122 viṣṇorvāsudevādināmasu mokṣādidātṛśaktivarṇanam
meaning:
121 पुष्करप्रयागकालञ्जरशक्रतीर्थादिषु ब्रह्मयोगशायिमहादेवशतक्रत्वादिदेवपूजननियमः ..
.
122 विष्णोर्वासुदेवादिनामसु मोक्षादिदातृशक्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt:
121 Rules for worshiping deities such as Brahmā, Yogaśāyin, Mahādeva, and Śatakratu at holy sites such as Puṣkara, Prayāga, Kālañjara, and Śakratīrtha.
.
122 Description of the power to grant liberation and other rewards inherent in the names of Viṣṇu, beginning with Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast: 123 pūrvādidikparatvena kṣemādikāmaparatvena ca viṣṇoścakryādināmasmaraṇakīrttanādinābhīṣṭasiddhiḥ
meaning: 123 पूर्वादिदिक्परत्वेन क्षेमादिकामपरत्वेन च विष्णोश्चक्र्यादिनामस्मरणकीर्त्तनादिनाभीष्टसिद्धिः
text_mt: 123 Attainment of desired ends through remembering, chanting, and reciting the names of Viṣṇu, such as the Discus-bearer, in relation to the directions beginning with the east and in relation to desires such as security.

sanskrit_iast: 124 caitrādimāsaparatvena kṛttikādinakṣatraparatvena ca viṣṇvādināmasmaraṇaphalāni
meaning: 124 चैत्रादिमासपरत्वेन कृत्तिकादिनक्षत्रपरत्वेन च विष्ण्वादिनामस्मरणफलानि
text_mt: 124 The fruits of remembering the names of Viṣṇu and others according to the months beginning with Caitra and according to the asterisms beginning with Kṛttikā.

sanskrit_iast: 125 arjunānurodhena puṣkarādikṣetreṣu puṇḍarīkākṣādipañcapañcāśannāmakīrtanādinā pāpakṣayapurassaraṃ mahatphalam
meaning: 125 अर्जुनानुरोधेन पुष्करादिक्षेत्रेषु पुण्डरीकाक्षादिपञ्चपञ्चाशन्नामकीर्तनादिना पापक्षयपुरस्सरं महत्फलम्
text_mt: 125 At the request of Arjuna, the great fruit preceded by the destruction of sins through the recitation of fifty-five names such as Lotus-Eyed in sacred fields such as Puṣkara.

sanskrit_iast: 126 aṣṭapatrakamalakarṇikāyāṃ brahmapūjanaṃ pūrvādipatreṣu ca ṛgādipūjanavidhānam
meaning: 126 अष्टपत्रकमलकर्णिकायां ब्रह्मपूजनं पूर्वादिपत्रेषु च ऋगादिपूजनविधानम्
text_mt: 126 Worship of Brahmā in the pericarp of an eight-petaled lotus, and the rule for worshiping the Ṛgveda and other [Vedas] on the petals beginning with the east.

sanskrit_iast: 127 caitraśulapratipadādau brahmāditridevapūjanavidhānam
meaning: 127 चैत्रशुलप्रतिपदादौ ब्रह्मादित्रिदेवपूजनविधानम्
text_mt: 127 The rule for worshiping the triad of gods beginning with Brahmā on the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra and other [occasions].

sanskrit_iast: 128 caitraśuklapratipadi sthale jale vā viṣṇupūjanena sarvapāpakṣayamokṣaprāptiḥ
meaning: 128 चैत्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि स्थले जले वा विष्णुपूजनेन सर्वपापक्षयमोक्षप्राप्तिः
text_mt: 128 Destruction of all sins and attainment of liberation through the worship of Viṣṇu on land or in water on the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 129 agnīṣomātmakaprakṛtipuruṣayorlakṣmīvāsudetvaṃ, caitraśuklapratipadi vahnerlakṣmyāśca pūjanādiniyamāḥ
meaning: 129 अग्नीषोमात्मकप्रकृतिपुरुषयोर्लक्ष्मीवासुदेत्वं, चैत्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि वह्नेर्लक्ष्म्याश्च पूजनादिनियमाः
text_mt: 129 The nature of Lakṣmī and Vāsudeva as primordial matter and the Cosmic Person possessing the nature of fire and Soma; rules for worshiping Agni and Lakṣmī on the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, and related observances.

sanskrit_iast: 130 nāsatyapūjācakṣurvratapratipādanam
meaning: 130 नासत्यपूजाचक्षुर्व्रतप्रतिपादनम्
text_mt: 130 Exposition of the worship of the Nāsatyas and the eye-vow.

sanskrit_iast: 131 caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ bālenduvratavarṇanam
meaning: 131 चैत्रशुक्लद्वितीयायां बालेन्दुव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 131 Description of the vow of the crescent moon on the second day of the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 132 aśūnyaśayanadvitīyāvratam
meaning: 132 अशून्यशयनद्वितीयाव्रतम्
text_mt: 132 The vow of the bed not remaining empty on the second day [of the fortnight].

sanskrit_iast: 133 jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ trivikramavratam
meaning: 133 ज्येष्ठशुक्लतृतीयायां त्रिविक्रमव्रतम्
text_mt: 133 The vow of Trivikrama on the third day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: 134 asyāmeva tithau dvitīyaṃ traivikramavratam
meaning: 134 अस्यामेव तिथौ द्वितीयं त्रैविक्रमव्रतम्
text_mt: 134 The second vow of Trivikrama on that very lunar day.

sanskrit_iast: 135 asyāmeva tithau tṛtīyaṃ traivikramavratam
meaning: 135 अस्यामेव तिथौ तृतीयं त्रैविक्रमव्रतम्
text_mt: 135 The third vow of Trivikrama on that very lunar day.

sanskrit_iast: 136 vāyvarkacandradehasya viṣṇorukta-( jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ) tithau vratācaraṇapūrvakapūjanātsvargaloke yatheṣṭasukhaprāptiḥ
meaning: 136 वाय्वर्कचन्द्रदेहस्य विष्णोरुक्त-( ज्येष्ठशुक्लतृतीयायां) तिथौ व्रताचरणपूर्वकपूजनात्स्वर्गलोके यथेष्टसुखप्राप्तिः
text_mt: 136 Attainment of happiness according to one's desire in the heavenly world from worshiping Viṣṇu, whose body consists of wind, sun, and moon, preceded by the practice of the vow on the aforesaid lunar day (the third day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha).

sanskrit_iast: 137 vahnisūryasomavaruṇarūpiviṣṇoścaturmūrtivratavarṇanam
meaning: 137 वह्निसूर्यसोमवरुणरूपिविष्णोश्चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 137 Description of the vow of the four forms of Viṣṇu embodying Agni, Sūrya, Soma, and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: 138 indrayamavaruṇakuberacaturmūrtivratavarṇanam
meaning: 138 इन्द्रयमवरुणकुबेरचतुर्मूर्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 138 Description of the vow of the four forms consisting of Indra, Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera.

sanskrit_iast: 139 viṣṇubhūminabhobrahmacaturmūrtivratābhidhānam...
meaning: 139 विष्णुभूमिनभोब्रह्मचतुर्मूर्तिव्रताभिधानम्...
text_mt: 139 Statement of the vow of the four forms consisting of Viṣṇu, the earth, the sky, and Brahmā...

sanskrit_iast: 140 balajñānaiśvaryaśaktirūpicaturmūrtivratavarṇanam. - -
meaning: 140 बलज्ञानैश्वर्यशक्तिरूपिचतुर्मूर्तिव्रतवर्णनम्. - -
text_mt: 140 Description of the vow of the four forms embodying strength, knowledge, sovereignty, and power.

sanskrit_iast: 141 pañcamacaturmūrtikalpe vedavratakathanam
meaning: 141 पञ्चमचतुर्मूर्तिकल्पे वेदव्रतकथनम्
text_mt: 141 Account of the Vedic vow in the fifth ritual of the four forms.

sanskrit_iast: 142 caitraśuklacaturthyāṃ vāsudevasya vaiśākhe saṅkarṣaṇasya jyeṣṭhe pradyumnasyāṣāḍhe'niruddhasya cārcanaṃ vidhāya yogyabrāhmaṇāya tattadvratoktadakṣiṇādidānam
meaning: 142 चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां वासुदेवस्य वैशाखे सङ्कर्षणस्य ज्येष्ठे प्रद्युम्नस्याषाढेऽनिरुद्धस्य चार्चनं विधाय योग्यब्राह्मणाय तत्तद्व्रतोक्तदक्षिणादिदानम्
text_mt: 142 Having performed the worship of Vāsudeva on the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, of Saṃkarṣaṇa in Vaiśākha, of Pradyumna in Jyeṣṭha, and of Aniruddha in Āṣāḍha, giving the sacrificial fee and other gifts enjoined for each respective vow to a qualified brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: 143 saptamacaturmūrtikalpanegnivratavarṇanam
meaning: 143 सप्तमचतुर्मूर्तिकल्पनेग्निव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 143 Description of the fire-vow in the seventh ritual of the four forms.

sanskrit_iast: 144 aṣṭamacaturmūrtikalpe caturyugamūrtivarṇanam
meaning: 144 अष्टमचतुर्मूर्तिकल्पे चतुर्युगमूर्तिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 144 Description of the forms of the four ages in the eighth ritual of the four forms.

sanskrit_iast: 145 śrāvaṇādicaturmāseṣu viṣṇurūpicatuḥsāgaracihnapūrṇakumbhapūjanahavanādividhānam
meaning: 145 श्रावणादिचतुर्मासेषु विष्णुरूपिचतुःसागरचिह्नपूर्णकुम्भपूजनहवनादिविधानम्
text_mt: 145 The rule for worship, fire-oblations, and other rites of full water-jars marked with the emblems of the four oceans, representing Viṣṇu, during the four months beginning with Śrāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: 146 vāsudevādicaturmūrtergaruḍamakarādicihnasahitastha pūjanam
meaning: 146 वासुदेवादिचतुर्मूर्तेर्गरुडमकरादिचिह्नसहितस्थ पूजनम्
text_mt: 146 Worship of the four forms beginning with Vāsudeva together with their emblems such as Garuḍa and the makara.

sanskrit_iast: 147 īśānavahnivirūpākṣavāyurūpāṇi nirmāyya caitraśuklapratipadi bhaumanāde yatāṭākajalasnānadadhitilayavaghṛtahomādiprakāreṇa vratavarṇanam
meaning: 147 ईशानवह्निविरूपाक्षवायुरूपाणि निर्माय्य चैत्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि भौमनादे यताटाकजलस्नानदधितिलयवघृतहोमादिप्रकारेण व्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 147 Description of the vow after fashioning images of the forms of Īśāna, Agni, Virūpākṣa, and Vāyu, by means of bathing in rainwater on the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, in a pond, and offering oblations of curd, sesame, barley, and clarified butter, and other rites.

sanskrit_iast: 148 śaṃkhacakragadāpadmānāṃ vāsudevāniruddhādicaturdevātmakānāṃ śrāvaṇādicaturmāseṣu bahiḥsnānabhaktabhojanādiniyamapurassaramarcanam
meaning: 148 शंखचक्रगदापद्मानां वासुदेवानिरुद्धादिचतुर्देवात्मकानां श्रावणादिचतुर्मासेषु बहिःस्नानभक्तभोजनादिनियमपुरस्सरमर्चनम्
text_mt: 148 Worship of the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, which embody the four deities beginning with Vāsudeva and Aniruddha, during the four months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, preceded by rules such as bathing outdoors and partaking of consecrated food.

sanskrit_iast: 149 vāsantikaviṣuvaddine trirātropavāsapurassaraṃ yathāśakti vāsudevārcanaṃ vidhāya puro māsatrayaṃ ca nityārcanaphalāhārādividhiṃ kṛtvā vāsantika viṣuvaddine vrataṃ samāpayet
meaning: 149 वासन्तिकविषुवद्दिने त्रिरात्रोपवासपुरस्सरं यथाशक्ति वासुदेवार्चनं विधाय पुरो मासत्रयं च नित्यार्चनफलाहारादिविधिं कृत्वा वासन्तिक विषुवद्दिने व्रतं समापयेत्
text_mt: 149 On the day of the vernal equinox, having performed worship of Vāsudeva to the best of one's ability preceded by a fast of three nights, and having observed the rule of daily worship, fruit diet, and other rites for the three months ahead, one should conclude the vow on the day of the vernal equinox.

sanskrit_iast: 150 pūrvokta ( 149 adhyāyokta ) vrate viṣṇoḥ sthāne'naṃtapūjanaṃ vidhāya dvitīyādiṣu mahīgaganavedhasāmekavarṣaparyantaṃ vratamācarecceddhanarūpasukhādilābhaḥ
meaning: 150 पूर्वोक्त ( 149 अध्यायोक्त ) व्रते विष्णोः स्थानेऽनंतपूजनं विधाय द्वितीयादिषु महीगगनवेधसामेकवर्षपर्यन्तं व्रतमाचरेच्चेद्धनरूपसुखादिलाभः
text_mt: 150 If one performs worship of Ananta in place of Viṣṇu in the aforementioned vow (stated in Chapter 149), and practices the vow for one year for the earth, sky, and Brahmā on the second and subsequent [intervals], one attains wealth, beauty, happiness, and other benefits.

sanskrit_iast: 151 naranārāyaṇahayahaṃsādirūpacaturmūrtivratavarṇanam samāptaṃ caturmūrtivratam .. .
meaning: 151 नरनारायणहयहंसादिरूपचतुर्मूर्तिव्रतवर्णनम् समाप्तं चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतम् .. .
text_mt: 151 Description of the vow of the four forms whose natures are Nara, Nārāyaṇa, the Horse, the Swan, and others. The vow of the four forms is completed.

sanskrit_iast: atha paṃcamūrtivratam
meaning: अथ पंचमूर्तिव्रतम्
text_mt: Now, the vow of the five forms.

sanskrit_iast: 152 caitraśuklapaṃcamyāṃ pṛthivyādipaṃcabhūtātmakasya viṣṇoḥ śuklādivarṇamaṇḍaleṣu tattadvarṇagandhapuṣpādibhirarcanam
meaning: 152 चैत्रशुक्लपंचम्यां पृथिव्यादिपंचभूतात्मकस्य विष्णोः शुक्लादिवर्णमण्डलेषु तत्तद्वर्णगन्धपुष्पादिभिरर्चनम्
text_mt: 152 On the fifth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, worship of Viṣṇu, who consists of the five gross elements beginning with earth, upon sacred diagrams of white and other colors, with scents, flowers, and other offerings of corresponding colors.

sanskrit_iast: 153 vahnyarkādirūpisaṃvatsaraparivatsarādīnāṃ saphalavratavidhivarṇanam
meaning: 153 वह्न्यर्कादिरूपिसंवत्सरपरिवत्सरादीनां सफलव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 153 Description of the rule of vows with their fruits for the years of the cycle beginning with Saṃvatsara and Parivatsara, which embody Agni, Sūrya, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 154 savidhilakṣmīvratavarṇanam
meaning: 154 सविधिलक्ष्मीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 154 Description of the vow of Lakṣmī along with its ritual procedure.

sanskrit_iast: 155 paṃcamūrtivrate śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapūjanahavanādi ....
meaning: 155 पंचमूर्तिव्रते शंखचक्रगदापद्मपूजनहवनादि ....
text_mt: 155 Worship, oblations, and other rites for the conch, discus, mace, and lotus in the vow of the five forms...

sanskrit_iast: 156 vasaṃtādyṛtuṣu madhumādhavādipūjanātmakaṣaṇmūrtivratavarṇanam....
meaning: 156 वसंताद्यृतुषु मधुमाधवादिपूजनात्मकषण्मूर्तिव्रतवर्णनम्....
text_mt: 156 Description of the vow of the six forms consisting of the worship of Madhu, Mādhava, and others during the seasons beginning with spring...

sanskrit_iast: 157 saptamūrtivrate subhāsvarādipitṛvratavarṇanam
meaning: 157 सप्तमूर्तिव्रते सुभास्वरादिपितृव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 157 Description of the vow of the ancestors, such as the Subhāsvaras, in the vow of the seven forms.

sanskrit_iast: 158 caitramāsādārabhya kṛṣṇapakṣe pratidinaṃ rukmabhaumādipātālavratavarṇanam
meaning: 158 चैत्रमासादारभ्य कृष्णपक्षे प्रतिदिनं रुक्मभौमादिपातालव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 158 Description of the vow of the netherworlds beginning with Rukmabhauma, day by day in the dark fortnight beginning with the month of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 159 caitraśuklapakṣādārabhya pratyahaṃ saptāhaparyantaṃ jambūdvīpādisaptadvīpavarṇanam
meaning: 159 चैत्रशुक्लपक्षादारभ्य प्रत्यहं सप्ताहपर्यन्तं जम्बूद्वीपादिसप्तद्वीपवर्णनम्
text_mt: 159 Description of the seven continents beginning with Jambūdvīpa daily for a period of seven days beginning from the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 160 caitraśuklapakṣādārabhya lavaṇādisaptasamudravratavarṇanam
meaning: 160 चैत्रशुक्लपक्षादारभ्य लवणादिसप्तसमुद्रव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 160 Description of the vow of the seven oceans beginning with the salt ocean, beginning from the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 161 maheṃdrādisaptakulaparvatapūjanavidhānam .
meaning: 161 महेंद्रादिसप्तकुलपर्वतपूजनविधानम् .
text_mt: 161 The rule for worshiping the seven mountain ranges of the earth beginning with Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast: 162 saptavyāhṛtisaptalokavratavarṇanam
meaning: 162 सप्तव्याहृतिसप्तलोकव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 162 Description of the vow of the seven sacred utterances and the seven worlds.

sanskrit_iast: 163 hlādinyādinadīvratavarṇanam
meaning: 163 ह्लादिन्यादिनदीव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 163 Description of the vow of the rivers beginning with the Hlādinī.

sanskrit_iast: 164 sārasvatavratavarṇanam
meaning: 164 सारस्वतव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 164 Description of the vow of Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: 165 mokṣaprāptiphalapradaṃ saptarṣivratakathanam
meaning: 165 मोक्षप्राप्तिफलप्रदं सप्तर्षिव्रतकथनम्
text_mt: 165 Account of the vow of the seven sages, which grants the fruit of attaining liberation.

sanskrit_iast: 166 caitraśuklasaptamyāṃ marudvratavidhānam
meaning: 166 चैत्रशुक्लसप्तम्यां मरुद्व्रतविधानम्
text_mt: 166 The rule for the vow of the Maruts on the seventh day of the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 167 marudvratavarṇane gopatipūjanam, tatra cāṣṭadalakamalakarṇikāyāṃ vibhāvasuṃ saṃsthāpyartukārikādigandharvādipūjanavidhānam
meaning: 167 मरुद्व्रतवर्णने गोपतिपूजनम्, तत्र चाष्टदलकमलकर्णिकायां विभावसुं संस्थाप्यर्तुकारिकादिगन्धर्वादिपूजनविधानम्
text_mt: 167 Worship of Gopati in the description of the vow of the Maruts, and therein, having installed Vibhāvasu in the pericarp of an eight-petaled lotus, the rule for worshiping the Gandharvas and others beginning with the makers of the seasons.

sanskrit_iast: 168 vasantādyṛtvanusāraṃ sūryānucaradhātrādidevavarṇanam
meaning: 168 वसन्ताद्यृत्वनुसारं सूर्यानुचरधात्रादिदेववर्णनम्
text_mt: 168 Description of the deities attending the sun, beginning with Dhātṛ, according to the seasons beginning with spring.

sanskrit_iast: 169 aṣṭadalakamale bhāskarasya tadaṃgadevānāñca pūjanam
meaning: 169 अष्टदलकमले भास्करस्य तदंगदेवानाञ्च पूजनम्
text_mt: 169 Worship of the Sun and the deities of his retinue on an eight-petaled lotus.

sanskrit_iast: 170 raktasaptamīvratavarṇanaprasaṃgena sāṃgadevabhāskarapūjanam
meaning: 170 रक्तसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनप्रसंगेन सांगदेवभास्करपूजनम्
text_mt: 170 Worship of the Sun together with his attendant deities in the context of describing the vow of the red seventh day.

sanskrit_iast: 171 saṃvatsaraparyantamuktavidhinā saptamīvratakaraṇena sūryaprasādātsarvābhīṣṭasiddhiḥ
meaning: 171 संवत्सरपर्यन्तमुक्तविधिना सप्तमीव्रतकरणेन सूर्यप्रसादात्सर्वाभीष्टसिद्धिः
text_mt: 171 Attainment of all desired ends through the grace of the Sun by performing the vow of the seventh day according to the prescribed rule for a full year.

sanskrit_iast: 172 brahmacaryādiniyamapālanapurassaramaṣṭamyāmaṣṭavasupūjāmāhātmyam
meaning: 172 ब्रह्मचर्यादिनियमपालनपुरस्सरमष्टम्यामष्टवसुपूजामाहात्म्यम्
text_mt: 172 The greatness of worshiping the eight Vasus on the eighth day preceded by observing rules such as celibacy.

sanskrit_iast: 173 somāṣṭamyāṃ maheśvaravratapūjopavāsahavanādikaraṇaphalam
meaning: 173 सोमाष्टम्यां महेश्वरव्रतपूजोपवासहवनादिकरणफलम्
text_mt: 173 The fruit of observing the vow, worship, fasting, oblations, and other rites to Maheśvara on the eighth day falling on a Monday.

sanskrit_iast: 174 himavadādinavaśailarājānāṃ bhadrādinavavarṣāṇāñca navamyāṃ pūjanam
meaning: 174 हिमवदादिनवशैलराजानां भद्रादिनववर्षाणाञ्च नवम्यां पूजनम्
text_mt: 174 Worship of the nine royal mountains beginning with the Himālaya and the nine regions of the earth beginning with Bhadrā on the ninth day.

sanskrit_iast: 175 bhadrakālīvratapūjāvidhānam
meaning: 175 भद्रकालीव्रतपूजाविधानम्
text_mt: 175 The rule for the vow and worship of Bhadrakālī.

sanskrit_iast: 176 daśamyāṃ kratvādiviśvedevavratavarṇanaṃ samāhātmyam
meaning: 176 दशम्यां क्रत्वादिविश्वेदेवव्रतवर्णनं समाहात्म्यम्
text_mt: 176 Description of the vow of the Viśvedevas beginning with Kratu on the tenth day, together with its greatness.

sanskrit_iast: 177 aṅgirovratavarṇanam
meaning: 177 अङ्गिरोव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 177 Description of the vow of the Aṅgirases.

sanskrit_iast: 178 dharmavratavarṇanam
meaning: 178 धर्मव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 178 Description of the vow of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast: 179 mārgaśīrṣamāsamārabhyā''saṃvatsaramekādaśyāṃ bhadrapradarudravratavarṇanam
meaning: 179 मार्गशीर्षमासमारभ्या'ऽसंवत्सरमेकादश्यां भद्रप्रदरुद्रव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 179. Description of the Rudra vow that bestows good fortune, [observed] on the eleventh lunar day for a year starting from the month of Mārgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast: 180 mārgākṛṣṇadvādaśīṣu saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ bhṛguvratavarṇanam
meaning: 180 मार्गाकृष्णद्वादशीषु संवत्सरपर्यन्तं भृगुव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 180. Description of the Bhṛgu vow on the twelfth lunar days of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa for the duration of a year.

sanskrit_iast: 181 mārgaśīrṣadvādaśyāṃ vatsaraparyantaṃ sādhyavratavarṇanam
meaning: 181 मार्गशीर्षद्वादश्यां वत्सरपर्यन्तं साध्यव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 181. Description of the Sādhya vow on the twelfth lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa for the duration of a year.

sanskrit_iast: 182 mārgaśukladvādaśyāṃ dhātādidvādaśādityavratavarṇanam
meaning: 182 मार्गशुक्लद्वादश्यां धातादिद्वादशादित्यव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 182. Description of the vow of the twelve Ādityas, beginning with Dhātṛ, on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast: 183 vaiśākhatrayodaśyāṃ kāmadevavratam
meaning: 183 वैशाखत्रयोदश्यां कामदेवव्रतम्
text_mt: 183. The vow of Kāmadeva on the thirteenth lunar day of Vaiśākha.

sanskrit_iast: 184 phālgunaśukladvādaśīto vatsaraparyanta śuklatrayodaśyāṃ dhanavratam
meaning: 184 फाल्गुनशुक्लद्वादशीतो वत्सरपर्यन्त शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां धनव्रतम्
text_mt: 184. The vow for wealth on the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight for the duration of a year, starting from the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna.

sanskrit_iast: 185 jyeṣṭhaśuklapakṣīyacaturdaśyāṃ vāyulokapradaṃ vārṣikavratam
meaning: 185 ज्येष्ठशुक्लपक्षीयचतुर्दश्यां वायुलोकप्रदं वार्षिकव्रतम्
text_mt: 185. The annual vow that bestows the world of Vāyu on the fourteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast: 186 pauṣamāsikakṛṣṇacaturdaśīṣu vatsaraparyantaṃ virūpākṣavratam
meaning: 186 पौषमासिककृष्णचतुर्दशीषु वत्सरपर्यन्तं विरूपाक्षव्रतम्
text_mt: 186. The Virūpākṣa vow on the fourteenth lunar days of the dark fortnight of the month of Pauṣa for the duration of a year.

sanskrit_iast: 187 kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yamavratam
meaning: 187 कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यमव्रतम्
text_mt: 187. The Yama vow on the fourteenth lunar day of the dark fortnight.

sanskrit_iast: 188 phālgunaśuklapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ śivavratam
meaning: 188 फाल्गुनशुक्लपक्षचतुर्दश्यां शिवव्रतम्
text_mt: 188. The Śiva vow on the fourteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna.

sanskrit_iast: 189 caitraśuklapakṣādārabhya varṣaparyantaṃ pratipañcadaśīṣu śrāddharūpapitṛvratam
meaning: 189 चैत्रशुक्लपक्षादारभ्य वर्षपर्यन्तं प्रतिपञ्चदशीषु श्राद्धरूपपितृव्रतम्
text_mt: 189. The ancestral rite in the form of a śrāddha on each fifteenth lunar day for the duration of a year, starting from the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 190 caitrakṛṣṇapañcadaśīto varṣaparyantaṃ vahnipūjanahavanādikam
meaning: 190 चैत्रकृष्णपञ्चदशीतो वर्षपर्यन्तं वह्निपूजनहवनादिकम्
text_mt: 190. Worship of fire, oblations, and so forth for the duration of a year, starting from the fifteenth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 191 amāvāsyāyāṃ candrasūryavratavarṇanam
meaning: 191 अमावास्यायां चन्द्रसूर्यव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 191. Description of the vow of the moon and the sun on the new moon day.

sanskrit_iast: 192 kārttikātprabhṛti pratimāsaṃ kṛttikārohiṇyādinakṣatrayuktacandramaḥpūjanādivarṇanam
meaning: 192 कार्त्तिकात्प्रभृति प्रतिमासं कृत्तिकारोहिण्यादिनक्षत्रयुक्तचन्द्रमःपूजनादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 192. Description of the worship and so forth of the moon conjoined with lunar mansions such as Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī each month, starting from Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast: 193 kārtikapūrṇimāyāṃ ṣoḍaśadale padme karṇikāyāṃ candrasya kesareṣvaṣṭā viṃśatinakṣatrāṇāṃ patreṣu ca tithidevatānāṃ sacandrikāṇāṃ pūjanavidhiḥ
meaning: 193 कार्तिकपूर्णिमायां षोडशदले पद्मे कर्णिकायां चन्द्रस्य केसरेष्वष्टा विंशतिनक्षत्राणां पत्रेषु च तिथिदेवतानां सचन्द्रिकाणां पूजनविधिः
text_mt: 193. The rule of worship on the full moon day of Kārttika on a sixteen-petaled lotus, of the moon in the pericarp, of the twenty-eight lunar mansions in the filaments, and of the deities of the lunar days together with moonlight on the petals.

sanskrit_iast: 194 proṣṭhapadapūrṇimāyāṃ varuṇavratavarṇanam
meaning: 194 प्रोष्ठपदपूर्णिमायां वरुणव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 194. Description of the Varuṇa vow on the full moon day of Proṣṭhapada.

sanskrit_iast: 195 āśvayukpūrṇimāyāṃ śakravratavarṇanam
meaning: 195 आश्वयुक्पूर्णिमायां शक्रव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 195. Description of the Śakra vow on the full moon day of Āśvayuja.

sanskrit_iast: 196 āśvayukpūrṇimāyāṃ śakravratam
meaning: 196 आश्वयुक्पूर्णिमायां शक्रव्रतम्
text_mt: 196. The Śakra vow on the full moon day of Āśvayuja.

sanskrit_iast: 197 brahmakūrca-(pañcagavya) varṇanam
meaning: 197 ब्रह्मकूर्च-(पञ्चगव्य) वर्णनम्
text_mt: 197. Description of the brahmakūrca (five products of the cow).

sanskrit_iast: 198 pūrṇimāmāvāsyāsu dvādaśavarṣaparyantaṃ mahāvratam
meaning: 198 पूर्णिमामावास्यासु द्वादशवर्षपर्यन्तं महाव्रतम्
text_mt: 198. The great vow on full moon and new moon days for the duration of twelve years.

sanskrit_iast: 199 tiryagyonimlecchadeśajanmanivārakaṃ meṣādisaṃkrāntiṣu paraśurāmakṛṣṇādivratam
meaning: 199 तिर्यग्योनिम्लेच्छदेशजन्मनिवारकं मेषादिसंक्रान्तिषु परशुरामकृष्णादिव्रतम्
text_mt: 199. The vow of Paraśurāma, Kṛṣṇa, and others at the solstitial and equinoctial passages such as Aries, which prevents birth in an animal womb or a barbarian land.

sanskrit_iast: 200 iṣṭajātyavāptivratavarṇanam
meaning: 200 इष्टजात्यवाप्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 200. Description of the vow for obtaining a desired birth.

sanskrit_iast: 201 satkulāvāptivratavarṇanam
meaning: 201 सत्कुलावाप्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 201. Description of the vow for obtaining a noble family.

sanskrit_iast: 202 rūpāvāptivratavarṇanam
meaning: 202 रूपावाप्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 202. Description of the vow for obtaining beauty.

sanskrit_iast: 203 iha lāvaṇyamadamante ca svargaprāptikaraṃ vratam
meaning: 203 इह लावण्यमदमन्ते च स्वर्गप्राप्तिकरं व्रतम्
text_mt: 203. The vow that confers the intoxication of loveliness in this world and attainment of heaven in the end.

sanskrit_iast: 204 saubhāgyavidhāyakavratam
meaning: 204 सौभाग्यविधायकव्रतम्
text_mt: 204. The vow that brings good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: 205 āśvayukpratipadamārabhyamāsaparyantamārogyasampadādivarddhakavratavidhānam
meaning: 205 आश्वयुक्प्रतिपदमारभ्यमासपर्यन्तमारोग्यसम्पदादिवर्द्धकव्रतविधानम्
text_mt: 205. The ordinance of the vow that increases health, prosperity, and so forth, for the duration of a month starting from the first lunar day of Āśvayuja.

sanskrit_iast: 206 jñānabuddhivivarddhanaṃ vaiśākhamāsavratam
meaning: 206 ज्ञानबुद्धिविवर्द्धनं वैशाखमासव्रतम्
text_mt: 206. The vow of the month of Vaiśākha that increases knowledge and intellect.

sanskrit_iast: 207 vidyāvāptivratavarṇanam
meaning: 207 विद्यावाप्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 207. Description of the vow for obtaining learning.

sanskrit_iast: 208 śīlaprāptivratavarṇanam
meaning: 208 शीलप्राप्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 208. Description of the vow for obtaining virtuous conduct.

sanskrit_iast: 209 dharmaprāptikaraṃ śrāvaṇamāsavratam
meaning: 209 धर्मप्राप्तिकरं श्रावणमासव्रतम्
text_mt: 209. The vow of the month of Śrāvaṇa that brings dharma.

sanskrit_iast: 210 dhanaprāptikaraṃ saṅkarṣaṇadevavratam
meaning: 210 धनप्राप्तिकरं सङ्कर्षणदेवव्रतम्
text_mt: 210. The vow of the deity Saṃkarṣaṇa that brings wealth.

sanskrit_iast: 211 lakṣmīprāptikaraṃ jyeṣṭhamāsavratam
meaning: 211 लक्ष्मीप्राप्तिकरं ज्येष्ठमासव्रतम्
text_mt: 211. The vow of the month of Jyeṣṭha that brings Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast: 212 bhogāvāptikaramāṣāḍhamāsavratam
meaning: 212 भोगावाप्तिकरमाषाढमासव्रतम्
text_mt: 212. The vow of the month of Āṣāḍha that brings worldly enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast: 213 jayaprāptividhāyakaṃ kārtikamāsavratam
meaning: 213 जयप्राप्तिविधायकं कार्तिकमासव्रतम्
text_mt: 213. The vow of the month of Kārttika that brings victory.

sanskrit_iast: 214 kārtikīpūrṇamāsītaḥ śrāvaṇīparyantaṃ nṛsiṃhādidevapūjanavratavidhānam
meaning: 214 कार्तिकीपूर्णमासीतः श्रावणीपर्यन्तं नृसिंहादिदेवपूजनव्रतविधानम्
text_mt: 214. The ordinance of the vow of worshipping deities such as Nṛsiṃha from the full moon day of Kārttika up to that of Śrāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: 215 phālgunādyāśvayukchuklaikādaśīṣu vidhivatkṛṣṇakeśavādivratakaraṇādiha loke śreṣṭhagatimutkrāntisamaye ca śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇamāpnoti janaḥ
meaning: 215 फाल्गुनाद्याश्वयुक्छुक्लैकादशीषु विधिवत्कृष्णकेशवादिव्रतकरणादिह लोके श्रेष्ठगतिमुत्क्रान्तिसमये च श्रीकृष्णस्मरणमाप्नोति जनः
text_mt: 215. By performing the vows of Kṛṣṇa, Keśava, and others according to the rule on the eleventh lunar days of the bright fortnights from Phālguna to Āśvayuja, a person attains an exalted state in this world and remembrance of Śrī Kṛṣṇa at the time of departure [from life].

sanskrit_iast: 216 phālgunapūrṇamāyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇāvindurātrirūpiṇāvabhyarcya caitravaiśākhajyeṣṭhamāseṣu ca tathaivābhyarcyaikaṃ pāraṇam. āṣāḍhaśrāvaṇabhādrapadāśvinamāseṣu śriyā saha śrīdharaṃ sampūjya candramasaḥ pūjanena dvitīyaṃ pāraṇam .. kārttikādimāseṣu keśavamarcayitvā bhūmicandramasoḥ pūjanena tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇam . etatpāraṇatraye prathamapāraṇe pañcagavyaprāśanaṃ, dvitīye kuśodakaṃ, tṛtīye sūryāṃśutaptañjalamiti niyamena lakṣmīnārāyaṇau sampūjya naro naiṣṭairviyujyate'ntakāle labhate ca devasmṛtiṃ muktiñca tata iti
meaning: 216 फाल्गुनपूर्णमायां लक्ष्मीनारायणाविन्दुरात्रिरूपिणावभ्यर्च्य चैत्रवैशाखज्येष्ठमासेषु च तथैवाभ्यर्च्यैकं पारणम्. आषाढश्रावणभाद्रपदाश्विनमासेषु श्रिया सह श्रीधरं सम्पूज्य चन्द्रमसः पूजनेन द्वितीयं पारणम् .. कार्त्तिकादिमासेषु केशवमर्चयित्वा भूमिचन्द्रमसोः पूजनेन तृतीयं पारणम् . एतत्पारणत्रये प्रथमपारणे पञ्चगव्यप्राशनं, द्वितीये कुशोदकं, तृतीये सूर्यांशुतप्तञ्जलमिति नियमेन लक्ष्मीनारायणौ सम्पूज्य नरो नैष्टैर्वियुज्यतेऽन्तकाले लभते च देवस्मृतिं मुक्तिञ्च तत इति
text_mt: 216. Having worshipped Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa in the forms of the moon and night on the full moon day of Phālguna, and having worshipped likewise in the months of Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha, there is one breaking of the fast; having worshipped Śrīdhara together with Śrī in the months of Āṣāḍha, Śrāvaṇa, Bhādrapada, and Āśvina, the second breaking of the fast is with the worship of the moon; having worshipped Keśava in the months beginning with Kārttika, the third breaking of the fast is with the worship of the earth and the moon. In these three breakings of the fast, by consuming the five products of the cow at the first, kuśa-water at the second, and water heated by the sun's rays at the third according to rule, having worshipped Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, a person is not separated from loved ones, and at the end of life attains remembrance of the deity and thereby liberation.

sanskrit_iast: 217 caitrakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmupavāsapurassaraṃ kṛṣṇadevakyau samarcya vaiśākhajyeṣṭhayostrimāsikapāraṇavṛtasnapanādividhānena narassantānayuksadā syāt
meaning: 217 चैत्रकृष्णाष्टम्यामुपवासपुरस्सरं कृष्णदेवक्यौ समर्च्य वैशाखज्येष्ठयोस्त्रिमासिकपारणवृतस्नपनादिविधानेन नरस्सन्तानयुक्सदा स्यात्
text_mt: 217. Having worshipped Kṛṣṇa and Devakī preceded by fasting on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Caitra, through the ordinance of ablution and so forth accompanied by the vow with a three-month breaking of the fast in Vaiśākha and Jyeṣṭha, a person will always have offspring.

sanskrit_iast: 218 hariśayanaprabodhanayormadhye daśāhavratāsidhārāvratanirūpaṇam
meaning: 218 हरिशयनप्रबोधनयोर्मध्ये दशाहव्रतासिधाराव्रतनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 218. Exposition of the ten-day vow and the asidhārā vow between the sleeping and awakening of Hari.

sanskrit_iast: 219 bhādraśukladvādaśyāṃ prārabhya yāvadvatsaraṃ dvādaśīṣvanaṃtavratavarṇanam.
meaning: 219 भाद्रशुक्लद्वादश्यां प्रारभ्य यावद्वत्सरं द्वादशीष्वनंतव्रतवर्णनम्.
text_mt: 219. Description of the Ananta vow on the twelfth lunar days for the space of a year, beginning on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra.

sanskrit_iast: 220 pauṣaśukladdhādaśīto varṣapayantaṃ pratidvādaśīṣu janārddanārcanadānagomūtraprāśanādividhānam
meaning: 220 पौषशुक्लद्धादशीतो वर्षपयन्तं प्रतिद्वादशीषु जनार्द्दनार्चनदानगोमूत्रप्राशनादिविधानम्
text_mt: 220. The ordinance of worshipping Janārdana, giving gifts, drinking cow's urine, and so forth on each twelfth lunar day for the duration of a year, from the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa.

sanskrit_iast: 221 caitraśuklapratipadādau brahmādidevānāṃ sahetuphalakaṃ pūjanam
meaning: 221 चैत्रशुक्लप्रतिपदादौ ब्रह्मादिदेवानां सहेतुफलकं पूजनम्
text_mt: 221. Worship of deities such as Brahmā together with reasons and fruits, beginning on the first lunar day of the bright fortnight of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 222 roceṣu māsopavāsaphalanirūpaṇam
meaning: 222 रोचेषु मासोपवासफलनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 222. Exposition of the fruit of fasting for a month during the bright fortnights.

sanskrit_iast: 223 tattannakṣatreṣu tattaddevādipūjanavarṇanam
meaning: 223 तत्तन्नक्षत्रेषु तत्तद्देवादिपूजनवर्णनम्
text_mt: 223. Description of the worship of respective deities and so forth under the respective lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast: 224 aṣṭāvakradiksaṃvāde tayā strīsvabhāvādivarṇanaṃ bhārgaveṇa muninā'ṣṭāvakrāya svasutāyā diśo dānañca
meaning: 224 अष्टावक्रदिक्संवादे तया स्त्रीस्वभावादिवर्णनं भार्गवेण मुनिनाऽष्टावक्राय स्वसुताया दिशो दानञ्च
text_mt: 224. In the dialogue between Aṣṭāvakra and the cardinal direction, the description by her of the nature of women and so forth, and the giving of his own daughter Diś to Aṣṭāvakra by the sage born of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast: 225 puruṣasūktāvidhānena saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ haṃsasvarūpajanārdanapūjanavratam
meaning: 225 पुरुषसूक्ताविधानेन संवत्सरपर्यन्तं हंसस्वरूपजनार्दनपूजनव्रतम्
text_mt: 225. The vow of worshipping Janārdana in the form of a swan for the duration of a year according to the ordinance of the Puruṣasūkta.

sanskrit_iast: 226 kṛtayugāsyānte dāmpatyavyavahārapravṛtterlobhadveṣādidoṣākule loke haṃsarūpinārāyaṇena munyanurodhena jñānopadeśakaraṇapratijñātam
meaning: 226 कृतयुगास्यान्ते दाम्पत्यव्यवहारप्रवृत्तेर्लोभद्वेषादिदोषाकुले लोके हंसरूपिनारायणेन मुन्यनुरोधेन ज्ञानोपदेशकरणप्रतिज्ञातम्
text_mt: 226. At the end of the Kṛta age, when married life began to prevail and the world became afflicted with faults such as greed and hatred, the promise made by Nārāyaṇa in the form of a swan to impart spiritual knowledge at the entreaty of the sages.

sanskrit_iast: atha haṃsagītā .

text_mt: Now the Haṃsagītā.

text_mt: 227. Description of the duties of the social classes.
