meaning: 293 दाक्षिण्यनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 293 Ascertainment of courtesy

sanskrit_iast: 294 priyaṃvadapraśaṃsā
meaning: 294 प्रियंवदप्रशंसा
text_mt: 294 Praise of speaking kindly

sanskrit_iast: 295 ālasyadoṣaprakaṭanapurassaraṃ yatnasya kāryasādhakatāvarṇanam
meaning: 295 आलस्यदोषप्रकटनपुरस्सरं यत्नस्य कार्यसाधकतावर्णनम्
text_mt: 295 Description of effort as the accomplisher of tasks, preceded by revealing the fault of indolence

sanskrit_iast: 296 udakamahattvapradarśanapurassaraṃ taḍāgādinirmāṇaphalam
meaning: 296 उदकमहत्त्वप्रदर्शनपुरस्सरं तडागादिनिर्माणफलम्
text_mt: 296 The fruit of constructing ponds and the like, preceded by showing the importance of water

sanskrit_iast: 297 vṛkṣāropaṇapuṣpaphalārāmādinirmāṇakartṝṇāṃ tattaloke sukhanivāsanirūpaṇam
meaning: 297 वृक्षारोपणपुष्पफलारामादिनिर्माणकर्तॄणां तत्तलोके सुखनिवासनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 297 Demonstration of joyful dwelling in their respective realms for those who plant trees and make gardens of flowers and fruits

sanskrit_iast: 298 prapānirmāṇatajjalābhyāṃ pathikatṛptijanitāni prapākartrupacārakartroḥ phalāni
meaning: 298 प्रपानिर्माणतज्जलाभ्यां पथिकतृप्तिजनितानि प्रपाकर्त्रुपचारकर्त्रोः फलानि
text_mt: 298 The fruits for the provider of a water booth and for the attendant, arising from the satisfaction of travellers by the construction of the water booth and its water

sanskrit_iast: 299 tāmasādibhedena puṇyaphalopadeśaḥ, śuklakṛṣṇaśabalādibhedena dhanavicāraśca
meaning: 299 तामसादिभेदेन पुण्यफलोपदेशः, शुक्लकृष्णशबलादिभेदेन धनविचारश्च
text_mt: 299. Teaching on the fruit of merit according to divisions such as the tāmasic, and consideration of wealth according to divisions such as white, black, and spotted.

sanskrit_iast: 300 dānakālasampradānaphalādikathanam
meaning: 300 दानकालसम्प्रदानफलादिकथनम्
text_mt: 300. Exposition on the proper time for giving, the recipient, the fruit, and other aspects.

sanskrit_iast: 301 pratigrāhyapadārthapratigrahasamayataddevatādivarṇanam
meaning: 301 प्रतिग्राह्यपदार्थप्रतिग्रहसमयतद्देवतादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 301. Description of the objects acceptable for gifts, the time of acceptance of gifts, their deities, and other details.

sanskrit_iast: 302 abhayapradānapraśaṃsāvarṇanam
meaning: 302 अभयप्रदानप्रशंसावर्णनम्
text_mt: 302. Description praising the granting of safety from fear.

sanskrit_iast: 303 vedopavedavedāṅgadharmaśāstrādyadhyāpanasya dussaṅganivāraṇasya ca phalam
meaning: 303 वेदोपवेदवेदाङ्गधर्मशास्त्राद्यध्यापनस्य दुस्सङ्गनिवारणस्य च फलम्
text_mt: 303. The fruit of teaching the Vedas, Upavedas, Vedāṅgas, dharmaśāstras, and so forth, and of turning others away from bad company.

sanskrit_iast: 304 kanyādānaphalam
meaning: 304 कन्यादानफलम्
text_mt: 304. The fruit of giving away a maiden [in marriage].

sanskrit_iast: 305 ārāmajalāśayadevālayādiviśiṣṭopakārakabhūmervividhānnaratnākarabhuvaśca dāne phalāni
meaning: 305 आरामजलाशयदेवालयादिविशिष्टोपकारकभूमेर्विविधान्नरत्नाकरभुवश्च दाने फलानि
text_mt: 305. The fruits of giving land of distinguished utility such as pleasure gardens, reservoirs, and temples, as well as land yielding various foods and jewels.

sanskrit_iast: 306 gopradānakṣīraparamānnādiphalanirūpaṇam
meaning: 306 गोप्रदानक्षीरपरमान्नादिफलनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 306. Determining the fruits of giving a cow, milk, rice pudding, and other gifts.

sanskrit_iast: 307 ghṛtadhenukalpavarṇanam .
meaning: 307 घृतधेनुकल्पवर्णनम् .
text_mt: 307. Description of the ritual of the ghee-cow.

sanskrit_iast: 308 tiladhenuvidhidānavarṇanam
meaning: 308 तिलधेनुविधिदानवर्णनम्
text_mt: 308. Description of the rule and gift of the sesame-cow.

sanskrit_iast: 309 jaladhenuvidhidānavarṇanama
meaning: 309 जलधेनुविधिदानवर्णनम
text_mt: 309. Description of the rule and gift of the water-cow.

sanskrit_iast: 310 suvarṇaratnādividhinirūpaṇam
meaning: 310 सुवर्णरत्नादिविधिनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 310. Determination of the ritual rules for gold, jewels, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: 311 āsanaśayyāvitānacchatropānadrathādidānaphalavarṇanam
meaning: 311 आसनशय्यावितानच्छत्रोपानद्रथादिदानफलवर्णनम्
text_mt: 311. Description of the fruits of giving seats, beds, canopies, parasols, sandals, chariots, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: 312 nṛvāhaśibikādāsadāsyādidānamāhātmyam .
meaning: 312 नृवाहशिबिकादासदास्यादिदानमाहात्म्यम् .
text_mt: 312. The greatness of giving palanquins carried by men, male and female slaves, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: 313 rūpalāvaṇyadhanasaubhāgyādipradakṣeomakārpāsāvikādivastradānavarṇanam
meaning: 313 रूपलावण्यधनसौभाग्यादिप्रदक्षेओमकार्पासाविकादिवस्त्रदानवर्णनम्
text_mt: 313. Description of giving garments of silk, cotton, wool, and other materials, which grant beauty, charm, wealth, good fortune, and other blessings.

sanskrit_iast: 314 sūryagandharvaśakralokādiprāpakaraktaśālisugandhakalamādidhānyadānavarṇanam
meaning: 314 सूर्यगन्धर्वशक्रलोकादिप्रापकरक्तशालिसुगन्धकलमादिधान्यदानवर्णनम्
text_mt: 314. Description of giving grains such as red śāli rice and fragrant kalama rice, which lead to the realms of Sūrya, the Gandharvas, Śakra, and others.

sanskrit_iast: 315 prāṇānāmannagatatvātsarveṣāmapi jīvānāmannādhikāritvādaviśeṣeṇānnadānasya māhātmyaṃ tatrāpi bhojane brāhmaṇānnaguṇabāhulyam
meaning: 315 प्राणानामन्नगतत्वात्सर्वेषामपि जीवानामन्नाधिकारित्वादविशेषेणान्नदानस्य माहात्म्यं तत्रापि भोजने ब्राह्मणान्नगुणबाहुल्यम्
text_mt: 315. The greatness of giving food unconditionally, because life-breaths reside in food and all living beings are entitled to food; and, in that regard, the great abundance of merit in feeding a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: 316 pātraviśeṣeṇa dānaviśeṣaphalavarṇanam
meaning: 316 पात्रविशेषेण दानविशेषफलवर्णनम्
text_mt: 316. Description of the particular fruits of giving according to the specific recipient.

sanskrit_iast: 317 kālaviśeṣe dānaviśeṣaphalavarṇanam
meaning: 317 कालविशेषे दानविशेषफलवर्णनम्
text_mt: 317. Description of the particular fruits of giving at specific times.

sanskrit_iast: 318 sadānaphalaṃ nakṣatravratavarṇanam
meaning: 318 सदानफलं नक्षत्रव्रतवर्णनम्
text_mt: 318. Description of the lunar-mansion observances, along with the fruits of their attendant gifts.

sanskrit_iast: 319 caitrādipūrṇimāsu dvādaśīṣu ca vratopavāsadānādiphalavarṇanam
meaning: 319 चैत्रादिपूर्णिमासु द्वादशीषु च व्रतोपवासदानादिफलवर्णनम्
text_mt: 319. Description of the fruits of observances, fasts, gifts, and so forth on the full-moon days and on the twelfth lunar days beginning with Caitra.

sanskrit_iast: 320 caitrapaṃcadaśyāmupavāsacitravastradānādipurassaraṃ naktaikabhaktādiniyamapālanapūrvakaṃ māsavratavidhānam
meaning: 320 चैत्रपंचदश्यामुपवासचित्रवस्त्रदानादिपुरस्सरं नक्तैकभक्तादिनियमपालनपूर्वकं मासव्रतविधानम्
text_mt: 320. The procedure for the month-long observance beginning with fasting and gifting variegated garments on the fifteenth day of Caitra, preceded by observing restrictions such as eating only at night or eating only a single meal.

sanskrit_iast: 321 gurvatithipūjanatapaścaraṇādinā yamakuberādityādilokeṣu pratiṣṭhāsukhādiprāptitattallokānandānubhavādivarṇanam
meaning: 321 गुर्वतिथिपूजनतपश्चरणादिना यमकुबेरादित्यादिलोकेषु प्रतिष्ठासुखादिप्राप्तितत्तल्लोकानन्दानुभवादिवर्णनम्
text_mt: 321. Description of obtaining status, happiness, and the like in the realms of Yama, Kubera, Āditya, and others, and experiencing the bliss of those various realms through worshipping elders and guests, practicing austerities, and similar deeds.

sanskrit_iast: 322 pātivratyādistrīdharmanirūpaṇam
meaning: 322 पातिव्रत्यादिस्त्रीधर्मनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 322. Determination of the duties of women, such as devotion to the husband.

sanskrit_iast: 323 varṇānāṃ svesve dharme sthāpanādirājadharmanirūpaṇam
meaning: 323 वर्णानां स्वेस्वे धर्मे स्थापनादिराजधर्मनिरूपणम्
text_mt: 323. Determination of the duties of a king, such as establishing the social orders in their respective duties.

sanskrit_iast: 324 kulaśreṇyādyaṣṭādhikṛtagaṇaniyogapurassaraṃ vidvadbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha rājño vyavahāradarśanavarṇanam
meaning: 324 कुलश्रेण्याद्यष्टाधिकृतगणनियोगपुरस्सरं विद्वद्ब्राह्मणैः सह राज्ञो व्यवहारदर्शनवर्णनम्
text_mt: 324. Description of the king's administration of justice together with learned brahmins, preceded by the appointment of the eight official corporate bodies such as family councils and guilds.

sanskrit_iast: 325 viśuddhāgamapūrvakasya bhūmyādibhogasya prāmāṇyavarṇanam
meaning: 325 विशुद्धागमपूर्वकस्य भूम्यादिभोगस्य प्रामाण्यवर्णनम्
text_mt: 325. Description of the legal validity of enjoyment of land and other property when preceded by a pure title.

sanskrit_iast: 326 vyavahāreṣu pauruṣadivyayornirṇayayorlikhitasākṣibhedena dvividhapauruṣe'pi rājasākṣikasasākṣikasvahastalikhitabhedaistraividhyaṃ tatra sthāvarāṇāṃ lekhyenaiva siddhirlekhyasya sopadhye divyādyairvyavasthā
meaning: 326 व्यवहारेषु पौरुषदिव्ययोर्निर्णययोर्लिखितसाक्षिभेदेन द्विविधपौरुषेऽपि राजसाक्षिकससाक्षिकस्वहस्तलिखितभेदैस्त्रैविध्यं तत्र स्थावराणां लेख्येनैव सिद्धिर्लेख्यस्य सोपध्ये दिव्याद्यैर्व्यवस्था
text_mt: 326. In legal disputes, of the two modes of determination—human and divine—the human mode is twofold, divided into documents and witnesses; this is further threefold as witnessed by the king, witnessed by private witnesses, and handwritten by one's own hand; among these, establishing title to immovable property is by document alone, while in case of fraud regarding a document, settlement is made by ordeals and the like.

sanskrit_iast: 327 kṛtākṛtabhedena sākṣiṇāmekādaśavidhatā, pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ sākṣiṣu pūrvaṃ praśnāḥ, sākṣibhedasūcisākṣiṇorniṣedhaḥ, nṛpatiśilpiśrotriyādīnāṃ sākṣyaniṣedhaḥ, āptānāṃ sarvavarṇeṣu sākṣitvam devadvijādisannidhāvudaṅmukhena pūrvāhṇe saśaucaṃ sākṣigrahaṇam, sākṣyārambhe brāhmaṇādīnāṃ satyādinā śapanam
meaning: 327 कृताकृतभेदेन साक्षिणामेकादशविधता, पूर्वपक्षिणः साक्षिषु पूर्वं प्रश्नाः, साक्षिभेदसूचिसाक्षिणोर्निषेधः, नृपतिशिल्पिश्रोत्रियादीनां साक्ष्यनिषेधः, आप्तानां सर्ववर्णेषु साक्षित्वम् देवद्विजादिसन्निधावुदङ्मुखेन पूर्वाह्णे सशौचं साक्षिग्रहणम्, साक्ष्यारम्भे ब्राह्मणादीनां सत्यादिना शपनम्
text_mt: 327. The eleven kinds of witnesses divided into appointed and unappointed; questioning the plaintiff's witnesses first; prohibition of hostile witnesses and secret-informing witnesses; prohibition of kings, artisans, learned Vedic scholars, and the like from being witnesses; trustworthy persons of all social orders acting as witnesses; taking witness testimony in the presence of deities, the twice-born, and others, facing north in the forenoon, while purified; and administering oaths to brahmins and others by truth and so on at the beginning of testimony.

sanskrit_iast: 328 kośadhaṭādibhedena divyānāmaṣṭavidhatā, tatra kośasyāśiraskatā, vipravarjyaṃ varṇināṃ kośadānam, deśakālāvanusṛtya divyadānam, rājñā svadeśātkaṇṭakānāṃ nissāraṇaṃ kartavyam, divyārhadvijakathanam, tulāyogyadāru tatpramāṇanirmāṇaprakāratadupaveśanādipurassaraṃ tadupaviṣṭasya śuddhijñānam, vahnitoyādādivyānāṃ vidhānaprakāraḥ
meaning: 328 कोशधटादिभेदेन दिव्यानामष्टविधता, तत्र कोशस्याशिरस्कता, विप्रवर्ज्यं वर्णिनां कोशदानम्, देशकालावनुसृत्य दिव्यदानम्, राज्ञा स्वदेशात्कण्टकानां निस्सारणं कर्तव्यम्, दिव्यार्हद्विजकथनम्, तुलायोग्यदारु तत्प्रमाणनिर्माणप्रकारतदुपवेशनादिपुरस्सरं तदुपविष्टस्य शुद्धिज्ञानम्, वह्नितोयादादिव्यानां विधानप्रकारः
text_mt: 328. The eightfold division of divine ordeals such as the sacred libation and the balance; therein the libation without capital consequence; administering the libation to members of the social orders except brahmins; administering ordeals in accordance with place and time; the king's duty to eliminate thorns from his own realm; statement of the twice-born fit for ordeals; the wood suitable for the balance, its dimensions, the manner of its construction, and seating upon it, followed by knowing the purity of the one seated upon it; and the procedure for ordeals such as fire and water.

sanskrit_iast: 329 brāhmaṇādivarṇānāmaṣṭau vivāhāḥ kanyādoṣapracchādakāropakayordaṇḍau, jñātibalādidṛptabhartraticāriṇyāḥ kaṭhoraprāṇadaṇḍaḥ, bhāryāyā vyabhicāre daṇḍaḥ, ekavarāya kanyāṃ datvā'nyasmai dātre viktacaturthāṃśadaṇḍo rājñā deyaḥ . ṛtau bhāryāmagacchato bharturbhartrāhūtāyā agacchantyā bhāryāyāśca daṇḍaḥ. ṛtumatyā bhartre'pratipāditāyā varṣatrayātsvayaṃ vivāhādhikāraḥ
meaning: 329 ब्राह्मणादिवर्णानामष्टौ विवाहाः कन्यादोषप्रच्छादकारोपकयोर्दण्डौ, ज्ञातिबलादिदृप्तभर्त्रतिचारिण्याः कठोरप्राणदण्डः, भार्याया व्यभिचारे दण्डः, एकवराय कन्यां दत्वाऽन्यस्मै दात्रे विक्तचतुर्थांशदण्डो राज्ञा देयः . ऋतौ भार्यामगच्छतो भर्तुर्भर्त्राहूताया अगच्छन्त्या भार्यायाश्च दण्डः. ऋतुमत्या भर्त्रेऽप्रतिपादिताया वर्षत्रयात्स्वयं विवाहाधिकारः
text_mt: 329. The eight forms of marriage for brahmins and other social orders; the fines for the concealer and the false accuser of a maiden's defect; severe capital punishment for a wife who transgresses against her husband out of pride in her kinsmen's power or the like; the fine for an unfaithful wife; a fine of one-fourth of his wealth to be imposed by the king on a man who gives a maiden to another after having given her to one groom; the fine for a husband who does not approach his wife in her fertile period, and for a wife who does not approach when summoned by her husband; and the right of an unmarried maiden in her fertile period to choose a husband for herself after three years if she has not been given in marriage.

sanskrit_iast: 330 aurasādidvādaśavidhaputtrāṇāṃ pitṛrikthādhikāraḥ, pratilomajānāṃ jaḍāndhādīnāñca bharaṇamātraṃ, patitānāmanadhikāraḥ, kramāgatabhūmyādau pitāputrayostulyādhikāraḥ, pitrūrdhvaṃ vibhāge mātāpi samāṃśabhāginī, brāhmaṇādīnāṃ kṣattriyādiputrāṇāmaṃśavibhāgaḥ, aputradhānabhājāṃ nirdeśaḥ, strīdhanantadadhikārinirūpaṇañca
meaning: 330 औरसादिद्वादशविधपुत्त्राणां पितृरिक्थाधिकारः, प्रतिलोमजानां जडान्धादीनाञ्च भरणमात्रं, पतितानामनधिकारः, क्रमागतभूम्यादौ पितापुत्रयोस्तुल्याधिकारः, पित्रूर्ध्वं विभागे मातापि समांशभागिनी, ब्राह्मणादीनां क्षत्त्रियादिपुत्राणामंशविभागः, अपुत्रधानभाजां निर्देशः, स्त्रीधनन्तदधिकारिनिरूपणञ्च
text_mt: 330. The right of the twelve kinds of sons, beginning with the body-born, to inherit the father's estate; mere maintenance for children of reverse-order unions, the dull-witted, the blind, and the like; exclusion of fallen persons; equal rights of father and son in ancestral land and other property; the mother also receiving an equal share in partition after the father's death; the partition of shares for sons of kṣatriya and other wives born to brahmins and others; specification of the inheritors of childless wealth; and determination of a woman's separate property and its rightful claimants.

sanskrit_iast: 331 ṛṇādānaprasaṃge cottamarṇāyādhamarṇena dhanaṃ savṛddhyavṛddhi vā yathāniyamaṃ deyam, daivarājadoṣādṛte cādhibhoktrā savṛddhirādhirdeyaḥ, ekasyādhimanyasmai dātuḥ prāṇadaṇḍaḥ, paśvādicetanādhau naṣṭe'pi dhanino'kṣatiḥ, hiraṇyapaśvādiṣu vṛddhiniyamaḥ, tripuruṣaparyantamṛṇadānam, prātibhāvye ṛṇadānavyavasthā, aśaktau karmakaraṇam,
meaning: 331 ऋणादानप्रसंगे चोत्तमर्णायाधमर्णेन धनं सवृद्ध्यवृद्धि वा यथानियमं देयम्, दैवराजदोषादृते चाधिभोक्त्रा सवृद्धिराधिर्देयः, एकस्याधिमन्यस्मै दातुः प्राणदण्डः, पश्वादिचेतनाधौ नष्टेऽपि धनिनोऽक्षतिः, हिरण्यपश्वादिषु वृद्धिनियमः, त्रिपुरुषपर्यन्तमृणदानम्, प्रातिभाव्ये ऋणदानव्यवस्था, अशक्तौ कर्मकरणम्,
text_mt: 331. On the subject of non-payment of debts: wealth must be repaid by the debtor to the creditor with or without interest according to the rule; a pledge enjoyed by the creditor must be returned with interest unless damaged by act of God or the king; capital punishment for one who pledges a single item to another; no loss of property to the creditor even when an animate pledge such as cattle is destroyed; the rules of interest on gold, cattle, and other loans; repayment of debt up to three generations; the arrangement for debt repayment in suretyship; and performing manual labor in case of inability to pay.

sanskrit_iast: 332 nikṣeparakṣāvarṇanena yācitānvāhitādīnāmapi gatārthatā
meaning: 332 निक्षेपरक्षावर्णनेन याचितान्वाहितादीनामपि गतार्थता
text_mt: 332. By the description of the preservation of deposits, items borrowed for use, secondary bailments, and the like are also explained.

sanskrit_iast: 333 sambhūyasamutthāne kṣayavyayavṛddhyanusāramaṃśakalpanā
meaning: 333 सम्भूयसमुत्थाने क्षयव्ययवृद्ध्यनुसारमंशकल्पना
text_mt: 333. Apportionment of shares in joint partnerships in accordance with loss, expense, and profit.

sanskrit_iast: 334 kāladeśakarmāvadhikakarmakarabhṛtidānādiniyamaḥ
meaning: 334 कालदेशकर्मावधिककर्मकरभृतिदानादिनियमः
text_mt: 334. Rules for the payment of wages to laborers determined by time, place, and task.

sanskrit_iast: 335 krayavikrayaniyamanirṇayaḥ
meaning: 335 क्रयविक्रयनियमनिर्णयः
text_mt: 335. Determination of the rules governing buying and selling.

sanskrit_iast: 336 pāṣaṇḍanaigamādivibhāgavarṇanam
meaning: 336 पाषण्डनैगमादिविभागवर्णनम्
text_mt: 336. Description of the divisions of heretics, merchant guilds, and the like.

sanskrit_iast: 337 sīmāvivāde sāmantasthaviragopakṛṣakādidvārā tannirṇayaḥ, sasyakṣetreṣu sasyanāśakamahiṣādīnāṃ svāmiṣu daṇḍakalpanā
meaning: 337 सीमाविवादे सामन्तस्थविरगोपकृषकादिद्वारा तन्निर्णयः, सस्यक्षेत्रेषु सस्यनाशकमहिषादीनां स्वामिषु दण्डकल्पना
text_mt: 337. Settlement in boundary disputes through neighboring landholders, village elders, cowherds, farmers, and the like; and the assessment of fines on the owners of buffaloes and other animals that destroy crops in cultivated fields.

sanskrit_iast: 338 dharmārthakāmamūlaṃ dhanaṃ nṛṇāṃ bahiścarāḥ prāṇāstaddhartṝnrājā ghātayet, brāhmaṇāṃstu svarāṣṭrādvivāsayet, mahāpātakisāhasikādīnavaśyaṃ daṇḍayet .
meaning: 338 धर्मार्थकाममूलं धनं नृणां बहिश्चराः प्राणास्तद्धर्तॄन्राजा घातयेत्, ब्राह्मणांस्तु स्वराष्ट्राद्विवासयेत्, महापातकिसाहसिकादीनवश्यं दण्डयेत् .
text_mt: 338. Wealth is the foundation of dharma, material prosperity, and pleasure, and is the external vital breath of men; the king should execute those who steal it, but banish brahmins from his realm; and he must invariably punish those guilty of major sins, crimes of violence, and the like.

sanskrit_iast: 339 ātmano valīpalitamapatyasya cāpatyaṃ vīkṣya gṛhī vānaprasthamāśrayet, tatra ca sabhāryo nirbhāryo vā nityamagnīnupācaranvanyena ca kandūmūlādinā vartayandevapitratithīnyajanyathābalampañcāgnitapaścaraṇādinākālaṃ nayet. grāmādvāṣṭau grāsānānīyāśnīyādalābhe na viṣīdellābhe ca na hṛṣyedityādivānaprasthadharmeṇa duṣkarantapaḥ kuryāt
meaning: 339 आत्मनो वलीपलितमपत्यस्य चापत्यं वीक्ष्य गृही वानप्रस्थमाश्रयेत्, तत्र च सभार्यो निर्भार्यो वा नित्यमग्नीनुपाचरन्वन्येन च कन्दूमूलादिना वर्तयन्देवपित्रतिथीन्यजन्यथाबलम्पञ्चाग्नितपश्चरणादिनाकालं नयेत्. ग्रामाद्वाष्टौ ग्रासानानीयाश्नीयादलाभे न विषीदेल्लाभे च न हृष्येदित्यादिवानप्रस्थधर्मेण दुष्करन्तपः कुर्यात्
text_mt: 339. Seeing wrinkles and grey hair on his body and the child of his child, the householder should enter the forest-dwelling stage of life; and there, either with his wife or without his wife, constantly tending the sacred fires, subsisting on forest products such as edible roots and tubers, worshipping gods, ancestors, and guests according to his ability, he should spend his time by practicing austerities such as the five fires; or he may bring eight mouthfuls of food from a village and eat, not sorrowing when he receives nothing and not rejoicing when he receives food—thus he should perform difficult austerities according to the duties of a forest-dweller.

sanskrit_iast:
340 āyuṣaścaturthentye bhāge yatidharmamāśrayet, tatra ceṣṭipurassaramagnīnātmani samāropya brahmāśramī bhavet . rasāsvādalampaṭo na syāt,
karmavāṅmanodaṇḍavānbhavet, dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet, satyapūtāṃ vadedvāṇīṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret. śatrumitrādiṣu samānabhāvaṃ kuryāt
meaning:
340 आयुषश्चतुर्थेन्त्ये भागे यतिधर्ममाश्रयेत्, तत्र चेष्टिपुरस्सरमग्नीनात्मनि समारोप्य ब्रह्माश्रमी भवेत् . रसास्वादलम्पटो न स्यात्,
कर्मवाङ्मनोदण्डवान्भवेत्, दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत्पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत्, सत्यपूतां वदेद्वाणीं मनःपूतं समाचरेत्. शत्रुमित्रादिषु समानभावं कुर्यात्
text_mt:
340 In the fourth and final portion of life, one should take up the dharma of an ascetic. There, after performing an offering, one should deposit the sacred fires within oneself and enter the stage of life dedicated to Brahman. One should not be covetous of savouring tastes;
one should restrain bodily actions, speech, and mind; one should step where the ground is purified by sight, drink water purified by cloth, speak speech purified by truth, and act as purified by the mind. One should maintain an equal attitude toward enemies, friends, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
341 viṣṇumāśritya kṛtānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ phalavattvam, tatsmaraṇākīrtanādibhaktiyogasya sarvārthasādhakatvam, devālayannirmāya tadgataparamāṇusaṃkhyābdasahasraparyantaṃ svargaloke pūjyate devālayakṛt . kāṣṭhāśmalauhatāmraraupyaratnanirmitaprāsāde viṣṇupratimāpūjane'nantapuṇyam . devaprāsāde sudhāsaṃskāra-citrakaraṇa–gītavādyanṛtyakaraṇa-prekṣaṇīyapradānābhyarcanābhyukṣaṇa-sammārjanopalepana–puṣpopacaya-jīrṇoddhāra-kīrtana sahasranāmoñcāraṇapūrvakastavana-caturvedoktaprakārābhiṣṭavana-bhaktibhāvapūrṇasvaracitastavastavana-tanmāhātmyapratipādakapustakavitaraṇa-tadbhakte
bhyastanmāhātmyaśrāvaṇa-tadālaye śaṃkhaghaṇṭākiṃkiṇīpatākādipradānavividhapuṣpasamalaṃkṛtavāṭikāpuṣkariṇyādinirmāṇairasaṅkhyapuṇyaphalabhāktvam. evaṃvidhamahāpūjayā sakāmasyānantakālaparimitasukhabhogāvāptāvapi na tādṛgbhagavatoṣo yādṛṅ niṣkāmasyeti
meaning:
341 विष्णुमाश्रित्य कृतानां धर्माणां फलवत्त्वम्, तत्स्मरणाकीर्तनादिभक्तियोगस्य सर्वार्थसाधकत्वम्, देवालयन्निर्माय तद्गतपरमाणुसंख्याब्दसहस्रपर्यन्तं स्वर्गलोके पूज्यते देवालयकृत् . काष्ठाश्मलौहताम्ररौप्यरत्ननिर्मितप्रासादे विष्णुप्रतिमापूजनेऽनन्तपुण्यम् . देवप्रासादे सुधासंस्कार-चित्रकरण–गीतवाद्यनृत्यकरण-प्रेक्षणीयप्रदानाभ्यर्चनाभ्युक्षण-सम्मार्जनोपलेपन–पुष्पोपचय-जीर्णोद्धार-कीर्तन सहस्रनामोञ्चारणपूर्वकस्तवन-चतुर्वेदोक्तप्रकाराभिष्टवन-भक्तिभावपूर्णस्वरचितस्तवस्तवन-तन्माहात्म्यप्रतिपादकपुस्तकवितरण-तद्भक्ते
भ्यस्तन्माहात्म्यश्रावण-तदालये शंखघण्टाकिंकिणीपताकादिप्रदानविविधपुष्पसमलंकृतवाटिकापुष्करिण्यादिनिर्माणैरसङ्ख्यपुण्यफलभाक्त्वम्. एवंविधमहापूजया सकामस्यानन्तकालपरिमितसुखभोगावाप्तावपि न तादृग्भगवतोषो यादृङ् निष्कामस्येति
text_mt: 341 Fruitfulness belongs to pious works performed taking refuge in Viṣṇu; the yoga of devotion through His remembrance, glorification, and the like brings about all aims. Having built a temple of God, the maker of the temple is honoured in heaven for thousands of years equal in number to the atoms contained in it. In a temple built of wood, stone, iron, copper, silver, or gems, worshipping the image of Viṣṇu brings endless merit. One gains the fruit of countless merits by renovating with lime, painting, performing singing, instrumental music, and dance, offering theatrical performances, worshipping, sprinkling, sweeping, smearing [with cowdung], gathering flowers, restoring what is dilapidated, singing praises preceded by chanting the thousand names, praising according to the manner declared in the four Vedas, praising with self-composed hymns filled with the mood of devotion, distributing books expounding His greatness, causing His greatness to be heard by His devotees, offering conches, bells, small bells, flags, and the like in His temple, and constructing gardens, lotus ponds, and the like adorned with diverse flowers. Though a person with desires obtains the enjoyment of happiness measured by endless time through such grand worship, the Lord's satisfaction is not as great as [it is with] one free from desires.

sanskrit_iast: 342 śrīviṣṇustavānte munidṛṣṭahaṃsa ( viṣṇu ) viśvarūpadarśanam
meaning: 342 श्रीविष्णुस्तवान्ते मुनिदृष्टहंस ( विष्णु ) विश्वरूपदर्शनम्
text_mt: 342 At the end of the praise of glorious Viṣṇu, the vision of the universal form of Haṃsa (Viṣṇu) seen by the sage.

sanskrit_iast: . iti haṃsagītā .
meaning: . इति हंसगीता .
text_mt: Thus ends the Haṃsagītā.

sanskrit_iast: 343 guṇakāśyāsvaputryā varamārgaṇāya nāradasahāye mātalau nirgate sumukhākhyaṃ tāvapaśyatām, tatraiva śakradarśanānantaraṃ tau tārkṣāttasyābhayamayācetām, omiti śakroktāvapi viṣṇumabhyetya mātalirvainateyādabhayaṃ sumukhasyāpat . svārātyabhayadāyini harau ruṣṭe'valipte ca garutmati harirbāhumekaṃ tatpṛṣṭhe'sthāpayattadbhārākrāntasya tārkṣyasya pakṣaśātanaṃ balahāniśca samajani, harirvāryasyaiva mahimā ko'haṃ varāka iti gatagarvāya khageśvarāya bhagavatā prasādapurassaramaparimitabalamadāyi
meaning: 343 गुणकाश्यास्वपुत्र्या वरमार्गणाय नारदसहाये मातलौ निर्गते सुमुखाख्यं तावपश्यताम्, तत्रैव शक्रदर्शनानन्तरं तौ तार्क्षात्तस्याभयमयाचेताम्, ओमिति शक्रोक्तावपि विष्णुमभ्येत्य मातलिर्वैनतेयादभयं सुमुखस्यापत् . स्वारात्यभयदायिनि हरौ रुष्टेऽवलिप्ते च गरुत्मति हरिर्बाहुमेकं तत्पृष्ठेऽस्थापयत्तद्भाराक्रान्तस्य तार्क्ष्यस्य पक्षशातनं बलहानिश्च समजनि, हरिर्वार्यस्यैव महिमा कोऽहं वराक इति गतगर्वाय खगेश्वराय भगवता प्रसादपुरस्सरमपरिमितबलमदायि
text_mt: 343 When Mātali, accompanied by Nārada, set out to search for a bridegroom for his daughter Guṇakeśī, the two saw [the Nāga] named Sumukha. Right there, after seeing Śakra, the two asked him for protection from Tārkṣya for [Sumukha]. Even though Śakra said "Yes," Mātali approached Viṣṇu and sought protection for Sumukha from Vainateya. When Hari granted protection to his own enemy, Garuḍa became enraged and proud; Hari placed one arm upon his back, and pressed down by that weight, Tārkṣya suffered the breaking of his wings and loss of strength. To the lord of birds, who had lost his pride and thought, "Hari's is indeed the greatness, what am I, a wretched creature?", the Lord, preceded by His grace, granted immeasurable strength.

sanskrit_iast: 344 kaśyapakṛtaviṣṇustavaḥ
meaning: 344 कश्यपकृतविष्णुस्तवः
text_mt: 344 The hymn of praise to Viṣṇu composed by Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast: 345 bhūvivarastharājño ( uparicaravasoḥ ) rakṣāvarṇanam
meaning: 345 भूविवरस्थराज्ञो ( उपरिचरवसोः ) रक्षावर्णनम्
text_mt: 345 Description of the protection of the king (Uparicara Vasu) dwelling in a subterranean cavity.

sanskrit_iast: 346 vaiṣṇavyaparājitāvidyāvarṇanapurassaraṃ vasukṛtagaruḍastotram
meaning: 346 वैष्णव्यपराजिताविद्यावर्णनपुरस्सरं वसुकृतगरुडस्तोत्रम्
text_mt: 346 The hymn to Garuḍa composed by Vasu, preceded by the description of the Vaiṣṇava Aparājitā spell.

sanskrit_iast: 347 vasukṛtaṃ vāsudevastotram
meaning: 347 वसुकृतं वासुदेवस्तोत्रम्
text_mt: 347 The hymn to Vāsudeva composed by Vasu.

sanskrit_iast: 348 viṣṇunā vasave satyapālanapurassaraṃ brāhmaṇāpamānavarjanopadeśakathanam
meaning: 348 विष्णुना वसवे सत्यपालनपुरस्सरं ब्राह्मणापमानवर्जनोपदेशकथनम्
text_mt: 348 Narration of the instruction given by Viṣṇu to Vasu on observing truth and avoiding insult to brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: 349 viśvarūpadarśanārthaṃ nāradasya śvetadvīpagamanam ... ... . . .
meaning: 349 विश्वरूपदर्शनार्थं नारदस्य श्वेतद्वीपगमनम् ... ... . . .
text_mt: 349 Nārada's departure to Śvetadvīpa in order to behold the universal form [...]

sanskrit_iast:
350 viśvarūpadidṛkṣayā śvetadvīpe nāradakṛtaṃ stotram . . .
.
351 śvetadvīpe nāradasya viśvarūpadarśanaṃ tatprasādānmānasīsiddhiprāptiśca
meaning:
350 विश्वरूपदिदृक्षया श्वेतद्वीपे नारदकृतं स्तोत्रम् . . .
.
351 श्वेतद्वीपे नारदस्य विश्वरूपदर्शनं तत्प्रसादान्मानसीसिद्धिप्राप्तिश्च
text_mt:
350 The hymn composed by Nārada in Śvetadvīpa with the desire to see the universal form [...]

351 Nārada's vision of the universal form in Śvetadvīpa and his attainment of mental perfection through His grace.

sanskrit_iast: 352 saraḥsarinnirjharasavidhe'nyasminvā hṛdye pradeśe hastamitammaṇḍalaṃ nirmāya madhye'ṣṭapatrapadmaṃ likhet, tatkarṇikāmadhye śvetaśatapatrakarṇikoparyarkamaṇḍalaṃ, tadupari candramaṇḍalaṃ, taduparyagnimaṇḍale paramapuruṣamoṅkāraṃ vinyaset, kamalapūrvādidaleṣvakārādiṣu vāsudevasaṃkarṣaṇādīnnyaset, prapūrvādidvāreṣu vainateyādīṃśca nyasitvā bāhyasthāṃ yathāsvadiśamokārākāradikpātaśakrāgniyamanirṛti varuṇakuberāneśānyāṃ nyaset, yathoktarūpaṃ dhyāyet . oṃnamo bhagavate vāsudevāyetyanena oṃnamo nārāyaṇāyetyanena vā savidhi pūjayet.
meaning: 352 सरःसरिन्निर्झरसविधेऽन्यस्मिन्वा हृद्ये प्रदेशे हस्तमितम्मण्डलं निर्माय मध्येऽष्टपत्रपद्मं लिखेत्, तत्कर्णिकामध्ये श्वेतशतपत्रकर्णिकोपर्यर्कमण्डलं, तदुपरि चन्द्रमण्डलं, तदुपर्यग्निमण्डले परमपुरुषमोङ्कारं विन्यसेत्, कमलपूर्वादिदलेष्वकारादिषु वासुदेवसंकर्षणादीन्न्यसेत्, प्रपूर्वादिद्वारेषु वैनतेयादींश्च न्यसित्वा बाह्यस्थां यथास्वदिशमोकाराकारदिक्पातशक्राग्नियमनिरृति वरुणकुबेरानेशान्यां न्यसेत्, यथोक्तरूपं ध्यायेत् . ओंनमो भगवते वासुदेवायेत्यनेन ओंनमो नारायणायेत्यनेन वा सविधि पूजयेत्.
text_mt: 352 Near a lake, river, or waterfall, or in another pleasing location, having made a sacred diagram of one cubit, one should draw an eight-petalled lotus in the centre. In the centre of its pericarp, above the pericarp of a white hundred-petalled lotus, one should place the sun's circle; above that, the moon's circle; and above that, on the fire's circle, the Supreme Person as the syllable Oṃ. On the petals of the lotus, beginning with the east and with the letter "a" and so forth, one should ritually place Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, and the others. Having placed Vainateya and the others at the eastern and other gates, one should place the guardians of the directions in their respective directions on the outside: Śakra, Agni, Yama, Nirṛti, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Īśāna. One should meditate upon the form as described. One should worship according to the prescribed rules either with "Om, salutation to the Lord Vāsudeva" or with "Om, salutation to Nārāyaṇa".

sanskrit_iast: 353 nāradaprasādapurassaraṃ nāradādiviśvarūpasākṣātkārakartranirdeśaḥ
meaning: 353 नारदप्रसादपुरस्सरं नारदादिविश्वरूपसाक्षात्कारकर्त्रनिर्देशः
text_mt: 353 Bestowal of grace upon Nārada, and designation of those who directly perceive the universal form, beginning with Nārada.

sanskrit_iast: 354 liṅgasphoṭananarasiṃhavarṇanam
meaning: 354 लिङ्गस्फोटननरसिंहवर्णनम्
text_mt: 354 Description of Narasiṃha bursting out of the pillar.

sanskrit_iast: 355 śrīnṛsiṃhastotravarṇanam
meaning: 355 श्रीनृसिंहस्तोत्रवर्णनम्
